verses.name: Genesis 1:1
verses.text: IN the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.

verses.name: Genesis 1:2
verses.text: And the earth was without form, and void; and darkness <hi type="italic">was</hi> upon the face of the deep. And the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters.

verses.name: Genesis 1:3
verses.text: And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.

verses.name: Genesis 1:4
verses.text: And God saw the light, that <hi type="italic">it was</hi> good: and God divided the light from the darkness.

verses.name: Genesis 1:5
verses.text: And God called the light Day, and the darkness he called Night. And the evening and the morning were the first day.

verses.name: Genesis 1:6
verses.text: ¶ And God said, Let there be a firmament in the midst of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.

verses.name: Genesis 1:7
verses.text: And God made the firmament, and divided the waters which <hi type="italic">were</hi> under the firmament from the waters which <hi type="italic">were</hi> above the firmament: and it was so.

verses.name: Genesis 1:8
verses.text: And God called the firmament Heaven. And the evening and the morning were the second day.

verses.name: Genesis 1:9
verses.text: ¶ And God said, Let the waters under the heaven be gathered together unto one place, and let the dry <hi type="italic">land</hi> appear: and it was so.

verses.name: Genesis 1:10
verses.text: And God called the dry <hi type="italic">land</hi> Earth; and the gathering together of the waters called he Seas: and God saw that <hi type="italic">it was</hi> good.

verses.name: Genesis 1:11
verses.text: And God said, Let the earth bring forth grass, the herb yielding seed, <hi type="italic">and</hi> the fruit tree yielding fruit after his kind, whose seed <hi type="italic">is</hi> in itself, upon the earth: and it was so.

verses.name: Genesis 1:12
verses.text: And the earth brought forth grass, <hi type="italic">and</hi> herb yielding seed after his kind, and the tree yielding fruit, whose seed <hi type="italic">was</hi> in itself, after his kind: and God saw that <hi type="italic">it was</hi> good.

verses.name: Genesis 1:13
verses.text: And the evening and the morning were the third day.

verses.name: Genesis 1:14
verses.text: ¶ And God said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years:

verses.name: Genesis 1:15
verses.text: And let them be for lights in the firmament of the heaven to give light upon the earth: and it was so.

verses.name: Genesis 1:16
verses.text: And God made two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night: <hi type="italic">he made</hi> the stars also.

verses.name: Genesis 1:17
verses.text: And God set them in the firmament of the heaven to give light upon the earth,

verses.name: Genesis 1:18
verses.text: And to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness: and God saw that <hi type="italic">it was</hi> good.

verses.name: Genesis 1:19
verses.text: And the evening and the morning were the fourth day.

verses.name: Genesis 1:20
verses.text: And God said, Let the waters bring forth abundantly the moving creature that hath life, and fowl <hi type="italic">that</hi> may fly above the earth in the open firmament of heaven.

verses.name: Genesis 1:21
verses.text: And God created great whales, and every living creature that moveth, which the waters brought forth abundantly, after their kind, and every winged fowl after his kind: and God saw that <hi type="italic">it was</hi> good.

verses.name: Genesis 1:22
verses.text: And God blessed them, saying, Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let fowl multiply in the earth.

verses.name: Genesis 1:23
verses.text: And the evening and the morning were the fifth day.

verses.name: Genesis 1:24
verses.text: ¶ And God said, Let the earth bring forth the living creature after his kind, cattle, and creeping thing, and beast of the earth after his kind: and it was so.

verses.name: Genesis 1:25
verses.text: And God made the beast of the earth after his kind, and cattle after their kind, and every thing that creepeth upon the earth after his kind: and God saw that <hi type="italic">it was</hi> good.

verses.name: Genesis 1:26
verses.text: ¶ And God said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.

verses.name: Genesis 1:27
verses.text: So God created man in his <hi type="italic">own</hi> image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.

verses.name: Genesis 1:28
verses.text: And God blessed them, and God said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it: and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over every living thing that moveth upon the earth.

verses.name: Genesis 1:29
verses.text: ¶ And God said, Behold, I have given you every herb bearing seed, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> upon the face of all the earth, and every tree, in the which <hi type="italic">is</hi> the fruit of a tree yielding seed; to you it shall be for meat.

verses.name: Genesis 1:30
verses.text: And to every beast of the earth, and to every fowl of the air, and to every thing that creepeth upon the earth, wherein <hi type="italic">there is</hi> life, <hi type="italic">I have given</hi> every green herb for meat: and it was so.

verses.name: Genesis 1:31
verses.text: And God saw every thing that he had made, and, behold, <hi type="italic">it was</hi> very good. And the evening and the morning were the sixth day.  <chapter eID="Gen.1"/><div eID="gen3" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 2:1
verses.text: THUS the heavens and the earth were finished, and all the host of them.

verses.name: Genesis 2:2
verses.text: And on the seventh day God ended his work which he had made; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had made.

verses.name: Genesis 2:3
verses.text: And God blessed the seventh day, and sanctified it: because that in it he had rested from all his work which God created and made.

verses.name: Genesis 2:4
verses.text: ¶ These <hi type="italic">are</hi> the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created, in the day that the Lord God made the earth and the heavens,

verses.name: Genesis 2:5
verses.text: And every plant of the field before it was in the earth, and every herb of the field before it grew: for the Lord God had not caused it to rain upon the earth, and <hi type="italic">there was</hi> not a man to till the ground.

verses.name: Genesis 2:6
verses.text: But there went up a mist from the earth, and watered the whole face of the ground.

verses.name: Genesis 2:7
verses.text: And the Lord God formed man <hi type="italic">of</hi> the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.

verses.name: Genesis 2:8
verses.text: ¶ And the Lord God planted a garden eastward in Eden; and there he put the man whom he had formed.

verses.name: Genesis 2:9
verses.text: And out of the ground made the Lord God to grow every tree that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food; the tree of life also in the midst of the garden, and the tree of knowledge of good and evil.

verses.name: Genesis 2:10
verses.text: And a river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from thence it was parted, and became into four heads.

verses.name: Genesis 2:11
verses.text: The name of the first <hi type="italic">is</hi> Pison: that <hi type="italic">is</hi> it which compasseth the whole land of Havilah, where <hi type="italic">there is</hi> gold;

verses.name: Genesis 2:12
verses.text: And the gold of that land <hi type="italic">is</hi> good: there <hi type="italic">is</hi> bdellium and the onyx stone.

verses.name: Genesis 2:13
verses.text: And the name of the second river <hi type="italic">is</hi> Gihon: the same <hi type="italic">is</hi> it that compasseth the whole land of Ethiopia.

verses.name: Genesis 2:14
verses.text: And the name of the third river <hi type="italic">is</hi> Hiddekel: that <hi type="italic">is</hi> it which goeth toward the east of Assyria. And the fourth river <hi type="italic">is</hi> Euphrates.

verses.name: Genesis 2:15
verses.text: And the Lord God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to dress it and to keep it.

verses.name: Genesis 2:16
verses.text: And the Lord God commanded the man, saying, Of every tree of the garden thou mayest freely eat:

verses.name: Genesis 2:17
verses.text: But of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, thou shalt not eat of it: for in the day that thou eatest thereof thou shalt surely die.

verses.name: Genesis 2:18
verses.text: ¶ And the Lord God said, <hi type="italic">It is</hi> not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him.

verses.name: Genesis 2:19
verses.text: And out of the ground the Lord God formed every beast of the field, and every fowl of the air; and brought <hi type="italic">them</hi> unto Adam to see what he would call them: and whatsoever Adam called every living creature, that <hi type="italic">was</hi> the name thereof.

verses.name: Genesis 2:20
verses.text: And Adam gave names to all cattle, and to the fowl of the air, and to every beast of the field; but for Adam there was not found an help meet for him.

verses.name: Genesis 2:21
verses.text: And the Lord God caused a deep sleep to fall upon Adam, and he slept: and he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh instead thereof;

verses.name: Genesis 2:22
verses.text: And the rib, which the Lord God had taken from man, made he a woman, and brought her unto the man.

verses.name: Genesis 2:23
verses.text: And Adam said, This <hi type="italic">is</hi> now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh: she shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man.

verses.name: Genesis 2:24
verses.text: Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh.

verses.name: Genesis 2:25
verses.text: And they were both naked, the man and his wife, and were not ashamed.  <chapter eID="Gen.2"/><div eID="gen4" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 3:1
verses.text: NOW the serpent was more subtil than any beast of the field which the Lord God had made. And he said unto the woman, Yea, hath God said, Ye shall not eat of every tree of the garden?

verses.name: Genesis 3:2
verses.text: And the woman said unto the serpent, We may eat of the fruit of the trees of the garden:

verses.name: Genesis 3:3
verses.text: But of the fruit of the tree which <hi type="italic">is</hi> in the midst of the garden, God hath said, Ye shall not eat of it, neither shall ye touch it, lest ye die.

verses.name: Genesis 3:4
verses.text: And the serpent said unto the woman, Ye shall not surely die:

verses.name: Genesis 3:5
verses.text: For God doth know that in the day ye eat thereof, then your eyes shall be opened, and ye shall be as gods, knowing good and evil.

verses.name: Genesis 3:6
verses.text: And when the woman saw that the tree <hi type="italic">was</hi> good for food, and that it <hi type="italic">was</hi> pleasant to the eyes, and a tree to be desired to make <hi type="italic">one</hi> wise, she took of the fruit thereof, and did eat, and gave also unto her husband with her; and he did eat.

verses.name: Genesis 3:7
verses.text: And the eyes of them both were opened, and they knew that they <hi type="italic">were</hi> naked; and they sewed fig leaves together, and made themselves aprons.

verses.name: Genesis 3:8
verses.text: And they heard the voice of the Lord God walking in the garden in the cool of the day: and Adam and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the Lord God amongst the trees of the garden.

verses.name: Genesis 3:9
verses.text: And the Lord God called unto Adam, and said unto him, Where <hi type="italic">art</hi> thou?

verses.name: Genesis 3:10
verses.text: And he said, I heard thy voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I <hi type="italic">was</hi> naked; and I hid myself.

verses.name: Genesis 3:11
verses.text: And he said, Who told thee that thou <hi type="italic">wast</hi> naked? Hast thou eaten of the tree, whereof I commanded thee that thou shouldest not eat?

verses.name: Genesis 3:12
verses.text: And the man said, The woman whom thou gavest <hi type="italic">to be</hi> with me, she gave me of the tree, and I did eat.

verses.name: Genesis 3:13
verses.text: And the Lord God said unto the woman, What <hi type="italic">is</hi> this <hi type="italic">that</hi> thou hast done? And the woman said, The serpent beguiled me, and I did eat.

verses.name: Genesis 3:14
verses.text: And the Lord God said unto the serpent, Because thou hast done this, thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> cursed above all cattle, and above every beast of the field; upon thy belly shalt thou go, and dust shalt thou eat all the days of thy life:

verses.name: Genesis 3:15
verses.text: And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.

verses.name: Genesis 3:16
verses.text: Unto the woman he said, I will greatly multiply thy sorrow and thy conception; in sorrow thou shalt bring forth children; and thy desire <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> to thy husband, and he shall rule over thee.

verses.name: Genesis 3:17
verses.text: And unto Adam he said, Because thou hast hearkened unto the voice of thy wife, and hast eaten of the tree, of which I commanded thee, saying, Thou shalt not eat of it: cursed <hi type="italic">is</hi> the ground for thy sake; in sorrow shalt thou eat <hi type="italic">of</hi> it all the days of thy life;

verses.name: Genesis 3:18
verses.text: Thorns also and thistles shall it bring forth to thee; and thou shalt eat the herb of the field;

verses.name: Genesis 3:19
verses.text: In the sweat of thy face shalt thou eat bread, till thou return unto the ground; for out of it wast thou taken: for dust thou <hi type="italic">art</hi>, and unto dust shalt thou return.

verses.name: Genesis 3:20
verses.text: And Adam called his wife’s name Eve; because she was the mother of all living.

verses.name: Genesis 3:21
verses.text: Unto Adam also and to his wife did the Lord God make coats of skins, and clothed them.

verses.name: Genesis 3:22
verses.text: ¶ And the Lord God said, Behold, the man is become as one of us, to know good and evil: and now, lest he put forth his hand, and take also of the tree of life, and eat, and live for ever:

verses.name: Genesis 3:23
verses.text: Therefore the Lord God sent him forth from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from whence he was taken.

verses.name: Genesis 3:24
verses.text: So he drove out the man; and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubims, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.  <chapter eID="Gen.3"/><div eID="gen5" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 4:1
verses.text: AND Adam knew Eve his wife; and she conceived, and bare Cain, and said, I have gotten a man from the Lord.

verses.name: Genesis 4:2
verses.text: And she again bare his brother Abel. And Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.

verses.name: Genesis 4:3
verses.text: And in process of time it came to pass, that Cain brought of the fruit of the ground an offering unto the Lord.

verses.name: Genesis 4:4
verses.text: And Abel, he also brought of the firstlings of his flock and of the fat thereof. And the Lord had respect unto Abel and to his offering:

verses.name: Genesis 4:5
verses.text: But unto Cain and to his offering he had not respect. And Cain was very wroth, and his countenance fell.

verses.name: Genesis 4:6
verses.text: And the Lord said unto Cain, Why art thou wroth? and why is thy countenance fallen?

verses.name: Genesis 4:7
verses.text: If thou doest well, shalt thou not be accepted? and if thou doest not well, sin lieth at the door. And unto thee <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> his desire, and thou shalt rule over him.

verses.name: Genesis 4:8
verses.text: And Cain talked with Abel his brother: and it came to pass, when they were in the field, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother, and slew him.

verses.name: Genesis 4:9
verses.text: ¶ And the Lord said unto Cain, Where <hi type="italic">is</hi> Abel thy brother? And he said, I know not: <hi type="italic">Am</hi> I my brother’s keeper?

verses.name: Genesis 4:10
verses.text: And he said, What hast thou done? the voice of thy brother’s blood crieth unto me from the ground.

verses.name: Genesis 4:11
verses.text: And now <hi type="italic">art</hi> thou cursed from the earth, which hath opened her mouth to receive thy brother’s blood from thy hand;

verses.name: Genesis 4:12
verses.text: When thou tillest the ground, it shall not henceforth yield unto thee her strength; a fugitive and a vagabond shalt thou be in the earth.

verses.name: Genesis 4:13
verses.text: And Cain said unto the Lord, My punishment <hi type="italic">is</hi> greater than I can bear.

verses.name: Genesis 4:14
verses.text: Behold, thou hast driven me out this day from the face of the earth; and from thy face shall I be hid; and I shall be a fugitive and a vagabond in the earth; and it shall come to pass, <hi type="italic">that</hi> every one that findeth me shall slay me.

verses.name: Genesis 4:15
verses.text: And the Lord said unto him, Therefore whosoever slayeth Cain, vengeance shall be taken on him sevenfold. And the Lord set a mark upon Cain, lest any finding him should kill him.

verses.name: Genesis 4:16
verses.text: ¶ And Cain went out from the presence of the Lord, and dwelt in the land of Nod, on the east of Eden.

verses.name: Genesis 4:17
verses.text: And Cain knew his wife; and she conceived, and bare Enoch: and he builded a city, and called the name of the city, after the name of his son, Enoch.

verses.name: Genesis 4:18
verses.text: And unto Enoch was born Irad: and Irad begat Mehujael: and Mehujael begat Methusael: and Methusael begat Lamech.

verses.name: Genesis 4:19
verses.text: ¶ And Lamech took unto him two wives: the name of the one <hi type="italic">was</hi> Adah, and the name of the other Zillah.

verses.name: Genesis 4:20
verses.text: And Adah bare Jabal: he was the father of such as dwell in tents, and <hi type="italic">of such as have</hi> cattle.

verses.name: Genesis 4:21
verses.text: And his brother’s name <hi type="italic">was</hi> Jubal: he was the father of all such as handle the harp and organ.

verses.name: Genesis 4:22
verses.text: And Zillah, she also bare Tubal-cain, an instructer of every artificer in brass and iron: and the sister of Tubal-cain <hi type="italic">was</hi> Naamah.

verses.name: Genesis 4:23
verses.text: And Lamech said unto his wives, Adah and Zillah, Hear my voice; ye wives of Lamech, hearken unto my speech: for I have slain a man to my wounding, and a young man to my hurt.

verses.name: Genesis 4:24
verses.text: If Cain shall be avenged sevenfold, truly Lamech seventy and sevenfold.

verses.name: Genesis 4:25
verses.text: ¶ And Adam knew his wife again; and she bare a son, and called his name Seth: For God, <hi type="italic">said she</hi>, hath appointed me another seed instead of Abel, whom Cain slew.

verses.name: Genesis 4:26
verses.text: And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enos: then began men to call upon the name of the Lord.  <chapter eID="Gen.4"/><div eID="gen6" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 5:1
verses.text: THIS <hi type="italic">is</hi> the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, in the likeness of God made he him;

verses.name: Genesis 5:2
verses.text: Male and female created he them; and blessed them, and called their name Adam, in the day when they were created.

verses.name: Genesis 5:3
verses.text: ¶ And Adam lived an hundred and thirty years, and begat <hi type="italic">a son</hi> in his own likeness, after his image; and called his name Seth:

verses.name: Genesis 5:4
verses.text: And the days of Adam after he had begotten Seth were eight hundred years: and he begat sons and daughters:

verses.name: Genesis 5:5
verses.text: And all the days that Adam lived were nine hundred and thirty years: and he died.

verses.name: Genesis 5:6
verses.text: And Seth lived an hundred and five years, and begat Enos:

verses.name: Genesis 5:7
verses.text: And Seth lived after he begat Enos eight hundred and seven years, and begat sons and daughters:

verses.name: Genesis 5:8
verses.text: And all the days of Seth were nine hundred and twelve years: and he died.

verses.name: Genesis 5:9
verses.text: ¶ And Enos lived ninety years, and begat Cainan:

verses.name: Genesis 5:10
verses.text: And Enos lived after he begat Cainan eight hundred and fifteen years, and begat sons and daughters:

verses.name: Genesis 5:11
verses.text: And all the days of Enos were nine hundred and five years: and he died.

verses.name: Genesis 5:12
verses.text: ¶ And Cainan lived seventy years, and begat Mahalaleel:

verses.name: Genesis 5:13
verses.text: And Cainan lived after he begat Mahalaleel eight hundred and forty years, and begat sons and daughters:

verses.name: Genesis 5:14
verses.text: And all the days of Cainan were nine hundred and ten years: and he died.

verses.name: Genesis 5:15
verses.text: ¶ And Mahalaleel lived sixty and five years, and begat Jared:

verses.name: Genesis 5:16
verses.text: And Mahalaleel lived after he begat Jared eight hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters:

verses.name: Genesis 5:17
verses.text: And all the days of Mahalaleel were eight hundred ninety and five years: and he died.

verses.name: Genesis 5:18
verses.text: ¶ And Jared lived an hundred sixty and two years, and he begat Enoch:

verses.name: Genesis 5:19
verses.text: And Jared lived after he begat Enoch eight hundred years, and begat sons and daughters:

verses.name: Genesis 5:20
verses.text: And all the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty and two years: and he died.

verses.name: Genesis 5:21
verses.text: ¶ And Enoch lived sixty and five years, and begat Methuselah:

verses.name: Genesis 5:22
verses.text: And Enoch walked with God after he begat Methuselah three hundred years, and begat sons and daughters:

verses.name: Genesis 5:23
verses.text: And all the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty and five years:

verses.name: Genesis 5:24
verses.text: And Enoch walked with God: and he <hi type="italic">was</hi> not; for God took him.

verses.name: Genesis 5:25
verses.text: And Methuselah lived an hundred eighty and seven years, and begat Lamech:

verses.name: Genesis 5:26
verses.text: And Methuselah lived after he begat Lamech seven hundred eighty and two years, and begat sons and daughters:

verses.name: Genesis 5:27
verses.text: And all the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty and nine years: and he died.

verses.name: Genesis 5:28
verses.text: ¶ And Lamech lived an hundred eighty and two years, and begat a son:

verses.name: Genesis 5:29
verses.text: And he called his name Noah, saying, This <hi type="italic">same</hi> shall comfort us concerning our work and toil of our hands, because of the ground which the Lord hath cursed.

verses.name: Genesis 5:30
verses.text: And Lamech lived after he begat Noah five hundred ninety and five years, and begat sons and daughters:

verses.name: Genesis 5:31
verses.text: And all the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy and seven years: and he died.

verses.name: Genesis 5:32
verses.text: And Noah was five hundred years old: and Noah begat Shem, Ham, and Japheth.  <chapter eID="Gen.5"/><div eID="gen7" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 6:1
verses.text: AND it came to pass, when men began to multiply on the face of the earth, and daughters were born unto them,

verses.name: Genesis 6:2
verses.text: That the sons of God saw the daughters of men that they <hi type="italic">were</hi> fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.

verses.name: Genesis 6:3
verses.text: And the Lord said, My spirit shall not always strive with man, for that he also <hi type="italic">is</hi> flesh: yet his days shall be an hundred and twenty years.

verses.name: Genesis 6:4
verses.text: There were giants in the earth in those days; and also after that, when the sons of God came in unto the daughters of men, and they bare <hi type="italic">children</hi> to them, the same <hi type="italic">became</hi> mighty men which <hi type="italic">were</hi> of old, men of renown.

verses.name: Genesis 6:5
verses.text: ¶ And God saw that the wickedness of man <hi type="italic">was</hi> great in the earth, and <hi type="italic">that</hi> every imagination of the thoughts of his heart <hi type="italic">was</hi> only evil continually.

verses.name: Genesis 6:6
verses.text: And it repented the Lord that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him at his heart.

verses.name: Genesis 6:7
verses.text: And the Lord said, I will destroy man whom I have created from the face of the earth; both man, and beast, and the creeping thing, and the fowls of the air; for it repenteth me that I have made them.

verses.name: Genesis 6:8
verses.text: But Noah found grace in the eyes of the Lord.

verses.name: Genesis 6:9
verses.text: ¶ These <hi type="italic">are</hi> the generations of Noah: Noah was a just man <hi type="italic">and</hi> perfect in his generations, <hi type="italic">and</hi> Noah walked with God.

verses.name: Genesis 6:10
verses.text: And Noah begat three sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

verses.name: Genesis 6:11
verses.text: The earth also was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.

verses.name: Genesis 6:12
verses.text: And God looked upon the earth, and, behold, it was corrupt; for all flesh had corrupted his way upon the earth.

verses.name: Genesis 6:13
verses.text: And God said unto Noah, The end of all flesh is come before me; for the earth is filled with violence through them; and, behold, I will destroy them with the earth.

verses.name: Genesis 6:14
verses.text: ¶ Make thee an ark of gopher wood; rooms shalt thou make in the ark, and shalt pitch it within and without with pitch.

verses.name: Genesis 6:15
verses.text: And this <hi type="italic">is the fashion</hi> which thou shalt make it <hi type="italic">of:</hi> The length of the ark <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> three hundred cubits, the breadth of it fifty cubits, and the height of it thirty cubits.

verses.name: Genesis 6:16
verses.text: A window shalt thou make to the ark, and in a cubit shalt thou finish it above; and the door of the ark shalt thou set in the side thereof; <hi type="italic">with</hi> lower, second, and third <hi type="italic">stories</hi> shalt thou make it.

verses.name: Genesis 6:17
verses.text: And, behold, I, even I, do bring a flood of waters upon the earth, to destroy all flesh, wherein <hi type="italic">is</hi> the breath of life, from under heaven; <hi type="italic">and</hi> every thing that <hi type="italic">is</hi> in the earth shall die.

verses.name: Genesis 6:18
verses.text: But with thee will I establish my covenant; and thou shalt come into the ark, thou, and thy sons, and thy wife, and thy sons’ wives with thee.

verses.name: Genesis 6:19
verses.text: And of every living thing of all flesh, two of every <hi type="italic">sort</hi> shalt thou bring into the ark, to keep <hi type="italic">them</hi> alive with thee; they shall be male and female.

verses.name: Genesis 6:20
verses.text: Of fowls after their kind, and of cattle after their kind, of every creeping thing of the earth after his kind, two of every <hi type="italic">sort</hi> shall come unto thee, to keep <hi type="italic">them</hi> alive.

verses.name: Genesis 6:21
verses.text: And take thou unto thee of all food that is eaten, and thou shalt gather <hi type="italic">it</hi> to thee; and it shall be for food for thee, and for them.

verses.name: Genesis 6:22
verses.text: Thus did Noah; according to all that God commanded him, so did he.  <chapter eID="Gen.6"/><div eID="gen8" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 7:1
verses.text: AND the Lord said unto Noah, Come thou and all thy house into the ark; for thee have I seen righteous before me in this generation.

verses.name: Genesis 7:2
verses.text: Of every clean beast thou shalt take to thee by sevens, the male and his female: and of beasts that <hi type="italic">are</hi> not clean by two, the male and his female.

verses.name: Genesis 7:3
verses.text: Of fowls also of the air by sevens, the male and the female; to keep seed alive upon the face of all the earth.

verses.name: Genesis 7:4
verses.text: For yet seven days, and I will cause it to rain upon the earth forty days and forty nights; and every living substance that I have made will I destroy from off the face of the earth.

verses.name: Genesis 7:5
verses.text: And Noah did according unto all that the Lord commanded him.

verses.name: Genesis 7:6
verses.text: And Noah <hi type="italic">was</hi> six hundred years old when the flood of waters was upon the earth.

verses.name: Genesis 7:7
verses.text: ¶ And Noah went in, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons’ wives with him, into the ark, because of the waters of the flood.

verses.name: Genesis 7:8
verses.text: Of clean beasts, and of beasts that <hi type="italic">are</hi> not clean, and of fowls, and of every thing that creepeth upon the earth,

verses.name: Genesis 7:9
verses.text: There went in two and two unto Noah into the ark, the male and the female, as God had commanded Noah.

verses.name: Genesis 7:10
verses.text: And it came to pass after seven days, that the waters of the flood were upon the earth.

verses.name: Genesis 7:11
verses.text: ¶ In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, in the second month, the seventeenth day of the month, the same day were all the fountains of the great deep broken up, and the windows of heaven were opened.

verses.name: Genesis 7:12
verses.text: And the rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights.

verses.name: Genesis 7:13
verses.text: In the selfsame day entered Noah, and Shem, and Ham, and Japheth, the sons of Noah, and Noah’s wife, and the three wives of his sons with them, into the ark;

verses.name: Genesis 7:14
verses.text: They, and every beast after his kind, and all the cattle after their kind, and every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth after his kind, and every fowl after his kind, every bird of every sort.

verses.name: Genesis 7:15
verses.text: And they went in unto Noah into the ark, two and two of all flesh, wherein <hi type="italic">is</hi> the breath of life.

verses.name: Genesis 7:16
verses.text: And they that went in, went in male and female of all flesh, as God had commanded him: and the Lord shut him in.

verses.name: Genesis 7:17
verses.text: And the flood was forty days upon the earth; and the waters increased, and bare up the ark, and it was lift up above the earth.

verses.name: Genesis 7:18
verses.text: And the waters prevailed, and were increased greatly upon the earth; and the ark went upon the face of the waters.

verses.name: Genesis 7:19
verses.text: And the waters prevailed exceedingly upon the earth; and all the high hills, that <hi type="italic">were</hi> under the whole heaven, were covered.

verses.name: Genesis 7:20
verses.text: Fifteen cubits upward did the waters prevail; and the mountains were covered.

verses.name: Genesis 7:21
verses.text: And all flesh died that moved upon the earth, both of fowl, and of cattle, and of beast, and of every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth, and every man:

verses.name: Genesis 7:22
verses.text: All in whose nostrils <hi type="italic">was</hi> the breath of life, of all that <hi type="italic">was</hi> in the dry <hi type="italic">land</hi>, died.

verses.name: Genesis 7:23
verses.text: And every living substance was destroyed which was upon the face of the ground, both man, and cattle, and the creeping things, and the fowl of the heaven; and they were destroyed from the earth: and Noah only remained <hi type="italic">alive</hi>, and they that <hi type="italic">were</hi> with him in the ark.

verses.name: Genesis 7:24
verses.text: And the waters prevailed upon the earth an hundred and fifty days.  <chapter eID="Gen.7"/><div eID="gen9" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 8:1
verses.text: AND God remembered Noah, and every living thing, and all the cattle that <hi type="italic">was</hi> with him in the ark: and God made a wind to pass over the earth, and the waters asswaged;

verses.name: Genesis 8:2
verses.text: The fountains also of the deep and the windows of heaven were stopped, and the rain from heaven was restrained;

verses.name: Genesis 8:3
verses.text: And the waters returned from off the earth continually: and after the end of the hundred and fifty days the waters were abated.

verses.name: Genesis 8:4
verses.text: And the ark rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, upon the mountains of Ararat.

verses.name: Genesis 8:5
verses.text: And the waters decreased continually until the tenth month: in the tenth <hi type="italic">month</hi>, on the first <hi type="italic">day</hi> of the month, were the tops of the mountains seen.

verses.name: Genesis 8:6
verses.text: ¶ And it came to pass at the end of forty days, that Noah opened the window of the ark which he had made:

verses.name: Genesis 8:7
verses.text: And he sent forth a raven, which went forth to and fro, until the waters were dried up from off the earth.

verses.name: Genesis 8:8
verses.text: Also he sent forth a dove from him, to see if the waters were abated from off the face of the ground;

verses.name: Genesis 8:9
verses.text: But the dove found no rest for the sole of her foot, and she returned unto him into the ark, for the waters <hi type="italic">were</hi> on the face of the whole earth: then he put forth his hand, and took her, and pulled her in unto him into the ark.

verses.name: Genesis 8:10
verses.text: And he stayed yet other seven days; and again he sent forth the dove out of the ark;

verses.name: Genesis 8:11
verses.text: And the dove came in to him in the evening; and, lo, in her mouth <hi type="italic">was</hi> an olive leaf pluckt off: so Noah knew that the waters were abated from off the earth.

verses.name: Genesis 8:12
verses.text: And he stayed yet other seven days; and sent forth the dove; which returned not again unto him any more.

verses.name: Genesis 8:13
verses.text: ¶ And it came to pass in the six hundredth and first year, in the first <hi type="italic">month</hi>, the first <hi type="italic">day</hi> of the month, the waters were dried up from off the earth: and Noah removed the covering of the ark, and looked, and, behold, the face of the ground was dry.

verses.name: Genesis 8:14
verses.text: And in the second month, on the seven and twentieth day of the month, was the earth dried.

verses.name: Genesis 8:15
verses.text: ¶ And God spake unto Noah, saying,

verses.name: Genesis 8:16
verses.text: Go forth of the ark, thou, and thy wife, and thy sons, and thy sons’ wives with thee.

verses.name: Genesis 8:17
verses.text: Bring forth with thee every living thing that <hi type="italic">is</hi> with thee, of all flesh, <hi type="italic">both</hi> of fowl, and of cattle, and of every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth; that they may breed abundantly in the earth, and be fruitful, and multiply upon the earth.

verses.name: Genesis 8:18
verses.text: And Noah went forth, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons’ wives with him:

verses.name: Genesis 8:19
verses.text: Every beast, every creeping thing, and every fowl, <hi type="italic">and</hi> whatsoever creepeth upon the earth, after their kinds, went forth out of the ark.

verses.name: Genesis 8:20
verses.text: ¶ And Noah builded an altar unto the Lord; and took of every clean beast, and of every clean fowl, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.

verses.name: Genesis 8:21
verses.text: And the Lord smelled a sweet savour; and the Lord said in his heart, I will not again curse the ground any more for man’s sake; for the imagination of man’s heart <hi type="italic">is</hi> evil from his youth; neither will I again smite any more every thing living, as I have done.

verses.name: Genesis 8:22
verses.text: While the earth remaineth, seedtime and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night shall not cease.  <chapter eID="Gen.8"/><div eID="gen10" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 9:1
verses.text: AND God blessed Noah and his sons, and said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth.

verses.name: Genesis 9:2
verses.text: And the fear of you and the dread of you shall be upon every beast of the earth, and upon every fowl of the air, upon all that moveth <hi type="italic">upon</hi> the earth, and upon all the fishes of the sea; into your hand are they delivered.

verses.name: Genesis 9:3
verses.text: Every moving thing that liveth shall be meat for you; even as the green herb have I given you all things.

verses.name: Genesis 9:4
verses.text: But flesh with the life thereof, <hi type="italic">which is</hi> the blood thereof, shall ye not eat.

verses.name: Genesis 9:5
verses.text: And surely your blood of your lives will I require; at the hand of every beast will I require it, and at the hand of man; at the hand of every man’s brother will I require the life of man.

verses.name: Genesis 9:6
verses.text: Whoso sheddeth man’s blood, by man shall his blood be shed: for in the image of God made he man.

verses.name: Genesis 9:7
verses.text: And you, be ye fruitful, and multiply; bring forth abundantly in the earth, and multiply therein.

verses.name: Genesis 9:8
verses.text: ¶ And God spake unto Noah, and to his sons with him, saying,

verses.name: Genesis 9:9
verses.text: And I, behold, I establish my covenant with you, and with your seed after you;

verses.name: Genesis 9:10
verses.text: And with every living creature that <hi type="italic">is</hi> with you, of the fowl, of the cattle, and of every beast of the earth with you; from all that go out of the ark, to every beast of the earth.

verses.name: Genesis 9:11
verses.text: And I will establish my covenant with you; neither shall all flesh be cut off any more by the waters of a flood; neither shall there any more be a flood to destroy the earth.

verses.name: Genesis 9:12
verses.text: And God said, This <hi type="italic">is</hi> the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that <hi type="italic">is</hi> with you, for perpetual generations:

verses.name: Genesis 9:13
verses.text: I do set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth.

verses.name: Genesis 9:14
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, when I bring a cloud over the earth, that the bow shall be seen in the cloud:

verses.name: Genesis 9:15
verses.text: And I will remember my covenant, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> between me and you and every living creature of all flesh; and the waters shall no more become a flood to destroy all flesh.

verses.name: Genesis 9:16
verses.text: And the bow shall be in the cloud; and I will look upon it, that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that <hi type="italic">is</hi> upon the earth.

verses.name: Genesis 9:17
verses.text: And God said unto Noah, This <hi type="italic">is</hi> the token of the covenant, which I have established between me and all flesh that <hi type="italic">is</hi> upon the earth.

verses.name: Genesis 9:18
verses.text: ¶ And the sons of Noah, that went forth of the ark, were Shem, and Ham, and Japheth: and Ham <hi type="italic">is</hi> the father of Canaan.

verses.name: Genesis 9:19
verses.text: These <hi type="italic">are</hi> the three sons of Noah: and of them was the whole earth overspread.

verses.name: Genesis 9:20
verses.text: And Noah began <hi type="italic">to be</hi> an husbandman, and he planted a vineyard:

verses.name: Genesis 9:21
verses.text: And he drank of the wine, and was drunken; and he was uncovered within his tent.

verses.name: Genesis 9:22
verses.text: And Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brethren without.

verses.name: Genesis 9:23
verses.text: And Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid <hi type="italic">it</hi> upon both their shoulders, and went backward, and covered the nakedness of their father; and their faces <hi type="italic">were</hi> backward, and they saw not their father’s nakedness.

verses.name: Genesis 9:24
verses.text: And Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his younger son had done unto him.

verses.name: Genesis 9:25
verses.text: And he said, Cursed <hi type="italic">be</hi> Canaan; a servant of servants shall he be unto his brethren.

verses.name: Genesis 9:26
verses.text: And he said, Blessed <hi type="italic">be</hi> the Lord God of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.

verses.name: Genesis 9:27
verses.text: God shall enlarge Japheth, and he shall dwell in the tents of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.

verses.name: Genesis 9:28
verses.text: ¶ And Noah lived after the flood three hundred and fifty years.

verses.name: Genesis 9:29
verses.text: And all the days of Noah were nine hundred and fifty years: and he died.  <chapter eID="Gen.9"/><div eID="gen11" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 10:1
verses.text: NOW these <hi type="italic">are</hi> the generations of the sons of Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth: and unto them were sons born after the flood.

verses.name: Genesis 10:2
verses.text: The sons of Japheth; Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.

verses.name: Genesis 10:3
verses.text: And the sons of Gomer; Ashkenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.

verses.name: Genesis 10:4
verses.text: And the sons of Javan; Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.

verses.name: Genesis 10:5
verses.text: By these were the isles of the Gentiles divided in their lands; every one after his tongue, after their families, in their nations.

verses.name: Genesis 10:6
verses.text: ¶ And the sons of Ham; Cush, and Mizraim, and Phut, and Canaan.

verses.name: Genesis 10:7
verses.text: And the sons of Cush; Seba, and Havilah, and Sabtah, and Raamah, and Sabtecha: and the sons of Raamah; Sheba, and Dedan.

verses.name: Genesis 10:8
verses.text: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be a mighty one in the earth.

verses.name: Genesis 10:9
verses.text: He was a mighty hunter before the Lord: wherefore it is said, Even as Nimrod the mighty hunter before the Lord.

verses.name: Genesis 10:10
verses.text: And the beginning of his kingdom was Babel, and Erech, and Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.

verses.name: Genesis 10:11
verses.text: Out of that land went forth Asshur, and builded Nineveh, and the city Rehoboth, and Calah,

verses.name: Genesis 10:12
verses.text: And Resen between Nineveh and Calah: the same <hi type="italic">is</hi> a great city.

verses.name: Genesis 10:13
verses.text: And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,

verses.name: Genesis 10:14
verses.text: And Pathrusim, and Casluhim, (out of whom came Philistim,) and Caphtorim.

verses.name: Genesis 10:15
verses.text: ¶ And Canaan begat Sidon his firstborn, and Heth,

verses.name: Genesis 10:16
verses.text: And the Jebusite, and the Amorite, and the Girgasite,

verses.name: Genesis 10:17
verses.text: And the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,

verses.name: Genesis 10:18
verses.text: And the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite: and afterward were the families of the Canaanites spread abroad.

verses.name: Genesis 10:19
verses.text: And the border of the Canaanites was from Sidon, as thou comest to Gerar, unto Gaza; as thou goest, unto Sodom, and Gomorrah, and Admah, and Zeboim, even unto Lasha.

verses.name: Genesis 10:20
verses.text: These <hi type="italic">are</hi> the sons of Ham, after their families, after their tongues, in their countries, <hi type="italic">and</hi> in their nations.

verses.name: Genesis 10:21
verses.text: ¶ Unto Shem also, the father of all the children of Eber, the brother of Japheth the elder, even to him were <hi type="italic">children</hi> born.

verses.name: Genesis 10:22
verses.text: The children of Shem; Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram.

verses.name: Genesis 10:23
verses.text: And the children of Aram; Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Mash.

verses.name: Genesis 10:24
verses.text: And Arphaxad begat Salah; and Salah begat Eber.

verses.name: Genesis 10:25
verses.text: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of one <hi type="italic">was</hi> Peleg; for in his days was the earth divided; and his brother’s name <hi type="italic">was</hi> Joktan.

verses.name: Genesis 10:26
verses.text: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,

verses.name: Genesis 10:27
verses.text: And Hadoram, and Uzal, and Diklah,

verses.name: Genesis 10:28
verses.text: And Obal, and Abimael, and Sheba,

verses.name: Genesis 10:29
verses.text: And Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab: all these <hi type="italic">were</hi> the sons of Joktan.

verses.name: Genesis 10:30
verses.text: And their dwelling was from Mesha, as thou goest unto Sephar a mount of the east.

verses.name: Genesis 10:31
verses.text: These <hi type="italic">are</hi> the sons of Shem, after their families, after their tongues, in their lands, after their nations.

verses.name: Genesis 10:32
verses.text: These <hi type="italic">are</hi> the families of the sons of Noah, after their generations, in their nations: and by these were the nations divided in the earth after the flood.  <chapter eID="Gen.10"/><div eID="gen12" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 11:1
verses.text: AND the whole earth was of one language, and of one speech.

verses.name: Genesis 11:2
verses.text: And it came to pass, as they journeyed from the east, that they found a plain in the land of Shinar; and they dwelt there.

verses.name: Genesis 11:3
verses.text: And they said one to another, Go to, let us make brick, and burn them throughly. And they had brick for stone, and slime had they for morter.

verses.name: Genesis 11:4
verses.text: And they said, Go to, let us build us a city and a tower, whose top <hi type="italic">may reach</hi> unto heaven; and let us make us a name, lest we be scattered abroad upon the face of the whole earth.

verses.name: Genesis 11:5
verses.text: And the Lord came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men builded.

verses.name: Genesis 11:6
verses.text: And the Lord said, Behold, the people <hi type="italic">is</hi> one, and they have all one language; and this they begin to do: and now nothing will be restrained from them, which they have imagined to do.

verses.name: Genesis 11:7
verses.text: Go to, let us go down, and there confound their language, that they may not understand one another’s speech.

verses.name: Genesis 11:8
verses.text: So the Lord scattered them abroad from thence upon the face of all the earth: and they left off to build the city.

verses.name: Genesis 11:9
verses.text: Therefore is the name of it called Babel; because the Lord did there confound the language of all the earth: and from thence did the Lord scatter them abroad upon the face of all the earth.

verses.name: Genesis 11:10
verses.text: ¶ These <hi type="italic">are</hi> the generations of Shem: Shem <hi type="italic">was</hi> an hundred years old, and begat Arphaxad two years after the flood:

verses.name: Genesis 11:11
verses.text: And Shem lived after he begat Arphaxad five hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.

verses.name: Genesis 11:12
verses.text: And Arphaxad lived five and thirty years, and begat Salah:

verses.name: Genesis 11:13
verses.text: And Arphaxad lived after he begat Salah four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.

verses.name: Genesis 11:14
verses.text: And Salah lived thirty years, and begat Eber:

verses.name: Genesis 11:15
verses.text: And Salah lived after he begat Eber four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.

verses.name: Genesis 11:16
verses.text: And Eber lived four and thirty years, and begat Peleg:

verses.name: Genesis 11:17
verses.text: And Eber lived after he begat Peleg four hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters.

verses.name: Genesis 11:18
verses.text: And Peleg lived thirty years, and begat Reu:

verses.name: Genesis 11:19
verses.text: And Peleg lived after he begat Reu two hundred and nine years, and begat sons and daughters.

verses.name: Genesis 11:20
verses.text: And Reu lived two and thirty years, and begat Serug:

verses.name: Genesis 11:21
verses.text: And Reu lived after he begat Serug two hundred and seven years, and begat sons and daughters.

verses.name: Genesis 11:22
verses.text: And Serug lived thirty years, and begat Nahor:

verses.name: Genesis 11:23
verses.text: And Serug lived after he begat Nahor two hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.

verses.name: Genesis 11:24
verses.text: And Nahor lived nine and twenty years, and begat Terah:

verses.name: Genesis 11:25
verses.text: And Nahor lived after he begat Terah an hundred and nineteen years, and begat sons and daughters.

verses.name: Genesis 11:26
verses.text: And Terah lived seventy years, and begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran.

verses.name: Genesis 11:27
verses.text: ¶ Now these <hi type="italic">are</hi> the generations of Terah: Terah begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran; and Haran begat Lot.

verses.name: Genesis 11:28
verses.text: And Haran died before his father Terah in the land of his nativity, in Ur of the Chaldees.

verses.name: Genesis 11:29
verses.text: And Abram and Nahor took them wives: the name of Abram’s wife <hi type="italic">was</hi> Sarai; and the name of Nahor’s wife, Milcah, the daughter of Haran, the father of Milcah, and the father of Iscah.

verses.name: Genesis 11:30
verses.text: But Sarai was barren; she <hi type="italic">had</hi> no child.

verses.name: Genesis 11:31
verses.text: And Terah took Abram his son, and Lot the son of Haran his son’s son, and Sarai his daughter in law, his son Abram’s wife; and they went forth with them from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan; and they came unto Haran, and dwelt there.

verses.name: Genesis 11:32
verses.text: And the days of Terah were two hundred and five years: and Terah died in Haran.  <chapter eID="Gen.11"/><div eID="gen13" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 12:1
verses.text: NOW the Lord had said unto Abram, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and from thy father’s house, unto a land that I will shew thee:

verses.name: Genesis 12:2
verses.text: And I will make of thee a great nation, and I will bless thee, and make thy name great; and thou shalt be a blessing:

verses.name: Genesis 12:3
verses.text: And I will bless them that bless thee, and curse him that curseth thee: and in thee shall all families of the earth be blessed.

verses.name: Genesis 12:4
verses.text: So Abram departed, as the Lord had spoken unto him; and Lot went with him: and Abram <hi type="italic">was</hi> seventy and five years old when he departed out of Haran.

verses.name: Genesis 12:5
verses.text: And Abram took Sarai his wife, and Lot his brother’s son, and all their substance that they had gathered, and the souls that they had gotten in Haran; and they went forth to go into the land of Canaan; and into the land of Canaan they came.

verses.name: Genesis 12:6
verses.text: ¶ And Abram passed through the land unto the place of Sichem, unto the plain of Moreh. And the Canaanite <hi type="italic">was</hi> then in the land.

verses.name: Genesis 12:7
verses.text: And the Lord appeared unto Abram, and said, Unto thy seed will I give this land: and there builded he an altar unto the Lord, who appeared unto him.

verses.name: Genesis 12:8
verses.text: And he removed from thence unto a mountain on the east of Beth-el, and pitched his tent, <hi type="italic">having</hi> Beth-el on the west, and Hai on the east: and there he builded an altar unto the Lord, and called upon the name of the Lord.

verses.name: Genesis 12:9
verses.text: And Abram journeyed, going on still toward the south.

verses.name: Genesis 12:10
verses.text: ¶ And there was a famine in the land: and Abram went down into Egypt to sojourn there; for the famine <hi type="italic">was</hi> grievous in the land.

verses.name: Genesis 12:11
verses.text: And it came to pass, when he was come near to enter into Egypt, that he said unto Sarai his wife, Behold now, I know that thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> a fair woman to look upon:

verses.name: Genesis 12:12
verses.text: Therefore it shall come to pass, when the Egyptians shall see thee, that they shall say, This <hi type="italic">is</hi> his wife: and they will kill me, but they will save thee alive.

verses.name: Genesis 12:13
verses.text: Say, I pray thee, thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> my sister: that it may be well with me for thy sake; and my soul shall live because of thee.

verses.name: Genesis 12:14
verses.text: ¶ And it came to pass, that, when Abram was come into Egypt, the Egyptians beheld the woman that she <hi type="italic">was</hi> very fair.

verses.name: Genesis 12:15
verses.text: The princes also of Pharaoh saw her, and commended her before Pharaoh: and the woman was taken into Pharaoh’s house.

verses.name: Genesis 12:16
verses.text: And he entreated Abram well for her sake: and he had sheep, and oxen, and he asses, and menservants, and maidservants, and she asses, and camels.

verses.name: Genesis 12:17
verses.text: And the Lord plagued Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai Abram’s wife.

verses.name: Genesis 12:18
verses.text: And Pharaoh called Abram, and said, What <hi type="italic">is</hi> this <hi type="italic">that</hi> thou hast done unto me? why didst thou not tell me that she <hi type="italic">was</hi> thy wife?

verses.name: Genesis 12:19
verses.text: Why saidst thou, She <hi type="italic">is</hi> my sister? so I might have taken her to me to wife: now therefore behold thy wife, take <hi type="italic">her</hi>, and go thy way.

verses.name: Genesis 12:20
verses.text: And Pharaoh commanded <hi type="italic">his</hi> men concerning him: and they sent him away, and his wife, and all that he had.  <chapter eID="Gen.12"/><div eID="gen14" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 13:1
verses.text: AND Abram went up out of Egypt, he, and his wife, and all that he had, and Lot with him, into the south.

verses.name: Genesis 13:2
verses.text: And Abram <hi type="italic">was</hi> very rich in cattle, in silver, and in gold.

verses.name: Genesis 13:3
verses.text: And he went on his journeys from the south even to Beth-el, unto the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Beth-el and Hai;

verses.name: Genesis 13:4
verses.text: Unto the place of the altar, which he had made there at the first: and there Abram called on the name of the Lord.

verses.name: Genesis 13:5
verses.text: ¶ And Lot also, which went with Abram, had flocks, and herds, and tents.

verses.name: Genesis 13:6
verses.text: And the land was not able to bear them, that they might dwell together: for their substance was great, so that they could not dwell together.

verses.name: Genesis 13:7
verses.text: And there was a strife between the herdmen of Abram’s cattle and the herdmen of Lot’s cattle: and the Canaanite and the Perizzite dwelled then in the land.

verses.name: Genesis 13:8
verses.text: And Abram said unto Lot, Let there be no strife, I pray thee, between me and thee, and between my herdmen and thy herdmen; for we <hi type="italic">be</hi> brethren.

verses.name: Genesis 13:9
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Is</hi> not the whole land before thee? separate thyself, I pray thee, from me: if <hi type="italic">thou wilt take</hi> the left hand, then I will go to the right; or if <hi type="italic">thou depart</hi> to the right hand, then I will go to the left.

verses.name: Genesis 13:10
verses.text: And Lot lifted up his eyes, and beheld all the plain of Jordan, that it <hi type="italic">was</hi> well watered every where, before the Lord destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah, <hi type="italic">even</hi> as the garden of the Lord, like the land of Egypt, as thou comest unto Zoar.

verses.name: Genesis 13:11
verses.text: Then Lot chose him all the plain of Jordan; and Lot journeyed east: and they separated themselves the one from the other.

verses.name: Genesis 13:12
verses.text: Abram dwelled in the land of Canaan, and Lot dwelled in the cities of the plain, and pitched <hi type="italic">his</hi> tent toward Sodom.

verses.name: Genesis 13:13
verses.text: But the men of Sodom <hi type="italic">were</hi> wicked and sinners before the Lord exceedingly.

verses.name: Genesis 13:14
verses.text: ¶ And the Lord said unto Abram, after that Lot was separated from him, Lift up now thine eyes, and look from the place where thou art northward, and southward, and eastward, and westward:

verses.name: Genesis 13:15
verses.text: For all the land which thou seest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed for ever.

verses.name: Genesis 13:16
verses.text: And I will make thy seed as the dust of the earth: so that if a man can number the dust of the earth, <hi type="italic">then</hi> shall thy seed also be numbered.

verses.name: Genesis 13:17
verses.text: Arise, walk through the land in the length of it and in the breadth of it; for I will give it unto thee.

verses.name: Genesis 13:18
verses.text: Then Abram removed <hi type="italic">his</hi> tent, and came and dwelt in the plain of Mamre, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> in Hebron, and built there an altar unto the Lord.  <chapter eID="Gen.13"/><div eID="gen15" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 14:1
verses.text: AND it came to pass in the days of Amraphel king of Shinar, Arioch king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of nations;

verses.name: Genesis 14:2
verses.text: <hi type="italic">That these</hi> made war with Bera king of Sodom, and with Birsha king of Gomorrah, Shinab king of Admah, and Shemeber king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela, which is Zoar.

verses.name: Genesis 14:3
verses.text: All these were joined together in the vale of Siddim, which is the salt sea.

verses.name: Genesis 14:4
verses.text: Twelve years they served Chedorlaomer, and in the thirteenth year they rebelled.

verses.name: Genesis 14:5
verses.text: And in the fourteenth year came Chedorlaomer, and the kings that <hi type="italic">were</hi> with him, and smote the Rephaims in Ashteroth Karnaim, and the Zuzims in Ham, and the Emims in Shaveh Kiriathaim,

verses.name: Genesis 14:6
verses.text: And the Horites in their mount Seir, unto El-paran, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> by the wilderness.

verses.name: Genesis 14:7
verses.text: And they returned, and came to En-mishpat, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> Kadesh, and smote all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites, that dwelt in Hazezon-tamar.

verses.name: Genesis 14:8
verses.text: And there went out the king of Sodom, and the king of Gomorrah, and the king of Admah, and the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (the same <hi type="italic">is</hi> Zoar;) and they joined battle with them in the vale of Siddim;

verses.name: Genesis 14:9
verses.text: With Chedorlaomer the king of Elam, and with Tidal king of nations, and Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar; four kings with five.

verses.name: Genesis 14:10
verses.text: And the vale of Siddim <hi type="italic">was full of</hi> slimepits; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and fell there; and they that remained fled to the mountain.

verses.name: Genesis 14:11
verses.text: And they took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all their victuals, and went their way.

verses.name: Genesis 14:12
verses.text: And they took Lot, Abram’s brother’s son, who dwelt in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.

verses.name: Genesis 14:13
verses.text: ¶ And there came one that had escaped, and told Abram the Hebrew; for he dwelt in the plain of Mamre the Amorite, brother of Eshcol, and brother of Aner: and these <hi type="italic">were</hi> confederate with Abram.

verses.name: Genesis 14:14
verses.text: And when Abram heard that his brother was taken captive, he armed his trained <hi type="italic">servants</hi>, born in his own house, three hundred and eighteen, and pursued <hi type="italic">them</hi> unto Dan.

verses.name: Genesis 14:15
verses.text: And he divided himself against them, he and his servants, by night, and smote them, and pursued them unto Hobah, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> on the left hand of Damascus.

verses.name: Genesis 14:16
verses.text: And he brought back all the goods, and also brought again his brother Lot, and his goods, and the women also, and the people.

verses.name: Genesis 14:17
verses.text: ¶ And the king of Sodom went out to meet him after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer, and of the kings that <hi type="italic">were</hi> with him, at the valley of Shaveh, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> the king’s dale.

verses.name: Genesis 14:18
verses.text: And Melchizedek king of Salem brought forth bread and wine: and he <hi type="italic">was</hi> the priest of the most high God.

verses.name: Genesis 14:19
verses.text: And he blessed him, and said, Blessed <hi type="italic">be</hi> Abram of the most high God, possessor of heaven and earth:

verses.name: Genesis 14:20
verses.text: And blessed be the most high God, which hath delivered thine enemies into thy hand. And he gave him tithes of all.

verses.name: Genesis 14:21
verses.text: And the king of Sodom said unto Abram, Give me the persons, and take the goods to thyself.

verses.name: Genesis 14:22
verses.text: And Abram said to the king of Sodom, I have lift up mine hand unto the Lord, the most high God, the possessor of heaven and earth,

verses.name: Genesis 14:23
verses.text: That I will not <hi type="italic">take</hi> from a thread even to a shoelatchet, and that I will not take any thing that <hi type="italic">is</hi> thine, lest thou shouldest say, I have made Abram rich:

verses.name: Genesis 14:24
verses.text: Save only that which the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men which went with me, Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre; let them take their portion.  <chapter eID="Gen.14"/><div eID="gen16" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 15:1
verses.text: AFTER these things the word of the Lord came unto Abram in a vision, saying, Fear not, Abram: I <hi type="italic">am</hi> thy shield, <hi type="italic">and</hi> thy exceeding great reward.

verses.name: Genesis 15:2
verses.text: And Abram said, Lord God, what wilt thou give me, seeing I go childless, and the steward of my house <hi type="italic">is</hi> this Eliezer of Damascus?

verses.name: Genesis 15:3
verses.text: And Abram said, Behold, to me thou hast given no seed: and, lo, one born in my house is mine heir.

verses.name: Genesis 15:4
verses.text: And, behold, the word of the Lord <hi type="italic">came</hi> unto him, saying, This shall not be thine heir; but he that shall come forth out of thine own bowels shall be thine heir.

verses.name: Genesis 15:5
verses.text: And he brought him forth abroad, and said, Look now toward heaven, and tell the stars, if thou be able to number them: and he said unto him, So shall thy seed be.

verses.name: Genesis 15:6
verses.text: And he believed in the Lord; and he counted it to him for righteousness.

verses.name: Genesis 15:7
verses.text: And he said unto him, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord that brought thee out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give thee this land to inherit it.

verses.name: Genesis 15:8
verses.text: And he said, Lord God, whereby shall I know that I shall inherit it?

verses.name: Genesis 15:9
verses.text: And he said unto him, Take me an heifer of three years old, and a she goat of three years old, and a ram of three years old, and a turtledove, and a young pigeon.

verses.name: Genesis 15:10
verses.text: And he took unto him all these, and divided them in the midst, and laid each piece one against another: but the birds divided he not.

verses.name: Genesis 15:11
verses.text: And when the fowls came down upon the carcases, Abram drove them away.

verses.name: Genesis 15:12
verses.text: And when the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell upon Abram; and, lo, an horror of great darkness fell upon him.

verses.name: Genesis 15:13
verses.text: And he said unto Abram, Know of a surety that thy seed shall be a stranger in a land <hi type="italic">that is</hi> not theirs, and shall serve them; and they shall afflict them four hundred years;

verses.name: Genesis 15:14
verses.text: And also that nation, whom they shall serve, will I judge: and afterward shall they come out with great substance.

verses.name: Genesis 15:15
verses.text: And thou shalt go to thy fathers in peace; thou shalt be buried in a good old age.

verses.name: Genesis 15:16
verses.text: But in the fourth generation they shall come hither again: for the iniquity of the Amorites <hi type="italic">is</hi> not yet full.

verses.name: Genesis 15:17
verses.text: And it came to pass, that, when the sun went down, and it was dark, behold a smoking furnace, and a burning lamp that passed between those pieces.

verses.name: Genesis 15:18
verses.text: In the same day the Lord made a covenant with Abram, saying, Unto thy seed have I given this land, from the river of Egypt unto the great river, the river Euphrates:

verses.name: Genesis 15:19
verses.text: The Kenites, and the Kenizzites, and the Kadmonites,

verses.name: Genesis 15:20
verses.text: And the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Rephaims,

verses.name: Genesis 15:21
verses.text: And the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Girgashites, and the Jebusites.  <chapter eID="Gen.15"/><div eID="gen17" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 16:1
verses.text: NOW Sarai Abram’s wife bare him no children: and she had an handmaid, an Egyptian, whose name <hi type="italic">was</hi> Hagar.

verses.name: Genesis 16:2
verses.text: And Sarai said unto Abram, Behold now, the Lord hath restrained me from bearing: I pray thee, go in unto my maid; it may be that I may obtain children by her. And Abram hearkened to the voice of Sarai.

verses.name: Genesis 16:3
verses.text: And Sarai Abram’s wife took Hagar her maid the Egyptian, after Abram had dwelt ten years in the land of Canaan, and gave her to her husband Abram to be his wife.

verses.name: Genesis 16:4
verses.text: ¶ And he went in unto Hagar, and she conceived: and when she saw that she had conceived, her mistress was despised in her eyes.

verses.name: Genesis 16:5
verses.text: And Sarai said unto Abram, My wrong <hi type="italic">be</hi> upon thee: I have given my maid into thy bosom; and when she saw that she had conceived, I was despised in her eyes: the Lord judge between me and thee.

verses.name: Genesis 16:6
verses.text: But Abram said unto Sarai, Behold, thy maid <hi type="italic">is</hi> in thy hand; do to her as it pleaseth thee. And when Sarai dealt hardly with her, she fled from her face.

verses.name: Genesis 16:7
verses.text: ¶ And the angel of the Lord found her by a fountain of water in the wilderness, by the fountain in the way to Shur.

verses.name: Genesis 16:8
verses.text: And he said, Hagar, Sarai’s maid, whence camest thou? and whither wilt thou go? And she said, I flee from the face of my mistress Sarai.

verses.name: Genesis 16:9
verses.text: And the angel of the Lord said unto her, Return to thy mistress, and submit thyself under her hands.

verses.name: Genesis 16:10
verses.text: And the angel of the Lord said unto her, I will multiply thy seed exceedingly, that it shall not be numbered for multitude.

verses.name: Genesis 16:11
verses.text: And the angel of the Lord said unto her, Behold, thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> with child, and shalt bear a son, and shalt call his name Ishmael; because the Lord hath heard thy affliction.

verses.name: Genesis 16:12
verses.text: And he will be a wild man; his hand <hi type="italic">will be</hi> against every man, and every man’s hand against him; and he shall dwell in the presence of all his brethren.

verses.name: Genesis 16:13
verses.text: And she called the name of the Lord that spake unto her, Thou God seest me: for she said, Have I also here looked after him that seeth me?

verses.name: Genesis 16:14
verses.text: Wherefore the well was called Beer-lahai-roi; behold, <hi type="italic">it is</hi> between Kadesh and Bered.

verses.name: Genesis 16:15
verses.text: ¶ And Hagar bare Abram a son: and Abram called his son’s name, which Hagar bare, Ishmael.

verses.name: Genesis 16:16
verses.text: And Abram <hi type="italic">was</hi> fourscore and six years old, when Hagar bare Ishmael to Abram.  <chapter eID="Gen.16"/><div eID="gen18" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 17:1
verses.text: AND when Abram was ninety years old and nine, the Lord appeared to Abram, and said unto him, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Almighty God; walk before me, and be thou perfect.

verses.name: Genesis 17:2
verses.text: And I will make my covenant between me and thee, and will multiply thee exceedingly.

verses.name: Genesis 17:3
verses.text: And Abram fell on his face: and God talked with him, saying,

verses.name: Genesis 17:4
verses.text: As for me, behold, my covenant <hi type="italic">is</hi> with thee, and thou shalt be a father of many nations.

verses.name: Genesis 17:5
verses.text: Neither shall thy name any more be called Abram, but thy name shall be Abraham; for a father of many nations have I made thee.

verses.name: Genesis 17:6
verses.text: And I will make thee exceeding fruitful, and I will make nations of thee, and kings shall come out of thee.

verses.name: Genesis 17:7
verses.text: And I will establish my covenant between me and thee and thy seed after thee in their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be a God unto thee, and to thy seed after thee.

verses.name: Genesis 17:8
verses.text: And I will give unto thee, and to thy seed after thee, the land wherein thou art a stranger, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession; and I will be their God.

verses.name: Genesis 17:9
verses.text: ¶ And God said unto Abraham, Thou shalt keep my covenant therefore, thou, and thy seed after thee in their generations.

verses.name: Genesis 17:10
verses.text: This <hi type="italic">is</hi> my covenant, which ye shall keep, between me and you and thy seed after thee; Every man child among you shall be circumcised.

verses.name: Genesis 17:11
verses.text: And ye shall circumcise the flesh of your foreskin; and it shall be a token of the covenant betwixt me and you.

verses.name: Genesis 17:12
verses.text: And he that is eight days old shall be circumcised among you, every man child in your generations, he that is born in the house, or bought with money of any stranger, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> not of thy seed.

verses.name: Genesis 17:13
verses.text: He that is born in thy house, and he that is bought with thy money, must needs be circumcised: and my covenant shall be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant.

verses.name: Genesis 17:14
verses.text: And the uncircumcised man child whose flesh of his foreskin is not circumcised, that soul shall be cut off from his people; he hath broken my covenant.

verses.name: Genesis 17:15
verses.text: ¶ And God said unto Abraham, As for Sarai thy wife, thou shalt not call her name Sarai, but Sarah <hi type="italic">shall</hi> her name <hi type="italic">be</hi>.

verses.name: Genesis 17:16
verses.text: And I will bless her, and give thee a son also of her: yea, I will bless her, and she shall be <hi type="italic">a mother</hi> of nations; kings of people shall be of her.

verses.name: Genesis 17:17
verses.text: Then Abraham fell upon his face, and laughed, and said in his heart, Shall <hi type="italic">a child</hi> be born unto him that is an hundred years old? and shall Sarah, that is ninety years old, bear?

verses.name: Genesis 17:18
verses.text: And Abraham said unto God, O that Ishmael might live before thee!

verses.name: Genesis 17:19
verses.text: And God said, Sarah thy wife shall bear thee a son indeed; and thou shalt call his name Isaac: and I will establish my covenant with him for an everlasting covenant, <hi type="italic">and</hi> with his seed after him.

verses.name: Genesis 17:20
verses.text: And as for Ishmael, I have heard thee: Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly; twelve princes shall he beget, and I will make him a great nation.

verses.name: Genesis 17:21
verses.text: But my covenant will I establish with Isaac, which Sarah shall bear unto thee at this set time in the next year.

verses.name: Genesis 17:22
verses.text: And he left off talking with him, and God went up from Abraham.

verses.name: Genesis 17:23
verses.text: ¶ And Abraham took Ishmael his son, and all that were born in his house, and all that were bought with his money, every male among the men of Abraham’s house; and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin in the selfsame day, as God had said unto him.

verses.name: Genesis 17:24
verses.text: And Abraham <hi type="italic">was</hi> ninety years old and nine, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.

verses.name: Genesis 17:25
verses.text: And Ishmael his son <hi type="italic">was</hi> thirteen years old, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.

verses.name: Genesis 17:26
verses.text: In the selfsame day was Abraham circumcised, and Ishmael his son.

verses.name: Genesis 17:27
verses.text: And all the men of his house, born in the house, and bought with money of the stranger, were circumcised with him.  <chapter eID="Gen.17"/><div eID="gen19" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 18:1
verses.text: AND the Lord appeared unto him in the plains of Mamre: and he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day;

verses.name: Genesis 18:2
verses.text: And he lift up his eyes and looked, and, lo, three men stood by him: and when he saw <hi type="italic">them</hi>, he ran to meet them from the tent door, and bowed himself toward the ground,

verses.name: Genesis 18:3
verses.text: And said, My Lord, if now I have found favour in thy sight, pass not away, I pray thee, from thy servant:

verses.name: Genesis 18:4
verses.text: Let a little water, I pray you, be fetched, and wash your feet, and rest yourselves under the tree:

verses.name: Genesis 18:5
verses.text: And I will fetch a morsel of bread, and comfort ye your hearts; after that ye shall pass on: for therefore are ye come to your servant. And they said, So do, as thou hast said.

verses.name: Genesis 18:6
verses.text: And Abraham hastened into the tent unto Sarah, and said, Make ready quickly three measures of fine meal, knead <hi type="italic">it</hi>, and make cakes upon the hearth.

verses.name: Genesis 18:7
verses.text: And Abraham ran unto the herd, and fetcht a calf tender and good, and gave <hi type="italic">it</hi> unto a young man; and he hasted to dress it.

verses.name: Genesis 18:8
verses.text: And he took butter, and milk, and the calf which he had dressed, and set <hi type="italic">it</hi> before them; and he stood by them under the tree, and they did eat.

verses.name: Genesis 18:9
verses.text: ¶ And they said unto him, Where <hi type="italic">is</hi> Sarah thy wife? And he said, Behold, in the tent.

verses.name: Genesis 18:10
verses.text: And he said, I will certainly return unto thee according to the time of life; and, lo, Sarah thy wife shall have a son. And Sarah heard <hi type="italic">it</hi> in the tent door, which <hi type="italic">was</hi> behind him.

verses.name: Genesis 18:11
verses.text: Now Abraham and Sarah <hi type="italic">were</hi> old <hi type="italic">and</hi> well stricken in age; <hi type="italic">and</hi> it ceased to be with Sarah after the manner of women.

verses.name: Genesis 18:12
verses.text: Therefore Sarah laughed within herself, saying, After I am waxed old shall I have pleasure, my lord being old also?

verses.name: Genesis 18:13
verses.text: And the Lord said unto Abraham, Wherefore did Sarah laugh, saying, Shall I of a surety bear a child, which am old?

verses.name: Genesis 18:14
verses.text: Is any thing too hard for the Lord? At the time appointed I will return unto thee, according to the time of life, and Sarah shall have a son.

verses.name: Genesis 18:15
verses.text: Then Sarah denied, saying, I laughed not; for she was afraid. And he said, Nay; but thou didst laugh.

verses.name: Genesis 18:16
verses.text: ¶ And the men rose up from thence, and looked toward Sodom: and Abraham went with them to bring them on the way.

verses.name: Genesis 18:17
verses.text: And the Lord said, Shall I hide from Abraham that thing which I do;

verses.name: Genesis 18:18
verses.text: Seeing that Abraham shall surely become a great and mighty nation, and all the nations of the earth shall be blessed in him?

verses.name: Genesis 18:19
verses.text: For I know him, that he will command his children and his household after him, and they shall keep the way of the Lord, to do justice and judgment; that the Lord may bring upon Abraham that which he hath spoken of him.

verses.name: Genesis 18:20
verses.text: And the Lord said, Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and because their sin is very grievous;

verses.name: Genesis 18:21
verses.text: I will go down now, and see whether they have done altogether according to the cry of it, which is come unto me; and if not, I will know.

verses.name: Genesis 18:22
verses.text: And the men turned their faces from thence, and went toward Sodom: but Abraham stood yet before the Lord.

verses.name: Genesis 18:23
verses.text: ¶ And Abraham drew near, and said, Wilt thou also destroy the righteous with the wicked?

verses.name: Genesis 18:24
verses.text: Peradventure there be fifty righteous within the city: wilt thou also destroy and not spare the place for the fifty righteous that <hi type="italic">are</hi> therein?

verses.name: Genesis 18:25
verses.text: That be far from thee to do after this manner, to slay the righteous with the wicked: and that the righteous should be as the wicked, that be far from thee: Shall not the Judge of all the earth do right?

verses.name: Genesis 18:26
verses.text: And the Lord said, If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city, then I will spare all the place for their sakes.

verses.name: Genesis 18:27
verses.text: And Abraham answered and said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord, which <hi type="italic">am but</hi> dust and ashes:

verses.name: Genesis 18:28
verses.text: Peradventure there shall lack five of the fifty righteous: wilt thou destroy all the city for <hi type="italic">lack of</hi> five? And he said, If I find there forty and five, I will not destroy <hi type="italic">it</hi>.

verses.name: Genesis 18:29
verses.text: And he spake unto him yet again, and said, Peradventure there shall be forty found there. And he said, I will not do <hi type="italic">it</hi> for forty’s sake.

verses.name: Genesis 18:30
verses.text: And he said <hi type="italic">unto him</hi>, Oh let not the Lord be angry, and I will speak: Peradventure there shall thirty be found there. And he said, I will not do <hi type="italic">it</hi>, if I find thirty there.

verses.name: Genesis 18:31
