verses.text: And he said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord: Peradventure there shall be twenty found there. And he said, I will not destroy <hi type="italic">it</hi> for twenty’s sake.

verses.name: Genesis 18:32
verses.text: And he said, Oh let not the Lord be angry, and I will speak yet but this once: Peradventure ten shall be found there. And he said, I will not destroy <hi type="italic">it</hi> for ten’s sake.

verses.name: Genesis 18:33
verses.text: And the Lord went his way, as soon as he had left communing with Abraham: and Abraham returned unto his place.  <chapter eID="Gen.18"/><div eID="gen20" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 19:1
verses.text: AND there came two angels to Sodom at even; and Lot sat in the gate of Sodom: and Lot seeing <hi type="italic">them</hi> rose up to meet them; and he bowed himself with his face toward the ground;

verses.name: Genesis 19:2
verses.text: And he said, Behold now, my lords, turn in, I pray you, into your servant’s house, and tarry all night, and wash your feet, and ye shall rise up early, and go on your ways. And they said, Nay; but we will abide in the street all night.

verses.name: Genesis 19:3
verses.text: And he pressed upon them greatly; and they turned in unto him, and entered into his house; and he made them a feast, and did bake unleavened bread, and they did eat.

verses.name: Genesis 19:4
verses.text: ¶ But before they lay down, the men of the city, <hi type="italic">even</hi> the men of Sodom, compassed the house round, both old and young, all the people from every quarter:

verses.name: Genesis 19:5
verses.text: And they called unto Lot, and said unto him, Where <hi type="italic">are</hi> the men which came in to thee this night? bring them out unto us, that we may know them.

verses.name: Genesis 19:6
verses.text: And Lot went out at the door unto them, and shut the door after him,

verses.name: Genesis 19:7
verses.text: And said, I pray you, brethren, do not so wickedly.

verses.name: Genesis 19:8
verses.text: Behold now, I have two daughters which have not known man; let me, I pray you, bring them out unto you, and do ye to them as <hi type="italic">is</hi> good in your eyes: only unto these men do nothing; for therefore came they under the shadow of my roof.

verses.name: Genesis 19:9
verses.text: And they said, Stand back. And they said <hi type="italic">again</hi>, This one <hi type="italic">fellow</hi> came in to sojourn, and he will needs be a judge: now will we deal worse with thee, than with them. And they pressed sore upon the man, <hi type="italic">even</hi> Lot, and came near to break the door.

verses.name: Genesis 19:10
verses.text: But the men put forth their hand, and pulled Lot into the house to them, and shut to the door.

verses.name: Genesis 19:11
verses.text: And they smote the men that <hi type="italic">were</hi> at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great: so that they wearied themselves to find the door.

verses.name: Genesis 19:12
verses.text: ¶ And the men said unto Lot, Hast thou here any besides? son in law, and thy sons, and thy daughters, and whatsoever thou hast in the city, bring <hi type="italic">them</hi> out of this place:

verses.name: Genesis 19:13
verses.text: For we will destroy this place, because the cry of them is waxen great before the face of the Lord; and the Lord hath sent us to destroy it.

verses.name: Genesis 19:14
verses.text: And Lot went out, and spake unto his sons in law, which married his daughters, and said, Up, get you out of this place; for the Lord will destroy this city. But he seemed as one that mocked unto his sons in law.

verses.name: Genesis 19:15
verses.text: ¶ And when the morning arose, then the angels hastened Lot, saying, Arise, take thy wife, and thy two daughters, which are here; lest thou be consumed in the iniquity of the city.

verses.name: Genesis 19:16
verses.text: And while he lingered, the men laid hold upon his hand, and upon the hand of his wife, and upon the hand of his two daughters; the Lord being merciful unto him: and they brought him forth, and set him without the city.

verses.name: Genesis 19:17
verses.text: ¶ And it came to pass, when they had brought them forth abroad, that he said, Escape for thy life; look not behind thee, neither stay thou in all the plain; escape to the mountain, lest thou be consumed.

verses.name: Genesis 19:18
verses.text: And Lot said unto them, Oh, not so, my Lord:

verses.name: Genesis 19:19
verses.text: Behold now, thy servant hath found grace in thy sight, and thou hast magnified thy mercy, which thou hast shewed unto me in saving my life; and I cannot escape to the mountain, lest some evil take me, and I die:

verses.name: Genesis 19:20
verses.text: Behold now, this city <hi type="italic">is</hi> near to flee unto, and it <hi type="italic">is</hi> a little one: Oh, let me escape thither, (<hi type="italic">is</hi> it not a little one?) and my soul shall live.

verses.name: Genesis 19:21
verses.text: And he said unto him, See, I have accepted thee concerning this thing also, that I will not overthrow this city, for the which thou hast spoken.

verses.name: Genesis 19:22
verses.text: Haste thee, escape thither; for I cannot do any thing till thou be come thither. Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar.

verses.name: Genesis 19:23
verses.text: ¶ The sun was risen upon the earth when Lot entered into Zoar.

verses.name: Genesis 19:24
verses.text: Then the Lord rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah brimstone and fire from the Lord out of heaven;

verses.name: Genesis 19:25
verses.text: And he overthrew those cities, and all the plain, and all the inhabitants of the cities, and that which grew upon the ground.

verses.name: Genesis 19:26
verses.text: ¶ But his wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.

verses.name: Genesis 19:27
verses.text: ¶ And Abraham gat up early in the morning to the place where he stood before the Lord:

verses.name: Genesis 19:28
verses.text: And he looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the plain, and beheld, and, lo, the smoke of the country went up as the smoke of a furnace.

verses.name: Genesis 19:29
verses.text: ¶ And it came to pass, when God destroyed the cities of the plain, that God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the midst of the overthrow, when he overthrew the cities in the which Lot dwelt.

verses.name: Genesis 19:30
verses.text: ¶ And Lot went up out of Zoar, and dwelt in the mountain, and his two daughters with him; for he feared to dwell in Zoar: and he dwelt in a cave, he and his two daughters.

verses.name: Genesis 19:31
verses.text: And the firstborn said unto the younger, Our father <hi type="italic">is</hi> old, and <hi type="italic">there is</hi> not a man in the earth to come in unto us after the manner of all the earth:

verses.name: Genesis 19:32
verses.text: Come, let us make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.

verses.name: Genesis 19:33
verses.text: And they made their father drink wine that night: and the firstborn went in, and lay with her father; and he perceived not when she lay down, nor when she arose.

verses.name: Genesis 19:34
verses.text: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the firstborn said unto the younger, Behold, I lay yesternight with my father: let us make him drink wine this night also; and go thou in, <hi type="italic">and</hi> lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.

verses.name: Genesis 19:35
verses.text: And they made their father drink wine that night also: and the younger arose, and lay with him; and he perceived not when she lay down, nor when she arose.

verses.name: Genesis 19:36
verses.text: Thus were both the daughters of Lot with child by their father.

verses.name: Genesis 19:37
verses.text: And the firstborn bare a son, and called his name Moab: the same <hi type="italic">is</hi> the father of the Moabites unto this day.

verses.name: Genesis 19:38
verses.text: And the younger, she also bare a son, and called his name Ben-ammi: the same <hi type="italic">is</hi> the father of the children of Ammon unto this day.  <chapter eID="Gen.19"/><div eID="gen21" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 20:1
verses.text: AND Abraham journeyed from thence toward the south country, and dwelled between Kadesh and Shur, and sojourned in Gerar.

verses.name: Genesis 20:2
verses.text: And Abraham said of Sarah his wife, She <hi type="italic">is</hi> my sister: and Abimelech king of Gerar sent, and took Sarah.

verses.name: Genesis 20:3
verses.text: But God came to Abimelech in a dream by night, and said to him, Behold, thou <hi type="italic">art but</hi> a dead man, for the woman which thou hast taken; for she <hi type="italic">is</hi> a man’s wife.

verses.name: Genesis 20:4
verses.text: But Abimelech had not come near her: and he said, Lord, wilt thou slay also a righteous nation?

verses.name: Genesis 20:5
verses.text: Said he not unto me, She <hi type="italic">is</hi> my sister? and she, even she herself said, He <hi type="italic">is</hi> my brother: in the integrity of my heart and innocency of my hands have I done this.

verses.name: Genesis 20:6
verses.text: And God said unto him in a dream, Yea, I know that thou didst this in the integrity of thy heart; for I also withheld thee from sinning against me: therefore suffered I thee not to touch her.

verses.name: Genesis 20:7
verses.text: Now therefore restore the man <hi type="italic">his</hi> wife; for he <hi type="italic">is</hi> a prophet, and he shall pray for thee, and thou shalt live: and if thou restore <hi type="italic">her</hi> not, know thou that thou shalt surely die, thou, and all that <hi type="italic">are</hi> thine.

verses.name: Genesis 20:8
verses.text: Therefore Abimelech rose early in the morning, and called all his servants, and told all these things in their ears: and the men were sore afraid.

verses.name: Genesis 20:9
verses.text: Then Abimelech called Abraham, and said unto him, What hast thou done unto us? and what have I offended thee, that thou hast brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin? thou hast done deeds unto me that ought not to be done.

verses.name: Genesis 20:10
verses.text: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What sawest thou, that thou hast done this thing?

verses.name: Genesis 20:11
verses.text: And Abraham said, Because I thought, Surely the fear of God <hi type="italic">is</hi> not in this place; and they will slay me for my wife’s sake.

verses.name: Genesis 20:12
verses.text: And yet indeed <hi type="italic">she is</hi> my sister; she <hi type="italic">is</hi> the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife.

verses.name: Genesis 20:13
verses.text: And it came to pass, when God caused me to wander from my father’s house, that I said unto her, This <hi type="italic">is</hi> thy kindness which thou shalt shew unto me; at every place whither we shall come, say of me, He <hi type="italic">is</hi> my brother.

verses.name: Genesis 20:14
verses.text: And Abimelech took sheep, and oxen, and menservants, and womenservants, and gave <hi type="italic">them</hi> unto Abraham, and restored him Sarah his wife.

verses.name: Genesis 20:15
verses.text: And Abimelech said, Behold, my land <hi type="italic">is</hi> before thee: dwell where it pleaseth thee.

verses.name: Genesis 20:16
verses.text: And unto Sarah he said, Behold, I have given thy brother a thousand <hi type="italic">pieces</hi> of silver: behold, he <hi type="italic">is</hi> to thee a covering of the eyes, unto all that <hi type="italic">are</hi> with thee, and with all <hi type="italic">other:</hi> thus she was reproved.

verses.name: Genesis 20:17
verses.text: ¶ So Abraham prayed unto God: and God healed Abimelech, and his wife, and his maidservants; and they bare <hi type="italic">children</hi>.

verses.name: Genesis 20:18
verses.text: For the Lord had fast closed up all the wombs of the house of Abimelech, because of Sarah Abraham’s wife.  <chapter eID="Gen.20"/><div eID="gen22" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 21:1
verses.text: AND the Lord visited Sarah as he had said, and the Lord did unto Sarah as he had spoken.

verses.name: Genesis 21:2
verses.text: For Sarah conceived, and bare Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.

verses.name: Genesis 21:3
verses.text: And Abraham called the name of his son that was born unto him, whom Sarah bare to him, Isaac.

verses.name: Genesis 21:4
verses.text: And Abraham circumcised his son Isaac being eight days old, as God had commanded him.

verses.name: Genesis 21:5
verses.text: And Abraham was an hundred years old, when his son Isaac was born unto him.

verses.name: Genesis 21:6
verses.text: ¶ And Sarah said, God hath made me to laugh, <hi type="italic">so that</hi> all that hear will laugh with me.

verses.name: Genesis 21:7
verses.text: And she said, Who would have said unto Abraham, that Sarah should have given children suck? for I have born <hi type="italic">him</hi> a son in his old age.

verses.name: Genesis 21:8
verses.text: And the child grew, and was weaned: and Abraham made a great feast the <hi type="italic">same</hi> day that Isaac was weaned.

verses.name: Genesis 21:9
verses.text: ¶ And Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, which she had born unto Abraham, mocking.

verses.name: Genesis 21:10
verses.text: Wherefore she said unto Abraham, Cast out this bondwoman and her son: for the son of this bondwoman shall not be heir with my son, <hi type="italic">even</hi> with Isaac.

verses.name: Genesis 21:11
verses.text: And the thing was very grievous in Abraham’s sight because of his son.

verses.name: Genesis 21:12
verses.text: ¶ And God said unto Abraham, Let it not be grievous in thy sight because of the lad, and because of thy bondwoman; in all that Sarah hath said unto thee, hearken unto her voice; for in Isaac shall thy seed be called.

verses.name: Genesis 21:13
verses.text: And also of the son of the bondwoman will I make a nation, because he <hi type="italic">is</hi> thy seed.

verses.name: Genesis 21:14
verses.text: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread, and a bottle of water, and gave <hi type="italic">it</hi> unto Hagar, putting <hi type="italic">it</hi> on her shoulder, and the child, and sent her away: and she departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beer-sheba.

verses.name: Genesis 21:15
verses.text: And the water was spent in the bottle, and she cast the child under one of the shrubs.

verses.name: Genesis 21:16
verses.text: And she went, and sat her down over against <hi type="italic">him</hi> a good way off, as it were a bowshot: for she said, Let me not see the death of the child. And she sat over against <hi type="italic">him</hi>, and lift up her voice, and wept.

verses.name: Genesis 21:17
verses.text: And God heard the voice of the lad; and the angel of God called to Hagar out of heaven, and said unto her, What aileth thee, Hagar? fear not; for God hath heard the voice of the lad where he <hi type="italic">is</hi>.

verses.name: Genesis 21:18
verses.text: Arise, lift up the lad, and hold him in thine hand; for I will make him a great nation.

verses.name: Genesis 21:19
verses.text: And God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water; and she went, and filled the bottle with water, and gave the lad drink.

verses.name: Genesis 21:20
verses.text: And God was with the lad; and he grew, and dwelt in the wilderness, and became an archer.

verses.name: Genesis 21:21
verses.text: And he dwelt in the wilderness of Paran: and his mother took him a wife out of the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Genesis 21:22
verses.text: ¶ And it came to pass at that time, that Abimelech and Phichol the chief captain of his host spake unto Abraham, saying, God <hi type="italic">is</hi> with thee in all that thou doest:

verses.name: Genesis 21:23
verses.text: Now therefore swear unto me here by God that thou wilt not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my son’s son: <hi type="italic">but</hi> according to the kindness that I have done unto thee, thou shalt do unto me, and to the land wherein thou hast sojourned.

verses.name: Genesis 21:24
verses.text: And Abraham said, I will swear.

verses.name: Genesis 21:25
verses.text: And Abraham reproved Abimelech because of a well of water, which Abimelech’s servants had violently taken away.

verses.name: Genesis 21:26
verses.text: And Abimelech said, I wot not who hath done this thing: neither didst thou tell me, neither yet heard I <hi type="italic">of it</hi>, but to day.

verses.name: Genesis 21:27
verses.text: And Abraham took sheep and oxen, and gave them unto Abimelech; and both of them made a covenant.

verses.name: Genesis 21:28
verses.text: And Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.

verses.name: Genesis 21:29
verses.text: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What <hi type="italic">mean</hi> these seven ewe lambs which thou hast set by themselves?

verses.name: Genesis 21:30
verses.text: And he said, For <hi type="italic">these</hi> seven ewe lambs shalt thou take of my hand, that they may be a witness unto me, that I have digged this well.

verses.name: Genesis 21:31
verses.text: Wherefore he called that place Beer-sheba; because there they sware both of them.

verses.name: Genesis 21:32
verses.text: Thus they made a covenant at Beer-sheba: then Abimelech rose up, and Phichol the chief captain of his host, and they returned into the land of the Philistines.

verses.name: Genesis 21:33
verses.text: ¶ And <hi type="italic">Abraham</hi> planted a grove in Beer-sheba, and called there on the name of the Lord, the everlasting God.

verses.name: Genesis 21:34
verses.text: And Abraham sojourned in the Philistines’ land many days.  <chapter eID="Gen.21"/><div eID="gen23" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 22:1
verses.text: AND it came to pass after these things, that God did tempt Abraham, and said unto him, Abraham: and he said, Behold, <hi type="italic">here</hi> I <hi type="italic">am</hi>.

verses.name: Genesis 22:2
verses.text: And he said, Take now thy son, thine only <hi type="italic">son</hi> Isaac, whom thou lovest, and get thee into the land of Moriah; and offer him there for a burnt offering upon one of the mountains which I will tell thee of.

verses.name: Genesis 22:3
verses.text: ¶ And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and saddled his ass, and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son, and clave the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went unto the place of which God had told him.

verses.name: Genesis 22:4
verses.text: Then on the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place afar off.

verses.name: Genesis 22:5
verses.text: And Abraham said unto his young men, Abide ye here with the ass; and I and the lad will go yonder and worship, and come again to you.

verses.name: Genesis 22:6
verses.text: And Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering, and laid <hi type="italic">it</hi> upon Isaac his son; and he took the fire in his hand, and a knife; and they went both of them together.

verses.name: Genesis 22:7
verses.text: And Isaac spake unto Abraham his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here <hi type="italic">am</hi> I, my son. And he said, Behold the fire and the wood: but where <hi type="italic">is</hi> the lamb for a burnt offering?

verses.name: Genesis 22:8
verses.text: And Abraham said, My son, God will provide himself a lamb for a burnt offering: so they went both of them together.

verses.name: Genesis 22:9
verses.text: And they came to the place which God had told him of; and Abraham built an altar there, and laid the wood in order, and bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar upon the wood.

verses.name: Genesis 22:10
verses.text: And Abraham stretched forth his hand, and took the knife to slay his son.

verses.name: Genesis 22:11
verses.text: And the angel of the Lord called unto him out of heaven, and said, Abraham, Abraham: and he said, Here <hi type="italic">am</hi> I.

verses.name: Genesis 22:12
verses.text: And he said, Lay not thine hand upon the lad, neither do thou any thing unto him: for now I know that thou fearest God, seeing thou hast not withheld thy son, thine only <hi type="italic">son</hi> from me.

verses.name: Genesis 22:13
verses.text: And Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold behind <hi type="italic">him</hi> a ram caught in a thicket by his horns: and Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering in the stead of his son.

verses.name: Genesis 22:14
verses.text: And Abraham called the name of that place Jehovah-jireh: as it is said <hi type="italic">to</hi> this day, In the mount of the Lord it shall be seen.

verses.name: Genesis 22:15
verses.text: ¶ And the angel of the Lord called unto Abraham out of heaven the second time,

verses.name: Genesis 22:16
verses.text: And said, By myself have I sworn, saith the Lord, for because thou hast done this thing, and hast not withheld thy son, thine only <hi type="italic">son:</hi>

verses.name: Genesis 22:17
verses.text: That in blessing I will bless thee, and in multiplying I will multiply thy seed as the stars of the heaven, and as the sand which <hi type="italic">is</hi> upon the sea shore; and thy seed shall possess the gate of his enemies;

verses.name: Genesis 22:18
verses.text: And in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed; because thou hast obeyed my voice.

verses.name: Genesis 22:19
verses.text: So Abraham returned unto his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beer-sheba; and Abraham dwelt at Beer-sheba.

verses.name: Genesis 22:20
verses.text: ¶ And it came to pass after these things, that it was told Abraham, saying, Behold, Milcah, she hath also born children unto thy brother Nahor;

verses.name: Genesis 22:21
verses.text: Huz his firstborn, and Buz his brother, and Kemuel the father of Aram,

verses.name: Genesis 22:22
verses.text: And Chesed, and Hazo, and Pildash, and Jidlaph, and Bethuel.

verses.name: Genesis 22:23
verses.text: And Bethuel begat Rebekah: these eight Milcah did bear to Nahor, Abraham’s brother.

verses.name: Genesis 22:24
verses.text: And his concubine, whose name <hi type="italic">was</hi> Reumah, she bare also Tebah, and Gaham, and Thahash, and Maachah.  <chapter eID="Gen.22"/><div eID="gen24" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 23:1
verses.text: AND Sarah was an hundred and seven and twenty years old: <hi type="italic">these were</hi> the years of the life of Sarah.

verses.name: Genesis 23:2
verses.text: And Sarah died in Kirjath-arba; the same <hi type="italic">is</hi> Hebron in the land of Canaan: and Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.

verses.name: Genesis 23:3
verses.text: ¶ And Abraham stood up from before his dead, and spake unto the sons of Heth, saying,

verses.name: Genesis 23:4
verses.text: I <hi type="italic">am</hi> a stranger and a sojourner with you: give me a possession of a buryingplace with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.

verses.name: Genesis 23:5
verses.text: And the children of Heth answered Abraham, saying unto him,

verses.name: Genesis 23:6
verses.text: Hear us, my lord: thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> a mighty prince among us: in the choice of our sepulchres bury thy dead; none of us shall withhold from thee his sepulchre, but that thou mayest bury thy dead.

verses.name: Genesis 23:7
verses.text: And Abraham stood up, and bowed himself to the people of the land, <hi type="italic">even</hi> to the children of Heth.

verses.name: Genesis 23:8
verses.text: And he communed with them, saying, If it be your mind that I should bury my dead out of my sight; hear me, and intreat for me to Ephron the son of Zohar,

verses.name: Genesis 23:9
verses.text: That he may give me the cave of Machpelah, which he hath, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> in the end of his field; for as much money as it is worth he shall give it me for a possession of a buryingplace amongst you.

verses.name: Genesis 23:10
verses.text: And Ephron dwelt among the children of Heth: and Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the audience of the children of Heth, <hi type="italic">even</hi> of all that went in at the gate of his city, saying,

verses.name: Genesis 23:11
verses.text: Nay, my lord, hear me: the field give I thee, and the cave that <hi type="italic">is</hi> therein, I give it thee; in the presence of the sons of my people give I it thee: bury thy dead.

verses.name: Genesis 23:12
verses.text: And Abraham bowed down himself before the people of the land.

verses.name: Genesis 23:13
verses.text: And he spake unto Ephron in the audience of the people of the land, saying, But if thou <hi type="italic">wilt give it</hi>, I pray thee, hear me: I will give thee money for the field; take <hi type="italic">it</hi> of me, and I will bury my dead there.

verses.name: Genesis 23:14
verses.text: And Ephron answered Abraham, saying unto him,

verses.name: Genesis 23:15
verses.text: My lord, hearken unto me: the land <hi type="italic">is worth</hi> four hundred shekels of silver; what <hi type="italic">is</hi> that betwixt me and thee? bury therefore thy dead.

verses.name: Genesis 23:16
verses.text: And Abraham hearkened unto Ephron; and Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver, which he had named in the audience of the sons of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, current <hi type="italic">money</hi> with the merchant.

verses.name: Genesis 23:17
verses.text: ¶ And the field of Ephron, which <hi type="italic">was</hi> in Machpelah, which <hi type="italic">was</hi> before Mamre, the field, and the cave which <hi type="italic">was</hi> therein, and all the trees that <hi type="italic">were</hi> in the field, that <hi type="italic">were</hi> in all the borders round about, were made sure

verses.name: Genesis 23:18
verses.text: Unto Abraham for a possession in the presence of the children of Heth, before all that went in at the gate of his city.

verses.name: Genesis 23:19
verses.text: And after this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre: the same <hi type="italic">is</hi> Hebron in the land of Canaan.

verses.name: Genesis 23:20
verses.text: And the field, and the cave that <hi type="italic">is</hi> therein, were made sure unto Abraham for a possession of a buryingplace by the sons of Heth.  <chapter eID="Gen.23"/><div eID="gen25" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 24:1
verses.text: AND Abraham was old, <hi type="italic">and</hi> well stricken in age: and the Lord had blessed Abraham in all things.

verses.name: Genesis 24:2
verses.text: And Abraham said unto his eldest servant of his house, that ruled over all that he had, Put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh:

verses.name: Genesis 24:3
verses.text: And I will make thee swear by the Lord, the God of heaven, and the God of the earth, that thou shalt not take a wife unto my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I dwell:

verses.name: Genesis 24:4
verses.text: But thou shalt go unto my country, and to my kindred, and take a wife unto my son Isaac.

verses.name: Genesis 24:5
verses.text: And the servant said unto him, Peradventure the woman will not be willing to follow me unto this land: must I needs bring thy son again unto the land from whence thou camest?

verses.name: Genesis 24:6
verses.text: And Abraham said unto him, Beware thou that thou bring not my son thither again.

verses.name: Genesis 24:7
verses.text: ¶ The Lord God of heaven, which took me from my father’s house, and from the land of my kindred, and which spake unto me, and that sware unto me, saying, Unto thy seed will I give this land; he shall send his angel before thee, and thou shalt take a wife unto my son from thence.

verses.name: Genesis 24:8
verses.text: And if the woman will not be willing to follow thee, then thou shalt be clear from this my oath: only bring not my son thither again.

verses.name: Genesis 24:9
verses.text: And the servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and sware to him concerning that matter.

verses.name: Genesis 24:10
verses.text: ¶ And the servant took ten camels of the camels of his master, and departed; for all the goods of his master <hi type="italic">were</hi> in his hand: and he arose, and went to Mesopotamia, unto the city of Nahor.

verses.name: Genesis 24:11
verses.text: And he made his camels to kneel down without the city by a well of water at the time of the evening, <hi type="italic">even</hi> the time that women go out to draw <hi type="italic">water</hi>.

verses.name: Genesis 24:12
verses.text: And he said, O Lord God of my master Abraham, I pray thee, send me good speed this day, and shew kindness unto my master Abraham.

verses.name: Genesis 24:13
verses.text: Behold, I stand <hi type="italic">here</hi> by the well of water; and the daughters of the men of the city come out to draw water:

verses.name: Genesis 24:14
verses.text: And let it come to pass, that the damsel to whom I shall say, Let down thy pitcher, I pray thee, that I may drink; and she shall say, Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also: <hi type="italic">let the same be</hi> she <hi type="italic">that</hi> thou hast appointed for thy servant Isaac; and thereby shall I know that thou hast shewed kindness unto my master.

verses.name: Genesis 24:15
verses.text: ¶ And it came to pass, before he had done speaking, that, behold, Rebekah came out, who was born to Bethuel, son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham’s brother, with her pitcher upon her shoulder.

verses.name: Genesis 24:16
verses.text: And the damsel <hi type="italic">was</hi> very fair to look upon, a virgin, neither had any man known her: and she went down to the well, and filled her pitcher, and came up.

verses.name: Genesis 24:17
verses.text: And the servant ran to meet her, and said, Let me, I pray thee, drink a little water of thy pitcher.

verses.name: Genesis 24:18
verses.text: And she said, Drink, my lord: and she hasted, and let down her pitcher upon her hand, and gave him drink.

verses.name: Genesis 24:19
verses.text: And when she had done giving him drink, she said, I will draw <hi type="italic">water</hi> for thy camels also, until they have done drinking.

verses.name: Genesis 24:20
verses.text: And she hasted, and emptied her pitcher into the trough, and ran again unto the well to draw <hi type="italic">water</hi>, and drew for all his camels.

verses.name: Genesis 24:21
verses.text: And the man wondering at her held his peace, to wit whether the Lord had made his journey prosperous or not.

verses.name: Genesis 24:22
verses.text: And it came to pass, as the camels had done drinking, that the man took a golden earring of half a shekel weight, and two bracelets for her hands of ten <hi type="italic">shekels</hi> weight of gold;

verses.name: Genesis 24:23
verses.text: And said, Whose daughter <hi type="italic">art</hi> thou? tell me, I pray thee: is there room <hi type="italic">in</hi> thy father’s house for us to lodge in?

verses.name: Genesis 24:24
verses.text: And she said unto him, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah, which she bare unto Nahor.

verses.name: Genesis 24:25
verses.text: She said moreover unto him, We have both straw and provender enough, and room to lodge in.

verses.name: Genesis 24:26
verses.text: And the man bowed down his head, and worshipped the Lord.

verses.name: Genesis 24:27
verses.text: And he said, Blessed <hi type="italic">be</hi> the Lord God of my master Abraham, who hath not left destitute my master of his mercy and his truth: I <hi type="italic">being</hi> in the way, the Lord led me to the house of my master’s brethren.

verses.name: Genesis 24:28
verses.text: And the damsel ran, and told <hi type="italic">them of</hi> her mother’s house these things.

verses.name: Genesis 24:29
verses.text: ¶ And Rebekah had a brother, and his name <hi type="italic">was</hi> Laban: and Laban ran out unto the man, unto the well.

verses.name: Genesis 24:30
verses.text: And it came to pass, when he saw the earring and bracelets upon his sister’s hands, and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister, saying, Thus spake the man unto me; that he came unto the man; and, behold, he stood by the camels at the well.

verses.name: Genesis 24:31
verses.text: And he said, Come in, thou blessed of the Lord; wherefore standest thou without? for I have prepared the house, and room for the camels.

verses.name: Genesis 24:32
verses.text: ¶ And the man came into the house: and he ungirded his camels, and gave straw and provender for the camels, and water to wash his feet, and the men’s feet that <hi type="italic">were</hi> with him.

verses.name: Genesis 24:33
verses.text: And there was set <hi type="italic">meat</hi> before him to eat: but he said, I will not eat, until I have told mine errand. And he said, Speak on.

verses.name: Genesis 24:34
verses.text: And he said, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> Abraham’s servant.

verses.name: Genesis 24:35
verses.text: And the Lord hath blessed my master greatly; and he is become great: and he hath given him flocks, and herds, and silver, and gold, and menservants, and maidservants, and camels, and asses.

verses.name: Genesis 24:36
verses.text: And Sarah my master’s wife bare a son to my master when she was old: and unto him hath he given all that he hath.

verses.name: Genesis 24:37
verses.text: And my master made me swear, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife to my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I dwell:

verses.name: Genesis 24:38
verses.text: But thou shalt go unto my father’s house, and to my kindred, and take a wife unto my son.

verses.name: Genesis 24:39
verses.text: And I said unto my master, Peradventure the woman will not follow me.

verses.name: Genesis 24:40
verses.text: And he said unto me, The Lord, before whom I walk, will send his angel with thee, and prosper thy way; and thou shalt take a wife for my son of my kindred, and of my father’s house:

verses.name: Genesis 24:41
verses.text: Then shalt thou be clear from <hi type="italic">this</hi> my oath, when thou comest to my kindred; and if they give not thee <hi type="italic">one</hi>, thou shalt be clear from my oath.

verses.name: Genesis 24:42
verses.text: And I came this day unto the well, and said, O Lord God of my master Abraham, if now thou do prosper my way which I go:

verses.name: Genesis 24:43
verses.text: Behold, I stand by the well of water; and it shall come to pass, that when the virgin cometh forth to draw <hi type="italic">water</hi>, and I say to her, Give me, I pray thee, a little water of thy pitcher to drink;

verses.name: Genesis 24:44
verses.text: And she say to me, Both drink thou, and I will also draw for thy camels: <hi type="italic">let</hi> the same <hi type="italic">be</hi> the woman whom the Lord hath appointed out for my master’s son.

verses.name: Genesis 24:45
verses.text: And before I had done speaking in mine heart, behold, Rebekah came forth with her pitcher on her shoulder; and she went down unto the well, and drew <hi type="italic">water:</hi> and I said unto her, Let me drink, I pray thee.

verses.name: Genesis 24:46
verses.text: And she made haste, and let down her pitcher from her <hi type="italic">shoulder</hi>, and said, Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also: so I drank, and she made the camels drink also.

verses.name: Genesis 24:47
verses.text: And I asked her, and said, Whose daughter <hi type="italic">art</hi> thou? And she said, The daughter of Bethuel, Nahor’s son, whom Milcah bare unto him: and I put the earring upon her face, and the bracelets upon her hands.

verses.name: Genesis 24:48
verses.text: And I bowed down my head, and worshipped the Lord, and blessed the Lord God of my master Abraham, which had led me in the right way to take my master’s brother’s daughter unto his son.

verses.name: Genesis 24:49
verses.text: And now if ye will deal kindly and truly with my master, tell me: and if not, tell me; that I may turn to the right hand, or to the left.

verses.name: Genesis 24:50
verses.text: Then Laban and Bethuel answered and said, The thing proceedeth from the Lord: we cannot speak unto thee bad or good.

verses.name: Genesis 24:51
verses.text: Behold, Rebekah <hi type="italic">is</hi> before thee, take <hi type="italic">her</hi>, and go, and let her be thy master’s son’s wife, as the Lord hath spoken.

verses.name: Genesis 24:52
verses.text: And it came to pass, that, when Abraham’s servant heard their words, he worshipped the Lord, <hi type="italic">bowing himself</hi> to the earth.

verses.name: Genesis 24:53
verses.text: And the servant brought forth jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment, and gave <hi type="italic">them</hi> to Rebekah: he gave also to her brother and to her mother precious things.

verses.name: Genesis 24:54
verses.text: And they did eat and drink, he and the men that <hi type="italic">were</hi> with him, and tarried all night; and they rose up in the morning, and he said, Send me away unto my master.

verses.name: Genesis 24:55
verses.text: And her brother and her mother said, Let the damsel abide with us <hi type="italic">a few</hi> days, at the least ten; after that she shall go.

verses.name: Genesis 24:56
verses.text: And he said unto them, Hinder me not, seeing the Lord hath prospered my way; send me away that I may go to my master.

verses.name: Genesis 24:57
verses.text: And they said, We will call the damsel, and inquire at her mouth.

verses.name: Genesis 24:58
verses.text: And they called Rebekah, and said unto her, Wilt thou go with this man? And she said, I will go.

verses.name: Genesis 24:59
verses.text: And they sent away Rebekah their sister, and her nurse, and Abraham’s servant, and his men.

verses.name: Genesis 24:60
verses.text: And they blessed Rebekah, and said unto her, Thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> our sister, be thou <hi type="italic">the mother</hi> of thousands of millions, and let thy seed possess the gate of those which hate them.

verses.name: Genesis 24:61
verses.text: ¶ And Rebekah arose, and her damsels, and they rode upon the camels, and followed the man: and the servant took Rebekah, and went his way.

verses.name: Genesis 24:62
verses.text: And Isaac came from the way of the well Lahai-roi; for he dwelt in the south country.

verses.name: Genesis 24:63
verses.text: And Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the eventide: and he lifted up his eyes, and saw, and, behold, the camels <hi type="italic">were</hi> coming.

verses.name: Genesis 24:64
verses.text: And Rebekah lifted up her eyes, and when she saw Isaac, she lighted off the camel.

verses.name: Genesis 24:65
verses.text: For she <hi type="italic">had</hi> said unto the servant, What man <hi type="italic">is</hi> this that walketh in the field to meet us? And the servant <hi type="italic">had</hi> said, It <hi type="italic">is</hi> my master: therefore she took a vail, and covered herself.

verses.name: Genesis 24:66
verses.text: And the servant told Isaac all things that he had done.

verses.name: Genesis 24:67
verses.text: And Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah’s tent, and took Rebekah, and she became his wife; and he loved her: and Isaac was comforted after his mother’s <hi type="italic">death</hi>.  <chapter eID="Gen.24"/><div eID="gen26" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 25:1
verses.text: THEN again Abraham took a wife, and her name <hi type="italic">was</hi> Keturah.

verses.name: Genesis 25:2
verses.text: And she bare him Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah.

verses.name: Genesis 25:3
verses.text: And Jokshan begat Sheba, and Dedan. And the sons of Dedan were Asshurim, and Letushim, and Leummim.

verses.name: Genesis 25:4
verses.text: And the sons of Midian; Ephah, and Epher, and Hanoch, and Abida, and Eldaah. All these <hi type="italic">were</hi> the children of Keturah.

verses.name: Genesis 25:5
verses.text: ¶ And Abraham gave all that he had unto Isaac.

verses.name: Genesis 25:6
verses.text: But unto the sons of the concubines, which Abraham had, Abraham gave gifts, and sent them away from Isaac his son, while he yet lived, eastward, unto the east country.

verses.name: Genesis 25:7
verses.text: And these <hi type="italic">are</hi> the days of the years of Abraham’s life which he lived, an hundred threescore and fifteen years.

verses.name: Genesis 25:8
verses.text: Then Abraham gave up the ghost, and died in a good old age, an old man, and full <hi type="italic">of years;</hi> and was gathered to his people.

verses.name: Genesis 25:9
verses.text: And his sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron the son of Zohar the Hittite, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> before Mamre;

verses.name: Genesis 25:10
verses.text: The field which Abraham purchased of the sons of Heth: there was Abraham buried, and Sarah his wife.

verses.name: Genesis 25:11
verses.text: ¶ And it came to pass after the death of Abraham, that God blessed his son Isaac; and Isaac dwelt by the well Lahai-roi.

verses.name: Genesis 25:12
verses.text: ¶ Now these <hi type="italic">are</hi> the generations of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah’s handmaid, bare unto Abraham:

verses.name: Genesis 25:13
verses.text: And these <hi type="italic">are</hi> the names of the sons of Ishmael, by their names, according to their generations: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebajoth; and Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,

verses.name: Genesis 25:14
verses.text: And Mishma, and Dumah, and Massa,

verses.name: Genesis 25:15
verses.text: Hadar, and Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah:

verses.name: Genesis 25:16
verses.text: These <hi type="italic">are</hi> the sons of Ishmael, and these <hi type="italic">are</hi> their names, by their towns, and by their castles; twelve princes according to their nations.

verses.name: Genesis 25:17
verses.text: And these <hi type="italic">are</hi> the years of the life of Ishmael, an hundred and thirty and seven years: and he gave up the ghost and died; and was gathered unto his people.

verses.name: Genesis 25:18
verses.text: And they dwelt from Havilah unto Shur, that <hi type="italic">is</hi> before Egypt, as thou goest toward Assyria: <hi type="italic">and</hi> he died in the presence of all his brethren.

verses.name: Genesis 25:19
verses.text: ¶ And these <hi type="italic">are</hi> the generations of Isaac, Abraham’s son: Abraham begat Isaac:

verses.name: Genesis 25:20
verses.text: And Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah to wife, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Padan-aram, the sister to Laban the Syrian.

verses.name: Genesis 25:21
verses.text: And Isaac intreated the Lord for his wife, because she <hi type="italic">was</hi> barren: and the Lord was intreated of him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.

verses.name: Genesis 25:22
verses.text: And the children struggled together within her; and she said, If <hi type="italic">it be</hi> so, why <hi type="italic">am</hi> I thus? And she went to inquire of the Lord.

verses.name: Genesis 25:23
verses.text: And the Lord said unto her, Two nations <hi type="italic">are</hi> in thy womb, and two manner of people shall be separated from thy bowels; and <hi type="italic">the one</hi> people shall be stronger than <hi type="italic">the other</hi> people; and the elder shall serve the younger.

verses.name: Genesis 25:24
verses.text: ¶ And when her days to be delivered were fulfilled, behold, <hi type="italic">there were</hi> twins in her womb.

verses.name: Genesis 25:25
verses.text: And the first came out red, all over like an hairy garment; and they called his name Esau.

verses.name: Genesis 25:26
verses.text: And after that came his brother out, and his hand took hold on Esau’s heel; and his name was called Jacob: and Isaac <hi type="italic">was</hi> threescore years old when she bare them.

verses.name: Genesis 25:27
verses.text: And the boys grew: and Esau was a cunning hunter, a man of the field; and Jacob <hi type="italic">was</hi> a plain man, dwelling in tents.

verses.name: Genesis 25:28
verses.text: And Isaac loved Esau, because he did eat of <hi type="italic">his</hi> venison: but Rebekah loved Jacob.

verses.name: Genesis 25:29
verses.text: ¶ And Jacob sod pottage: and Esau came from the field, and he <hi type="italic">was</hi> faint:

verses.name: Genesis 25:30
verses.text: And Esau said to Jacob, Feed me, I pray thee, with that same red <hi type="italic">pottage;</hi> for I <hi type="italic">am</hi> faint: therefore was his name called Edom.

verses.name: Genesis 25:31
verses.text: And Jacob said, Sell me this day thy birthright.

verses.name: Genesis 25:32
verses.text: And Esau said, Behold, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> at the point to die: and what profit shall this birthright do to me?

verses.name: Genesis 25:33
verses.text: And Jacob said, Swear to me this day; and he sware unto him: and he sold his birthright unto Jacob.

verses.name: Genesis 25:34
verses.text: Then Jacob gave Esau bread and pottage of lentiles; and he did eat and drink, and rose up, and went his way: thus Esau despised <hi type="italic">his</hi> birthright.  <chapter eID="Gen.25"/><div eID="gen27" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 26:1
verses.text: AND there was a famine in the land, beside the first famine that was in the days of Abraham. And Isaac went unto Abimelech king of the Philistines unto Gerar.

verses.name: Genesis 26:2
verses.text: And the Lord appeared unto him, and said, Go not down into Egypt; dwell in the land which I shall tell thee of:

verses.name: Genesis 26:3
verses.text: Sojourn in this land, and I will be with thee, and will bless thee; for unto thee, and unto thy seed, I will give all these countries, and I will perform the oath which I sware unto Abraham thy father;

verses.name: Genesis 26:4
verses.text: And I will make thy seed to multiply as the stars of heaven, and will give unto thy seed all these countries; and in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed;

verses.name: Genesis 26:5
verses.text: Because that Abraham obeyed my voice, and kept my charge, my commandments, my statutes, and my laws.

verses.name: Genesis 26:6
verses.text: ¶ And Isaac dwelt in Gerar:

verses.name: Genesis 26:7
verses.text: And the men of the place asked <hi type="italic">him</hi> of his wife; and he said, She <hi type="italic">is</hi> my sister: for he feared to say, <hi type="italic">She is</hi> my wife; lest, <hi type="italic">said he</hi>, the men of the place should kill me for Rebekah; because she <hi type="italic">was</hi> fair to look upon.

verses.name: Genesis 26:8
verses.text: And it came to pass, when he had been there a long time, that Abimelech king of the Philistines looked out at a window, and saw, and, behold, Isaac <hi type="italic">was</hi> sporting with Rebekah his wife.

verses.name: Genesis 26:9
verses.text: And Abimelech called Isaac, and said, Behold, of a surety she <hi type="italic">is</hi> thy wife: and how saidst thou, She <hi type="italic">is</hi> my sister? And Isaac said unto him, Because I said, Lest I die for her.

verses.name: Genesis 26:10
verses.text: And Abimelech said, What <hi type="italic">is</hi> this thou hast done unto us? one of the people might lightly have lien with thy wife, and thou shouldest have brought guiltiness upon us.

verses.name: Genesis 26:11
verses.text: And Abimelech charged all <hi type="italic">his</hi> people, saying, He that toucheth this man or his wife shall surely be put to death.

verses.name: Genesis 26:12
verses.text: Then Isaac sowed in that land, and received in the same year an hundredfold: and the Lord blessed him.

verses.name: Genesis 26:13
verses.text: And the man waxed great, and went forward, and grew until he became very great:

verses.name: Genesis 26:14
verses.text: For he had possession of flocks, and possession of herds, and great store of servants: and the Philistines envied him.

verses.name: Genesis 26:15
verses.text: For all the wells which his father’s servants had digged in the days of Abraham his father, the Philistines had stopped them, and filled them with earth.

verses.name: Genesis 26:16
verses.text: And Abimelech said unto Isaac, Go from us; for thou art much mightier than we.

verses.name: Genesis 26:17
verses.text: ¶ And Isaac departed thence, and pitched his tent in the valley of Gerar, and dwelt there.

verses.name: Genesis 26:18
verses.text: And Isaac digged again the wells of water, which they had digged in the days of Abraham his father; for the Philistines had stopped them after the death of Abraham: and he called their names after the names by which his father had called them.

verses.name: Genesis 26:19
verses.text: And Isaac’s servants digged in the valley, and found there a well of springing water.

verses.name: Genesis 26:20
verses.text: And the herdmen of Gerar did strive with Isaac’s herdmen, saying, The water <hi type="italic">is</hi> ours: and he called the name of the well Esek; because they strove with him.

verses.name: Genesis 26:21
verses.text: And they digged another well, and strove for that also: and he called the name of it Sitnah.

verses.name: Genesis 26:22
verses.text: And he removed from thence, and digged another well; and for that they strove not: and he called the name of it Rehoboth; and he said, For now the Lord hath made room for us, and we shall be fruitful in the land.

verses.name: Genesis 26:23
verses.text: And he went up from thence to Beer-sheba.

verses.name: Genesis 26:24
verses.text: And the Lord appeared unto him the same night, and said, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the God of Abraham thy father: fear not, for I <hi type="italic">am</hi> with thee, and will bless thee, and multiply thy seed for my servant Abraham’s sake.

verses.name: Genesis 26:25
verses.text: And he builded an altar there, and called upon the name of the Lord, and pitched his tent there: and there Isaac’s servants digged a well.

verses.name: Genesis 26:26
verses.text: ¶ Then Abimelech went to him from Gerar, and Ahuzzath one of his friends, and Phichol the chief captain of his army.

verses.name: Genesis 26:27
verses.text: And Isaac said unto them, Wherefore come ye to me, seeing ye hate me, and have sent me away from you?

verses.name: Genesis 26:28
verses.text: And they said, We saw certainly that the Lord was with thee: and we said, Let there be now an oath betwixt us, <hi type="italic">even</hi> betwixt us and thee, and let us make a covenant with thee;

verses.name: Genesis 26:29
verses.text: That thou wilt do us no hurt, as we have not touched thee, and as we have done unto thee nothing but good, and have sent thee away in peace: thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> now the blessed of the Lord.

verses.name: Genesis 26:30
verses.text: And he made them a feast, and they did eat and drink.

verses.name: Genesis 26:31
verses.text: And they rose up betimes in the morning, and sware one to another: and Isaac sent them away, and they departed from him in peace.

verses.name: Genesis 26:32
verses.text: And it came to pass the same day, that Isaac’s servants came, and told him concerning the well which they had digged, and said unto him, We have found water.

verses.name: Genesis 26:33
verses.text: And he called it Shebah: therefore the name of the city <hi type="italic">is</hi> Beer-sheba unto this day.

verses.name: Genesis 26:34
verses.text: ¶ And Esau was forty years old when he took to wife Judith the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Bashemath the daughter of Elon the Hittite:

verses.name: Genesis 26:35
verses.text: Which were a grief of mind unto Isaac and to Rebekah.  <chapter eID="Gen.26"/><div eID="gen28" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 27:1
verses.text: AND it came to pass, that when Isaac was old, and his eyes were dim, so that he could not see, he called Esau his eldest son, and said unto him, My son: and he said unto him, Behold, <hi type="italic">here am</hi> I.

verses.name: Genesis 27:2
verses.text: And he said, Behold now, I am old, I know not the day of my death:

verses.name: Genesis 27:3
verses.text: Now therefore take, I pray thee, thy weapons, thy quiver and thy bow, and go out to the field, and take me <hi type="italic">some</hi> venison;

verses.name: Genesis 27:4
verses.text: And make me savoury meat, such as I love, and bring <hi type="italic">it</hi> to me, that I may eat; that my soul may bless thee before I die.

verses.name: Genesis 27:5
verses.text: And Rebekah heard when Isaac spake to Esau his son. And Esau went to the field to hunt <hi type="italic">for</hi> venison, <hi type="italic">and</hi> to bring <hi type="italic">it</hi>.

verses.name: Genesis 27:6
verses.text: ¶ And Rebekah spake unto Jacob her son, saying, Behold, I heard thy father speak unto Esau thy brother, saying,

verses.name: Genesis 27:7
verses.text: Bring me venison, and make me savoury meat, that I may eat, and bless thee before the Lord before my death.

verses.name: Genesis 27:8
verses.text: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice according to that which I command thee.

verses.name: Genesis 27:9
verses.text: Go now to the flock, and fetch me from thence two good kids of the goats; and I will make them savoury meat for thy father, such as he loveth:

verses.name: Genesis 27:10
verses.text: And thou shalt bring <hi type="italic">it</hi> to thy father, that he may eat, and that he may bless thee before his death.

verses.name: Genesis 27:11
verses.text: And Jacob said to Rebekah his mother, Behold, Esau my brother <hi type="italic">is</hi> a hairy man, and I <hi type="italic">am</hi> a smooth man:

verses.name: Genesis 27:12
verses.text: My father peradventure will feel me, and I shall seem to him as a deceiver; and I shall bring a curse upon me, and not a blessing.

verses.name: Genesis 27:13
verses.text: And his mother said unto him, Upon me <hi type="italic">be</hi> thy curse, my son: only obey my voice, and go fetch me <hi type="italic">them</hi>.

verses.name: Genesis 27:14
verses.text: And he went, and fetched, and brought <hi type="italic">them</hi> to his mother: and his mother made savoury meat, such as his father loved.

verses.name: Genesis 27:15
verses.text: And Rebekah took goodly raiment of her eldest son Esau, which <hi type="italic">were</hi> with her in the house, and put them upon Jacob her younger son:

verses.name: Genesis 27:16
verses.text: And she put the skins of the kids of the goats upon his hands, and upon the smooth of his neck:

verses.name: Genesis 27:17
verses.text: And she gave the savoury meat and the bread, which she had prepared, into the hand of her son Jacob.

verses.name: Genesis 27:18
verses.text: ¶ And he came unto his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here <hi type="italic">am</hi> I; who <hi type="italic">art</hi> thou, my son?

verses.name: Genesis 27:19
verses.text: And Jacob said unto his father, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> Esau thy firstborn; I have done according as thou badest me: arise, I pray thee, sit and eat of my venison, that thy soul may bless me.

verses.name: Genesis 27:20
verses.text: And Isaac said unto his son, How <hi type="italic">is it</hi> that thou hast found <hi type="italic">it</hi> so quickly, my son? And he said, Because the Lord thy God brought <hi type="italic">it</hi> to me.

verses.name: Genesis 27:21
verses.text: And Isaac said unto Jacob, Come near, I pray thee, that I may feel thee, my son, whether thou <hi type="italic">be</hi> my very son Esau or not.

verses.name: Genesis 27:22
verses.text: And Jacob went near unto Isaac his father; and he felt him, and said, The voice <hi type="italic">is</hi> Jacob’s voice, but the hands <hi type="italic">are</hi> the hands of Esau.

verses.name: Genesis 27:23
verses.text: And he discerned him not, because his hands were hairy, as his brother Esau’s hands: so he blessed him.

verses.name: Genesis 27:24
verses.text: And he said, <hi type="italic">Art</hi> thou my very son Esau? And he said, I <hi type="italic">am</hi>.

verses.name: Genesis 27:25
verses.text: And he said, Bring <hi type="italic">it</hi> near to me, and I will eat of my son’s venison, that my soul may bless thee. And he brought <hi type="italic">it</hi> near to him, and he did eat: and he brought him wine, and he drank.

verses.name: Genesis 27:26
verses.text: And his father Isaac said unto him, Come near now, and kiss me, my son.

verses.name: Genesis 27:27
verses.text: And he came near, and kissed him: and he smelled the smell of his raiment, and blessed him, and said, See, the smell of my son <hi type="italic">is</hi> as the smell of a field which the Lord hath blessed:

verses.name: Genesis 27:28
verses.text: Therefore God give thee of the dew of heaven, and the fatness of the earth, and plenty of corn and wine:

verses.name: Genesis 27:29
verses.text: Let people serve thee, and nations bow down to thee: be lord over thy brethren, and let thy mother’s sons bow down to thee: cursed <hi type="italic">be</hi> every one that curseth thee, and blessed <hi type="italic">be</hi> he that blesseth thee.

verses.name: Genesis 27:30
verses.text: ¶ And it came to pass, as soon as Isaac had made an end of blessing Jacob, and Jacob was yet scarce gone out from the presence of Isaac his father, that Esau his brother came in from his hunting.

verses.name: Genesis 27:31
verses.text: And he also had made savoury meat, and brought it unto his father, and said unto his father, Let my father arise, and eat of his son’s venison, that thy soul may bless me.

verses.name: Genesis 27:32
verses.text: And Isaac his father said unto him, Who <hi type="italic">art</hi> thou? And he said, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> thy son, thy firstborn Esau.

verses.name: Genesis 27:33
verses.text: And Isaac trembled very exceedingly, and said, Who? where <hi type="italic">is</hi> he that hath taken venison, and brought <hi type="italic">it</hi> me, and I have eaten of all before thou camest, and have blessed him? yea, <hi type="italic">and</hi> he shall be blessed.

verses.name: Genesis 27:34
verses.text: And when Esau heard the words of his father, he cried with a great and exceeding bitter cry, and said unto his father, Bless me, <hi type="italic">even</hi> me also, O my father.

verses.name: Genesis 27:35
verses.text: And he said, Thy brother came with subtilty, and hath taken away thy blessing.

verses.name: Genesis 27:36
verses.text: And he said, Is not he rightly named Jacob? for he hath supplanted me these two times: he took away my birthright; and, behold, now he hath taken away my blessing. And he said, Hast thou not reserved a blessing for me?

verses.name: Genesis 27:37
verses.text: And Isaac answered and said unto Esau, Behold, I have made him thy lord, and all his brethren have I given to him for servants; and with corn and wine have I sustained him: and what shall I do now unto thee, my son?

verses.name: Genesis 27:38
verses.text: And Esau said unto his father, Hast thou but one blessing, my father? bless me, <hi type="italic">even</hi> me also, O my father. And Esau lifted up his voice, and wept.

verses.name: Genesis 27:39
verses.text: And Isaac his father answered and said unto him, Behold, thy dwelling shall be the fatness of the earth, and of the dew of heaven from above;

verses.name: Genesis 27:40
verses.text: And by thy sword shalt thou live, and shalt serve thy brother; and it shall come to pass when thou shalt have the dominion, that thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck.

verses.name: Genesis 27:41
verses.text: ¶ And Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing wherewith his father blessed him: and Esau said in his heart, The days of mourning for my father are at hand; then will I slay my brother Jacob.

verses.name: Genesis 27:42
verses.text: And these words of Esau her elder son were told to Rebekah: and she sent and called Jacob her younger son, and said unto him, Behold, thy brother Esau, as touching thee, doth comfort himself, <hi type="italic">purposing</hi> to kill thee.

verses.name: Genesis 27:43
verses.text: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice; and arise, flee thou to Laban my brother to Haran;

verses.name: Genesis 27:44
verses.text: And tarry with him a few days, until thy brother’s fury turn away;

verses.name: Genesis 27:45
verses.text: Until thy brother’s anger turn away from thee, and he forget <hi type="italic">that</hi> which thou hast done to him: then I will send, and fetch thee from thence: why should I be deprived also of you both in one day?

verses.name: Genesis 27:46
verses.text: And Rebekah said to Isaac, I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth: if Jacob take a wife of the daughters of Heth, such as these <hi type="italic">which are</hi> of the daughters of the land, what good shall my life do me?  <chapter eID="Gen.27"/><div eID="gen29" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 28:1
verses.text: AND Isaac called Jacob, and blessed him, and charged him, and said unto him, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan.

verses.name: Genesis 28:2
verses.text: Arise, go to Padan-aram, to the house of Bethuel thy mother’s father; and take thee a wife from thence of the daughters of Laban thy mother’s brother.

verses.name: Genesis 28:3
verses.text: And God Almighty bless thee, and make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, that thou mayest be a multitude of people;

verses.name: Genesis 28:4
verses.text: And give thee the blessing of Abraham, to thee, and to thy seed with thee; that thou mayest inherit the land wherein thou art a stranger, which God gave unto Abraham.

verses.name: Genesis 28:5
verses.text: And Isaac sent away Jacob: and he went to Padan-aram unto Laban, son of Bethuel the Syrian, the brother of Rebekah, Jacob’s and Esau’s mother.

verses.name: Genesis 28:6
verses.text: ¶ When Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob, and sent him away to Padan-aram, to take him a wife from thence; and that as he blessed him he gave him a charge, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan;

verses.name: Genesis 28:7
verses.text: And that Jacob obeyed his father and his mother, and was gone to Padan-aram;

verses.name: Genesis 28:8
verses.text: And Esau seeing that the daughters of Canaan pleased not Isaac his father;

verses.name: Genesis 28:9
verses.text: Then went Esau unto Ishmael, and took unto the wives which he had Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael Abraham’s son, the sister of Nebajoth, to be his wife.

verses.name: Genesis 28:10
verses.text: ¶ And Jacob went out from Beer-sheba, and went toward Haran.

verses.name: Genesis 28:11
verses.text: And he lighted upon a certain place, and tarried there all night, because the sun was set; and he took of the stones of that place, and put <hi type="italic">them for</hi> his pillows, and lay down in that place to sleep.

verses.name: Genesis 28:12
verses.text: And he dreamed, and behold a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven: and behold the angels of God ascending and descending on it.

verses.name: Genesis 28:13
verses.text: And, behold, the Lord stood above it, and said, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord God of Abraham thy father, and the God of Isaac: the land whereon thou liest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed;

verses.name: Genesis 28:14
verses.text: And thy seed shall be as the dust of the earth, and thou shalt spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south: and in thee and in thy seed shall all the families of the earth be blessed.

verses.name: Genesis 28:15
verses.text: And, behold, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> with thee, and will keep thee in all <hi type="italic">places</hi> whither thou goest, and will bring thee again into this land; for I will not leave thee, until I have done <hi type="italic">that</hi> which I have spoken to thee of.

verses.name: Genesis 28:16
verses.text: ¶ And Jacob awaked out of his sleep, and he said, Surely the Lord is in this place; and I knew <hi type="italic">it</hi> not.

verses.name: Genesis 28:17
verses.text: And he was afraid, and said, How dreadful <hi type="italic">is</hi> this place! this <hi type="italic">is</hi> none other but the house of God, and this <hi type="italic">is</hi> the gate of heaven.

verses.name: Genesis 28:18
verses.text: And Jacob rose up early in the morning, and took the stone that he had put <hi type="italic">for</hi> his pillows, and set it up <hi type="italic">for</hi> a pillar, and poured oil upon the top of it.

verses.name: Genesis 28:19
verses.text: And he called the name of that place Beth-el: but the name of that city <hi type="italic">was called</hi> Luz at the first.

verses.name: Genesis 28:20
verses.text: And Jacob vowed a vow, saying, If God will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go, and will give me bread to eat, and raiment to put on,

verses.name: Genesis 28:21
verses.text: So that I come again to my father’s house in peace; then shall the Lord be my God:

verses.name: Genesis 28:22
verses.text: And this stone, which I have set <hi type="italic">for</hi> a pillar, shall be God’s house: and of all that thou shalt give me I will surely give the tenth unto thee.  <chapter eID="Gen.28"/><div eID="gen30" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 29:1
verses.text: THEN Jacob went on his journey, and came into the land of the people of the east.

verses.name: Genesis 29:2
verses.text: And he looked, and behold a well in the field, and, lo, there <hi type="italic">were</hi> three flocks of sheep lying by it; for out of that well they watered the flocks: and a great stone <hi type="italic">was</hi> upon the well’s mouth.

verses.name: Genesis 29:3
verses.text: And thither were all the flocks gathered: and they rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the sheep, and put the stone again upon the well’s mouth in his place.

verses.name: Genesis 29:4
verses.text: And Jacob said unto them, My brethren, whence <hi type="italic">be</hi> ye? And they said, Of Haran <hi type="italic">are</hi> we.

verses.name: Genesis 29:5
verses.text: And he said unto them, Know ye Laban the son of Nahor? And they said, We know <hi type="italic">him</hi>.

verses.name: Genesis 29:6
verses.text: And he said unto them, <hi type="italic">Is</hi> he well? And they said, <hi type="italic">He is</hi> well: and, behold, Rachel his daughter cometh with the sheep.

verses.name: Genesis 29:7
verses.text: And he said, Lo, <hi type="italic">it is</hi> yet high day, neither <hi type="italic">is it</hi> time that the cattle should be gathered together: water ye the sheep, and go <hi type="italic">and</hi> feed <hi type="italic">them</hi>.

verses.name: Genesis 29:8
verses.text: And they said, We cannot, until all the flocks be gathered together, and <hi type="italic">till</hi> they roll the stone from the well’s mouth; then we water the sheep.

verses.name: Genesis 29:9
verses.text: ¶ And while he yet spake with them, Rachel came with her father’s sheep: for she kept them.

verses.name: Genesis 29:10
verses.text: And it came to pass, when Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban his mother’s brother, and the sheep of Laban his mother’s brother, that Jacob went near, and rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the flock of Laban his mother’s brother.

verses.name: Genesis 29:11
verses.text: And Jacob kissed Rachel, and lifted up his voice, and wept.

verses.name: Genesis 29:12
verses.text: And Jacob told Rachel that he <hi type="italic">was</hi> her father’s brother, and that he <hi type="italic">was</hi> Rebekah’s son: and she ran and told her father.

verses.name: Genesis 29:13
verses.text: And it came to pass, when Laban heard the tidings of Jacob his sister’s son, that he ran to meet him, and embraced him, and kissed him, and brought him to his house. And he told Laban all these things.

verses.name: Genesis 29:14
verses.text: And Laban said to him, Surely thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> my bone and my flesh. And he abode with him the space of a month.

verses.name: Genesis 29:15
verses.text: ¶ And Laban said unto Jacob, Because thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> my brother, shouldest thou therefore serve me for nought? tell me, what <hi type="italic">shall</hi> thy wages <hi type="italic">be?</hi>

verses.name: Genesis 29:16
verses.text: And Laban had two daughters: the name of the elder <hi type="italic">was</hi> Leah, and the name of the younger <hi type="italic">was</hi> Rachel.

verses.name: Genesis 29:17
verses.text: Leah <hi type="italic">was</hi> tender eyed; but Rachel was beautiful and well favoured.

verses.name: Genesis 29:18
verses.text: And Jacob loved Rachel; and said, I will serve thee seven years for Rachel thy younger daughter.

verses.name: Genesis 29:19
verses.text: And Laban said, <hi type="italic">It is</hi> better that I give her to thee, than that I should give her to another man: abide with me.

verses.name: Genesis 29:20
verses.text: And Jacob served seven years for Rachel; and they seemed unto him <hi type="italic">but</hi> a few days, for the love he had to her.

verses.name: Genesis 29:21
verses.text: ¶ And Jacob said unto Laban, Give <hi type="italic">me</hi> my wife, for my days are fulfilled, that I may go in unto her.

verses.name: Genesis 29:22
verses.text: And Laban gathered together all the men of the place, and made a feast.

verses.name: Genesis 29:23
verses.text: And it came to pass in the evening, that he took Leah his daughter, and brought her to him; and he went in unto her.

verses.name: Genesis 29:24
verses.text: And Laban gave unto his daughter Leah Zilpah his maid <hi type="italic">for</hi> an handmaid.

verses.name: Genesis 29:25
verses.text: And it came to pass, that in the morning, behold, it <hi type="italic">was</hi> Leah: and he said to Laban, What <hi type="italic">is</hi> this thou hast done unto me? did not I serve with thee for Rachel? wherefore then hast thou beguiled me?

verses.name: Genesis 29:26
verses.text: And Laban said, It must not be so done in our country, to give the younger before the firstborn.

verses.name: Genesis 29:27
verses.text: Fulfil her week, and we will give thee this also for the service which thou shalt serve with me yet seven other years.

verses.name: Genesis 29:28
verses.text: And Jacob did so, and fulfilled her week: and he gave him Rachel his daughter to wife also.

verses.name: Genesis 29:29
verses.text: And Laban gave to Rachel his daughter Bilhah his handmaid to be her maid.

verses.name: Genesis 29:30
verses.text: And he went in also unto Rachel, and he loved also Rachel more than Leah, and served with him yet seven other years.

verses.name: Genesis 29:31
verses.text: ¶ And when the Lord saw that Leah <hi type="italic">was</hi> hated, he opened her womb: but Rachel <hi type="italic">was</hi> barren.

verses.name: Genesis 29:32
verses.text: And Leah conceived, and bare a son, and she called his name Reuben: for she said, Surely the Lord hath looked upon my affliction; now therefore my husband will love me.

verses.name: Genesis 29:33
verses.text: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and said, Because the Lord hath heard that I <hi type="italic">was</hi> hated, he hath therefore given me this <hi type="italic">son</hi> also: and she called his name Simeon.

verses.name: Genesis 29:34
verses.text: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and said, Now this time will my husband be joined unto me, because I have born him three sons: therefore was his name called Levi.

verses.name: Genesis 29:35
verses.text: And she conceived again, and bare a son: and she said, Now will I praise the Lord: therefore she called his name Judah; and left bearing.  <chapter eID="Gen.29"/><div eID="gen31" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 30:1
verses.text: AND when Rachel saw that she bare Jacob no children, Rachel envied her sister; and said unto Jacob, Give me children, or else I die.

verses.name: Genesis 30:2
verses.text: And Jacob’s anger was kindled against Rachel: and he said, <hi type="italic">Am</hi> I in God’s stead, who hath withheld from thee the fruit of the womb?

verses.name: Genesis 30:3
verses.text: And she said, Behold my maid Bilhah, go in unto her; and she shall bear upon my knees, that I may also have children by her.

verses.name: Genesis 30:4
verses.text: And she gave him Bilhah her handmaid to wife: and Jacob went in unto her.

verses.name: Genesis 30:5
verses.text: And Bilhah conceived, and bare Jacob a son.

verses.name: Genesis 30:6
verses.text: And Rachel said, God hath judged me, and hath also heard my voice, and hath given me a son: therefore called she his name Dan.

verses.name: Genesis 30:7
verses.text: And Bilhah Rachel’s maid conceived again, and bare Jacob a second son.

verses.name: Genesis 30:8
verses.text: And Rachel said, With great wrestlings have I wrestled with my sister, and I have prevailed: and she called his name Naphtali.

verses.name: Genesis 30:9
verses.text: When Leah saw that she had left bearing, she took Zilpah her maid, and gave her Jacob to wife.

verses.name: Genesis 30:10
verses.text: And Zilpah Leah’s maid bare Jacob a son.

verses.name: Genesis 30:11
verses.text: And Leah said, A troop cometh: and she called his name Gad.

verses.name: Genesis 30:12
verses.text: And Zilpah Leah’s maid bare Jacob a second son.

verses.name: Genesis 30:13
verses.text: And Leah said, Happy am I, for the daughters will call me blessed: and she called his name Asher.

verses.name: Genesis 30:14
verses.text: ¶ And Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest, and found mandrakes in the field, and brought them unto his mother Leah. Then Rachel said to Leah, Give me, I pray thee, of thy son’s mandrakes.

verses.name: Genesis 30:15
verses.text: And she said unto her, <hi type="italic">Is it</hi> a small matter that thou hast taken my husband? and wouldest thou take away my son’s mandrakes also? And Rachel said, Therefore he shall lie with thee to night for thy son’s mandrakes.

verses.name: Genesis 30:16
verses.text: And Jacob came out of the field in the evening, and Leah went out to meet him, and said, Thou must come in unto me; for surely I have hired thee with my son’s mandrakes. And he lay with her that night.

verses.name: Genesis 30:17
verses.text: And God hearkened unto Leah, and she conceived, and bare Jacob the fifth son.

verses.name: Genesis 30:18
verses.text: And Leah said, God hath given me my hire, because I have given my maiden to my husband: and she called his name Issachar.

verses.name: Genesis 30:19
verses.text: And Leah conceived again, and bare Jacob the sixth son.

verses.name: Genesis 30:20
verses.text: And Leah said, God hath endued me <hi type="italic">with</hi> a good dowry; now will my husband dwell with me, because I have born him six sons: and she called his name Zebulun.

verses.name: Genesis 30:21
verses.text: And afterwards she bare a daughter, and called her name Dinah.

verses.name: Genesis 30:22
verses.text: ¶ And God remembered Rachel, and God hearkened to her, and opened her womb.

verses.name: Genesis 30:23
verses.text: And she conceived, and bare a son; and said, God hath taken away my reproach:

verses.name: Genesis 30:24
verses.text: And she called his name Joseph; and said, The Lord shall add to me another son.

verses.name: Genesis 30:25
verses.text: ¶ And it came to pass, when Rachel had born Joseph, that Jacob said unto Laban, Send me away, that I may go unto mine own place, and to my country.

verses.name: Genesis 30:26
verses.text: Give <hi type="italic">me</hi> my wives and my children, for whom I have served thee, and let me go: for thou knowest my service which I have done thee.

verses.name: Genesis 30:27
verses.text: And Laban said unto him, I pray thee, if I have found favour in thine eyes, <hi type="italic">tarry: for</hi> I have learned by experience that the Lord hath blessed me for thy sake.

verses.name: Genesis 30:28
verses.text: And he said, Appoint me thy wages, and I will give <hi type="italic">it</hi>.

verses.name: Genesis 30:29
verses.text: And he said unto him, Thou knowest how I have served thee, and how thy cattle was with me.

verses.name: Genesis 30:30
verses.text: For <hi type="italic">it was</hi> little which thou hadst before I <hi type="italic">came</hi>, and it is <hi type="italic">now</hi> increased unto a multitude; and the Lord hath blessed thee since my coming: and now when shall I provide for mine own house also?

verses.name: Genesis 30:31
verses.text: And he said, What shall I give thee? And Jacob said, Thou shalt not give me any thing: if thou wilt do this thing for me, I will again feed <hi type="italic">and</hi> keep thy flock:

verses.name: Genesis 30:32
verses.text: I will pass through all thy flock to day, removing from thence all the speckled and spotted cattle, and all the brown cattle among the sheep, and the spotted and speckled among the goats: and <hi type="italic">of such</hi> shall be my hire.

verses.name: Genesis 30:33
verses.text: So shall my righteousness answer for me in time to come, when it shall come for my hire before thy face: every one that <hi type="italic">is</hi> not speckled and spotted among the goats, and brown among the sheep, that shall be counted stolen with me.

verses.name: Genesis 30:34
verses.text: And Laban said, Behold, I would it might be according to thy word.

verses.name: Genesis 30:35
verses.text: And he removed that day the he goats that were ringstraked and spotted, and all the she goats that were speckled and spotted, <hi type="italic">and</hi> every one that had <hi type="italic">some</hi> white in it, and all the brown among the sheep, and gave <hi type="italic">them</hi> into the hand of his sons.

verses.name: Genesis 30:36
verses.text: And he set three days’ journey betwixt himself and Jacob: and Jacob fed the rest of Laban’s flocks.

verses.name: Genesis 30:37
verses.text: ¶ And Jacob took him rods of green poplar, and of the hazel and chesnut tree; and pilled white strakes in them, and made the white appear which <hi type="italic">was</hi> in the rods.

verses.name: Genesis 30:38
verses.text: And he set the rods which he had pilled before the flocks in the gutters in the watering troughs when the flocks came to drink, that they should conceive when they came to drink.

verses.name: Genesis 30:39
verses.text: And the flocks conceived before the rods, and brought forth cattle ringstraked, speckled, and spotted.

verses.name: Genesis 30:40
verses.text: And Jacob did separate the lambs, and set the faces of the flocks toward the ringstraked, and all the brown in the flock of Laban; and he put his own flocks by themselves, and put them not unto Laban’s cattle.

verses.name: Genesis 30:41
verses.text: And it came to pass, whensoever the stronger cattle did conceive, that Jacob laid the rods before the eyes of the cattle in the gutters, that they might conceive among the rods.

verses.name: Genesis 30:42
verses.text: But when the cattle were feeble, he put <hi type="italic">them</hi> not in: so the feebler were Laban’s, and the stronger Jacob’s.

verses.name: Genesis 30:43
verses.text: And the man increased exceedingly, and had much cattle, and maidservants, and menservants, and camels, and asses.  <chapter eID="Gen.30"/><div eID="gen32" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 31:1
verses.text: AND he heard the words of Laban’s sons, saying, Jacob hath taken away all that <hi type="italic">was</hi> our father’s; and of <hi type="italic">that</hi> which <hi type="italic">was</hi> our father’s hath he gotten all this glory.

verses.name: Genesis 31:2
verses.text: And Jacob beheld the countenance of Laban, and, behold, it <hi type="italic">was</hi> not toward him as before.

verses.name: Genesis 31:3
verses.text: And the Lord said unto Jacob, Return unto the land of thy fathers, and to thy kindred; and I will be with thee.

verses.name: Genesis 31:4
