verses.text: And they said, The man asked us straitly of our state, and of our kindred, saying, <hi type="italic">Is</hi> your father yet alive? have ye <hi type="italic">another</hi> brother? and we told him according to the tenor of these words: could we certainly know that he would say, Bring your brother down?

verses.name: Genesis 43:8
verses.text: And Judah said unto Israel his father, Send the lad with me, and we will arise and go; that we may live, and not die, both we, and thou, <hi type="italic">and</hi> also our little ones.

verses.name: Genesis 43:9
verses.text: I will be surety for him; of my hand shalt thou require him: if I bring him not unto thee, and set him before thee, then let me bear the blame for ever:

verses.name: Genesis 43:10
verses.text: For except we had lingered, surely now we had returned this second time.

verses.name: Genesis 43:11
verses.text: And their father Israel said unto them, If <hi type="italic">it must be</hi> so now, do this; take of the best fruits in the land in your vessels, and carry down the man a present, a little balm, and a little honey, spices, and myrrh, nuts, and almonds:

verses.name: Genesis 43:12
verses.text: And take double money in your hand; and the money that was brought again in the mouth of your sacks, carry <hi type="italic">it</hi> again in your hand; peradventure it <hi type="italic">was</hi> an oversight:

verses.name: Genesis 43:13
verses.text: Take also your brother, and arise, go again unto the man:

verses.name: Genesis 43:14
verses.text: And God Almighty give you mercy before the man, that he may send away your other brother, and Benjamin. If I be bereaved <hi type="italic">of my children</hi>, I am bereaved.

verses.name: Genesis 43:15
verses.text: ¶ And the men took that present, and they took double money in their hand, and Benjamin; and rose up, and went down to Egypt, and stood before Joseph.

verses.name: Genesis 43:16
verses.text: And when Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to the ruler of his house, Bring <hi type="italic">these</hi> men home, and slay, and make ready; for <hi type="italic">these</hi> men shall dine with me at noon.

verses.name: Genesis 43:17
verses.text: And the man did as Joseph bade; and the man brought the men into Joseph’s house.

verses.name: Genesis 43:18
verses.text: And the men were afraid, because they were brought into Joseph’s house; and they said, Because of the money that was returned in our sacks at the first time are we brought in; that he may seek occasion against us, and fall upon us, and take us for bondmen, and our asses.

verses.name: Genesis 43:19
verses.text: And they came near to the steward of Joseph’s house, and they communed with him at the door of the house,

verses.name: Genesis 43:20
verses.text: And said, O sir, we came indeed down at the first time to buy food:

verses.name: Genesis 43:21
verses.text: And it came to pass, when we came to the inn, that we opened our sacks, and, behold, <hi type="italic">every</hi> man’s money <hi type="italic">was</hi> in the mouth of his sack, our money in full weight: and we have brought it again in our hand.

verses.name: Genesis 43:22
verses.text: And other money have we brought down in our hands to buy food: we cannot tell who put our money in our sacks.

verses.name: Genesis 43:23
verses.text: And he said, Peace <hi type="italic">be</hi> to you, fear not: your God, and the God of your father, hath given you treasure in your sacks: I had your money. And he brought Simeon out unto them.

verses.name: Genesis 43:24
verses.text: And the man brought the men into Joseph’s house, and gave <hi type="italic">them</hi> water, and they washed their feet; and he gave their asses provender.

verses.name: Genesis 43:25
verses.text: And they made ready the present against Joseph came at noon: for they heard that they should eat bread there.

verses.name: Genesis 43:26
verses.text: ¶ And when Joseph came home, they brought him the present which <hi type="italic">was</hi> in their hand into the house, and bowed themselves to him to the earth.

verses.name: Genesis 43:27
verses.text: And he asked them of <hi type="italic">their</hi> welfare, and said, <hi type="italic">Is</hi> your father well, the old man of whom ye spake? <hi type="italic">Is</hi> he yet alive?

verses.name: Genesis 43:28
verses.text: And they answered, Thy servant our father <hi type="italic">is</hi> in good health, he <hi type="italic">is</hi> yet alive. And they bowed down their heads, and made obeisance.

verses.name: Genesis 43:29
verses.text: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw his brother Benjamin, his mother’s son, and said, <hi type="italic">Is</hi> this your younger brother, of whom ye spake unto me? And he said, God be gracious unto thee, my son.

verses.name: Genesis 43:30
verses.text: And Joseph made haste; for his bowels did yearn upon his brother: and he sought <hi type="italic">where</hi> to weep; and he entered into <hi type="italic">his</hi> chamber, and wept there.

verses.name: Genesis 43:31
verses.text: And he washed his face, and went out, and refrained himself, and said, Set on bread.

verses.name: Genesis 43:32
verses.text: And they set on for him by himself, and for them by themselves, and for the Egyptians, which did eat with him, by themselves: because the Egyptians might not eat bread with the Hebrews; for that <hi type="italic">is</hi> an abomination unto the Egyptians.

verses.name: Genesis 43:33
verses.text: And they sat before him, the firstborn according to his birthright, and the youngest according to his youth: and the men marvelled one at another.

verses.name: Genesis 43:34
verses.text: And he took <hi type="italic">and sent</hi> messes unto them from before him: but Benjamin’s mess was five times so much as any of theirs. And they drank, and were merry with him.  <chapter eID="Gen.43"/><div eID="gen45" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 44:1
verses.text: AND he commanded the steward of his house, saying, Fill the men’s sacks <hi type="italic">with</hi> food, as much as they can carry, and put every man’s money in his sack’s mouth.

verses.name: Genesis 44:2
verses.text: And put my cup, the silver cup, in the sack’s mouth of the youngest, and his corn money. And he did according to the word that Joseph had spoken.

verses.name: Genesis 44:3
verses.text: As soon as the morning was light, the men were sent away, they and their asses.

verses.name: Genesis 44:4
verses.text: <hi type="italic">And</hi> when they were gone out of the city, <hi type="italic">and</hi> not <hi type="italic">yet</hi> far off, Joseph said unto his steward, Up, follow after the men; and when thou dost overtake them, say unto them, Wherefore have ye rewarded evil for good?

verses.name: Genesis 44:5
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Is</hi> not this <hi type="italic">it</hi> in which my lord drinketh, and whereby indeed he divineth? ye have done evil in so doing.

verses.name: Genesis 44:6
verses.text: ¶ And he overtook them, and he spake unto them these same words.

verses.name: Genesis 44:7
verses.text: And they said unto him, Wherefore saith my lord these words? God forbid that thy servants should do according to this thing:

verses.name: Genesis 44:8
verses.text: Behold, the money, which we found in our sacks’ mouths, we brought again unto thee out of the land of Canaan: how then should we steal out of thy lord’s house silver or gold?

verses.name: Genesis 44:9
verses.text: With whomsoever of thy servants it be found, both let him die, and we also will be my lord’s bondmen.

verses.name: Genesis 44:10
verses.text: And he said, Now also <hi type="italic">let</hi> it <hi type="italic">be</hi> according unto your words: he with whom it is found shall be my servant; and ye shall be blameless.

verses.name: Genesis 44:11
verses.text: Then they speedily took down every man his sack to the ground, and opened every man his sack.

verses.name: Genesis 44:12
verses.text: And he searched, <hi type="italic">and</hi> began at the eldest, and left at the youngest: and the cup was found in Benjamin’s sack.

verses.name: Genesis 44:13
verses.text: Then they rent their clothes, and laded every man his ass, and returned to the city.

verses.name: Genesis 44:14
verses.text: ¶ And Judah and his brethren came to Joseph’s house; for he <hi type="italic">was</hi> yet there: and they fell before him on the ground.

verses.name: Genesis 44:15
verses.text: And Joseph said unto them, What deed <hi type="italic">is</hi> this that ye have done? wot ye not that such a man as I can certainly divine?

verses.name: Genesis 44:16
verses.text: And Judah said, What shall we say unto my lord? what shall we speak? or how shall we clear ourselves? God hath found out the iniquity of thy servants: behold, we <hi type="italic">are</hi> my lord’s servants, both we, and <hi type="italic">he</hi> also with whom the cup is found.

verses.name: Genesis 44:17
verses.text: And he said, God forbid that I should do so: <hi type="italic">but</hi> the man in whose hand the cup is found, he shall be my servant; and as for you, get you up in peace unto your father.

verses.name: Genesis 44:18
verses.text: ¶ Then Judah came near unto him, and said, Oh my lord, let thy servant, I pray thee, speak a word in my lord’s ears, and let not thine anger burn against thy servant: for thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> even as Pharaoh.

verses.name: Genesis 44:19
verses.text: My lord asked his servants, saying, Have ye a father, or a brother?

verses.name: Genesis 44:20
verses.text: And we said unto my lord, We have a father, an old man, and a child of his old age, a little one; and his brother is dead, and he alone is left of his mother, and his father loveth him.

verses.name: Genesis 44:21
verses.text: And thou saidst unto thy servants, Bring him down unto me, that I may set mine eyes upon him.

verses.name: Genesis 44:22
verses.text: And we said unto my lord, The lad cannot leave his father: for <hi type="italic">if</hi> he should leave his father, <hi type="italic">his father</hi> would die.

verses.name: Genesis 44:23
verses.text: And thou saidst unto thy servants, Except your youngest brother come down with you, ye shall see my face no more.

verses.name: Genesis 44:24
verses.text: And it came to pass when we came up unto thy servant my father, we told him the words of my lord.

verses.name: Genesis 44:25
verses.text: And our father said, Go again, <hi type="italic">and</hi> buy us a little food.

verses.name: Genesis 44:26
verses.text: And we said, We cannot go down: if our youngest brother be with us, then will we go down: for we may not see the man’s face, except our youngest brother <hi type="italic">be</hi> with us.

verses.name: Genesis 44:27
verses.text: And thy servant my father said unto us, Ye know that my wife bare me two <hi type="italic">sons:</hi>

verses.name: Genesis 44:28
verses.text: And the one went out from me, and I said, Surely he is torn in pieces; and I saw him not since:

verses.name: Genesis 44:29
verses.text: And if ye take this also from me, and mischief befall him, ye shall bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.

verses.name: Genesis 44:30
verses.text: Now therefore when I come to thy servant my father, and the lad <hi type="italic">be</hi> not with us; seeing that his life is bound up in the lad’s life;

verses.name: Genesis 44:31
verses.text: It shall come to pass, when he seeth that the lad <hi type="italic">is</hi> not <hi type="italic">with us</hi>, that he will die: and thy servants shall bring down the gray hairs of thy servant our father with sorrow to the grave.

verses.name: Genesis 44:32
verses.text: For thy servant became surety for the lad unto my father, saying, If I bring him not unto thee, then I shall bear the blame to my father for ever.

verses.name: Genesis 44:33
verses.text: Now therefore, I pray thee, let thy servant abide instead of the lad a bondman to my lord; and let the lad go up with his brethren.

verses.name: Genesis 44:34
verses.text: For how shall I go up to my father, and the lad <hi type="italic">be</hi> not with me? lest peradventure I see the evil that shall come on my father.  <chapter eID="Gen.44"/><div eID="gen46" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 45:1
verses.text: THEN Joseph could not refrain himself before all them that stood by him; and he cried, Cause every man to go out from me. And there stood no man with him, while Joseph made himself known unto his brethren.

verses.name: Genesis 45:2
verses.text: And he wept aloud: and the Egyptians and the house of Pharaoh heard.

verses.name: Genesis 45:3
verses.text: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> Joseph; doth my father yet live? And his brethren could not answer him; for they were troubled at his presence.

verses.name: Genesis 45:4
verses.text: And Joseph said unto his brethren, Come near to me, I pray you. And they came near. And he said, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> Joseph your brother, whom ye sold into Egypt.

verses.name: Genesis 45:5
verses.text: Now therefore be not grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that ye sold me hither: for God did send me before you to preserve life.

verses.name: Genesis 45:6
verses.text: For these two years <hi type="italic">hath</hi> the famine <hi type="italic">been</hi> in the land: and yet <hi type="italic">there are</hi> five years, in the which <hi type="italic">there shall</hi> neither <hi type="italic">be</hi> earing nor harvest.

verses.name: Genesis 45:7
verses.text: And God sent me before you to preserve you a posterity in the earth, and to save your lives by a great deliverance.

verses.name: Genesis 45:8
verses.text: So now <hi type="italic">it was</hi> not you <hi type="italic">that</hi> sent me hither, but God: and he hath made me a father to Pharaoh, and lord of all his house, and a ruler throughout all the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Genesis 45:9
verses.text: Haste ye, and go up to my father, and say unto him, Thus saith thy son Joseph, God hath made me lord of all Egypt: come down unto me, tarry not:

verses.name: Genesis 45:10
verses.text: And thou shalt dwell in the land of Goshen, and thou shalt be near unto me, thou, and thy children, and thy children’s children, and thy flocks, and thy herds, and all that thou hast:

verses.name: Genesis 45:11
verses.text: And there will I nourish thee; for yet <hi type="italic">there are</hi> five years of famine; lest thou, and thy household, and all that thou hast, come to poverty.

verses.name: Genesis 45:12
verses.text: And, behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that <hi type="italic">it is</hi> my mouth that speaketh unto you.

verses.name: Genesis 45:13
verses.text: And ye shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt, and of all that ye have seen; and ye shall haste and bring down my father hither.

verses.name: Genesis 45:14
verses.text: And he fell upon his brother Benjamin’s neck, and wept; and Benjamin wept upon his neck.

verses.name: Genesis 45:15
verses.text: Moreover he kissed all his brethren, and wept upon them: and after that his brethren talked with him.

verses.name: Genesis 45:16
verses.text: ¶ And the fame thereof was heard in Pharaoh’s house, saying, Joseph’s brethren are come: and it pleased Pharaoh well, and his servants.

verses.name: Genesis 45:17
verses.text: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Say unto thy brethren, This do ye; lade your beasts, and go, get you unto the land of Canaan;

verses.name: Genesis 45:18
verses.text: And take your father and your households, and come unto me: and I will give you the good of the land of Egypt, and ye shall eat the fat of the land.

verses.name: Genesis 45:19
verses.text: Now thou art commanded, this do ye; take you wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones, and for your wives, and bring your father, and come.

verses.name: Genesis 45:20
verses.text: Also regard not your stuff; for the good of all the land of Egypt <hi type="italic">is</hi> yours.

verses.name: Genesis 45:21
verses.text: And the children of Israel did so: and Joseph gave them wagons, according to the commandment of Pharaoh, and gave them provision for the way.

verses.name: Genesis 45:22
verses.text: To all of them he gave each man changes of raiment; but to Benjamin he gave three hundred <hi type="italic">pieces</hi> of silver, and five changes of raiment.

verses.name: Genesis 45:23
verses.text: And to his father he sent after this <hi type="italic">manner;</hi> ten asses laden with the good things of Egypt, and ten she asses laden with corn and bread and meat for his father by the way.

verses.name: Genesis 45:24
verses.text: So he sent his brethren away, and they departed: and he said unto them, See that ye fall not out by the way.

verses.name: Genesis 45:25
verses.text: ¶ And they went up out of Egypt, and came into the land of Canaan unto Jacob their father,

verses.name: Genesis 45:26
verses.text: And told him, saying, Joseph <hi type="italic">is</hi> yet alive, and he <hi type="italic">is</hi> governor over all the land of Egypt. And Jacob’s heart fainted, for he believed them not.

verses.name: Genesis 45:27
verses.text: And they told him all the words of Joseph, which he had said unto them: and when he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent to carry him, the spirit of Jacob their father revived:

verses.name: Genesis 45:28
verses.text: And Israel said, <hi type="italic">It is</hi> enough; Joseph my son <hi type="italic">is</hi> yet alive: I will go and see him before I die.  <chapter eID="Gen.45"/><div eID="gen47" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 46:1
verses.text: AND Israel took his journey with all that he had, and came to Beer-sheba, and offered sacrifices unto the God of his father Isaac.

verses.name: Genesis 46:2
verses.text: And God spake unto Israel in the visions of the night, and said, Jacob, Jacob. And he said, Here <hi type="italic">am</hi> I.

verses.name: Genesis 46:3
verses.text: And he said, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> God, the God of thy father: fear not to go down into Egypt; for I will there make of thee a great nation:

verses.name: Genesis 46:4
verses.text: I will go down with thee into Egypt; and I will also surely bring thee up <hi type="italic">again:</hi> and Joseph shall put his hand upon thine eyes.

verses.name: Genesis 46:5
verses.text: And Jacob rose up from Beer-sheba: and the sons of Israel carried Jacob their father, and their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.

verses.name: Genesis 46:6
verses.text: And they took their cattle, and their goods, which they had gotten in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt, Jacob, and all his seed with him:

verses.name: Genesis 46:7
verses.text: His sons, and his sons’ sons with him, his daughters, and his sons’ daughters, and all his seed brought he with him into Egypt.

verses.name: Genesis 46:8
verses.text: ¶ And these <hi type="italic">are</hi> the names of the children of Israel, which came into Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Reuben, Jacob’s firstborn.

verses.name: Genesis 46:9
verses.text: And the sons of Reuben; Hanoch, and Phallu, and Hezron, and Carmi.

verses.name: Genesis 46:10
verses.text: ¶ And the sons of Simeon; Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman.

verses.name: Genesis 46:11
verses.text: ¶ And the sons of Levi; Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

verses.name: Genesis 46:12
verses.text: ¶ And the sons of Judah; Er, and Onan, and Shelah, and Pharez, and Zerah: but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. And the sons of Pharez were Hezron and Hamul.

verses.name: Genesis 46:13
verses.text: ¶ And the sons of Issachar; Tola, and Phuvah, and Job, and Shimron.

verses.name: Genesis 46:14
verses.text: ¶ And the sons of Zebulun; Sered, and Elon, and Jahleel.

verses.name: Genesis 46:15
verses.text: These <hi type="italic">be</hi> the sons of Leah, which she bare unto Jacob in Padan-aram, with his daughter Dinah: all the souls of his sons and his daughters <hi type="italic">were</hi> thirty and three.

verses.name: Genesis 46:16
verses.text: ¶ And the sons of Gad; Ziphion, and Haggi, Shuni, and Ezbon, Eri, and Arodi, and Areli.

verses.name: Genesis 46:17
verses.text: ¶ And the sons of Asher; Jimnah, and Ishuah, and Isui, and Beriah, and Serah their sister: and the sons of Beriah; Heber, and Malchiel.

verses.name: Genesis 46:18
verses.text: These <hi type="italic">are</hi> the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah his daughter, and these she bare unto Jacob, <hi type="italic">even</hi> sixteen souls.

verses.name: Genesis 46:19
verses.text: The sons of Rachel Jacob’s wife; Joseph, and Benjamin.

verses.name: Genesis 46:20
verses.text: ¶ And unto Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, which Asenath the daughter of Poti-pherah priest of On bare unto him.

verses.name: Genesis 46:21
verses.text: ¶ And the sons of Benjamin <hi type="italic">were</hi> Belah, and Becher, and Ashbel, Gera, and Naaman, Ehi, and Rosh, Muppim, and Huppim, and Ard.

verses.name: Genesis 46:22
verses.text: These <hi type="italic">are</hi> the sons of Rachel, which were born to Jacob: all the souls <hi type="italic">were</hi> fourteen.

verses.name: Genesis 46:23
verses.text: ¶ And the sons of Dan; Hushim.

verses.name: Genesis 46:24
verses.text: ¶ And the sons of Naphtali; Jahzeel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shillem.

verses.name: Genesis 46:25
verses.text: These <hi type="italic">are</hi> the sons of Bilhah, which Laban gave unto Rachel his daughter, and she bare these unto Jacob: all the souls <hi type="italic">were</hi> seven.

verses.name: Genesis 46:26
verses.text: All the souls that came with Jacob into Egypt, which came out of his loins, besides Jacob’s sons’ wives, all the souls <hi type="italic">were</hi> threescore and six;

verses.name: Genesis 46:27
verses.text: And the sons of Joseph, which were born him in Egypt, <hi type="italic">were</hi> two souls: all the souls of the house of Jacob, which came into Egypt, <hi type="italic">were</hi> threescore and ten.

verses.name: Genesis 46:28
verses.text: ¶ And he sent Judah before him unto Joseph, to direct his face unto Goshen; and they came into the land of Goshen.

verses.name: Genesis 46:29
verses.text: And Joseph made ready his chariot, and went up to meet Israel his father, to Goshen, and presented himself unto him; and he fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a good while.

verses.name: Genesis 46:30
verses.text: And Israel said unto Joseph, Now let me die, since I have seen thy face, because thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> yet alive.

verses.name: Genesis 46:31
verses.text: And Joseph said unto his brethren, and unto his father’s house, I will go up, and shew Pharaoh, and say unto him, My brethren, and my father’s house, which <hi type="italic">were</hi> in the land of Canaan, are come unto me;

verses.name: Genesis 46:32
verses.text: And the men <hi type="italic">are</hi> shepherds, for their trade hath been to feed cattle; and they have brought their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have.

verses.name: Genesis 46:33
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, when Pharaoh shall call you, and shall say, What <hi type="italic">is</hi> your occupation?

verses.name: Genesis 46:34
verses.text: That ye shall say, Thy servants’ trade hath been about cattle from our youth even until now, both we, <hi type="italic">and</hi> also our fathers: that ye may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd <hi type="italic">is</hi> an abomination unto the Egyptians.  <chapter eID="Gen.46"/><div eID="gen48" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 47:1
verses.text: THEN Joseph came and told Pharaoh, and said, My father and my brethren, and their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have, are come out of the land of Canaan; and, behold, they <hi type="italic">are</hi> in the land of Goshen.

verses.name: Genesis 47:2
verses.text: And he took some of his brethren, <hi type="italic">even</hi> five men, and presented them unto Pharaoh.

verses.name: Genesis 47:3
verses.text: And Pharaoh said unto his brethren, What <hi type="italic">is</hi> your occupation? And they said unto Pharaoh, Thy servants <hi type="italic">are</hi> shepherds, both we, <hi type="italic">and</hi> also our fathers.

verses.name: Genesis 47:4
verses.text: They said moreover unto Pharaoh, For to sojourn in the land are we come; for thy servants have no pasture for their flocks; for the famine <hi type="italic">is</hi> sore in the land of Canaan: now therefore, we pray thee, let thy servants dwell in the land of Goshen.

verses.name: Genesis 47:5
verses.text: And Pharaoh spake unto Joseph, saying, Thy father and thy brethren are come unto thee:

verses.name: Genesis 47:6
verses.text: The land of Egypt <hi type="italic">is</hi> before thee; in the best of the land make thy father and brethren to dwell; in the land of Goshen let them dwell: and if thou knowest <hi type="italic">any</hi> men of activity among them, then make them rulers over my cattle.

verses.name: Genesis 47:7
verses.text: And Joseph brought in Jacob his father, and set him before Pharaoh: and Jacob blessed Pharaoh.

verses.name: Genesis 47:8
verses.text: And Pharaoh said unto Jacob, How old <hi type="italic">art</hi> thou?

verses.name: Genesis 47:9
verses.text: And Jacob said unto Pharaoh, The days of the years of my pilgrimage <hi type="italic">are</hi> an hundred and thirty years: few and evil have the days of the years of my life been, and have not attained unto the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage.

verses.name: Genesis 47:10
verses.text: And Jacob blessed Pharaoh, and went out from before Pharaoh.

verses.name: Genesis 47:11
verses.text: ¶ And Joseph placed his father and his brethren, and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt, in the best of the land, in the land of Rameses, as Pharaoh had commanded.

verses.name: Genesis 47:12
verses.text: And Joseph nourished his father, and his brethren, and all his father’s household, with bread, according to <hi type="italic">their</hi> families.

verses.name: Genesis 47:13
verses.text: ¶ And <hi type="italic">there was</hi> no bread in all the land; for the famine <hi type="italic">was</hi> very sore, so that the land of Egypt and <hi type="italic">all</hi> the land of Canaan fainted by reason of the famine.

verses.name: Genesis 47:14
verses.text: And Joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, for the corn which they bought: and Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh’s house.

verses.name: Genesis 47:15
verses.text: And when money failed in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, all the Egyptians came unto Joseph, and said, Give us bread: for why should we die in thy presence? for the money faileth.

verses.name: Genesis 47:16
verses.text: And Joseph said, Give your cattle; and I will give you for your cattle, if money fail.

verses.name: Genesis 47:17
verses.text: And they brought their cattle unto Joseph: and Joseph gave them bread <hi type="italic">in exchange</hi> for horses, and for the flocks, and for the cattle of the herds, and for the asses: and he fed them with bread for all their cattle for that year.

verses.name: Genesis 47:18
verses.text: When that year was ended, they came unto him the second year, and said unto him, We will not hide <hi type="italic">it</hi> from my lord, how that our money is spent; my lord also hath our herds of cattle; there is not ought left in the sight of my lord, but our bodies, and our lands:

verses.name: Genesis 47:19
verses.text: Wherefore shall we die before thine eyes, both we and our land? buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be servants unto Pharaoh: and give <hi type="italic">us</hi> seed, that we may live, and not die, that the land be not desolate.

verses.name: Genesis 47:20
verses.text: And Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh; for the Egyptians sold every man his field, because the famine prevailed over them: so the land became Pharaoh’s.

verses.name: Genesis 47:21
verses.text: And as for the people, he removed them to cities from <hi type="italic">one</hi> end of the borders of Egypt even to the <hi type="italic">other</hi> end thereof.

verses.name: Genesis 47:22
verses.text: Only the land of the priests bought he not; for the priests had a portion <hi type="italic">assigned them</hi> of Pharaoh, and did eat their portion which Pharaoh gave them: wherefore they sold not their lands.

verses.name: Genesis 47:23
verses.text: Then Joseph said unto the people, Behold, I have bought you this day and your land for Pharaoh: lo, <hi type="italic">here is</hi> seed for you, and ye shall sow the land.

verses.name: Genesis 47:24
verses.text: And it shall come to pass in the increase, that ye shall give the fifth <hi type="italic">part</hi> unto Pharaoh, and four parts shall be your own, for seed of the field, and for your food, and for them of your households, and for food for your little ones.

verses.name: Genesis 47:25
verses.text: And they said, Thou hast saved our lives: let us find grace in the sight of my lord, and we will be Pharaoh’s servants.

verses.name: Genesis 47:26
verses.text: And Joseph made it a law over the land of Egypt unto this day, <hi type="italic">that</hi> Pharaoh should have the fifth <hi type="italic">part;</hi> except the land of the priests only, <hi type="italic">which</hi> became not Pharaoh’s.

verses.name: Genesis 47:27
verses.text: ¶ And Israel dwelt in the land of Egypt, in the country of Goshen; and they had possessions therein, and grew, and multiplied exceedingly.

verses.name: Genesis 47:28
verses.text: And Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years: so the whole age of Jacob was an hundred forty and seven years.

verses.name: Genesis 47:29
verses.text: And the time drew nigh that Israel must die: and he called his son Joseph, and said unto him, If now I have found grace in thy sight, put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh, and deal kindly and truly with me; bury me not, I pray thee, in Egypt:

verses.name: Genesis 47:30
verses.text: But I will lie with my fathers, and thou shalt carry me out of Egypt, and bury me in their buryingplace. And he said, I will do as thou hast said.

verses.name: Genesis 47:31
verses.text: And he said, Swear unto me. And he sware unto him. And Israel bowed himself upon the bed’s head.  <chapter eID="Gen.47"/><div eID="gen49" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 48:1
verses.text: AND it came to pass after these things, that <hi type="italic">one</hi> told Joseph, Behold, thy father <hi type="italic">is</hi> sick: and he took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.

verses.name: Genesis 48:2
verses.text: And <hi type="italic">one</hi> told Jacob, and said, Behold, thy son Joseph cometh unto thee: and Israel strengthened himself, and sat upon the bed.

verses.name: Genesis 48:3
verses.text: And Jacob said unto Joseph, God Almighty appeared unto me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and blessed me,

verses.name: Genesis 48:4
verses.text: And said unto me, Behold, I will make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, and I will make of thee a multitude of people; and will give this land to thy seed after thee <hi type="italic">for</hi> an everlasting possession.

verses.name: Genesis 48:5
verses.text: ¶ And now thy two sons, Ephraim and Manasseh, which were born unto thee in the land of Egypt before I came unto thee into Egypt, <hi type="italic">are</hi> mine; as Reuben and Simeon, they shall be mine.

verses.name: Genesis 48:6
verses.text: And thy issue, which thou begettest after them, shall be thine, <hi type="italic">and</hi> shall be called after the name of their brethren in their inheritance.

verses.name: Genesis 48:7
verses.text: And as for me, when I came from Padan, Rachel died by me in the land of Canaan in the way, when yet <hi type="italic">there was</hi> but a little way to come unto Ephrath: and I buried her there in the way of Ephrath; the same <hi type="italic">is</hi> Beth-lehem.

verses.name: Genesis 48:8
verses.text: And Israel beheld Joseph’s sons, and said, Who <hi type="italic">are</hi> these?

verses.name: Genesis 48:9
verses.text: And Joseph said unto his father, They <hi type="italic">are</hi> my sons, whom God hath given me in this <hi type="italic">place</hi>. And he said, Bring them, I pray thee, unto me, and I will bless them.

verses.name: Genesis 48:10
verses.text: Now the eyes of Israel were dim for age, <hi type="italic">so that</hi> he could not see. And he brought them near unto him; and he kissed them, and embraced them.

verses.name: Genesis 48:11
verses.text: And Israel said unto Joseph, I had not thought to see thy face: and, lo, God hath shewed me also thy seed.

verses.name: Genesis 48:12
verses.text: And Joseph brought them out from between his knees, and he bowed himself with his face to the earth.

verses.name: Genesis 48:13
verses.text: And Joseph took them both, Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel’s left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel’s right hand, and brought <hi type="italic">them</hi> near unto him.

verses.name: Genesis 48:14
verses.text: And Israel stretched out his right hand, and laid <hi type="italic">it</hi> upon Ephraim’s head, who <hi type="italic">was</hi> the younger, and his left hand upon Manasseh’s head, guiding his hands wittingly; for Manasseh <hi type="italic">was</hi> the firstborn.

verses.name: Genesis 48:15
verses.text: ¶ And he blessed Joseph, and said, God, before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac did walk, the God which fed me all my life long unto this day,

verses.name: Genesis 48:16
verses.text: The Angel which redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads; and let my name be named on them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac; and let them grow into a multitude in the midst of the earth.

verses.name: Genesis 48:17
verses.text: And when Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand upon the head of Ephraim, it displeased him: and he held up his father’s hand, to remove it from Ephraim’s head unto Manasseh’s head.

verses.name: Genesis 48:18
verses.text: And Joseph said unto his father, Not so, my father: for this <hi type="italic">is</hi> the firstborn; put thy right hand upon his head.

verses.name: Genesis 48:19
verses.text: And his father refused, and said, I know <hi type="italic">it</hi>, my son, I know <hi type="italic">it:</hi> he also shall become a people, and he also shall be great: but truly his younger brother shall be greater than he, and his seed shall become a multitude of nations.

verses.name: Genesis 48:20
verses.text: And he blessed them that day, saying, In thee shall Israel bless, saying, God make thee as Ephraim and as Manasseh: and he set Ephraim before Manasseh.

verses.name: Genesis 48:21
verses.text: And Israel said unto Joseph, Behold, I die: but God shall be with you, and bring you again unto the land of your fathers.

verses.name: Genesis 48:22
verses.text: Moreover I have given to thee one portion above thy brethren, which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my bow.  <chapter eID="Gen.48"/><div eID="gen50" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 49:1
verses.text: AND Jacob called unto his sons, and said, Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you <hi type="italic">that</hi> which shall befall you in the last days.

verses.name: Genesis 49:2
verses.text: Gather yourselves together, and hear, ye sons of Jacob; and hearken unto Israel your father.

verses.name: Genesis 49:3
verses.text: ¶ Reuben, thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength, the excellency of dignity, and the excellency of power:

verses.name: Genesis 49:4
verses.text: Unstable as water, thou shalt not excel; because thou wentest up to thy father’s bed; then defiledst thou <hi type="italic">it:</hi> he went up to my couch.

verses.name: Genesis 49:5
verses.text: ¶ Simeon and Levi <hi type="italic">are</hi> brethren; instruments of cruelty <hi type="italic">are in</hi> their habitations.

verses.name: Genesis 49:6
verses.text: O my soul, come not thou into their secret; unto their assembly, mine honour, be not thou united: for in their anger they slew a man, and in their selfwill they digged down a wall.

verses.name: Genesis 49:7
verses.text: Cursed <hi type="italic">be</hi> their anger, for <hi type="italic">it was</hi> fierce; and their wrath, for it was cruel: I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Israel.

verses.name: Genesis 49:8
verses.text: ¶ Judah, thou <hi type="italic">art he</hi> whom thy brethren shall praise: thy hand <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> in the neck of thine enemies; thy father’s children shall bow down before thee.

verses.name: Genesis 49:9
verses.text: Judah <hi type="italic">is</hi> a lion’s whelp: from the prey, my son, thou art gone up: he stooped down, he couched as a lion, and as an old lion; who shall rouse him up?

verses.name: Genesis 49:10
verses.text: The sceptre shall not depart from Judah, nor a lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come; and unto him <hi type="italic">shall</hi> the gathering of the people <hi type="italic">be</hi>.

verses.name: Genesis 49:11
verses.text: Binding his foal unto the vine, and his ass’s colt unto the choice vine; he washed his garments in wine, and his clothes in the blood of grapes:

verses.name: Genesis 49:12
verses.text: His eyes <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> red with wine, and his teeth white with milk.

verses.name: Genesis 49:13
verses.text: ¶ Zebulun shall dwell at the haven of the sea; and he <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> for an haven of ships; and his border <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> unto Zidon.

verses.name: Genesis 49:14
verses.text: ¶ Issachar <hi type="italic">is</hi> a strong ass couching down between two burdens:

verses.name: Genesis 49:15
verses.text: And he saw that rest <hi type="italic">was</hi> good, and the land that <hi type="italic">it was</hi> pleasant; and bowed his shoulder to bear, and became a servant unto tribute.

verses.name: Genesis 49:16
verses.text: ¶ Dan shall judge his people, as one of the tribes of Israel.

verses.name: Genesis 49:17
verses.text: Dan shall be a serpent by the way, an adder in the path, that biteth the horse heels, so that his rider shall fall backward.

verses.name: Genesis 49:18
verses.text: I have waited for thy salvation, O Lord.

verses.name: Genesis 49:19
verses.text: ¶ Gad, a troop shall overcome him: but he shall overcome at the last.

verses.name: Genesis 49:20
verses.text: ¶ Out of Asher his bread <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> fat, and he shall yield royal dainties.

verses.name: Genesis 49:21
verses.text: ¶ Naphtali <hi type="italic">is</hi> a hind let loose: he giveth goodly words.

verses.name: Genesis 49:22
verses.text: ¶ Joseph <hi type="italic">is</hi> a fruitful bough, <hi type="italic">even</hi> a fruitful bough by a well; <hi type="italic">whose</hi> branches run over the wall:

verses.name: Genesis 49:23
verses.text: The archers have sorely grieved him, and shot <hi type="italic">at him</hi>, and hated him:

verses.name: Genesis 49:24
verses.text: But his bow abode in strength, and the arms of his hands were made strong by the hands of the mighty <hi type="italic">God</hi> of Jacob; (from thence <hi type="italic">is</hi> the shepherd, the stone of Israel:)

verses.name: Genesis 49:25
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Even</hi> by the God of thy father, who shall help thee; and by the Almighty, who shall bless thee with blessings of heaven above, blessings of the deep that lieth under, blessings of the breasts, and of the womb:

verses.name: Genesis 49:26
verses.text: The blessings of thy father have prevailed above the blessings of my progenitors unto the utmost bound of the everlasting hills: they shall be on the head of Joseph, and on the crown of the head of him that was separate from his brethren.

verses.name: Genesis 49:27
verses.text: ¶ Benjamin shall ravin <hi type="italic">as</hi> a wolf: in the morning he shall devour the prey, and at night he shall divide the spoil.

verses.name: Genesis 49:28
verses.text: ¶ All these <hi type="italic">are</hi> the twelve tribes of Israel: and this <hi type="italic">is it</hi> that their father spake unto them, and blessed them; every one according to his blessing he blessed them.

verses.name: Genesis 49:29
verses.text: And he charged them, and said unto them, I am to be gathered unto my people: bury me with my fathers in the cave that <hi type="italic">is</hi> in the field of Ephron the Hittite,

verses.name: Genesis 49:30
verses.text: In the cave that <hi type="italic">is</hi> in the field of Machpelah, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field of Ephron the Hittite for a possession of a buryingplace.

verses.name: Genesis 49:31
verses.text: There they buried Abraham and Sarah his wife; there they buried Isaac and Rebekah his wife; and there I buried Leah.

verses.name: Genesis 49:32
verses.text: The purchase of the field and of the cave that <hi type="italic">is</hi> therein <hi type="italic">was</hi> from the children of Heth.

verses.name: Genesis 49:33
verses.text: And when Jacob had made an end of commanding his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, and yielded up the ghost, and was gathered unto his people.  <chapter eID="Gen.49"/><div eID="gen51" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 50:1
verses.text: AND Joseph fell upon his father’s face, and wept upon him, and kissed him.

verses.name: Genesis 50:2
verses.text: And Joseph commanded his servants the physicians to embalm his father: and the physicians embalmed Israel.

verses.name: Genesis 50:3
verses.text: And forty days were fulfilled for him; for so are fulfilled the days of those which are embalmed: and the Egyptians mourned for him threescore and ten days.

verses.name: Genesis 50:4
verses.text: And when the days of his mourning were past, Joseph spake unto the house of Pharaoh, saying, If now I have found grace in your eyes, speak, I pray you, in the ears of Pharaoh, saying,

verses.name: Genesis 50:5
verses.text: My father made me swear, saying, Lo, I die: in my grave which I have digged for me in the land of Canaan, there shalt thou bury me. Now therefore let me go up, I pray thee, and bury my father, and I will come again.

verses.name: Genesis 50:6
verses.text: And Pharaoh said, Go up, and bury thy father, according as he made thee swear.

verses.name: Genesis 50:7
verses.text: ¶ And Joseph went up to bury his father: and with him went up all the servants of Pharaoh, the elders of his house, and all the elders of the land of Egypt,

verses.name: Genesis 50:8
verses.text: And all the house of Joseph, and his brethren, and his father’s house: only their little ones, and their flocks, and their herds, they left in the land of Goshen.

verses.name: Genesis 50:9
verses.text: And there went up with him both chariots and horsemen: and it was a very great company.

verses.name: Genesis 50:10
verses.text: And they came to the threshingfloor of Atad, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> beyond Jordan, and there they mourned with a great and very sore lamentation: and he made a mourning for his father seven days.

verses.name: Genesis 50:11
verses.text: And when the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, saw the mourning in the floor of Atad, they said, This <hi type="italic">is</hi> a grievous mourning to the Egyptians: wherefore the name of it was called Abel-mizraim, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> beyond Jordan.

verses.name: Genesis 50:12
verses.text: And his sons did unto him according as he commanded them:

verses.name: Genesis 50:13
verses.text: For his sons carried him into the land of Canaan, and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah, which Abraham bought with the field for a possession of a buryingplace of Ephron the Hittite, before Mamre.

verses.name: Genesis 50:14
verses.text: ¶ And Joseph returned into Egypt, he, and his brethren, and all that went up with him to bury his father, after he had buried his father.

verses.name: Genesis 50:15
verses.text: ¶ And when Joseph’s brethren saw that their father was dead, they said, Joseph will peradventure hate us, and will certainly requite us all the evil which we did unto him.

verses.name: Genesis 50:16
verses.text: And they sent a messenger unto Joseph, saying, Thy father did command before he died, saying,

verses.name: Genesis 50:17
verses.text: So shall ye say unto Joseph, Forgive, I pray thee now, the trespass of thy brethren, and their sin; for they did unto thee evil: and now, we pray thee, forgive the trespass of the servants of the God of thy father. And Joseph wept when they spake unto him.

verses.name: Genesis 50:18
verses.text: And his brethren also went and fell down before his face; and they said, Behold, we <hi type="italic">be</hi> thy servants.

verses.name: Genesis 50:19
verses.text: And Joseph said unto them, Fear not: for <hi type="italic">am</hi> I in the place of God?

verses.name: Genesis 50:20
verses.text: But as for you, ye thought evil against me; <hi type="italic">but</hi> God meant it unto good, to bring to pass, as <hi type="italic">it is</hi> this day, to save much people alive.

verses.name: Genesis 50:21
verses.text: Now therefore fear ye not: I will nourish you, and your little ones. And he comforted them, and spake kindly unto them.

verses.name: Genesis 50:22
verses.text: ¶ And Joseph dwelt in Egypt, he, and his father’s house: and Joseph lived an hundred and ten years.

verses.name: Genesis 50:23
verses.text: And Joseph saw Ephraim’s children of the third <hi type="italic">generation:</hi> the children also of Machir the son of Manasseh were brought up upon Joseph’s knees.

verses.name: Genesis 50:24
verses.text: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I die: and God will surely visit you, and bring you out of this land unto the land which he sware to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

verses.name: Genesis 50:25
verses.text: And Joseph took an oath of the children of Israel, saying, God will surely visit you, and ye shall carry up my bones from hence.

verses.name: Genesis 50:26
verses.text: So Joseph died, <hi type="italic">being</hi> an hundred and ten years old: and they embalmed him, and he was put in a coffin in Egypt.  <chapter eID="Gen.50"/><div eID="gen52" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen2" osisID="Gen" type="book"/>

verses.name: Exodus 1:1
verses.text: NOW these <hi type="italic">are</hi> the names of the children of Israel, which came into Egypt; every man and his household came with Jacob.

verses.name: Exodus 1:2
verses.text: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah,

verses.name: Exodus 1:3
verses.text: Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin,

verses.name: Exodus 1:4
verses.text: Dan, and Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.

verses.name: Exodus 1:5
verses.text: And all the souls that came out of the loins of Jacob were seventy souls: for Joseph was in Egypt <hi type="italic">already</hi>.

verses.name: Exodus 1:6
verses.text: And Joseph died, and all his brethren, and all that generation.

verses.name: Exodus 1:7
verses.text: ¶ And the children of Israel were fruitful, and increased abundantly, and multiplied, and waxed exceeding mighty; and the land was filled with them.

verses.name: Exodus 1:8
verses.text: Now there arose up a new king over Egypt, which knew not Joseph.

verses.name: Exodus 1:9
verses.text: And he said unto his people, Behold, the people of the children of Israel <hi type="italic">are</hi> more and mightier than we:

verses.name: Exodus 1:10
verses.text: Come on, let us deal wisely with them; lest they multiply, and it come to pass, that, when there falleth out any war, they join also unto our enemies, and fight against us, and <hi type="italic">so</hi> get them up out of the land.

verses.name: Exodus 1:11
verses.text: Therefore they did set over them taskmasters to afflict them with their burdens. And they built for Pharaoh treasure cities, Pithom and Raamses.

verses.name: Exodus 1:12
verses.text: But the more they afflicted them, the more they multiplied and grew. And they were grieved because of the children of Israel.

verses.name: Exodus 1:13
verses.text: And the Egyptians made the children of Israel to serve with rigour:

verses.name: Exodus 1:14
verses.text: And they made their lives bitter with hard bondage, in morter, and in brick, and in all manner of service in the field: all their service, wherein they made them serve, <hi type="italic">was</hi> with rigour.

verses.name: Exodus 1:15
verses.text: ¶ And the king of Egypt spake to the Hebrew midwives, of which the name of the one <hi type="italic">was</hi> Shiphrah, and the name of the other Puah:

verses.name: Exodus 1:16
verses.text: And he said, When ye do the office of a midwife to the Hebrew women, and see <hi type="italic">them</hi> upon the stools; if it <hi type="italic">be</hi> a son, then ye shall kill him: but if it <hi type="italic">be</hi> a daughter, then she shall live.

verses.name: Exodus 1:17
verses.text: But the midwives feared God, and did not as the king of Egypt commanded them, but saved the men children alive.

verses.name: Exodus 1:18
verses.text: And the king of Egypt called for the midwives, and said unto them, Why have ye done this thing, and have saved the men children alive?

verses.name: Exodus 1:19
verses.text: And the midwives said unto Pharaoh, Because the Hebrew women <hi type="italic">are</hi> not as the Egyptian women; for they <hi type="italic">are</hi> lively, and are delivered ere the midwives come in unto them.

verses.name: Exodus 1:20
verses.text: Therefore God dealt well with the midwives: and the people multiplied, and waxed very mighty.

verses.name: Exodus 1:21
verses.text: And it came to pass, because the midwives feared God, that he made them houses.

verses.name: Exodus 1:22
verses.text: And Pharaoh charged all his people, saying, Every son that is born ye shall cast into the river, and every daughter ye shall save alive.  <chapter eID="Exod.1"/><div eID="gen54" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 2:1
verses.text: AND there went a man of the house of Levi, and took <hi type="italic">to wife</hi> a daughter of Levi.

verses.name: Exodus 2:2
verses.text: And the woman conceived, and bare a son: and when she saw him that he <hi type="italic">was a</hi> goodly <hi type="italic">child</hi>, she hid him three months.

verses.name: Exodus 2:3
verses.text: And when she could not longer hide him, she took for him an ark of bulrushes, and daubed it with slime and with pitch, and put the child therein; and she laid <hi type="italic">it</hi> in the flags by the river’s brink.

verses.name: Exodus 2:4
verses.text: And his sister stood afar off, to wit what would be done to him.

verses.name: Exodus 2:5
verses.text: ¶ And the daughter of Pharaoh came down to wash <hi type="italic">herself</hi> at the river; and her maidens walked along by the river’s side; and when she saw the ark among the flags, she sent her maid to fetch it.

verses.name: Exodus 2:6
verses.text: And when she had opened <hi type="italic">it</hi>, she saw the child: and, behold, the babe wept. And she had compassion on him, and said, This <hi type="italic">is one</hi> of the Hebrews’ children.

verses.name: Exodus 2:7
verses.text: Then said his sister to Pharaoh’s daughter, Shall I go and call to thee a nurse of the Hebrew women, that she may nurse the child for thee?

verses.name: Exodus 2:8
verses.text: And Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, Go. And the maid went and called the child’s mother.

verses.name: Exodus 2:9
verses.text: And Pharaoh’s daughter said unto her, Take this child away, and nurse it for me, and I will give <hi type="italic">thee</hi> thy wages. And the woman took the child, and nursed it.

verses.name: Exodus 2:10
verses.text: And the child grew, and she brought him unto Pharaoh’s daughter, and he became her son. And she called his name Moses: and she said, Because I drew him out of the water.

verses.name: Exodus 2:11
verses.text: ¶ And it came to pass in those days, when Moses was grown, that he went out unto his brethren, and looked on their burdens: and he spied an Egyptian smiting an Hebrew, one of his brethren.

verses.name: Exodus 2:12
verses.text: And he looked this way and that way, and when he saw that <hi type="italic">there was</hi> no man, he slew the Egyptian, and hid him in the sand.

verses.name: Exodus 2:13
verses.text: And when he went out the second day, behold, two men of the Hebrews strove together: and he said to him that did the wrong, Wherefore smitest thou thy fellow?

verses.name: Exodus 2:14
verses.text: And he said, Who made thee a prince and a judge over us? intendest thou to kill me, as thou killedst the Egyptian? And Moses feared, and said, Surely this thing is known.

verses.name: Exodus 2:15
verses.text: Now when Pharaoh heard this thing, he sought to slay Moses. But Moses fled from the face of Pharaoh, and dwelt in the land of Midian: and he sat down by a well.

verses.name: Exodus 2:16
verses.text: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters: and they came and drew <hi type="italic">water</hi>, and filled the troughs to water their father’s flock.

verses.name: Exodus 2:17
verses.text: And the shepherds came and drove them away: but Moses stood up and helped them, and watered their flock.

verses.name: Exodus 2:18
verses.text: And when they came to Reuel their father, he said, How <hi type="italic">is it that</hi> ye are come so soon to day?

verses.name: Exodus 2:19
verses.text: And they said, An Egyptian delivered us out of the hand of the shepherds, and also drew <hi type="italic">water</hi> enough for us, and watered the flock.

verses.name: Exodus 2:20
verses.text: And he said unto his daughters, And where <hi type="italic">is</hi> he? why <hi type="italic">is</hi> it <hi type="italic">that</hi> ye have left the man? call him, that he may eat bread.

verses.name: Exodus 2:21
verses.text: And Moses was content to dwell with the man: and he gave Moses Zipporah his daughter.

verses.name: Exodus 2:22
verses.text: And she bare <hi type="italic">him</hi> a son, and he called his name Gershom: for he said, I have been a stranger in a strange land.

verses.name: Exodus 2:23
verses.text: ¶ And it came to pass in process of time, that the king of Egypt died: and the children of Israel sighed by reason of the bondage, and they cried, and their cry came up unto God by reason of the bondage.

verses.name: Exodus 2:24
verses.text: And God heard their groaning, and God remembered his covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob.

verses.name: Exodus 2:25
verses.text: And God looked upon the children of Israel, and God had respect unto <hi type="italic">them</hi>.  <chapter eID="Exod.2"/><div eID="gen55" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 3:1
verses.text: NOW Moses kept the flock of Jethro his father in law, the priest of Midian: and he led the flock to the backside of the desert, and came to the mountain of God, <hi type="italic">even</hi> to Horeb.

verses.name: Exodus 3:2
verses.text: And the angel of the Lord appeared unto him in a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush: and he looked, and, behold, the bush burned with fire, and the bush <hi type="italic">was</hi> not consumed.

verses.name: Exodus 3:3
verses.text: And Moses said, I will now turn aside, and see this great sight, why the bush is not burnt.

verses.name: Exodus 3:4
verses.text: And when the Lord saw that he turned aside to see, God called unto him out of the midst of the bush, and said, Moses, Moses. And he said, Here <hi type="italic">am</hi> I.

verses.name: Exodus 3:5
verses.text: And he said, Draw not nigh hither: put off thy shoes from off thy feet, for the place whereon thou standest <hi type="italic">is</hi> holy ground.

verses.name: Exodus 3:6
verses.text: Moreover he said, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the God of thy father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. And Moses hid his face; for he was afraid to look upon God.

verses.name: Exodus 3:7
verses.text: ¶ And the Lord said, I have surely seen the affliction of my people which <hi type="italic">are</hi> in Egypt, and have heard their cry by reason of their taskmasters; for I know their sorrows;

verses.name: Exodus 3:8
verses.text: And I am come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, and to bring them up out of that land unto a good land and a large, unto a land flowing with milk and honey; unto the place of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites.

verses.name: Exodus 3:9
verses.text: Now therefore, behold, the cry of the children of Israel is come unto me: and I have also seen the oppression wherewith the Egyptians oppress them.

verses.name: Exodus 3:10
verses.text: Come now therefore, and I will send thee unto Pharaoh, that thou mayest bring forth my people the children of Israel out of Egypt.

verses.name: Exodus 3:11
verses.text: ¶ And Moses said unto God, Who <hi type="italic">am</hi> I, that I should go unto Pharaoh, and that I should bring forth the children of Israel out of Egypt?

verses.name: Exodus 3:12
verses.text: And he said, Certainly I will be with thee; and this <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> a token unto thee, that I have sent thee: When thou hast brought forth the people out of Egypt, ye shall serve God upon this mountain.

verses.name: Exodus 3:13
verses.text: And Moses said unto God, Behold, <hi type="italic">when</hi> I come unto the children of Israel, and shall say unto them, The God of your fathers hath sent me unto you; and they shall say to me, What <hi type="italic">is</hi> his name? what shall I say unto them?

verses.name: Exodus 3:14
verses.text: And God said unto Moses, I AM THAT I AM: and he said, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, I AM hath sent me unto you.

verses.name: Exodus 3:15
verses.text: And God said moreover unto Moses, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, The Lord God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, hath sent me unto you: this <hi type="italic">is</hi> my name for ever, and this <hi type="italic">is</hi> my memorial unto all generations.

verses.name: Exodus 3:16
verses.text: Go, and gather the elders of Israel together, and say unto them, The Lord God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Jacob, appeared unto me, saying, I have surely visited you, and <hi type="italic">seen</hi> that which is done to you in Egypt:

verses.name: Exodus 3:17
verses.text: And I have said, I will bring you up out of the affliction of Egypt unto the land of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, unto a land flowing with milk and honey.

verses.name: Exodus 3:18
verses.text: And they shall hearken to thy voice: and thou shalt come, thou and the elders of Israel, unto the king of Egypt, and ye shall say unto him, The Lord God of the Hebrews hath met with us: and now let us go, we beseech thee, three days’ journey into the wilderness, that we may sacrifice to the Lord our God.

verses.name: Exodus 3:19
verses.text: ¶ And I am sure that the king of Egypt will not let you go, no, not by a mighty hand.

verses.name: Exodus 3:20
verses.text: And I will stretch out my hand, and smite Egypt with all my wonders which I will do in the midst thereof: and after that he will let you go.

verses.name: Exodus 3:21
verses.text: And I will give this people favour in the sight of the Egyptians: and it shall come to pass, that, when ye go, ye shall not go empty:

verses.name: Exodus 3:22
verses.text: But every woman shall borrow of her neighbour, and of her that sojourneth in her house, jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment: and ye shall put <hi type="italic">them</hi> upon your sons, and upon your daughters; and ye shall spoil the Egyptians.  <chapter eID="Exod.3"/><div eID="gen56" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 4:1
verses.text: AND Moses answered and said, But, behold, they will not believe me, nor hearken unto my voice: for they will say, The Lord hath not appeared unto thee.

verses.name: Exodus 4:2
verses.text: And the Lord said unto him, What <hi type="italic">is</hi> that in thine hand? And he said, A rod.

verses.name: Exodus 4:3
verses.text: And he said, Cast it on the ground. And he cast it on the ground, and it became a serpent; and Moses fled from before it.

verses.name: Exodus 4:4
verses.text: And the Lord said unto Moses, Put forth thine hand, and take it by the tail. And he put forth his hand, and caught it, and it became a rod in his hand:

verses.name: Exodus 4:5
verses.text: That they may believe that the Lord God of their fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, hath appeared unto thee.

verses.name: Exodus 4:6
verses.text: ¶ And the Lord said furthermore unto him, Put now thine hand into thy bosom. And he put his hand into his bosom: and when he took it out, behold, his hand <hi type="italic">was</hi> leprous as snow.

verses.name: Exodus 4:7
verses.text: And he said, Put thine hand into thy bosom again. And he put his hand into his bosom again; and plucked it out of his bosom, and, behold, it was turned again as his <hi type="italic">other</hi> flesh.

verses.name: Exodus 4:8
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, if they will not believe thee, neither hearken to the voice of the first sign, that they will believe the voice of the latter sign.

verses.name: Exodus 4:9
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, if they will not believe also these two signs, neither hearken unto thy voice, that thou shalt take of the water of the river, and pour <hi type="italic">it</hi> upon the dry <hi type="italic">land:</hi> and the water which thou takest out of the river shall become blood upon the dry <hi type="italic">land</hi>.

verses.name: Exodus 4:10
verses.text: ¶ And Moses said unto the Lord, O my Lord, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> not eloquent, neither heretofore, nor since thou hast spoken unto thy servant: but I <hi type="italic">am</hi> slow of speech, and of a slow tongue.

verses.name: Exodus 4:11
verses.text: And the Lord said unto him, Who hath made man’s mouth? or who maketh the dumb, or deaf, or the seeing, or the blind? have not I the Lord?

verses.name: Exodus 4:12
verses.text: Now therefore go, and I will be with thy mouth, and teach thee what thou shalt say.

verses.name: Exodus 4:13
verses.text: And he said, O my Lord, send, I pray thee, by the hand <hi type="italic">of him whom</hi> thou wilt send.

verses.name: Exodus 4:14
verses.text: And the anger of the Lord was kindled against Moses, and he said, <hi type="italic">Is</hi> not Aaron the Levite thy brother? I know that he can speak well. And also, behold, he cometh forth to meet thee: and when he seeth thee, he will be glad in his heart.

verses.name: Exodus 4:15
verses.text: And thou shalt speak unto him, and put words in his mouth: and I will be with thy mouth, and with his mouth, and will teach you what ye shall do.

verses.name: Exodus 4:16
verses.text: And he shall be thy spokesman unto the people: and he shall be, <hi type="italic">even</hi> he shall be to thee instead of a mouth, and thou shalt be to him instead of God.

verses.name: Exodus 4:17
verses.text: And thou shalt take this rod in thine hand, wherewith thou shalt do signs.

verses.name: Exodus 4:18
verses.text: ¶ And Moses went and returned to Jethro his father in law, and said unto him, Let me go, I pray thee, and return unto my brethren which <hi type="italic">are</hi> in Egypt, and see whether they be yet alive. And Jethro said to Moses, Go in peace.

verses.name: Exodus 4:19
verses.text: And the Lord said unto Moses in Midian, Go, return into Egypt: for all the men are dead which sought thy life.

verses.name: Exodus 4:20
verses.text: And Moses took his wife and his sons, and set them upon an ass, and he returned to the land of Egypt: and Moses took the rod of God in his hand.

verses.name: Exodus 4:21
verses.text: And the Lord said unto Moses, When thou goest to return into Egypt, see that thou do all those wonders before Pharaoh, which I have put in thine hand: but I will harden his heart, that he shall not let the people go.

verses.name: Exodus 4:22
verses.text: And thou shalt say unto Pharaoh, Thus saith the Lord, Israel <hi type="italic">is</hi> my son, <hi type="italic">even</hi> my firstborn:

verses.name: Exodus 4:23
verses.text: And I say unto thee, Let my son go, that he may serve me: and if thou refuse to let him go, behold, I will slay thy son, <hi type="italic">even</hi> thy firstborn.

verses.name: Exodus 4:24
verses.text: ¶ And it came to pass by the way in the inn, that the Lord met him, and sought to kill him.

verses.name: Exodus 4:25
verses.text: Then Zipporah took a sharp stone, and cut off the foreskin of her son, and cast <hi type="italic">it</hi> at his feet, and said, Surely a bloody husband <hi type="italic">art</hi> thou to me.

verses.name: Exodus 4:26
verses.text: So he let him go: then she said, A bloody husband <hi type="italic">thou art</hi>, because of the circumcision.

verses.name: Exodus 4:27
verses.text: ¶ And the Lord said to Aaron, Go into the wilderness to meet Moses. And he went, and met him in the mount of God, and kissed him.

verses.name: Exodus 4:28
verses.text: And Moses told Aaron all the words of the Lord who had sent him, and all the signs which he had commanded him.

verses.name: Exodus 4:29
verses.text: ¶ And Moses and Aaron went and gathered together all the elders of the children of Israel:

verses.name: Exodus 4:30
verses.text: And Aaron spake all the words which the Lord had spoken unto Moses, and did the signs in the sight of the people.

verses.name: Exodus 4:31
verses.text: And the people believed: and when they heard that the Lord had visited the children of Israel, and that he had looked upon their affliction, then they bowed their heads and worshipped.  <chapter eID="Exod.4"/><div eID="gen57" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 5:1
verses.text: AND afterward Moses and Aaron went in, and told Pharaoh, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, Let my people go, that they may hold a feast unto me in the wilderness.

verses.name: Exodus 5:2
verses.text: And Pharaoh said, Who <hi type="italic">is</hi> the Lord, that I should obey his voice to let Israel go? I know not the Lord, neither will I let Israel go.

verses.name: Exodus 5:3
verses.text: And they said, The God of the Hebrews hath met with us: let us go, we pray thee, three days’ journey into the desert, and sacrifice unto the Lord our God; lest he fall upon us with pestilence, or with the sword.

verses.name: Exodus 5:4
verses.text: And the king of Egypt said unto them, Wherefore do ye, Moses and Aaron, let the people from their works? get you unto your burdens.

verses.name: Exodus 5:5
verses.text: And Pharaoh said, Behold, the people of the land now <hi type="italic">are</hi> many, and ye make them rest from their burdens.

verses.name: Exodus 5:6
verses.text: And Pharaoh commanded the same day the taskmasters of the people, and their officers, saying,

verses.name: Exodus 5:7
verses.text: Ye shall no more give the people straw to make brick, as heretofore: let them go and gather straw for themselves.

verses.name: Exodus 5:8
verses.text: And the tale of the bricks, which they did make heretofore, ye shall lay upon them; ye shall not diminish <hi type="italic">ought</hi> thereof: for they <hi type="italic">be</hi> idle; therefore they cry, saying, Let us go <hi type="italic">and</hi> sacrifice to our God.

verses.name: Exodus 5:9
verses.text: Let there more work be laid upon the men, that they may labour therein; and let them not regard vain words.

verses.name: Exodus 5:10
verses.text: ¶ And the taskmasters of the people went out, and their officers, and they spake to the people, saying, Thus saith Pharaoh, I will not give you straw.

verses.name: Exodus 5:11
verses.text: Go ye, get you straw where ye can find it: yet not ought of your work shall be diminished.

verses.name: Exodus 5:12
verses.text: So the people were scattered abroad throughout all the land of Egypt to gather stubble instead of straw.

verses.name: Exodus 5:13
verses.text: And the taskmasters hasted <hi type="italic">them</hi>, saying, Fulfil your works, <hi type="italic">your</hi> daily tasks, as when there was straw.

verses.name: Exodus 5:14
verses.text: And the officers of the children of Israel, which Pharaoh’s taskmasters had set over them, were beaten, <hi type="italic">and</hi> demanded, Wherefore have ye not fulfilled your task in making brick both yesterday and to day, as heretofore?

verses.name: Exodus 5:15
verses.text: ¶ Then the officers of the children of Israel came and cried unto Pharaoh, saying, Wherefore dealest thou thus with thy servants?

verses.name: Exodus 5:16
verses.text: There is no straw given unto thy servants, and they say to us, Make brick: and, behold, thy servants <hi type="italic">are</hi> beaten; but the fault <hi type="italic">is</hi> in thine own people.

verses.name: Exodus 5:17
verses.text: But he said, Ye <hi type="italic">are</hi> idle, <hi type="italic">ye are</hi> idle: therefore ye say, Let us go <hi type="italic">and</hi> do sacrifice to the Lord.

verses.name: Exodus 5:18
verses.text: Go therefore now, <hi type="italic">and</hi> work; for there shall no straw be given you, yet shall ye deliver the tale of bricks.

verses.name: Exodus 5:19
verses.text: And the officers of the children of Israel did see <hi type="italic">that</hi> they <hi type="italic">were</hi> in evil <hi type="italic">case</hi>, after it was said, Ye shall not minish <hi type="italic">ought</hi> from your bricks of your daily task.

verses.name: Exodus 5:20
verses.text: ¶ And they met Moses and Aaron, who stood in the way, as they came forth from Pharaoh:

verses.name: Exodus 5:21
verses.text: And they said unto them, The Lord look upon you, and judge; because ye have made our savour to be abhorred in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of his servants, to put a sword in their hand to slay us.

verses.name: Exodus 5:22
verses.text: And Moses returned unto the Lord, and said, Lord, wherefore hast thou <hi type="italic">so</hi> evil entreated this people? why <hi type="italic">is</hi> it <hi type="italic">that</hi> thou hast sent me?

verses.name: Exodus 5:23
verses.text: For since I came to Pharaoh to speak in thy name, he hath done evil to this people; neither hast thou delivered thy people at all.  <chapter eID="Exod.5"/><div eID="gen58" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 6:1
verses.text: THEN the Lord said unto Moses, Now shalt thou see what I will do to Pharaoh: for with a strong hand shall he let them go, and with a strong hand shall he drive them out of his land.

verses.name: Exodus 6:2
verses.text: And God spake unto Moses, and said unto him, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord:

verses.name: Exodus 6:3
verses.text: And I appeared unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob, by <hi type="italic">the name of</hi> God Almighty, but by my name JEHOVAH was I not known to them.

verses.name: Exodus 6:4
verses.text: And I have also established my covenant with them, to give them the land of Canaan, the land of their pilgrimage, wherein they were strangers.

verses.name: Exodus 6:5
verses.text: And I have also heard the groaning of the children of Israel, whom the Egyptians keep in bondage; and I have remembered my covenant.

verses.name: Exodus 6:6
verses.text: Wherefore say unto the children of Israel, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord, and I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians, and I will rid you out of their bondage, and I will redeem you with a stretched out arm, and with great judgments:

verses.name: Exodus 6:7
verses.text: And I will take you to me for a people, and I will be to you a God: and ye shall know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord your God, which bringeth you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians.

verses.name: Exodus 6:8
verses.text: And I will bring you in unto the land, concerning the which I did swear to give it to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; and I will give it you for an heritage: I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord.

verses.name: Exodus 6:9
verses.text: ¶ And Moses spake so unto the children of Israel: but they hearkened not unto Moses for anguish of spirit, and for cruel bondage.

verses.name: Exodus 6:10
verses.text: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.name: Exodus 6:11
verses.text: Go in, speak unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, that he let the children of Israel go out of his land.

verses.name: Exodus 6:12
verses.text: And Moses spake before the Lord, saying, Behold, the children of Israel have not hearkened unto me; how then shall Pharaoh hear me, who <hi type="italic">am</hi> of uncircumcised lips?

verses.name: Exodus 6:13
verses.text: And the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, and gave them a charge unto the children of Israel, and unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Exodus 6:14
verses.text: ¶ These <hi type="italic">be</hi> the heads of their fathers’ houses: The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel; Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi: these <hi type="italic">be</hi> the families of Reuben.

verses.name: Exodus 6:15
verses.text: And the sons of Simeon; Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman: these <hi type="italic">are</hi> the families of Simeon.

verses.name: Exodus 6:16
verses.text: ¶ And these <hi type="italic">are</hi> the names of the sons of Levi according to their generations; Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari: and the years of the life of Levi <hi type="italic">were</hi> an hundred thirty and seven years.

verses.name: Exodus 6:17
verses.text: The sons of Gershon; Libni, and Shimi, according to their families.

verses.name: Exodus 6:18
verses.text: And the sons of Kohath; Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel: and the years of the life of Kohath <hi type="italic">were</hi> an hundred thirty and three years.

verses.name: Exodus 6:19
verses.text: And the sons of Merari; Mahali and Mushi: these <hi type="italic">are</hi> the families of Levi according to their generations.

verses.name: Exodus 6:20
verses.text: And Amram took him Jochebed his father’s sister to wife; and she bare him Aaron and Moses: and the years of the life of Amram <hi type="italic">were</hi> an hundred and thirty and seven years.

verses.name: Exodus 6:21
verses.text: ¶ And the sons of Izhar; Korah, and Nepheg, and Zichri.

verses.name: Exodus 6:22
verses.text: And the sons of Uzziel; Mishael, and Elzaphan, and Zithri.

verses.name: Exodus 6:23
verses.text: And Aaron took him Elisheba, daughter of Amminadab, sister of Naashon, to wife; and she bare him Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

verses.name: Exodus 6:24
verses.text: And the sons of Korah; Assir, and Elkanah, and Abiasaph: these <hi type="italic">are</hi> the families of the Korhites.

verses.name: Exodus 6:25
verses.text: And Eleazar Aaron’s son took him <hi type="italic">one</hi> of the daughters of Putiel to wife; and she bare him Phinehas: these <hi type="italic">are</hi> the heads of the fathers of the Levites according to their families.

verses.name: Exodus 6:26
verses.text: These <hi type="italic">are</hi> that Aaron and Moses, to whom the Lord said, Bring out the children of Israel from the land of Egypt according to their armies.

verses.name: Exodus 6:27
verses.text: These <hi type="italic">are</hi> they which spake to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring out the children of Israel from Egypt: these <hi type="italic">are</hi> that Moses and Aaron.

verses.name: Exodus 6:28
verses.text: ¶ And it came to pass on the day <hi type="italic">when</hi> the Lord spake unto Moses in the land of Egypt,

verses.name: Exodus 6:29
verses.text: That the Lord spake unto Moses, saying, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord: speak thou unto Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I say unto thee.

verses.name: Exodus 6:30
verses.text: And Moses said before the Lord, Behold, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> of uncircumcised lips, and how shall Pharaoh hearken unto me?  <chapter eID="Exod.6"/><div eID="gen59" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 7:1
verses.text: AND the Lord said unto Moses, See, I have made thee a god to Pharaoh: and Aaron thy brother shall be thy prophet.

verses.name: Exodus 7:2
verses.text: Thou shalt speak all that I command thee: and Aaron thy brother shall speak unto Pharaoh, that he send the children of Israel out of his land.

verses.name: Exodus 7:3
verses.text: And I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, and multiply my signs and my wonders in the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Exodus 7:4
verses.text: But Pharaoh shall not hearken unto you, that I may lay my hand upon Egypt, and bring forth mine armies, <hi type="italic">and</hi> my people the children of Israel, out of the land of Egypt by great judgments.

verses.name: Exodus 7:5
verses.text: And the Egyptians shall know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord, when I stretch forth mine hand upon Egypt, and bring out the children of Israel from among them.

verses.name: Exodus 7:6
verses.text: And Moses and Aaron did as the Lord commanded them, so did they.

verses.name: Exodus 7:7
verses.text: And Moses <hi type="italic">was</hi> fourscore years old, and Aaron fourscore and three years old, when they spake unto Pharaoh.

verses.name: Exodus 7:8
verses.text: ¶ And the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

verses.name: Exodus 7:9
verses.text: When Pharaoh shall speak unto you, saying, Shew a miracle for you: then thou shalt say unto Aaron, Take thy rod, and cast <hi type="italic">it</hi> before Pharaoh, <hi type="italic">and</hi> it shall become a serpent.

verses.name: Exodus 7:10
verses.text: ¶ And Moses and Aaron went in unto Pharaoh, and they did so as the Lord had commanded: and Aaron cast down his rod before Pharaoh, and before his servants, and it became a serpent.

verses.name: Exodus 7:11
verses.text: Then Pharaoh also called the wise men and the sorcerers: now the magicians of Egypt, they also did in like manner with their enchantments.

verses.name: Exodus 7:12
verses.text: For they cast down every man his rod, and they became serpents: but Aaron’s rod swallowed up their rods.

verses.name: Exodus 7:13
verses.text: And he hardened Pharaoh’s heart, that he hearkened not unto them; as the Lord had said.

verses.name: Exodus 7:14
verses.text: ¶ And the Lord said unto Moses, Pharaoh’s heart <hi type="italic">is</hi> hardened, he refuseth to let the people go.

verses.name: Exodus 7:15
verses.text: Get thee unto Pharaoh in the morning; lo, he goeth out unto the water; and thou shalt stand by the river’s brink against he come; and the rod which was turned to a serpent shalt thou take in thine hand.

verses.name: Exodus 7:16
verses.text: And thou shalt say unto him, The Lord God of the Hebrews hath sent me unto thee, saying, Let my people go, that they may serve me in the wilderness: and, behold, hitherto thou wouldest not hear.

verses.name: Exodus 7:17
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord, In this thou shalt know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord: behold, I will smite with the rod that <hi type="italic">is</hi> in mine hand upon the waters which <hi type="italic">are</hi> in the river, and they shall be turned to blood.

verses.name: Exodus 7:18
verses.text: And the fish that <hi type="italic">is</hi> in the river shall die, and the river shall stink; and the Egyptians shall lothe to drink of the water of the river.

verses.name: Exodus 7:19
