verses.text: And the two kidneys, and the fat that <hi type="italic">is</hi> on them, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> by the flanks, and the caul <hi type="italic">that is</hi> above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away:

verses.name: Leviticus 7:5
verses.text: And the priest shall burn them upon the altar <hi type="italic">for</hi> an offering made by fire unto the Lord: it <hi type="italic">is</hi> a trespass offering.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:6
verses.text: Every male among the priests shall eat thereof: it shall be eaten in the holy place: it <hi type="italic">is</hi> most holy.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:7
verses.text: As the sin offering <hi type="italic">is</hi>, so <hi type="italic">is</hi> the trespass offering: <hi type="italic">there is</hi> one law for them: the priest that maketh atonement therewith shall have <hi type="italic">it</hi>.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:8
verses.text: And the priest that offereth any man’s burnt offering, <hi type="italic">even</hi> the priest shall have to himself the skin of the burnt offering which he hath offered.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:9
verses.text: And all the meat offering that is baken in the oven, and all that is dressed in the fryingpan, and in the pan, shall be the priest’s that offereth it.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:10
verses.text: And every meat offering, mingled with oil, and dry, shall all the sons of Aaron have, one <hi type="italic">as much</hi> as another.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:11
verses.text: And this <hi type="italic">is</hi> the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which he shall offer unto the Lord.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:12
verses.text: If he offer it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mingled with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and cakes mingled with oil, of fine flour, fried.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:13
verses.text: Besides the cakes, he shall offer <hi type="italic">for</hi> his offering leavened bread with the sacrifice of thanksgiving of his peace offerings.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:14
verses.text: And of it he shall offer one out of the whole oblation <hi type="italic">for</hi> an heave offering unto the Lord, <hi type="italic">and</hi> it shall be the priest’s that sprinkleth the blood of the peace offerings.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:15
verses.text: And the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten the same day that it is offered; he shall not leave any of it until the morning.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:16
verses.text: But if the sacrifice of his offering <hi type="italic">be</hi> a vow, or a voluntary offering, it shall be eaten the same day that he offereth his sacrifice: and on the morrow also the remainder of it shall be eaten:

verses.name: Leviticus 7:17
verses.text: But the remainder of the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burnt with fire.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:18
verses.text: And if <hi type="italic">any</hi> of the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings be eaten at all on the third day, it shall not be accepted, neither shall it be imputed unto him that offereth it: it shall be an abomination, and the soul that eateth of it shall bear his iniquity.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:19
verses.text: And the flesh that toucheth any unclean <hi type="italic">thing</hi> shall not be eaten; it shall be burnt with fire: and as for the flesh, all that be clean shall eat thereof.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:20
verses.text: But the soul that eateth <hi type="italic">of</hi> the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, that <hi type="italic">pertain</hi> unto the Lord, having his uncleanness upon him, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:21
verses.text: Moreover the soul that shall touch any unclean <hi type="italic">thing</hi>, <hi type="italic">as</hi> the uncleanness of man, or <hi type="italic">any</hi> unclean beast, or any abominable unclean <hi type="italic">thing</hi>, and eat of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which <hi type="italic">pertain</hi> unto the Lord, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:22
verses.text: ¶ And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 7:23
verses.text: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Ye shall eat no manner of fat, of ox, or of sheep, or of goat.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:24
verses.text: And the fat of the beast that dieth of itself, and the fat of that which is torn with beasts, may be used in any other use: but ye shall in no wise eat of it.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:25
verses.text: For whosoever eateth the fat of the beast, of which men offer an offering made by fire unto the Lord, even the soul that eateth <hi type="italic">it</hi> shall be cut off from his people.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:26
verses.text: Moreover ye shall eat no manner of blood, <hi type="italic">whether it be</hi> of fowl or of beast, in any of your dwellings.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:27
verses.text: Whatsoever soul <hi type="italic">it be</hi> that eateth any manner of blood, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:28
verses.text: ¶ And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 7:29
verses.text: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, He that offereth the sacrifice of his peace offerings unto the Lord shall bring his oblation unto the Lord of the sacrifice of his peace offerings.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:30
verses.text: His own hands shall bring the offerings of the Lord made by fire, the fat with the breast, it shall he bring, that the breast may be waved <hi type="italic">for</hi> a wave offering before the Lord.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:31
verses.text: And the priest shall burn the fat upon the altar: but the breast shall be Aaron’s and his sons’.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:32
verses.text: And the right shoulder shall ye give unto the priest <hi type="italic">for</hi> an heave offering of the sacrifices of your peace offerings.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:33
verses.text: He among the sons of Aaron, that offereth the blood of the peace offerings, and the fat, shall have the right shoulder for <hi type="italic">his</hi> part.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:34
verses.text: For the wave breast and the heave shoulder have I taken of the children of Israel from off the sacrifices of their peace offerings, and have given them unto Aaron the priest and unto his sons by a statute for ever from among the children of Israel.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:35
verses.text: ¶ This <hi type="italic">is the portion</hi> of the anointing of Aaron, and of the anointing of his sons, out of the offerings of the Lord made by fire, in the day <hi type="italic">when</hi> he presented them to minister unto the Lord in the priest’s office;

verses.name: Leviticus 7:36
verses.text: Which the Lord commanded to be given them of the children of Israel, in the day that he anointed them, <hi type="italic">by</hi> a statute for ever throughout their generations.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:37
verses.text: This <hi type="italic">is</hi> the law of the burnt offering, of the meat offering, and of the sin offering, and of the trespass offering, and of the consecrations, and of the sacrifice of the peace offerings;

verses.name: Leviticus 7:38
verses.text: Which the Lord commanded Moses in mount Sinai, in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to offer their oblations unto the Lord, in the wilderness of Sinai.  <chapter eID="Lev.7"/><div eID="gen101" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 8:1
verses.text: AND the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 8:2
verses.text: Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments, and the anointing oil, and a bullock for the sin offering, and two rams, and a basket of unleavened bread;

verses.name: Leviticus 8:3
verses.text: And gather thou all the congregation together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:4
verses.text: And Moses did as the Lord commanded him; and the assembly was gathered together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:5
verses.text: And Moses said unto the congregation, This <hi type="italic">is</hi> the thing which the Lord commanded to be done.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:6
verses.text: And Moses brought Aaron and his sons, and washed them with water.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:7
verses.text: And he put upon him the coat, and girded him with the girdle, and clothed him with the robe, and put the ephod upon him, and he girded him with the curious girdle of the ephod, and bound <hi type="italic">it</hi> unto him therewith.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:8
verses.text: And he put the breastplate upon him: also he put in the breastplate the Urim and the Thummim.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:9
verses.text: And he put the mitre upon his head; also upon the mitre, <hi type="italic">even</hi> upon his forefront, did he put the golden plate, the holy crown; as the Lord commanded Moses.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:10
verses.text: And Moses took the anointing oil, and anointed the tabernacle and all that <hi type="italic">was</hi> therein, and sanctified them.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:11
verses.text: And he sprinkled thereof upon the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and all his vessels, both the laver and his foot, to sanctify them.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:12
verses.text: And he poured of the anointing oil upon Aaron’s head, and anointed him, to sanctify him.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:13
verses.text: And Moses brought Aaron’s sons, and put coats upon them, and girded them with girdles, and put bonnets upon them; as the Lord commanded Moses.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:14
verses.text: And he brought the bullock for the sin offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the bullock for the sin offering.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:15
verses.text: And he slew <hi type="italic">it;</hi> and Moses took the blood, and put <hi type="italic">it</hi> upon the horns of the altar round about with his finger, and purified the altar, and poured the blood at the bottom of the altar, and sanctified it, to make reconciliation upon it.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:16
verses.text: And he took all the fat that <hi type="italic">was</hi> upon the inwards, and the caul <hi type="italic">above</hi> the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and Moses burned <hi type="italic">it</hi> upon the altar.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:17
verses.text: But the bullock, and his hide, his flesh, and his dung, he burnt with fire without the camp; as the Lord commanded Moses.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:18
verses.text: ¶ And he brought the ram for the burnt offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:19
verses.text: And he killed <hi type="italic">it;</hi> and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:20
verses.text: And he cut the ram into pieces; and Moses burnt the head, and the pieces, and the fat.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:21
verses.text: And he washed the inwards and the legs in water; and Moses burnt the whole ram upon the altar: it <hi type="italic">was</hi> a burnt sacrifice for a sweet savour, <hi type="italic">and</hi> an offering made by fire unto the Lord; as the Lord commanded Moses.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:22
verses.text: ¶ And he brought the other ram, the ram of consecration: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:23
verses.text: And he slew <hi type="italic">it;</hi> and Moses took of the blood of it, and put <hi type="italic">it</hi> upon the tip of Aaron’s right ear, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:24
verses.text: And he brought Aaron’s sons, and Moses put of the blood upon the tip of their right ear, and upon the thumbs of their right hands, and upon the great toes of their right feet: and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:25
verses.text: And he took the fat, and the rump, and all the fat that <hi type="italic">was</hi> upon the inwards, and the caul <hi type="italic">above</hi> the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and the right shoulder:

verses.name: Leviticus 8:26
verses.text: And out of the basket of unleavened bread, that <hi type="italic">was</hi> before the Lord, he took one unleavened cake, and a cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, and put <hi type="italic">them</hi> on the fat, and upon the right shoulder:

verses.name: Leviticus 8:27
verses.text: And he put all upon Aaron’s hands, and upon his sons’ hands, and waved them <hi type="italic">for</hi> a wave offering before the Lord.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:28
verses.text: And Moses took them from off their hands, and burnt <hi type="italic">them</hi> on the altar upon the burnt offering: they <hi type="italic">were</hi> consecrations for a sweet savour: it <hi type="italic">is</hi> an offering made by fire unto the Lord.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:29
verses.text: And Moses took the breast, and waved it <hi type="italic">for</hi> a wave offering before the Lord: <hi type="italic">for</hi> of the ram of consecration it was Moses’ part; as the Lord commanded Moses.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:30
verses.text: And Moses took of the anointing oil, and of the blood which <hi type="italic">was</hi> upon the altar, and sprinkled <hi type="italic">it</hi> upon Aaron, <hi type="italic">and</hi> upon his garments, and upon his sons, and upon his sons’ garments with him; and sanctified Aaron, <hi type="italic">and</hi> his garments, and his sons, and his sons’ garments with him.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:31
verses.text: ¶ And Moses said unto Aaron and to his sons, Boil the flesh <hi type="italic">at</hi> the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and there eat it with the bread that <hi type="italic">is</hi> in the basket of consecrations, as I commanded, saying, Aaron and his sons shall eat it.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:32
verses.text: And that which remaineth of the flesh and of the bread shall ye burn with fire.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:33
verses.text: And ye shall not go out of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation <hi type="italic">in</hi> seven days, until the days of your consecration be at an end: for seven days shall he consecrate you.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:34
verses.text: As he hath done this day, <hi type="italic">so</hi> the Lord hath commanded to do, to make an atonement for you.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:35
verses.text: Therefore shall ye abide <hi type="italic">at</hi> the door of the tabernacle of the congregation day and night seven days, and keep the charge of the Lord, that ye die not: for so I am commanded.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:36
verses.text: So Aaron and his sons did all things which the Lord commanded by the hand of Moses.  <chapter eID="Lev.8"/><div eID="gen102" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 9:1
verses.text: AND it came to pass on the eighth day, <hi type="italic">that</hi> Moses called Aaron and his sons, and the elders of Israel;

verses.name: Leviticus 9:2
verses.text: And he said unto Aaron, Take thee a young calf for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering, without blemish, and offer <hi type="italic">them</hi> before the Lord.

verses.name: Leviticus 9:3
verses.text: And unto the children of Israel thou shalt speak, saying, Take ye a kid of the goats for a sin offering; and a calf and a lamb, <hi type="italic">both</hi> of the first year, without blemish, for a burnt offering;

verses.name: Leviticus 9:4
verses.text: Also a bullock and a ram for peace offerings, to sacrifice before the Lord; and a meat offering mingled with oil: for to day the Lord will appear unto you.

verses.name: Leviticus 9:5
verses.text: ¶ And they brought <hi type="italic">that</hi> which Moses commanded before the tabernacle of the congregation: and all the congregation drew near and stood before the Lord.

verses.name: Leviticus 9:6
verses.text: And Moses said, This <hi type="italic">is</hi> the thing which the Lord commanded that ye should do: and the glory of the Lord shall appear unto you.

verses.name: Leviticus 9:7
verses.text: And Moses said unto Aaron, Go unto the altar, and offer thy sin offering, and thy burnt offering, and make an atonement for thyself, and for the people: and offer the offering of the people, and make an atonement for them; as the Lord commanded.

verses.name: Leviticus 9:8
verses.text: ¶ Aaron therefore went unto the altar, and slew the calf of the sin offering, which <hi type="italic">was</hi> for himself.

verses.name: Leviticus 9:9
verses.text: And the sons of Aaron brought the blood unto him: and he dipped his finger in the blood, and put <hi type="italic">it</hi> upon the horns of the altar, and poured out the blood at the bottom of the altar:

verses.name: Leviticus 9:10
verses.text: But the fat, and the kidneys, and the caul above the liver of the sin offering, he burnt upon the altar; as the Lord commanded Moses.

verses.name: Leviticus 9:11
verses.text: And the flesh and the hide he burnt with fire without the camp.

verses.name: Leviticus 9:12
verses.text: And he slew the burnt offering; and Aaron’s sons presented unto him the blood, which he sprinkled round about upon the altar.

verses.name: Leviticus 9:13
verses.text: And they presented the burnt offering unto him, with the pieces thereof, and the head: and he burnt <hi type="italic">them</hi> upon the altar.

verses.name: Leviticus 9:14
verses.text: And he did wash the inwards and the legs, and burnt <hi type="italic">them</hi> upon the burnt offering on the altar.

verses.name: Leviticus 9:15
verses.text: ¶ And he brought the people’s offering, and took the goat, which <hi type="italic">was</hi> the sin offering for the people, and slew it, and offered it for sin, as the first.

verses.name: Leviticus 9:16
verses.text: And he brought the burnt offering, and offered it according to the manner.

verses.name: Leviticus 9:17
verses.text: And he brought the meat offering, and took an handful thereof, and burnt <hi type="italic">it</hi> upon the altar, beside the burnt sacrifice of the morning.

verses.name: Leviticus 9:18
verses.text: He slew also the bullock and the ram <hi type="italic">for</hi> a sacrifice of peace offerings, which <hi type="italic">was</hi> for the people: and Aaron’s sons presented unto him the blood, which he sprinkled upon the altar round about,

verses.name: Leviticus 9:19
verses.text: And the fat of the bullock and of the ram, the rump, and that which covereth <hi type="italic">the inwards</hi>, and the kidneys, and the caul <hi type="italic">above</hi> the liver:

verses.name: Leviticus 9:20
verses.text: And they put the fat upon the breasts, and he burnt the fat upon the altar:

verses.name: Leviticus 9:21
verses.text: And the breasts and the right shoulder Aaron waved <hi type="italic">for</hi> a wave offering before the Lord; as Moses commanded.

verses.name: Leviticus 9:22
verses.text: And Aaron lifted up his hand toward the people, and blessed them, and came down from offering of the sin offering, and the burnt offering, and peace offerings.

verses.name: Leviticus 9:23
verses.text: And Moses and Aaron went into the tabernacle of the congregation, and came out, and blessed the people: and the glory of the Lord appeared unto all the people.

verses.name: Leviticus 9:24
verses.text: And there came a fire out from before the Lord, and consumed upon the altar the burnt offering and the fat: <hi type="italic">which</hi> when all the people saw, they shouted, and fell on their faces.  <chapter eID="Lev.9"/><div eID="gen103" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 10:1
verses.text: AND Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, took either of them his censer, and put fire therein, and put incense thereon, and offered strange fire before the Lord, which he commanded them not.

verses.name: Leviticus 10:2
verses.text: And there went out fire from the Lord, and devoured them, and they died before the Lord.

verses.name: Leviticus 10:3
verses.text: Then Moses said unto Aaron, This <hi type="italic">is it</hi> that the Lord spake, saying, I will be sanctified in them that come nigh me, and before all the people I will be glorified. And Aaron held his peace.

verses.name: Leviticus 10:4
verses.text: And Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel the uncle of Aaron, and said unto them, Come near, carry your brethren from before the sanctuary out of the camp.

verses.name: Leviticus 10:5
verses.text: So they went near, and carried them in their coats out of the camp; as Moses had said.

verses.name: Leviticus 10:6
verses.text: And Moses said unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, his sons, Uncover not your heads, neither rend your clothes; lest ye die, and lest wrath come upon all the people: but let your brethren, the whole house of Israel, bewail the burning which the Lord hath kindled.

verses.name: Leviticus 10:7
verses.text: And ye shall not go out from the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, lest ye die: for the anointing oil of the Lord <hi type="italic">is</hi> upon you. And they did according to the word of Moses.

verses.name: Leviticus 10:8
verses.text: ¶ And the Lord spake unto Aaron, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 10:9
verses.text: Do not drink wine nor strong drink, thou, nor thy sons with thee, when ye go into the tabernacle of the congregation, lest ye die: <hi type="italic">it shall be</hi> a statute for ever throughout your generations:

verses.name: Leviticus 10:10
verses.text: And that ye may put difference between holy and unholy, and between unclean and clean;

verses.name: Leviticus 10:11
verses.text: And that ye may teach the children of Israel all the statutes which the Lord hath spoken unto them by the hand of Moses.

verses.name: Leviticus 10:12
verses.text: ¶ And Moses spake unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, his sons that were left, Take the meat offering that remaineth of the offerings of the Lord made by fire, and eat it without leaven beside the altar: for it <hi type="italic">is</hi> most holy:

verses.name: Leviticus 10:13
verses.text: And ye shall eat it in the holy place, because it <hi type="italic">is</hi> thy due, and thy sons’ due, of the sacrifices of the Lord made by fire: for so I am commanded.

verses.name: Leviticus 10:14
verses.text: And the wave breast and heave shoulder shall ye eat in a clean place; thou, and thy sons, and thy daughters with thee: for <hi type="italic">they be</hi> thy due, and thy sons’ due, <hi type="italic">which</hi> are given out of the sacrifices of peace offerings of the children of Israel.

verses.name: Leviticus 10:15
verses.text: The heave shoulder and the wave breast shall they bring with the offerings made by fire of the fat, to wave <hi type="italic">it for</hi> a wave offering before the Lord; and it shall be thine, and thy sons’ with thee, by a statute for ever; as the Lord hath commanded.

verses.name: Leviticus 10:16
verses.text: ¶ And Moses diligently sought the goat of the sin offering, and, behold, it was burnt: and he was angry with Eleazar and Ithamar, the sons of Aaron <hi type="italic">which were</hi> left <hi type="italic">alive</hi>, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 10:17
verses.text: Wherefore have ye not eaten the sin offering in the holy place, seeing it <hi type="italic">is</hi> most holy, and <hi type="italic">God</hi> hath given it you to bear the iniquity of the congregation, to make atonement for them before the Lord?

verses.name: Leviticus 10:18
verses.text: Behold, the blood of it was not brought in within the holy <hi type="italic">place:</hi> ye should indeed have eaten it in the holy <hi type="italic">place</hi>, as I commanded.

verses.name: Leviticus 10:19
verses.text: And Aaron said unto Moses, Behold, this day have they offered their sin offering and their burnt offering before the Lord; and such things have befallen me: and <hi type="italic">if</hi> I had eaten the sin offering to day, should it have been accepted in the sight of the Lord?

verses.name: Leviticus 10:20
verses.text: And when Moses heard <hi type="italic">that</hi>, he was content.  <chapter eID="Lev.10"/><div eID="gen104" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 11:1
verses.text: AND the Lord spake unto Moses and to Aaron, saying unto them,

verses.name: Leviticus 11:2
verses.text: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, These <hi type="italic">are</hi> the beasts which ye shall eat among all the beasts that <hi type="italic">are</hi> on the earth.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:3
verses.text: Whatsoever parteth the hoof, and is clovenfooted, <hi type="italic">and</hi> cheweth the cud, among the beasts, that shall ye eat.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:4
verses.text: Nevertheless these shall ye not eat of them that chew the cud, or of them that divide the hoof: <hi type="italic">as</hi> the camel, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he <hi type="italic">is</hi> unclean unto you.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:5
verses.text: And the coney, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he <hi type="italic">is</hi> unclean unto you.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:6
verses.text: And the hare, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he <hi type="italic">is</hi> unclean unto you.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:7
verses.text: And the swine, though he divide the hoof, and be clovenfooted, yet he cheweth not the cud; he <hi type="italic">is</hi> unclean to you.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:8
verses.text: Of their flesh shall ye not eat, and their carcase shall ye not touch; they <hi type="italic">are</hi> unclean to you.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:9
verses.text: ¶ These shall ye eat of all that <hi type="italic">are</hi> in the waters: whatsoever hath fins and scales in the waters, in the seas, and in the rivers, them shall ye eat.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:10
verses.text: And all that have not fins and scales in the seas, and in the rivers, of all that move in the waters, and of any living thing which <hi type="italic">is</hi> in the waters, they <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> an abomination unto you:

verses.name: Leviticus 11:11
verses.text: They shall be even an abomination unto you; ye shall not eat of their flesh, but ye shall have their carcases in abomination.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:12
verses.text: Whatsoever hath no fins nor scales in the waters, that <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> an abomination unto you.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:13
verses.text: ¶ And these <hi type="italic">are they which</hi> ye shall have in abomination among the fowls; they shall not be eaten, they <hi type="italic">are</hi> an abomination: the eagle, and the ossifrage, and the ospray,

verses.name: Leviticus 11:14
verses.text: And the vulture, and the kite after his kind;

verses.name: Leviticus 11:15
verses.text: Every raven after his kind;

verses.name: Leviticus 11:16
verses.text: And the owl, and the night hawk, and the cuckow, and the hawk after his kind,

verses.name: Leviticus 11:17
verses.text: And the little owl, and the cormorant, and the great owl,

verses.name: Leviticus 11:18
verses.text: And the swan, and the pelican, and the gier eagle,

verses.name: Leviticus 11:19
verses.text: And the stork, the heron after her kind, and the lapwing, and the bat.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:20
verses.text: All fowls that creep, going upon <hi type="italic">all</hi> four, <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> an abomination unto you.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:21
verses.text: Yet these may ye eat of every flying creeping thing that goeth upon <hi type="italic">all</hi> four, which have legs above their feet, to leap withal upon the earth;

verses.name: Leviticus 11:22
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Even</hi> these of them ye may eat; the locust after his kind, and the bald locust after his kind, and the beetle after his kind, and the grasshopper after his kind.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:23
verses.text: But all <hi type="italic">other</hi> flying creeping things, which have four feet, <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> an abomination unto you.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:24
verses.text: And for these ye shall be unclean: whosoever toucheth the carcase of them shall be unclean until the even.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:25
verses.text: And whosoever beareth <hi type="italic">ought</hi> of the carcase of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:26
verses.text: <hi type="italic">The carcases</hi> of every beast which divideth the hoof, and <hi type="italic">is</hi> not clovenfooted, nor cheweth the cud, <hi type="italic">are</hi> unclean unto you: every one that toucheth them shall be unclean.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:27
verses.text: And whatsoever goeth upon his paws, among all manner of beasts that go on <hi type="italic">all</hi> four, those <hi type="italic">are</hi> unclean unto you: whoso toucheth their carcase shall be unclean until the even.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:28
verses.text: And he that beareth the carcase of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: they <hi type="italic">are</hi> unclean unto you.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:29
verses.text: ¶ These also <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> unclean unto you among the creeping things that creep upon the earth; the weasel, and the mouse, and the tortoise after his kind,

verses.name: Leviticus 11:30
verses.text: And the ferret, and the chameleon, and the lizard, and the snail, and the mole.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:31
verses.text: These <hi type="italic">are</hi> unclean to you among all that creep: whosoever doth touch them, when they be dead, shall be unclean until the even.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:32
verses.text: And upon whatsoever <hi type="italic">any</hi> of them, when they are dead, doth fall, it shall be unclean; whether <hi type="italic">it be</hi> any vessel of wood, or raiment, or skin, or sack, whatsoever vessel <hi type="italic">it be</hi>, wherein <hi type="italic">any</hi> work is done, it must be put into water, and it shall be unclean until the even; so it shall be cleansed.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:33
verses.text: And every earthen vessel, whereinto <hi type="italic">any</hi> of them falleth, whatsoever <hi type="italic">is</hi> in it shall be unclean; and ye shall break it.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:34
verses.text: Of all meat which may be eaten, <hi type="italic">that</hi> on which <hi type="italic">such</hi> water cometh shall be unclean: and all drink that may be drunk in every <hi type="italic">such</hi> vessel shall be unclean.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:35
verses.text: And every <hi type="italic">thing</hi> whereupon <hi type="italic">any part</hi> of their carcase falleth shall be unclean; <hi type="italic">whether it be</hi> oven, or ranges for pots, they shall be broken down: <hi type="italic">for</hi> they <hi type="italic">are</hi> unclean, and shall be unclean unto you.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:36
verses.text: Nevertheless a fountain or pit, <hi type="italic">wherein there is</hi> plenty of water, shall be clean: but that which toucheth their carcase shall be unclean.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:37
verses.text: And if <hi type="italic">any part</hi> of their carcase fall upon any sowing seed which is to be sown, it <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> clean.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:38
verses.text: But if <hi type="italic">any</hi> water be put upon the seed, and <hi type="italic">any part</hi> of their carcase fall thereon, it <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> unclean unto you.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:39
verses.text: And if any beast, of which ye may eat, die; he that toucheth the carcase thereof shall be unclean until the even.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:40
verses.text: And he that eateth of the carcase of it shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: he also that beareth the carcase of it shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:41
verses.text: And every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> an abomination; it shall not be eaten.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:42
verses.text: Whatsoever goeth upon the belly, and whatsoever goeth upon <hi type="italic">all</hi> four, or whatsoever hath more feet among all creeping things that creep upon the earth, them ye shall not eat; for they <hi type="italic">are</hi> an abomination.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:43
verses.text: Ye shall not make yourselves abominable with any creeping thing that creepeth, neither shall ye make yourselves unclean with them, that ye should be defiled thereby.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:44
verses.text: For I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord your God: ye shall therefore sanctify yourselves, and ye shall be holy; for I <hi type="italic">am</hi> holy: neither shall ye defile yourselves with any manner of creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:45
verses.text: For I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord that bringeth you up out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: ye shall therefore be holy, for I <hi type="italic">am</hi> holy.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:46
verses.text: This <hi type="italic">is</hi> the law of the beasts, and of the fowl, and of every living creature that moveth in the waters, and of every creature that creepeth upon the earth:

verses.name: Leviticus 11:47
verses.text: To make a difference between the unclean and the clean, and between the beast that may be eaten and the beast that may not be eaten.  <chapter eID="Lev.11"/><div eID="gen105" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 12:1
verses.text: AND the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 12:2
verses.text: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a woman have conceived seed, and born a man child: then she shall be unclean seven days; according to the days of the separation for her infirmity shall she be unclean.

verses.name: Leviticus 12:3
verses.text: And in the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised.

verses.name: Leviticus 12:4
verses.text: And she shall then continue in the blood of her purifying three and thirty days; she shall touch no hallowed thing, nor come into the sanctuary, until the days of her purifying be fulfilled.

verses.name: Leviticus 12:5
verses.text: But if she bear a maid child, then she shall be unclean two weeks, as in her separation: and she shall continue in the blood of her purifying threescore and six days.

verses.name: Leviticus 12:6
verses.text: And when the days of her purifying are fulfilled, for a son, or for a daughter, she shall bring a lamb of the first year for a burnt offering, and a young pigeon, or a turtledove, for a sin offering, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, unto the priest:

verses.name: Leviticus 12:7
verses.text: Who shall offer it before the Lord, and make an atonement for her; and she shall be cleansed from the issue of her blood. This <hi type="italic">is</hi> the law for her that hath born a male or a female.

verses.name: Leviticus 12:8
verses.text: And if she be not able to bring a lamb, then she shall bring two turtles, or two young pigeons; the one for the burnt offering, and the other for a sin offering: and the priest shall make an atonement for her, and she shall be clean.  <chapter eID="Lev.12"/><div eID="gen106" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 13:1
verses.text: AND the Lord spake unto Moses and Aaron, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 13:2
verses.text: When a man shall have in the skin of his flesh a rising, a scab, or bright spot, and it be in the skin of his flesh <hi type="italic">like</hi> the plague of leprosy; then he shall be brought unto Aaron the priest, or unto one of his sons the priests:

verses.name: Leviticus 13:3
verses.text: And the priest shall look on the plague in the skin of the flesh: and <hi type="italic">when</hi> the hair in the plague is turned white, and the plague in sight <hi type="italic">be</hi> deeper than the skin of his flesh, it <hi type="italic">is</hi> a plague of leprosy: and the priest shall look on him, and pronounce him unclean.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:4
verses.text: If the bright spot <hi type="italic">be</hi> white in the skin of his flesh, and in sight <hi type="italic">be</hi> not deeper than the skin, and the hair thereof be not turned white; then the priest shall shut up <hi type="italic">him that hath</hi> the plague seven days:

verses.name: Leviticus 13:5
verses.text: And the priest shall look on him the seventh day: and, behold, <hi type="italic">if</hi> the plague in his sight be at a stay, <hi type="italic">and</hi> the plague spread not in the skin; then the priest shall shut him up seven days more:

verses.name: Leviticus 13:6
verses.text: And the priest shall look on him again the seventh day: and, behold, <hi type="italic">if</hi> the plague <hi type="italic">be</hi> somewhat dark, <hi type="italic">and</hi> the plague spread not in the skin, the priest shall pronounce him clean: it <hi type="italic">is but</hi> a scab: and he shall wash his clothes, and be clean.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:7
verses.text: But if the scab spread much abroad in the skin, after that he hath been seen of the priest for his cleansing, he shall be seen of the priest again:

verses.name: Leviticus 13:8
verses.text: And <hi type="italic">if</hi> the priest see that, behold, the scab spreadeth in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it <hi type="italic">is</hi> a leprosy.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:9
verses.text: ¶ When the plague of leprosy is in a man, then he shall be brought unto the priest;

verses.name: Leviticus 13:10
verses.text: And the priest shall see <hi type="italic">him:</hi> and, behold, <hi type="italic">if</hi> the rising <hi type="italic">be</hi> white in the skin, and it have turned the hair white, and <hi type="italic">there be</hi> quick raw flesh in the rising;

verses.name: Leviticus 13:11
verses.text: It <hi type="italic">is</hi> an old leprosy in the skin of his flesh, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean, and shall not shut him up: for he <hi type="italic">is</hi> unclean.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:12
verses.text: And if a leprosy break out abroad in the skin, and the leprosy cover all the skin of <hi type="italic">him that hath</hi> the plague from his head even to his foot, wheresoever the priest looketh;

verses.name: Leviticus 13:13
verses.text: Then the priest shall consider: and, behold, <hi type="italic">if</hi> the leprosy have covered all his flesh, he shall pronounce <hi type="italic">him</hi> clean <hi type="italic">that hath</hi> the plague: it is all turned white: he <hi type="italic">is</hi> clean.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:14
verses.text: But when raw flesh appeareth in him, he shall be unclean.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:15
verses.text: And the priest shall see the raw flesh, and pronounce him to be unclean: <hi type="italic">for</hi> the raw flesh <hi type="italic">is</hi> unclean: it <hi type="italic">is</hi> a leprosy.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:16
verses.text: Or if the raw flesh turn again, and be changed unto white, he shall come unto the priest;

verses.name: Leviticus 13:17
verses.text: And the priest shall see him: and, behold, <hi type="italic">if</hi> the plague be turned into white; then the priest shall pronounce <hi type="italic">him</hi> clean <hi type="italic">that hath</hi> the plague: he <hi type="italic">is</hi> clean.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:18
verses.text: ¶ The flesh also, in which, <hi type="italic">even</hi> in the skin thereof, was a boil, and is healed,

verses.name: Leviticus 13:19
verses.text: And in the place of the boil there be a white rising, or a bright spot, white, and somewhat reddish, and it be shewed to the priest;

verses.name: Leviticus 13:20
verses.text: And if, when the priest seeth it, behold, it <hi type="italic">be</hi> in sight lower than the skin, and the hair thereof be turned white; the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it <hi type="italic">is</hi> a plague of leprosy broken out of the boil.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:21
verses.text: But if the priest look on it, and, behold, <hi type="italic">there be</hi> no white hairs therein, and <hi type="italic">if</hi> it <hi type="italic">be</hi> not lower than the skin, but <hi type="italic">be</hi> somewhat dark; then the priest shall shut him up seven days:

verses.name: Leviticus 13:22
verses.text: And if it spread much abroad in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it <hi type="italic">is</hi> a plague.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:23
verses.text: But if the bright spot stay in his place, <hi type="italic">and</hi> spread not, it <hi type="italic">is</hi> a burning boil; and the priest shall pronounce him clean.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:24
verses.text: ¶ Or if there be <hi type="italic">any</hi> flesh, in the skin whereof <hi type="italic">there is</hi> a hot burning, and the quick <hi type="italic">flesh</hi> that burneth have a white bright spot, somewhat reddish, or white;

verses.name: Leviticus 13:25
verses.text: Then the priest shall look upon it: and, behold, <hi type="italic">if</hi> the hair in the bright spot be turned white, and it <hi type="italic">be in</hi> sight deeper than the skin; it <hi type="italic">is</hi> a leprosy broken out of the burning: wherefore the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it <hi type="italic">is</hi> the plague of leprosy.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:26
verses.text: But if the priest look on it, and, behold, <hi type="italic">there be</hi> no white hair in the bright spot, and it <hi type="italic">be</hi> no lower than the <hi type="italic">other</hi> skin, but <hi type="italic">be</hi> somewhat dark; then the priest shall shut him up seven days:

verses.name: Leviticus 13:27
verses.text: And the priest shall look upon him the seventh day: <hi type="italic">and</hi> if it be spread much abroad in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it <hi type="italic">is</hi> the plague of leprosy.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:28
verses.text: And if the bright spot stay in his place, <hi type="italic">and</hi> spread not in the skin, but it <hi type="italic">be</hi> somewhat dark; it <hi type="italic">is</hi> a rising of the burning, and the priest shall pronounce him clean: for it <hi type="italic">is</hi> an inflammation of the burning.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:29
verses.text: ¶ If a man or woman have a plague upon the head or the beard;

verses.name: Leviticus 13:30
verses.text: Then the priest shall see the plague: and, behold, if it <hi type="italic">be</hi> in sight deeper than the skin; <hi type="italic">and there be</hi> in it a yellow thin hair; then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it <hi type="italic">is</hi> a dry scall, <hi type="italic">even</hi> a leprosy upon the head or beard.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:31
verses.text: And if the priest look on the plague of the scall, and, behold, it <hi type="italic">be</hi> not in sight deeper than the skin, and <hi type="italic">that there is</hi> no black hair in it; then the priest shall shut up <hi type="italic">him that hath</hi> the plague of the scall seven days:

verses.name: Leviticus 13:32
verses.text: And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the plague: and, behold, <hi type="italic">if</hi> the scall spread not, and there be in it no yellow hair, and the scall <hi type="italic">be</hi> not in sight deeper than the skin;

verses.name: Leviticus 13:33
verses.text: He shall be shaven, but the scall shall he not shave; and the priest shall shut up <hi type="italic">him that hath</hi> the scall seven days more:

verses.name: Leviticus 13:34
verses.text: And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the scall: and, behold, <hi type="italic">if</hi> the scall be not spread in the skin, nor <hi type="italic">be</hi> in sight deeper than the skin; then the priest shall pronounce him clean: and he shall wash his clothes, and be clean.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:35
verses.text: But if the scall spread much in the skin after his cleansing;

verses.name: Leviticus 13:36
verses.text: Then the priest shall look on him: and, behold, if the scall be spread in the skin, the priest shall not seek for yellow hair; he <hi type="italic">is</hi> unclean.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:37
verses.text: But if the scall be in his sight at a stay, and <hi type="italic">that</hi> there is black hair grown up therein; the scall is healed, he <hi type="italic">is</hi> clean: and the priest shall pronounce him clean.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:38
verses.text: ¶ If a man also or a woman have in the skin of their flesh bright spots, <hi type="italic">even</hi> white bright spots;

verses.name: Leviticus 13:39
verses.text: Then the priest shall look: and, behold, <hi type="italic">if</hi> the bright spots in the skin of their flesh <hi type="italic">be</hi> darkish white; it <hi type="italic">is</hi> a freckled spot <hi type="italic">that</hi> groweth in the skin; he <hi type="italic">is</hi> clean.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:40
verses.text: And the man whose hair is fallen off his head, he <hi type="italic">is</hi> bald; <hi type="italic">yet is</hi> he clean.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:41
verses.text: And he that hath his hair fallen off from the part of his head toward his face, he <hi type="italic">is</hi> forehead bald: <hi type="italic">yet is</hi> he clean.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:42
verses.text: And if there be in the bald head, or bald forehead, a white reddish sore; it <hi type="italic">is</hi> a leprosy sprung up in his bald head, or his bald forehead.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:43
verses.text: Then the priest shall look upon it: and, behold, <hi type="italic">if</hi> the rising of the sore <hi type="italic">be</hi> white reddish in his bald head, or in his bald forehead, as the leprosy appeareth in the skin of the flesh;

verses.name: Leviticus 13:44
verses.text: He is a leprous man, he <hi type="italic">is</hi> unclean: the priest shall pronounce him utterly unclean; his plague <hi type="italic">is</hi> in his head.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:45
verses.text: And the leper in whom the plague <hi type="italic">is</hi>, his clothes shall be rent, and his head bare, and he shall put a covering upon his upper lip, and shall cry, Unclean, unclean.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:46
verses.text: All the days wherein the plague <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> in him he shall be defiled; he <hi type="italic">is</hi> unclean: he shall dwell alone; without the camp <hi type="italic">shall</hi> his habitation <hi type="italic">be</hi>.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:47
verses.text: ¶ The garment also that the plague of leprosy is in, <hi type="italic">whether it be</hi> a woollen garment, or a linen garment;

verses.name: Leviticus 13:48
verses.text: Whether <hi type="italic">it be</hi> in the warp, or woof; of linen, or of woollen; whether in a skin, or in any thing made of skin;

verses.name: Leviticus 13:49
verses.text: And if the plague be greenish or reddish in the garment, or in the skin, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin; it <hi type="italic">is</hi> a plague of leprosy, and shall be shewed unto the priest:

verses.name: Leviticus 13:50
verses.text: And the priest shall look upon the plague, and shut up <hi type="italic">it that hath</hi> the plague seven days:

verses.name: Leviticus 13:51
verses.text: And he shall look on the plague on the seventh day: if the plague be spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in a skin, <hi type="italic">or</hi> in any work that is made of skin; the plague <hi type="italic">is</hi> a fretting leprosy; it <hi type="italic">is</hi> unclean.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:52
verses.text: He shall therefore burn that garment, whether warp or woof, in woollen or in linen, or any thing of skin, wherein the plague is: for it <hi type="italic">is</hi> a fretting leprosy; it shall be burnt in the fire.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:53
verses.text: And if the priest shall look, and, behold, the plague be not spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin;

verses.name: Leviticus 13:54
verses.text: Then the priest shall command that they wash <hi type="italic">the thing</hi> wherein the plague <hi type="italic">is</hi>, and he shall shut it up seven days more:

verses.name: Leviticus 13:55
verses.text: And the priest shall look on the plague, after that it is washed: and, behold, <hi type="italic">if</hi> the plague have not changed his colour, and the plague be not spread; it <hi type="italic">is</hi> unclean; thou shalt burn it in the fire; it <hi type="italic">is</hi> fret inward, <hi type="italic">whether</hi> it <hi type="italic">be</hi> bare within or without.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:56
verses.text: And if the priest look, and, behold, the plague <hi type="italic">be</hi> somewhat dark after the washing of it; then he shall rend it out of the garment, or out of the skin, or out of the warp, or out of the woof:

verses.name: Leviticus 13:57
verses.text: And if it appear still in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin; it <hi type="italic">is</hi> a spreading <hi type="italic">plague:</hi> thou shalt burn that wherein the plague <hi type="italic">is</hi> with fire.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:58
verses.text: And the garment, either warp, or woof, or whatsoever thing of skin <hi type="italic">it be</hi>, which thou shalt wash, if the plague be departed from them, then it shall be washed the second time, and shall be clean.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:59
verses.text: This <hi type="italic">is</hi> the law of the plague of leprosy in a garment of woollen or linen, either in the warp, or woof, or any thing of skins, to pronounce it clean, or to pronounce it unclean.  <chapter eID="Lev.13"/><div eID="gen107" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 14:1
verses.text: AND the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 14:2
verses.text: This shall be the law of the leper in the day of his cleansing: He shall be brought unto the priest:

verses.name: Leviticus 14:3
verses.text: And the priest shall go forth out of the camp; and the priest shall look, and, behold, <hi type="italic">if</hi> the plague of leprosy be healed in the leper;

verses.name: Leviticus 14:4
verses.text: Then shall the priest command to take for him that is to be cleansed two birds alive <hi type="italic">and</hi> clean, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop:

verses.name: Leviticus 14:5
verses.text: And the priest shall command that one of the birds be killed in an earthen vessel over running water:

verses.name: Leviticus 14:6
verses.text: As for the living bird, he shall take it, and the cedar wood, and the scarlet, and the hyssop, and shall dip them and the living bird in the blood of the bird <hi type="italic">that was</hi> killed over the running water:

verses.name: Leviticus 14:7
verses.text: And he shall sprinkle upon him that is to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times, and shall pronounce him clean, and shall let the living bird loose into the open field.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:8
verses.text: And he that is to be cleansed shall wash his clothes, and shave off all his hair, and wash himself in water, that he may be clean: and after that he shall come into the camp, and shall tarry abroad out of his tent seven days.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:9
verses.text: But it shall be on the seventh day, that he shall shave all his hair off his head and his beard and his eyebrows, even all his hair he shall shave off: and he shall wash his clothes, also he shall wash his flesh in water, and he shall be clean.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:10
verses.text: And on the eighth day he shall take two he lambs without blemish, and one ewe lamb of the first year without blemish, and three tenth deals of fine flour <hi type="italic">for</hi> a meat offering, mingled with oil, and one log of oil.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:11
verses.text: And the priest that maketh <hi type="italic">him</hi> clean shall present the man that is to be made clean, and those things, before the Lord, <hi type="italic">at</hi> the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:

verses.name: Leviticus 14:12
verses.text: And the priest shall take one he lamb, and offer him for a trespass offering, and the log of oil, and wave them <hi type="italic">for</hi> a wave offering before the Lord:

verses.name: Leviticus 14:13
verses.text: And he shall slay the lamb in the place where he shall kill the sin offering and the burnt offering, in the holy place: for as the sin offering <hi type="italic">is</hi> the priest’s, <hi type="italic">so is</hi> the trespass offering: it <hi type="italic">is</hi> most holy:

verses.name: Leviticus 14:14
verses.text: And the priest shall take <hi type="italic">some</hi> of the blood of the trespass offering, and the priest shall put <hi type="italic">it</hi> upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot:

verses.name: Leviticus 14:15
verses.text: And the priest shall take <hi type="italic">some</hi> of the log of oil, and pour <hi type="italic">it</hi> into the palm of his own left hand:

verses.name: Leviticus 14:16
verses.text: And the priest shall dip his right finger in the oil that <hi type="italic">is</hi> in his left hand, and shall sprinkle of the oil with his finger seven times before the Lord:

verses.name: Leviticus 14:17
verses.text: And of the rest of the oil that <hi type="italic">is</hi> in his hand shall the priest put upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot, upon the blood of the trespass offering:

verses.name: Leviticus 14:18
verses.text: And the remnant of the oil that <hi type="italic">is</hi> in the priest’s hand he shall pour upon the head of him that is to be cleansed: and the priest shall make an atonement for him before the Lord.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:19
verses.text: And the priest shall offer the sin offering, and make an atonement for him that is to be cleansed from his uncleanness; and afterward he shall kill the burnt offering:

verses.name: Leviticus 14:20
verses.text: And the priest shall offer the burnt offering and the meat offering upon the altar: and the priest shall make an atonement for him, and he shall be clean.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:21
verses.text: And if he <hi type="italic">be</hi> poor, and cannot get so much; then he shall take one lamb <hi type="italic">for</hi> a trespass offering to be waved, to make an atonement for him, and one tenth deal of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering, and a log of oil;

verses.name: Leviticus 14:22
verses.text: And two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, such as he is able to get; and the one shall be a sin offering, and the other a burnt offering.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:23
verses.text: And he shall bring them on the eighth day for his cleansing unto the priest, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, before the Lord.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:24
verses.text: And the priest shall take the lamb of the trespass offering, and the log of oil, and the priest shall wave them <hi type="italic">for</hi> a wave offering before the Lord:

verses.name: Leviticus 14:25
verses.text: And he shall kill the lamb of the trespass offering, and the priest shall take <hi type="italic">some</hi> of the blood of the trespass offering, and put <hi type="italic">it</hi> upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot:

verses.name: Leviticus 14:26
verses.text: And the priest shall pour of the oil into the palm of his own left hand:

verses.name: Leviticus 14:27
verses.text: And the priest shall sprinkle with his right finger <hi type="italic">some</hi> of the oil that <hi type="italic">is</hi> in his left hand seven times before the Lord:

verses.name: Leviticus 14:28
verses.text: And the priest shall put of the oil that <hi type="italic">is</hi> in his hand upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot, upon the place of the blood of the trespass offering:

verses.name: Leviticus 14:29
verses.text: And the rest of the oil that <hi type="italic">is</hi> in the priest’s hand he shall put upon the head of him that is to be cleansed, to make an atonement for him before the Lord.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:30
verses.text: And he shall offer the one of the turtledoves, or of the young pigeons, such as he can get;

verses.name: Leviticus 14:31
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Even</hi> such as he is able to get, the one <hi type="italic">for</hi> a sin offering, and the other <hi type="italic">for</hi> a burnt offering, with the meat offering: and the priest shall make an atonement for him that is to be cleansed before the Lord.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:32
verses.text: This <hi type="italic">is</hi> the law <hi type="italic">of him</hi> in whom <hi type="italic">is</hi> the plague of leprosy, whose hand is not able to get <hi type="italic">that which pertaineth</hi> to his cleansing.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:33
verses.text: ¶ And the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 14:34
verses.text: When ye be come into the land of Canaan, which I give to you for a possession, and I put the plague of leprosy in a house of the land of your possession;

verses.name: Leviticus 14:35
verses.text: And he that owneth the house shall come and tell the priest, saying, It seemeth to me <hi type="italic">there is</hi> as it were a plague in the house:

verses.name: Leviticus 14:36
verses.text: Then the priest shall command that they empty the house, before the priest go <hi type="italic">into it</hi> to see the plague, that all that <hi type="italic">is</hi> in the house be not made unclean: and afterward the priest shall go in to see the house:

verses.name: Leviticus 14:37
verses.text: And he shall look on the plague, and, behold, <hi type="italic">if</hi> the plague <hi type="italic">be</hi> in the walls of the house with hollow strakes, greenish or reddish, which in sight <hi type="italic">are</hi> lower than the wall;

verses.name: Leviticus 14:38
verses.text: Then the priest shall go out of the house to the door of the house, and shut up the house seven days:

verses.name: Leviticus 14:39
verses.text: And the priest shall come again the seventh day, and shall look: and, behold, <hi type="italic">if</hi> the plague be spread in the walls of the house;

verses.name: Leviticus 14:40
verses.text: Then the priest shall command that they take away the stones in which the plague <hi type="italic">is</hi>, and they shall cast them into an unclean place without the city:

verses.name: Leviticus 14:41
verses.text: And he shall cause the house to be scraped within round about, and they shall pour out the dust that they scrape off without the city into an unclean place:

verses.name: Leviticus 14:42
verses.text: And they shall take other stones, and put <hi type="italic">them</hi> in the place of those stones; and he shall take other morter, and shall plaister the house.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:43
verses.text: And if the plague come again, and break out in the house, after that he hath taken away the stones, and after he hath scraped the house, and after it is plaistered;

verses.name: Leviticus 14:44
verses.text: Then the priest shall come and look, and, behold, <hi type="italic">if</hi> the plague be spread in the house, it <hi type="italic">is</hi> a fretting leprosy in the house: it <hi type="italic">is</hi> unclean.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:45
verses.text: And he shall break down the house, the stones of it, and the timber thereof, and all the morter of the house; and he shall carry <hi type="italic">them</hi> forth out of the city into an unclean place.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:46
verses.text: Moreover he that goeth into the house all the while that it is shut up shall be unclean until the even.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:47
verses.text: And he that lieth in the house shall wash his clothes; and he that eateth in the house shall wash his clothes.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:48
verses.text: And if the priest shall come in, and look <hi type="italic">upon it</hi>, and, behold, the plague hath not spread in the house, after the house was plaistered: then the priest shall pronounce the house clean, because the plague is healed.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:49
verses.text: And he shall take to cleanse the house two birds, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop:

verses.name: Leviticus 14:50
verses.text: And he shall kill the one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water:

verses.name: Leviticus 14:51
verses.text: And he shall take the cedar wood, and the hyssop, and the scarlet, and the living bird, and dip them in the blood of the slain bird, and in the running water, and sprinkle the house seven times:

verses.name: Leviticus 14:52
verses.text: And he shall cleanse the house with the blood of the bird, and with the running water, and with the living bird, and with the cedar wood, and with the hyssop, and with the scarlet:

verses.name: Leviticus 14:53
verses.text: But he shall let go the living bird out of the city into the open fields, and make an atonement for the house: and it shall be clean.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:54
verses.text: This <hi type="italic">is</hi> the law for all manner of plague of leprosy, and scall,

verses.name: Leviticus 14:55
verses.text: And for the leprosy of a garment, and of a house,

verses.name: Leviticus 14:56
verses.text: And for a rising, and for a scab, and for a bright spot:

verses.name: Leviticus 14:57
verses.text: To teach when <hi type="italic">it is</hi> unclean, and when <hi type="italic">it is</hi> clean: this <hi type="italic">is</hi> the law of leprosy.  <chapter eID="Lev.14"/><div eID="gen108" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 15:1
verses.text: AND the Lord spake unto Moses and to Aaron, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 15:2
verses.text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When any man hath a running issue out of his flesh, <hi type="italic">because of</hi> his issue he <hi type="italic">is</hi> unclean.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:3
verses.text: And this shall be his uncleanness in his issue: whether his flesh run with his issue, or his flesh be stopped from his issue, it <hi type="italic">is</hi> his uncleanness.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:4
verses.text: Every bed, whereon he lieth that hath the issue, is unclean: and every thing, whereon he sitteth, shall be unclean.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:5
verses.text: And whosoever toucheth his bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe <hi type="italic">himself</hi> in water, and be unclean until the even.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:6
verses.text: And he that sitteth on <hi type="italic">any</hi> thing whereon he sat that hath the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe <hi type="italic">himself</hi> in water, and be unclean until the even.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:7
verses.text: And he that toucheth the flesh of him that hath the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe <hi type="italic">himself</hi> in water, and be unclean until the even.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:8
verses.text: And if he that hath the issue spit upon him that is clean; then he shall wash his clothes, and bathe <hi type="italic">himself</hi> in water, and be unclean until the even.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:9
verses.text: And what saddle soever he rideth upon that hath the issue shall be unclean.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:10
verses.text: And whosoever toucheth any thing that was under him shall be unclean until the even: and he that beareth <hi type="italic">any of</hi> those things shall wash his clothes, and bathe <hi type="italic">himself</hi> in water, and be unclean until the even.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:11
verses.text: And whomsoever he toucheth that hath the issue, and hath not rinsed his hands in water, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe <hi type="italic">himself</hi> in water, and be unclean until the even.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:12
verses.text: And the vessel of earth, that he toucheth which hath the issue, shall be broken: and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:13
verses.text: And when he that hath an issue is cleansed of his issue; then he shall number to himself seven days for his cleansing, and wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in running water, and shall be clean.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:14
verses.text: And on the eighth day he shall take to him two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and come before the Lord unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and give them unto the priest:

verses.name: Leviticus 15:15
verses.text: And the priest shall offer them, the one <hi type="italic">for</hi> a sin offering, and the other <hi type="italic">for</hi> a burnt offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for him before the Lord for his issue.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:16
verses.text: And if any man’s seed of copulation go out from him, then he shall wash all his flesh in water, and be unclean until the even.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:17
verses.text: And every garment, and every skin, whereon is the seed of copulation, shall be washed with water, and be unclean until the even.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:18
verses.text: The woman also with whom man shall lie <hi type="italic">with</hi> seed of copulation, they shall <hi type="italic">both</hi> bathe <hi type="italic">themselves</hi> in water, and be unclean until the even.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:19
verses.text: ¶ And if a woman have an issue, <hi type="italic">and</hi> her issue in her flesh be blood, she shall be put apart seven days: and whosoever toucheth her shall be unclean until the even.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:20
verses.text: And every thing that she lieth upon in her separation shall be unclean: every thing also that she sitteth upon shall be unclean.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:21
verses.text: And whosoever toucheth her bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe <hi type="italic">himself</hi> in water, and be unclean until the even.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:22
verses.text: And whosoever toucheth any thing that she sat upon shall wash his clothes, and bathe <hi type="italic">himself</hi> in water, and be unclean until the even.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:23
verses.text: And if it <hi type="italic">be</hi> on <hi type="italic">her</hi> bed, or on any thing whereon she sitteth, when he toucheth it, he shall be unclean until the even.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:24
verses.text: And if any man lie with her at all, and her flowers be upon him, he shall be unclean seven days; and all the bed whereon he lieth shall be unclean.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:25
verses.text: And if a woman have an issue of her blood many days out of the time of her separation, or if it run beyond the time of her separation; all the days of the issue of her uncleanness shall be as the days of her separation: she <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> unclean.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:26
verses.text: Every bed whereon she lieth all the days of her issue shall be unto her as the bed of her separation: and whatsoever she sitteth upon shall be unclean, as the uncleanness of her separation.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:27
verses.text: And whosoever toucheth those things shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes, and bathe <hi type="italic">himself</hi> in water, and be unclean until the even.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:28
verses.text: But if she be cleansed of her issue, then she shall number to herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:29
verses.text: And on the eighth day she shall take unto her two turtles, or two young pigeons, and bring them unto the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:30
verses.text: And the priest shall offer the one <hi type="italic">for</hi> a sin offering, and the other <hi type="italic">for</hi> a burnt offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for her before the Lord for the issue of her uncleanness.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:31
verses.text: Thus shall ye separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness; that they die not in their uncleanness, when they defile my tabernacle that <hi type="italic">is</hi> among them.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:32
verses.text: This <hi type="italic">is</hi> the law of him that hath an issue, and <hi type="italic">of him</hi> whose seed goeth from him, and is defiled therewith;

verses.name: Leviticus 15:33
verses.text: And of her that is sick of her flowers, and of him that hath an issue, of the man, and of the woman, and of him that lieth with her that is unclean.  <chapter eID="Lev.15"/><div eID="gen109" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 16:1
verses.text: AND the Lord spake unto Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they offered before the Lord, and died;

verses.name: Leviticus 16:2
verses.text: And the Lord said unto Moses, Speak unto Aaron thy brother, that he come not at all times into the holy <hi type="italic">place</hi> within the vail before the mercy seat, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> upon the ark; that he die not: for I will appear in the cloud upon the mercy seat.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:3
verses.text: Thus shall Aaron come into the holy <hi type="italic">place:</hi> with a young bullock for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:4
verses.text: He shall put on the holy linen coat, and he shall have the linen breeches upon his flesh, and shall be girded with a linen girdle, and with the linen mitre shall he be attired: these <hi type="italic">are</hi> holy garments; therefore shall he wash his flesh in water, and <hi type="italic">so</hi> put them on.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:5
verses.text: And he shall take of the congregation of the children of Israel two kids of the goats for a sin offering, and one ram for a burnt offering.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:6
verses.text: And Aaron shall offer his bullock of the sin offering, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> for himself, and make an atonement for himself, and for his house.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:7
verses.text: And he shall take the two goats, and present them before the Lord <hi type="italic">at</hi> the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:8
verses.text: And Aaron shall cast lots upon the two goats; one lot for the Lord, and the other lot for the scapegoat.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:9
verses.text: And Aaron shall bring the goat upon which the Lord’s lot fell, and offer him <hi type="italic">for</hi> a sin offering.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:10
verses.text: But the goat, on which the lot fell to be the scapegoat, shall be presented alive before the Lord, to make an atonement with him, <hi type="italic">and</hi> to let him go for a scapegoat into the wilderness.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:11
verses.text: And Aaron shall bring the bullock of the sin offering, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> for himself, and shall make an atonement for himself, and for his house, and shall kill the bullock of the sin offering which <hi type="italic">is</hi> for himself:

verses.name: Leviticus 16:12
verses.text: And he shall take a censer full of burning coals of fire from off the altar before the Lord, and his hands full of sweet incense beaten small, and bring <hi type="italic">it</hi> within the vail:

verses.name: Leviticus 16:13
verses.text: And he shall put the incense upon the fire before the Lord, that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy seat that <hi type="italic">is</hi> upon the testimony, that he die not:

verses.name: Leviticus 16:14
verses.text: And he shall take of the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle <hi type="italic">it</hi> with his finger upon the mercy seat eastward; and before the mercy seat shall he sprinkle of the blood with his finger seven times.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:15
verses.text: ¶ Then shall he kill the goat of the sin offering, that <hi type="italic">is</hi> for the people, and bring his blood within the vail, and do with that blood as he did with the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it upon the mercy seat, and before the mercy seat:

verses.name: Leviticus 16:16
verses.text: And he shall make an atonement for the holy <hi type="italic">place</hi>, because of the uncleanness of the children of Israel, and because of their transgressions in all their sins: and so shall he do for the tabernacle of the congregation, that remaineth among them in the midst of their uncleanness.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:17
verses.text: And there shall be no man in the tabernacle of the congregation when he goeth in to make an atonement in the holy <hi type="italic">place</hi>, until he come out, and have made an atonement for himself, and for his household, and for all the congregation of Israel.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:18
verses.text: And he shall go out unto the altar that <hi type="italic">is</hi> before the Lord, and make an atonement for it; and shall take of the blood of the bullock, and of the blood of the goat, and put <hi type="italic">it</hi> upon the horns of the altar round about.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:19
verses.text: And he shall sprinkle of the blood upon it with his finger seven times, and cleanse it, and hallow it from the uncleanness of the children of Israel.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:20
verses.text: ¶ And when he hath made an end of reconciling the holy <hi type="italic">place</hi>, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and the altar, he shall bring the live goat:

verses.name: Leviticus 16:21
verses.text: And Aaron shall lay both his hands upon the head of the live goat, and confess over him all the iniquities of the children of Israel, and all their transgressions in all their sins, putting them upon the head of the goat, and shall send <hi type="italic">him</hi> away by the hand of a fit man into the wilderness:

verses.name: Leviticus 16:22
verses.text: And the goat shall bear upon him all their iniquities unto a land not inhabited: and he shall let go the goat in the wilderness.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:23
verses.text: And Aaron shall come into the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall put off the linen garments, which he put on when he went into the holy <hi type="italic">place</hi>, and shall leave them there:

verses.name: Leviticus 16:24
verses.text: And he shall wash his flesh with water in the holy place, and put on his garments, and come forth, and offer his burnt offering, and the burnt offering of the people, and make an atonement for himself, and for the people.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:25
verses.text: And the fat of the sin offering shall he burn upon the altar.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:26
verses.text: And he that let go the goat for the scapegoat shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward come into the camp.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:27
verses.text: And the bullock <hi type="italic">for</hi> the sin offering, and the goat <hi type="italic">for</hi> the sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the holy <hi type="italic">place</hi>, shall <hi type="italic">one</hi> carry forth without the camp; and they shall burn in the fire their skins, and their flesh, and their dung.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:28
verses.text: And he that burneth them shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:29
verses.text: ¶ And <hi type="italic">this</hi> shall be a statute for ever unto you: <hi type="italic">that</hi> in the seventh month, on the tenth <hi type="italic">day</hi> of the month, ye shall afflict your souls, and do no work at all, <hi type="italic">whether it be</hi> one of your own country, or a stranger that sojourneth among you:

verses.name: Leviticus 16:30
verses.text: For on that day shall <hi type="italic">the priest</hi> make an atonement for you, to cleanse you, <hi type="italic">that</hi> ye may be clean from all your sins before the Lord.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:31
verses.text: It <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> a sabbath of rest unto you, and ye shall afflict your souls, by a statute for ever.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:32
verses.text: And the priest, whom he shall anoint, and whom he shall consecrate to minister in the priest’s office in his father’s stead, shall make the atonement, and shall put on the linen clothes, <hi type="italic">even</hi> the holy garments:

verses.name: Leviticus 16:33
verses.text: And he shall make an atonement for the holy sanctuary, and he shall make an atonement for the tabernacle of the congregation, and for the altar, and he shall make an atonement for the priests, and for all the people of the congregation.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:34
verses.text: And this shall be an everlasting statute unto you, to make an atonement for the children of Israel for all their sins once a year. And he did as the Lord commanded Moses.  <chapter eID="Lev.16"/><div eID="gen110" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 17:1
verses.text: AND the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 17:2
verses.text: Speak unto Aaron, and unto his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them; This <hi type="italic">is</hi> the thing which the Lord hath commanded, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 17:3
verses.text: What man soever <hi type="italic">there be</hi> of the house of Israel, that killeth an ox, or lamb, or goat, in the camp, or that killeth <hi type="italic">it</hi> out of the camp,

verses.name: Leviticus 17:4
verses.text: And bringeth it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, to offer an offering unto the Lord before the tabernacle of the Lord; blood shall be imputed unto that man; he hath shed blood; and that man shall be cut off from among his people:

verses.name: Leviticus 17:5
verses.text: To the end that the children of Israel may bring their sacrifices, which they offer in the open field, even that they may bring them unto the Lord, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, unto the priest, and offer them <hi type="italic">for</hi> peace offerings unto the Lord.

verses.name: Leviticus 17:6
verses.text: And the priest shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar of the Lord <hi type="italic">at</hi> the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and burn the fat for a sweet savour unto the Lord.

verses.name: Leviticus 17:7
verses.text: And they shall no more offer their sacrifices unto devils, after whom they have gone a whoring. This shall be a statute for ever unto them throughout their generations.

verses.name: Leviticus 17:8
verses.text: ¶ And thou shalt say unto them, Whatsoever man <hi type="italic">there be</hi> of the house of Israel, or of the strangers which sojourn among you, that offereth a burnt offering or sacrifice,

verses.name: Leviticus 17:9
verses.text: And bringeth it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, to offer it unto the Lord; even that man shall be cut off from among his people.

verses.name: Leviticus 17:10
verses.text: ¶ And whatsoever man <hi type="italic">there be</hi> of the house of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among you, that eateth any manner of blood; I will even set my face against that soul that eateth blood, and will cut him off from among his people.

verses.name: Leviticus 17:11
