verses.text: For the life of the flesh <hi type="italic">is</hi> in the blood: and I have given it to you upon the altar to make an atonement for your souls: for it <hi type="italic">is</hi> the blood <hi type="italic">that</hi> maketh an atonement for the soul.

verses.name: Leviticus 17:12
verses.text: Therefore I said unto the children of Israel, No soul of you shall eat blood, neither shall any stranger that sojourneth among you eat blood.

verses.name: Leviticus 17:13
verses.text: And whatsoever man <hi type="italic">there be</hi> of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among you, which hunteth and catcheth any beast or fowl that may be eaten; he shall even pour out the blood thereof, and cover it with dust.

verses.name: Leviticus 17:14
verses.text: For <hi type="italic">it is</hi> the life of all flesh; the blood of it <hi type="italic">is</hi> for the life thereof: therefore I said unto the children of Israel, Ye shall eat the blood of no manner of flesh: for the life of all flesh <hi type="italic">is</hi> the blood thereof: whosoever eateth it shall be cut off.

verses.name: Leviticus 17:15
verses.text: And every soul that eateth that which died <hi type="italic">of itself</hi>, or that which was torn <hi type="italic">with beasts</hi>, <hi type="italic">whether it be</hi> one of your own country, or a stranger, he shall both wash his clothes, and bathe <hi type="italic">himself</hi> in water, and be unclean until the even: then shall he be clean.

verses.name: Leviticus 17:16
verses.text: But if he wash <hi type="italic">them</hi> not, nor bathe his flesh; then he shall bear his iniquity.  <chapter eID="Lev.17"/><div eID="gen111" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 18:1
verses.text: AND the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 18:2
verses.text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, I am the Lord your God.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:3
verses.text: After the doings of the land of Egypt, wherein ye dwelt, shall ye not do: and after the doings of the land of Canaan, whither I bring you, shall ye not do: neither shall ye walk in their ordinances.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:4
verses.text: Ye shall do my judgments, and keep mine ordinances, to walk therein: I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord your God.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:5
verses.text: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes, and my judgments: which if a man do, he shall live in them: I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:6
verses.text: ¶ None of you shall approach to any that is near of kin to him, to uncover <hi type="italic">their</hi> nakedness: I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:7
verses.text: The nakedness of thy father, or the nakedness of thy mother, shalt thou not uncover: she <hi type="italic">is</hi> thy mother; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:8
verses.text: The nakedness of thy father’s wife shalt thou not uncover: it <hi type="italic">is</hi> thy father’s nakedness.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:9
verses.text: The nakedness of thy sister, the daughter of thy father, or daughter of thy mother, <hi type="italic">whether she be</hi> born at home, or born abroad, <hi type="italic">even</hi> their nakedness thou shalt not uncover.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:10
verses.text: The nakedness of thy son’s daughter, or of thy daughter’s daughter, <hi type="italic">even</hi> their nakedness thou shalt not uncover: for theirs <hi type="italic">is</hi> thine own nakedness.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:11
verses.text: The nakedness of thy father’s wife’s daughter, begotten of thy father, she <hi type="italic">is</hi> thy sister, thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:12
verses.text: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father’s sister: she <hi type="italic">is</hi> thy father’s near kinswoman.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:13
verses.text: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother’s sister: for she <hi type="italic">is</hi> thy mother’s near kinswoman.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:14
verses.text: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father’s brother, thou shalt not approach to his wife: she <hi type="italic">is</hi> thine aunt.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:15
verses.text: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy daughter in law: she <hi type="italic">is</hi> thy son’s wife; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:16
verses.text: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy brother’s wife: it <hi type="italic">is</hi> thy brother’s nakedness.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:17
verses.text: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter, neither shalt thou take her son’s daughter, or her daughter’s daughter, to uncover her nakedness; <hi type="italic">for</hi> they <hi type="italic">are</hi> her near kinswomen: it <hi type="italic">is</hi> wickedness.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:18
verses.text: Neither shalt thou take a wife to her sister, to vex <hi type="italic">her</hi>, to uncover her nakedness, beside the other in her life <hi type="italic">time</hi>.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:19
verses.text: Also thou shalt not approach unto a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is put apart for her uncleanness.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:20
verses.text: Moreover thou shalt not lie carnally with thy neighbour’s wife, to defile thyself with her.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:21
verses.text: And thou shalt not let any of thy seed pass through <hi type="italic">the fire</hi> to Molech, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:22
verses.text: Thou shalt not lie with mankind, as with womankind: it <hi type="italic">is</hi> abomination.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:23
verses.text: Neither shalt thou lie with any beast to defile thyself therewith: neither shall any woman stand before a beast to lie down thereto: it <hi type="italic">is</hi> confusion.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:24
verses.text: Defile not ye yourselves in any of these things: for in all these the nations are defiled which I cast out before you:

verses.name: Leviticus 18:25
verses.text: And the land is defiled: therefore I do visit the iniquity thereof upon it, and the land itself vomiteth out her inhabitants.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:26
verses.text: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes and my judgments, and shall not commit <hi type="italic">any</hi> of these abominations; <hi type="italic">neither</hi> any of your own nation, nor any stranger that sojourneth among you:

verses.name: Leviticus 18:27
verses.text: (For all these abominations have the men of the land done, which <hi type="italic">were</hi> before you, and the land is defiled;)

verses.name: Leviticus 18:28
verses.text: That the land spue not you out also, when ye defile it, as it spued out the nations that <hi type="italic">were</hi> before you.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:29
verses.text: For whosoever shall commit any of these abominations, even the souls that commit <hi type="italic">them</hi> shall be cut off from among their people.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:30
verses.text: Therefore shall ye keep mine ordinance, that <hi type="italic">ye</hi> commit not <hi type="italic">any one</hi> of these abominable customs, which were committed before you, and that ye defile not yourselves therein: I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord your God.  <chapter eID="Lev.18"/><div eID="gen112" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 19:1
verses.text: AND the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 19:2
verses.text: Speak unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, and say unto them, Ye shall be holy: for I the Lord your God <hi type="italic">am</hi> holy.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:3
verses.text: ¶ Ye shall fear every man his mother, and his father, and keep my sabbaths: I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord your God.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:4
verses.text: ¶ Turn ye not unto idols, nor make to yourselves molten gods: I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord your God.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:5
verses.text: ¶ And if ye offer a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the Lord, ye shall offer it at your own will.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:6
verses.text: It shall be eaten the same day ye offer it, and on the morrow: and if ought remain until the third day, it shall be burnt in the fire.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:7
verses.text: And if it be eaten at all on the third day, it <hi type="italic">is</hi> abominable; it shall not be accepted.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:8
verses.text: Therefore <hi type="italic">every one</hi> that eateth it shall bear his iniquity, because he hath profaned the hallowed thing of the Lord: and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:9
verses.text: ¶ And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not wholly reap the corners of thy field, neither shalt thou gather the gleanings of thy harvest.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:10
verses.text: And thou shalt not glean thy vineyard, neither shalt thou gather <hi type="italic">every</hi> grape of thy vineyard; thou shalt leave them for the poor and stranger: I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord your God.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:11
verses.text: ¶ Ye shall not steal, neither deal falsely, neither lie one to another.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:12
verses.text: ¶ And ye shall not swear by my name falsely, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:13
verses.text: ¶ Thou shalt not defraud thy neighbour, neither rob <hi type="italic">him:</hi> the wages of him that is hired shall not abide with thee all night until the morning.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:14
verses.text: ¶ Thou shalt not curse the deaf, nor put a stumblingblock before the blind, but shalt fear thy God: I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:15
verses.text: ¶ Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment: thou shalt not respect the person of the poor, nor honour the person of the mighty: <hi type="italic">but</hi> in righteousness shalt thou judge thy neighbour.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:16
verses.text: ¶ Thou shalt not go up and down <hi type="italic">as</hi> a talebearer among thy people: neither shalt thou stand against the blood of thy neighbour: I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:17
verses.text: ¶ Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thine heart: thou shalt in any wise rebuke thy neighbour, and not suffer sin upon him.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:18
verses.text: ¶ Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:19
verses.text: ¶ Ye shall keep my statutes. Thou shalt not let thy cattle gender with a diverse kind: thou shalt not sow thy field with mingled seed: neither shall a garment mingled of linen and woollen come upon thee.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:20
verses.text: ¶ And whosoever lieth carnally with a woman, that <hi type="italic">is</hi> a bondmaid, betrothed to an husband, and not at all redeemed, nor freedom given her; she shall be scourged; they shall not be put to death, because she was not free.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:21
verses.text: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the Lord, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, <hi type="italic">even</hi> a ram for a trespass offering.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:22
verses.text: And the priest shall make an atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering before the Lord for his sin which he hath done: and the sin which he hath done shall be forgiven him.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:23
verses.text: ¶ And when ye shall come into the land, and shall have planted all manner of trees for food, then ye shall count the fruit thereof as uncircumcised: three years shall it be as uncircumcised unto you: it shall not be eaten of.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:24
verses.text: But in the fourth year all the fruit thereof shall be holy to praise the Lord <hi type="italic">withal</hi>.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:25
verses.text: And in the fifth year shall ye eat of the fruit thereof, that it may yield unto you the increase thereof: I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord your God.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:26
verses.text: ¶ Ye shall not eat <hi type="italic">any thing</hi> with the blood: neither shall ye use enchantment, nor observe times.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:27
verses.text: Ye shall not round the corners of your heads, neither shalt thou mar the corners of thy beard.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:28
verses.text: Ye shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor print any marks upon you: I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:29
verses.text: ¶ Do not prostitute thy daughter, to cause her to be a whore; lest the land fall to whoredom, and the land become full of wickedness.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:30
verses.text: ¶ Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:31
verses.text: ¶ Regard not them that have familiar spirits, neither seek after wizards, to be defiled by them: I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord your God.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:32
verses.text: ¶ Thou shalt rise up before the hoary head, and honour the face of the old man, and fear thy God: I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:33
verses.text: ¶ And if a stranger sojourn with thee in your land, ye shall not vex him.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:34
verses.text: <hi type="italic">But</hi> the stranger that dwelleth with you shall be unto you as one born among you, and thou shalt love him as thyself; for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt: I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord your God.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:35
verses.text: ¶ Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in meteyard, in weight, or in measure.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:36
verses.text: Just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin, shall ye have: I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:37
verses.text: Therefore shall ye observe all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord.  <chapter eID="Lev.19"/><div eID="gen113" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 20:1
verses.text: AND the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 20:2
verses.text: Again, thou shalt say to the children of Israel, Whosoever <hi type="italic">he be</hi> of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn in Israel, that giveth <hi type="italic">any</hi> of his seed unto Molech; he shall surely be put to death: the people of the land shall stone him with stones.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:3
verses.text: And I will set my face against that man, and will cut him off from among his people; because he hath given of his seed unto Molech, to defile my sanctuary, and to profane my holy name.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:4
verses.text: And if the people of the land do any ways hide their eyes from the man, when he giveth of his seed unto Molech, and kill him not:

verses.name: Leviticus 20:5
verses.text: Then I will set my face against that man, and against his family, and will cut him off, and all that go a whoring after him, to commit whoredom with Molech, from among their people.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:6
verses.text: ¶ And the soul that turneth after such as have familiar spirits, and after wizards, to go a whoring after them, I will even set my face against that soul, and will cut him off from among his people.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:7
verses.text: ¶ Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be ye holy: for I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord your God.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:8
verses.text: And ye shall keep my statutes, and do them: I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord which sanctify you.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:9
verses.text: ¶ For every one that curseth his father or his mother shall be surely put to death: he hath cursed his father or his mother; his blood <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> upon him.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:10
verses.text: ¶ And the man that committeth adultery with <hi type="italic">another</hi> man’s wife, <hi type="italic">even he</hi> that committeth adultery with his neighbour’s wife, the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:11
verses.text: And the man that lieth with his father’s wife hath uncovered his father’s nakedness: both of them shall surely be put to death; their blood <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> upon them.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:12
verses.text: And if a man lie with his daughter in law, both of them shall surely be put to death: they have wrought confusion; their blood <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> upon them.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:13
verses.text: If a man also lie with mankind, as he lieth with a woman, both of them have committed an abomination: they shall surely be put to death; their blood <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> upon them.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:14
verses.text: And if a man take a wife and her mother, it <hi type="italic">is</hi> wickedness: they shall be burnt with fire, both he and they; that there be no wickedness among you.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:15
verses.text: And if a man lie with a beast, he shall surely be put to death: and ye shall slay the beast.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:16
verses.text: And if a woman approach unto any beast, and lie down thereto, thou shalt kill the woman, and the beast: they shall surely be put to death; their blood <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> upon them.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:17
verses.text: And if a man shall take his sister, his father’s daughter, or his mother’s daughter, and see her nakedness, and she see his nakedness; it <hi type="italic">is</hi> a wicked thing; and they shall be cut off in the sight of their people: he hath uncovered his sister’s nakedness; he shall bear his iniquity.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:18
verses.text: And if a man shall lie with a woman having her sickness, and shall uncover her nakedness; he hath discovered her fountain, and she hath uncovered the fountain of her blood: and both of them shall be cut off from among their people.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:19
verses.text: And thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother’s sister, nor of thy father’s sister: for he uncovereth his near kin: they shall bear their iniquity.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:20
verses.text: And if a man shall lie with his uncle’s wife, he hath uncovered his uncle’s nakedness: they shall bear their sin; they shall die childless.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:21
verses.text: And if a man shall take his brother’s wife, it <hi type="italic">is</hi> an unclean thing: he hath uncovered his brother’s nakedness; they shall be childless.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:22
verses.text: ¶ Ye shall therefore keep all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: that the land, whither I bring you to dwell therein, spue you not out.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:23
verses.text: And ye shall not walk in the manners of the nation, which I cast out before you: for they committed all these things, and therefore I abhorred them.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:24
verses.text: But I have said unto you, Ye shall inherit their land, and I will give it unto you to possess it, a land that floweth with milk and honey: I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord your God, which have separated you from <hi type="italic">other</hi> people.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:25
verses.text: Ye shall therefore put difference between clean beasts and unclean, and between unclean fowls and clean: and ye shall not make your souls abominable by beast, or by fowl, or by any manner of living thing that creepeth on the ground, which I have separated from you as unclean.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:26
verses.text: And ye shall be holy unto me: for I the Lord <hi type="italic">am</hi> holy, and have severed you from <hi type="italic">other</hi> people, that ye should be mine.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:27
verses.text: ¶ A man also or woman that hath a familiar spirit, or that is a wizard, shall surely be put to death: they shall stone them with stones: their blood <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> upon them.  <chapter eID="Lev.20"/><div eID="gen114" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 21:1
verses.text: AND the Lord said unto Moses, Speak unto the priests the sons of Aaron, and say unto them, There shall none be defiled for the dead among his people:

verses.name: Leviticus 21:2
verses.text: But for his kin, that is near unto him, <hi type="italic">that is</hi>, for his mother, and for his father, and for his son, and for his daughter, and for his brother,

verses.name: Leviticus 21:3
verses.text: And for his sister a virgin, that is nigh unto him, which hath had no husband; for her may he be defiled.

verses.name: Leviticus 21:4
verses.text: <hi type="italic">But</hi> he shall not defile himself, <hi type="italic">being</hi> a chief man among his people, to profane himself.

verses.name: Leviticus 21:5
verses.text: They shall not make baldness upon their head, neither shall they shave off the corner of their beard, nor make any cuttings in their flesh.

verses.name: Leviticus 21:6
verses.text: They shall be holy unto their God, and not profane the name of their God: for the offerings of the Lord made by fire, <hi type="italic">and</hi> the bread of their God, they do offer: therefore they shall be holy.

verses.name: Leviticus 21:7
verses.text: They shall not take a wife <hi type="italic">that is</hi> a whore, or profane; neither shall they take a woman put away from her husband: for he <hi type="italic">is</hi> holy unto his God.

verses.name: Leviticus 21:8
verses.text: Thou shalt sanctify him therefore; for he offereth the bread of thy God: he shall be holy unto thee: for I the Lord, which sanctify you, <hi type="italic">am</hi> holy.

verses.name: Leviticus 21:9
verses.text: ¶ And the daughter of any priest, if she profane herself by playing the whore, she profaneth her father: she shall be burnt with fire.

verses.name: Leviticus 21:10
verses.text: And <hi type="italic">he that is</hi> the high priest among his brethren, upon whose head the anointing oil was poured, and that is consecrated to put on the garments, shall not uncover his head, nor rend his clothes;

verses.name: Leviticus 21:11
verses.text: Neither shall he go in to any dead body, nor defile himself for his father, or for his mother;

verses.name: Leviticus 21:12
verses.text: Neither shall he go out of the sanctuary, nor profane the sanctuary of his God; for the crown of the anointing oil of his God <hi type="italic">is</hi> upon him: I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord.

verses.name: Leviticus 21:13
verses.text: And he shall take a wife in her virginity.

verses.name: Leviticus 21:14
verses.text: A widow, or a divorced woman, or profane, <hi type="italic">or</hi> an harlot, these shall he not take: but he shall take a virgin of his own people to wife.

verses.name: Leviticus 21:15
verses.text: Neither shall he profane his seed among his people: for I the Lord do sanctify him.

verses.name: Leviticus 21:16
verses.text: ¶ And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 21:17
verses.text: Speak unto Aaron, saying, Whosoever <hi type="italic">he be</hi> of thy seed in their generations that hath <hi type="italic">any</hi> blemish, let him not approach to offer the bread of his God.

verses.name: Leviticus 21:18
verses.text: For whatsoever man <hi type="italic">he be</hi> that hath a blemish, he shall not approach: a blind man, or a lame, or he that hath a flat nose, or any thing superfluous,

verses.name: Leviticus 21:19
verses.text: Or a man that is brokenfooted, or brokenhanded,

verses.name: Leviticus 21:20
verses.text: Or crookbackt, or a dwarf, or that hath a blemish in his eye, or be scurvy, or scabbed, or hath his stones broken;

verses.name: Leviticus 21:21
verses.text: No man that hath a blemish of the seed of Aaron the priest shall come nigh to offer the offerings of the Lord made by fire: he hath a blemish; he shall not come nigh to offer the bread of his God.

verses.name: Leviticus 21:22
verses.text: He shall eat the bread of his God, <hi type="italic">both</hi> of the most holy, and of the holy.

verses.name: Leviticus 21:23
verses.text: Only he shall not go in unto the vail, nor come nigh unto the altar, because he hath a blemish; that he profane not my sanctuaries: for I the Lord do sanctify them.

verses.name: Leviticus 21:24
verses.text: And Moses told <hi type="italic">it</hi> unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Israel.  <chapter eID="Lev.21"/><div eID="gen115" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 22:1
verses.text: AND the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 22:2
verses.text: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons, that they separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel, and that they profane not my holy name <hi type="italic">in those things</hi> which they hallow unto me: I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:3
verses.text: Say unto them, Whosoever <hi type="italic">he be</hi> of all your seed among your generations, that goeth unto the holy things, which the children of Israel hallow unto the Lord, having his uncleanness upon him, that soul shall be cut off from my presence: I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:4
verses.text: What man soever of the seed of Aaron <hi type="italic">is</hi> a leper, or hath a running issue; he shall not eat of the holy things, until he be clean. And whoso toucheth any thing <hi type="italic">that is</hi> unclean <hi type="italic">by</hi> the dead, or a man whose seed goeth from him;

verses.name: Leviticus 22:5
verses.text: Or whosoever toucheth any creeping thing, whereby he may be made unclean, or a man of whom he may take uncleanness, whatsoever uncleanness he hath;

verses.name: Leviticus 22:6
verses.text: The soul which hath touched any such shall be unclean until even, and shall not eat of the holy things, unless he wash his flesh with water.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:7
verses.text: And when the sun is down, he shall be clean, and shall afterward eat of the holy things; because it <hi type="italic">is</hi> his food.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:8
verses.text: That which dieth of itself, or is torn <hi type="italic">with beasts</hi>, he shall not eat to defile himself therewith: I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:9
verses.text: They shall therefore keep mine ordinance, lest they bear sin for it, and die therefore, if they profane it: I the Lord do sanctify them.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:10
verses.text: There shall no stranger eat <hi type="italic">of</hi> the holy thing: a sojourner of the priest, or an hired servant, shall not eat <hi type="italic">of</hi> the holy thing.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:11
verses.text: But if the priest buy <hi type="italic">any</hi> soul with his money, he shall eat of it, and he that is born in his house: they shall eat of his meat.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:12
verses.text: If the priest’s daughter also be <hi type="italic">married</hi> unto a stranger, she may not eat of an offering of the holy things.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:13
verses.text: But if the priest’s daughter be a widow, or divorced, and have no child, and is returned unto her father’s house, as in her youth, she shall eat of her father’s meat: but there shall no stranger eat thereof.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:14
verses.text: ¶ And if a man eat <hi type="italic">of</hi> the holy thing unwittingly, then he shall put the fifth <hi type="italic">part</hi> thereof unto it, and shall give <hi type="italic">it</hi> unto the priest with the holy thing.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:15
verses.text: And they shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, which they offer unto the Lord;

verses.name: Leviticus 22:16
verses.text: Or suffer them to bear the iniquity of trespass, when they eat their holy things: for I the Lord do sanctify them.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:17
verses.text: ¶ And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 22:18
verses.text: Speak unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them, Whatsoever <hi type="italic">he be</hi> of the house of Israel, or of the strangers in Israel, that will offer his oblation for all his vows, and for all his freewill offerings, which they will offer unto the Lord for a burnt offering;

verses.name: Leviticus 22:19
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Ye shall offer</hi> at your own will a male without blemish, of the beeves, of the sheep, or of the goats.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:20
verses.text: <hi type="italic">But</hi> whatsoever hath a blemish, <hi type="italic">that</hi> shall ye not offer: for it shall not be acceptable for you.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:21
verses.text: And whosoever offereth a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the Lord to accomplish <hi type="italic">his</hi> vow, or a freewill offering in beeves or sheep, it shall be perfect to be accepted; there shall be no blemish therein.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:22
verses.text: Blind, or broken, or maimed, or having a wen, or scurvy, or scabbed, ye shall not offer these unto the Lord, nor make an offering by fire of them upon the altar unto the Lord.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:23
verses.text: Either a bullock or a lamb that hath any thing superfluous or lacking in his parts, that mayest thou offer <hi type="italic">for</hi> a freewill offering; but for a vow it shall not be accepted.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:24
verses.text: Ye shall not offer unto the Lord that which is bruised, or crushed, or broken, or cut; neither shall ye make <hi type="italic">any offering thereof</hi> in your land.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:25
verses.text: Neither from a stranger’s hand shall ye offer the bread of your God of any of these; because their corruption <hi type="italic">is</hi> in them, <hi type="italic">and</hi> blemishes <hi type="italic">be</hi> in them: they shall not be accepted for you.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:26
verses.text: ¶ And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 22:27
verses.text: When a bullock, or a sheep, or a goat, is brought forth, then it shall be seven days under the dam; and from the eighth day and thenceforth it shall be accepted for an offering made by fire unto the Lord.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:28
verses.text: And <hi type="italic">whether it be</hi> cow or ewe, ye shall not kill it and her young both in one day.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:29
verses.text: And when ye will offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving unto the Lord, offer <hi type="italic">it</hi> at your own will.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:30
verses.text: On the same day it shall be eaten up; ye shall leave none of it until the morrow: I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:31
verses.text: Therefore shall ye keep my commandments, and do them: I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:32
verses.text: Neither shall ye profane my holy name; but I will be hallowed among the children of Israel: I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord which hallow you,

verses.name: Leviticus 22:33
verses.text: That brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord.  <chapter eID="Lev.22"/><div eID="gen116" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 23:1
verses.text: AND the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 23:2
verses.text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, <hi type="italic">Concerning</hi> the feasts of the Lord, which ye shall proclaim <hi type="italic">to be</hi> holy convocations, <hi type="italic">even</hi> these <hi type="italic">are</hi> my feasts.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:3
verses.text: Six days shall work be done: but the seventh day <hi type="italic">is</hi> the sabbath of rest, an holy convocation; ye shall do no work <hi type="italic">therein:</hi> it <hi type="italic">is</hi> the sabbath of the Lord in all your dwellings.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:4
verses.text: ¶ These <hi type="italic">are</hi> the feasts of the Lord, <hi type="italic">even</hi> holy convocations, which ye shall proclaim in their seasons.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:5
verses.text: In the fourteenth <hi type="italic">day</hi> of the first month at even <hi type="italic">is</hi> the Lord’s passover.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:6
verses.text: And on the fifteenth day of the same month <hi type="italic">is</hi> the feast of unleavened bread unto the Lord: seven days ye must eat unleavened bread.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:7
verses.text: In the first day ye shall have an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work therein.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:8
verses.text: But ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the Lord seven days: in the seventh day <hi type="italic">is</hi> an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work <hi type="italic">therein</hi>.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:9
verses.text: ¶ And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 23:10
verses.text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come into the land which I give unto you, and shall reap the harvest thereof, then ye shall bring a sheaf of the firstfruits of your harvest unto the priest:

verses.name: Leviticus 23:11
verses.text: And he shall wave the sheaf before the Lord, to be accepted for you: on the morrow after the sabbath the priest shall wave it.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:12
verses.text: And ye shall offer that day when ye wave the sheaf an he lamb without blemish of the first year for a burnt offering unto the Lord.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:13
verses.text: And the meat offering thereof <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> two tenth deals of fine flour mingled with oil, an offering made by fire unto the Lord <hi type="italic">for</hi> a sweet savour: and the drink offering thereof <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> of wine, the fourth <hi type="italic">part</hi> of an hin.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:14
verses.text: And ye shall eat neither bread, nor parched corn, nor green ears, until the selfsame day that ye have brought an offering unto your God: <hi type="italic">it shall be</hi> a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:15
verses.text: ¶ And ye shall count unto you from the morrow after the sabbath, from the day that ye brought the sheaf of the wave offering; seven sabbaths shall be complete:

verses.name: Leviticus 23:16
verses.text: Even unto the morrow after the seventh sabbath shall ye number fifty days; and ye shall offer a new meat offering unto the Lord.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:17
verses.text: Ye shall bring out of your habitations two wave loaves of two tenth deals: they shall be of fine flour; they shall be baken with leaven; <hi type="italic">they are</hi> the firstfruits unto the Lord.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:18
verses.text: And ye shall offer with the bread seven lambs without blemish of the first year, and one young bullock, and two rams: they shall be <hi type="italic">for</hi> a burnt offering unto the Lord, with their meat offering, and their drink offerings, <hi type="italic">even</hi> an offering made by fire, of sweet savour unto the Lord.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:19
verses.text: Then ye shall sacrifice one kid of the goats for a sin offering, and two lambs of the first year for a sacrifice of peace offerings.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:20
verses.text: And the priest shall wave them with the bread of the firstfruits <hi type="italic">for</hi> a wave offering before the Lord, with the two lambs: they shall be holy to the Lord for the priest.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:21
verses.text: And ye shall proclaim on the selfsame day, <hi type="italic">that</hi> it may be an holy convocation unto you: ye shall do no servile work <hi type="italic">therein: it shall be</hi> a statute for ever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:22
verses.text: ¶ And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not make clean riddance of the corners of thy field when thou reapest, neither shalt thou gather any gleaning of thy harvest: thou shalt leave them unto the poor, and to the stranger: I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord your God.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:23
verses.text: ¶ And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 23:24
verses.text: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, In the seventh month, in the first <hi type="italic">day</hi> of the month, shall ye have a sabbath, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, an holy convocation.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:25
verses.text: Ye shall do no servile work <hi type="italic">therein:</hi> but ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the Lord.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:26
verses.text: ¶ And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 23:27
verses.text: Also on the tenth <hi type="italic">day</hi> of this seventh month <hi type="italic">there shall be</hi> a day of atonement: it shall be an holy convocation unto you; and ye shall afflict your souls, and offer an offering made by fire unto the Lord.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:28
verses.text: And ye shall do no work in that same day: for it <hi type="italic">is</hi> a day of atonement, to make an atonement for you before the Lord your God.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:29
verses.text: For whatsoever soul <hi type="italic">it be</hi> that shall not be afflicted in that same day, he shall be cut off from among his people.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:30
verses.text: And whatsoever soul <hi type="italic">it be</hi> that doeth any work in that same day, the same soul will I destroy from among his people.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:31
verses.text: Ye shall do no manner of work: <hi type="italic">it shall be</hi> a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:32
verses.text: It <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> unto you a sabbath of rest, and ye shall afflict your souls: in the ninth <hi type="italic">day</hi> of the month at even, from even unto even, shall ye celebrate your sabbath.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:33
verses.text: ¶ And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 23:34
verses.text: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, The fifteenth day of this seventh month <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> the feast of tabernacles <hi type="italic">for</hi> seven days unto the Lord.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:35
verses.text: On the first day <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work <hi type="italic">therein</hi>.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:36
verses.text: Seven days ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the Lord: on the eighth day shall be an holy convocation unto you; and ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the Lord: it <hi type="italic">is</hi> a solemn assembly; <hi type="italic">and</hi> ye shall do no servile work <hi type="italic">therein</hi>.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:37
verses.text: These <hi type="italic">are</hi> the feasts of the Lord, which ye shall proclaim <hi type="italic">to be</hi> holy convocations, to offer an offering made by fire unto the Lord, a burnt offering, and a meat offering, a sacrifice, and drink offerings, every thing upon his day:

verses.name: Leviticus 23:38
verses.text: Beside the sabbaths of the Lord, and beside your gifts, and beside all your vows, and beside all your freewill offerings, which ye give unto the Lord.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:39
verses.text: Also in the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when ye have gathered in the fruit of the land, ye shall keep a feast unto the Lord seven days: on the first day <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> a sabbath, and on the eighth day <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> a sabbath.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:40
verses.text: And ye shall take you on the first day the boughs of goodly trees, branches of palm trees, and the boughs of thick trees, and willows of the brook; and ye shall rejoice before the Lord your God seven days.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:41
verses.text: And ye shall keep it a feast unto the Lord seven days in the year. <hi type="italic">It shall be</hi> a statute for ever in your generations: ye shall celebrate it in the seventh month.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:42
verses.text: Ye shall dwell in booths seven days; all that are Israelites born shall dwell in booths:

verses.name: Leviticus 23:43
verses.text: That your generations may know that I made the children of Israel to dwell in booths, when I brought them out of the land of Egypt: I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord your God.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:44
verses.text: And Moses declared unto the children of Israel the feasts of the Lord.  <chapter eID="Lev.23"/><div eID="gen117" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 24:1
verses.text: AND the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 24:2
verses.text: Command the children of Israel, that they bring unto thee pure oil olive beaten for the light, to cause the lamps to burn continually.

verses.name: Leviticus 24:3
verses.text: Without the vail of the testimony, in the tabernacle of the congregation, shall Aaron order it from the evening unto the morning before the Lord continually: <hi type="italic">it shall be</hi> a statute for ever in your generations.

verses.name: Leviticus 24:4
verses.text: He shall order the lamps upon the pure candlestick before the Lord continually.

verses.name: Leviticus 24:5
verses.text: ¶ And thou shalt take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes thereof: two tenth deals shall be in one cake.

verses.name: Leviticus 24:6
verses.text: And thou shalt set them in two rows, six on a row, upon the pure table before the Lord.

verses.name: Leviticus 24:7
verses.text: And thou shalt put pure frankincense upon <hi type="italic">each</hi> row, that it may be on the bread for a memorial, <hi type="italic">even</hi> an offering made by fire unto the Lord.

verses.name: Leviticus 24:8
verses.text: Every sabbath he shall set it in order before the Lord continually, <hi type="italic">being taken</hi> from the children of Israel by an everlasting covenant.

verses.name: Leviticus 24:9
verses.text: And it shall be Aaron’s and his sons’; and they shall eat it in the holy place: for it <hi type="italic">is</hi> most holy unto him of the offerings of the Lord made by fire by a perpetual statute.

verses.name: Leviticus 24:10
verses.text: ¶ And the son of an Israelitish woman, whose father <hi type="italic">was</hi> an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel: and this son of the Israelitish <hi type="italic">woman</hi> and a man of Israel strove together in the camp;

verses.name: Leviticus 24:11
verses.text: And the Israelitish woman’s son blasphemed the name <hi type="italic">of the L</hi><hi type="italic">ord</hi>, and cursed. And they brought him unto Moses: (and his mother’s name <hi type="italic">was</hi> Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan:)

verses.name: Leviticus 24:12
verses.text: And they put him in ward, that the mind of the Lord might be shewed them.

verses.name: Leviticus 24:13
verses.text: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 24:14
verses.text: Bring forth him that hath cursed without the camp; and let all that heard <hi type="italic">him</hi> lay their hands upon his head, and let all the congregation stone him.

verses.name: Leviticus 24:15
verses.text: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Whosoever curseth his God shall bear his sin.

verses.name: Leviticus 24:16
verses.text: And he that blasphemeth the name of the Lord, he shall surely be put to death, <hi type="italic">and</hi> all the congregation shall certainly stone him: as well the stranger, as he that is born in the land, when he blasphemeth the name <hi type="italic">of the L</hi><hi type="italic">ord</hi>, shall be put to death.

verses.name: Leviticus 24:17
verses.text: ¶ And he that killeth any man shall surely be put to death.

verses.name: Leviticus 24:18
verses.text: And he that killeth a beast shall make it good; beast for beast.

verses.name: Leviticus 24:19
verses.text: And if a man cause a blemish in his neighbour; as he hath done, so shall it be done to him;

verses.name: Leviticus 24:20
verses.text: Breach for breach, eye for eye, tooth for tooth: as he hath caused a blemish in a man, so shall it be done to him <hi type="italic">again</hi>.

verses.name: Leviticus 24:21
verses.text: And he that killeth a beast, he shall restore it: and he that killeth a man, he shall be put to death.

verses.name: Leviticus 24:22
verses.text: Ye shall have one manner of law, as well for the stranger, as for one of your own country: for I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord your God.

verses.name: Leviticus 24:23
verses.text: ¶ And Moses spake to the children of Israel, that they should bring forth him that had cursed out of the camp, and stone him with stones. And the children of Israel did as the Lord commanded Moses.  <chapter eID="Lev.24"/><div eID="gen118" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 25:1
verses.text: AND the Lord spake unto Moses in mount Sinai, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 25:2
verses.text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land which I give you, then shall the land keep a sabbath unto the Lord.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:3
verses.text: Six years thou shalt sow thy field, and six years thou shalt prune thy vineyard, and gather in the fruit thereof;

verses.name: Leviticus 25:4
verses.text: But in the seventh year shall be a sabbath of rest unto the land, a sabbath for the Lord: thou shalt neither sow thy field, nor prune thy vineyard.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:5
verses.text: That which groweth of its own accord of thy harvest thou shalt not reap, neither gather the grapes of thy vine undressed: <hi type="italic">for</hi> it is a year of rest unto the land.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:6
verses.text: And the sabbath of the land shall be meat for you; for thee, and for thy servant, and for thy maid, and for thy hired servant, and for thy stranger that sojourneth with thee,

verses.name: Leviticus 25:7
verses.text: And for thy cattle, and for the beast that <hi type="italic">are</hi> in thy land, shall all the increase thereof be meat.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:8
verses.text: ¶ And thou shalt number seven sabbaths of years unto thee, seven times seven years; and the space of the seven sabbaths of years shall be unto thee forty and nine years.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:9
verses.text: Then shalt thou cause the trumpet of the jubile to sound on the tenth <hi type="italic">day</hi> of the seventh month, in the day of atonement shall ye make the trumpet sound throughout all your land.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:10
verses.text: And ye shall hallow the fiftieth year, and proclaim liberty throughout <hi type="italic">all</hi> the land unto all the inhabitants thereof: it shall be a jubile unto you; and ye shall return every man unto his possession, and ye shall return every man unto his family.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:11
verses.text: A jubile shall that fiftieth year be unto you: ye shall not sow, neither reap that which groweth of itself in it, nor gather <hi type="italic">the grapes</hi> in it of thy vine undressed.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:12
verses.text: For it <hi type="italic">is</hi> the jubile; it shall be holy unto you: ye shall eat the increase thereof out of the field.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:13
verses.text: In the year of this jubile ye shall return every man unto his possession.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:14
verses.text: And if thou sell ought unto thy neighbour, or buyest <hi type="italic">ought</hi> of thy neighbour’s hand, ye shall not oppress one another:

verses.name: Leviticus 25:15
verses.text: According to the number of years after the jubile thou shalt buy of thy neighbour, <hi type="italic">and</hi> according unto the number of years of the fruits he shall sell unto thee:

verses.name: Leviticus 25:16
verses.text: According to the multitude of years thou shalt increase the price thereof, and according to the fewness of years thou shalt diminish the price of it: for <hi type="italic">according</hi> to the number <hi type="italic">of the years</hi> of the fruits doth he sell unto thee.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:17
verses.text: Ye shall not therefore oppress one another; but thou shalt fear thy God: for I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord your God.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:18
verses.text: ¶ Wherefore ye shall do my statutes, and keep my judgments, and do them; and ye shall dwell in the land in safety.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:19
verses.text: And the land shall yield her fruit, and ye shall eat your fill, and dwell therein in safety.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:20
verses.text: And if ye shall say, What shall we eat the seventh year? behold, we shall not sow, nor gather in our increase:

verses.name: Leviticus 25:21
verses.text: Then I will command my blessing upon you in the sixth year, and it shall bring forth fruit for three years.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:22
verses.text: And ye shall sow the eighth year, and eat <hi type="italic">yet</hi> of old fruit until the ninth year; until her fruits come in ye shall eat <hi type="italic">of</hi> the old <hi type="italic">store</hi>.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:23
verses.text: ¶ The land shall not be sold for ever: for the land <hi type="italic">is</hi> mine; for ye <hi type="italic">are</hi> strangers and sojourners with me.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:24
verses.text: And in all the land of your possession ye shall grant a redemption for the land.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:25
verses.text: ¶ If thy brother be waxen poor, and hath sold away <hi type="italic">some</hi> of his possession, and if any of his kin come to redeem it, then shall he redeem that which his brother sold.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:26
verses.text: And if the man have none to redeem it, and himself be able to redeem it;

verses.name: Leviticus 25:27
verses.text: Then let him count the years of the sale thereof, and restore the overplus unto the man to whom he sold it; that he may return unto his possession.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:28
verses.text: But if he be not able to restore <hi type="italic">it</hi> to him, then that which is sold shall remain in the hand of him that hath bought it until the year of jubile: and in the jubile it shall go out, and he shall return unto his possession.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:29
verses.text: And if a man sell a dwelling house in a walled city, then he may redeem it within a whole year after it is sold; <hi type="italic">within</hi> a full year may he redeem it.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:30
verses.text: And if it be not redeemed within the space of a full year, then the house that <hi type="italic">is</hi> in the walled city shall be established for ever to him that bought it throughout his generations: it shall not go out in the jubile.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:31
verses.text: But the houses of the villages which have no wall round about them shall be counted as the fields of the country: they may be redeemed, and they shall go out in the jubile.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:32
verses.text: Notwithstanding the cities of the Levites, <hi type="italic">and</hi> the houses of the cities of their possession, may the Levites redeem at any time.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:33
verses.text: And if a man purchase of the Levites, then the house that was sold, and the city of his possession, shall go out in <hi type="italic">the year of</hi> jubile: for the houses of the cities of the Levites <hi type="italic">are</hi> their possession among the children of Israel.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:34
verses.text: But the field of the suburbs of their cities may not be sold; for it <hi type="italic">is</hi> their perpetual possession.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:35
verses.text: ¶ And if thy brother be waxen poor, and fallen in decay with thee; then thou shalt relieve him: <hi type="italic">yea</hi>, <hi type="italic">though he be</hi> a stranger, or a sojourner; that he may live with thee.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:36
verses.text: Take thou no usury of him, or increase: but fear thy God; that thy brother may live with thee.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:37
verses.text: Thou shalt not give him thy money upon usury, nor lend him thy victuals for increase.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:38
verses.text: I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord your God, which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, <hi type="italic">and</hi> to be your God.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:39
verses.text: ¶ And if thy brother <hi type="italic">that dwelleth</hi> by thee be waxen poor, and be sold unto thee; thou shalt not compel him to serve as a bondservant:

verses.name: Leviticus 25:40
verses.text: <hi type="italic">But</hi> as an hired servant, <hi type="italic">and</hi> as a sojourner, he shall be with thee, <hi type="italic">and</hi> shall serve thee unto the year of jubile:

verses.name: Leviticus 25:41
verses.text: And <hi type="italic">then</hi> shall he depart from thee, <hi type="italic">both</hi> he and his children with him, and shall return unto his own family, and unto the possession of his fathers shall he return.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:42
verses.text: For they <hi type="italic">are</hi> my servants, which I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: they shall not be sold as bondmen.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:43
verses.text: Thou shalt not rule over him with rigour; but shalt fear thy God.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:44
verses.text: Both thy bondmen, and thy bondmaids, which thou shalt have, <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> of the heathen that are round about you; of them shall ye buy bondmen and bondmaids.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:45
verses.text: Moreover of the children of the strangers that do sojourn among you, of them shall ye buy, and of their families that <hi type="italic">are</hi> with you, which they begat in your land: and they shall be your possession.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:46
verses.text: And ye shall take them as an inheritance for your children after you, to inherit <hi type="italic">them for</hi> a possession; they shall be your bondmen for ever: but over your brethren the children of Israel, ye shall not rule one over another with rigour.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:47
verses.text: ¶ And if a sojourner or stranger wax rich by thee, and thy brother <hi type="italic">that dwelleth</hi> by him wax poor, and sell himself unto the stranger <hi type="italic">or</hi> sojourner by thee, or to the stock of the stranger’s family:

verses.name: Leviticus 25:48
verses.text: After that he is sold he may be redeemed again; one of his brethren may redeem him:

verses.name: Leviticus 25:49
verses.text: Either his uncle, or his uncle’s son, may redeem him, or <hi type="italic">any</hi> that is nigh of kin unto him of his family may redeem him; or if he be able, he may redeem himself.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:50
verses.text: And he shall reckon with him that bought him from the year that he was sold to him unto the year of jubile: and the price of his sale shall be according unto the number of years, according to the time of an hired servant shall it be with him.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:51
verses.text: If <hi type="italic">there be</hi> yet many years <hi type="italic">behind</hi>, according unto them he shall give again the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:52
verses.text: And if there remain but few years unto the year of jubile, then he shall count with him, <hi type="italic">and</hi> according unto his years shall he give him again the price of his redemption.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:53
verses.text: <hi type="italic">And</hi> as a yearly hired servant shall he be with him: <hi type="italic">and the other</hi> shall not rule with rigour over him in thy sight.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:54
verses.text: And if he be not redeemed in these <hi type="italic">years</hi>, then he shall go out in the year of jubile, <hi type="italic">both</hi> he, and his children with him.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:55
verses.text: For unto me the children of Israel <hi type="italic">are</hi> servants; they <hi type="italic">are</hi> my servants whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord your God.  <chapter eID="Lev.25"/><div eID="gen119" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 26:1
verses.text: YE shall make you no idols nor graven image, neither rear you up a standing image, neither shall ye set up <hi type="italic">any</hi> image of stone in your land, to bow down unto it: for I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord your God.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:2
verses.text: ¶ Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:3
verses.text: ¶ If ye walk in my statutes, and keep my commandments, and do them;

verses.name: Leviticus 26:4
verses.text: Then I will give you rain in due season, and the land shall yield her increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:5
verses.text: And your threshing shall reach unto the vintage, and the vintage shall reach unto the sowing time: and ye shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:6
verses.text: And I will give peace in the land, and ye shall lie down, and none shall make <hi type="italic">you</hi> afraid: and I will rid evil beasts out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:7
verses.text: And ye shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:8
verses.text: And five of you shall chase an hundred, and an hundred of you shall put ten thousand to flight: and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:9
verses.text: For I will have respect unto you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, and establish my covenant with you.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:10
verses.text: And ye shall eat old store, and bring forth the old because of the new.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:11
verses.text: And I will set my tabernacle among you: and my soul shall not abhor you.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:12
verses.text: And I will walk among you, and will be your God, and ye shall be my people.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:13
verses.text: I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord your God, which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, that ye should not be their bondmen; and I have broken the bands of your yoke, and made you go upright.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:14
verses.text: ¶ But if ye will not hearken unto me, and will not do all these commandments;

verses.name: Leviticus 26:15
verses.text: And if ye shall despise my statutes, or if your soul abhor my judgments, so that ye will not do all my commandments, <hi type="italic">but</hi> that ye break my covenant:

verses.name: Leviticus 26:16
verses.text: I also will do this unto you; I will even appoint over you terror, consumption, and the burning ague, that shall consume the eyes, and cause sorrow of heart: and ye shall sow your seed in vain, for your enemies shall eat it.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:17
verses.text: And I will set my face against you, and ye shall be slain before your enemies: they that hate you shall reign over you; and ye shall flee when none pursueth you.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:18
verses.text: And if ye will not yet for all this hearken unto me, then I will punish you seven times more for your sins.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:19
verses.text: And I will break the pride of your power; and I will make your heaven as iron, and your earth as brass:

verses.name: Leviticus 26:20
verses.text: And your strength shall be spent in vain: for your land shall not yield her increase, neither shall the trees of the land yield their fruits.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:21
verses.text: ¶ And if ye walk contrary unto me, and will not hearken unto me; I will bring seven times more plagues upon you according to your sins.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:22
verses.text: I will also send wild beasts among you, which shall rob you of your children, and destroy your cattle, and make you few in number; and your <hi type="italic">high</hi> ways shall be desolate.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:23
verses.text: And if ye will not be reformed by me by these things, but will walk contrary unto me;

verses.name: Leviticus 26:24
verses.text: Then will I also walk contrary unto you, and will punish you yet seven times for your sins.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:25
verses.text: And I will bring a sword upon you, that shall avenge the quarrel of <hi type="italic">my</hi> covenant: and when ye are gathered together within your cities, I will send the pestilence among you; and ye shall be delivered into the hand of the enemy.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:26
verses.text: <hi type="italic">And</hi> when I have broken the staff of your bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall deliver <hi type="italic">you</hi> your bread again by weight: and ye shall eat, and not be satisfied.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:27
verses.text: And if ye will not for all this hearken unto me, but walk contrary unto me;

verses.name: Leviticus 26:28
verses.text: Then I will walk contrary unto you also in fury; and I, even I, will chastise you seven times for your sins.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:29
verses.text: And ye shall eat the flesh of your sons, and the flesh of your daughters shall ye eat.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:30
verses.text: And I will destroy your high places, and cut down your images, and cast your carcases upon the carcases of your idols, and my soul shall abhor you.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:31
verses.text: And I will make your cities waste, and bring your sanctuaries unto desolation, and I will not smell the savour of your sweet odours.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:32
verses.text: And I will bring the land into desolation: and your enemies which dwell therein shall be astonished at it.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:33
verses.text: And I will scatter you among the heathen, and will draw out a sword after you: and your land shall be desolate, and your cities waste.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:34
verses.text: Then shall the land enjoy her sabbaths, as long as it lieth desolate, and ye <hi type="italic">be</hi> in your enemies’ land; <hi type="italic">even</hi> then shall the land rest, and enjoy her sabbaths.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:35
verses.text: As long as it lieth desolate it shall rest; because it did not rest in your sabbaths, when ye dwelt upon it.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:36
verses.text: And upon them that are left <hi type="italic">alive</hi> of you I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies; and the sound of a shaken leaf shall chase them; and they shall flee, as fleeing from a sword; and they shall fall when none pursueth.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:37
verses.text: And they shall fall one upon another, as it were before a sword, when none pursueth: and ye shall have no power to stand before your enemies.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:38
verses.text: And ye shall perish among the heathen, and the land of your enemies shall eat you up.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:39
verses.text: And they that are left of you shall pine away in their iniquity in your enemies’ lands; and also in the iniquities of their fathers shall they pine away with them.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:40
verses.text: If they shall confess their iniquity, and the iniquity of their fathers, with their trespass which they trespassed against me, and that also they have walked contrary unto me;

verses.name: Leviticus 26:41
verses.text: And <hi type="italic">that</hi> I also have walked contrary unto them, and have brought them into the land of their enemies; if then their uncircumcised hearts be humbled, and they then accept of the punishment of their iniquity:

verses.name: Leviticus 26:42
verses.text: Then will I remember my covenant with Jacob, and also my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham will I remember; and I will remember the land.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:43
verses.text: The land also shall be left of them, and shall enjoy her sabbaths, while she lieth desolate without them: and they shall accept of the punishment of their iniquity: because, even because they despised my judgments, and because their soul abhorred my statutes.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:44
verses.text: And yet for all that, when they be in the land of their enemies, I will not cast them away, neither will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly, and to break my covenant with them: for I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord their God.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:45
verses.text: But I will for their sakes remember the covenant of their ancestors, whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the heathen, that I might be their God: I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:46
verses.text: These <hi type="italic">are</hi> the statutes and judgments and laws, which the Lord made between him and the children of Israel in mount Sinai by the hand of Moses.  <chapter eID="Lev.26"/><div eID="gen120" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 27:1
verses.text: AND the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 27:2
verses.text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When a man shall make a singular vow, the persons <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> for the Lord by thy estimation.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:3
verses.text: And thy estimation shall be of the male from twenty years old even unto sixty years old, even thy estimation shall be fifty shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:4
verses.text: And if it <hi type="italic">be</hi> a female, then thy estimation shall be thirty shekels.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:5
verses.text: And if <hi type="italic">it be</hi> from five years old even unto twenty years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male twenty shekels, and for the female ten shekels.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:6
verses.text: And if <hi type="italic">it be</hi> from a month old even unto five years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male five shekels of silver, and for the female thy estimation <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> three shekels of silver.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:7
verses.text: And if <hi type="italic">it be</hi> from sixty years old and above; if <hi type="italic">it be</hi> a male, then thy estimation shall be fifteen shekels, and for the female ten shekels.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:8
verses.text: But if he be poorer than thy estimation, then he shall present himself before the priest, and the priest shall value him; according to his ability that vowed shall the priest value him.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:9
verses.text: And if <hi type="italic">it be</hi> a beast, whereof men bring an offering unto the Lord, all that <hi type="italic">any man</hi> giveth of such unto the Lord shall be holy.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:10
verses.text: He shall not alter it, nor change it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good: and if he shall at all change beast for beast, then it and the exchange thereof shall be holy.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:11
verses.text: And if <hi type="italic">it be</hi> any unclean beast, of which they do not offer a sacrifice unto the Lord, then he shall present the beast before the priest:

verses.name: Leviticus 27:12
verses.text: And the priest shall value it, whether it be good or bad: as thou valuest it, <hi type="italic">who art</hi> the priest, so shall it be.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:13
verses.text: But if he will at all redeem it, then he shall add a fifth <hi type="italic">part</hi> thereof unto thy estimation.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:14
verses.text: ¶ And when a man shall sanctify his house <hi type="italic">to be</hi> holy unto the Lord, then the priest shall estimate it, whether it be good or bad: as the priest shall estimate it, so shall it stand.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:15
verses.text: And if he that sanctified it will redeem his house, then he shall add the fifth <hi type="italic">part</hi> of the money of thy estimation unto it, and it shall be his.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:16
verses.text: And if a man shall sanctify unto the Lord <hi type="italic">some part</hi> of a field of his possession, then thy estimation shall be according to the seed thereof: an homer of barley seed <hi type="italic">shall be valued</hi> at fifty shekels of silver.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:17
verses.text: If he sanctify his field from the year of jubile, according to thy estimation it shall stand.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:18
verses.text: But if he sanctify his field after the jubile, then the priest shall reckon unto him the money according to the years that remain, even unto the year of the jubile, and it shall be abated from thy estimation.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:19
verses.text: And if he that sanctified the field will in any wise redeem it, then he shall add the fifth <hi type="italic">part</hi> of the money of thy estimation unto it, and it shall be assured to him.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:20
verses.text: And if he will not redeem the field, or if he have sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed any more.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:21
verses.text: But the field, when it goeth out in the jubile, shall be holy unto the Lord, as a field devoted; the possession thereof shall be the priest’s.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:22
verses.text: And if <hi type="italic">a man</hi> sanctify unto the Lord a field which he hath bought, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> not of the fields of his possession;

verses.name: Leviticus 27:23
verses.text: Then the priest shall reckon unto him the worth of thy estimation, <hi type="italic">even</hi> unto the year of the jubile: and he shall give thine estimation in that day, <hi type="italic">as</hi> a holy thing unto the Lord.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:24
verses.text: In the year of the jubile the field shall return unto him of whom it was bought, <hi type="italic">even</hi> to him to whom the possession of the land <hi type="italic">did belong</hi>.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:25
verses.text: And all thy estimations shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary: twenty gerahs shall be the shekel.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:26
verses.text: ¶ Only the firstling of the beasts, which should be the Lord’s firstling, no man shall sanctify it; whether <hi type="italic">it be</hi> ox, or sheep: it <hi type="italic">is</hi> the Lord’s.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:27
verses.text: And if <hi type="italic">it be</hi> of an unclean beast, then he shall redeem <hi type="italic">it</hi> according to thine estimation, and shall add a fifth <hi type="italic">part</hi> of it thereto: or if it be not redeemed, then it shall be sold according to thy estimation.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:28
verses.text: Notwithstanding no devoted thing, that a man shall devote unto the Lord of all that he hath, <hi type="italic">both</hi> of man and beast, and of the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed: every devoted thing <hi type="italic">is</hi> most holy unto the Lord.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:29
verses.text: None devoted, which shall be devoted of men, shall be redeemed; <hi type="italic">but</hi> shall surely be put to death.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:30
verses.text: And all the tithe of the land, <hi type="italic">whether</hi> of the seed of the land, <hi type="italic">or</hi> of the fruit of the tree, <hi type="italic">is</hi> the Lord’s: <hi type="italic">it is</hi> holy unto the Lord.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:31
verses.text: And if a man will at all redeem <hi type="italic">ought</hi> of his tithes, he shall add thereto the fifth <hi type="italic">part</hi> thereof.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:32
verses.text: And concerning the tithe of the herd, or of the flock, <hi type="italic">even</hi> of whatsoever passeth under the rod, the tenth shall be holy unto the Lord.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:33
verses.text: He shall not search whether it be good or bad, neither shall he change it: and if he change it at all, then both it and the change thereof shall be holy; it shall not be redeemed.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:34
verses.text: These <hi type="italic">are</hi> the commandments, which the Lord commanded Moses for the children of Israel in mount Sinai.  <chapter eID="Lev.27"/><div eID="gen121" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen94" osisID="Lev" type="book"/>

verses.name: Numbers 1:1
verses.text: AND the Lord spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the tabernacle of the congregation, on the first <hi type="italic">day</hi> of the second month, in the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 1:2
verses.text: Take ye the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, after their families, by the house of their fathers, with the number of <hi type="italic">their</hi> names, every male by their polls;

verses.name: Numbers 1:3
verses.text: From twenty years old and upward, all that are able to go forth to war in Israel: thou and Aaron shall number them by their armies.

verses.name: Numbers 1:4
verses.text: And with you there shall be a man of every tribe; every one head of the house of his fathers.

verses.name: Numbers 1:5
verses.text: ¶ And these <hi type="italic">are</hi> the names of the men that shall stand with you: of <hi type="italic">the tribe of</hi> Reuben; Elizur the son of Shedeur.

verses.name: Numbers 1:6
verses.text: Of Simeon; Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

verses.name: Numbers 1:7
verses.text: Of Judah; Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

verses.name: Numbers 1:8
verses.text: Of Issachar; Nethaneel the son of Zuar.

verses.name: Numbers 1:9
verses.text: Of Zebulun; Eliab the son of Helon.

verses.name: Numbers 1:10
verses.text: Of the children of Joseph: of Ephraim; Elishama the son of Ammihud: of Manasseh; Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

verses.name: Numbers 1:11
verses.text: Of Benjamin; Abidan the son of Gideoni.

verses.name: Numbers 1:12
verses.text: Of Dan; Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

verses.name: Numbers 1:13
verses.text: Of Asher; Pagiel the son of Ocran.

verses.name: Numbers 1:14
verses.text: Of Gad; Eliasaph the son of Deuel.

verses.name: Numbers 1:15
verses.text: Of Naphtali; Ahira the son of Enan.

verses.name: Numbers 1:16
verses.text: These <hi type="italic">were</hi> the renowned of the congregation, princes of the tribes of their fathers, heads of thousands in Israel.

verses.name: Numbers 1:17
verses.text: ¶ And Moses and Aaron took these men which are expressed by <hi type="italic">their</hi> names:

verses.name: Numbers 1:18
verses.text: And they assembled all the congregation together on the first <hi type="italic">day</hi> of the second month, and they declared their pedigrees after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, by their polls.

verses.name: Numbers 1:19
verses.text: As the Lord commanded Moses, so he numbered them in the wilderness of Sinai.

verses.name: Numbers 1:20
verses.text: And the children of Reuben, Israel’s eldest son, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

verses.name: Numbers 1:21
verses.text: Those that were numbered of them, <hi type="italic">even</hi> of the tribe of Reuben, <hi type="italic">were</hi> forty and six thousand and five hundred.

verses.name: Numbers 1:22
verses.text: ¶ Of the children of Simeon, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, those that were numbered of them, according to the number of the names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

verses.name: Numbers 1:23
verses.text: Those that were numbered of them, <hi type="italic">even</hi> of the tribe of Simeon, <hi type="italic">were</hi> fifty and nine thousand and three hundred.

verses.name: Numbers 1:24
verses.text: ¶ Of the children of Gad, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

verses.name: Numbers 1:25
verses.text: Those that were numbered of them, <hi type="italic">even</hi> of the tribe of Gad, <hi type="italic">were</hi> forty and five thousand six hundred and fifty.

verses.name: Numbers 1:26
verses.text: ¶ Of the children of Judah, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

verses.name: Numbers 1:27
verses.text: Those that were numbered of them, <hi type="italic">even</hi> of the tribe of Judah, <hi type="italic">were</hi> threescore and fourteen thousand and six hundred.

verses.name: Numbers 1:28
verses.text: ¶ Of the children of Issachar, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

verses.name: Numbers 1:29
verses.text: Those that were numbered of them, <hi type="italic">even</hi> of the tribe of Issachar, <hi type="italic">were</hi> fifty and four thousand and four hundred.

verses.name: Numbers 1:30
verses.text: ¶ Of the children of Zebulun, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

verses.name: Numbers 1:31
verses.text: Those that were numbered of them, <hi type="italic">even</hi> of the tribe of Zebulun, <hi type="italic">were</hi> fifty and seven thousand and four hundred.

verses.name: Numbers 1:32
verses.text: ¶ Of the children of Joseph, <hi type="italic">namely</hi>, of the children of Ephraim, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

verses.name: Numbers 1:33
verses.text: Those that were numbered of them, <hi type="italic">even</hi> of the tribe of Ephraim, <hi type="italic">were</hi> forty thousand and five hundred.

verses.name: Numbers 1:34
verses.text: ¶ Of the children of Manasseh, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

verses.name: Numbers 1:35
verses.text: Those that were numbered of them, <hi type="italic">even</hi> of the tribe of Manasseh, <hi type="italic">were</hi> thirty and two thousand and two hundred.

verses.name: Numbers 1:36
verses.text: ¶ Of the children of Benjamin, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

verses.name: Numbers 1:37
verses.text: Those that were numbered of them, <hi type="italic">even</hi> of the tribe of Benjamin, <hi type="italic">were</hi> thirty and five thousand and four hundred.

verses.name: Numbers 1:38
