verses.text: The tender and delicate woman among you, which would not adventure to set the sole of her foot upon the ground for delicateness and tenderness, her eye shall be evil toward the husband of her bosom, and toward her son, and toward her daughter,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:57
verses.text: And toward her young one that cometh out from between her feet, and toward her children which she shall bear: for she shall eat them for want of all <hi type="italic">things</hi> secretly in the siege and straitness, wherewith thine enemy shall distress thee in thy gates.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:58
verses.text: If thou wilt not observe to do all the words of this law that are written in this book, that thou mayest fear this glorious and fearful name, THE LORD THY GOD;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:59
verses.text: Then the Lord will make thy plagues wonderful, and the plagues of thy seed, <hi type="italic">even</hi> great plagues, and of long continuance, and sore sicknesses, and of long continuance.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:60
verses.text: Moreover he will bring upon thee all the diseases of Egypt, which thou wast afraid of; and they shall cleave unto thee.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:61
verses.text: Also every sickness, and every plague, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> not written in the book of this law, them will the Lord bring upon thee, until thou be destroyed.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:62
verses.text: And ye shall be left few in number, whereas ye were as the stars of heaven for multitude; because thou wouldest not obey the voice of the Lord thy God.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:63
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, <hi type="italic">that</hi> as the Lord rejoiced over you to do you good, and to multiply you; so the Lord will rejoice over you to destroy you, and to bring you to nought; and ye shall be plucked from off the land whither thou goest to possess it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:64
verses.text: And the Lord shall scatter thee among all people, from the one end of the earth even unto the other; and there thou shalt serve other gods, which neither thou nor thy fathers have known, <hi type="italic">even</hi> wood and stone.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:65
verses.text: And among these nations shalt thou find no ease, neither shall the sole of thy foot have rest: but the Lord shall give thee there a trembling heart, and failing of eyes, and sorrow of mind:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:66
verses.text: And thy life shall hang in doubt before thee; and thou shalt fear day and night, and shalt have none assurance of thy life:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:67
verses.text: In the morning thou shalt say, Would God it were even! and at even thou shalt say, Would God it were morning! for the fear of thine heart wherewith thou shalt fear, and for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:68
verses.text: And the Lord shall bring thee into Egypt again with ships, by the way whereof I spake unto thee, Thou shalt see it no more again: and there ye shall be sold unto your enemies for bondmen and bondwomen, and no man shall buy <hi type="italic">you</hi>.  <chapter eID="Deut.28"/><div eID="gen187" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:1
verses.text: THESE <hi type="italic">are</hi> the words of the covenant, which the Lord commanded Moses to make with the children of Israel in the land of Moab, beside the covenant which he made with them in Horeb.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:2
verses.text: ¶ And Moses called unto all Israel, and said unto them, Ye have seen all that the Lord did before your eyes in the land of Egypt unto Pharaoh, and unto all his servants, and unto all his land;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:3
verses.text: The great temptations which thine eyes have seen, the signs, and those great miracles:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:4
verses.text: Yet the Lord hath not given you an heart to perceive, and eyes to see, and ears to hear, unto this day.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:5
verses.text: And I have led you forty years in the wilderness: your clothes are not waxen old upon you, and thy shoe is not waxen old upon thy foot.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:6
verses.text: Ye have not eaten bread, neither have ye drunk wine or strong drink: that ye might know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord your God.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:7
verses.text: And when ye came unto this place, Sihon the king of Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, came out against us unto battle, and we smote them:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:8
verses.text: And we took their land, and gave it for an inheritance unto the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half tribe of Manasseh.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:9
verses.text: Keep therefore the words of this covenant, and do them, that ye may prosper in all that ye do.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:10
verses.text: ¶ Ye stand this day all of you before the Lord your God; your captains of your tribes, your elders, and your officers, <hi type="italic">with</hi> all the men of Israel,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:11
verses.text: Your little ones, your wives, and thy stranger that <hi type="italic">is</hi> in thy camp, from the hewer of thy wood unto the drawer of thy water:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:12
verses.text: That thou shouldest enter into covenant with the Lord thy God, and into his oath, which the Lord thy God maketh with thee this day:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:13
verses.text: That he may establish thee to day for a people unto himself, and <hi type="italic">that</hi> he may be unto thee a God, as he hath said unto thee, and as he hath sworn unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:14
verses.text: Neither with you only do I make this covenant and this oath;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:15
verses.text: But with <hi type="italic">him</hi> that standeth here with us this day before the Lord our God, and also with <hi type="italic">him</hi> that <hi type="italic">is</hi> not here with us this day:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:16
verses.text: (For ye know how we have dwelt in the land of Egypt; and how we came through the nations which ye passed by;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:17
verses.text: And ye have seen their abominations, and their idols, wood and stone, silver and gold, which <hi type="italic">were</hi> among them:)

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:18
verses.text: Lest there should be among you man, or woman, or family, or tribe, whose heart turneth away this day from the Lord our God, to go <hi type="italic">and</hi> serve the gods of these nations; lest there should be among you a root that beareth gall and wormwood;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:19
verses.text: And it come to pass, when he heareth the words of this curse, that he bless himself in his heart, saying, I shall have peace, though I walk in the imagination of mine heart, to add drunkenness to thirst:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:20
verses.text: The Lord will not spare him, but then the anger of the Lord and his jealousy shall smoke against that man, and all the curses that are written in this book shall lie upon him, and the Lord shall blot out his name from under heaven.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:21
verses.text: And the Lord shall separate him unto evil out of all the tribes of Israel, according to all the curses of the covenant that are written in this book of the law:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:22
verses.text: So that the generation to come of your children that shall rise up after you, and the stranger that shall come from a far land, shall say, when they see the plagues of that land, and the sicknesses which the Lord hath laid upon it;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:23
verses.text: <hi type="italic">And that</hi> the whole land thereof <hi type="italic">is</hi> brimstone, and salt, <hi type="italic">and</hi> burning, <hi type="italic">that</hi> it is not sown, nor beareth, nor any grass groweth therein, like the overthrow of Sodom, and Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboim, which the Lord overthrew in his anger, and in his wrath:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:24
verses.text: Even all nations shall say, Wherefore hath the Lord done thus unto this land? what <hi type="italic">meaneth</hi> the heat of this great anger?

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:25
verses.text: Then men shall say, Because they have forsaken the covenant of the Lord God of their fathers, which he made with them when he brought them forth out of the land of Egypt:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:26
verses.text: For they went and served other gods, and worshipped them, gods whom they knew not, and <hi type="italic">whom</hi> he had not given unto them:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:27
verses.text: And the anger of the Lord was kindled against this land, to bring upon it all the curses that are written in this book:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:28
verses.text: And the Lord rooted them out of their land in anger, and in wrath, and in great indignation, and cast them into another land, as <hi type="italic">it is</hi> this day.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:29
verses.text: The secret <hi type="italic">things belong</hi> unto the Lord our God: but those <hi type="italic">things which are</hi> revealed <hi type="italic">belong</hi> unto us and to our children for ever, that <hi type="italic">we</hi> may do all the words of this law.  <chapter eID="Deut.29"/><div eID="gen188" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:1
verses.text: AND it shall come to pass, when all these things are come upon thee, the blessing and the curse, which I have set before thee, and thou shalt call <hi type="italic">them</hi> to mind among all the nations, whither the Lord thy God hath driven thee,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:2
verses.text: And shalt return unto the Lord thy God, and shalt obey his voice according to all that I command thee this day, thou and thy children, with all thine heart, and with all thy soul;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:3
verses.text: That then the Lord thy God will turn thy captivity, and have compassion upon thee, and will return and gather thee from all the nations, whither the Lord thy God hath scattered thee.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:4
verses.text: If <hi type="italic">any</hi> of thine be driven out unto the outmost <hi type="italic">parts</hi> of heaven, from thence will the Lord thy God gather thee, and from thence will he fetch thee:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:5
verses.text: And the Lord thy God will bring thee into the land which thy fathers possessed, and thou shalt possess it; and he will do thee good, and multiply thee above thy fathers.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:6
verses.text: And the Lord thy God will circumcise thine heart, and the heart of thy seed, to love the Lord thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, that thou mayest live.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:7
verses.text: And the Lord thy God will put all these curses upon thine enemies, and on them that hate thee, which persecuted thee.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:8
verses.text: And thou shalt return and obey the voice of the Lord, and do all his commandments which I command thee this day.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:9
verses.text: And the Lord thy God will make thee plenteous in every work of thine hand, in the fruit of thy body, and in the fruit of thy cattle, and in the fruit of thy land, for good: for the Lord will again rejoice over thee for good, as he rejoiced over thy fathers:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:10
verses.text: If thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the Lord thy God, to keep his commandments and his statutes which are written in this book of the law, <hi type="italic">and</hi> if thou turn unto the Lord thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:11
verses.text: ¶ For this commandment which I command thee this day, it <hi type="italic">is</hi> not hidden from thee, neither <hi type="italic">is</hi> it far off.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:12
verses.text: It <hi type="italic">is</hi> not in heaven, that thou shouldest say, Who shall go up for us to heaven, and bring it unto us, that we may hear it, and do it?

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:13
verses.text: Neither <hi type="italic">is</hi> it beyond the sea, that thou shouldest say, Who shall go over the sea for us, and bring it unto us, that we may hear it, and do it?

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:14
verses.text: But the word <hi type="italic">is</hi> very nigh unto thee, in thy mouth, and in thy heart, that thou mayest do it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:15
verses.text: ¶ See, I have set before thee this day life and good, and death and evil;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:16
verses.text: In that I command thee this day to love the Lord thy God, to walk in his ways, and to keep his commandments and his statutes and his judgments, that thou mayest live and multiply: and the Lord thy God shall bless thee in the land whither thou goest to possess it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:17
verses.text: But if thine heart turn away, so that thou wilt not hear, but shalt be drawn away, and worship other gods, and serve them;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:18
verses.text: I denounce unto you this day, that ye shall surely perish, <hi type="italic">and that</hi> ye shall not prolong <hi type="italic">your</hi> days upon the land, whither thou passest over Jordan to go to possess it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:19
verses.text: I call heaven and earth to record this day against you, <hi type="italic">that</hi> I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing: therefore choose life, that both thou and thy seed may live:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:20
verses.text: That thou mayest love the Lord thy God, <hi type="italic">and</hi> that thou mayest obey his voice, and that thou mayest cleave unto him: for he <hi type="italic">is</hi> thy life, and the length of thy days: that thou mayest dwell in the land which the Lord sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them.  <chapter eID="Deut.30"/><div eID="gen189" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:1
verses.text: AND Moses went and spake these words unto all Israel.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:2
verses.text: And he said unto them, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> an hundred and twenty years old this day; I can no more go out and come in: also the Lord hath said unto me, Thou shalt not go over this Jordan.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:3
verses.text: The Lord thy God, he will go over before thee, <hi type="italic">and</hi> he will destroy these nations from before thee, and thou shalt possess them: <hi type="italic">and</hi> Joshua, he shall go over before thee, as the Lord hath said.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:4
verses.text: And the Lord shall do unto them as he did to Sihon and to Og, kings of the Amorites, and unto the land of them, whom he destroyed.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:5
verses.text: And the Lord shall give them up before your face, that ye may do unto them according unto all the commandments which I have commanded you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:6
verses.text: Be strong and of a good courage, fear not, nor be afraid of them: for the Lord thy God, he <hi type="italic">it is</hi> that doth go with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:7
verses.text: ¶ And Moses called unto Joshua, and said unto him in the sight of all Israel, Be strong and of a good courage: for thou must go with this people unto the land which the Lord hath sworn unto their fathers to give them; and thou shalt cause them to inherit it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:8
verses.text: And the Lord, he <hi type="italic">it is</hi> that doth go before thee; he will be with thee, he will not fail thee, neither forsake thee: fear not, neither be dismayed.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:9
verses.text: ¶ And Moses wrote this law, and delivered it unto the priests the sons of Levi, which bare the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and unto all the elders of Israel.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:10
verses.text: And Moses commanded them, saying, At the end of <hi type="italic">every</hi> seven years, in the solemnity of the year of release, in the feast of tabernacles,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:11
verses.text: When all Israel is come to appear before the Lord thy God in the place which he shall choose, thou shalt read this law before all Israel in their hearing.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:12
verses.text: Gather the people together, men, and women, and children, and thy stranger that <hi type="italic">is</hi> within thy gates, that they may hear, and that they may learn, and fear the Lord your God, and observe to do all the words of this law:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:13
verses.text: And <hi type="italic">that</hi> their children, which have not known <hi type="italic">any thing</hi>, may hear, and learn to fear the Lord your God, as long as ye live in the land whither ye go over Jordan to possess it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:14
verses.text: ¶ And the Lord said unto Moses, Behold, thy days approach that thou must die: call Joshua, and present yourselves in the tabernacle of the congregation, that I may give him a charge. And Moses and Joshua went, and presented themselves in the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:15
verses.text: And the Lord appeared in the tabernacle in a pillar of a cloud: and the pillar of the cloud stood over the door of the tabernacle.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:16
verses.text: ¶ And the Lord said unto Moses, Behold, thou shalt sleep with thy fathers; and this people will rise up, and go a whoring after the gods of the strangers of the land, whither they go <hi type="italic">to be</hi> among them, and will forsake me, and break my covenant which I have made with them.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:17
verses.text: Then my anger shall be kindled against them in that day, and I will forsake them, and I will hide my face from them, and they shall be devoured, and many evils and troubles shall befall them; so that they will say in that day, Are not these evils come upon us, because our God <hi type="italic">is</hi> not among us?

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:18
verses.text: And I will surely hide my face in that day for all the evils which they shall have wrought, in that they are turned unto other gods.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:19
verses.text: Now therefore write ye this song for you, and teach it the children of Israel: put it in their mouths, that this song may be a witness for me against the children of Israel.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:20
verses.text: For when I shall have brought them into the land which I sware unto their fathers, that floweth with milk and honey; and they shall have eaten and filled themselves, and waxen fat; then will they turn unto other gods, and serve them, and provoke me, and break my covenant.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:21
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, when many evils and troubles are befallen them, that this song shall testify against them as a witness; for it shall not be forgotten out of the mouths of their seed: for I know their imagination which they go about, even now, before I have brought them into the land which I sware.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:22
verses.text: ¶ Moses therefore wrote this song the same day, and taught it the children of Israel.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:23
verses.text: And he gave Joshua the son of Nun a charge, and said, Be strong and of a good courage: for thou shalt bring the children of Israel into the land which I sware unto them: and I will be with thee.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:24
verses.text: ¶ And it came to pass, when Moses had made an end of writing the words of this law in a book, until they were finished,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:25
verses.text: That Moses commanded the Levites, which bare the ark of the covenant of the Lord, saying,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:26
verses.text: Take this book of the law, and put it in the side of the ark of the covenant of the Lord your God, that it may be there for a witness against thee.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:27
verses.text: For I know thy rebellion, and thy stiff neck: behold, while I am yet alive with you this day, ye have been rebellious against the Lord; and how much more after my death?

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:28
verses.text: ¶ Gather unto me all the elders of your tribes, and your officers, that I may speak these words in their ears, and call heaven and earth to record against them.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:29
verses.text: For I know that after my death ye will utterly corrupt <hi type="italic">yourselves</hi>, and turn aside from the way which I have commanded you; and evil will befall you in the latter days; because ye will do evil in the sight of the Lord, to provoke him to anger through the work of your hands.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:30
verses.text: And Moses spake in the ears of all the congregation of Israel the words of this song, until they were ended.  <chapter eID="Deut.31"/><div eID="gen190" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:1
verses.text: GIVE ear, O ye heavens, and I will speak; and hear, O earth, the words of my mouth.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:2
verses.text: My doctrine shall drop as the rain, my speech shall distil as the dew, as the small rain upon the tender herb, and as the showers upon the grass:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:3
verses.text: Because I will publish the name of the Lord: ascribe ye greatness unto our God.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:4
verses.text: <hi type="italic">He is</hi> the Rock, his work <hi type="italic">is</hi> perfect: for all his ways <hi type="italic">are</hi> judgment: a God of truth and without iniquity, just and right <hi type="italic">is</hi> he.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:5
verses.text: They have corrupted themselves, their spot <hi type="italic">is</hi> not <hi type="italic">the spot</hi> of his children: <hi type="italic">they are</hi> a perverse and crooked generation.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:6
verses.text: Do ye thus requite the Lord, O foolish people and unwise? <hi type="italic">is</hi> not he thy father <hi type="italic">that</hi> hath bought thee? hath he not made thee, and established thee?

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:7
verses.text: ¶ Remember the days of old, consider the years of many generations: ask thy father, and he will shew thee; thy elders, and they will tell thee.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:8
verses.text: When the most High divided to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the sons of Adam, he set the bounds of the people according to the number of the children of Israel.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:9
verses.text: For the Lord’s portion <hi type="italic">is</hi> his people; Jacob <hi type="italic">is</hi> the lot of his inheritance.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:10
verses.text: He found him in a desert land, and in the waste howling wilderness; he led him about, he instructed him, he kept him as the apple of his eye.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:11
verses.text: As an eagle stirreth up her nest, fluttereth over her young, spreadeth abroad her wings, taketh them, beareth them on her wings:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:12
verses.text: <hi type="italic">So</hi> the Lord alone did lead him, and <hi type="italic">there was</hi> no strange god with him.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:13
verses.text: He made him ride on the high places of the earth, that he might eat the increase of the fields; and he made him to suck honey out of the rock, and oil out of the flinty rock;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:14
verses.text: Butter of kine, and milk of sheep, with fat of lambs, and rams of the breed of Bashan, and goats, with the fat of kidneys of wheat; and thou didst drink the pure blood of the grape.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:15
verses.text: ¶ But Jeshurun waxed fat, and kicked: thou art waxen fat, thou art grown thick, thou art covered <hi type="italic">with fatness;</hi> then he forsook God <hi type="italic">which</hi> made him, and lightly esteemed the Rock of his salvation.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:16
verses.text: They provoked him to jealousy with strange <hi type="italic">gods</hi>, with abominations provoked they him to anger.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:17
verses.text: They sacrificed unto devils, not to God; to gods whom they knew not, to new <hi type="italic">gods that</hi> came newly up, whom your fathers feared not.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:18
verses.text: Of the Rock <hi type="italic">that</hi> begat thee thou art unmindful, and hast forgotten God that formed thee.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:19
verses.text: And when the Lord saw <hi type="italic">it</hi>, he abhorred <hi type="italic">them</hi>, because of the provoking of his sons, and of his daughters.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:20
verses.text: And he said, I will hide my face from them, I will see what their end <hi type="italic">shall be:</hi> for they <hi type="italic">are</hi> a very froward generation, children in whom <hi type="italic">is</hi> no faith.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:21
verses.text: They have moved me to jealousy with <hi type="italic">that which is</hi> not God; they have provoked me to anger with their vanities: and I will move them to jealousy with <hi type="italic">those which are</hi> not a people; I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:22
verses.text: For a fire is kindled in mine anger, and shall burn unto the lowest hell, and shall consume the earth with her increase, and set on fire the foundations of the mountains.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:23
verses.text: I will heap mischiefs upon them; I will spend mine arrows upon them.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:24
verses.text: <hi type="italic">They shall be</hi> burnt with hunger, and devoured with burning heat, and with bitter destruction: I will also send the teeth of beasts upon them, with the poison of serpents of the dust.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:25
verses.text: The sword without, and terror within, shall destroy both the young man and the virgin, the suckling <hi type="italic">also</hi> with the man of gray hairs.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:26
verses.text: I said, I would scatter them into corners, I would make the remembrance of them to cease from among men:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:27
verses.text: Were it not that I feared the wrath of the enemy, lest their adversaries should behave themselves strangely, <hi type="italic">and</hi> lest they should say, Our hand <hi type="italic">is</hi> high, and the Lord hath not done all this.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:28
verses.text: For they <hi type="italic">are</hi> a nation void of counsel, neither <hi type="italic">is there any</hi> understanding in them.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:29
verses.text: O that they were wise, <hi type="italic">that</hi> they understood this, <hi type="italic">that</hi> they would consider their latter end!

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:30
verses.text: How should one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, except their Rock had sold them, and the Lord had shut them up?

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:31
verses.text: For their rock <hi type="italic">is</hi> not as our Rock, even our enemies themselves <hi type="italic">being</hi> judges.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:32
verses.text: For their vine <hi type="italic">is</hi> of the vine of Sodom, and of the fields of Gomorrah: their grapes <hi type="italic">are</hi> grapes of gall, their clusters <hi type="italic">are</hi> bitter:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:33
verses.text: Their wine <hi type="italic">is</hi> the poison of dragons, and the cruel venom of asps.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:34
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Is</hi> not this laid up in store with me, <hi type="italic">and</hi> sealed up among my treasures?

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:35
verses.text: To me <hi type="italic">belongeth</hi> vengeance, and recompence; their foot shall slide in <hi type="italic">due</hi> time: for the day of their calamity <hi type="italic">is</hi> at hand, and the things that shall come upon them make haste.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:36
verses.text: For the Lord shall judge his people, and repent himself for his servants, when he seeth that <hi type="italic">their</hi> power is gone, and <hi type="italic">there is</hi> none shut up, or left.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:37
verses.text: And he shall say, Where <hi type="italic">are</hi> their gods, <hi type="italic">their</hi> rock in whom they trusted,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:38
verses.text: Which did eat the fat of their sacrifices, <hi type="italic">and</hi> drank the wine of their drink offerings? let them rise up and help you, <hi type="italic">and</hi> be your protection.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:39
verses.text: See now that I, <hi type="italic">even</hi> I, <hi type="italic">am</hi> he, and <hi type="italic">there is</hi> no god with me: I kill, and I make alive; I wound, and I heal: neither <hi type="italic">is there any</hi> that can deliver out of my hand.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:40
verses.text: For I lift up my hand to heaven, and say, I live for ever.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:41
verses.text: If I whet my glittering sword, and mine hand take hold on judgment; I will render vengeance to mine enemies, and will reward them that hate me.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:42
verses.text: I will make mine arrows drunk with blood, and my sword shall devour flesh; <hi type="italic">and that</hi> with the blood of the slain and of the captives, from the beginning of revenges upon the enemy.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:43
verses.text: Rejoice, O ye nations, <hi type="italic">with</hi> his people: for he will avenge the blood of his servants, and will render vengeance to his adversaries, and will be merciful unto his land, <hi type="italic">and</hi> to his people.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:44
verses.text: ¶ And Moses came and spake all the words of this song in the ears of the people, he, and Hoshea the son of Nun.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:45
verses.text: And Moses made an end of speaking all these words to all Israel:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:46
verses.text: And he said unto them, Set your hearts unto all the words which I testify among you this day, which ye shall command your children to observe to do, all the words of this law.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:47
verses.text: For it <hi type="italic">is</hi> not a vain thing for you; because it <hi type="italic">is</hi> your life: and through this thing ye shall prolong <hi type="italic">your</hi> days in the land, whither ye go over Jordan to possess it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:48
verses.text: And the Lord spake unto Moses that selfsame day, saying,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:49
verses.text: Get thee up into this mountain Abarim, <hi type="italic">unto</hi> mount Nebo, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> in the land of Moab, that <hi type="italic">is</hi> over against Jericho; and behold the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel for a possession:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:50
verses.text: And die in the mount whither thou goest up, and be gathered unto thy people; as Aaron thy brother died in mount Hor, and was gathered unto his people:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:51
verses.text: Because ye trespassed against me among the children of Israel at the waters of Meribah-Kadesh, in the wilderness of Zin; because ye sanctified me not in the midst of the children of Israel.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:52
verses.text: Yet thou shalt see the land before <hi type="italic">thee;</hi> but thou shalt not go thither unto the land which I give the children of Israel.  <chapter eID="Deut.32"/><div eID="gen191" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:1
verses.text: AND this <hi type="italic">is</hi> the blessing, wherewith Moses the man of God blessed the children of Israel before his death.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:2
verses.text: And he said, The Lord came from Sinai, and rose up from Seir unto them; he shined forth from mount Paran, and he came with ten thousands of saints: from his right hand <hi type="italic">went</hi> a fiery law for them.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:3
verses.text: Yea, he loved the people; all his saints <hi type="italic">are</hi> in thy hand: and they sat down at thy feet; <hi type="italic">every one</hi> shall receive of thy words.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:4
verses.text: Moses commanded us a law, <hi type="italic">even</hi> the inheritance of the congregation of Jacob.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:5
verses.text: And he was king in Jeshurun, when the heads of the people <hi type="italic">and</hi> the tribes of Israel were gathered together.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:6
verses.text: ¶ Let Reuben live, and not die; and let <hi type="italic">not</hi> his men be few.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:7
verses.text: ¶ And this <hi type="italic">is the blessing</hi> of Judah: and he said, Hear, Lord, the voice of Judah, and bring him unto his people: let his hands be sufficient for him; and be thou an help <hi type="italic">to him</hi> from his enemies.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:8
verses.text: ¶ And of Levi he said, <hi type="italic">Let</hi> thy Thummim and thy Urim <hi type="italic">be</hi> with thy holy one, whom thou didst prove at Massah, <hi type="italic">and with</hi> whom thou didst strive at the waters of Meribah;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:9
verses.text: Who said unto his father and to his mother, I have not seen him; neither did he acknowledge his brethren, nor knew his own children: for they have observed thy word, and kept thy covenant.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:10
verses.text: They shall teach Jacob thy judgments, and Israel thy law: they shall put incense before thee, and whole burnt sacrifice upon thine altar.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:11
verses.text: Bless, Lord, his substance, and accept the work of his hands: smite through the loins of them that rise against him, and of them that hate him, that they rise not again.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:12
verses.text: ¶ <hi type="italic">And</hi> of Benjamin he said, The beloved of the Lord shall dwell in safety by him; <hi type="italic">and the L</hi><hi type="italic">ord</hi> shall cover him all the day long, and he shall dwell between his shoulders.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:13
verses.text: ¶ And of Joseph he said, Blessed of the Lord <hi type="italic">be</hi> his land, for the precious things of heaven, for the dew, and for the deep that coucheth beneath,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:14
verses.text: And for the precious fruits <hi type="italic">brought forth</hi> by the sun, and for the precious things put forth by the moon,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:15
verses.text: And for the chief things of the ancient mountains, and for the precious things of the lasting hills,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:16
verses.text: And for the precious things of the earth and fulness thereof, and <hi type="italic">for</hi> the good will of him that dwelt in the bush: let <hi type="italic">the blessing</hi> come upon the head of Joseph, and upon the top of the head of him <hi type="italic">that was</hi> separated from his brethren.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:17
verses.text: His glory <hi type="italic">is like</hi> the firstling of his bullock, and his horns <hi type="italic">are like</hi> the horns of unicorns: with them he shall push the people together to the ends of the earth: and they <hi type="italic">are</hi> the ten thousands of Ephraim, and they <hi type="italic">are</hi> the thousands of Manasseh.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:18
verses.text: ¶ And of Zebulun he said, Rejoice, Zebulun, in thy going out; and, Issachar, in thy tents.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:19
verses.text: They shall call the people unto the mountain; there they shall offer sacrifices of righteousness: for they shall suck <hi type="italic">of</hi> the abundance of the seas, and <hi type="italic">of</hi> treasures hid in the sand.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:20
verses.text: ¶ And of Gad he said, Blessed <hi type="italic">be</hi> he that enlargeth Gad: he dwelleth as a lion, and teareth the arm with the crown of the head.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:21
verses.text: And he provided the first part for himself, because there, <hi type="italic">in</hi> a portion of the lawgiver, <hi type="italic">was he</hi> seated; and he came with the heads of the people, he executed the justice of the Lord, and his judgments with Israel.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:22
verses.text: ¶ And of Dan he said, Dan <hi type="italic">is</hi> a lion’s whelp: he shall leap from Bashan.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:23
verses.text: ¶ And of Naphtali he said, O Naphtali, satisfied with favour, and full with the blessing of the Lord: possess thou the west and the south.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:24
verses.text: ¶ And of Asher he said, <hi type="italic">Let</hi> Asher <hi type="italic">be</hi> blessed with children; let him be acceptable to his brethren, and let him dip his foot in oil.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:25
verses.text: Thy shoes <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> iron and brass; and as thy days, <hi type="italic">so shall</hi> thy strength <hi type="italic">be</hi>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:26
verses.text: ¶ <hi type="italic">There is</hi> none like unto the God of Jeshurun, <hi type="italic">who</hi> rideth upon the heaven in thy help, and in his excellency on the sky.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:27
verses.text: The eternal God <hi type="italic">is thy</hi> refuge, and underneath <hi type="italic">are</hi> the everlasting arms: and he shall thrust out the enemy from before thee; and shall say, Destroy <hi type="italic">them</hi>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:28
verses.text: Israel then shall dwell in safety alone: the fountain of Jacob <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> upon a land of corn and wine; also his heavens shall drop down dew.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:29
verses.text: Happy <hi type="italic">art</hi> thou, O Israel: who <hi type="italic">is</hi> like unto thee, O people saved by the Lord, the shield of thy help, and who <hi type="italic">is</hi> the sword of thy excellency! and thine enemies shall be found liars unto thee; and thou shalt tread upon their high places.  <chapter eID="Deut.33"/><div eID="gen192" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:1
verses.text: AND Moses went up from the plains of Moab unto the mountain of Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, that <hi type="italic">is</hi> over against Jericho. And the Lord shewed him all the land of Gilead, unto Dan,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:2
verses.text: And all Naphtali, and the land of Ephraim, and Manasseh, and all the land of Judah, unto the utmost sea,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:3
verses.text: And the south, and the plain of the valley of Jericho, the city of palm trees, unto Zoar.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:4
verses.text: And the Lord said unto him, This <hi type="italic">is</hi> the land which I sware unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob, saying, I will give it unto thy seed: I have caused thee to see <hi type="italic">it</hi> with thine eyes, but thou shalt not go over thither.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:5
verses.text: ¶ So Moses the servant of the Lord died there in the land of Moab, according to the word of the Lord.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:6
verses.text: And he buried him in a valley in the land of Moab, over against Beth-peor: but no man knoweth of his sepulchre unto this day.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:7
verses.text: ¶ And Moses <hi type="italic">was</hi> an hundred and twenty years old when he died: his eye was not dim, nor his natural force abated.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:8
verses.text: ¶ And the children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days: so the days of weeping <hi type="italic">and</hi> mourning for Moses were ended.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:9
verses.text: ¶ And Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom; for Moses had laid his hands upon him: and the children of Israel hearkened unto him, and did as the Lord commanded Moses.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:10
verses.text: ¶ And there arose not a prophet since in Israel like unto Moses, whom the Lord knew face to face,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:11
verses.text: In all the signs and the wonders, which the Lord sent him to do in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:12
verses.text: And in all that mighty hand, and in all the great terror which Moses shewed in the sight of all Israel.  <chapter eID="Deut.34"/><div eID="gen193" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen159" osisID="Deut" type="book"/>

verses.name: Joshua 1:1
verses.text: NOW after the death of Moses the servant of the Lord it came to pass, that the Lord spake unto Joshua the son of Nun, Moses’ minister, saying,

verses.name: Joshua 1:2
verses.text: Moses my servant is dead; now therefore arise, go over this Jordan, thou, and all this people, unto the land which I do give to them, <hi type="italic">even</hi> to the children of Israel.

verses.name: Joshua 1:3
verses.text: Every place that the sole of your foot shall tread upon, that have I given unto you, as I said unto Moses.

verses.name: Joshua 1:4
verses.text: From the wilderness and this Lebanon even unto the great river, the river Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites, and unto the great sea toward the going down of the sun, shall be your coast.

verses.name: Joshua 1:5
verses.text: There shall not any man be able to stand before thee all the days of thy life: as I was with Moses, <hi type="italic">so</hi> I will be with thee: I will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.

verses.name: Joshua 1:6
verses.text: Be strong and of a good courage: for unto this people shalt thou divide for an inheritance the land, which I sware unto their fathers to give them.

verses.name: Joshua 1:7
verses.text: Only be thou strong and very courageous, that thou mayest observe to do according to all the law, which Moses my servant commanded thee: turn not from it <hi type="italic">to</hi> the right hand or <hi type="italic">to</hi> the left, that thou mayest prosper whithersoever thou goest.

verses.name: Joshua 1:8
verses.text: This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth; but thou shalt meditate therein day and night, that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein: for then thou shalt make thy way prosperous, and then thou shalt have good success.

verses.name: Joshua 1:9
verses.text: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the Lord thy God <hi type="italic">is</hi> with thee whithersoever thou goest.

verses.name: Joshua 1:10
verses.text: ¶ Then Joshua commanded the officers of the people, saying,

verses.name: Joshua 1:11
verses.text: Pass through the host, and command the people, saying, Prepare you victuals; for within three days ye shall pass over this Jordan, to go in to possess the land, which the Lord your God giveth you to possess it.

verses.name: Joshua 1:12
verses.text: ¶ And to the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to half the tribe of Manasseh, spake Joshua, saying,

verses.name: Joshua 1:13
verses.text: Remember the word which Moses the servant of the Lord commanded you, saying, The Lord your God hath given you rest, and hath given you this land.

verses.name: Joshua 1:14
verses.text: Your wives, your little ones, and your cattle, shall remain in the land which Moses gave you on this side Jordan; but ye shall pass before your brethren armed, all the mighty men of valour, and help them;

verses.name: Joshua 1:15
verses.text: Until the Lord have given your brethren rest, as <hi type="italic">he hath given</hi> you, and they also have possessed the land which the Lord your God giveth them: then ye shall return unto the land of your possession, and enjoy it, which Moses the Lord’s servant gave you on this side Jordan toward the sunrising.

verses.name: Joshua 1:16
verses.text: ¶ And they answered Joshua, saying, All that thou commandest us we will do, and whithersoever thou sendest us, we will go.

verses.name: Joshua 1:17
verses.text: According as we hearkened unto Moses in all things, so will we hearken unto thee: only the Lord thy God be with thee, as he was with Moses.

verses.name: Joshua 1:18
verses.text: Whosoever <hi type="italic">he be</hi> that doth rebel against thy commandment, and will not hearken unto thy words in all that thou commandest him, he shall be put to death: only be strong and of a good courage.  <chapter eID="Josh.1"/><div eID="gen195" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 2:1
verses.text: AND Joshua the son of Nun sent out of Shittim two men to spy secretly, saying, Go view the land, even Jericho. And they went, and came into an harlot’s house, named Rahab, and lodged there.

verses.name: Joshua 2:2
verses.text: And it was told the king of Jericho, saying, Behold, there came men in hither to night of the children of Israel to search out the country.

verses.name: Joshua 2:3
verses.text: And the king of Jericho sent unto Rahab, saying, Bring forth the men that are come to thee, which are entered into thine house: for they be come to search out all the country.

verses.name: Joshua 2:4
verses.text: And the woman took the two men, and hid them, and said thus, There came men unto me, but I wist not whence they <hi type="italic">were:</hi>

verses.name: Joshua 2:5
verses.text: And it came to pass <hi type="italic">about the time</hi> of shutting of the gate, when it was dark, that the men went out: whither the men went I wot not: pursue after them quickly; for ye shall overtake them.

verses.name: Joshua 2:6
verses.text: But she had brought them up to the roof of the house, and hid them with the stalks of flax, which she had laid in order upon the roof.

verses.name: Joshua 2:7
verses.text: And the men pursued after them the way to Jordan unto the fords: and as soon as they which pursued after them were gone out, they shut the gate.

verses.name: Joshua 2:8
verses.text: ¶ And before they were laid down, she came up unto them upon the roof;

verses.name: Joshua 2:9
verses.text: And she said unto the men, I know that the Lord hath given you the land, and that your terror is fallen upon us, and that all the inhabitants of the land faint because of you.

verses.name: Joshua 2:10
verses.text: For we have heard how the Lord dried up the water of the Red sea for you, when ye came out of Egypt; and what ye did unto the two kings of the Amorites, that <hi type="italic">were</hi> on the other side Jordan, Sihon and Og, whom ye utterly destroyed.

verses.name: Joshua 2:11
verses.text: And as soon as we had heard <hi type="italic">these things</hi>, our hearts did melt, neither did there remain any more courage in any man, because of you: for the Lord your God, he <hi type="italic">is</hi> God in heaven above, and in earth beneath.

verses.name: Joshua 2:12
verses.text: Now therefore, I pray you, swear unto me by the Lord, since I have shewed you kindness, that ye will also shew kindness unto my father’s house, and give me a true token:

verses.name: Joshua 2:13
verses.text: And <hi type="italic">that</hi> ye will save alive my father, and my mother, and my brethren, and my sisters, and all that they have, and deliver our lives from death.

verses.name: Joshua 2:14
verses.text: And the men answered her, Our life for yours, if ye utter not this our business. And it shall be, when the Lord hath given us the land, that we will deal kindly and truly with thee.

verses.name: Joshua 2:15
verses.text: Then she let them down by a cord through the window: for her house <hi type="italic">was</hi> upon the town wall, and she dwelt upon the wall.

verses.name: Joshua 2:16
verses.text: And she said unto them, Get you to the mountain, lest the pursuers meet you; and hide yourselves there three days, until the pursuers be returned: and afterward may ye go your way.

verses.name: Joshua 2:17
verses.text: And the men said unto her, We <hi type="italic">will be</hi> blameless of this thine oath which thou hast made us swear.

verses.name: Joshua 2:18
verses.text: Behold, <hi type="italic">when</hi> we come into the land, thou shalt bind this line of scarlet thread in the window which thou didst let us down by: and thou shalt bring thy father, and thy mother, and thy brethren, and all thy father’s household, home unto thee.

verses.name: Joshua 2:19
verses.text: And it shall be, <hi type="italic">that</hi> whosoever shall go out of the doors of thy house into the street, his blood <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> upon his head, and we <hi type="italic">will be</hi> guiltless: and whosoever shall be with thee in the house, his blood <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> on our head, if <hi type="italic">any</hi> hand be upon him.

verses.name: Joshua 2:20
verses.text: And if thou utter this our business, then we will be quit of thine oath which thou hast made us to swear.

verses.name: Joshua 2:21
verses.text: And she said, According unto your words, so <hi type="italic">be</hi> it. And she sent them away, and they departed: and she bound the scarlet line in the window.

verses.name: Joshua 2:22
verses.text: And they went, and came unto the mountain, and abode there three days, until the pursuers were returned: and the pursuers sought <hi type="italic">them</hi> throughout all the way, but found <hi type="italic">them</hi> not.

verses.name: Joshua 2:23
verses.text: ¶ So the two men returned, and descended from the mountain, and passed over, and came to Joshua the son of Nun, and told him all <hi type="italic">things</hi> that befell them:

verses.name: Joshua 2:24
verses.text: And they said unto Joshua, Truly the Lord hath delivered into our hands all the land; for even all the inhabitants of the country do faint because of us.  <chapter eID="Josh.2"/><div eID="gen196" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 3:1
verses.text: AND Joshua rose early in the morning; and they removed from Shittim, and came to Jordan, he and all the children of Israel, and lodged there before they passed over.

verses.name: Joshua 3:2
verses.text: And it came to pass after three days, that the officers went through the host;

verses.name: Joshua 3:3
verses.text: And they commanded the people, saying, When ye see the ark of the covenant of the Lord your God, and the priests the Levites bearing it, then ye shall remove from your place, and go after it.

verses.name: Joshua 3:4
verses.text: Yet there shall be a space between you and it, about two thousand cubits by measure: come not near unto it, that ye may know the way by which ye must go: for ye have not passed <hi type="italic">this</hi> way heretofore.

verses.name: Joshua 3:5
verses.text: And Joshua said unto the people, Sanctify yourselves: for to morrow the Lord will do wonders among you.

verses.name: Joshua 3:6
verses.text: And Joshua spake unto the priests, saying, Take up the ark of the covenant, and pass over before the people. And they took up the ark of the covenant, and went before the people.

verses.name: Joshua 3:7
verses.text: ¶ And the Lord said unto Joshua, This day will I begin to magnify thee in the sight of all Israel, that they may know that, as I was with Moses, <hi type="italic">so</hi> I will be with thee.

verses.name: Joshua 3:8
verses.text: And thou shalt command the priests that bear the ark of the covenant, saying, When ye are come to the brink of the water of Jordan, ye shall stand still in Jordan.

verses.name: Joshua 3:9
verses.text: ¶ And Joshua said unto the children of Israel, Come hither, and hear the words of the Lord your God.

verses.name: Joshua 3:10
verses.text: And Joshua said, Hereby ye shall know that the living God <hi type="italic">is</hi> among you, and <hi type="italic">that</hi> he will without fail drive out from before you the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Hivites, and the Perizzites, and the Girgashites, and the Amorites, and the Jebusites.

verses.name: Joshua 3:11
verses.text: Behold, the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth passeth over before you into Jordan.

verses.name: Joshua 3:12
verses.text: Now therefore take you twelve men out of the tribes of Israel, out of every tribe a man.

verses.name: Joshua 3:13
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, as soon as the soles of the feet of the priests that bear the ark of the Lord, the Lord of all the earth, shall rest in the waters of Jordan, <hi type="italic">that</hi> the waters of Jordan shall be cut off <hi type="italic">from</hi> the waters that come down from above; and they shall stand upon an heap.

verses.name: Joshua 3:14
verses.text: ¶ And it came to pass, when the people removed from their tents, to pass over Jordan, and the priests bearing the ark of the covenant before the people;

verses.name: Joshua 3:15
verses.text: And as they that bare the ark were come unto Jordan, and the feet of the priests that bare the ark were dipped in the brim of the water, (for Jordan overfloweth all his banks all the time of harvest,)

verses.name: Joshua 3:16
verses.text: That the waters which came down from above stood <hi type="italic">and</hi> rose up upon an heap very far from the city Adam, that <hi type="italic">is</hi> beside Zaretan: and those that came down toward the sea of the plain, <hi type="italic">even</hi> the salt sea, failed, <hi type="italic">and</hi> were cut off: and the people passed over right against Jericho.

verses.name: Joshua 3:17
verses.text: And the priests that bare the ark of the covenant of the Lord stood firm on dry ground in the midst of Jordan, and all the Israelites passed over on dry ground, until all the people were passed clean over Jordan.  <chapter eID="Josh.3"/><div eID="gen197" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 4:1
verses.text: AND it came to pass, when all the people were clean passed over Jordan, that the Lord spake unto Joshua, saying,

verses.name: Joshua 4:2
verses.text: Take you twelve men out of the people, out of every tribe a man,

verses.name: Joshua 4:3
verses.text: And command ye them, saying, Take you hence out of the midst of Jordan, out of the place where the priests’ feet stood firm, twelve stones, and ye shall carry them over with you, and leave them in the lodging place, where ye shall lodge this night.

verses.name: Joshua 4:4
verses.text: Then Joshua called the twelve men, whom he had prepared of the children of Israel, out of every tribe a man:

verses.name: Joshua 4:5
verses.text: And Joshua said unto them, Pass over before the ark of the Lord your God into the midst of Jordan, and take ye up every man of you a stone upon his shoulder, according unto the number of the tribes of the children of Israel:

verses.name: Joshua 4:6
verses.text: That this may be a sign among you, <hi type="italic">that</hi> when your children ask <hi type="italic">their fathers</hi> in time to come, saying, What <hi type="italic">mean</hi> ye by these stones?

verses.name: Joshua 4:7
verses.text: Then ye shall answer them, That the waters of Jordan were cut off before the ark of the covenant of the Lord; when it passed over Jordan, the waters of Jordan were cut off: and these stones shall be for a memorial unto the children of Israel for ever.

verses.name: Joshua 4:8
verses.text: And the children of Israel did so as Joshua commanded, and took up twelve stones out of the midst of Jordan, as the Lord spake unto Joshua, according to the number of the tribes of the children of Israel, and carried them over with them unto the place where they lodged, and laid them down there.

verses.name: Joshua 4:9
verses.text: And Joshua set up twelve stones in the midst of Jordan, in the place where the feet of the priests which bare the ark of the covenant stood: and they are there unto this day.

verses.name: Joshua 4:10
verses.text: ¶ For the priests which bare the ark stood in the midst of Jordan, until every thing was finished that the Lord commanded Joshua to speak unto the people, according to all that Moses commanded Joshua: and the people hasted and passed over.

verses.name: Joshua 4:11
verses.text: And it came to pass, when all the people were clean passed over, that the ark of the Lord passed over, and the priests, in the presence of the people.

verses.name: Joshua 4:12
verses.text: And the children of Reuben, and the children of Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh, passed over armed before the children of Israel, as Moses spake unto them:

verses.name: Joshua 4:13
verses.text: About forty thousand prepared for war passed over before the Lord unto battle, to the plains of Jericho.

verses.name: Joshua 4:14
verses.text: ¶ On that day the Lord magnified Joshua in the sight of all Israel; and they feared him, as they feared Moses, all the days of his life.

verses.name: Joshua 4:15
verses.text: And the Lord spake unto Joshua, saying,

verses.name: Joshua 4:16
verses.text: Command the priests that bear the ark of the testimony, that they come up out of Jordan.

verses.name: Joshua 4:17
verses.text: Joshua therefore commanded the priests, saying, Come ye up out of Jordan.

verses.name: Joshua 4:18
verses.text: And it came to pass, when the priests that bare the ark of the covenant of the Lord were come up out of the midst of Jordan, <hi type="italic">and</hi> the soles of the priests’ feet were lifted up unto the dry land, that the waters of Jordan returned unto their place, and flowed over all his banks, as <hi type="italic">they did</hi> before.

verses.name: Joshua 4:19
verses.text: ¶ And the people came up out of Jordan on the tenth <hi type="italic">day</hi> of the first month, and encamped in Gilgal, in the east border of Jericho.

verses.name: Joshua 4:20
verses.text: And those twelve stones, which they took out of Jordan, did Joshua pitch in Gilgal.

verses.name: Joshua 4:21
verses.text: And he spake unto the children of Israel, saying, When your children shall ask their fathers in time to come, saying, What <hi type="italic">mean</hi> these stones?

verses.name: Joshua 4:22
verses.text: Then ye shall let your children know, saying, Israel came over this Jordan on dry land.

verses.name: Joshua 4:23
verses.text: For the Lord your God dried up the waters of Jordan from before you, until ye were passed over, as the Lord your God did to the Red sea, which he dried up from before us, until we were gone over:

verses.name: Joshua 4:24
verses.text: That all the people of the earth might know the hand of the Lord, that it <hi type="italic">is</hi> mighty: that ye might fear the Lord your God for ever.  <chapter eID="Josh.4"/><div eID="gen198" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 5:1
verses.text: AND it came to pass, when all the kings of the Amorites, which <hi type="italic">were</hi> on the side of Jordan westward, and all the kings of the Canaanites, which <hi type="italic">were</hi> by the sea, heard that the Lord had dried up the waters of Jordan from before the children of Israel, until we were passed over, that their heart melted, neither was there spirit in them any more, because of the children of Israel.

verses.name: Joshua 5:2
verses.text: ¶ At that time the Lord said unto Joshua, Make thee sharp knives, and circumcise again the children of Israel the second time.

verses.name: Joshua 5:3
verses.text: And Joshua made him sharp knives, and circumcised the children of Israel at the hill of the foreskins.

verses.name: Joshua 5:4
verses.text: And this <hi type="italic">is</hi> the cause why Joshua did circumcise: All the people that came out of Egypt, <hi type="italic">that were</hi> males, <hi type="italic">even</hi> all the men of war, died in the wilderness by the way, after they came out of Egypt.

verses.name: Joshua 5:5
verses.text: Now all the people that came out were circumcised: but all the people <hi type="italic">that were</hi> born in the wilderness by the way as they came forth out of Egypt, <hi type="italic">them</hi> they had not circumcised.

verses.name: Joshua 5:6
verses.text: For the children of Israel walked forty years in the wilderness, till all the people <hi type="italic">that were</hi> men of war, which came out of Egypt, were consumed, because they obeyed not the voice of the Lord: unto whom the Lord sware that he would not shew them the land, which the Lord sware unto their fathers that he would give us, a land that floweth with milk and honey.

verses.name: Joshua 5:7
verses.text: And their children, <hi type="italic">whom</hi> he raised up in their stead, them Joshua circumcised: for they were uncircumcised, because they had not circumcised them by the way.

verses.name: Joshua 5:8
verses.text: And it came to pass, when they had done circumcising all the people, that they abode in their places in the camp, till they were whole.

verses.name: Joshua 5:9
verses.text: And the Lord said unto Joshua, This day have I rolled away the reproach of Egypt from off you. Wherefore the name of the place is called Gilgal unto this day.

verses.name: Joshua 5:10
verses.text: ¶ And the children of Israel encamped in Gilgal, and kept the passover on the fourteenth day of the month at even in the plains of Jericho.

verses.name: Joshua 5:11
verses.text: And they did eat of the old corn of the land on the morrow after the passover, unleavened cakes, and parched <hi type="italic">corn</hi> in the selfsame day.

verses.name: Joshua 5:12
verses.text: ¶ And the manna ceased on the morrow after they had eaten of the old corn of the land; neither had the children of Israel manna any more; but they did eat of the fruit of the land of Canaan that year.

verses.name: Joshua 5:13
verses.text: ¶ And it came to pass, when Joshua was by Jericho, that he lifted up his eyes and looked, and, behold, there stood a man over against him with his sword drawn in his hand: and Joshua went unto him, and said unto him, <hi type="italic">Art</hi> thou for us, or for our adversaries?

verses.name: Joshua 5:14
verses.text: And he said, Nay; but <hi type="italic">as</hi> captain of the host of the Lord am I now come. And Joshua fell on his face to the earth, and did worship, and said unto him, What saith my lord unto his servant?

verses.name: Joshua 5:15
verses.text: And the captain of the Lord’s host said unto Joshua, Loose thy shoe from off thy foot; for the place whereon thou standest <hi type="italic">is</hi> holy. And Joshua did so.  <chapter eID="Josh.5"/><div eID="gen199" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 6:1
verses.text: NOW Jericho was straitly shut up because of the children of Israel: none went out, and none came in.

verses.name: Joshua 6:2
verses.text: And the Lord said unto Joshua, See, I have given into thine hand Jericho, and the king thereof, <hi type="italic">and</hi> the mighty men of valour.

verses.name: Joshua 6:3
verses.text: And ye shall compass the city, all <hi type="italic">ye</hi> men of war, <hi type="italic">and</hi> go round about the city once. Thus shalt thou do six days.

verses.name: Joshua 6:4
verses.text: And seven priests shall bear before the ark seven trumpets of rams’ horns: and the seventh day ye shall compass the city seven times, and the priests shall blow with the trumpets.

verses.name: Joshua 6:5
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, that when they make a long <hi type="italic">blast</hi> with the ram’s horn, <hi type="italic">and</hi> when ye hear the sound of the trumpet, all the people shall shout with a great shout; and the wall of the city shall fall down flat, and the people shall ascend up every man straight before him.

verses.name: Joshua 6:6
verses.text: ¶ And Joshua the son of Nun called the priests, and said unto them, Take up the ark of the covenant, and let seven priests bear seven trumpets of rams’ horns before the ark of the Lord.

verses.name: Joshua 6:7
verses.text: And he said unto the people, Pass on, and compass the city, and let him that is armed pass on before the ark of the Lord.

verses.name: Joshua 6:8
verses.text: ¶ And it came to pass, when Joshua had spoken unto the people, that the seven priests bearing the seven trumpets of rams’ horns passed on before the Lord, and blew with the trumpets: and the ark of the covenant of the Lord followed them.

verses.name: Joshua 6:9
verses.text: ¶ And the armed men went before the priests that blew with the trumpets, and the rereward came after the ark, <hi type="italic">the priests</hi> going on, and blowing with the trumpets.

verses.name: Joshua 6:10
verses.text: And Joshua had commanded the people, saying, Ye shall not shout, nor make any noise with your voice, neither shall <hi type="italic">any</hi> word proceed out of your mouth, until the day I bid you shout; then shall ye shout.

verses.name: Joshua 6:11
verses.text: So the ark of the Lord compassed the city, going about <hi type="italic">it</hi> once: and they came into the camp, and lodged in the camp.

verses.name: Joshua 6:12
verses.text: ¶ And Joshua rose early in the morning, and the priests took up the ark of the Lord.

verses.name: Joshua 6:13
verses.text: And seven priests bearing seven trumpets of rams’ horns before the ark of the Lord went on continually, and blew with the trumpets: and the armed men went before them; but the rereward came after the ark of the Lord, <hi type="italic">the priests</hi> going on, and blowing with the trumpets.

verses.name: Joshua 6:14
verses.text: And the second day they compassed the city once, and returned into the camp: so they did six days.

verses.name: Joshua 6:15
verses.text: And it came to pass on the seventh day, that they rose early about the dawning of the day, and compassed the city after the same manner seven times: only on that day they compassed the city seven times.

verses.name: Joshua 6:16
verses.text: And it came to pass at the seventh time, when the priests blew with the trumpets, Joshua said unto the people, Shout; for the Lord hath given you the city.

verses.name: Joshua 6:17
verses.text: ¶ And the city shall be accursed, <hi type="italic">even</hi> it, and all that <hi type="italic">are</hi> therein, to the Lord: only Rahab the harlot shall live, she and all that <hi type="italic">are</hi> with her in the house, because she hid the messengers that we sent.

verses.name: Joshua 6:18
verses.text: And ye, in any wise keep <hi type="italic">yourselves</hi> from the accursed thing, lest ye make <hi type="italic">yourselves</hi> accursed, when ye take of the accursed thing, and make the camp of Israel a curse, and trouble it.

verses.name: Joshua 6:19
verses.text: But all the silver, and gold, and vessels of brass and iron, <hi type="italic">are</hi> consecrated unto the Lord: they shall come into the treasury of the Lord.

verses.name: Joshua 6:20
verses.text: So the people shouted when <hi type="italic">the priests</hi> blew with the trumpets: and it came to pass, when the people heard the sound of the trumpet, and the people shouted with a great shout, that the wall fell down flat, so that the people went up into the city, every man straight before him, and they took the city.

verses.name: Joshua 6:21
verses.text: And they utterly destroyed all that <hi type="italic">was</hi> in the city, both man and woman, young and old, and ox, and sheep, and ass, with the edge of the sword.

verses.name: Joshua 6:22
verses.text: But Joshua had said unto the two men that had spied out the country, Go into the harlot’s house, and bring out thence the woman, and all that she hath, as ye sware unto her.

verses.name: Joshua 6:23
verses.text: And the young men that were spies went in, and brought out Rahab, and her father, and her mother, and her brethren, and all that she had; and they brought out all her kindred, and left them without the camp of Israel.

verses.name: Joshua 6:24
verses.text: And they burnt the city with fire, and all that <hi type="italic">was</hi> therein: only the silver, and the gold, and the vessels of brass and of iron, they put into the treasury of the house of the Lord.

verses.name: Joshua 6:25
verses.text: And Joshua saved Rahab the harlot alive, and her father’s household, and all that she had; and she dwelleth in Israel <hi type="italic">even</hi> unto this day; because she hid the messengers, which Joshua sent to spy out Jericho.

verses.name: Joshua 6:26
verses.text: ¶ And Joshua adjured <hi type="italic">them</hi> at that time, saying, Cursed <hi type="italic">be</hi> the man before the Lord, that riseth up and buildeth this city Jericho: he shall lay the foundation thereof in his firstborn, and in his youngest <hi type="italic">son</hi> shall he set up the gates of it.

verses.name: Joshua 6:27
verses.text: So the Lord was with Joshua; and his fame was <hi type="italic">noised</hi> throughout all the country.  <chapter eID="Josh.6"/><div eID="gen200" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 7:1
verses.text: BUT the children of Israel committed a trespass in the accursed thing: for Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, took of the accursed thing: and the anger of the Lord was kindled against the children of Israel.

verses.name: Joshua 7:2
verses.text: And Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> beside Beth-aven, on the east side of Beth-el, and spake unto them, saying, Go up and view the country. And the men went up and viewed Ai.

verses.name: Joshua 7:3
verses.text: And they returned to Joshua, and said unto him, Let not all the people go up; but let about two or three thousand men go up and smite Ai; <hi type="italic">and</hi> make not all the people to labour thither; for they <hi type="italic">are but</hi> few.

verses.name: Joshua 7:4
verses.text: So there went up thither of the people about three thousand men: and they fled before the men of Ai.

verses.name: Joshua 7:5
verses.text: And the men of Ai smote of them about thirty and six men: for they chased them <hi type="italic">from</hi> before the gate <hi type="italic">even</hi> unto Shebarim, and smote them in the going down: wherefore the hearts of the people melted, and became as water.

verses.name: Joshua 7:6
verses.text: ¶ And Joshua rent his clothes, and fell to the earth upon his face before the ark of the Lord until the eventide, he and the elders of Israel, and put dust upon their heads.

verses.name: Joshua 7:7
verses.text: And Joshua said, Alas, O Lord God, wherefore hast thou at all brought this people over Jordan, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us? would to God we had been content, and dwelt on the other side Jordan!

verses.name: Joshua 7:8
verses.text: O Lord, what shall I say, when Israel turneth their backs before their enemies!

verses.name: Joshua 7:9
verses.text: For the Canaanites and all the inhabitants of the land shall hear <hi type="italic">of it</hi>, and shall environ us round, and cut off our name from the earth: and what wilt thou do unto thy great name?

verses.name: Joshua 7:10
verses.text: ¶ And the Lord said unto Joshua, Get thee up; wherefore liest thou thus upon thy face?

verses.name: Joshua 7:11
verses.text: Israel hath sinned, and they have also transgressed my covenant which I commanded them: for they have even taken of the accursed thing, and have also stolen, and dissembled also, and they have put <hi type="italic">it</hi> even among their own stuff.

verses.name: Joshua 7:12
verses.text: Therefore the children of Israel could not stand before their enemies, <hi type="italic">but</hi> turned <hi type="italic">their</hi> backs before their enemies, because they were accursed: neither will I be with you any more, except ye destroy the accursed from among you.

verses.name: Joshua 7:13
verses.text: Up, sanctify the people, and say, Sanctify yourselves against to morrow: for thus saith the Lord God of Israel, <hi type="italic">There is</hi> an accursed thing in the midst of thee, O Israel: thou canst not stand before thine enemies, until ye take away the accursed thing from among you.

verses.name: Joshua 7:14
verses.text: In the morning therefore ye shall be brought according to your tribes: and it shall be, <hi type="italic">that</hi> the tribe which the Lord taketh shall come according to the families <hi type="italic">thereof;</hi> and the family which the Lord shall take shall come by households; and the household which the Lord shall take shall come man by man.

verses.name: Joshua 7:15
verses.text: And it shall be, <hi type="italic">that</hi> he that is taken with the accursed thing shall be burnt with fire, he and all that he hath: because he hath transgressed the covenant of the Lord, and because he hath wrought folly in Israel.

verses.name: Joshua 7:16
verses.text: ¶ So Joshua rose up early in the morning, and brought Israel by their tribes; and the tribe of Judah was taken:

verses.name: Joshua 7:17
verses.text: And he brought the family of Judah; and he took the family of the Zarhites: and he brought the family of the Zarhites man by man; and Zabdi was taken:

verses.name: Joshua 7:18
verses.text: And he brought his household man by man; and Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, was taken.

verses.name: Joshua 7:19
verses.text: And Joshua said unto Achan, My son, give, I pray thee, glory to the Lord God of Israel, and make confession unto him; and tell me now what thou hast done; hide <hi type="italic">it</hi> not from me.

verses.name: Joshua 7:20
verses.text: And Achan answered Joshua, and said, Indeed I have sinned against the Lord God of Israel, and thus and thus have I done:

verses.name: Joshua 7:21
verses.text: When I saw among the spoils a goodly Babylonish garment, and two hundred shekels of silver, and a wedge of gold of fifty shekels weight, then I coveted them, and took them; and, behold, they <hi type="italic">are</hi> hid in the earth in the midst of my tent, and the silver under it.

verses.name: Joshua 7:22
verses.text: ¶ So Joshua sent messengers, and they ran unto the tent; and, behold, <hi type="italic">it was</hi> hid in his tent, and the silver under it.

verses.name: Joshua 7:23
verses.text: And they took them out of the midst of the tent, and brought them unto Joshua, and unto all the children of Israel, and laid them out before the Lord.

verses.name: Joshua 7:24
verses.text: And Joshua, and all Israel with him, took Achan the son of Zerah, and the silver, and the garment, and the wedge of gold, and his sons, and his daughters, and his oxen, and his asses, and his sheep, and his tent, and all that he had: and they brought them unto the valley of Achor.

verses.name: Joshua 7:25
verses.text: And Joshua said, Why hast thou troubled us? the Lord shall trouble thee this day. And all Israel stoned him with stones, and burned them with fire, after they had stoned them with stones.

verses.name: Joshua 7:26
verses.text: And they raised over him a great heap of stones unto this day. So the Lord turned from the fierceness of his anger. Wherefore the name of that place was called, The valley of Achor, unto this day.  <chapter eID="Josh.7"/><div eID="gen201" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 8:1
verses.text: AND the Lord said unto Joshua, Fear not, neither be thou dismayed: take all the people of war with thee, and arise, go up to Ai: see, I have given into thy hand the king of Ai, and his people, and his city, and his land:

verses.name: Joshua 8:2
verses.text: And thou shalt do to Ai and her king as thou didst unto Jericho and her king: only the spoil thereof, and the cattle thereof, shall ye take for a prey unto yourselves: lay thee an ambush for the city behind it.

verses.name: Joshua 8:3
verses.text: ¶ So Joshua arose, and all the people of war, to go up against Ai: and Joshua chose out thirty thousand mighty men of valour, and sent them away by night.

verses.name: Joshua 8:4
verses.text: And he commanded them, saying, Behold, ye shall lie in wait against the city, <hi type="italic">even</hi> behind the city: go not very far from the city, but be ye all ready:

verses.name: Joshua 8:5
verses.text: And I, and all the people that <hi type="italic">are</hi> with me, will approach unto the city: and it shall come to pass, when they come out against us, as at the first, that we will flee before them,

verses.name: Joshua 8:6
verses.text: (For they will come out after us) till we have drawn them from the city; for they will say, They flee before us, as at the first: therefore we will flee before them.

verses.name: Joshua 8:7
verses.text: Then ye shall rise up from the ambush, and seize upon the city: for the Lord your God will deliver it into your hand.

verses.name: Joshua 8:8
verses.text: And it shall be, when ye have taken the city, <hi type="italic">that</hi> ye shall set the city on fire: according to the commandment of the Lord shall ye do. See, I have commanded you.

verses.name: Joshua 8:9
verses.text: ¶ Joshua therefore sent them forth: and they went to lie in ambush, and abode between Beth-el and Ai, on the west side of Ai: but Joshua lodged that night among the people.

verses.name: Joshua 8:10
verses.text: And Joshua rose up early in the morning, and numbered the people, and went up, he and the elders of Israel, before the people to Ai.

verses.name: Joshua 8:11
verses.text: And all the people, <hi type="italic">even the people</hi> of war that <hi type="italic">were</hi> with him, went up, and drew nigh, and came before the city, and pitched on the north side of Ai: now <hi type="italic">there was</hi> a valley between them and Ai.

verses.name: Joshua 8:12
verses.text: And he took about five thousand men, and set them to lie in ambush between Beth-el and Ai, on the west side of the city.

verses.name: Joshua 8:13
verses.text: And when they had set the people, <hi type="italic">even</hi> all the host that <hi type="italic">was</hi> on the north of the city, and their liers in wait on the west of the city, Joshua went that night into the midst of the valley.

verses.name: Joshua 8:14
verses.text: ¶ And it came to pass, when the king of Ai saw <hi type="italic">it</hi>, that they hasted and rose up early, and the men of the city went out against Israel to battle, he and all his people, at a time appointed, before the plain; but he wist not that <hi type="italic">there were</hi> liers in ambush against him behind the city.

verses.name: Joshua 8:15
verses.text: And Joshua and all Israel made as if they were beaten before them, and fled by the way of the wilderness.

verses.name: Joshua 8:16
verses.text: And all the people that <hi type="italic">were</hi> in Ai were called together to pursue after them: and they pursued after Joshua, and were drawn away from the city.

verses.name: Joshua 8:17
verses.text: And there was not a man left in Ai or Beth-el, that went not out after Israel: and they left the city open, and pursued after Israel.

verses.name: Joshua 8:18
verses.text: And the Lord said unto Joshua, Stretch out the spear that <hi type="italic">is</hi> in thy hand toward Ai; for I will give it into thine hand. And Joshua stretched out the spear that <hi type="italic">he had</hi> in his hand toward the city.

verses.name: Joshua 8:19
verses.text: And the ambush arose quickly out of their place, and they ran as soon as he had stretched out his hand: and they entered into the city, and took it, and hasted and set the city on fire.

verses.name: Joshua 8:20
verses.text: And when the men of Ai looked behind them, they saw, and, behold, the smoke of the city ascended up to heaven, and they had no power to flee this way or that way: and the people that fled to the wilderness turned back upon the pursuers.

verses.name: Joshua 8:21
verses.text: And when Joshua and all Israel saw that the ambush had taken the city, and that the smoke of the city ascended, then they turned again, and slew the men of Ai.

verses.name: Joshua 8:22
