verses.text: And the other issued out of the city against them; so they were in the midst of Israel, some on this side, and some on that side: and they smote them, so that they let none of them remain or escape.

verses.name: Joshua 8:23
verses.text: And the king of Ai they took alive, and brought him to Joshua.

verses.name: Joshua 8:24
verses.text: And it came to pass, when Israel had made an end of slaying all the inhabitants of Ai in the field, in the wilderness wherein they chased them, and when they were all fallen on the edge of the sword, until they were consumed, that all the Israelites returned unto Ai, and smote it with the edge of the sword.

verses.name: Joshua 8:25
verses.text: And <hi type="italic">so</hi> it was, <hi type="italic">that</hi> all that fell that day, both of men and women, <hi type="italic">were</hi> twelve thousand, <hi type="italic">even</hi> all the men of Ai.

verses.name: Joshua 8:26
verses.text: For Joshua drew not his hand back, wherewith he stretched out the spear, until he had utterly destroyed all the inhabitants of Ai.

verses.name: Joshua 8:27
verses.text: Only the cattle and the spoil of that city Israel took for a prey unto themselves, according unto the word of the Lord which he commanded Joshua.

verses.name: Joshua 8:28
verses.text: And Joshua burnt Ai, and made it an heap for ever, <hi type="italic">even</hi> a desolation unto this day.

verses.name: Joshua 8:29
verses.text: And the king of Ai he hanged on a tree until eventide: and as soon as the sun was down, Joshua commanded that they should take his carcase down from the tree, and cast it at the entering of the gate of the city, and raise thereon a great heap of stones, <hi type="italic">that remaineth</hi> unto this day.

verses.name: Joshua 8:30
verses.text: ¶ Then Joshua built an altar unto the Lord God of Israel in mount Ebal,

verses.name: Joshua 8:31
verses.text: As Moses the servant of the Lord commanded the children of Israel, as it is written in the book of the law of Moses, an altar of whole stones, over which no man hath lift up <hi type="italic">any</hi> iron: and they offered thereon burnt offerings unto the Lord, and sacrificed peace offerings.

verses.name: Joshua 8:32
verses.text: ¶ And he wrote there upon the stones a copy of the law of Moses, which he wrote in the presence of the children of Israel.

verses.name: Joshua 8:33
verses.text: And all Israel, and their elders, and officers, and their judges, stood on this side the ark and on that side before the priests the Levites, which bare the ark of the covenant of the Lord, as well the stranger, as he that was born among them; half of them over against mount Gerizim, and half of them over against mount Ebal; as Moses the servant of the Lord had commanded before, that they should bless the people of Israel.

verses.name: Joshua 8:34
verses.text: And afterward he read all the words of the law, the blessings and cursings, according to all that is written in the book of the law.

verses.name: Joshua 8:35
verses.text: There was not a word of all that Moses commanded, which Joshua read not before all the congregation of Israel, with the women, and the little ones, and the strangers that were conversant among them.  <chapter eID="Josh.8"/><div eID="gen202" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 9:1
verses.text: AND it came to pass, when all the kings which <hi type="italic">were</hi> on this side Jordan, in the hills, and in the valleys, and in all the coasts of the great sea over against Lebanon, the Hittite, and the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, heard <hi type="italic">thereof;</hi>

verses.name: Joshua 9:2
verses.text: That they gathered themselves together, to fight with Joshua and with Israel, with one accord.

verses.name: Joshua 9:3
verses.text: ¶ And when the inhabitants of Gibeon heard what Joshua had done unto Jericho and to Ai,

verses.name: Joshua 9:4
verses.text: They did work wilily, and went and made as if they had been ambassadors, and took old sacks upon their asses, and wine bottles, old, and rent, and bound up;

verses.name: Joshua 9:5
verses.text: And old shoes and clouted upon their feet, and old garments upon them; and all the bread of their provision was dry <hi type="italic">and</hi> mouldy.

verses.name: Joshua 9:6
verses.text: And they went to Joshua unto the camp at Gilgal, and said unto him, and to the men of Israel, We be come from a far country: now therefore make ye a league with us.

verses.name: Joshua 9:7
verses.text: And the men of Israel said unto the Hivites, Peradventure ye dwell among us; and how shall we make a league with you?

verses.name: Joshua 9:8
verses.text: And they said unto Joshua, We <hi type="italic">are</hi> thy servants. And Joshua said unto them, Who <hi type="italic">are</hi> ye? and from whence come ye?

verses.name: Joshua 9:9
verses.text: And they said unto him, From a very far country thy servants are come because of the name of the Lord thy God: for we have heard the fame of him, and all that he did in Egypt,

verses.name: Joshua 9:10
verses.text: And all that he did to the two kings of the Amorites, that <hi type="italic">were</hi> beyond Jordan, to Sihon king of Heshbon, and to Og king of Bashan, which <hi type="italic">was</hi> at Ashtaroth.

verses.name: Joshua 9:11
verses.text: Wherefore our elders and all the inhabitants of our country spake to us, saying, Take victuals with you for the journey, and go to meet them, and say unto them, We <hi type="italic">are</hi> your servants: therefore now make ye a league with us.

verses.name: Joshua 9:12
verses.text: This our bread we took hot <hi type="italic">for</hi> our provision out of our houses on the day we came forth to go unto you; but now, behold, it is dry, and it is mouldy:

verses.name: Joshua 9:13
verses.text: And these bottles of wine, which we filled, <hi type="italic">were</hi> new; and, behold, they be rent: and these our garments and our shoes are become old by reason of the very long journey.

verses.name: Joshua 9:14
verses.text: And the men took of their victuals, and asked not <hi type="italic">counsel</hi> at the mouth of the Lord.

verses.name: Joshua 9:15
verses.text: And Joshua made peace with them, and made a league with them, to let them live: and the princes of the congregation sware unto them.

verses.name: Joshua 9:16
verses.text: ¶ And it came to pass at the end of three days after they had made a league with them, that they heard that they <hi type="italic">were</hi> their neighbours, and <hi type="italic">that</hi> they dwelt among them.

verses.name: Joshua 9:17
verses.text: And the children of Israel journeyed, and came unto their cities on the third day. Now their cities <hi type="italic">were</hi> Gibeon, and Chephirah, and Beeroth, and Kirjath-jearim.

verses.name: Joshua 9:18
verses.text: And the children of Israel smote them not, because the princes of the congregation had sworn unto them by the Lord God of Israel. And all the congregation murmured against the princes.

verses.name: Joshua 9:19
verses.text: But all the princes said unto all the congregation, We have sworn unto them by the Lord God of Israel: now therefore we may not touch them.

verses.name: Joshua 9:20
verses.text: This we will do to them; we will even let them live, lest wrath be upon us, because of the oath which we sware unto them.

verses.name: Joshua 9:21
verses.text: And the princes said unto them, Let them live; but let them be hewers of wood and drawers of water unto all the congregation; as the princes had promised them.

verses.name: Joshua 9:22
verses.text: ¶ And Joshua called for them, and he spake unto them, saying, Wherefore have ye beguiled us, saying, We <hi type="italic">are</hi> very far from you; when ye dwell among us?

verses.name: Joshua 9:23
verses.text: Now therefore ye <hi type="italic">are</hi> cursed, and there shall none of you be freed from being bondmen, and hewers of wood and drawers of water for the house of my God.

verses.name: Joshua 9:24
verses.text: And they answered Joshua, and said, Because it was certainly told thy servants, how that the Lord thy God commanded his servant Moses to give you all the land, and to destroy all the inhabitants of the land from before you, therefore we were sore afraid of our lives because of you, and have done this thing.

verses.name: Joshua 9:25
verses.text: And now, behold, we <hi type="italic">are</hi> in thine hand: as it seemeth good and right unto thee to do unto us, do.

verses.name: Joshua 9:26
verses.text: And so did he unto them, and delivered them out of the hand of the children of Israel, that they slew them not.

verses.name: Joshua 9:27
verses.text: And Joshua made them that day hewers of wood and drawers of water for the congregation, and for the altar of the Lord, even unto this day, in the place which he should choose.  <chapter eID="Josh.9"/><div eID="gen203" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 10:1
verses.text: NOW it came to pass, when Adoni-zedek king of Jerusalem had heard how Joshua had taken Ai, and had utterly destroyed it; as he had done to Jericho and her king, so he had done to Ai and her king; and how the inhabitants of Gibeon had made peace with Israel, and were among them;

verses.name: Joshua 10:2
verses.text: That they feared greatly, because Gibeon <hi type="italic">was</hi> a great city, as one of the royal cities, and because it <hi type="italic">was</hi> greater than Ai, and all the men thereof <hi type="italic">were</hi> mighty.

verses.name: Joshua 10:3
verses.text: Wherefore Adoni-zedek king of Jerusalem sent unto Hoham king of Hebron, and unto Piram king of Jarmuth, and unto Japhia king of Lachish, and unto Debir king of Eglon, saying,

verses.name: Joshua 10:4
verses.text: Come up unto me, and help me, that we may smite Gibeon: for it hath made peace with Joshua and with the children of Israel.

verses.name: Joshua 10:5
verses.text: Therefore the five kings of the Amorites, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, the king of Eglon, gathered themselves together, and went up, they and all their hosts, and encamped before Gibeon, and made war against it.

verses.name: Joshua 10:6
verses.text: ¶ And the men of Gibeon sent unto Joshua to the camp to Gilgal, saying, Slack not thy hand from thy servants; come up to us quickly, and save us, and help us: for all the kings of the Amorites that dwell in the mountains are gathered together against us.

verses.name: Joshua 10:7
verses.text: So Joshua ascended from Gilgal, he, and all the people of war with him, and all the mighty men of valour.

verses.name: Joshua 10:8
verses.text: ¶ And the Lord said unto Joshua, Fear them not: for I have delivered them into thine hand; there shall not a man of them stand before thee.

verses.name: Joshua 10:9
verses.text: Joshua therefore came unto them suddenly, <hi type="italic">and</hi> went up from Gilgal all night.

verses.name: Joshua 10:10
verses.text: And the Lord discomfited them before Israel, and slew them with a great slaughter at Gibeon, and chased them along the way that goeth up to Beth-horon, and smote them to Azekah, and unto Makkedah.

verses.name: Joshua 10:11
verses.text: And it came to pass, as they fled from before Israel, <hi type="italic">and</hi> were in the going down to Beth-horon, that the Lord cast down great stones from heaven upon them unto Azekah, and they died: <hi type="italic">they were</hi> more which died with hailstones than <hi type="italic">they</hi> whom the children of Israel slew with the sword.

verses.name: Joshua 10:12
verses.text: ¶ Then spake Joshua to the Lord in the day when the Lord delivered up the Amorites before the children of Israel, and he said in the sight of Israel, Sun, stand thou still upon Gibeon; and thou, Moon, in the valley of Ajalon.

verses.name: Joshua 10:13
verses.text: And the sun stood still, and the moon stayed, until the people had avenged themselves upon their enemies. <hi type="italic">Is</hi> not this written in the book of Jasher? So the sun stood still in the midst of heaven, and hasted not to go down about a whole day.

verses.name: Joshua 10:14
verses.text: And there was no day like that before it or after it, that the Lord hearkened unto the voice of a man: for the Lord fought for Israel.

verses.name: Joshua 10:15
verses.text: ¶ And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, unto the camp to Gilgal.

verses.name: Joshua 10:16
verses.text: But these five kings fled, and hid themselves in a cave at Makkedah.

verses.name: Joshua 10:17
verses.text: And it was told Joshua, saying, The five kings are found hid in a cave at Makkedah.

verses.name: Joshua 10:18
verses.text: And Joshua said, Roll great stones upon the mouth of the cave, and set men by it for to keep them:

verses.name: Joshua 10:19
verses.text: And stay ye not, <hi type="italic">but</hi> pursue after your enemies, and smite the hindmost of them; suffer them not to enter into their cities: for the Lord your God hath delivered them into your hand.

verses.name: Joshua 10:20
verses.text: And it came to pass, when Joshua and the children of Israel had made an end of slaying them with a very great slaughter, till they were consumed, that the rest <hi type="italic">which</hi> remained of them entered into fenced cities.

verses.name: Joshua 10:21
verses.text: And all the people returned to the camp to Joshua at Makkedah in peace: none moved his tongue against any of the children of Israel.

verses.name: Joshua 10:22
verses.text: Then said Joshua, Open the mouth of the cave, and bring out those five kings unto me out of the cave.

verses.name: Joshua 10:23
verses.text: And they did so, and brought forth those five kings unto him out of the cave, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, <hi type="italic">and</hi> the king of Eglon.

verses.name: Joshua 10:24
verses.text: And it came to pass, when they brought out those kings unto Joshua, that Joshua called for all the men of Israel, and said unto the captains of the men of war which went with him, Come near, put your feet upon the necks of these kings. And they came near, and put their feet upon the necks of them.

verses.name: Joshua 10:25
verses.text: And Joshua said unto them, Fear not, nor be dismayed, be strong and of good courage: for thus shall the Lord do to all your enemies against whom ye fight.

verses.name: Joshua 10:26
verses.text: And afterward Joshua smote them, and slew them, and hanged them on five trees: and they were hanging upon the trees until the evening.

verses.name: Joshua 10:27
verses.text: And it came to pass at the time of the going down of the sun, <hi type="italic">that</hi> Joshua commanded, and they took them down off the trees, and cast them into the cave wherein they had been hid, and laid great stones in the cave’s mouth, <hi type="italic">which remain</hi> until this very day.

verses.name: Joshua 10:28
verses.text: ¶ And that day Joshua took Makkedah, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and the king thereof he utterly destroyed, them, and all the souls that <hi type="italic">were</hi> therein; he let none remain: and he did to the king of Makkedah as he did unto the king of Jericho.

verses.name: Joshua 10:29
verses.text: Then Joshua passed from Makkedah, and all Israel with him, unto Libnah, and fought against Libnah:

verses.name: Joshua 10:30
verses.text: And the Lord delivered it also, and the king thereof, into the hand of Israel; and he smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that <hi type="italic">were</hi> therein; he let none remain in it; but did unto the king thereof as he did unto the king of Jericho.

verses.name: Joshua 10:31
verses.text: ¶ And Joshua passed from Libnah, and all Israel with him, unto Lachish, and encamped against it, and fought against it:

verses.name: Joshua 10:32
verses.text: And the Lord delivered Lachish into the hand of Israel, which took it on the second day, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that <hi type="italic">were</hi> therein, according to all that he had done to Libnah.

verses.name: Joshua 10:33
verses.text: ¶ Then Horam king of Gezer came up to help Lachish; and Joshua smote him and his people, until he had left him none remaining.

verses.name: Joshua 10:34
verses.text: ¶ And from Lachish Joshua passed unto Eglon, and all Israel with him; and they encamped against it, and fought against it:

verses.name: Joshua 10:35
verses.text: And they took it on that day, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that <hi type="italic">were</hi> therein he utterly destroyed that day, according to all that he had done to Lachish.

verses.name: Joshua 10:36
verses.text: And Joshua went up from Eglon, and all Israel with him, unto Hebron; and they fought against it:

verses.name: Joshua 10:37
verses.text: And they took it, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and the king thereof, and all the cities thereof, and all the souls that <hi type="italic">were</hi> therein; he left none remaining, according to all that he had done to Eglon; but destroyed it utterly, and all the souls that <hi type="italic">were</hi> therein.

verses.name: Joshua 10:38
verses.text: ¶ And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to Debir; and fought against it:

verses.name: Joshua 10:39
verses.text: And he took it, and the king thereof, and all the cities thereof; and they smote them with the edge of the sword, and utterly destroyed all the souls that <hi type="italic">were</hi> therein; he left none remaining: as he had done to Hebron, so he did to Debir, and to the king thereof; as he had done also to Libnah, and to her king.

verses.name: Joshua 10:40
verses.text: ¶ So Joshua smote all the country of the hills, and of the south, and of the vale, and of the springs, and all their kings: he left none remaining, but utterly destroyed all that breathed, as the Lord God of Israel commanded.

verses.name: Joshua 10:41
verses.text: And Joshua smote them from Kadesh-barnea even unto Gaza, and all the country of Goshen, even unto Gibeon.

verses.name: Joshua 10:42
verses.text: And all these kings and their land did Joshua take at one time, because the Lord God of Israel fought for Israel.

verses.name: Joshua 10:43
verses.text: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, unto the camp to Gilgal.  <chapter eID="Josh.10"/><div eID="gen204" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 11:1
verses.text: AND it came to pass, when Jabin king of Hazor had heard <hi type="italic">those things</hi>, that he sent to Jobab king of Madon, and to the king of Shimron, and to the king of Achshaph,

verses.name: Joshua 11:2
verses.text: And to the kings that <hi type="italic">were</hi> on the north of the mountains, and of the plains south of Chinneroth, and in the valley, and in the borders of Dor on the west,

verses.name: Joshua 11:3
verses.text: <hi type="italic">And to</hi> the Canaanite on the east and on the west, and <hi type="italic">to</hi> the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Jebusite in the mountains, and <hi type="italic">to</hi> the Hivite under Hermon in the land of Mizpeh.

verses.name: Joshua 11:4
verses.text: And they went out, they and all their hosts with them, much people, even as the sand that <hi type="italic">is</hi> upon the sea shore in multitude, with horses and chariots very many.

verses.name: Joshua 11:5
verses.text: And when all these kings were met together, they came and pitched together at the waters of Merom, to fight against Israel.

verses.name: Joshua 11:6
verses.text: ¶ And the Lord said unto Joshua, Be not afraid because of them: for to morrow about this time will I deliver them up all slain before Israel: thou shalt hough their horses, and burn their chariots with fire.

verses.name: Joshua 11:7
verses.text: So Joshua came, and all the people of war with him, against them by the waters of Merom suddenly; and they fell upon them.

verses.name: Joshua 11:8
verses.text: And the Lord delivered them into the hand of Israel, who smote them, and chased them unto great Zidon, and unto Misrephoth-maim, and unto the valley of Mizpeh eastward; and they smote them, until they left them none remaining.

verses.name: Joshua 11:9
verses.text: And Joshua did unto them as the Lord bade him: he houghed their horses, and burnt their chariots with fire.

verses.name: Joshua 11:10
verses.text: ¶ And Joshua at that time turned back, and took Hazor, and smote the king thereof with the sword: for Hazor beforetime was the head of all those kingdoms.

verses.name: Joshua 11:11
verses.text: And they smote all the souls that <hi type="italic">were</hi> therein with the edge of the sword, utterly destroying <hi type="italic">them:</hi> there was not any left to breathe: and he burnt Hazor with fire.

verses.name: Joshua 11:12
verses.text: And all the cities of those kings, and all the kings of them, did Joshua take, and smote them with the edge of the sword, <hi type="italic">and</hi> he utterly destroyed them, as Moses the servant of the Lord commanded.

verses.name: Joshua 11:13
verses.text: But <hi type="italic">as for</hi> the cities that stood still in their strength, Israel burned none of them, save Hazor only; <hi type="italic">that</hi> did Joshua burn.

verses.name: Joshua 11:14
verses.text: And all the spoil of these cities, and the cattle, the children of Israel took for a prey unto themselves; but every man they smote with the edge of the sword, until they had destroyed them, neither left they any to breathe.

verses.name: Joshua 11:15
verses.text: ¶ As the Lord commanded Moses his servant, so did Moses command Joshua, and so did Joshua; he left nothing undone of all that the Lord commanded Moses.

verses.name: Joshua 11:16
verses.text: So Joshua took all that land, the hills, and all the south country, and all the land of Goshen, and the valley, and the plain, and the mountain of Israel, and the valley of the same;

verses.name: Joshua 11:17
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Even</hi> from the mount Halak, that goeth up to Seir, even unto Baal-gad in the valley of Lebanon under mount Hermon: and all their kings he took, and smote them, and slew them.

verses.name: Joshua 11:18
verses.text: Joshua made war a long time with all those kings.

verses.name: Joshua 11:19
verses.text: There was not a city that made peace with the children of Israel, save the Hivites the inhabitants of Gibeon: all <hi type="italic">other</hi> they took in battle.

verses.name: Joshua 11:20
verses.text: For it was of the Lord to harden their hearts, that they should come against Israel in battle, that he might destroy them utterly, <hi type="italic">and</hi> that they might have no favour, but that he might destroy them, as the Lord commanded Moses.

verses.name: Joshua 11:21
verses.text: ¶ And at that time came Joshua, and cut off the Anakims from the mountains, from Hebron, from Debir, from Anab, and from all the mountains of Judah, and from all the mountains of Israel: Joshua destroyed them utterly with their cities.

verses.name: Joshua 11:22
verses.text: There was none of the Anakims left in the land of the children of Israel: only in Gaza, in Gath, and in Ashdod, there remained.

verses.name: Joshua 11:23
verses.text: So Joshua took the whole land, according to all that the Lord said unto Moses; and Joshua gave it for an inheritance unto Israel according to their divisions by their tribes. And the land rested from war.  <chapter eID="Josh.11"/><div eID="gen205" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 12:1
verses.text: NOW these <hi type="italic">are</hi> the kings of the land, which the children of Israel smote, and possessed their land on the other side Jordan toward the rising of the sun, from the river Arnon unto mount Hermon, and all the plain on the east:

verses.name: Joshua 12:2
verses.text: Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt in Heshbon, <hi type="italic">and</hi> ruled from Aroer, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> upon the bank of the river Arnon, and from the middle of the river, and from half Gilead, even unto the river Jabbok, <hi type="italic">which is</hi> the border of the children of Ammon;

verses.name: Joshua 12:3
verses.text: And from the plain to the sea of Chinneroth on the east, and unto the sea of the plain, <hi type="italic">even</hi> the salt sea on the east, the way to Beth-jeshimoth; and from the south, under Ashdoth-pisgah:

verses.name: Joshua 12:4
verses.text: ¶ And the coast of Og king of Bashan, <hi type="italic">which was</hi> of the remnant of the giants, that dwelt at Ashtaroth and at Edrei,

verses.name: Joshua 12:5
verses.text: And reigned in mount Hermon, and in Salcah, and in all Bashan, unto the border of the Geshurites and the Maachathites, and half Gilead, the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.

verses.name: Joshua 12:6
verses.text: Them did Moses the servant of the Lord and the children of Israel smite: and Moses the servant of the Lord gave it <hi type="italic">for</hi> a possession unto the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh.

verses.name: Joshua 12:7
verses.text: ¶ And these <hi type="italic">are</hi> the kings of the country which Joshua and the children of Israel smote on this side Jordan on the west, from Baal-gad in the valley of Lebanon even unto the mount Halak, that goeth up to Seir; which Joshua gave unto the tribes of Israel <hi type="italic">for</hi> a possession according to their divisions;

verses.name: Joshua 12:8
verses.text: In the mountains, and in the valleys, and in the plains, and in the springs, and in the wilderness, and in the south country; the Hittites, the Amorites, and the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites:

verses.name: Joshua 12:9
verses.text: ¶ The king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> beside Beth-el, one;

verses.name: Joshua 12:10
verses.text: The king of Jerusalem, one; the king of Hebron, one;

verses.name: Joshua 12:11
verses.text: The king of Jarmuth, one; the king of Lachish, one;

verses.name: Joshua 12:12
verses.text: The king of Eglon, one; the king of Gezer, one;

verses.name: Joshua 12:13
verses.text: The king of Debir, one; the king of Geder, one;

verses.name: Joshua 12:14
verses.text: The king of Hormah, one; the king of Arad, one;

verses.name: Joshua 12:15
verses.text: The king of Libnah, one; the king of Adullam, one;

verses.name: Joshua 12:16
verses.text: The king of Makkedah, one; the king of Beth-el, one;

verses.name: Joshua 12:17
verses.text: The king of Tappuah, one; the king of Hepher, one;

verses.name: Joshua 12:18
verses.text: The king of Aphek, one; the king of Lasharon, one;

verses.name: Joshua 12:19
verses.text: The king of Madon, one; the king of Hazor, one;

verses.name: Joshua 12:20
verses.text: The king of Shimron-meron, one; the king of Achshaph, one;

verses.name: Joshua 12:21
verses.text: The king of Taanach, one; the king of Megiddo, one;

verses.name: Joshua 12:22
verses.text: The king of Kedesh, one; the king of Jokneam of Carmel, one;

verses.name: Joshua 12:23
verses.text: The king of Dor in the coast of Dor, one; the king of the nations of Gilgal, one;

verses.name: Joshua 12:24
verses.text: The king of Tirzah, one: all the kings thirty and one.  <chapter eID="Josh.12"/><div eID="gen206" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 13:1
verses.text: NOW Joshua was old <hi type="italic">and</hi> stricken in years; and the Lord said unto him, Thou art old <hi type="italic">and</hi> stricken in years, and there remaineth yet very much land to be possessed.

verses.name: Joshua 13:2
verses.text: This <hi type="italic">is</hi> the land that yet remaineth: all the borders of the Philistines, and all Geshuri,

verses.name: Joshua 13:3
verses.text: From Sihor, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> before Egypt, even unto the borders of Ekron northward, <hi type="italic">which</hi> is counted to the Canaanite: five lords of the Philistines; the Gazathites, and the Ashdothites, the Eshkalonites, the Gittites, and the Ekronites; also the Avites:

verses.name: Joshua 13:4
verses.text: From the south, all the land of the Canaanites, and Mearah that <hi type="italic">is</hi> beside the Sidonians, unto Aphek, to the borders of the Amorites:

verses.name: Joshua 13:5
verses.text: And the land of the Giblites, and all Lebanon, toward the sunrising, from Baal-gad under mount Hermon unto the entering into Hamath.

verses.name: Joshua 13:6
verses.text: All the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon unto Misrephoth-maim, <hi type="italic">and</hi> all the Sidonians, them will I drive out from before the children of Israel: only divide thou it by lot unto the Israelites for an inheritance, as I have commanded thee.

verses.name: Joshua 13:7
verses.text: Now therefore divide this land for an inheritance unto the nine tribes, and the half tribe of Manasseh,

verses.name: Joshua 13:8
verses.text: With whom the Reubenites and the Gadites have received their inheritance, which Moses gave them, beyond Jordan eastward, <hi type="italic">even</hi> as Moses the servant of the Lord gave them;

verses.name: Joshua 13:9
verses.text: From Aroer, that <hi type="italic">is</hi> upon the bank of the river Arnon, and the city that <hi type="italic">is</hi> in the midst of the river, and all the plain of Medeba unto Dibon;

verses.name: Joshua 13:10
verses.text: And all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites, which reigned in Heshbon, unto the border of the children of Ammon;

verses.name: Joshua 13:11
verses.text: And Gilead, and the border of the Geshurites and Maachathites, and all mount Hermon, and all Bashan unto Salcah;

verses.name: Joshua 13:12
verses.text: All the kingdom of Og in Bashan, which reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei, who remained of the remnant of the giants: for these did Moses smite, and cast them out.

verses.name: Joshua 13:13
verses.text: Nevertheless the children of Israel expelled not the Geshurites, nor the Maachathites: but the Geshurites and the Maachathites dwell among the Israelites until this day.

verses.name: Joshua 13:14
verses.text: Only unto the tribe of Levi he gave none inheritance; the sacrifices of the Lord God of Israel made by fire <hi type="italic">are</hi> their inheritance, as he said unto them.

verses.name: Joshua 13:15
verses.text: ¶ And Moses gave unto the tribe of the children of Reuben <hi type="italic">inheritance</hi> according to their families.

verses.name: Joshua 13:16
verses.text: And their coast was from Aroer, that <hi type="italic">is</hi> on the bank of the river Arnon, and the city that <hi type="italic">is</hi> in the midst of the river, and all the plain by Medeba;

verses.name: Joshua 13:17
verses.text: Heshbon, and all her cities that <hi type="italic">are</hi> in the plain; Dibon, and Bamoth-baal, and Beth-baal-meon,

verses.name: Joshua 13:18
verses.text: And Jahazah, and Kedemoth, and Mephaath,

verses.name: Joshua 13:19
verses.text: And Kirjathaim, and Sibmah, and Zareth-shahar in the mount of the valley,

verses.name: Joshua 13:20
verses.text: And Beth-peor, and Ashdoth-pisgah, and Beth-jeshimoth,

verses.name: Joshua 13:21
verses.text: And all the cities of the plain, and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, which reigned in Heshbon, whom Moses smote with the princes of Midian, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, <hi type="italic">which were</hi> dukes of Sihon, dwelling in the country.

verses.name: Joshua 13:22
verses.text: ¶ Balaam also the son of Beor, the soothsayer, did the children of Israel slay with the sword among them that were slain by them.

verses.name: Joshua 13:23
verses.text: And the border of the children of Reuben was Jordan, and the border <hi type="italic">thereof</hi>. This <hi type="italic">was</hi> the inheritance of the children of Reuben after their families, the cities and the villages thereof.

verses.name: Joshua 13:24
verses.text: And Moses gave <hi type="italic">inheritance</hi> unto the tribe of Gad, <hi type="italic">even</hi> unto the children of Gad according to their families.

verses.name: Joshua 13:25
verses.text: And their coast was Jazer, and all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the children of Ammon, unto Aroer that <hi type="italic">is</hi> before Rabbah;

verses.name: Joshua 13:26
verses.text: And from Heshbon unto Ramath-mizpeh, and Betonim; and from Mahanaim unto the border of Debir;

verses.name: Joshua 13:27
verses.text: And in the valley, Beth-aram, and Beth-nimrah, and Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, Jordan and <hi type="italic">his</hi> border, <hi type="italic">even</hi> unto the edge of the sea of Chinnereth on the other side Jordan eastward.

verses.name: Joshua 13:28
verses.text: This <hi type="italic">is</hi> the inheritance of the children of Gad after their families, the cities, and their villages.

verses.name: Joshua 13:29
verses.text: ¶ And Moses gave <hi type="italic">inheritance</hi> unto the half tribe of Manasseh: and <hi type="italic">this</hi> was <hi type="italic">the possession</hi> of the half tribe of the children of Manasseh by their families.

verses.name: Joshua 13:30
verses.text: And their coast was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the towns of Jair, which <hi type="italic">are</hi> in Bashan, threescore cities:

verses.name: Joshua 13:31
verses.text: And half Gilead, and Ashtaroth, and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, <hi type="italic">were pertaining</hi> unto the children of Machir the son of Manasseh, <hi type="italic">even</hi> to the one half of the children of Machir by their families.

verses.name: Joshua 13:32
verses.text: These <hi type="italic">are the countries</hi> which Moses did distribute for inheritance in the plains of Moab, on the other side Jordan, by Jericho, eastward.

verses.name: Joshua 13:33
verses.text: But unto the tribe of Levi Moses gave not <hi type="italic">any</hi> inheritance: the Lord God of Israel <hi type="italic">was</hi> their inheritance, as he said unto them.  <chapter eID="Josh.13"/><div eID="gen207" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 14:1
verses.text: AND these <hi type="italic">are the countries</hi> which the children of Israel inherited in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed for inheritance to them.

verses.name: Joshua 14:2
verses.text: By lot <hi type="italic">was</hi> their inheritance, as the Lord commanded by the hand of Moses, for the nine tribes, and <hi type="italic">for</hi> the half tribe.

verses.name: Joshua 14:3
verses.text: For Moses had given the inheritance of two tribes and an half tribe on the other side Jordan: but unto the Levites he gave none inheritance among them.

verses.name: Joshua 14:4
verses.text: For the children of Joseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim: therefore they gave no part unto the Levites in the land, save cities to dwell <hi type="italic">in</hi>, with their suburbs for their cattle and for their substance.

verses.name: Joshua 14:5
verses.text: As the Lord commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did, and they divided the land.

verses.name: Joshua 14:6
verses.text: ¶ Then the children of Judah came unto Joshua in Gilgal: and Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite said unto him, Thou knowest the thing that the Lord said unto Moses the man of God concerning me and thee in Kadesh-barnea.

verses.name: Joshua 14:7
verses.text: Forty years old <hi type="italic">was</hi> I when Moses the servant of the Lord sent me from Kadesh-barnea to espy out the land; and I brought him word again as <hi type="italic">it was</hi> in mine heart.

verses.name: Joshua 14:8
verses.text: Nevertheless my brethren that went up with me made the heart of the people melt: but I wholly followed the Lord my God.

verses.name: Joshua 14:9
verses.text: And Moses sware on that day, saying, Surely the land whereon thy feet have trodden shall be thine inheritance, and thy children’s for ever, because thou hast wholly followed the Lord my God.

verses.name: Joshua 14:10
verses.text: And now, behold, the Lord hath kept me alive, as he said, these forty and five years, even since the Lord spake this word unto Moses, while <hi type="italic">the children of</hi> Israel wandered in the wilderness: and now, lo, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> this day fourscore and five years old.

verses.name: Joshua 14:11
verses.text: As yet I <hi type="italic">am as</hi> strong this day as <hi type="italic">I was</hi> in the day that Moses sent me: as my strength <hi type="italic">was</hi> then, even so <hi type="italic">is</hi> my strength now, for war, both to go out, and to come in.

verses.name: Joshua 14:12
verses.text: Now therefore give me this mountain, whereof the Lord spake in that day; for thou heardest in that day how the Anakims <hi type="italic">were</hi> there, and <hi type="italic">that</hi> the cities <hi type="italic">were</hi> great <hi type="italic">and</hi> fenced: if so be the Lord <hi type="italic">will be</hi> with me, then I shall be able to drive them out, as the Lord said.

verses.name: Joshua 14:13
verses.text: And Joshua blessed him, and gave unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh Hebron for an inheritance.

verses.name: Joshua 14:14
verses.text: Hebron therefore became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite unto this day, because that he wholly followed the Lord God of Israel.

verses.name: Joshua 14:15
verses.text: And the name of Hebron before <hi type="italic">was</hi> Kirjath-arba; <hi type="italic">which Arba was</hi> a great man among the Anakims. And the land had rest from war.  <chapter eID="Josh.14"/><div eID="gen208" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 15:2
verses.text: And their south border was from the shore of the salt sea, from the bay that looketh southward:

verses.name: Joshua 15:3
verses.text: And it went out to the south side to Maaleh-acrabbim, and passed along to Zin, and ascended up on the south side unto Kadesh-barnea, and passed along to Hezron, and went up to Adar, and fetched a compass to Karkaa:

verses.name: Joshua 15:4
verses.text: <hi type="italic">From thence</hi> it passed toward Azmon, and went out unto the river of Egypt; and the goings out of that coast were at the sea: this shall be your south coast.

verses.name: Joshua 15:5
verses.text: And the east border <hi type="italic">was</hi> the salt sea, <hi type="italic">even</hi> unto the end of Jordan. And <hi type="italic">their</hi> border in the north quarter <hi type="italic">was</hi> from the bay of the sea at the uttermost part of Jordan:

verses.name: Joshua 15:6
verses.text: And the border went up to Beth-hogla, and passed along by the north of Beth-arabah; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben:

verses.name: Joshua 15:7
verses.text: And the border went up toward Debir from the valley of Achor, and so northward, looking toward Gilgal, that <hi type="italic">is</hi> before the going up to Adummim, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> on the south side of the river: and the border passed toward the waters of En-shemesh, and the goings out thereof were at En-rogel:

verses.name: Joshua 15:8
verses.text: And the border went up by the valley of the son of Hinnom unto the south side of the Jebusite; the same <hi type="italic">is</hi> Jerusalem: and the border went up to the top of the mountain that <hi type="italic">lieth</hi> before the valley of Hinnom westward, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> at the end of the valley of the giants northward:

verses.name: Joshua 15:9
verses.text: And the border was drawn from the top of the hill unto the fountain of the water of Nephtoah, and went out to the cities of mount Ephron; and the border was drawn to Baalah, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> Kirjath-jearim:

verses.name: Joshua 15:10
verses.text: And the border compassed from Baalah westward unto mount Seir, and passed along unto the side of mount Jearim, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> Chesalon, on the north side, and went down to Beth-shemesh, and passed on to Timnah:

verses.name: Joshua 15:11
verses.text: And the border went out unto the side of Ekron northward: and the border was drawn to Shicron, and passed along to mount Baalah, and went out unto Jabneel; and the goings out of the border were at the sea.

verses.name: Joshua 15:12
verses.text: And the west border <hi type="italic">was</hi> to the great sea, and the coast <hi type="italic">thereof</hi>. This <hi type="italic">is</hi> the coast of the children of Judah round about according to their families.

verses.name: Joshua 15:13
verses.text: ¶ And unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh he gave a part among the children of Judah, according to the commandment of the Lord to Joshua, <hi type="italic">even</hi> the city of Arba the father of Anak, which <hi type="italic">city is</hi> Hebron.

verses.name: Joshua 15:14
verses.text: And Caleb drove thence the three sons of Anak, Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.

verses.name: Joshua 15:15
verses.text: And he went up thence to the inhabitants of Debir: and the name of Debir before <hi type="italic">was</hi> Kirjath-sepher.

verses.name: Joshua 15:16
verses.text: ¶ And Caleb said, He that smiteth Kirjath-sepher, and taketh it, to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife.

verses.name: Joshua 15:17
verses.text: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife.

verses.name: Joshua 15:18
verses.text: And it came to pass, as she came <hi type="italic">unto him</hi>, that she moved him to ask of her father a field: and she lighted off <hi type="italic">her</hi> ass; and Caleb said unto her, What wouldest thou?

verses.name: Joshua 15:19
verses.text: Who answered, Give me a blessing; for thou hast given me a south land; give me also springs of water. And he gave her the upper springs, and the nether springs.

verses.name: Joshua 15:20
verses.text: This <hi type="italic">is</hi> the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families.

verses.name: Joshua 15:21
verses.text: And the uttermost cities of the tribe of the children of Judah toward the coast of Edom southward were Kabzeel, and Eder, and Jagur,

verses.name: Joshua 15:22
verses.text: And Kinah, and Dimonah, and Adadah,

verses.name: Joshua 15:23
verses.text: And Kedesh, and Hazor, and Ithnan,

verses.name: Joshua 15:24
verses.text: Ziph, and Telem, and Bealoth,

verses.name: Joshua 15:25
verses.text: And Hazor, Hadattah, and Kerioth, <hi type="italic">and</hi> Hezron, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> Hazor,

verses.name: Joshua 15:26
verses.text: Amam, and Shema, and Moladah,

verses.name: Joshua 15:27
verses.text: And Hazar-gaddah, and Heshmon, and Beth-palet,

verses.name: Joshua 15:28
verses.text: And Hazar-shual, and Beer-sheba, and Bizjothjah,

verses.name: Joshua 15:29
verses.text: Baalah, and Iim, and Azem,

verses.name: Joshua 15:30
verses.text: And Eltolad, and Chesil, and Hormah,

verses.name: Joshua 15:31
verses.text: And Ziklag, and Madmannah, and Sansannah,

verses.name: Joshua 15:32
verses.text: And Lebaoth, and Shilhim, and Ain, and Rimmon: all the cities <hi type="italic">are</hi> twenty and nine, with their villages:

verses.name: Joshua 15:33
verses.text: <hi type="italic">And</hi> in the valley, Eshtaol, and Zoreah, and Ashnah,

verses.name: Joshua 15:34
verses.text: And Zanoah, and En-gannim, Tappuah, and Enam,

verses.name: Joshua 15:35
verses.text: Jarmuth, and Adullam, Socoh, and Azekah,

verses.name: Joshua 15:36
verses.text: And Sharaim, and Adithaim, and Gederah, and Gederothaim; fourteen cities with their villages:

verses.name: Joshua 15:37
verses.text: Zenan, and Hadashah, and Migdal-gad,

verses.name: Joshua 15:38
verses.text: And Dilean, and Mizpeh, and Joktheel,

verses.name: Joshua 15:39
verses.text: Lachish, and Bozkath, and Eglon,

verses.name: Joshua 15:40
verses.text: And Cabbon, and Lahmam, and Kithlish,

verses.name: Joshua 15:41
verses.text: And Gederoth, Beth-dagon, and Naamah, and Makkedah; sixteen cities with their villages:

verses.name: Joshua 15:42
verses.text: Libnah, and Ether, and Ashan,

verses.name: Joshua 15:43
verses.text: And Jiphtah, and Ashnah, and Nezib,

verses.name: Joshua 15:44
verses.text: And Keilah, and Achzib, and Mareshah; nine cities with their villages:

verses.name: Joshua 15:45
verses.text: Ekron, with her towns and her villages:

verses.name: Joshua 15:46
verses.text: From Ekron even unto the sea, all that <hi type="italic">lay</hi> near Ashdod, with their villages:

verses.name: Joshua 15:47
verses.text: Ashdod with her towns and her villages, Gaza with her towns and her villages, unto the river of Egypt, and the great sea, and the border <hi type="italic">thereof:</hi>

verses.name: Joshua 15:48
verses.text: ¶ And in the mountains, Shamir, and Jattir, and Socoh,

verses.name: Joshua 15:49
verses.text: And Dannah, and Kirjath-sannah, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> Debir,

verses.name: Joshua 15:50
verses.text: And Anab, and Eshtemoh, and Anim,

verses.name: Joshua 15:51
verses.text: And Goshen, and Holon, and Giloh; eleven cities with their villages:

verses.name: Joshua 15:52
verses.text: Arab, and Dumah, and Eshean,

verses.name: Joshua 15:53
verses.text: And Janum, and Beth-tappuah, and Aphekah,

verses.name: Joshua 15:54
verses.text: And Humtah, and Kirjath-arba, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> Hebron, and Zior; nine cities with their villages:

verses.name: Joshua 15:55
verses.text: Maon, Carmel, and Ziph, and Juttah,

verses.name: Joshua 15:56
verses.text: And Jezreel, and Jokdeam, and Zanoah,

verses.name: Joshua 15:57
verses.text: Cain, Gibeah, and Timnah; ten cities with their villages:

verses.name: Joshua 15:58
verses.text: Halhul, Beth-zur, and Gedor,

verses.name: Joshua 15:59
verses.text: And Maarath, and Beth-anoth, and Eltekon; six cities with their villages:

verses.name: Joshua 15:60
verses.text: Kirjath-baal, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> Kirjath-jearim, and Rabbah; two cities with their villages:

verses.name: Joshua 15:61
verses.text: In the wilderness, Beth-arabah, Middin, and Secacah,

verses.name: Joshua 15:62
verses.text: And Nibshan, and the city of Salt, and En-gedi; six cities with their villages.

verses.name: Joshua 15:63
verses.text: ¶ As for the Jebusites the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the children of Judah could not drive them out: but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Judah at Jerusalem unto this day.  <chapter eID="Josh.15"/><div eID="gen209" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 16:1
verses.text: AND the lot of the children of Joseph fell from Jordan by Jericho, unto the water of Jericho on the east, to the wilderness that goeth up from Jericho throughout mount Beth-el,

verses.name: Joshua 16:2
verses.text: And goeth out from Beth-el to Luz, and passeth along unto the borders of Archi to Ataroth,

verses.name: Joshua 16:3
verses.text: And goeth down westward to the coast of Japhleti, unto the coast of Beth-horon the nether, and to Gezer: and the goings out thereof are at the sea.

verses.name: Joshua 16:4
verses.text: So the children of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, took their inheritance.

verses.name: Joshua 16:5
verses.text: ¶ And the border of the children of Ephraim according to their families was <hi type="italic">thus:</hi> even the border of their inheritance on the east side was Ataroth-addar, unto Beth-horon the upper;

verses.name: Joshua 16:6
verses.text: And the border went out toward the sea to Michmethah on the north side; and the border went about eastward unto Taanath-shiloh, and passed by it on the east to Janohah;

verses.name: Joshua 16:7
verses.text: And it went down from Janohah to Ataroth, and to Naarath, and came to Jericho, and went out at Jordan.

verses.name: Joshua 16:8
verses.text: The border went out from Tappuah westward unto the river Kanah; and the goings out thereof were at the sea. This <hi type="italic">is</hi> the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Ephraim by their families.

verses.name: Joshua 16:9
verses.text: And the separate cities for the children of Ephraim <hi type="italic">were</hi> among the inheritance of the children of Manasseh, all the cities with their villages.

verses.name: Joshua 16:10
verses.text: And they drave not out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer: but the Canaanites dwell among the Ephraimites unto this day, and serve under tribute.  <chapter eID="Josh.16"/><div eID="gen210" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 17:1
verses.text: THERE was also a lot for the tribe of Manasseh; for he <hi type="italic">was</hi> the firstborn of Joseph; <hi type="italic">to wit</hi>, for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead: because he was a man of war, therefore he had Gilead and Bashan.

verses.name: Joshua 17:2
verses.text: There was also <hi type="italic">a lot</hi> for the rest of the children of Manasseh by their families; for the children of Abiezer, and for the children of Helek, and for the children of Asriel, and for the children of Shechem, and for the children of Hepher, and for the children of Shemida: these <hi type="italic">were</hi> the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph by their families.

verses.name: Joshua 17:3
verses.text: ¶ But Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, but daughters: and these <hi type="italic">are</hi> the names of his daughters, Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

verses.name: Joshua 17:4
verses.text: And they came near before Eleazar the priest, and before Joshua the son of Nun, and before the princes, saying, The Lord commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brethren. Therefore according to the commandment of the Lord he gave them an inheritance among the brethren of their father.

verses.name: Joshua 17:5
verses.text: And there fell ten portions to Manasseh, beside the land of Gilead and Bashan, which <hi type="italic">were</hi> on the other side Jordan;

verses.name: Joshua 17:6
verses.text: Because the daughters of Manasseh had an inheritance among his sons: and the rest of Manasseh’s sons had the land of Gilead.

verses.name: Joshua 17:7
verses.text: ¶ And the coast of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethah, that <hi type="italic">lieth</hi> before Shechem; and the border went along on the right hand unto the inhabitants of En-tappuah.

verses.name: Joshua 17:8
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Now</hi> Manasseh had the land of Tappuah: but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh <hi type="italic">belonged</hi> to the children of Ephraim;

verses.name: Joshua 17:9
verses.text: And the coast descended unto the river Kanah, southward of the river: these cities of Ephraim <hi type="italic">are</hi> among the cities of Manasseh: the coast of Manasseh also <hi type="italic">was</hi> on the north side of the river, and the outgoings of it were at the sea:

verses.name: Joshua 17:10
verses.text: Southward <hi type="italic">it was</hi> Ephraim’s, and northward <hi type="italic">it was</hi> Manasseh’s, and the sea is his border; and they met together in Asher on the north, and in Issachar on the east.

verses.name: Joshua 17:11
verses.text: And Manasseh had in Issachar and in Asher Beth-shean and her towns, and Ibleam and her towns, and the inhabitants of Dor and her towns, and the inhabitants of Endor and her towns, and the inhabitants of Taanach and her towns, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and her towns, <hi type="italic">even</hi> three countries.

verses.name: Joshua 17:12
verses.text: Yet the children of Manasseh could not drive out <hi type="italic">the inhabitants of</hi> those cities; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.

verses.name: Joshua 17:13
verses.text: Yet it came to pass, when the children of Israel were waxen strong, that they put the Canaanites to tribute; but did not utterly drive them out.

verses.name: Joshua 17:14
verses.text: And the children of Joseph spake unto Joshua, saying, Why hast thou given me <hi type="italic">but</hi> one lot and one portion to inherit, seeing I <hi type="italic">am</hi> a great people, forasmuch as the Lord hath blessed me hitherto?

verses.name: Joshua 17:15
verses.text: And Joshua answered them, If thou <hi type="italic">be</hi> a great people, <hi type="italic">then</hi> get thee up to the wood <hi type="italic">country</hi>, and cut down for thyself there in the land of the Perizzites and of the giants, if mount Ephraim be too narrow for thee.

verses.name: Joshua 17:16
verses.text: And the children of Joseph said, The hill is not enough for us: and all the Canaanites that dwell in the land of the valley have chariots of iron, <hi type="italic">both they</hi> who <hi type="italic">are</hi> of Beth-shean and her towns, and <hi type="italic">they</hi> who <hi type="italic">are</hi> of the valley of Jezreel.

verses.name: Joshua 17:17
verses.text: And Joshua spake unto the house of Joseph, <hi type="italic">even</hi> to Ephraim and to Manasseh, saying, Thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> a great people, and hast great power: thou shalt not have one lot <hi type="italic">only:</hi>

verses.name: Joshua 17:18
verses.text: But the mountain shall be thine; for it <hi type="italic">is</hi> a wood, and thou shalt cut it down: and the outgoings of it shall be thine: for thou shalt drive out the Canaanites, though they have iron chariots, <hi type="italic">and</hi> though they <hi type="italic">be</hi> strong.  <chapter eID="Josh.17"/><div eID="gen211" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 18:1
verses.text: AND the whole congregation of the children of Israel assembled together at Shiloh, and set up the tabernacle of the congregation there. And the land was subdued before them.

verses.name: Joshua 18:2
verses.text: And there remained among the children of Israel seven tribes, which had not yet received their inheritance.

verses.name: Joshua 18:3
verses.text: And Joshua said unto the children of Israel, How long <hi type="italic">are</hi> ye slack to go to possess the land, which the Lord God of your fathers hath given you?

verses.name: Joshua 18:4
verses.text: Give out from among you three men for <hi type="italic">each</hi> tribe: and I will send them, and they shall rise, and go through the land, and describe it according to the inheritance of them; and they shall come <hi type="italic">again</hi> to me.

verses.name: Joshua 18:5
verses.text: And they shall divide it into seven parts: Judah shall abide in their coast on the south, and the house of Joseph shall abide in their coasts on the north.

verses.name: Joshua 18:6
verses.text: Ye shall therefore describe the land <hi type="italic">into</hi> seven parts, and bring <hi type="italic">the description</hi> hither to me, that I may cast lots for you here before the Lord our God.

verses.name: Joshua 18:7
verses.text: But the Levites have no part among you; for the priesthood of the Lord <hi type="italic">is</hi> their inheritance: and Gad, and Reuben, and half the tribe of Manasseh, have received their inheritance beyond Jordan on the east, which Moses the servant of the Lord gave them.

verses.name: Joshua 18:8
verses.text: ¶ And the men arose, and went away: and Joshua charged them that went to describe the land, saying, Go and walk through the land, and describe it, and come again to me, that I may here cast lots for you before the Lord in Shiloh.

verses.name: Joshua 18:9
verses.text: And the men went and passed through the land, and described it by cities into seven parts in a book, and came <hi type="italic">again</hi> to Joshua to the host at Shiloh.

verses.name: Joshua 18:10
verses.text: ¶ And Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before the Lord: and there Joshua divided the land unto the children of Israel according to their divisions.

verses.name: Joshua 18:11
verses.text: ¶ And the lot of the tribe of the children of Benjamin came up according to their families: and the coast of their lot came forth between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph.

verses.name: Joshua 18:12
verses.text: And their border on the north side was from Jordan; and the border went up to the side of Jericho on the north side, and went up through the mountains westward; and the goings out thereof were at the wilderness of Beth-aven.

verses.name: Joshua 18:13
verses.text: And the border went over from thence toward Luz, to the side of Luz, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> Beth-el, southward; and the border descended to Ataroth-adar, near the hill that <hi type="italic">lieth</hi> on the south side of the nether Beth-horon.

verses.name: Joshua 18:14
verses.text: And the border was drawn <hi type="italic">thence</hi>, and compassed the corner of the sea southward, from the hill that <hi type="italic">lieth</hi> before Beth-horon southward; and the goings out thereof were at Kirjath-baal, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> Kirjath-jearim, a city of the children of Judah: this <hi type="italic">was</hi> the west quarter.

verses.name: Joshua 18:15
verses.text: And the south quarter <hi type="italic">was</hi> from the end of Kirjath-jearim, and the border went out on the west, and went out to the well of waters of Nephtoah:

verses.name: Joshua 18:16
verses.text: And the border came down to the end of the mountain that <hi type="italic">lieth</hi> before the valley of the son of Hinnom, <hi type="italic">and</hi> which <hi type="italic">is</hi> in the valley of the giants on the north, and descended to the valley of Hinnom, to the side of Jebusi on the south, and descended to En-rogel,

verses.name: Joshua 18:17
verses.text: And was drawn from the north, and went forth to En-shemesh, and went forth toward Geliloth, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> over against the going up of Adummim, and descended to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben,

verses.name: Joshua 18:18
verses.text: And passed along toward the side over against Arabah northward, and went down unto Arabah:

verses.name: Joshua 18:19
verses.text: And the border passed along to the side of Beth-hoglah northward: and the outgoings of the border were at the north bay of the salt sea at the south end of Jordan: this <hi type="italic">was</hi> the south coast.

verses.name: Joshua 18:20
verses.text: And Jordan was the border of it on the east side. This <hi type="italic">was</hi> the inheritance of the children of Benjamin, by the coasts thereof round about, according to their families.

verses.name: Joshua 18:21
verses.text: Now the cities of the tribe of the children of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho, and Beth-hoglah, and the valley of Keziz,

verses.name: Joshua 18:22
verses.text: And Beth-arabah, and Zemaraim, and Beth-el,

verses.name: Joshua 18:23
verses.text: And Avim, and Parah, and Ophrah,

verses.name: Joshua 18:24
verses.text: And Chephar-haammonai, and Ophni, and Gaba; twelve cities with their villages:

verses.name: Joshua 18:25
verses.text: Gibeon, and Ramah, and Beeroth,

verses.name: Joshua 18:26
verses.text: And Mizpeh, and Chephirah, and Mozah,

verses.name: Joshua 18:27
verses.text: And Rekem, and Irpeel, and Taralah,

verses.name: Joshua 18:28
verses.text: And Zelah, Eleph, and Jebusi, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> Jerusalem, Gibeath, <hi type="italic">and</hi> Kirjath; fourteen cities with their villages. This <hi type="italic">is</hi> the inheritance of the children of Benjamin according to their families.  <chapter eID="Josh.18"/><div eID="gen212" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 19:1
verses.text: AND the second lot came forth to Simeon, <hi type="italic">even</hi> for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families: and their inheritance was within the inheritance of the children of Judah.

verses.name: Joshua 19:2
verses.text: And they had in their inheritance Beer-sheba, or Sheba, and Moladah,

verses.name: Joshua 19:3
verses.text: And Hazar-shual, and Balah, and Azem,

verses.name: Joshua 19:4
verses.text: And Eltolad, and Bethul, and Hormah,

verses.name: Joshua 19:5
verses.text: And Ziklag, and Beth-marcaboth, and Hazar-susah,

verses.name: Joshua 19:6
verses.text: And Beth-lebaoth, and Sharuhen; thirteen cities and their villages:

verses.name: Joshua 19:7
verses.text: Ain, Remmon, and Ether, and Ashan; four cities and their villages:

verses.name: Joshua 19:8
verses.text: And all the villages that <hi type="italic">were</hi> round about these cities to Baalath-beer, Ramath of the south. This <hi type="italic">is</hi> the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families.

verses.name: Joshua 19:9
verses.text: Out of the portion of the children of Judah <hi type="italic">was</hi> the inheritance of the children of Simeon: for the part of the children of Judah was too much for them: therefore the children of Simeon had their inheritance within the inheritance of them.

verses.name: Joshua 19:10
verses.text: ¶ And the third lot came up for the children of Zebulun according to their families: and the border of their inheritance was unto Sarid:

verses.name: Joshua 19:11
verses.text: And their border went up toward the sea, and Maralah, and reached to Dabbasheth, and reached to the river that <hi type="italic">is</hi> before Jokneam;

verses.name: Joshua 19:12
verses.text: And turned from Sarid eastward toward the sunrising unto the border of Chisloth-tabor, and then goeth out to Daberath, and goeth up to Japhia,

verses.name: Joshua 19:13
verses.text: And from thence passeth on along on the east to Gittah-hepher, to Ittah-kazin, and goeth out to Remmon-methoar to Neah;

verses.name: Joshua 19:14
verses.text: And the border compasseth it on the north side to Hannathon: and the outgoings thereof are in the valley of Jiphthah-el:

verses.name: Joshua 19:15
verses.text: And Kattath, and Nahallal, and Shimron, and Idalah, and Beth-lehem: twelve cities with their villages.

verses.name: Joshua 19:16
verses.text: This <hi type="italic">is</hi> the inheritance of the children of Zebulun according to their families, these cities with their villages.

verses.name: Joshua 19:17
verses.text: ¶ <hi type="italic">And</hi> the fourth lot came out to Issachar, for the children of Issachar according to their families.

verses.name: Joshua 19:18
verses.text: And their border was toward Jezreel, and Chesulloth, and Shunem,

verses.name: Joshua 19:19
verses.text: And Hapharaim, and Shion, and Anaharath,

verses.name: Joshua 19:20
verses.text: And Rabbith, and Kishion, and Abez,

verses.name: Joshua 19:21
verses.text: And Remeth, and En-gannim, and En-haddah, and Beth-pazzez;

verses.name: Joshua 19:22
verses.text: And the coast reacheth to Tabor, and Shahazimah, and Beth-shemesh; and the outgoings of their border were at Jordan: sixteen cities with their villages.

verses.name: Joshua 19:23
verses.text: This <hi type="italic">is</hi> the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Issachar according to their families, the cities and their villages.

verses.name: Joshua 19:24
verses.text: ¶ And the fifth lot came out for the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families.

verses.name: Joshua 19:25
verses.text: And their border was Helkath, and Hali, and Beten, and Achshaph,

verses.name: Joshua 19:26
verses.text: And Alammelech, and Amad, and Misheal; and reacheth to Carmel westward, and to Shihor-libnath;

verses.name: Joshua 19:27
verses.text: And turneth toward the sunrising to Beth-dagon, and reacheth to Zebulun, and to the valley of Jiphthah-el toward the north side of Beth-emek, and Neiel, and goeth out to Cabul on the left hand,

verses.name: Joshua 19:28
verses.text: And Hebron, and Rehob, and Hammon, and Kanah, <hi type="italic">even</hi> unto great Zidon;

verses.name: Joshua 19:29
verses.text: And <hi type="italic">then</hi> the coast turneth to Ramah, and to the strong city Tyre; and the coast turneth to Hosah; and the outgoings thereof are at the sea from the coast to Achzib:

verses.name: Joshua 19:30
verses.text: Ummah also, and Aphek, and Rehob: twenty and two cities with their villages.

verses.name: Joshua 19:31
verses.text: This <hi type="italic">is</hi> the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families, these cities with their villages.

verses.name: Joshua 19:32
verses.text: ¶ The sixth lot came out to the children of Naphtali, <hi type="italic">even</hi> for the children of Naphtali according to their families.

verses.name: Joshua 19:33
verses.text: And their coast was from Heleph, from Allon to Zaanannim, and Adami, Nekeb, and Jabneel, unto Lakum; and the outgoings thereof were at Jordan:

verses.name: Joshua 19:34
verses.text: And <hi type="italic">then</hi> the coast turneth westward to Aznoth-tabor, and goeth out from thence to Hukkok, and reacheth to Zebulun on the south side, and reacheth to Asher on the west side, and to Judah upon Jordan toward the sunrising.

verses.name: Joshua 19:35
verses.text: And the fenced cities <hi type="italic">are</hi> Ziddim, Zer, and Hammath, Rakkath, and Chinnereth,

verses.name: Joshua 19:36
verses.text: And Adamah, and Ramah, and Hazor,

verses.name: Joshua 19:37
verses.text: And Kedesh, and Edrei, and En-hazor,

verses.name: Joshua 19:38
verses.text: And Iron, and Migdal-el, Horem, and Beth-anath, and Beth-shemesh; nineteen cities with their villages.

verses.name: Joshua 19:39
verses.text: This <hi type="italic">is</hi> the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Naphtali according to their families, the cities and their villages.

verses.name: Joshua 19:40
verses.text: ¶ <hi type="italic">And</hi> the seventh lot came out for the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families.

verses.name: Joshua 19:41
verses.text: And the coast of their inheritance was Zorah, and Eshtaol, and Ir-shemesh,

verses.name: Joshua 19:42
verses.text: And Shaalabbin, and Ajalon, and Jethlah,

verses.name: Joshua 19:43
verses.text: And Elon, and Thimnathah, and Ekron,

verses.name: Joshua 19:44
verses.text: And Eltekeh, and Gibbethon, and Baalath,

verses.name: Joshua 19:45
verses.text: And Jehud, and Bene-berak, and Gath-rimmon,

verses.name: Joshua 19:46
verses.text: And Me-jarkon, and Rakkon, with the border before Japho.

verses.name: Joshua 19:47
verses.text: And the coast of the children of Dan went out <hi type="italic">too little</hi> for them: therefore the children of Dan went up to fight against Leshem, and took it, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and possessed it, and dwelt therein, and called Leshem, Dan, after the name of Dan their father.

verses.name: Joshua 19:48
verses.text: This <hi type="italic">is</hi> the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families, these cities with their villages.

verses.name: Joshua 19:49
verses.text: ¶ When they had made an end of dividing the land for inheritance by their coasts, the children of Israel gave an inheritance to Joshua the son of Nun among them:

verses.name: Joshua 19:50
verses.text: According to the word of the Lord they gave him the city which he asked, <hi type="italic">even</hi> Timnath-serah in mount Ephraim: and he built the city, and dwelt therein.

verses.name: Joshua 19:51
verses.text: These <hi type="italic">are</hi> the inheritances, which Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel, divided for an inheritance by lot in Shiloh before the Lord, at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation. So they made an end of dividing the country.  <chapter eID="Josh.19"/><div eID="gen213" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 20:1
verses.text: THE Lord also spake unto Joshua, saying,

verses.name: Joshua 20:2
verses.text: Speak to the children of Israel, saying, Appoint out for you cities of refuge, whereof I spake unto you by the hand of Moses:

verses.name: Joshua 20:3
verses.text: That the slayer that killeth <hi type="italic">any</hi> person unawares <hi type="italic">and</hi> unwittingly may flee thither: and they shall be your refuge from the avenger of blood.

verses.name: Joshua 20:4
verses.text: And when he that doth flee unto one of those cities shall stand at the entering of the gate of the city, and shall declare his cause in the ears of the elders of that city, they shall take him into the city unto them, and give him a place, that he may dwell among them.

verses.name: Joshua 20:5
verses.text: And if the avenger of blood pursue after him, then they shall not deliver the slayer up into his hand; because he smote his neighbour unwittingly, and hated him not beforetime.

verses.name: Joshua 20:6
verses.text: And he shall dwell in that city, until he stand before the congregation for judgment, <hi type="italic">and</hi> until the death of the high priest that shall be in those days: then shall the slayer return, and come unto his own city, and unto his own house, unto the city from whence he fled.

verses.name: Joshua 20:7
verses.text: ¶ And they appointed Kedesh in Galilee in mount Naphtali, and Shechem in mount Ephraim, and Kirjath-arba, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> Hebron, in the mountain of Judah.

verses.name: Joshua 20:8
verses.text: And on the other side Jordan by Jericho eastward, they assigned Bezer in the wilderness upon the plain out of the tribe of Reuben, and Ramoth in Gilead out of the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan out of the tribe of Manasseh.

verses.name: Joshua 20:9
verses.text: These were the cities appointed for all the children of Israel, and for the stranger that sojourneth among them, that whosoever killeth <hi type="italic">any</hi> person at unawares might flee thither, and not die by the hand of the avenger of blood, until he stood before the congregation.  <chapter eID="Josh.20"/><div eID="gen214" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 21:1
verses.text: THEN came near the heads of the fathers of the Levites unto Eleazar the priest, and unto Joshua the son of Nun, and unto the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel;

verses.name: Joshua 21:2
verses.text: And they spake unto them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, saying, The Lord commanded by the hand of Moses to give us cities to dwell in, with the suburbs thereof for our cattle.

verses.name: Joshua 21:3
verses.text: And the children of Israel gave unto the Levites out of their inheritance, at the commandment of the Lord, these cities and their suburbs.

verses.name: Joshua 21:4
verses.text: And the lot came out for the families of the Kohathites: and the children of Aaron the priest, <hi type="italic">which were</hi> of the Levites, had by lot out of the tribe of Judah, and out of the tribe of Simeon, and out of the tribe of Benjamin, thirteen cities.

verses.name: Joshua 21:5
verses.text: And the rest of the children of Kohath <hi type="italic">had</hi> by lot out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim, and out of the tribe of Dan, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh, ten cities.

verses.name: Joshua 21:6
verses.text: And the children of Gershon <hi type="italic">had</hi> by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.

verses.name: Joshua 21:7
verses.text: The children of Merari by their families <hi type="italic">had</hi> out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.

verses.name: Joshua 21:8
verses.text: And the children of Israel gave by lot unto the Levites these cities with their suburbs, as the Lord commanded by the hand of Moses.

verses.name: Joshua 21:9
verses.text: ¶ And they gave out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, these cities which are <hi type="italic">here</hi> mentioned by name,

verses.name: Joshua 21:10
verses.text: Which the children of Aaron, <hi type="italic">being</hi> of the families of the Kohathites, <hi type="italic">who were</hi> of the children of Levi, had: for theirs was the first lot.

verses.name: Joshua 21:11
verses.text: And they gave them the city of Arba the father of Anak, which <hi type="italic">city is</hi> Hebron, in the hill <hi type="italic">country</hi> of Judah, with the suburbs thereof round about it.

verses.name: Joshua 21:12
verses.text: But the fields of the city, and the villages thereof, gave they to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for his possession.

verses.name: Joshua 21:13
verses.text: ¶ Thus they gave to the children of Aaron the priest Hebron with her suburbs, <hi type="italic">to be</hi> a city of refuge for the slayer; and Libnah with her suburbs,

verses.name: Joshua 21:14
verses.text: And Jattir with her suburbs, and Eshtemoa with her suburbs,

verses.name: Joshua 21:15
verses.text: And Holon with her suburbs, and Debir with her suburbs,

verses.name: Joshua 21:16
verses.text: And Ain with her suburbs, and Juttah with her suburbs, <hi type="italic">and</hi> Beth-shemesh with her suburbs; nine cities out of those two tribes.

verses.name: Joshua 21:17
verses.text: And out of the tribe of Benjamin, Gibeon with her suburbs, Geba with her suburbs,

verses.name: Joshua 21:18
verses.text: Anathoth with her suburbs, and Almon with her suburbs; four cities.

verses.name: Joshua 21:19
verses.text: All the cities of the children of Aaron, the priests, <hi type="italic">were</hi> thirteen cities with their suburbs.

verses.name: Joshua 21:20
verses.text: ¶ And the families of the children of Kohath, the Levites which remained of the children of Kohath, even they had the cities of their lot out of the tribe of Ephraim.

verses.name: Joshua 21:21
verses.text: For they gave them Shechem with her suburbs in mount Ephraim, <hi type="italic">to be</hi> a city of refuge for the slayer; and Gezer with her suburbs,

verses.name: Joshua 21:22
verses.text: And Kibzaim with her suburbs, and Beth-horon with her suburbs; four cities.

verses.name: Joshua 21:23
verses.text: And out of the tribe of Dan, Eltekeh with her suburbs, Gibbethon with her suburbs,

verses.name: Joshua 21:24
verses.text: Aijalon with her suburbs, Gath-rimmon with her suburbs; four cities.

verses.name: Joshua 21:25
verses.text: And out of the half tribe of Manasseh, Tanach with her suburbs, and Gath-rimmon with her suburbs; two cities.

verses.name: Joshua 21:26
verses.text: All the cities <hi type="italic">were</hi> ten with their suburbs for the families of the children of Kohath that remained.

verses.name: Joshua 21:27
verses.text: ¶ And unto the children of Gershon, of the families of the Levites, out of the <hi type="italic">other</hi> half tribe of Manasseh <hi type="italic">they gave</hi> Golan in Bashan with her suburbs, <hi type="italic">to be</hi> a city of refuge for the slayer; and Beesh-terah with her suburbs; two cities.

verses.name: Joshua 21:28
verses.text: And out of the tribe of Issachar, Kishon with her suburbs, Dabareh with her suburbs,

verses.name: Joshua 21:29
verses.text: Jarmuth with her suburbs, En-gannim with her suburbs; four cities.

verses.name: Joshua 21:30
verses.text: And out of the tribe of Asher, Mishal with her suburbs, Abdon with her suburbs,

verses.name: Joshua 21:31
verses.text: Helkath with her suburbs, and Rehob with her suburbs; four cities.

verses.name: Joshua 21:32
verses.text: And out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with her suburbs, <hi type="italic">to be</hi> a city of refuge for the slayer; and Hammoth-dor with her suburbs, and Kartan with her suburbs; three cities.

verses.name: Joshua 21:33
verses.text: All the cities of the Gershonites according to their families <hi type="italic">were</hi> thirteen cities with their suburbs.

verses.name: Joshua 21:34
verses.text: ¶ And unto the families of the children of Merari, the rest of the Levites, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam with her suburbs, and Kartah with her suburbs,

verses.name: Joshua 21:35
verses.text: Dimnah with her suburbs, Nahalal with her suburbs; four cities.

verses.name: Joshua 21:36
verses.text: And out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer with her suburbs, and Jahazah with her suburbs,

verses.name: Joshua 21:37
verses.text: Kedemoth with her suburbs, and Mephaath with her suburbs; four cities.

verses.name: Joshua 21:38
verses.text: And out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with her suburbs, <hi type="italic">to be</hi> a city of refuge for the slayer; and Mahanaim with her suburbs,

verses.name: Joshua 21:39
verses.text: Heshbon with her suburbs, Jazer with her suburbs; four cities in all.

verses.name: Joshua 21:40
verses.text: So all the cities for the children of Merari by their families, which were remaining of the families of the Levites, were <hi type="italic">by</hi> their lot twelve cities.

verses.name: Joshua 21:41
verses.text: All the cities of the Levites within the possession of the children of Israel <hi type="italic">were</hi> forty and eight cities with their suburbs.

verses.name: Joshua 21:42
verses.text: These cities were every one with their suburbs round about them: thus <hi type="italic">were</hi> all these cities.

verses.name: Joshua 21:43
verses.text: ¶ And the Lord gave unto Israel all the land which he sware to give unto their fathers; and they possessed it, and dwelt therein.

verses.name: Joshua 21:44
verses.text: And the Lord gave them rest round about, according to all that he sware unto their fathers: and there stood not a man of all their enemies before them; the Lord delivered all their enemies into their hand.

verses.name: Joshua 21:45
verses.text: There failed not ought of any good thing which the Lord had spoken unto the house of Israel; all came to pass.  <chapter eID="Josh.21"/><div eID="gen215" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 22:1
verses.text: THEN Joshua called the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh,

verses.name: Joshua 22:2
verses.text: And said unto them, Ye have kept all that Moses the servant of the Lord commanded you, and have obeyed my voice in all that I commanded you:

verses.name: Joshua 22:3
verses.text: Ye have not left your brethren these many days unto this day, but have kept the charge of the commandment of the Lord your God.

verses.name: Joshua 22:4
verses.text: And now the Lord your God hath given rest unto your brethren, as he promised them: therefore now return ye, and get you unto your tents, <hi type="italic">and</hi> unto the land of your possession, which Moses the servant of the Lord gave you on the other side Jordan.

verses.name: Joshua 22:5
verses.text: But take diligent heed to do the commandment and the law, which Moses the servant of the Lord charged you, to love the Lord your God, and to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, and to cleave unto him, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul.

verses.name: Joshua 22:6
verses.text: So Joshua blessed them, and sent them away: and they went unto their tents.

verses.name: Joshua 22:7
verses.text: ¶ Now to the <hi type="italic">one</hi> half of the tribe of Manasseh Moses had given <hi type="italic">possession</hi> in Bashan: but unto the <hi type="italic">other</hi> half thereof gave Joshua among their brethren on this side Jordan westward. And when Joshua sent them away also unto their tents, then he blessed them,

verses.name: Joshua 22:8
verses.text: And he spake unto them, saying, Return with much riches unto your tents, and with very much cattle, with silver, and with gold, and with brass, and with iron, and with very much raiment: divide the spoil of your enemies with your brethren.

verses.name: Joshua 22:9
