verses.text: And it was told Abimelech, that all the men of the tower of Shechem were gathered together.

verses.name: Judges 9:48
verses.text: And Abimelech gat him up to mount Zalmon, he and all the people that <hi type="italic">were</hi> with him; and Abimelech took an axe in his hand, and cut down a bough from the trees, and took it, and laid <hi type="italic">it</hi> on his shoulder, and said unto the people that <hi type="italic">were</hi> with him, What ye have seen me do, make haste, <hi type="italic">and</hi> do as I <hi type="italic">have done</hi>.

verses.name: Judges 9:49
verses.text: And all the people likewise cut down every man his bough, and followed Abimelech, and put <hi type="italic">them</hi> to the hold, and set the hold on fire upon them; so that all the men of the tower of Shechem died also, about a thousand men and women.

verses.name: Judges 9:50
verses.text: ¶ Then went Abimelech to Thebez, and encamped against Thebez, and took it.

verses.name: Judges 9:51
verses.text: But there was a strong tower within the city, and thither fled all the men and women, and all they of the city, and shut <hi type="italic">it</hi> to them, and gat them up to the top of the tower.

verses.name: Judges 9:52
verses.text: And Abimelech came unto the tower, and fought against it, and went hard unto the door of the tower to burn it with fire.

verses.name: Judges 9:53
verses.text: And a certain woman cast a piece of a millstone upon Abimelech’s head, and all to brake his skull.

verses.name: Judges 9:54
verses.text: Then he called hastily unto the young man his armourbearer, and said unto him, Draw thy sword, and slay me, that men say not of me, A woman slew him. And his young man thrust him through, and he died.

verses.name: Judges 9:55
verses.text: And when the men of Israel saw that Abimelech was dead, they departed every man unto his place.

verses.name: Judges 9:56
verses.text: ¶ Thus God rendered the wickedness of Abimelech, which he did unto his father, in slaying his seventy brethren:

verses.name: Judges 9:57
verses.text: And all the evil of the men of Shechem did God render upon their heads: and upon them came the curse of Jotham the son of Jerubbaal.  <chapter eID="Judg.9"/><div eID="gen228" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 10:1
verses.text: AND after Abimelech there arose to defend Israel Tola the son of Puah, the son of Dodo, a man of Issachar; and he dwelt in Shamir in mount Ephraim.

verses.name: Judges 10:2
verses.text: And he judged Israel twenty and three years, and died, and was buried in Shamir.

verses.name: Judges 10:3
verses.text: ¶ And after him arose Jair, a Gileadite, and judged Israel twenty and two years.

verses.name: Judges 10:4
verses.text: And he had thirty sons that rode on thirty ass colts, and they had thirty cities, which are called Havoth-jair unto this day, which <hi type="italic">are</hi> in the land of Gilead.

verses.name: Judges 10:5
verses.text: And Jair died, and was buried in Camon.

verses.name: Judges 10:6
verses.text: ¶ And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the Lord, and served Baalim, and Ashtaroth, and the gods of Syria, and the gods of Zidon, and the gods of Moab, and the gods of the children of Ammon, and the gods of the Philistines, and forsook the Lord, and served not him.

verses.name: Judges 10:7
verses.text: And the anger of the Lord was hot against Israel, and he sold them into the hands of the Philistines, and into the hands of the children of Ammon.

verses.name: Judges 10:8
verses.text: And that year they vexed and oppressed the children of Israel: eighteen years, all the children of Israel that <hi type="italic">were</hi> on the other side Jordan in the land of the Amorites, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> in Gilead.

verses.name: Judges 10:9
verses.text: Moreover the children of Ammon passed over Jordan to fight also against Judah, and against Benjamin, and against the house of Ephraim; so that Israel was sore distressed.

verses.name: Judges 10:10
verses.text: ¶ And the children of Israel cried unto the Lord, saying, We have sinned against thee, both because we have forsaken our God, and also served Baalim.

verses.name: Judges 10:11
verses.text: And the Lord said unto the children of Israel, <hi type="italic">Did</hi> not <hi type="italic">I deliver you</hi> from the Egyptians, and from the Amorites, from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines?

verses.name: Judges 10:12
verses.text: The Zidonians also, and the Amalekites, and the Maonites, did oppress you; and ye cried to me, and I delivered you out of their hand.

verses.name: Judges 10:13
verses.text: Yet ye have forsaken me, and served other gods: wherefore I will deliver you no more.

verses.name: Judges 10:14
verses.text: Go and cry unto the gods which ye have chosen; let them deliver you in the time of your tribulation.

verses.name: Judges 10:15
verses.text: ¶ And the children of Israel said unto the Lord, We have sinned: do thou unto us whatsoever seemeth good unto thee; deliver us only, we pray thee, this day.

verses.name: Judges 10:16
verses.text: And they put away the strange gods from among them, and served the Lord: and his soul was grieved for the misery of Israel.

verses.name: Judges 10:17
verses.text: Then the children of Ammon were gathered together, and encamped in Gilead. And the children of Israel assembled themselves together, and encamped in Mizpeh.

verses.name: Judges 10:18
verses.text: And the people <hi type="italic">and</hi> princes of Gilead said one to another, What man <hi type="italic">is he</hi> that will begin to fight against the children of Ammon? he shall be head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.  <chapter eID="Judg.10"/><div eID="gen229" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 11:1
verses.text: NOW Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty man of valour, and he <hi type="italic">was</hi> the son of an harlot: and Gilead begat Jephthah.

verses.name: Judges 11:2
verses.text: And Gilead’s wife bare him sons; and his wife’s sons grew up, and they thrust out Jephthah, and said unto him, Thou shalt not inherit in our father’s house; for thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> the son of a strange woman.

verses.name: Judges 11:3
verses.text: Then Jephthah fled from his brethren, and dwelt in the land of Tob: and there were gathered vain men to Jephthah, and went out with him.

verses.name: Judges 11:4
verses.text: ¶ And it came to pass in process of time, that the children of Ammon made war against Israel.

verses.name: Judges 11:5
verses.text: And it was so, that when the children of Ammon made war against Israel, the elders of Gilead went to fetch Jephthah out of the land of Tob:

verses.name: Judges 11:6
verses.text: And they said unto Jephthah, Come, and be our captain, that we may fight with the children of Ammon.

verses.name: Judges 11:7
verses.text: And Jephthah said unto the elders of Gilead, Did not ye hate me, and expel me out of my father’s house? and why are ye come unto me now when ye are in distress?

verses.name: Judges 11:8
verses.text: And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah, Therefore we turn again to thee now, that thou mayest go with us, and fight against the children of Ammon, and be our head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.

verses.name: Judges 11:9
verses.text: And Jephthah said unto the elders of Gilead, If ye bring me home again to fight against the children of Ammon, and the Lord deliver them before me, shall I be your head?

verses.name: Judges 11:10
verses.text: And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah, The Lord be witness between us, if we do not so according to thy words.

verses.name: Judges 11:11
verses.text: Then Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead, and the people made him head and captain over them: and Jephthah uttered all his words before the Lord in Mizpeh.

verses.name: Judges 11:12
verses.text: ¶ And Jephthah sent messengers unto the king of the children of Ammon, saying, What hast thou to do with me, that thou art come against me to fight in my land?

verses.name: Judges 11:13
verses.text: And the king of the children of Ammon answered unto the messengers of Jephthah, Because Israel took away my land, when they came up out of Egypt, from Arnon even unto Jabbok, and unto Jordan: now therefore restore those <hi type="italic">lands</hi> again peaceably.

verses.name: Judges 11:14
verses.text: And Jephthah sent messengers again unto the king of the children of Ammon:

verses.name: Judges 11:15
verses.text: And said unto him, Thus saith Jephthah, Israel took not away the land of Moab, nor the land of the children of Ammon:

verses.name: Judges 11:16
verses.text: But when Israel came up from Egypt, and walked through the wilderness unto the Red sea, and came to Kadesh;

verses.name: Judges 11:17
verses.text: Then Israel sent messengers unto the king of Edom, saying, Let me, I pray thee, pass through thy land: but the king of Edom would not hearken <hi type="italic">thereto</hi>. And in like manner they sent unto the king of Moab: but he would not <hi type="italic">consent:</hi> and Israel abode in Kadesh.

verses.name: Judges 11:18
verses.text: Then they went along through the wilderness, and compassed the land of Edom, and the land of Moab, and came by the east side of the land of Moab, and pitched on the other side of Arnon, but came not within the border of Moab: for Arnon <hi type="italic">was</hi> the border of Moab.

verses.name: Judges 11:19
verses.text: And Israel sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites, the king of Heshbon; and Israel said unto him, Let us pass, we pray thee, through thy land into my place.

verses.name: Judges 11:20
verses.text: But Sihon trusted not Israel to pass through his coast: but Sihon gathered all his people together, and pitched in Jahaz, and fought against Israel.

verses.name: Judges 11:21
verses.text: And the Lord God of Israel delivered Sihon and all his people into the hand of Israel, and they smote them: so Israel possessed all the land of the Amorites, the inhabitants of that country.

verses.name: Judges 11:22
verses.text: And they possessed all the coasts of the Amorites, from Arnon even unto Jabbok, and from the wilderness even unto Jordan.

verses.name: Judges 11:23
verses.text: So now the Lord God of Israel hath dispossessed the Amorites from before his people Israel, and shouldest thou possess it?

verses.name: Judges 11:24
verses.text: Wilt not thou possess that which Chemosh thy god giveth thee to possess? So whomsoever the Lord our God shall drive out from before us, them will we possess.

verses.name: Judges 11:25
verses.text: And now <hi type="italic">art</hi> thou any thing better than Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab? did he ever strive against Israel, or did he ever fight against them,

verses.name: Judges 11:26
verses.text: While Israel dwelt in Heshbon and her towns, and in Aroer and her towns, and in all the cities that <hi type="italic">be</hi> along by the coasts of Arnon, three hundred years? why therefore did ye not recover <hi type="italic">them</hi> within that time?

verses.name: Judges 11:27
verses.text: Wherefore I have not sinned against thee, but thou doest me wrong to war against me: the Lord the Judge be judge this day between the children of Israel and the children of Ammon.

verses.name: Judges 11:28
verses.text: Howbeit the king of the children of Ammon hearkened not unto the words of Jephthah which he sent him.

verses.name: Judges 11:29
verses.text: ¶ Then the Spirit of the Lord came upon Jephthah, and he passed over Gilead, and Manasseh, and passed over Mizpeh of Gilead, and from Mizpeh of Gilead he passed over <hi type="italic">unto</hi> the children of Ammon.

verses.name: Judges 11:30
verses.text: And Jephthah vowed a vow unto the Lord, and said, If thou shalt without fail deliver the children of Ammon into mine hands,

verses.name: Judges 11:31
verses.text: Then it shall be, that whatsoever cometh forth of the doors of my house to meet me, when I return in peace from the children of Ammon, shall surely be the Lord’s, and I will offer it up for a burnt offering.

verses.name: Judges 11:32
verses.text: ¶ So Jephthah passed over unto the children of Ammon to fight against them; and the Lord delivered them into his hands.

verses.name: Judges 11:33
verses.text: And he smote them from Aroer, even till thou come to Minnith, <hi type="italic">even</hi> twenty cities, and unto the plain of the vineyards, with a very great slaughter. Thus the children of Ammon were subdued before the children of Israel.

verses.name: Judges 11:34
verses.text: ¶ And Jephthah came to Mizpeh unto his house, and, behold, his daughter came out to meet him with timbrels and with dances: and she <hi type="italic">was his</hi> only child; beside her he had neither son nor daughter.

verses.name: Judges 11:35
verses.text: And it came to pass, when he saw her, that he rent his clothes, and said, Alas, my daughter! thou hast brought me very low, and thou art one of them that trouble me: for I have opened my mouth unto the Lord, and I cannot go back.

verses.name: Judges 11:36
verses.text: And she said unto him, My father, <hi type="italic">if</hi> thou hast opened thy mouth unto the Lord, do to me according to that which hath proceeded out of thy mouth; forasmuch as the Lord hath taken vengeance for thee of thine enemies, <hi type="italic">even</hi> of the children of Ammon.

verses.name: Judges 11:37
verses.text: And she said unto her father, Let this thing be done for me: let me alone two months, that I may go up and down upon the mountains, and bewail my virginity, I and my fellows.

verses.name: Judges 11:38
verses.text: And he said, Go. And he sent her away <hi type="italic">for</hi> two months: and she went with her companions, and bewailed her virginity upon the mountains.

verses.name: Judges 11:39
verses.text: And it came to pass at the end of two months, that she returned unto her father, who did with her <hi type="italic">according</hi> to his vow which he had vowed: and she knew no man. And it was a custom in Israel,

verses.name: Judges 11:40
verses.text: <hi type="italic">That</hi> the daughters of Israel went yearly to lament the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite four days in a year.  <chapter eID="Judg.11"/><div eID="gen230" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 12:1
verses.text: AND the men of Ephraim gathered themselves together, and went northward, and said unto Jephthah, Wherefore passedst thou over to fight against the children of Ammon, and didst not call us to go with thee? we will burn thine house upon thee with fire.

verses.name: Judges 12:2
verses.text: And Jephthah said unto them, I and my people were at great strife with the children of Ammon; and when I called you, ye delivered me not out of their hands.

verses.name: Judges 12:3
verses.text: And when I saw that ye delivered <hi type="italic">me</hi> not, I put my life in my hands, and passed over against the children of Ammon, and the Lord delivered them into my hand: wherefore then are ye come up unto me this day, to fight against me?

verses.name: Judges 12:4
verses.text: Then Jephthah gathered together all the men of Gilead, and fought with Ephraim: and the men of Gilead smote Ephraim, because they said, Ye Gileadites <hi type="italic">are</hi> fugitives of Ephraim among the Ephraimites, <hi type="italic">and</hi> among the Manassites.

verses.name: Judges 12:5
verses.text: And the Gileadites took the passages of Jordan before the Ephraimites: and it was <hi type="italic">so</hi>, that when those Ephraimites which were escaped said, Let me go over; that the men of Gilead said unto him, <hi type="italic">Art</hi> thou an Ephraimite? If he said, Nay;

verses.name: Judges 12:6
verses.text: Then said they unto him, Say now Shibboleth: and he said Sibboleth: for he could not frame to pronounce <hi type="italic">it</hi> right. Then they took him, and slew him at the passages of Jordan: and there fell at that time of the Ephraimites forty and two thousand.

verses.name: Judges 12:7
verses.text: And Jephthah judged Israel six years. Then died Jephthah the Gileadite, and was buried in <hi type="italic">one of</hi> the cities of Gilead.

verses.name: Judges 12:8
verses.text: ¶ And after him Ibzan of Beth-lehem judged Israel.

verses.name: Judges 12:9
verses.text: And he had thirty sons, and thirty daughters, <hi type="italic">whom</hi> he sent abroad, and took in thirty daughters from abroad for his sons. And he judged Israel seven years.

verses.name: Judges 12:10
verses.text: Then died Ibzan, and was buried at Beth-lehem.

verses.name: Judges 12:11
verses.text: ¶ And after him Elon, a Zebulonite, judged Israel; and he judged Israel ten years.

verses.name: Judges 12:12
verses.text: And Elon the Zebulonite died, and was buried in Aijalon in the country of Zebulun.

verses.name: Judges 12:13
verses.text: ¶ And after him Abdon the son of Hillel, a Pirathonite, judged Israel.

verses.name: Judges 12:14
verses.text: And he had forty sons and thirty nephews, that rode on threescore and ten ass colts: and he judged Israel eight years.

verses.name: Judges 12:15
verses.text: And Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite died, and was buried in Pirathon in the land of Ephraim, in the mount of the Amalekites.  <chapter eID="Judg.12"/><div eID="gen231" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 13:1
verses.text: AND the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the Lord; and the Lord delivered them into the hand of the Philistines forty years.

verses.name: Judges 13:2
verses.text: ¶ And there was a certain man of Zorah, of the family of the Danites, whose name <hi type="italic">was</hi> Manoah; and his wife <hi type="italic">was</hi> barren, and bare not.

verses.name: Judges 13:3
verses.text: And the angel of the Lord appeared unto the woman, and said unto her, Behold now, thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> barren, and bearest not: but thou shalt conceive, and bear a son.

verses.name: Judges 13:4
verses.text: Now therefore beware, I pray thee, and drink not wine nor strong drink, and eat not any unclean <hi type="italic">thing:</hi>

verses.name: Judges 13:5
verses.text: For, lo, thou shalt conceive, and bear a son; and no rasor shall come on his head: for the child shall be a Nazarite unto God from the womb: and he shall begin to deliver Israel out of the hand of the Philistines.

verses.name: Judges 13:6
verses.text: ¶ Then the woman came and told her husband, saying, A man of God came unto me, and his countenance <hi type="italic">was</hi> like the countenance of an angel of God, very terrible: but I asked him not whence he <hi type="italic">was</hi>, neither told he me his name:

verses.name: Judges 13:7
verses.text: But he said unto me, Behold, thou shalt conceive, and bear a son; and now drink no wine nor strong drink, neither eat any unclean <hi type="italic">thing:</hi> for the child shall be a Nazarite to God from the womb to the day of his death.

verses.name: Judges 13:8
verses.text: ¶ Then Manoah intreated the Lord, and said, O my Lord, let the man of God which thou didst send come again unto us, and teach us what we shall do unto the child that shall be born.

verses.name: Judges 13:9
verses.text: And God hearkened to the voice of Manoah; and the angel of God came again unto the woman as she sat in the field: but Manoah her husband <hi type="italic">was</hi> not with her.

verses.name: Judges 13:10
verses.text: And the woman made haste, and ran, and shewed her husband, and said unto him, Behold, the man hath appeared unto me, that came unto me the <hi type="italic">other</hi> day.

verses.name: Judges 13:11
verses.text: And Manoah arose, and went after his wife, and came to the man, and said unto him, <hi type="italic">Art</hi> thou the man that spakest unto the woman? And he said, I <hi type="italic">am</hi>.

verses.name: Judges 13:12
verses.text: And Manoah said, Now let thy words come to pass. How shall we order the child, and <hi type="italic">how</hi> shall we do unto him?

verses.name: Judges 13:13
verses.text: And the angel of the Lord said unto Manoah, Of all that I said unto the woman let her beware.

verses.name: Judges 13:14
verses.text: She may not eat of any <hi type="italic">thing</hi> that cometh of the vine, neither let her drink wine or strong drink, nor eat any unclean <hi type="italic">thing:</hi> all that I commanded her let her observe.

verses.name: Judges 13:15
verses.text: ¶ And Manoah said unto the angel of the Lord, I pray thee, let us detain thee, until we shall have made ready a kid for thee.

verses.name: Judges 13:16
verses.text: And the angel of the Lord said unto Manoah, Though thou detain me, I will not eat of thy bread: and if thou wilt offer a burnt offering, thou must offer it unto the Lord. For Manoah knew not that he <hi type="italic">was</hi> an angel of the Lord.

verses.name: Judges 13:17
verses.text: And Manoah said unto the angel of the Lord, What <hi type="italic">is</hi> thy name, that when thy sayings come to pass we may do thee honour?

verses.name: Judges 13:18
verses.text: And the angel of the Lord said unto him, Why askest thou thus after my name, seeing it <hi type="italic">is</hi> secret?

verses.name: Judges 13:19
verses.text: So Manoah took a kid with a meat offering, and offered <hi type="italic">it</hi> upon a rock unto the Lord: and <hi type="italic">the angel</hi> did wondrously; and Manoah and his wife looked on.

verses.name: Judges 13:20
verses.text: For it came to pass, when the flame went up toward heaven from off the altar, that the angel of the Lord ascended in the flame of the altar. And Manoah and his wife looked on <hi type="italic">it</hi>, and fell on their faces to the ground.

verses.name: Judges 13:21
verses.text: But the angel of the Lord did no more appear to Manoah and to his wife. Then Manoah knew that he <hi type="italic">was</hi> an angel of the Lord.

verses.name: Judges 13:22
verses.text: And Manoah said unto his wife, We shall surely die, because we have seen God.

verses.name: Judges 13:23
verses.text: But his wife said unto him, If the Lord were pleased to kill us, he would not have received a burnt offering and a meat offering at our hands, neither would he have shewed us all these <hi type="italic">things</hi>, nor would as at this time have told us <hi type="italic">such things</hi> as these.

verses.name: Judges 13:24
verses.text: ¶ And the woman bare a son, and called his name Samson: and the child grew, and the Lord blessed him.

verses.name: Judges 13:25
verses.text: And the Spirit of the Lord began to move him at times in the camp of Dan between Zorah and Eshtaol.  <chapter eID="Judg.13"/><div eID="gen232" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 14:1
verses.text: AND Samson went down to Timnath, and saw a woman in Timnath of the daughters of the Philistines.

verses.name: Judges 14:2
verses.text: And he came up, and told his father and his mother, and said, I have seen a woman in Timnath of the daughters of the Philistines: now therefore get her for me to wife.

verses.name: Judges 14:3
verses.text: Then his father and his mother said unto him, <hi type="italic">Is there</hi> never a woman among the daughters of thy brethren, or among all my people, that thou goest to take a wife of the uncircumcised Philistines? And Samson said unto his father, Get her for me; for she pleaseth me well.

verses.name: Judges 14:4
verses.text: But his father and his mother knew not that it <hi type="italic">was</hi> of the Lord, that he sought an occasion against the Philistines: for at that time the Philistines had dominion over Israel.

verses.name: Judges 14:5
verses.text: ¶ Then went Samson down, and his father and his mother, to Timnath, and came to the vineyards of Timnath: and, behold, a young lion roared against him.

verses.name: Judges 14:6
verses.text: And the Spirit of the Lord came mightily upon him, and he rent him as he would have rent a kid, and <hi type="italic">he had</hi> nothing in his hand: but he told not his father or his mother what he had done.

verses.name: Judges 14:7
verses.text: And he went down, and talked with the woman; and she pleased Samson well.

verses.name: Judges 14:8
verses.text: ¶ And after a time he returned to take her, and he turned aside to see the carcase of the lion: and, behold, <hi type="italic">there was</hi> a swarm of bees and honey in the carcase of the lion.

verses.name: Judges 14:9
verses.text: And he took thereof in his hands, and went on eating, and came to his father and mother, and he gave them, and they did eat: but he told not them that he had taken the honey out of the carcase of the lion.

verses.name: Judges 14:10
verses.text: ¶ So his father went down unto the woman: and Samson made there a feast; for so used the young men to do.

verses.name: Judges 14:11
verses.text: And it came to pass, when they saw him, that they brought thirty companions to be with him.

verses.name: Judges 14:12
verses.text: ¶ And Samson said unto them, I will now put forth a riddle unto you: if ye can certainly declare it me within the seven days of the feast, and find <hi type="italic">it</hi> out, then I will give you thirty sheets and thirty change of garments:

verses.name: Judges 14:13
verses.text: But if ye cannot declare <hi type="italic">it</hi> me, then shall ye give me thirty sheets and thirty change of garments. And they said unto him, Put forth thy riddle, that we may hear it.

verses.name: Judges 14:14
verses.text: And he said unto them, Out of the eater came forth meat, and out of the strong came forth sweetness. And they could not in three days expound the riddle.

verses.name: Judges 14:15
verses.text: And it came to pass on the seventh day, that they said unto Samson’s wife, Entice thy husband, that he may declare unto us the riddle, lest we burn thee and thy father’s house with fire: have ye called us to take that we have? <hi type="italic">is it</hi> not <hi type="italic">so?</hi>

verses.name: Judges 14:16
verses.text: And Samson’s wife wept before him, and said, Thou dost but hate me, and lovest me not: thou hast put forth a riddle unto the children of my people, and hast not told <hi type="italic">it</hi> me. And he said unto her, Behold, I have not told <hi type="italic">it</hi> my father nor my mother, and shall I tell <hi type="italic">it</hi> thee?

verses.name: Judges 14:17
verses.text: And she wept before him the seven days, while their feast lasted: and it came to pass on the seventh day, that he told her, because she lay sore upon him: and she told the riddle to the children of her people.

verses.name: Judges 14:18
verses.text: And the men of the city said unto him on the seventh day before the sun went down, What <hi type="italic">is</hi> sweeter than honey? and what <hi type="italic">is</hi> stronger than a lion? And he said unto them, If ye had not plowed with my heifer, ye had not found out my riddle.

verses.name: Judges 14:19
verses.text: ¶ And the Spirit of the Lord came upon him, and he went down to Ashkelon, and slew thirty men of them, and took their spoil, and gave change of garments unto them which expounded the riddle. And his anger was kindled, and he went up to his father’s house.

verses.name: Judges 14:20
verses.text: But Samson’s wife was <hi type="italic">given</hi> to his companion, whom he had used as his friend.  <chapter eID="Judg.14"/><div eID="gen233" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 15:1
verses.text: BUT it came to pass within a while after, in the time of wheat harvest, that Samson visited his wife with a kid; and he said, I will go in to my wife into the chamber. But her father would not suffer him to go in.

verses.name: Judges 15:2
verses.text: And her father said, I verily thought that thou hadst utterly hated her; therefore I gave her to thy companion: <hi type="italic">is</hi> not her younger sister fairer than she? take her, I pray thee, instead of her.

verses.name: Judges 15:3
verses.text: ¶ And Samson said concerning them, Now shall I be more blameless than the Philistines, though I do them a displeasure.

verses.name: Judges 15:4
verses.text: And Samson went and caught three hundred foxes, and took firebrands, and turned tail to tail, and put a firebrand in the midst between two tails.

verses.name: Judges 15:5
verses.text: And when he had set the brands on fire, he let <hi type="italic">them</hi> go into the standing corn of the Philistines, and burnt up both the shocks, and also the standing corn, with the vineyards <hi type="italic">and</hi> olives.

verses.name: Judges 15:6
verses.text: ¶ Then the Philistines said, Who hath done this? And they answered, Samson, the son in law of the Timnite, because he had taken his wife, and given her to his companion. And the Philistines came up, and burnt her and her father with fire.

verses.name: Judges 15:7
verses.text: ¶ And Samson said unto them, Though ye have done this, yet will I be avenged of you, and after that I will cease.

verses.name: Judges 15:8
verses.text: And he smote them hip and thigh with a great slaughter: and he went down and dwelt in the top of the rock Etam.

verses.name: Judges 15:9
verses.text: ¶ Then the Philistines went up, and pitched in Judah, and spread themselves in Lehi.

verses.name: Judges 15:10
verses.text: And the men of Judah said, Why are ye come up against us? And they answered, To bind Samson are we come up, to do to him as he hath done to us.

verses.name: Judges 15:11
verses.text: Then three thousand men of Judah went to the top of the rock Etam, and said to Samson, Knowest thou not that the Philistines <hi type="italic">are</hi> rulers over us? what <hi type="italic">is</hi> this <hi type="italic">that</hi> thou hast done unto us? And he said unto them, As they did unto me, so have I done unto them.

verses.name: Judges 15:12
verses.text: And they said unto him, We are come down to bind thee, that we may deliver thee into the hand of the Philistines. And Samson said unto them, Swear unto me, that ye will not fall upon me yourselves.

verses.name: Judges 15:13
verses.text: And they spake unto him, saying, No; but we will bind thee fast, and deliver thee into their hand: but surely we will not kill thee. And they bound him with two new cords, and brought him up from the rock.

verses.name: Judges 15:14
verses.text: ¶ <hi type="italic">And</hi> when he came unto Lehi, the Philistines shouted against him: and the Spirit of the Lord came mightily upon him, and the cords that <hi type="italic">were</hi> upon his arms became as flax that was burnt with fire, and his bands loosed from off his hands.

verses.name: Judges 15:15
verses.text: And he found a new jawbone of an ass, and put forth his hand, and took it, and slew a thousand men therewith.

verses.name: Judges 15:16
verses.text: And Samson said, With the jawbone of an ass, heaps upon heaps, with the jaw of an ass have I slain a thousand men.

verses.name: Judges 15:17
verses.text: And it came to pass, when he had made an end of speaking, that he cast away the jawbone out of his hand, and called that place Ramath-lehi.

verses.name: Judges 15:18
verses.text: ¶ And he was sore athirst, and called on the Lord, and said, Thou hast given this great deliverance into the hand of thy servant: and now shall I die for thirst, and fall into the hand of the uncircumcised?

verses.name: Judges 15:19
verses.text: But God clave an hollow place that <hi type="italic">was</hi> in the jaw, and there came water thereout; and when he had drunk, his spirit came again, and he revived: wherefore he called the name thereof En-hakkore, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> in Lehi unto this day.

verses.name: Judges 15:20
verses.text: And he judged Israel in the days of the Philistines twenty years.  <chapter eID="Judg.15"/><div eID="gen234" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 16:1
verses.text: THEN went Samson to Gaza, and saw there an harlot, and went in unto her.

verses.name: Judges 16:2
verses.text: <hi type="italic">And it was told</hi> the Gazites, saying, Samson is come hither. And they compassed <hi type="italic">him</hi> in, and laid wait for him all night in the gate of the city, and were quiet all the night, saying, In the morning, when it is day, we shall kill him.

verses.name: Judges 16:3
verses.text: And Samson lay till midnight, and arose at midnight, and took the doors of the gate of the city, and the two posts, and went away with them, bar and all, and put <hi type="italic">them</hi> upon his shoulders, and carried them up to the top of an hill that <hi type="italic">is</hi> before Hebron.

verses.name: Judges 16:4
verses.text: ¶ And it came to pass afterward, that he loved a woman in the valley of Sorek, whose name <hi type="italic">was</hi> Delilah.

verses.name: Judges 16:5
verses.text: And the lords of the Philistines came up unto her, and said unto her, Entice him, and see wherein his great strength <hi type="italic">lieth</hi>, and by what <hi type="italic">means</hi> we may prevail against him, that we may bind him to afflict him: and we will give thee every one of us eleven hundred <hi type="italic">pieces</hi> of silver.

verses.name: Judges 16:6
verses.text: ¶ And Delilah said to Samson, Tell me, I pray thee, wherein thy great strength <hi type="italic">lieth</hi>, and wherewith thou mightest be bound to afflict thee.

verses.name: Judges 16:7
verses.text: And Samson said unto her, If they bind me with seven green withs that were never dried, then shall I be weak, and be as another man.

verses.name: Judges 16:8
verses.text: Then the lords of the Philistines brought up to her seven green withs which had not been dried, and she bound him with them.

verses.name: Judges 16:9
verses.text: Now <hi type="italic">there were</hi> men lying in wait, abiding with her in the chamber. And she said unto him, The Philistines <hi type="italic">be</hi> upon thee, Samson. And he brake the withs, as a thread of tow is broken when it toucheth the fire. So his strength was not known.

verses.name: Judges 16:10
verses.text: And Delilah said unto Samson, Behold, thou hast mocked me, and told me lies: now tell me, I pray thee, wherewith thou mightest be bound.

verses.name: Judges 16:11
verses.text: And he said unto her, If they bind me fast with new ropes that never were occupied, then shall I be weak, and be as another man.

verses.name: Judges 16:12
verses.text: Delilah therefore took new ropes, and bound him therewith, and said unto him, The Philistines <hi type="italic">be</hi> upon thee, Samson. And <hi type="italic">there were</hi> liers in wait abiding in the chamber. And he brake them from off his arms like a thread.

verses.name: Judges 16:13
verses.text: And Delilah said unto Samson, Hitherto thou hast mocked me, and told me lies: tell me wherewith thou mightest be bound. And he said unto her, If thou weavest the seven locks of my head with the web.

verses.name: Judges 16:14
verses.text: And she fastened <hi type="italic">it</hi> with the pin, and said unto him, The Philistines <hi type="italic">be</hi> upon thee, Samson. And he awaked out of his sleep, and went away with the pin of the beam, and with the web.

verses.name: Judges 16:15
verses.text: ¶ And she said unto him, How canst thou say, I love thee, when thine heart <hi type="italic">is</hi> not with me? thou hast mocked me these three times, and hast not told me wherein thy great strength <hi type="italic">lieth</hi>.

verses.name: Judges 16:16
verses.text: And it came to pass, when she pressed him daily with her words, and urged him, <hi type="italic">so</hi> that his soul was vexed unto death;

verses.name: Judges 16:17
verses.text: That he told her all his heart, and said unto her, There hath not come a rasor upon mine head; for I <hi type="italic">have been</hi> a Nazarite unto God from my mother’s womb: if I be shaven, then my strength will go from me, and I shall become weak, and be like any <hi type="italic">other</hi> man.

verses.name: Judges 16:18
verses.text: And when Delilah saw that he had told her all his heart, she sent and called for the lords of the Philistines, saying, Come up this once, for he hath shewed me all his heart. Then the lords of the Philistines came up unto her, and brought money in their hand.

verses.name: Judges 16:19
verses.text: And she made him sleep upon her knees; and she called for a man, and she caused him to shave off the seven locks of his head; and she began to afflict him, and his strength went from him.

verses.name: Judges 16:20
verses.text: And she said, The Philistines <hi type="italic">be</hi> upon thee, Samson. And he awoke out of his sleep, and said, I will go out as at other times before, and shake myself. And he wist not that the Lord was departed from him.

verses.name: Judges 16:21
verses.text: ¶ But the Philistines took him, and put out his eyes, and brought him down to Gaza, and bound him with fetters of brass; and he did grind in the prison house.

verses.name: Judges 16:22
verses.text: Howbeit the hair of his head began to grow again after he was shaven.

verses.name: Judges 16:23
verses.text: Then the lords of the Philistines gathered them together for to offer a great sacrifice unto Dagon their god, and to rejoice: for they said, Our god hath delivered Samson our enemy into our hand.

verses.name: Judges 16:24
verses.text: And when the people saw him, they praised their god: for they said, Our god hath delivered into our hands our enemy, and the destroyer of our country, which slew many of us.

verses.name: Judges 16:25
verses.text: And it came to pass, when their hearts were merry, that they said, Call for Samson, that he may make us sport. And they called for Samson out of the prison house; and he made them sport: and they set him between the pillars.

verses.name: Judges 16:26
verses.text: And Samson said unto the lad that held him by the hand, Suffer me that I may feel the pillars whereupon the house standeth, that I may lean upon them.

verses.name: Judges 16:27
verses.text: Now the house was full of men and women; and all the lords of the Philistines <hi type="italic">were</hi> there; and <hi type="italic">there were</hi> upon the roof about three thousand men and women, that beheld while Samson made sport.

verses.name: Judges 16:28
verses.text: And Samson called unto the Lord, and said, O Lord God, remember me, I pray thee, and strengthen me, I pray thee, only this once, O God, that I may be at once avenged of the Philistines for my two eyes.

verses.name: Judges 16:29
verses.text: And Samson took hold of the two middle pillars upon which the house stood, and on which it was borne up, of the one with his right hand, and of the other with his left.

verses.name: Judges 16:30
verses.text: And Samson said, Let me die with the Philistines. And he bowed himself with <hi type="italic">all his</hi> might; and the house fell upon the lords, and upon all the people that <hi type="italic">were</hi> therein. So the dead which he slew at his death were more than <hi type="italic">they</hi> which he slew in his life.

verses.name: Judges 16:31
verses.text: Then his brethren and all the house of his father came down, and took him, and brought <hi type="italic">him</hi> up, and buried him between Zorah and Eshtaol in the buryingplace of Manoah his father. And he judged Israel twenty years.  <chapter eID="Judg.16"/><div eID="gen235" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 17:1
verses.text: AND there was a man of mount Ephraim, whose name <hi type="italic">was</hi> Micah.

verses.name: Judges 17:2
verses.text: And he said unto his mother, The eleven hundred <hi type="italic">shekels</hi> of silver that were taken from thee, about which thou cursedst, and spakest of also in mine ears, behold, the silver <hi type="italic">is</hi> with me; I took it. And his mother said, Blessed <hi type="italic">be thou</hi> of the Lord, my son.

verses.name: Judges 17:3
verses.text: And when he had restored the eleven hundred <hi type="italic">shekels</hi> of silver to his mother, his mother said, I had wholly dedicated the silver unto the Lord from my hand for my son, to make a graven image and a molten image: now therefore I will restore it unto thee.

verses.name: Judges 17:4
verses.text: Yet he restored the money unto his mother; and his mother took two hundred <hi type="italic">shekels</hi> of silver, and gave them to the founder, who made thereof a graven image and a molten image: and they were in the house of Micah.

verses.name: Judges 17:5
verses.text: And the man Micah had an house of gods, and made an ephod, and teraphim, and consecrated one of his sons, who became his priest.

verses.name: Judges 17:6
verses.text: In those days <hi type="italic">there was</hi> no king in Israel, <hi type="italic">but</hi> every man did <hi type="italic">that which was</hi> right in his own eyes.

verses.name: Judges 17:7
verses.text: ¶ And there was a young man out of Beth-lehem-judah of the family of Judah, who <hi type="italic">was</hi> a Levite, and he sojourned there.

verses.name: Judges 17:8
verses.text: And the man departed out of the city from Beth-lehem-judah to sojourn where he could find <hi type="italic">a place:</hi> and he came to mount Ephraim to the house of Micah, as he journeyed.

verses.name: Judges 17:9
verses.text: And Micah said unto him, Whence comest thou? And he said unto him, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> a Levite of Beth-lehem-judah, and I go to sojourn where I may find <hi type="italic">a place</hi>.

verses.name: Judges 17:10
verses.text: And Micah said unto him, Dwell with me, and be unto me a father and a priest, and I will give thee ten <hi type="italic">shekels</hi> of silver by the year, and a suit of apparel, and thy victuals. So the Levite went in.

verses.name: Judges 17:11
verses.text: And the Levite was content to dwell with the man; and the young man was unto him as one of his sons.

verses.name: Judges 17:12
verses.text: And Micah consecrated the Levite; and the young man became his priest, and was in the house of Micah.

verses.name: Judges 17:13
verses.text: Then said Micah, Now know I that the Lord will do me good, seeing I have a Levite to <hi type="italic">my</hi> priest.  <chapter eID="Judg.17"/><div eID="gen236" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 18:1
verses.text: IN those days <hi type="italic">there was</hi> no king in Israel: and in those days the tribe of the Danites sought them an inheritance to dwell in; for unto that day <hi type="italic">all their</hi> inheritance had not fallen unto them among the tribes of Israel.

verses.name: Judges 18:2
verses.text: And the children of Dan sent of their family five men from their coasts, men of valour, from Zorah, and from Eshtaol, to spy out the land, and to search it; and they said unto them, Go, search the land: who when they came to mount Ephraim, to the house of Micah, they lodged there.

verses.name: Judges 18:3
verses.text: When they <hi type="italic">were</hi> by the house of Micah, they knew the voice of the young man the Levite: and they turned in thither, and said unto him, Who brought thee hither? and what makest thou in this <hi type="italic">place?</hi> and what hast thou here?

verses.name: Judges 18:4
verses.text: And he said unto them, Thus and thus dealeth Micah with me, and hath hired me, and I am his priest.

verses.name: Judges 18:5
verses.text: And they said unto him, Ask counsel, we pray thee, of God, that we may know whether our way which we go shall be prosperous.

verses.name: Judges 18:6
verses.text: And the priest said unto them, Go in peace: before the Lord <hi type="italic">is</hi> your way wherein ye go.

verses.name: Judges 18:7
verses.text: ¶ Then the five men departed, and came to Laish, and saw the people that <hi type="italic">were</hi> therein, how they dwelt careless, after the manner of the Zidonians, quiet and secure; and <hi type="italic">there was</hi> no magistrate in the land, that might put <hi type="italic">them</hi> to shame in <hi type="italic">any</hi> thing; and they <hi type="italic">were</hi> far from the Zidonians, and had no business with <hi type="italic">any</hi> man.

verses.name: Judges 18:8
verses.text: And they came unto their brethren to Zorah and Eshtaol: and their brethren said unto them, What <hi type="italic">say</hi> ye?

verses.name: Judges 18:9
verses.text: And they said, Arise, that we may go up against them: for we have seen the land, and, behold, it <hi type="italic">is</hi> very good: and <hi type="italic">are</hi> ye still? be not slothful to go, <hi type="italic">and</hi> to enter to possess the land.

verses.name: Judges 18:10
verses.text: When ye go, ye shall come unto a people secure, and to a large land: for God hath given it into your hands; a place where <hi type="italic">there is</hi> no want of any thing that <hi type="italic">is</hi> in the earth.

verses.name: Judges 18:11
verses.text: ¶ And there went from thence of the family of the Danites, out of Zorah and out of Eshtaol, six hundred men appointed with weapons of war.

verses.name: Judges 18:12
verses.text: And they went up, and pitched in Kirjath-jearim, in Judah: wherefore they called that place Mahaneh-dan unto this day: behold, <hi type="italic">it is</hi> behind Kirjath-jearim.

verses.name: Judges 18:13
verses.text: And they passed thence unto mount Ephraim, and came unto the house of Micah.

verses.name: Judges 18:14
verses.text: ¶ Then answered the five men that went to spy out the country of Laish, and said unto their brethren, Do ye know that there is in these houses an ephod, and teraphim, and a graven image, and a molten image? now therefore consider what ye have to do.

verses.name: Judges 18:15
verses.text: And they turned thitherward, and came to the house of the young man the Levite, <hi type="italic">even</hi> unto the house of Micah, and saluted him.

verses.name: Judges 18:16
verses.text: And the six hundred men appointed with their weapons of war, which <hi type="italic">were</hi> of the children of Dan, stood by the entering of the gate.

verses.name: Judges 18:17
verses.text: And the five men that went to spy out the land went up, <hi type="italic">and</hi> came in thither, <hi type="italic">and</hi> took the graven image, and the ephod, and the teraphim, and the molten image: and the priest stood in the entering of the gate with the six hundred men <hi type="italic">that were</hi> appointed with weapons of war.

verses.name: Judges 18:18
verses.text: And these went into Micah’s house, and fetched the carved image, the ephod, and the teraphim, and the molten image. Then said the priest unto them, What do ye?

verses.name: Judges 18:19
verses.text: And they said unto him, Hold thy peace, lay thine hand upon thy mouth, and go with us, and be to us a father and a priest: <hi type="italic">is it</hi> better for thee to be a priest unto the house of one man, or that thou be a priest unto a tribe and a family in Israel?

verses.name: Judges 18:20
verses.text: And the priest’s heart was glad, and he took the ephod, and the teraphim, and the graven image, and went in the midst of the people.

verses.name: Judges 18:21
verses.text: So they turned and departed, and put the little ones and the cattle and the carriage before them.

verses.name: Judges 18:22
verses.text: ¶ <hi type="italic">And</hi> when they were a good way from the house of Micah, the men that <hi type="italic">were</hi> in the houses near to Micah’s house were gathered together, and overtook the children of Dan.

verses.name: Judges 18:23
verses.text: And they cried unto the children of Dan. And they turned their faces, and said unto Micah, What aileth thee, that thou comest with such a company?

verses.name: Judges 18:24
verses.text: And he said, Ye have taken away my gods which I made, and the priest, and ye are gone away: and what have I more? and what <hi type="italic">is</hi> this <hi type="italic">that</hi> ye say unto me, What aileth thee?

verses.name: Judges 18:25
verses.text: And the children of Dan said unto him, Let not thy voice be heard among us, lest angry fellows run upon thee, and thou lose thy life, with the lives of thy household.

verses.name: Judges 18:26
verses.text: And the children of Dan went their way: and when Micah saw that they <hi type="italic">were</hi> too strong for him, he turned and went back unto his house.

verses.name: Judges 18:27
verses.text: And they took <hi type="italic">the things</hi> which Micah had made, and the priest which he had, and came unto Laish, unto a people <hi type="italic">that were</hi> at quiet and secure: and they smote them with the edge of the sword, and burnt the city with fire.

verses.name: Judges 18:28
verses.text: And <hi type="italic">there was</hi> no deliverer, because it <hi type="italic">was</hi> far from Zidon, and they had no business with <hi type="italic">any</hi> man; and it was in the valley that <hi type="italic">lieth</hi> by Beth-rehob. And they built a city, and dwelt therein.

verses.name: Judges 18:29
verses.text: And they called the name of the city Dan, after the name of Dan their father, who was born unto Israel: howbeit the name of the city <hi type="italic">was</hi> Laish at the first.

verses.name: Judges 18:30
verses.text: ¶ And the children of Dan set up the graven image: and Jonathan, the son of Gershom, the son of Manasseh, he and his sons were priests to the tribe of Dan until the day of the captivity of the land.

verses.name: Judges 18:31
verses.text: And they set them up Micah’s graven image, which he made, all the time that the house of God was in Shiloh.  <chapter eID="Judg.18"/><div eID="gen237" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 19:1
verses.text: AND it came to pass in those days, when <hi type="italic">there was</hi> no king in Israel, that there was a certain Levite sojourning on the side of mount Ephraim, who took to him a concubine out of Beth-lehem-judah.

verses.name: Judges 19:2
verses.text: And his concubine played the whore against him, and went away from him unto her father’s house to Beth-lehem-judah, and was there four whole months.

verses.name: Judges 19:3
verses.text: And her husband arose, and went after her, to speak friendly unto her, <hi type="italic">and</hi> to bring her again, having his servant with him, and a couple of asses: and she brought him into her father’s house: and when the father of the damsel saw him, he rejoiced to meet him.

verses.name: Judges 19:4
verses.text: And his father in law, the damsel’s father, retained him; and he abode with him three days: so they did eat and drink, and lodged there.

verses.name: Judges 19:5
verses.text: ¶ And it came to pass on the fourth day, when they arose early in the morning, that he rose up to depart: and the damsel’s father said unto his son in law, Comfort thine heart with a morsel of bread, and afterward go your way.

verses.name: Judges 19:6
verses.text: And they sat down, and did eat and drink both of them together: for the damsel’s father had said unto the man, Be content, I pray thee, and tarry all night, and let thine heart be merry.

verses.name: Judges 19:7
verses.text: And when the man rose up to depart, his father in law urged him: therefore he lodged there again.

verses.name: Judges 19:8
verses.text: And he arose early in the morning on the fifth day to depart: and the damsel’s father said, Comfort thine heart, I pray thee. And they tarried until afternoon, and they did eat both of them.

verses.name: Judges 19:9
verses.text: And when the man rose up to depart, he, and his concubine, and his servant, his father in law, the damsel’s father, said unto him, Behold, now the day draweth toward evening, I pray you tarry all night: behold, the day groweth to an end, lodge here, that thine heart may be merry; and to morrow get you early on your way, that thou mayest go home.

verses.name: Judges 19:10
verses.text: But the man would not tarry that night, but he rose up and departed, and came over against Jebus, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> Jerusalem; and <hi type="italic">there were</hi> with him two asses saddled, his concubine also <hi type="italic">was</hi> with him.

verses.name: Judges 19:11
verses.text: <hi type="italic">And</hi> when they <hi type="italic">were</hi> by Jebus, the day was far spent; and the servant said unto his master, Come, I pray thee, and let us turn in into this city of the Jebusites, and lodge in it.

verses.name: Judges 19:12
verses.text: And his master said unto him, We will not turn aside hither into the city of a stranger, that <hi type="italic">is</hi> not of the children of Israel; we will pass over to Gibeah.

verses.name: Judges 19:13
verses.text: And he said unto his servant, Come, and let us draw near to one of these places to lodge all night, in Gibeah, or in Ramah.

verses.name: Judges 19:14
verses.text: And they passed on and went their way; and the sun went down upon them <hi type="italic">when they were</hi> by Gibeah, which <hi type="italic">belongeth</hi> to Benjamin.

verses.name: Judges 19:15
verses.text: And they turned aside thither, to go in <hi type="italic">and</hi> to lodge in Gibeah: and when he went in, he sat him down in a street of the city: for <hi type="italic">there was</hi> no man that took them into his house to lodging.

verses.name: Judges 19:16
verses.text: ¶ And, behold, there came an old man from his work out of the field at even, which <hi type="italic">was</hi> also of mount Ephraim; and he sojourned in Gibeah: but the men of the place <hi type="italic">were</hi> Benjamites.

verses.name: Judges 19:17
verses.text: And when he had lifted up his eyes, he saw a wayfaring man in the street of the city: and the old man said, Whither goest thou? and whence comest thou?

verses.name: Judges 19:18
verses.text: And he said unto him, We <hi type="italic">are</hi> passing from Beth-lehem-judah toward the side of mount Ephraim; from thence <hi type="italic">am</hi> I: and I went to Beth-lehem-judah, but I <hi type="italic">am now</hi> going to the house of the Lord; and there <hi type="italic">is</hi> no man that receiveth me to house.

verses.name: Judges 19:19
verses.text: Yet there is both straw and provender for our asses; and there is bread and wine also for me, and for thy handmaid, and for the young man <hi type="italic">which is</hi> with thy servants: <hi type="italic">there is</hi> no want of any thing.

verses.name: Judges 19:20
verses.text: And the old man said, Peace <hi type="italic">be</hi> with thee; howsoever <hi type="italic">let</hi> all thy wants <hi type="italic">lie</hi> upon me; only lodge not in the street.

verses.name: Judges 19:21
verses.text: So he brought him into his house, and gave provender unto the asses: and they washed their feet, and did eat and drink.

verses.name: Judges 19:22
verses.text: ¶ <hi type="italic">Now</hi> as they were making their hearts merry, behold, the men of the city, certain sons of Belial, beset the house round about, <hi type="italic">and</hi> beat at the door, and spake to the master of the house, the old man, saying, Bring forth the man that came into thine house, that we may know him.

verses.name: Judges 19:23
verses.text: And the man, the master of the house, went out unto them, and said unto them, Nay, my brethren, <hi type="italic">nay</hi>, I pray you, do not <hi type="italic">so</hi> wickedly; seeing that this man is come into mine house, do not this folly.

verses.name: Judges 19:24
verses.text: Behold, <hi type="italic">here is</hi> my daughter a maiden, and his concubine; them I will bring out now, and humble ye them, and do with them what seemeth good unto you: but unto this man do not so vile a thing.

verses.name: Judges 19:25
verses.text: But the men would not hearken to him: so the man took his concubine, and brought her forth unto them; and they knew her, and abused her all the night until the morning: and when the day began to spring, they let her go.

verses.name: Judges 19:26
verses.text: Then came the woman in the dawning of the day, and fell down at the door of the man’s house where her lord <hi type="italic">was</hi>, till it was light.

verses.name: Judges 19:27
verses.text: And her lord rose up in the morning, and opened the doors of the house, and went out to go his way: and, behold, the woman his concubine was fallen down <hi type="italic">at</hi> the door of the house, and her hands <hi type="italic">were</hi> upon the threshold.

verses.name: Judges 19:28
verses.text: And he said unto her, Up, and let us be going. But none answered. Then the man took her <hi type="italic">up</hi> upon an ass, and the man rose up, and gat him unto his place.

verses.name: Judges 19:29
verses.text: ¶ And when he was come into his house, he took a knife, and laid hold on his concubine, and divided her, <hi type="italic">together</hi> with her bones, into twelve pieces, and sent her into all the coasts of Israel.

verses.name: Judges 19:30
verses.text: And it was so, that all that saw it said, There was no such deed done nor seen from the day that the children of Israel came up out of the land of Egypt unto this day: consider of it, take advice, and speak <hi type="italic">your minds</hi>.  <chapter eID="Judg.19"/><div eID="gen238" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 20:1
verses.text: THEN all the children of Israel went out, and the congregation was gathered together as one man, from Dan even to Beer-sheba, with the land of Gilead, unto the Lord in Mizpeh.

verses.name: Judges 20:2
verses.text: And the chief of all the people, <hi type="italic">even</hi> of all the tribes of Israel, presented themselves in the assembly of the people of God, four hundred thousand footmen that drew sword.

verses.name: Judges 20:3
verses.text: (Now the children of Benjamin heard that the children of Israel were gone up to Mizpeh.) Then said the children of Israel, Tell <hi type="italic">us</hi>, how was this wickedness?

verses.name: Judges 20:4
verses.text: And the Levite, the husband of the woman that was slain, answered and said, I came into Gibeah that <hi type="italic">belongeth</hi> to Benjamin, I and my concubine, to lodge.

verses.name: Judges 20:5
verses.text: And the men of Gibeah rose against me, and beset the house round about upon me by night, <hi type="italic">and</hi> thought to have slain me: and my concubine have they forced, that she is dead.

verses.name: Judges 20:6
verses.text: And I took my concubine, and cut her in pieces, and sent her throughout all the country of the inheritance of Israel: for they have committed lewdness and folly in Israel.

verses.name: Judges 20:7
verses.text: Behold, ye <hi type="italic">are</hi> all children of Israel; give here your advice and counsel.

verses.name: Judges 20:8
verses.text: ¶ And all the people arose as one man, saying, We will not any <hi type="italic">of us</hi> go to his tent, neither will we any <hi type="italic">of us</hi> turn into his house.

verses.name: Judges 20:9
verses.text: But now this <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> the thing which we will do to Gibeah; <hi type="italic">we will go up</hi> by lot against it;

verses.name: Judges 20:10
verses.text: And we will take ten men of an hundred throughout all the tribes of Israel, and an hundred of a thousand, and a thousand out of ten thousand, to fetch victual for the people, that they may do, when they come to Gibeah of Benjamin, according to all the folly that they have wrought in Israel.

verses.name: Judges 20:11
verses.text: So all the men of Israel were gathered against the city, knit together as one man.

verses.name: Judges 20:12
verses.text: ¶ And the tribes of Israel sent men through all the tribe of Benjamin, saying, What wickedness <hi type="italic">is</hi> this that is done among you?

verses.name: Judges 20:13
verses.text: Now therefore deliver <hi type="italic">us</hi> the men, the children of Belial, which <hi type="italic">are</hi> in Gibeah, that we may put them to death, and put away evil from Israel. But the children of Benjamin would not hearken to the voice of their brethren the children of Israel:

verses.name: Judges 20:14
verses.text: But the children of Benjamin gathered themselves together out of the cities unto Gibeah, to go out to battle against the children of Israel.

verses.name: Judges 20:15
verses.text: And the children of Benjamin were numbered at that time out of the cities twenty and six thousand men that drew sword, beside the inhabitants of Gibeah, which were numbered seven hundred chosen men.

verses.name: Judges 20:16
verses.text: Among all this people <hi type="italic">there were</hi> seven hundred chosen men lefthanded; every one could sling stones at an hair <hi type="italic">breadth</hi>, and not miss.

verses.name: Judges 20:17
verses.text: And the men of Israel, beside Benjamin, were numbered four hundred thousand men that drew sword: all these <hi type="italic">were</hi> men of war.

verses.name: Judges 20:18
verses.text: ¶ And the children of Israel arose, and went up to the house of God, and asked counsel of God, and said, Which of us shall go up first to the battle against the children of Benjamin? And the Lord said, Judah <hi type="italic">shall go up</hi> first.

verses.name: Judges 20:19
verses.text: And the children of Israel rose up in the morning, and encamped against Gibeah.

verses.name: Judges 20:20
verses.text: And the men of Israel went out to battle against Benjamin; and the men of Israel put themselves in array to fight against them at Gibeah.

verses.name: Judges 20:21
verses.text: And the children of Benjamin came forth out of Gibeah, and destroyed down to the ground of the Israelites that day twenty and two thousand men.

verses.name: Judges 20:22
verses.text: And the people the men of Israel encouraged themselves, and set their battle again in array in the place where they put themselves in array the first day.

verses.name: Judges 20:23
verses.text: (And the children of Israel went up and wept before the Lord until even, and asked counsel of the Lord, saying, Shall I go up again to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother? And the Lord said, Go up against him.)

verses.name: Judges 20:24
verses.text: And the children of Israel came near against the children of Benjamin the second day.

verses.name: Judges 20:25
verses.text: And Benjamin went forth against them out of Gibeah the second day, and destroyed down to the ground of the children of Israel again eighteen thousand men; all these drew the sword.

verses.name: Judges 20:26
verses.text: ¶ Then all the children of Israel, and all the people, went up, and came unto the house of God, and wept, and sat there before the Lord, and fasted that day until even, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the Lord.

verses.name: Judges 20:27
verses.text: And the children of Israel inquired of the Lord, (for the ark of the covenant of God <hi type="italic">was</hi> there in those days,

verses.name: Judges 20:28
verses.text: And Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, stood before it in those days,) saying, Shall I yet again go out to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother, or shall I cease? And the Lord said, Go up; for to morrow I will deliver them into thine hand.

verses.name: Judges 20:29
verses.text: And Israel set liers in wait round about Gibeah.

verses.name: Judges 20:30
verses.text: And the children of Israel went up against the children of Benjamin on the third day, and put themselves in array against Gibeah, as at other times.

verses.name: Judges 20:31
verses.text: And the children of Benjamin went out against the people, <hi type="italic">and</hi> were drawn away from the city; and they began to smite of the people, <hi type="italic">and</hi> kill, as at other times, in the highways, of which one goeth up to the house of God, and the other to Gibeah in the field, about thirty men of Israel.

verses.name: Judges 20:32
verses.text: And the children of Benjamin said, They <hi type="italic">are</hi> smitten down before us, as at the first. But the children of Israel said, Let us flee, and draw them from the city unto the highways.

verses.name: Judges 20:33
verses.text: And all the men of Israel rose up out of their place, and put themselves in array at Baal-tamar: and the liers in wait of Israel came forth out of their places, <hi type="italic">even</hi> out of the meadows of Gibeah.

verses.name: Judges 20:34
verses.text: And there came against Gibeah ten thousand chosen men out of all Israel, and the battle was sore: but they knew not that evil <hi type="italic">was</hi> near them.

verses.name: Judges 20:35
verses.text: And the Lord smote Benjamin before Israel: and the children of Israel destroyed of the Benjamites that day twenty and five thousand and an hundred men: all these drew the sword.

verses.name: Judges 20:36
verses.text: So the children of Benjamin saw that they were smitten: for the men of Israel gave place to the Benjamites, because they trusted unto the liers in wait which they had set beside Gibeah.

verses.name: Judges 20:37
verses.text: And the liers in wait hasted, and rushed upon Gibeah; and the liers in wait drew <hi type="italic">themselves</hi> along, and smote all the city with the edge of the sword.

verses.name: Judges 20:38
verses.text: Now there was an appointed sign between the men of Israel and the liers in wait, that they should make a great flame with smoke rise up out of the city.

verses.name: Judges 20:39
verses.text: And when the men of Israel retired in the battle, Benjamin began to smite <hi type="italic">and</hi> kill of the men of Israel about thirty persons: for they said, Surely they are smitten down before us, as <hi type="italic">in</hi> the first battle.

verses.name: Judges 20:40
verses.text: But when the flame began to arise up out of the city with a pillar of smoke, the Benjamites looked behind them, and, behold, the flame of the city ascended up to heaven.

verses.name: Judges 20:41
verses.text: And when the men of Israel turned again, the men of Benjamin were amazed: for they saw that evil was come upon them.

verses.name: Judges 20:42
verses.text: Therefore they turned <hi type="italic">their backs</hi> before the men of Israel unto the way of the wilderness; but the battle overtook them; and them which <hi type="italic">came</hi> out of the cities they destroyed in the midst of them.

verses.name: Judges 20:43
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Thus</hi> they inclosed the Benjamites round about, <hi type="italic">and</hi> chased them, <hi type="italic">and</hi> trode them down with ease over against Gibeah toward the sunrising.

verses.name: Judges 20:44
verses.text: And there fell of Benjamin eighteen thousand men; all these <hi type="italic">were</hi> men of valour.

verses.name: Judges 20:45
verses.text: And they turned and fled toward the wilderness unto the rock of Rimmon: and they gleaned of them in the highways five thousand men; and pursued hard after them unto Gidom, and slew two thousand men of them.

verses.name: Judges 20:46
verses.text: So that all which fell that day of Benjamin were twenty and five thousand men that drew the sword; all these <hi type="italic">were</hi> men of valour.

verses.name: Judges 20:47
verses.text: But six hundred men turned and fled to the wilderness unto the rock Rimmon, and abode in the rock Rimmon four months.

verses.name: Judges 20:48
verses.text: And the men of Israel turned again upon the children of Benjamin, and smote them with the edge of the sword, as well the men of <hi type="italic">every</hi> city, as the beast, and all that came to hand: also they set on fire all the cities that they came to.  <chapter eID="Judg.20"/><div eID="gen239" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 21:1
verses.text: NOW the men of Israel had sworn in Mizpeh, saying, There shall not any of us give his daughter unto Benjamin to wife.

verses.name: Judges 21:2
verses.text: And the people came to the house of God, and abode there till even before God, and lifted up their voices, and wept sore;

verses.name: Judges 21:3
verses.text: And said, O Lord God of Israel, why is this come to pass in Israel, that there should be to day one tribe lacking in Israel?

verses.name: Judges 21:4
verses.text: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the people rose early, and built there an altar, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings.

verses.name: Judges 21:5
verses.text: And the children of Israel said, Who <hi type="italic">is there</hi> among all the tribes of Israel that came not up with the congregation unto the Lord? For they had made a great oath concerning him that came not up to the Lord to Mizpeh, saying, He shall surely be put to death.

verses.name: Judges 21:6
verses.text: And the children of Israel repented them for Benjamin their brother, and said, There is one tribe cut off from Israel this day.

verses.name: Judges 21:7
verses.text: How shall we do for wives for them that remain, seeing we have sworn by the Lord that we will not give them of our daughters to wives?

verses.name: Judges 21:8
verses.text: ¶ And they said, What one <hi type="italic">is there</hi> of the tribes of Israel that came not up to Mizpeh to the Lord? And, behold, there came none to the camp from Jabesh-gilead to the assembly.

verses.name: Judges 21:9
verses.text: For the people were numbered, and, behold, <hi type="italic">there were</hi> none of the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead there.

verses.name: Judges 21:10
verses.text: And the congregation sent thither twelve thousand men of the valiantest, and commanded them, saying, Go and smite the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead with the edge of the sword, with the women and the children.

verses.name: Judges 21:11
verses.text: And this <hi type="italic">is</hi> the thing that ye shall do, Ye shall utterly destroy every male, and every woman that hath lain by man.

verses.name: Judges 21:12
verses.text: And they found among the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead four hundred young virgins, that had known no man by lying with any male: and they brought them unto the camp to Shiloh, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> in the land of Canaan.

verses.name: Judges 21:13
verses.text: And the whole congregation sent <hi type="italic">some</hi> to speak to the children of Benjamin that <hi type="italic">were</hi> in the rock Rimmon, and to call peaceably unto them.

verses.name: Judges 21:14
verses.text: And Benjamin came again at that time; and they gave them wives which they had saved alive of the women of Jabesh-gilead: and yet so they sufficed them not.

verses.name: Judges 21:15
verses.text: And the people repented them for Benjamin, because that the Lord had made a breach in the tribes of Israel.

verses.name: Judges 21:16
verses.text: ¶ Then the elders of the congregation said, How shall we do for wives for them that remain, seeing the women are destroyed out of Benjamin?

verses.name: Judges 21:17
verses.text: And they said, <hi type="italic">There must be</hi> an inheritance for them that be escaped of Benjamin, that a tribe be not destroyed out of Israel.

verses.name: Judges 21:18
verses.text: Howbeit we may not give them wives of our daughters: for the children of Israel have sworn, saying, Cursed <hi type="italic">be</hi> he that giveth a wife to Benjamin.

verses.name: Judges 21:19
verses.text: Then they said, Behold, <hi type="italic">there is</hi> a feast of the Lord in Shiloh yearly <hi type="italic">in a place</hi> which <hi type="italic">is</hi> on the north side of Beth-el, on the east side of the highway that goeth up from Beth-el to Shechem, and on the south of Lebonah.

verses.name: Judges 21:20
verses.text: Therefore they commanded the children of Benjamin, saying, Go and lie in wait in the vineyards;

verses.name: Judges 21:21
verses.text: And see, and, behold, if the daughters of Shiloh come out to dance in dances, then come ye out of the vineyards, and catch you every man his wife of the daughters of Shiloh, and go to the land of Benjamin.

verses.name: Judges 21:22
verses.text: And it shall be, when their fathers or their brethren come unto us to complain, that we will say unto them, Be favourable unto them for our sakes: because we reserved not to each man his wife in the war: for ye did not give unto them at this time, <hi type="italic">that</hi> ye should be guilty.

verses.name: Judges 21:23
verses.text: And the children of Benjamin did so, and took <hi type="italic">them</hi> wives, according to their number, of them that danced, whom they caught: and they went and returned unto their inheritance, and repaired the cities, and dwelt in them.

verses.name: Judges 21:24
verses.text: And the children of Israel departed thence at that time, every man to his tribe and to his family, and they went out from thence every man to his inheritance.

verses.name: Judges 21:25
verses.text: In those days <hi type="italic">there was</hi> no king in Israel: every man did <hi type="italic">that which was</hi> right in his own eyes.  <chapter eID="Judg.21"/><div eID="gen240" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen219" osisID="Judg" type="book"/>

verses.name: Ruth 1:1
verses.text: NOW it came to pass in the days when the judges ruled, that there was a famine in the land. And a certain man of Beth-lehem-judah went to sojourn in the country of Moab, he, and his wife, and his two sons.

verses.name: Ruth 1:2
verses.text: And the name of the man <hi type="italic">was</hi> Elimelech, and the name of his wife Naomi, and the name of his two sons Mahlon and Chilion, Ephrathites of Beth-lehem-judah. And they came into the country of Moab, and continued there.

verses.name: Ruth 1:3
verses.text: And Elimelech Naomi’s husband died; and she was left, and her two sons.

verses.name: Ruth 1:4
verses.text: And they took them wives of the women of Moab; the name of the one <hi type="italic">was</hi> Orpah, and the name of the other Ruth: and they dwelled there about ten years.

verses.name: Ruth 1:5
verses.text: And Mahlon and Chilion died also both of them; and the woman was left of her two sons and her husband.

verses.name: Ruth 1:6
verses.text: ¶ Then she arose with her daughters in law, that she might return from the country of Moab: for she had heard in the country of Moab how that the Lord had visited his people in giving them bread.

verses.name: Ruth 1:7
verses.text: Wherefore she went forth out of the place where she was, and her two daughters in law with her; and they went on the way to return unto the land of Judah.

verses.name: Ruth 1:8
verses.text: And Naomi said unto her two daughters in law, Go, return each to her mother’s house: the Lord deal kindly with you, as ye have dealt with the dead, and with me.

verses.name: Ruth 1:9
verses.text: The Lord grant you that ye may find rest, each <hi type="italic">of you</hi> in the house of her husband. Then she kissed them; and they lifted up their voice, and wept.

verses.name: Ruth 1:10
verses.text: And they said unto her, Surely we will return with thee unto thy people.

verses.name: Ruth 1:11
verses.text: And Naomi said, Turn again, my daughters: why will ye go with me? <hi type="italic">are</hi> there yet <hi type="italic">any more</hi> sons in my womb, that they may be your husbands?

verses.name: Ruth 1:12
verses.text: Turn again, my daughters, go <hi type="italic">your way;</hi> for I am too old to have an husband. If I should say, I have hope, <hi type="italic">if</hi> I should have an husband also to night, and should also bear sons;

verses.name: Ruth 1:13
verses.text: Would ye tarry for them till they were grown? would ye stay for them from having husbands? nay, my daughters; for it grieveth me much for your sakes that the hand of the Lord is gone out against me.

verses.name: Ruth 1:14
verses.text: And they lifted up their voice, and wept again: and Orpah kissed her mother in law; but Ruth clave unto her.

verses.name: Ruth 1:15
verses.text: And she said, Behold, thy sister in law is gone back unto her people, and unto her gods: return thou after thy sister in law.

verses.name: Ruth 1:16
verses.text: And Ruth said, Intreat me not to leave thee, <hi type="italic">or</hi> to return from following after thee: for whither thou goest, I will go; and where thou lodgest, I will lodge: thy people <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> my people, and thy God my God:

verses.name: Ruth 1:17
verses.text: Where thou diest, will I die, and there will I be buried: the Lord do so to me, and more also, <hi type="italic">if ought</hi> but death part thee and me.

verses.name: Ruth 1:18
verses.text: When she saw that she was stedfastly minded to go with her, then she left speaking unto her.

verses.name: Ruth 1:19
verses.text: ¶ So they two went until they came to Beth-lehem. And it came to pass, when they were come to Beth-lehem, that all the city was moved about them, and they said, <hi type="italic">Is</hi> this Naomi?

verses.name: Ruth 1:20
verses.text: And she said unto them, Call me not Naomi, call me Mara: for the Almighty hath dealt very bitterly with me.

verses.name: Ruth 1:21
verses.text: I went out full, and the Lord hath brought me home again empty: why <hi type="italic">then</hi> call ye me Naomi, seeing the Lord hath testified against me, and the Almighty hath afflicted me?

verses.name: Ruth 1:22
verses.text: So Naomi returned, and Ruth the Moabitess, her daughter in law, with her, which returned out of the country of Moab: and they came to Beth-lehem in the beginning of barley harvest.  <chapter eID="Ruth.1"/><div eID="gen242" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ruth 2:1
verses.text: AND Naomi had a kinsman of her husband’s, a mighty man of wealth, of the family of Elimelech; and his name <hi type="italic">was</hi> Boaz.

verses.name: Ruth 2:2
verses.text: And Ruth the Moabitess said unto Naomi, Let me now go to the field, and glean ears of corn after <hi type="italic">him</hi> in whose sight I shall find grace. And she said unto her, Go, my daughter.

verses.name: Ruth 2:3
verses.text: And she went, and came, and gleaned in the field after the reapers: and her hap was to light on a part of the field <hi type="italic">belonging</hi> unto Boaz, who <hi type="italic">was</hi> of the kindred of Elimelech.

verses.name: Ruth 2:4
verses.text: ¶ And, behold, Boaz came from Beth-lehem, and said unto the reapers, The Lord <hi type="italic">be</hi> with you. And they answered him, The Lord bless thee.

verses.name: Ruth 2:5
verses.text: Then said Boaz unto his servant that was set over the reapers, Whose damsel <hi type="italic">is</hi> this?

verses.name: Ruth 2:6
verses.text: And the servant that was set over the reapers answered and said, It <hi type="italic">is</hi> the Moabitish damsel that came back with Naomi out of the country of Moab:

verses.name: Ruth 2:7
verses.text: And she said, I pray you, let me glean and gather after the reapers among the sheaves: so she came, and hath continued even from the morning until now, that she tarried a little in the house.

verses.name: Ruth 2:8
verses.text: Then said Boaz unto Ruth, Hearest thou not, my daughter? Go not to glean in another field, neither go from hence, but abide here fast by my maidens:

verses.name: Ruth 2:9
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Let</hi> thine eyes <hi type="italic">be</hi> on the field that they do reap, and go thou after them: have I not charged the young men that they shall not touch thee? and when thou art athirst, go unto the vessels, and drink of <hi type="italic">that</hi> which the young men have drawn.

verses.name: Ruth 2:10
verses.text: Then she fell on her face, and bowed herself to the ground, and said unto him, Why have I found grace in thine eyes, that thou shouldest take knowledge of me, seeing I <hi type="italic">am</hi> a stranger?

verses.name: Ruth 2:11
