verses.text: But the people held their peace, and answered him not a word: for the king’s commandment was, saying, Answer him not.

verses.name: II Kings 18:37
verses.text: Then came Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, which <hi type="italic">was</hi> over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder, to Hezekiah with <hi type="italic">their</hi> clothes rent, and told him the words of Rab-shakeh.  <chapter eID="2Kgs.18"/><div eID="gen344" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: II Kings 19:1
verses.text: AND it came to pass, when king Hezekiah heard <hi type="italic">it</hi>, that he rent his clothes, and covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the house of the Lord.

verses.name: II Kings 19:2
verses.text: And he sent Eliakim, which <hi type="italic">was</hi> over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests, covered with sackcloth, to Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz.

verses.name: II Kings 19:3
verses.text: And they said unto him, Thus saith Hezekiah, This day <hi type="italic">is</hi> a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and blasphemy: for the children are come to the birth, and <hi type="italic">there is</hi> not strength to bring forth.

verses.name: II Kings 19:4
verses.text: It may be the Lord thy God will hear all the words of Rab-shakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master hath sent to reproach the living God; and will reprove the words which the Lord thy God hath heard: wherefore lift up <hi type="italic">thy</hi> prayer for the remnant that are left.

verses.name: II Kings 19:5
verses.text: So the servants of king Hezekiah came to Isaiah.

verses.name: II Kings 19:6
verses.text: ¶ And Isaiah said unto them, Thus shall ye say to your master, Thus saith the Lord, Be not afraid of the words which thou hast heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.

verses.name: II Kings 19:7
verses.text: Behold, I will send a blast upon him, and he shall hear a rumour, and shall return to his own land; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.

verses.name: II Kings 19:8
verses.text: ¶ So Rab-shakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah: for he had heard that he was departed from Lachish.

verses.name: II Kings 19:9
verses.text: And when he heard say of Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, Behold, he is come out to fight against thee: he sent messengers again unto Hezekiah, saying,

verses.name: II Kings 19:10
verses.text: Thus shall ye speak to Hezekiah king of Judah, saying, Let not thy God in whom thou trustest deceive thee, saying, Jerusalem shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.

verses.name: II Kings 19:11
verses.text: Behold, thou hast heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands, by destroying them utterly: and shalt thou be delivered?

verses.name: II Kings 19:12
verses.text: Have the gods of the nations delivered them which my fathers have destroyed; <hi type="italic">as</hi> Gozan, and Haran, and Rezeph, and the children of Eden which <hi type="italic">were</hi> in Thelasar?

verses.name: II Kings 19:13
verses.text: Where <hi type="italic">is</hi> the king of Hamath, and the king of Arpad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and Ivah?

verses.name: II Kings 19:14
verses.text: ¶ And Hezekiah received the letter of the hand of the messengers, and read it: and Hezekiah went up into the house of the Lord, and spread it before the Lord.

verses.name: II Kings 19:15
verses.text: And Hezekiah prayed before the Lord, and said, O Lord God of Israel, which dwellest <hi type="italic">between</hi> the cherubims, thou art the God, <hi type="italic">even</hi> thou alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth; thou hast made heaven and earth.

verses.name: II Kings 19:16
verses.text: Lord, bow down thine ear, and hear: open, Lord, thine eyes, and see: and hear the words of Sennacherib, which hath sent him to reproach the living God.

verses.name: II Kings 19:17
verses.text: Of a truth, Lord, the kings of Assyria have destroyed the nations and their lands,

verses.name: II Kings 19:18
verses.text: And have cast their gods into the fire: for they <hi type="italic">were</hi> no gods, but the work of men’s hands, wood and stone: therefore they have destroyed them.

verses.name: II Kings 19:19
verses.text: Now therefore, O Lord our God, I beseech thee, save thou us out of his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> the Lord God, <hi type="italic">even</hi> thou only.

verses.name: II Kings 19:20
verses.text: ¶ Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent to Hezekiah, saying, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, <hi type="italic">That</hi> which thou hast prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria I have heard.

verses.name: II Kings 19:21
verses.text: This <hi type="italic">is</hi> the word that the Lord hath spoken concerning him; The virgin the daughter of Zion hath despised thee, <hi type="italic">and</hi> laughed thee to scorn; the daughter of Jerusalem hath shaken her head at thee.

verses.name: II Kings 19:22
verses.text: Whom hast thou reproached and blasphemed? and against whom hast thou exalted <hi type="italic">thy</hi> voice, and lifted up thine eyes on high? <hi type="italic">even</hi> against the Holy <hi type="italic">One</hi> of Israel.

verses.name: II Kings 19:23
verses.text: By thy messengers thou hast reproached the Lord, and hast said, With the multitude of my chariots I am come up to the height of the mountains, to the sides of Lebanon, and will cut down the tall cedar trees thereof, <hi type="italic">and</hi> the choice fir trees thereof: and I will enter into the lodgings of his borders, <hi type="italic">and into</hi> the forest of his Carmel.

verses.name: II Kings 19:24
verses.text: I have digged and drunk strange waters, and with the sole of my feet have I dried up all the rivers of besieged places.

verses.name: II Kings 19:25
verses.text: Hast thou not heard long ago <hi type="italic">how</hi> I have done it, <hi type="italic">and</hi> of ancient times that I have formed it? now have I brought it to pass, that thou shouldest be to lay waste fenced cities <hi type="italic">into</hi> ruinous heaps.

verses.name: II Kings 19:26
verses.text: Therefore their inhabitants were of small power, they were dismayed and confounded; they were <hi type="italic">as</hi> the grass of the field, and <hi type="italic">as</hi> the green herb, <hi type="italic">as</hi> the grass on the housetops, and <hi type="italic">as corn</hi> blasted before it be grown up.

verses.name: II Kings 19:27
verses.text: But I know thy abode, and thy going out, and thy coming in, and thy rage against me.

verses.name: II Kings 19:28
verses.text: Because thy rage against me and thy tumult is come up into mine ears, therefore I will put my hook in thy nose, and my bridle in thy lips, and I will turn thee back by the way by which thou camest.

verses.name: II Kings 19:29
verses.text: And this <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> a sign unto thee, Ye shall eat this year such things as grow of themselves, and in the second year that which springeth of the same; and in the third year sow ye, and reap, and plant vineyards, and eat the fruits thereof.

verses.name: II Kings 19:30
verses.text: And the remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah shall yet again take root downward, and bear fruit upward.

verses.name: II Kings 19:31
verses.text: For out of Jerusalem shall go forth a remnant, and they that escape out of mount Zion: the zeal of the Lord <hi type="italic">of hosts</hi> shall do this.

verses.name: II Kings 19:32
verses.text: Therefore thus saith the Lord concerning the king of Assyria, He shall not come into this city, nor shoot an arrow there, nor come before it with shield, nor cast a bank against it.

verses.name: II Kings 19:33
verses.text: By the way that he came, by the same shall he return, and shall not come into this city, saith the Lord.

verses.name: II Kings 19:34
verses.text: For I will defend this city, to save it, for mine own sake, and for my servant David’s sake.

verses.name: II Kings 19:35
verses.text: ¶ And it came to pass that night, that the angel of the Lord went out, and smote in the camp of the Assyrians an hundred fourscore and five thousand: and when they arose early in the morning, behold, they <hi type="italic">were</hi> all dead corpses.

verses.name: II Kings 19:36
verses.text: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, and went and returned, and dwelt at Nineveh.

verses.name: II Kings 19:37
verses.text: And it came to pass, as he was worshipping in the house of Nisroch his god, that Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons smote him with the sword: and they escaped into the land of Armenia. And Esarhaddon his son reigned in his stead.  <chapter eID="2Kgs.19"/><div eID="gen345" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: II Kings 20:1
verses.text: IN those days was Hezekiah sick unto death. And the prophet Isaiah the son of Amoz came to him, and said unto him, Thus saith the Lord, Set thine house in order; for thou shalt die, and not live.

verses.name: II Kings 20:2
verses.text: Then he turned his face to the wall, and prayed unto the Lord, saying,

verses.name: II Kings 20:3
verses.text: I beseech thee, O Lord, remember now how I have walked before thee in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done <hi type="italic">that which is</hi> good in thy sight. And Hezekiah wept sore.

verses.name: II Kings 20:4
verses.text: And it came to pass, afore Isaiah was gone out into the middle court, that the word of the Lord came to him, saying,

verses.name: II Kings 20:5
verses.text: Turn again, and tell Hezekiah the captain of my people, Thus saith the Lord, the God of David thy father, I have heard thy prayer, I have seen thy tears: behold, I will heal thee: on the third day thou shalt go up unto the house of the Lord.

verses.name: II Kings 20:6
verses.text: And I will add unto thy days fifteen years; and I will deliver thee and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria; and I will defend this city for mine own sake, and for my servant David’s sake.

verses.name: II Kings 20:7
verses.text: And Isaiah said, Take a lump of figs. And they took and laid <hi type="italic">it</hi> on the boil, and he recovered.

verses.name: II Kings 20:8
verses.text: ¶ And Hezekiah said unto Isaiah, What <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> the sign that the Lord will heal me, and that I shall go up into the house of the Lord the third day?

verses.name: II Kings 20:9
verses.text: And Isaiah said, This sign shalt thou have of the Lord, that the Lord will do the thing that he hath spoken: shall the shadow go forward ten degrees, or go back ten degrees?

verses.name: II Kings 20:10
verses.text: And Hezekiah answered, It is a light thing for the shadow to go down ten degrees: nay, but let the shadow return backward ten degrees.

verses.name: II Kings 20:11
verses.text: And Isaiah the prophet cried unto the Lord: and he brought the shadow ten degrees backward, by which it had gone down in the dial of Ahaz.

verses.name: II Kings 20:12
verses.text: ¶ At that time Berodach-baladan, the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present unto Hezekiah: for he had heard that Hezekiah had been sick.

verses.name: II Kings 20:13
verses.text: And Hezekiah hearkened unto them, and shewed them all the house of his precious things, the silver, and the gold, and the spices, and the precious ointment, and <hi type="italic">all</hi> the house of his armour, and all that was found in his treasures: there was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion, that Hezekiah shewed them not.

verses.name: II Kings 20:14
verses.text: ¶ Then came Isaiah the prophet unto king Hezekiah, and said unto him, What said these men? and from whence came they unto thee? And Hezekiah said, They are come from a far country, <hi type="italic">even</hi> from Babylon.

verses.name: II Kings 20:15
verses.text: And he said, What have they seen in thine house? And Hezekiah answered, All <hi type="italic">the things</hi> that <hi type="italic">are</hi> in mine house have they seen: there is nothing among my treasures that I have not shewed them.

verses.name: II Kings 20:16
verses.text: And Isaiah said unto Hezekiah, Hear the word of the Lord.

verses.name: II Kings 20:17
verses.text: Behold, the days come, that all that <hi type="italic">is</hi> in thine house, and that which thy fathers have laid up in store unto this day, shall be carried into Babylon: nothing shall be left, saith the Lord.

verses.name: II Kings 20:18
verses.text: And of thy sons that shall issue from thee, which thou shalt beget, shall they take away; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.

verses.name: II Kings 20:19
verses.text: Then said Hezekiah unto Isaiah, Good <hi type="italic">is</hi> the word of the Lord which thou hast spoken. And he said, <hi type="italic">Is it</hi> not <hi type="italic">good</hi>, if peace and truth be in my days?

verses.name: II Kings 20:20
verses.text: ¶ And the rest of the acts of Hezekiah, and all his might, and how he made a pool, and a conduit, and brought water into the city, <hi type="italic">are</hi> they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

verses.name: II Kings 20:21
verses.text: And Hezekiah slept with his fathers: and Manasseh his son reigned in his stead.  <chapter eID="2Kgs.20"/><div eID="gen346" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: II Kings 21:1
verses.text: MANASSEH <hi type="italic">was</hi> twelve years old when he began to reign, and reigned fifty and five years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name <hi type="italic">was</hi> Hephzi-bah.

verses.name: II Kings 21:2
verses.text: And he did <hi type="italic">that which was</hi> evil in the sight of the Lord, after the abominations of the heathen, whom the Lord cast out before the children of Israel.

verses.name: II Kings 21:3
verses.text: For he built up again the high places which Hezekiah his father had destroyed; and he reared up altars for Baal, and made a grove, as did Ahab king of Israel; and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served them.

verses.name: II Kings 21:4
verses.text: And he built altars in the house of the Lord, of which the Lord said, In Jerusalem will I put my name.

verses.name: II Kings 21:5
verses.text: And he built altars for all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of the Lord.

verses.name: II Kings 21:6
verses.text: And he made his son pass through the fire, and observed times, and used enchantments, and dealt with familiar spirits and wizards: he wrought much wickedness in the sight of the Lord, to provoke <hi type="italic">him</hi> to anger.

verses.name: II Kings 21:7
verses.text: And he set a graven image of the grove that he had made in the house, of which the Lord said to David, and to Solomon his son, In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all tribes of Israel, will I put my name for ever:

verses.name: II Kings 21:8
verses.text: Neither will I make the feet of Israel move any more out of the land which I gave their fathers; only if they will observe to do according to all that I have commanded them, and according to all the law that my servant Moses commanded them.

verses.name: II Kings 21:9
verses.text: But they hearkened not: and Manasseh seduced them to do more evil than did the nations whom the Lord destroyed before the children of Israel.

verses.name: II Kings 21:10
verses.text: ¶ And the Lord spake by his servants the prophets, saying,

verses.name: II Kings 21:11
verses.text: Because Manasseh king of Judah hath done these abominations, <hi type="italic">and</hi> hath done wickedly above all that the Amorites did, which <hi type="italic">were</hi> before him, and hath made Judah also to sin with his idols:

verses.name: II Kings 21:12
verses.text: Therefore thus saith the Lord God of Israel, Behold, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> bringing <hi type="italic">such</hi> evil upon Jerusalem and Judah, that whosoever heareth of it, both his ears shall tingle.

verses.name: II Kings 21:13
verses.text: And I will stretch over Jerusalem the line of Samaria, and the plummet of the house of Ahab: and I will wipe Jerusalem as <hi type="italic">a man</hi> wipeth a dish, wiping <hi type="italic">it</hi>, and turning <hi type="italic">it</hi> upside down.

verses.name: II Kings 21:14
verses.text: And I will forsake the remnant of mine inheritance, and deliver them into the hand of their enemies; and they shall become a prey and a spoil to all their enemies;

verses.name: II Kings 21:15
verses.text: Because they have done <hi type="italic">that which was</hi> evil in my sight, and have provoked me to anger, since the day their fathers came forth out of Egypt, even unto this day.

verses.name: II Kings 21:16
verses.text: Moreover Manasseh shed innocent blood very much, till he had filled Jerusalem from one end to another; beside his sin wherewith he made Judah to sin, in doing <hi type="italic">that which was</hi> evil in the sight of the Lord.

verses.name: II Kings 21:17
verses.text: ¶ Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and all that he did, and his sin that he sinned, <hi type="italic">are</hi> they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

verses.name: II Kings 21:18
verses.text: And Manasseh slept with his fathers, and was buried in the garden of his own house, in the garden of Uzza: and Amon his son reigned in his stead.

verses.name: II Kings 21:19
verses.text: ¶ Amon <hi type="italic">was</hi> twenty and two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned two years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name <hi type="italic">was</hi> Meshullemeth, the daughter of Haruz of Jotbah.

verses.name: II Kings 21:20
verses.text: And he did <hi type="italic">that which was</hi> evil in the sight of the Lord, as his father Manasseh did.

verses.name: II Kings 21:21
verses.text: And he walked in all the way that his father walked in, and served the idols that his father served, and worshipped them:

verses.name: II Kings 21:22
verses.text: And he forsook the Lord God of his fathers, and walked not in the way of the Lord.

verses.name: II Kings 21:23
verses.text: ¶ And the servants of Amon conspired against him, and slew the king in his own house.

verses.name: II Kings 21:24
verses.text: And the people of the land slew all them that had conspired against king Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his stead.

verses.name: II Kings 21:25
verses.text: Now the rest of the acts of Amon which he did, <hi type="italic">are</hi> they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

verses.name: II Kings 21:26
verses.text: And he was buried in his sepulchre in the garden of Uzza: and Josiah his son reigned in his stead.  <chapter eID="2Kgs.21"/><div eID="gen347" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: II Kings 22:1
verses.text: JOSIAH <hi type="italic">was</hi> eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty and one years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name <hi type="italic">was</hi> Jedidah, the daughter of Adaiah of Boscath.

verses.name: II Kings 22:2
verses.text: And he did <hi type="italic">that which was</hi> right in the sight of the Lord, and walked in all the way of David his father, and turned not aside to the right hand or to the left.

verses.name: II Kings 22:3
verses.text: ¶ And it came to pass in the eighteenth year of king Josiah, <hi type="italic">that</hi> the king sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah, the son of Meshullam, the scribe, to the house of the Lord, saying,

verses.name: II Kings 22:4
verses.text: Go up to Hilkiah the high priest, that he may sum the silver which is brought into the house of the Lord, which the keepers of the door have gathered of the people:

verses.name: II Kings 22:5
verses.text: And let them deliver it into the hand of the doers of the work, that have the oversight of the house of the Lord: and let them give it to the doers of the work which <hi type="italic">is</hi> in the house of the Lord, to repair the breaches of the house,

verses.name: II Kings 22:6
verses.text: Unto carpenters, and builders, and masons, and to buy timber and hewn stone to repair the house.

verses.name: II Kings 22:7
verses.text: Howbeit there was no reckoning made with them of the money that was delivered into their hand, because they dealt faithfully.

verses.name: II Kings 22:8
verses.text: ¶ And Hilkiah the high priest said unto Shaphan the scribe, I have found the book of the law in the house of the Lord. And Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan, and he read it.

verses.name: II Kings 22:9
verses.text: And Shaphan the scribe came to the king, and brought the king word again, and said, Thy servants have gathered the money that was found in the house, and have delivered it into the hand of them that do the work, that have the oversight of the house of the Lord.

verses.name: II Kings 22:10
verses.text: And Shaphan the scribe shewed the king, saying, Hilkiah the priest hath delivered me a book. And Shaphan read it before the king.

verses.name: II Kings 22:11
verses.text: And it came to pass, when the king had heard the words of the book of the law, that he rent his clothes.

verses.name: II Kings 22:12
verses.text: And the king commanded Hilkiah the priest, and Ahikam the son of Shaphan, and Achbor the son of Michaiah, and Shaphan the scribe, and Asahiah a servant of the king’s, saying,

verses.name: II Kings 22:13
verses.text: Go ye, inquire of the Lord for me, and for the people, and for all Judah, concerning the words of this book that is found: for great <hi type="italic">is</hi> the wrath of the Lord that is kindled against us, because our fathers have not hearkened unto the words of this book, to do according unto all that which is written concerning us.

verses.name: II Kings 22:14
verses.text: So Hilkiah the priest, and Ahikam, and Achbor, and Shaphan, and Asahiah, went unto Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvah, the son of Harhas, keeper of the wardrobe; (now she dwelt in Jerusalem in the college;) and they communed with her.

verses.name: II Kings 22:15
verses.text: ¶ And she said unto them, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, Tell the man that sent you to me,

verses.name: II Kings 22:16
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord, Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, and upon the inhabitants thereof, <hi type="italic">even</hi> all the words of the book which the king of Judah hath read:

verses.name: II Kings 22:17
verses.text: Because they have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands; therefore my wrath shall be kindled against this place, and shall not be quenched.

verses.name: II Kings 22:18
verses.text: But to the king of Judah which sent you to inquire of the Lord, thus shall ye say to him, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, <hi type="italic">As touching</hi> the words which thou hast heard;

verses.name: II Kings 22:19
verses.text: Because thine heart was tender, and thou hast humbled thyself before the Lord, when thou heardest what I spake against this place, and against the inhabitants thereof, that they should become a desolation and a curse, and hast rent thy clothes, and wept before me; I also have heard <hi type="italic">thee</hi>, saith the Lord.

verses.name: II Kings 22:20
verses.text: Behold therefore, I will gather thee unto thy fathers, and thou shalt be gathered into thy grave in peace; and thine eyes shall not see all the evil which I will bring upon this place. And they brought the king word again.  <chapter eID="2Kgs.22"/><div eID="gen348" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: II Kings 23:1
verses.text: AND the king sent, and they gathered unto him all the elders of Judah and of Jerusalem.

verses.name: II Kings 23:2
verses.text: And the king went up into the house of the Lord, and all the men of Judah and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem with him, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the people, both small and great: and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant which was found in the house of the Lord.

verses.name: II Kings 23:3
verses.text: ¶ And the king stood by a pillar, and made a covenant before the Lord, to walk after the Lord, and to keep his commandments and his testimonies and his statutes with all <hi type="italic">their</hi> heart and all <hi type="italic">their</hi> soul, to perform the words of this covenant that were written in this book. And all the people stood to the covenant.

verses.name: II Kings 23:4
verses.text: And the king commanded Hilkiah the high priest, and the priests of the second order, and the keepers of the door, to bring forth out of the temple of the Lord all the vessels that were made for Baal, and for the grove, and for all the host of heaven: and he burned them without Jerusalem in the fields of Kidron, and carried the ashes of them unto Beth-el.

verses.name: II Kings 23:5
verses.text: And he put down the idolatrous priests, whom the kings of Judah had ordained to burn incense in the high places in the cities of Judah, and in the places round about Jerusalem; them also that burned incense unto Baal, to the sun, and to the moon, and to the planets, and to all the host of heaven.

verses.name: II Kings 23:6
verses.text: And he brought out the grove from the house of the Lord, without Jerusalem, unto the brook Kidron, and burned it at the brook Kidron, and stamped <hi type="italic">it</hi> small to powder, and cast the powder thereof upon the graves of the children of the people.

verses.name: II Kings 23:7
verses.text: And he brake down the houses of the sodomites, that <hi type="italic">were</hi> by the house of the Lord, where the women wove hangings for the grove.

verses.name: II Kings 23:8
verses.text: And he brought all the priests out of the cities of Judah, and defiled the high places where the priests had burned incense, from Geba to Beer-sheba, and brake down the high places of the gates that <hi type="italic">were</hi> in the entering in of the gate of Joshua the governor of the city, which <hi type="italic">were</hi> on a man’s left hand at the gate of the city.

verses.name: II Kings 23:9
verses.text: Nevertheless the priests of the high places came not up to the altar of the Lord in Jerusalem, but they did eat of the unleavened bread among their brethren.

verses.name: II Kings 23:10
verses.text: And he defiled Topheth, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> in the valley of the children of Hinnom, that no man might make his son or his daughter to pass through the fire to Molech.

verses.name: II Kings 23:11
verses.text: And he took away the horses that the kings of Judah had given to the sun, at the entering in of the house of the Lord, by the chamber of Nathan-melech the chamberlain, which <hi type="italic">was</hi> in the suburbs, and burned the chariots of the sun with fire.

verses.name: II Kings 23:12
verses.text: And the altars that <hi type="italic">were</hi> on the top of the upper chamber of Ahaz, which the kings of Judah had made, and the altars which Manasseh had made in the two courts of the house of the Lord, did the king beat down, and brake <hi type="italic">them</hi> down from thence, and cast the dust of them into the brook Kidron.

verses.name: II Kings 23:13
verses.text: And the high places that <hi type="italic">were</hi> before Jerusalem, which <hi type="italic">were</hi> on the right hand of the mount of corruption, which Solomon the king of Israel had builded for Ashtoreth the abomination of the Zidonians, and for Chemosh the abomination of the Moabites, and for Milcom the abomination of the children of Ammon, did the king defile.

verses.name: II Kings 23:14
verses.text: And he brake in pieces the images, and cut down the groves, and filled their places with the bones of men.

verses.name: II Kings 23:15
verses.text: ¶ Moreover the altar that <hi type="italic">was</hi> at Beth-el, <hi type="italic">and</hi> the high place which Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, had made, both that altar and the high place he brake down, and burned the high place, <hi type="italic">and</hi> stamped <hi type="italic">it</hi> small to powder, and burned the grove.

verses.name: II Kings 23:16
verses.text: And as Josiah turned himself, he spied the sepulchres that <hi type="italic">were</hi> there in the mount, and sent, and took the bones out of the sepulchres, and burned <hi type="italic">them</hi> upon the altar, and polluted it, according to the word of the Lord which the man of God proclaimed, who proclaimed these words.

verses.name: II Kings 23:17
verses.text: Then he said, What title <hi type="italic">is</hi> that that I see? And the men of the city told him, <hi type="italic">It is</hi> the sepulchre of the man of God, which came from Judah, and proclaimed these things that thou hast done against the altar of Beth-el.

verses.name: II Kings 23:18
verses.text: And he said, Let him alone; let no man move his bones. So they let his bones alone, with the bones of the prophet that came out of Samaria.

verses.name: II Kings 23:19
verses.text: And all the houses also of the high places that <hi type="italic">were</hi> in the cities of Samaria, which the kings of Israel had made to provoke <hi type="italic">the L</hi><hi type="italic">ord</hi> to anger, Josiah took away, and did to them according to all the acts that he had done in Beth-el.

verses.name: II Kings 23:20
verses.text: And he slew all the priests of the high places that <hi type="italic">were</hi> there upon the altars, and burned men’s bones upon them, and returned to Jerusalem.

verses.name: II Kings 23:21
verses.text: ¶ And the king commanded all the people, saying, Keep the passover unto the Lord your God, as <hi type="italic">it is</hi> written in the book of this covenant.

verses.name: II Kings 23:22
verses.text: Surely there was not holden such a passover from the days of the judges that judged Israel, nor in all the days of the kings of Israel, nor of the kings of Judah;

verses.name: II Kings 23:23
verses.text: But in the eighteenth year of king Josiah, <hi type="italic">wherein</hi> this passover was holden to the Lord in Jerusalem.

verses.name: II Kings 23:24
verses.text: ¶ Moreover the <hi type="italic">workers with</hi> familiar spirits, and the wizards, and the images, and the idols, and all the abominations that were spied in the land of Judah and in Jerusalem, did Josiah put away, that he might perform the words of the law which were written in the book that Hilkiah the priest found in the house of the Lord.

verses.name: II Kings 23:25
verses.text: And like unto him was there no king before him, that turned to the Lord with all his heart, and with all his soul, and with all his might, according to all the law of Moses; neither after him arose there <hi type="italic">any</hi> like him.

verses.name: II Kings 23:26
verses.text: ¶ Notwithstanding the Lord turned not from the fierceness of his great wrath, wherewith his anger was kindled against Judah, because of all the provocations that Manasseh had provoked him withal.

verses.name: II Kings 23:27
verses.text: And the Lord said, I will remove Judah also out of my sight, as I have removed Israel, and will cast off this city Jerusalem which I have chosen, and the house of which I said, My name shall be there.

verses.name: II Kings 23:28
verses.text: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and all that he did, <hi type="italic">are</hi> they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

verses.name: II Kings 23:29
verses.text: ¶ In his days Pharaoh-nechoh king of Egypt went up against the king of Assyria to the river Euphrates: and king Josiah went against him; and he slew him at Megiddo, when he had seen him.

verses.name: II Kings 23:30
verses.text: And his servants carried him in a chariot dead from Megiddo, and brought him to Jerusalem, and buried him in his own sepulchre. And the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and anointed him, and made him king in his father’s stead.

verses.name: II Kings 23:31
verses.text: ¶ Jehoahaz <hi type="italic">was</hi> twenty and three years old when he began to reign; and he reigned three months in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name <hi type="italic">was</hi> Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

verses.name: II Kings 23:32
verses.text: And he did <hi type="italic">that which was</hi> evil in the sight of the Lord, according to all that his fathers had done.

verses.name: II Kings 23:33
verses.text: And Pharaoh-nechoh put him in bands at Riblah in the land of Hamath, that he might not reign in Jerusalem; and put the land to a tribute of an hundred talents of silver, and a talent of gold.

verses.name: II Kings 23:34
verses.text: And Pharaoh-nechoh made Eliakim the son of Josiah king in the room of Josiah his father, and turned his name to Jehoiakim, and took Jehoahaz away: and he came to Egypt, and died there.

verses.name: II Kings 23:35
verses.text: And Jehoiakim gave the silver and the gold to Pharaoh; but he taxed the land to give the money according to the commandment of Pharaoh: he exacted the silver and the gold of the people of the land, of every one according to his taxation, to give <hi type="italic">it</hi> unto Pharaoh-nechoh.

verses.name: II Kings 23:36
verses.text: ¶ Jehoiakim <hi type="italic">was</hi> twenty and five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name <hi type="italic">was</hi> Zebudah, the daughter of Pedaiah of Rumah.

verses.name: II Kings 23:37
verses.text: And he did <hi type="italic">that which was</hi> evil in the sight of the Lord, according to all that his fathers had done.  <chapter eID="2Kgs.23"/><div eID="gen349" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: II Kings 24:1
verses.text: IN his days Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up, and Jehoiakim became his servant three years: then he turned and rebelled against him.

verses.name: II Kings 24:2
verses.text: And the Lord sent against him bands of the Chaldees, and bands of the Syrians, and bands of the Moabites, and bands of the children of Ammon, and sent them against Judah to destroy it, according to the word of the Lord, which he spake by his servants the prophets.

verses.name: II Kings 24:3
verses.text: Surely at the commandment of the Lord came <hi type="italic">this</hi> upon Judah, to remove <hi type="italic">them</hi> out of his sight, for the sins of Manasseh, according to all that he did;

verses.name: II Kings 24:4
verses.text: And also for the innocent blood that he shed: for he filled Jerusalem with innocent blood; which the Lord would not pardon.

verses.name: II Kings 24:5
verses.text: ¶ Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and all that he did, <hi type="italic">are</hi> they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

verses.name: II Kings 24:6
verses.text: So Jehoiakim slept with his fathers: and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his stead.

verses.name: II Kings 24:7
verses.text: And the king of Egypt came not again any more out of his land: for the king of Babylon had taken from the river of Egypt unto the river Euphrates all that pertained to the king of Egypt.

verses.name: II Kings 24:8
verses.text: ¶ Jehoiachin <hi type="italic">was</hi> eighteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. And his mother’s name <hi type="italic">was</hi> Nehushta, the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem.

verses.name: II Kings 24:9
verses.text: And he did <hi type="italic">that which was</hi> evil in the sight of the Lord, according to all that his father had done.

verses.name: II Kings 24:10
verses.text: ¶ At that time the servants of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against Jerusalem, and the city was besieged.

verses.name: II Kings 24:11
verses.text: And Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came against the city, and his servants did besiege it.

verses.name: II Kings 24:12
verses.text: And Jehoiachin the king of Judah went out to the king of Babylon, he, and his mother, and his servants, and his princes, and his officers: and the king of Babylon took him in the eighth year of his reign.

verses.name: II Kings 24:13
verses.text: And he carried out thence all the treasures of the house of the Lord, and the treasures of the king’s house, and cut in pieces all the vessels of gold which Solomon king of Israel had made in the temple of the Lord, as the Lord had said.

verses.name: II Kings 24:14
verses.text: And he carried away all Jerusalem, and all the princes, and all the mighty men of valour, <hi type="italic">even</hi> ten thousand captives, and all the craftsmen and smiths: none remained, save the poorest sort of the people of the land.

verses.name: II Kings 24:15
verses.text: And he carried away Jehoiachin to Babylon, and the king’s mother, and the king’s wives, and his officers, and the mighty of the land, <hi type="italic">those</hi> carried he into captivity from Jerusalem to Babylon.

verses.name: II Kings 24:16
verses.text: And all the men of might, <hi type="italic">even</hi> seven thousand, and craftsmen and smiths a thousand, all <hi type="italic">that were</hi> strong <hi type="italic">and</hi> apt for war, even them the king of Babylon brought captive to Babylon.

verses.name: II Kings 24:17
verses.text: ¶ And the king of Babylon made Mattaniah his father’s brother king in his stead, and changed his name to Zedekiah.

verses.name: II Kings 24:18
verses.text: Zedekiah <hi type="italic">was</hi> twenty and one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name <hi type="italic">was</hi> Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

verses.name: II Kings 24:19
verses.text: And he did <hi type="italic">that which was</hi> evil in the sight of the Lord, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.

verses.name: II Kings 24:20
verses.text: For through the anger of the Lord it came to pass in Jerusalem and Judah, until he had cast them out from his presence, that Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.  <chapter eID="2Kgs.24"/><div eID="gen350" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: II Kings 25:1
verses.text: AND it came to pass in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth <hi type="italic">day</hi> of the month, <hi type="italic">that</hi> Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he, and all his host, against Jerusalem, and pitched against it; and they built forts against it round about.

verses.name: II Kings 25:2
verses.text: And the city was besieged unto the eleventh year of king Zedekiah.

verses.name: II Kings 25:3
verses.text: And on the ninth <hi type="italic">day</hi> of the <hi type="italic">fourth</hi> month the famine prevailed in the city, and there was no bread for the people of the land.

verses.name: II Kings 25:4
verses.text: ¶ And the city was broken up, and all the men of war <hi type="italic">fled</hi> by night by the way of the gate between two walls, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> by the king’s garden: (now the Chaldees <hi type="italic">were</hi> against the city round about:) and <hi type="italic">the king</hi> went the way toward the plain.

verses.name: II Kings 25:5
verses.text: And the army of the Chaldees pursued after the king, and overtook him in the plains of Jericho: and all his army were scattered from him.

verses.name: II Kings 25:6
verses.text: So they took the king, and brought him up to the king of Babylon to Riblah; and they gave judgment upon him.

verses.name: II Kings 25:7
verses.text: And they slew the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes, and put out the eyes of Zedekiah, and bound him with fetters of brass, and carried him to Babylon.

verses.name: II Kings 25:8
verses.text: ¶ And in the fifth month, on the seventh <hi type="italic">day</hi> of the month, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> the nineteenth year of king Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, came Nebuzar-adan, captain of the guard, a servant of the king of Babylon, unto Jerusalem:

verses.name: II Kings 25:9
verses.text: And he burnt the house of the Lord, and the king’s house, and all the houses of Jerusalem, and every great <hi type="italic">man</hi>’<hi type="italic">s</hi> house burnt he with fire.

verses.name: II Kings 25:10
verses.text: And all the army of the Chaldees, that <hi type="italic">were with</hi> the captain of the guard, brake down the walls of Jerusalem round about.

verses.name: II Kings 25:11
verses.text: Now the rest of the people <hi type="italic">that were</hi> left in the city, and the fugitives that fell away to the king of Babylon, with the remnant of the multitude, did Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard carry away.

verses.name: II Kings 25:12
verses.text: But the captain of the guard left of the poor of the land <hi type="italic">to be</hi> vinedressers and husbandmen.

verses.name: II Kings 25:13
verses.text: And the pillars of brass that <hi type="italic">were</hi> in the house of the Lord, and the bases, and the brasen sea that <hi type="italic">was</hi> in the house of the Lord, did the Chaldees break in pieces, and carried the brass of them to Babylon.

verses.name: II Kings 25:14
verses.text: And the pots, and the shovels, and the snuffers, and the spoons, and all the vessels of brass wherewith they ministered, took they away.

verses.name: II Kings 25:15
verses.text: And the firepans, and the bowls, <hi type="italic">and</hi> such things as <hi type="italic">were</hi> of gold, <hi type="italic">in</hi> gold, and of silver, <hi type="italic">in</hi> silver, the captain of the guard took away.

verses.name: II Kings 25:16
verses.text: The two pillars, one sea, and the bases which Solomon had made for the house of the Lord; the brass of all these vessels was without weight.

verses.name: II Kings 25:17
verses.text: The height of the one pillar <hi type="italic">was</hi> eighteen cubits, and the chapiter upon it <hi type="italic">was</hi> brass: and the height of the chapiter three cubits; and the wreathen work, and pomegranates upon the chapiter round about, all of brass: and like unto these had the second pillar with wreathen work.

verses.name: II Kings 25:18
verses.text: ¶ And the captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the door:

verses.name: II Kings 25:19
verses.text: And out of the city he took an officer that was set over the men of war, and five men of them that were in the king’s presence, which were found in the city, and the principal scribe of the host, which mustered the people of the land, and threescore men of the people of the land <hi type="italic">that were</hi> found in the city:

verses.name: II Kings 25:20
verses.text: And Nebuzar-adan captain of the guard took these, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah:

verses.name: II Kings 25:21
verses.text: And the king of Babylon smote them, and slew them at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah was carried away out of their land.

verses.name: II Kings 25:22
verses.text: ¶ And <hi type="italic">as for</hi> the people that remained in the land of Judah, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had left, even over them he made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, ruler.

verses.name: II Kings 25:23
verses.text: And when all the captains of the armies, they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah governor, there came to Gedaliah to Mizpah, even Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and Johanan the son of Careah, and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, and Jaazaniah the son of a Maachathite, they and their men.

verses.name: II Kings 25:24
verses.text: And Gedaliah sware to them, and to their men, and said unto them, Fear not to be the servants of the Chaldees: dwell in the land, and serve the king of Babylon; and it shall be well with you.

verses.name: II Kings 25:25
verses.text: But it came to pass in the seventh month, that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, of the seed royal, came, and ten men with him, and smote Gedaliah, that he died, and the Jews and the Chaldees that were with him at Mizpah.

verses.name: II Kings 25:26
verses.text: And all the people, both small and great, and the captains of the armies, arose, and came to Egypt: for they were afraid of the Chaldees.

verses.name: II Kings 25:27
verses.text: ¶ And it came to pass in the seven and thirtieth year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, on the seven and twentieth <hi type="italic">day</hi> of the month, <hi type="italic">that</hi> Evil-merodach king of Babylon in the year that he began to reign did lift up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah out of prison;

verses.name: II Kings 25:28
verses.text: And he spake kindly to him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings that <hi type="italic">were</hi> with him in Babylon;

verses.name: II Kings 25:29
verses.text: And changed his prison garments: and he did eat bread continually before him all the days of his life.

verses.name: II Kings 25:30
verses.text: And his allowance <hi type="italic">was</hi> a continual allowance given him of the king, a daily rate for every day, all the days of his life.  <chapter eID="2Kgs.25"/><div eID="gen351" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen326" osisID="2Kgs" type="book"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:1
verses.text: ADAM, Sheth, Enosh,

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:2
verses.text: Kenan, Mahalaleel, Jered,

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:3
verses.text: Henoch, Methuselah, Lamech,

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:4
verses.text: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:5
verses.text: ¶ The sons of Japheth; Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:6
verses.text: And the sons of Gomer; Ashchenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:7
verses.text: And the sons of Javan; Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:8
verses.text: ¶ The sons of Ham; Cush, and Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:9
verses.text: And the sons of Cush; Seba, and Havilah, and Sabta, and Raamah, and Sabtecha. And the sons of Raamah; Sheba, and Dedan.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:10
verses.text: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be mighty upon the earth.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:11
verses.text: And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:12
verses.text: And Pathrusim, and Casluhim, (of whom came the Philistines,) and Caphthorim.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:13
verses.text: And Canaan begat Zidon his firstborn, and Heth,

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:14
verses.text: The Jebusite also, and the Amorite, and the Girgashite,

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:15
verses.text: And the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:16
verses.text: And the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:17
verses.text: ¶ The sons of Shem; Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram, and Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Meshech.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:18
verses.text: And Arphaxad begat Shelah, and Shelah begat Eber.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:19
verses.text: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of the one <hi type="italic">was</hi> Peleg; because in his days the earth was divided: and his brother’s name <hi type="italic">was</hi> Joktan.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:20
verses.text: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:21
verses.text: Hadoram also, and Uzal, and Diklah,

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:22
verses.text: And Ebal, and Abimael, and Sheba,

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:23
verses.text: And Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab. All these <hi type="italic">were</hi> the sons of Joktan.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:24
verses.text: ¶ Shem, Arphaxad, Shelah,

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:25
verses.text: Eber, Peleg, Reu,

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:26
verses.text: Serug, Nahor, Terah,

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:27
verses.text: Abram; the same <hi type="italic">is</hi> Abraham.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:28
verses.text: The sons of Abraham; Isaac, and Ishmael.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:29
verses.text: ¶ These <hi type="italic">are</hi> their generations: The firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:30
verses.text: Mishma, and Dumah, Massa, Hadad, and Tema,

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:31
verses.text: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:32
verses.text: ¶ Now the sons of Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: she bare Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah. And the sons of Jokshan; Sheba, and Dedan.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:33
verses.text: And the sons of Midian; Ephah, and Epher, and Henoch, and Abida, and Eldaah. All these <hi type="italic">are</hi> the sons of Keturah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:34
verses.text: And Abraham begat Isaac. The sons of Isaac; Esau and Israel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:35
verses.text: ¶ The sons of Esau; Eliphaz, Reuel, and Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:36
verses.text: The sons of Eliphaz; Teman, and Omar, Zephi, and Gatam, Kenaz, and Timna, and Amalek.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:37
verses.text: The sons of Reuel; Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:38
verses.text: And the sons of Seir; Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah, and Dishon, and Ezer, and Dishan.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:39
verses.text: And the sons of Lotan; Hori, and Homam: and Timna <hi type="italic">was</hi> Lotan’s sister.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:40
verses.text: The sons of Shobal; Alian, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. And the sons of Zibeon; Aiah, and Anah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:41
verses.text: The sons of Anah; Dishon. And the sons of Dishon; Amram, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:42
verses.text: The sons of Ezer; Bilhan, and Zavan, <hi type="italic">and</hi> Jakan. The sons of Dishan; Uz, and Aran.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:43
verses.text: ¶ Now these <hi type="italic">are</hi> the kings that reigned in the land of Edom before <hi type="italic">any</hi> king reigned over the children of Israel; Bela the son of Beor: and the name of his city <hi type="italic">was</hi> Dinhabah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:44
verses.text: And when Bela was dead, Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:45
verses.text: And when Jobab was dead, Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his stead.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:46
verses.text: And when Husham was dead, Hadad the son of Bedad, which smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city <hi type="italic">was</hi> Avith.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:47
verses.text: And when Hadad was dead, Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:48
verses.text: And when Samlah was dead, Shaul of Rehoboth by the river reigned in his stead.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:49
verses.text: And when Shaul was dead, Baal-hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:50
verses.text: And when Baal-hanan was dead, Hadad reigned in his stead: and the name of his city <hi type="italic">was</hi> Pai; and his wife’s name <hi type="italic">was</hi> Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:51
verses.text: ¶ Hadad died also. And the dukes of Edom were; duke Timnah, duke Aliah, duke Jetheth,

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:52
verses.text: Duke Aholibamah, duke Elah, duke Pinon,

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:53
verses.text: Duke Kenaz, duke Teman, duke Mibzar,

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:54
verses.text: Duke Magdiel, duke Iram. These <hi type="italic">are</hi> the dukes of Edom.  <chapter eID="1Chr.1"/><div eID="gen353" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:1
verses.text: THESE <hi type="italic">are</hi> the sons of Israel; Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun,

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:2
verses.text: Dan, Joseph, and Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:3
verses.text: ¶ The sons of Judah; Er, and Onan, and Shelah: <hi type="italic">which</hi> three were born unto him of the daughter of Shua the Canaanitess. And Er, the firstborn of Judah, was evil in the sight of the Lord; and he slew him.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:4
verses.text: And Tamar his daughter in law bare him Pharez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah <hi type="italic">were</hi> five.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:5
verses.text: The sons of Pharez; Hezron, and Hamul.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:6
verses.text: And the sons of Zerah; Zimri, and Ethan, and Heman, and Calcol, and Dara: five of them in all.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:7
verses.text: And the sons of Carmi; Achar, the troubler of Israel, who transgressed in the thing accursed.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:8
verses.text: And the sons of Ethan; Azariah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:9
verses.text: The sons also of Hezron, that were born unto him; Jerahmeel, and Ram, and Chelubai.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:10
verses.text: And Ram begat Amminadab; and Amminadab begat Nahshon, prince of the children of Judah;

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:11
verses.text: And Nahshon begat Salma, and Salma begat Boaz,

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:12
verses.text: And Boaz begat Obed, and Obed begat Jesse,

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:13
verses.text: ¶ And Jesse begat his firstborn Eliab, and Abinadab the second, and Shimma the third,

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:14
verses.text: Nethaneel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:15
verses.text: Ozem the sixth, David the seventh:

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:16
verses.text: Whose sisters <hi type="italic">were</hi> Zeruiah, and Abigail. And the sons of Zeruiah; Abishai, and Joab, and Asahel, three.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:17
verses.text: And Abigail bare Amasa: and the father of Amasa <hi type="italic">was</hi> Jether the Ishmeelite.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:18
verses.text: ¶ And Caleb the son of Hezron begat <hi type="italic">children</hi> of Azubah <hi type="italic">his</hi> wife, and of Jerioth: her sons <hi type="italic">are</hi> these; Jesher, and Shobab, and Ardon.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:19
verses.text: And when Azubah was dead, Caleb took unto him Ephrath, which bare him Hur.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:20
verses.text: And Hur begat Uri, and Uri begat Bezaleel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:21
verses.text: ¶ And afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he married when he <hi type="italic">was</hi> threescore years old; and she bare him Segub.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:22
verses.text: And Segub begat Jair, who had three and twenty cities in the land of Gilead.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:23
verses.text: And he took Geshur, and Aram, with the towns of Jair, from them, with Kenath, and the towns thereof, <hi type="italic">even</hi> threescore cities. All these <hi type="italic">belonged to</hi> the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:24
verses.text: And after that Hezron was dead in Caleb-ephratah, then Abiah Hezron’s wife bare him Ashur the father of Tekoa.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:25
verses.text: ¶ And the sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were, Ram the firstborn, and Bunah, and Oren, and Ozem, <hi type="italic">and</hi> Ahijah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:26
verses.text: Jerahmeel had also another wife, whose name <hi type="italic">was</hi> Atarah; she <hi type="italic">was</hi> the mother of Onam.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:27
verses.text: And the sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel were, Maaz, and Jamin, and Eker.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:28
verses.text: And the sons of Onam were, Shammai, and Jada. And the sons of Shammai; Nadab, and Abishur.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:29
verses.text: And the name of the wife of Abishur <hi type="italic">was</hi> Abihail, and she bare him Ahban, and Molid.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:30
verses.text: And the sons of Nadab; Seled, and Appaim: but Seled died without children.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:31
verses.text: And the sons of Appaim; Ishi. And the sons of Ishi; Sheshan. And the children of Sheshan; Ahlai.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:32
verses.text: And the sons of Jada the brother of Shammai; Jether, and Jonathan: and Jether died without children.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:33
verses.text: And the sons of Jonathan; Peleth, and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:34
verses.text: ¶ Now Sheshan had no sons, but daughters. And Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name <hi type="italic">was</hi> Jarha.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:35
verses.text: And Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant to wife; and she bare him Attai.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:36
verses.text: And Attai begat Nathan, and Nathan begat Zabad,

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:37
verses.text: And Zabad begat Ephlal, and Ephlal begat Obed,

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:38
verses.text: And Obed begat Jehu, and Jehu begat Azariah,

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:39
verses.text: And Azariah begat Helez, and Helez begat Eleasah,

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:40
verses.text: And Eleasah begat Sisamai, and Sisamai begat Shallum,

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:41
verses.text: And Shallum begat Jekamiah, and Jekamiah begat Elishama.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:42
verses.text: ¶ Now the sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel <hi type="italic">were</hi>, Mesha his firstborn, which <hi type="italic">was</hi> the father of Ziph; and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:43
verses.text: And the sons of Hebron; Korah, and Tappuah, and Rekem, and Shema.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:44
verses.text: And Shema begat Raham, the father of Jorkoam: and Rekem begat Shammai.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:45
verses.text: And the son of Shammai <hi type="italic">was</hi> Maon: and Maon <hi type="italic">was</hi> the father of Beth-zur.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:46
verses.text: And Ephah, Caleb’s concubine, bare Haran, and Moza, and Gazez: and Haran begat Gazez.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:47
verses.text: And the sons of Jahdai; Regem, and Jotham, and Geshan, and Pelet, and Ephah, and Shaaph.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:48
verses.text: Maachah, Caleb’s concubine, bare Sheber, and Tirhanah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:49
verses.text: She bare also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbenah, and the father of Gibea: and the daughter of Caleb <hi type="italic">was</hi> Achsah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:50
verses.text: ¶ These were the sons of Caleb the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah; Shobal the father of Kirjath-jearim,

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:51
verses.text: Salma the father of Beth-lehem, Hareph the father of Beth-gader.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:52
verses.text: And Shobal the father of Kirjath-jearim had sons; Haroeh, <hi type="italic">and</hi> half of the Manahethites.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:53
verses.text: And the families of Kirjath-jearim; the Ithrites, and the Puhites, and the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; of them came the Zareathites, and the Eshtaulites.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:54
verses.text: The sons of Salma; Beth-lehem, and the Netophathites, Ataroth, the house of Joab, and half of the Manahethites, the Zorites.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:55
verses.text: And the families of the scribes which dwelt at Jabez; the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, <hi type="italic">and</hi> Suchathites. These <hi type="italic">are</hi> the Kenites that came of Hemath, the father of the house of Rechab.  <chapter eID="1Chr.2"/><div eID="gen354" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:1
verses.text: NOW these were the sons of David, which were born unto him in Hebron; the firstborn Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second Daniel, of Abigail the Carmelitess:

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:2
verses.text: The third, Absalom the son of Maachah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur: the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith:

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:3
verses.text: The fifth, Shephatiah of Abital: the sixth, Ithream by Eglah his wife.

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:4
verses.text: <hi type="italic">These</hi> six were born unto him in Hebron; and there he reigned seven years and six months: and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years.

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:5
verses.text: And these were born unto him in Jerusalem; Shimea, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon, four, of Bath-shua the daughter of Ammiel:

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:6
verses.text: Ibhar also, and Elishama, and Eliphelet,

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:7
verses.text: And Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:8
verses.text: And Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:9
verses.text: <hi type="italic">These were</hi> all the sons of David, beside the sons of the concubines, and Tamar their sister.

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:10
verses.text: ¶ And Solomon’s son <hi type="italic">was</hi> Rehoboam, Abia his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:11
verses.text: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:12
verses.text: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:13
verses.text: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:14
verses.text: Amon his son, Josiah his son.

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:15
verses.text: And the sons of Josiah <hi type="italic">were</hi>, the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum.

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:16
verses.text: And the sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son.

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:17
verses.text: ¶ And the sons of Jeconiah; Assir, Salathiel his son,

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:18
verses.text: Malchiram also, and Pedaiah, and Shenazar, Jecamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:19
verses.text: And the sons of Pedaiah <hi type="italic">were</hi>, Zerubbabel, and Shimei: and the sons of Zerubbabel; Meshullam, and Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister:

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:20
verses.text: And Hashubah, and Ohel, and Berechiah, and Hasadiah, Jushab-hesed, five.

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:21
verses.text: And the sons of Hananiah; Pelatiah, and Jesaiah: the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shechaniah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:22
verses.text: And the sons of Shechaniah; Shemaiah: and the sons of Shemaiah; Hattush, and Igeal, and Bariah, and Neariah, and Shaphat, six.

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:23
verses.text: And the sons of Neariah; Elioenai, and Hezekiah, and Azrikam, three.

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:24
verses.text: And the sons of Elioenai <hi type="italic">were</hi>, Hodaiah, and Eliashib, and Pelaiah, and Akkub, and Johanan, and Dalaiah, and Anani, seven.  <chapter eID="1Chr.3"/><div eID="gen355" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:1
verses.text: THE sons of Judah; Pharez, Hezron, and Carmi, and Hur, and Shobal.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:2
verses.text: And Reaiah the son of Shobal begat Jahath; and Jahath begat Ahumai, and Lahad. These <hi type="italic">are</hi> the families of the Zorathites.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:3
verses.text: And these <hi type="italic">were of</hi> the father of Etam; Jezreel, and Ishma, and Idbash: and the name of their sister <hi type="italic">was</hi> Hazelelponi:

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:4
verses.text: And Penuel the father of Gedor, and Ezer the father of Hushah. These <hi type="italic">are</hi> the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah, the father of Beth-lehem.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:5
verses.text: ¶ And Ashur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:6
verses.text: And Naarah bare him Ahuzam, and Hepher, and Temeni, and Haahashtari. These <hi type="italic">were</hi> the sons of Naarah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:7
verses.text: And the sons of Helah <hi type="italic">were</hi>, Zereth, and Jezoar, and Ethnan.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:8
verses.text: And Coz begat Anub, and Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:9
verses.text: ¶ And Jabez was more honourable than his brethren: and his mother called his name Jabez, saying, Because I bare him with sorrow.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:10
verses.text: And Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, Oh that thou wouldest bless me indeed, and enlarge my coast, and that thine hand might be with me, and that thou wouldest keep <hi type="italic">me</hi> from evil, that it may not grieve me! And God granted him that which he requested.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:11
verses.text: ¶ And Chelub the brother of Shuah begat Mehir, which <hi type="italic">was</hi> the father of Eshton.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:12
verses.text: And Eshton begat Beth-rapha, and Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Ir-nahash. These <hi type="italic">are</hi> the men of Rechah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:13
verses.text: And the sons of Kenaz; Othniel, and Seraiah: and the sons of Othniel; Hathath.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:14
verses.text: And Meonothai begat Ophrah: and Seraiah begat Joab, the father of the valley of Charashim; for they were craftsmen.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:15
verses.text: And the sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh; Iru, Elah, and Naam: and the sons of Elah, even Kenaz.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:16
verses.text: And the sons of Jehaleleel; Ziph, and Ziphah, Tiria, and Asareel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:17
verses.text: And the sons of Ezra <hi type="italic">were</hi>, Jether, and Mered, and Epher, and Jalon: and she bare Miriam, and Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:18
verses.text: And his wife Jehudijah bare Jered the father of Gedor, and Heber the father of Socho, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. And these <hi type="italic">are</hi> the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, which Mered took.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:19
verses.text: And the sons of <hi type="italic">his</hi> wife Hodiah the sister of Naham, the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maachathite.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:20
verses.text: And the sons of Shimon <hi type="italic">were</hi>, Amnon, and Rinnah, Ben-hanan, and Tilon. And the sons of Ishi <hi type="italic">were</hi>, Zoheth, and Ben-zoheth.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:21
verses.text: ¶ The sons of Shelah the son of Judah <hi type="italic">were</hi>, Er the father of Lecah, and Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of them that wrought fine linen, of the house of Ashbea,

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:22
verses.text: And Jokim, and the men of Chozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had the dominion in Moab, and Jashubi-lehem. And <hi type="italic">these are</hi> ancient things.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:23
verses.text: These <hi type="italic">were</hi> the potters, and those that dwelt among plants and hedges: there they dwelt with the king for his work.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:24
verses.text: ¶ The sons of Simeon <hi type="italic">were</hi>, Nemuel, and Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, <hi type="italic">and</hi> Shaul:

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:25
verses.text: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, Mishma his son.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:26
verses.text: And the sons of Mishma; Hamuel his son, Zacchur his son, Shimei his son.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:27
verses.text: And Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brethren had not many children, neither did all their family multiply, like to the children of Judah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:28
verses.text: And they dwelt at Beer-sheba, and Moladah, and Hazar-shual,

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:29
verses.text: And at Bilhah, and at Ezem, and at Tolad,

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:30
verses.text: And at Bethuel, and at Hormah, and at Ziklag,

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:31
verses.text: And at Beth-marcaboth, and Hazar-susim, and at Beth-birei, and at Shaaraim. These <hi type="italic">were</hi> their cities unto the reign of David.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:32
verses.text: And their villages <hi type="italic">were</hi>, Etam, and Ain, Rimmon, and Tochen, and Ashan, five cities:

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:33
verses.text: And all their villages that <hi type="italic">were</hi> round about the same cities, unto Baal. These <hi type="italic">were</hi> their habitations, and their genealogy.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:34
verses.text: And Meshobab, and Jamlech, and Joshah the son of Amaziah,

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:35
verses.text: And Joel, and Jehu the son of Josibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:36
verses.text: And Elioenai, and Jaakobah, and Jeshohaiah, and Asaiah, and Adiel, and Jesimiel, and Benaiah,

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:37
verses.text: And Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah;

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:38
verses.text: These mentioned by <hi type="italic">their</hi> names <hi type="italic">were</hi> princes in their families: and the house of their fathers increased greatly.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:39
verses.text: ¶ And they went to the entrance of Gedor, <hi type="italic">even</hi> unto the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:40
verses.text: And they found fat pasture and good, and the land <hi type="italic">was</hi> wide, and quiet, and peaceable; for <hi type="italic">they</hi> of Ham had dwelt there of old.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:41
verses.text: And these written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and smote their tents, and the habitations that were found there, and destroyed them utterly unto this day, and dwelt in their rooms: because <hi type="italic">there was</hi> pasture there for their flocks.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:42
verses.text: And <hi type="italic">some</hi> of them, <hi type="italic">even</hi> of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to mount Seir, having for their captains Pelatiah, and Neariah, and Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:43
verses.text: And they smote the rest of the Amalekites that were escaped, and dwelt there unto this day.  <chapter eID="1Chr.4"/><div eID="gen356" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:1
verses.text: NOW the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel, (for he <hi type="italic">was</hi> the firstborn; but, forasmuch as he defiled his father’s bed, his birthright was given unto the sons of Joseph the son of Israel: and the genealogy is not to be reckoned after the birthright.

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:2
verses.text: For Judah prevailed above his brethren, and of him <hi type="italic">came</hi> the chief ruler; but the birthright <hi type="italic">was</hi> Joseph’s:)

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:3
verses.text: The sons, <hi type="italic">I say</hi>, of Reuben the firstborn of Israel <hi type="italic">were</hi>, Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:4
verses.text: The sons of Joel; Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:5
verses.text: Micah his son, Reaia his son, Baal his son,

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:6
verses.text: Beerah his son, whom Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria carried away <hi type="italic">captive:</hi> he <hi type="italic">was</hi> prince of the Reubenites.

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:7
verses.text: And his brethren by their families, when the genealogy of their generations was reckoned, <hi type="italic">were</hi> the chief, Jeiel, and Zechariah,

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:8
verses.text: And Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who dwelt in Aroer, even unto Nebo and Baal-meon:

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:9
verses.text: And eastward he inhabited unto the entering in of the wilderness from the river Euphrates: because their cattle were multiplied in the land of Gilead.

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:10
verses.text: And in the days of Saul they made war with the Hagarites, who fell by their hand: and they dwelt in their tents throughout all the east <hi type="italic">land</hi> of Gilead.

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:11
verses.text: ¶ And the children of Gad dwelt over against them, in the land of Bashan unto Salchah:

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:12
verses.text: Joel the chief, and Shapham the next, and Jaanai, and Shaphat in Bashan.

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:13
verses.text: And their brethren of the house of their fathers <hi type="italic">were</hi>, Michael, and Meshullam, and Sheba, and Jorai, and Jachan, and Zia, and Heber, seven.

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:14
verses.text: These <hi type="italic">are</hi> the children of Abihail the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:15
verses.text: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of the house of their fathers.

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:16
verses.text: And they dwelt in Gilead in Bashan, and in her towns, and in all the suburbs of Sharon, upon their borders.

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:17
verses.text: All these were reckoned by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:18
verses.text: ¶ The sons of Reuben, and the Gadites, and half the tribe of Manasseh, of valiant men, men able to bear buckler and sword, and to shoot with bow, and skilful in war, <hi type="italic">were</hi> four and forty thousand seven hundred and threescore, that went out to the war.

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:19
verses.text: And they made war with the Hagarites, with Jetur, and Nephish, and Nodab.

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:20
verses.text: And they were helped against them, and the Hagarites were delivered into their hand, and all that <hi type="italic">were</hi> with them: for they cried to God in the battle, and he was intreated of them; because they put their trust in him.

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:21
verses.text: And they took away their cattle; of their camels fifty thousand, and of sheep two hundred and fifty thousand, and of asses two thousand, and of men an hundred thousand.

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:22
verses.text: For there fell down many slain, because the war <hi type="italic">was</hi> of God. And they dwelt in their steads until the captivity.

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:23
verses.text: ¶ And the children of the half tribe of Manasseh dwelt in the land: they increased from Bashan unto Baal-hermon and Senir, and unto mount Hermon.

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:24
verses.text: And these <hi type="italic">were</hi> the heads of the house of their fathers, even Epher, and Ishi, and Eliel, and Azriel, and Jeremiah, and Hodaviah, and Jahdiel, mighty men of valour, famous men, <hi type="italic">and</hi> heads of the house of their fathers.

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:25
verses.text: ¶ And they transgressed against the God of their fathers, and went a whoring after the gods of the people of the land, whom God destroyed before them.

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:26
verses.text: And the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria, and he carried them away, even the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, and brought them unto Halah, and Habor, and Hara, and to the river Gozan, unto this day.  <chapter eID="1Chr.5"/><div eID="gen357" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:1
verses.text: THE sons of Levi; Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:2
verses.text: And the sons of Kohath; Amram, Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:3
verses.text: And the children of Amram; Aaron, and Moses, and Miriam. The sons also of Aaron; Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:4
verses.text: ¶ Eleazar begat Phinehas, Phinehas begat Abishua,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:5
verses.text: And Abishua begat Bukki, and Bukki begat Uzzi,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:6
verses.text: And Uzzi begat Zerahiah, and Zerahiah begat Meraioth,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:7
verses.text: Meraioth begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:8
verses.text: And Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Ahimaaz,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:9
verses.text: And Ahimaaz begat Azariah, and Azariah begat Johanan,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:10
verses.text: And Johanan begat Azariah, (he <hi type="italic">it is</hi> that executed the priest’s office in the temple that Solomon built in Jerusalem:)

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:11
verses.text: And Azariah begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:12
verses.text: And Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Shallum,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:13
verses.text: And Shallum begat Hilkiah, and Hilkiah begat Azariah,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:14
verses.text: And Azariah begat Seraiah, and Seraiah begat Jehozadak,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:15
verses.text: And Jehozadak went <hi type="italic">into captivity</hi>, when the Lord carried away Judah and Jerusalem by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:16
verses.text: ¶ The sons of Levi; Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:17
verses.text: And these <hi type="italic">be</hi> the names of the sons of Gershom; Libni, and Shimei.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:18
verses.text: And the sons of Kohath <hi type="italic">were</hi>, Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:19
verses.text: The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. And these <hi type="italic">are</hi> the families of the Levites according to their fathers.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:20
verses.text: Of Gershom; Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:21
verses.text: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, Jeaterai his son.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:22
verses.text: The sons of Kohath; Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:23
verses.text: Elkanah his son, and Ebiasaph his son, and Assir his son,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:24
verses.text: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:25
verses.text: And the sons of Elkanah; Amasai, and Ahimoth.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:26
verses.text: <hi type="italic">As for</hi> Elkanah: the sons of Elkanah; Zophai his son, and Nahath his son,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:27
verses.text: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:28
verses.text: And the sons of Samuel; the firstborn Vashni, and Abiah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:29
verses.text: The sons of Merari; Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzza his son,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:30
verses.text: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:31
verses.text: And these <hi type="italic">are they</hi> whom David set over the service of song in the house of the Lord, after that the ark had rest.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:32
verses.text: And they ministered before the dwelling place of the tabernacle of the congregation with singing, until Solomon had built the house of the Lord in Jerusalem: and <hi type="italic">then</hi> they waited on their office according to their order.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:33
