verses.text: And when the servants of Hadarezer saw that they were put to the worse before Israel, they made peace with David, and became his servants: neither would the Syrians help the children of Ammon any more.  <chapter eID="1Chr.19"/><div eID="gen371" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 20:1
verses.text: AND it came to pass, that after the year was expired, at the time that kings go out <hi type="italic">to battle</hi>, Joab led forth the power of the army, and wasted the country of the children of Ammon, and came and besieged Rabbah. But David tarried at Jerusalem. And Joab smote Rabbah, and destroyed it.

verses.name: I Chronicles 20:2
verses.text: And David took the crown of their king from off his head, and found it to weigh a talent of gold, and <hi type="italic">there were</hi> precious stones in it; and it was set upon David’s head: and he brought also exceeding much spoil out of the city.

verses.name: I Chronicles 20:3
verses.text: And he brought out the people that <hi type="italic">were</hi> in it, and cut <hi type="italic">them</hi> with saws, and with harrows of iron, and with axes. Even so dealt David with all the cities of the children of Ammon. And David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.

verses.name: I Chronicles 20:4
verses.text: ¶ And it came to pass after this, that there arose war at Gezer with the Philistines; at which time Sibbechai the Hushathite slew Sippai, <hi type="italic">that was</hi> of the children of the giant: and they were subdued.

verses.name: I Chronicles 20:5
verses.text: And there was war again with the Philistines; and Elhanan the son of Jair slew Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, whose spear staff <hi type="italic">was</hi> like a weaver’s beam.

verses.name: I Chronicles 20:6
verses.text: And yet again there was war at Gath, where was a man of <hi type="italic">great</hi> stature, whose fingers and toes <hi type="italic">were</hi> four and twenty, six <hi type="italic">on each hand</hi>, and six <hi type="italic">on each foot:</hi> and he also was the son of the giant.

verses.name: I Chronicles 20:7
verses.text: But when he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea David’s brother slew him.

verses.name: I Chronicles 20:8
verses.text: These were born unto the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.  <chapter eID="1Chr.20"/><div eID="gen372" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:1
verses.text: AND Satan stood up against Israel, and provoked David to number Israel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:2
verses.text: And David said to Joab and to the rulers of the people, Go, number Israel from Beer-sheba even to Dan; and bring the number of them to me, that I may know <hi type="italic">it</hi>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:3
verses.text: And Joab answered, The Lord make his people an hundred times so many more as they <hi type="italic">be:</hi> but, my lord the king, <hi type="italic">are</hi> they not all my lord’s servants? why then doth my lord require this thing? why will he be a cause of trespass to Israel?

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:4
verses.text: Nevertheless the king’s word prevailed against Joab. Wherefore Joab departed, and went throughout all Israel, and came to Jerusalem.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:5
verses.text: ¶ And Joab gave the sum of the number of the people unto David. And all <hi type="italic">they of</hi> Israel were a thousand thousand and an hundred thousand men that drew sword: and Judah <hi type="italic">was</hi> four hundred threescore and ten thousand men that drew sword.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:6
verses.text: But Levi and Benjamin counted he not among them: for the king’s word was abominable to Joab.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:7
verses.text: And God was displeased with this thing; therefore he smote Israel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:8
verses.text: And David said unto God, I have sinned greatly, because I have done this thing: but now, I beseech thee, do away the iniquity of thy servant; for I have done very foolishly.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:9
verses.text: ¶ And the Lord spake unto Gad, David’s seer, saying,

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:10
verses.text: Go and tell David, saying, Thus saith the Lord, I offer thee three <hi type="italic">things:</hi> choose thee one of them, that I may do <hi type="italic">it</hi> unto thee.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:11
verses.text: So Gad came to David, and said unto him, Thus saith the Lord, Choose thee

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:12
verses.text: Either three years’ famine; or three months to be destroyed before thy foes, while that the sword of thine enemies overtaketh <hi type="italic">thee;</hi> or else three days the sword of the Lord, even the pestilence, in the land, and the angel of the Lord destroying throughout all the coasts of Israel. Now therefore advise thyself what word I shall bring again to him that sent me.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:13
verses.text: And David said unto Gad, I am in a great strait: let me fall now into the hand of the Lord; for very great <hi type="italic">are</hi> his mercies: but let me not fall into the hand of man.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:14
verses.text: ¶ So the Lord sent pestilence upon Israel: and there fell of Israel seventy thousand men.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:15
verses.text: And God sent an angel unto Jerusalem to destroy it: and as he was destroying, the Lord beheld, and he repented him of the evil, and said to the angel that destroyed, It is enough, stay now thine hand. And the angel of the Lord stood by the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:16
verses.text: And David lifted up his eyes, and saw the angel of the Lord stand between the earth and the heaven, having a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders <hi type="italic">of Israel</hi>, <hi type="italic">who were</hi> clothed in sackcloth, fell upon their faces.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:17
verses.text: And David said unto God, <hi type="italic">Is it</hi> not I <hi type="italic">that</hi> commanded the people to be numbered? even I it is that have sinned and done evil indeed; but <hi type="italic">as for</hi> these sheep, what have they done? let thine hand, I pray thee, O Lord my God, be on me, and on my father’s house; but not on thy people, that they should be plagued.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:18
verses.text: ¶ Then the angel of the Lord commanded Gad to say to David, that David should go up, and set up an altar unto the Lord in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:19
verses.text: And David went up at the saying of Gad, which he spake in the name of the Lord.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:20
verses.text: And Ornan turned back, and saw the angel; and his four sons with him hid themselves. Now Ornan was threshing wheat.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:21
verses.text: And as David came to Ornan, Ornan looked and saw David, and went out of the threshingfloor, and bowed himself to David with <hi type="italic">his</hi> face to the ground.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:22
verses.text: Then David said to Ornan, Grant me the place of <hi type="italic">this</hi> threshingfloor, that I may build an altar therein unto the Lord: thou shalt grant it me for the full price: that the plague may be stayed from the people.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:23
verses.text: And Ornan said unto David, Take <hi type="italic">it</hi> to thee, and let my lord the king do <hi type="italic">that which is</hi> good in his eyes: lo, I give <hi type="italic">thee</hi> the oxen <hi type="italic">also</hi> for burnt offerings, and the threshing instruments for wood, and the wheat for the meat offering; I give it all.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:24
verses.text: And king David said to Ornan, Nay; but I will verily buy it for the full price: for I will not take <hi type="italic">that</hi> which <hi type="italic">is</hi> thine for the Lord, nor offer burnt offerings without cost.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:25
verses.text: So David gave to Ornan for the place six hundred shekels of gold by weight.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:26
verses.text: And David built there an altar unto the Lord, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings, and called upon the Lord; and he answered him from heaven by fire upon the altar of burnt offering.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:27
verses.text: And the Lord commanded the angel; and he put up his sword again into the sheath thereof.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:28
verses.text: ¶ At that time when David saw that the Lord had answered him in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite, then he sacrificed there.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:29
verses.text: For the tabernacle of the Lord, which Moses made in the wilderness, and the altar of the burnt offering, <hi type="italic">were</hi> at that season in the high place at Gibeon.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:30
verses.text: But David could not go before it to inquire of God: for he was afraid because of the sword of the angel of the Lord.  <chapter eID="1Chr.21"/><div eID="gen373" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:1
verses.text: THEN David said, This <hi type="italic">is</hi> the house of the Lord God, and this <hi type="italic">is</hi> the altar of the burnt offering for Israel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:2
verses.text: And David commanded to gather together the strangers that <hi type="italic">were</hi> in the land of Israel; and he set masons to hew wrought stones to build the house of God.

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:3
verses.text: And David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates, and for the joinings; and brass in abundance without weight;

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:4
verses.text: Also cedar trees in abundance: for the Zidonians and they of Tyre brought much cedar wood to David.

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:5
verses.text: And David said, Solomon my son <hi type="italic">is</hi> young and tender, and the house <hi type="italic">that is</hi> to be builded for the Lord <hi type="italic">must be</hi> exceeding magnifical, of fame and of glory throughout all countries: I will <hi type="italic">therefore</hi> now make preparation for it. So David prepared abundantly before his death.

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:6
verses.text: ¶ Then he called for Solomon his son, and charged him to build an house for the Lord God of Israel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:7
verses.text: And David said to Solomon, My son, as for me, it was in my mind to build an house unto the name of the Lord my God:

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:8
verses.text: But the word of the Lord came to me, saying, Thou hast shed blood abundantly, and hast made great wars: thou shalt not build an house unto my name, because thou hast shed much blood upon the earth in my sight.

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:9
verses.text: Behold, a son shall be born to thee, who shall be a man of rest; and I will give him rest from all his enemies round about: for his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness unto Israel in his days.

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:10
verses.text: He shall build an house for my name; and he shall be my son, and I <hi type="italic">will be</hi> his father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel for ever.

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:11
verses.text: Now, my son, the Lord be with thee; and prosper thou, and build the house of the Lord thy God, as he hath said of thee.

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:12
verses.text: Only the Lord give thee wisdom and understanding, and give thee charge concerning Israel, that thou mayest keep the law of the Lord thy God.

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:13
verses.text: Then shalt thou prosper, if thou takest heed to fulfil the statutes and judgments which the Lord charged Moses with concerning Israel: be strong, and of good courage; dread not, nor be dismayed.

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:14
verses.text: Now, behold, in my trouble I have prepared for the house of the Lord an hundred thousand talents of gold, and a thousand thousand talents of silver; and of brass and iron without weight; for it is in abundance: timber also and stone have I prepared; and thou mayest add thereto.

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:15
verses.text: Moreover <hi type="italic">there are</hi> workmen with thee in abundance, hewers and workers of stone and timber, and all manner of cunning men for every manner of work.

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:16
verses.text: Of the gold, the silver, and the brass, and the iron, <hi type="italic">there is</hi> no number. Arise <hi type="italic">therefore</hi>, and be doing, and the Lord be with thee.

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:17
verses.text: ¶ David also commanded all the princes of Israel to help Solomon his son, <hi type="italic">saying</hi>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:18
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Is</hi> not the Lord your God with you? and hath he <hi type="italic">not</hi> given you rest on every side? for he hath given the inhabitants of the land into mine hand; and the land is subdued before the Lord, and before his people.

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:19
verses.text: Now set your heart and your soul to seek the Lord your God; arise therefore, and build ye the sanctuary of the Lord God, to bring the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and the holy vessels of God, into the house that is to be built to the name of the Lord.  <chapter eID="1Chr.22"/><div eID="gen374" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:1
verses.text: SO when David was old and full of days, he made Solomon his son king over Israel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:2
verses.text: ¶ And he gathered together all the princes of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:3
verses.text: Now the Levites were numbered from the age of thirty years and upward: and their number by their polls, man by man, was thirty and eight thousand.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:4
verses.text: Of which, twenty and four thousand <hi type="italic">were</hi> to set forward the work of the house of the Lord; and six thousand <hi type="italic">were</hi> officers and judges:

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:5
verses.text: Moreover four thousand <hi type="italic">were</hi> porters; and four thousand praised the Lord with the instruments which I made, <hi type="italic">said David</hi>, to praise <hi type="italic">therewith</hi>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:6
verses.text: And David divided them into courses among the sons of Levi, <hi type="italic">namely</hi>, Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:7
verses.text: ¶ Of the Gershonites <hi type="italic">were</hi>, Laadan, and Shimei.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:8
verses.text: The sons of Laadan; the chief <hi type="italic">was</hi> Jehiel, and Zetham, and Joel, three.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:9
verses.text: The sons of Shimei; Shelomith, and Haziel, and Haran, three. These <hi type="italic">were</hi> the chief of the fathers of Laadan.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:10
verses.text: And the sons of Shimei <hi type="italic">were</hi>, Jahath, Zina, and Jeush, and Beriah. These four <hi type="italic">were</hi> the sons of Shimei.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:11
verses.text: And Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second: but Jeush and Beriah had not many sons; therefore they were in one reckoning, according to <hi type="italic">their</hi> father’s house.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:12
verses.text: ¶ The sons of Kohath; Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:13
verses.text: The sons of Amram; Aaron and Moses: and Aaron was separated, that he should sanctify the most holy things, he and his sons for ever, to burn incense before the Lord, to minister unto him, and to bless in his name for ever.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:14
verses.text: Now <hi type="italic">concerning</hi> Moses the man of God, his sons were named of the tribe of Levi.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:15
verses.text: The sons of Moses <hi type="italic">were</hi>, Gershom, and Eliezer.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:16
verses.text: Of the sons of Gershom, Shebuel <hi type="italic">was</hi> the chief.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:17
verses.text: And the sons of Eliezer <hi type="italic">were</hi>, Rehabiah the chief. And Eliezer had none other sons; but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:18
verses.text: Of the sons of Izhar; Shelomith the chief.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:19
verses.text: Of the sons of Hebron; Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:20
verses.text: Of the sons of Uzziel; Michah the first, and Jesiah the second.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:21
verses.text: ¶ The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. The sons of Mahli; Eleazar, and Kish.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:22
verses.text: And Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters: and their brethren the sons of Kish took them.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:23
verses.text: The sons of Mushi; Mahli, and Eder, and Jeremoth, three.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:24
verses.text: ¶ These <hi type="italic">were</hi> the sons of Levi after the house of their fathers; <hi type="italic">even</hi> the chief of the fathers, as they were counted by number of names by their polls, that did the work for the service of the house of the Lord, from the age of twenty years and upward.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:25
verses.text: For David said, The Lord God of Israel hath given rest unto his people, that they may dwell in Jerusalem for ever:

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:26
verses.text: And also unto the Levites; they shall no <hi type="italic">more</hi> carry the tabernacle, nor any vessels of it for the service thereof.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:27
verses.text: For by the last words of David the Levites <hi type="italic">were</hi> numbered from twenty years old and above:

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:28
verses.text: Because their office <hi type="italic">was</hi> to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of the house of the Lord, in the courts, and in the chambers, and in the purifying of all holy things, and the work of the service of the house of God;

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:29
verses.text: Both for the shewbread, and for the fine flour for meat offering, and for the unleavened cakes, and for <hi type="italic">that which is baked in</hi> the pan, and for that which is fried, and for all manner of measure and size;

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:30
verses.text: And to stand every morning to thank and praise the Lord, and likewise at even;

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:31
verses.text: And to offer all burnt sacrifices unto the Lord in the sabbaths, in the new moons, and on the set feasts, by number, according to the order commanded unto them, continually before the Lord:

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:32
verses.text: And that they should keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the charge of the holy <hi type="italic">place</hi>, and the charge of the sons of Aaron their brethren, in the service of the house of the Lord.  <chapter eID="1Chr.23"/><div eID="gen375" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:1
verses.text: NOW <hi type="italic">these are</hi> the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron; Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:2
verses.text: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children: therefore Eleazar and Ithamar executed the priest’s office.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:3
verses.text: And David distributed them, both Zadok of the sons of Eleazar, and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, according to their offices in their service.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:4
verses.text: And there were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar; and <hi type="italic">thus</hi> were they divided. Among the sons of Eleazar <hi type="italic">there were</hi> sixteen chief men of the house of <hi type="italic">their</hi> fathers, and eight among the sons of Ithamar according to the house of their fathers.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:5
verses.text: Thus were they divided by lot, one sort with another; for the governors of the sanctuary, and governors <hi type="italic">of the house</hi> of God, were of the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:6
verses.text: And Shemaiah the son of Nethaneel the scribe, <hi type="italic">one</hi> of the Levites, wrote them before the king, and the princes, and Zadok the priest, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and <hi type="italic">before</hi> the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites: one principal household being taken for Eleazar, and <hi type="italic">one</hi> taken for Ithamar.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:7
verses.text: Now the first lot came forth to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:8
verses.text: The third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:9
verses.text: The fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:10
verses.text: The seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:11
verses.text: The ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah,

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:12
verses.text: The eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:13
verses.text: The thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:14
verses.text: The fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:15
verses.text: The seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Aphses,

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:16
verses.text: The nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezekel,

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:17
verses.text: The one and twentieth to Jachin, the two and twentieth to Gamul,

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:18
verses.text: The three and twentieth to Delaiah, the four and twentieth to Maaziah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:19
verses.text: These <hi type="italic">were</hi> the orderings of them in their service to come into the house of the Lord, according to their manner, under Aaron their father, as the Lord God of Israel had commanded him.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:20
verses.text: ¶ And the rest of the sons of Levi <hi type="italic">were these:</hi> Of the sons of Amram; Shubael: of the sons of Shubael; Jehdeiah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:21
verses.text: Concerning Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, the first <hi type="italic">was</hi> Isshiah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:22
verses.text: Of the Izharites; Shelomoth: of the sons of Shelomoth; Jahath.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:23
verses.text: And the sons <hi type="italic">of Hebron;</hi> Jeriah <hi type="italic">the first</hi>, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, Jekameam the fourth.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:24
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Of</hi> the sons of Uzziel; Michah: of the sons of Michah; Shamir.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:25
verses.text: The brother of Michah <hi type="italic">was</hi> Isshiah: of the sons of Isshiah; Zechariah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:26
verses.text: The sons of Merari <hi type="italic">were</hi> Mahli and Mushi: the sons of Jaaziah; Beno.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:27
verses.text: ¶ The sons of Merari by Jaaziah; Beno, and Shoham, and Zaccur, and Ibri.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:28
verses.text: Of Mahli <hi type="italic">came</hi> Eleazar, who had no sons.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:29
verses.text: Concerning Kish: the son of Kish <hi type="italic">was</hi> Jerahmeel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:30
verses.text: The sons also of Mushi; Mahli, and Eder, and Jerimoth. These <hi type="italic">were</hi> the sons of the Levites after the house of their fathers.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:31
verses.text: These likewise cast lots over against their brethren the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, and Zadok, and Ahimelech, and the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites, even the principal fathers over against their younger brethren.  <chapter eID="1Chr.24"/><div eID="gen376" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:1
verses.text: MOREOVER David and the captains of the host separated to the service of the sons of Asaph, and of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who should prophesy with harps, with psalteries, and with cymbals: and the number of the workmen according to their service was:

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:2
verses.text: Of the sons of Asaph; Zaccur, and Joseph, and Nethaniah, and Asarelah, the sons of Asaph under the hands of Asaph, which prophesied according to the order of the king.

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:3
verses.text: Of Jeduthun: the sons of Jeduthun; Gedaliah, and Zeri, and Jeshaiah, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied with a harp, to give thanks and to praise the Lord.

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:4
verses.text: Of Heman: the sons of Heman; Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, and Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, and Romamti-ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, <hi type="italic">and</hi> Mahazioth:

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:5
verses.text: All these <hi type="italic">were</hi> the sons of Heman the king’s seer in the words of God, to lift up the horn. And God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:6
verses.text: All these <hi type="italic">were</hi> under the hands of their father for song <hi type="italic">in</hi> the house of the Lord, with cymbals, psalteries, and harps, for the service of the house of God, according to the king’s order to Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman.

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:7
verses.text: So the number of them, with their brethren that were instructed in the songs of the Lord, <hi type="italic">even</hi> all that were cunning, was two hundred fourscore and eight.

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:8
verses.text: ¶ And they cast lots, ward against <hi type="italic">ward</hi>, as well the small as the great, the teacher as the scholar.

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:9
verses.text: Now the first lot came forth for Asaph to Joseph: the second to Gedaliah, who with his brethren and sons <hi type="italic">were</hi> twelve:

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:10
verses.text: The third to Zaccur, <hi type="italic">he</hi>, his sons, and his brethren, <hi type="italic">were</hi> twelve:

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:11
verses.text: The fourth to Izri, <hi type="italic">he</hi>, his sons, and his brethren, <hi type="italic">were</hi> twelve:

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:12
verses.text: The fifth to Nethaniah, <hi type="italic">he</hi>, his sons, and his brethren, <hi type="italic">were</hi> twelve:

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:13
verses.text: The sixth to Bukkiah, <hi type="italic">he</hi>, his sons, and his brethren, <hi type="italic">were</hi> twelve:

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:14
verses.text: The seventh to Jesharelah, <hi type="italic">he</hi>, his sons, and his brethren, <hi type="italic">were</hi> twelve:

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:15
verses.text: The eighth to Jeshaiah, <hi type="italic">he</hi>, his sons, and his brethren, <hi type="italic">were</hi> twelve:

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:16
verses.text: The ninth to Mattaniah, <hi type="italic">he</hi>, his sons, and his brethren, <hi type="italic">were</hi> twelve:

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:17
verses.text: The tenth to Shimei, <hi type="italic">he</hi>, his sons, and his brethren, <hi type="italic">were</hi> twelve:

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:18
verses.text: The eleventh to Azareel, <hi type="italic">he</hi>, his sons, and his brethren, <hi type="italic">were</hi> twelve:

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:19
verses.text: The twelfth to Hashabiah, <hi type="italic">he</hi>, his sons, and his brethren, <hi type="italic">were</hi> twelve:

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:20
verses.text: The thirteenth to Shubael, <hi type="italic">he</hi>, his sons, and his brethren, <hi type="italic">were</hi> twelve:

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:21
verses.text: The fourteenth to Mattithiah, <hi type="italic">he</hi>, his sons, and his brethren, <hi type="italic">were</hi> twelve:

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:22
verses.text: The fifteenth to Jeremoth, <hi type="italic">he</hi>, his sons, and his brethren, <hi type="italic">were</hi> twelve:

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:23
verses.text: The sixteenth to Hananiah, <hi type="italic">he</hi>, his sons, and his brethren, <hi type="italic">were</hi> twelve:

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:24
verses.text: The seventeenth to Joshbekashah, <hi type="italic">he</hi>, his sons, and his brethren, <hi type="italic">were</hi> twelve:

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:25
verses.text: The eighteenth to Hanani, <hi type="italic">he</hi>, his sons, and his brethren, <hi type="italic">were</hi> twelve:

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:26
verses.text: The nineteenth to Mallothi, <hi type="italic">he</hi>, his sons, and his brethren, <hi type="italic">were</hi> twelve:

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:27
verses.text: The twentieth to Eliathah, <hi type="italic">he</hi>, his sons, and his brethren, <hi type="italic">were</hi> twelve:

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:28
verses.text: The one and twentieth to Hothir, <hi type="italic">he</hi>, his sons, and his brethren, <hi type="italic">were</hi> twelve:

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:29
verses.text: The two and twentieth to Giddalti, <hi type="italic">he</hi>, his sons, and his brethren, <hi type="italic">were</hi> twelve:

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:30
verses.text: The three and twentieth to Mahazioth, <hi type="italic">he</hi>, his sons, and his brethren, <hi type="italic">were</hi> twelve:

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:31
verses.text: The four and twentieth to Romamti-ezer, <hi type="italic">he</hi>, his sons, and his brethren, <hi type="italic">were</hi> twelve.  <chapter eID="1Chr.25"/><div eID="gen377" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:1
verses.text: CONCERNING the divisions of the porters: Of the Korhites <hi type="italic">was</hi> Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:2
verses.text: And the sons of Meshelemiah <hi type="italic">were</hi>, Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:3
verses.text: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, Elioenai the seventh.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:4
verses.text: Moreover the sons of Obed-edom <hi type="italic">were</hi>, Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, and Sacar the fourth, and Nethaneel the fifth,

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:5
verses.text: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, Peulthai the eighth: for God blessed him.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:6
verses.text: Also unto Shemaiah his son were sons born, that ruled throughout the house of their father: for they <hi type="italic">were</hi> mighty men of valour.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:7
verses.text: The sons of Shemaiah; Othni, and Rephael, and Obed, Elzabad, whose brethren <hi type="italic">were</hi> strong men, Elihu, and Semachiah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:8
verses.text: All these of the sons of Obed-edom: they and their sons and their brethren, able men for strength for the service, <hi type="italic">were</hi> threescore and two of Obed-edom.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:9
verses.text: And Meshelemiah had sons and brethren, strong men, eighteen.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:10
verses.text: Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons; Simri the chief, (for <hi type="italic">though</hi> he was not the firstborn, yet his father made him the chief;)

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:11
verses.text: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, Zechariah the fourth: all the sons and brethren of Hosah <hi type="italic">were</hi> thirteen.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:12
verses.text: Among these <hi type="italic">were</hi> the divisions of the porters, <hi type="italic">even</hi> among the chief men, <hi type="italic">having</hi> wards one against another, to minister in the house of the Lord.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:13
verses.text: ¶ And they cast lots, as well the small as the great, according to the house of their fathers, for every gate.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:14
verses.text: And the lot eastward fell to Shelemiah. Then for Zechariah his son, a wise counseller, they cast lots; and his lot came out northward.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:15
verses.text: To Obed-edom southward; and to his sons the house of Asuppim.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:16
verses.text: To Shuppim and Hosah <hi type="italic">the lot came forth</hi> westward, with the gate Shallecheth, by the causeway of the going up, ward against ward.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:17
verses.text: Eastward <hi type="italic">were</hi> six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and toward Asuppim two <hi type="italic">and</hi> two.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:18
verses.text: At Parbar westward, four at the causeway, <hi type="italic">and</hi> two at Parbar.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:19
verses.text: These <hi type="italic">are</hi> the divisions of the porters among the sons of Kore, and among the sons of Merari.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:20
verses.text: ¶ And of the Levites, Ahijah <hi type="italic">was</hi> over the treasures of the house of God, and over the treasures of the dedicated things.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:21
verses.text: <hi type="italic">As concerning</hi> the sons of Laadan; the sons of the Gershonite Laadan, chief fathers, <hi type="italic">even</hi> of Laadan the Gershonite, <hi type="italic">were</hi> Jehieli.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:22
verses.text: The sons of Jehieli; Zetham, and Joel his brother, <hi type="italic">which were</hi> over the treasures of the house of the Lord.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:23
verses.text: Of the Amramites, <hi type="italic">and</hi> the Izharites, the Hebronites, <hi type="italic">and</hi> the Uzzielites:

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:24
verses.text: And Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, <hi type="italic">was</hi> ruler of the treasures.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:25
verses.text: And his brethren by Eliezer; Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomith his son.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:26
verses.text: Which Shelomith and his brethren <hi type="italic">were</hi> over all the treasures of the dedicated things, which David the king, and the chief fathers, the captains over thousands and hundreds, and the captains of the host, had dedicated.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:27
verses.text: Out of the spoils won in battles did they dedicate to maintain the house of the Lord.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:28
verses.text: And all that Samuel the seer, and Saul the son of Kish, and Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah, had dedicated; <hi type="italic">and</hi> whosoever had dedicated <hi type="italic">any thing</hi>, <hi type="italic">it was</hi> under the hand of Shelomith, and of his brethren.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:29
verses.text: ¶ Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons <hi type="italic">were</hi> for the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:30
verses.text: <hi type="italic">And</hi> of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brethren, men of valour, a thousand and seven hundred, <hi type="italic">were</hi> officers among them of Israel on this side Jordan westward in all the business of the Lord, and in the service of the king.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:31
verses.text: Among the Hebronites <hi type="italic">was</hi> Jerijah the chief, <hi type="italic">even</hi> among the Hebronites, according to the generations of his fathers. In the fortieth year of the reign of David they were sought for, and there were found among them mighty men of valour at Jazer of Gilead.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:32
verses.text: And his brethren, men of valour, <hi type="italic">were</hi> two thousand and seven hundred chief fathers, whom king David made rulers over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, for every matter pertaining to God, and affairs of the king.  <chapter eID="1Chr.26"/><div eID="gen378" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:1
verses.text: NOW the children of Israel after their number, <hi type="italic">to wit</hi>, the chief fathers and captains of thousands and hundreds, and their officers that served the king in any matter of the courses, which came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year, of every course <hi type="italic">were</hi> twenty and four thousand.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:2
verses.text: Over the first course for the first month <hi type="italic">was</hi> Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel: and in his course <hi type="italic">were</hi> twenty and four thousand.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:3
verses.text: Of the children of Perez <hi type="italic">was</hi> the chief of all the captains of the host for the first month.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:4
verses.text: And over the course of the second month <hi type="italic">was</hi> Dodai an Ahohite, and of his course <hi type="italic">was</hi> Mikloth also the ruler: in his course likewise <hi type="italic">were</hi> twenty and four thousand.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:5
verses.text: The third captain of the host for the third month <hi type="italic">was</hi> Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, a chief priest: and in his course <hi type="italic">were</hi> twenty and four thousand.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:6
verses.text: This <hi type="italic">is that</hi> Benaiah, <hi type="italic">who was</hi> mighty <hi type="italic">among</hi> the thirty, and above the thirty: and in his course <hi type="italic">was</hi> Ammizabad his son.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:7
verses.text: The fourth <hi type="italic">captain</hi> for the fourth month <hi type="italic">was</hi> Asahel the brother of Joab, and Zebadiah his son after him: and in his course <hi type="italic">were</hi> twenty and four thousand.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:8
verses.text: The fifth captain for the fifth month <hi type="italic">was</hi> Shamhuth the Izrahite: and in his course <hi type="italic">were</hi> twenty and four thousand.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:9
verses.text: The sixth <hi type="italic">captain</hi> for the sixth month <hi type="italic">was</hi> Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite: and in his course <hi type="italic">were</hi> twenty and four thousand.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:10
verses.text: The seventh <hi type="italic">captain</hi> for the seventh month <hi type="italic">was</hi> Helez the Pelonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his course <hi type="italic">were</hi> twenty and four thousand.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:11
verses.text: The eighth <hi type="italic">captain</hi> for the eighth month <hi type="italic">was</hi> Sibbecai the Hushathite, of the Zarhites: and in his course <hi type="italic">were</hi> twenty and four thousand.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:12
verses.text: The ninth <hi type="italic">captain</hi> for the ninth month <hi type="italic">was</hi> Abiezer the Anetothite, of the Benjamites: and in his course <hi type="italic">were</hi> twenty and four thousand.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:13
verses.text: The tenth <hi type="italic">captain</hi> for the tenth month <hi type="italic">was</hi> Maharai the Netophathite, of the Zarhites: and in his course <hi type="italic">were</hi> twenty and four thousand.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:14
verses.text: The eleventh <hi type="italic">captain</hi> for the eleventh month <hi type="italic">was</hi> Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his course <hi type="italic">were</hi> twenty and four thousand.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:15
verses.text: The twelfth <hi type="italic">captain</hi> for the twelfth month <hi type="italic">was</hi> Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel: and in his course <hi type="italic">were</hi> twenty and four thousand.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:16
verses.text: ¶ Furthermore over the tribes of Israel: the ruler of the Reubenites <hi type="italic">was</hi> Eliezer the son of Zichri: of the Simeonites, Shephatiah the son of Maachah:

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:17
verses.text: Of the Levites, Hashabiah the son of Kemuel: of the Aaronites, Zadok:

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:18
verses.text: Of Judah, Elihu, <hi type="italic">one</hi> of the brethren of David: of Issachar, Omri the son of Michael:

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:19
verses.text: Of Zebulun, Ishmaiah the son of Obadiah: of Naphtali, Jerimoth the son of Azriel:

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:20
verses.text: Of the children of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Azaziah: of the half tribe of Manasseh, Joel the son of Pedaiah:

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:21
verses.text: Of the half <hi type="italic">tribe</hi> of Manasseh in Gilead, Iddo the son of Zechariah: of Benjamin, Jaasiel the son of Abner:

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:22
verses.text: Of Dan, Azareel the son of Jeroham. These <hi type="italic">were</hi> the princes of the tribes of Israel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:23
verses.text: ¶ But David took not the number of them from twenty years old and under: because the Lord had said he would increase Israel like to the stars of the heavens.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:24
verses.text: Joab the son of Zeruiah began to number, but he finished not, because there fell wrath for it against Israel; neither was the number put in the account of the chronicles of king David.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:25
verses.text: ¶ And over the king’s treasures <hi type="italic">was</hi> Azmaveth the son of Adiel: and over the storehouses in the fields, in the cities, and in the villages, and in the castles, <hi type="italic">was</hi> Jehonathan the son of Uzziah:

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:26
verses.text: And over them that did the work of the field for tillage of the ground <hi type="italic">was</hi> Ezri the son of Chelub:

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:27
verses.text: And over the vineyards <hi type="italic">was</hi> Shimei the Ramathite: over the increase of the vineyards for the wine cellars <hi type="italic">was</hi> Zabdi the Shiphmite:

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:28
verses.text: And over the olive trees and the sycomore trees that <hi type="italic">were</hi> in the low plains <hi type="italic">was</hi> Baal-hanan the Gederite: and over the cellars of oil <hi type="italic">was</hi> Joash:

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:29
verses.text: And over the herds that fed in Sharon <hi type="italic">was</hi> Shitrai the Sharonite: and over the herds <hi type="italic">that were</hi> in the valleys <hi type="italic">was</hi> Shaphat the son of Adlai:

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:30
verses.text: Over the camels also <hi type="italic">was</hi> Obil the Ishmaelite: and over the asses <hi type="italic">was</hi> Jehdeiah the Meronothite:

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:31
verses.text: And over the flocks <hi type="italic">was</hi> Jaziz the Hagerite. All these <hi type="italic">were</hi> the rulers of the substance which <hi type="italic">was</hi> king David’s.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:32
verses.text: Also Jonathan David’s uncle was a counseller, a wise man, and a scribe: and Jehiel the son of Hachmoni <hi type="italic">was</hi> with the king’s sons:

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:33
verses.text: And Ahithophel <hi type="italic">was</hi> the king’s counseller: and Hushai the Archite <hi type="italic">was</hi> the king’s companion:

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:34
verses.text: And after Ahithophel <hi type="italic">was</hi> Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar: and the general of the king’s army <hi type="italic">was</hi> Joab.  <chapter eID="1Chr.27"/><div eID="gen379" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:1
verses.text: AND David assembled all the princes of Israel, the princes of the tribes, and the captains of the companies that ministered to the king by course, and the captains over the thousands, and captains over the hundreds, and the stewards over all the substance and possession of the king, and of his sons, with the officers, and with the mighty men, and with all the valiant men, unto Jerusalem.

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:2
verses.text: Then David the king stood up upon his feet, and said, Hear me, my brethren, and my people: <hi type="italic">As for me</hi>, I <hi type="italic">had</hi> in mine heart to build an house of rest for the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and for the footstool of our God, and had made ready for the building:

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:3
verses.text: But God said unto me, Thou shalt not build an house for my name, because thou <hi type="italic">hast been</hi> a man of war, and hast shed blood.

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:4
verses.text: Howbeit the Lord God of Israel chose me before all the house of my father to be king over Israel for ever: for he hath chosen Judah <hi type="italic">to be</hi> the ruler; and of the house of Judah, the house of my father; and among the sons of my father he liked me to make <hi type="italic">me</hi> king over all Israel:

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:5
verses.text: And of all my sons, (for the Lord hath given me many sons,) he hath chosen Solomon my son to sit upon the throne of the kingdom of the Lord over Israel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:6
verses.text: And he said unto me, Solomon thy son, he shall build my house and my courts: for I have chosen him <hi type="italic">to be</hi> my son, and I will be his father.

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:7
verses.text: Moreover I will establish his kingdom for ever, if he be constant to do my commandments and my judgments, as at this day.

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:8
verses.text: Now therefore in the sight of all Israel the congregation of the Lord, and in the audience of our God, keep and seek for all the commandments of the Lord your God: that ye may possess this good land, and leave <hi type="italic">it</hi> for an inheritance for your children after you for ever.

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:9
verses.text: ¶ And thou, Solomon my son, know thou the God of thy father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind: for the Lord searcheth all hearts, and understandeth all the imaginations of the thoughts: if thou seek him, he will be found of thee; but if thou forsake him, he will cast thee off for ever.

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:10
verses.text: Take heed now; for the Lord hath chosen thee to build an house for the sanctuary: be strong, and do <hi type="italic">it</hi>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:11
verses.text: ¶ Then David gave to Solomon his son the pattern of the porch, and of the houses thereof, and of the treasuries thereof, and of the upper chambers thereof, and of the inner parlours thereof, and of the place of the mercy seat,

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:12
verses.text: And the pattern of all that he had by the spirit, of the courts of the house of the Lord, and of all the chambers round about, of the treasuries of the house of God, and of the treasuries of the dedicated things:

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:13
verses.text: Also for the courses of the priests and the Levites, and for all the work of the service of the house of the Lord, and for all the vessels of service in the house of the Lord.

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:14
verses.text: <hi type="italic">He gave</hi> of gold by weight for <hi type="italic">things</hi> of gold, for all instruments of all manner of service; <hi type="italic">silver also</hi> for all instruments of silver by weight, for all instruments of every kind of service:

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:15
verses.text: Even the weight for the candlesticks of gold, and for their lamps of gold, by weight for every candlestick, and for the lamps thereof: and for the candlesticks of silver by weight, <hi type="italic">both</hi> for the candlestick, and <hi type="italic">also</hi> for the lamps thereof, according to the use of every candlestick.

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:16
verses.text: And by weight <hi type="italic">he gave</hi> gold for the tables of shewbread, for every table; and <hi type="italic">likewise</hi> silver for the tables of silver:

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:17
verses.text: Also pure gold for the fleshhooks, and the bowls, and the cups: and for the golden basons <hi type="italic">he gave gold</hi> by weight for every bason; and <hi type="italic">likewise silver</hi> by weight for every bason of silver:

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:18
verses.text: And for the altar of incense refined gold by weight; and gold for the pattern of the chariot of the cherubims, that spread out <hi type="italic">their wings</hi>, and covered the ark of the covenant of the Lord.

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:19
verses.text: All <hi type="italic">this</hi>, <hi type="italic">said David</hi>, the Lord made me understand in writing by <hi type="italic">his</hi> hand upon me, <hi type="italic">even</hi> all the works of this pattern.

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:20
verses.text: And David said to Solomon his son, Be strong and of good courage, and do <hi type="italic">it:</hi> fear not, nor be dismayed: for the Lord God, <hi type="italic">even</hi> my God, <hi type="italic">will be</hi> with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee, until thou hast finished all the work for the service of the house of the Lord.

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:21
verses.text: And, behold, the courses of the priests and the Levites, <hi type="italic">even they shall be with thee</hi> for all the service of the house of God: and <hi type="italic">there shall be</hi> with thee for all manner of workmanship every willing skilful man, for any manner of service: also the princes and all the people <hi type="italic">will be</hi> wholly at thy commandment.  <chapter eID="1Chr.28"/><div eID="gen380" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:1
verses.text: FURTHERMORE David the king said unto all the congregation, Solomon my son, whom alone God hath chosen, <hi type="italic">is yet</hi> young and tender, and the work <hi type="italic">is</hi> great: for the palace <hi type="italic">is</hi> not for man, but for the Lord God.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:2
verses.text: Now I have prepared with all my might for the house of my God the gold for <hi type="italic">things to be made</hi> of gold, and the silver for <hi type="italic">things</hi> of silver, and the brass for <hi type="italic">things</hi> of brass, the iron for <hi type="italic">things</hi> of iron, and wood for <hi type="italic">things</hi> of wood; onyx stones, and <hi type="italic">stones</hi> to be set, glistering stones, and of divers colours, and all manner of precious stones, and marble stones in abundance.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:3
verses.text: Moreover, because I have set my affection to the house of my God, I have of mine own proper good, of gold and silver, <hi type="italic">which</hi> I have given to the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house,

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:4
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Even</hi> three thousand talents of gold, of the gold of Ophir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver, to overlay the walls of the houses <hi type="italic">withal:</hi>

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:5
verses.text: The gold for <hi type="italic">things</hi> of gold, and the silver for <hi type="italic">things</hi> of silver, and for all manner of work <hi type="italic">to be made</hi> by the hands of artificers. And who <hi type="italic">then</hi> is willing to consecrate his service this day unto the Lord?

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:6
verses.text: ¶ Then the chief of the fathers and princes of the tribes of Israel, and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, with the rulers of the king’s work, offered willingly,

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:7
verses.text: And gave for the service of the house of God of gold five thousand talents and ten thousand drams, and of silver ten thousand talents, and of brass eighteen thousand talents, and one hundred thousand talents of iron.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:8
verses.text: And they with whom <hi type="italic">precious</hi> stones were found gave <hi type="italic">them</hi> to the treasure of the house of the Lord, by the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:9
verses.text: Then the people rejoiced, for that they offered willingly, because with perfect heart they offered willingly to the Lord: and David the king also rejoiced with great joy.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:10
verses.text: ¶ Wherefore David blessed the Lord before all the congregation: and David said, Blessed <hi type="italic">be</hi> thou, Lord God of Israel our father, for ever and ever.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:11
verses.text: Thine, O Lord, <hi type="italic">is</hi> the greatness, and the power, and the glory, and the victory, and the majesty: for all <hi type="italic">that is</hi> in the heaven and in the earth <hi type="italic">is thine;</hi> thine <hi type="italic">is</hi> the kingdom, O Lord, and thou art exalted as head above all.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:12
verses.text: Both riches and honour <hi type="italic">come</hi> of thee, and thou reignest over all; and in thine hand <hi type="italic">is</hi> power and might; and in thine hand <hi type="italic">it is</hi> to make great, and to give strength unto all.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:13
verses.text: Now therefore, our God, we thank thee, and praise thy glorious name.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:14
verses.text: But who <hi type="italic">am</hi> I, and what <hi type="italic">is</hi> my people, that we should be able to offer so willingly after this sort? for all things <hi type="italic">come</hi> of thee, and of thine own have we given thee.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:15
verses.text: For we <hi type="italic">are</hi> strangers before thee, and sojourners, as <hi type="italic">were</hi> all our fathers: our days on the earth <hi type="italic">are</hi> as a shadow, and <hi type="italic">there is</hi> none abiding.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:16
verses.text: O Lord our God, all this store that we have prepared to build thee an house for thine holy name <hi type="italic">cometh</hi> of thine hand, and <hi type="italic">is</hi> all thine own.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:17
verses.text: I know also, my God, that thou triest the heart, and hast pleasure in uprightness. As for me, in the uprightness of mine heart I have willingly offered all these things: and now have I seen with joy thy people, which are present here, to offer willingly unto thee.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:18
verses.text: O Lord God of Abraham, Isaac, and of Israel, our fathers, keep this for ever in the imagination of the thoughts of the heart of thy people, and prepare their heart unto thee:

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:19
verses.text: And give unto Solomon my son a perfect heart, to keep thy commandments, thy testimonies, and thy statutes, and to do all <hi type="italic">these things</hi>, and to build the palace, <hi type="italic">for</hi> the which I have made provision.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:20
verses.text: ¶ And David said to all the congregation, Now bless the Lord your God. And all the congregation blessed the Lord God of their fathers, and bowed down their heads, and worshipped the Lord, and the king.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:21
verses.text: And they sacrificed sacrifices unto the Lord, and offered burnt offerings unto the Lord, on the morrow after that day, <hi type="italic">even</hi> a thousand bullocks, a thousand rams, <hi type="italic">and</hi> a thousand lambs, with their drink offerings, and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel:

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:22
verses.text: And did eat and drink before the Lord on that day with great gladness. And they made Solomon the son of David king the second time, and anointed <hi type="italic">him</hi> unto the Lord <hi type="italic">to be</hi> the chief governor, and Zadok <hi type="italic">to be</hi> priest.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:23
verses.text: Then Solomon sat on the throne of the Lord as king instead of David his father, and prospered; and all Israel obeyed him.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:24
verses.text: And all the princes, and the mighty men, and all the sons likewise of king David, submitted themselves unto Solomon the king.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:25
verses.text: And the Lord magnified Solomon exceedingly in the sight of all Israel, and bestowed upon him <hi type="italic">such</hi> royal majesty as had not been on any king before him in Israel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:26
verses.text: ¶ Thus David the son of Jesse reigned over all Israel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:27
verses.text: And the time that he reigned over Israel <hi type="italic">was</hi> forty years; seven years reigned he in Hebron, and thirty and three <hi type="italic">years</hi> reigned he in Jerusalem.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:28
verses.text: And he died in a good old age, full of days, riches, and honour: and Solomon his son reigned in his stead.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:29
verses.text: Now the acts of David the king, first and last, behold, they <hi type="italic">are</hi> written in the book of Samuel the seer, and in the book of Nathan the prophet, and in the book of Gad the seer,

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:30
verses.text: With all his reign and his might, and the times that went over him, and over Israel, and over all the kingdoms of the countries.  <chapter eID="1Chr.29"/><div eID="gen381" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen352" osisID="1Chr" type="book"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 1:1
verses.text: AND Solomon the son of David was strengthened in his kingdom, and the Lord his God <hi type="italic">was</hi> with him, and magnified him exceedingly.

verses.name: II Chronicles 1:2
verses.text: Then Solomon spake unto all Israel, to the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and to the judges, and to every governor in all Israel, the chief of the fathers.

verses.name: II Chronicles 1:3
verses.text: So Solomon, and all the congregation with him, went to the high place that <hi type="italic">was</hi> at Gibeon; for there was the tabernacle of the congregation of God, which Moses the servant of the Lord had made in the wilderness.

verses.name: II Chronicles 1:4
verses.text: But the ark of God had David brought up from Kirjath-jearim to <hi type="italic">the place which</hi> David had prepared for it: for he had pitched a tent for it at Jerusalem.

verses.name: II Chronicles 1:5
verses.text: Moreover the brasen altar, that Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, had made, he put before the tabernacle of the Lord: and Solomon and the congregation sought unto it.

verses.name: II Chronicles 1:6
verses.text: And Solomon went up thither to the brasen altar before the Lord, which <hi type="italic">was</hi> at the tabernacle of the congregation, and offered a thousand burnt offerings upon it.

verses.name: II Chronicles 1:7
verses.text: ¶ In that night did God appear unto Solomon, and said unto him, Ask what I shall give thee.

verses.name: II Chronicles 1:8
verses.text: And Solomon said unto God, Thou hast shewed great mercy unto David my father, and hast made me to reign in his stead.

verses.name: II Chronicles 1:9
verses.text: Now, O Lord God, let thy promise unto David my father be established: for thou hast made me king over a people like the dust of the earth in multitude.

verses.name: II Chronicles 1:10
verses.text: Give me now wisdom and knowledge, that I may go out and come in before this people: for who can judge this thy people, <hi type="italic">that is so</hi> great?

verses.name: II Chronicles 1:11
verses.text: And God said to Solomon, Because this was in thine heart, and thou hast not asked riches, wealth, or honour, nor the life of thine enemies, neither yet hast asked long life; but hast asked wisdom and knowledge for thyself, that thou mayest judge my people, over whom I have made thee king:

verses.name: II Chronicles 1:12
verses.text: Wisdom and knowledge <hi type="italic">is</hi> granted unto thee; and I will give thee riches, and wealth, and honour, such as none of the kings have had that <hi type="italic">have been</hi> before thee, neither shall there any after thee have the like.

verses.name: II Chronicles 1:13
verses.text: ¶ Then Solomon came <hi type="italic">from his journey</hi> to the high place that <hi type="italic">was</hi> at Gibeon to Jerusalem, from before the tabernacle of the congregation, and reigned over Israel.

verses.name: II Chronicles 1:14
verses.text: And Solomon gathered chariots and horsemen: and he had a thousand and four hundred chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen, which he placed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.

verses.name: II Chronicles 1:15
verses.text: And the king made silver and gold at Jerusalem <hi type="italic">as plenteous</hi> as stones, and cedar trees made he as the sycomore trees that <hi type="italic">are</hi> in the vale for abundance.

verses.name: II Chronicles 1:16
verses.text: And Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt, and linen yarn: the king’s merchants received the linen yarn at a price.

verses.name: II Chronicles 1:17
verses.text: And they fetched up, and brought forth out of Egypt a chariot for six hundred <hi type="italic">shekels</hi> of silver, and an horse for an hundred and fifty: and so brought they out <hi type="italic">horses</hi> for all the kings of the Hittites, and for the kings of Syria, by their means.  <chapter eID="2Chr.1"/><div eID="gen383" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 2:1
verses.text: AND Solomon determined to build an house for the name of the Lord, and an house for his kingdom.

verses.name: II Chronicles 2:2
verses.text: And Solomon told out threescore and ten thousand men to bear burdens, and fourscore thousand to hew in the mountain, and three thousand and six hundred to oversee them.

verses.name: II Chronicles 2:3
verses.text: ¶ And Solomon sent to Huram the king of Tyre, saying, As thou didst deal with David my father, and didst send him cedars to build him an house to dwell therein, <hi type="italic">even so deal with me</hi>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 2:4
verses.text: Behold, I build an house to the name of the Lord my God, to dedicate <hi type="italic">it</hi> to him, <hi type="italic">and</hi> to burn before him sweet incense, and for the continual shewbread, and for the burnt offerings morning and evening, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the solemn feasts of the Lord our God. This <hi type="italic">is an ordinance</hi> for ever to Israel.

verses.name: II Chronicles 2:5
verses.text: And the house which I build <hi type="italic">is</hi> great: for great <hi type="italic">is</hi> our God above all gods.

verses.name: II Chronicles 2:6
verses.text: But who is able to build him an house, seeing the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain him? who <hi type="italic">am</hi> I then, that I should build him an house, save only to burn sacrifice before him?

verses.name: II Chronicles 2:7
verses.text: Send me now therefore a man cunning to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass, and in iron, and in purple, and crimson, and blue, and that can skill to grave with the cunning men that <hi type="italic">are</hi> with me in Judah and in Jerusalem, whom David my father did provide.

verses.name: II Chronicles 2:8
verses.text: Send me also cedar trees, fir trees, and algum trees, out of Lebanon: for I know that thy servants can skill to cut timber in Lebanon; and, behold, my servants <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> with thy servants,

verses.name: II Chronicles 2:9
verses.text: Even to prepare me timber in abundance: for the house which I am about to build <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> wonderful great.

verses.name: II Chronicles 2:10
verses.text: And, behold, I will give to thy servants, the hewers that cut timber, twenty thousand measures of beaten wheat, and twenty thousand measures of barley, and twenty thousand baths of wine, and twenty thousand baths of oil.

verses.name: II Chronicles 2:11
verses.text: ¶ Then Huram the king of Tyre answered in writing, which he sent to Solomon, Because the Lord hath loved his people, he hath made thee king over them.

verses.name: II Chronicles 2:12
verses.text: Huram said moreover, Blessed <hi type="italic">be</hi> the Lord God of Israel, that made heaven and earth, who hath given to David the king a wise son, endued with prudence and understanding, that might build an house for the Lord, and an house for his kingdom.

verses.name: II Chronicles 2:13
verses.text: And now I have sent a cunning man, endued with understanding, of Huram my father’s,

verses.name: II Chronicles 2:14
verses.text: The son of a woman of the daughters of Dan, and his father <hi type="italic">was</hi> a man of Tyre, skilful to work in gold, and in silver, in brass, in iron, in stone, and in timber, in purple, in blue, and in fine linen, and in crimson; also to grave any manner of graving, and to find out every device which shall be put to him, with thy cunning men, and with the cunning men of my lord David thy father.

verses.name: II Chronicles 2:15
verses.text: Now therefore the wheat, and the barley, the oil, and the wine, which my lord hath spoken of, let him send unto his servants:

verses.name: II Chronicles 2:16
verses.text: And we will cut wood out of Lebanon, as much as thou shalt need: and we will bring it to thee in floats by sea to Joppa; and thou shalt carry it up to Jerusalem.

verses.name: II Chronicles 2:17
verses.text: ¶ And Solomon numbered all the strangers that <hi type="italic">were</hi> in the land of Israel, after the numbering wherewith David his father had numbered them; and they were found an hundred and fifty thousand and three thousand and six hundred.

verses.name: II Chronicles 2:18
verses.text: And he set threescore and ten thousand of them <hi type="italic">to be</hi> bearers of burdens, and fourscore thousand <hi type="italic">to be</hi> hewers in the mountain, and three thousand and six hundred overseers to set the people a work.  <chapter eID="2Chr.2"/><div eID="gen384" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 3:1
verses.text: THEN Solomon began to build the house of the Lord at Jerusalem in mount Moriah, where <hi type="italic">the L</hi><hi type="italic">ord</hi> appeared unto David his father, in the place that David had prepared in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.

verses.name: II Chronicles 3:2
verses.text: And he began to build in the second <hi type="italic">day</hi> of the second month, in the fourth year of his reign.

verses.name: II Chronicles 3:3
verses.text: ¶ Now these <hi type="italic">are the things wherein</hi> Solomon was instructed for the building of the house of God. The length by cubits after the first measure <hi type="italic">was</hi> threescore cubits, and the breadth twenty cubits.

verses.name: II Chronicles 3:4
verses.text: And the porch that <hi type="italic">was</hi> in the front <hi type="italic">of the house</hi>, the length <hi type="italic">of it was</hi> according to the breadth of the house, twenty cubits, and the height <hi type="italic">was</hi> an hundred and twenty: and he overlaid it within with pure gold.

verses.name: II Chronicles 3:5
verses.text: And the greater house he cieled with fir tree, which he overlaid with fine gold, and set thereon palm trees and chains.

verses.name: II Chronicles 3:6
verses.text: And he garnished the house with precious stones for beauty: and the gold <hi type="italic">was</hi> gold of Parvaim.

verses.name: II Chronicles 3:7
verses.text: He overlaid also the house, the beams, the posts, and the walls thereof, and the doors thereof, with gold; and graved cherubims on the walls.

verses.name: II Chronicles 3:8
verses.text: And he made the most holy house, the length whereof <hi type="italic">was</hi> according to the breadth of the house, twenty cubits, and the breadth thereof twenty cubits: and he overlaid it with fine gold, <hi type="italic">amounting</hi> to six hundred talents.

verses.name: II Chronicles 3:9
verses.text: And the weight of the nails <hi type="italic">was</hi> fifty shekels of gold. And he overlaid the upper chambers with gold.

verses.name: II Chronicles 3:10
verses.text: And in the most holy house he made two cherubims of image work, and overlaid them with gold.

verses.name: II Chronicles 3:11
verses.text: ¶ And the wings of the cherubims <hi type="italic">were</hi> twenty cubits long: one wing <hi type="italic">of the one cherub was</hi> five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house: and the other wing <hi type="italic">was likewise</hi> five cubits, reaching to the wing of the other cherub.

verses.name: II Chronicles 3:12
verses.text: And <hi type="italic">one</hi> wing of the other cherub <hi type="italic">was</hi> five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house: and the other wing <hi type="italic">was</hi> five cubits <hi type="italic">also</hi>, joining to the wing of the other cherub.

verses.name: II Chronicles 3:13
verses.text: The wings of these cherubims spread themselves forth twenty cubits: and they stood on their feet, and their faces <hi type="italic">were</hi> inward.

verses.name: II Chronicles 3:14
verses.text: ¶ And he made the vail <hi type="italic">of</hi> blue, and purple, and crimson, and fine linen, and wrought cherubims thereon.

verses.name: II Chronicles 3:15
verses.text: Also he made before the house two pillars of thirty and five cubits high, and the chapiter that <hi type="italic">was</hi> on the top of each of them <hi type="italic">was</hi> five cubits.

verses.name: II Chronicles 3:16
verses.text: And he made chains, <hi type="italic">as</hi> in the oracle, and put <hi type="italic">them</hi> on the heads of the pillars; and made an hundred pomegranates, and put <hi type="italic">them</hi> on the chains.

verses.name: II Chronicles 3:17
verses.text: And he reared up the pillars before the temple, one on the right hand, and the other on the left; and called the name of that on the right hand Jachin, and the name of that on the left Boaz.  <chapter eID="2Chr.3"/><div eID="gen385" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 4:1
verses.text: MOREOVER he made an altar of brass, twenty cubits the length thereof, and twenty cubits the breadth thereof, and ten cubits the height thereof.

verses.name: II Chronicles 4:2
verses.text: ¶ Also he made a molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim, round in compass, and five cubits the height thereof; and a line of thirty cubits did compass it round about.

verses.name: II Chronicles 4:3
verses.text: And under it <hi type="italic">was</hi> the similitude of oxen, which did compass it round about: ten in a cubit, compassing the sea round about. Two rows of oxen <hi type="italic">were</hi> cast, when it was cast.

verses.name: II Chronicles 4:4
verses.text: It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east: and the sea <hi type="italic">was set</hi> above upon them, and all their hinder parts <hi type="italic">were</hi> inward.

verses.name: II Chronicles 4:5
verses.text: And the thickness of it <hi type="italic">was</hi> an handbreadth, and the brim of it like the work of the brim of a cup, with flowers of lilies; <hi type="italic">and</hi> it received and held three thousand baths.

verses.name: II Chronicles 4:6
verses.text: ¶ He made also ten lavers, and put five on the right hand, and five on the left, to wash in them: such things as they offered for the burnt offering they washed in them; but the sea <hi type="italic">was</hi> for the priests to wash in.

verses.name: II Chronicles 4:7
verses.text: And he made ten candlesticks of gold according to their form, and set <hi type="italic">them</hi> in the temple, five on the right hand, and five on the left.

verses.name: II Chronicles 4:8
verses.text: He made also ten tables, and placed <hi type="italic">them</hi> in the temple, five on the right side, and five on the left. And he made an hundred basons of gold.

verses.name: II Chronicles 4:9
verses.text: ¶ Furthermore he made the court of the priests, and the great court, and doors for the court, and overlaid the doors of them with brass.

verses.name: II Chronicles 4:10
verses.text: And he set the sea on the right side of the east end, over against the south.

verses.name: II Chronicles 4:11
verses.text: And Huram made the pots, and the shovels, and the basons. And Huram finished the work that he was to make for king Solomon for the house of God;

verses.name: II Chronicles 4:12
verses.text: <hi type="italic">To wit</hi>, the two pillars, and the pommels, and the chapiters <hi type="italic">which were</hi> on the top of the two pillars, and the two wreaths to cover the two pommels of the chapiters which <hi type="italic">were</hi> on the top of the pillars;

verses.name: II Chronicles 4:13
verses.text: And four hundred pomegranates on the two wreaths; two rows of pomegranates on each wreath, to cover the two pommels of the chapiters which <hi type="italic">were</hi> upon the pillars.

verses.name: II Chronicles 4:14
verses.text: He made also bases, and lavers made he upon the bases;

verses.name: II Chronicles 4:15
verses.text: One sea, and twelve oxen under it.

verses.name: II Chronicles 4:16
verses.text: The pots also, and the shovels, and the fleshhooks, and all their instruments, did Huram his father make to king Solomon for the house of the Lord of bright brass.

verses.name: II Chronicles 4:17
verses.text: In the plain of Jordan did the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredathah.

verses.name: II Chronicles 4:18
verses.text: Thus Solomon made all these vessels in great abundance: for the weight of the brass could not be found out.

verses.name: II Chronicles 4:19
verses.text: ¶ And Solomon made all the vessels that <hi type="italic">were for</hi> the house of God, the golden altar also, and the tables whereon the shewbread <hi type="italic">was set;</hi>

verses.name: II Chronicles 4:20
verses.text: Moreover the candlesticks with their lamps, that they should burn after the manner before the oracle, of pure gold;

verses.name: II Chronicles 4:21
verses.text: And the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs, <hi type="italic">made he of</hi> gold, <hi type="italic">and</hi> that perfect gold;

verses.name: II Chronicles 4:22
verses.text: And the snuffers, and the basons, and the spoons, and the censers, <hi type="italic">of</hi> pure gold: and the entry of the house, the inner doors thereof for the most holy <hi type="italic">place</hi>, and the doors of the house of the temple, <hi type="italic">were of</hi> gold.  <chapter eID="2Chr.4"/><div eID="gen386" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 5:1
verses.text: THUS all the work that Solomon made for the house of the Lord was finished: and Solomon brought in <hi type="italic">all</hi> the things that David his father had dedicated; and the silver, and the gold, and all the instruments, put he among the treasures of the house of God.

verses.name: II Chronicles 5:2
verses.text: ¶ Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel, and all the heads of the tribes, the chief of the fathers of the children of Israel, unto Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the covenant of the Lord out of the city of David, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> Zion.

verses.name: II Chronicles 5:3
verses.text: Wherefore all the men of Israel assembled themselves unto the king in the feast which <hi type="italic">was</hi> in the seventh month.

verses.name: II Chronicles 5:4
verses.text: And all the elders of Israel came; and the Levites took up the ark.

verses.name: II Chronicles 5:5
verses.text: And they brought up the ark, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and all the holy vessels that <hi type="italic">were</hi> in the tabernacle, these did the priests <hi type="italic">and</hi> the Levites bring up.

verses.name: II Chronicles 5:6
verses.text: Also king Solomon, and all the congregation of Israel that were assembled unto him before the ark, sacrificed sheep and oxen, which could not be told nor numbered for multitude.

verses.name: II Chronicles 5:7
verses.text: And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of the Lord unto his place, to the oracle of the house, into the most holy <hi type="italic">place</hi>, <hi type="italic">even</hi> under the wings of the cherubims:

verses.name: II Chronicles 5:8
verses.text: For the cherubims spread forth <hi type="italic">their</hi> wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubims covered the ark and the staves thereof above.

verses.name: II Chronicles 5:9
verses.text: And they drew out the staves <hi type="italic">of the ark</hi>, that the ends of the staves were seen from the ark before the oracle; but they were not seen without. And there it is unto this day.

verses.name: II Chronicles 5:10
verses.text: <hi type="italic">There was</hi> nothing in the ark save the two tables which Moses put <hi type="italic">therein</hi> at Horeb, when the Lord made <hi type="italic">a covenant</hi> with the children of Israel, when they came out of Egypt.

verses.name: II Chronicles 5:11
verses.text: ¶ And it came to pass, when the priests were come out of the holy <hi type="italic">place:</hi> (for all the priests <hi type="italic">that were</hi> present were sanctified, <hi type="italic">and</hi> did not <hi type="italic">then</hi> wait by course:

verses.name: II Chronicles 5:12
verses.text: Also the Levites <hi type="italic">which were</hi> the singers, all of them of Asaph, of Heman, of Jeduthun, with their sons and their brethren, <hi type="italic">being</hi> arrayed in white linen, having cymbals and psalteries and harps, stood at the east end of the altar, and with them an hundred and twenty priests sounding with trumpets:)

verses.name: II Chronicles 5:13
verses.text: It came even to pass, as the trumpeters and singers <hi type="italic">were</hi> as one, to make one sound to be heard in praising and thanking the Lord; and when they lifted up <hi type="italic">their</hi> voice with the trumpets and cymbals and instruments of musick, and praised the Lord, <hi type="italic">saying</hi>, For <hi type="italic">he is</hi> good; for his mercy <hi type="italic">endureth</hi> for ever: that <hi type="italic">then</hi> the house was filled with a cloud, <hi type="italic">even</hi> the house of the Lord;

verses.name: II Chronicles 5:14
verses.text: So that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud: for the glory of the Lord had filled the house of God.  <chapter eID="2Chr.5"/><div eID="gen387" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 6:1
verses.text: THEN said Solomon, The Lord hath said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.

verses.name: II Chronicles 6:2
verses.text: But I have built an house of habitation for thee, and a place for thy dwelling for ever.

verses.name: II Chronicles 6:3
verses.text: And the king turned his face, and blessed the whole congregation of Israel: and all the congregation of Israel stood.

verses.name: II Chronicles 6:4
verses.text: And he said, Blessed <hi type="italic">be</hi> the Lord God of Israel, who hath with his hands fulfilled <hi type="italic">that</hi> which he spake with his mouth to my father David, saying,

verses.name: II Chronicles 6:5
verses.text: Since the day that I brought forth my people out of the land of Egypt I chose no city among all the tribes of Israel to build an house in, that my name might be there; neither chose I any man to be a ruler over my people Israel:

verses.name: II Chronicles 6:6
