verses.text: And next to him repaired Ezer the son of Jeshua, the ruler of Mizpah, another piece over against the going up to the armoury at the turning <hi type="italic">of the wall</hi>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:20
verses.text: After him Baruch the son of Zabbai earnestly repaired the other piece, from the turning <hi type="italic">of the wall</hi> unto the door of the house of Eliashib the high priest.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:21
verses.text: After him repaired Meremoth the son of Urijah the son of Koz another piece, from the door of the house of Eliashib even to the end of the house of Eliashib.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:22
verses.text: And after him repaired the priests, the men of the plain.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:23
verses.text: After him repaired Benjamin and Hashub over against their house. After him repaired Azariah the son of Maaseiah the son of Ananiah by his house.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:24
verses.text: After him repaired Binnui the son of Henadad another piece, from the house of Azariah unto the turning <hi type="italic">of the wall</hi>, even unto the corner.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:25
verses.text: Palal the son of Uzai, over against the turning <hi type="italic">of the wall</hi>, and the tower which lieth out from the king’s high house, that <hi type="italic">was</hi> by the court of the prison. After him Pedaiah the son of Parosh.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:26
verses.text: Moreover the Nethinims dwelt in Ophel, unto <hi type="italic">the place</hi> over against the water gate toward the east, and the tower that lieth out.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:27
verses.text: After them the Tekoites repaired another piece, over against the great tower that lieth out, even unto the wall of Ophel.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:28
verses.text: From above the horse gate repaired the priests, every one over against his house.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:29
verses.text: After them repaired Zadok the son of Immer over against his house. After him repaired also Shemaiah the son of Shechaniah, the keeper of the east gate.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:30
verses.text: After him repaired Hananiah the son of Shelemiah, and Hanun the sixth son of Zalaph, another piece. After him repaired Meshullam the son of Berechiah over against his chamber.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:31
verses.text: After him repaired Malchiah the goldsmith’s son unto the place of the Nethinims, and of the merchants, over against the gate Miphkad, and to the going up of the corner.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:32
verses.text: And between the going up of the corner unto the sheep gate repaired the goldsmiths and the merchants.  <chapter eID="Neh.3"/><div eID="gen433" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:1
verses.text: BUT it came to pass, that when Sanballat heard that we builded the wall, he was wroth, and took great indignation, and mocked the Jews.

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:2
verses.text: And he spake before his brethren and the army of Samaria, and said, What do these feeble Jews? will they fortify themselves? will they sacrifice? will they make an end in a day? will they revive the stones out of the heaps of the rubbish which are burned?

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:3
verses.text: Now Tobiah the Ammonite <hi type="italic">was</hi> by him, and he said, Even that which they build, if a fox go up, he shall even break down their stone wall.

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:4
verses.text: Hear, O our God; for we are despised: and turn their reproach upon their own head, and give them for a prey in the land of captivity:

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:5
verses.text: And cover not their iniquity, and let not their sin be blotted out from before thee: for they have provoked <hi type="italic">thee</hi> to anger before the builders.

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:6
verses.text: So built we the wall; and all the wall was joined together unto the half thereof: for the people had a mind to work.

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:7
verses.text: ¶ But it came to pass, <hi type="italic">that</hi> when Sanballat, and Tobiah, and the Arabians, and the Ammonites, and the Ashdodites, heard that the walls of Jerusalem were made up, <hi type="italic">and</hi> that the breaches began to be stopped, then they were very wroth,

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:8
verses.text: And conspired all of them together to come <hi type="italic">and</hi> to fight against Jerusalem, and to hinder it.

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:9
verses.text: Nevertheless we made our prayer unto our God, and set a watch against them day and night, because of them.

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:10
verses.text: And Judah said, The strength of the bearers of burdens is decayed, and <hi type="italic">there is</hi> much rubbish; so that we are not able to build the wall.

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:11
verses.text: And our adversaries said, They shall not know, neither see, till we come in the midst among them, and slay them, and cause the work to cease.

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:12
verses.text: And it came to pass, that when the Jews which dwelt by them came, they said unto us ten times, From all places whence ye shall return unto us <hi type="italic">they will be upon you</hi>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:13
verses.text: ¶ Therefore set I in the lower places behind the wall, <hi type="italic">and</hi> on the higher places, I even set the people after their families with their swords, their spears, and their bows.

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:14
verses.text: And I looked, and rose up, and said unto the nobles, and to the rulers, and to the rest of the people, Be not ye afraid of them: remember the Lord, <hi type="italic">which is</hi> great and terrible, and fight for your brethren, your sons, and your daughters, your wives, and your houses.

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:15
verses.text: And it came to pass, when our enemies heard that it was known unto us, and God had brought their counsel to nought, that we returned all of us to the wall, every one unto his work.

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:16
verses.text: And it came to pass from that time forth, <hi type="italic">that</hi> the half of my servants wrought in the work, and the other half of them held both the spears, the shields, and the bows, and the habergeons; and the rulers <hi type="italic">were</hi> behind all the house of Judah.

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:17
verses.text: They which builded on the wall, and they that bare burdens, with those that laded, <hi type="italic">every one</hi> with one of his hands wrought in the work, and with the other <hi type="italic">hand</hi> held a weapon.

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:18
verses.text: For the builders, every one had his sword girded by his side, and <hi type="italic">so</hi> builded. And he that sounded the trumpet <hi type="italic">was</hi> by me.

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:19
verses.text: ¶ And I said unto the nobles, and to the rulers, and to the rest of the people, The work <hi type="italic">is</hi> great and large, and we are separated upon the wall, one far from another.

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:20
verses.text: In what place <hi type="italic">therefore</hi> ye hear the sound of the trumpet, resort ye thither unto us: our God shall fight for us.

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:21
verses.text: So we laboured in the work: and half of them held the spears from the rising of the morning till the stars appeared.

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:22
verses.text: Likewise at the same time said I unto the people, Let every one with his servant lodge within Jerusalem, that in the night they may be a guard to us, and labour on the day.

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:23
verses.text: So neither I, nor my brethren, nor my servants, nor the men of the guard which followed me, none of us put off our clothes, <hi type="italic">saving that</hi> every one put them off for washing.  <chapter eID="Neh.4"/><div eID="gen434" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:1
verses.text: AND there was a great cry of the people and of their wives against their brethren the Jews.

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:2
verses.text: For there were that said, We, our sons, and our daughters, <hi type="italic">are</hi> many: therefore we take up corn <hi type="italic">for them</hi>, that we may eat, and live.

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:3
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Some</hi> also there were that said, We have mortgaged our lands, vineyards, and houses, that we might buy corn, because of the dearth.

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:4
verses.text: There were also that said, We have borrowed money for the king’s tribute, <hi type="italic">and that upon</hi> our lands and vineyards.

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:5
verses.text: Yet now our flesh <hi type="italic">is</hi> as the flesh of our brethren, our children as their children: and, lo, we bring into bondage our sons and our daughters to be servants, and <hi type="italic">some</hi> of our daughters are brought unto bondage <hi type="italic">already:</hi> neither <hi type="italic">is it</hi> in our power <hi type="italic">to redeem them;</hi> for other men have our lands and vineyards.

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:6
verses.text: ¶ And I was very angry when I heard their cry and these words.

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:7
verses.text: Then I consulted with myself, and I rebuked the nobles, and the rulers, and said unto them, Ye exact usury, every one of his brother. And I set a great assembly against them.

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:8
verses.text: And I said unto them, We after our ability have redeemed our brethren the Jews, which were sold unto the heathen; and will ye even sell your brethren? or shall they be sold unto us? Then held they their peace, and found nothing <hi type="italic">to answer</hi>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:9
verses.text: Also I said, It <hi type="italic">is</hi> not good that ye do: ought ye not to walk in the fear of our God because of the reproach of the heathen our enemies?

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:10
verses.text: I likewise, <hi type="italic">and</hi> my brethren, and my servants, might exact of them money and corn: I pray you, let us leave off this usury.

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:11
verses.text: Restore, I pray you, to them, even this day, their lands, their vineyards, their oliveyards, and their houses, also the hundredth <hi type="italic">part</hi> of the money, and of the corn, the wine, and the oil, that ye exact of them.

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:12
verses.text: Then said they, We will restore <hi type="italic">them</hi>, and will require nothing of them; so will we do as thou sayest. Then I called the priests, and took an oath of them, that they should do according to this promise.

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:13
verses.text: Also I shook my lap, and said, So God shake out every man from his house, and from his labour, that performeth not this promise, even thus be he shaken out, and emptied. And all the congregation said, Amen, and praised the Lord. And the people did according to this promise.

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:14
verses.text: ¶ Moreover from the time that I was appointed to be their governor in the land of Judah, from the twentieth year even unto the two and thirtieth year of Artaxerxes the king, <hi type="italic">that is</hi>, twelve years, I and my brethren have not eaten the bread of the governor.

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:15
verses.text: But the former governors that <hi type="italic">had been</hi> before me were chargeable unto the people, and had taken of them bread and wine, beside forty shekels of silver; yea, even their servants bare rule over the people: but so did not I, because of the fear of God.

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:16
verses.text: Yea, also I continued in the work of this wall, neither bought we any land: and all my servants <hi type="italic">were</hi> gathered thither unto the work.

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:17
verses.text: Moreover <hi type="italic">there were</hi> at my table an hundred and fifty of the Jews and rulers, beside those that came unto us from among the heathen that <hi type="italic">are</hi> about us.

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:18
verses.text: Now <hi type="italic">that</hi> which was prepared <hi type="italic">for me</hi> daily <hi type="italic">was</hi> one ox <hi type="italic">and</hi> six choice sheep; also fowls were prepared for me, and once in ten days store of all sorts of wine: yet for all this required not I the bread of the governor, because the bondage was heavy upon this people.

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:19
verses.text: Think upon me, my God, for good, <hi type="italic">according</hi> to all that I have done for this people.  <chapter eID="Neh.5"/><div eID="gen435" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:1
verses.text: NOW it came to pass, when Sanballat, and Tobiah, and Geshem the Arabian, and the rest of our enemies, heard that I had builded the wall, and <hi type="italic">that</hi> there was no breach left therein; (though at that time I had not set up the doors upon the gates;)

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:2
verses.text: That Sanballat and Geshem sent unto me, saying, Come, let us meet together in <hi type="italic">some one of</hi> the villages in the plain of Ono. But they thought to do me mischief.

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:3
verses.text: And I sent messengers unto them, saying, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> doing a great work, so that I cannot come down: why should the work cease, whilst I leave it, and come down to you?

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:4
verses.text: Yet they sent unto me four times after this sort; and I answered them after the same manner.

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:5
verses.text: Then sent Sanballat his servant unto me in like manner the fifth time with an open letter in his hand;

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:6
verses.text: Wherein <hi type="italic">was</hi> written, It is reported among the heathen, and Gashmu saith <hi type="italic">it</hi>, <hi type="italic">that</hi> thou and the Jews think to rebel: for which cause thou buildest the wall, that thou mayest be their king, according to these words.

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:7
verses.text: And thou hast also appointed prophets to preach of thee at Jerusalem, saying, <hi type="italic">There is</hi> a king in Judah: and now shall it be reported to the king according to these words. Come now therefore, and let us take counsel together.

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:8
verses.text: Then I sent unto him, saying, There are no such things done as thou sayest, but thou feignest them out of thine own heart.

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:9
verses.text: For they all made us afraid, saying, Their hands shall be weakened from the work, that it be not done. Now therefore, <hi type="italic">O God</hi>, strengthen my hands.

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:10
verses.text: Afterward I came unto the house of Shemaiah the son of Delaiah the son of Mehetabeel, who <hi type="italic">was</hi> shut up; and he said, Let us meet together in the house of God, within the temple, and let us shut the doors of the temple: for they will come to slay thee; yea, in the night will they come to slay thee.

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:11
verses.text: And I said, Should such a man as I flee? and who <hi type="italic">is there</hi>, that, <hi type="italic">being</hi> as I <hi type="italic">am</hi>, would go into the temple to save his life? I will not go in.

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:12
verses.text: And, lo, I perceived that God had not sent him; but that he pronounced this prophecy against me: for Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him.

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:13
verses.text: Therefore <hi type="italic">was</hi> he hired, that I should be afraid, and do so, and sin, and <hi type="italic">that</hi> they might have <hi type="italic">matter</hi> for an evil report, that they might reproach me.

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:14
verses.text: My God, think thou upon Tobiah and Sanballat according to these their works, and on the prophetess Noadiah, and the rest of the prophets, that would have put me in fear.

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:15
verses.text: ¶ So the wall was finished in the twenty and fifth <hi type="italic">day</hi> of <hi type="italic">the month</hi> Elul, in fifty and two days.

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:16
verses.text: And it came to pass, that when all our enemies heard <hi type="italic">thereof</hi>, and all the heathen that <hi type="italic">were</hi> about us saw <hi type="italic">these things</hi>, they were much cast down in their own eyes: for they perceived that this work was wrought of our God.

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:17
verses.text: ¶ Moreover in those days the nobles of Judah sent many letters unto Tobiah, and <hi type="italic">the letters</hi> of Tobiah came unto them.

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:18
verses.text: For <hi type="italic">there were</hi> many in Judah sworn unto him, because he <hi type="italic">was</hi> the son in law of Shechaniah the son of Arah; and his son Johanan had taken the daughter of Meshullam the son of Berechiah.

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:19
verses.text: Also they reported his good deeds before me, and uttered my words to him. <hi type="italic">And</hi> Tobiah sent letters to put me in fear.  <chapter eID="Neh.6"/><div eID="gen436" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:1
verses.text: NOW it came to pass, when the wall was built, and I had set up the doors, and the porters and the singers and the Levites were appointed,

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:2
verses.text: That I gave my brother Hanani, and Hananiah the ruler of the palace, charge over Jerusalem: for he <hi type="italic">was</hi> a faithful man, and feared God above many.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:3
verses.text: And I said unto them, Let not the gates of Jerusalem be opened until the sun be hot; and while they stand by, let them shut the doors, and bar <hi type="italic">them:</hi> and appoint watches of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, every one in his watch, and every one <hi type="italic">to be</hi> over against his house.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:4
verses.text: Now the city <hi type="italic">was</hi> large and great: but the people <hi type="italic">were</hi> few therein, and the houses <hi type="italic">were</hi> not builded.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:5
verses.text: ¶ And my God put into mine heart to gather together the nobles, and the rulers, and the people, that they might be reckoned by genealogy. And I found a register of the genealogy of them which came up at the first, and found written therein,

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:6
verses.text: These <hi type="italic">are</hi> the children of the province, that went up out of the captivity, of those that had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away, and came again to Jerusalem and to Judah, every one unto his city;

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:7
verses.text: Who came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, Baanah. The number, <hi type="italic">I say</hi>, of the men of the people of Israel <hi type="italic">was this;</hi>

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:8
verses.text: The children of Parosh, two thousand an hundred seventy and two.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:9
verses.text: The children of Shephatiah, three hundred seventy and two.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:10
verses.text: The children of Arah, six hundred fifty and two.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:11
verses.text: The children of Pahath-moab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab, two thousand and eight hundred <hi type="italic">and</hi> eighteen.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:12
verses.text: The children of Elam, a thousand two hundred fifty and four.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:13
verses.text: The children of Zattu, eight hundred forty and five.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:14
verses.text: The children of Zaccai, seven hundred and threescore.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:15
verses.text: The children of Binnui, six hundred forty and eight.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:16
verses.text: The children of Bebai, six hundred twenty and eight.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:17
verses.text: The children of Azgad, two thousand three hundred twenty and two.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:18
verses.text: The children of Adonikam, six hundred threescore and seven.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:19
verses.text: The children of Bigvai, two thousand threescore and seven.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:20
verses.text: The children of Adin, six hundred fifty and five.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:21
verses.text: The children of Ater of Hezekiah, ninety and eight.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:22
verses.text: The children of Hashum, three hundred twenty and eight.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:23
verses.text: The children of Bezai, three hundred twenty and four.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:24
verses.text: The children of Hariph, an hundred and twelve.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:25
verses.text: The children of Gibeon, ninety and five.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:26
verses.text: The men of Beth-lehem and Netophah, an hundred fourscore and eight.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:27
verses.text: The men of Anathoth, an hundred twenty and eight.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:28
verses.text: The men of Beth-azmaveth, forty and two.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:29
verses.text: The men of Kirjath-jearim, Chephirah, and Beeroth, seven hundred forty and three.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:30
verses.text: The men of Ramah and Geba, six hundred twenty and one.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:31
verses.text: The men of Michmas, an hundred and twenty and two.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:32
verses.text: The men of Beth-el and Ai, an hundred twenty and three.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:33
verses.text: The men of the other Nebo, fifty and two.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:34
verses.text: The children of the other Elam, a thousand two hundred fifty and four.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:35
verses.text: The children of Harim, three hundred and twenty.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:36
verses.text: The children of Jericho, three hundred forty and five.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:37
verses.text: The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono, seven hundred twenty and one.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:38
verses.text: The children of Senaah, three thousand nine hundred and thirty.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:39
verses.text: ¶ The priests: the children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua, nine hundred seventy and three.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:40
verses.text: The children of Immer, a thousand fifty and two.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:41
verses.text: The children of Pashur, a thousand two hundred forty and seven.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:42
verses.text: The children of Harim, a thousand and seventeen.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:43
verses.text: ¶ The Levites: the children of Jeshua, of Kadmiel, <hi type="italic">and</hi> of the children of Hodevah, seventy and four.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:44
verses.text: ¶ The singers: the children of Asaph, an hundred forty and eight.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:45
verses.text: ¶ The porters: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai, an hundred thirty and eight.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:46
verses.text: ¶ The Nethinims: the children of Ziha, the children of Hashupha, the children of Tabbaoth,

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:47
verses.text: The children of Keros, the children of Sia, the children of Padon,

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:48
verses.text: The children of Lebana, the children of Hagaba, the children of Shalmai,

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:49
verses.text: The children of Hanan, the children of Giddel, the children of Gahar,

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:50
verses.text: The children of Reaiah, the children of Rezin, the children of Nekoda,

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:51
verses.text: The children of Gazzam, the children of Uzza, the children of Phaseah,

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:52
verses.text: The children of Besai, the children of Meunim, the children of Nephishesim,

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:53
verses.text: The children of Bakbuk, the children of Hakupha, the children of Harhur,

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:54
verses.text: The children of Bazlith, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:55
verses.text: The children of Barkos, the children of Sisera, the children of Tamah,

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:56
verses.text: The children of Neziah, the children of Hatipha.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:57
verses.text: ¶ The children of Solomon’s servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Sophereth, the children of Perida,

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:58
verses.text: The children of Jaala, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel,

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:59
verses.text: The children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth of Zebaim, the children of Amon.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:60
verses.text: All the Nethinims, and the children of Solomon’s servants, <hi type="italic">were</hi> three hundred ninety and two.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:61
verses.text: And these <hi type="italic">were</hi> they which went up <hi type="italic">also</hi> from Tel-melah, Tel-haresha, Cherub, Addon, and Immer: but they could not shew their father’s house, nor their seed, whether they <hi type="italic">were</hi> of Israel.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:62
verses.text: The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred forty and two.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:63
verses.text: ¶ And of the priests: the children of Habaiah, the children of Koz, the children of Barzillai, which took <hi type="italic">one</hi> of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite to wife, and was called after their name.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:64
verses.text: These sought their register <hi type="italic">among</hi> those that were reckoned by genealogy, but it was not found: therefore were they, as polluted, put from the priesthood.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:65
verses.text: And the Tirshatha said unto them, that they should not eat of the most holy things, till there stood <hi type="italic">up</hi> a priest with Urim and Thummim.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:66
verses.text: ¶ The whole congregation together <hi type="italic">was</hi> forty and two thousand three hundred and threescore,

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:67
verses.text: Beside their manservants and their maidservants, of whom <hi type="italic">there were</hi> seven thousand three hundred thirty and seven: and they had two hundred forty and five singing men and singing women.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:68
verses.text: Their horses, seven hundred thirty and six: their mules, two hundred forty and five:

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:69
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Their</hi> camels, four hundred thirty and five: six thousand seven hundred and twenty asses.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:70
verses.text: ¶ And some of the chief of the fathers gave unto the work. The Tirshatha gave to the treasure a thousand drams of gold, fifty basons, five hundred and thirty priests’ garments.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:71
verses.text: And <hi type="italic">some</hi> of the chief of the fathers gave to the treasure of the work twenty thousand drams of gold, and two thousand and two hundred pound of silver.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:72
verses.text: And <hi type="italic">that</hi> which the rest of the people gave <hi type="italic">was</hi> twenty thousand drams of gold, and two thousand pound of silver, and threescore and seven priests’ garments.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:73
verses.text: So the priests, and the Levites, and the porters, and the singers, and <hi type="italic">some</hi> of the people, and the Nethinims, and all Israel, dwelt in their cities; and when the seventh month came, the children of Israel <hi type="italic">were</hi> in their cities.  <chapter eID="Neh.7"/><div eID="gen437" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:1
verses.text: AND all the people gathered themselves together as one man into the street that <hi type="italic">was</hi> before the water gate; and they spake unto Ezra the scribe to bring the book of the law of Moses, which the Lord had commanded to Israel.

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:2
verses.text: And Ezra the priest brought the law before the congregation both of men and women, and all that could hear with understanding, upon the first day of the seventh month.

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:3
verses.text: And he read therein before the street that <hi type="italic">was</hi> before the water gate from the morning until midday, before the men and the women, and those that could understand; and the ears of all the people <hi type="italic">were attentive</hi> unto the book of the law.

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:4
verses.text: And Ezra the scribe stood upon a pulpit of wood, which they had made for the purpose; and beside him stood Mattithiah, and Shema, and Anaiah, and Urijah, and Hilkiah, and Maaseiah, on his right hand; and on his left hand, Pedaiah, and Mishael, and Malchiah, and Hashum, and Hashbadana, Zechariah, <hi type="italic">and</hi> Meshullam.

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:5
verses.text: And Ezra opened the book in the sight of all the people; (for he was above all the people;) and when he opened it, all the people stood up:

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:6
verses.text: And Ezra blessed the Lord, the great God. And all the people answered, Amen, Amen, with lifting up their hands: and they bowed their heads, and worshipped the Lord with <hi type="italic">their</hi> faces to the ground.

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:7
verses.text: Also Jeshua, and Bani, and Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodijah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaiah, and the Levites, caused the people to understand the law: and the people <hi type="italic">stood</hi> in their place.

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:8
verses.text: So they read in the book in the law of God distinctly, and gave the sense, and caused <hi type="italic">them</hi> to understand the reading.

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:9
verses.text: ¶ And Nehemiah, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> the Tirshatha, and Ezra the priest the scribe, and the Levites that taught the people, said unto all the people, This day <hi type="italic">is</hi> holy unto the Lord your God; mourn not, nor weep. For all the people wept, when they heard the words of the law.

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:10
verses.text: Then he said unto them, Go your way, eat the fat, and drink the sweet, and send portions unto them for whom nothing is prepared: for <hi type="italic">this</hi> day <hi type="italic">is</hi> holy unto our Lord: neither be ye sorry; for the joy of the Lord is your strength.

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:11
verses.text: So the Levites stilled all the people, saying, Hold your peace, for the day <hi type="italic">is</hi> holy; neither be ye grieved.

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:12
verses.text: And all the people went their way to eat, and to drink, and to send portions, and to make great mirth, because they had understood the words that were declared unto them.

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:13
verses.text: ¶ And on the second day were gathered together the chief of the fathers of all the people, the priests, and the Levites, unto Ezra the scribe, even to understand the words of the law.

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:14
verses.text: And they found written in the law which the Lord had commanded by Moses, that the children of Israel should dwell in booths in the feast of the seventh month:

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:15
verses.text: And that they should publish and proclaim in all their cities, and in Jerusalem, saying, Go forth unto the mount, and fetch olive branches, and pine branches, and myrtle branches, and palm branches, and branches of thick trees, to make booths, as <hi type="italic">it is</hi> written.

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:16
verses.text: ¶ So the people went forth, and brought <hi type="italic">them</hi>, and made themselves booths, every one upon the roof of his house, and in their courts, and in the courts of the house of God, and in the street of the water gate, and in the street of the gate of Ephraim.

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:17
verses.text: And all the congregation of them that were come again out of the captivity made booths, and sat under the booths: for since the days of Jeshua the son of Nun unto that day had not the children of Israel done so. And there was very great gladness.

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:18
verses.text: Also day by day, from the first day unto the last day, he read in the book of the law of God. And they kept the feast seven days; and on the eighth day <hi type="italic">was</hi> a solemn assembly, according unto the manner.  <chapter eID="Neh.8"/><div eID="gen438" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:1
verses.text: NOW in the twenty and fourth day of this month the children of Israel were assembled with fasting, and with sackclothes, and earth upon them.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:2
verses.text: And the seed of Israel separated themselves from all strangers, and stood and confessed their sins, and the iniquities of their fathers.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:3
verses.text: And they stood up in their place, and read in the book of the law of the Lord their God <hi type="italic">one</hi> fourth part of the day; and <hi type="italic">another</hi> fourth part they confessed, and worshipped the Lord their God.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:4
verses.text: ¶ Then stood up upon the stairs, of the Levites, Jeshua, and Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, <hi type="italic">and</hi> Chenani, and cried with a loud voice unto the Lord their God.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:5
verses.text: Then the Levites, Jeshua, and Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabniah, Sherebiah, Hodijah, Shebaniah, <hi type="italic">and</hi> Pethahiah, said, Stand up <hi type="italic">and</hi> bless the Lord your God for ever and ever: and blessed be thy glorious name, which is exalted above all blessing and praise.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:6
verses.text: Thou, <hi type="italic">even</hi> thou, <hi type="italic">art</hi> Lord alone; thou hast made heaven, the heaven of heavens, with all their host, the earth, and all <hi type="italic">things</hi> that <hi type="italic">are</hi> therein, the seas, and all that <hi type="italic">is</hi> therein, and thou preservest them all; and the host of heaven worshippeth thee.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:7
verses.text: Thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> the Lord the God, who didst choose Abram, and broughtest him forth out of Ur of the Chaldees, and gavest him the name of Abraham;

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:8
verses.text: And foundest his heart faithful before thee, and madest a covenant with him to give the land of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Jebusites, and the Girgashites, to give <hi type="italic">it</hi>, <hi type="italic">I say</hi>, to his seed, and hast performed thy words; for thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> righteous:

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:9
verses.text: And didst see the affliction of our fathers in Egypt, and heardest their cry by the Red sea;

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:10
verses.text: And shewedst signs and wonders upon Pharaoh, and on all his servants, and on all the people of his land: for thou knewest that they dealt proudly against them. So didst thou get thee a name, as <hi type="italic">it is</hi> this day.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:11
verses.text: And thou didst divide the sea before them, so that they went through the midst of the sea on the dry land; and their persecutors thou threwest into the deeps, as a stone into the mighty waters.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:12
verses.text: Moreover thou leddest them in the day by a cloudy pillar; and in the night by a pillar of fire, to give them light in the way wherein they should go.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:13
verses.text: Thou camest down also upon mount Sinai, and spakest with them from heaven, and gavest them right judgments, and true laws, good statutes and commandments:

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:14
verses.text: And madest known unto them thy holy sabbath, and commandedst them precepts, statutes, and laws, by the hand of Moses thy servant:

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:15
verses.text: And gavest them bread from heaven for their hunger, and broughtest forth water for them out of the rock for their thirst, and promisedst them that they should go in to possess the land which thou hadst sworn to give them.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:16
verses.text: But they and our fathers dealt proudly, and hardened their necks, and hearkened not to thy commandments,

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:17
verses.text: And refused to obey, neither were mindful of thy wonders that thou didst among them; but hardened their necks, and in their rebellion appointed a captain to return to their bondage: but thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> a God ready to pardon, gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and forsookest them not.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:18
verses.text: Yea, when they had made them a molten calf, and said, This <hi type="italic">is</hi> thy God that brought thee up out of Egypt, and had wrought great provocations;

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:19
verses.text: Yet thou in thy manifold mercies forsookest them not in the wilderness: the pillar of the cloud departed not from them by day, to lead them in the way; neither the pillar of fire by night, to shew them light, and the way wherein they should go.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:20
verses.text: Thou gavest also thy good spirit to instruct them, and withheldest not thy manna from their mouth, and gavest them water for their thirst.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:21
verses.text: Yea, forty years didst thou sustain them in the wilderness, <hi type="italic">so that</hi> they lacked nothing; their clothes waxed not old, and their feet swelled not.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:22
verses.text: Moreover thou gavest them kingdoms and nations, and didst divide them into corners: so they possessed the land of Sihon, and the land of the king of Heshbon, and the land of Og king of Bashan.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:23
verses.text: Their children also multipliedst thou as the stars of heaven, and broughtest them into the land, concerning which thou hadst promised to their fathers, that they should go in to possess <hi type="italic">it</hi>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:24
verses.text: So the children went in and possessed the land, and thou subduedst before them the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, and gavest them into their hands, with their kings, and the people of the land, that they might do with them as they would.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:25
verses.text: And they took strong cities, and a fat land, and possessed houses full of all goods, wells digged, vineyards, and oliveyards, and fruit trees in abundance: so they did eat, and were filled, and became fat, and delighted themselves in thy great goodness.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:26
verses.text: Nevertheless they were disobedient, and rebelled against thee, and cast thy law behind their backs, and slew thy prophets which testified against them to turn them to thee, and they wrought great provocations.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:27
verses.text: Therefore thou deliveredst them into the hand of their enemies, who vexed them: and in the time of their trouble, when they cried unto thee, thou heardest <hi type="italic">them</hi> from heaven; and according to thy manifold mercies thou gavest them saviours, who saved them out of the hand of their enemies.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:28
verses.text: But after they had rest, they did evil again before thee: therefore leftest thou them in the hand of their enemies, so that they had the dominion over them: yet when they returned, and cried unto thee, thou heardest <hi type="italic">them</hi> from heaven; and many times didst thou deliver them according to thy mercies;

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:29
verses.text: And testifiedst against them, that thou mightest bring them again unto thy law: yet they dealt proudly, and hearkened not unto thy commandments, but sinned against thy judgments, (which if a man do, he shall live in them;) and withdrew the shoulder, and hardened their neck, and would not hear.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:30
verses.text: Yet many years didst thou forbear them, and testifiedst against them by thy spirit in thy prophets: yet would they not give ear: therefore gavest thou them into the hand of the people of the lands.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:31
verses.text: Nevertheless for thy great mercies’ sake thou didst not utterly consume them, nor forsake them; for thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> a gracious and merciful God.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:32
verses.text: Now therefore, our God, the great, the mighty, and the terrible God, who keepest covenant and mercy, let not all the trouble seem little before thee, that hath come upon us, on our kings, on our princes, and on our priests, and on our prophets, and on our fathers, and on all thy people, since the time of the kings of Assyria unto this day.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:33
verses.text: Howbeit thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> just in all that is brought upon us; for thou hast done right, but we have done wickedly:

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:34
verses.text: Neither have our kings, our princes, our priests, nor our fathers, kept thy law, nor hearkened unto thy commandments and thy testimonies, wherewith thou didst testify against them.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:35
verses.text: For they have not served thee in their kingdom, and in thy great goodness that thou gavest them, and in the large and fat land which thou gavest before them, neither turned they from their wicked works.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:36
verses.text: Behold, we <hi type="italic">are</hi> servants this day, and <hi type="italic">for</hi> the land that thou gavest unto our fathers to eat the fruit thereof and the good thereof, behold, we <hi type="italic">are</hi> servants in it:

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:37
verses.text: And it yieldeth much increase unto the kings whom thou hast set over us because of our sins: also they have dominion over our bodies, and over our cattle, at their pleasure, and we <hi type="italic">are</hi> in great distress.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:38
verses.text: And because of all this we make a sure <hi type="italic">covenant</hi>, and write <hi type="italic">it;</hi> and our princes, Levites, <hi type="italic">and</hi> priests, seal <hi type="italic">unto it</hi>.  <chapter eID="Neh.9"/><div eID="gen439" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:1
verses.text: NOW those that sealed <hi type="italic">were</hi>, Nehemiah, the Tirshatha, the son of Hachaliah, and Zidkijah,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:2
verses.text: Seraiah, Azariah, Jeremiah,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:3
verses.text: Pashur, Amariah, Malchijah,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:4
verses.text: Hattush, Shebaniah, Malluch,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:5
verses.text: Harim, Meremoth, Obadiah,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:6
verses.text: Daniel, Ginnethon, Baruch,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:7
verses.text: Meshullam, Abijah, Mijamin,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:8
verses.text: Maaziah, Bilgai, Shemaiah: these <hi type="italic">were</hi> the priests.

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:9
verses.text: And the Levites: both Jeshua the son of Azaniah, Binnui of the sons of Henadad, Kadmiel;

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:10
verses.text: And their brethren, Shebaniah, Hodijah, Kelita, Pelaiah, Hanan,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:11
verses.text: Micha, Rehob, Hashabiah,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:12
verses.text: Zaccur, Sherebiah, Shebaniah,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:13
verses.text: Hodijah, Bani, Beninu.

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:14
verses.text: The chief of the people; Parosh, Pahath-moab, Elam, Zatthu, Bani,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:15
verses.text: Bunni, Azgad, Bebai,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:16
verses.text: Adonijah, Bigvai, Adin,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:17
verses.text: Ater, Hizkijah, Azzur,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:18
verses.text: Hodijah, Hashum, Bezai,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:19
verses.text: Hariph, Anathoth, Nebai,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:20
verses.text: Magpiash, Meshullam, Hezir,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:21
verses.text: Meshezabeel, Zadok, Jaddua,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:22
verses.text: Pelatiah, Hanan, Anaiah,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:23
verses.text: Hoshea, Hananiah, Hashub,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:24
verses.text: Hallohesh, Pileha, Shobek,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:25
verses.text: Rehum, Hashabnah, Maaseiah,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:26
verses.text: And Ahijah, Hanan, Anan,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:27
verses.text: Malluch, Harim, Baanah.

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:28
verses.text: ¶ And the rest of the people, the priests, the Levites, the porters, the singers, the Nethinims, and all they that had separated themselves from the people of the lands unto the law of God, their wives, their sons, and their daughters, every one having knowledge, and having understanding;

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:29
verses.text: They clave to their brethren, their nobles, and entered into a curse, and into an oath, to walk in God’s law, which was given by Moses the servant of God, and to observe and do all the commandments of the Lord our Lord, and his judgments and his statutes;

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:30
verses.text: And that we would not give our daughters unto the people of the land, nor take their daughters for our sons:

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:31
verses.text: And <hi type="italic">if</hi> the people of the land bring ware or any victuals on the sabbath day to sell, <hi type="italic">that</hi> we would not buy it of them on the sabbath, or on the holy day: and <hi type="italic">that</hi> we would leave the seventh year, and the exaction of every debt.

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:32
verses.text: Also we made ordinances for us, to charge ourselves yearly with the third part of a shekel for the service of the house of our God;

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:33
verses.text: For the shewbread, and for the continual meat offering, and for the continual burnt offering, of the sabbaths, of the new moons, for the set feasts, and for the holy <hi type="italic">things</hi>, and for the sin offerings to make an atonement for Israel, and <hi type="italic">for</hi> all the work of the house of our God.

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:34
verses.text: And we cast the lots among the priests, the Levites, and the people, for the wood offering, to bring <hi type="italic">it</hi> into the house of our God, after the houses of our fathers, at times appointed year by year, to burn upon the altar of the Lord our God, as <hi type="italic">it is</hi> written in the law:

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:35
verses.text: And to bring the firstfruits of our ground, and the firstfruits of all fruit of all trees, year by year, unto the house of the Lord:

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:36
verses.text: Also the firstborn of our sons, and of our cattle, as <hi type="italic">it is</hi> written in the law, and the firstlings of our herds and of our flocks, to bring to the house of our God, unto the priests that minister in the house of our God:

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:37
verses.text: And <hi type="italic">that</hi> we should bring the firstfruits of our dough, and our offerings, and the fruit of all manner of trees, of wine and of oil, unto the priests, to the chambers of the house of our God; and the tithes of our ground unto the Levites, that the same Levites might have the tithes in all the cities of our tillage.

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:38
verses.text: And the priest the son of Aaron shall be with the Levites, when the Levites take tithes: and the Levites shall bring up the tithe of the tithes unto the house of our God, to the chambers, into the treasure house.

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:39
verses.text: For the children of Israel and the children of Levi shall bring the offering of the corn, of the new wine, and the oil, unto the chambers, where <hi type="italic">are</hi> the vessels of the sanctuary, and the priests that minister, and the porters, and the singers: and we will not forsake the house of our God.  <chapter eID="Neh.10"/><div eID="gen440" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:1
verses.text: AND the rulers of the people dwelt at Jerusalem: the rest of the people also cast lots, to bring one of ten to dwell in Jerusalem the holy city, and nine parts <hi type="italic">to dwell</hi> in <hi type="italic">other</hi> cities.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:2
verses.text: And the people blessed all the men, that willingly offered themselves to dwell at Jerusalem.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:3
verses.text: ¶ Now these <hi type="italic">are</hi> the chief of the province that dwelt in Jerusalem: but in the cities of Judah dwelt every one in his possession in their cities, <hi type="italic">to wit</hi>, Israel, the priests, and the Levites, and the Nethinims, and the children of Solomon’s servants.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:4
verses.text: And at Jerusalem dwelt <hi type="italic">certain</hi> of the children of Judah, and of the children of Benjamin. Of the children of Judah; Athaiah the son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalaleel, of the children of Perez;

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:5
verses.text: And Maaseiah the son of Baruch, the son of Col-hozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, the son of Shiloni.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:6
verses.text: All the sons of Perez that dwelt at Jerusalem <hi type="italic">were</hi> four hundred threescore and eight valiant men.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:7
verses.text: And these <hi type="italic">are</hi> the sons of Benjamin; Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jesaiah.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:8
verses.text: And after him Gabbai, Sallai, nine hundred twenty and eight.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:9
verses.text: And Joel the son of Zichri <hi type="italic">was</hi> their overseer: and Judah the son of Senuah <hi type="italic">was</hi> second over the city.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:10
verses.text: Of the priests: Jedaiah the son of Joiarib, Jachin.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:11
verses.text: Seraiah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, <hi type="italic">was</hi> the ruler of the house of God.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:12
verses.text: And their brethren that did the work of the house <hi type="italic">were</hi> eight hundred twenty and two: and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashur, the son of Malchiah,

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:13
verses.text: And his brethren, chief of the fathers, two hundred forty and two: and Amashai the son of Azareel, the son of Ahasai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer,

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:14
verses.text: And their brethren, mighty men of valour, an hundred twenty and eight: and their overseer <hi type="italic">was</hi> Zabdiel, the son of <hi type="italic">one of</hi> the great men.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:15
verses.text: Also of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hashub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:16
verses.text: And Shabbethai and Jozabad, of the chief of the Levites, <hi type="italic">had</hi> the oversight of the outward business of the house of God.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:17
verses.text: And Mattaniah the son of Micha, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, <hi type="italic">was</hi> the principal to begin the thanksgiving in prayer: and Bakbukiah the second among his brethren, and Abda the son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:18
verses.text: All the Levites in the holy city <hi type="italic">were</hi> two hundred fourscore and four.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:19
verses.text: Moreover the porters, Akkub, Talmon, and their brethren that kept the gates, <hi type="italic">were</hi> an hundred seventy and two.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:20
verses.text: ¶ And the residue of Israel, of the priests, <hi type="italic">and</hi> the Levites, <hi type="italic">were</hi> in all the cities of Judah, every one in his inheritance.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:21
verses.text: But the Nethinims dwelt in Ophel: and Ziha and Gispa <hi type="italic">were</hi> over the Nethinims.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:22
verses.text: The overseer also of the Levites at Jerusalem <hi type="italic">was</hi> Uzzi the son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Micha. Of the sons of Asaph, the singers <hi type="italic">were</hi> over the business of the house of God.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:23
verses.text: For <hi type="italic">it was</hi> the king’s commandment concerning them, that a certain portion should be for the singers, due for every day.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:24
verses.text: And Pethahiah the son of Meshezabeel, of the children of Zerah the son of Judah, <hi type="italic">was</hi> at the king’s hand in all matters concerning the people.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:25
verses.text: And for the villages, with their fields, <hi type="italic">some</hi> of the children of Judah dwelt at Kirjath-arba, and <hi type="italic">in</hi> the villages thereof, and at Dibon, and <hi type="italic">in</hi> the villages thereof, and at Jekabzeel, and <hi type="italic">in</hi> the villages thereof,

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:26
verses.text: And at Jeshua, and at Moladah, and at Beth-phelet,

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:27
verses.text: And at Hazar-shual, and at Beer-sheba, and <hi type="italic">in</hi> the villages thereof,

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:28
verses.text: And at Ziklag, and at Mekonah, and in the villages thereof,

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:29
verses.text: And at En-rimmon, and at Zareah, and at Jarmuth,

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:30
verses.text: Zanoah, Adullam, and <hi type="italic">in</hi> their villages, at Lachish, and the fields thereof, at Azekah, and <hi type="italic">in</hi> the villages thereof. And they dwelt from Beer-sheba unto the valley of Hinnom.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:31
verses.text: The children also of Benjamin from Geba <hi type="italic">dwelt</hi> at Michmash, and Aija, and Beth-el, and <hi type="italic">in</hi> their villages,

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:32
verses.text: <hi type="italic">And</hi> at Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah,

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:33
verses.text: Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim,

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:34
verses.text: Hadid, Zeboim, Neballat,

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:35
verses.text: Lod, and Ono, the valley of craftsmen.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:36
verses.text: And of the Levites <hi type="italic">were</hi> divisions <hi type="italic">in</hi> Judah, <hi type="italic">and</hi> in Benjamin.  <chapter eID="Neh.11"/><div eID="gen441" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:1
verses.text: NOW these <hi type="italic">are</hi> the priests and the Levites that went up with Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua: Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra,

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:2
verses.text: Amariah, Malluch, Hattush,

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:3
verses.text: Shechaniah, Rehum, Meremoth,

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:4
verses.text: Iddo, Ginnetho, Abijah,

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:5
verses.text: Miamin, Maadiah, Bilgah,

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:6
verses.text: Shemaiah, and Joiarib, Jedaiah,

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:7
verses.text: Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah, Jedaiah. These <hi type="italic">were</hi> the chief of the priests and of their brethren in the days of Jeshua.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:8
verses.text: Moreover the Levites: Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, <hi type="italic">and</hi> Mattaniah, <hi type="italic">which was</hi> over the thanksgiving, he and his brethren.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:9
verses.text: Also Bakbukiah and Unni, their brethren, <hi type="italic">were</hi> over against them in the watches.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:10
verses.text: ¶ And Jeshua begat Joiakim, Joiakim also begat Eliashib, and Eliashib begat Joiada,

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:11
verses.text: And Joiada begat Jonathan, and Jonathan begat Jaddua.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:12
verses.text: And in the days of Joiakim were priests, the chief of the fathers: of Seraiah, Meraiah; of Jeremiah, Hananiah;

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:13
verses.text: Of Ezra, Meshullam; of Amariah, Jehohanan;

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:14
verses.text: Of Melicu, Jonathan; of Shebaniah, Joseph;

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:15
verses.text: Of Harim, Adna; of Meraioth, Helkai;

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:16
verses.text: Of Iddo, Zechariah; of Ginnethon, Meshullam;

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:17
verses.text: Of Abijah, Zichri; of Miniamin, of Moadiah, Piltai;

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:18
verses.text: Of Bilgah, Shammua; of Shemaiah, Jehonathan;

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:19
verses.text: And of Joiarib, Mattenai; of Jedaiah, Uzzi;

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:20
verses.text: Of Sallai, Kallai; of Amok, Eber;

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:21
verses.text: Of Hilkiah, Hashabiah; of Jedaiah, Nethaneel.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:22
verses.text: ¶ The Levites in the days of Eliashib, Joiada, and Johanan, and Jaddua, <hi type="italic">were</hi> recorded chief of the fathers: also the priests, to the reign of Darius the Persian.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:23
verses.text: The sons of Levi, the chief of the fathers, <hi type="italic">were</hi> written in the book of the chronicles, even until the days of Johanan the son of Eliashib.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:24
verses.text: And the chief of the Levites: Hashabiah, Sherebiah, and Jeshua the son of Kadmiel, with their brethren over against them, to praise <hi type="italic">and</hi> to give thanks, according to the commandment of David the man of God, ward over against ward.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:25
verses.text: Mattaniah, and Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, Akkub, <hi type="italic">were</hi> porters keeping the ward at the thresholds of the gates.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:26
verses.text: These <hi type="italic">were</hi> in the days of Joiakim the son of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor, and of Ezra the priest, the scribe.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:27
verses.text: ¶ And at the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem they sought the Levites out of all their places, to bring them to Jerusalem, to keep the dedication with gladness, both with thanksgivings, and with singing, <hi type="italic">with</hi> cymbals, psalteries, and with harps.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:28
verses.text: And the sons of the singers gathered themselves together, both out of the plain country round about Jerusalem, and from the villages of Netophathi;

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:29
verses.text: Also from the house of Gilgal, and out of the fields of Geba and Azmaveth: for the singers had builded them villages round about Jerusalem.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:30
verses.text: And the priests and the Levites purified themselves, and purified the people, and the gates, and the wall.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:31
verses.text: Then I brought up the princes of Judah upon the wall, and appointed two great <hi type="italic">companies of them that gave</hi> thanks, <hi type="italic">whereof one</hi> went on the right hand upon the wall toward the dung gate:

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:32
verses.text: And after them went Hoshaiah, and half of the princes of Judah,

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:33
verses.text: And Azariah, Ezra, and Meshullam,

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:34
verses.text: Judah, and Benjamin, and Shemaiah, and Jeremiah,

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:35
verses.text: And <hi type="italic">certain</hi> of the priests’ sons with trumpets; <hi type="italic">namely</hi>, Zechariah the son of Jonathan, the son of Shemaiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Michaiah, the son of Zaccur, the son of Asaph:

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:36
verses.text: And his brethren, Shemaiah, and Azarael, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethaneel, and Judah, Hanani, with the musical instruments of David the man of God, and Ezra the scribe before them.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:37
verses.text: And at the fountain gate, which was over against them, they went up by the stairs of the city of David, at the going up of the wall, above the house of David, even unto the water gate eastward.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:38
verses.text: And the other <hi type="italic">company of them that gave</hi> thanks went over against <hi type="italic">them</hi>, and I after them, and the half of the people upon the wall, from beyond the tower of the furnaces even unto the broad wall;

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:39
verses.text: And from above the gate of Ephraim, and above the old gate, and above the fish gate, and the tower of Hananeel, and the tower of Meah, even unto the sheep gate: and they stood still in the prison gate.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:40
verses.text: So stood the two <hi type="italic">companies of them that gave</hi> thanks in the house of God, and I, and the half of the rulers with me:

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:41
verses.text: And the priests; Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Michaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, <hi type="italic">and</hi> Hananiah, with trumpets;

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:42
verses.text: And Maaseiah, and Shemaiah, and Eleazar, and Uzzi, and Jehohanan, and Malchijah, and Elam, and Ezer. And the singers sang loud, with Jezrahiah <hi type="italic">their</hi> overseer.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:43
verses.text: Also that day they offered great sacrifices, and rejoiced: for God had made them rejoice with great joy: the wives also and the children rejoiced: so that the joy of Jerusalem was heard even afar off.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:44
verses.text: ¶ And at that time were some appointed over the chambers for the treasures, for the offerings, for the firstfruits, and for the tithes, to gather into them out of the fields of the cities the portions of the law for the priests and Levites: for Judah rejoiced for the priests and for the Levites that waited.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:45
verses.text: And both the singers and the porters kept the ward of their God, and the ward of the purification, according to the commandment of David, <hi type="italic">and</hi> of Solomon his son.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:46
verses.text: For in the days of David and Asaph of old <hi type="italic">there were</hi> chief of the singers, and songs of praise and thanksgiving unto God.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:47
verses.text: And all Israel in the days of Zerubbabel, and in the days of Nehemiah, gave the portions of the singers and the porters, every day his portion: and they sanctified <hi type="italic">holy things</hi> unto the Levites; and the Levites sanctified <hi type="italic">them</hi> unto the children of Aaron.  <chapter eID="Neh.12"/><div eID="gen442" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:1
verses.text: ON that day they read in the book of Moses in the audience of the people; and therein was found written, that the Ammonite and the Moabite should not come into the congregation of God for ever;

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:2
verses.text: Because they met not the children of Israel with bread and with water, but hired Balaam against them, that he should curse them: howbeit our God turned the curse into a blessing.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:3
verses.text: Now it came to pass, when they had heard the law, that they separated from Israel all the mixed multitude.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:4
verses.text: ¶ And before this, Eliashib the priest, having the oversight of the chamber of the house of our God, <hi type="italic">was</hi> allied unto Tobiah:

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:5
verses.text: And he had prepared for him a great chamber, where aforetime they laid the meat offerings, the frankincense, and the vessels, and the tithes of the corn, the new wine, and the oil, which was commanded <hi type="italic">to be given</hi> to the Levites, and the singers, and the porters; and the offerings of the priests.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:6
verses.text: But in all this <hi type="italic">time</hi> was not I at Jerusalem: for in the two and thirtieth year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon came I unto the king, and after certain days obtained I leave of the king:

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:7
verses.text: And I came to Jerusalem, and understood of the evil that Eliashib did for Tobiah, in preparing him a chamber in the courts of the house of God.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:8
verses.text: And it grieved me sore: therefore I cast forth all the household stuff of Tobiah out of the chamber.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:9
verses.text: Then I commanded, and they cleansed the chambers: and thither brought I again the vessels of the house of God, with the meat offering and the frankincense.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:10
verses.text: ¶ And I perceived that the portions of the Levites had not been given <hi type="italic">them:</hi> for the Levites and the singers, that did the work, were fled every one to his field.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:11
verses.text: Then contended I with the rulers, and said, Why is the house of God forsaken? And I gathered them together, and set them in their place.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:12
verses.text: Then brought all Judah the tithe of the corn and the new wine and the oil unto the treasuries.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:13
verses.text: And I made treasurers over the treasuries, Shelemiah the priest, and Zadok the scribe, and of the Levites, Pedaiah: and next to them <hi type="italic">was</hi> Hanan the son of Zaccur, the son of Mattaniah: for they were counted faithful, and their office <hi type="italic">was</hi> to distribute unto their brethren.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:14
verses.text: Remember me, O my God, concerning this, and wipe not out my good deeds that I have done for the house of my God, and for the offices thereof.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:15
verses.text: ¶ In those days saw I in Judah <hi type="italic">some</hi> treading wine presses on the sabbath, and bringing in sheaves, and lading asses; as also wine, grapes, and figs, and all <hi type="italic">manner of</hi> burdens, which they brought into Jerusalem on the sabbath day: and I testified <hi type="italic">against them</hi> in the day wherein they sold victuals.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:16
verses.text: There dwelt men of Tyre also therein, which brought fish, and all manner of ware, and sold on the sabbath unto the children of Judah, and in Jerusalem.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:17
verses.text: Then I contended with the nobles of Judah, and said unto them, What evil thing <hi type="italic">is</hi> this that ye do, and profane the sabbath day?

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:18
verses.text: Did not your fathers thus, and did not our God bring all this evil upon us, and upon this city? yet ye bring more wrath upon Israel by profaning the sabbath.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:19
verses.text: And it came to pass, that when the gates of Jerusalem began to be dark before the sabbath, I commanded that the gates should be shut, and charged that they should not be opened till after the sabbath: and <hi type="italic">some</hi> of my servants set I at the gates, <hi type="italic">that</hi> there should no burden be brought in on the sabbath day.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:20
verses.text: So the merchants and sellers of all kind of ware lodged without Jerusalem once or twice.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:21
verses.text: Then I testified against them, and said unto them, Why lodge ye about the wall? if ye do <hi type="italic">so</hi> again, I will lay hands on you. From that time forth came they no <hi type="italic">more</hi> on the sabbath.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:22
verses.text: And I commanded the Levites that they should cleanse themselves, and <hi type="italic">that</hi> they should come <hi type="italic">and</hi> keep the gates, to sanctify the sabbath day. Remember me, O my God, <hi type="italic">concerning</hi> this also, and spare me according to the greatness of thy mercy.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:23
verses.text: ¶ In those days also saw I Jews <hi type="italic">that</hi> had married wives of Ashdod, of Ammon, <hi type="italic">and</hi> of Moab:

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:24
verses.text: And their children spake half in the speech of Ashdod, and could not speak in the Jews’ language, but according to the language of each people.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:25
verses.text: And I contended with them, and cursed them, and smote certain of them, and plucked off their hair, and made them swear by God, <hi type="italic">saying</hi>, Ye shall not give your daughters unto their sons, nor take their daughters unto your sons, or for yourselves.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:26
verses.text: Did not Solomon king of Israel sin by these things? yet among many nations was there no king like him, who was beloved of his God, and God made him king over all Israel: nevertheless even him did outlandish women cause to sin.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:27
verses.text: Shall we then hearken unto you to do all this great evil, to transgress against our God in marrying strange wives?

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:28
verses.text: And <hi type="italic">one</hi> of the sons of Joiada, the son of Eliashib the high priest, <hi type="italic">was</hi> son in law to Sanballat the Horonite: therefore I chased him from me.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:29
verses.text: Remember them, O my God, because they have defiled the priesthood, and the covenant of the priesthood, and of the Levites.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:30
verses.text: Thus cleansed I them from all strangers, and appointed the wards of the priests and the Levites, every one in his business;

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:31
verses.text: And for the wood offering, at times appointed, and for the firstfruits. Remember me, O my God, for good. THE  <chapter eID="Neh.13"/><div eID="gen443" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen430" osisID="Neh" type="book"/>

verses.name: Esther 1:1
verses.text: NOW it came to pass in the days of Ahasuerus, (this <hi type="italic">is</hi> Ahasuerus which reigned, from India even unto Ethiopia, <hi type="italic">over</hi> an hundred and seven and twenty provinces:)

verses.name: Esther 1:2
verses.text: <hi type="italic">That</hi> in those days, when the king Ahasuerus sat on the throne of his kingdom, which <hi type="italic">was</hi> in Shushan the palace,

verses.name: Esther 1:3
verses.text: In the third year of his reign, he made a feast unto all his princes and his servants; the power of Persia and Media, the nobles and princes of the provinces, <hi type="italic">being</hi> before him:

verses.name: Esther 1:4
verses.text: When he shewed the riches of his glorious kingdom and the honour of his excellent majesty many days, <hi type="italic">even</hi> an hundred and fourscore days.

verses.name: Esther 1:5
verses.text: And when these days were expired, the king made a feast unto all the people that were present in Shushan the palace, both unto great and small, seven days, in the court of the garden of the king’s palace;

verses.name: Esther 1:6
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Where were</hi> white, green, and blue, <hi type="italic">hangings</hi>, fastened with cords of fine linen and purple to silver rings and pillars of marble: the beds <hi type="italic">were of</hi> gold and silver, upon a pavement of red, and blue, and white, and black, marble.

verses.name: Esther 1:7
verses.text: And they gave <hi type="italic">them</hi> drink in vessels of gold, (the vessels being diverse one from another,) and royal wine in abundance, according to the state of the king.

verses.name: Esther 1:8
verses.text: And the drinking <hi type="italic">was</hi> according to the law; none did compel: for so the king had appointed to all the officers of his house, that they should do according to every man’s pleasure.

verses.name: Esther 1:9
verses.text: Also Vashti the queen made a feast for the women <hi type="italic">in</hi> the royal house which <hi type="italic">belonged</hi> to king Ahasuerus.

verses.name: Esther 1:10
verses.text: ¶ On the seventh day, when the heart of the king was merry with wine, he commanded Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, and Abagtha, Zethar, and Carcas, the seven chamberlains that served in the presence of Ahasuerus the king,

verses.name: Esther 1:11
verses.text: To bring Vashti the queen before the king with the crown royal, to shew the people and the princes her beauty: for she <hi type="italic">was</hi> fair to look on.

verses.name: Esther 1:12
verses.text: But the queen Vashti refused to come at the king’s commandment by <hi type="italic">his</hi> chamberlains: therefore was the king very wroth, and his anger burned in him.

verses.name: Esther 1:13
verses.text: ¶ Then the king said to the wise men, which knew the times, (for so <hi type="italic">was</hi> the king’s manner toward all that knew law and judgment:

verses.name: Esther 1:14
verses.text: And the next unto him <hi type="italic">was</hi> Carshena, Shethar, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena, <hi type="italic">and</hi> Memucan, the seven princes of Persia and Media, which saw the king’s face, <hi type="italic">and</hi> which sat the first in the kingdom;)

verses.name: Esther 1:15
verses.text: What shall we do unto the queen Vashti according to law, because she hath not performed the commandment of the king Ahasuerus by the chamberlains?

verses.name: Esther 1:16
verses.text: And Memucan answered before the king and the princes, Vashti the queen hath not done wrong to the king only, but also to all the princes, and to all the people that <hi type="italic">are</hi> in all the provinces of the king Ahasuerus.

verses.name: Esther 1:17
verses.text: For <hi type="italic">this</hi> deed of the queen shall come abroad unto all women, so that they shall despise their husbands in their eyes, when it shall be reported, The king Ahasuerus commanded Vashti the queen to be brought in before him, but she came not.

verses.name: Esther 1:18
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Likewise</hi> shall the ladies of Persia and Media say this day unto all the king’s princes, which have heard of the deed of the queen. Thus <hi type="italic">shall there arise</hi> too much contempt and wrath.

verses.name: Esther 1:19
verses.text: If it please the king, let there go a royal commandment from him, and let it be written among the laws of the Persians and the Medes, that it be not altered, That Vashti come no more before king Ahasuerus; and let the king give her royal estate unto another that is better than she.

verses.name: Esther 1:20
verses.text: And when the king’s decree which he shall make shall be published throughout all his empire, (for it is great,) all the wives shall give to their husbands honour, both to great and small.

verses.name: Esther 1:21
verses.text: And the saying pleased the king and the princes; and the king did according to the word of Memucan:

verses.name: Esther 1:22
verses.text: For he sent letters into all the king’s provinces, into every province according to the writing thereof, and to every people after their language, that every man should bear rule in his own house, and that <hi type="italic">it</hi> should be published according to the language of every people.  <chapter eID="Esth.1"/><div eID="gen445" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Esther 2:1
verses.text: AFTER these things, when the wrath of king Ahasuerus was appeased, he remembered Vashti, and what she had done, and what was decreed against her.

verses.name: Esther 2:2
verses.text: Then said the king’s servants that ministered unto him, Let there be fair young virgins sought for the king:

verses.name: Esther 2:3
verses.text: And let the king appoint officers in all the provinces of his kingdom, that they may gather together all the fair young virgins unto Shushan the palace, to the house of the women, unto the custody of Hege the king’s chamberlain, keeper of the women; and let their things for purification be given <hi type="italic">them:</hi>

verses.name: Esther 2:4
verses.text: And let the maiden which pleaseth the king be queen instead of Vashti. And the thing pleased the king; and he did so.

verses.name: Esther 2:5
verses.text: ¶ <hi type="italic">Now</hi> in Shushan the palace there was a certain Jew, whose name <hi type="italic">was</hi> Mordecai, the son of Jair, the son of Shimei, the son of Kish, a Benjamite;

verses.name: Esther 2:6
verses.text: Who had been carried away from Jerusalem with the captivity which had been carried away with Jeconiah king of Judah, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away.

verses.name: Esther 2:7
verses.text: And he brought up Hadassah, that <hi type="italic">is</hi>, Esther, his uncle’s daughter: for she had neither father nor mother, and the maid <hi type="italic">was</hi> fair and beautiful; whom Mordecai, when her father and mother were dead, took for his own daughter.

verses.name: Esther 2:8
verses.text: ¶ So it came to pass, when the king’s commandment and his decree was heard, and when many maidens were gathered together unto Shushan the palace, to the custody of Hegai, that Esther was brought also unto the king’s house, to the custody of Hegai, keeper of the women.

verses.name: Esther 2:9
verses.text: And the maiden pleased him, and she obtained kindness of him; and he speedily gave her her things for purification, with such things as belonged to her, and seven maidens, <hi type="italic">which were</hi> meet to be given her, out of the king’s house: and he preferred her and her maids unto the best <hi type="italic">place</hi> of the house of the women.

verses.name: Esther 2:10
verses.text: Esther had not shewed her people nor her kindred: for Mordecai had charged her that she should not shew <hi type="italic">it</hi>.

verses.name: Esther 2:11
verses.text: And Mordecai walked every day before the court of the women’s house, to know how Esther did, and what should become of her.

verses.name: Esther 2:12
verses.text: ¶ Now when every maid’s turn was come to go in to king Ahasuerus, after that she had been twelve months, according to the manner of the women, (for so were the days of their purifications accomplished, <hi type="italic">to wit</hi>, six months with oil of myrrh, and six months with sweet odours, and with <hi type="italic">other</hi> things for the purifying of the women;)

verses.name: Esther 2:13
verses.text: Then thus came <hi type="italic">every</hi> maiden unto the king; whatsoever she desired was given her to go with her out of the house of the women unto the king’s house.

verses.name: Esther 2:14
verses.text: In the evening she went, and on the morrow she returned into the second house of the women, to the custody of Shaashgaz, the king’s chamberlain, which kept the concubines: she came in unto the king no more, except the king delighted in her, and that she were called by name.

verses.name: Esther 2:15
verses.text: ¶ Now when the turn of Esther, the daughter of Abihail the uncle of Mordecai, who had taken her for his daughter, was come to go in unto the king, she required nothing but what Hegai the king’s chamberlain, the keeper of the women, appointed. And Esther obtained favour in the sight of all them that looked upon her.

verses.name: Esther 2:16
verses.text: So Esther was taken unto king Ahasuerus into his house royal in the tenth month, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> the month Tebeth, in the seventh year of his reign.

verses.name: Esther 2:17
verses.text: And the king loved Esther above all the women, and she obtained grace and favour in his sight more than all the virgins; so that he set the royal crown upon her head, and made her queen instead of Vashti.

verses.name: Esther 2:18
verses.text: Then the king made a great feast unto all his princes and his servants, <hi type="italic">even</hi> Esther’s feast; and he made a release to the provinces, and gave gifts, according to the state of the king.

verses.name: Esther 2:19
verses.text: And when the virgins were gathered together the second time, then Mordecai sat in the king’s gate.

verses.name: Esther 2:20
verses.text: Esther had not <hi type="italic">yet</hi> shewed her kindred nor her people; as Mordecai had charged her: for Esther did the commandment of Mordecai, like as when she was brought up with him.

verses.name: Esther 2:21
verses.text: ¶ In those days, while Mordecai sat in the king’s gate, two of the king’s chamberlains, Bigthan and Teresh, of those which kept the door, were wroth, and sought to lay hand on the king Ahasuerus.
