verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv23"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><hi type="italic">A Psalm</hi> of David.</title> <div sID="gen524" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv23"/>JUDGE me, O Lord; for I have walked in mine integrity: I have trusted also in the Lord; <hi type="italic">therefore</hi> I shall not slide.

verses.name: Psalms 26:2
verses.text: Examine me, O Lord, and prove me; try my reins and my heart.

verses.name: Psalms 26:3
verses.text: For thy lovingkindness <hi type="italic">is</hi> before mine eyes: and I have walked in thy truth.

verses.name: Psalms 26:4
verses.text: I have not sat with vain persons, neither will I go in with dissemblers.

verses.name: Psalms 26:5
verses.text: I have hated the congregation of evil doers; and will not sit with the wicked.

verses.name: Psalms 26:6
verses.text: I will wash mine hands in innocency: so will I compass thine altar, O Lord:

verses.name: Psalms 26:7
verses.text: That I may publish with the voice of thanksgiving, and tell of all thy wondrous works.

verses.name: Psalms 26:8
verses.text: Lord, I have loved the habitation of thy house, and the place where thine honour dwelleth.

verses.name: Psalms 26:9
verses.text: Gather not my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloody men:

verses.name: Psalms 26:10
verses.text: In whose hands <hi type="italic">is</hi> mischief, and their right hand is full of bribes.

verses.name: Psalms 26:11
verses.text: But as for me, I will walk in mine integrity: redeem me, and be merciful unto me.

verses.name: Psalms 26:12
verses.text: My foot standeth in an even place: in the congregations will I bless the Lord.  <chapter eID="Ps.26"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv24"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><hi type="italic">A Psalm</hi> of David.</title> <div sID="gen525" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv24"/>THE Lord <hi type="italic">is</hi> my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the Lord <hi type="italic">is</hi> the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?

verses.name: Psalms 27:2
verses.text: When the wicked, <hi type="italic">even</hi> mine enemies and my foes, came upon me to eat up my flesh, they stumbled and fell.

verses.name: Psalms 27:3
verses.text: Though an host should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear: though war should rise against me, in this <hi type="italic">will</hi> I <hi type="italic">be</hi> confident.

verses.name: Psalms 27:4
verses.text: One <hi type="italic">thing</hi> have I desired of the Lord, that will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of the Lord all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of the Lord, and to inquire in his temple.

verses.name: Psalms 27:5
verses.text: For in the time of trouble he shall hide me in his pavilion: in the secret of his tabernacle shall he hide me; he shall set me up upon a rock.

verses.name: Psalms 27:6
verses.text: And now shall mine head be lifted up above mine enemies round about me: therefore will I offer in his tabernacle sacrifices of joy; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises unto the Lord.

verses.name: Psalms 27:7
verses.text: Hear, O Lord, <hi type="italic">when</hi> I cry with my voice: have mercy also upon me, and answer me.

verses.name: Psalms 27:8
verses.text: <hi type="italic">When thou saidst</hi>, Seek ye my face; my heart said unto thee, Thy face, Lord, will I seek.

verses.name: Psalms 27:9
verses.text: Hide not thy face <hi type="italic">far</hi> from me; put not thy servant away in anger: thou hast been my help; leave me not, neither forsake me, O God of my salvation.

verses.name: Psalms 27:10
verses.text: When my father and my mother forsake me, then the Lord will take me up.

verses.name: Psalms 27:11
verses.text: Teach me thy way, O Lord, and lead me in a plain path, because of mine enemies.

verses.name: Psalms 27:12
verses.text: Deliver me not over unto the will of mine enemies: for false witnesses are risen up against me, and such as breathe out cruelty.

verses.name: Psalms 27:13
verses.text: <hi type="italic">I had fainted</hi>, unless I had believed to see the goodness of the Lord in the land of the living.

verses.name: Psalms 27:14
verses.text: Wait on the Lord: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on the Lord.  <chapter eID="Ps.27"/>

verses.name: Psalms 28:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv25"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><hi type="italic">A Psalm</hi> of David.</title> <div sID="gen526" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv25"/>UNTO thee will I cry, O Lord my rock; be not silent to me: lest, <hi type="italic">if</hi> thou be silent to me, I become like them that go down into the pit.

verses.name: Psalms 28:2
verses.text: Hear the voice of my supplications, when I cry unto thee, when I lift up my hands toward thy holy oracle.

verses.name: Psalms 28:3
verses.text: Draw me not away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, which speak peace to their neighbours, but mischief <hi type="italic">is</hi> in their hearts.

verses.name: Psalms 28:4
verses.text: Give them according to their deeds, and according to the wickedness of their endeavours: give them after the work of their hands; render to them their desert.

verses.name: Psalms 28:5
verses.text: Because they regard not the works of the Lord, nor the operation of his hands, he shall destroy them, and not build them up.

verses.name: Psalms 28:6
verses.text: Blessed <hi type="italic">be</hi> the Lord, because he hath heard the voice of my supplications.

verses.name: Psalms 28:7
verses.text: The Lord <hi type="italic">is</hi> my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped: therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; and with my song will I praise him.

verses.name: Psalms 28:8
verses.text: The Lord <hi type="italic">is</hi> their strength, and he <hi type="italic">is</hi> the saving strength of his anointed.

verses.name: Psalms 28:9
verses.text: Save thy people, and bless thine inheritance: feed them also, and lift them up for ever.  <chapter eID="Ps.28"/>

verses.name: Psalms 29:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv26"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">A Psalm of David.</title> <div sID="gen527" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv26"/>GIVE unto the Lord, O ye mighty, give unto the Lord glory and strength.

verses.name: Psalms 29:2
verses.text: Give unto the Lord the glory due unto his name; worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness.

verses.name: Psalms 29:3
verses.text: The voice of the Lord <hi type="italic">is</hi> upon the waters: the God of glory thundereth: the Lord <hi type="italic">is</hi> upon many waters.

verses.name: Psalms 29:4
verses.text: The voice of the Lord <hi type="italic">is</hi> powerful; the voice of the Lord <hi type="italic">is</hi> full of majesty.

verses.name: Psalms 29:5
verses.text: The voice of the Lord breaketh the cedars; yea, the Lord breaketh the cedars of Lebanon.

verses.name: Psalms 29:6
verses.text: He maketh them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young unicorn.

verses.name: Psalms 29:7
verses.text: The voice of the Lord divideth the flames of fire.

verses.name: Psalms 29:8
verses.text: The voice of the Lord shaketh the wilderness; the Lord shaketh the wilderness of Kadesh.

verses.name: Psalms 29:9
verses.text: The voice of the Lord maketh the hinds to calve, and discovereth the forests: and in his temple doth every one speak of <hi type="italic">his</hi> glory.

verses.name: Psalms 29:10
verses.text: The Lord sitteth upon the flood; yea, the Lord sitteth King for ever.

verses.name: Psalms 29:11
verses.text: The Lord will give strength unto his people; the Lord will bless his people with peace.  <chapter eID="Ps.29"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv27"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">A Psalm <hi type="italic">and</hi> Song <hi type="italic">at</hi> the dedication of the house of David.</title> <div sID="gen528" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv27"/>I WILL extol thee, O Lord; for thou hast lifted me up, and hast not made my foes to rejoice over me.

verses.name: Psalms 30:2
verses.text: O Lord my God, I cried unto thee, and thou hast healed me.

verses.name: Psalms 30:3
verses.text: O Lord, thou hast brought up my soul from the grave: thou hast kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.

verses.name: Psalms 30:4
verses.text: Sing unto the Lord, O ye saints of his, and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.

verses.name: Psalms 30:5
verses.text: For his anger <hi type="italic">endureth but</hi> a moment; in his favour <hi type="italic">is</hi> life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy <hi type="italic">cometh</hi> in the morning.

verses.name: Psalms 30:6
verses.text: And in my prosperity I said, I shall never be moved.

verses.name: Psalms 30:7
verses.text: Lord, by thy favour thou hast made my mountain to stand strong: thou didst hide thy face, <hi type="italic">and</hi> I was troubled.

verses.name: Psalms 30:8
verses.text: I cried to thee, O Lord; and unto the Lord I made supplication.

verses.name: Psalms 30:9
verses.text: What profit <hi type="italic">is there</hi> in my blood, when I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise thee? shall it declare thy truth?

verses.name: Psalms 30:10
verses.text: Hear, O Lord, and have mercy upon me: Lord, be thou my helper.

verses.name: Psalms 30:11
verses.text: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing: thou hast put off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;

verses.name: Psalms 30:12
verses.text: To the end that <hi type="italic">my</hi> glory may sing praise to thee, and not be silent. O Lord my God, I will give thanks unto thee for ever.  <chapter eID="Ps.30"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv28"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.</title> <div sID="gen529" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv28"/>IN thee, O Lord, do I put my trust; let me never be ashamed: deliver me in thy righteousness.

verses.name: Psalms 31:2
verses.text: Bow down thine ear to me; deliver me speedily: be thou my strong rock, for an house of defence to save me.

verses.name: Psalms 31:3
verses.text: For thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> my rock and my fortress; therefore for thy name’s sake lead me, and guide me.

verses.name: Psalms 31:4
verses.text: Pull me out of the net that they have laid privily for me: for thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> my strength.

verses.name: Psalms 31:5
verses.text: Into thine hand I commit my spirit: thou hast redeemed me, O Lord God of truth.

verses.name: Psalms 31:6
verses.text: I have hated them that regard lying vanities: but I trust in the Lord.

verses.name: Psalms 31:7
verses.text: I will be glad and rejoice in thy mercy: for thou hast considered my trouble; thou hast known my soul in adversities;

verses.name: Psalms 31:8
verses.text: And hast not shut me up into the hand of the enemy: thou hast set my feet in a large room.

verses.name: Psalms 31:9
verses.text: Have mercy upon me, O Lord, for I am in trouble: mine eye is consumed with grief, <hi type="italic">yea</hi>, my soul and my belly.

verses.name: Psalms 31:10
verses.text: For my life is spent with grief, and my years with sighing: my strength faileth because of mine iniquity, and my bones are consumed.

verses.name: Psalms 31:11
verses.text: I was a reproach among all mine enemies, but especially among my neighbours, and a fear to mine acquaintance: they that did see me without fled from me.

verses.name: Psalms 31:12
verses.text: I am forgotten as a dead man out of mind: I am like a broken vessel.

verses.name: Psalms 31:13
verses.text: For I have heard the slander of many: fear <hi type="italic">was</hi> on every side: while they took counsel together against me, they devised to take away my life.

verses.name: Psalms 31:14
verses.text: But I trusted in thee, O Lord: I said, Thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> my God.

verses.name: Psalms 31:15
verses.text: My times <hi type="italic">are</hi> in thy hand: deliver me from the hand of mine enemies, and from them that persecute me.

verses.name: Psalms 31:16
verses.text: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant: save me for thy mercies’ sake.

verses.name: Psalms 31:17
verses.text: Let me not be ashamed, O Lord; for I have called upon thee: let the wicked be ashamed, <hi type="italic">and</hi> let them be silent in the grave.

verses.name: Psalms 31:18
verses.text: Let the lying lips be put to silence; which speak grievous things proudly and contemptuously against the righteous.

verses.name: Psalms 31:19
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Oh</hi> how great <hi type="italic">is</hi> thy goodness, which thou hast laid up for them that fear thee; <hi type="italic">which</hi> thou hast wrought for them that trust in thee before the sons of men!

verses.name: Psalms 31:20
verses.text: Thou shalt hide them in the secret of thy presence from the pride of man: thou shalt keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.

verses.name: Psalms 31:21
verses.text: Blessed <hi type="italic">be</hi> the Lord: for he hath shewed me his marvellous kindness in a strong city.

verses.name: Psalms 31:22
verses.text: For I said in my haste, I am cut off from before thine eyes: nevertheless thou heardest the voice of my supplications when I cried unto thee.

verses.name: Psalms 31:23
verses.text: O love the Lord, all ye his saints: <hi type="italic">for</hi> the Lord preserveth the faithful, and plentifully rewardeth the proud doer.

verses.name: Psalms 31:24
verses.text: Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all ye that hope in the Lord.  <chapter eID="Ps.31"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv29"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><hi type="italic">A Psalm</hi> of David, Maschil.</title> <div sID="gen530" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv29"/>BLESSED <hi type="italic">is he whose</hi> transgression <hi type="italic">is</hi> forgiven, <hi type="italic">whose</hi> sin <hi type="italic">is</hi> covered.

verses.name: Psalms 32:2
verses.text: Blessed <hi type="italic">is</hi> the man unto whom the Lord imputeth not iniquity, and in whose spirit <hi type="italic">there is</hi> no guile.

verses.name: Psalms 32:3
verses.text: When I kept silence, my bones waxed old through my roaring all the day long.

verses.name: Psalms 32:4
verses.text: For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me: my moisture is turned into the drought of summer. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 32:5
verses.text: I acknowledged my sin unto thee, and mine iniquity have I not hid. I said, I will confess my transgressions unto the Lord; and thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 32:6
verses.text: For this shall every one that is godly pray unto thee in a time when thou mayest be found: surely in the floods of great waters they shall not come nigh unto him.

verses.name: Psalms 32:7
verses.text: Thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> my hiding place; thou shalt preserve me from trouble; thou shalt compass me about with songs of deliverance. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 32:8
verses.text: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will guide thee with mine eye.

verses.name: Psalms 32:9
verses.text: Be ye not as the horse, <hi type="italic">or</hi> as the mule, <hi type="italic">which</hi> have no understanding: whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, lest they come near unto thee.

verses.name: Psalms 32:10
verses.text: Many sorrows <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> to the wicked: but he that trusteth in the Lord, mercy shall compass him about.

verses.name: Psalms 32:11
verses.text: Be glad in the Lord, and rejoice, ye righteous: and shout for joy, all <hi type="italic">ye that are</hi> upright in heart.  <chapter eID="Ps.32"/><div eID="gen530" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:1
verses.text: REJOICE in the Lord, O ye righteous: <hi type="italic">for</hi> praise is comely for the upright.

verses.name: Psalms 33:2
verses.text: Praise the Lord with harp: sing unto him with the psaltery <hi type="italic">and</hi> an instrument of ten strings.

verses.name: Psalms 33:3
verses.text: Sing unto him a new song; play skilfully with a loud noise.

verses.name: Psalms 33:4
verses.text: For the word of the Lord <hi type="italic">is</hi> right; and all his works <hi type="italic">are done</hi> in truth.

verses.name: Psalms 33:5
verses.text: He loveth righteousness and judgment: the earth is full of the goodness of the Lord.

verses.name: Psalms 33:6
verses.text: By the word of the Lord were the heavens made; and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.

verses.name: Psalms 33:7
verses.text: He gathereth the waters of the sea together as an heap: he layeth up the depth in storehouses.

verses.name: Psalms 33:8
verses.text: Let all the earth fear the Lord: let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.

verses.name: Psalms 33:9
verses.text: For he spake, and it was <hi type="italic">done;</hi> he commanded, and it stood fast.

verses.name: Psalms 33:10
verses.text: The Lord bringeth the counsel of the heathen to nought: he maketh the devices of the people of none effect.

verses.name: Psalms 33:11
verses.text: The counsel of the Lord standeth for ever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.

verses.name: Psalms 33:12
verses.text: Blessed <hi type="italic">is</hi> the nation whose God <hi type="italic">is</hi> the Lord; <hi type="italic">and</hi> the people <hi type="italic">whom</hi> he hath chosen for his own inheritance.

verses.name: Psalms 33:13
verses.text: The Lord looketh from heaven; he beholdeth all the sons of men.

verses.name: Psalms 33:14
verses.text: From the place of his habitation he looketh upon all the inhabitants of the earth.

verses.name: Psalms 33:15
verses.text: He fashioneth their hearts alike; he considereth all their works.

verses.name: Psalms 33:16
verses.text: There is no king saved by the multitude of an host: a mighty man is not delivered by much strength.

verses.name: Psalms 33:17
verses.text: An horse <hi type="italic">is</hi> a vain thing for safety: neither shall he deliver <hi type="italic">any</hi> by his great strength.

verses.name: Psalms 33:18
verses.text: Behold, the eye of the Lord <hi type="italic">is</hi> upon them that fear him, upon them that hope in his mercy;

verses.name: Psalms 33:19
verses.text: To deliver their soul from death, and to keep them alive in famine.

verses.name: Psalms 33:20
verses.text: Our soul waiteth for the Lord: he <hi type="italic">is</hi> our help and our shield.

verses.name: Psalms 33:21
verses.text: For our heart shall rejoice in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.

verses.name: Psalms 33:22
verses.text: Let thy mercy, O Lord, be upon us, according as we hope in thee.  <chapter eID="Ps.33"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv30"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><hi type="italic">A Psalm</hi> of David, when he changed his behaviour before Abimelech; who drove him away, and he departed.</title> <div sID="gen532" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv30"/>I WILL bless the Lord at all times: his praise <hi type="italic">shall</hi> continually <hi type="italic">be</hi> in my mouth.

verses.name: Psalms 34:2
verses.text: My soul shall make her boast in the Lord: the humble shall hear <hi type="italic">thereof</hi>, and be glad.

verses.name: Psalms 34:3
verses.text: O magnify the Lord with me, and let us exalt his name together.

verses.name: Psalms 34:4
verses.text: I sought the Lord, and he heard me, and delivered me from all my fears.

verses.name: Psalms 34:5
verses.text: They looked unto him, and were lightened: and their faces were not ashamed.

verses.name: Psalms 34:6
verses.text: This poor man cried, and the Lord heard <hi type="italic">him</hi>, and saved him out of all his troubles.

verses.name: Psalms 34:7
verses.text: The angel of the Lord encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivereth them.

verses.name: Psalms 34:8
verses.text: O taste and see that the Lord <hi type="italic">is</hi> good: blessed <hi type="italic">is</hi> the man <hi type="italic">that</hi> trusteth in him.

verses.name: Psalms 34:9
verses.text: O fear the Lord, ye his saints: for <hi type="italic">there is</hi> no want to them that fear him.

verses.name: Psalms 34:10
verses.text: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger: but they that seek the Lord shall not want any good <hi type="italic">thing</hi>.

verses.name: Psalms 34:11
verses.text: Come, ye children, hearken unto me: I will teach you the fear of the Lord.

verses.name: Psalms 34:12
verses.text: What man <hi type="italic">is he that</hi> desireth life, <hi type="italic">and</hi> loveth <hi type="italic">many</hi> days, that he may see good?

verses.name: Psalms 34:13
verses.text: Keep thy tongue from evil, and thy lips from speaking guile.

verses.name: Psalms 34:14
verses.text: Depart from evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it.

verses.name: Psalms 34:15
verses.text: The eyes of the Lord <hi type="italic">are</hi> upon the righteous, and his ears <hi type="italic">are open</hi> unto their cry.

verses.name: Psalms 34:16
verses.text: The face of the Lord <hi type="italic">is</hi> against them that do evil, to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.

verses.name: Psalms 34:17
verses.text: <hi type="italic">The righteous</hi> cry, and the Lord heareth, and delivereth them out of all their troubles.

verses.name: Psalms 34:18
verses.text: The Lord <hi type="italic">is</hi> nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.

verses.name: Psalms 34:19
verses.text: Many <hi type="italic">are</hi> the afflictions of the righteous: but the Lord delivereth him out of them all.

verses.name: Psalms 34:20
verses.text: He keepeth all his bones: not one of them is broken.

verses.name: Psalms 34:21
verses.text: Evil shall slay the wicked: and they that hate the righteous shall be desolate.

verses.name: Psalms 34:22
verses.text: The Lord redeemeth the soul of his servants: and none of them that trust in him shall be desolate.  <chapter eID="Ps.34"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv31"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><hi type="italic">A Psalm</hi> of David.</title> <div sID="gen533" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv31"/>PLEAD <hi type="italic">my cause</hi>, O Lord, with them that strive with me: fight against them that fight against me.

verses.name: Psalms 35:2
verses.text: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for mine help.

verses.name: Psalms 35:3
verses.text: Draw out also the spear, and stop <hi type="italic">the way</hi> against them that persecute me: say unto my soul, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> thy salvation.

verses.name: Psalms 35:4
verses.text: Let them be confounded and put to shame that seek after my soul: let them be turned back and brought to confusion that devise my hurt.

verses.name: Psalms 35:5
verses.text: Let them be as chaff before the wind: and let the angel of the Lord chase <hi type="italic">them</hi>.

verses.name: Psalms 35:6
verses.text: Let their way be dark and slippery: and let the angel of the Lord persecute them.

verses.name: Psalms 35:7
verses.text: For without cause have they hid for me their net <hi type="italic">in</hi> a pit, <hi type="italic">which</hi> without cause they have digged for my soul.

verses.name: Psalms 35:8
verses.text: Let destruction come upon him at unawares; and let his net that he hath hid catch himself: into that very destruction let him fall.

verses.name: Psalms 35:9
verses.text: And my soul shall be joyful in the Lord: it shall rejoice in his salvation.

verses.name: Psalms 35:10
verses.text: All my bones shall say, Lord, who <hi type="italic">is</hi> like unto thee, which deliverest the poor from him that is too strong for him, yea, the poor and the needy from him that spoileth him?

verses.name: Psalms 35:11
verses.text: False witnesses did rise up; they laid to my charge <hi type="italic">things</hi> that I knew not.

verses.name: Psalms 35:12
verses.text: They rewarded me evil for good <hi type="italic">to</hi> the spoiling of my soul.

verses.name: Psalms 35:13
verses.text: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing <hi type="italic">was</hi> sackcloth: I humbled my soul with fasting; and my prayer returned into mine own bosom.

verses.name: Psalms 35:14
verses.text: I behaved myself as though <hi type="italic">he had been</hi> my friend <hi type="italic">or</hi> brother: I bowed down heavily, as one that mourneth <hi type="italic">for his</hi> mother.

verses.name: Psalms 35:15
verses.text: But in mine adversity they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together: <hi type="italic">yea</hi>, the abjects gathered themselves together against me, and I knew <hi type="italic">it</hi> not; they did tear <hi type="italic">me</hi>, and ceased not:

verses.name: Psalms 35:16
verses.text: With hypocritical mockers in feasts, they gnashed upon me with their teeth.

verses.name: Psalms 35:17
verses.text: Lord, how long wilt thou look on? rescue my soul from their destructions, my darling from the lions.

verses.name: Psalms 35:18
verses.text: I will give thee thanks in the great congregation: I will praise thee among much people.

verses.name: Psalms 35:19
verses.text: Let not them that are mine enemies wrongfully rejoice over me: <hi type="italic">neither</hi> let them wink with the eye that hate me without a cause.

verses.name: Psalms 35:20
verses.text: For they speak not peace: but they devise deceitful matters against <hi type="italic">them that are</hi> quiet in the land.

verses.name: Psalms 35:21
verses.text: Yea, they opened their mouth wide against me, <hi type="italic">and</hi> said, Aha, aha, our eye hath seen <hi type="italic">it</hi>.

verses.name: Psalms 35:22
verses.text: <hi type="italic">This</hi> thou hast seen, O Lord: keep not silence: O Lord, be not far from me.

verses.name: Psalms 35:23
verses.text: Stir up thyself, and awake to my judgment, <hi type="italic">even</hi> unto my cause, my God and my Lord.

verses.name: Psalms 35:24
verses.text: Judge me, O Lord my God, according to thy righteousness; and let them not rejoice over me.

verses.name: Psalms 35:25
verses.text: Let them not say in their hearts, Ah, so would we have it: let them not say, We have swallowed him up.

verses.name: Psalms 35:26
verses.text: Let them be ashamed and brought to confusion together that rejoice at mine hurt: let them be clothed with shame and dishonour that magnify <hi type="italic">themselves</hi> against me.

verses.name: Psalms 35:27
verses.text: Let them shout for joy, and be glad, that favour my righteous cause: yea, let them say continually, Let the Lord be magnified, which hath pleasure in the prosperity of his servant.

verses.name: Psalms 35:28
verses.text: And my tongue shall speak of thy righteousness <hi type="italic">and</hi> of thy praise all the day long.  <chapter eID="Ps.35"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv32"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">To the chief Musician, <hi type="italic">A Psalm</hi> of David the servant of the Lord.</title> <div sID="gen534" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv32"/>THE transgression of the wicked saith within my heart, <hi type="italic">that there is</hi> no fear of God before his eyes.

verses.name: Psalms 36:2
verses.text: For he flattereth himself in his own eyes, until his iniquity be found to be hateful.

verses.name: Psalms 36:3
verses.text: The words of his mouth <hi type="italic">are</hi> iniquity and deceit: he hath left off to be wise, <hi type="italic">and</hi> to do good.

verses.name: Psalms 36:4
verses.text: He deviseth mischief upon his bed; he setteth himself in a way <hi type="italic">that is</hi> not good; he abhorreth not evil.

verses.name: Psalms 36:5
verses.text: Thy mercy, O Lord, <hi type="italic">is</hi> in the heavens; <hi type="italic">and</hi> thy faithfulness <hi type="italic">reacheth</hi> unto the clouds.

verses.name: Psalms 36:6
verses.text: Thy righteousness <hi type="italic">is</hi> like the great mountains; thy judgments <hi type="italic">are</hi> a great deep: O Lord, thou preservest man and beast.

verses.name: Psalms 36:7
verses.text: How excellent <hi type="italic">is</hi> thy lovingkindness, O God! therefore the children of men put their trust under the shadow of thy wings.

verses.name: Psalms 36:8
verses.text: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the fatness of thy house; and thou shalt make them drink of the river of thy pleasures.

verses.name: Psalms 36:9
verses.text: For with thee <hi type="italic">is</hi> the fountain of life: in thy light shall we see light.

verses.name: Psalms 36:10
verses.text: O continue thy lovingkindness unto them that know thee; and thy righteousness to the upright in heart.

verses.name: Psalms 36:11
verses.text: Let not the foot of pride come against me, and let not the hand of the wicked remove me.

verses.name: Psalms 36:12
verses.text: There are the workers of iniquity fallen: they are cast down, and shall not be able to rise.  <chapter eID="Ps.36"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv33"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><hi type="italic">A Psalm</hi> of David.</title> <div sID="gen535" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv33"/>FRET not thyself because of evildoers, neither be thou envious against the workers of iniquity.

verses.name: Psalms 37:2
verses.text: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither as the green herb.

verses.name: Psalms 37:3
verses.text: Trust in the Lord, and do good; <hi type="italic">so</hi> shalt thou dwell in the land, and verily thou shalt be fed.

verses.name: Psalms 37:4
verses.text: Delight thyself also in the Lord; and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.

verses.name: Psalms 37:5
verses.text: Commit thy way unto the Lord; trust also in him; and he shall bring <hi type="italic">it</hi> to pass.

verses.name: Psalms 37:6
verses.text: And he shall bring forth thy righteousness as the light, and thy judgment as the noonday.

verses.name: Psalms 37:7
verses.text: Rest in the Lord, and wait patiently for him: fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass.

verses.name: Psalms 37:8
verses.text: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: fret not thyself in any wise to do evil.

verses.name: Psalms 37:9
verses.text: For evildoers shall be cut off: but those that wait upon the Lord, they shall inherit the earth.

verses.name: Psalms 37:10
verses.text: For yet a little while, and the wicked <hi type="italic">shall</hi> not <hi type="italic">be:</hi> yea, thou shalt diligently consider his place, and it <hi type="italic">shall</hi> not <hi type="italic">be</hi>.

verses.name: Psalms 37:11
verses.text: But the meek shall inherit the earth; and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.

verses.name: Psalms 37:12
verses.text: The wicked plotteth against the just, and gnasheth upon him with his teeth.

verses.name: Psalms 37:13
verses.text: The Lord shall laugh at him: for he seeth that his day is coming.

verses.name: Psalms 37:14
verses.text: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, <hi type="italic">and</hi> to slay such as be of upright conversation.

verses.name: Psalms 37:15
verses.text: Their sword shall enter into their own heart, and their bows shall be broken.

verses.name: Psalms 37:16
verses.text: A little that a righteous man hath <hi type="italic">is</hi> better than the riches of many wicked.

verses.name: Psalms 37:17
verses.text: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken: but the Lord upholdeth the righteous.

verses.name: Psalms 37:18
verses.text: The Lord knoweth the days of the upright: and their inheritance shall be for ever.

verses.name: Psalms 37:19
verses.text: They shall not be ashamed in the evil time: and in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.

verses.name: Psalms 37:20
verses.text: But the wicked shall perish, and the enemies of the Lord <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> as the fat of lambs: they shall consume; into smoke shall they consume away.

verses.name: Psalms 37:21
verses.text: The wicked borroweth, and payeth not again: but the righteous sheweth mercy, and giveth.

verses.name: Psalms 37:22
verses.text: For <hi type="italic">such as be</hi> blessed of him shall inherit the earth; and <hi type="italic">they that be</hi> cursed of him shall be cut off.

verses.name: Psalms 37:23
verses.text: The steps of a <hi type="italic">good</hi> man are ordered by the Lord: and he delighteth in his way.

verses.name: Psalms 37:24
verses.text: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down: for the Lord upholdeth <hi type="italic">him with</hi> his hand.

verses.name: Psalms 37:25
verses.text: I have been young, and <hi type="italic">now</hi> am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread.

verses.name: Psalms 37:26
verses.text: <hi type="italic">He is</hi> ever merciful, and lendeth; and his seed <hi type="italic">is</hi> blessed.

verses.name: Psalms 37:27
verses.text: Depart from evil, and do good; and dwell for evermore.

verses.name: Psalms 37:28
verses.text: For the Lord loveth judgment, and forsaketh not his saints; they are preserved for ever: but the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.

verses.name: Psalms 37:29
verses.text: The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell therein for ever.

verses.name: Psalms 37:30
verses.text: The mouth of the righteous speaketh wisdom, and his tongue talketh of judgment.

verses.name: Psalms 37:31
verses.text: The law of his God <hi type="italic">is</hi> in his heart; none of his steps shall slide.

verses.name: Psalms 37:32
verses.text: The wicked watcheth the righteous, and seeketh to slay him.

verses.name: Psalms 37:33
verses.text: The Lord will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.

verses.name: Psalms 37:34
verses.text: Wait on the Lord, and keep his way, and he shall exalt thee to inherit the land: when the wicked are cut off, thou shalt see <hi type="italic">it</hi>.

verses.name: Psalms 37:35
verses.text: I have seen the wicked in great power, and spreading himself like a green bay tree.

verses.name: Psalms 37:36
verses.text: Yet he passed away, and, lo, he <hi type="italic">was</hi> not: yea, I sought him, but he could not be found.

verses.name: Psalms 37:37
verses.text: Mark the perfect <hi type="italic">man</hi>, and behold the upright: for the end of <hi type="italic">that</hi> man <hi type="italic">is</hi> peace.

verses.name: Psalms 37:38
verses.text: But the transgressors shall be destroyed together: the end of the wicked shall be cut off.

verses.name: Psalms 37:39
verses.text: But the salvation of the righteous <hi type="italic">is</hi> of the Lord: <hi type="italic">he is</hi> their strength in the time of trouble.

verses.name: Psalms 37:40
verses.text: And the Lord shall help them, and deliver them: he shall deliver them from the wicked, and save them, because they trust in him.  <chapter eID="Ps.37"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv34"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">A Psalm of David, to bring to remembrance.</title> <div sID="gen536" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv34"/>O LORD, rebuke me not in thy wrath: neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.

verses.name: Psalms 38:2
verses.text: For thine arrows stick fast in me, and thy hand presseth me sore.

verses.name: Psalms 38:3
verses.text: <hi type="italic">There is</hi> no soundness in my flesh because of thine anger; neither <hi type="italic">is there any</hi> rest in my bones because of my sin.

verses.name: Psalms 38:4
verses.text: For mine iniquities are gone over mine head: as an heavy burden they are too heavy for me.

verses.name: Psalms 38:5
verses.text: My wounds stink <hi type="italic">and</hi> are corrupt because of my foolishness.

verses.name: Psalms 38:6
verses.text: I am troubled; I am bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day long.

verses.name: Psalms 38:7
verses.text: For my loins are filled with a loathsome <hi type="italic">disease:</hi> and <hi type="italic">there is</hi> no soundness in my flesh.

verses.name: Psalms 38:8
verses.text: I am feeble and sore broken: I have roared by reason of the disquietness of my heart.

verses.name: Psalms 38:9
verses.text: Lord, all my desire <hi type="italic">is</hi> before thee; and my groaning is not hid from thee.

verses.name: Psalms 38:10
verses.text: My heart panteth, my strength faileth me: as for the light of mine eyes, it also is gone from me.

verses.name: Psalms 38:11
verses.text: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my sore; and my kinsmen stand afar off.

verses.name: Psalms 38:12
verses.text: They also that seek after my life lay snares <hi type="italic">for me:</hi> and they that seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and imagine deceits all the day long.

verses.name: Psalms 38:13
verses.text: But I, as a deaf <hi type="italic">man</hi>, heard not; and <hi type="italic">I was</hi> as a dumb man <hi type="italic">that</hi> openeth not his mouth.

verses.name: Psalms 38:14
verses.text: Thus I was as a man that heareth not, and in whose mouth <hi type="italic">are</hi> no reproofs.

verses.name: Psalms 38:15
verses.text: For in thee, O Lord, do I hope: thou wilt hear, O Lord my God.

verses.name: Psalms 38:16
verses.text: For I said, <hi type="italic">Hear me</hi>, lest <hi type="italic">otherwise</hi> they should rejoice over me: when my foot slippeth, they magnify <hi type="italic">themselves</hi> against me.

verses.name: Psalms 38:17
verses.text: For I <hi type="italic">am</hi> ready to halt, and my sorrow <hi type="italic">is</hi> continually before me.

verses.name: Psalms 38:18
verses.text: For I will declare mine iniquity; I will be sorry for my sin.

verses.name: Psalms 38:19
verses.text: But mine enemies <hi type="italic">are</hi> lively, <hi type="italic">and</hi> they are strong: and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.

verses.name: Psalms 38:20
verses.text: They also that render evil for good are mine adversaries; because I follow <hi type="italic">the thing that</hi> good <hi type="italic">is</hi>.

verses.name: Psalms 38:21
verses.text: Forsake me not, O Lord: O my God, be not far from me.

verses.name: Psalms 38:22
verses.text: Make haste to help me, O Lord my salvation.  <chapter eID="Ps.38"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv35"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">To the chief Musician, <hi type="italic">even</hi> to Jeduthun, A Psalm of David.</title> <div sID="gen537" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv35"/>I SAID, I will take heed to my ways, that I sin not with my tongue: I will keep my mouth with a bridle, while the wicked is before me.

verses.name: Psalms 39:2
verses.text: I was dumb with silence, I held my peace, <hi type="italic">even</hi> from good; and my sorrow was stirred.

verses.name: Psalms 39:3
verses.text: My heart was hot within me, while I was musing the fire burned: <hi type="italic">then</hi> spake I with my tongue,

verses.name: Psalms 39:4
verses.text: Lord, make me to know mine end, and the measure of my days, what it <hi type="italic">is; that</hi> I may know how frail I <hi type="italic">am</hi>.

verses.name: Psalms 39:5
verses.text: Behold, thou hast made my days <hi type="italic">as</hi> an handbreadth; and mine age <hi type="italic">is</hi> as nothing before thee: verily every man at his best state <hi type="italic">is</hi> altogether vanity. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 39:6
verses.text: Surely every man walketh in a vain shew: surely they are disquieted in vain: he heapeth up <hi type="italic">riches</hi>, and knoweth not who shall gather them.

verses.name: Psalms 39:7
verses.text: And now, Lord, what wait I for? my hope <hi type="italic">is</hi> in thee.

verses.name: Psalms 39:8
verses.text: Deliver me from all my transgressions: make me not the reproach of the foolish.

verses.name: Psalms 39:9
verses.text: I was dumb, I opened not my mouth; because thou didst <hi type="italic">it</hi>.

verses.name: Psalms 39:10
verses.text: Remove thy stroke away from me: I am consumed by the blow of thine hand.

verses.name: Psalms 39:11
verses.text: When thou with rebukes dost correct man for iniquity, thou makest his beauty to consume away like a moth: surely every man <hi type="italic">is</hi> vanity. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 39:12
verses.text: Hear my prayer, O Lord, and give ear unto my cry; hold not thy peace at my tears: for I <hi type="italic">am</hi> a stranger with thee, <hi type="italic">and</hi> a sojourner, as all my fathers <hi type="italic">were</hi>.

verses.name: Psalms 39:13
verses.text: O spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go hence, and be no more.  <chapter eID="Ps.39"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv36"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.</title> <div sID="gen538" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv36"/>I WAITED patiently for the Lord; and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.

verses.name: Psalms 40:2
verses.text: He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock, <hi type="italic">and</hi> established my goings.

verses.name: Psalms 40:3
verses.text: And he hath put a new song in my mouth, <hi type="italic">even</hi> praise unto our God: many shall see <hi type="italic">it</hi>, and fear, and shall trust in the Lord.

verses.name: Psalms 40:4
verses.text: Blessed <hi type="italic">is</hi> that man that maketh the Lord his trust, and respecteth not the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.

verses.name: Psalms 40:5
verses.text: Many, O Lord my God, <hi type="italic">are</hi> thy wonderful works <hi type="italic">which</hi> thou hast done, and thy thoughts <hi type="italic">which are</hi> to us-ward: they cannot be reckoned up in order unto thee: <hi type="italic">if</hi> I would declare and speak <hi type="italic">of them</hi>, they are more than can be numbered.

verses.name: Psalms 40:6
verses.text: Sacrifice and offering thou didst not desire; mine ears hast thou opened: burnt offering and sin offering hast thou not required.

verses.name: Psalms 40:7
verses.text: Then said I, Lo, I come: in the volume of the book <hi type="italic">it is</hi> written of me,

verses.name: Psalms 40:8
verses.text: I delight to do thy will, O my God: yea, thy law <hi type="italic">is</hi> within my heart.

verses.name: Psalms 40:9
verses.text: I have preached righteousness in the great congregation: lo, I have not refrained my lips, O Lord, thou knowest.

verses.name: Psalms 40:10
verses.text: I have not hid thy righteousness within my heart; I have declared thy faithfulness and thy salvation: I have not concealed thy lovingkindness and thy truth from the great congregation.

verses.name: Psalms 40:11
verses.text: Withhold not thou thy tender mercies from me, O Lord: let thy lovingkindness and thy truth continually preserve me.

verses.name: Psalms 40:12
verses.text: For innumerable evils have compassed me about: mine iniquities have taken hold upon me, so that I am not able to look up; they are more than the hairs of mine head: therefore my heart faileth me.

verses.name: Psalms 40:13
verses.text: Be pleased, O Lord, to deliver me: O Lord, make haste to help me.

verses.name: Psalms 40:14
verses.text: Let them be ashamed and confounded together that seek after my soul to destroy it; let them be driven backward and put to shame that wish me evil.

verses.name: Psalms 40:15
verses.text: Let them be desolate for a reward of their shame that say unto me, Aha, aha.

verses.name: Psalms 40:16
verses.text: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: let such as love thy salvation say continually, The Lord be magnified.

verses.name: Psalms 40:17
verses.text: But I <hi type="italic">am</hi> poor and needy; <hi type="italic">yet</hi> the Lord thinketh upon me: thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> my help and my deliverer; make no tarrying, O my God.  <chapter eID="Ps.40"/>

verses.name: Psalms 41:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv37"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.</title> <div sID="gen539" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv37"/>BLESSED <hi type="italic">is</hi> he that considereth the poor: the Lord will deliver him in time of trouble.

verses.name: Psalms 41:2
verses.text: The Lord will preserve him, and keep him alive; <hi type="italic">and</hi> he shall be blessed upon the earth: and thou wilt not deliver him unto the will of his enemies.

verses.name: Psalms 41:3
verses.text: The Lord will strengthen him upon the bed of languishing: thou wilt make all his bed in his sickness.

verses.name: Psalms 41:4
verses.text: I said, Lord, be merciful unto me: heal my soul; for I have sinned against thee.

verses.name: Psalms 41:5
verses.text: Mine enemies speak evil of me, When shall he die, and his name perish?

verses.name: Psalms 41:6
verses.text: And if he come to see <hi type="italic">me</hi>, he speaketh vanity: his heart gathereth iniquity to itself; <hi type="italic">when</hi> he goeth abroad, he telleth <hi type="italic">it</hi>.

verses.name: Psalms 41:7
verses.text: All that hate me whisper together against me: against me do they devise my hurt.

verses.name: Psalms 41:8
verses.text: An evil disease, <hi type="italic">say they</hi>, cleaveth fast unto him: and <hi type="italic">now</hi> that he lieth he shall rise up no more.

verses.name: Psalms 41:9
verses.text: Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, which did eat of my bread, hath lifted up <hi type="italic">his</hi> heel against me.

verses.name: Psalms 41:10
verses.text: But thou, O Lord, be merciful unto me, and raise me up, that I may requite them.

verses.name: Psalms 41:11
verses.text: By this I know that thou favourest me, because mine enemy doth not triumph over me.

verses.name: Psalms 41:12
verses.text: And as for me, thou upholdest me in mine integrity, and settest me before thy face for ever.

verses.name: Psalms 41:13
verses.text: Blessed <hi type="italic">be</hi> the Lord God of Israel from everlasting, and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen.  <chapter eID="Ps.41"/>

verses.name: Psalms 42:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv38"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">To the chief Musician, Maschil, for the sons of Korah.</title> <div sID="gen540" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv38"/>AS the hart panteth after the water brooks, so panteth my soul after thee, O God.

verses.name: Psalms 42:2
verses.text: My soul thirsteth for God, for the living God: when shall I come and appear before God?

verses.name: Psalms 42:3
verses.text: My tears have been my meat day and night, while they continually say unto me, Where <hi type="italic">is</hi> thy God?

verses.name: Psalms 42:4
verses.text: When I remember these <hi type="italic">things</hi>, I pour out my soul in me: for I had gone with the multitude, I went with them to the house of God, with the voice of joy and praise, with a multitude that kept holyday.

verses.name: Psalms 42:5
verses.text: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and <hi type="italic">why</hi> art thou disquieted in me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him <hi type="italic">for</hi> the help of his countenance.

verses.name: Psalms 42:6
verses.text: O my God, my soul is cast down within me: therefore will I remember thee from the land of Jordan, and of the Hermonites, from the hill Mizar.

verses.name: Psalms 42:7
verses.text: Deep calleth unto deep at the noise of thy waterspouts: all thy waves and thy billows are gone over me.

verses.name: Psalms 42:8
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Yet</hi> the Lord will command his lovingkindness in the daytime, and in the night his song <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> with me, <hi type="italic">and</hi> my prayer unto the God of my life.

verses.name: Psalms 42:9
verses.text: I will say unto God my rock, Why hast thou forgotten me? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

verses.name: Psalms 42:10
verses.text: <hi type="italic">As</hi> with a sword in my bones, mine enemies reproach me; while they say daily unto me, Where <hi type="italic">is</hi> thy God?

verses.name: Psalms 42:11
verses.text: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him, <hi type="italic">who is</hi> the health of my countenance, and my God.  <chapter eID="Ps.42"/><div eID="gen540" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 43:1
verses.text: JUDGE me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation: O deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man.

verses.name: Psalms 43:2
verses.text: For thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> the God of my strength: why dost thou cast me off? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

verses.name: Psalms 43:3
verses.text: O send out thy light and thy truth: let them lead me; let them bring me unto thy holy hill, and to thy tabernacles.

verses.name: Psalms 43:4
verses.text: Then will I go unto the altar of God, unto God my exceeding joy: yea, upon the harp will I praise thee, O God my God.

verses.name: Psalms 43:5
verses.text: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope in God: for I shall yet praise him, <hi type="italic">who is</hi> the health of my countenance, and my God.  <chapter eID="Ps.43"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv39"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, Maschil.</title> <div sID="gen542" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv39"/>WE have heard with our ears, O God, our fathers have told us, <hi type="italic">what</hi> work thou didst in their days, in the times of old.

verses.name: Psalms 44:2
verses.text: <hi type="italic">How</hi> thou didst drive out the heathen with thy hand, and plantedst them; <hi type="italic">how</hi> thou didst afflict the people, and cast them out.

verses.name: Psalms 44:3
verses.text: For they got not the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them: but thy right hand, and thine arm, and the light of thy countenance, because thou hadst a favour unto them.

verses.name: Psalms 44:4
verses.text: Thou art my King, O God: command deliverances for Jacob.

verses.name: Psalms 44:5
verses.text: Through thee will we push down our enemies: through thy name will we tread them under that rise up against us.

verses.name: Psalms 44:6
verses.text: For I will not trust in my bow, neither shall my sword save me.

verses.name: Psalms 44:7
verses.text: But thou hast saved us from our enemies, and hast put them to shame that hated us.

verses.name: Psalms 44:8
verses.text: In God we boast all the day long, and praise thy name for ever. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 44:9
verses.text: But thou hast cast off, and put us to shame; and goest not forth with our armies.

verses.name: Psalms 44:10
verses.text: Thou makest us to turn back from the enemy: and they which hate us spoil for themselves.

verses.name: Psalms 44:11
verses.text: Thou hast given us like sheep <hi type="italic">appointed</hi> for meat; and hast scattered us among the heathen.

verses.name: Psalms 44:12
verses.text: Thou sellest thy people for nought, and dost not increase <hi type="italic">thy wealth</hi> by their price.

verses.name: Psalms 44:13
verses.text: Thou makest us a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and a derision to them that are round about us.

verses.name: Psalms 44:14
verses.text: Thou makest us a byword among the heathen, a shaking of the head among the people.

verses.name: Psalms 44:15
verses.text: My confusion <hi type="italic">is</hi> continually before me, and the shame of my face hath covered me,

verses.name: Psalms 44:16
verses.text: For the voice of him that reproacheth and blasphemeth; by reason of the enemy and avenger.

verses.name: Psalms 44:17
verses.text: All this is come upon us; yet have we not forgotten thee, neither have we dealt falsely in thy covenant.

verses.name: Psalms 44:18
verses.text: Our heart is not turned back, neither have our steps declined from thy way;

verses.name: Psalms 44:19
verses.text: Though thou hast sore broken us in the place of dragons, and covered us with the shadow of death.

verses.name: Psalms 44:20
verses.text: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or stretched out our hands to a strange god;

verses.name: Psalms 44:21
verses.text: Shall not God search this out? for he knoweth the secrets of the heart.

verses.name: Psalms 44:22
verses.text: Yea, for thy sake are we killed all the day long; we are counted as sheep for the slaughter.

verses.name: Psalms 44:23
verses.text: Awake, why sleepest thou, O Lord? arise, cast <hi type="italic">us</hi> not off for ever.

verses.name: Psalms 44:24
verses.text: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, <hi type="italic">and</hi> forgettest our affliction and our oppression?

verses.name: Psalms 44:25
verses.text: For our soul is bowed down to the dust: our belly cleaveth unto the earth.

verses.name: Psalms 44:26
verses.text: Arise for our help, and redeem us for thy mercies’ sake.  <chapter eID="Ps.44"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv40"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">To the chief Musician upon Shoshannim, for the sons of Korah, Maschil, A Song of loves.</title> <div sID="gen543" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv40"/>MY heart is inditing a good matter: I speak of the things which I have made touching the king: my tongue <hi type="italic">is</hi> the pen of a ready writer.

verses.name: Psalms 45:2
verses.text: Thou art fairer than the children of men: grace is poured into thy lips: therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.

verses.name: Psalms 45:3
verses.text: Gird thy sword upon <hi type="italic">thy</hi> thigh, O <hi type="italic">most</hi> mighty, with thy glory and thy majesty.

verses.name: Psalms 45:4
verses.text: And in thy majesty ride prosperously because of truth and meekness <hi type="italic">and</hi> righteousness; and thy right hand shall teach thee terrible things.

verses.name: Psalms 45:5
verses.text: Thine arrows <hi type="italic">are</hi> sharp in the heart of the king’s enemies; <hi type="italic">whereby</hi> the people fall under thee.

verses.name: Psalms 45:6
verses.text: Thy throne, O God, <hi type="italic">is</hi> for ever and ever: the sceptre of thy kingdom <hi type="italic">is</hi> a right sceptre.

verses.name: Psalms 45:7
verses.text: Thou lovest righteousness, and hatest wickedness: therefore God, thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.

verses.name: Psalms 45:8
verses.text: All thy garments <hi type="italic">smell</hi> of myrrh, and aloes, <hi type="italic">and</hi> cassia, out of the ivory palaces, whereby they have made thee glad.

verses.name: Psalms 45:9
verses.text: Kings’ daughters <hi type="italic">were</hi> among thy honourable women: upon thy right hand did stand the queen in gold of Ophir.

verses.name: Psalms 45:10
verses.text: Hearken, O daughter, and consider, and incline thine ear; forget also thine own people, and thy father’s house;

verses.name: Psalms 45:11
verses.text: So shall the king greatly desire thy beauty: for he <hi type="italic">is</hi> thy Lord; and worship thou him.

verses.name: Psalms 45:12
verses.text: And the daughter of Tyre <hi type="italic">shall be there</hi> with a gift; <hi type="italic">even</hi> the rich among the people shall intreat thy favour.

verses.name: Psalms 45:13
verses.text: The king’s daughter <hi type="italic">is</hi> all glorious within: her clothing <hi type="italic">is</hi> of wrought gold.

verses.name: Psalms 45:14
verses.text: She shall be brought unto the king in raiment of needlework: the virgins her companions that follow her shall be brought unto thee.

verses.name: Psalms 45:15
verses.text: With gladness and rejoicing shall they be brought: they shall enter into the king’s palace.

verses.name: Psalms 45:16
verses.text: Instead of thy fathers shall be thy children, whom thou mayest make princes in all the earth.

verses.name: Psalms 45:17
verses.text: I will make thy name to be remembered in all generations: therefore shall the people praise thee for ever and ever.  <chapter eID="Ps.45"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv41"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth.</title> <div sID="gen544" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv41"/>GOD <hi type="italic">is</hi> our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

verses.name: Psalms 46:2
verses.text: Therefore will not we fear, though the earth be removed, and though the mountains be carried into the midst of the sea;

verses.name: Psalms 46:3
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Though</hi> the waters thereof roar <hi type="italic">and</hi> be troubled, <hi type="italic">though</hi> the mountains shake with the swelling thereof. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 46:4
verses.text: <hi type="italic">There is</hi> a river, the streams whereof shall make glad the city of God, the holy <hi type="italic">place</hi> of the tabernacles of the most High.

verses.name: Psalms 46:5
verses.text: God <hi type="italic">is</hi> in the midst of her; she shall not be moved: God shall help her, <hi type="italic">and that</hi> right early.

verses.name: Psalms 46:6
verses.text: The heathen raged, the kingdoms were moved: he uttered his voice, the earth melted.

verses.name: Psalms 46:7
verses.text: The Lord of hosts <hi type="italic">is</hi> with us; the God of Jacob <hi type="italic">is</hi> our refuge. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 46:8
verses.text: Come, behold the works of the Lord, what desolations he hath made in the earth.

verses.name: Psalms 46:9
verses.text: He maketh wars to cease unto the end of the earth; he breaketh the bow, and cutteth the spear in sunder; he burneth the chariot in the fire.

verses.name: Psalms 46:10
verses.text: Be still, and know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.

verses.name: Psalms 46:11
verses.text: The Lord of hosts <hi type="italic">is</hi> with us; the God of Jacob <hi type="italic">is</hi> our refuge. Selah.  <chapter eID="Ps.46"/>

verses.name: Psalms 47:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv42"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">To the chief Musician, A Psalm for the sons of Korah.</title> <div sID="gen545" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv42"/>O CLAP your hands, all ye people; shout unto God with the voice of triumph.

verses.name: Psalms 47:2
verses.text: For the Lord most high <hi type="italic">is</hi> terrible; <hi type="italic">he is</hi> a great King over all the earth.

verses.name: Psalms 47:3
verses.text: He shall subdue the people under us, and the nations under our feet.

verses.name: Psalms 47:4
verses.text: He shall choose our inheritance for us, the excellency of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 47:5
verses.text: God is gone up with a shout, the Lord with the sound of a trumpet.

verses.name: Psalms 47:6
verses.text: Sing praises to God, sing praises: sing praises unto our King, sing praises.

verses.name: Psalms 47:7
verses.text: For God <hi type="italic">is</hi> the King of all the earth: sing ye praises with understanding.

verses.name: Psalms 47:8
verses.text: God reigneth over the heathen: God sitteth upon the throne of his holiness.

verses.name: Psalms 47:9
verses.text: The princes of the people are gathered together, <hi type="italic">even</hi> the people of the God of Abraham: for the shields of the earth <hi type="italic">belong</hi> unto God: he is greatly exalted.  <chapter eID="Ps.47"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv43"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">A Song <hi type="italic">and</hi> Psalm for the sons of Korah.</title> <div sID="gen546" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv43"/>GREAT <hi type="italic">is</hi> the Lord, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, <hi type="italic">in</hi> the mountain of his holiness.

verses.name: Psalms 48:2
verses.text: Beautiful for situation, the joy of the whole earth, <hi type="italic">is</hi> mount Zion, <hi type="italic">on</hi> the sides of the north, the city of the great King.

verses.name: Psalms 48:3
verses.text: God is known in her palaces for a refuge.

verses.name: Psalms 48:4
verses.text: For, lo, the kings were assembled, they passed by together.

verses.name: Psalms 48:5
verses.text: They saw <hi type="italic">it</hi>, <hi type="italic">and</hi> so they marvelled; they were troubled, <hi type="italic">and</hi> hasted away.

verses.name: Psalms 48:6
verses.text: Fear took hold upon them there, <hi type="italic">and</hi> pain, as of a woman in travail.

verses.name: Psalms 48:7
verses.text: Thou breakest the ships of Tarshish with an east wind.

verses.name: Psalms 48:8
verses.text: As we have heard, so have we seen in the city of the Lord of hosts, in the city of our God: God will establish it for ever. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 48:9
verses.text: We have thought of thy lovingkindness, O God, in the midst of thy temple.

verses.name: Psalms 48:10
verses.text: According to thy name, O God, so <hi type="italic">is</hi> thy praise unto the ends of the earth: thy right hand is full of righteousness.

verses.name: Psalms 48:11
verses.text: Let mount Zion rejoice, let the daughters of Judah be glad, because of thy judgments.

verses.name: Psalms 48:12
verses.text: Walk about Zion, and go round about her: tell the towers thereof.

verses.name: Psalms 48:13
verses.text: Mark ye well her bulwarks, consider her palaces; that ye may tell <hi type="italic">it</hi> to the generation following.

verses.name: Psalms 48:14
verses.text: For this God <hi type="italic">is</hi> our God for ever and ever: he will be our guide <hi type="italic">even</hi> unto death.  <chapter eID="Ps.48"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv44"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">To the chief Musician, A Psalm for the sons of Korah.</title> <div sID="gen547" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv44"/>HEAR this, all <hi type="italic">ye</hi> people; give ear, all <hi type="italic">ye</hi> inhabitants of the world:

verses.name: Psalms 49:2
verses.text: Both low and high, rich and poor, together.

verses.name: Psalms 49:3
verses.text: My mouth shall speak of wisdom; and the meditation of my heart <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> of understanding.

verses.name: Psalms 49:4
verses.text: I will incline mine ear to a parable: I will open my dark saying upon the harp.

verses.name: Psalms 49:5
verses.text: Wherefore should I fear in the days of evil, <hi type="italic">when</hi> the iniquity of my heels shall compass me about?

verses.name: Psalms 49:6
verses.text: They that trust in their wealth, and boast themselves in the multitude of their riches;

verses.name: Psalms 49:7
verses.text: None <hi type="italic">of them</hi> can by any means redeem his brother, nor give to God a ransom for him:

verses.name: Psalms 49:8
verses.text: (For the redemption of their soul <hi type="italic">is</hi> precious, and it ceaseth for ever:)

verses.name: Psalms 49:9
verses.text: That he should still live for ever, <hi type="italic">and</hi> not see corruption.

verses.name: Psalms 49:10
verses.text: For he seeth <hi type="italic">that</hi> wise men die, likewise the fool and the brutish person perish, and leave their wealth to others.

verses.name: Psalms 49:11
verses.text: Their inward thought <hi type="italic">is</hi>, <hi type="italic">that</hi> their houses <hi type="italic">shall continue</hi> for ever, <hi type="italic">and</hi> their dwelling places to all generations; they call <hi type="italic">their</hi> lands after their own names.

verses.name: Psalms 49:12
verses.text: Nevertheless man <hi type="italic">being</hi> in honour abideth not: he is like the beasts <hi type="italic">that</hi> perish.

verses.name: Psalms 49:13
verses.text: This their way <hi type="italic">is</hi> their folly: yet their posterity approve their sayings. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 49:14
verses.text: Like sheep they are laid in the grave; death shall feed on them; and the upright shall have dominion over them in the morning; and their beauty shall consume in the grave from their dwelling.

verses.name: Psalms 49:15
verses.text: But God will redeem my soul from the power of the grave: for he shall receive me. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 49:16
verses.text: Be not thou afraid when one is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;

verses.name: Psalms 49:17
verses.text: For when he dieth he shall carry nothing away: his glory shall not descend after him.

verses.name: Psalms 49:18
verses.text: Though while he lived he blessed his soul: and <hi type="italic">men</hi> will praise thee, when thou doest well to thyself.

verses.name: Psalms 49:19
verses.text: He shall go to the generation of his fathers; they shall never see light.

verses.name: Psalms 49:20
verses.text: Man <hi type="italic">that is</hi> in honour, and understandeth not, is like the beasts <hi type="italic">that</hi> perish.  <chapter eID="Ps.49"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv45"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">A Psalm of Asaph.</title> <div sID="gen548" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv45"/>THE mighty God, <hi type="italic">even</hi> the Lord, hath spoken, and called the earth from the rising of the sun unto the going down thereof.

verses.name: Psalms 50:2
verses.text: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God hath shined.

verses.name: Psalms 50:3
verses.text: Our God shall come, and shall not keep silence: a fire shall devour before him, and it shall be very tempestuous round about him.

verses.name: Psalms 50:4
verses.text: He shall call to the heavens from above, and to the earth, that he may judge his people.

verses.name: Psalms 50:5
verses.text: Gather my saints together unto me; those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.

verses.name: Psalms 50:6
verses.text: And the heavens shall declare his righteousness: for God <hi type="italic">is</hi> judge himself. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 50:7
verses.text: Hear, O my people, and I will speak; O Israel, and I will testify against thee: I <hi type="italic">am</hi> God, <hi type="italic">even</hi> thy God.

verses.name: Psalms 50:8
verses.text: I will not reprove thee for thy sacrifices or thy burnt offerings, <hi type="italic">to have been</hi> continually before me.

verses.name: Psalms 50:9
verses.text: I will take no bullock out of thy house, <hi type="italic">nor</hi> he goats out of thy folds.

verses.name: Psalms 50:10
verses.text: For every beast of the forest <hi type="italic">is</hi> mine, <hi type="italic">and</hi> the cattle upon a thousand hills.

verses.name: Psalms 50:11
verses.text: I know all the fowls of the mountains: and the wild beasts of the field <hi type="italic">are</hi> mine.

verses.name: Psalms 50:12
verses.text: If I were hungry, I would not tell thee: for the world <hi type="italic">is</hi> mine, and the fulness thereof.

verses.name: Psalms 50:13
verses.text: Will I eat the flesh of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?

verses.name: Psalms 50:14
verses.text: Offer unto God thanksgiving; and pay thy vows unto the most High:

verses.name: Psalms 50:15
verses.text: And call upon me in the day of trouble: I will deliver thee, and thou shalt glorify me.

verses.name: Psalms 50:16
verses.text: But unto the wicked God saith, What hast thou to do to declare my statutes, or <hi type="italic">that</hi> thou shouldest take my covenant in thy mouth?

verses.name: Psalms 50:17
verses.text: Seeing thou hatest instruction, and castest my words behind thee.

verses.name: Psalms 50:18
verses.text: When thou sawest a thief, then thou consentedst with him, and hast been partaker with adulterers.

verses.name: Psalms 50:19
verses.text: Thou givest thy mouth to evil, and thy tongue frameth deceit.

verses.name: Psalms 50:20
verses.text: Thou sittest <hi type="italic">and</hi> speakest against thy brother; thou slanderest thine own mother’s son.

verses.name: Psalms 50:21
verses.text: These <hi type="italic">things</hi> hast thou done, and I kept silence; thou thoughtest that I was altogether <hi type="italic">such an one</hi> as thyself: <hi type="italic">but</hi> I will reprove thee, and set <hi type="italic">them</hi> in order before thine eyes.

verses.name: Psalms 50:22
verses.text: Now consider this, ye that forget God, lest I tear <hi type="italic">you</hi> in pieces, and <hi type="italic">there be</hi> none to deliver.

verses.name: Psalms 50:23
verses.text: Whoso offereth praise glorifieth me: and to him that ordereth <hi type="italic">his</hi> conversation <hi type="italic">aright</hi> will I shew the salvation of God.  <chapter eID="Ps.50"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv46"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David, when Nathan the prophet came unto him, after he had gone in to Bath-sheba.</title> <div sID="gen549" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv46"/>HAVE mercy upon me, O God, according to thy lovingkindness: according unto the multitude of thy tender mercies blot out my transgressions.

verses.name: Psalms 51:2
verses.text: Wash me throughly from mine iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.

verses.name: Psalms 51:3
verses.text: For I acknowledge my transgressions: and my sin <hi type="italic">is</hi> ever before me.

verses.name: Psalms 51:4
verses.text: Against thee, thee only, have I sinned, and done <hi type="italic">this</hi> evil in thy sight: that thou mightest be justified when thou speakest, <hi type="italic">and</hi> be clear when thou judgest.

verses.name: Psalms 51:5
verses.text: Behold, I was shapen in iniquity; and in sin did my mother conceive me.

verses.name: Psalms 51:6
verses.text: Behold, thou desirest truth in the inward parts: and in the hidden <hi type="italic">part</hi> thou shalt make me to know wisdom.

verses.name: Psalms 51:7
verses.text: Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean: wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.

verses.name: Psalms 51:8
verses.text: Make me to hear joy and gladness; <hi type="italic">that</hi> the bones <hi type="italic">which</hi> thou hast broken may rejoice.

verses.name: Psalms 51:9
verses.text: Hide thy face from my sins, and blot out all mine iniquities.

verses.name: Psalms 51:10
verses.text: Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.

verses.name: Psalms 51:11
verses.text: Cast me not away from thy presence; and take not thy holy spirit from me.

verses.name: Psalms 51:12
verses.text: Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation; and uphold me <hi type="italic">with thy</hi> free spirit.

verses.name: Psalms 51:13
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Then</hi> will I teach transgressors thy ways; and sinners shall be converted unto thee.

verses.name: Psalms 51:14
verses.text: Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O God, thou God of my salvation: <hi type="italic">and</hi> my tongue shall sing aloud of thy righteousness.

verses.name: Psalms 51:15
verses.text: O Lord, open thou my lips; and my mouth shall shew forth thy praise.

verses.name: Psalms 51:16
verses.text: For thou desirest not sacrifice; else would I give <hi type="italic">it:</hi> thou delightest not in burnt offering.

verses.name: Psalms 51:17
verses.text: The sacrifices of God <hi type="italic">are</hi> a broken spirit: a broken and a contrite heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.

verses.name: Psalms 51:18
verses.text: Do good in thy good pleasure unto Zion: build thou the walls of Jerusalem.

verses.name: Psalms 51:19
verses.text: Then shalt thou be pleased with the sacrifices of righteousness, with burnt offering and whole burnt offering: then shall they offer bullocks upon thine altar.  <chapter eID="Ps.51"/>

verses.name: Psalms 52:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv47"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">To the chief Musician, Maschil, <hi type="italic">A Psalm</hi> of David, when Doeg the Edomite came and told Saul, and said unto him, David is come to the house of Ahimelech.</title> <div sID="gen550" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv47"/>WHY boastest thou thyself in mischief, O mighty man? the goodness of God <hi type="italic">endureth</hi> continually.

verses.name: Psalms 52:2
verses.text: Thy tongue deviseth mischiefs; like a sharp rasor, working deceitfully.

verses.name: Psalms 52:3
verses.text: Thou lovest evil more than good; <hi type="italic">and</hi> lying rather than to speak righteousness. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 52:4
verses.text: Thou lovest all devouring words, O <hi type="italic">thou</hi> deceitful tongue.

verses.name: Psalms 52:5
verses.text: God shall likewise destroy thee for ever, he shall take thee away, and pluck thee out of <hi type="italic">thy</hi> dwelling place, and root thee out of the land of the living. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 52:6
verses.text: The righteous also shall see, and fear, and shall laugh at him:

verses.name: Psalms 52:7
verses.text: Lo, <hi type="italic">this is</hi> the man <hi type="italic">that</hi> made not God his strength; but trusted in the abundance of his riches, <hi type="italic">and</hi> strengthened himself in his wickedness.

verses.name: Psalms 52:8
verses.text: But I <hi type="italic">am</hi> like a green olive tree in the house of God: I trust in the mercy of God for ever and ever.

verses.name: Psalms 52:9
verses.text: I will praise thee for ever, because thou hast done <hi type="italic">it:</hi> and I will wait on thy name; for <hi type="italic">it is</hi> good before thy saints.  <chapter eID="Ps.52"/>

verses.name: Psalms 53:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv48"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">To the chief Musician upon Mahalath, Maschil, A Psalm of David.</title> <div sID="gen551" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv48"/>THE fool hath said in his heart, <hi type="italic">There is</hi> no God. Corrupt are they, and have done abominable iniquity: <hi type="italic">there is</hi> none that doeth good.

verses.name: Psalms 53:2
verses.text: God looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were <hi type="italic">any</hi> that did understand, that did seek God.

verses.name: Psalms 53:3
verses.text: Every one of them is gone back: they are altogether become filthy; <hi type="italic">there is</hi> none that doeth good, no, not one.

verses.name: Psalms 53:4
verses.text: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people <hi type="italic">as</hi> they eat bread: they have not called upon God.

verses.name: Psalms 53:5
verses.text: There were they in great fear, <hi type="italic">where</hi> no fear was: for God hath scattered the bones of him that encampeth <hi type="italic">against</hi> thee: thou hast put <hi type="italic">them</hi> to shame, because God hath despised them.

verses.name: Psalms 53:6
verses.text: Oh that the salvation of Israel <hi type="italic">were come</hi> out of Zion! When God bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, <hi type="italic">and</hi> Israel shall be glad.  <chapter eID="Ps.53"/>

verses.name: Psalms 54:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv49"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">To the chief Musician on Neginoth, Maschil, <hi type="italic">A Psalm</hi> of David, when the Ziphims came and said to Saul, Doth not David hide himself with us?</title> <div sID="gen552" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv49"/>SAVE me, O God, by thy name, and judge me by thy strength.

verses.name: Psalms 54:2
verses.text: Hear my prayer, O God; give ear to the words of my mouth.

verses.name: Psalms 54:3
verses.text: For strangers are risen up against me, and oppressors seek after my soul: they have not set God before them. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 54:4
verses.text: Behold, God <hi type="italic">is</hi> mine helper: the Lord <hi type="italic">is</hi> with them that uphold my soul.

verses.name: Psalms 54:5
verses.text: He shall reward evil unto mine enemies: cut them off in thy truth.

verses.name: Psalms 54:6
verses.text: I will freely sacrifice unto thee: I will praise thy name, O Lord; for <hi type="italic">it is</hi> good.

verses.name: Psalms 54:7
verses.text: For he hath delivered me out of all trouble: and mine eye hath seen <hi type="italic">his desire</hi> upon mine enemies.  <chapter eID="Ps.54"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv50"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">To the chief Musician on Neginoth, Maschil, <hi type="italic">A Psalm</hi> of David.</title> <div sID="gen553" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv50"/>GIVE ear to my prayer, O God; and hide not thyself from my supplication.

verses.name: Psalms 55:2
verses.text: Attend unto me, and hear me: I mourn in my complaint, and make a noise;

verses.name: Psalms 55:3
verses.text: Because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked: for they cast iniquity upon me, and in wrath they hate me.

verses.name: Psalms 55:4
verses.text: My heart is sore pained within me: and the terrors of death are fallen upon me.

verses.name: Psalms 55:5
verses.text: Fearfulness and trembling are come upon me, and horror hath overwhelmed me.

verses.name: Psalms 55:6
verses.text: And I said, Oh that I had wings like a dove! <hi type="italic">for then</hi> would I fly away, and be at rest.

verses.name: Psalms 55:7
verses.text: Lo, <hi type="italic">then</hi> would I wander far off, <hi type="italic">and</hi> remain in the wilderness. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 55:8
verses.text: I would hasten my escape from the windy storm <hi type="italic">and</hi> tempest.

verses.name: Psalms 55:9
verses.text: Destroy, O Lord, <hi type="italic">and</hi> divide their tongues: for I have seen violence and strife in the city.

verses.name: Psalms 55:10
verses.text: Day and night they go about it upon the walls thereof: mischief also and sorrow <hi type="italic">are</hi> in the midst of it.

verses.name: Psalms 55:11
