verses.text: Wickedness <hi type="italic">is</hi> in the midst thereof: deceit and guile depart not from her streets.

verses.name: Psalms 55:12
verses.text: For <hi type="italic">it was</hi> not an enemy <hi type="italic">that</hi> reproached me; then I could have borne <hi type="italic">it:</hi> neither <hi type="italic">was it</hi> he that hated me <hi type="italic">that</hi> did magnify <hi type="italic">himself</hi> against me; then I would have hid myself from him:

verses.name: Psalms 55:13
verses.text: But <hi type="italic">it was</hi> thou, a man mine equal, my guide, and mine acquaintance.

verses.name: Psalms 55:14
verses.text: We took sweet counsel together, <hi type="italic">and</hi> walked unto the house of God in company.

verses.name: Psalms 55:15
verses.text: Let death seize upon them, <hi type="italic">and</hi> let them go down quick into hell: for wickedness <hi type="italic">is</hi> in their dwellings, <hi type="italic">and</hi> among them.

verses.name: Psalms 55:16
verses.text: As for me, I will call upon God; and the Lord shall save me.

verses.name: Psalms 55:17
verses.text: Evening, and morning, and at noon, will I pray, and cry aloud: and he shall hear my voice.

verses.name: Psalms 55:18
verses.text: He hath delivered my soul in peace from the battle <hi type="italic">that was</hi> against me: for there were many with me.

verses.name: Psalms 55:19
verses.text: God shall hear, and afflict them, even he that abideth of old. Selah. Because they have no changes, therefore they fear not God.

verses.name: Psalms 55:20
verses.text: He hath put forth his hands against such as be at peace with him: he hath broken his covenant.

verses.name: Psalms 55:21
verses.text: <hi type="italic">The words</hi> of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war <hi type="italic">was</hi> in his heart: his words were softer than oil, yet <hi type="italic">were</hi> they drawn swords.

verses.name: Psalms 55:22
verses.text: Cast thy burden upon the Lord, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.

verses.name: Psalms 55:23
verses.text: But thou, O God, shalt bring them down into the pit of destruction: bloody and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; but I will trust in thee.  <chapter eID="Ps.55"/>

verses.name: Psalms 56:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv51"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">To the chief Musician upon Jonath-elem-rechokim, Michtam of David, when the Philistines took him in Gath.</title> <div sID="gen554" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv51"/>BE merciful unto me, O God: for man would swallow me up; he fighting daily oppresseth me.

verses.name: Psalms 56:2
verses.text: Mine enemies would daily swallow <hi type="italic">me</hi> up: for <hi type="italic">they be</hi> many that fight against me, O thou most High.

verses.name: Psalms 56:3
verses.text: What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.

verses.name: Psalms 56:4
verses.text: In God I will praise his word, in God I have put my trust; I will not fear what flesh can do unto me.

verses.name: Psalms 56:5
verses.text: Every day they wrest my words: all their thoughts <hi type="italic">are</hi> against me for evil.

verses.name: Psalms 56:6
verses.text: They gather themselves together, they hide themselves, they mark my steps, when they wait for my soul.

verses.name: Psalms 56:7
verses.text: Shall they escape by iniquity? in <hi type="italic">thine</hi> anger cast down the people, O God.

verses.name: Psalms 56:8
verses.text: Thou tellest my wanderings: put thou my tears into thy bottle: <hi type="italic">are they</hi> not in thy book?

verses.name: Psalms 56:9
verses.text: When I cry <hi type="italic">unto thee</hi>, then shall mine enemies turn back: this I know; for God <hi type="italic">is</hi> for me.

verses.name: Psalms 56:10
verses.text: In God will I praise <hi type="italic">his</hi> word: in the Lord will I praise <hi type="italic">his</hi> word.

verses.name: Psalms 56:11
verses.text: In God have I put my trust: I will not be afraid what man can do unto me.

verses.name: Psalms 56:12
verses.text: Thy vows <hi type="italic">are</hi> upon me, O God: I will render praises unto thee.

verses.name: Psalms 56:13
verses.text: For thou hast delivered my soul from death: <hi type="italic">wilt</hi> not <hi type="italic">thou deliver</hi> my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living?  <chapter eID="Ps.56"/>

verses.name: Psalms 57:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv52"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">To the chief Musician, Al-taschith, Michtam of David, when he fled from Saul in the cave.</title> <div sID="gen555" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv52"/>BE merciful unto me, O God, be merciful unto me: for my soul trusteth in thee: yea, in the shadow of thy wings will I make my refuge, until <hi type="italic">these</hi> calamities be overpast.

verses.name: Psalms 57:2
verses.text: I will cry unto God most high; unto God that performeth <hi type="italic">all things</hi> for me.

verses.name: Psalms 57:3
verses.text: He shall send from heaven, and save me <hi type="italic">from</hi> the reproach of him that would swallow me up. Selah. God shall send forth his mercy and his truth.

verses.name: Psalms 57:4
verses.text: My soul <hi type="italic">is</hi> among lions: <hi type="italic">and</hi> I lie <hi type="italic">even among</hi> them that are set on fire, <hi type="italic">even</hi> the sons of men, whose teeth <hi type="italic">are</hi> spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.

verses.name: Psalms 57:5
verses.text: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens; <hi type="italic">let</hi> thy glory <hi type="italic">be</hi> above all the earth.

verses.name: Psalms 57:6
verses.text: They have prepared a net for my steps; my soul is bowed down: they have digged a pit before me, into the midst whereof they are fallen <hi type="italic">themselves</hi>. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 57:7
verses.text: My heart is fixed, O God, my heart is fixed: I will sing and give praise.

verses.name: Psalms 57:8
verses.text: Awake up, my glory; awake, psaltery and harp: I <hi type="italic">myself</hi> will awake early.

verses.name: Psalms 57:9
verses.text: I will praise thee, O Lord, among the people: I will sing unto thee among the nations.

verses.name: Psalms 57:10
verses.text: For thy mercy <hi type="italic">is</hi> great unto the heavens, and thy truth unto the clouds.

verses.name: Psalms 57:11
verses.text: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: <hi type="italic">let</hi> thy glory <hi type="italic">be</hi> above all the earth.  <chapter eID="Ps.57"/>

verses.name: Psalms 58:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv53"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">To the chief Musician, Al-taschith, Michtam of David.</title> <div sID="gen556" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv53"/>DO ye indeed speak righteousness, O congregation? do ye judge uprightly, O ye sons of men?

verses.name: Psalms 58:2
verses.text: Yea, in heart ye work wickedness; ye weigh the violence of your hands in the earth.

verses.name: Psalms 58:3
verses.text: The wicked are estranged from the womb: they go astray as soon as they be born, speaking lies.

verses.name: Psalms 58:4
verses.text: Their poison <hi type="italic">is</hi> like the poison of a serpent: <hi type="italic">they are</hi> like the deaf adder <hi type="italic">that</hi> stoppeth her ear;

verses.name: Psalms 58:5
verses.text: Which will not hearken to the voice of charmers, charming never so wisely.

verses.name: Psalms 58:6
verses.text: Break their teeth, O God, in their mouth: break out the great teeth of the young lions, O Lord.

verses.name: Psalms 58:7
verses.text: Let them melt away as waters <hi type="italic">which</hi> run continually: <hi type="italic">when</hi> he bendeth <hi type="italic">his bow to shoot</hi> his arrows, let them be as cut in pieces.

verses.name: Psalms 58:8
verses.text: As a snail <hi type="italic">which</hi> melteth, let <hi type="italic">every one of them</hi> pass away: <hi type="italic">like</hi> the untimely birth of a woman, <hi type="italic">that</hi> they may not see the sun.

verses.name: Psalms 58:9
verses.text: Before your pots can feel the thorns, he shall take them away as with a whirlwind, both living, and in <hi type="italic">his</hi> wrath.

verses.name: Psalms 58:10
verses.text: The righteous shall rejoice when he seeth the vengeance: he shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked.

verses.name: Psalms 58:11
verses.text: So that a man shall say, Verily <hi type="italic">there is</hi> a reward for the righteous: verily he is a God that judgeth in the earth.  <chapter eID="Ps.58"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv54"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">To the chief Musician, Al-taschith, Michtam of David; when Saul sent, and they watched the house to kill him.</title> <div sID="gen557" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv54"/>DELIVER me from mine enemies, O my God: defend me from them that rise up against me.

verses.name: Psalms 59:2
verses.text: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, and save me from bloody men.

verses.name: Psalms 59:3
verses.text: For, lo, they lie in wait for my soul: the mighty are gathered against me; not <hi type="italic">for</hi> my transgression, nor <hi type="italic">for</hi> my sin, O Lord.

verses.name: Psalms 59:4
verses.text: They run and prepare themselves without <hi type="italic">my</hi> fault: awake to help me, and behold.

verses.name: Psalms 59:5
verses.text: Thou therefore, O Lord God of hosts, the God of Israel, awake to visit all the heathen: be not merciful to any wicked transgressors. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 59:6
verses.text: They return at evening: they make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.

verses.name: Psalms 59:7
verses.text: Behold, they belch out with their mouth: swords <hi type="italic">are</hi> in their lips: for who, <hi type="italic">say they</hi>, doth hear?

verses.name: Psalms 59:8
verses.text: But thou, O Lord, shalt laugh at them; thou shalt have all the heathen in derision.

verses.name: Psalms 59:9
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Because of</hi> his strength will I wait upon thee: for God <hi type="italic">is</hi> my defence.

verses.name: Psalms 59:10
verses.text: The God of my mercy shall prevent me: God shall let me see <hi type="italic">my desire</hi> upon mine enemies.

verses.name: Psalms 59:11
verses.text: Slay them not, lest my people forget: scatter them by thy power; and bring them down, O Lord our shield.

verses.name: Psalms 59:12
verses.text: <hi type="italic">For</hi> the sin of their mouth <hi type="italic">and</hi> the words of their lips let them even be taken in their pride: and for cursing and lying <hi type="italic">which</hi> they speak.

verses.name: Psalms 59:13
verses.text: Consume <hi type="italic">them</hi> in wrath, consume <hi type="italic">them</hi>, that they <hi type="italic">may</hi> not <hi type="italic">be:</hi> and let them know that God ruleth in Jacob unto the ends of the earth. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 59:14
verses.text: And at evening let them return; <hi type="italic">and</hi> let them make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.

verses.name: Psalms 59:15
verses.text: Let them wander up and down for meat, and grudge if they be not satisfied.

verses.name: Psalms 59:16
verses.text: But I will sing of thy power; yea, I will sing aloud of thy mercy in the morning: for thou hast been my defence and refuge in the day of my trouble.

verses.name: Psalms 59:17
verses.text: Unto thee, O my strength, will I sing: for God <hi type="italic">is</hi> my defence, <hi type="italic">and</hi> the God of my mercy.  <chapter eID="Ps.59"/>

verses.name: Psalms 60:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv55"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">To the chief Musician upon Shushan-eduth, Michtam of David, to teach; when he strove with Aram-naharaim and with Aram-zobah, when Joab returned, and smote of Edom in the valley of salt twelve thousand.</title> <div sID="gen558" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv55"/>O GOD, thou hast cast us off, thou hast scattered us, thou hast been displeased; O turn thyself to us again.

verses.name: Psalms 60:2
verses.text: Thou hast made the earth to tremble; thou hast broken it: heal the breaches thereof; for it shaketh.

verses.name: Psalms 60:3
verses.text: Thou hast shewed thy people hard things: thou hast made us to drink the wine of astonishment.

verses.name: Psalms 60:4
verses.text: Thou hast given a banner to them that fear thee, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 60:5
verses.text: That thy beloved may be delivered; save <hi type="italic">with</hi> thy right hand, and hear me.

verses.name: Psalms 60:6
verses.text: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.

verses.name: Psalms 60:7
verses.text: Gilead <hi type="italic">is</hi> mine, and Manasseh <hi type="italic">is</hi> mine; Ephraim also <hi type="italic">is</hi> the strength of mine head; Judah <hi type="italic">is</hi> my lawgiver;

verses.name: Psalms 60:8
verses.text: Moab <hi type="italic">is</hi> my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe: Philistia, triumph thou because of me.

verses.name: Psalms 60:9
verses.text: Who will bring me <hi type="italic">into</hi> the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?

verses.name: Psalms 60:10
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Wilt</hi> not thou, O God, <hi type="italic">which</hi> hadst cast us off? and <hi type="italic">thou</hi>, O God, <hi type="italic">which</hi> didst not go out with our armies?

verses.name: Psalms 60:11
verses.text: Give us help from trouble: for vain <hi type="italic">is</hi> the help of man.

verses.name: Psalms 60:12
verses.text: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he <hi type="italic">it is that</hi> shall tread down our enemies.  <chapter eID="Ps.60"/>

verses.name: Psalms 61:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv56"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">To the chief Musician upon Neginah, <hi type="italic">A Psalm</hi> of David.</title> <div sID="gen559" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv56"/>HEAR my cry, O God; attend unto my prayer.

verses.name: Psalms 61:2
verses.text: From the end of the earth will I cry unto thee, when my heart is overwhelmed: lead me to the rock <hi type="italic">that</hi> is higher than I.

verses.name: Psalms 61:3
verses.text: For thou hast been a shelter for me, <hi type="italic">and</hi> a strong tower from the enemy.

verses.name: Psalms 61:4
verses.text: I will abide in thy tabernacle for ever: I will trust in the covert of thy wings. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 61:5
verses.text: For thou, O God, hast heard my vows: thou hast given <hi type="italic">me</hi> the heritage of those that fear thy name.

verses.name: Psalms 61:6
verses.text: Thou wilt prolong the king’s life: <hi type="italic">and</hi> his years as many generations.

verses.name: Psalms 61:7
verses.text: He shall abide before God for ever: O prepare mercy and truth, <hi type="italic">which</hi> may preserve him.

verses.name: Psalms 61:8
verses.text: So will I sing praise unto thy name for ever, that I may daily perform my vows.  <chapter eID="Ps.61"/>

verses.name: Psalms 62:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv57"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">To the chief Musician, to Jeduthun, A Psalm of David.</title> <div sID="gen560" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv57"/>TRULY my soul waiteth upon God: from him <hi type="italic">cometh</hi> my salvation.

verses.name: Psalms 62:2
verses.text: He only <hi type="italic">is</hi> my rock and my salvation; <hi type="italic">he is</hi> my defence; I shall not be greatly moved.

verses.name: Psalms 62:3
verses.text: How long will ye imagine mischief against a man? ye shall be slain all of you: as a bowing wall <hi type="italic">shall ye be</hi>, <hi type="italic">and as</hi> a tottering fence.

verses.name: Psalms 62:4
verses.text: They only consult to cast <hi type="italic">him</hi> down from his excellency: they delight in lies: they bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 62:5
verses.text: My soul, wait thou only upon God; for my expectation <hi type="italic">is</hi> from him.

verses.name: Psalms 62:6
verses.text: He only <hi type="italic">is</hi> my rock and my salvation: <hi type="italic">he is</hi> my defence; I shall not be moved.

verses.name: Psalms 62:7
verses.text: In God <hi type="italic">is</hi> my salvation and my glory: the rock of my strength, <hi type="italic">and</hi> my refuge, <hi type="italic">is</hi> in God.

verses.name: Psalms 62:8
verses.text: Trust in him at all times; ye people, pour out your heart before him: God <hi type="italic">is</hi> a refuge for us. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 62:9
verses.text: Surely men of low degree <hi type="italic">are</hi> vanity, <hi type="italic">and</hi> men of high degree <hi type="italic">are</hi> a lie: to be laid in the balance, they <hi type="italic">are</hi> altogether <hi type="italic">lighter</hi> than vanity.

verses.name: Psalms 62:10
verses.text: Trust not in oppression, and become not vain in robbery: if riches increase, set not your heart <hi type="italic">upon them</hi>.

verses.name: Psalms 62:11
verses.text: God hath spoken once; twice have I heard this; that power <hi type="italic">belongeth</hi> unto God.

verses.name: Psalms 62:12
verses.text: Also unto thee, O Lord, <hi type="italic">belongeth</hi> mercy: for thou renderest to every man according to his work.  <chapter eID="Ps.62"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv58"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">A Psalm of David, when he was in the wilderness of Judah.</title> <div sID="gen561" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv58"/>O GOD, thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> my God; early will I seek thee: my soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;

verses.name: Psalms 63:2
verses.text: To see thy power and thy glory, so <hi type="italic">as</hi> I have seen thee in the sanctuary.

verses.name: Psalms 63:3
verses.text: Because thy lovingkindness <hi type="italic">is</hi> better than life, my lips shall praise thee.

verses.name: Psalms 63:4
verses.text: Thus will I bless thee while I live: I will lift up my hands in thy name.

verses.name: Psalms 63:5
verses.text: My soul shall be satisfied as <hi type="italic">with</hi> marrow and fatness; and my mouth shall praise <hi type="italic">thee</hi> with joyful lips:

verses.name: Psalms 63:6
verses.text: When I remember thee upon my bed, <hi type="italic">and</hi> meditate on thee in the <hi type="italic">night</hi> watches.

verses.name: Psalms 63:7
verses.text: Because thou hast been my help, therefore in the shadow of thy wings will I rejoice.

verses.name: Psalms 63:8
verses.text: My soul followeth hard after thee: thy right hand upholdeth me.

verses.name: Psalms 63:9
verses.text: But those <hi type="italic">that</hi> seek my soul, to destroy <hi type="italic">it</hi>, shall go into the lower parts of the earth.

verses.name: Psalms 63:10
verses.text: They shall fall by the sword: they shall be a portion for foxes.

verses.name: Psalms 63:11
verses.text: But the king shall rejoice in God; every one that sweareth by him shall glory: but the mouth of them that speak lies shall be stopped.  <chapter eID="Ps.63"/>

verses.name: Psalms 64:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv59"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.</title> <div sID="gen562" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv59"/>HEAR my voice, O God, in my prayer: preserve my life from fear of the enemy.

verses.name: Psalms 64:2
verses.text: Hide me from the secret counsel of the wicked; from the insurrection of the workers of iniquity:

verses.name: Psalms 64:3
verses.text: Who whet their tongue like a sword, <hi type="italic">and</hi> bend <hi type="italic">their bows to shoot</hi> their arrows, <hi type="italic">even</hi> bitter words:

verses.name: Psalms 64:4
verses.text: That they may shoot in secret at the perfect: suddenly do they shoot at him, and fear not.

verses.name: Psalms 64:5
verses.text: They encourage themselves <hi type="italic">in</hi> an evil matter: they commune of laying snares privily; they say, Who shall see them?

verses.name: Psalms 64:6
verses.text: They search out iniquities; they accomplish a diligent search: both the inward <hi type="italic">thought</hi> of every one <hi type="italic">of them</hi>, and the heart, <hi type="italic">is</hi> deep.

verses.name: Psalms 64:7
verses.text: But God shall shoot at them <hi type="italic">with</hi> an arrow; suddenly shall they be wounded.

verses.name: Psalms 64:8
verses.text: So they shall make their own tongue to fall upon themselves: all that see them shall flee away.

verses.name: Psalms 64:9
verses.text: And all men shall fear, and shall declare the work of God; for they shall wisely consider of his doing.

verses.name: Psalms 64:10
verses.text: The righteous shall be glad in the Lord, and shall trust in him; and all the upright in heart shall glory.  <chapter eID="Ps.64"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv60"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">To the chief Musician, A Psalm <hi type="italic">and</hi> Song of David.</title> <div sID="gen563" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv60"/>PRAISE waiteth for thee, O God, in Sion: and unto thee shall the vow be performed.

verses.name: Psalms 65:2
verses.text: O thou that hearest prayer, unto thee shall all flesh come.

verses.name: Psalms 65:3
verses.text: Iniquities prevail against me: <hi type="italic">as for</hi> our transgressions, thou shalt purge them away.

verses.name: Psalms 65:4
verses.text: Blessed <hi type="italic">is the man whom</hi> thou choosest, and causest to approach <hi type="italic">unto thee</hi>, <hi type="italic">that</hi> he may dwell in thy courts: we shall be satisfied with the goodness of thy house, <hi type="italic">even</hi> of thy holy temple.

verses.name: Psalms 65:5
verses.text: <hi type="italic">By</hi> terrible things in righteousness wilt thou answer us, O God of our salvation; <hi type="italic">who art</hi> the confidence of all the ends of the earth, and of them that are afar off <hi type="italic">upon</hi> the sea:

verses.name: Psalms 65:6
verses.text: Which by his strength setteth fast the mountains; <hi type="italic">being</hi> girded with power:

verses.name: Psalms 65:7
verses.text: Which stilleth the noise of the seas, the noise of their waves, and the tumult of the people.

verses.name: Psalms 65:8
verses.text: They also that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at thy tokens: thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.

verses.name: Psalms 65:9
verses.text: Thou visitest the earth, and waterest it: thou greatly enrichest it with the river of God, <hi type="italic">which</hi> is full of water: thou preparest them corn, when thou hast so provided for it.

verses.name: Psalms 65:10
verses.text: Thou waterest the ridges thereof abundantly: thou settlest the furrows thereof: thou makest it soft with showers: thou blessest the springing thereof.

verses.name: Psalms 65:11
verses.text: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness; and thy paths drop fatness.

verses.name: Psalms 65:12
verses.text: They drop <hi type="italic">upon</hi> the pastures of the wilderness: and the little hills rejoice on every side.

verses.name: Psalms 65:13
verses.text: The pastures are clothed with flocks; the valleys also are covered over with corn; they shout for joy, they also sing.  <chapter eID="Ps.65"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv61"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">To the chief Musician, A Song <hi type="italic">or</hi> Psalm.</title> <div sID="gen564" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv61"/>MAKE a joyful noise unto God, all ye lands:

verses.name: Psalms 66:2
verses.text: Sing forth the honour of his name: make his praise glorious.

verses.name: Psalms 66:3
verses.text: Say unto God, How terrible <hi type="italic">art thou in</hi> thy works! through the greatness of thy power shall thine enemies submit themselves unto thee.

verses.name: Psalms 66:4
verses.text: All the earth shall worship thee, and shall sing unto thee; they shall sing <hi type="italic">to</hi> thy name. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 66:5
verses.text: Come and see the works of God: <hi type="italic">he is</hi> terrible <hi type="italic">in his</hi> doing toward the children of men.

verses.name: Psalms 66:6
verses.text: He turned the sea into dry <hi type="italic">land:</hi> they went through the flood on foot: there did we rejoice in him.

verses.name: Psalms 66:7
verses.text: He ruleth by his power for ever; his eyes behold the nations: let not the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 66:8
verses.text: O bless our God, ye people, and make the voice of his praise to be heard:

verses.name: Psalms 66:9
verses.text: Which holdeth our soul in life, and suffereth not our feet to be moved.

verses.name: Psalms 66:10
verses.text: For thou, O God, hast proved us: thou hast tried us, as silver is tried.

verses.name: Psalms 66:11
verses.text: Thou broughtest us into the net; thou laidst affliction upon our loins.

verses.name: Psalms 66:12
verses.text: Thou hast caused men to ride over our heads; we went through fire and through water: but thou broughtest us out into a wealthy <hi type="italic">place</hi>.

verses.name: Psalms 66:13
verses.text: I will go into thy house with burnt offerings: I will pay thee my vows,

verses.name: Psalms 66:14
verses.text: Which my lips have uttered, and my mouth hath spoken, when I was in trouble.

verses.name: Psalms 66:15
verses.text: I will offer unto thee burnt sacrifices of fatlings, with the incense of rams; I will offer bullocks with goats. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 66:16
verses.text: Come <hi type="italic">and</hi> hear, all ye that fear God, and I will declare what he hath done for my soul.

verses.name: Psalms 66:17
verses.text: I cried unto him with my mouth, and he was extolled with my tongue.

verses.name: Psalms 66:18
verses.text: If I regard iniquity in my heart, the Lord will not hear <hi type="italic">me:</hi>

verses.name: Psalms 66:19
verses.text: <hi type="italic">But</hi> verily God hath heard <hi type="italic">me;</hi> he hath attended to the voice of my prayer.

verses.name: Psalms 66:20
verses.text: Blessed <hi type="italic">be</hi> God, which hath not turned away my prayer, nor his mercy from me.  <chapter eID="Ps.66"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv62"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">To the chief Musician on Neginoth, A Psalm <hi type="italic">or</hi> Song.</title> <div sID="gen565" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv62"/>GOD be merciful unto us, and bless us; <hi type="italic">and</hi> cause his face to shine upon us; Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 67:2
verses.text: That thy way may be known upon earth, thy saving health among all nations.

verses.name: Psalms 67:3
verses.text: Let the people praise thee, O God; let all the people praise thee.

verses.name: Psalms 67:4
verses.text: O let the nations be glad and sing for joy: for thou shalt judge the people righteously, and govern the nations upon earth. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 67:5
verses.text: Let the people praise thee, O God; let all the people praise thee.

verses.name: Psalms 67:6
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Then</hi> shall the earth yield her increase; <hi type="italic">and</hi> God, <hi type="italic">even</hi> our own God, shall bless us.

verses.name: Psalms 67:7
verses.text: God shall bless us; and all the ends of the earth shall fear him.  <chapter eID="Ps.67"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv63"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">To the chief Musician, A Psalm <hi type="italic">or</hi> Song of David.</title> <div sID="gen566" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv63"/>LET God arise, let his enemies be scattered: let them also that hate him flee before him.

verses.name: Psalms 68:2
verses.text: As smoke is driven away, <hi type="italic">so</hi> drive <hi type="italic">them</hi> away: as wax melteth before the fire, <hi type="italic">so</hi> let the wicked perish at the presence of God.

verses.name: Psalms 68:3
verses.text: But let the righteous be glad; let them rejoice before God: yea, let them exceedingly rejoice.

verses.name: Psalms 68:4
verses.text: Sing unto God, sing praises to his name: extol him that rideth upon the heavens by his name JAH, and rejoice before him.

verses.name: Psalms 68:5
verses.text: A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows, <hi type="italic">is</hi> God in his holy habitation.

verses.name: Psalms 68:6
verses.text: God setteth the solitary in families: he bringeth out those which are bound with chains: but the rebellious dwell in a dry <hi type="italic">land</hi>.

verses.name: Psalms 68:7
verses.text: O God, when thou wentest forth before thy people, when thou didst march through the wilderness; Selah:

verses.name: Psalms 68:8
verses.text: The earth shook, the heavens also dropped at the presence of God: <hi type="italic">even</hi> Sinai itself <hi type="italic">was moved</hi> at the presence of God, the God of Israel.

verses.name: Psalms 68:9
verses.text: Thou, O God, didst send a plentiful rain, whereby thou didst confirm thine inheritance, when it was weary.

verses.name: Psalms 68:10
verses.text: Thy congregation hath dwelt therein: thou, O God, hast prepared of thy goodness for the poor.

verses.name: Psalms 68:11
verses.text: The Lord gave the word: great <hi type="italic">was</hi> the company of those that published <hi type="italic">it</hi>.

verses.name: Psalms 68:12
verses.text: Kings of armies did flee apace: and she that tarried at home divided the spoil.

verses.name: Psalms 68:13
verses.text: Though ye have lien among the pots, <hi type="italic">yet shall ye be as</hi> the wings of a dove covered with silver, and her feathers with yellow gold.

verses.name: Psalms 68:14
verses.text: When the Almighty scattered kings in it, it was <hi type="italic">white</hi> as snow in Salmon.

verses.name: Psalms 68:15
verses.text: The hill of God <hi type="italic">is as</hi> the hill of Bashan; an high hill <hi type="italic">as</hi> the hill of Bashan.

verses.name: Psalms 68:16
verses.text: Why leap ye, ye high hills? <hi type="italic">this is</hi> the hill <hi type="italic">which</hi> God desireth to dwell in; yea, the Lord will dwell <hi type="italic">in it</hi> for ever.

verses.name: Psalms 68:17
verses.text: The chariots of God <hi type="italic">are</hi> twenty thousand, <hi type="italic">even</hi> thousands of angels: the Lord <hi type="italic">is</hi> among them, <hi type="italic">as in</hi> Sinai, in the holy <hi type="italic">place</hi>.

verses.name: Psalms 68:18
verses.text: Thou hast ascended on high, thou hast led captivity captive: thou hast received gifts for men; yea, <hi type="italic">for</hi> the rebellious also, that the Lord God might dwell <hi type="italic">among them</hi>.

verses.name: Psalms 68:19
verses.text: Blessed <hi type="italic">be</hi> the Lord, <hi type="italic">who</hi> daily loadeth us <hi type="italic">with benefits</hi>, <hi type="italic">even</hi> the God of our salvation. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 68:20
verses.text: <hi type="italic">He that is</hi> our God <hi type="italic">is</hi> the God of salvation; and unto God the Lord <hi type="italic">belong</hi> the issues from death.

verses.name: Psalms 68:21
verses.text: But God shall wound the head of his enemies, <hi type="italic">and</hi> the hairy scalp of such an one as goeth on still in his trespasses.

verses.name: Psalms 68:22
verses.text: The Lord said, I will bring again from Bashan, I will bring <hi type="italic">my people</hi> again from the depths of the sea:

verses.name: Psalms 68:23
verses.text: That thy foot may be dipped in the blood of <hi type="italic">thine</hi> enemies, <hi type="italic">and</hi> the tongue of thy dogs in the same.

verses.name: Psalms 68:24
verses.text: They have seen thy goings, O God; <hi type="italic">even</hi> the goings of my God, my King, in the sanctuary.

verses.name: Psalms 68:25
verses.text: The singers went before, the players on instruments <hi type="italic">followed</hi> after; among <hi type="italic">them were</hi> the damsels playing with timbrels.

verses.name: Psalms 68:26
verses.text: Bless ye God in the congregations, <hi type="italic">even</hi> the Lord, from the fountain of Israel.

verses.name: Psalms 68:27
verses.text: There <hi type="italic">is</hi> little Benjamin <hi type="italic">with</hi> their ruler, the princes of Judah <hi type="italic">and</hi> their council, the princes of Zebulun, <hi type="italic">and</hi> the princes of Naphtali.

verses.name: Psalms 68:28
verses.text: Thy God hath commanded thy strength: strengthen, O God, that which thou hast wrought for us.

verses.name: Psalms 68:29
verses.text: Because of thy temple at Jerusalem shall kings bring presents unto thee.

verses.name: Psalms 68:30
verses.text: Rebuke the company of spearmen, the multitude of the bulls, with the calves of the people, <hi type="italic">till every one</hi> submit himself with pieces of silver: scatter thou the people <hi type="italic">that</hi> delight in war.

verses.name: Psalms 68:31
verses.text: Princes shall come out of Egypt; Ethiopia shall soon stretch out her hands unto God.

verses.name: Psalms 68:32
verses.text: Sing unto God, ye kingdoms of the earth; O sing praises unto the Lord; Selah:

verses.name: Psalms 68:33
verses.text: To him that rideth upon the heavens of heavens, <hi type="italic">which were</hi> of old; lo, he doth send out his voice, <hi type="italic">and that</hi> a mighty voice.

verses.name: Psalms 68:34
verses.text: Ascribe ye strength unto God: his excellency <hi type="italic">is</hi> over Israel, and his strength <hi type="italic">is</hi> in the clouds.

verses.name: Psalms 68:35
verses.text: O God, <hi type="italic">thou art</hi> terrible out of thy holy places: the God of Israel <hi type="italic">is</hi> he that giveth strength and power unto <hi type="italic">his</hi> people. Blessed <hi type="italic">be</hi> God.  <chapter eID="Ps.68"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv64"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">To the chief Musician upon Shoshannim, <hi type="italic">A Psalm</hi> of David.</title> <div sID="gen567" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv64"/>SAVE me, O God; for the waters are come in unto <hi type="italic">my</hi> soul.

verses.name: Psalms 69:2
verses.text: I sink in deep mire, where <hi type="italic">there is</hi> no standing: I am come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.

verses.name: Psalms 69:3
verses.text: I am weary of my crying: my throat is dried: mine eyes fail while I wait for my God.

verses.name: Psalms 69:4
verses.text: They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of mine head: they that would destroy me, <hi type="italic">being</hi> mine enemies wrongfully, are mighty: then I restored <hi type="italic">that</hi> which I took not away.

verses.name: Psalms 69:5
verses.text: O God, thou knowest my foolishness; and my sins are not hid from thee.

verses.name: Psalms 69:6
verses.text: Let not them that wait on thee, O Lord God of hosts, be ashamed for my sake: let not those that seek thee be confounded for my sake, O God of Israel.

verses.name: Psalms 69:7
verses.text: Because for thy sake I have borne reproach; shame hath covered my face.

verses.name: Psalms 69:8
verses.text: I am become a stranger unto my brethren, and an alien unto my mother’s children.

verses.name: Psalms 69:9
verses.text: For the zeal of thine house hath eaten me up; and the reproaches of them that reproached thee are fallen upon me.

verses.name: Psalms 69:10
verses.text: When I wept, <hi type="italic">and chastened</hi> my soul with fasting, that was to my reproach.

verses.name: Psalms 69:11
verses.text: I made sackcloth also my garment; and I became a proverb to them.

verses.name: Psalms 69:12
verses.text: They that sit in the gate speak against me; and I <hi type="italic">was</hi> the song of the drunkards.

verses.name: Psalms 69:13
verses.text: But as for me, my prayer <hi type="italic">is</hi> unto thee, O Lord, <hi type="italic">in</hi> an acceptable time: O God, in the multitude of thy mercy hear me, in the truth of thy salvation.

verses.name: Psalms 69:14
verses.text: Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink: let me be delivered from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters.

verses.name: Psalms 69:15
verses.text: Let not the waterflood overflow me, neither let the deep swallow me up, and let not the pit shut her mouth upon me.

verses.name: Psalms 69:16
verses.text: Hear me, O Lord; for thy lovingkindness <hi type="italic">is</hi> good: turn unto me according to the multitude of thy tender mercies.

verses.name: Psalms 69:17
verses.text: And hide not thy face from thy servant; for I am in trouble: hear me speedily.

verses.name: Psalms 69:18
verses.text: Draw nigh unto my soul, <hi type="italic">and</hi> redeem it: deliver me because of mine enemies.

verses.name: Psalms 69:19
verses.text: Thou hast known my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonour: mine adversaries <hi type="italic">are</hi> all before thee.

verses.name: Psalms 69:20
verses.text: Reproach hath broken my heart; and I am full of heaviness: and I looked <hi type="italic">for some</hi> to take pity, but <hi type="italic">there was</hi> none; and for comforters, but I found none.

verses.name: Psalms 69:21
verses.text: They gave me also gall for my meat; and in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.

verses.name: Psalms 69:22
verses.text: Let their table become a snare before them: and <hi type="italic">that which should have been</hi> for <hi type="italic">their</hi> welfare, <hi type="italic">let it become</hi> a trap.

verses.name: Psalms 69:23
verses.text: Let their eyes be darkened, that they see not; and make their loins continually to shake.

verses.name: Psalms 69:24
verses.text: Pour out thine indignation upon them, and let thy wrathful anger take hold of them.

verses.name: Psalms 69:25
verses.text: Let their habitation be desolate; <hi type="italic">and</hi> let none dwell in their tents.

verses.name: Psalms 69:26
verses.text: For they persecute <hi type="italic">him</hi> whom thou hast smitten; and they talk to the grief of those whom thou hast wounded.

verses.name: Psalms 69:27
verses.text: Add iniquity unto their iniquity: and let them not come into thy righteousness.

verses.name: Psalms 69:28
verses.text: Let them be blotted out of the book of the living, and not be written with the righteous.

verses.name: Psalms 69:29
verses.text: But I <hi type="italic">am</hi> poor and sorrowful: let thy salvation, O God, set me up on high.

verses.name: Psalms 69:30
verses.text: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.

verses.name: Psalms 69:31
verses.text: <hi type="italic">This</hi> also shall please the Lord better than an ox <hi type="italic">or</hi> bullock that hath horns and hoofs.

verses.name: Psalms 69:32
verses.text: The humble shall see <hi type="italic">this</hi>, <hi type="italic">and</hi> be glad: and your heart shall live that seek God.

verses.name: Psalms 69:33
verses.text: For the Lord heareth the poor, and despiseth not his prisoners.

verses.name: Psalms 69:34
verses.text: Let the heaven and earth praise him, the seas, and every thing that moveth therein.

verses.name: Psalms 69:35
verses.text: For God will save Zion, and will build the cities of Judah: that they may dwell there, and have it in possession.

verses.name: Psalms 69:36
verses.text: The seed also of his servants shall inherit it: and they that love his name shall dwell therein.  <chapter eID="Ps.69"/>

verses.name: Psalms 70:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv65"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">To the chief Musician, <hi type="italic">A Psalm</hi> of David, to bring to remembrance.</title> <div sID="gen568" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv65"/><hi type="italic">MAKE haste</hi>, O God, to deliver me; make haste to help me, O Lord.

verses.name: Psalms 70:2
verses.text: Let them be ashamed and confounded that seek after my soul: let them be turned backward, and put to confusion, that desire my hurt.

verses.name: Psalms 70:3
verses.text: Let them be turned back for a reward of their shame that say, Aha, aha.

verses.name: Psalms 70:4
verses.text: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: and let such as love thy salvation say continually, Let God be magnified.

verses.name: Psalms 70:5
verses.text: But I <hi type="italic">am</hi> poor and needy: make haste unto me, O God: thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> my help and my deliverer; O Lord, make no tarrying.  <chapter eID="Ps.70"/><div eID="gen568" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:1
verses.text: IN thee, O Lord, do I put my trust: let me never be put to confusion.

verses.name: Psalms 71:2
verses.text: Deliver me in thy righteousness, and cause me to escape: incline thine ear unto me, and save me.

verses.name: Psalms 71:3
verses.text: Be thou my strong habitation, whereunto I may continually resort: thou hast given commandment to save me; for thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> my rock and my fortress.

verses.name: Psalms 71:4
verses.text: Deliver me, O my God, out of the hand of the wicked, out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.

verses.name: Psalms 71:5
verses.text: For thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> my hope, O Lord God: <hi type="italic">thou art</hi> my trust from my youth.

verses.name: Psalms 71:6
verses.text: By thee have I been holden up from the womb: thou art he that took me out of my mother’s bowels: my praise <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> continually of thee.

verses.name: Psalms 71:7
verses.text: I am as a wonder unto many; but thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> my strong refuge.

verses.name: Psalms 71:8
verses.text: Let my mouth be filled <hi type="italic">with</hi> thy praise <hi type="italic">and with</hi> thy honour all the day.

verses.name: Psalms 71:9
verses.text: Cast me not off in the time of old age; forsake me not when my strength faileth.

verses.name: Psalms 71:10
verses.text: For mine enemies speak against me; and they that lay wait for my soul take counsel together,

verses.name: Psalms 71:11
verses.text: Saying, God hath forsaken him: persecute and take him; for <hi type="italic">there is</hi> none to deliver <hi type="italic">him</hi>.

verses.name: Psalms 71:12
verses.text: O God, be not far from me: O my God, make haste for my help.

verses.name: Psalms 71:13
verses.text: Let them be confounded <hi type="italic">and</hi> consumed that are adversaries to my soul; let them be covered <hi type="italic">with</hi> reproach and dishonour that seek my hurt.

verses.name: Psalms 71:14
verses.text: But I will hope continually, and will yet praise thee more and more.

verses.name: Psalms 71:15
verses.text: My mouth shall shew forth thy righteousness <hi type="italic">and</hi> thy salvation all the day; for I know not the numbers <hi type="italic">thereof</hi>.

verses.name: Psalms 71:16
verses.text: I will go in the strength of the Lord God: I will make mention of thy righteousness, <hi type="italic">even</hi> of thine only.

verses.name: Psalms 71:17
verses.text: O God, thou hast taught me from my youth: and hitherto have I declared thy wondrous works.

verses.name: Psalms 71:18
verses.text: Now also when I am old and grayheaded, O God, forsake me not; until I have shewed thy strength unto <hi type="italic">this</hi> generation, <hi type="italic">and</hi> thy power to every one <hi type="italic">that</hi> is to come.

verses.name: Psalms 71:19
verses.text: Thy righteousness also, O God, <hi type="italic">is</hi> very high, who hast done great things: O God, who <hi type="italic">is</hi> like unto thee!

verses.name: Psalms 71:20
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Thou</hi>, which hast shewed me great and sore troubles, shalt quicken me again, and shalt bring me up again from the depths of the earth.

verses.name: Psalms 71:21
verses.text: Thou shalt increase my greatness, and comfort me on every side.

verses.name: Psalms 71:22
verses.text: I will also praise thee with the psaltery, <hi type="italic">even</hi> thy truth, O my God: unto thee will I sing with the harp, O thou Holy One of Israel.

verses.name: Psalms 71:23
verses.text: My lips shall greatly rejoice when I sing unto thee; and my soul, which thou hast redeemed.

verses.name: Psalms 71:24
verses.text: My tongue also shall talk of thy righteousness all the day long: for they are confounded, for they are brought unto shame, that seek my hurt.  <chapter eID="Ps.71"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv66"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><hi type="italic">A Psalm</hi> for Solomon.</title> <div sID="gen570" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv66"/>GIVE the king thy judgments, O God, and thy righteousness unto the king’s son.

verses.name: Psalms 72:2
verses.text: He shall judge thy people with righteousness, and thy poor with judgment.

verses.name: Psalms 72:3
verses.text: The mountains shall bring peace to the people, and the little hills, by righteousness.

verses.name: Psalms 72:4
verses.text: He shall judge the poor of the people, he shall save the children of the needy, and shall break in pieces the oppressor.

verses.name: Psalms 72:5
verses.text: They shall fear thee as long as the sun and moon endure, throughout all generations.

verses.name: Psalms 72:6
verses.text: He shall come down like rain upon the mown grass: as showers <hi type="italic">that</hi> water the earth.

verses.name: Psalms 72:7
verses.text: In his days shall the righteous flourish; and abundance of peace so long as the moon endureth.

verses.name: Psalms 72:8
verses.text: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, and from the river unto the ends of the earth.

verses.name: Psalms 72:9
verses.text: They that dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him; and his enemies shall lick the dust.

verses.name: Psalms 72:10
verses.text: The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall bring presents: the kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.

verses.name: Psalms 72:11
verses.text: Yea, all kings shall fall down before him: all nations shall serve him.

verses.name: Psalms 72:12
verses.text: For he shall deliver the needy when he crieth; the poor also, and <hi type="italic">him</hi> that hath no helper.

verses.name: Psalms 72:13
verses.text: He shall spare the poor and needy, and shall save the souls of the needy.

verses.name: Psalms 72:14
verses.text: He shall redeem their soul from deceit and violence: and precious shall their blood be in his sight.

verses.name: Psalms 72:15
verses.text: And he shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba: prayer also shall be made for him continually; <hi type="italic">and</hi> daily shall he be praised.

verses.name: Psalms 72:16
verses.text: There shall be an handful of corn in the earth upon the top of the mountains; the fruit thereof shall shake like Lebanon: and <hi type="italic">they</hi> of the city shall flourish like grass of the earth.

verses.name: Psalms 72:17
verses.text: His name shall endure for ever: his name shall be continued as long as the sun: and <hi type="italic">men</hi> shall be blessed in him: all nations shall call him blessed.

verses.name: Psalms 72:18
verses.text: Blessed <hi type="italic">be</hi> the Lord God, the God of Israel, who only doeth wondrous things.

verses.name: Psalms 72:19
verses.text: And blessed <hi type="italic">be</hi> his glorious name for ever: and let the whole earth be filled <hi type="italic">with</hi> his glory; Amen, and Amen.

verses.name: Psalms 72:20
verses.text: The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended.  <chapter eID="Ps.72"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv67"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">A Psalm of Asaph.</title> <div sID="gen571" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv67"/>TRULY God <hi type="italic">is</hi> good to Israel, <hi type="italic">even</hi> to such as are of a clean heart.

verses.name: Psalms 73:2
verses.text: But as for me, my feet were almost gone; my steps had well nigh slipped.

verses.name: Psalms 73:3
verses.text: For I was envious at the foolish, <hi type="italic">when</hi> I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

verses.name: Psalms 73:4
verses.text: For <hi type="italic">there are</hi> no bands in their death: but their strength <hi type="italic">is</hi> firm.

verses.name: Psalms 73:5
verses.text: They <hi type="italic">are</hi> not in trouble <hi type="italic">as other</hi> men; neither are they plagued like <hi type="italic">other</hi> men.

verses.name: Psalms 73:6
verses.text: Therefore pride compasseth them about as a chain; violence covereth them <hi type="italic">as</hi> a garment.

verses.name: Psalms 73:7
verses.text: Their eyes stand out with fatness: they have more than heart could wish.

verses.name: Psalms 73:8
verses.text: They are corrupt, and speak wickedly <hi type="italic">concerning</hi> oppression: they speak loftily.

verses.name: Psalms 73:9
verses.text: They set their mouth against the heavens, and their tongue walketh through the earth.

verses.name: Psalms 73:10
verses.text: Therefore his people return hither: and waters of a full <hi type="italic">cup</hi> are wrung out to them.

verses.name: Psalms 73:11
verses.text: And they say, How doth God know? and is there knowledge in the most High?

verses.name: Psalms 73:12
verses.text: Behold, these <hi type="italic">are</hi> the ungodly, who prosper in the world; they increase <hi type="italic">in</hi> riches.

verses.name: Psalms 73:13
verses.text: Verily I have cleansed my heart <hi type="italic">in</hi> vain, and washed my hands in innocency.

verses.name: Psalms 73:14
verses.text: For all the day long have I been plagued, and chastened every morning.

verses.name: Psalms 73:15
verses.text: If I say, I will speak thus; behold, I should offend <hi type="italic">against</hi> the generation of thy children.

verses.name: Psalms 73:16
verses.text: When I thought to know this, it <hi type="italic">was</hi> too painful for me;

verses.name: Psalms 73:17
verses.text: Until I went into the sanctuary of God; <hi type="italic">then</hi> understood I their end.

verses.name: Psalms 73:18
verses.text: Surely thou didst set them in slippery places: thou castedst them down into destruction.

verses.name: Psalms 73:19
verses.text: How are they <hi type="italic">brought</hi> into desolation, as in a moment! they are utterly consumed with terrors.

verses.name: Psalms 73:20
verses.text: As a dream when <hi type="italic">one</hi> awaketh; <hi type="italic">so</hi>, O Lord, when thou awakest, thou shalt despise their image.

verses.name: Psalms 73:21
verses.text: Thus my heart was grieved, and I was pricked in my reins.

verses.name: Psalms 73:22
verses.text: So foolish <hi type="italic">was</hi> I, and ignorant: I was <hi type="italic">as</hi> a beast before thee.

verses.name: Psalms 73:23
verses.text: Nevertheless I <hi type="italic">am</hi> continually with thee: thou hast holden <hi type="italic">me</hi> by my right hand.

verses.name: Psalms 73:24
verses.text: Thou shalt guide me with thy counsel, and afterward receive me <hi type="italic">to</hi> glory.

verses.name: Psalms 73:25
verses.text: Whom have I in heaven <hi type="italic">but thee?</hi> and <hi type="italic">there is</hi> none upon earth <hi type="italic">that</hi> I desire beside thee.

verses.name: Psalms 73:26
verses.text: My flesh and my heart faileth: <hi type="italic">but</hi> God <hi type="italic">is</hi> the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.

verses.name: Psalms 73:27
verses.text: For, lo, they that are far from thee shall perish: thou hast destroyed all them that go a whoring from thee.

verses.name: Psalms 73:28
verses.text: But <hi type="italic">it is</hi> good for me to draw near to God: I have put my trust in the Lord God, that I may declare all thy works.  <chapter eID="Ps.73"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv68"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">Maschil of Asaph.</title> <div sID="gen572" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv68"/>O GOD, why hast thou cast <hi type="italic">us</hi> off for ever? <hi type="italic">why</hi> doth thine anger smoke against the sheep of thy pasture?

verses.name: Psalms 74:2
verses.text: Remember thy congregation, <hi type="italic">which</hi> thou hast purchased of old; the rod of thine inheritance, <hi type="italic">which</hi> thou hast redeemed; this mount Zion, wherein thou hast dwelt.

verses.name: Psalms 74:3
verses.text: Lift up thy feet unto the perpetual desolations; <hi type="italic">even</hi> all <hi type="italic">that</hi> the enemy hath done wickedly in the sanctuary.

verses.name: Psalms 74:4
verses.text: Thine enemies roar in the midst of thy congregations; they set up their ensigns <hi type="italic">for</hi> signs.

verses.name: Psalms 74:5
verses.text: <hi type="italic">A man</hi> was famous according as he had lifted up axes upon the thick trees.

verses.name: Psalms 74:6
verses.text: But now they break down the carved work thereof at once with axes and hammers.

verses.name: Psalms 74:7
verses.text: They have cast fire into thy sanctuary, they have defiled <hi type="italic">by casting down</hi> the dwelling place of thy name to the ground.

verses.name: Psalms 74:8
verses.text: They said in their hearts, Let us destroy them together: they have burned up all the synagogues of God in the land.

verses.name: Psalms 74:9
verses.text: We see not our signs: <hi type="italic">there is</hi> no more any prophet: neither <hi type="italic">is there</hi> among us any that knoweth how long.

verses.name: Psalms 74:10
verses.text: O God, how long shall the adversary reproach? shall the enemy blaspheme thy name for ever?

verses.name: Psalms 74:11
verses.text: Why withdrawest thou thy hand, even thy right hand? pluck <hi type="italic">it</hi> out of thy bosom.

verses.name: Psalms 74:12
verses.text: For God <hi type="italic">is</hi> my King of old, working salvation in the midst of the earth.

verses.name: Psalms 74:13
verses.text: Thou didst divide the sea by thy strength: thou brakest the heads of the dragons in the waters.

verses.name: Psalms 74:14
verses.text: Thou brakest the heads of leviathan in pieces, <hi type="italic">and</hi> gavest him <hi type="italic">to be</hi> meat to the people inhabiting the wilderness.

verses.name: Psalms 74:15
verses.text: Thou didst cleave the fountain and the flood: thou driedst up mighty rivers.

verses.name: Psalms 74:16
verses.text: The day <hi type="italic">is</hi> thine, the night also <hi type="italic">is</hi> thine: thou hast prepared the light and the sun.

verses.name: Psalms 74:17
verses.text: Thou hast set all the borders of the earth: thou hast made summer and winter.

verses.name: Psalms 74:18
verses.text: Remember this, <hi type="italic">that</hi> the enemy hath reproached, O Lord, and <hi type="italic">that</hi> the foolish people have blasphemed thy name.

verses.name: Psalms 74:19
verses.text: O deliver not the soul of thy turtledove unto the multitude <hi type="italic">of the wicked:</hi> forget not the congregation of thy poor for ever.

verses.name: Psalms 74:20
verses.text: Have respect unto the covenant: for the dark places of the earth are full of the habitations of cruelty.

verses.name: Psalms 74:21
verses.text: O let not the oppressed return ashamed: let the poor and needy praise thy name.

verses.name: Psalms 74:22
verses.text: Arise, O God, plead thine own cause: remember how the foolish man reproacheth thee daily.

verses.name: Psalms 74:23
verses.text: Forget not the voice of thine enemies: the tumult of those that rise up against thee increaseth continually.  <chapter eID="Ps.74"/>

verses.name: Psalms 75:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv69"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">To the chief Musician, Al-taschith, A Psalm <hi type="italic">or</hi> Song of Asaph.</title> <div sID="gen573" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv69"/>UNTO thee, O God, do we give thanks, <hi type="italic">unto thee</hi> do we give thanks: for <hi type="italic">that</hi> thy name is near thy wondrous works declare.

verses.name: Psalms 75:2
verses.text: When I shall receive the congregation I will judge uprightly.

verses.name: Psalms 75:3
verses.text: The earth and all the inhabitants thereof are dissolved: I bear up the pillars of it. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 75:4
verses.text: I said unto the fools, Deal not foolishly: and to the wicked, Lift not up the horn:

verses.name: Psalms 75:5
verses.text: Lift not up your horn on high: speak <hi type="italic">not with</hi> a stiff neck.

verses.name: Psalms 75:6
verses.text: For promotion <hi type="italic">cometh</hi> neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the south.

verses.name: Psalms 75:7
verses.text: But God <hi type="italic">is</hi> the judge: he putteth down one, and setteth up another.

verses.name: Psalms 75:8
verses.text: For in the hand of the Lord <hi type="italic">there is</hi> a cup, and the wine is red; it is full of mixture; and he poureth out of the same: but the dregs thereof, all the wicked of the earth shall wring <hi type="italic">them</hi> out, <hi type="italic">and</hi> drink <hi type="italic">them</hi>.

verses.name: Psalms 75:9
verses.text: But I will declare for ever; I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.

verses.name: Psalms 75:10
verses.text: All the horns of the wicked also will I cut off; <hi type="italic">but</hi> the horns of the righteous shall be exalted.  <chapter eID="Ps.75"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv70"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">To the chief Musician on Neginoth, A Psalm <hi type="italic">or</hi> Song of Asaph.</title> <div sID="gen574" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv70"/>IN Judah <hi type="italic">is</hi> God known: his name <hi type="italic">is</hi> great in Israel.

verses.name: Psalms 76:2
verses.text: In Salem also is his tabernacle, and his dwelling place in Zion.

verses.name: Psalms 76:3
verses.text: There brake he the arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the battle. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 76:4
verses.text: Thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> more glorious <hi type="italic">and</hi> excellent than the mountains of prey.

verses.name: Psalms 76:5
verses.text: The stouthearted are spoiled, they have slept their sleep: and none of the men of might have found their hands.

verses.name: Psalms 76:6
verses.text: At thy rebuke, O God of Jacob, both the chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.

verses.name: Psalms 76:7
verses.text: Thou, <hi type="italic">even</hi> thou, <hi type="italic">art</hi> to be feared: and who may stand in thy sight when once thou art angry?

verses.name: Psalms 76:8
verses.text: Thou didst cause judgment to be heard from heaven; the earth feared, and was still,

verses.name: Psalms 76:9
verses.text: When God arose to judgment, to save all the meek of the earth. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 76:10
verses.text: Surely the wrath of man shall praise thee: the remainder of wrath shalt thou restrain.

verses.name: Psalms 76:11
verses.text: Vow, and pay unto the Lord your God: let all that be round about him bring presents unto him that ought to be feared.

verses.name: Psalms 76:12
verses.text: He shall cut off the spirit of princes: <hi type="italic">he is</hi> terrible to the kings of the earth.  <chapter eID="Ps.76"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv71"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">To the chief Musician, to Jeduthun, A Psalm of Asaph.</title> <div sID="gen575" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv71"/>I CRIED unto God with my voice, <hi type="italic">even</hi> unto God with my voice; and he gave ear unto me.

verses.name: Psalms 77:2
verses.text: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord: my sore ran in the night, and ceased not: my soul refused to be comforted.

verses.name: Psalms 77:3
verses.text: I remembered God, and was troubled: I complained, and my spirit was overwhelmed. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 77:4
verses.text: Thou holdest mine eyes waking: I am so troubled that I cannot speak.

verses.name: Psalms 77:5
verses.text: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.

verses.name: Psalms 77:6
verses.text: I call to remembrance my song in the night: I commune with mine own heart: and my spirit made diligent search.

verses.name: Psalms 77:7
verses.text: Will the Lord cast off for ever? and will he be favourable no more?

verses.name: Psalms 77:8
verses.text: Is his mercy clean gone for ever? doth <hi type="italic">his</hi> promise fail for evermore?

verses.name: Psalms 77:9
verses.text: Hath God forgotten to be gracious? hath he in anger shut up his tender mercies? Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 77:10
verses.text: And I said, This <hi type="italic">is</hi> my infirmity: <hi type="italic">but I will remember</hi> the years of the right hand of the most High.

verses.name: Psalms 77:11
verses.text: I will remember the works of the Lord: surely I will remember thy wonders of old.

verses.name: Psalms 77:12
verses.text: I will meditate also of all thy work, and talk of thy doings.

verses.name: Psalms 77:13
verses.text: Thy way, O God, <hi type="italic">is</hi> in the sanctuary: who <hi type="italic">is so</hi> great a God as <hi type="italic">our</hi> God?

verses.name: Psalms 77:14
verses.text: Thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> the God that doest wonders: thou hast declared thy strength among the people.

verses.name: Psalms 77:15
verses.text: Thou hast with <hi type="italic">thine</hi> arm redeemed thy people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 77:16
verses.text: The waters saw thee, O God, the waters saw thee; they were afraid: the depths also were troubled.

verses.name: Psalms 77:17
verses.text: The clouds poured out water: the skies sent out a sound: thine arrows also went abroad.

verses.name: Psalms 77:18
verses.text: The voice of thy thunder <hi type="italic">was</hi> in the heaven: the lightnings lightened the world: the earth trembled and shook.

verses.name: Psalms 77:19
verses.text: Thy way <hi type="italic">is</hi> in the sea, and thy path in the great waters, and thy footsteps are not known.

verses.name: Psalms 77:20
verses.text: Thou leddest thy people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.  <chapter eID="Ps.77"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv72"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">Maschil of Asaph.</title> <div sID="gen576" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv72"/>GIVE ear, O my people, <hi type="italic">to</hi> my law: incline your ears to the words of my mouth.

verses.name: Psalms 78:2
verses.text: I will open my mouth in a parable: I will utter dark sayings of old:

verses.name: Psalms 78:3
verses.text: Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.

verses.name: Psalms 78:4
verses.text: We will not hide <hi type="italic">them</hi> from their children, shewing to the generation to come the praises of the Lord, and his strength, and his wonderful works that he hath done.

verses.name: Psalms 78:5
verses.text: For he established a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a law in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children:

verses.name: Psalms 78:6
verses.text: That the generation to come might know <hi type="italic">them</hi>, <hi type="italic">even</hi> the children <hi type="italic">which</hi> should be born; <hi type="italic">who</hi> should arise and declare <hi type="italic">them</hi> to their children:

verses.name: Psalms 78:7
verses.text: That they might set their hope in God, and not forget the works of God, but keep his commandments:

verses.name: Psalms 78:8
verses.text: And might not be as their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation; a generation <hi type="italic">that</hi> set not their heart aright, and whose spirit was not stedfast with God.

verses.name: Psalms 78:9
verses.text: The children of Ephraim, <hi type="italic">being</hi> armed, <hi type="italic">and</hi> carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.

verses.name: Psalms 78:10
verses.text: They kept not the covenant of God, and refused to walk in his law;

verses.name: Psalms 78:11
verses.text: And forgat his works, and his wonders that he had shewed them.

verses.name: Psalms 78:12
verses.text: Marvellous things did he in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, <hi type="italic">in</hi> the field of Zoan.

verses.name: Psalms 78:13
verses.text: He divided the sea, and caused them to pass through; and he made the waters to stand as an heap.

verses.name: Psalms 78:14
verses.text: In the daytime also he led them with a cloud, and all the night with a light of fire.

verses.name: Psalms 78:15
verses.text: He clave the rocks in the wilderness, and gave <hi type="italic">them</hi> drink as <hi type="italic">out of</hi> the great depths.

verses.name: Psalms 78:16
verses.text: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.

verses.name: Psalms 78:17
verses.text: And they sinned yet more against him by provoking the most High in the wilderness.

verses.name: Psalms 78:18
verses.text: And they tempted God in their heart by asking meat for their lust.

verses.name: Psalms 78:19
verses.text: Yea, they spake against God; they said, Can God furnish a table in the wilderness?

verses.name: Psalms 78:20
verses.text: Behold, he smote the rock, that the waters gushed out, and the streams overflowed; can he give bread also? can he provide flesh for his people?

verses.name: Psalms 78:21
verses.text: Therefore the Lord heard <hi type="italic">this</hi>, and was wroth: so a fire was kindled against Jacob, and anger also came up against Israel;

verses.name: Psalms 78:22
verses.text: Because they believed not in God, and trusted not in his salvation:

verses.name: Psalms 78:23
verses.text: Though he had commanded the clouds from above, and opened the doors of heaven,

verses.name: Psalms 78:24
verses.text: And had rained down manna upon them to eat, and had given them of the corn of heaven.

verses.name: Psalms 78:25
verses.text: Man did eat angels’ food: he sent them meat to the full.

verses.name: Psalms 78:26
verses.text: He caused an east wind to blow in the heaven: and by his power he brought in the south wind.

verses.name: Psalms 78:27
verses.text: He rained flesh also upon them as dust, and feathered fowls like as the sand of the sea:

verses.name: Psalms 78:28
verses.text: And he let <hi type="italic">it</hi> fall in the midst of their camp, round about their habitations.

verses.name: Psalms 78:29
verses.text: So they did eat, and were well filled: for he gave them their own desire;

verses.name: Psalms 78:30
verses.text: They were not estranged from their lust. But while their meat <hi type="italic">was</hi> yet in their mouths,

verses.name: Psalms 78:31
verses.text: The wrath of God came upon them, and slew the fattest of them, and smote down the chosen <hi type="italic">men</hi> of Israel.

verses.name: Psalms 78:32
verses.text: For all this they sinned still, and believed not for his wondrous works.

verses.name: Psalms 78:33
verses.text: Therefore their days did he consume in vanity, and their years in trouble.

verses.name: Psalms 78:34
verses.text: When he slew them, then they sought him: and they returned and inquired early after God.

verses.name: Psalms 78:35
verses.text: And they remembered that God <hi type="italic">was</hi> their rock, and the high God their redeemer.

verses.name: Psalms 78:36
verses.text: Nevertheless they did flatter him with their mouth, and they lied unto him with their tongues.

verses.name: Psalms 78:37
verses.text: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they stedfast in his covenant.

verses.name: Psalms 78:38
verses.text: But he, <hi type="italic">being</hi> full of compassion, forgave <hi type="italic">their</hi> iniquity, and destroyed <hi type="italic">them</hi> not: yea, many a time turned he his anger away, and did not stir up all his wrath.

verses.name: Psalms 78:39
verses.text: For he remembered that they <hi type="italic">were but</hi> flesh; a wind that passeth away, and cometh not again.

verses.name: Psalms 78:40
verses.text: How oft did they provoke him in the wilderness, <hi type="italic">and</hi> grieve him in the desert!

verses.name: Psalms 78:41
verses.text: Yea, they turned back and tempted God, and limited the Holy One of Israel.

verses.name: Psalms 78:42
verses.text: They remembered not his hand, <hi type="italic">nor</hi> the day when he delivered them from the enemy.

verses.name: Psalms 78:43
verses.text: How he had wrought his signs in Egypt, and his wonders in the field of Zoan:

verses.name: Psalms 78:44
verses.text: And had turned their rivers into blood; and their floods, that they could not drink.

verses.name: Psalms 78:45
verses.text: He sent divers sorts of flies among them, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.

verses.name: Psalms 78:46
verses.text: He gave also their increase unto the caterpiller, and their labour unto the locust.

verses.name: Psalms 78:47
verses.text: He destroyed their vines with hail, and their sycomore trees with frost.

verses.name: Psalms 78:48
verses.text: He gave up their cattle also to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.

verses.name: Psalms 78:49
verses.text: He cast upon them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, and indignation, and trouble, by sending evil angels <hi type="italic">among them</hi>.

verses.name: Psalms 78:50
verses.text: He made a way to his anger; he spared not their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence;

verses.name: Psalms 78:51
verses.text: And smote all the firstborn in Egypt; the chief of <hi type="italic">their</hi> strength in the tabernacles of Ham:

verses.name: Psalms 78:52
verses.text: But made his own people to go forth like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.

verses.name: Psalms 78:53
verses.text: And he led them on safely, so that they feared not: but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.

verses.name: Psalms 78:54
verses.text: And he brought them to the border of his sanctuary, <hi type="italic">even to</hi> this mountain, <hi type="italic">which</hi> his right hand had purchased.

verses.name: Psalms 78:55
verses.text: He cast out the heathen also before them, and divided them an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.

verses.name: Psalms 78:56
verses.text: Yet they tempted and provoked the most high God, and kept not his testimonies:

verses.name: Psalms 78:57
verses.text: But turned back, and dealt unfaithfully like their fathers: they were turned aside like a deceitful bow.

verses.name: Psalms 78:58
verses.text: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their graven images.

verses.name: Psalms 78:59
verses.text: When God heard <hi type="italic">this</hi>, he was wroth, and greatly abhorred Israel:

verses.name: Psalms 78:60
verses.text: So that he forsook the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent <hi type="italic">which</hi> he placed among men;

verses.name: Psalms 78:61
verses.text: And delivered his strength into captivity, and his glory into the enemy’s hand.

verses.name: Psalms 78:62
verses.text: He gave his people over also unto the sword; and was wroth with his inheritance.

verses.name: Psalms 78:63
verses.text: The fire consumed their young men; and their maidens were not given to marriage.

verses.name: Psalms 78:64
verses.text: Their priests fell by the sword; and their widows made no lamentation.

verses.name: Psalms 78:65
verses.text: Then the Lord awaked as one out of sleep, <hi type="italic">and</hi> like a mighty man that shouteth by reason of wine.

verses.name: Psalms 78:66
verses.text: And he smote his enemies in the hinder parts: he put them to a perpetual reproach.

verses.name: Psalms 78:67
verses.text: Moreover he refused the tabernacle of Joseph, and chose not the tribe of Ephraim:

verses.name: Psalms 78:68
verses.text: But chose the tribe of Judah, the mount Zion which he loved.

verses.name: Psalms 78:69
verses.text: And he built his sanctuary like high <hi type="italic">palaces</hi>, like the earth which he hath established for ever.

verses.name: Psalms 78:70
verses.text: He chose David also his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds:

verses.name: Psalms 78:71
verses.text: From following the ewes great with young he brought him to feed Jacob his people, and Israel his inheritance.

verses.name: Psalms 78:72
verses.text: So he fed them according to the integrity of his heart; and guided them by the skilfulness of his hands.  <chapter eID="Ps.78"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv73"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">A Psalm of Asaph.</title> <div sID="gen577" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv73"/>O GOD, the heathen are come into thine inheritance; thy holy temple have they defiled; they have laid Jerusalem on heaps.

verses.name: Psalms 79:2
verses.text: The dead bodies of thy servants have they given <hi type="italic">to be</hi> meat unto the fowls of the heaven, the flesh of thy saints unto the beasts of the earth.

verses.name: Psalms 79:3
verses.text: Their blood have they shed like water round about Jerusalem; and <hi type="italic">there was</hi> none to bury <hi type="italic">them</hi>.

verses.name: Psalms 79:4
verses.text: We are become a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and derision to them that are round about us.

verses.name: Psalms 79:5
verses.text: How long, Lord? wilt thou be angry for ever? shall thy jealousy burn like fire?

verses.name: Psalms 79:6
verses.text: Pour out thy wrath upon the heathen that have not known thee, and upon the kingdoms that have not called upon thy name.

verses.name: Psalms 79:7
verses.text: For they have devoured Jacob, and laid waste his dwelling place.

verses.name: Psalms 79:8
verses.text: O remember not against us former iniquities: let thy tender mercies speedily prevent us: for we are brought very low.

verses.name: Psalms 79:9
verses.text: Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of thy name: and deliver us, and purge away our sins, for thy name’s sake.

verses.name: Psalms 79:10
verses.text: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where <hi type="italic">is</hi> their God? let him be known among the heathen in our sight <hi type="italic">by</hi> the revenging of the blood of thy servants <hi type="italic">which is</hi> shed.

verses.name: Psalms 79:11
verses.text: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before thee; according to the greatness of thy power preserve thou those that are appointed to die;

verses.name: Psalms 79:12
verses.text: And render unto our neighbours sevenfold into their bosom their reproach, wherewith they have reproached thee, O Lord.

verses.name: Psalms 79:13
verses.text: So we thy people and sheep of thy pasture will give thee thanks for ever: we will shew forth thy praise to all generations.  <chapter eID="Ps.79"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv74"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">To the chief Musician upon Shoshannim-Eduth, A Psalm of Asaph.</title> <div sID="gen578" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv74"/>GIVE ear, O Shepherd of Israel, thou that leadest Joseph like a flock; thou that dwellest <hi type="italic">between</hi> the cherubims, shine forth.

verses.name: Psalms 80:2
verses.text: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh stir up thy strength, and come <hi type="italic">and</hi> save us.

verses.name: Psalms 80:3
verses.text: Turn us again, O God, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.

verses.name: Psalms 80:4
verses.text: O Lord God of hosts, how long wilt thou be angry against the prayer of thy people?

verses.name: Psalms 80:5
verses.text: Thou feedest them with the bread of tears; and givest them tears to drink in great measure.

verses.name: Psalms 80:6
verses.text: Thou makest us a strife unto our neighbours: and our enemies laugh among themselves.

verses.name: Psalms 80:7
verses.text: Turn us again, O God of hosts, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.

verses.name: Psalms 80:8
verses.text: Thou hast brought a vine out of Egypt: thou hast cast out the heathen, and planted it.

verses.name: Psalms 80:9
verses.text: Thou preparedst <hi type="italic">room</hi> before it, and didst cause it to take deep root, and it filled the land.

verses.name: Psalms 80:10
verses.text: The hills were covered with the shadow of it, and the boughs thereof <hi type="italic">were like</hi> the goodly cedars.

verses.name: Psalms 80:11
verses.text: She sent out her boughs unto the sea, and her branches unto the river.

verses.name: Psalms 80:12
verses.text: Why hast thou <hi type="italic">then</hi> broken down her hedges, so that all they which pass by the way do pluck her?

verses.name: Psalms 80:13
verses.text: The boar out of the wood doth waste it, and the wild beast of the field doth devour it.

verses.name: Psalms 80:14
verses.text: Return, we beseech thee, O God of hosts: look down from heaven, and behold, and visit this vine;

verses.name: Psalms 80:15
verses.text: And the vineyard which thy right hand hath planted, and the branch <hi type="italic">that</hi> thou madest strong for thyself.

verses.name: Psalms 80:16
verses.text: <hi type="italic">It is</hi> burned with fire, <hi type="italic">it is</hi> cut down: they perish at the rebuke of thy countenance.

verses.name: Psalms 80:17
verses.text: Let thy hand be upon the man of thy right hand, upon the son of man <hi type="italic">whom</hi> thou madest strong for thyself.

verses.name: Psalms 80:18
verses.text: So will not we go back from thee: quicken us, and we will call upon thy name.

verses.name: Psalms 80:19
verses.text: Turn us again, O Lord God of hosts, cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.  <chapter eID="Ps.80"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:1
