verses.text: That thy beloved may be delivered: save <hi type="italic">with</hi> thy right hand, and answer me.

verses.name: Psalms 108:7
verses.text: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.

verses.name: Psalms 108:8
verses.text: Gilead <hi type="italic">is</hi> mine; Manasseh <hi type="italic">is</hi> mine; Ephraim also <hi type="italic">is</hi> the strength of mine head; Judah <hi type="italic">is</hi> my lawgiver;

verses.name: Psalms 108:9
verses.text: Moab <hi type="italic">is</hi> my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe; over Philistia will I triumph.

verses.name: Psalms 108:10
verses.text: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?

verses.name: Psalms 108:11
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Wilt</hi> not <hi type="italic">thou</hi>, O God, <hi type="italic">who</hi> hast cast us off? and wilt not thou, O God, go forth with our hosts?

verses.name: Psalms 108:12
verses.text: Give us help from trouble: for vain <hi type="italic">is</hi> the help of man.

verses.name: Psalms 108:13
verses.text: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he <hi type="italic">it is that</hi> shall tread down our enemies.  <chapter eID="Ps.108"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv92"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.</title> <div sID="gen607" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv92"/>HOLD not thy peace, O God of my praise;

verses.name: Psalms 109:2
verses.text: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful are opened against me: they have spoken against me with a lying tongue.

verses.name: Psalms 109:3
verses.text: They compassed me about also with words of hatred; and fought against me without a cause.

verses.name: Psalms 109:4
verses.text: For my love they are my adversaries: but I <hi type="italic">give myself unto</hi> prayer.

verses.name: Psalms 109:5
verses.text: And they have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.

verses.name: Psalms 109:6
verses.text: Set thou a wicked man over him: and let Satan stand at his right hand.

verses.name: Psalms 109:7
verses.text: When he shall be judged, let him be condemned: and let his prayer become sin.

verses.name: Psalms 109:8
verses.text: Let his days be few; <hi type="italic">and</hi> let another take his office.

verses.name: Psalms 109:9
verses.text: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.

verses.name: Psalms 109:10
verses.text: Let his children be continually vagabonds, and beg: let them seek <hi type="italic">their bread</hi> also out of their desolate places.

verses.name: Psalms 109:11
verses.text: Let the extortioner catch all that he hath; and let the strangers spoil his labour.

verses.name: Psalms 109:12
verses.text: Let there be none to extend mercy unto him: neither let there be any to favour his fatherless children.

verses.name: Psalms 109:13
verses.text: Let his posterity be cut off; <hi type="italic">and</hi> in the generation following let their name be blotted out.

verses.name: Psalms 109:14
verses.text: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with the Lord; and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.

verses.name: Psalms 109:15
verses.text: Let them be before the Lord continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.

verses.name: Psalms 109:16
verses.text: Because that he remembered not to shew mercy, but persecuted the poor and needy man, that he might even slay the broken in heart.

verses.name: Psalms 109:17
verses.text: As he loved cursing, so let it come unto him: as he delighted not in blessing, so let it be far from him.

verses.name: Psalms 109:18
verses.text: As he clothed himself with cursing like as with his garment, so let it come into his bowels like water, and like oil into his bones.

verses.name: Psalms 109:19
verses.text: Let it be unto him as the garment <hi type="italic">which</hi> covereth him, and for a girdle wherewith he is girded continually.

verses.name: Psalms 109:20
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Let</hi> this <hi type="italic">be</hi> the reward of mine adversaries from the Lord, and of them that speak evil against my soul.

verses.name: Psalms 109:21
verses.text: But do thou for me, O God the Lord, for thy name’s sake: because thy mercy <hi type="italic">is</hi> good, deliver thou me.

verses.name: Psalms 109:22
verses.text: For I <hi type="italic">am</hi> poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.

verses.name: Psalms 109:23
verses.text: I am gone like the shadow when it declineth: I am tossed up and down as the locust.

verses.name: Psalms 109:24
verses.text: My knees are weak through fasting; and my flesh faileth of fatness.

verses.name: Psalms 109:25
verses.text: I became also a reproach unto them: <hi type="italic">when</hi> they looked upon me they shaked their heads.

verses.name: Psalms 109:26
verses.text: Help me, O Lord my God: O save me according to thy mercy:

verses.name: Psalms 109:27
verses.text: That they may know that this <hi type="italic">is</hi> thy hand; <hi type="italic">that</hi> thou, Lord, hast done it.

verses.name: Psalms 109:28
verses.text: Let them curse, but bless thou: when they arise, let them be ashamed; but let thy servant rejoice.

verses.name: Psalms 109:29
verses.text: Let mine adversaries be clothed with shame, and let them cover themselves with their own confusion, as with a mantle.

verses.name: Psalms 109:30
verses.text: I will greatly praise the Lord with my mouth; yea, I will praise him among the multitude.

verses.name: Psalms 109:31
verses.text: For he shall stand at the right hand of the poor, to save <hi type="italic">him</hi> from those that condemn his soul.  <chapter eID="Ps.109"/>

verses.name: Psalms 110:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv93"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">A Psalm of David.</title> <div sID="gen608" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv93"/>THE Lord said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.

verses.name: Psalms 110:2
verses.text: The Lord shall send the rod of thy strength out of Zion: rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.

verses.name: Psalms 110:3
verses.text: Thy people <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> willing in the day of thy power, in the beauties of holiness from the womb of the morning: thou hast the dew of thy youth.

verses.name: Psalms 110:4
verses.text: The Lord hath sworn, and will not repent, Thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek.

verses.name: Psalms 110:5
verses.text: The Lord at thy right hand shall strike through kings in the day of his wrath.

verses.name: Psalms 110:6
verses.text: He shall judge among the heathen, he shall fill <hi type="italic">the places</hi> with the dead bodies; he shall wound the heads over many countries.

verses.name: Psalms 110:7
verses.text: He shall drink of the brook in the way: therefore shall he lift up the head.  <chapter eID="Ps.110"/><div eID="gen608" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 111:1
verses.text: PRAISE ye the Lord. I will praise the Lord with <hi type="italic">my</hi> whole heart, in the assembly of the upright, and <hi type="italic">in</hi> the congregation.

verses.name: Psalms 111:2
verses.text: The works of the Lord <hi type="italic">are</hi> great, sought out of all them that have pleasure therein.

verses.name: Psalms 111:3
verses.text: His work <hi type="italic">is</hi> honourable and glorious: and his righteousness endureth for ever.

verses.name: Psalms 111:4
verses.text: He hath made his wonderful works to be remembered: the Lord <hi type="italic">is</hi> gracious and full of compassion.

verses.name: Psalms 111:5
verses.text: He hath given meat unto them that fear him: he will ever be mindful of his covenant.

verses.name: Psalms 111:6
verses.text: He hath shewed his people the power of his works, that he may give them the heritage of the heathen.

verses.name: Psalms 111:7
verses.text: The works of his hands <hi type="italic">are</hi> verity and judgment; all his commandments <hi type="italic">are</hi> sure.

verses.name: Psalms 111:8
verses.text: They stand fast for ever and ever, <hi type="italic">and are</hi> done in truth and uprightness.

verses.name: Psalms 111:9
verses.text: He sent redemption unto his people: he hath commanded his covenant for ever: holy and reverend <hi type="italic">is</hi> his name.

verses.name: Psalms 111:10
verses.text: The fear of the Lord <hi type="italic">is</hi> the beginning of wisdom: a good understanding have all they that do <hi type="italic">his commandments:</hi> his praise endureth for ever.  <chapter eID="Ps.111"/><div eID="gen609" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 112:1
verses.text: PRAISE ye the Lord. Blessed <hi type="italic">is</hi> the man <hi type="italic">that</hi> feareth the Lord, <hi type="italic">that</hi> delighteth greatly in his commandments.

verses.name: Psalms 112:2
verses.text: His seed shall be mighty upon earth: the generation of the upright shall be blessed.

verses.name: Psalms 112:3
verses.text: Wealth and riches <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> in his house: and his righteousness endureth for ever.

verses.name: Psalms 112:4
verses.text: Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness: <hi type="italic">he is</hi> gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.

verses.name: Psalms 112:5
verses.text: A good man sheweth favour, and lendeth: he will guide his affairs with discretion.

verses.name: Psalms 112:6
verses.text: Surely he shall not be moved for ever: the righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance.

verses.name: Psalms 112:7
verses.text: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is fixed, trusting in the Lord.

verses.name: Psalms 112:8
verses.text: His heart <hi type="italic">is</hi> established, he shall not be afraid, until he see <hi type="italic">his desire</hi> upon his enemies.

verses.name: Psalms 112:9
verses.text: He hath dispersed, he hath given to the poor; his righteousness endureth for ever; his horn shall be exalted with honour.

verses.name: Psalms 112:10
verses.text: The wicked shall see <hi type="italic">it</hi>, and be grieved; he shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away: the desire of the wicked shall perish.  <chapter eID="Ps.112"/><div eID="gen610" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 113:1
verses.text: PRAISE ye the Lord. Praise, O ye servants of the Lord, praise the name of the Lord.

verses.name: Psalms 113:2
verses.text: Blessed be the name of the Lord from this time forth and for evermore.

verses.name: Psalms 113:3
verses.text: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same the Lord’s name <hi type="italic">is</hi> to be praised.

verses.name: Psalms 113:4
verses.text: The Lord <hi type="italic">is</hi> high above all nations, <hi type="italic">and</hi> his glory above the heavens.

verses.name: Psalms 113:5
verses.text: Who <hi type="italic">is</hi> like unto the Lord our God, who dwelleth on high,

verses.name: Psalms 113:6
verses.text: Who humbleth <hi type="italic">himself</hi> to behold <hi type="italic">the things that are</hi> in heaven, and in the earth!

verses.name: Psalms 113:7
verses.text: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, <hi type="italic">and</hi> lifteth the needy out of the dunghill;

verses.name: Psalms 113:8
verses.text: That he may set <hi type="italic">him</hi> with princes, <hi type="italic">even</hi> with the princes of his people.

verses.name: Psalms 113:9
verses.text: He maketh the barren woman to keep house, <hi type="italic">and to be</hi> a joyful mother of children. Praise ye the Lord.  <chapter eID="Ps.113"/><div eID="gen611" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 114:1
verses.text: WHEN Israel went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of strange language;

verses.name: Psalms 114:2
verses.text: Judah was his sanctuary, <hi type="italic">and</hi> Israel his dominion.

verses.name: Psalms 114:3
verses.text: The sea saw <hi type="italic">it</hi>, and fled: Jordan was driven back.

verses.name: Psalms 114:4
verses.text: The mountains skipped like rams, <hi type="italic">and</hi> the little hills like lambs.

verses.name: Psalms 114:5
verses.text: What <hi type="italic">ailed</hi> thee, O thou sea, that thou fleddest? thou Jordan, <hi type="italic">that</hi> thou wast driven back?

verses.name: Psalms 114:6
verses.text: Ye mountains, <hi type="italic">that</hi> ye skipped like rams; <hi type="italic">and</hi> ye little hills, like lambs?

verses.name: Psalms 114:7
verses.text: Tremble, thou earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob;

verses.name: Psalms 114:8
verses.text: Which turned the rock <hi type="italic">into</hi> a standing water, the flint into a fountain of waters.  <chapter eID="Ps.114"/><div eID="gen612" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:1
verses.text: NOT unto us, O Lord, not unto us, but unto thy name give glory, for thy mercy, <hi type="italic">and</hi> for thy truth’s sake.

verses.name: Psalms 115:2
verses.text: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where <hi type="italic">is</hi> now their God?

verses.name: Psalms 115:3
verses.text: But our God <hi type="italic">is</hi> in the heavens: he hath done whatsoever he hath pleased.

verses.name: Psalms 115:4
verses.text: Their idols <hi type="italic">are</hi> silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.

verses.name: Psalms 115:5
verses.text: They have mouths, but they speak not: eyes have they, but they see not:

verses.name: Psalms 115:6
verses.text: They have ears, but they hear not: noses have they, but they smell not:

verses.name: Psalms 115:7
verses.text: They have hands, but they handle not: feet have they, but they walk not: neither speak they through their throat.

verses.name: Psalms 115:8
verses.text: They that make them are like unto them; <hi type="italic">so is</hi> every one that trusteth in them.

verses.name: Psalms 115:9
verses.text: O Israel, trust thou in the Lord: he <hi type="italic">is</hi> their help and their shield.

verses.name: Psalms 115:10
verses.text: O house of Aaron, trust in the Lord: he <hi type="italic">is</hi> their help and their shield.

verses.name: Psalms 115:11
verses.text: Ye that fear the Lord, trust in the Lord: he <hi type="italic">is</hi> their help and their shield.

verses.name: Psalms 115:12
verses.text: The Lord hath been mindful of us: he will bless <hi type="italic">us;</hi> he will bless the house of Israel; he will bless the house of Aaron.

verses.name: Psalms 115:13
verses.text: He will bless them that fear the Lord, <hi type="italic">both</hi> small and great.

verses.name: Psalms 115:14
verses.text: The Lord shall increase you more and more, you and your children.

verses.name: Psalms 115:15
verses.text: Ye <hi type="italic">are</hi> blessed of the Lord which made heaven and earth.

verses.name: Psalms 115:16
verses.text: The heaven, <hi type="italic">even</hi> the heavens, <hi type="italic">are</hi> the Lord’s: but the earth hath he given to the children of men.

verses.name: Psalms 115:17
verses.text: The dead praise not the Lord, neither any that go down into silence.

verses.name: Psalms 115:18
verses.text: But we will bless the Lord from this time forth and for evermore. Praise the Lord.  <chapter eID="Ps.115"/><div eID="gen613" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:1
verses.text: I LOVE the Lord, because he hath heard my voice <hi type="italic">and</hi> my supplications.

verses.name: Psalms 116:2
verses.text: Because he hath inclined his ear unto me, therefore will I call upon <hi type="italic">him</hi> as long as I live.

verses.name: Psalms 116:3
verses.text: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the pains of hell gat hold upon me: I found trouble and sorrow.

verses.name: Psalms 116:4
verses.text: Then called I upon the name of the Lord; O Lord, I beseech thee, deliver my soul.

verses.name: Psalms 116:5
verses.text: Gracious <hi type="italic">is</hi> the Lord, and righteous; yea, our God <hi type="italic">is</hi> merciful.

verses.name: Psalms 116:6
verses.text: The Lord preserveth the simple: I was brought low, and he helped me.

verses.name: Psalms 116:7
verses.text: Return unto thy rest, O my soul; for the Lord hath dealt bountifully with thee.

verses.name: Psalms 116:8
verses.text: For thou hast delivered my soul from death, mine eyes from tears, <hi type="italic">and</hi> my feet from falling.

verses.name: Psalms 116:9
verses.text: I will walk before the Lord in the land of the living.

verses.name: Psalms 116:10
verses.text: I believed, therefore have I spoken: I was greatly afflicted:

verses.name: Psalms 116:11
verses.text: I said in my haste, All men <hi type="italic">are</hi> liars.

verses.name: Psalms 116:12
verses.text: What shall I render unto the Lord <hi type="italic">for</hi> all his benefits toward me?

verses.name: Psalms 116:13
verses.text: I will take the cup of salvation, and call upon the name of the Lord.

verses.name: Psalms 116:14
verses.text: I will pay my vows unto the Lord now in the presence of all his people.

verses.name: Psalms 116:15
verses.text: Precious in the sight of the Lord <hi type="italic">is</hi> the death of his saints.

verses.name: Psalms 116:16
verses.text: O Lord, truly I <hi type="italic">am</hi> thy servant; I <hi type="italic">am</hi> thy servant, <hi type="italic">and</hi> the son of thine handmaid: thou hast loosed my bonds.

verses.name: Psalms 116:17
verses.text: I will offer to thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call upon the name of the Lord.

verses.name: Psalms 116:18
verses.text: I will pay my vows unto the Lord now in the presence of all his people,

verses.name: Psalms 116:19
verses.text: In the courts of the Lord’s house, in the midst of thee, O Jerusalem. Praise ye the Lord.  <chapter eID="Ps.116"/><div eID="gen614" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 117:1
verses.text: O PRAISE the Lord, all ye nations: praise him, all ye people.

verses.name: Psalms 117:2
verses.text: For his merciful kindness is great toward us: and the truth of the Lord <hi type="italic">endureth</hi> for ever. Praise ye the Lord.  <chapter eID="Ps.117"/><div eID="gen615" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:1
verses.text: O GIVE thanks unto the Lord; for <hi type="italic">he is</hi> good: because his mercy <hi type="italic">endureth</hi> for ever.

verses.name: Psalms 118:2
verses.text: Let Israel now say, that his mercy <hi type="italic">endureth</hi> for ever.

verses.name: Psalms 118:3
verses.text: Let the house of Aaron now say, that his mercy <hi type="italic">endureth</hi> for ever.

verses.name: Psalms 118:4
verses.text: Let them now that fear the Lord say, that his mercy <hi type="italic">endureth</hi> for ever.

verses.name: Psalms 118:5
verses.text: I called upon the Lord in distress: the Lord answered me, <hi type="italic">and set me</hi> in a large place.

verses.name: Psalms 118:6
verses.text: The Lord <hi type="italic">is</hi> on my side; I will not fear: what can man do unto me?

verses.name: Psalms 118:7
verses.text: The Lord taketh my part with them that help me: therefore shall I see <hi type="italic">my desire</hi> upon them that hate me.

verses.name: Psalms 118:8
verses.text: <hi type="italic">It is</hi> better to trust in the Lord than to put confidence in man.

verses.name: Psalms 118:9
verses.text: <hi type="italic">It is</hi> better to trust in the Lord than to put confidence in princes.

verses.name: Psalms 118:10
verses.text: All nations compassed me about: but in the name of the Lord will I destroy them.

verses.name: Psalms 118:11
verses.text: They compassed me about; yea, they compassed me about: but in the name of the Lord I will destroy them.

verses.name: Psalms 118:12
verses.text: They compassed me about like bees; they are quenched as the fire of thorns: for in the name of the Lord I will destroy them.

verses.name: Psalms 118:13
verses.text: Thou hast thrust sore at me that I might fall: but the Lord helped me.

verses.name: Psalms 118:14
verses.text: The Lord <hi type="italic">is</hi> my strength and song, and is become my salvation.

verses.name: Psalms 118:15
verses.text: The voice of rejoicing and salvation <hi type="italic">is</hi> in the tabernacles of the righteous: the right hand of the Lord doeth valiantly.

verses.name: Psalms 118:16
verses.text: The right hand of the Lord is exalted: the right hand of the Lord doeth valiantly.

verses.name: Psalms 118:17
verses.text: I shall not die, but live, and declare the works of the Lord.

verses.name: Psalms 118:18
verses.text: The Lord hath chastened me sore: but he hath not given me over unto death.

verses.name: Psalms 118:19
verses.text: Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will go into them, <hi type="italic">and</hi> I will praise the Lord:

verses.name: Psalms 118:20
verses.text: This gate of the Lord, into which the righteous shall enter.

verses.name: Psalms 118:21
verses.text: I will praise thee: for thou hast heard me, and art become my salvation.

verses.name: Psalms 118:22
verses.text: The stone <hi type="italic">which</hi> the builders refused is become the head <hi type="italic">stone</hi> of the corner.

verses.name: Psalms 118:23
verses.text: This is the Lord’s doing; it <hi type="italic">is</hi> marvellous in our eyes.

verses.name: Psalms 118:24
verses.text: This <hi type="italic">is</hi> the day <hi type="italic">which</hi> the Lord hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.

verses.name: Psalms 118:25
verses.text: Save now, I beseech thee, O Lord: O Lord, I beseech thee, send now prosperity.

verses.name: Psalms 118:26
verses.text: Blessed <hi type="italic">be</hi> he that cometh in the name of the Lord: we have blessed you out of the house of the Lord.

verses.name: Psalms 118:27
verses.text: God <hi type="italic">is</hi> the Lord, which hath shewed us light: bind the sacrifice with cords, <hi type="italic">even</hi> unto the horns of the altar.

verses.name: Psalms 118:28
verses.text: Thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> my God, and I will praise thee: <hi type="italic">thou art</hi> my God, I will exalt thee.

verses.name: Psalms 118:29
verses.text: O give thanks unto the Lord; for <hi type="italic">he is</hi> good: for his mercy <hi type="italic">endureth</hi> for ever.  <chapter eID="Ps.118"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv94"/><title type="acrostic">ALEPH.</title> <div sID="gen618" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv94"/>BLESSED <hi type="italic">are</hi> the undefiled in the way, who walk in the law of the Lord.

verses.name: Psalms 119:2
verses.text: Blessed <hi type="italic">are</hi> they that keep his testimonies, <hi type="italic">and that</hi> seek him with the whole heart.

verses.name: Psalms 119:3
verses.text: They also do no iniquity: they walk in his ways.

verses.name: Psalms 119:4
verses.text: Thou hast commanded <hi type="italic">us</hi> to keep thy precepts diligently.

verses.name: Psalms 119:5
verses.text: O that my ways were directed to keep thy statutes!

verses.name: Psalms 119:6
verses.text: Then shall I not be ashamed, when I have respect unto all thy commandments.

verses.name: Psalms 119:7
verses.text: I will praise thee with uprightness of heart, when I shall have learned thy righteous judgments.

verses.name: Psalms 119:8
verses.text: I will keep thy statutes: O forsake me not utterly.<div eID="gen618" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen619"/> <lg eID="gen619"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv95"/><title type="acrostic">BETH.</title> <div sID="gen620" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv95"/>Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way? by taking heed <hi type="italic">thereto</hi> according to thy word.

verses.name: Psalms 119:10
verses.text: With my whole heart have I sought thee: O let me not wander from thy commandments.

verses.name: Psalms 119:11
verses.text: Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.

verses.name: Psalms 119:12
verses.text: Blessed <hi type="italic">art</hi> thou, O Lord: teach me thy statutes.

verses.name: Psalms 119:13
verses.text: With my lips have I declared all the judgments of thy mouth.

verses.name: Psalms 119:14
verses.text: I have rejoiced in the way of thy testimonies, as <hi type="italic">much as</hi> in all riches.

verses.name: Psalms 119:15
verses.text: I will meditate in thy precepts, and have respect unto thy ways.

verses.name: Psalms 119:16
verses.text: I will delight myself in thy statutes: I will not forget thy word.<div eID="gen620" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen621"/> <lg eID="gen621"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv96"/><title type="acrostic">GIMEL.</title> <div sID="gen622" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv96"/>Deal bountifully with thy servant, <hi type="italic">that</hi> I may live, and keep thy word.

verses.name: Psalms 119:18
verses.text: Open thou mine eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of thy law.

verses.name: Psalms 119:19
verses.text: I <hi type="italic">am</hi> a stranger in the earth: hide not thy commandments from me.

verses.name: Psalms 119:20
verses.text: My soul breaketh for the longing <hi type="italic">that it hath</hi> unto thy judgments at all times.

verses.name: Psalms 119:21
verses.text: Thou hast rebuked the proud <hi type="italic">that are</hi> cursed, which do err from thy commandments.

verses.name: Psalms 119:22
verses.text: Remove from me reproach and contempt; for I have kept thy testimonies.

verses.name: Psalms 119:23
verses.text: Princes also did sit <hi type="italic">and</hi> speak against me: <hi type="italic">but</hi> thy servant did meditate in thy statutes.

verses.name: Psalms 119:24
verses.text: Thy testimonies also <hi type="italic">are</hi> my delight <hi type="italic">and</hi> my counsellers.<div eID="gen622" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen623"/> <lg eID="gen623"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv97"/><title type="acrostic">DALETH.</title> <div sID="gen624" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv97"/>My soul cleaveth unto the dust: quicken thou me according to thy word.

verses.name: Psalms 119:26
verses.text: I have declared my ways, and thou heardest me: teach me thy statutes.

verses.name: Psalms 119:27
verses.text: Make me to understand the way of thy precepts: so shall I talk of thy wondrous works.

verses.name: Psalms 119:28
verses.text: My soul melteth for heaviness: strengthen thou me according unto thy word.

verses.name: Psalms 119:29
verses.text: Remove from me the way of lying: and grant me thy law graciously.

verses.name: Psalms 119:30
verses.text: I have chosen the way of truth: thy judgments have I laid <hi type="italic">before me</hi>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:31
verses.text: I have stuck unto thy testimonies: O Lord, put me not to shame.

verses.name: Psalms 119:32
verses.text: I will run the way of thy commandments, when thou shalt enlarge my heart.<div eID="gen624" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen625"/> <lg eID="gen625"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv98"/><title type="acrostic">HE.</title> <div sID="gen626" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv98"/>Teach me, O Lord, the way of thy statutes; and I shall keep it <hi type="italic">unto</hi> the end.

verses.name: Psalms 119:34
verses.text: Give me understanding, and I shall keep thy law; yea, I shall observe it with <hi type="italic">my</hi> whole heart.

verses.name: Psalms 119:35
verses.text: Make me to go in the path of thy commandments; for therein do I delight.

verses.name: Psalms 119:36
verses.text: Incline my heart unto thy testimonies, and not to covetousness.

verses.name: Psalms 119:37
verses.text: Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity; <hi type="italic">and</hi> quicken thou me in thy way.

verses.name: Psalms 119:38
verses.text: Stablish thy word unto thy servant, who <hi type="italic">is devoted</hi> to thy fear.

verses.name: Psalms 119:39
verses.text: Turn away my reproach which I fear: for thy judgments <hi type="italic">are</hi> good.

verses.name: Psalms 119:40
verses.text: Behold, I have longed after thy precepts: quicken me in thy righteousness.<div eID="gen626" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen627"/> <lg eID="gen627"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv99"/><title type="acrostic">VAU.</title> <div sID="gen628" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv99"/>Let thy mercies come also unto me, O Lord, <hi type="italic">even</hi> thy salvation, according to thy word.

verses.name: Psalms 119:42
verses.text: So shall I have wherewith to answer him that reproacheth me: for I trust in thy word.

verses.name: Psalms 119:43
verses.text: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; for I have hoped in thy judgments.

verses.name: Psalms 119:44
verses.text: So shall I keep thy law continually for ever and ever.

verses.name: Psalms 119:45
verses.text: And I will walk at liberty: for I seek thy precepts.

verses.name: Psalms 119:46
verses.text: I will speak of thy testimonies also before kings, and will not be ashamed.

verses.name: Psalms 119:47
verses.text: And I will delight myself in thy commandments, which I have loved.

verses.name: Psalms 119:48
verses.text: My hands also will I lift up unto thy commandments, which I have loved; and I will meditate in thy statutes.<div eID="gen628" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen629"/> <lg eID="gen629"/> <title type="acrostic"/> <lg sID="gen630"/> <lg eID="gen630"/> <title type="acrostic">ZAIN.</title> <lg sID="gen631"/>  <lg eID="gen631"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:49
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv100"/><div sID="gen632" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv100"/>Remember the word unto thy servant, upon which thou hast caused me to hope.

verses.name: Psalms 119:50
verses.text: This <hi type="italic">is</hi> my comfort in my affliction: for thy word hath quickened me.

verses.name: Psalms 119:51
verses.text: The proud have had me greatly in derision: <hi type="italic">yet</hi> have I not declined from thy law.

verses.name: Psalms 119:52
verses.text: I remembered thy judgments of old, O Lord; and have comforted myself.

verses.name: Psalms 119:53
verses.text: Horror hath taken hold upon me because of the wicked that forsake thy law.

verses.name: Psalms 119:54
verses.text: Thy statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage.

verses.name: Psalms 119:55
verses.text: I have remembered thy name, O Lord, in the night, and have kept thy law.

verses.name: Psalms 119:56
verses.text: This I had, because I kept thy precepts.<div eID="gen632" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen633"/> <lg eID="gen633"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:57
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv101"/><title type="acrostic">CHETH.</title> <div sID="gen634" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv101"/><hi type="italic">Thou art</hi> my portion, O Lord: I have said that I would keep thy words.

verses.name: Psalms 119:58
verses.text: I intreated thy favour with <hi type="italic">my</hi> whole heart: be merciful unto me according to thy word.

verses.name: Psalms 119:59
verses.text: I thought on my ways, and turned my feet unto thy testimonies.

verses.name: Psalms 119:60
verses.text: I made haste, and delayed not to keep thy commandments.

verses.name: Psalms 119:61
verses.text: The bands of the wicked have robbed me: <hi type="italic">but</hi> I have not forgotten thy law.

verses.name: Psalms 119:62
verses.text: At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto thee because of thy righteous judgments.

verses.name: Psalms 119:63
verses.text: I <hi type="italic">am</hi> a companion of all <hi type="italic">them</hi> that fear thee, and of them that keep thy precepts.

verses.name: Psalms 119:64
verses.text: The earth, O Lord, is full of thy mercy: teach me thy statutes.<div eID="gen634" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen635"/> <lg eID="gen635"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:65
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv102"/><title type="acrostic">TETH.</title> <div sID="gen636" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv102"/>Thou hast dealt well with thy servant, O Lord, according unto thy word.

verses.name: Psalms 119:66
verses.text: Teach me good judgment and knowledge: for I have believed thy commandments.

verses.name: Psalms 119:67
verses.text: Before I was afflicted I went astray: but now have I kept thy word.

verses.name: Psalms 119:68
verses.text: Thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> good, and doest good; teach me thy statutes.

verses.name: Psalms 119:69
verses.text: The proud have forged a lie against me: <hi type="italic">but</hi> I will keep thy precepts with <hi type="italic">my</hi> whole heart.

verses.name: Psalms 119:70
verses.text: Their heart is as fat as grease; <hi type="italic">but</hi> I delight in thy law.

verses.name: Psalms 119:71
verses.text: <hi type="italic">It is</hi> good for me that I have been afflicted; that I might learn thy statutes.

verses.name: Psalms 119:72
verses.text: The law of thy mouth <hi type="italic">is</hi> better unto me than thousands of gold and silver.<div eID="gen636" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen637"/> <lg eID="gen637"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:73
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv103"/><title type="acrostic">JOD.</title> <div sID="gen638" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv103"/>Thy hands have made me and fashioned me: give me understanding, that I may learn thy commandments.

verses.name: Psalms 119:74
verses.text: They that fear thee will be glad when they see me; because I have hoped in thy word.

verses.name: Psalms 119:75
verses.text: I know, O Lord, that thy judgments <hi type="italic">are</hi> right, and <hi type="italic">that</hi> thou in faithfulness hast afflicted me.

verses.name: Psalms 119:76
verses.text: Let, I pray thee, thy merciful kindness be for my comfort, according to thy word unto thy servant.

verses.name: Psalms 119:77
verses.text: Let thy tender mercies come unto me, that I may live: for thy law <hi type="italic">is</hi> my delight.

verses.name: Psalms 119:78
verses.text: Let the proud be ashamed; for they dealt perversely with me without a cause: <hi type="italic">but</hi> I will meditate in thy precepts.

verses.name: Psalms 119:79
verses.text: Let those that fear thee turn unto me, and those that have known thy testimonies.

verses.name: Psalms 119:80
verses.text: Let my heart be sound in thy statutes; that I be not ashamed.<div eID="gen638" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen639"/> <lg eID="gen639"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:81
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv104"/><title type="acrostic">CAPH.</title> <div sID="gen640" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv104"/>My soul fainteth for thy salvation: <hi type="italic">but</hi> I hope in thy word.

verses.name: Psalms 119:82
verses.text: Mine eyes fail for thy word, saying, When wilt thou comfort me?

verses.name: Psalms 119:83
verses.text: For I am become like a bottle in the smoke; <hi type="italic">yet</hi> do I not forget thy statutes.

verses.name: Psalms 119:84
verses.text: How many <hi type="italic">are</hi> the days of thy servant? when wilt thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?

verses.name: Psalms 119:85
verses.text: The proud have digged pits for me, which <hi type="italic">are</hi> not after thy law.

verses.name: Psalms 119:86
verses.text: All thy commandments <hi type="italic">are</hi> faithful: they persecute me wrongfully; help thou me.

verses.name: Psalms 119:87
verses.text: They had almost consumed me upon earth; but I forsook not thy precepts.

verses.name: Psalms 119:88
verses.text: Quicken me after thy lovingkindness; so shall I keep the testimony of thy mouth.<div eID="gen640" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen641"/> <lg eID="gen641"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:89
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv105"/><title type="acrostic">LAMED.</title> <div sID="gen642" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv105"/>For ever, O Lord, thy word is settled in heaven.

verses.name: Psalms 119:90
verses.text: Thy faithfulness <hi type="italic">is</hi> unto all generations: thou hast established the earth, and it abideth.

verses.name: Psalms 119:91
verses.text: They continue this day according to thine ordinances: for all <hi type="italic">are</hi> thy servants.

verses.name: Psalms 119:92
verses.text: Unless thy law <hi type="italic">had been</hi> my delights, I should then have perished in mine affliction.

verses.name: Psalms 119:93
verses.text: I will never forget thy precepts: for with them thou hast quickened me.

verses.name: Psalms 119:94
verses.text: I <hi type="italic">am</hi> thine, save me; for I have sought thy precepts.

verses.name: Psalms 119:95
verses.text: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me: <hi type="italic">but</hi> I will consider thy testimonies.

verses.name: Psalms 119:96
verses.text: I have seen an end of all perfection: <hi type="italic">but</hi> thy commandment <hi type="italic">is</hi> exceeding broad.<div eID="gen642" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen643"/> <lg eID="gen643"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:97
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv106"/><title type="acrostic">MEM.</title> <div sID="gen644" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv106"/>O how love I thy law! it <hi type="italic">is</hi> my meditation all the day.

verses.name: Psalms 119:98
verses.text: Thou through thy commandments hast made me wiser than mine enemies: for they <hi type="italic">are</hi> ever with me.

verses.name: Psalms 119:99
verses.text: I have more understanding than all my teachers: for thy testimonies <hi type="italic">are</hi> my meditation.

verses.name: Psalms 119:100
verses.text: I understand more than the ancients, because I keep thy precepts.

verses.name: Psalms 119:101
verses.text: I have refrained my feet from every evil way, that I might keep thy word.

verses.name: Psalms 119:102
verses.text: I have not departed from thy judgments: for thou hast taught me.

verses.name: Psalms 119:103
verses.text: How sweet are thy words unto my taste! <hi type="italic">yea</hi>, <hi type="italic">sweeter</hi> than honey to my mouth!

verses.name: Psalms 119:104
verses.text: Through thy precepts I get understanding: therefore I hate every false way.<div eID="gen644" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen645"/> <lg eID="gen645"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:105
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv107"/><title type="acrostic">NUN.</title> <div sID="gen646" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv107"/>Thy word <hi type="italic">is</hi> a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.

verses.name: Psalms 119:106
verses.text: I have sworn, and I will perform <hi type="italic">it</hi>, that I will keep thy righteous judgments.

verses.name: Psalms 119:107
verses.text: I am afflicted very much: quicken me, O Lord, according unto thy word.

verses.name: Psalms 119:108
verses.text: Accept, I beseech thee, the freewill offerings of my mouth, O Lord, and teach me thy judgments.

verses.name: Psalms 119:109
verses.text: My soul <hi type="italic">is</hi> continually in my hand: yet do I not forget thy law.

verses.name: Psalms 119:110
verses.text: The wicked have laid a snare for me: yet I erred not from thy precepts.

verses.name: Psalms 119:111
verses.text: Thy testimonies have I taken as an heritage for ever: for they <hi type="italic">are</hi> the rejoicing of my heart.

verses.name: Psalms 119:112
verses.text: I have inclined mine heart to perform thy statutes alway, <hi type="italic">even unto</hi> the end.<div eID="gen646" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen647"/> <lg eID="gen647"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:113
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv108"/><title type="acrostic">SAMECH.</title> <div sID="gen648" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv108"/>I hate <hi type="italic">vain</hi> thoughts: but thy law do I love.

verses.name: Psalms 119:114
verses.text: Thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> my hiding place and my shield: I hope in thy word.

verses.name: Psalms 119:115
verses.text: Depart from me, ye evildoers: for I will keep the commandments of my God.

verses.name: Psalms 119:116
verses.text: Uphold me according unto thy word, that I may live: and let me not be ashamed of my hope.

verses.name: Psalms 119:117
verses.text: Hold thou me up, and I shall be safe: and I will have respect unto thy statutes continually.

verses.name: Psalms 119:118
verses.text: Thou hast trodden down all them that err from thy statutes: for their deceit <hi type="italic">is</hi> falsehood.

verses.name: Psalms 119:119
verses.text: Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth <hi type="italic">like</hi> dross: therefore I love thy testimonies.

verses.name: Psalms 119:120
verses.text: My flesh trembleth for fear of thee; and I am afraid of thy judgments. AIN.

verses.name: Psalms 119:121
verses.text: I have done judgment and justice: leave me not to mine oppressors.

verses.name: Psalms 119:122
verses.text: Be surety for thy servant for good: let not the proud oppress me.

verses.name: Psalms 119:123
verses.text: Mine eyes fail for thy salvation, and for the word of thy righteousness.

verses.name: Psalms 119:124
verses.text: Deal with thy servant according unto thy mercy, and teach me thy statutes.

verses.name: Psalms 119:125
verses.text: I <hi type="italic">am</hi> thy servant; give me understanding, that I may know thy testimonies.

verses.name: Psalms 119:126
verses.text: <hi type="italic">It is</hi> time for <hi type="italic">thee</hi>, Lord, to work: <hi type="italic">for</hi> they have made void thy law.

verses.name: Psalms 119:127
verses.text: Therefore I love thy commandments above gold; yea, above fine gold.

verses.name: Psalms 119:128
verses.text: Therefore I esteem all <hi type="italic">thy</hi> precepts <hi type="italic">concerning</hi> all <hi type="italic">things to be</hi> right; <hi type="italic">and</hi> I hate every false way.<div eID="gen648" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen649"/> <lg eID="gen649"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:129
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv109"/><title type="acrostic">PE.</title> <div sID="gen650" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv109"/>Thy testimonies <hi type="italic">are</hi> wonderful: therefore doth my soul keep them.

verses.name: Psalms 119:130
verses.text: The entrance of thy words giveth light; it giveth understanding unto the simple.

verses.name: Psalms 119:131
verses.text: I opened my mouth, and panted: for I longed for thy commandments.

verses.name: Psalms 119:132
verses.text: Look thou upon me, and be merciful unto me, as thou usest to do unto those that love thy name.

verses.name: Psalms 119:133
verses.text: Order my steps in thy word: and let not any iniquity have dominion over me.

verses.name: Psalms 119:134
verses.text: Deliver me from the oppression of man: so will I keep thy precepts.

verses.name: Psalms 119:135
verses.text: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant; and teach me thy statutes.

verses.name: Psalms 119:136
verses.text: Rivers of waters run down mine eyes, because they keep not thy law.<div eID="gen650" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen651"/> <lg eID="gen651"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:137
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv110"/><title type="acrostic">TZADDI.</title> <div sID="gen652" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv110"/>Righteous <hi type="italic">art</hi> thou, O Lord, and upright <hi type="italic">are</hi> thy judgments.

verses.name: Psalms 119:138
verses.text: Thy testimonies <hi type="italic">that</hi> thou hast commanded <hi type="italic">are</hi> righteous and very faithful.

verses.name: Psalms 119:139
verses.text: My zeal hath consumed me, because mine enemies have forgotten thy words.

verses.name: Psalms 119:140
verses.text: Thy word <hi type="italic">is</hi> very pure: therefore thy servant loveth it.

verses.name: Psalms 119:141
verses.text: I <hi type="italic">am</hi> small and despised: <hi type="italic">yet</hi> do not I forget thy precepts.

verses.name: Psalms 119:142
verses.text: Thy righteousness <hi type="italic">is</hi> an everlasting righteousness, and thy law <hi type="italic">is</hi> the truth.

verses.name: Psalms 119:143
verses.text: Trouble and anguish have taken hold on me: <hi type="italic">yet</hi> thy commandments <hi type="italic">are</hi> my delights.

verses.name: Psalms 119:144
verses.text: The righteousness of thy testimonies <hi type="italic">is</hi> everlasting: give me understanding, and I shall live.<div eID="gen652" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen653"/> <lg eID="gen653"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:145
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv111"/><title type="acrostic">KOPH.</title> <div sID="gen654" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv111"/>I cried with <hi type="italic">my</hi> whole heart; hear me, O Lord: I will keep thy statutes.

verses.name: Psalms 119:146
verses.text: I cried unto thee; save me, and I shall keep thy testimonies.

verses.name: Psalms 119:147
verses.text: I prevented the dawning of the morning, and cried: I hoped in thy word.

verses.name: Psalms 119:148
verses.text: Mine eyes prevent the <hi type="italic">night</hi> watches, that I might meditate in thy word.

verses.name: Psalms 119:149
verses.text: Hear my voice according unto thy lovingkindness: O Lord, quicken me according to thy judgment.

verses.name: Psalms 119:150
verses.text: They draw nigh that follow after mischief: they are far from thy law.

verses.name: Psalms 119:151
verses.text: Thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> near, O Lord; and all thy commandments <hi type="italic">are</hi> truth.

verses.name: Psalms 119:152
verses.text: Concerning thy testimonies, I have known of old that thou hast founded them for ever.<div eID="gen654" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen655"/> <lg eID="gen655"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:153
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv112"/><title type="acrostic">RESH.</title> <div sID="gen656" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv112"/>Consider mine affliction, and deliver me: for I do not forget thy law.

verses.name: Psalms 119:154
verses.text: Plead my cause, and deliver me: quicken me according to thy word.

verses.name: Psalms 119:155
verses.text: Salvation <hi type="italic">is</hi> far from the wicked: for they seek not thy statutes.

verses.name: Psalms 119:156
verses.text: Great <hi type="italic">are</hi> thy tender mercies, O Lord: quicken me according to thy judgments.

verses.name: Psalms 119:157
verses.text: Many <hi type="italic">are</hi> my persecutors and mine enemies; <hi type="italic">yet</hi> do I not decline from thy testimonies.

verses.name: Psalms 119:158
verses.text: I beheld the transgressors, and was grieved; because they kept not thy word.

verses.name: Psalms 119:159
verses.text: Consider how I love thy precepts: quicken me, O Lord, according to thy lovingkindness.

verses.name: Psalms 119:160
verses.text: Thy word <hi type="italic">is</hi> true <hi type="italic">from</hi> the beginning: and every one of thy righteous judgments <hi type="italic">endureth</hi> for ever.<div eID="gen656" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen657"/> <lg eID="gen657"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:161
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv113"/><title type="acrostic">SCHIN.</title> <div sID="gen658" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv113"/>Princes have persecuted me without a cause: but my heart standeth in awe of thy word.

verses.name: Psalms 119:162
verses.text: I rejoice at thy word, as one that findeth great spoil.

verses.name: Psalms 119:163
verses.text: I hate and abhor lying: <hi type="italic">but</hi> thy law do I love.

verses.name: Psalms 119:164
verses.text: Seven times a day do I praise thee because of thy righteous judgments.

verses.name: Psalms 119:165
verses.text: Great peace have they which love thy law: and nothing shall offend them.

verses.name: Psalms 119:166
verses.text: Lord, I have hoped for thy salvation, and done thy commandments.

verses.name: Psalms 119:167
verses.text: My soul hath kept thy testimonies; and I love them exceedingly.

verses.name: Psalms 119:168
verses.text: I have kept thy precepts and thy testimonies: for all my ways <hi type="italic">are</hi> before thee.<div eID="gen658" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen659"/> <lg eID="gen659"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:169
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv114"/><title type="acrostic">TAU.</title> <div sID="gen660" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv114"/>Let my cry come near before thee, O Lord: give me understanding according to thy word.

verses.name: Psalms 119:170
verses.text: Let my supplication come before thee: deliver me according to thy word.

verses.name: Psalms 119:171
verses.text: My lips shall utter praise, when thou hast taught me thy statutes.

verses.name: Psalms 119:172
verses.text: My tongue shall speak of thy word: for all thy commandments <hi type="italic">are</hi> righteousness.

verses.name: Psalms 119:173
verses.text: Let thine hand help me; for I have chosen thy precepts.

verses.name: Psalms 119:174
verses.text: I have longed for thy salvation, O Lord; and thy law <hi type="italic">is</hi> my delight.

verses.name: Psalms 119:175
verses.text: Let my soul live, and it shall praise thee; and let thy judgments help me.

verses.name: Psalms 119:176
verses.text: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek thy servant; for I do not forget thy commandments.  <chapter eID="Ps.119"/>

verses.name: Psalms 120:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv115"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">A Song of degrees.</title> <div sID="gen661" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv115"/>IN my distress I cried unto the Lord, and he heard me.

verses.name: Psalms 120:2
verses.text: Deliver my soul, O Lord, from lying lips, <hi type="italic">and</hi> from a deceitful tongue.

verses.name: Psalms 120:3
verses.text: What shall be given unto thee? or what shall be done unto thee, thou false tongue?

verses.name: Psalms 120:4
verses.text: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.

verses.name: Psalms 120:5
verses.text: Woe is me, that I sojourn in Mesech, <hi type="italic">that</hi> I dwell in the tents of Kedar!

verses.name: Psalms 120:6
verses.text: My soul hath long dwelt with him that hateth peace.

verses.name: Psalms 120:7
verses.text: I <hi type="italic">am for</hi> peace: but when I speak, they <hi type="italic">are</hi> for war.  <chapter eID="Ps.120"/>

verses.name: Psalms 121:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv116"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">A Song of degrees.</title> <div sID="gen662" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv116"/>I WILL lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help.

verses.name: Psalms 121:2
verses.text: My help <hi type="italic">cometh</hi> from the Lord, which made heaven and earth.

verses.name: Psalms 121:3
verses.text: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: he that keepeth thee will not slumber.

verses.name: Psalms 121:4
verses.text: Behold, he that keepeth Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep.

verses.name: Psalms 121:5
verses.text: The Lord <hi type="italic">is</hi> thy keeper: the Lord <hi type="italic">is</hi> thy shade upon thy right hand.

verses.name: Psalms 121:6
verses.text: The sun shall not smite thee by day, nor the moon by night.

verses.name: Psalms 121:7
verses.text: The Lord shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul.

verses.name: Psalms 121:8
verses.text: The Lord shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore.  <chapter eID="Ps.121"/>

verses.name: Psalms 122:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv117"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">A Song of degrees of David.</title> <div sID="gen663" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv117"/>I WAS glad when they said unto me, Let us go into the house of the Lord.

verses.name: Psalms 122:2
verses.text: Our feet shall stand within thy gates, O Jerusalem.

verses.name: Psalms 122:3
verses.text: Jerusalem is builded as a city that is compact together:

verses.name: Psalms 122:4
verses.text: Whither the tribes go up, the tribes of the Lord, unto the testimony of Israel, to give thanks unto the name of the Lord.

verses.name: Psalms 122:5
verses.text: For there are set thrones of judgment, the thrones of the house of David.

verses.name: Psalms 122:6
verses.text: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: they shall prosper that love thee.

verses.name: Psalms 122:7
verses.text: Peace be within thy walls, <hi type="italic">and</hi> prosperity within thy palaces.

verses.name: Psalms 122:8
verses.text: For my brethren and companions’ sakes, I will now say, Peace <hi type="italic">be</hi> within thee.

verses.name: Psalms 122:9
verses.text: Because of the house of the Lord our God I will seek thy good.  <chapter eID="Ps.122"/>

verses.name: Psalms 123:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv118"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">A Song of degrees.</title> <div sID="gen664" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv118"/>UNTO thee lift I up mine eyes, O thou that dwellest in the heavens.

verses.name: Psalms 123:2
verses.text: Behold, as the eyes of servants <hi type="italic">look</hi> unto the hand of their masters, <hi type="italic">and</hi> as the eyes of a maiden unto the hand of her mistress; so our eyes <hi type="italic">wait</hi> upon the Lord our God, until that he have mercy upon us.

verses.name: Psalms 123:3
verses.text: Have mercy upon us, O Lord, have mercy upon us: for we are exceedingly filled with contempt.

verses.name: Psalms 123:4
verses.text: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scorning of those that are at ease, <hi type="italic">and</hi> with the contempt of the proud.  <chapter eID="Ps.123"/>

verses.name: Psalms 124:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv119"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">A Song of degrees of David.</title> <div sID="gen665" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv119"/>IF <hi type="italic">it had</hi> not <hi type="italic">been</hi> the Lord who was on our side, now may Israel say;

verses.name: Psalms 124:2
verses.text: If <hi type="italic">it had</hi> not <hi type="italic">been</hi> the Lord who was on our side, when men rose up against us:

verses.name: Psalms 124:3
verses.text: Then they had swallowed us up quick, when their wrath was kindled against us:

verses.name: Psalms 124:4
verses.text: Then the waters had overwhelmed us, the stream had gone over our soul:

verses.name: Psalms 124:5
verses.text: Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.

verses.name: Psalms 124:6
verses.text: Blessed <hi type="italic">be</hi> the Lord, who hath not given us <hi type="italic">as</hi> a prey to their teeth.

verses.name: Psalms 124:7
verses.text: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: the snare is broken, and we are escaped.

verses.name: Psalms 124:8
verses.text: Our help <hi type="italic">is</hi> in the name of the Lord, who made heaven and earth.  <chapter eID="Ps.124"/>

verses.name: Psalms 125:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv120"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">A Song of degrees.</title> <div sID="gen666" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv120"/>THEY that trust in the Lord <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> as mount Zion, <hi type="italic">which</hi> cannot be removed, <hi type="italic">but</hi> abideth for ever.

verses.name: Psalms 125:2
verses.text: <hi type="italic">As</hi> the mountains <hi type="italic">are</hi> round about Jerusalem, so the Lord <hi type="italic">is</hi> round about his people from henceforth even for ever.

verses.name: Psalms 125:3
verses.text: For the rod of the wicked shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous; lest the righteous put forth their hands unto iniquity.

verses.name: Psalms 125:4
verses.text: Do good, O Lord, unto <hi type="italic">those that be</hi> good, and to <hi type="italic">them that are</hi> upright in their hearts.

verses.name: Psalms 125:5
verses.text: As for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways, the Lord shall lead them forth with the workers of iniquity: <hi type="italic">but</hi> peace <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> upon Israel.  <chapter eID="Ps.125"/>

verses.name: Psalms 126:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv121"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">A Song of degrees.</title> <div sID="gen667" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv121"/>WHEN the Lord turned again the captivity of Zion, we were like them that dream.

verses.name: Psalms 126:2
verses.text: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing: then said they among the heathen, The Lord hath done great things for them.

verses.name: Psalms 126:3
verses.text: The Lord hath done great things for us; <hi type="italic">whereof</hi> we are glad.

verses.name: Psalms 126:4
verses.text: Turn again our captivity, O Lord, as the streams in the south.

verses.name: Psalms 126:5
verses.text: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.

verses.name: Psalms 126:6
verses.text: He that goeth forth and weepeth, bearing precious seed, shall doubtless come again with rejoicing, bringing his sheaves <hi type="italic">with him</hi>.  <chapter eID="Ps.126"/>

verses.name: Psalms 127:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv122"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">A Song of degrees for Solomon.</title> <div sID="gen668" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv122"/>EXCEPT the Lord build the house, they labour in vain that build it: except the Lord keep the city, the watchman waketh <hi type="italic">but</hi> in vain.

verses.name: Psalms 127:2
verses.text: <hi type="italic">It is</hi> vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of sorrows: <hi type="italic">for</hi> so he giveth his beloved sleep.

verses.name: Psalms 127:3
verses.text: Lo, children <hi type="italic">are</hi> an heritage of the Lord: <hi type="italic">and</hi> the fruit of the womb <hi type="italic">is his</hi> reward.

verses.name: Psalms 127:4
verses.text: As arrows <hi type="italic">are</hi> in the hand of a mighty man; so <hi type="italic">are</hi> children of the youth.

verses.name: Psalms 127:5
verses.text: Happy <hi type="italic">is</hi> the man that hath his quiver full of them: they shall not be ashamed, but they shall speak with the enemies in the gate.  <chapter eID="Ps.127"/>

verses.name: Psalms 128:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv123"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">A Song of degrees.</title> <div sID="gen669" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv123"/>BLESSED <hi type="italic">is</hi> every one that feareth the Lord; that walketh in his ways.

verses.name: Psalms 128:2
verses.text: For thou shalt eat the labour of thine hands: happy <hi type="italic">shalt</hi> thou <hi type="italic">be</hi>, and <hi type="italic">it shall be</hi> well with thee.

verses.name: Psalms 128:3
verses.text: Thy wife <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> as a fruitful vine by the sides of thine house: thy children like olive plants round about thy table.

verses.name: Psalms 128:4
verses.text: Behold, that thus shall the man be blessed that feareth the Lord.

verses.name: Psalms 128:5
verses.text: The Lord shall bless thee out of Zion: and thou shalt see the good of Jerusalem all the days of thy life.

verses.name: Psalms 128:6
verses.text: Yea, thou shalt see thy children’s children, <hi type="italic">and</hi> peace upon Israel.  <chapter eID="Ps.128"/>

verses.name: Psalms 129:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv124"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">A Song of degrees.</title> <div sID="gen670" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv124"/>MANY a time have they afflicted me from my youth, may Israel now say:

verses.name: Psalms 129:2
verses.text: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth: yet they have not prevailed against me.

verses.name: Psalms 129:3
verses.text: The plowers plowed upon my back: they made long their furrows.

verses.name: Psalms 129:4
verses.text: The Lord <hi type="italic">is</hi> righteous: he hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.

verses.name: Psalms 129:5
verses.text: Let them all be confounded and turned back that hate Zion.

verses.name: Psalms 129:6
verses.text: Let them be as the grass <hi type="italic">upon</hi> the housetops, which withereth afore it groweth up:

verses.name: Psalms 129:7
verses.text: Wherewith the mower filleth not his hand; nor he that bindeth sheaves his bosom.

verses.name: Psalms 129:8
verses.text: Neither do they which go by say, The blessing of the Lord <hi type="italic">be</hi> upon you: we bless you in the name of the Lord.  <chapter eID="Ps.129"/>

verses.name: Psalms 130:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv125"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">A Song of degrees.</title> <div sID="gen671" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv125"/>OUT of the depths have I cried unto thee, O Lord.

verses.name: Psalms 130:2
verses.text: Lord, hear my voice: let thine ears be attentive to the voice of my supplications.

verses.name: Psalms 130:3
verses.text: If thou, Lord, shouldest mark iniquities, O Lord, who shall stand?

verses.name: Psalms 130:4
verses.text: But <hi type="italic">there is</hi> forgiveness with thee, that thou mayest be feared.

verses.name: Psalms 130:5
verses.text: I wait for the Lord, my soul doth wait, and in his word do I hope.

verses.name: Psalms 130:6
verses.text: My soul <hi type="italic">waiteth</hi> for the Lord more than they that watch for the morning: <hi type="italic">I say</hi>, <hi type="italic">more than</hi> they that watch for the morning.

verses.name: Psalms 130:7
verses.text: Let Israel hope in the Lord: for with the Lord <hi type="italic">there is</hi> mercy, and with him <hi type="italic">is</hi> plenteous redemption.

verses.name: Psalms 130:8
verses.text: And he shall redeem Israel from all his iniquities.  <chapter eID="Ps.130"/>

verses.name: Psalms 131:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv126"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">A Song of degrees of David.</title> <div sID="gen672" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv126"/>LORD, my heart is not haughty, nor mine eyes lofty: neither do I exercise myself in great matters, or in things too high for me.

verses.name: Psalms 131:2
verses.text: Surely I have behaved and quieted myself, as a child that is weaned of his mother: my soul <hi type="italic">is</hi> even as a weaned child.

verses.name: Psalms 131:3
verses.text: Let Israel hope in the Lord from henceforth and for ever.  <chapter eID="Ps.131"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv127"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">A Song of degrees.</title> <div sID="gen673" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv127"/>LORD, remember David, <hi type="italic">and</hi> all his afflictions:

verses.name: Psalms 132:2
verses.text: How he sware unto the Lord, <hi type="italic">and</hi> vowed unto the mighty <hi type="italic">God</hi> of Jacob;

verses.name: Psalms 132:3
verses.text: Surely I will not come into the tabernacle of my house, nor go up into my bed;

verses.name: Psalms 132:4
verses.text: I will not give sleep to mine eyes, <hi type="italic">or</hi> slumber to mine eyelids,

verses.name: Psalms 132:5
verses.text: Until I find out a place for the Lord, an habitation for the mighty <hi type="italic">God</hi> of Jacob.

verses.name: Psalms 132:6
verses.text: Lo, we heard of it at Ephratah: we found it in the fields of the wood.

verses.name: Psalms 132:7
verses.text: We will go into his tabernacles: we will worship at his footstool.

verses.name: Psalms 132:8
verses.text: Arise, O Lord, into thy rest; thou, and the ark of thy strength.

verses.name: Psalms 132:9
verses.text: Let thy priests be clothed with righteousness; and let thy saints shout for joy.

verses.name: Psalms 132:10
verses.text: For thy servant David’s sake turn not away the face of thine anointed.

verses.name: Psalms 132:11
verses.text: The Lord hath sworn <hi type="italic">in</hi> truth unto David; he will not turn from it; Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne.

verses.name: Psalms 132:12
verses.text: If thy children will keep my covenant and my testimony that I shall teach them, their children shall also sit upon thy throne for evermore.

verses.name: Psalms 132:13
verses.text: For the Lord hath chosen Zion; he hath desired <hi type="italic">it</hi> for his habitation.

verses.name: Psalms 132:14
verses.text: This <hi type="italic">is</hi> my rest for ever: here will I dwell; for I have desired it.

verses.name: Psalms 132:15
verses.text: I will abundantly bless her provision: I will satisfy her poor with bread.

verses.name: Psalms 132:16
verses.text: I will also clothe her priests with salvation: and her saints shall shout aloud for joy.

verses.name: Psalms 132:17
verses.text: There will I make the horn of David to bud: I have ordained a lamp for mine anointed.

verses.name: Psalms 132:18
verses.text: His enemies will I clothe with shame: but upon himself shall his crown flourish.  <chapter eID="Ps.132"/>

verses.name: Psalms 133:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv128"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">A Song of degrees of David.</title> <div sID="gen674" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv128"/>BEHOLD, how good and how pleasant <hi type="italic">it is</hi> for brethren to dwell together in unity!

verses.name: Psalms 133:2
verses.text: <hi type="italic">It is</hi> like the precious ointment upon the head, that ran down upon the beard, <hi type="italic">even</hi> Aaron’s beard: that went down to the skirts of his garments;

verses.name: Psalms 133:3
verses.text: As the dew of Hermon, <hi type="italic">and as the dew</hi> that descended upon the mountains of Zion: for there the Lord commanded the blessing, <hi type="italic">even</hi> life for evermore.  <chapter eID="Ps.133"/>

verses.name: Psalms 134:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv129"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">A Song of degrees.</title> <div sID="gen675" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv129"/>BEHOLD, bless ye the Lord, all <hi type="italic">ye</hi> servants of the Lord, which by night stand in the house of the Lord.

verses.name: Psalms 134:2
verses.text: Lift up your hands <hi type="italic">in</hi> the sanctuary, and bless the Lord.

verses.name: Psalms 134:3
verses.text: The Lord that made heaven and earth bless thee out of Zion.  <chapter eID="Ps.134"/><div eID="gen675" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:1
verses.text: PRAISE ye the Lord. Praise ye the name of the Lord; praise <hi type="italic">him</hi>, O ye servants of the Lord.

verses.name: Psalms 135:2
verses.text: Ye that stand in the house of the Lord, in the courts of the house of our God,

verses.name: Psalms 135:3
verses.text: Praise the Lord; for the Lord <hi type="italic">is</hi> good: sing praises unto his name; for <hi type="italic">it is</hi> pleasant.

verses.name: Psalms 135:4
verses.text: For the Lord hath chosen Jacob unto himself, <hi type="italic">and</hi> Israel for his peculiar treasure.

verses.name: Psalms 135:5
verses.text: For I know that the Lord <hi type="italic">is</hi> great, and <hi type="italic">that</hi> our Lord <hi type="italic">is</hi> above all gods.

verses.name: Psalms 135:6
verses.text: Whatsoever the Lord pleased, <hi type="italic">that</hi> did he in heaven, and in earth, in the seas, and all deep places.

verses.name: Psalms 135:7
verses.text: He causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings for the rain; he bringeth the wind out of his treasuries.

verses.name: Psalms 135:8
verses.text: Who smote the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and beast.

verses.name: Psalms 135:9
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Who</hi> sent tokens and wonders into the midst of thee, O Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his servants.

verses.name: Psalms 135:10
verses.text: Who smote great nations, and slew mighty kings;

verses.name: Psalms 135:11
verses.text: Sihon king of the Amorites, and Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan:

verses.name: Psalms 135:12
verses.text: And gave their land <hi type="italic">for</hi> an heritage, an heritage unto Israel his people.

verses.name: Psalms 135:13
verses.text: Thy name, O Lord, <hi type="italic">endureth</hi> for ever; <hi type="italic">and</hi> thy memorial, O Lord, throughout all generations.

verses.name: Psalms 135:14
verses.text: For the Lord will judge his people, and he will repent himself concerning his servants.

verses.name: Psalms 135:15
verses.text: The idols of the heathen <hi type="italic">are</hi> silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.

verses.name: Psalms 135:16
verses.text: They have mouths, but they speak not; eyes have they, but they see not;

verses.name: Psalms 135:17
verses.text: They have ears, but they hear not; neither is there <hi type="italic">any</hi> breath in their mouths.

verses.name: Psalms 135:18
verses.text: They that make them are like unto them: <hi type="italic">so is</hi> every one that trusteth in them.

verses.name: Psalms 135:19
verses.text: Bless the Lord, O house of Israel: bless the Lord, O house of Aaron:

verses.name: Psalms 135:20
verses.text: Bless the Lord, O house of Levi: ye that fear the Lord, bless the Lord.

verses.name: Psalms 135:21
verses.text: Blessed be the Lord out of Zion, which dwelleth at Jerusalem. Praise ye the Lord.  <chapter eID="Ps.135"/><div eID="gen676" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:1
verses.text: O GIVE thanks unto the Lord; for <hi type="italic">he is</hi> good: for his mercy <hi type="italic">endureth</hi> for ever.

verses.name: Psalms 136:2
verses.text: O give thanks unto the God of gods: for his mercy <hi type="italic">endureth</hi> for ever.

verses.name: Psalms 136:3
verses.text: O give thanks to the Lord of lords: for his mercy <hi type="italic">endureth</hi> for ever.

verses.name: Psalms 136:4
verses.text: To him who alone doeth great wonders: for his mercy <hi type="italic">endureth</hi> for ever.

verses.name: Psalms 136:5
verses.text: To him that by wisdom made the heavens: for his mercy <hi type="italic">endureth</hi> for ever.

verses.name: Psalms 136:6
verses.text: To him that stretched out the earth above the waters: for his mercy <hi type="italic">endureth</hi> for ever.

verses.name: Psalms 136:7
verses.text: To him that made great lights: for his mercy <hi type="italic">endureth</hi> for ever:

verses.name: Psalms 136:8
verses.text: The sun to rule by day: for his mercy <hi type="italic">endureth</hi> for ever:

verses.name: Psalms 136:9
verses.text: The moon and stars to rule by night: for his mercy <hi type="italic">endureth</hi> for ever.

verses.name: Psalms 136:10
verses.text: To him that smote Egypt in their firstborn: for his mercy <hi type="italic">endureth</hi> for ever:

verses.name: Psalms 136:11
verses.text: And brought out Israel from among them: for his mercy <hi type="italic">endureth</hi> for ever:

verses.name: Psalms 136:12
verses.text: With a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm: for his mercy <hi type="italic">endureth</hi> for ever.

verses.name: Psalms 136:13
verses.text: To him which divided the Red sea into parts: for his mercy <hi type="italic">endureth</hi> for ever:

verses.name: Psalms 136:14
verses.text: And made Israel to pass through the midst of it: for his mercy <hi type="italic">endureth</hi> for ever:

verses.name: Psalms 136:15
verses.text: But overthrew Pharaoh and his host in the Red sea: for his mercy <hi type="italic">endureth</hi> for ever.

verses.name: Psalms 136:16
verses.text: To him which led his people through the wilderness: for his mercy <hi type="italic">endureth</hi> for ever.

verses.name: Psalms 136:17
verses.text: To him which smote great kings: for his mercy <hi type="italic">endureth</hi> for ever:

verses.name: Psalms 136:18
verses.text: And slew famous kings: for his mercy <hi type="italic">endureth</hi> for ever:

verses.name: Psalms 136:19
verses.text: Sihon king of the Amorites: for his mercy <hi type="italic">endureth</hi> for ever:

verses.name: Psalms 136:20
verses.text: And Og the king of Bashan: for his mercy <hi type="italic">endureth</hi> for ever:

verses.name: Psalms 136:21
verses.text: And gave their land for an heritage: for his mercy <hi type="italic">endureth</hi> for ever:

verses.name: Psalms 136:22
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Even</hi> an heritage unto Israel his servant: for his mercy <hi type="italic">endureth</hi> for ever.

verses.name: Psalms 136:23
verses.text: Who remembered us in our low estate: for his mercy <hi type="italic">endureth</hi> for ever:

verses.name: Psalms 136:24
verses.text: And hath redeemed us from our enemies: for his mercy <hi type="italic">endureth</hi> for ever.

verses.name: Psalms 136:25
verses.text: Who giveth food to all flesh: for his mercy <hi type="italic">endureth</hi> for ever.

verses.name: Psalms 136:26
verses.text: O give thanks unto the God of heaven: for his mercy <hi type="italic">endureth</hi> for ever.  <chapter eID="Ps.136"/><div eID="gen677" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 137:1
verses.text: BY the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down, yea, we wept, when we remembered Zion.

verses.name: Psalms 137:2
verses.text: We hanged our harps upon the willows in the midst thereof.

verses.name: Psalms 137:3
verses.text: For there they that carried us away captive required of us a song; and they that wasted us <hi type="italic">required of us</hi> mirth, <hi type="italic">saying</hi>, Sing us <hi type="italic">one</hi> of the songs of Zion.

verses.name: Psalms 137:4
verses.text: How shall we sing the Lord’s song in a strange land?

verses.name: Psalms 137:5
verses.text: If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, let my right hand forget <hi type="italic">her cunning</hi>.

verses.name: Psalms 137:6
verses.text: If I do not remember thee, let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth; if I prefer not Jerusalem above my chief joy.

verses.name: Psalms 137:7
verses.text: Remember, O Lord, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase <hi type="italic">it</hi>, rase <hi type="italic">it</hi>, <hi type="italic">even</hi> to the foundation thereof.

verses.name: Psalms 137:8
verses.text: O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed; happy <hi type="italic">shall he be</hi>, that rewardeth thee as thou hast served us.

verses.name: Psalms 137:9
verses.text: Happy <hi type="italic">shall he be</hi>, that taketh and dasheth thy little ones against the stones.  <chapter eID="Ps.137"/>

verses.name: Psalms 138:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv130"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><hi type="italic">A Psalm</hi> of David.</title> <div sID="gen679" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv130"/>I WILL praise thee with my whole heart: before the gods will I sing praise unto thee.

verses.name: Psalms 138:2
verses.text: I will worship toward thy holy temple, and praise thy name for thy lovingkindness and for thy truth: for thou hast magnified thy word above all thy name.

verses.name: Psalms 138:3
verses.text: In the day when I cried thou answeredst me, <hi type="italic">and</hi> strengthenedst me <hi type="italic">with</hi> strength in my soul.

verses.name: Psalms 138:4
verses.text: All the kings of the earth shall praise thee, O Lord, when they hear the words of thy mouth.

verses.name: Psalms 138:5
verses.text: Yea, they shall sing in the ways of the Lord: for great <hi type="italic">is</hi> the glory of the Lord.

verses.name: Psalms 138:6
verses.text: Though the Lord <hi type="italic">be</hi> high, yet hath he respect unto the lowly: but the proud he knoweth afar off.

verses.name: Psalms 138:7
verses.text: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, thou wilt revive me: thou shalt stretch forth thine hand against the wrath of mine enemies, and thy right hand shall save me.

verses.name: Psalms 138:8
verses.text: The Lord will perfect <hi type="italic">that which</hi> concerneth me: thy mercy, O Lord, <hi type="italic">endureth</hi> for ever: forsake not the works of thine own hands.  <chapter eID="Ps.138"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv131"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm">To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.</title> <div sID="gen680" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv131"/>O LORD, thou hast searched me, and known <hi type="italic">me</hi>.

verses.name: Psalms 139:2
verses.text: Thou knowest my downsitting and mine uprising, thou understandest my thought afar off.

verses.name: Psalms 139:3
verses.text: Thou compassest my path and my lying down, and art acquainted <hi type="italic">with</hi> all my ways.

verses.name: Psalms 139:4
verses.text: For <hi type="italic">there is</hi> not a word in my tongue, <hi type="italic">but</hi>, lo, O Lord, thou knowest it altogether.

verses.name: Psalms 139:5
verses.text: Thou hast beset me behind and before, and laid thine hand upon me.

verses.name: Psalms 139:6
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Such</hi> knowledge <hi type="italic">is</hi> too wonderful for me; it is high, I cannot <hi type="italic">attain</hi> unto it.

verses.name: Psalms 139:7
verses.text: Whither shall I go from thy spirit? or whither shall I flee from thy presence?

verses.name: Psalms 139:8
verses.text: If I ascend up into heaven, thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> there: if I make my bed in hell, behold, thou <hi type="italic">art there</hi>.

verses.name: Psalms 139:9
verses.text: <hi type="italic">If</hi> I take the wings of the morning, <hi type="italic">and</hi> dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea;

verses.name: Psalms 139:10
verses.text: Even there shall thy hand lead me, and thy right hand shall hold me.

verses.name: Psalms 139:11
verses.text: If I say, Surely the darkness shall cover me; even the night shall be light about me.

verses.name: Psalms 139:12
verses.text: Yea, the darkness hideth not from thee; but the night shineth as the day: the darkness and the light <hi type="italic">are</hi> both alike <hi type="italic">to thee</hi>.

verses.name: Psalms 139:13
verses.text: For thou hast possessed my reins: thou hast covered me in my mother’s womb.

verses.name: Psalms 139:14
