verses.text: And her merchandise and her hire shall be holiness to the Lord: it shall not be treasured nor laid up; for her merchandise shall be for them that dwell before the Lord, to eat sufficiently, and for durable clothing.  <chapter eID="Isa.23"/><div eID="gen769" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:1
verses.text: BEHOLD, the Lord maketh the earth empty, and maketh it waste, and turneth it upside down, and scattereth abroad the inhabitants thereof.

verses.name: Isaiah 24:2
verses.text: And it shall be, as with the people, so with the priest; as with the servant, so with his master; as with the maid, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the lender, so with the borrower; as with the taker of usury, so with the giver of usury to him.

verses.name: Isaiah 24:3
verses.text: The land shall be utterly emptied, and utterly spoiled: for the Lord hath spoken this word.

verses.name: Isaiah 24:4
verses.text: The earth mourneth <hi type="italic">and</hi> fadeth away, the world languisheth <hi type="italic">and</hi> fadeth away, the haughty people of the earth do languish.

verses.name: Isaiah 24:5
verses.text: The earth also is defiled under the inhabitants thereof; because they have transgressed the laws, changed the ordinance, broken the everlasting covenant.

verses.name: Isaiah 24:6
verses.text: Therefore hath the curse devoured the earth, and they that dwell therein are desolate: therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, and few men left.

verses.name: Isaiah 24:7
verses.text: The new wine mourneth, the vine languisheth, all the merryhearted do sigh.

verses.name: Isaiah 24:8
verses.text: The mirth of tabrets ceaseth, the noise of them that rejoice endeth, the joy of the harp ceaseth.

verses.name: Isaiah 24:9
verses.text: They shall not drink wine with a song; strong drink shall be bitter to them that drink it.

verses.name: Isaiah 24:10
verses.text: The city of confusion is broken down: every house is shut up, that no man may come in.

verses.name: Isaiah 24:11
verses.text: <hi type="italic">There is</hi> a crying for wine in the streets; all joy is darkened, the mirth of the land is gone.

verses.name: Isaiah 24:12
verses.text: In the city is left desolation, and the gate is smitten with destruction.

verses.name: Isaiah 24:13
verses.text: ¶ When thus it shall be in the midst of the land among the people, <hi type="italic">there shall be</hi> as the shaking of an olive tree, <hi type="italic">and</hi> as the gleaning grapes when the vintage is done.

verses.name: Isaiah 24:14
verses.text: They shall lift up their voice, they shall sing for the majesty of the Lord, they shall cry aloud from the sea.

verses.name: Isaiah 24:15
verses.text: Wherefore glorify ye the Lord in the fires, <hi type="italic">even</hi> the name of the Lord God of Israel in the isles of the sea.

verses.name: Isaiah 24:16
verses.text: ¶ From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs, <hi type="italic">even</hi> glory to the righteous. But I said, My leanness, my leanness, woe unto me! the treacherous dealers have dealt treacherously; yea, the treacherous dealers have dealt very treacherously.

verses.name: Isaiah 24:17
verses.text: Fear, and the pit, and the snare, <hi type="italic">are</hi> upon thee, O inhabitant of the earth.

verses.name: Isaiah 24:18
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, <hi type="italic">that</hi> he who fleeth from the noise of the fear shall fall into the pit; and he that cometh up out of the midst of the pit shall be taken in the snare: for the windows from on high are open, and the foundations of the earth do shake.

verses.name: Isaiah 24:19
verses.text: The earth is utterly broken down, the earth is clean dissolved, the earth is moved exceedingly.

verses.name: Isaiah 24:20
verses.text: The earth shall reel to and fro like a drunkard, and shall be removed like a cottage; and the transgression thereof shall be heavy upon it; and it shall fall, and not rise again.

verses.name: Isaiah 24:21
verses.text: And it shall come to pass in that day, <hi type="italic">that</hi> the Lord shall punish the host of the high ones <hi type="italic">that are</hi> on high, and the kings of the earth upon the earth.

verses.name: Isaiah 24:22
verses.text: And they shall be gathered together, <hi type="italic">as</hi> prisoners are gathered in the pit, and shall be shut up in the prison, and after many days shall they be visited.

verses.name: Isaiah 24:23
verses.text: Then the moon shall be confounded, and the sun ashamed, when the Lord of hosts shall reign in mount Zion, and in Jerusalem, and before his ancients gloriously.  <chapter eID="Isa.24"/><div eID="gen770" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 25:1
verses.text: O LORD, thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> my God; I will exalt thee, I will praise thy name; for thou hast done wonderful <hi type="italic">things; thy</hi> counsels of old <hi type="italic">are</hi> faithfulness <hi type="italic">and</hi> truth.

verses.name: Isaiah 25:2
verses.text: For thou hast made of a city an heap; <hi type="italic">of</hi> a defenced city a ruin: a palace of strangers to be no city; it shall never be built.

verses.name: Isaiah 25:3
verses.text: Therefore shall the strong people glorify thee, the city of the terrible nations shall fear thee.

verses.name: Isaiah 25:4
verses.text: For thou hast been a strength to the poor, a strength to the needy in his distress, a refuge from the storm, a shadow from the heat, when the blast of the terrible ones <hi type="italic">is</hi> as a storm <hi type="italic">against</hi> the wall.

verses.name: Isaiah 25:5
verses.text: Thou shalt bring down the noise of strangers, as the heat in a dry place; <hi type="italic">even</hi> the heat with the shadow of a cloud: the branch of the terrible ones shall be brought low.

verses.name: Isaiah 25:6
verses.text: ¶ And in this mountain shall the Lord of hosts make unto all people a feast of fat things, a feast of wines on the lees, of fat things full of marrow, of wines on the lees well refined.

verses.name: Isaiah 25:7
verses.text: And he will destroy in this mountain the face of the covering cast over all people, and the vail that is spread over all nations.

verses.name: Isaiah 25:8
verses.text: He will swallow up death in victory; and the Lord God will wipe away tears from off all faces; and the rebuke of his people shall he take away from off all the earth: for the Lord hath spoken <hi type="italic">it</hi>.

verses.name: Isaiah 25:9
verses.text: ¶ And it shall be said in that day, Lo, this <hi type="italic">is</hi> our God; we have waited for him, and he will save us: this <hi type="italic">is</hi> the Lord; we have waited for him, we will be glad and rejoice in his salvation.

verses.name: Isaiah 25:10
verses.text: For in this mountain shall the hand of the Lord rest, and Moab shall be trodden down under him, even as straw is trodden down for the dunghill.

verses.name: Isaiah 25:11
verses.text: And he shall spread forth his hands in the midst of them, as he that swimmeth spreadeth forth <hi type="italic">his hands</hi> to swim: and he shall bring down their pride together with the spoils of their hands.

verses.name: Isaiah 25:12
verses.text: And the fortress of the high fort of thy walls shall he bring down, lay low, <hi type="italic">and</hi> bring to the ground, <hi type="italic">even</hi> to the dust.  <chapter eID="Isa.25"/><div eID="gen771" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 26:1
verses.text: IN that day shall this song be sung in the land of Judah; We have a strong city; salvation will <hi type="italic">God</hi> appoint <hi type="italic">for</hi> walls and bulwarks.

verses.name: Isaiah 26:2
verses.text: Open ye the gates, that the righteous nation which keepeth the truth may enter in.

verses.name: Isaiah 26:3
verses.text: Thou wilt keep <hi type="italic">him</hi> in perfect peace, <hi type="italic">whose</hi> mind <hi type="italic">is</hi> stayed <hi type="italic">on thee:</hi> because he trusteth in thee.

verses.name: Isaiah 26:4
verses.text: Trust ye in the Lord for ever: for in the Lord JEHOVAH <hi type="italic">is</hi> everlasting strength:

verses.name: Isaiah 26:5
verses.text: ¶ For he bringeth down them that dwell on high; the lofty city, he layeth it low; he layeth it low, <hi type="italic">even</hi> to the ground; he bringeth it <hi type="italic">even</hi> to the dust.

verses.name: Isaiah 26:6
verses.text: The foot shall tread it down, <hi type="italic">even</hi> the feet of the poor, <hi type="italic">and</hi> the steps of the needy.

verses.name: Isaiah 26:7
verses.text: The way of the just <hi type="italic">is</hi> uprightness: thou, most upright, dost weigh the path of the just.

verses.name: Isaiah 26:8
verses.text: Yea, in the way of thy judgments, O Lord, have we waited for thee; the desire of <hi type="italic">our</hi> soul <hi type="italic">is</hi> to thy name, and to the remembrance of thee.

verses.name: Isaiah 26:9
verses.text: With my soul have I desired thee in the night; yea, with my spirit within me will I seek thee early: for when thy judgments <hi type="italic">are</hi> in the earth, the inhabitants of the world will learn righteousness.

verses.name: Isaiah 26:10
verses.text: Let favour be shewed to the wicked, <hi type="italic">yet</hi> will he not learn righteousness: in the land of uprightness will he deal unjustly, and will not behold the majesty of the Lord.

verses.name: Isaiah 26:11
verses.text: Lord, <hi type="italic">when</hi> thy hand is lifted up, they will not see: <hi type="italic">but</hi> they shall see, and be ashamed for <hi type="italic">their</hi> envy at the people; yea, the fire of thine enemies shall devour them.

verses.name: Isaiah 26:12
verses.text: ¶ Lord, thou wilt ordain peace for us: for thou also hast wrought all our works in us.

verses.name: Isaiah 26:13
verses.text: O Lord our God, <hi type="italic">other</hi> lords beside thee have had dominion over us: <hi type="italic">but</hi> by thee only will we make mention of thy name.

verses.name: Isaiah 26:14
verses.text: <hi type="italic">They are</hi> dead, they shall not live; <hi type="italic">they are</hi> deceased, they shall not rise: therefore hast thou visited and destroyed them, and made all their memory to perish.

verses.name: Isaiah 26:15
verses.text: Thou hast increased the nation, O Lord, thou hast increased the nation: thou art glorified: thou hadst removed <hi type="italic">it</hi> far <hi type="italic">unto</hi> all the ends of the earth.

verses.name: Isaiah 26:16
verses.text: Lord, in trouble have they visited thee, they poured out a prayer <hi type="italic">when</hi> thy chastening <hi type="italic">was</hi> upon them.

verses.name: Isaiah 26:17
verses.text: Like as a woman with child, <hi type="italic">that</hi> draweth near the time of her delivery, is in pain, <hi type="italic">and</hi> crieth out in her pangs; so have we been in thy sight, O Lord.

verses.name: Isaiah 26:18
verses.text: We have been with child, we have been in pain, we have as it were brought forth wind; we have not wrought any deliverance in the earth; neither have the inhabitants of the world fallen.

verses.name: Isaiah 26:19
verses.text: Thy dead <hi type="italic">men</hi> shall live, <hi type="italic">together with</hi> my dead body shall they arise. Awake and sing, ye that dwell in dust: for thy dew <hi type="italic">is as</hi> the dew of herbs, and the earth shall cast out the dead.

verses.name: Isaiah 26:20
verses.text: ¶ Come, my people, enter thou into thy chambers, and shut thy doors about thee: hide thyself as it were for a little moment, until the indignation be overpast.

verses.name: Isaiah 26:21
verses.text: For, behold, the Lord cometh out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity: the earth also shall disclose her blood, and shall no more cover her slain.  <chapter eID="Isa.26"/><div eID="gen772" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 27:1
verses.text: IN that day the Lord with his sore and great and strong sword shall punish leviathan the piercing serpent, even leviathan that crooked serpent; and he shall slay the dragon that <hi type="italic">is</hi> in the sea.

verses.name: Isaiah 27:2
verses.text: In that day sing ye unto her, A vineyard of red wine.

verses.name: Isaiah 27:3
verses.text: I the Lord do keep it; I will water it every moment: lest <hi type="italic">any</hi> hurt it, I will keep it night and day.

verses.name: Isaiah 27:4
verses.text: Fury <hi type="italic">is</hi> not in me: who would set the briers <hi type="italic">and</hi> thorns against me in battle? I would go through them, I would burn them together.

verses.name: Isaiah 27:5
verses.text: Or let him take hold of my strength, <hi type="italic">that</hi> he may make peace with me; <hi type="italic">and</hi> he shall make peace with me.

verses.name: Isaiah 27:6
verses.text: He shall cause them that come of Jacob to take root: Israel shall blossom and bud, and fill the face of the world with fruit.

verses.name: Isaiah 27:7
verses.text: ¶ Hath he smitten him, as he smote those that smote him? <hi type="italic">or</hi> is he slain according to the slaughter of them that are slain by him?

verses.name: Isaiah 27:8
verses.text: In measure, when it shooteth forth, thou wilt debate with it: he stayeth his rough wind in the day of the east wind.

verses.name: Isaiah 27:9
verses.text: By this therefore shall the iniquity of Jacob be purged; and this <hi type="italic">is</hi> all the fruit to take away his sin; when he maketh all the stones of the altar as chalkstones that are beaten in sunder, the groves and images shall not stand up.

verses.name: Isaiah 27:10
verses.text: Yet the defenced city <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> desolate, <hi type="italic">and</hi> the habitation forsaken, and left like a wilderness: there shall the calf feed, and there shall he lie down, and consume the branches thereof.

verses.name: Isaiah 27:11
verses.text: When the boughs thereof are withered, they shall be broken off: the women come, <hi type="italic">and</hi> set them on fire: for it <hi type="italic">is</hi> a people of no understanding: therefore he that made them will not have mercy on them, and he that formed them will shew them no favour.

verses.name: Isaiah 27:12
verses.text: ¶ And it shall come to pass in that day, <hi type="italic">that</hi> the Lord shall beat off from the channel of the river unto the stream of Egypt, and ye shall be gathered one by one, O ye children of Israel.

verses.name: Isaiah 27:13
verses.text: And it shall come to pass in that day, <hi type="italic">that</hi> the great trumpet shall be blown, and they shall come which were ready to perish in the land of Assyria, and the outcasts in the land of Egypt, and shall worship the Lord in the holy mount at Jerusalem.  <chapter eID="Isa.27"/><div eID="gen773" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:1
verses.text: WOE to the crown of pride, to the drunkards of Ephraim, whose glorious beauty <hi type="italic">is</hi> a fading flower, which <hi type="italic">are</hi> on the head of the fat valleys of them that are overcome with wine!

verses.name: Isaiah 28:2
verses.text: Behold, the Lord hath a mighty and strong one, <hi type="italic">which</hi> as a tempest of hail <hi type="italic">and</hi> a destroying storm, as a flood of mighty waters overflowing, shall cast down to the earth with the hand.

verses.name: Isaiah 28:3
verses.text: The crown of pride, the drunkards of Ephraim, shall be trodden under feet:

verses.name: Isaiah 28:4
verses.text: And the glorious beauty, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> on the head of the fat valley, shall be a fading flower, <hi type="italic">and</hi> as the hasty fruit before the summer; which <hi type="italic">when</hi> he that looketh upon it seeth, while it is yet in his hand he eateth it up.

verses.name: Isaiah 28:5
verses.text: ¶ In that day shall the Lord of hosts be for a crown of glory, and for a diadem of beauty, unto the residue of his people,

verses.name: Isaiah 28:6
verses.text: And for a spirit of judgment to him that sitteth in judgment, and for strength to them that turn the battle to the gate.

verses.name: Isaiah 28:7
verses.text: ¶ But they also have erred through wine, and through strong drink are out of the way; the priest and the prophet have erred through strong drink, they are swallowed up of wine, they are out of the way through strong drink; they err in vision, they stumble <hi type="italic">in</hi> judgment.

verses.name: Isaiah 28:8
verses.text: For all tables are full of vomit <hi type="italic">and</hi> filthiness, <hi type="italic">so that there is</hi> no place <hi type="italic">clean</hi>.

verses.name: Isaiah 28:9
verses.text: ¶ Whom shall he teach knowledge? and whom shall he make to understand doctrine? <hi type="italic">them that are</hi> weaned from the milk, <hi type="italic">and</hi> drawn from the breasts.

verses.name: Isaiah 28:10
verses.text: For precept <hi type="italic">must be</hi> upon precept, precept upon precept; line upon line, line upon line; here a little, <hi type="italic">and</hi> there a little:

verses.name: Isaiah 28:11
verses.text: For with stammering lips and another tongue will he speak to this people.

verses.name: Isaiah 28:12
verses.text: To whom he said, This <hi type="italic">is</hi> the rest <hi type="italic">wherewith</hi> ye may cause the weary to rest; and this <hi type="italic">is</hi> the refreshing: yet they would not hear.

verses.name: Isaiah 28:13
verses.text: But the word of the Lord was unto them precept upon precept, precept upon precept; line upon line, line upon line; here a little, <hi type="italic">and</hi> there a little; that they might go, and fall backward, and be broken, and snared, and taken.

verses.name: Isaiah 28:14
verses.text: ¶ Wherefore hear the word of the Lord, ye scornful men, that rule this people which <hi type="italic">is</hi> in Jerusalem.

verses.name: Isaiah 28:15
verses.text: Because ye have said, We have made a covenant with death, and with hell are we at agreement; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through, it shall not come unto us: for we have made lies our refuge, and under falsehood have we hid ourselves:

verses.name: Isaiah 28:16
verses.text: ¶ Therefore thus saith the Lord God, Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious corner <hi type="italic">stone</hi>, a sure foundation: he that believeth shall not make haste.

verses.name: Isaiah 28:17
verses.text: Judgment also will I lay to the line, and righteousness to the plummet: and the hail shall sweep away the refuge of lies, and the waters shall overflow the hiding place.

verses.name: Isaiah 28:18
verses.text: ¶ And your covenant with death shall be disannulled, and your agreement with hell shall not stand; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through, then ye shall be trodden down by it.

verses.name: Isaiah 28:19
verses.text: From the time that it goeth forth it shall take you: for morning by morning shall it pass over, by day and by night: and it shall be a vexation only <hi type="italic">to</hi> understand the report.

verses.name: Isaiah 28:20
verses.text: For the bed is shorter than that <hi type="italic">a man</hi> can stretch himself <hi type="italic">on it:</hi> and the covering narrower than that he can wrap himself <hi type="italic">in it</hi>.

verses.name: Isaiah 28:21
verses.text: For the Lord shall rise up as <hi type="italic">in</hi> mount Perazim, he shall be wroth as <hi type="italic">in</hi> the valley of Gibeon, that he may do his work, his strange work; and bring to pass his act, his strange act.

verses.name: Isaiah 28:22
verses.text: Now therefore be ye not mockers, lest your bands be made strong: for I have heard from the Lord God of hosts a consumption, even determined upon the whole earth.

verses.name: Isaiah 28:23
verses.text: ¶ Give ye ear, and hear my voice; hearken, and hear my speech.

verses.name: Isaiah 28:24
verses.text: Doth the plowman plow all day to sow? doth he open and break the clods of his ground?

verses.name: Isaiah 28:25
verses.text: When he hath made plain the face thereof, doth he not cast abroad the fitches, and scatter the cummin, and cast in the principal wheat and the appointed barley and the rie in their place?

verses.name: Isaiah 28:26
verses.text: For his God doth instruct him to discretion, <hi type="italic">and</hi> doth teach him.

verses.name: Isaiah 28:27
verses.text: For the fitches are not threshed with a threshing instrument, neither is a cart wheel turned about upon the cummin; but the fitches are beaten out with a staff, and the cummin with a rod.

verses.name: Isaiah 28:28
verses.text: Bread <hi type="italic">corn</hi> is bruised; because he will not ever be threshing it, nor break <hi type="italic">it with</hi> the wheel of his cart, nor bruise it <hi type="italic">with</hi> his horsemen.

verses.name: Isaiah 28:29
verses.text: This also cometh forth from the Lord of hosts, <hi type="italic">which</hi> is wonderful in counsel, <hi type="italic">and</hi> excellent in working.  <chapter eID="Isa.28"/><div eID="gen774" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:1
verses.text: WOE to Ariel, to Ariel, the city <hi type="italic">where</hi> David dwelt! add ye year to year; let them kill sacrifices.

verses.name: Isaiah 29:2
verses.text: Yet I will distress Ariel, and there shall be heaviness and sorrow: and it shall be unto me as Ariel.

verses.name: Isaiah 29:3
verses.text: And I will camp against thee round about, and will lay siege against thee with a mount, and I will raise forts against thee.

verses.name: Isaiah 29:4
verses.text: And thou shalt be brought down, <hi type="italic">and</hi> shalt speak out of the ground, and thy speech shall be low out of the dust, and thy voice shall be, as of one that hath a familiar spirit, out of the ground, and thy speech shall whisper out of the dust.

verses.name: Isaiah 29:5
verses.text: Moreover the multitude of thy strangers shall be like small dust, and the multitude of the terrible ones <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> as chaff that passeth away: yea, it shall be at an instant suddenly.

verses.name: Isaiah 29:6
verses.text: Thou shalt be visited of the Lord of hosts with thunder, and with earthquake, and great noise, with storm and tempest, and the flame of devouring fire.

verses.name: Isaiah 29:7
verses.text: ¶ And the multitude of all the nations that fight against Ariel, even all that fight against her and her munition, and that distress her, shall be as a dream of a night vision.

verses.name: Isaiah 29:8
verses.text: It shall even be as when an hungry <hi type="italic">man</hi> dreameth, and, behold, he eateth; but he awaketh, and his soul is empty: or as when a thirsty man dreameth, and, behold, he drinketh; but he awaketh, and, behold, <hi type="italic">he is</hi> faint, and his soul hath appetite: so shall the multitude of all the nations be, that fight against mount Zion.

verses.name: Isaiah 29:9
verses.text: ¶ Stay yourselves, and wonder; cry ye out, and cry: they are drunken, but not with wine; they stagger, but not with strong drink.

verses.name: Isaiah 29:10
verses.text: For the Lord hath poured out upon you the spirit of deep sleep, and hath closed your eyes: the prophets and your rulers, the seers hath he covered.

verses.name: Isaiah 29:11
verses.text: And the vision of all is become unto you as the words of a book that is sealed, which <hi type="italic">men</hi> deliver to one that is learned, saying, Read this, I pray thee: and he saith, I cannot; for it <hi type="italic">is</hi> sealed:

verses.name: Isaiah 29:12
verses.text: And the book is delivered to him that is not learned, saying, Read this, I pray thee: and he saith, I am not learned.

verses.name: Isaiah 29:13
verses.text: ¶ Wherefore the Lord said, Forasmuch as this people draw near <hi type="italic">me</hi> with their mouth, and with their lips do honour me, but have removed their heart far from me, and their fear toward me is taught by the precept of men:

verses.name: Isaiah 29:14
verses.text: Therefore, behold, I will proceed to do a marvellous work among this people, <hi type="italic">even</hi> a marvellous work and a wonder: for the wisdom of their wise <hi type="italic">men</hi> shall perish, and the understanding of their prudent <hi type="italic">men</hi> shall be hid.

verses.name: Isaiah 29:15
verses.text: Woe unto them that seek deep to hide their counsel from the Lord, and their works are in the dark, and they say, Who seeth us? and who knoweth us?

verses.name: Isaiah 29:16
verses.text: Surely your turning of things upside down shall be esteemed as the potter’s clay: for shall the work say of him that made it, He made me not? or shall the thing framed say of him that framed it, He had no understanding?

verses.name: Isaiah 29:17
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Is</hi> it not yet a very little while, and Lebanon shall be turned into a fruitful field, and the fruitful field shall be esteemed as a forest?

verses.name: Isaiah 29:18
verses.text: ¶ And in that day shall the deaf hear the words of the book, and the eyes of the blind shall see out of obscurity, and out of darkness.

verses.name: Isaiah 29:19
verses.text: The meek also shall increase <hi type="italic">their</hi> joy in the Lord, and the poor among men shall rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.

verses.name: Isaiah 29:20
verses.text: For the terrible one is brought to nought, and the scorner is consumed, and all that watch for iniquity are cut off:

verses.name: Isaiah 29:21
verses.text: That make a man an offender for a word, and lay a snare for him that reproveth in the gate, and turn aside the just for a thing of nought.

verses.name: Isaiah 29:22
verses.text: Therefore thus saith the Lord, who redeemed Abraham, concerning the house of Jacob, Jacob shall not now be ashamed, neither shall his face now wax pale.

verses.name: Isaiah 29:23
verses.text: But when he seeth his children, the work of mine hands, in the midst of him, they shall sanctify my name, and sanctify the Holy One of Jacob, and shall fear the God of Israel.

verses.name: Isaiah 29:24
verses.text: They also that erred in spirit shall come to understanding, and they that murmured shall learn doctrine.  <chapter eID="Isa.29"/><div eID="gen775" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:1
verses.text: WOE to the rebellious children, saith the Lord, that take counsel, but not of me; and that cover with a covering, but not of my spirit, that they may add sin to sin:

verses.name: Isaiah 30:2
verses.text: That walk to go down into Egypt, and have not asked at my mouth; to strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh, and to trust in the shadow of Egypt!

verses.name: Isaiah 30:3
verses.text: Therefore shall the strength of Pharaoh be your shame, and the trust in the shadow of Egypt <hi type="italic">your</hi> confusion.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:4
verses.text: For his princes were at Zoan, and his ambassadors came to Hanes.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:5
verses.text: They were all ashamed of a people <hi type="italic">that</hi> could not profit them, nor be an help nor profit, but a shame, and also a reproach.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:6
verses.text: The burden of the beasts of the south: into the land of trouble and anguish, from whence <hi type="italic">come</hi> the young and old lion, the viper and fiery flying serpent, they will carry their riches upon the shoulders of young asses, and their treasures upon the bunches of camels, to a people <hi type="italic">that</hi> shall not profit <hi type="italic">them</hi>.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:7
verses.text: For the Egyptians shall help in vain, and to no purpose: therefore have I cried concerning this, Their strength <hi type="italic">is</hi> to sit still.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:8
verses.text: ¶ Now go, write it before them in a table, and note it in a book, that it may be for the time to come for ever and ever:

verses.name: Isaiah 30:9
verses.text: That this <hi type="italic">is</hi> a rebellious people, lying children, children <hi type="italic">that</hi> will not hear the law of the Lord:

verses.name: Isaiah 30:10
verses.text: Which say to the seers, See not; and to the prophets, Prophesy not unto us right things, speak unto us smooth things, prophesy deceits:

verses.name: Isaiah 30:11
verses.text: Get you out of the way, turn aside out of the path, cause the Holy One of Israel to cease from before us.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:12
verses.text: Wherefore thus saith the Holy One of Israel, Because ye despise this word, and trust in oppression and perverseness, and stay thereon:

verses.name: Isaiah 30:13
verses.text: Therefore this iniquity shall be to you as a breach ready to fall, swelling out in a high wall, whose breaking cometh suddenly at an instant.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:14
verses.text: And he shall break it as the breaking of the potters’ vessel that is broken in pieces; he shall not spare: so that there shall not be found in the bursting of it a sherd to take fire from the hearth, or to take water <hi type="italic">withal</hi> out of the pit.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:15
verses.text: For thus saith the Lord God, the Holy One of Israel; In returning and rest shall ye be saved; in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength: and ye would not.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:16
verses.text: But ye said, No; for we will flee upon horses; therefore shall ye flee: and, We will ride upon the swift; therefore shall they that pursue you be swift.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:17
verses.text: One thousand <hi type="italic">shall flee</hi> at the rebuke of one; at the rebuke of five shall ye flee: till ye be left as a beacon upon the top of a mountain, and as an ensign on an hill.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:18
verses.text: ¶ And therefore will the Lord wait, that he may be gracious unto you, and therefore will he be exalted, that he may have mercy upon you: for the Lord <hi type="italic">is</hi> a God of judgment: blessed <hi type="italic">are</hi> all they that wait for him.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:19
verses.text: For the people shall dwell in Zion at Jerusalem: thou shalt weep no more: he will be very gracious unto thee at the voice of thy cry; when he shall hear it, he will answer thee.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:20
verses.text: And <hi type="italic">though</hi> the Lord give you the bread of adversity, and the water of affliction, yet shall not thy teachers be removed into a corner any more, but thine eyes shall see thy teachers:

verses.name: Isaiah 30:21
verses.text: And thine ears shall hear a word behind thee, saying, This <hi type="italic">is</hi> the way, walk ye in it, when ye turn to the right hand, and when ye turn to the left.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:22
verses.text: Ye shall defile also the covering of thy graven images of silver, and the ornament of thy molten images of gold: thou shalt cast them away as a menstruous cloth; thou shalt say unto it, Get thee hence.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:23
verses.text: Then shall he give the rain of thy seed, that thou shalt sow the ground withal; and bread of the increase of the earth, and it shall be fat and plenteous: in that day shall thy cattle feed in large pastures.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:24
verses.text: The oxen likewise and the young asses that ear the ground shall eat clean provender, which hath been winnowed with the shovel and with the fan.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:25
verses.text: And there shall be upon every high mountain, and upon every high hill, rivers <hi type="italic">and</hi> streams of waters in the day of the great slaughter, when the towers fall.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:26
verses.text: Moreover the light of the moon shall be as the light of the sun, and the light of the sun shall be sevenfold, as the light of seven days, in the day that the Lord bindeth up the breach of his people, and healeth the stroke of their wound.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:27
verses.text: ¶ Behold, the name of the Lord cometh from far, burning <hi type="italic">with</hi> his anger, and the burden <hi type="italic">thereof is</hi> heavy: his lips are full of indignation, and his tongue as a devouring fire:

verses.name: Isaiah 30:28
verses.text: And his breath, as an overflowing stream, shall reach to the midst of the neck, to sift the nations with the sieve of vanity: and <hi type="italic">there shall be</hi> a bridle in the jaws of the people, causing <hi type="italic">them</hi> to err.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:29
verses.text: Ye shall have a song, as in the night <hi type="italic">when</hi> a holy solemnity is kept; and gladness of heart, as when one goeth with a pipe to come into the mountain of the Lord, to the mighty One of Israel.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:30
verses.text: And the Lord shall cause his glorious voice to be heard, and shall shew the lighting down of his arm, with the indignation of <hi type="italic">his</hi> anger, and <hi type="italic">with</hi> the flame of a devouring fire, <hi type="italic">with</hi> scattering, and tempest, and hailstones.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:31
verses.text: For through the voice of the Lord shall the Assyrian be beaten down, <hi type="italic">which</hi> smote with a rod.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:32
verses.text: And <hi type="italic">in</hi> every place where the grounded staff shall pass, which the Lord shall lay upon him, <hi type="italic">it</hi> shall be with tabrets and harps: and in battles of shaking will he fight with it.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:33
verses.text: For Tophet <hi type="italic">is</hi> ordained of old; yea, for the king it is prepared; he hath made <hi type="italic">it</hi> deep <hi type="italic">and</hi> large: the pile thereof <hi type="italic">is</hi> fire and much wood; the breath of the Lord, like a stream of brimstone, doth kindle it.  <chapter eID="Isa.30"/><div eID="gen776" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 31:1
verses.text: WOE to them that go down to Egypt for help; and stay on horses, and trust in chariots, because <hi type="italic">they are</hi> many; and in horsemen, because they are very strong; but they look not unto the Holy One of Israel, neither seek the Lord!

verses.name: Isaiah 31:2
verses.text: Yet he also <hi type="italic">is</hi> wise, and will bring evil, and will not call back his words: but will arise against the house of the evildoers, and against the help of them that work iniquity.

verses.name: Isaiah 31:3
verses.text: Now the Egyptians <hi type="italic">are</hi> men, and not God; and their horses flesh, and not spirit. When the Lord shall stretch out his hand, both he that helpeth shall fall, and he that is holpen shall fall down, and they all shall fail together.

verses.name: Isaiah 31:4
verses.text: For thus hath the Lord spoken unto me, Like as the lion and the young lion roaring on his prey, when a multitude of shepherds is called forth against him, <hi type="italic">he</hi> will not be afraid of their voice, nor abase himself for the noise of them: so shall the Lord of hosts come down to fight for mount Zion, and for the hill thereof.

verses.name: Isaiah 31:5
verses.text: As birds flying, so will the Lord of hosts defend Jerusalem; defending also he will deliver <hi type="italic">it; and</hi> passing over he will preserve <hi type="italic">it</hi>.

verses.name: Isaiah 31:6
verses.text: ¶ Turn ye unto <hi type="italic">him from</hi> whom the children of Israel have deeply revolted.

verses.name: Isaiah 31:7
verses.text: For in that day every man shall cast away his idols of silver, and his idols of gold, which your own hands have made unto you <hi type="italic">for</hi> a sin.

verses.name: Isaiah 31:8
verses.text: ¶ Then shall the Assyrian fall with the sword, not of a mighty man; and the sword, not of a mean man, shall devour him: but he shall flee from the sword, and his young men shall be discomfited.

verses.name: Isaiah 31:9
verses.text: And he shall pass over to his strong hold for fear, and his princes shall be afraid of the ensign, saith the Lord, whose fire <hi type="italic">is</hi> in Zion, and his furnace in Jerusalem.  <chapter eID="Isa.31"/><div eID="gen777" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 32:1
verses.text: BEHOLD, a king shall reign in righteousness, and princes shall rule in judgment.

verses.name: Isaiah 32:2
verses.text: And a man shall be as an hiding place from the wind, and a covert from the tempest; as rivers of water in a dry place, as the shadow of a great rock in a weary land.

verses.name: Isaiah 32:3
verses.text: And the eyes of them that see shall not be dim, and the ears of them that hear shall hearken.

verses.name: Isaiah 32:4
verses.text: The heart also of the rash shall understand knowledge, and the tongue of the stammerers shall be ready to speak plainly.

verses.name: Isaiah 32:5
verses.text: The vile person shall be no more called liberal, nor the churl said <hi type="italic">to be</hi> bountiful.

verses.name: Isaiah 32:6
verses.text: For the vile person will speak villany, and his heart will work iniquity, to practise hypocrisy, and to utter error against the Lord, to make empty the soul of the hungry, and he will cause the drink of the thirsty to fail.

verses.name: Isaiah 32:7
verses.text: The instruments also of the churl <hi type="italic">are</hi> evil: he deviseth wicked devices to destroy the poor with lying words, even when the needy speaketh right.

verses.name: Isaiah 32:8
verses.text: But the liberal deviseth liberal things; and by liberal things shall he stand.

verses.name: Isaiah 32:9
verses.text: ¶ Rise up, ye women that are at ease; hear my voice, ye careless daughters; give ear unto my speech.

verses.name: Isaiah 32:10
verses.text: Many days and years shall ye be troubled, ye careless women: for the vintage shall fail, the gathering shall not come.

verses.name: Isaiah 32:11
verses.text: Tremble, ye women that are at ease; be troubled, ye careless ones: strip you, and make you bare, and gird <hi type="italic">sackcloth</hi> upon <hi type="italic">your</hi> loins.

verses.name: Isaiah 32:12
verses.text: They shall lament for the teats, for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine.

verses.name: Isaiah 32:13
verses.text: Upon the land of my people shall come up thorns <hi type="italic">and</hi> briers; yea, upon all the houses of joy <hi type="italic">in</hi> the joyous city:

verses.name: Isaiah 32:14
verses.text: Because the palaces shall be forsaken; the multitude of the city shall be left; the forts and towers shall be for dens for ever, a joy of wild asses, a pasture of flocks;

verses.name: Isaiah 32:15
verses.text: Until the spirit be poured upon us from on high, and the wilderness be a fruitful field, and the fruitful field be counted for a forest.

verses.name: Isaiah 32:16
verses.text: Then judgment shall dwell in the wilderness, and righteousness remain in the fruitful field.

verses.name: Isaiah 32:17
verses.text: And the work of righteousness shall be peace; and the effect of righteousness quietness and assurance for ever.

verses.name: Isaiah 32:18
verses.text: And my people shall dwell in a peaceable habitation, and in sure dwellings, and in quiet resting places;

verses.name: Isaiah 32:19
verses.text: When it shall hail, coming down on the forest; and the city shall be low in a low place.

verses.name: Isaiah 32:20
verses.text: Blessed <hi type="italic">are</hi> ye that sow beside all waters, that send forth <hi type="italic">thither</hi> the feet of the ox and the ass.  <chapter eID="Isa.32"/><div eID="gen778" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:1
verses.text: WOE to thee that spoilest, and thou <hi type="italic">wast</hi> not spoiled; and dealest treacherously, and they dealt not treacherously with thee! when thou shalt cease to spoil, thou shalt be spoiled; <hi type="italic">and</hi> when thou shalt make an end to deal treacherously, they shall deal treacherously with thee.

verses.name: Isaiah 33:2
verses.text: O Lord, be gracious unto us; we have waited for thee: be thou their arm every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.

verses.name: Isaiah 33:3
verses.text: At the noise of the tumult the people fled; at the lifting up of thyself the nations were scattered.

verses.name: Isaiah 33:4
verses.text: And your spoil shall be gathered <hi type="italic">like</hi> the gathering of the caterpiller: as the running to and fro of locusts shall he run upon them.

verses.name: Isaiah 33:5
verses.text: The Lord is exalted; for he dwelleth on high: he hath filled Zion with judgment and righteousness.

verses.name: Isaiah 33:6
verses.text: And wisdom and knowledge shall be the stability of thy times, <hi type="italic">and</hi> strength of salvation: the fear of the Lord <hi type="italic">is</hi> his treasure.

verses.name: Isaiah 33:7
verses.text: Behold, their valiant ones shall cry without: the ambassadors of peace shall weep bitterly.

verses.name: Isaiah 33:8
verses.text: The highways lie waste, the wayfaring man ceaseth: he hath broken the covenant, he hath despised the cities, he regardeth no man.

verses.name: Isaiah 33:9
verses.text: The earth mourneth <hi type="italic">and</hi> languisheth: Lebanon is ashamed <hi type="italic">and</hi> hewn down: Sharon is like a wilderness; and Bashan and Carmel shake off <hi type="italic">their fruits</hi>.

verses.name: Isaiah 33:10
verses.text: Now will I rise, saith the Lord; now will I be exalted; now will I lift up myself.

verses.name: Isaiah 33:11
verses.text: Ye shall conceive chaff, ye shall bring forth stubble: your breath, <hi type="italic">as</hi> fire, shall devour you.

verses.name: Isaiah 33:12
verses.text: And the people shall be <hi type="italic">as</hi> the burnings of lime: <hi type="italic">as</hi> thorns cut up shall they be burned in the fire.

verses.name: Isaiah 33:13
verses.text: ¶ Hear, ye <hi type="italic">that are</hi> far off, what I have done; and, ye <hi type="italic">that are</hi> near, acknowledge my might.

verses.name: Isaiah 33:14
verses.text: The sinners in Zion are afraid; fearfulness hath surprised the hypocrites. Who among us shall dwell with the devouring fire? who among us shall dwell with everlasting burnings?

verses.name: Isaiah 33:15
verses.text: He that walketh righteously, and speaketh uprightly; he that despiseth the gain of oppressions, that shaketh his hands from holding of bribes, that stoppeth his ears from hearing of blood, and shutteth his eyes from seeing evil;

verses.name: Isaiah 33:16
verses.text: He shall dwell on high: his place of defence <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> the munitions of rocks: bread shall be given him; his waters <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> sure.

verses.name: Isaiah 33:17
verses.text: Thine eyes shall see the king in his beauty: they shall behold the land that is very far off.

verses.name: Isaiah 33:18
verses.text: Thine heart shall meditate terror. Where <hi type="italic">is</hi> the scribe? where <hi type="italic">is</hi> the receiver? where <hi type="italic">is</hi> he that counted the towers?

verses.name: Isaiah 33:19
verses.text: Thou shalt not see a fierce people, a people of a deeper speech than thou canst perceive; of a stammering tongue, <hi type="italic">that thou canst</hi> not understand.

verses.name: Isaiah 33:20
verses.text: Look upon Zion, the city of our solemnities: thine eyes shall see Jerusalem a quiet habitation, a tabernacle <hi type="italic">that</hi> shall not be taken down; not one of the stakes thereof shall ever be removed, neither shall any of the cords thereof be broken.

verses.name: Isaiah 33:21
verses.text: But there the glorious Lord <hi type="italic">will be</hi> unto us a place of broad rivers <hi type="italic">and</hi> streams; wherein shall go no galley with oars, neither shall gallant ship pass thereby.

verses.name: Isaiah 33:22
verses.text: For the Lord <hi type="italic">is</hi> our judge, the Lord <hi type="italic">is</hi> our lawgiver, the Lord <hi type="italic">is</hi> our king; he will save us.

verses.name: Isaiah 33:23
verses.text: Thy tacklings are loosed; they could not well strengthen their mast, they could not spread the sail: then is the prey of a great spoil divided; the lame take the prey.

verses.name: Isaiah 33:24
verses.text: And the inhabitant shall not say, I am sick: the people that dwell therein <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> forgiven <hi type="italic">their</hi> iniquity.  <chapter eID="Isa.33"/><div eID="gen779" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 34:1
verses.text: COME near, ye nations, to hear; and hearken, ye people: let the earth hear, and all that is therein; the world, and all things that come forth of it.

verses.name: Isaiah 34:2
verses.text: For the indignation of the Lord <hi type="italic">is</hi> upon all nations, and <hi type="italic">his</hi> fury upon all their armies: he hath utterly destroyed them, he hath delivered them to the slaughter.

verses.name: Isaiah 34:3
verses.text: Their slain also shall be cast out, and their stink shall come up out of their carcases, and the mountains shall be melted with their blood.

verses.name: Isaiah 34:4
verses.text: And all the host of heaven shall be dissolved, and the heavens shall be rolled together as a scroll: and all their host shall fall down, as the leaf falleth off from the vine, and as a falling <hi type="italic">fig</hi> from the fig tree.

verses.name: Isaiah 34:5
verses.text: For my sword shall be bathed in heaven: behold, it shall come down upon Idumea, and upon the people of my curse, to judgment.

verses.name: Isaiah 34:6
verses.text: The sword of the Lord is filled with blood, it is made fat with fatness, <hi type="italic">and</hi> with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of the kidneys of rams: for the Lord hath a sacrifice in Bozrah, and a great slaughter in the land of Idumea.

verses.name: Isaiah 34:7
verses.text: And the unicorns shall come down with them, and the bullocks with the bulls; and their land shall be soaked with blood, and their dust made fat with fatness.

verses.name: Isaiah 34:8
verses.text: For <hi type="italic">it is</hi> the day of the Lord’s vengeance, <hi type="italic">and</hi> the year of recompences for the controversy of Zion.

verses.name: Isaiah 34:9
verses.text: And the streams thereof shall be turned into pitch, and the dust thereof into brimstone, and the land thereof shall become burning pitch.

verses.name: Isaiah 34:10
verses.text: It shall not be quenched night nor day; the smoke thereof shall go up for ever: from generation to generation it shall lie waste; none shall pass through it for ever and ever.

verses.name: Isaiah 34:11
verses.text: ¶ But the cormorant and the bittern shall possess it; the owl also and the raven shall dwell in it: and he shall stretch out upon it the line of confusion, and the stones of emptiness.

verses.name: Isaiah 34:12
verses.text: They shall call the nobles thereof to the kingdom, but none <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> there, and all her princes shall be nothing.

verses.name: Isaiah 34:13
verses.text: And thorns shall come up in her palaces, nettles and brambles in the fortresses thereof: and it shall be an habitation of dragons, <hi type="italic">and</hi> a court for owls.

verses.name: Isaiah 34:14
verses.text: The wild beasts of the desert shall also meet with the wild beasts of the island, and the satyr shall cry to his fellow; the screech owl also shall rest there, and find for herself a place of rest.

verses.name: Isaiah 34:15
verses.text: There shall the great owl make her nest, and lay, and hatch, and gather under her shadow: there shall the vultures also be gathered, every one with her mate.

verses.name: Isaiah 34:16
verses.text: ¶ Seek ye out of the book of the Lord, and read: no one of these shall fail, none shall want her mate: for my mouth it hath commanded, and his spirit it hath gathered them.

verses.name: Isaiah 34:17
verses.text: And he hath cast the lot for them, and his hand hath divided it unto them by line: they shall possess it for ever, from generation to generation shall they dwell therein.  <chapter eID="Isa.34"/><div eID="gen780" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 35:1
verses.text: THE wilderness and the solitary place shall be glad for them; and the desert shall rejoice, and blossom as the rose.

verses.name: Isaiah 35:2
verses.text: It shall blossom abundantly, and rejoice even with joy and singing: the glory of Lebanon shall be given unto it, the excellency of Carmel and Sharon, they shall see the glory of the Lord, <hi type="italic">and</hi> the excellency of our God.

verses.name: Isaiah 35:3
verses.text: ¶ Strengthen ye the weak hands, and confirm the feeble knees.

verses.name: Isaiah 35:4
verses.text: Say to them <hi type="italic">that are</hi> of a fearful heart, Be strong, fear not: behold, your God will come <hi type="italic">with</hi> vengeance, <hi type="italic">even</hi> God <hi type="italic">with</hi> a recompence; he will come and save you.

verses.name: Isaiah 35:5
verses.text: Then the eyes of the blind shall be opened, and the ears of the deaf shall be unstopped.

verses.name: Isaiah 35:6
verses.text: Then shall the lame <hi type="italic">man</hi> leap as an hart, and the tongue of the dumb sing: for in the wilderness shall waters break out, and streams in the desert.

verses.name: Isaiah 35:7
verses.text: And the parched ground shall become a pool, and the thirsty land springs of water: in the habitation of dragons, where each lay, <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> grass with reeds and rushes.

verses.name: Isaiah 35:8
verses.text: And an highway shall be there, and a way, and it shall be called The way of holiness; the unclean shall not pass over it; but it <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> for those: the wayfaring men, though fools, shall not err <hi type="italic">therein</hi>.

verses.name: Isaiah 35:9
verses.text: No lion shall be there, nor <hi type="italic">any</hi> ravenous beast shall go up thereon, it shall not be found there; but the redeemed shall walk <hi type="italic">there:</hi>

verses.name: Isaiah 35:10
verses.text: And the ransomed of the Lord shall return, and come to Zion with songs and everlasting joy upon their heads: they shall obtain joy and gladness, and sorrow and sighing shall flee away.  <chapter eID="Isa.35"/><div eID="gen781" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 36:1
verses.text: NOW it came to pass in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah, <hi type="italic">that</hi> Sennacherib king of Assyria came up against all the defenced cities of Judah, and took them.

verses.name: Isaiah 36:2
verses.text: And the king of Assyria sent Rabshakeh from Lachish to Jerusalem unto king Hezekiah with a great army. And he stood by the conduit of the upper pool in the highway of the fuller’s field.

verses.name: Isaiah 36:3
verses.text: Then came forth unto him Eliakim, Hilkiah’s son, which was over the house, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, Asaph’s son, the recorder.

verses.name: Isaiah 36:4
verses.text: ¶ And Rabshakeh said unto them, Say ye now to Hezekiah, Thus saith the great king, the king of Assyria, What confidence <hi type="italic">is</hi> this wherein thou trustest?

verses.name: Isaiah 36:5
verses.text: I say, <hi type="italic">sayest thou</hi>, (but <hi type="italic">they are but</hi> vain words) <hi type="italic">I have</hi> counsel and strength for war: now on whom dost thou trust, that thou rebellest against me?

verses.name: Isaiah 36:6
verses.text: Lo, thou trustest in the staff of this broken reed, on Egypt; whereon if a man lean, it will go into his hand, and pierce it: so <hi type="italic">is</hi> Pharaoh king of Egypt to all that trust in him.

verses.name: Isaiah 36:7
verses.text: But if thou say to me, We trust in the Lord our God: <hi type="italic">is it</hi> not he, whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah hath taken away, and said to Judah and to Jerusalem, Ye shall worship before this altar?

verses.name: Isaiah 36:8
verses.text: Now therefore give pledges, I pray thee, to my master the king of Assyria, and I will give thee two thousand horses, if thou be able on thy part to set riders upon them.

verses.name: Isaiah 36:9
verses.text: How then wilt thou turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master’s servants, and put thy trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?

verses.name: Isaiah 36:10
verses.text: And am I now come up without the Lord against this land to destroy it? the Lord said unto me, Go up against this land, and destroy it.

verses.name: Isaiah 36:11
verses.text: ¶ Then said Eliakim and Shebna and Joah unto Rabshakeh, Speak, I pray thee, unto thy servants in the Syrian language; for we understand <hi type="italic">it:</hi> and speak not to us in the Jews’ language, in the ears of the people that <hi type="italic">are</hi> on the wall.

verses.name: Isaiah 36:12
verses.text: ¶ But Rabshakeh said, Hath my master sent me to thy master and to thee to speak these words? <hi type="italic">hath he</hi> not <hi type="italic">sent me</hi> to the men that sit upon the wall, that they may eat their own dung, and drink their own piss with you?

verses.name: Isaiah 36:13
verses.text: Then Rabshakeh stood, and cried with a loud voice in the Jews’ language, and said, Hear ye the words of the great king, the king of Assyria.

verses.name: Isaiah 36:14
verses.text: Thus saith the king, Let not Hezekiah deceive you: for he shall not be able to deliver you.

verses.name: Isaiah 36:15
verses.text: Neither let Hezekiah make you trust in the Lord, saying, The Lord will surely deliver us: this city shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.

verses.name: Isaiah 36:16
verses.text: Hearken not to Hezekiah: for thus saith the king of Assyria, Make <hi type="italic">an agreement</hi> with me <hi type="italic">by</hi> a present, and come out to me: and eat ye every one of his vine, and every one of his fig tree, and drink ye every one the waters of his own cistern;

verses.name: Isaiah 36:17
verses.text: Until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of corn and wine, a land of bread and vineyards.

verses.name: Isaiah 36:18
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Beware</hi> lest Hezekiah persuade you, saying, The Lord will deliver us. Hath any of the gods of the nations delivered his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?

verses.name: Isaiah 36:19
verses.text: Where <hi type="italic">are</hi> the gods of Hamath and Arphad? where <hi type="italic">are</hi> the gods of Sepharvaim? and have they delivered Samaria out of my hand?

verses.name: Isaiah 36:20
verses.text: Who <hi type="italic">are they</hi> among all the gods of these lands, that have delivered their land out of my hand, that the Lord should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand?

verses.name: Isaiah 36:21
verses.text: But they held their peace, and answered him not a word: for the king’s commandment was, saying, Answer him not.

verses.name: Isaiah 36:22
verses.text: ¶ Then came Eliakim, the son of Hilkiah, that <hi type="italic">was</hi> over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph, the recorder, to Hezekiah with <hi type="italic">their</hi> clothes rent, and told him the words of Rabshakeh.  <chapter eID="Isa.36"/><div eID="gen782" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 37:1
verses.text: AND it came to pass, when king Hezekiah heard <hi type="italic">it</hi>, that he rent his clothes, and covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the house of the Lord.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:2
verses.text: And he sent Eliakim, who <hi type="italic">was</hi> over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests covered with sackcloth, unto Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:3
verses.text: And they said unto him, Thus saith Hezekiah, This day <hi type="italic">is</hi> a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and of blasphemy: for the children are come to the birth, and <hi type="italic">there is</hi> not strength to bring forth.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:4
verses.text: It may be the Lord thy God will hear the words of Rabshakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master hath sent to reproach the living God, and will reprove the words which the Lord thy God hath heard: wherefore lift up <hi type="italic">thy</hi> prayer for the remnant that is left.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:5
verses.text: So the servants of king Hezekiah came to Isaiah.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:6
verses.text: ¶ And Isaiah said unto them, Thus shall ye say unto your master, Thus saith the Lord, Be not afraid of the words that thou hast heard, wherewith the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:7
verses.text: Behold, I will send a blast upon him, and he shall hear a rumour, and return to his own land; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:8
verses.text: ¶ So Rabshakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah: for he had heard that he was departed from Lachish.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:9
verses.text: And he heard say concerning Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, He is come forth to make war with thee. And when he heard <hi type="italic">it</hi>, he sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,

verses.name: Isaiah 37:10
verses.text: Thus shall ye speak to Hezekiah king of Judah, saying, Let not thy God, in whom thou trustest, deceive thee, saying, Jerusalem shall not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:11
verses.text: Behold, thou hast heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands by destroying them utterly; and shalt thou be delivered?

verses.name: Isaiah 37:12
verses.text: Have the gods of the nations delivered them which my fathers have destroyed, <hi type="italic">as</hi> Gozan, and Haran, and Rezeph, and the children of Eden which <hi type="italic">were</hi> in Telassar?

verses.name: Isaiah 37:13
verses.text: Where <hi type="italic">is</hi> the king of Hamath, and the king of Arphad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivah?

verses.name: Isaiah 37:14
verses.text: ¶ And Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers, and read it: and Hezekiah went up unto the house of the Lord, and spread it before the Lord.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:15
verses.text: And Hezekiah prayed unto the Lord, saying,

verses.name: Isaiah 37:16
verses.text: O Lord of hosts, God of Israel, that dwellest <hi type="italic">between</hi> the cherubims, thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> the God, <hi type="italic">even</hi> thou alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth: thou hast made heaven and earth.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:17
verses.text: Incline thine ear, O Lord, and hear; open thine eyes, O Lord, and see: and hear all the words of Sennacherib, which hath sent to reproach the living God.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:18
verses.text: Of a truth, Lord, the kings of Assyria have laid waste all the nations, and their countries,

verses.name: Isaiah 37:19
verses.text: And have cast their gods into the fire: for they <hi type="italic">were</hi> no gods, but the work of men’s hands, wood and stone: therefore they have destroyed them.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:20
verses.text: Now therefore, O Lord our God, save us from his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> the Lord, <hi type="italic">even</hi> thou only.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:21
verses.text: ¶ Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent unto Hezekiah, saying, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, Whereas thou hast prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria:

verses.name: Isaiah 37:22
verses.text: This <hi type="italic">is</hi> the word which the Lord hath spoken concerning him; The virgin, the daughter of Zion, hath despised thee, <hi type="italic">and</hi> laughed thee to scorn; the daughter of Jerusalem hath shaken her head at thee.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:23
verses.text: Whom hast thou reproached and blasphemed? and against whom hast thou exalted <hi type="italic">thy</hi> voice, and lifted up thine eyes on high? <hi type="italic">even</hi> against the Holy One of Israel.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:24
verses.text: By thy servants hast thou reproached the Lord, and hast said, By the multitude of my chariots am I come up to the height of the mountains, to the sides of Lebanon; and I will cut down the tall cedars thereof, <hi type="italic">and</hi> the choice fir trees thereof: and I will enter into the height of his border, <hi type="italic">and</hi> the forest of his Carmel.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:25
verses.text: I have digged, and drunk water; and with the sole of my feet have I dried up all the rivers of the besieged places.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:26
verses.text: Hast thou not heard long ago, <hi type="italic">how</hi> I have done it; <hi type="italic">and</hi> of ancient times, that I have formed it? now have I brought it to pass, that thou shouldest be to lay waste defenced cities <hi type="italic">into</hi> ruinous heaps.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:27
verses.text: Therefore their inhabitants <hi type="italic">were</hi> of small power, they were dismayed and confounded: they were <hi type="italic">as</hi> the grass of the field, and <hi type="italic">as</hi> the green herb, <hi type="italic">as</hi> the grass on the housetops, and <hi type="italic">as corn</hi> blasted before it be grown up.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:28
verses.text: But I know thy abode, and thy going out, and thy coming in, and thy rage against me.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:29
verses.text: Because thy rage against me, and thy tumult, is come up into mine ears, therefore will I put my hook in thy nose, and my bridle in thy lips, and I will turn thee back by the way by which thou camest.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:30
verses.text: And this <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> a sign unto thee, Ye shall eat <hi type="italic">this</hi> year such as groweth of itself; and the second year that which springeth of the same: and in the third year sow ye, and reap, and plant vineyards, and eat the fruit thereof.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:31
verses.text: And the remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah shall again take root downward, and bear fruit upward:

verses.name: Isaiah 37:32
verses.text: For out of Jerusalem shall go forth a remnant, and they that escape out of mount Zion: the zeal of the Lord of hosts shall do this.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:33
verses.text: Therefore thus saith the Lord concerning the king of Assyria, He shall not come into this city, nor shoot an arrow there, nor come before it with shields, nor cast a bank against it.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:34
verses.text: By the way that he came, by the same shall he return, and shall not come into this city, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:35
verses.text: For I will defend this city to save it for mine own sake, and for my servant David’s sake.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:36
verses.text: Then the angel of the Lord went forth, and smote in the camp of the Assyrians a hundred and fourscore and five thousand: and when they arose early in the morning, behold, they <hi type="italic">were</hi> all dead corpses.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:37
verses.text: ¶ So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, and went and returned, and dwelt at Nineveh.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:38
verses.text: And it came to pass, as he was worshipping in the house of Nisroch his god, that Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons smote him with the sword; and they escaped into the land of Armenia: and Esar-haddon his son reigned in his stead.  <chapter eID="Isa.37"/><div eID="gen783" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 38:1
verses.text: IN those days was Hezekiah sick unto death. And Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz came unto him, and said unto him, Thus saith the Lord, Set thine house in order: for thou shalt die, and not live.

verses.name: Isaiah 38:2
verses.text: Then Hezekiah turned his face toward the wall, and prayed unto the Lord,

verses.name: Isaiah 38:3
verses.text: And said, Remember now, O Lord, I beseech thee, how I have walked before thee in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done <hi type="italic">that which is</hi> good in thy sight. And Hezekiah wept sore.

verses.name: Isaiah 38:4
verses.text: ¶ Then came the word of the Lord to Isaiah, saying,

verses.name: Isaiah 38:5
verses.text: Go, and say to Hezekiah, Thus saith the Lord, the God of David thy father, I have heard thy prayer, I have seen thy tears: behold, I will add unto thy days fifteen years.

verses.name: Isaiah 38:6
verses.text: And I will deliver thee and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria: and I will defend this city.

verses.name: Isaiah 38:7
verses.text: And this <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> a sign unto thee from the Lord, that the Lord will do this thing that he hath spoken;

verses.name: Isaiah 38:8
verses.text: Behold, I will bring again the shadow of the degrees, which is gone down in the sun dial of Ahaz, ten degrees backward. So the sun returned ten degrees, by which degrees it was gone down.

verses.name: Isaiah 38:9
verses.text: ¶ The writing of Hezekiah king of Judah, when he had been sick, and was recovered of his sickness:

verses.name: Isaiah 38:10
verses.text: I said in the cutting off of my days, I shall go to the gates of the grave: I am deprived of the residue of my years.

verses.name: Isaiah 38:11
verses.text: I said, I shall not see the Lord, <hi type="italic">even</hi> the Lord, in the land of the living: I shall behold man no more with the inhabitants of the world.

verses.name: Isaiah 38:12
verses.text: Mine age is departed, and is removed from me as a shepherd’s tent: I have cut off like a weaver my life: he will cut me off with pining sickness: from day <hi type="italic">even</hi> to night wilt thou make an end of me.

verses.name: Isaiah 38:13
verses.text: I reckoned till morning, <hi type="italic">that</hi>, as a lion, so will he break all my bones: from day <hi type="italic">even</hi> to night wilt thou make an end of me.

verses.name: Isaiah 38:14
verses.text: Like a crane <hi type="italic">or</hi> a swallow, so did I chatter: I did mourn as a dove: mine eyes fail <hi type="italic">with looking</hi> upward: O Lord, I am oppressed; undertake for me.

verses.name: Isaiah 38:15
verses.text: What shall I say? he hath both spoken unto me, and himself hath done <hi type="italic">it:</hi> I shall go softly all my years in the bitterness of my soul.

verses.name: Isaiah 38:16
verses.text: O Lord, by these <hi type="italic">things men</hi> live, and in all these <hi type="italic">things is</hi> the life of my spirit: so wilt thou recover me, and make me to live.

verses.name: Isaiah 38:17
verses.text: Behold, for peace I had great bitterness: but thou hast in love to my soul <hi type="italic">delivered it</hi> from the pit of corruption: for thou hast cast all my sins behind thy back.

verses.name: Isaiah 38:18
verses.text: For the grave cannot praise thee, death can <hi type="italic">not</hi> celebrate thee: they that go down into the pit cannot hope for thy truth.

verses.name: Isaiah 38:19
verses.text: The living, the living, he shall praise thee, as I <hi type="italic">do</hi> this day: the father to the children shall make known thy truth.

verses.name: Isaiah 38:20
verses.text: The Lord <hi type="italic">was ready</hi> to save me: therefore we will sing my songs to the stringed instruments all the days of our life in the house of the Lord.

verses.name: Isaiah 38:21
verses.text: For Isaiah had said, Let them take a lump of figs, and lay <hi type="italic">it</hi> for a plaister upon the boil, and he shall recover.

verses.name: Isaiah 38:22
verses.text: Hezekiah also had said, What <hi type="italic">is</hi> the sign that I shall go up to the house of the Lord?  <chapter eID="Isa.38"/><div eID="gen784" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 39:1
verses.text: AT that time Merodach-baladan, the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present to Hezekiah: for he had heard that he had been sick, and was recovered.

verses.name: Isaiah 39:2
verses.text: And Hezekiah was glad of them, and shewed them the house of his precious things, the silver, and the gold, and the spices, and the precious ointment, and all the house of his armour, and all that was found in his treasures: there was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion, that Hezekiah shewed them not.

verses.name: Isaiah 39:3
verses.text: ¶ Then came Isaiah the prophet unto king Hezekiah, and said unto him, What said these men? and from whence came they unto thee? And Hezekiah said, They are come from a far country unto me, <hi type="italic">even</hi> from Babylon.

verses.name: Isaiah 39:4
verses.text: Then said he, What have they seen in thine house? And Hezekiah answered, All that <hi type="italic">is</hi> in mine house have they seen: there is nothing among my treasures that I have not shewed them.

verses.name: Isaiah 39:5
verses.text: Then said Isaiah to Hezekiah, Hear the word of the Lord of hosts:

verses.name: Isaiah 39:6
verses.text: Behold, the days come, that all that <hi type="italic">is</hi> in thine house, and <hi type="italic">that</hi> which thy fathers have laid up in store until this day, shall be carried to Babylon: nothing shall be left, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Isaiah 39:7
verses.text: And of thy sons that shall issue from thee, which thou shalt beget, shall they take away; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.

verses.name: Isaiah 39:8
verses.text: Then said Hezekiah to Isaiah, Good <hi type="italic">is</hi> the word of the Lord which thou hast spoken. He said moreover, For there shall be peace and truth in my days.  <chapter eID="Isa.39"/><div eID="gen785" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:1
verses.text: COMFORT ye, comfort ye my people, saith your God.

verses.name: Isaiah 40:2
verses.text: Speak ye comfortably to Jerusalem, and cry unto her, that her warfare is accomplished, that her iniquity is pardoned: for she hath received of the Lord’s hand double for all her sins.

verses.name: Isaiah 40:3
verses.text: ¶ The voice of him that crieth in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make straight in the desert a highway for our God.

verses.name: Isaiah 40:4
verses.text: Every valley shall be exalted, and every mountain and hill shall be made low: and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough places plain:

verses.name: Isaiah 40:5
verses.text: And the glory of the Lord shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see <hi type="italic">it</hi> together: for the mouth of the Lord hath spoken <hi type="italic">it</hi>.

verses.name: Isaiah 40:6
verses.text: The voice said, Cry. And he said, What shall I cry? All flesh <hi type="italic">is</hi> grass, and all the goodliness thereof <hi type="italic">is</hi> as the flower of the field:

verses.name: Isaiah 40:7
verses.text: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: because the spirit of the Lord bloweth upon it: surely the people <hi type="italic">is</hi> grass.

verses.name: Isaiah 40:8
verses.text: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: but the word of our God shall stand for ever.

verses.name: Isaiah 40:9
verses.text: ¶ O Zion, that bringest good tidings, get thee up into the high mountain; O Jerusalem, that bringest good tidings, lift up thy voice with strength; lift <hi type="italic">it</hi> up, be not afraid; say unto the cities of Judah, Behold your God!

verses.name: Isaiah 40:10
verses.text: Behold, the Lord God will come with strong <hi type="italic">hand</hi>, and his arm shall rule for him: behold, his reward <hi type="italic">is</hi> with him, and his work before him.

verses.name: Isaiah 40:11
verses.text: He shall feed his flock like a shepherd: he shall gather the lambs with his arm, and carry <hi type="italic">them</hi> in his bosom, <hi type="italic">and</hi> shall gently lead those that are with young.

verses.name: Isaiah 40:12
verses.text: ¶ Who hath measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, and meted out heaven with the span, and comprehended the dust of the earth in a measure, and weighed the mountains in scales, and the hills in a balance?

verses.name: Isaiah 40:13
verses.text: Who hath directed the Spirit of the Lord, or <hi type="italic">being</hi> his counseller hath taught him?

verses.name: Isaiah 40:14
verses.text: With whom took he counsel, and <hi type="italic">who</hi> instructed him, and taught him in the path of judgment, and taught him knowledge, and shewed to him the way of understanding?

verses.name: Isaiah 40:15
verses.text: Behold, the nations <hi type="italic">are</hi> as a drop of a bucket, and are counted as the small dust of the balance: behold, he taketh up the isles as a very little thing.

verses.name: Isaiah 40:16
verses.text: And Lebanon <hi type="italic">is</hi> not sufficient to burn, nor the beasts thereof sufficient for a burnt offering.

verses.name: Isaiah 40:17
verses.text: All nations before him <hi type="italic">are</hi> as nothing; and they are counted to him less than nothing, and vanity.

verses.name: Isaiah 40:18
verses.text: ¶ To whom then will ye liken God? or what likeness will ye compare unto him?

verses.name: Isaiah 40:19
verses.text: The workman melteth a graven image, and the goldsmith spreadeth it over with gold, and casteth silver chains.

verses.name: Isaiah 40:20
verses.text: He that <hi type="italic">is</hi> so impoverished that he hath no oblation chooseth a tree <hi type="italic">that</hi> will not rot; he seeketh unto him a cunning workman to prepare a graven image, <hi type="italic">that</hi> shall not be moved.

verses.name: Isaiah 40:21
verses.text: Have ye not known? have ye not heard? hath it not been told you from the beginning? have ye not understood from the foundations of the earth?

verses.name: Isaiah 40:22
verses.text: <hi type="italic">It is</hi> he that sitteth upon the circle of the earth, and the inhabitants thereof <hi type="italic">are</hi> as grasshoppers; that stretcheth out the heavens as a curtain, and spreadeth them out as a tent to dwell in:

verses.name: Isaiah 40:23
verses.text: That bringeth the princes to nothing; he maketh the judges of the earth as vanity.

verses.name: Isaiah 40:24
verses.text: Yea, they shall not be planted; yea, they shall not be sown: yea, their stock shall not take root in the earth: and he shall also blow upon them, and they shall wither, and the whirlwind shall take them away as stubble.

verses.name: Isaiah 40:25
verses.text: To whom then will ye liken me, or shall I be equal? saith the Holy One.

verses.name: Isaiah 40:26
verses.text: Lift up your eyes on high, and behold who hath created these <hi type="italic">things</hi>, that bringeth out their host by number: he calleth them all by names by the greatness of his might, for that <hi type="italic">he is</hi> strong in power; not one faileth.

verses.name: Isaiah 40:27
verses.text: Why sayest thou, O Jacob, and speakest, O Israel, My way is hid from the Lord, and my judgment is passed over from my God?

verses.name: Isaiah 40:28
verses.text: ¶ Hast thou not known? hast thou not heard, <hi type="italic">that</hi> the everlasting God, the Lord, the Creator of the ends of the earth, fainteth not, neither is weary? <hi type="italic">there is</hi> no searching of his understanding.

verses.name: Isaiah 40:29
verses.text: He giveth power to the faint; and to <hi type="italic">them that have</hi> no might he increaseth strength.

verses.name: Isaiah 40:30
verses.text: Even the youths shall faint and be weary, and the young men shall utterly fall:

verses.name: Isaiah 40:31
verses.text: But they that wait upon the Lord shall renew <hi type="italic">their</hi> strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; <hi type="italic">and</hi> they shall walk, and not faint.  <chapter eID="Isa.40"/><div eID="gen786" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:1
verses.text: KEEP silence before me, O islands; and let the people renew <hi type="italic">their</hi> strength: let them come near; then let them speak: let us come near together to judgment.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:2
verses.text: Who raised up the righteous <hi type="italic">man</hi> from the east, called him to his foot, gave the nations before him, and made <hi type="italic">him</hi> rule over kings? he gave <hi type="italic">them</hi> as the dust to his sword, <hi type="italic">and</hi> as driven stubble to his bow.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:3
verses.text: He pursued them, <hi type="italic">and</hi> passed safely; <hi type="italic">even</hi> by the way <hi type="italic">that</hi> he had not gone with his feet.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:4
verses.text: Who hath wrought and done <hi type="italic">it</hi>, calling the generations from the beginning? I the Lord, the first, and with the last; I <hi type="italic">am</hi> he.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:5
verses.text: The isles saw <hi type="italic">it</hi>, and feared; the ends of the earth were afraid, drew near, and came.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:6
verses.text: They helped every one his neighbour; and <hi type="italic">every one</hi> said to his brother, Be of good courage.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:7
verses.text: So the carpenter encouraged the goldsmith, <hi type="italic">and</hi> he that smootheth <hi type="italic">with</hi> the hammer him that smote the anvil, saying, It <hi type="italic">is</hi> ready for the sodering: and he fastened it with nails, <hi type="italic">that</hi> it should not be moved.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:8
verses.text: But thou, Israel, <hi type="italic">art</hi> my servant, Jacob whom I have chosen, the seed of Abraham my friend.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:9
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Thou</hi> whom I have taken from the ends of the earth, and called thee from the chief men thereof, and said unto thee, Thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> my servant; I have chosen thee, and not cast thee away.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:10
verses.text: ¶ Fear thou not; for I <hi type="italic">am</hi> with thee: be not dismayed; for I <hi type="italic">am</hi> thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:11
verses.text: Behold, all they that were incensed against thee shall be ashamed and confounded: they shall be as nothing; and they that strive with thee shall perish.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:12
verses.text: Thou shalt seek them, and shalt not find them, <hi type="italic">even</hi> them that contended with thee: they that war against thee shall be as nothing, and as a thing of nought.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:13
verses.text: For I the Lord thy God will hold thy right hand, saying unto thee, Fear not; I will help thee.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:14
verses.text: Fear not, thou worm Jacob, <hi type="italic">and</hi> ye men of Israel; I will help thee, saith the Lord, and thy redeemer, the Holy One of Israel.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:15
verses.text: Behold, I will make thee a new sharp threshing instrument having teeth: thou shalt thresh the mountains, and beat <hi type="italic">them</hi> small, and shalt make the hills as chaff.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:16
verses.text: Thou shalt fan them, and the wind shall carry them away, and the whirlwind shall scatter them: and thou shalt rejoice in the Lord, <hi type="italic">and</hi> shalt glory in the Holy One of Israel.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:17
verses.text: <hi type="italic">When</hi> the poor and needy seek water, and <hi type="italic">there is</hi> none, <hi type="italic">and</hi> their tongue faileth for thirst, I the Lord will hear them, <hi type="italic">I</hi> the God of Israel will not forsake them.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:18
verses.text: I will open rivers in high places, and fountains in the midst of the valleys: I will make the wilderness a pool of water, and the dry land springs of water.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:19
verses.text: I will plant in the wilderness the cedar, the shittah tree, and the myrtle, and the oil tree; I will set in the desert the fir tree, <hi type="italic">and</hi> the pine, and the box tree together:

verses.name: Isaiah 41:20
