verses.text: That they may see, and know, and consider, and understand together, that the hand of the Lord hath done this, and the Holy One of Israel hath created it.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:21
verses.text: Produce your cause, saith the Lord; bring forth your strong <hi type="italic">reasons</hi>, saith the King of Jacob.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:22
verses.text: Let them bring <hi type="italic">them</hi> forth, and shew us what shall happen: let them shew the former things, what they <hi type="italic">be</hi>, that we may consider them, and know the latter end of them; or declare us things for to come.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:23
verses.text: Shew the things that are to come hereafter, that we may know that ye <hi type="italic">are</hi> gods: yea, do good, or do evil, that we may be dismayed, and behold <hi type="italic">it</hi> together.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:24
verses.text: Behold, ye <hi type="italic">are</hi> of nothing, and your work of nought: an abomination <hi type="italic">is he that</hi> chooseth you.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:25
verses.text: I have raised up <hi type="italic">one</hi> from the north, and he shall come: from the rising of the sun shall he call upon my name: and he shall come upon princes as <hi type="italic">upon</hi> morter, and as the potter treadeth clay.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:26
verses.text: Who hath declared from the beginning, that we may know? and beforetime, that we may say, <hi type="italic">He is</hi> righteous? yea, <hi type="italic">there is</hi> none that sheweth, yea, <hi type="italic">there is</hi> none that declareth, yea, <hi type="italic">there is</hi> none that heareth your words.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:27
verses.text: The first <hi type="italic">shall say</hi> to Zion, Behold, behold them: and I will give to Jerusalem one that bringeth good tidings.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:28
verses.text: For I beheld, and <hi type="italic">there was</hi> no man; even among them, and <hi type="italic">there was</hi> no counseller, that, when I asked of them, could answer a word.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:29
verses.text: Behold, they <hi type="italic">are</hi> all vanity; their works <hi type="italic">are</hi> nothing: their molten images <hi type="italic">are</hi> wind and confusion.  <chapter eID="Isa.41"/><div eID="gen787" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:1
verses.text: BEHOLD my servant, whom I uphold; mine elect, <hi type="italic">in whom</hi> my soul delighteth; I have put my spirit upon him: he shall bring forth judgment to the Gentiles.

verses.name: Isaiah 42:2
verses.text: He shall not cry, nor lift up, nor cause his voice to be heard in the street.

verses.name: Isaiah 42:3
verses.text: A bruised reed shall he not break, and the smoking flax shall he not quench: he shall bring forth judgment unto truth.

verses.name: Isaiah 42:4
verses.text: He shall not fail nor be discouraged, till he have set judgment in the earth: and the isles shall wait for his law.

verses.name: Isaiah 42:5
verses.text: ¶ Thus saith God the Lord, he that created the heavens, and stretched them out; he that spread forth the earth, and that which cometh out of it; he that giveth breath unto the people upon it, and spirit to them that walk therein:

verses.name: Isaiah 42:6
verses.text: I the Lord have called thee in righteousness, and will hold thine hand, and will keep thee, and give thee for a covenant of the people, for a light of the Gentiles;

verses.name: Isaiah 42:7
verses.text: To open the blind eyes, to bring out the prisoners from the prison, <hi type="italic">and</hi> them that sit in darkness out of the prison house.

verses.name: Isaiah 42:8
verses.text: I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord: that <hi type="italic">is</hi> my name: and my glory will I not give to another, neither my praise to graven images.

verses.name: Isaiah 42:9
verses.text: Behold, the former things are come to pass, and new things do I declare: before they spring forth I tell you of them.

verses.name: Isaiah 42:10
verses.text: Sing unto the Lord a new song, <hi type="italic">and</hi> his praise from the end of the earth, ye that go down to the sea, and all that is therein; the isles, and the inhabitants thereof.

verses.name: Isaiah 42:11
verses.text: Let the wilderness and the cities thereof lift up <hi type="italic">their voice</hi>, the villages <hi type="italic">that</hi> Kedar doth inhabit: let the inhabitants of the rock sing, let them shout from the top of the mountains.

verses.name: Isaiah 42:12
verses.text: Let them give glory unto the Lord, and declare his praise in the islands.

verses.name: Isaiah 42:13
verses.text: The Lord shall go forth as a mighty man, he shall stir up jealousy like a man of war: he shall cry, yea, roar; he shall prevail against his enemies.

verses.name: Isaiah 42:14
verses.text: I have long time holden my peace; I have been still, <hi type="italic">and</hi> refrained myself: <hi type="italic">now</hi> will I cry like a travailing woman; I will destroy and devour at once.

verses.name: Isaiah 42:15
verses.text: I will make waste mountains and hills, and dry up all their herbs; and I will make the rivers islands, and I will dry up the pools.

verses.name: Isaiah 42:16
verses.text: And I will bring the blind by a way <hi type="italic">that</hi> they knew not; I will lead them in paths <hi type="italic">that</hi> they have not known: I will make darkness light before them, and crooked things straight. These things will I do unto them, and not forsake them.

verses.name: Isaiah 42:17
verses.text: ¶ They shall be turned back, they shall be greatly ashamed, that trust in graven images, that say to the molten images, Ye <hi type="italic">are</hi> our gods.

verses.name: Isaiah 42:18
verses.text: Hear, ye deaf; and look, ye blind, that ye may see.

verses.name: Isaiah 42:19
verses.text: Who <hi type="italic">is</hi> blind, but my servant? or deaf, as my messenger <hi type="italic">that</hi> I sent? who <hi type="italic">is</hi> blind as <hi type="italic">he that is</hi> perfect, and blind as the Lord’s servant?

verses.name: Isaiah 42:20
verses.text: Seeing many things, but thou observest not; opening the ears, but he heareth not.

verses.name: Isaiah 42:21
verses.text: The Lord is well pleased for his righteousness’ sake; he will magnify the law, and make <hi type="italic">it</hi> honourable.

verses.name: Isaiah 42:22
verses.text: But this <hi type="italic">is</hi> a people robbed and spoiled; <hi type="italic">they are</hi> all of them snared in holes, and they are hid in prison houses: they are for a prey, and none delivereth; for a spoil, and none saith, Restore.

verses.name: Isaiah 42:23
verses.text: Who among you will give ear to this? <hi type="italic">who</hi> will hearken and hear for the time to come?

verses.name: Isaiah 42:24
verses.text: Who gave Jacob for a spoil, and Israel to the robbers? did not the Lord, he against whom we have sinned? for they would not walk in his ways, neither were they obedient unto his law.

verses.name: Isaiah 42:25
verses.text: Therefore he hath poured upon him the fury of his anger, and the strength of battle: and it hath set him on fire round about, yet he knew not; and it burned him, yet he laid <hi type="italic">it</hi> not to heart.  <chapter eID="Isa.42"/><div eID="gen788" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:1
verses.text: BUT now thus saith the Lord that created thee, O Jacob, and he that formed thee, O Israel, Fear not: for I have redeemed thee, I have called <hi type="italic">thee</hi> by thy name; thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> mine.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:2
verses.text: When thou passest through the waters, I <hi type="italic">will be</hi> with thee; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee: when thou walkest through the fire, thou shalt not be burned; neither shall the flame kindle upon thee.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:3
verses.text: For I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord thy God, the Holy One of Israel, thy Saviour: I gave Egypt <hi type="italic">for</hi> thy ransom, Ethiopia and Seba for thee.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:4
verses.text: Since thou wast precious in my sight, thou hast been honourable, and I have loved thee: therefore will I give men for thee, and people for thy life.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:5
verses.text: Fear not: for I <hi type="italic">am</hi> with thee: I will bring thy seed from the east, and gather thee from the west;

verses.name: Isaiah 43:6
verses.text: I will say to the north, Give up; and to the south, Keep not back: bring my sons from far, and my daughters from the ends of the earth;

verses.name: Isaiah 43:7
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Even</hi> every one that is called by my name: for I have created him for my glory, I have formed him; yea, I have made him.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:8
verses.text: ¶ Bring forth the blind people that have eyes, and the deaf that have ears.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:9
verses.text: Let all the nations be gathered together, and let the people be assembled: who among them can declare this, and shew us former things? let them bring forth their witnesses, that they may be justified: or let them hear, and say, <hi type="italic">It is</hi> truth.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:10
verses.text: Ye <hi type="italic">are</hi> my witnesses, saith the Lord, and my servant whom I have chosen: that ye may know and believe me, and understand that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> he: before me there was no God formed, neither shall there be after me.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:11
verses.text: I, <hi type="italic">even</hi> I, <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord; and beside me <hi type="italic">there is</hi> no saviour.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:12
verses.text: I have declared, and have saved, and I have shewed, when <hi type="italic">there was</hi> no strange <hi type="italic">god</hi> among you: therefore ye <hi type="italic">are</hi> my witnesses, saith the Lord, that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> God.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:13
verses.text: Yea, before the day <hi type="italic">was</hi> I <hi type="italic">am</hi> he; and <hi type="italic">there is</hi> none that can deliver out of my hand: I will work, and who shall let it?

verses.name: Isaiah 43:14
verses.text: ¶ Thus saith the Lord, your redeemer, the Holy One of Israel; For your sake I have sent to Babylon, and have brought down all their nobles, and the Chaldeans, whose cry <hi type="italic">is</hi> in the ships.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:15
verses.text: I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord, your Holy One, the creator of Israel, your King.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:16
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord, which maketh a way in the sea, and a path in the mighty waters;

verses.name: Isaiah 43:17
verses.text: Which bringeth forth the chariot and horse, the army and the power; they shall lie down together, they shall not rise: they are extinct, they are quenched as tow.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:18
verses.text: ¶ Remember ye not the former things, neither consider the things of old.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:19
verses.text: Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, <hi type="italic">and</hi> rivers in the desert.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:20
verses.text: The beast of the field shall honour me, the dragons and the owls: because I give waters in the wilderness, <hi type="italic">and</hi> rivers in the desert, to give drink to my people, my chosen.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:21
verses.text: This people have I formed for myself; they shall shew forth my praise.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:22
verses.text: ¶ But thou hast not called upon me, O Jacob; but thou hast been weary of me, O Israel.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:23
verses.text: Thou hast not brought me the small cattle of thy burnt offerings; neither hast thou honoured me with thy sacrifices. I have not caused thee to serve with an offering, nor wearied thee with incense.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:24
verses.text: Thou hast bought me no sweet cane with money, neither hast thou filled me with the fat of thy sacrifices: but thou hast made me to serve with thy sins, thou hast wearied me with thine iniquities.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:25
verses.text: I, <hi type="italic">even</hi> I, <hi type="italic">am</hi> he that blotteth out thy transgressions for mine own sake, and will not remember thy sins.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:26
verses.text: Put me in remembrance: let us plead together: declare thou, that thou mayest be justified.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:27
verses.text: Thy first father hath sinned, and thy teachers have transgressed against me.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:28
verses.text: Therefore I have profaned the princes of the sanctuary, and have given Jacob to the curse, and Israel to reproaches.  <chapter eID="Isa.43"/><div eID="gen789" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:1
verses.text: YET now hear, O Jacob my servant; and Israel, whom I have chosen:

verses.name: Isaiah 44:2
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord that made thee, and formed thee from the womb, <hi type="italic">which</hi> will help thee; Fear not, O Jacob, my servant; and thou, Jesurun, whom I have chosen.

verses.name: Isaiah 44:3
verses.text: For I will pour water upon him that is thirsty, and floods upon the dry ground: I will pour my spirit upon thy seed, and my blessing upon thine offspring:

verses.name: Isaiah 44:4
verses.text: And they shall spring up <hi type="italic">as</hi> among the grass, as willows by the water courses.

verses.name: Isaiah 44:5
verses.text: One shall say, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord’s; and another shall call <hi type="italic">himself</hi> by the name of Jacob; and another shall subscribe <hi type="italic">with</hi> his hand unto the Lord, and surname <hi type="italic">himself</hi> by the name of Israel.

verses.name: Isaiah 44:6
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord the King of Israel, and his redeemer the Lord of hosts; I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the first, and I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the last; and beside me <hi type="italic">there is</hi> no God.

verses.name: Isaiah 44:7
verses.text: And who, as I, shall call, and shall declare it, and set it in order for me, since I appointed the ancient people? and the things that are coming, and shall come, let them shew unto them.

verses.name: Isaiah 44:8
verses.text: Fear ye not, neither be afraid: have not I told thee from that time, and have declared <hi type="italic">it?</hi> ye <hi type="italic">are</hi> even my witnesses. Is there a God beside me? yea, <hi type="italic">there is</hi> no God; I know not <hi type="italic">any</hi>.

verses.name: Isaiah 44:9
verses.text: ¶ They that make a graven image <hi type="italic">are</hi> all of them vanity; and their delectable things shall not profit; and they <hi type="italic">are</hi> their own witnesses; they see not, nor know; that they may be ashamed.

verses.name: Isaiah 44:10
verses.text: Who hath formed a god, or molten a graven image <hi type="italic">that</hi> is profitable for nothing?

verses.name: Isaiah 44:11
verses.text: Behold, all his fellows shall be ashamed: and the workmen, they <hi type="italic">are</hi> of men: let them all be gathered together, let them stand up; <hi type="italic">yet</hi> they shall fear, <hi type="italic">and</hi> they shall be ashamed together.

verses.name: Isaiah 44:12
verses.text: The smith with the tongs both worketh in the coals, and fashioneth it with hammers, and worketh it with the strength of his arms: yea, he is hungry, and his strength faileth: he drinketh no water, and is faint.

verses.name: Isaiah 44:13
verses.text: The carpenter stretcheth out <hi type="italic">his</hi> rule; he marketh it out with a line; he fitteth it with planes, and he marketh it out with the compass, and maketh it after the figure of a man, according to the beauty of a man; that it may remain in the house.

verses.name: Isaiah 44:14
verses.text: He heweth him down cedars, and taketh the cypress and the oak, which he strengtheneth for himself among the trees of the forest: he planteth an ash, and the rain doth nourish <hi type="italic">it</hi>.

verses.name: Isaiah 44:15
verses.text: Then shall it be for a man to burn: for he will take thereof, and warm himself; yea, he kindleth <hi type="italic">it</hi>, and baketh bread; yea, he maketh a god, and worshippeth <hi type="italic">it;</hi> he maketh it a graven image, and falleth down thereto.

verses.name: Isaiah 44:16
verses.text: He burneth part thereof in the fire; with part thereof he eateth flesh; he roasteth roast, and is satisfied: yea, he warmeth <hi type="italic">himself</hi>, and saith, Aha, I am warm, I have seen the fire:

verses.name: Isaiah 44:17
verses.text: And the residue thereof he maketh a god, <hi type="italic">even</hi> his graven image: he falleth down unto it, and worshippeth <hi type="italic">it</hi>, and prayeth unto it, and saith, Deliver me; for thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> my god.

verses.name: Isaiah 44:18
verses.text: They have not known nor understood: for he hath shut their eyes, that they cannot see; <hi type="italic">and</hi> their hearts, that they cannot understand.

verses.name: Isaiah 44:19
verses.text: And none considereth in his heart, neither <hi type="italic">is there</hi> knowledge nor understanding to say, I have burned part of it in the fire; yea, also I have baked bread upon the coals thereof; I have roasted flesh, and eaten <hi type="italic">it:</hi> and shall I make the residue thereof an abomination? shall I fall down to the stock of a tree?

verses.name: Isaiah 44:20
verses.text: He feedeth on ashes: a deceived heart hath turned him aside, that he cannot deliver his soul, nor say, <hi type="italic">Is there</hi> not a lie in my right hand?

verses.name: Isaiah 44:21
verses.text: ¶ Remember these, O Jacob and Israel; for thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> my servant: I have formed thee; thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> my servant: O Israel, thou shalt not be forgotten of me.

verses.name: Isaiah 44:22
verses.text: I have blotted out, as a thick cloud, thy transgressions, and, as a cloud, thy sins: return unto me; for I have redeemed thee.

verses.name: Isaiah 44:23
verses.text: Sing, O ye heavens; for the Lord hath done <hi type="italic">it:</hi> shout, ye lower parts of the earth: break forth into singing, ye mountains, O forest, and every tree therein: for the Lord hath redeemed Jacob, and glorified himself in Israel.

verses.name: Isaiah 44:24
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord, thy redeemer, and he that formed thee from the womb, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord that maketh all <hi type="italic">things;</hi> that stretcheth forth the heavens alone; that spreadeth abroad the earth by myself;

verses.name: Isaiah 44:25
verses.text: That frustrateth the tokens of the liars, and maketh diviners mad; that turneth wise <hi type="italic">men</hi> backward, and maketh their knowledge foolish;

verses.name: Isaiah 44:26
verses.text: That confirmeth the word of his servant, and performeth the counsel of his messengers; that saith to Jerusalem, Thou shalt be inhabited; and to the cities of Judah, Ye shall be built, and I will raise up the decayed places thereof:

verses.name: Isaiah 44:27
verses.text: That saith to the deep, Be dry, and I will dry up thy rivers:

verses.name: Isaiah 44:28
verses.text: That saith of Cyrus, <hi type="italic">He is</hi> my shepherd, and shall perform all my pleasure: even saying to Jerusalem, Thou shalt be built; and to the temple, Thy foundation shall be laid.  <chapter eID="Isa.44"/><div eID="gen790" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:1
verses.text: THUS saith the Lord to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have holden, to subdue nations before him; and I will loose the loins of kings, to open before him the two leaved gates; and the gates shall not be shut;

verses.name: Isaiah 45:2
verses.text: I will go before thee, and make the crooked places straight: I will break in pieces the gates of brass, and cut in sunder the bars of iron:

verses.name: Isaiah 45:3
verses.text: And I will give thee the treasures of darkness, and hidden riches of secret places, that thou mayest know that I, the Lord, which call <hi type="italic">thee</hi> by thy name, <hi type="italic">am</hi> the God of Israel.

verses.name: Isaiah 45:4
verses.text: For Jacob my servant’s sake, and Israel mine elect, I have even called thee by thy name: I have surnamed thee, though thou hast not known me.

verses.name: Isaiah 45:5
verses.text: ¶ I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord, and <hi type="italic">there is</hi> none else, <hi type="italic">there is</hi> no God beside me: I girded thee, though thou hast not known me:

verses.name: Isaiah 45:6
verses.text: That they may know from the rising of the sun, and from the west, that <hi type="italic">there is</hi> none beside me. I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord, and <hi type="italic">there is</hi> none else.

verses.name: Isaiah 45:7
verses.text: I form the light, and create darkness: I make peace, and create evil: I the Lord do all these <hi type="italic">things</hi>.

verses.name: Isaiah 45:8
verses.text: Drop down, ye heavens, from above, and let the skies pour down righteousness: let the earth open, and let them bring forth salvation, and let righteousness spring up together; I the Lord have created it.

verses.name: Isaiah 45:9
verses.text: Woe unto him that striveth with his Maker! <hi type="italic">Let</hi> the potsherd <hi type="italic">strive</hi> with the potsherds of the earth. Shall the clay say to him that fashioneth it, What makest thou? or thy work, He hath no hands?

verses.name: Isaiah 45:10
verses.text: Woe unto him that saith unto <hi type="italic">his</hi> father, What begettest thou? or to the woman, What hast thou brought forth?

verses.name: Isaiah 45:11
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord, the Holy One of Israel, and his Maker, Ask me of things to come concerning my sons, and concerning the work of my hands command ye me.

verses.name: Isaiah 45:12
verses.text: I have made the earth, and created man upon it: I, <hi type="italic">even</hi> my hands, have stretched out the heavens, and all their host have I commanded.

verses.name: Isaiah 45:13
verses.text: I have raised him up in righteousness, and I will direct all his ways: he shall build my city, and he shall let go my captives, not for price nor reward, saith the Lord of hosts.

verses.name: Isaiah 45:14
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord, The labour of Egypt, and merchandise of Ethiopia and of the Sabeans, men of stature, shall come over unto thee, and they shall be thine: they shall come after thee; in chains they shall come over, and they shall fall down unto thee, they shall make supplication unto thee, <hi type="italic">saying</hi>, Surely God <hi type="italic">is</hi> in thee; and <hi type="italic">there is</hi> none else, <hi type="italic">there is</hi> no God.

verses.name: Isaiah 45:15
verses.text: Verily thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> a God that hidest thyself, O God of Israel, the Saviour.

verses.name: Isaiah 45:16
verses.text: They shall be ashamed, and also confounded, all of them: they shall go to confusion together <hi type="italic">that are</hi> makers of idols.

verses.name: Isaiah 45:17
verses.text: <hi type="italic">But</hi> Israel shall be saved in the Lord with an everlasting salvation: ye shall not be ashamed nor confounded world without end.

verses.name: Isaiah 45:18
verses.text: For thus saith the Lord that created the heavens; God himself that formed the earth and made it; he hath established it, he created it not in vain, he formed it to be inhabited: I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord; and <hi type="italic">there is</hi> none else.

verses.name: Isaiah 45:19
verses.text: I have not spoken in secret, in a dark place of the earth: I said not unto the seed of Jacob, Seek ye me in vain: I the Lord speak righteousness, I declare things that are right.

verses.name: Isaiah 45:20
verses.text: ¶ Assemble yourselves and come; draw near together, ye <hi type="italic">that are</hi> escaped of the nations: they have no knowledge that set up the wood of their graven image, and pray unto a god <hi type="italic">that</hi> cannot save.

verses.name: Isaiah 45:21
verses.text: Tell ye, and bring <hi type="italic">them</hi> near; yea, let them take counsel together: who hath declared this from ancient time? <hi type="italic">who</hi> hath told it from that time? <hi type="italic">have</hi> not I the Lord? and <hi type="italic">there is</hi> no God else beside me; a just God and a Saviour; <hi type="italic">there is</hi> none beside me.

verses.name: Isaiah 45:22
verses.text: Look unto me, and be ye saved, all the ends of the earth: for I <hi type="italic">am</hi> God, and <hi type="italic">there is</hi> none else.

verses.name: Isaiah 45:23
verses.text: I have sworn by myself, the word is gone out of my mouth <hi type="italic">in</hi> righteousness, and shall not return, That unto me every knee shall bow, every tongue shall swear.

verses.name: Isaiah 45:24
verses.text: Surely, shall <hi type="italic">one</hi> say, in the Lord have I righteousness and strength: <hi type="italic">even</hi> to him shall <hi type="italic">men</hi> come; and all that are incensed against him shall be ashamed.

verses.name: Isaiah 45:25
verses.text: In the Lord shall all the seed of Israel be justified, and shall glory.  <chapter eID="Isa.45"/><div eID="gen791" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 46:1
verses.text: BEL boweth down, Nebo stoopeth, their idols were upon the beasts, and upon the cattle: your carriages <hi type="italic">were</hi> heavy loaden; <hi type="italic">they are</hi> a burden to the weary <hi type="italic">beast</hi>.

verses.name: Isaiah 46:2
verses.text: They stoop, they bow down together; they could not deliver the burden, but themselves are gone into captivity.

verses.name: Isaiah 46:3
verses.text: ¶ Hearken unto me, O house of Jacob, and all the remnant of the house of Israel, which are borne <hi type="italic">by me</hi> from the belly, which are carried from the womb:

verses.name: Isaiah 46:4
verses.text: And <hi type="italic">even</hi> to <hi type="italic">your</hi> old age I <hi type="italic">am</hi> he; and <hi type="italic">even</hi> to hoar hairs will I carry <hi type="italic">you:</hi> I have made, and I will bear; even I will carry, and will deliver <hi type="italic">you</hi>.

verses.name: Isaiah 46:5
verses.text: ¶ To whom will ye liken me, and make <hi type="italic">me</hi> equal, and compare me, that we may be like?

verses.name: Isaiah 46:6
verses.text: They lavish gold out of the bag, and weigh silver in the balance, <hi type="italic">and</hi> hire a goldsmith; and he maketh it a god: they fall down, yea, they worship.

verses.name: Isaiah 46:7
verses.text: They bear him upon the shoulder, they carry him, and set him in his place, and he standeth; from his place shall he not remove: yea, <hi type="italic">one</hi> shall cry unto him, yet can he not answer, nor save him out of his trouble.

verses.name: Isaiah 46:8
verses.text: Remember this, and shew yourselves men: bring <hi type="italic">it</hi> again to mind, O ye transgressors.

verses.name: Isaiah 46:9
verses.text: Remember the former things of old: for I <hi type="italic">am</hi> God, and <hi type="italic">there is</hi> none else; <hi type="italic">I am</hi> God, and <hi type="italic">there is</hi> none like me,

verses.name: Isaiah 46:10
verses.text: Declaring the end from the beginning, and from ancient times <hi type="italic">the things</hi> that are not <hi type="italic">yet</hi> done, saying, My counsel shall stand, and I will do all my pleasure:

verses.name: Isaiah 46:11
verses.text: Calling a ravenous bird from the east, the man that executeth my counsel from a far country: yea, I have spoken <hi type="italic">it</hi>, I will also bring it to pass; I have purposed <hi type="italic">it</hi>, I will also do it.

verses.name: Isaiah 46:12
verses.text: ¶ Hearken unto me, ye stouthearted, that <hi type="italic">are</hi> far from righteousness:

verses.name: Isaiah 46:13
verses.text: I bring near my righteousness; it shall not be far off, and my salvation shall not tarry: and I will place salvation in Zion for Israel my glory.  <chapter eID="Isa.46"/><div eID="gen792" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 47:1
verses.text: COME down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon, sit on the ground: <hi type="italic">there is</hi> no throne, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for thou shalt no more be called tender and delicate.

verses.name: Isaiah 47:2
verses.text: Take the millstones, and grind meal: uncover thy locks, make bare the leg, uncover the thigh, pass over the rivers.

verses.name: Isaiah 47:3
verses.text: Thy nakedness shall be uncovered, yea, thy shame shall be seen: I will take vengeance, and I will not meet <hi type="italic">thee as</hi> a man.

verses.name: Isaiah 47:4
verses.text: <hi type="italic">As for</hi> our redeemer, the Lord of hosts <hi type="italic">is</hi> his name, the Holy One of Israel.

verses.name: Isaiah 47:5
verses.text: Sit thou silent, and get thee into darkness, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for thou shalt no more be called, The lady of kingdoms.

verses.name: Isaiah 47:6
verses.text: ¶ I was wroth with my people, I have polluted mine inheritance, and given them into thine hand: thou didst shew them no mercy; upon the ancient hast thou very heavily laid thy yoke.

verses.name: Isaiah 47:7
verses.text: ¶ And thou saidst, I shall be a lady for ever: <hi type="italic">so</hi> that thou didst not lay these <hi type="italic">things</hi> to thy heart, neither didst remember the latter end of it.

verses.name: Isaiah 47:8
verses.text: Therefore hear now this, <hi type="italic">thou that art</hi> given to pleasures, that dwellest carelessly, that sayest in thine heart, I <hi type="italic">am</hi>, and none else beside me; I shall not sit <hi type="italic">as</hi> a widow, neither shall I know the loss of children:

verses.name: Isaiah 47:9
verses.text: But these two <hi type="italic">things</hi> shall come to thee in a moment in one day, the loss of children, and widowhood: they shall come upon thee in their perfection for the multitude of thy sorceries, <hi type="italic">and</hi> for the great abundance of thine enchantments.

verses.name: Isaiah 47:10
verses.text: ¶ For thou hast trusted in thy wickedness: thou hast said, None seeth me. Thy wisdom and thy knowledge, it hath perverted thee; and thou hast said in thine heart, I <hi type="italic">am</hi>, and none else beside me.

verses.name: Isaiah 47:11
verses.text: ¶ Therefore shall evil come upon thee; thou shalt not know from whence it riseth: and mischief shall fall upon thee; thou shalt not be able to put it off: and desolation shall come upon thee suddenly, <hi type="italic">which</hi> thou shalt not know.

verses.name: Isaiah 47:12
verses.text: Stand now with thine enchantments, and with the multitude of thy sorceries, wherein thou hast laboured from thy youth; if so be thou shalt be able to profit, if so be thou mayest prevail.

verses.name: Isaiah 47:13
verses.text: Thou art wearied in the multitude of thy counsels. Let now the astrologers, the stargazers, the monthly prognosticators, stand up, and save thee from <hi type="italic">these things</hi> that shall come upon thee.

verses.name: Isaiah 47:14
verses.text: Behold, they shall be as stubble; the fire shall burn them; they shall not deliver themselves from the power of the flame: <hi type="italic">there shall</hi> not <hi type="italic">be</hi> a coal to warm at, <hi type="italic">nor</hi> fire to sit before it.

verses.name: Isaiah 47:15
verses.text: Thus shall they be unto thee with whom thou hast laboured, <hi type="italic">even</hi> thy merchants, from thy youth: they shall wander every one to his quarter; none shall save thee.  <chapter eID="Isa.47"/><div eID="gen793" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 48:1
verses.text: HEAR ye this, O house of Jacob, which are called by the name of Israel, and are come forth out of the waters of Judah, which swear by the name of the Lord, and make mention of the God of Israel, <hi type="italic">but</hi> not in truth, nor in righteousness.

verses.name: Isaiah 48:2
verses.text: For they call themselves of the holy city, and stay themselves upon the God of Israel; The Lord of hosts <hi type="italic">is</hi> his name.

verses.name: Isaiah 48:3
verses.text: I have declared the former things from the beginning; and they went forth out of my mouth, and I shewed them; I did <hi type="italic">them</hi> suddenly, and they came to pass.

verses.name: Isaiah 48:4
verses.text: Because I knew that thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> obstinate, and thy neck <hi type="italic">is</hi> an iron sinew, and thy brow brass;

verses.name: Isaiah 48:5
verses.text: I have even from the beginning declared <hi type="italic">it</hi> to thee; before it came to pass I shewed <hi type="italic">it</hi> thee: lest thou shouldest say, Mine idol hath done them, and my graven image, and my molten image, hath commanded them.

verses.name: Isaiah 48:6
verses.text: Thou hast heard, see all this; and will not ye declare <hi type="italic">it?</hi> I have shewed thee new things from this time, even hidden things, and thou didst not know them.

verses.name: Isaiah 48:7
verses.text: They are created now, and not from the beginning; even before the day when thou heardest them not; lest thou shouldest say, Behold, I knew them.

verses.name: Isaiah 48:8
verses.text: Yea, thou heardest not; yea, thou knewest not; yea, from that time <hi type="italic">that</hi> thine ear was not opened: for I knew that thou wouldest deal very treacherously, and wast called a transgressor from the womb.

verses.name: Isaiah 48:9
verses.text: ¶ For my name’s sake will I defer mine anger, and for my praise will I refrain for thee, that I cut thee not off.

verses.name: Isaiah 48:10
verses.text: Behold, I have refined thee, but not with silver; I have chosen thee in the furnace of affliction.

verses.name: Isaiah 48:11
verses.text: For mine own sake, <hi type="italic">even</hi> for mine own sake, will I do <hi type="italic">it:</hi> for how should <hi type="italic">my name</hi> be polluted? and I will not give my glory unto another.

verses.name: Isaiah 48:12
verses.text: ¶ Hearken unto me, O Jacob and Israel, my called; I <hi type="italic">am</hi> he; I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the first, I also <hi type="italic">am</hi> the last.

verses.name: Isaiah 48:13
verses.text: Mine hand also hath laid the foundation of the earth, and my right hand hath spanned the heavens: <hi type="italic">when</hi> I call unto them, they stand up together.

verses.name: Isaiah 48:14
verses.text: All ye, assemble yourselves, and hear; which among them hath declared these <hi type="italic">things?</hi> The Lord hath loved him: he will do his pleasure on Babylon, and his arm <hi type="italic">shall be on</hi> the Chaldeans.

verses.name: Isaiah 48:15
verses.text: I, <hi type="italic">even</hi> I, have spoken; yea, I have called him: I have brought him, and he shall make his way prosperous.

verses.name: Isaiah 48:16
verses.text: ¶ Come ye near unto me, hear ye this; I have not spoken in secret from the beginning; from the time that it was, there <hi type="italic">am</hi> I: and now the Lord God, and his Spirit, hath sent me.

verses.name: Isaiah 48:17
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord, thy Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel; I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord thy God which teacheth thee to profit, which leadeth thee by the way <hi type="italic">that</hi> thou shouldest go.

verses.name: Isaiah 48:18
verses.text: O that thou hadst hearkened to my commandments! then had thy peace been as a river, and thy righteousness as the waves of the sea:

verses.name: Isaiah 48:19
verses.text: Thy seed also had been as the sand, and the offspring of thy bowels like the gravel thereof; his name should not have been cut off nor destroyed from before me.

verses.name: Isaiah 48:20
verses.text: ¶ Go ye forth of Babylon, flee ye from the Chaldeans, with a voice of singing declare ye, tell this, utter it <hi type="italic">even</hi> to the end of the earth; say ye, The Lord hath redeemed his servant Jacob.

verses.name: Isaiah 48:21
verses.text: And they thirsted not <hi type="italic">when</hi> he led them through the deserts: he caused the waters to flow out of the rock for them: he clave the rock also, and the waters gushed out.

verses.name: Isaiah 48:22
verses.text: <hi type="italic">There is</hi> no peace, saith the Lord, unto the wicked.  <chapter eID="Isa.48"/><div eID="gen794" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:1
verses.text: LISTEN, O isles, unto me; and hearken, ye people, from far; The Lord hath called me from the womb; from the bowels of my mother hath he made mention of my name.

verses.name: Isaiah 49:2
verses.text: And he hath made my mouth like a sharp sword; in the shadow of his hand hath he hid me, and made me a polished shaft; in his quiver hath he hid me;

verses.name: Isaiah 49:3
verses.text: And said unto me, Thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> my servant, O Israel, in whom I will be glorified.

verses.name: Isaiah 49:4
verses.text: Then I said, I have laboured in vain, I have spent my strength for nought, and in vain: <hi type="italic">yet</hi> surely my judgment <hi type="italic">is</hi> with the Lord, and my work with my God.

verses.name: Isaiah 49:5
verses.text: ¶ And now, saith the Lord that formed me from the womb <hi type="italic">to be</hi> his servant, to bring Jacob again to him, Though Israel be not gathered, yet shall I be glorious in the eyes of the Lord, and my God shall be my strength.

verses.name: Isaiah 49:6
verses.text: And he said, It is a light thing that thou shouldest be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore the preserved of Israel: I will also give thee for a light to the Gentiles, that thou mayest be my salvation unto the end of the earth.

verses.name: Isaiah 49:7
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord, the Redeemer of Israel, <hi type="italic">and</hi> his Holy One, to him whom man despiseth, to him whom the nation abhorreth, to a servant of rulers, Kings shall see and arise, princes also shall worship, because of the Lord that is faithful, <hi type="italic">and</hi> the Holy One of Israel, and he shall choose thee.

verses.name: Isaiah 49:8
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord, In an acceptable time have I heard thee, and in a day of salvation have I helped thee: and I will preserve thee, and give thee for a covenant of the people, to establish the earth, to cause to inherit the desolate heritages;

verses.name: Isaiah 49:9
verses.text: That thou mayest say to the prisoners, Go forth; to them that <hi type="italic">are</hi> in darkness, Shew yourselves. They shall feed in the ways, and their pastures <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> in all high places.

verses.name: Isaiah 49:10
verses.text: They shall not hunger nor thirst; neither shall the heat nor sun smite them: for he that hath mercy on them shall lead them, even by the springs of water shall he guide them.

verses.name: Isaiah 49:11
verses.text: And I will make all my mountains a way, and my highways shall be exalted.

verses.name: Isaiah 49:12
verses.text: Behold, these shall come from far: and, lo, these from the north and from the west; and these from the land of Sinim.

verses.name: Isaiah 49:13
verses.text: ¶ Sing, O heavens; and be joyful, O earth; and break forth into singing, O mountains: for the Lord hath comforted his people, and will have mercy upon his afflicted.

verses.name: Isaiah 49:14
verses.text: But Zion said, The Lord hath forsaken me, and my Lord hath forgotten me.

verses.name: Isaiah 49:15
verses.text: Can a woman forget her sucking child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? yea, they may forget, yet will I not forget thee.

verses.name: Isaiah 49:16
verses.text: Behold, I have graven thee upon the palms of <hi type="italic">my</hi> hands; thy walls <hi type="italic">are</hi> continually before me.

verses.name: Isaiah 49:17
verses.text: Thy children shall make haste; thy destroyers and they that made thee waste shall go forth of thee.

verses.name: Isaiah 49:18
verses.text: ¶ Lift up thine eyes round about, and behold: all these gather themselves together, <hi type="italic">and</hi> come to thee. <hi type="italic">As</hi> I live, saith the Lord, thou shalt surely clothe thee with them all, as with an ornament, and bind them <hi type="italic">on thee</hi>, as a bride <hi type="italic">doeth</hi>.

verses.name: Isaiah 49:19
verses.text: For thy waste and thy desolate places, and the land of thy destruction, shall even now be too narrow by reason of the inhabitants, and they that swallowed thee up shall be far away.

verses.name: Isaiah 49:20
verses.text: The children which thou shalt have, after thou hast lost the other, shall say again in thine ears, The place <hi type="italic">is</hi> too strait for me: give place to me that I may dwell.

verses.name: Isaiah 49:21
verses.text: Then shalt thou say in thine heart, Who hath begotten me these, seeing I have lost my children, and am desolate, a captive, and removing to and fro? and who hath brought up these? Behold, I was left alone; these, where <hi type="italic">had</hi> they <hi type="italic">been?</hi>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:22
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord God, Behold, I will lift up mine hand to the Gentiles, and set up my standard to the people: and they shall bring thy sons in <hi type="italic">their</hi> arms, and thy daughters shall be carried upon <hi type="italic">their</hi> shoulders.

verses.name: Isaiah 49:23
verses.text: And kings shall be thy nursing fathers, and their queens thy nursing mothers: they shall bow down to thee with <hi type="italic">their</hi> face toward the earth, and lick up the dust of thy feet; and thou shalt know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord: for they shall not be ashamed that wait for me.

verses.name: Isaiah 49:24
verses.text: ¶ Shall the prey be taken from the mighty, or the lawful captive delivered?

verses.name: Isaiah 49:25
verses.text: But thus saith the Lord, Even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away, and the prey of the terrible shall be delivered: for I will contend with him that contendeth with thee, and I will save thy children.

verses.name: Isaiah 49:26
verses.text: And I will feed them that oppress thee with their own flesh; and they shall be drunken with their own blood, as with sweet wine: and all flesh shall know that I the Lord <hi type="italic">am</hi> thy Saviour and thy Redeemer, the mighty One of Jacob.  <chapter eID="Isa.49"/><div eID="gen795" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 50:1
verses.text: THUS saith the Lord, Where <hi type="italic">is</hi> the bill of your mother’s divorcement, whom I have put away? or which of my creditors <hi type="italic">is it</hi> to whom I have sold you? Behold, for your iniquities have ye sold yourselves, and for your transgressions is your mother put away.

verses.name: Isaiah 50:2
verses.text: Wherefore, when I came, <hi type="italic">was there</hi> no man? when I called, <hi type="italic">was there</hi> none to answer? Is my hand shortened at all, that it cannot redeem? or have I no power to deliver? behold, at my rebuke I dry up the sea, I make the rivers a wilderness: their fish stinketh, because <hi type="italic">there is</hi> no water, and dieth for thirst.

verses.name: Isaiah 50:3
verses.text: I clothe the heavens with blackness, and I make sackcloth their covering.

verses.name: Isaiah 50:4
verses.text: The Lord God hath given me the tongue of the learned, that I should know how to speak a word in season to <hi type="italic">him that is</hi> weary: he wakeneth morning by morning, he wakeneth mine ear to hear as the learned.

verses.name: Isaiah 50:5
verses.text: ¶ The Lord God hath opened mine ear, and I was not rebellious, neither turned away back.

verses.name: Isaiah 50:6
verses.text: I gave my back to the smiters, and my cheeks to them that plucked off the hair: I hid not my face from shame and spitting.

verses.name: Isaiah 50:7
verses.text: ¶ For the Lord God will help me; therefore shall I not be confounded: therefore have I set my face like a flint, and I know that I shall not be ashamed.

verses.name: Isaiah 50:8
verses.text: <hi type="italic">He is</hi> near that justifieth me; who will contend with me? let us stand together: who <hi type="italic">is</hi> mine adversary? let him come near to me.

verses.name: Isaiah 50:9
verses.text: Behold, the Lord God will help me; who <hi type="italic">is</hi> he <hi type="italic">that</hi> shall condemn me? lo, they all shall wax old as a garment; the moth shall eat them up.

verses.name: Isaiah 50:10
verses.text: ¶ Who <hi type="italic">is</hi> among you that feareth the Lord, that obeyeth the voice of his servant, that walketh <hi type="italic">in</hi> darkness, and hath no light? let him trust in the name of the Lord, and stay upon his God.

verses.name: Isaiah 50:11
verses.text: Behold, all ye that kindle a fire, that compass <hi type="italic">yourselves</hi> about with sparks: walk in the light of your fire, and in the sparks <hi type="italic">that</hi> ye have kindled. This shall ye have of mine hand; ye shall lie down in sorrow.  <chapter eID="Isa.50"/><div eID="gen796" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 51:1
verses.text: HEARKEN to me, ye that follow after righteousness, ye that seek the Lord: look unto the rock <hi type="italic">whence</hi> ye are hewn, and to the hole of the pit <hi type="italic">whence</hi> ye are digged.

verses.name: Isaiah 51:2
verses.text: Look unto Abraham your father, and unto Sarah <hi type="italic">that</hi> bare you: for I called him alone, and blessed him, and increased him.

verses.name: Isaiah 51:3
verses.text: For the Lord shall comfort Zion: he will comfort all her waste places; and he will make her wilderness like Eden, and her desert like the garden of the Lord; joy and gladness shall be found therein, thanksgiving, and the voice of melody.

verses.name: Isaiah 51:4
verses.text: ¶ Hearken unto me, my people; and give ear unto me, O my nation: for a law shall proceed from me, and I will make my judgment to rest for a light of the people.

verses.name: Isaiah 51:5
verses.text: My righteousness <hi type="italic">is</hi> near; my salvation is gone forth, and mine arms shall judge the people; the isles shall wait upon me, and on mine arm shall they trust.

verses.name: Isaiah 51:6
verses.text: Lift up your eyes to the heavens, and look upon the earth beneath: for the heavens shall vanish away like smoke, and the earth shall wax old like a garment, and they that dwell therein shall die in like manner: but my salvation shall be for ever, and my righteousness shall not be abolished.

verses.name: Isaiah 51:7
verses.text: ¶ Hearken unto me, ye that know righteousness, the people in whose heart <hi type="italic">is</hi> my law; fear ye not the reproach of men, neither be ye afraid of their revilings.

verses.name: Isaiah 51:8
verses.text: For the moth shall eat them up like a garment, and the worm shall eat them like wool: but my righteousness shall be for ever, and my salvation from generation to generation.

verses.name: Isaiah 51:9
verses.text: ¶ Awake, awake, put on strength, O arm of the Lord; awake, as in the ancient days, in the generations of old. <hi type="italic">Art</hi> thou not it that hath cut Rahab, <hi type="italic">and</hi> wounded the dragon?

verses.name: Isaiah 51:10
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Art</hi> thou not it which hath dried the sea, the waters of the great deep; that hath made the depths of the sea a way for the ransomed to pass over?

verses.name: Isaiah 51:11
verses.text: Therefore the redeemed of the Lord shall return, and come with singing unto Zion; and everlasting joy <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> upon their head: they shall obtain gladness and joy; <hi type="italic">and</hi> sorrow and mourning shall flee away.

verses.name: Isaiah 51:12
verses.text: I, <hi type="italic">even</hi> I, <hi type="italic">am</hi> he that comforteth you: who <hi type="italic">art</hi> thou, that thou shouldest be afraid of a man <hi type="italic">that</hi> shall die, and of the son of man <hi type="italic">which</hi> shall be made <hi type="italic">as</hi> grass;

verses.name: Isaiah 51:13
verses.text: And forgettest the Lord thy maker, that hath stretched forth the heavens, and laid the foundations of the earth; and hast feared continually every day because of the fury of the oppressor, as if he were ready to destroy? and where <hi type="italic">is</hi> the fury of the oppressor?

verses.name: Isaiah 51:14
verses.text: The captive exile hasteneth that he may be loosed, and that he should not die in the pit, nor that his bread should fail.

verses.name: Isaiah 51:15
verses.text: But I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord thy God, that divided the sea, whose waves roared: The Lord of hosts <hi type="italic">is</hi> his name.

verses.name: Isaiah 51:16
verses.text: And I have put my words in thy mouth, and I have covered thee in the shadow of mine hand, that I may plant the heavens, and lay the foundations of the earth, and say unto Zion, Thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> my people.

verses.name: Isaiah 51:17
verses.text: ¶ Awake, awake, stand up, O Jerusalem, which hast drunk at the hand of the Lord the cup of his fury; thou hast drunken the dregs of the cup of trembling, <hi type="italic">and</hi> wrung <hi type="italic">them</hi> out.

verses.name: Isaiah 51:18
verses.text: <hi type="italic">There is</hi> none to guide her among all the sons <hi type="italic">whom</hi> she hath brought forth; neither <hi type="italic">is there any</hi> that taketh her by the hand of all the sons <hi type="italic">that</hi> she hath brought up.

verses.name: Isaiah 51:19
verses.text: These two <hi type="italic">things</hi> are come unto thee; who shall be sorry for thee? desolation, and destruction, and the famine, and the sword: by whom shall I comfort thee?

verses.name: Isaiah 51:20
verses.text: Thy sons have fainted, they lie at the head of all the streets, as a wild bull in a net: they are full of the fury of the Lord, the rebuke of thy God.

verses.name: Isaiah 51:21
verses.text: ¶ Therefore hear now this, thou afflicted, and drunken, but not with wine:

verses.name: Isaiah 51:22
verses.text: Thus saith thy Lord the Lord, and thy God <hi type="italic">that</hi> pleadeth the cause of his people, Behold, I have taken out of thine hand the cup of trembling, <hi type="italic">even</hi> the dregs of the cup of my fury; thou shalt no more drink it again:

verses.name: Isaiah 51:23
verses.text: But I will put it into the hand of them that afflict thee; which have said to thy soul, Bow down, that we may go over: and thou hast laid thy body as the ground, and as the street, to them that went over.  <chapter eID="Isa.51"/><div eID="gen797" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 52:1
verses.text: AWAKE, awake; put on thy strength, O Zion; put on thy beautiful garments, O Jerusalem, the holy city: for henceforth there shall no more come into thee the uncircumcised and the unclean.

verses.name: Isaiah 52:2
verses.text: Shake thyself from the dust; arise, <hi type="italic">and</hi> sit down, O Jerusalem: loose thyself from the bands of thy neck, O captive daughter of Zion.

verses.name: Isaiah 52:3
verses.text: For thus saith the Lord, Ye have sold yourselves for nought; and ye shall be redeemed without money.

verses.name: Isaiah 52:4
verses.text: For thus saith the Lord God, My people went down aforetime into Egypt to sojourn there; and the Assyrian oppressed them without cause.

verses.name: Isaiah 52:5
verses.text: Now therefore, what have I here, saith the Lord, that my people is taken away for nought? they that rule over them make them to howl, saith the Lord; and my name continually every day <hi type="italic">is</hi> blasphemed.

verses.name: Isaiah 52:6
verses.text: Therefore my people shall know my name: therefore <hi type="italic">they shall know</hi> in that day that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> he that doth speak: behold, <hi type="italic">it is</hi> I.

verses.name: Isaiah 52:7
verses.text: ¶ How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace; that bringeth good tidings of good, that publisheth salvation; that saith unto Zion, Thy God reigneth!

verses.name: Isaiah 52:8
verses.text: Thy watchmen shall lift up the voice; with the voice together shall they sing: for they shall see eye to eye, when the Lord shall bring again Zion.

verses.name: Isaiah 52:9
verses.text: ¶ Break forth into joy, sing together, ye waste places of Jerusalem: for the Lord hath comforted his people, he hath redeemed Jerusalem.

verses.name: Isaiah 52:10
verses.text: The Lord hath made bare his holy arm in the eyes of all the nations; and all the ends of the earth shall see the salvation of our God.

verses.name: Isaiah 52:11
verses.text: ¶ Depart ye, depart ye, go ye out from thence, touch no unclean <hi type="italic">thing;</hi> go ye out of the midst of her; be ye clean, that bear the vessels of the Lord.

verses.name: Isaiah 52:12
verses.text: For ye shall not go out with haste, nor go by flight: for the Lord will go before you; and the God of Israel <hi type="italic">will be</hi> your rereward.

verses.name: Isaiah 52:13
verses.text: ¶ Behold, my servant shall deal prudently, he shall be exalted and extolled, and be very high.

verses.name: Isaiah 52:14
verses.text: As many were astonied at thee; his visage was so marred more than any man, and his form more than the sons of men:

verses.name: Isaiah 52:15
verses.text: So shall he sprinkle many nations; the kings shall shut their mouths at him: for <hi type="italic">that</hi> which had not been told them shall they see; and <hi type="italic">that</hi> which they had not heard shall they consider.  <chapter eID="Isa.52"/><div eID="gen798" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 53:1
verses.text: WHO hath believed our report? and to whom is the arm of the Lord revealed?

verses.name: Isaiah 53:2
verses.text: For he shall grow up before him as a tender plant, and as a root out of a dry ground: he hath no form nor comeliness; and when we shall see him, <hi type="italic">there is</hi> no beauty that we should desire him.

verses.name: Isaiah 53:3
verses.text: He is despised and rejected of men; a man of sorrows, and acquainted with grief: and we hid as it were <hi type="italic">our</hi> faces from him; he was despised, and we esteemed him not.

verses.name: Isaiah 53:4
verses.text: ¶ Surely he hath borne our griefs, and carried our sorrows: yet we did esteem him stricken, smitten of God, and afflicted.

verses.name: Isaiah 53:5
verses.text: But he <hi type="italic">was</hi> wounded for our transgressions, <hi type="italic">he was</hi> bruised for our iniquities: the chastisement of our peace <hi type="italic">was</hi> upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.

verses.name: Isaiah 53:6
verses.text: All we like sheep have gone astray; we have turned every one to his own way; and the Lord hath laid on him the iniquity of us all.

verses.name: Isaiah 53:7
verses.text: He was oppressed, and he was afflicted, yet he opened not his mouth: he is brought as a lamb to the slaughter, and as a sheep before her shearers is dumb, so he openeth not his mouth.

verses.name: Isaiah 53:8
verses.text: He was taken from prison and from judgment: and who shall declare his generation? for he was cut off out of the land of the living: for the transgression of my people was he stricken.

verses.name: Isaiah 53:9
verses.text: And he made his grave with the wicked, and with the rich in his death; because he had done no violence, neither <hi type="italic">was any</hi> deceit in his mouth.

verses.name: Isaiah 53:10
verses.text: ¶ Yet it pleased the Lord to bruise him; he hath put <hi type="italic">him</hi> to grief: when thou shalt make his soul an offering for sin, he shall see <hi type="italic">his</hi> seed, he shall prolong <hi type="italic">his</hi> days, and the pleasure of the Lord shall prosper in his hand.

verses.name: Isaiah 53:11
verses.text: He shall see of the travail of his soul, <hi type="italic">and</hi> shall be satisfied: by his knowledge shall my righteous servant justify many; for he shall bear their iniquities.

verses.name: Isaiah 53:12
verses.text: Therefore will I divide him <hi type="italic">a portion</hi> with the great, and he shall divide the spoil with the strong; because he hath poured out his soul unto death: and he was numbered with the transgressors; and he bare the sin of many, and made intercession for the transgressors.  <chapter eID="Isa.53"/><div eID="gen799" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 54:1
verses.text: SING, O barren, thou <hi type="italic">that</hi> didst not bear; break forth into singing, and cry aloud, thou <hi type="italic">that</hi> didst not travail with child: for more <hi type="italic">are</hi> the children of the desolate than the children of the married wife, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Isaiah 54:2
verses.text: Enlarge the place of thy tent, and let them stretch forth the curtains of thine habitations: spare not, lengthen thy cords, and strengthen thy stakes;

verses.name: Isaiah 54:3
verses.text: For thou shalt break forth on the right hand and on the left; and thy seed shall inherit the Gentiles, and make the desolate cities to be inhabited.

verses.name: Isaiah 54:4
verses.text: Fear not; for thou shalt not be ashamed: neither be thou confounded; for thou shalt not be put to shame: for thou shalt forget the shame of thy youth, and shalt not remember the reproach of thy widowhood any more.

verses.name: Isaiah 54:5
verses.text: For thy Maker <hi type="italic">is</hi> thine husband; the Lord of hosts <hi type="italic">is</hi> his name; and thy Redeemer the Holy One of Israel; The God of the whole earth shall he be called.

verses.name: Isaiah 54:6
verses.text: For the Lord hath called thee as a woman forsaken and grieved in spirit, and a wife of youth, when thou wast refused, saith thy God.

verses.name: Isaiah 54:7
verses.text: For a small moment have I forsaken thee; but with great mercies will I gather thee.

verses.name: Isaiah 54:8
verses.text: In a little wrath I hid my face from thee for a moment; but with everlasting kindness will I have mercy on thee, saith the Lord thy Redeemer.

verses.name: Isaiah 54:9
verses.text: For this <hi type="italic">is as</hi> the waters of Noah unto me: for <hi type="italic">as</hi> I have sworn that the waters of Noah should no more go over the earth; so have I sworn that I would not be wroth with thee, nor rebuke thee.

verses.name: Isaiah 54:10
verses.text: For the mountains shall depart, and the hills be removed; but my kindness shall not depart from thee, neither shall the covenant of my peace be removed, saith the Lord that hath mercy on thee.

verses.name: Isaiah 54:11
verses.text: ¶ O thou afflicted, tossed with tempest, <hi type="italic">and</hi> not comforted, behold, I will lay thy stones with fair colours, and lay thy foundations with sapphires.

verses.name: Isaiah 54:12
verses.text: And I will make thy windows of agates, and thy gates of carbuncles, and all thy borders of pleasant stones.

verses.name: Isaiah 54:13
verses.text: And all thy children <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> taught of the Lord; and great <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> the peace of thy children.

verses.name: Isaiah 54:14
verses.text: In righteousness shalt thou be established: thou shalt be far from oppression; for thou shalt not fear: and from terror; for it shall not come near thee.

verses.name: Isaiah 54:15
verses.text: Behold, they shall surely gather together, <hi type="italic">but</hi> not by me: whosoever shall gather together against thee shall fall for thy sake.

verses.name: Isaiah 54:16
verses.text: Behold, I have created the smith that bloweth the coals in the fire, and that bringeth forth an instrument for his work; and I have created the waster to destroy.

verses.name: Isaiah 54:17
verses.text: ¶ No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper; and every tongue <hi type="italic">that</hi> shall rise against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn. This <hi type="italic">is</hi> the heritage of the servants of the Lord, and their righteousness <hi type="italic">is</hi> of me, saith the Lord.  <chapter eID="Isa.54"/><div eID="gen800" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 55:1
verses.text: HO, every one that thirsteth, come ye to the waters, and he that hath no money; come ye, buy, and eat; yea, come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.

verses.name: Isaiah 55:2
verses.text: Wherefore do ye spend money for <hi type="italic">that which is</hi> not bread? and your labour for <hi type="italic">that which</hi> satisfieth not? hearken diligently unto me, and eat ye <hi type="italic">that which is</hi> good, and let your soul delight itself in fatness.

verses.name: Isaiah 55:3
verses.text: Incline your ear, and come unto me: hear, and your soul shall live; and I will make an everlasting covenant with you, <hi type="italic">even</hi> the sure mercies of David.

verses.name: Isaiah 55:4
verses.text: Behold, I have given him <hi type="italic">for</hi> a witness to the people, a leader and commander to the people.

verses.name: Isaiah 55:5
verses.text: Behold, thou shalt call a nation <hi type="italic">that</hi> thou knowest not, and nations <hi type="italic">that</hi> knew not thee shall run unto thee because of the Lord thy God, and for the Holy One of Israel; for he hath glorified thee.

verses.name: Isaiah 55:6
verses.text: ¶ Seek ye the Lord while he may be found, call ye upon him while he is near:

verses.name: Isaiah 55:7
verses.text: Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts: and let him return unto the Lord, and he will have mercy upon him; and to our God, for he will abundantly pardon.

verses.name: Isaiah 55:8
verses.text: ¶ For my thoughts <hi type="italic">are</hi> not your thoughts, neither <hi type="italic">are</hi> your ways my ways, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Isaiah 55:9
verses.text: For <hi type="italic">as</hi> the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.

verses.name: Isaiah 55:10
verses.text: For as the rain cometh down, and the snow from heaven, and returneth not thither, but watereth the earth, and maketh it bring forth and bud, that it may give seed to the sower, and bread to the eater:

verses.name: Isaiah 55:11
verses.text: So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth: it shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please, and it shall prosper <hi type="italic">in the thing</hi> whereto I sent it.

verses.name: Isaiah 55:12
verses.text: For ye shall go out with joy, and be led forth with peace: the mountains and the hills shall break forth before you into singing, and all the trees of the field shall clap <hi type="italic">their</hi> hands.

verses.name: Isaiah 55:13
verses.text: Instead of the thorn shall come up the fir tree, and instead of the brier shall come up the myrtle tree: and it shall be to the Lord for a name, for an everlasting sign <hi type="italic">that</hi> shall not be cut off.  <chapter eID="Isa.55"/><div eID="gen801" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 56:1
verses.text: THUS saith the Lord, Keep ye judgment, and do justice: for my salvation <hi type="italic">is</hi> near to come, and my righteousness to be revealed.

verses.name: Isaiah 56:2
verses.text: Blessed <hi type="italic">is</hi> the man <hi type="italic">that</hi> doeth this, and the son of man <hi type="italic">that</hi> layeth hold on it; that keepeth the sabbath from polluting it, and keepeth his hand from doing any evil.

verses.name: Isaiah 56:3
verses.text: ¶ Neither let the son of the stranger, that hath joined himself to the Lord, speak, saying, The Lord hath utterly separated me from his people: neither let the eunuch say, Behold, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> a dry tree.

verses.name: Isaiah 56:4
verses.text: For thus saith the Lord unto the eunuchs that keep my sabbaths, and choose <hi type="italic">the things</hi> that please me, and take hold of my covenant;

verses.name: Isaiah 56:5
verses.text: Even unto them will I give in mine house and within my walls a place and a name better than of sons and of daughters: I will give them an everlasting name, that shall not be cut off.

verses.name: Isaiah 56:6
verses.text: Also the sons of the stranger, that join themselves to the Lord, to serve him, and to love the name of the Lord, to be his servants, every one that keepeth the sabbath from polluting it, and taketh hold of my covenant;

verses.name: Isaiah 56:7
verses.text: Even them will I bring to my holy mountain, and make them joyful in my house of prayer: their burnt offerings and their sacrifices <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> accepted upon mine altar; for mine house shall be called an house of prayer for all people.

verses.name: Isaiah 56:8
verses.text: The Lord God which gathereth the outcasts of Israel saith, Yet will I gather <hi type="italic">others</hi> to him, beside those that are gathered unto him.

verses.name: Isaiah 56:9
verses.text: ¶ All ye beasts of the field, come to devour, <hi type="italic">yea</hi>, all ye beasts in the forest.

verses.name: Isaiah 56:10
verses.text: His watchmen <hi type="italic">are</hi> blind: they are all ignorant, they <hi type="italic">are</hi> all dumb dogs, they cannot bark; sleeping, lying down, loving to slumber.

verses.name: Isaiah 56:11
verses.text: Yea, <hi type="italic">they are</hi> greedy dogs <hi type="italic">which</hi> can never have enough, and they <hi type="italic">are</hi> shepherds <hi type="italic">that</hi> cannot understand: they all look to their own way, every one for his gain, from his quarter.

verses.name: Isaiah 56:12
verses.text: Come ye, <hi type="italic">say they</hi>, I will fetch wine, and we will fill ourselves with strong drink; and to morrow shall be as this day, <hi type="italic">and</hi> much more abundant.  <chapter eID="Isa.56"/><div eID="gen802" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 57:1
verses.text: THE righteous perisheth, and no man layeth <hi type="italic">it</hi> to heart: and merciful men <hi type="italic">are</hi> taken away, none considering that the righteous is taken away from the evil <hi type="italic">to come</hi>.

verses.name: Isaiah 57:2
verses.text: He shall enter into peace: they shall rest in their beds, <hi type="italic">each one</hi> walking <hi type="italic">in</hi> his uprightness.

verses.name: Isaiah 57:3
verses.text: ¶ But draw near hither, ye sons of the sorceress, the seed of the adulterer and the whore.

verses.name: Isaiah 57:4
verses.text: Against whom do ye sport yourselves? against whom make ye a wide mouth, <hi type="italic">and</hi> draw out the tongue? <hi type="italic">are</hi> ye not children of transgression, a seed of falsehood,

verses.name: Isaiah 57:5
verses.text: Enflaming yourselves with idols under every green tree, slaying the children in the valleys under the clifts of the rocks?

verses.name: Isaiah 57:6
verses.text: Among the smooth <hi type="italic">stones</hi> of the stream <hi type="italic">is</hi> thy portion; they, they <hi type="italic">are</hi> thy lot: even to them hast thou poured a drink offering, thou hast offered a meat offering. Should I receive comfort in these?

verses.name: Isaiah 57:7
verses.text: Upon a lofty and high mountain hast thou set thy bed: even thither wentest thou up to offer sacrifice.

verses.name: Isaiah 57:8
verses.text: Behind the doors also and the posts hast thou set up thy remembrance: for thou hast discovered <hi type="italic">thyself to another</hi> than me, and art gone up; thou hast enlarged thy bed, and made thee <hi type="italic">a covenant</hi> with them; thou lovedst their bed where thou sawest <hi type="italic">it</hi>.

verses.name: Isaiah 57:9
verses.text: And thou wentest to the king with ointment, and didst increase thy perfumes, and didst send thy messengers far off, and didst debase <hi type="italic">thyself even</hi> unto hell.

verses.name: Isaiah 57:10
verses.text: Thou art wearied in the greatness of thy way; <hi type="italic">yet</hi> saidst thou not, There is no hope: thou hast found the life of thine hand; therefore thou wast not grieved.

verses.name: Isaiah 57:11
verses.text: And of whom hast thou been afraid or feared, that thou hast lied, and hast not remembered me, nor laid <hi type="italic">it</hi> to thy heart? have not I held my peace even of old, and thou fearest me not?

verses.name: Isaiah 57:12
verses.text: I will declare thy righteousness, and thy works; for they shall not profit thee.

verses.name: Isaiah 57:13
verses.text: ¶ When thou criest, let thy companies deliver thee; but the wind shall carry them all away; vanity shall take <hi type="italic">them:</hi> but he that putteth his trust in me shall possess the land, and shall inherit my holy mountain;

verses.name: Isaiah 57:14
verses.text: And shall say, Cast ye up, cast ye up, prepare the way, take up the stumblingblock out of the way of my people.

verses.name: Isaiah 57:15
verses.text: For thus saith the high and lofty One that inhabiteth eternity, whose name <hi type="italic">is</hi> Holy; I dwell in the high and holy <hi type="italic">place</hi>, with him also <hi type="italic">that is</hi> of a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite ones.

verses.name: Isaiah 57:16
verses.text: For I will not contend for ever, neither will I be always wroth: for the spirit should fail before me, and the souls <hi type="italic">which</hi> I have made.

verses.name: Isaiah 57:17
verses.text: For the iniquity of his covetousness was I wroth, and smote him: I hid me, and was wroth, and he went on frowardly in the way of his heart.

verses.name: Isaiah 57:18
verses.text: I have seen his ways, and will heal him: I will lead him also, and restore comforts unto him and to his mourners.

verses.name: Isaiah 57:19
verses.text: I create the fruit of the lips; Peace, peace to <hi type="italic">him that is</hi> far off, and to <hi type="italic">him that is</hi> near, saith the Lord; and I will heal him.

verses.name: Isaiah 57:20
verses.text: But the wicked <hi type="italic">are</hi> like the troubled sea, when it cannot rest, whose waters cast up mire and dirt.

verses.name: Isaiah 57:21
verses.text: <hi type="italic">There is</hi> no peace, saith my God, to the wicked.  <chapter eID="Isa.57"/><div eID="gen803" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 58:1
verses.text: CRY aloud, spare not, lift up thy voice like a trumpet, and shew my people their transgression, and the house of Jacob their sins.

verses.name: Isaiah 58:2
verses.text: Yet they seek me daily, and delight to know my ways, as a nation that did righteousness, and forsook not the ordinance of their God: they ask of me the ordinances of justice; they take delight in approaching to God.

verses.name: Isaiah 58:3
verses.text: ¶ Wherefore have we fasted, <hi type="italic">say they</hi>, and thou seest not? <hi type="italic">wherefore</hi> have we afflicted our soul, and thou takest no knowledge? Behold, in the day of your fast ye find pleasure, and exact all your labours.

verses.name: Isaiah 58:4
verses.text: Behold, ye fast for strife and debate, and to smite with the fist of wickedness: ye shall not fast as <hi type="italic">ye do this</hi> day, to make your voice to be heard on high.

verses.name: Isaiah 58:5
verses.text: Is it such a fast that I have chosen? a day for a man to afflict his soul? <hi type="italic">is it</hi> to bow down his head as a bulrush, and to spread sackcloth and ashes <hi type="italic">under him?</hi> wilt thou call this a fast, and an acceptable day to the Lord?

verses.name: Isaiah 58:6
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Is</hi> not this the fast that I have chosen? to loose the bands of wickedness, to undo the heavy burdens, and to let the oppressed go free, and that ye break every yoke?

verses.name: Isaiah 58:7
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Is it</hi> not to deal thy bread to the hungry, and that thou bring the poor that are cast out to thy house? when thou seest the naked, that thou cover him; and that thou hide not thyself from thine own flesh?

verses.name: Isaiah 58:8
verses.text: ¶ Then shall thy light break forth as the morning, and thine health shall spring forth speedily: and thy righteousness shall go before thee; the glory of the Lord shall be thy rereward.

verses.name: Isaiah 58:9
verses.text: Then shalt thou call, and the Lord shall answer; thou shalt cry, and he shall say, Here I <hi type="italic">am</hi>. If thou take away from the midst of thee the yoke, the putting forth of the finger, and speaking vanity;

verses.name: Isaiah 58:10
verses.text: And <hi type="italic">if</hi> thou draw out thy soul to the hungry, and satisfy the afflicted soul; then shall thy light rise in obscurity, and thy darkness <hi type="italic">be</hi> as the noonday:

verses.name: Isaiah 58:11
verses.text: And the Lord shall guide thee continually, and satisfy thy soul in drought, and make fat thy bones: and thou shalt be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water, whose waters fail not.

verses.name: Isaiah 58:12
verses.text: And <hi type="italic">they that shall be</hi> of thee shall build the old waste places: thou shalt raise up the foundations of many generations; and thou shalt be called, The repairer of the breach, The restorer of paths to dwell in.

verses.name: Isaiah 58:13
verses.text: ¶ If thou turn away thy foot from the sabbath, <hi type="italic">from</hi> doing thy pleasure on my holy day; and call the sabbath a delight, the holy of the Lord, honourable; and shalt honour him, not doing thine own ways, nor finding thine own pleasure, nor speaking <hi type="italic">thine own</hi> words:

verses.name: Isaiah 58:14
verses.text: Then shalt thou delight thyself in the Lord; and I will cause thee to ride upon the high places of the earth, and feed thee with the heritage of Jacob thy father: for the mouth of the Lord hath spoken <hi type="italic">it</hi>.  <chapter eID="Isa.58"/><div eID="gen804" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 59:1
verses.text: BEHOLD, the Lord’s hand is not shortened, that it cannot save; neither his ear heavy, that it cannot hear:

verses.name: Isaiah 59:2
verses.text: But your iniquities have separated between you and your God, and your sins have hid <hi type="italic">his</hi> face from you, that he will not hear.

verses.name: Isaiah 59:3
verses.text: For your hands are defiled with blood, and your fingers with iniquity; your lips have spoken lies, your tongue hath muttered perverseness.

verses.name: Isaiah 59:4
verses.text: None calleth for justice, nor <hi type="italic">any</hi> pleadeth for truth: they trust in vanity, and speak lies; they conceive mischief, and bring forth iniquity.

verses.name: Isaiah 59:5
verses.text: They hatch cockatrice’ eggs, and weave the spider’s web: he that eateth of their eggs dieth, and that which is crushed breaketh out into a viper.

verses.name: Isaiah 59:6
verses.text: Their webs shall not become garments, neither shall they cover themselves with their works: their works <hi type="italic">are</hi> works of iniquity, and the act of violence <hi type="italic">is</hi> in their hands.

verses.name: Isaiah 59:7
verses.text: Their feet run to evil, and they make haste to shed innocent blood: their thoughts <hi type="italic">are</hi> thoughts of iniquity; wasting and destruction <hi type="italic">are</hi> in their paths.

verses.name: Isaiah 59:8
verses.text: The way of peace they know not; and <hi type="italic">there is</hi> no judgment in their goings: they have made them crooked paths: whosoever goeth therein shall not know peace.

verses.name: Isaiah 59:9
verses.text: ¶ Therefore is judgment far from us, neither doth justice overtake us: we wait for light, but behold obscurity; for brightness, <hi type="italic">but</hi> we walk in darkness.

verses.name: Isaiah 59:10
verses.text: We grope for the wall like the blind, and we grope as if <hi type="italic">we had</hi> no eyes: we stumble at noonday as in the night; <hi type="italic">we are</hi> in desolate places as dead <hi type="italic">men</hi>.

verses.name: Isaiah 59:11
verses.text: We roar all like bears, and mourn sore like doves: we look for judgment, but <hi type="italic">there is</hi> none; for salvation, <hi type="italic">but</hi> it is far off from us.

verses.name: Isaiah 59:12
verses.text: For our transgressions are multiplied before thee, and our sins testify against us: for our transgressions <hi type="italic">are</hi> with us; and <hi type="italic">as for</hi> our iniquities, we know them;

verses.name: Isaiah 59:13
verses.text: In transgressing and lying against the Lord, and departing away from our God, speaking oppression and revolt, conceiving and uttering from the heart words of falsehood.

verses.name: Isaiah 59:14
verses.text: And judgment is turned away backward, and justice standeth afar off: for truth is fallen in the street, and equity cannot enter.

verses.name: Isaiah 59:15
verses.text: Yea, truth faileth; and he <hi type="italic">that</hi> departeth from evil maketh himself a prey: and the Lord saw <hi type="italic">it</hi>, and it displeased him that <hi type="italic">there was</hi> no judgment.

verses.name: Isaiah 59:16
verses.text: ¶ And he saw that <hi type="italic">there was</hi> no man, and wondered that <hi type="italic">there was</hi> no intercessor: therefore his arm brought salvation unto him; and his righteousness, it sustained him.

verses.name: Isaiah 59:17
verses.text: For he put on righteousness as a breastplate, and an helmet of salvation upon his head; and he put on the garments of vengeance <hi type="italic">for</hi> clothing, and was clad with zeal as a cloke.

verses.name: Isaiah 59:18
verses.text: According to <hi type="italic">their</hi> deeds, accordingly he will repay, fury to his adversaries, recompence to his enemies; to the islands he will repay recompence.

verses.name: Isaiah 59:19
verses.text: So shall they fear the name of the Lord from the west, and his glory from the rising of the sun. When the enemy shall come in like a flood, the Spirit of the Lord shall lift up a standard against him.

verses.name: Isaiah 59:20
verses.text: ¶ And the Redeemer shall come to Zion, and unto them that turn from transgression in Jacob, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Isaiah 59:21
verses.text: As for me, this <hi type="italic">is</hi> my covenant with them, saith the Lord; My spirit that <hi type="italic">is</hi> upon thee, and my words which I have put in thy mouth, shall not depart out of thy mouth, nor out of the mouth of thy seed, nor out of the mouth of thy seed’s seed, saith the Lord, from henceforth and for ever.  <chapter eID="Isa.59"/><div eID="gen805" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 60:1
verses.text: ARISE, shine; for thy light is come, and the glory of the Lord is risen upon thee.

verses.name: Isaiah 60:2
verses.text: For, behold, the darkness shall cover the earth, and gross darkness the people: but the Lord shall arise upon thee, and his glory shall be seen upon thee.

verses.name: Isaiah 60:3
verses.text: And the Gentiles shall come to thy light, and kings to the brightness of thy rising.

verses.name: Isaiah 60:4
verses.text: Lift up thine eyes round about, and see: all they gather themselves together, they come to thee: thy sons shall come from far, and thy daughters shall be nursed at <hi type="italic">thy</hi> side.

verses.name: Isaiah 60:5
verses.text: Then thou shalt see, and flow together, and thine heart shall fear, and be enlarged; because the abundance of the sea shall be converted unto thee, the forces of the Gentiles shall come unto thee.

verses.name: Isaiah 60:6
