verses.text: The multitude of camels shall cover thee, the dromedaries of Midian and Ephah; all they from Sheba shall come: they shall bring gold and incense; and they shall shew forth the praises of the Lord.

verses.name: Isaiah 60:7
verses.text: All the flocks of Kedar shall be gathered together unto thee, the rams of Nebaioth shall minister unto thee: they shall come up with acceptance on mine altar, and I will glorify the house of my glory.

verses.name: Isaiah 60:8
verses.text: Who <hi type="italic">are</hi> these <hi type="italic">that</hi> fly as a cloud, and as the doves to their windows?

verses.name: Isaiah 60:9
verses.text: Surely the isles shall wait for me, and the ships of Tarshish first, to bring thy sons from far, their silver and their gold with them, unto the name of the Lord thy God, and to the Holy One of Israel, because he hath glorified thee.

verses.name: Isaiah 60:10
verses.text: And the sons of strangers shall build up thy walls, and their kings shall minister unto thee: for in my wrath I smote thee, but in my favour have I had mercy on thee.

verses.name: Isaiah 60:11
verses.text: Therefore thy gates shall be open continually; they shall not be shut day nor night; that <hi type="italic">men</hi> may bring unto thee the forces of the Gentiles, and <hi type="italic">that</hi> their kings <hi type="italic">may be</hi> brought.

verses.name: Isaiah 60:12
verses.text: For the nation and kingdom that will not serve thee shall perish; yea, <hi type="italic">those</hi> nations shall be utterly wasted.

verses.name: Isaiah 60:13
verses.text: The glory of Lebanon shall come unto thee, the fir tree, the pine tree, and the box together, to beautify the place of my sanctuary; and I will make the place of my feet glorious.

verses.name: Isaiah 60:14
verses.text: The sons also of them that afflicted thee shall come bending unto thee; and all they that despised thee shall bow themselves down at the soles of thy feet; and they shall call thee, The city of the Lord, The Zion of the Holy One of Israel.

verses.name: Isaiah 60:15
verses.text: Whereas thou hast been forsaken and hated, so that no man went through <hi type="italic">thee</hi>, I will make thee an eternal excellency, a joy of many generations.

verses.name: Isaiah 60:16
verses.text: Thou shalt also suck the milk of the Gentiles, and shalt suck the breast of kings: and thou shalt know that I the Lord <hi type="italic">am</hi> thy Saviour and thy Redeemer, the mighty One of Jacob.

verses.name: Isaiah 60:17
verses.text: For brass I will bring gold, and for iron I will bring silver, and for wood brass, and for stones iron: I will also make thy officers peace, and thine exactors righteousness.

verses.name: Isaiah 60:18
verses.text: Violence shall no more be heard in thy land, wasting nor destruction within thy borders; but thou shalt call thy walls Salvation, and thy gates Praise.

verses.name: Isaiah 60:19
verses.text: The sun shall be no more thy light by day; neither for brightness shall the moon give light unto thee: but the Lord shall be unto thee an everlasting light, and thy God thy glory.

verses.name: Isaiah 60:20
verses.text: Thy sun shall no more go down; neither shall thy moon withdraw itself: for the Lord shall be thine everlasting light, and the days of thy mourning shall be ended.

verses.name: Isaiah 60:21
verses.text: Thy people also <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> all righteous: they shall inherit the land for ever, the branch of my planting, the work of my hands, that I may be glorified.

verses.name: Isaiah 60:22
verses.text: A little one shall become a thousand, and a small one a strong nation: I the Lord will hasten it in his time.  <chapter eID="Isa.60"/><div eID="gen806" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 61:1
verses.text: THE Spirit of the Lord God <hi type="italic">is</hi> upon me; because the Lord hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek; he hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to <hi type="italic">them that are</hi> bound;

verses.name: Isaiah 61:2
verses.text: To proclaim the acceptable year of the Lord, and the day of vengeance of our God; to comfort all that mourn;

verses.name: Isaiah 61:3
verses.text: To appoint unto them that mourn in Zion, to give unto them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness; that they might be called trees of righteousness, the planting of the Lord, that he might be glorified.

verses.name: Isaiah 61:4
verses.text: ¶ And they shall build the old wastes, they shall raise up the former desolations, and they shall repair the waste cities, the desolations of many generations.

verses.name: Isaiah 61:5
verses.text: And strangers shall stand and feed your flocks, and the sons of the alien <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> your plowmen and your vinedressers.

verses.name: Isaiah 61:6
verses.text: But ye shall be named the Priests of the Lord: <hi type="italic">men</hi> shall call you the Ministers of our God: ye shall eat the riches of the Gentiles, and in their glory shall ye boast yourselves.

verses.name: Isaiah 61:7
verses.text: ¶ For your shame <hi type="italic">ye shall have</hi> double; and <hi type="italic">for</hi> confusion they shall rejoice in their portion: therefore in their land they shall possess the double: everlasting joy shall be unto them.

verses.name: Isaiah 61:8
verses.text: For I the Lord love judgment, I hate robbery for burnt offering; and I will direct their work in truth, and I will make an everlasting covenant with them.

verses.name: Isaiah 61:9
verses.text: And their seed shall be known among the Gentiles, and their offspring among the people: all that see them shall acknowledge them, that they <hi type="italic">are</hi> the seed <hi type="italic">which</hi> the Lord hath blessed.

verses.name: Isaiah 61:10
verses.text: I will greatly rejoice in the Lord, my soul shall be joyful in my God; for he hath clothed me with the garments of salvation, he hath covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decketh <hi type="italic">himself</hi> with ornaments, and as a bride adorneth <hi type="italic">herself</hi> with her jewels.

verses.name: Isaiah 61:11
verses.text: For as the earth bringeth forth her bud, and as the garden causeth the things that are sown in it to spring forth; so the Lord God will cause righteousness and praise to spring forth before all the nations.  <chapter eID="Isa.61"/><div eID="gen807" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 62:1
verses.text: FOR Zion’s sake will I not hold my peace, and for Jerusalem’s sake I will not rest, until the righteousness thereof go forth as brightness, and the salvation thereof as a lamp <hi type="italic">that</hi> burneth.

verses.name: Isaiah 62:2
verses.text: And the Gentiles shall see thy righteousness, and all kings thy glory: and thou shalt be called by a new name, which the mouth of the Lord shall name.

verses.name: Isaiah 62:3
verses.text: Thou shalt also be a crown of glory in the hand of the Lord, and a royal diadem in the hand of thy God.

verses.name: Isaiah 62:4
verses.text: Thou shalt no more be termed Forsaken; neither shall thy land any more be termed Desolate: but thou shalt be called Hephzi-bah, and thy land Beulah: for the Lord delighteth in thee, and thy land shall be married.

verses.name: Isaiah 62:5
verses.text: ¶ For <hi type="italic">as</hi> a young man marrieth a virgin, <hi type="italic">so</hi> shall thy sons marry thee: and <hi type="italic">as</hi> the bridegroom rejoiceth over the bride, <hi type="italic">so</hi> shall thy God rejoice over thee.

verses.name: Isaiah 62:6
verses.text: I have set watchmen upon thy walls, O Jerusalem, <hi type="italic">which</hi> shall never hold their peace day nor night: ye that make mention of the Lord, keep not silence,

verses.name: Isaiah 62:7
verses.text: And give him no rest, till he establish, and till he make Jerusalem a praise in the earth.

verses.name: Isaiah 62:8
verses.text: The Lord hath sworn by his right hand, and by the arm of his strength, Surely I will no more give thy corn <hi type="italic">to be</hi> meat for thine enemies; and the sons of the stranger shall not drink thy wine, for the which thou hast laboured:

verses.name: Isaiah 62:9
verses.text: But they that have gathered it shall eat it, and praise the Lord; and they that have brought it together shall drink it in the courts of my holiness.

verses.name: Isaiah 62:10
verses.text: ¶ Go through, go through the gates; prepare ye the way of the people; cast up, cast up the highway; gather out the stones; lift up a standard for the people.

verses.name: Isaiah 62:11
verses.text: Behold, the Lord hath proclaimed unto the end of the world, Say ye to the daughter of Zion, Behold, thy salvation cometh; behold, his reward <hi type="italic">is</hi> with him, and his work before him.

verses.name: Isaiah 62:12
verses.text: And they shall call them, The holy people, The redeemed of the Lord: and thou shalt be called, Sought out, A city not forsaken.  <chapter eID="Isa.62"/><div eID="gen808" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 63:1
verses.text: WHO <hi type="italic">is</hi> this that cometh from Edom, with dyed garments from Bozrah? this <hi type="italic">that is</hi> glorious in his apparel, travelling in the greatness of his strength? I that speak in righteousness, mighty to save.

verses.name: Isaiah 63:2
verses.text: Wherefore <hi type="italic">art thou</hi> red in thine apparel, and thy garments like him that treadeth in the winefat?

verses.name: Isaiah 63:3
verses.text: I have trodden the winepress alone; and of the people <hi type="italic">there was</hi> none with me: for I will tread them in mine anger, and trample them in my fury; and their blood shall be sprinkled upon my garments, and I will stain all my raiment.

verses.name: Isaiah 63:4
verses.text: For the day of vengeance <hi type="italic">is</hi> in mine heart, and the year of my redeemed is come.

verses.name: Isaiah 63:5
verses.text: And I looked, and <hi type="italic">there was</hi> none to help; and I wondered that <hi type="italic">there was</hi> none to uphold: therefore mine own arm brought salvation unto me; and my fury, it upheld me.

verses.name: Isaiah 63:6
verses.text: And I will tread down the people in mine anger, and make them drunk in my fury, and I will bring down their strength to the earth.

verses.name: Isaiah 63:7
verses.text: ¶ I will mention the lovingkindnesses of the Lord, <hi type="italic">and</hi> the praises of the Lord, according to all that the Lord hath bestowed on us, and the great goodness toward the house of Israel, which he hath bestowed on them according to his mercies, and according to the multitude of his lovingkindnesses.

verses.name: Isaiah 63:8
verses.text: For he said, Surely they <hi type="italic">are</hi> my people, children <hi type="italic">that</hi> will not lie: so he was their Saviour.

verses.name: Isaiah 63:9
verses.text: In all their affliction he was afflicted, and the angel of his presence saved them: in his love and in his pity he redeemed them; and he bare them, and carried them all the days of old.

verses.name: Isaiah 63:10
verses.text: ¶ But they rebelled, and vexed his holy Spirit: therefore he was turned to be their enemy, <hi type="italic">and</hi> he fought against them.

verses.name: Isaiah 63:11
verses.text: Then he remembered the days of old, Moses, <hi type="italic">and</hi> his people, <hi type="italic">saying</hi>, Where <hi type="italic">is</hi> he that brought them up out of the sea with the shepherd of his flock? where <hi type="italic">is</hi> he that put his holy Spirit within him?

verses.name: Isaiah 63:12
verses.text: That led <hi type="italic">them</hi> by the right hand of Moses with his glorious arm, dividing the water before them, to make himself an everlasting name?

verses.name: Isaiah 63:13
verses.text: That led them through the deep, as an horse in the wilderness, <hi type="italic">that</hi> they should not stumble?

verses.name: Isaiah 63:14
verses.text: As a beast goeth down into the valley, the Spirit of the Lord caused him to rest: so didst thou lead thy people, to make thyself a glorious name.

verses.name: Isaiah 63:15
verses.text: ¶ Look down from heaven, and behold from the habitation of thy holiness and of thy glory: where <hi type="italic">is</hi> thy zeal and thy strength, the sounding of thy bowels and of thy mercies toward me? are they restrained?

verses.name: Isaiah 63:16
verses.text: Doubtless thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> our father, though Abraham be ignorant of us, and Israel acknowledge us not: thou, O Lord, <hi type="italic">art</hi> our father, our redeemer; thy name <hi type="italic">is</hi> from everlasting.

verses.name: Isaiah 63:17
verses.text: ¶ O Lord, why hast thou made us to err from thy ways, <hi type="italic">and</hi> hardened our heart from thy fear? Return for thy servants’ sake, the tribes of thine inheritance.

verses.name: Isaiah 63:18
verses.text: The people of thy holiness have possessed <hi type="italic">it</hi> but a little while: our adversaries have trodden down thy sanctuary.

verses.name: Isaiah 63:19
verses.text: We are <hi type="italic">thine:</hi> thou never barest rule over them; they were not called by thy name.  <chapter eID="Isa.63"/><div eID="gen809" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 64:1
verses.text: OH that thou wouldest rend the heavens, that thou wouldest come down, that the mountains might flow down at thy presence,

verses.name: Isaiah 64:2
verses.text: As <hi type="italic">when</hi> the melting fire burneth, the fire causeth the waters to boil, to make thy name known to thine adversaries, <hi type="italic">that</hi> the nations may tremble at thy presence!

verses.name: Isaiah 64:3
verses.text: When thou didst terrible things <hi type="italic">which</hi> we looked not for, thou camest down, the mountains flowed down at thy presence.

verses.name: Isaiah 64:4
verses.text: For since the beginning of the world <hi type="italic">men</hi> have not heard, nor perceived by the ear, neither hath the eye seen, O God, beside thee, <hi type="italic">what</hi> he hath prepared for him that waiteth for him.

verses.name: Isaiah 64:5
verses.text: Thou meetest him that rejoiceth and worketh righteousness, <hi type="italic">those that</hi> remember thee in thy ways: behold, thou art wroth; for we have sinned: in those is continuance, and we shall be saved.

verses.name: Isaiah 64:6
verses.text: But we are all as an unclean <hi type="italic">thing</hi>, and all our righteousnesses <hi type="italic">are</hi> as filthy rags; and we all do fade as a leaf; and our iniquities, like the wind, have taken us away.

verses.name: Isaiah 64:7
verses.text: And <hi type="italic">there is</hi> none that calleth upon thy name, that stirreth up himself to take hold of thee: for thou hast hid thy face from us, and hast consumed us, because of our iniquities.

verses.name: Isaiah 64:8
verses.text: But now, O Lord, thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> our father; we <hi type="italic">are</hi> the clay, and thou our potter; and we all <hi type="italic">are</hi> the work of thy hand.

verses.name: Isaiah 64:9
verses.text: ¶ Be not wroth very sore, O Lord, neither remember iniquity for ever: behold, see, we beseech thee, we <hi type="italic">are</hi> all thy people.

verses.name: Isaiah 64:10
verses.text: Thy holy cities are a wilderness, Zion is a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation.

verses.name: Isaiah 64:11
verses.text: Our holy and our beautiful house, where our fathers praised thee, is burned up with fire: and all our pleasant things are laid waste.

verses.name: Isaiah 64:12
verses.text: Wilt thou refrain thyself for these <hi type="italic">things</hi>, O Lord? wilt thou hold thy peace, and afflict us very sore?  <chapter eID="Isa.64"/><div eID="gen810" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:1
verses.text: I AM sought of <hi type="italic">them that</hi> asked not <hi type="italic">for me;</hi> I am found of <hi type="italic">them that</hi> sought me not: I said, Behold me, behold me, unto a nation <hi type="italic">that</hi> was not called by my name.

verses.name: Isaiah 65:2
verses.text: I have spread out my hands all the day unto a rebellious people, which walketh in a way <hi type="italic">that was</hi> not good, after their own thoughts;

verses.name: Isaiah 65:3
verses.text: A people that provoketh me to anger continually to my face; that sacrificeth in gardens, and burneth incense upon altars of brick;

verses.name: Isaiah 65:4
verses.text: Which remain among the graves, and lodge in the monuments, which eat swine’s flesh, and broth of abominable <hi type="italic">things is in</hi> their vessels;

verses.name: Isaiah 65:5
verses.text: Which say, Stand by thyself, come not near to me; for I am holier than thou. These <hi type="italic">are</hi> a smoke in my nose, a fire that burneth all the day.

verses.name: Isaiah 65:6
verses.text: Behold, <hi type="italic">it is</hi> written before me: I will not keep silence, but will recompense, even recompense into their bosom,

verses.name: Isaiah 65:7
verses.text: Your iniquities, and the iniquities of your fathers together, saith the Lord, which have burned incense upon the mountains, and blasphemed me upon the hills: therefore will I measure their former work into their bosom.

verses.name: Isaiah 65:8
verses.text: ¶ Thus saith the Lord, As the new wine is found in the cluster, and <hi type="italic">one</hi> saith, Destroy it not; for a blessing <hi type="italic">is</hi> in it: so will I do for my servants’ sakes, that I may not destroy them all.

verses.name: Isaiah 65:9
verses.text: And I will bring forth a seed out of Jacob, and out of Judah an inheritor of my mountains: and mine elect shall inherit it, and my servants shall dwell there.

verses.name: Isaiah 65:10
verses.text: And Sharon shall be a fold of flocks, and the valley of Achor a place for the herds to lie down in, for my people that have sought me.

verses.name: Isaiah 65:11
verses.text: ¶ But ye <hi type="italic">are</hi> they that forsake the Lord, that forget my holy mountain, that prepare a table for that troop, and that furnish the drink offering unto that number.

verses.name: Isaiah 65:12
verses.text: Therefore will I number you to the sword, and ye shall all bow down to the slaughter: because when I called, ye did not answer; when I spake, ye did not hear; but did evil before mine eyes, and did choose <hi type="italic">that</hi> wherein I delighted not.

verses.name: Isaiah 65:13
verses.text: Therefore thus saith the Lord God, Behold, my servants shall eat, but ye shall be hungry: behold, my servants shall drink, but ye shall be thirsty: behold, my servants shall rejoice, but ye shall be ashamed:

verses.name: Isaiah 65:14
verses.text: Behold, my servants shall sing for joy of heart, but ye shall cry for sorrow of heart, and shall howl for vexation of spirit.

verses.name: Isaiah 65:15
verses.text: And ye shall leave your name for a curse unto my chosen: for the Lord God shall slay thee, and call his servants by another name:

verses.name: Isaiah 65:16
verses.text: That he who blesseth himself in the earth shall bless himself in the God of truth; and he that sweareth in the earth shall swear by the God of truth; because the former troubles are forgotten, and because they are hid from mine eyes.

verses.name: Isaiah 65:17
verses.text: ¶ For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth: and the former shall not be remembered, nor come into mind.

verses.name: Isaiah 65:18
verses.text: But be ye glad and rejoice for ever <hi type="italic">in that</hi> which I create: for, behold, I create Jerusalem a rejoicing, and her people a joy.

verses.name: Isaiah 65:19
verses.text: And I will rejoice in Jerusalem, and joy in my people: and the voice of weeping shall be no more heard in her, nor the voice of crying.

verses.name: Isaiah 65:20
verses.text: There shall be no more thence an infant of days, nor an old man that hath not filled his days: for the child shall die an hundred years old; but the sinner <hi type="italic">being</hi> an hundred years old shall be accursed.

verses.name: Isaiah 65:21
verses.text: And they shall build houses, and inhabit <hi type="italic">them;</hi> and they shall plant vineyards, and eat the fruit of them.

verses.name: Isaiah 65:22
verses.text: They shall not build, and another inhabit; they shall not plant, and another eat: for as the days of a tree <hi type="italic">are</hi> the days of my people, and mine elect shall long enjoy the work of their hands.

verses.name: Isaiah 65:23
verses.text: They shall not labour in vain, nor bring forth for trouble; for they <hi type="italic">are</hi> the seed of the blessed of the Lord, and their offspring with them.

verses.name: Isaiah 65:24
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, that before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear.

verses.name: Isaiah 65:25
verses.text: The wolf and the lamb shall feed together, and the lion shall eat straw like the bullock: and dust <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> the serpent’s meat. They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain, saith the Lord.  <chapter eID="Isa.65"/><div eID="gen811" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 66:1
verses.text: THUS saith the Lord, The heaven <hi type="italic">is</hi> my throne, and the earth <hi type="italic">is</hi> my footstool: where <hi type="italic">is</hi> the house that ye build unto me? and where <hi type="italic">is</hi> the place of my rest?

verses.name: Isaiah 66:2
verses.text: For all those <hi type="italic">things</hi> hath mine hand made, and all those <hi type="italic">things</hi> have been, saith the Lord: but to this <hi type="italic">man</hi> will I look, <hi type="italic">even</hi> to <hi type="italic">him that is</hi> poor and of a contrite spirit, and trembleth at my word.

verses.name: Isaiah 66:3
verses.text: He that killeth an ox <hi type="italic">is as if</hi> he slew a man; he that sacrificeth a lamb, <hi type="italic">as if</hi> he cut off a dog’s neck; he that offereth an oblation, <hi type="italic">as if he offered</hi> swine’s blood; he that burneth incense, <hi type="italic">as if</hi> he blessed an idol. Yea, they have chosen their own ways, and their soul delighteth in their abominations.

verses.name: Isaiah 66:4
verses.text: I also will choose their delusions, and will bring their fears upon them; because when I called, none did answer; when I spake, they did not hear: but they did evil before mine eyes, and chose <hi type="italic">that</hi> in which I delighted not.

verses.name: Isaiah 66:5
verses.text: ¶ Hear the word of the Lord, ye that tremble at his word; Your brethren that hated you, that cast you out for my name’s sake, said, Let the Lord be glorified: but he shall appear to your joy, and they shall be ashamed.

verses.name: Isaiah 66:6
verses.text: A voice of noise from the city, a voice from the temple, a voice of the Lord that rendereth recompence to his enemies.

verses.name: Isaiah 66:7
verses.text: Before she travailed, she brought forth; before her pain came, she was delivered of a man child.

verses.name: Isaiah 66:8
verses.text: Who hath heard such a thing? who hath seen such things? Shall the earth be made to bring forth in one day? <hi type="italic">or</hi> shall a nation be born at once? for as soon as Zion travailed, she brought forth her children.

verses.name: Isaiah 66:9
verses.text: Shall I bring to the birth, and not cause to bring forth? saith the Lord: shall I cause to bring forth, and shut <hi type="italic">the womb?</hi> saith thy God.

verses.name: Isaiah 66:10
verses.text: Rejoice ye with Jerusalem, and be glad with her, all ye that love her: rejoice for joy with her, all ye that mourn for her:

verses.name: Isaiah 66:11
verses.text: That ye may suck, and be satisfied with the breasts of her consolations; that ye may milk out, and be delighted with the abundance of her glory.

verses.name: Isaiah 66:12
verses.text: For thus saith the Lord, Behold, I will extend peace to her like a river, and the glory of the Gentiles like a flowing stream: then shall ye suck, ye shall be borne upon <hi type="italic">her</hi> sides, and be dandled upon <hi type="italic">her</hi> knees.

verses.name: Isaiah 66:13
verses.text: As one whom his mother comforteth, so will I comfort you; and ye shall be comforted in Jerusalem.

verses.name: Isaiah 66:14
verses.text: And when ye see <hi type="italic">this</hi>, your heart shall rejoice, and your bones shall flourish like an herb: and the hand of the Lord shall be known toward his servants, and <hi type="italic">his</hi> indignation toward his enemies.

verses.name: Isaiah 66:15
verses.text: For, behold, the Lord will come with fire, and with his chariots like a whirlwind, to render his anger with fury, and his rebuke with flames of fire.

verses.name: Isaiah 66:16
verses.text: For by fire and by his sword will the Lord plead with all flesh: and the slain of the Lord shall be many.

verses.name: Isaiah 66:17
verses.text: They that sanctify themselves, and purify themselves in the gardens behind one <hi type="italic">tree</hi> in the midst, eating swine’s flesh, and the abomination, and the mouse, shall be consumed together, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Isaiah 66:18
verses.text: For I <hi type="italic">know</hi> their works and their thoughts: it shall come, that I will gather all nations and tongues; and they shall come, and see my glory.

verses.name: Isaiah 66:19
verses.text: And I will set a sign among them, and I will send those that escape of them unto the nations, <hi type="italic">to</hi> Tarshish, Pul, and Lud, that draw the bow, <hi type="italic">to</hi> Tubal, and Javan, <hi type="italic">to</hi> the isles afar off, that have not heard my fame, neither have seen my glory; and they shall declare my glory among the Gentiles.

verses.name: Isaiah 66:20
verses.text: And they shall bring all your brethren <hi type="italic">for</hi> an offering unto the Lord out of all nations upon horses, and in chariots, and in litters, and upon mules, and upon swift beasts, to my holy mountain Jerusalem, saith the Lord, as the children of Israel bring an offering in a clean vessel into the house of the Lord.

verses.name: Isaiah 66:21
verses.text: And I will also take of them for priests <hi type="italic">and</hi> for Levites, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Isaiah 66:22
verses.text: For as the new heavens and the new earth, which I will make, shall remain before me, saith the Lord, so shall your seed and your name remain.

verses.name: Isaiah 66:23
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, <hi type="italic">that</hi> from one new moon to another, and from one sabbath to another, shall all flesh come to worship before me, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Isaiah 66:24
verses.text: And they shall go forth, and look upon the carcases of the men that have transgressed against me: for their worm shall not die, neither shall their fire be quenched; and they shall be an abhorring unto all flesh.  <chapter eID="Isa.66"/><div eID="gen812" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen746" osisID="Isa" type="book"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:1
verses.text: THE words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, of the priests that <hi type="italic">were</hi> in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin:

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:2
verses.text: To whom the word of the Lord came in the days of Josiah the son of Amon king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:3
verses.text: It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, unto the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah the son of Josiah king of Judah, unto the carrying away of Jerusalem captive in the fifth month.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:4
verses.text: Then the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:5
verses.text: Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee; and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee, <hi type="italic">and</hi> I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:6
verses.text: Then said I, Ah, Lord God! behold, I cannot speak: for I <hi type="italic">am</hi> a child.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:7
verses.text: ¶ But the Lord said unto me, Say not, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> a child: for thou shalt go to all that I shall send thee, and whatsoever I command thee thou shalt speak.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:8
verses.text: Be not afraid of their faces: for I <hi type="italic">am</hi> with thee to deliver thee, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:9
verses.text: Then the Lord put forth his hand, and touched my mouth. And the Lord said unto me, Behold, I have put my words in thy mouth.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:10
verses.text: See, I have this day set thee over the nations and over the kingdoms, to root out, and to pull down, and to destroy, and to throw down, to build, and to plant.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:11
verses.text: ¶ Moreover the word of the Lord came unto me, saying, Jeremiah, what seest thou? And I said, I see a rod of an almond tree.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:12
verses.text: Then said the Lord unto me, Thou hast well seen: for I will hasten my word to perform it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:13
verses.text: And the word of the Lord came unto me the second time, saying, What seest thou? And I said, I see a seething pot; and the face thereof <hi type="italic">is</hi> toward the north.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:14
verses.text: Then the Lord said unto me, Out of the north an evil shall break forth upon all the inhabitants of the land.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:15
verses.text: For, lo, I will call all the families of the kingdoms of the north, saith the Lord; and they shall come, and they shall set every one his throne at the entering of the gates of Jerusalem, and against all the walls thereof round about, and against all the cities of Judah.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:16
verses.text: And I will utter my judgments against them touching all their wickedness, who have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, and worshipped the works of their own hands.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:17
verses.text: ¶ Thou therefore gird up thy loins, and arise, and speak unto them all that I command thee: be not dismayed at their faces, lest I confound thee before them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:18
verses.text: For, behold, I have made thee this day a defenced city, and an iron pillar, and brasen walls against the whole land, against the kings of Judah, against the princes thereof, against the priests thereof, and against the people of the land.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:19
verses.text: And they shall fight against thee; but they shall not prevail against thee; for I <hi type="italic">am</hi> with thee, saith the Lord, to deliver thee.  <chapter eID="Jer.1"/><div eID="gen814" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:1
verses.text: MOREOVER the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:2
verses.text: Go and cry in the ears of Jerusalem, saying, Thus saith the Lord; I remember thee, the kindness of thy youth, the love of thine espousals, when thou wentest after me in the wilderness, in a land <hi type="italic">that was</hi> not sown.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:3
verses.text: Israel <hi type="italic">was</hi> holiness unto the Lord, <hi type="italic">and</hi> the firstfruits of his increase: all that devour him shall offend; evil shall come upon them, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:4
verses.text: Hear ye the word of the Lord, O house of Jacob, and all the families of the house of Israel:

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:5
verses.text: ¶ Thus saith the Lord, What iniquity have your fathers found in me, that they are gone far from me, and have walked after vanity, and are become vain?

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:6
verses.text: Neither said they, Where <hi type="italic">is</hi> the Lord that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, that led us through the wilderness, through a land of deserts and of pits, through a land of drought, and of the shadow of death, through a land that no man passed through, and where no man dwelt?

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:7
verses.text: And I brought you into a plentiful country, to eat the fruit thereof and the goodness thereof; but when ye entered, ye defiled my land, and made mine heritage an abomination.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:8
verses.text: The priests said not, Where <hi type="italic">is</hi> the Lord? and they that handle the law knew me not: the pastors also transgressed against me, and the prophets prophesied by Baal, and walked after <hi type="italic">things that</hi> do not profit.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:9
verses.text: ¶ Wherefore I will yet plead with you, saith the Lord, and with your children’s children will I plead.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:10
verses.text: For pass over the isles of Chittim, and see; and send unto Kedar, and consider diligently, and see if there be such a thing.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:11
verses.text: Hath a nation changed <hi type="italic">their</hi> gods, which <hi type="italic">are</hi> yet no gods? but my people have changed their glory for <hi type="italic">that which</hi> doth not profit.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:12
verses.text: Be astonished, O ye heavens, at this, and be horribly afraid, be ye very desolate, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:13
verses.text: For my people have committed two evils; they have forsaken me the fountain of living waters, <hi type="italic">and</hi> hewed them out cisterns, broken cisterns, that can hold no water.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:14
verses.text: ¶ <hi type="italic">Is</hi> Israel a servant? <hi type="italic">is</hi> he a homeborn <hi type="italic">slave?</hi> why is he spoiled?

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:15
verses.text: The young lions roared upon him, <hi type="italic">and</hi> yelled, and they made his land waste: his cities are burned without inhabitant.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:16
verses.text: Also the children of Noph and Tahapanes have broken the crown of thy head.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:17
verses.text: Hast thou not procured this unto thyself, in that thou hast forsaken the Lord thy God, when he led thee by the way?

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:18
verses.text: And now what hast thou to do in the way of Egypt, to drink the waters of Sihor? or what hast thou to do in the way of Assyria, to drink the waters of the river?

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:19
verses.text: Thine own wickedness shall correct thee, and thy backslidings shall reprove thee: know therefore and see that <hi type="italic">it is</hi> an evil <hi type="italic">thing</hi> and bitter, that thou hast forsaken the Lord thy God, and that my fear <hi type="italic">is</hi> not in thee, saith the Lord God of hosts.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:20
verses.text: ¶ For of old time I have broken thy yoke, <hi type="italic">and</hi> burst thy bands; and thou saidst, I will not transgress; when upon every high hill and under every green tree thou wanderest, playing the harlot.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:21
verses.text: Yet I had planted thee a noble vine, wholly a right seed: how then art thou turned into the degenerate plant of a strange vine unto me?

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:22
verses.text: For though thou wash thee with nitre, and take thee much soap, <hi type="italic">yet</hi> thine iniquity is marked before me, saith the Lord God.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:23
verses.text: How canst thou say, I am not polluted, I have not gone after Baalim? see thy way in the valley, know what thou hast done: <hi type="italic">thou art</hi> a swift dromedary traversing her ways;

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:24
verses.text: A wild ass used to the wilderness, <hi type="italic">that</hi> snuffeth up the wind at her pleasure; in her occasion who can turn her away? all they that seek her will not weary themselves; in her month they shall find her.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:25
verses.text: Withhold thy foot from being unshod, and thy throat from thirst: but thou saidst, There is no hope: no; for I have loved strangers, and after them will I go.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:26
verses.text: As the thief is ashamed when he is found, so is the house of Israel ashamed; they, their kings, their princes, and their priests, and their prophets,

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:27
verses.text: Saying to a stock, Thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> my father; and to a stone, Thou hast brought me forth: for they have turned <hi type="italic">their</hi> back unto me, and not <hi type="italic">their</hi> face: but in the time of their trouble they will say, Arise, and save us.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:28
verses.text: But where <hi type="italic">are</hi> thy gods that thou hast made thee? let them arise, if they can save thee in the time of thy trouble: for <hi type="italic">according to</hi> the number of thy cities are thy gods, O Judah.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:29
verses.text: Wherefore will ye plead with me? ye all have transgressed against me, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:30
verses.text: In vain have I smitten your children; they received no correction: your own sword hath devoured your prophets, like a destroying lion.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:31
verses.text: ¶ O generation, see ye the word of the Lord. Have I been a wilderness unto Israel? a land of darkness? wherefore say my people, We are lords; we will come no more unto thee?

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:32
verses.text: Can a maid forget her ornaments, <hi type="italic">or</hi> a bride her attire? yet my people have forgotten me days without number.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:33
verses.text: Why trimmest thou thy way to seek love? therefore hast thou also taught the wicked ones thy ways.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:34
verses.text: Also in thy skirts is found the blood of the souls of the poor innocents: I have not found it by secret search, but upon all these.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:35
verses.text: Yet thou sayest, Because I am innocent, surely his anger shall turn from me. Behold, I will plead with thee, because thou sayest, I have not sinned.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:36
verses.text: Why gaddest thou about so much to change thy way? thou also shalt be ashamed of Egypt, as thou wast ashamed of Assyria.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:37
verses.text: Yea, thou shalt go forth from him, and thine hands upon thine head: for the Lord hath rejected thy confidences, and thou shalt not prosper in them.  <chapter eID="Jer.2"/><div eID="gen815" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:1
verses.text: THEY say, If a man put away his wife, and she go from him, and become another man’s, shall he return unto her again? shall not that land be greatly polluted? but thou hast played the harlot with many lovers; yet return again to me, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:2
verses.text: Lift up thine eyes unto the high places, and see where thou hast not been lien with. In the ways hast thou sat for them, as the Arabian in the wilderness; and thou hast polluted the land with thy whoredoms and with thy wickedness.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:3
verses.text: Therefore the showers have been withholden, and there hath been no latter rain; and thou hadst a whore’s forehead, thou refusedst to be ashamed.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:4
verses.text: Wilt thou not from this time cry unto me, My father, thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> the guide of my youth?

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:5
verses.text: Will he reserve <hi type="italic">his anger</hi> for ever? will he keep <hi type="italic">it</hi> to the end? Behold, thou hast spoken and done evil things as thou couldest.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:6
verses.text: ¶ The Lord said also unto me in the days of Josiah the king, Hast thou seen <hi type="italic">that</hi> which backsliding Israel hath done? she is gone up upon every high mountain and under every green tree, and there hath played the harlot.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:7
verses.text: And I said after she had done all these <hi type="italic">things</hi>, Turn thou unto me. But she returned not. And her treacherous sister Judah saw <hi type="italic">it</hi>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:8
verses.text: And I saw, when for all the causes whereby backsliding Israel committed adultery I had put her away, and given her a bill of divorce; yet her treacherous sister Judah feared not, but went and played the harlot also.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:9
verses.text: And it came to pass through the lightness of her whoredom, that she defiled the land, and committed adultery with stones and with stocks.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:10
verses.text: And yet for all this her treacherous sister Judah hath not turned unto me with her whole heart, but feignedly, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:11
verses.text: And the Lord said unto me, The backsliding Israel hath justified herself more than treacherous Judah.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:12
verses.text: ¶ Go and proclaim these words toward the north, and say, Return, thou backsliding Israel, saith the Lord; <hi type="italic">and</hi> I will not cause mine anger to fall upon you: for I <hi type="italic">am</hi> merciful, saith the Lord, <hi type="italic">and</hi> I will not keep <hi type="italic">anger</hi> for ever.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:13
verses.text: Only acknowledge thine iniquity, that thou hast transgressed against the Lord thy God, and hast scattered thy ways to the strangers under every green tree, and ye have not obeyed my voice, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:14
verses.text: Turn, O backsliding children, saith the Lord; for I am married unto you: and I will take you one of a city, and two of a family, and I will bring you to Zion:

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:15
verses.text: And I will give you pastors according to mine heart, which shall feed you with knowledge and understanding.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:16
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, when ye be multiplied and increased in the land, in those days, saith the Lord, they shall say no more, The ark of the covenant of the Lord: neither shall it come to mind: neither shall they remember it; neither shall they visit <hi type="italic">it;</hi> neither shall <hi type="italic">that</hi> be done any more.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:17
verses.text: At that time they shall call Jerusalem the throne of the Lord; and all the nations shall be gathered unto it, to the name of the Lord, to Jerusalem: neither shall they walk any more after the imagination of their evil heart.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:18
verses.text: In those days the house of Judah shall walk with the house of Israel, and they shall come together out of the land of the north to the land that I have given for an inheritance unto your fathers.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:19
verses.text: But I said, How shall I put thee among the children, and give thee a pleasant land, a goodly heritage of the hosts of nations? and I said, Thou shalt call me, My father; and shalt not turn away from me.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:20
verses.text: ¶ Surely <hi type="italic">as</hi> a wife treacherously departeth from her husband, so have ye dealt treacherously with me, O house of Israel, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:21
verses.text: A voice was heard upon the high places, weeping <hi type="italic">and</hi> supplications of the children of Israel: for they have perverted their way, <hi type="italic">and</hi> they have forgotten the Lord their God.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:22
verses.text: Return, ye backsliding children, <hi type="italic">and</hi> I will heal your backslidings. Behold, we come unto thee; for thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> the Lord our God.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:23
verses.text: Truly in vain <hi type="italic">is salvation hoped for</hi> from the hills, <hi type="italic">and from</hi> the multitude of mountains: truly in the Lord our God <hi type="italic">is</hi> the salvation of Israel.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:24
verses.text: For shame hath devoured the labour of our fathers from our youth; their flocks and their herds, their sons and their daughters.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:25
verses.text: We lie down in our shame, and our confusion covereth us: for we have sinned against the Lord our God, we and our fathers, from our youth even unto this day, and have not obeyed the voice of the Lord our God.  <chapter eID="Jer.3"/><div eID="gen816" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:1
verses.text: IF thou wilt return, O Israel, saith the Lord, return unto me: and if thou wilt put away thine abominations out of my sight, then shalt thou not remove.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:2
verses.text: And thou shalt swear, The Lord liveth, in truth, in judgment, and in righteousness; and the nations shall bless themselves in him, and in him shall they glory.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:3
verses.text: ¶ For thus saith the Lord to the men of Judah and Jerusalem, Break up your fallow ground, and sow not among thorns.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:4
verses.text: Circumcise yourselves to the Lord, and take away the foreskins of your heart, ye men of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem: lest my fury come forth like fire, and burn that none can quench <hi type="italic">it</hi>, because of the evil of your doings.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:5
verses.text: Declare ye in Judah, and publish in Jerusalem; and say, Blow ye the trumpet in the land: cry, gather together, and say, Assemble yourselves, and let us go into the defenced cities.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:6
verses.text: Set up the standard toward Zion: retire, stay not: for I will bring evil from the north, and a great destruction.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:7
verses.text: The lion is come up from his thicket, and the destroyer of the Gentiles is on his way; he is gone forth from his place to make thy land desolate; <hi type="italic">and</hi> thy cities shall be laid waste, without an inhabitant.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:8
verses.text: For this gird you with sackcloth, lament and howl: for the fierce anger of the Lord is not turned back from us.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:9
verses.text: And it shall come to pass at that day, saith the Lord, <hi type="italic">that</hi> the heart of the king shall perish, and the heart of the princes; and the priests shall be astonished, and the prophets shall wonder.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:10
verses.text: Then said I, Ah, Lord God! surely thou hast greatly deceived this people and Jerusalem, saying, Ye shall have peace; whereas the sword reacheth unto the soul.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:11
verses.text: At that time shall it be said to this people and to Jerusalem, A dry wind of the high places in the wilderness toward the daughter of my people, not to fan, nor to cleanse,

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:12
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Even</hi> a full wind from those <hi type="italic">places</hi> shall come unto me: now also will I give sentence against them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:13
verses.text: Behold, he shall come up as clouds, and his chariots <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> as a whirlwind: his horses are swifter than eagles. Woe unto us! for we are spoiled.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:14
verses.text: O Jerusalem, wash thine heart from wickedness, that thou mayest be saved. How long shall thy vain thoughts lodge within thee?

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:15
verses.text: For a voice declareth from Dan, and publisheth affliction from mount Ephraim.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:16
verses.text: Make ye mention to the nations; behold, publish against Jerusalem, <hi type="italic">that</hi> watchers come from a far country, and give out their voice against the cities of Judah.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:17
verses.text: As keepers of a field, are they against her round about; because she hath been rebellious against me, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:18
verses.text: Thy way and thy doings have procured these <hi type="italic">things</hi> unto thee; this <hi type="italic">is</hi> thy wickedness, because it is bitter, because it reacheth unto thine heart.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:19
verses.text: ¶ My bowels, my bowels! I am pained at my very heart; my heart maketh a noise in me; I cannot hold my peace, because thou hast heard, O my soul, the sound of the trumpet, the alarm of war.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:20
verses.text: Destruction upon destruction is cried; for the whole land is spoiled: suddenly are my tents spoiled, <hi type="italic">and</hi> my curtains in a moment.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:21
verses.text: How long shall I see the standard, <hi type="italic">and</hi> hear the sound of the trumpet?

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:22
verses.text: For my people <hi type="italic">is</hi> foolish, they have not known me; they <hi type="italic">are</hi> sottish children, and they have none understanding: they <hi type="italic">are</hi> wise to do evil, but to do good they have no knowledge.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:23
verses.text: I beheld the earth, and, lo, <hi type="italic">it was</hi> without form, and void; and the heavens, and they <hi type="italic">had</hi> no light.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:24
verses.text: I beheld the mountains, and, lo, they trembled, and all the hills moved lightly.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:25
verses.text: I beheld, and, lo, <hi type="italic">there was</hi> no man, and all the birds of the heavens were fled.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:26
verses.text: I beheld, and, lo, the fruitful place <hi type="italic">was</hi> a wilderness, and all the cities thereof were broken down at the presence of the Lord, <hi type="italic">and</hi> by his fierce anger.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:27
verses.text: For thus hath the Lord said, The whole land shall be desolate; yet will I not make a full end.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:28
verses.text: For this shall the earth mourn, and the heavens above be black: because I have spoken <hi type="italic">it</hi>, I have purposed <hi type="italic">it</hi>, and will not repent, neither will I turn back from it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:29
verses.text: The whole city shall flee for the noise of the horsemen and bowmen; they shall go into thickets, and climb up upon the rocks: every city <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> forsaken, and not a man dwell therein.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:30
verses.text: And <hi type="italic">when</hi> thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> spoiled, what wilt thou do? Though thou clothest thyself with crimson, though thou deckest thee with ornaments of gold, though thou rentest thy face with painting, in vain shalt thou make thyself fair; <hi type="italic">thy</hi> lovers will despise thee, they will seek thy life.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:31
verses.text: For I have heard a voice as of a woman in travail, <hi type="italic">and</hi> the anguish as of her that bringeth forth her first child, the voice of the daughter of Zion, <hi type="italic">that</hi> bewaileth herself, <hi type="italic">that</hi> spreadeth her hands, <hi type="italic">saying</hi>, Woe <hi type="italic">is</hi> me now! for my soul is wearied because of murderers.  <chapter eID="Jer.4"/><div eID="gen817" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:1
verses.text: RUN ye to and fro through the streets of Jerusalem, and see now, and know, and seek in the broad places thereof, if ye can find a man, if there be <hi type="italic">any</hi> that executeth judgment, that seeketh the truth; and I will pardon it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:2
verses.text: And though they say, The Lord liveth; surely they swear falsely.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:3
verses.text: O Lord, <hi type="italic">are</hi> not thine eyes upon the truth? thou hast stricken them, but they have not grieved; thou hast consumed them, <hi type="italic">but</hi> they have refused to receive correction: they have made their faces harder than a rock; they have refused to return.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:4
verses.text: Therefore I said, Surely these <hi type="italic">are</hi> poor; they are foolish: for they know not the way of the Lord, <hi type="italic">nor</hi> the judgment of their God.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:5
verses.text: I will get me unto the great men, and will speak unto them; for they have known the way of the Lord, <hi type="italic">and</hi> the judgment of their God: but these have altogether broken the yoke, <hi type="italic">and</hi> burst the bonds.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:6
verses.text: Wherefore a lion out of the forest shall slay them, <hi type="italic">and</hi> a wolf of the evenings shall spoil them, a leopard shall watch over their cities: every one that goeth out thence shall be torn in pieces: because their transgressions are many, <hi type="italic">and</hi> their backslidings are increased.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:7
verses.text: ¶ How shall I pardon thee for this? thy children have forsaken me, and sworn by <hi type="italic">them that are</hi> no gods: when I had fed them to the full, they then committed adultery, and assembled themselves by troops in the harlots’ houses.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:8
verses.text: They were <hi type="italic">as</hi> fed horses in the morning: every one neighed after his neighbour’s wife.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:9
verses.text: Shall I not visit for these <hi type="italic">things?</hi> saith the Lord: and shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:10
verses.text: ¶ Go ye up upon her walls, and destroy; but make not a full end: take away her battlements; for they <hi type="italic">are</hi> not the Lord’s.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:11
verses.text: For the house of Israel and the house of Judah have dealt very treacherously against me, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:12
verses.text: They have belied the Lord, and said, <hi type="italic">It is</hi> not he; neither shall evil come upon us; neither shall we see sword nor famine:

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:13
verses.text: And the prophets shall become wind, and the word <hi type="italic">is</hi> not in them: thus shall it be done unto them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:14
verses.text: Wherefore thus saith the Lord God of hosts, Because ye speak this word, behold, I will make my words in thy mouth fire, and this people wood, and it shall devour them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:15
verses.text: Lo, I will bring a nation upon you from far, O house of Israel, saith the Lord: it <hi type="italic">is</hi> a mighty nation, it <hi type="italic">is</hi> an ancient nation, a nation whose language thou knowest not, neither understandest what they say.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:16
verses.text: Their quiver <hi type="italic">is</hi> as an open sepulchre, they <hi type="italic">are</hi> all mighty men.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:17
verses.text: And they shall eat up thine harvest, and thy bread, <hi type="italic">which</hi> thy sons and thy daughters should eat: they shall eat up thy flocks and thine herds: they shall eat up thy vines and thy fig trees: they shall impoverish thy fenced cities, wherein thou trustedst, with the sword.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:18
verses.text: Nevertheless in those days, saith the Lord, I will not make a full end with you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:19
verses.text: ¶ And it shall come to pass, when ye shall say, Wherefore doeth the Lord our God all these <hi type="italic">things</hi> unto us? then shalt thou answer them, Like as ye have forsaken me, and served strange gods in your land, so shall ye serve strangers in a land <hi type="italic">that is</hi> not yours.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:20
verses.text: Declare this in the house of Jacob, and publish it in Judah, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:21
verses.text: Hear now this, O foolish people, and without understanding; which have eyes, and see not; which have ears, and hear not:

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:22
verses.text: Fear ye not me? saith the Lord: will ye not tremble at my presence, which have placed the sand <hi type="italic">for</hi> the bound of the sea by a perpetual decree, that it cannot pass it: and though the waves thereof toss themselves, yet can they not prevail; though they roar, yet can they not pass over it?

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:23
verses.text: But this people hath a revolting and a rebellious heart; they are revolted and gone.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:24
verses.text: Neither say they in their heart, Let us now fear the Lord our God, that giveth rain, both the former and the latter, in his season: he reserveth unto us the appointed weeks of the harvest.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:25
verses.text: ¶ Your iniquities have turned away these <hi type="italic">things</hi>, and your sins have withholden good <hi type="italic">things</hi> from you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:26
verses.text: For among my people are found wicked <hi type="italic">men:</hi> they lay wait, as he that setteth snares; they set a trap, they catch men.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:27
verses.text: As a cage is full of birds, so <hi type="italic">are</hi> their houses full of deceit: therefore they are become great, and waxen rich.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:28
verses.text: They are waxen fat, they shine: yea, they overpass the deeds of the wicked: they judge not the cause, the cause of the fatherless, yet they prosper; and the right of the needy do they not judge.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:29
verses.text: Shall I not visit for these <hi type="italic">things?</hi> saith the Lord: shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:30
verses.text: ¶ A wonderful and horrible thing is committed in the land;

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:31
verses.text: The prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests bear rule by their means; and my people love <hi type="italic">to have it</hi> so: and what will ye do in the end thereof?  <chapter eID="Jer.5"/><div eID="gen818" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:1
verses.text: O YE children of Benjamin, gather yourselves to flee out of the midst of Jerusalem, and blow the trumpet in Tekoa, and set up a sign of fire in Beth-haccerem: for evil appeareth out of the north, and great destruction.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:2
verses.text: I have likened the daughter of Zion to a comely and delicate <hi type="italic">woman</hi>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:3
verses.text: The shepherds with their flocks shall come unto her; they shall pitch <hi type="italic">their</hi> tents against her round about; they shall feed every one in his place.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:4
verses.text: Prepare ye war against her; arise, and let us go up at noon. Woe unto us! for the day goeth away, for the shadows of the evening are stretched out.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:5
verses.text: Arise, and let us go by night, and let us destroy her palaces.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:6
verses.text: ¶ For thus hath the Lord of hosts said, Hew ye down trees, and cast a mount against Jerusalem: this <hi type="italic">is</hi> the city to be visited; she <hi type="italic">is</hi> wholly oppression in the midst of her.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:7
verses.text: As a fountain casteth out her waters, so she casteth out her wickedness: violence and spoil is heard in her; before me continually <hi type="italic">is</hi> grief and wounds.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:8
verses.text: Be thou instructed, O Jerusalem, lest my soul depart from thee; lest I make thee desolate, a land not inhabited.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:9
verses.text: ¶ Thus saith the Lord of hosts, They shall throughly glean the remnant of Israel as a vine: turn back thine hand as a grapegatherer into the baskets.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:10
verses.text: To whom shall I speak, and give warning, that they may hear? behold, their ear <hi type="italic">is</hi> uncircumcised, and they cannot hearken: behold, the word of the Lord is unto them a reproach; they have no delight in it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:11
verses.text: Therefore I am full of the fury of the Lord; I am weary with holding in: I will pour it out upon the children abroad, and upon the assembly of young men together: for even the husband with the wife shall be taken, the aged with <hi type="italic">him that is</hi> full of days.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:12
verses.text: And their houses shall be turned unto others, <hi type="italic">with their</hi> fields and wives together: for I will stretch out my hand upon the inhabitants of the land, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:13
verses.text: For from the least of them even unto the greatest of them every one <hi type="italic">is</hi> given to covetousness; and from the prophet even unto the priest every one dealeth falsely.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:14
verses.text: They have healed also the hurt <hi type="italic">of the daughter</hi> of my people slightly, saying, Peace, peace; when <hi type="italic">there is</hi> no peace.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:15
verses.text: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? nay, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush: therefore they shall fall among them that fall: at the time <hi type="italic">that</hi> I visit them they shall be cast down, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:16
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord, Stand ye in the ways, and see, and ask for the old paths, where <hi type="italic">is</hi> the good way, and walk therein, and ye shall find rest for your souls. But they said, We will not walk <hi type="italic">therein</hi>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:17
verses.text: Also I set watchmen over you, <hi type="italic">saying</hi>, Hearken to the sound of the trumpet. But they said, We will not hearken.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:18
verses.text: ¶ Therefore hear, ye nations, and know, O congregation, what <hi type="italic">is</hi> among them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:19
verses.text: Hear, O earth: behold, I will bring evil upon this people, <hi type="italic">even</hi> the fruit of their thoughts, because they have not hearkened unto my words, nor to my law, but rejected it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:20
verses.text: To what purpose cometh there to me incense from Sheba, and the sweet cane from a far country? your burnt offerings <hi type="italic">are</hi> not acceptable, nor your sacrifices sweet unto me.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:21
verses.text: Therefore thus saith the Lord, Behold, I will lay stumblingblocks before this people, and the fathers and the sons together shall fall upon them; the neighbour and his friend shall perish.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:22
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord, Behold, a people cometh from the north country, and a great nation shall be raised from the sides of the earth.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:23
verses.text: They shall lay hold on bow and spear; they <hi type="italic">are</hi> cruel, and have no mercy; their voice roareth like the sea; and they ride upon horses, set in array as men for war against thee, O daughter of Zion.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:24
verses.text: We have heard the fame thereof: our hands wax feeble: anguish hath taken hold of us, <hi type="italic">and</hi> pain, as of a woman in travail.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:25
verses.text: Go not forth into the field, nor walk by the way; for the sword of the enemy <hi type="italic">and</hi> fear <hi type="italic">is</hi> on every side.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:26
verses.text: ¶ O daughter of my people, gird <hi type="italic">thee</hi> with sackcloth, and wallow thyself in ashes: make thee mourning, <hi type="italic">as for</hi> an only son, most bitter lamentation: for the spoiler shall suddenly come upon us.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:27
verses.text: I have set thee <hi type="italic">for</hi> a tower <hi type="italic">and</hi> a fortress among my people, that thou mayest know and try their way.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:28
verses.text: They <hi type="italic">are</hi> all grievous revolters, walking with slanders: <hi type="italic">they are</hi> brass and iron; they <hi type="italic">are</hi> all corrupters.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:29
verses.text: The bellows are burned, the lead is consumed of the fire; the founder melteth in vain: for the wicked are not plucked away.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:30
verses.text: Reprobate silver shall <hi type="italic">men</hi> call them, because the Lord hath rejected them.  <chapter eID="Jer.6"/><div eID="gen819" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:1
verses.text: THE word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:2
verses.text: Stand in the gate of the Lord’s house, and proclaim there this word, and say, Hear the word of the Lord, all <hi type="italic">ye of</hi> Judah, that enter in at these gates to worship the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:3
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, Amend your ways and your doings, and I will cause you to dwell in this place.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:4
verses.text: Trust ye not in lying words, saying, The temple of the Lord, The temple of the Lord, The temple of the Lord, <hi type="italic">are</hi> these.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:5
verses.text: For if ye throughly amend your ways and your doings; if ye throughly execute judgment between a man and his neighbour;

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:6
verses.text: <hi type="italic">If</hi> ye oppress not the stranger, the fatherless, and the widow, and shed not innocent blood in this place, neither walk after other gods to your hurt:

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:7
verses.text: Then will I cause you to dwell in this place, in the land that I gave to your fathers, for ever and ever.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:8
verses.text: ¶ Behold, ye trust in lying words, that cannot profit.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:9
verses.text: Will ye steal, murder, and commit adultery, and swear falsely, and burn incense unto Baal, and walk after other gods whom ye know not;

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:10
verses.text: And come and stand before me in this house, which is called by my name, and say, We are delivered to do all these abominations?

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:11
verses.text: Is this house, which is called by my name, become a den of robbers in your eyes? Behold, even I have seen <hi type="italic">it</hi>, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:12
verses.text: But go ye now unto my place which <hi type="italic">was</hi> in Shiloh, where I set my name at the first, and see what I did to it for the wickedness of my people Israel.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:13
verses.text: And now, because ye have done all these works, saith the Lord, and I spake unto you, rising up early and speaking, but ye heard not; and I called you, but ye answered not;

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:14
verses.text: Therefore will I do unto <hi type="italic">this</hi> house, which is called by my name, wherein ye trust, and unto the place which I gave to you and to your fathers, as I have done to Shiloh.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:15
verses.text: And I will cast you out of my sight, as I have cast out all your brethren, <hi type="italic">even</hi> the whole seed of Ephraim.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:16
verses.text: Therefore pray not thou for this people, neither lift up cry nor prayer for them, neither make intercession to me: for I will not hear thee.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:17
verses.text: ¶ Seest thou not what they do in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:18
verses.text: The children gather wood, and the fathers kindle the fire, and the women knead <hi type="italic">their</hi> dough, to make cakes to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto other gods, that they may provoke me to anger.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:19
verses.text: Do they provoke me to anger? saith the Lord: <hi type="italic">do they</hi> not <hi type="italic">provoke</hi> themselves to the confusion of their own faces?

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:20
verses.text: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Behold, mine anger and my fury shall be poured out upon this place, upon man, and upon beast, and upon the trees of the field, and upon the fruit of the ground; and it shall burn, and shall not be quenched.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:21
verses.text: ¶ Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Put your burnt offerings unto your sacrifices, and eat flesh.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:22
verses.text: For I spake not unto your fathers, nor commanded them in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, concerning burnt offerings or sacrifices:

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:23
verses.text: But this thing commanded I them, saying, Obey my voice, and I will be your God, and ye shall be my people: and walk ye in all the ways that I have commanded you, that it may be well unto you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:24
verses.text: But they hearkened not, nor inclined their ear, but walked in the counsels <hi type="italic">and</hi> in the imagination of their evil heart, and went backward, and not forward.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:25
verses.text: Since the day that your fathers came forth out of the land of Egypt unto this day I have even sent unto you all my servants the prophets, daily rising up early and sending <hi type="italic">them:</hi>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:26
verses.text: Yet they hearkened not unto me, nor inclined their ear, but hardened their neck: they did worse than their fathers.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:27
verses.text: Therefore thou shalt speak all these words unto them; but they will not hearken to thee: thou shalt also call unto them; but they will not answer thee.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:28
verses.text: But thou shalt say unto them, This <hi type="italic">is</hi> a nation that obeyeth not the voice of the Lord their God, nor receiveth correction: truth is perished, and is cut off from their mouth.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:29
verses.text: ¶ Cut off thine hair, <hi type="italic">O Jerusalem</hi>, and cast <hi type="italic">it</hi> away, and take up a lamentation on high places; for the Lord hath rejected and forsaken the generation of his wrath.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:30
verses.text: For the children of Judah have done evil in my sight, saith the Lord: they have set their abominations in the house which is called by my name, to pollute it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:31
verses.text: And they have built the high places of Tophet, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire; which I commanded <hi type="italic">them</hi> not, neither came it into my heart.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:32
verses.text: ¶ Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that it shall no more be called Tophet, nor the valley of the son of Hinnom, but the valley of slaughter: for they shall bury in Tophet, till there be no place.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:33
verses.text: And the carcases of this people shall be meat for the fowls of the heaven, and for the beasts of the earth; and none shall fray <hi type="italic">them</hi> away.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:34
verses.text: Then will I cause to cease from the cities of Judah, and from the streets of Jerusalem, the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride: for the land shall be desolate.  <chapter eID="Jer.7"/><div eID="gen820" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:1
verses.text: AT that time, saith the Lord, they shall bring out the bones of the kings of Judah, and the bones of his princes, and the bones of the priests, and the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, out of their graves:

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:2
verses.text: And they shall spread them before the sun, and the moon, and all the host of heaven, whom they have loved, and whom they have served, and after whom they have walked, and whom they have sought, and whom they have worshipped: they shall not be gathered, nor be buried; they shall be for dung upon the face of the earth.

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:3
verses.text: And death shall be chosen rather than life by all the residue of them that remain of this evil family, which remain in all the places whither I have driven them, saith the Lord of hosts.

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:4
verses.text: ¶ Moreover thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord; Shall they fall, and not arise? shall he turn away, and not return?

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:5
verses.text: Why <hi type="italic">then</hi> is this people of Jerusalem slidden back by a perpetual backsliding? they hold fast deceit, they refuse to return.

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:6
verses.text: I hearkened and heard, <hi type="italic">but</hi> they spake not aright: no man repented him of his wickedness, saying, What have I done? every one turned to his course, as the horse rusheth into the battle.

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:7
verses.text: Yea, the stork in the heaven knoweth her appointed times; and the turtle and the crane and the swallow observe the time of their coming; but my people know not the judgment of the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:8
verses.text: How do ye say, We <hi type="italic">are</hi> wise, and the law of the Lord <hi type="italic">is</hi> with us? Lo, certainly in vain made he <hi type="italic">it;</hi> the pen of the scribes <hi type="italic">is</hi> in vain.

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:9
verses.text: The wise <hi type="italic">men</hi> are ashamed, they are dismayed and taken: lo, they have rejected the word of the Lord; and what wisdom <hi type="italic">is</hi> in them?

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:10
verses.text: Therefore will I give their wives unto others, <hi type="italic">and</hi> their fields to them that shall inherit <hi type="italic">them:</hi> for every one from the least even unto the greatest is given to covetousness, from the prophet even unto the priest every one dealeth falsely.

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:11
verses.text: For they have healed the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly, saying, Peace, peace; when <hi type="italic">there is</hi> no peace.

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:12
verses.text: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? nay, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush: therefore shall they fall among them that fall: in the time of their visitation they shall be cast down, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:13
verses.text: ¶ I will surely consume them, saith the Lord: <hi type="italic">there shall be</hi> no grapes on the vine, nor figs on the fig tree, and the leaf shall fade; and <hi type="italic">the things that</hi> I have given them shall pass away from them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:14
verses.text: Why do we sit still? assemble yourselves, and let us enter into the defenced cities, and let us be silent there: for the Lord our God hath put us to silence, and given us water of gall to drink, because we have sinned against the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:15
verses.text: We looked for peace, but no good <hi type="italic">came; and</hi> for a time of health, and behold trouble!

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:16
verses.text: The snorting of his horses was heard from Dan: the whole land trembled at the sound of the neighing of his strong ones; for they are come, and have devoured the land, and all that is in it; the city, and those that dwell therein.

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:17
verses.text: For, behold, I will send serpents, cockatrices, among you, which <hi type="italic">will</hi> not <hi type="italic">be</hi> charmed, and they shall bite you, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:18
verses.text: ¶ <hi type="italic">When</hi> I would comfort myself against sorrow, my heart <hi type="italic">is</hi> faint in me.

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:19
verses.text: Behold the voice of the cry of the daughter of my people because of them that dwell in a far country: <hi type="italic">Is</hi> not the Lord in Zion? <hi type="italic">is</hi> not her king in her? Why have they provoked me to anger with their graven images, <hi type="italic">and</hi> with strange vanities?

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:20
verses.text: The harvest is past, the summer is ended, and we are not saved.

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:21
verses.text: For the hurt of the daughter of my people am I hurt; I am black; astonishment hath taken hold on me.

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:22
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Is there</hi> no balm in Gilead; <hi type="italic">is there</hi> no physician there? why then is not the health of the daughter of my people recovered?  <chapter eID="Jer.8"/><div eID="gen821" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:1
verses.text: OH that my head were waters, and mine eyes a fountain of tears, that I might weep day and night for the slain of the daughter of my people!

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:2
verses.text: Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging place of wayfaring men; that I might leave my people, and go from them! for they <hi type="italic">be</hi> all adulterers, an assembly of treacherous men.

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:3
verses.text: And they bend their tongues <hi type="italic">like</hi> their bow <hi type="italic">for</hi> lies: but they are not valiant for the truth upon the earth; for they proceed from evil to evil, and they know not me, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:4
verses.text: Take ye heed every one of his neighbour, and trust ye not in any brother: for every brother will utterly supplant, and every neighbour will walk with slanders.

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:5
verses.text: And they will deceive every one his neighbour, and will not speak the truth: they have taught their tongue to speak lies, <hi type="italic">and</hi> weary themselves to commit iniquity.

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:6
verses.text: Thine habitation <hi type="italic">is</hi> in the midst of deceit; through deceit they refuse to know me, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:7
verses.text: Therefore thus saith the Lord of hosts, Behold, I will melt them, and try them; for how shall I do for the daughter of my people?

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:8
verses.text: Their tongue <hi type="italic">is as</hi> an arrow shot out; it speaketh deceit: <hi type="italic">one</hi> speaketh peaceably to his neighbour with his mouth, but in heart he layeth his wait.

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:9
verses.text: ¶ Shall I not visit them for these <hi type="italic">things?</hi> saith the Lord: shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:10
verses.text: For the mountains will I take up a weeping and wailing, and for the habitations of the wilderness a lamentation, because they are burned up, so that none can pass through <hi type="italic">them;</hi> neither can <hi type="italic">men</hi> hear the voice of the cattle; both the fowl of the heavens and the beast are fled; they are gone.

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:11
verses.text: And I will make Jerusalem heaps, <hi type="italic">and</hi> a den of dragons; and I will make the cities of Judah desolate, without an inhabitant.

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:12
verses.text: ¶ Who <hi type="italic">is</hi> the wise man, that may understand this? and <hi type="italic">who is he</hi> to whom the mouth of the Lord hath spoken, that he may declare it, for what the land perisheth <hi type="italic">and</hi> is burned up like a wilderness, that none passeth through?

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:13
verses.text: And the Lord saith, Because they have forsaken my law which I set before them, and have not obeyed my voice, neither walked therein;

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:14
verses.text: But have walked after the imagination of their own heart, and after Baalim, which their fathers taught them:

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:15
verses.text: Therefore thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will feed them, <hi type="italic">even</hi> this people, with wormwood, and give them water of gall to drink.

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:16
verses.text: I will scatter them also among the heathen, whom neither they nor their fathers have known: and I will send a sword after them, till I have consumed them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:17
verses.text: ¶ Thus saith the Lord of hosts, Consider ye, and call for the mourning women, that they may come; and send for cunning <hi type="italic">women</hi>, that they may come:

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:18
verses.text: And let them make haste, and take up a wailing for us, that our eyes may run down with tears, and our eyelids gush out with waters.

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:19
