verses.text: For a voice of wailing is heard out of Zion, How are we spoiled! we are greatly confounded, because we have forsaken the land, because our dwellings have cast <hi type="italic">us</hi> out.

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:20
verses.text: Yet hear the word of the Lord, O ye women, and let your ear receive the word of his mouth, and teach your daughters wailing, and every one her neighbour lamentation.

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:21
verses.text: For death is come up into our windows, <hi type="italic">and</hi> is entered into our palaces, to cut off the children from without, <hi type="italic">and</hi> the young men from the streets.

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:22
verses.text: Speak, Thus saith the Lord, Even the carcases of men shall fall as dung upon the open field, and as the handful after the harvestman, and none shall gather <hi type="italic">them</hi>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:23
verses.text: ¶ Thus saith the Lord, Let not the wise <hi type="italic">man</hi> glory in his wisdom, neither let the mighty <hi type="italic">man</hi> glory in his might, let not the rich <hi type="italic">man</hi> glory in his riches:

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:24
verses.text: But let him that glorieth glory in this, that he understandeth and knoweth me, that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord which exercise lovingkindness, judgment, and righteousness, in the earth: for in these <hi type="italic">things</hi> I delight, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:25
verses.text: ¶ Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that I will punish all <hi type="italic">them which are</hi> circumcised with the uncircumcised;

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:26
verses.text: Egypt, and Judah, and Edom, and the children of Ammon, and Moab, and all <hi type="italic">that are</hi> in the utmost corners, that dwell in the wilderness: for all <hi type="italic">these</hi> nations <hi type="italic">are</hi> uncircumcised, and all the house of Israel <hi type="italic">are</hi> uncircumcised in the heart.  <chapter eID="Jer.9"/><div eID="gen822" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:1
verses.text: HEAR ye the word which the Lord speaketh unto you, O house of Israel:

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:2
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord, Learn not the way of the heathen, and be not dismayed at the signs of heaven; for the heathen are dismayed at them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:3
verses.text: For the customs of the people <hi type="italic">are</hi> vain: for <hi type="italic">one</hi> cutteth a tree out of the forest, the work of the hands of the workman, with the axe.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:4
verses.text: They deck it with silver and with gold; they fasten it with nails and with hammers, that it move not.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:5
verses.text: They <hi type="italic">are</hi> upright as the palm tree, but speak not: they must needs be borne, because they cannot go. Be not afraid of them; for they cannot do evil, neither also <hi type="italic">is it</hi> in them to do good.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:6
verses.text: Forasmuch as <hi type="italic">there is</hi> none like unto thee, O Lord; thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> great, and thy name <hi type="italic">is</hi> great in might.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:7
verses.text: Who would not fear thee, O King of nations? for to thee doth it appertain: forasmuch as among all the wise <hi type="italic">men</hi> of the nations, and in all their kingdoms, <hi type="italic">there is</hi> none like unto thee.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:8
verses.text: But they are altogether brutish and foolish: the stock <hi type="italic">is</hi> a doctrine of vanities.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:9
verses.text: Silver spread into plates is brought from Tarshish, and gold from Uphaz, the work of the workman, and of the hands of the founder: blue and purple <hi type="italic">is</hi> their clothing: they <hi type="italic">are</hi> all the work of cunning <hi type="italic">men</hi>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:10
verses.text: But the Lord <hi type="italic">is</hi> the true God, he <hi type="italic">is</hi> the living God, and an everlasting king: at his wrath the earth shall tremble, and the nations shall not be able to abide his indignation.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:11
verses.text: Thus shall ye say unto them, The gods that have not made the heavens and the earth, <hi type="italic">even</hi> they shall perish from the earth, and from under these heavens.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:12
verses.text: He hath made the earth by his power, he hath established the world by his wisdom, and hath stretched out the heavens by his discretion.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:13
verses.text: When he uttereth his voice, <hi type="italic">there is</hi> a multitude of waters in the heavens, and he causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings with rain, and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasures.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:14
verses.text: Every man is brutish in <hi type="italic">his</hi> knowledge: every founder is confounded by the graven image: for his molten image <hi type="italic">is</hi> falsehood, and <hi type="italic">there is</hi> no breath in them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:15
verses.text: They <hi type="italic">are</hi> vanity, <hi type="italic">and</hi> the work of errors: in the time of their visitation they shall perish.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:16
verses.text: The portion of Jacob <hi type="italic">is</hi> not like them: for he <hi type="italic">is</hi> the former of all <hi type="italic">things;</hi> and Israel <hi type="italic">is</hi> the rod of his inheritance: The Lord of hosts <hi type="italic">is</hi> his name.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:17
verses.text: ¶ Gather up thy wares out of the land, O inhabitant of the fortress.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:18
verses.text: For thus saith the Lord, Behold, I will sling out the inhabitants of the land at this once, and will distress them, that they may find <hi type="italic">it so</hi>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:19
verses.text: ¶ Woe is me for my hurt! my wound is grievous: but I said, Truly this <hi type="italic">is</hi> a grief, and I must bear it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:20
verses.text: My tabernacle is spoiled, and all my cords are broken: my children are gone forth of me, and they <hi type="italic">are</hi> not: <hi type="italic">there is</hi> none to stretch forth my tent any more, and to set up my curtains.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:21
verses.text: For the pastors are become brutish, and have not sought the Lord: therefore they shall not prosper, and all their flocks shall be scattered.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:22
verses.text: Behold, the noise of the bruit is come, and a great commotion out of the north country, to make the cities of Judah desolate, <hi type="italic">and</hi> a den of dragons.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:23
verses.text: ¶ O Lord, I know that the way of man <hi type="italic">is</hi> not in himself: <hi type="italic">it is</hi> not in man that walketh to direct his steps.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:24
verses.text: O Lord, correct me, but with judgment; not in thine anger, lest thou bring me to nothing.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:25
verses.text: Pour out thy fury upon the heathen that know thee not, and upon the families that call not on thy name: for they have eaten up Jacob, and devoured him, and consumed him, and have made his habitation desolate.  <chapter eID="Jer.10"/><div eID="gen823" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:1
verses.text: THE word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:2
verses.text: Hear ye the words of this covenant, and speak unto the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem;

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:3
verses.text: And say thou unto them, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel; Cursed <hi type="italic">be</hi> the man that obeyeth not the words of this covenant,

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:4
verses.text: Which I commanded your fathers in the day <hi type="italic">that</hi> I brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, from the iron furnace, saying, Obey my voice, and do them, according to all which I command you: so shall ye be my people, and I will be your God:

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:5
verses.text: That I may perform the oath which I have sworn unto your fathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey, as <hi type="italic">it is</hi> this day. Then answered I, and said, So be it, O Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:6
verses.text: Then the Lord said unto me, Proclaim all these words in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, saying, Hear ye the words of this covenant, and do them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:7
verses.text: For I earnestly protested unto your fathers in the day <hi type="italic">that</hi> I brought them up out of the land of Egypt, <hi type="italic">even</hi> unto this day, rising early and protesting, saying, Obey my voice.

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:8
verses.text: Yet they obeyed not, nor inclined their ear, but walked every one in the imagination of their evil heart: therefore I will bring upon them all the words of this covenant, which I commanded <hi type="italic">them</hi> to do; but they did <hi type="italic">them</hi> not.

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:9
verses.text: And the Lord said unto me, A conspiracy is found among the men of Judah, and among the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:10
verses.text: They are turned back to the iniquities of their forefathers, which refused to hear my words; and they went after other gods to serve them: the house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken my covenant which I made with their fathers.

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:11
verses.text: ¶ Therefore thus saith the Lord, Behold, I will bring evil upon them, which they shall not be able to escape; and though they shall cry unto me, I will not hearken unto them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:12
verses.text: Then shall the cities of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem go, and cry unto the gods unto whom they offer incense: but they shall not save them at all in the time of their trouble.

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:13
verses.text: For <hi type="italic">according to</hi> the number of thy cities were thy gods, O Judah; and <hi type="italic">according to</hi> the number of the streets of Jerusalem have ye set up altars to <hi type="italic">that</hi> shameful thing, <hi type="italic">even</hi> altars to burn incense unto Baal.

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:14
verses.text: Therefore pray not thou for this people, neither lift up a cry or prayer for them: for I will not hear <hi type="italic">them</hi> in the time that they cry unto me for their trouble.

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:15
verses.text: What hath my beloved to do in mine house, <hi type="italic">seeing</hi> she hath wrought lewdness with many, and the holy flesh is passed from thee? when thou doest evil, then thou rejoicest.

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:16
verses.text: The Lord called thy name, A green olive tree, fair, <hi type="italic">and</hi> of goodly fruit: with the noise of a great tumult he hath kindled fire upon it, and the branches of it are broken.

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:17
verses.text: For the Lord of hosts, that planted thee, hath pronounced evil against thee, for the evil of the house of Israel and of the house of Judah, which they have done against themselves to provoke me to anger in offering incense unto Baal.

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:18
verses.text: ¶ And the Lord hath given me knowledge <hi type="italic">of it</hi>, and I know <hi type="italic">it:</hi> then thou shewedst me their doings.

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:19
verses.text: But I <hi type="italic">was</hi> like a lamb <hi type="italic">or</hi> an ox <hi type="italic">that</hi> is brought to the slaughter; and I knew not that they had devised devices against me, <hi type="italic">saying</hi>, Let us destroy the tree with the fruit thereof, and let us cut him off from the land of the living, that his name may be no more remembered.

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:20
verses.text: But, O Lord of hosts, that judgest righteously, that triest the reins and the heart, let me see thy vengeance on them: for unto thee have I revealed my cause.

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:21
verses.text: Therefore thus saith the Lord of the men of Anathoth, that seek thy life, saying, Prophesy not in the name of the Lord, that thou die not by our hand:

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:22
verses.text: Therefore thus saith the Lord of hosts, Behold, I will punish them: the young men shall die by the sword; their sons and their daughters shall die by famine:

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:23
verses.text: And there shall be no remnant of them: for I will bring evil upon the men of Anathoth, <hi type="italic">even</hi> the year of their visitation.  <chapter eID="Jer.11"/><div eID="gen824" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:1
verses.text: RIGHTEOUS <hi type="italic">art</hi> thou, O Lord, when I plead with thee: yet let me talk with thee of <hi type="italic">thy</hi> judgments: Wherefore doth the way of the wicked prosper? <hi type="italic">wherefore</hi> are all they happy that deal very treacherously?

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:2
verses.text: Thou hast planted them, yea, they have taken root: they grow, yea, they bring forth fruit: thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> near in their mouth, and far from their reins.

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:3
verses.text: But thou, O Lord, knowest me: thou hast seen me, and tried mine heart toward thee: pull them out like sheep for the slaughter, and prepare them for the day of slaughter.

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:4
verses.text: How long shall the land mourn, and the herbs of every field wither, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein? the beasts are consumed, and the birds; because they said, He shall not see our last end.

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:5
verses.text: ¶ If thou hast run with the footmen, and they have wearied thee, then how canst thou contend with horses? and <hi type="italic">if</hi> in the land of peace, <hi type="italic">wherein</hi> thou trustedst, <hi type="italic">they wearied thee</hi>, then how wilt thou do in the swelling of Jordan?

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:6
verses.text: For even thy brethren, and the house of thy father, even they have dealt treacherously with thee; yea, they have called a multitude after thee: believe them not, though they speak fair words unto thee.

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:7
verses.text: ¶ I have forsaken mine house, I have left mine heritage; I have given the dearly beloved of my soul into the hand of her enemies.

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:8
verses.text: Mine heritage is unto me as a lion in the forest; it crieth out against me: therefore have I hated it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:9
verses.text: Mine heritage <hi type="italic">is</hi> unto me <hi type="italic">as</hi> a speckled bird, the birds round about <hi type="italic">are</hi> against her; come ye, assemble all the beasts of the field, come to devour.

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:10
verses.text: Many pastors have destroyed my vineyard, they have trodden my portion under foot, they have made my pleasant portion a desolate wilderness.

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:11
verses.text: They have made it desolate, <hi type="italic">and being</hi> desolate it mourneth unto me; the whole land is made desolate, because no man layeth <hi type="italic">it</hi> to heart.

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:12
verses.text: The spoilers are come upon all high places through the wilderness: for the sword of the Lord shall devour from the <hi type="italic">one</hi> end of the land even to the <hi type="italic">other</hi> end of the land: no flesh shall have peace.

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:13
verses.text: They have sown wheat, but shall reap thorns: they have put themselves to pain, <hi type="italic">but</hi> shall not profit: and they shall be ashamed of your revenues because of the fierce anger of the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:14
verses.text: ¶ Thus saith the Lord against all mine evil neighbours, that touch the inheritance which I have caused my people Israel to inherit; Behold, I will pluck them out of their land, and pluck out the house of Judah from among them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:15
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, after that I have plucked them out I will return, and have compassion on them, and will bring them again, every man to his heritage, and every man to his land.

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:16
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, if they will diligently learn the ways of my people, to swear by my name, The Lord liveth; as they taught my people to swear by Baal; then shall they be built in the midst of my people.

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:17
verses.text: But if they will not obey, I will utterly pluck up and destroy that nation, saith the Lord.  <chapter eID="Jer.12"/><div eID="gen825" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:1
verses.text: THUS saith the Lord unto me, Go and get thee a linen girdle, and put it upon thy loins, and put it not in water.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:2
verses.text: So I got a girdle according to the word of the Lord, and put <hi type="italic">it</hi> on my loins.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:3
verses.text: And the word of the Lord came unto me the second time, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:4
verses.text: Take the girdle that thou hast got, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> upon thy loins, and arise, go to Euphrates, and hide it there in a hole of the rock.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:5
verses.text: So I went, and hid it by Euphrates, as the Lord commanded me.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:6
verses.text: And it came to pass after many days, that the Lord said unto me, Arise, go to Euphrates, and take the girdle from thence, which I commanded thee to hide there.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:7
verses.text: Then I went to Euphrates, and digged, and took the girdle from the place where I had hid it: and, behold, the girdle was marred, it was profitable for nothing.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:8
verses.text: Then the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:9
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord, After this manner will I mar the pride of Judah, and the great pride of Jerusalem.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:10
verses.text: This evil people, which refuse to hear my words, which walk in the imagination of their heart, and walk after other gods, to serve them, and to worship them, shall even be as this girdle, which is good for nothing.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:11
verses.text: For as the girdle cleaveth to the loins of a man, so have I caused to cleave unto me the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah, saith the Lord; that they might be unto me for a people, and for a name, and for a praise, and for a glory: but they would not hear.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:12
verses.text: ¶ Therefore thou shalt speak unto them this word; Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, Every bottle shall be filled with wine: and they shall say unto thee, Do we not certainly know that every bottle shall be filled with wine?

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:13
verses.text: Then shalt thou say unto them, Thus saith the Lord, Behold, I will fill all the inhabitants of this land, even the kings that sit upon David’s throne, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, with drunkenness.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:14
verses.text: And I will dash them one against another, even the fathers and the sons together, saith the Lord: I will not pity, nor spare, nor have mercy, but destroy them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:15
verses.text: ¶ Hear ye, and give ear; be not proud: for the Lord hath spoken.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:16
verses.text: Give glory to the Lord your God, before he cause darkness, and before your feet stumble upon the dark mountains, and, while ye look for light, he turn it into the shadow of death, <hi type="italic">and</hi> make <hi type="italic">it</hi> gross darkness.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:17
verses.text: But if ye will not hear it, my soul shall weep in secret places for <hi type="italic">your</hi> pride; and mine eye shall weep sore, and run down with tears, because the Lord’s flock is carried away captive.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:18
verses.text: Say unto the king and to the queen, Humble yourselves, sit down: for your principalities shall come down, <hi type="italic">even</hi> the crown of your glory.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:19
verses.text: The cities of the south shall be shut up, and none shall open <hi type="italic">them:</hi> Judah shall be carried away captive all of it, it shall be wholly carried away captive.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:20
verses.text: Lift up your eyes, and behold them that come from the north: where <hi type="italic">is</hi> the flock <hi type="italic">that</hi> was given thee, thy beautiful flock?

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:21
verses.text: What wilt thou say when he shall punish thee? for thou hast taught them <hi type="italic">to be</hi> captains, <hi type="italic">and</hi> as chief over thee: shall not sorrows take thee, as a woman in travail?

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:22
verses.text: ¶ And if thou say in thine heart, Wherefore come these things upon me? For the greatness of thine iniquity are thy skirts discovered, <hi type="italic">and</hi> thy heels made bare.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:23
verses.text: Can the Ethiopian change his skin, or the leopard his spots? <hi type="italic">then</hi> may ye also do good, that are accustomed to do evil.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:24
verses.text: Therefore will I scatter them as the stubble that passeth away by the wind of the wilderness.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:25
verses.text: This <hi type="italic">is</hi> thy lot, the portion of thy measures from me, saith the Lord; because thou hast forgotten me, and trusted in falsehood.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:26
verses.text: Therefore will I discover thy skirts upon thy face, that thy shame may appear.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:27
verses.text: I have seen thine adulteries, and thy neighings, the lewdness of thy whoredom, <hi type="italic">and</hi> thine abominations on the hills in the fields. Woe unto thee, O Jerusalem! wilt thou not be made clean? when <hi type="italic">shall it</hi> once <hi type="italic">be?</hi>  <chapter eID="Jer.13"/><div eID="gen826" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:1
verses.text: THE word of the Lord that came to Jeremiah concerning the dearth.

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:2
verses.text: Judah mourneth, and the gates thereof languish; they are black unto the ground; and the cry of Jerusalem is gone up.

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:3
verses.text: And their nobles have sent their little ones to the waters: they came to the pits, <hi type="italic">and</hi> found no water; they returned with their vessels empty; they were ashamed and confounded, and covered their heads.

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:4
verses.text: Because the ground is chapt, for there was no rain in the earth, the plowmen were ashamed, they covered their heads.

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:5
verses.text: Yea, the hind also calved in the field, and forsook <hi type="italic">it</hi>, because there was no grass.

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:6
verses.text: And the wild asses did stand in the high places, they snuffed up the wind like dragons; their eyes did fail, because <hi type="italic">there was</hi> no grass.

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:7
verses.text: ¶ O Lord, though our iniquities testify against us, do thou <hi type="italic">it</hi> for thy name’s sake: for our backslidings are many; we have sinned against thee.

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:8
verses.text: O the hope of Israel, the saviour thereof in time of trouble, why shouldest thou be as a stranger in the land, and as a wayfaring man <hi type="italic">that</hi> turneth aside to tarry for a night?

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:9
verses.text: Why shouldest thou be as a man astonied, as a mighty man <hi type="italic">that</hi> cannot save? yet thou, O Lord, <hi type="italic">art</hi> in the midst of us, and we are called by thy name; leave us not.

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:10
verses.text: ¶ Thus saith the Lord unto this people, Thus have they loved to wander, they have not refrained their feet, therefore the Lord doth not accept them; he will now remember their iniquity, and visit their sins.

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:11
verses.text: Then said the Lord unto me, Pray not for this people for <hi type="italic">their</hi> good.

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:12
verses.text: When they fast, I will not hear their cry; and when they offer burnt offering and an oblation, I will not accept them: but I will consume them by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence.

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:13
verses.text: ¶ Then said I, Ah, Lord God! behold, the prophets say unto them, Ye shall not see the sword, neither shall ye have famine; but I will give you assured peace in this place.

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:14
verses.text: Then the Lord said unto me, The prophets prophesy lies in my name: I sent them not, neither have I commanded them, neither spake unto them: they prophesy unto you a false vision and divination, and a thing of nought, and the deceit of their heart.

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:15
verses.text: Therefore thus saith the Lord concerning the prophets that prophesy in my name, and I sent them not, yet they say, Sword and famine shall not be in this land; By sword and famine shall those prophets be consumed.

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:16
verses.text: And the people to whom they prophesy shall be cast out in the streets of Jerusalem because of the famine and the sword; and they shall have none to bury them, them, their wives, nor their sons, nor their daughters: for I will pour their wickedness upon them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:17
verses.text: ¶ Therefore thou shalt say this word unto them; Let mine eyes run down with tears night and day, and let them not cease: for the virgin daughter of my people is broken with a great breach, with a very grievous blow.

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:18
verses.text: If I go forth into the field, then behold the slain with the sword! and if I enter into the city, then behold them that are sick with famine! yea, both the prophet and the priest go about into a land that they know not.

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:19
verses.text: Hast thou utterly rejected Judah? hath thy soul lothed Zion? why hast thou smitten us, and <hi type="italic">there is</hi> no healing for us? we looked for peace, and <hi type="italic">there is</hi> no good; and for the time of healing, and behold trouble!

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:20
verses.text: We acknowledge, O Lord, our wickedness, <hi type="italic">and</hi> the iniquity of our fathers: for we have sinned against thee.

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:21
verses.text: Do not abhor <hi type="italic">us</hi>, for thy name’s sake, do not disgrace the throne of thy glory: remember, break not thy covenant with us.

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:22
verses.text: Are there <hi type="italic">any</hi> among the vanities of the Gentiles that can cause rain? or can the heavens give showers? <hi type="italic">art</hi> not thou he, O Lord our God? therefore we will wait upon thee: for thou hast made all these <hi type="italic">things</hi>.  <chapter eID="Jer.14"/><div eID="gen827" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:1
verses.text: THEN said the Lord unto me, Though Moses and Samuel stood before me, <hi type="italic">yet</hi> my mind <hi type="italic">could</hi> not <hi type="italic">be</hi> toward this people: cast <hi type="italic">them</hi> out of my sight, and let them go forth.

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:2
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, if they say unto thee, Whither shall we go forth? then thou shalt tell them, Thus saith the Lord; Such as <hi type="italic">are</hi> for death, to death; and such as <hi type="italic">are</hi> for the sword, to the sword; and such as <hi type="italic">are</hi> for the famine, to the famine; and such as <hi type="italic">are</hi> for the captivity, to the captivity.

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:3
verses.text: And I will appoint over them four kinds, saith the Lord: the sword to slay, and the dogs to tear, and the fowls of the heaven, and the beasts of the earth, to devour and destroy.

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:4
verses.text: And I will cause them to be removed into all kingdoms of the earth, because of Manasseh the son of Hezekiah king of Judah, for <hi type="italic">that</hi> which he did in Jerusalem.

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:5
verses.text: For who shall have pity upon thee, O Jerusalem? or who shall bemoan thee? or who shall go aside to ask how thou doest?

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:6
verses.text: Thou hast forsaken me, saith the Lord, thou art gone backward: therefore will I stretch out my hand against thee, and destroy thee; I am weary with repenting.

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:7
verses.text: And I will fan them with a fan in the gates of the land; I will bereave <hi type="italic">them</hi> of children, I will destroy my people, <hi type="italic">since</hi> they return not from their ways.

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:8
verses.text: Their widows are increased to me above the sand of the seas: I have brought upon them against the mother of the young men a spoiler at noonday: I have caused <hi type="italic">him</hi> to fall upon it suddenly, and terrors upon the city.

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:9
verses.text: She that hath borne seven languisheth: she hath given up the ghost; her sun is gone down while <hi type="italic">it was</hi> yet day: she hath been ashamed and confounded: and the residue of them will I deliver to the sword before their enemies, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:10
verses.text: ¶ Woe is me, my mother, that thou hast borne me a man of strife and a man of contention to the whole earth! I have neither lent on usury, nor men have lent to me on usury; <hi type="italic">yet</hi> every one of them doth curse me.

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:11
verses.text: The Lord said, Verily it shall be well with thy remnant; verily I will cause the enemy to entreat thee <hi type="italic">well</hi> in the time of evil and in the time of affliction.

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:12
verses.text: Shall iron break the northern iron and the steel?

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:13
verses.text: Thy substance and thy treasures will I give to the spoil without price, and <hi type="italic">that</hi> for all thy sins, even in all thy borders.

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:14
verses.text: And I will make <hi type="italic">thee</hi> to pass with thine enemies into a land <hi type="italic">which</hi> thou knowest not: for a fire is kindled in mine anger, <hi type="italic">which</hi> shall burn upon you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:15
verses.text: ¶ O Lord, thou knowest: remember me, and visit me, and revenge me of my persecutors; take me not away in thy longsuffering: know that for thy sake I have suffered rebuke.

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:16
verses.text: Thy words were found, and I did eat them; and thy word was unto me the joy and rejoicing of mine heart: for I am called by thy name, O Lord God of hosts.

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:17
verses.text: I sat not in the assembly of the mockers, nor rejoiced; I sat alone because of thy hand: for thou hast filled me with indignation.

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:18
verses.text: Why is my pain perpetual, and my wound incurable, <hi type="italic">which</hi> refuseth to be healed? wilt thou be altogether unto me as a liar, <hi type="italic">and as</hi> waters <hi type="italic">that</hi> fail?

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:19
verses.text: ¶ Therefore thus saith the Lord, If thou return, then will I bring thee again, <hi type="italic">and</hi> thou shalt stand before me: and if thou take forth the precious from the vile, thou shalt be as my mouth: let them return unto thee; but return not thou unto them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:20
verses.text: And I will make thee unto this people a fenced brasen wall: and they shall fight against thee, but they shall not prevail against thee: for I <hi type="italic">am</hi> with thee to save thee and to deliver thee, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:21
verses.text: And I will deliver thee out of the hand of the wicked, and I will redeem thee out of the hand of the terrible.  <chapter eID="Jer.15"/><div eID="gen828" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:1
verses.text: THE word of the Lord came also unto me, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:2
verses.text: Thou shalt not take thee a wife, neither shalt thou have sons or daughters in this place.

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:3
verses.text: For thus saith the Lord concerning the sons and concerning the daughters that are born in this place, and concerning their mothers that bare them, and concerning their fathers that begat them in this land;

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:4
verses.text: They shall die of grievous deaths; they shall not be lamented; neither shall they be buried; <hi type="italic">but</hi> they shall be as dung upon the face of the earth: and they shall be consumed by the sword, and by famine; and their carcases shall be meat for the fowls of heaven, and for the beasts of the earth.

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:5
verses.text: For thus saith the Lord, Enter not into the house of mourning, neither go to lament nor bemoan them: for I have taken away my peace from this people, saith the Lord, <hi type="italic">even</hi> lovingkindness and mercies.

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:6
verses.text: Both the great and the small shall die in this land: they shall not be buried, neither shall <hi type="italic">men</hi> lament for them, nor cut themselves, nor make themselves bald for them:

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:7
verses.text: Neither shall <hi type="italic">men</hi> tear <hi type="italic">themselves</hi> for them in mourning, to comfort them for the dead; neither shall <hi type="italic">men</hi> give them the cup of consolation to drink for their father or for their mother.

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:8
verses.text: Thou shalt not also go into the house of feasting, to sit with them to eat and to drink.

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:9
verses.text: For thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will cause to cease out of this place in your eyes, and in your days, the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride.

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:10
verses.text: ¶ And it shall come to pass, when thou shalt shew this people all these words, and they shall say unto thee, Wherefore hath the Lord pronounced all this great evil against us? or what <hi type="italic">is</hi> our iniquity? or what <hi type="italic">is</hi> our sin that we have committed against the Lord our God?

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:11
verses.text: Then shalt thou say unto them, Because your fathers have forsaken me, saith the Lord, and have walked after other gods, and have served them, and have worshipped them, and have forsaken me, and have not kept my law;

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:12
verses.text: And ye have done worse than your fathers; for, behold, ye walk every one after the imagination of his evil heart, that they may not hearken unto me:

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:13
verses.text: Therefore will I cast you out of this land into a land that ye know not, <hi type="italic">neither</hi> ye nor your fathers; and there shall ye serve other gods day and night; where I will not shew you favour.

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:14
verses.text: ¶ Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that it shall no more be said, The Lord liveth, that brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:15
verses.text: But, The Lord liveth, that brought up the children of Israel from the land of the north, and from all the lands whither he had driven them: and I will bring them again into their land that I gave unto their fathers.

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:16
verses.text: ¶ Behold, I will send for many fishers, saith the Lord, and they shall fish them; and after will I send for many hunters, and they shall hunt them from every mountain, and from every hill, and out of the holes of the rocks.

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:17
verses.text: For mine eyes <hi type="italic">are</hi> upon all their ways: they are not hid from my face, neither is their iniquity hid from mine eyes.

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:18
verses.text: And first I will recompense their iniquity and their sin double; because they have defiled my land, they have filled mine inheritance with the carcases of their detestable and abominable things.

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:19
verses.text: O Lord, my strength, and my fortress, and my refuge in the day of affliction, the Gentiles shall come unto thee from the ends of the earth, and shall say, Surely our fathers have inherited lies, vanity, and <hi type="italic">things</hi> wherein <hi type="italic">there is</hi> no profit.

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:20
verses.text: Shall a man make gods unto himself, and they <hi type="italic">are</hi> no gods?

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:21
verses.text: Therefore, behold, I will this once cause them to know, I will cause them to know mine hand and my might; and they shall know that my name <hi type="italic">is</hi> The Lord.  <chapter eID="Jer.16"/><div eID="gen829" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:1
verses.text: THE sin of Judah <hi type="italic">is</hi> written with a pen of iron, <hi type="italic">and</hi> with the point of a diamond: <hi type="italic">it is</hi> graven upon the table of their heart, and upon the horns of your altars;

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:2
verses.text: Whilst their children remember their altars and their groves by the green trees upon the high hills.

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:3
verses.text: O my mountain in the field, I will give thy substance <hi type="italic">and</hi> all thy treasures to the spoil, <hi type="italic">and</hi> thy high places for sin, throughout all thy borders.

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:4
verses.text: And thou, even thyself, shalt discontinue from thine heritage that I gave thee; and I will cause thee to serve thine enemies in the land which thou knowest not: for ye have kindled a fire in mine anger, <hi type="italic">which</hi> shall burn for ever.

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:5
verses.text: ¶ Thus saith the Lord; Cursed <hi type="italic">be</hi> the man that trusteth in man, and maketh flesh his arm, and whose heart departeth from the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:6
verses.text: For he shall be like the heath in the desert, and shall not see when good cometh; but shall inhabit the parched places in the wilderness, <hi type="italic">in</hi> a salt land and not inhabited.

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:7
verses.text: Blessed <hi type="italic">is</hi> the man that trusteth in the Lord, and whose hope the Lord is.

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:8
verses.text: For he shall be as a tree planted by the waters, and <hi type="italic">that</hi> spreadeth out her roots by the river, and shall not see when heat cometh, but her leaf shall be green; and shall not be careful in the year of drought, neither shall cease from yielding fruit.

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:9
verses.text: ¶ The heart <hi type="italic">is</hi> deceitful above all <hi type="italic">things</hi>, and desperately wicked: who can know it?

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:10
verses.text: I the Lord search the heart, <hi type="italic">I</hi> try the reins, even to give every man according to his ways, <hi type="italic">and</hi> according to the fruit of his doings.

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:11
verses.text: <hi type="italic">As</hi> the partridge sitteth <hi type="italic">on eggs</hi>, and hatcheth <hi type="italic">them</hi> not; <hi type="italic">so</hi> he that getteth riches, and not by right, shall leave them in the midst of his days, and at his end shall be a fool.

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:12
verses.text: ¶ A glorious high throne from the beginning <hi type="italic">is</hi> the place of our sanctuary.

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:13
verses.text: O Lord, the hope of Israel, all that forsake thee shall be ashamed, <hi type="italic">and</hi> they that depart from me shall be written in the earth, because they have forsaken the Lord, the fountain of living waters.

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:14
verses.text: Heal me, O Lord, and I shall be healed; save me, and I shall be saved: for thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> my praise.

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:15
verses.text: ¶ Behold, they say unto me, Where <hi type="italic">is</hi> the word of the Lord? let it come now.

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:16
verses.text: As for me, I have not hastened from <hi type="italic">being</hi> a pastor to follow thee: neither have I desired the woeful day; thou knowest: that which came out of my lips was <hi type="italic">right</hi> before thee.

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:17
verses.text: Be not a terror unto me: thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> my hope in the day of evil.

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:18
verses.text: Let them be confounded that persecute me, but let not me be confounded: let them be dismayed, but let not me be dismayed: bring upon them the day of evil, and destroy them with double destruction.

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:19
verses.text: ¶ Thus said the Lord unto me; Go and stand in the gate of the children of the people, whereby the kings of Judah come in, and by the which they go out, and in all the gates of Jerusalem;

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:20
verses.text: And say unto them, Hear ye the word of the Lord, ye kings of Judah, and all Judah, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, that enter in by these gates:

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:21
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord; Take heed to yourselves, and bear no burden on the sabbath day, nor bring <hi type="italic">it</hi> in by the gates of Jerusalem;

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:22
verses.text: Neither carry forth a burden out of your houses on the sabbath day, neither do ye any work, but hallow ye the sabbath day, as I commanded your fathers.

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:23
verses.text: But they obeyed not, neither inclined their ear, but made their neck stiff, that they might not hear, nor receive instruction.

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:24
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, if ye diligently hearken unto me, saith the Lord, to bring in no burden through the gates of this city on the sabbath day, but hallow the sabbath day, to do no work therein;

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:25
verses.text: Then shall there enter into the gates of this city kings and princes sitting upon the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses, they, and their princes, the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem: and this city shall remain for ever.

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:26
verses.text: And they shall come from the cities of Judah, and from the places about Jerusalem, and from the land of Benjamin, and from the plain, and from the mountains, and from the south, bringing burnt offerings, and sacrifices, and meat offerings, and incense, and bringing sacrifices of praise, unto the house of the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:27
verses.text: But if ye will not hearken unto me to hallow the sabbath day, and not to bear a burden, even entering in at the gates of Jerusalem on the sabbath day; then will I kindle a fire in the gates thereof, and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem, and it shall not be quenched.  <chapter eID="Jer.17"/><div eID="gen830" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:1
verses.text: THE word which came to Jeremiah from the Lord, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:2
verses.text: Arise, and go down to the potter’s house, and there I will cause thee to hear my words.

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:3
verses.text: Then I went down to the potter’s house, and, behold, he wrought a work on the wheels.

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:4
verses.text: And the vessel that he made of clay was marred in the hand of the potter: so he made it again another vessel, as seemed good to the potter to make <hi type="italic">it</hi>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:5
verses.text: Then the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:6
verses.text: O house of Israel, cannot I do with you as this potter? saith the Lord. Behold, as the clay <hi type="italic">is</hi> in the potter’s hand, so <hi type="italic">are</hi> ye in mine hand, O house of Israel.

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:7
verses.text: <hi type="italic">At what</hi> instant I shall speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to pluck up, and to pull down, and to destroy <hi type="italic">it;</hi>

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:8
verses.text: If that nation, against whom I have pronounced, turn from their evil, I will repent of the evil that I thought to do unto them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:9
verses.text: And <hi type="italic">at what</hi> instant I shall speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to build and to plant <hi type="italic">it;</hi>

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:10
verses.text: If it do evil in my sight, that it obey not my voice, then I will repent of the good, wherewith I said I would benefit them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:11
verses.text: ¶ Now therefore go to, speak to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying, Thus saith the Lord; Behold, I frame evil against you, and devise a device against you: return ye now every one from his evil way, and make your ways and your doings good.

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:12
verses.text: And they said, There is no hope: but we will walk after our own devices, and we will every one do the imagination of his evil heart.

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:13
verses.text: Therefore thus saith the Lord; Ask ye now among the heathen, who hath heard such things: the virgin of Israel hath done a very horrible thing.

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:14
verses.text: Will <hi type="italic">a man</hi> leave the snow of Lebanon <hi type="italic">which cometh</hi> from the rock of the field? <hi type="italic">or</hi> shall the cold flowing waters that come from another place be forsaken?

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:15
verses.text: Because my people hath forgotten me, they have burned incense to vanity, and they have caused them to stumble in their ways <hi type="italic">from</hi> the ancient paths, to walk in paths, <hi type="italic">in</hi> a way not cast up;

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:16
verses.text: To make their land desolate, <hi type="italic">and</hi> a perpetual hissing; every one that passeth thereby shall be astonished, and wag his head.

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:17
verses.text: I will scatter them as with an east wind before the enemy; I will shew them the back, and not the face, in the day of their calamity.

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:18
verses.text: ¶ Then said they, Come, and let us devise devices against Jeremiah; for the law shall not perish from the priest, nor counsel from the wise, nor the word from the prophet. Come, and let us smite him with the tongue, and let us not give heed to any of his words.

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:19
verses.text: Give heed to me, O Lord, and hearken to the voice of them that contend with me.

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:20
verses.text: Shall evil be recompensed for good? for they have digged a pit for my soul. Remember that I stood before thee to speak good for them, <hi type="italic">and</hi> to turn away thy wrath from them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:21
verses.text: Therefore deliver up their children to the famine, and pour out their <hi type="italic">blood</hi> by the force of the sword; and let their wives be bereaved of their children, and <hi type="italic">be</hi> widows; and let their men be put to death; <hi type="italic">let</hi> their young men <hi type="italic">be</hi> slain by the sword in battle.

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:22
verses.text: Let a cry be heard from their houses, when thou shalt bring a troop suddenly upon them: for they have digged a pit to take me, and hid snares for my feet.

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:23
verses.text: Yet, Lord, thou knowest all their counsel against me to slay <hi type="italic">me:</hi> forgive not their iniquity, neither blot out their sin from thy sight, but let them be overthrown before thee; deal <hi type="italic">thus</hi> with them in the time of thine anger.  <chapter eID="Jer.18"/><div eID="gen831" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:1
verses.text: THUS saith the Lord, Go and get a potter’s earthen bottle, and <hi type="italic">take</hi> of the ancients of the people, and of the ancients of the priests;

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:2
verses.text: And go forth unto the valley of the son of Hinnom, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> by the entry of the east gate, and proclaim there the words that I shall tell thee,

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:3
verses.text: And say, Hear ye the word of the Lord, O kings of Judah, and inhabitants of Jerusalem; Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, the which whosoever heareth, his ears shall tingle.

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:4
verses.text: Because they have forsaken me, and have estranged this place, and have burned incense in it unto other gods, whom neither they nor their fathers have known, nor the kings of Judah, and have filled this place with the blood of innocents;

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:5
verses.text: They have built also the high places of Baal, to burn their sons with fire <hi type="italic">for</hi> burnt offerings unto Baal, which I commanded not, nor spake <hi type="italic">it</hi>, neither came <hi type="italic">it</hi> into my mind:

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:6
verses.text: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that this place shall no more be called Tophet, nor The valley of the son of Hinnom, but The valley of slaughter.

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:7
verses.text: And I will make void the counsel of Judah and Jerusalem in this place; and I will cause them to fall by the sword before their enemies, and by the hands of them that seek their lives: and their carcases will I give to be meat for the fowls of the heaven, and for the beasts of the earth.

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:8
verses.text: And I will make this city desolate, and an hissing; every one that passeth thereby shall be astonished and hiss because of all the plagues thereof.

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:9
verses.text: And I will cause them to eat the flesh of their sons and the flesh of their daughters, and they shall eat every one the flesh of his friend in the siege and straitness, wherewith their enemies, and they that seek their lives, shall straiten them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:10
verses.text: Then shalt thou break the bottle in the sight of the men that go with thee,

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:11
verses.text: And shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Even so will I break this people and this city, as <hi type="italic">one</hi> breaketh a potter’s vessel, that cannot be made whole again: and they shall bury <hi type="italic">them</hi> in Tophet, till <hi type="italic">there be</hi> no place to bury.

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:12
verses.text: Thus will I do unto this place, saith the Lord, and to the inhabitants thereof, and <hi type="italic">even</hi> make this city as Tophet:

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:13
verses.text: And the houses of Jerusalem, and the houses of the kings of Judah, shall be defiled as the place of Tophet, because of all the houses upon whose roofs they have burned incense unto all the host of heaven, and have poured out drink offerings unto other gods.

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:14
verses.text: Then came Jeremiah from Tophet, whither the Lord had sent him to prophesy; and he stood in the court of the Lord’s house; and said to all the people,

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:15
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will bring upon this city and upon all her towns all the evil that I have pronounced against it, because they have hardened their necks, that they might not hear my words.  <chapter eID="Jer.19"/><div eID="gen832" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:1
verses.text: NOW Pashur the son of Immer the priest, who <hi type="italic">was</hi> also chief governor in the house of the Lord, heard that Jeremiah prophesied these things.

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:2
verses.text: Then Pashur smote Jeremiah the prophet, and put him in the stocks that <hi type="italic">were</hi> in the high gate of Benjamin, which <hi type="italic">was</hi> by the house of the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:3
verses.text: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Pashur brought forth Jeremiah out of the stocks. Then said Jeremiah unto him, The Lord hath not called thy name Pashur, but Magor-missabib.

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:4
verses.text: For thus saith the Lord, Behold, I will make thee a terror to thyself, and to all thy friends: and they shall fall by the sword of their enemies, and thine eyes shall behold <hi type="italic">it:</hi> and I will give all Judah into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall carry them captive into Babylon, and shall slay them with the sword.

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:5
verses.text: Moreover I will deliver all the strength of this city, and all the labours thereof, and all the precious things thereof, and all the treasures of the kings of Judah will I give into the hand of their enemies, which shall spoil them, and take them, and carry them to Babylon.

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:6
verses.text: And thou, Pashur, and all that dwell in thine house shall go into captivity: and thou shalt come to Babylon, and there thou shalt die, and shalt be buried there, thou, and all thy friends, to whom thou hast prophesied lies.

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:7
verses.text: ¶ O Lord, thou hast deceived me, and I was deceived: thou art stronger than I, and hast prevailed: I am in derision daily, every one mocketh me.

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:8
verses.text: For since I spake, I cried out, I cried violence and spoil; because the word of the Lord was made a reproach unto me, and a derision, daily.

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:9
verses.text: Then I said, I will not make mention of him, nor speak any more in his name. But <hi type="italic">his word</hi> was in mine heart as a burning fire shut up in my bones, and I was weary with forbearing, and I could not <hi type="italic">stay</hi>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:10
verses.text: ¶ For I heard the defaming of many, fear on every side. Report, <hi type="italic">say they</hi>, and we will report it. All my familiars watched for my halting, <hi type="italic">saying</hi>, Peradventure he will be enticed, and we shall prevail against him, and we shall take our revenge on him.

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:11
verses.text: But the Lord <hi type="italic">is</hi> with me as a mighty terrible one: therefore my persecutors shall stumble, and they shall not prevail: they shall be greatly ashamed; for they shall not prosper: <hi type="italic">their</hi> everlasting confusion shall never be forgotten.

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:12
verses.text: But, O Lord of hosts, that triest the righteous, <hi type="italic">and</hi> seest the reins and the heart, let me see thy vengeance on them: for unto thee have I opened my cause.

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:13
verses.text: Sing unto the Lord, praise ye the Lord: for he hath delivered the soul of the poor from the hand of evildoers.

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:14
verses.text: ¶ Cursed <hi type="italic">be</hi> the day wherein I was born: let not the day wherein my mother bare me be blessed.

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:15
verses.text: Cursed <hi type="italic">be</hi> the man who brought tidings to my father, saying, A man child is born unto thee; making him very glad.

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:16
verses.text: And let that man be as the cities which the Lord overthrew, and repented not: and let him hear the cry in the morning, and the shouting at noontide;

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:17
verses.text: Because he slew me not from the womb; or that my mother might have been my grave, and her womb <hi type="italic">to be</hi> always great <hi type="italic">with me</hi>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:18
verses.text: Wherefore came I forth out of the womb to see labour and sorrow, that my days should be consumed with shame?  <chapter eID="Jer.20"/><div eID="gen833" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:1
verses.text: THE word which came unto Jeremiah from the Lord, when king Zedekiah sent unto him Pashur the son of Melchiah, and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:2
verses.text: Inquire, I pray thee, of the Lord for us; for Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon maketh war against us; if so be that the Lord will deal with us according to all his wondrous works, that he may go up from us.

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:3
verses.text: ¶ Then said Jeremiah unto them, Thus shall ye say to Zedekiah:

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:4
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord God of Israel; Behold, I will turn back the weapons of war that <hi type="italic">are</hi> in your hands, wherewith ye fight against the king of Babylon, and <hi type="italic">against</hi> the Chaldeans, which besiege you without the walls, and I will assemble them into the midst of this city.

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:5
verses.text: And I myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and with a strong arm, even in anger, and in fury, and in great wrath.

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:6
verses.text: And I will smite the inhabitants of this city, both man and beast: they shall die of a great pestilence.

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:7
verses.text: And afterward, saith the Lord, I will deliver Zedekiah king of Judah, and his servants, and the people, and such as are left in this city from the pestilence, from the sword, and from the famine, into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of those that seek their life: and he shall smite them with the edge of the sword; he shall not spare them, neither have pity, nor have mercy.

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:8
verses.text: ¶ And unto this people thou shalt say, Thus saith the Lord; Behold, I set before you the way of life, and the way of death.

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:9
verses.text: He that abideth in this city shall die by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence: but he that goeth out, and falleth to the Chaldeans that besiege you, he shall live, and his life shall be unto him for a prey.

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:10
verses.text: For I have set my face against this city for evil, and not for good, saith the Lord: it shall be given into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall burn it with fire.

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:11
verses.text: ¶ And touching the house of the king of Judah, <hi type="italic">say</hi>, Hear ye the word of the Lord;

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:12
verses.text: O house of David, thus saith the Lord; Execute judgment in the morning, and deliver <hi type="italic">him that is</hi> spoiled out of the hand of the oppressor, lest my fury go out like fire, and burn that none can quench <hi type="italic">it</hi>, because of the evil of your doings.

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:13
verses.text: Behold, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> against thee, O inhabitant of the valley, <hi type="italic">and</hi> rock of the plain, saith the Lord; which say, Who shall come down against us? or who shall enter into our habitations?

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:14
verses.text: But I will punish you according to the fruit of your doings, saith the Lord: and I will kindle a fire in the forest thereof, and it shall devour all things round about it.  <chapter eID="Jer.21"/><div eID="gen834" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:1
verses.text: THUS saith the Lord; Go down to the house of the king of Judah, and speak there this word,

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:2
verses.text: And say, Hear the word of the Lord, O king of Judah, that sittest upon the throne of David, thou, and thy servants, and thy people that enter in by these gates:

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:3
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord; Execute ye judgment and righteousness, and deliver the spoiled out of the hand of the oppressor: and do no wrong, do no violence to the stranger, the fatherless, nor the widow, neither shed innocent blood in this place.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:4
verses.text: For if ye do this thing indeed, then shall there enter in by the gates of this house kings sitting upon the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses, he, and his servants, and his people.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:5
verses.text: But if ye will not hear these words, I swear by myself, saith the Lord, that this house shall become a desolation.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:6
verses.text: For thus saith the Lord unto the king’s house of Judah; Thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> Gilead unto me, <hi type="italic">and</hi> the head of Lebanon: <hi type="italic">yet</hi> surely I will make thee a wilderness, <hi type="italic">and</hi> cities <hi type="italic">which</hi> are not inhabited.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:7
verses.text: And I will prepare destroyers against thee, every one with his weapons: and they shall cut down thy choice cedars, and cast <hi type="italic">them</hi> into the fire.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:8
verses.text: And many nations shall pass by this city, and they shall say every man to his neighbour, Wherefore hath the Lord done thus unto this great city?

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:9
verses.text: Then they shall answer, Because they have forsaken the covenant of the Lord their God, and worshipped other gods, and served them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:10
verses.text: ¶ Weep ye not for the dead, neither bemoan him: <hi type="italic">but</hi> weep sore for him that goeth away: for he shall return no more, nor see his native country.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:11
verses.text: For thus saith the Lord touching Shallum the son of Josiah king of Judah, which reigned instead of Josiah his father, which went forth out of this place; He shall not return thither any more:

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:12
verses.text: But he shall die in the place whither they have led him captive, and shall see this land no more.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:13
verses.text: ¶ Woe unto him that buildeth his house by unrighteousness, and his chambers by wrong; <hi type="italic">that</hi> useth his neighbour’s service without wages, and giveth him not for his work;

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:14
verses.text: That saith, I will build me a wide house and large chambers, and cutteth him out windows; and <hi type="italic">it is</hi> cieled with cedar, and painted with vermilion.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:15
verses.text: Shalt thou reign, because thou closest <hi type="italic">thyself</hi> in cedar? did not thy father eat and drink, and do judgment and justice, <hi type="italic">and</hi> then <hi type="italic">it was</hi> well with him?

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:16
verses.text: He judged the cause of the poor and needy; then <hi type="italic">it was</hi> well <hi type="italic">with him: was</hi> not this to know me? saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:17
verses.text: But thine eyes and thine heart <hi type="italic">are</hi> not but for thy covetousness, and for to shed innocent blood, and for oppression, and for violence, to do <hi type="italic">it</hi>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:18
verses.text: Therefore thus saith the Lord concerning Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah; They shall not lament for him, <hi type="italic">saying</hi>, Ah my brother! or, Ah sister! they shall not lament for him, <hi type="italic">saying</hi>, Ah lord! or, Ah his glory!

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:19
verses.text: He shall be buried with the burial of an ass, drawn and cast forth beyond the gates of Jerusalem.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:20
verses.text: ¶ Go up to Lebanon, and cry; and lift up thy voice in Bashan, and cry from the passages: for all thy lovers are destroyed.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:21
verses.text: I spake unto thee in thy prosperity; <hi type="italic">but</hi> thou saidst, I will not hear. This <hi type="italic">hath been</hi> thy manner from thy youth, that thou obeyedst not my voice.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:22
verses.text: The wind shall eat up all thy pastors, and thy lovers shall go into captivity: surely then shalt thou be ashamed and confounded for all thy wickedness.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:23
verses.text: O inhabitant of Lebanon, that makest thy nest in the cedars, how gracious shalt thou be when pangs come upon thee, the pain as of a woman in travail!

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:24
verses.text: <hi type="italic">As</hi> I live, saith the Lord, though Coniah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah were the signet upon my right hand, yet would I pluck thee thence;

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:25
verses.text: And I will give thee into the hand of them that seek thy life, and into the hand <hi type="italic">of them</hi> whose face thou fearest, even into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of the Chaldeans.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:26
verses.text: And I will cast thee out, and thy mother that bare thee, into another country, where ye were not born; and there shall ye die.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:27
verses.text: But to the land whereunto they desire to return, thither shall they not return.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:28
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Is</hi> this man Coniah a despised broken idol? <hi type="italic">is he</hi> a vessel wherein <hi type="italic">is</hi> no pleasure? wherefore are they cast out, he and his seed, and are cast into a land which they know not?

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:29
verses.text: O earth, earth, earth, hear the word of the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:30
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord, Write ye this man childless, a man <hi type="italic">that</hi> shall not prosper in his days: for no man of his seed shall prosper, sitting upon the throne of David, and ruling any more in Judah.  <chapter eID="Jer.22"/><div eID="gen835" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:1
verses.text: WOE be unto the pastors that destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture! saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:2
verses.text: Therefore thus saith the Lord God of Israel against the pastors that feed my people; Ye have scattered my flock, and driven them away, and have not visited them: behold, I will visit upon you the evil of your doings, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:3
verses.text: And I will gather the remnant of my flock out of all countries whither I have driven them, and will bring them again to their folds; and they shall be fruitful and increase.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:4
verses.text: And I will set up shepherds over them which shall feed them: and they shall fear no more, nor be dismayed, neither shall they be lacking, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:5
verses.text: ¶ Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that I will raise unto David a righteous Branch, and a King shall reign and prosper, and shall execute judgment and justice in the earth.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:6
verses.text: In his days Judah shall be saved, and Israel shall dwell safely: and this <hi type="italic">is</hi> his name whereby he shall be called, THE LORD OUR RIGHTEOUSNESS.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:7
verses.text: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that they shall no more say, The Lord liveth, which brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:8
verses.text: But, The Lord liveth, which brought up and which led the seed of the house of Israel out of the north country, and from all countries whither I had driven them; and they shall dwell in their own land.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:9
verses.text: ¶ Mine heart within me is broken because of the prophets; all my bones shake; I am like a drunken man, and like a man whom wine hath overcome, because of the Lord, and because of the words of his holiness.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:10
verses.text: For the land is full of adulterers; for because of swearing the land mourneth; the pleasant places of the wilderness are dried up, and their course is evil, and their force <hi type="italic">is</hi> not right.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:11
verses.text: For both prophet and priest are profane; yea, in my house have I found their wickedness, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:12
verses.text: Wherefore their way shall be unto them as slippery <hi type="italic">ways</hi> in the darkness: they shall be driven on, and fall therein: for I will bring evil upon them, <hi type="italic">even</hi> the year of their visitation, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:13
verses.text: And I have seen folly in the prophets of Samaria; they prophesied in Baal, and caused my people Israel to err.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:14
verses.text: I have seen also in the prophets of Jerusalem an horrible thing: they commit adultery, and walk in lies: they strengthen also the hands of evildoers, that none doth return from his wickedness: they are all of them unto me as Sodom, and the inhabitants thereof as Gomorrah.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:15
verses.text: Therefore thus saith the Lord of hosts concerning the prophets; Behold, I will feed them with wormwood, and make them drink the water of gall: for from the prophets of Jerusalem is profaneness gone forth into all the land.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:16
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, Hearken not unto the words of the prophets that prophesy unto you: they make you vain: they speak a vision of their own heart, <hi type="italic">and</hi> not out of the mouth of the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:17
verses.text: They say still unto them that despise me, The Lord hath said, Ye shall have peace; and they say unto every one that walketh after the imagination of his own heart, No evil shall come upon you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:18
verses.text: For who hath stood in the counsel of the Lord, and hath perceived and heard his word? who hath marked his word, and heard <hi type="italic">it?</hi>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:19
verses.text: Behold, a whirlwind of the Lord is gone forth in fury, even a grievous whirlwind: it shall fall grievously upon the head of the wicked.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:20
verses.text: The anger of the Lord shall not return, until he have executed, and till he have performed the thoughts of his heart: in the latter days ye shall consider it perfectly.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:21
verses.text: I have not sent these prophets, yet they ran: I have not spoken to them, yet they prophesied.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:22
verses.text: But if they had stood in my counsel, and had caused my people to hear my words, then they should have turned them from their evil way, and from the evil of their doings.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:23
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Am</hi> I a God at hand, saith the Lord, and not a God afar off?

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:24
verses.text: Can any hide himself in secret places that I shall not see him? saith the Lord. Do not I fill heaven and earth? saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:25
verses.text: I have heard what the prophets said, that prophesy lies in my name, saying, I have dreamed, I have dreamed.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:26
verses.text: How long shall <hi type="italic">this</hi> be in the heart of the prophets that prophesy lies? yea, <hi type="italic">they are</hi> prophets of the deceit of their own heart;

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:27
verses.text: Which think to cause my people to forget my name by their dreams which they tell every man to his neighbour, as their fathers have forgotten my name for Baal.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:28
verses.text: The prophet that hath a dream, let him tell a dream; and he that hath my word, let him speak my word faithfully. What <hi type="italic">is</hi> the chaff to the wheat? saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:29
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Is</hi> not my word like as a fire? saith the Lord; and like a hammer <hi type="italic">that</hi> breaketh the rock in pieces?

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:30
verses.text: Therefore, behold, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> against the prophets, saith the Lord, that steal my words every one from his neighbour.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:31
verses.text: Behold, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> against the prophets, saith the Lord, that use their tongues, and say, He saith.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:32
verses.text: Behold, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> against them that prophesy false dreams, saith the Lord, and do tell them, and cause my people to err by their lies, and by their lightness; yet I sent them not, nor commanded them: therefore they shall not profit this people at all, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:33
verses.text: ¶ And when this people, or the prophet, or a priest, shall ask thee, saying, What <hi type="italic">is</hi> the burden of the Lord? thou shalt then say unto them, What burden? I will even forsake you, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:34
verses.text: And <hi type="italic">as for</hi> the prophet, and the priest, and the people, that shall say, The burden of the Lord, I will even punish that man and his house.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:35
verses.text: Thus shall ye say every one to his neighbour, and every one to his brother, What hath the Lord answered? and, What hath the Lord spoken?

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:36
verses.text: And the burden of the Lord shall ye mention no more: for every man’s word shall be his burden; for ye have perverted the words of the living God, of the Lord of hosts our God.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:37
verses.text: Thus shalt thou say to the prophet, What hath the Lord answered thee? and, What hath the Lord spoken?

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:38
verses.text: But since ye say, The burden of the Lord; therefore thus saith the Lord; Because ye say this word, The burden of the Lord, and I have sent unto you, saying, Ye shall not say, The burden of the Lord;

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:39
verses.text: Therefore, behold, I, even I, will utterly forget you, and I will forsake you, and the city that I gave you and your fathers, <hi type="italic">and cast you</hi> out of my presence:

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:40
verses.text: And I will bring an everlasting reproach upon you, and a perpetual shame, which shall not be forgotten.  <chapter eID="Jer.23"/><div eID="gen836" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 24:1
verses.text: THE Lord shewed me, and, behold, two baskets of figs <hi type="italic">were</hi> set before the temple of the Lord, after that Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon had carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, and the princes of Judah, with the carpenters and smiths, from Jerusalem, and had brought them to Babylon.

verses.name: Jeremiah 24:2
verses.text: One basket <hi type="italic">had</hi> very good figs, <hi type="italic">even</hi> like the figs <hi type="italic">that are</hi> first ripe: and the other basket <hi type="italic">had</hi> very naughty figs, which could not be eaten, they were so bad.

verses.name: Jeremiah 24:3
verses.text: Then said the Lord unto me, What seest thou, Jeremiah? And I said, Figs; the good figs, very good; and the evil, very evil, that cannot be eaten, they are so evil.

verses.name: Jeremiah 24:4
verses.text: ¶ Again the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 24:5
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord, the God of Israel; Like these good figs, so will I acknowledge them that are carried away captive of Judah, whom I have sent out of this place into the land of the Chaldeans for <hi type="italic">their</hi> good.

verses.name: Jeremiah 24:6
verses.text: For I will set mine eyes upon them for good, and I will bring them again to this land: and I will build them, and not pull <hi type="italic">them</hi> down; and I will plant them, and not pluck <hi type="italic">them</hi> up.

verses.name: Jeremiah 24:7
verses.text: And I will give them an heart to know me, that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God: for they shall return unto me with their whole heart.

verses.name: Jeremiah 24:8
verses.text: ¶ And as the evil figs, which cannot be eaten, they are so evil; surely thus saith the Lord, So will I give Zedekiah the king of Judah, and his princes, and the residue of Jerusalem, that remain in this land, and them that dwell in the land of Egypt:

verses.name: Jeremiah 24:9
verses.text: And I will deliver them to be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth for <hi type="italic">their</hi> hurt, <hi type="italic">to be</hi> a reproach and a proverb, a taunt and a curse, in all places whither I shall drive them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 24:10
verses.text: And I will send the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, among them, till they be consumed from off the land that I gave unto them and to their fathers.  <chapter eID="Jer.24"/><div eID="gen837" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:1
verses.text: THE word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, that <hi type="italic">was</hi> the first year of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon;

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:2
verses.text: The which Jeremiah the prophet spake unto all the people of Judah, and to all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:3
verses.text: From the thirteenth year of Josiah the son of Amon king of Judah, even unto this day, that <hi type="italic">is</hi> the three and twentieth year, the word of the Lord hath come unto me, and I have spoken unto you, rising early and speaking; but ye have not hearkened.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:4
verses.text: And the Lord hath sent unto you all his servants the prophets, rising early and sending <hi type="italic">them;</hi> but ye have not hearkened, nor inclined your ear to hear.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:5
verses.text: They said, Turn ye again now every one from his evil way, and from the evil of your doings, and dwell in the land that the Lord hath given unto you and to your fathers for ever and ever:

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:6
verses.text: And go not after other gods to serve them, and to worship them, and provoke me not to anger with the works of your hands; and I will do you no hurt.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:7
verses.text: Yet ye have not hearkened unto me, saith the Lord; that ye might provoke me to anger with the works of your hands to your own hurt.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:8
verses.text: ¶ Therefore thus saith the Lord of hosts; Because ye have not heard my words,

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:9
verses.text: Behold, I will send and take all the families of the north, saith the Lord, and Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and will bring them against this land, and against the inhabitants thereof, and against all these nations round about, and will utterly destroy them, and make them an astonishment, and an hissing, and perpetual desolations.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:10
verses.text: Moreover I will take from them the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride, the sound of the millstones, and the light of the candle.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:11
verses.text: And this whole land shall be a desolation, <hi type="italic">and</hi> an astonishment; and these nations shall serve the king of Babylon seventy years.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:12
verses.text: ¶ And it shall come to pass, when seventy years are accomplished, <hi type="italic">that</hi> I will punish the king of Babylon, and that nation, saith the Lord, for their iniquity, and the land of the Chaldeans, and will make it perpetual desolations.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:13
verses.text: And I will bring upon that land all my words which I have pronounced against it, <hi type="italic">even</hi> all that is written in this book, which Jeremiah hath prophesied against all the nations.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:14
verses.text: For many nations and great kings shall serve themselves of them also: and I will recompense them according to their deeds, and according to the works of their own hands.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:15
