verses.text: ¶ For thus saith the Lord God of Israel unto me; Take the wine cup of this fury at my hand, and cause all the nations, to whom I send thee, to drink it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:16
verses.text: And they shall drink, and be moved, and be mad, because of the sword that I will send among them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:17
verses.text: Then took I the cup at the Lord’s hand, and made all the nations to drink, unto whom the Lord had sent me:

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:18
verses.text: <hi type="italic">To wit</hi>, Jerusalem, and the cities of Judah, and the kings thereof, and the princes thereof, to make them a desolation, an astonishment, an hissing, and a curse; as <hi type="italic">it is</hi> this day;

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:19
verses.text: Pharaoh king of Egypt, and his servants, and his princes, and all his people;

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:20
verses.text: And all the mingled people, and all the kings of the land of Uz, and all the kings of the land of the Philistines, and Ashkelon, and Azzah, and Ekron, and the remnant of Ashdod,

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:21
verses.text: Edom, and Moab, and the children of Ammon,

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:22
verses.text: And all the kings of Tyrus, and all the kings of Zidon, and the kings of the isles which <hi type="italic">are</hi> beyond the sea,

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:23
verses.text: Dedan, and Tema, and Buz, and all <hi type="italic">that are</hi> in the utmost corners,

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:24
verses.text: And all the kings of Arabia, and all the kings of the mingled people that dwell in the desert,

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:25
verses.text: And all the kings of Zimri, and all the kings of Elam, and all the kings of the Medes,

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:26
verses.text: And all the kings of the north, far and near, one with another, and all the kingdoms of the world, which <hi type="italic">are</hi> upon the face of the earth: and the king of Sheshach shall drink after them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:27
verses.text: Therefore thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Drink ye, and be drunken, and spue, and fall, and rise no more, because of the sword which I will send among you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:28
verses.text: And it shall be, if they refuse to take the cup at thine hand to drink, then shalt thou say unto them, Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Ye shall certainly drink.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:29
verses.text: For, lo, I begin to bring evil on the city which is called by my name, and should ye be utterly unpunished? Ye shall not be unpunished: for I will call for a sword upon all the inhabitants of the earth, saith the Lord of hosts.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:30
verses.text: Therefore prophesy thou against them all these words, and say unto them, The Lord shall roar from on high, and utter his voice from his holy habitation; he shall mightily roar upon his habitation; he shall give a shout, as they that tread <hi type="italic">the grapes</hi>, against all the inhabitants of the earth.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:31
verses.text: A noise shall come <hi type="italic">even</hi> to the ends of the earth; for the Lord hath a controversy with the nations, he will plead with all flesh; he will give them <hi type="italic">that are</hi> wicked to the sword, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:32
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, Behold, evil shall go forth from nation to nation, and a great whirlwind shall be raised up from the coasts of the earth.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:33
verses.text: And the slain of the Lord shall be at that day from <hi type="italic">one</hi> end of the earth even unto the <hi type="italic">other</hi> end of the earth: they shall not be lamented, neither gathered, nor buried; they shall be dung upon the ground.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:34
verses.text: ¶ Howl, ye shepherds, and cry; and wallow yourselves <hi type="italic">in the ashes</hi>, ye principal of the flock: for the days of your slaughter and of your dispersions are accomplished; and ye shall fall like a pleasant vessel.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:35
verses.text: And the shepherds shall have no way to flee, nor the principal of the flock to escape.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:36
verses.text: A voice of the cry of the shepherds, and an howling of the principal of the flock, <hi type="italic">shall be heard:</hi> for the Lord hath spoiled their pasture.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:37
verses.text: And the peaceable habitations are cut down because of the fierce anger of the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:38
verses.text: He hath forsaken his covert, as the lion: for their land is desolate because of the fierceness of the oppressor, and because of his fierce anger.  <chapter eID="Jer.25"/><div eID="gen838" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:1
verses.text: IN the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah came this word from the Lord, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:2
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord; Stand in the court of the Lord’s house, and speak unto all the cities of Judah, which come to worship in the Lord’s house, all the words that I command thee to speak unto them; diminish not a word:

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:3
verses.text: If so be they will hearken, and turn every man from his evil way, that I may repent me of the evil, which I purpose to do unto them because of the evil of their doings.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:4
verses.text: And thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord; If ye will not hearken to me, to walk in my law, which I have set before you,

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:5
verses.text: To hearken to the words of my servants the prophets, whom I sent unto you, both rising up early, and sending <hi type="italic">them</hi>, but ye have not hearkened;

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:6
verses.text: Then will I make this house like Shiloh, and will make this city a curse to all the nations of the earth.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:7
verses.text: So the priests and the prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in the house of the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:8
verses.text: ¶ Now it came to pass, when Jeremiah had made an end of speaking all that the Lord had commanded <hi type="italic">him</hi> to speak unto all the people, that the priests and the prophets and all the people took him, saying, Thou shalt surely die.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:9
verses.text: Why hast thou prophesied in the name of the Lord, saying, This house shall be like Shiloh, and this city shall be desolate without an inhabitant? And all the people were gathered against Jeremiah in the house of the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:10
verses.text: ¶ When the princes of Judah heard these things, then they came up from the king’s house unto the house of the Lord, and sat down in the entry of the new gate of the Lord’s <hi type="italic">house</hi>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:11
verses.text: Then spake the priests and the prophets unto the princes and to all the people, saying, This man <hi type="italic">is</hi> worthy to die; for he hath prophesied against this city, as ye have heard with your ears.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:12
verses.text: ¶ Then spake Jeremiah unto all the princes and to all the people, saying, The Lord sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city all the words that ye have heard.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:13
verses.text: Therefore now amend your ways and your doings, and obey the voice of the Lord your God; and the Lord will repent him of the evil that he hath pronounced against you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:14
verses.text: As for me, behold, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> in your hand: do with me as seemeth good and meet unto you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:15
verses.text: But know ye for certain, that if ye put me to death, ye shall surely bring innocent blood upon yourselves, and upon this city, and upon the inhabitants thereof: for of a truth the Lord hath sent me unto you to speak all these words in your ears.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:16
verses.text: ¶ Then said the princes and all the people unto the priests and to the prophets; This man <hi type="italic">is</hi> not worthy to die: for he hath spoken to us in the name of the Lord our God.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:17
verses.text: Then rose up certain of the elders of the land, and spake to all the assembly of the people, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:18
verses.text: Micah the Morasthite prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and spake to all the people of Judah, saying, Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Zion shall be plowed <hi type="italic">like</hi> a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps, and the mountain of the house as the high places of a forest.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:19
verses.text: Did Hezekiah king of Judah and all Judah put him at all to death? did he not fear the Lord, and besought the Lord, and the Lord repented him of the evil which he had pronounced against them? Thus might we procure great evil against our souls.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:20
verses.text: And there was also a man that prophesied in the name of the Lord, Urijah the son of Shemaiah of Kirjath-jearim, who prophesied against this city and against this land according to all the words of Jeremiah:

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:21
verses.text: And when Jehoiakim the king, with all his mighty men, and all the princes, heard his words, the king sought to put him to death: but when Urijah heard it, he was afraid, and fled, and went into Egypt;

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:22
verses.text: And Jehoiakim the king sent men into Egypt, <hi type="italic">namely</hi>, Elnathan the son of Achbor, and <hi type="italic">certain</hi> men with him into Egypt.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:23
verses.text: And they fetched forth Urijah out of Egypt, and brought him unto Jehoiakim the king; who slew him with the sword, and cast his dead body into the graves of the common people.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:24
verses.text: Nevertheless the hand of Ahikam the son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah, that they should not give him into the hand of the people to put him to death.  <chapter eID="Jer.26"/><div eID="gen839" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:1
verses.text: IN the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah came this word unto Jeremiah from the Lord, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:2
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord to me; Make thee bonds and yokes, and put them upon thy neck,

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:3
verses.text: And send them to the king of Edom, and to the king of Moab, and to the king of the Ammonites, and to the king of Tyrus, and to the king of Zidon, by the hand of the messengers which come to Jerusalem unto Zedekiah king of Judah;

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:4
verses.text: And command them to say unto their masters, Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Thus shall ye say unto your masters;

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:5
verses.text: I have made the earth, the man and the beast that <hi type="italic">are</hi> upon the ground, by my great power and by my outstretched arm, and have given it unto whom it seemed meet unto me.

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:6
verses.text: And now have I given all these lands into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant; and the beasts of the field have I given him also to serve him.

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:7
verses.text: And all nations shall serve him, and his son, and his son’s son, until the very time of his land come: and then many nations and great kings shall serve themselves of him.

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:8
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, <hi type="italic">that</hi> the nation and kingdom which will not serve the same Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, and that will not put their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, that nation will I punish, saith the Lord, with the sword, and with the famine, and with the pestilence, until I have consumed them by his hand.

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:9
verses.text: Therefore hearken not ye to your prophets, nor to your diviners, nor to your dreamers, nor to your enchanters, nor to your sorcerers, which speak unto you, saying, Ye shall not serve the king of Babylon:

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:10
verses.text: For they prophesy a lie unto you, to remove you far from your land; and that I should drive you out, and ye should perish.

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:11
verses.text: But the nations that bring their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him, those will I let remain still in their own land, saith the Lord; and they shall till it, and dwell therein.

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:12
verses.text: ¶ I spake also to Zedekiah king of Judah according to all these words, saying, Bring your necks under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him and his people, and live.

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:13
verses.text: Why will ye die, thou and thy people, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, as the Lord hath spoken against the nation that will not serve the king of Babylon?

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:14
verses.text: Therefore hearken not unto the words of the prophets that speak unto you, saying, Ye shall not serve the king of Babylon: for they prophesy a lie unto you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:15
verses.text: For I have not sent them, saith the Lord, yet they prophesy a lie in my name; that I might drive you out, and that ye might perish, ye, and the prophets that prophesy unto you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:16
verses.text: Also I spake to the priests and to all this people, saying, Thus saith the Lord; Hearken not to the words of your prophets that prophesy unto you, saying, Behold, the vessels of the Lord’s house shall now shortly be brought again from Babylon: for they prophesy a lie unto you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:17
verses.text: Hearken not unto them; serve the king of Babylon, and live: wherefore should this city be laid waste?

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:18
verses.text: But if they <hi type="italic">be</hi> prophets, and if the word of the Lord be with them, let them now make intercession to the Lord of hosts, that the vessels which are left in the house of the Lord, and <hi type="italic">in</hi> the house of the king of Judah, and at Jerusalem, go not to Babylon.

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:19
verses.text: ¶ For thus saith the Lord of hosts concerning the pillars, and concerning the sea, and concerning the bases, and concerning the residue of the vessels that remain in this city,

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:20
verses.text: Which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took not, when he carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah from Jerusalem to Babylon, and all the nobles of Judah and Jerusalem;

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:21
verses.text: Yea, thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, concerning the vessels that remain <hi type="italic">in</hi> the house of the Lord, and <hi type="italic">in</hi> the house of the king of Judah and of Jerusalem;

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:22
verses.text: They shall be carried to Babylon, and there shall they be until the day that I visit them, saith the Lord; then will I bring them up, and restore them to this place.  <chapter eID="Jer.27"/><div eID="gen840" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:1
verses.text: AND it came to pass the same year, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the fourth year, <hi type="italic">and</hi> in the fifth month, <hi type="italic">that</hi> Hananiah the son of Azur the prophet, which <hi type="italic">was</hi> of Gibeon, spake unto me in the house of the Lord, in the presence of the priests and of all the people, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:2
verses.text: Thus speaketh the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, saying, I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:3
verses.text: Within two full years will I bring again into this place all the vessels of the Lord’s house, that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took away from this place, and carried them to Babylon:

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:4
verses.text: And I will bring again to this place Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, with all the captives of Judah, that went into Babylon, saith the Lord: for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:5
verses.text: ¶ Then the prophet Jeremiah said unto the prophet Hananiah in the presence of the priests, and in the presence of all the people that stood in the house of the Lord,

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:6
verses.text: Even the prophet Jeremiah said, Amen: the Lord do so: the Lord perform thy words which thou hast prophesied, to bring again the vessels of the Lord’s house, and all that is carried away captive, from Babylon into this place.

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:7
verses.text: Nevertheless hear thou now this word that I speak in thine ears, and in the ears of all the people;

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:8
verses.text: The prophets that have been before me and before thee of old prophesied both against many countries, and against great kingdoms, of war, and of evil, and of pestilence.

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:9
verses.text: The prophet which prophesieth of peace, when the word of the prophet shall come to pass, <hi type="italic">then</hi> shall the prophet be known, that the Lord hath truly sent him.

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:10
verses.text: ¶ Then Hananiah the prophet took the yoke from off the prophet Jeremiah’s neck, and brake it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:11
verses.text: And Hananiah spake in the presence of all the people, saying, Thus saith the Lord; Even so will I break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon from the neck of all nations within the space of two full years. And the prophet Jeremiah went his way.

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:12
verses.text: ¶ Then the word of the Lord came unto Jeremiah <hi type="italic">the prophet</hi>, after that Hananiah the prophet had broken the yoke from off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:13
verses.text: Go and tell Hananiah, saying, Thus saith the Lord; Thou hast broken the yokes of wood; but thou shalt make for them yokes of iron.

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:14
verses.text: For thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; I have put a yoke of iron upon the neck of all these nations, that they may serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; and they shall serve him: and I have given him the beasts of the field also.

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:15
verses.text: ¶ Then said the prophet Jeremiah unto Hananiah the prophet, Hear now, Hananiah; The Lord hath not sent thee; but thou makest this people to trust in a lie.

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:16
verses.text: Therefore thus saith the Lord; Behold, I will cast thee from off the face of the earth: this year thou shalt die, because thou hast taught rebellion against the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:17
verses.text: So Hananiah the prophet died the same year in the seventh month.  <chapter eID="Jer.28"/><div eID="gen841" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:1
verses.text: NOW these <hi type="italic">are</hi> the words of the letter that Jeremiah the prophet sent from Jerusalem unto the residue of the elders which were carried away captives, and to the priests, and to the prophets, and to all the people whom Nebuchadnezzar had carried away captive from Jerusalem to Babylon;

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:2
verses.text: (After that Jeconiah the king, and the queen, and the eunuchs, the princes of Judah and Jerusalem, and the carpenters, and the smiths, were departed from Jerusalem;)

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:3
verses.text: By the hand of Elasah the son of Shaphan, and Gemariah the son of Hilkiah, (whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent unto Babylon to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon) saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:4
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, unto all that are carried away captives, whom I have caused to be carried away from Jerusalem unto Babylon;

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:5
verses.text: Build ye houses, and dwell <hi type="italic">in them;</hi> and plant gardens, and eat the fruit of them;

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:6
verses.text: Take ye wives, and beget sons and daughters; and take wives for your sons, and give your daughters to husbands, that they may bear sons and daughters; that ye may be increased there, and not diminished.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:7
verses.text: And seek the peace of the city whither I have caused you to be carried away captives, and pray unto the Lord for it: for in the peace thereof shall ye have peace.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:8
verses.text: ¶ For thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Let not your prophets and your diviners, that <hi type="italic">be</hi> in the midst of you, deceive you, neither hearken to your dreams which ye cause to be dreamed.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:9
verses.text: For they prophesy falsely unto you in my name: I have not sent them, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:10
verses.text: ¶ For thus saith the Lord, That after seventy years be accomplished at Babylon I will visit you, and perform my good word toward you, in causing you to return to this place.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:11
verses.text: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the Lord, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:12
verses.text: Then shall ye call upon me, and ye shall go and pray unto me, and I will hearken unto you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:13
verses.text: And ye shall seek me, and find <hi type="italic">me</hi>, when ye shall search for me with all your heart.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:14
verses.text: And I will be found of you, saith the Lord: and I will turn away your captivity, and I will gather you from all the nations, and from all the places whither I have driven you, saith the Lord; and I will bring you again into the place whence I caused you to be carried away captive.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:15
verses.text: ¶ Because ye have said, The Lord hath raised us up prophets in Babylon;

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:16
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Know</hi> that thus saith the Lord of the king that sitteth upon the throne of David, and of all the people that dwelleth in this city, <hi type="italic">and</hi> of your brethren that are not gone forth with you into captivity;

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:17
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Behold, I will send upon them the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, and will make them like vile figs, that cannot be eaten, they are so evil.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:18
verses.text: And I will persecute them with the sword, with the famine, and with the pestilence, and will deliver them to be removed to all the kingdoms of the earth, to be a curse, and an astonishment, and an hissing, and a reproach, among all the nations whither I have driven them:

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:19
verses.text: Because they have not hearkened to my words, saith the Lord, which I sent unto them by my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending <hi type="italic">them;</hi> but ye would not hear, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:20
verses.text: ¶ Hear ye therefore the word of the Lord, all ye of the captivity, whom I have sent from Jerusalem to Babylon:

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:21
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, of Ahab the son of Kolaiah, and of Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah, which prophesy a lie unto you in my name; Behold, I will deliver them into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon; and he shall slay them before your eyes;

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:22
verses.text: And of them shall be taken up a curse by all the captivity of Judah which <hi type="italic">are</hi> in Babylon, saying, The Lord make thee like Zedekiah and like Ahab, whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire;

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:23
verses.text: Because they have committed villany in Israel, and have committed adultery with their neighbours’ wives, and have spoken lying words in my name, which I have not commanded them; even I know, and <hi type="italic">am</hi> a witness, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:24
verses.text: ¶ <hi type="italic">Thus</hi> shalt thou also speak to Shemaiah the Nehelamite, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:25
verses.text: Thus speaketh the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, saying, Because thou hast sent letters in thy name unto all the people that <hi type="italic">are</hi> at Jerusalem, and to Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest, and to all the priests, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:26
verses.text: The Lord hath made thee priest in the stead of Jehoiada the priest, that ye should be officers in the house of the Lord, for every man <hi type="italic">that is</hi> mad, and maketh himself a prophet, that thou shouldest put him in prison, and in the stocks.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:27
verses.text: Now therefore why hast thou not reproved Jeremiah of Anathoth, which maketh himself a prophet to you?

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:28
verses.text: For therefore he sent unto us <hi type="italic">in</hi> Babylon, saying, This <hi type="italic">captivity is</hi> long: build ye houses, and dwell <hi type="italic">in them;</hi> and plant gardens, and eat the fruit of them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:29
verses.text: And Zephaniah the priest read this letter in the ears of Jeremiah the prophet.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:30
verses.text: ¶ Then came the word of the Lord unto Jeremiah, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:31
verses.text: Send to all them of the captivity, saying, Thus saith the Lord concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite; Because that Shemaiah hath prophesied unto you, and I sent him not, and he caused you to trust in a lie:

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:32
verses.text: Therefore thus saith the Lord; Behold, I will punish Shemaiah the Nehelamite, and his seed: he shall not have a man to dwell among this people; neither shall he behold the good that I will do for my people, saith the Lord; because he hath taught rebellion against the Lord.  <chapter eID="Jer.29"/><div eID="gen842" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:1
verses.text: THE word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:2
verses.text: Thus speaketh the Lord God of Israel, saying, Write thee all the words that I have spoken unto thee in a book.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:3
verses.text: For, lo, the days come, saith the Lord, that I will bring again the captivity of my people Israel and Judah, saith the Lord: and I will cause them to return to the land that I gave to their fathers, and they shall possess it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:4
verses.text: ¶ And these <hi type="italic">are</hi> the words that the Lord spake concerning Israel and concerning Judah.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:5
verses.text: For thus saith the Lord; We have heard a voice of trembling, of fear, and not of peace.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:6
verses.text: Ask ye now, and see whether a man doth travail with child? wherefore do I see every man with his hands on his loins, as a woman in travail, and all faces are turned into paleness?

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:7
verses.text: Alas! for that day <hi type="italic">is</hi> great, so that none <hi type="italic">is</hi> like it: it <hi type="italic">is</hi> even the time of Jacob’s trouble; but he shall be saved out of it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:8
verses.text: For it shall come to pass in that day, saith the Lord of hosts, <hi type="italic">that</hi> I will break his yoke from off thy neck, and will burst thy bonds, and strangers shall no more serve themselves of him:

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:9
verses.text: But they shall serve the Lord their God, and David their king, whom I will raise up unto them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:10
verses.text: ¶ Therefore fear thou not, O my servant Jacob, saith the Lord; neither be dismayed, O Israel: for, lo, I will save thee from afar, and thy seed from the land of their captivity; and Jacob shall return, and shall be in rest, and be quiet, and none shall make <hi type="italic">him</hi> afraid.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:11
verses.text: For I <hi type="italic">am</hi> with thee, saith the Lord, to save thee: though I make a full end of all nations whither I have scattered thee, yet will I not make a full end of thee: but I will correct thee in measure, and will not leave thee altogether unpunished.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:12
verses.text: For thus saith the Lord, Thy bruise <hi type="italic">is</hi> incurable, <hi type="italic">and</hi> thy wound <hi type="italic">is</hi> grievous.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:13
verses.text: <hi type="italic">There is</hi> none to plead thy cause, that thou mayest be bound up: thou hast no healing medicines.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:14
verses.text: All thy lovers have forgotten thee; they seek thee not; for I have wounded thee with the wound of an enemy, with the chastisement of a cruel one, for the multitude of thine iniquity; <hi type="italic">because</hi> thy sins were increased.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:15
verses.text: Why criest thou for thine affliction? thy sorrow <hi type="italic">is</hi> incurable for the multitude of thine iniquity: <hi type="italic">because</hi> thy sins were increased, I have done these things unto thee.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:16
verses.text: Therefore all they that devour thee shall be devoured; and all thine adversaries, every one of them, shall go into captivity; and they that spoil thee shall be a spoil, and all that prey upon thee will I give for a prey.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:17
verses.text: For I will restore health unto thee, and I will heal thee of thy wounds, saith the Lord; because they called thee an Outcast, <hi type="italic">saying</hi>, This <hi type="italic">is</hi> Zion, whom no man seeketh after.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:18
verses.text: ¶ Thus saith the Lord; Behold, I will bring again the captivity of Jacob’s tents, and have mercy on his dwellingplaces; and the city shall be builded upon her own heap, and the palace shall remain after the manner thereof.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:19
verses.text: And out of them shall proceed thanksgiving and the voice of them that make merry: and I will multiply them, and they shall not be few; I will also glorify them, and they shall not be small.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:20
verses.text: Their children also shall be as aforetime, and their congregation shall be established before me, and I will punish all that oppress them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:21
verses.text: And their nobles shall be of themselves, and their governor shall proceed from the midst of them; and I will cause him to draw near, and he shall approach unto me: for who <hi type="italic">is</hi> this that engaged his heart to approach unto me? saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:22
verses.text: And ye shall be my people, and I will be your God.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:23
verses.text: Behold, the whirlwind of the Lord goeth forth with fury, a continuing whirlwind: it shall fall with pain upon the head of the wicked.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:24
verses.text: The fierce anger of the Lord shall not return, until he have done <hi type="italic">it</hi>, and until he have performed the intents of his heart: in the latter days ye shall consider it.  <chapter eID="Jer.30"/><div eID="gen843" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:1
verses.text: AT the same time, saith the Lord, will I be the God of all the families of Israel, and they shall be my people.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:2
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord, The people <hi type="italic">which were</hi> left of the sword found grace in the wilderness; <hi type="italic">even</hi> Israel, when I went to cause him to rest.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:3
verses.text: The Lord hath appeared of old unto me, <hi type="italic">saying</hi>, Yea, I have loved thee with an everlasting love: therefore with lovingkindness have I drawn thee.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:4
verses.text: Again I will build thee, and thou shalt be built, O virgin of Israel: thou shalt again be adorned with thy tabrets, and shalt go forth in the dances of them that make merry.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:5
verses.text: Thou shalt yet plant vines upon the mountains of Samaria: the planters shall plant, and shall eat <hi type="italic">them</hi> as common things.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:6
verses.text: For there shall be a day, <hi type="italic">that</hi> the watchmen upon the mount Ephraim shall cry, Arise ye, and let us go up to Zion unto the Lord our God.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:7
verses.text: For thus saith the Lord; Sing with gladness for Jacob, and shout among the chief of the nations: publish ye, praise ye, and say, O Lord, save thy people, the remnant of Israel.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:8
verses.text: Behold, I will bring them from the north country, and gather them from the coasts of the earth, <hi type="italic">and</hi> with them the blind and the lame, the woman with child and her that travaileth with child together: a great company shall return thither.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:9
verses.text: They shall come with weeping, and with supplications will I lead them: I will cause them to walk by the rivers of waters in a straight way, wherein they shall not stumble: for I am a father to Israel, and Ephraim <hi type="italic">is</hi> my firstborn.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:10
verses.text: ¶ Hear the word of the Lord, O ye nations, and declare <hi type="italic">it</hi> in the isles afar off, and say, He that scattered Israel will gather him, and keep him, as a shepherd <hi type="italic">doth</hi> his flock.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:11
verses.text: For the Lord hath redeemed Jacob, and ransomed him from the hand of <hi type="italic">him that was</hi> stronger than he.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:12
verses.text: Therefore they shall come and sing in the height of Zion, and shall flow together to the goodness of the Lord, for wheat, and for wine, and for oil, and for the young of the flock and of the herd: and their soul shall be as a watered garden; and they shall not sorrow any more at all.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:13
verses.text: Then shall the virgin rejoice in the dance, both young men and old together: for I will turn their mourning into joy, and will comfort them, and make them rejoice from their sorrow.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:14
verses.text: And I will satiate the soul of the priests with fatness, and my people shall be satisfied with my goodness, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:15
verses.text: ¶ Thus saith the Lord; A voice was heard in Ramah, lamentation, <hi type="italic">and</hi> bitter weeping; Rahel weeping for her children refused to be comforted for her children, because they <hi type="italic">were</hi> not.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:16
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord; Refrain thy voice from weeping, and thine eyes from tears: for thy work shall be rewarded, saith the Lord; and they shall come again from the land of the enemy.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:17
verses.text: And there is hope in thine end, saith the Lord, that thy children shall come again to their own border.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:18
verses.text: ¶ I have surely heard Ephraim bemoaning himself <hi type="italic">thus;</hi> Thou hast chastised me, and I was chastised, as a bullock unaccustomed <hi type="italic">to the yoke:</hi> turn thou me, and I shall be turned; for thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> the Lord my God.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:19
verses.text: Surely after that I was turned, I repented; and after that I was instructed, I smote upon <hi type="italic">my</hi> thigh: I was ashamed, yea, even confounded, because I did bear the reproach of my youth.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:20
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Is</hi> Ephraim my dear son? <hi type="italic">is he</hi> a pleasant child? for since I spake against him, I do earnestly remember him still: therefore my bowels are troubled for him; I will surely have mercy upon him, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:21
verses.text: Set thee up waymarks, make thee high heaps: set thine heart toward the highway, <hi type="italic">even</hi> the way <hi type="italic">which</hi> thou wentest: turn again, O virgin of Israel, turn again to these thy cities.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:22
verses.text: ¶ How long wilt thou go about, O thou backsliding daughter? for the Lord hath created a new thing in the earth, A woman shall compass a man.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:23
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; As yet they shall use this speech in the land of Judah and in the cities thereof, when I shall bring again their captivity; The Lord bless thee, O habitation of justice, <hi type="italic">and</hi> mountain of holiness.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:24
verses.text: And there shall dwell in Judah itself, and in all the cities thereof together, husbandmen, and they <hi type="italic">that</hi> go forth with flocks.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:25
verses.text: For I have satiated the weary soul, and I have replenished every sorrowful soul.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:26
verses.text: Upon this I awaked, and beheld; and my sleep was sweet unto me.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:27
verses.text: ¶ Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that I will sow the house of Israel and the house of Judah with the seed of man, and with the seed of beast.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:28
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, <hi type="italic">that</hi> like as I have watched over them, to pluck up, and to break down, and to throw down, and to destroy, and to afflict; so will I watch over them, to build, and to plant, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:29
verses.text: In those days they shall say no more, The fathers have eaten a sour grape, and the children’s teeth are set on edge.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:30
verses.text: But every one shall die for his own iniquity: every man that eateth the sour grape, his teeth shall be set on edge.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:31
verses.text: ¶ Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel, and with the house of Judah:

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:32
verses.text: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day <hi type="italic">that</hi> I took them by the hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt; which my covenant they brake, although I was an husband unto them, saith the Lord:

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:33
verses.text: But this <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel; After those days, saith the Lord, I will put my law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts; and will be their God, and they shall be my people.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:34
verses.text: And they shall teach no more every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know the Lord: for they shall all know me, from the least of them unto the greatest of them, saith the Lord: for I will forgive their iniquity, and I will remember their sin no more.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:35
verses.text: ¶ Thus saith the Lord, which giveth the sun for a light by day, <hi type="italic">and</hi> the ordinances of the moon and of the stars for a light by night, which divideth the sea when the waves thereof roar; The Lord of hosts <hi type="italic">is</hi> his name:

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:36
verses.text: If those ordinances depart from before me, saith the Lord, <hi type="italic">then</hi> the seed of Israel also shall cease from being a nation before me for ever.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:37
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord; If heaven above can be measured, and the foundations of the earth searched out beneath, I will also cast off all the seed of Israel for all that they have done, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:38
verses.text: ¶ Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that the city shall be built to the Lord from the tower of Hananeel unto the gate of the corner.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:39
verses.text: And the measuring line shall yet go forth over against it upon the hill Gareb, and shall compass about to Goath.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:40
verses.text: And the whole valley of the dead bodies, and of the ashes, and all the fields unto the brook of Kidron, unto the corner of the horse gate toward the east, <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> holy unto the Lord; it shall not be plucked up, nor thrown down any more for ever.  <chapter eID="Jer.31"/><div eID="gen844" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:1
verses.text: THE word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord in the tenth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, which <hi type="italic">was</hi> the eighteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:2
verses.text: For then the king of Babylon’s army besieged Jerusalem: and Jeremiah the prophet was shut up in the court of the prison, which <hi type="italic">was</hi> in the king of Judah’s house.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:3
verses.text: For Zedekiah king of Judah had shut him up, saying, Wherefore dost thou prophesy, and say, Thus saith the Lord, Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall take it;

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:4
verses.text: And Zedekiah king of Judah shall not escape out of the hand of the Chaldeans, but shall surely be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon, and shall speak with him mouth to mouth, and his eyes shall behold his eyes;

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:5
verses.text: And he shall lead Zedekiah to Babylon, and there shall he be until I visit him, saith the Lord: though ye fight with the Chaldeans, ye shall not prosper?

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:6
verses.text: ¶ And Jeremiah said, The word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:7
verses.text: Behold, Hanameel the son of Shallum thine uncle shall come unto thee, saying, Buy thee my field that <hi type="italic">is</hi> in Anathoth: for the right of redemption <hi type="italic">is</hi> thine to buy <hi type="italic">it</hi>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:8
verses.text: So Hanameel mine uncle’s son came to me in the court of the prison according to the word of the Lord, and said unto me, Buy my field, I pray thee, that <hi type="italic">is</hi> in Anathoth, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> in the country of Benjamin: for the right of inheritance <hi type="italic">is</hi> thine, and the redemption <hi type="italic">is</hi> thine; buy <hi type="italic">it</hi> for thyself. Then I knew that this <hi type="italic">was</hi> the word of the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:9
verses.text: And I bought the field of Hanameel my uncle’s son, that <hi type="italic">was</hi> in Anathoth, and weighed him the money, <hi type="italic">even</hi> seventeen shekels of silver.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:10
verses.text: And I subscribed the evidence, and sealed <hi type="italic">it</hi>, and took witnesses, and weighed <hi type="italic">him</hi> the money in the balances.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:11
verses.text: So I took the evidence of the purchase, <hi type="italic">both</hi> that which was sealed <hi type="italic">according</hi> to the law and custom, and that which was open:

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:12
verses.text: And I gave the evidence of the purchase unto Baruch the son of Neriah, the son of Maaseiah, in the sight of Hanameel mine uncle’s <hi type="italic">son</hi>, and in the presence of the witnesses that subscribed the book of the purchase, before all the Jews that sat in the court of the prison.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:13
verses.text: ¶ And I charged Baruch before them, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:14
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Take these evidences, this evidence of the purchase, both which is sealed, and this evidence which is open; and put them in an earthen vessel, that they may continue many days.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:15
verses.text: For thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Houses and fields and vineyards shall be possessed again in this land.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:16
verses.text: ¶ Now when I had delivered the evidence of the purchase unto Baruch the son of Neriah, I prayed unto the Lord, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:17
verses.text: Ah Lord God! behold, thou hast made the heaven and the earth by thy great power and stretched out arm, <hi type="italic">and</hi> there is nothing too hard for thee:

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:18
verses.text: Thou shewest lovingkindness unto thousands, and recompensest the iniquity of the fathers into the bosom of their children after them: the Great, the Mighty God, the Lord of hosts, <hi type="italic">is</hi> his name,

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:19
verses.text: Great in counsel, and mighty in work: for thine eyes <hi type="italic">are</hi> open upon all the ways of the sons of men: to give every one according to his ways, and according to the fruit of his doings:

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:20
verses.text: Which hast set signs and wonders in the land of Egypt, <hi type="italic">even</hi> unto this day, and in Israel, and among <hi type="italic">other</hi> men; and hast made thee a name, as at this day;

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:21
verses.text: And hast brought forth thy people Israel out of the land of Egypt with signs, and with wonders, and with a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with great terror;

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:22
verses.text: And hast given them this land, which thou didst swear to their fathers to give them, a land flowing with milk and honey;

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:23
verses.text: And they came in, and possessed it; but they obeyed not thy voice, neither walked in thy law; they have done nothing of all that thou commandedst them to do: therefore thou hast caused all this evil to come upon them:

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:24
verses.text: Behold the mounts, they are come unto the city to take it; and the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans, that fight against it, because of the sword, and of the famine, and of the pestilence: and what thou hast spoken is come to pass; and, behold, thou seest <hi type="italic">it</hi>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:25
verses.text: And thou hast said unto me, O Lord God, Buy thee the field for money, and take witnesses; for the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:26
verses.text: ¶ Then came the word of the Lord unto Jeremiah, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:27
verses.text: Behold, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord, the God of all flesh: is there any thing too hard for me?

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:28
verses.text: Therefore thus saith the Lord; Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the Chaldeans, and into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and he shall take it:

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:29
verses.text: And the Chaldeans, that fight against this city, shall come and set fire on this city, and burn it with the houses, upon whose roofs they have offered incense unto Baal, and poured out drink offerings unto other gods, to provoke me to anger.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:30
verses.text: For the children of Israel and the children of Judah have only done evil before me from their youth: for the children of Israel have only provoked me to anger with the work of their hands, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:31
verses.text: For this city hath been to me <hi type="italic">as</hi> a provocation of mine anger and of my fury from the day that they built it even unto this day; that I should remove it from before my face,

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:32
verses.text: Because of all the evil of the children of Israel and of the children of Judah, which they have done to provoke me to anger, they, their kings, their princes, their priests, and their prophets, and the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:33
verses.text: And they have turned unto me the back, and not the face: though I taught them, rising up early and teaching <hi type="italic">them</hi>, yet they have not hearkened to receive instruction.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:34
verses.text: But they set their abominations in the house, which is called by my name, to defile it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:35
verses.text: And they built the high places of Baal, which <hi type="italic">are</hi> in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to cause their sons and their daughters to pass through <hi type="italic">the fire</hi> unto Molech; which I commanded them not, neither came it into my mind, that they should do this abomination, to cause Judah to sin.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:36
verses.text: ¶ And now therefore thus saith the Lord, the God of Israel, concerning this city, whereof ye say, It shall be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence;

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:37
verses.text: Behold, I will gather them out of all countries, whither I have driven them in mine anger, and in my fury, and in great wrath; and I will bring them again unto this place, and I will cause them to dwell safely:

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:38
verses.text: And they shall be my people, and I will be their God:

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:39
verses.text: And I will give them one heart, and one way, that they may fear me for ever, for the good of them, and of their children after them:

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:40
verses.text: And I will make an everlasting covenant with them, that I will not turn away from them, to do them good; but I will put my fear in their hearts, that they shall not depart from me.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:41
verses.text: Yea, I will rejoice over them to do them good, and I will plant them in this land assuredly with my whole heart and with my whole soul.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:42
verses.text: For thus saith the Lord; Like as I have brought all this great evil upon this people, so will I bring upon them all the good that I have promised them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:43
verses.text: And fields shall be bought in this land, whereof ye say, <hi type="italic">It is</hi> desolate without man or beast; it is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:44
verses.text: Men shall buy fields for money, and subscribe evidences, and seal <hi type="italic">them</hi>, and take witnesses in the land of Benjamin, and in the places about Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, and in the cities of the mountains, and in the cities of the valley, and in the cities of the south: for I will cause their captivity to return, saith the Lord.  <chapter eID="Jer.32"/><div eID="gen845" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:1
verses.text: MOREOVER the word of the Lord came unto Jeremiah the second time, while he was yet shut up in the court of the prison, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:2
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord the maker thereof, the Lord that formed it, to establish it; the Lord <hi type="italic">is</hi> his name;

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:3
verses.text: Call unto me, and I will answer thee, and shew thee great and mighty things, which thou knowest not.

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:4
verses.text: For thus saith the Lord, the God of Israel, concerning the houses of this city, and concerning the houses of the kings of Judah, which are thrown down by the mounts, and by the sword;

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:5
verses.text: They come to fight with the Chaldeans, but <hi type="italic">it is</hi> to fill them with the dead bodies of men, whom I have slain in mine anger and in my fury, and for all whose wickedness I have hid my face from this city.

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:6
verses.text: Behold, I will bring it health and cure, and I will cure them, and will reveal unto them the abundance of peace and truth.

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:7
verses.text: And I will cause the captivity of Judah and the captivity of Israel to return, and will build them, as at the first.

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:8
verses.text: And I will cleanse them from all their iniquity, whereby they have sinned against me; and I will pardon all their iniquities, whereby they have sinned, and whereby they have transgressed against me.

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:9
verses.text: ¶ And it shall be to me a name of joy, a praise and an honour before all the nations of the earth, which shall hear all the good that I do unto them: and they shall fear and tremble for all the goodness and for all the prosperity that I procure unto it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:10
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord; Again there shall be heard in this place, which ye say <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> desolate without man and without beast, <hi type="italic">even</hi> in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, that are desolate, without man, and without inhabitant, and without beast,

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:11
verses.text: The voice of joy, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride, the voice of them that shall say, Praise the Lord of hosts: for the Lord <hi type="italic">is</hi> good; for his mercy <hi type="italic">endureth</hi> for ever: <hi type="italic">and</hi> of them that shall bring the sacrifice of praise into the house of the Lord. For I will cause to return the captivity of the land, as at the first, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:12
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Again in this place, which is desolate without man and without beast, and in all the cities thereof, shall be an habitation of shepherds causing <hi type="italic">their</hi> flocks to lie down.

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:13
verses.text: In the cities of the mountains, in the cities of the vale, and in the cities of the south, and in the land of Benjamin, and in the places about Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, shall the flocks pass again under the hands of him that telleth <hi type="italic">them</hi>, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:14
verses.text: Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that I will perform that good thing which I have promised unto the house of Israel and to the house of Judah.

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:15
verses.text: ¶ In those days, and at that time, will I cause the Branch of righteousness to grow up unto David; and he shall execute judgment and righteousness in the land.

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:16
verses.text: In those days shall Judah be saved, and Jerusalem shall dwell safely: and this <hi type="italic">is the name</hi> wherewith she shall be called, The Lord our righteousness.

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:17
verses.text: ¶ For thus saith the Lord; David shall never want a man to sit upon the throne of the house of Israel;

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:18
verses.text: Neither shall the priests the Levites want a man before me to offer burnt offerings, and to kindle meat offerings, and to do sacrifice continually.

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:19
verses.text: ¶ And the word of the Lord came unto Jeremiah, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:20
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord; If ye can break my covenant of the day, and my covenant of the night, and that there should not be day and night in their season;

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:21
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Then</hi> may also my covenant be broken with David my servant, that he should not have a son to reign upon his throne; and with the Levites the priests, my ministers.

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:22
verses.text: As the host of heaven cannot be numbered, neither the sand of the sea measured: so will I multiply the seed of David my servant, and the Levites that minister unto me.

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:23
verses.text: Moreover the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:24
verses.text: Considerest thou not what this people have spoken, saying, The two families which the Lord hath chosen, he hath even cast them off? thus they have despised my people, that they should be no more a nation before them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:25
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord; If my covenant <hi type="italic">be</hi> not with day and night, <hi type="italic">and if</hi> I have not appointed the ordinances of heaven and earth;

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:26
verses.text: Then will I cast away the seed of Jacob, and David my servant, <hi type="italic">so</hi> that I will not take <hi type="italic">any</hi> of his seed <hi type="italic">to be</hi> rulers over the seed of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob: for I will cause their captivity to return, and have mercy on them.  <chapter eID="Jer.33"/><div eID="gen846" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:1
verses.text: THE word which came unto Jeremiah from the Lord, when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and all his army, and all the kingdoms of the earth of his dominion, and all the people, fought against Jerusalem, and against all the cities thereof, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:2
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord, the God of Israel; Go and speak to Zedekiah king of Judah, and tell him, Thus saith the Lord; Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall burn it with fire:

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:3
verses.text: And thou shalt not escape out of his hand, but shalt surely be taken, and delivered into his hand; and thine eyes shall behold the eyes of the king of Babylon, and he shall speak with thee mouth to mouth, and thou shalt go to Babylon.

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:4
verses.text: Yet hear the word of the Lord, O Zedekiah king of Judah; Thus saith the Lord of thee, Thou shalt not die by the sword:

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:5
verses.text: <hi type="italic">But</hi> thou shalt die in peace: and with the burnings of thy fathers, the former kings which were before thee, so shall they burn <hi type="italic">odours</hi> for thee; and they will lament thee, <hi type="italic">saying</hi>, Ah lord! for I have pronounced the word, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:6
verses.text: Then Jeremiah the prophet spake all these words unto Zedekiah king of Judah in Jerusalem,

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:7
verses.text: When the king of Babylon’s army fought against Jerusalem, and against all the cities of Judah that were left, against Lachish, and against Azekah: for these defenced cities remained of the cities of Judah.

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:8
verses.text: ¶ <hi type="italic">This is</hi> the word that came unto Jeremiah from the Lord, after that the king Zedekiah had made a covenant with all the people which <hi type="italic">were</hi> at Jerusalem, to proclaim liberty unto them;

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:9
verses.text: That every man should let his manservant, and every man his maidservant, <hi type="italic">being</hi> an Hebrew or an Hebrewess, go free; that none should serve himself of them, <hi type="italic">to wit</hi>, of a Jew his brother.

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:10
verses.text: Now when all the princes, and all the people, which had entered into the covenant, heard that every one should let his manservant, and every one his maidservant, go free, that none should serve themselves of them any more, then they obeyed, and let <hi type="italic">them</hi> go.

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:11
verses.text: But afterward they turned, and caused the servants and the handmaids, whom they had let go free, to return, and brought them into subjection for servants and for handmaids.

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:12
verses.text: ¶ Therefore the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah from the Lord, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:13
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord, the God of Israel; I made a covenant with your fathers in the day that I brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondmen, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:14
verses.text: At the end of seven years let ye go every man his brother an Hebrew, which hath been sold unto thee; and when he hath served thee six years, thou shalt let him go free from thee: but your fathers hearkened not unto me, neither inclined their ear.

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:15
verses.text: And ye were now turned, and had done right in my sight, in proclaiming liberty every man to his neighbour; and ye had made a covenant before me in the house which is called by my name:

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:16
verses.text: But ye turned and polluted my name, and caused every man his servant, and every man his handmaid, whom ye had set at liberty at their pleasure, to return, and brought them into subjection, to be unto you for servants and for handmaids.

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:17
verses.text: Therefore thus saith the Lord; Ye have not hearkened unto me, in proclaiming liberty, every one to his brother, and every man to his neighbour: behold, I proclaim a liberty for you, saith the Lord, to the sword, to the pestilence, and to the famine; and I will make you to be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth.

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:18
verses.text: And I will give the men that have transgressed my covenant, which have not performed the words of the covenant which they had made before me, when they cut the calf in twain, and passed between the parts thereof,

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:19
verses.text: The princes of Judah, and the princes of Jerusalem, the eunuchs, and the priests, and all the people of the land, which passed between the parts of the calf;

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:20
verses.text: I will even give them into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of them that seek their life: and their dead bodies shall be for meat unto the fowls of the heaven, and to the beasts of the earth.

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:21
verses.text: And Zedekiah king of Judah and his princes will I give into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of them that seek their life, and into the hand of the king of Babylon’s army, which are gone up from you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:22
verses.text: Behold, I will command, saith the Lord, and cause them to return to this city; and they shall fight against it, and take it, and burn it with fire: and I will make the cities of Judah a desolation without an inhabitant.  <chapter eID="Jer.34"/><div eID="gen847" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:1
verses.text: THE word which came unto Jeremiah from the Lord in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:2
verses.text: Go unto the house of the Rechabites, and speak unto them, and bring them into the house of the Lord, into one of the chambers, and give them wine to drink.

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:3
verses.text: Then I took Jaazaniah the son of Jeremiah, the son of Habaziniah, and his brethren, and all his sons, and the whole house of the Rechabites;

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:4
verses.text: And I brought them into the house of the Lord, into the chamber of the sons of Hanan, the son of Igdaliah, a man of God, which <hi type="italic">was</hi> by the chamber of the princes, which <hi type="italic">was</hi> above the chamber of Maaseiah the son of Shallum, the keeper of the door:

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:5
verses.text: And I set before the sons of the house of the Rechabites pots full of wine, and cups, and I said unto them, Drink ye wine.

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:6
verses.text: But they said, We will drink no wine: for Jonadab the son of Rechab our father commanded us, saying, Ye shall drink no wine, <hi type="italic">neither</hi> ye, nor your sons for ever:

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:7
verses.text: Neither shall ye build house, nor sow seed, nor plant vineyard, nor have <hi type="italic">any:</hi> but all your days ye shall dwell in tents; that ye may live many days in the land where ye <hi type="italic">be</hi> strangers.

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:8
verses.text: Thus have we obeyed the voice of Jonadab the son of Rechab our father in all that he hath charged us, to drink no wine all our days, we, our wives, our sons, nor our daughters;

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:9
verses.text: Nor to build houses for us to dwell in: neither have we vineyard, nor field, nor seed:

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:10
verses.text: But we have dwelt in tents, and have obeyed, and done according to all that Jonadab our father commanded us.

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:11
verses.text: But it came to pass, when Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon came up into the land, that we said, Come, and let us go to Jerusalem for fear of the army of the Chaldeans, and for fear of the army of the Syrians: so we dwell at Jerusalem.

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:12
verses.text: ¶ Then came the word of the Lord unto Jeremiah, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:13
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Go and tell the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, Will ye not receive instruction to hearken to my words? saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:14
verses.text: The words of Jonadab the son of Rechab, that he commanded his sons not to drink wine, are performed; for unto this day they drink none, but obey their father’s commandment: notwithstanding I have spoken unto you, rising early and speaking; but ye hearkened not unto me.

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:15
verses.text: I have sent also unto you all my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending <hi type="italic">them</hi>, saying, Return ye now every man from his evil way, and amend your doings, and go not after other gods to serve them, and ye shall dwell in the land which I have given to you and to your fathers: but ye have not inclined your ear, nor hearkened unto me.

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:16
verses.text: Because the sons of Jonadab the son of Rechab have performed the commandment of their father, which he commanded them; but this people hath not hearkened unto me:

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:17
verses.text: Therefore thus saith the Lord God of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will bring upon Judah and upon all the inhabitants of Jerusalem all the evil that I have pronounced against them: because I have spoken unto them, but they have not heard; and I have called unto them, but they have not answered.

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:18
verses.text: ¶ And Jeremiah said unto the house of the Rechabites, Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Because ye have obeyed the commandment of Jonadab your father, and kept all his precepts, and done according unto all that he hath commanded you:

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:19
verses.text: Therefore thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Jonadab the son of Rechab shall not want a man to stand before me for ever.  <chapter eID="Jer.35"/><div eID="gen848" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:1
verses.text: AND it came to pass in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, <hi type="italic">that</hi> this word came unto Jeremiah from the Lord, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:2
verses.text: Take thee a roll of a book, and write therein all the words that I have spoken unto thee against Israel, and against Judah, and against all the nations, from the day I spake unto thee, from the days of Josiah, even unto this day.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:3
verses.text: It may be that the house of Judah will hear all the evil which I purpose to do unto them; that they may return every man from his evil way; that I may forgive their iniquity and their sin.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:4
verses.text: Then Jeremiah called Baruch the son of Neriah: and Baruch wrote from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the Lord, which he had spoken unto him, upon a roll of a book.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:5
verses.text: And Jeremiah commanded Baruch, saying, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> shut up; I cannot go into the house of the Lord:

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:6
verses.text: Therefore go thou, and read in the roll, which thou hast written from my mouth, the words of the Lord in the ears of the people in the Lord’s house upon the fasting day: and also thou shalt read them in the ears of all Judah that come out of their cities.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:7
verses.text: It may be they will present their supplication before the Lord, and will return every one from his evil way: for great <hi type="italic">is</hi> the anger and the fury that the Lord hath pronounced against this people.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:8
verses.text: And Baruch the son of Neriah did according to all that Jeremiah the prophet commanded him, reading in the book the words of the Lord in the Lord’s house.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:9
verses.text: And it came to pass in the fifth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, in the ninth month, <hi type="italic">that</hi> they proclaimed a fast before the Lord to all the people in Jerusalem, and to all the people that came from the cities of Judah unto Jerusalem.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:10
verses.text: Then read Baruch in the book the words of Jeremiah in the house of the Lord, in the chamber of Gemariah the son of Shaphan the scribe, in the higher court, at the entry of the new gate of the Lord’s house, in the ears of all the people.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:11
verses.text: ¶ When Michaiah the son of Gemariah, the son of Shaphan, had heard out of the book all the words of the Lord,

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:12
verses.text: Then he went down into the king’s house, into the scribe’s chamber: and, lo, all the princes sat there, <hi type="italic">even</hi> Elishama the scribe, and Delaiah the son of Shemaiah, and Elnathan the son of Achbor, and Gemariah the son of Shaphan, and Zedekiah the son of Hananiah, and all the princes.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:13
verses.text: Then Michaiah declared unto them all the words that he had heard, when Baruch read the book in the ears of the people.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:14
verses.text: Therefore all the princes sent Jehudi the son of Nethaniah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Cushi, unto Baruch, saying, Take in thine hand the roll wherein thou hast read in the ears of the people, and come. So Baruch the son of Neriah took the roll in his hand, and came unto them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:15
verses.text: And they said unto him, Sit down now, and read it in our ears. So Baruch read <hi type="italic">it</hi> in their ears.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:16
verses.text: Now it came to pass, when they had heard all the words, they were afraid both one and other, and said unto Baruch, We will surely tell the king of all these words.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:17
verses.text: And they asked Baruch, saying, Tell us now, How didst thou write all these words at his mouth?

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:18
verses.text: Then Baruch answered them, He pronounced all these words unto me with his mouth, and I wrote <hi type="italic">them</hi> with ink in the book.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:19
verses.text: Then said the princes unto Baruch, Go, hide thee, thou and Jeremiah; and let no man know where ye be.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:20
verses.text: ¶ And they went in to the king into the court, but they laid up the roll in the chamber of Elishama the scribe, and told all the words in the ears of the king.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:21
verses.text: So the king sent Jehudi to fetch the roll: and he took it out of Elishama the scribe’s chamber. And Jehudi read it in the ears of the king, and in the ears of all the princes which stood beside the king.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:22
verses.text: Now the king sat in the winterhouse in the ninth month: and <hi type="italic">there was a fire</hi> on the hearth burning before him.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:23
verses.text: And it came to pass, <hi type="italic">that</hi> when Jehudi had read three or four leaves, he cut it with the penknife, and cast <hi type="italic">it</hi> into the fire that <hi type="italic">was</hi> on the hearth, until all the roll was consumed in the fire that <hi type="italic">was</hi> on the hearth.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:24
verses.text: Yet they were not afraid, nor rent their garments, <hi type="italic">neither</hi> the king, nor any of his servants that heard all these words.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:25
verses.text: Nevertheless Elnathan and Delaiah and Gemariah had made intercession to the king that he would not burn the roll: but he would not hear them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:26
verses.text: But the king commanded Jerahmeel the son of Hammelech, and Seraiah the son of Azriel, and Shelemiah the son of Abdeel, to take Baruch the scribe and Jeremiah the prophet: but the Lord hid them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:27
verses.text: ¶ Then the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah, after that the king had burned the roll, and the words which Baruch wrote at the mouth of Jeremiah, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:28
verses.text: Take thee again another roll, and write in it all the former words that were in the first roll, which Jehoiakim the king of Judah hath burned.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:29
verses.text: And thou shalt say to Jehoiakim king of Judah, Thus saith the Lord; Thou hast burned this roll, saying, Why hast thou written therein, saying, The king of Babylon shall certainly come and destroy this land, and shall cause to cease from thence man and beast?

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:30
verses.text: Therefore thus saith the Lord of Jehoiakim king of Judah; He shall have none to sit upon the throne of David: and his dead body shall be cast out in the day to the heat, and in the night to the frost.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:31
verses.text: And I will punish him and his seed and his servants for their iniquity; and I will bring upon them, and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and upon the men of Judah, all the evil that I have pronounced against them; but they hearkened not.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:32
verses.text: ¶ Then took Jeremiah another roll, and gave it to Baruch the scribe, the son of Neriah; who wrote therein from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the book which Jehoiakim king of Judah had burned in the fire: and there were added besides unto them many like words.  <chapter eID="Jer.36"/><div eID="gen849" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:1
verses.text: AND king Zedekiah the son of Josiah reigned instead of Coniah the son of Jehoiakim, whom Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon made king in the land of Judah.

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:2
verses.text: But neither he, nor his servants, nor the people of the land, did hearken unto the words of the Lord, which he spake by the prophet Jeremiah.

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:3
verses.text: And Zedekiah the king sent Jehucal the son of Shelemiah and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest to the prophet Jeremiah, saying, Pray now unto the Lord our God for us.

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:4
verses.text: Now Jeremiah came in and went out among the people: for they had not put him into prison.

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:5
verses.text: Then Pharaoh’s army was come forth out of Egypt: and when the Chaldeans that besieged Jerusalem heard tidings of them, they departed from Jerusalem.

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:6
verses.text: ¶ Then came the word of the Lord unto the prophet Jeremiah, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:7
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord, the God of Israel; Thus shall ye say to the king of Judah, that sent you unto me to inquire of me; Behold, Pharaoh’s army, which is come forth to help you, shall return to Egypt into their own land.

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:8
verses.text: And the Chaldeans shall come again, and fight against this city, and take it, and burn it with fire.

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:9
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord; Deceive not yourselves, saying, The Chaldeans shall surely depart from us: for they shall not depart.

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:10
verses.text: For though ye had smitten the whole army of the Chaldeans that fight against you, and there remained <hi type="italic">but</hi> wounded men among them, <hi type="italic">yet</hi> should they rise up every man in his tent, and burn this city with fire.

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:11
verses.text: ¶ And it came to pass, that when the army of the Chaldeans was broken up from Jerusalem for fear of Pharaoh’s army,

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:12
verses.text: Then Jeremiah went forth out of Jerusalem to go into the land of Benjamin, to separate himself thence in the midst of the people.

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:13
verses.text: And when he was in the gate of Benjamin, a captain of the ward <hi type="italic">was</hi> there, whose name <hi type="italic">was</hi> Irijah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Hananiah; and he took Jeremiah the prophet, saying, Thou fallest away to the Chaldeans.

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:14
verses.text: Then said Jeremiah, <hi type="italic">It is</hi> false; I fall not away to the Chaldeans. But he hearkened not to him: so Irijah took Jeremiah, and brought him to the princes.

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:15
verses.text: Wherefore the princes were wroth with Jeremiah, and smote him, and put him in prison in the house of Jonathan the scribe: for they had made that the prison.

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:16
verses.text: ¶ When Jeremiah was entered into the dungeon, and into the cabins, and Jeremiah had remained there many days;

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:17
verses.text: Then Zedekiah the king sent, and took him out: and the king asked him secretly in his house, and said, Is there <hi type="italic">any</hi> word from the Lord? And Jeremiah said, There is: for, said he, thou shalt be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon.

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:18
verses.text: Moreover Jeremiah said unto king Zedekiah, What have I offended against thee, or against thy servants, or against this people, that ye have put me in prison?

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:19
verses.text: Where <hi type="italic">are</hi> now your prophets which prophesied unto you, saying, The king of Babylon shall not come against you, nor against this land?

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:20
verses.text: Therefore hear now, I pray thee, O my lord the king: let my supplication, I pray thee, be accepted before thee; that thou cause me not to return to the house of Jonathan the scribe, lest I die there.

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:21
verses.text: Then Zedekiah the king commanded that they should commit Jeremiah into the court of the prison, and that they should give him daily a piece of bread out of the bakers’ street, until all the bread in the city were spent. Thus Jeremiah remained in the court of the prison.  <chapter eID="Jer.37"/><div eID="gen850" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:1
verses.text: THEN Shephatiah the son of Mattan, and Gedaliah the son of Pashur, and Jucal the son of Shelemiah, and Pashur the son of Malchiah, heard the words that Jeremiah had spoken unto all the people, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:2
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord, He that remaineth in this city shall die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence: but he that goeth forth to the Chaldeans shall live; for he shall have his life for a prey, and shall live.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:3
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord, This city shall surely be given into the hand of the king of Babylon’s army, which shall take it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:4
verses.text: Therefore the princes said unto the king, We beseech thee, let this man be put to death: for thus he weakeneth the hands of the men of war that remain in this city, and the hands of all the people, in speaking such words unto them: for this man seeketh not the welfare of this people, but the hurt.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:5
verses.text: Then Zedekiah the king said, Behold, he <hi type="italic">is</hi> in your hand: for the king <hi type="italic">is</hi> not <hi type="italic">he that</hi> can do <hi type="italic">any</hi> thing against you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:6
verses.text: Then took they Jeremiah, and cast him into the dungeon of Malchiah the son of Hammelech, that <hi type="italic">was</hi> in the court of the prison: and they let down Jeremiah with cords. And in the dungeon <hi type="italic">there was</hi> no water, but mire: so Jeremiah sunk in the mire.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:7
