verses.text: ¶ Now when Ebed-melech the Ethiopian, one of the eunuchs which was in the king’s house, heard that they had put Jeremiah in the dungeon; the king then sitting in the gate of Benjamin;

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:8
verses.text: Ebed-melech went forth out of the king’s house, and spake to the king, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:9
verses.text: My lord the king, these men have done evil in all that they have done to Jeremiah the prophet, whom they have cast into the dungeon; and he is like to die for hunger in the place where he is: for <hi type="italic">there is</hi> no more bread in the city.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:10
verses.text: Then the king commanded Ebed-melech the Ethiopian, saying, Take from hence thirty men with thee, and take up Jeremiah the prophet out of the dungeon, before he die.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:11
verses.text: So Ebed-melech took the men with him, and went into the house of the king under the treasury, and took thence old cast clouts and old rotten rags, and let them down by cords into the dungeon to Jeremiah.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:12
verses.text: And Ebed-melech the Ethiopian said unto Jeremiah, Put now <hi type="italic">these</hi> old cast clouts and rotten rags under thine armholes under the cords. And Jeremiah did so.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:13
verses.text: So they drew up Jeremiah with cords, and took him up out of the dungeon: and Jeremiah remained in the court of the prison.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:14
verses.text: ¶ Then Zedekiah the king sent, and took Jeremiah the prophet unto him into the third entry that <hi type="italic">is</hi> in the house of the Lord: and the king said unto Jeremiah, I will ask thee a thing; hide nothing from me.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:15
verses.text: Then Jeremiah said unto Zedekiah, If I declare <hi type="italic">it</hi> unto thee, wilt thou not surely put me to death? and if I give thee counsel, wilt thou not hearken unto me?

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:16
verses.text: So Zedekiah the king sware secretly unto Jeremiah, saying, <hi type="italic">As</hi> the Lord liveth, that made us this soul, I will not put thee to death, neither will I give thee into the hand of these men that seek thy life.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:17
verses.text: Then said Jeremiah unto Zedekiah, Thus saith the Lord, the God of hosts, the God of Israel; If thou wilt assuredly go forth unto the king of Babylon’s princes, then thy soul shall live, and this city shall not be burned with fire; and thou shalt live, and thine house:

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:18
verses.text: But if thou wilt not go forth to the king of Babylon’s princes, then shall this city be given into the hand of the Chaldeans, and they shall burn it with fire, and thou shalt not escape out of their hand.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:19
verses.text: And Zedekiah the king said unto Jeremiah, I am afraid of the Jews that are fallen to the Chaldeans, lest they deliver me into their hand, and they mock me.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:20
verses.text: But Jeremiah said, They shall not deliver <hi type="italic">thee</hi>. Obey, I beseech thee, the voice of the Lord, which I speak unto thee: so it shall be well unto thee, and thy soul shall live.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:21
verses.text: But if thou refuse to go forth, this <hi type="italic">is</hi> the word that the Lord hath shewed me:

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:22
verses.text: And, behold, all the women that are left in the king of Judah’s house <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> brought forth to the king of Babylon’s princes, and those <hi type="italic">women</hi> shall say, Thy friends have set thee on, and have prevailed against thee: thy feet are sunk in the mire, <hi type="italic">and</hi> they are turned away back.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:23
verses.text: So they shall bring out all thy wives and thy children to the Chaldeans: and thou shalt not escape out of their hand, but shalt be taken by the hand of the king of Babylon: and thou shalt cause this city to be burned with fire.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:24
verses.text: ¶ Then said Zedekiah unto Jeremiah, Let no man know of these words, and thou shalt not die.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:25
verses.text: But if the princes hear that I have talked with thee, and they come unto thee, and say unto thee, Declare unto us now what thou hast said unto the king, hide it not from us, and we will not put thee to death; also what the king said unto thee:

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:26
verses.text: Then thou shalt say unto them, I presented my supplication before the king, that he would not cause me to return to Jonathan’s house, to die there.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:27
verses.text: Then came all the princes unto Jeremiah, and asked him: and he told them according to all these words that the king had commanded. So they left off speaking with him; for the matter was not perceived.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:28
verses.text: So Jeremiah abode in the court of the prison until the day that Jerusalem was taken: and he was <hi type="italic">there</hi> when Jerusalem was taken.  <chapter eID="Jer.38"/><div eID="gen851" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:1
verses.text: IN the ninth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the tenth month, came Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon and all his army against Jerusalem, and they besieged it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:2
verses.text: <hi type="italic">And</hi> in the eleventh year of Zedekiah, in the fourth month, the ninth <hi type="italic">day</hi> of the month, the city was broken up.

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:3
verses.text: And all the princes of the king of Babylon came in, and sat in the middle gate, <hi type="italic">even</hi> Nergal-sharezer, Samgar-nebo, Sarsechim, Rab-saris, Nergal-sharezer, Rab-mag, with all the residue of the princes of the king of Babylon.

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:4
verses.text: ¶ And it came to pass, <hi type="italic">that</hi> when Zedekiah the king of Judah saw them, and all the men of war, then they fled, and went forth out of the city by night, by the way of the king’s garden, by the gate betwixt the two walls: and he went out the way of the plain.

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:5
verses.text: But the Chaldeans’ army pursued after them, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho: and when they had taken him, they brought him up to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath, where he gave judgment upon him.

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:6
verses.text: Then the king of Babylon slew the sons of Zedekiah in Riblah before his eyes: also the king of Babylon slew all the nobles of Judah.

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:7
verses.text: Moreover he put out Zedekiah’s eyes, and bound him with chains, to carry him to Babylon.

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:8
verses.text: ¶ And the Chaldeans burned the king’s house, and the houses of the people, with fire, and brake down the walls of Jerusalem.

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:9
verses.text: Then Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard carried away captive into Babylon the remnant of the people that remained in the city, and those that fell away, that fell to him, with the rest of the people that remained.

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:10
verses.text: But Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard left of the poor of the people, which had nothing, in the land of Judah, and gave them vineyards and fields at the same time.

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:11
verses.text: ¶ Now Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon gave charge concerning Jeremiah to Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:12
verses.text: Take him, and look well to him, and do him no harm; but do unto him even as he shall say unto thee.

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:13
verses.text: So Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard sent, and Nebushasban, Rab-saris, and Nergal-sharezer, Rab-mag, and all the king of Babylon’s princes;

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:14
verses.text: Even they sent, and took Jeremiah out of the court of the prison, and committed him unto Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan, that he should carry him home: so he dwelt among the people.

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:15
verses.text: ¶ Now the word of the Lord came unto Jeremiah, while he was shut up in the court of the prison, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:16
verses.text: Go and speak to Ebed-melech the Ethiopian, saying, Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will bring my words upon this city for evil, and not for good; and they shall be <hi type="italic">accomplished</hi> in that day before thee.

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:17
verses.text: But I will deliver thee in that day, saith the Lord: and thou shalt not be given into the hand of the men of whom thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> afraid.

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:18
verses.text: For I will surely deliver thee, and thou shalt not fall by the sword, but thy life shall be for a prey unto thee: because thou hast put thy trust in me, saith the Lord.  <chapter eID="Jer.39"/><div eID="gen852" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:1
verses.text: THE word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord, after that Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard had let him go from Ramah, when he had taken him being bound in chains among all that were carried away captive of Jerusalem and Judah, which were carried away captive unto Babylon.

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:2
verses.text: And the captain of the guard took Jeremiah, and said unto him, The Lord thy God hath pronounced this evil upon this place.

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:3
verses.text: Now the Lord hath brought <hi type="italic">it</hi>, and done according as he hath said: because ye have sinned against the Lord, and have not obeyed his voice, therefore this thing is come upon you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:4
verses.text: And now, behold, I loose thee this day from the chains which <hi type="italic">were</hi> upon thine hand. If it seem good unto thee to come with me into Babylon, come; and I will look well unto thee: but if it seem ill unto thee to come with me into Babylon, forbear: behold, all the land <hi type="italic">is</hi> before thee: whither it seemeth good and convenient for thee to go, thither go.

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:5
verses.text: Now while he was not yet gone back, <hi type="italic">he said</hi>, Go back also to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan, whom the king of Babylon hath made governor over the cities of Judah, and dwell with him among the people: or go wheresoever it seemeth convenient unto thee to go. So the captain of the guard gave him victuals and a reward, and let him go.

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:6
verses.text: Then went Jeremiah unto Gedaliah the son of Ahikam to Mizpah; and dwelt with him among the people that were left in the land.

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:7
verses.text: ¶ Now when all the captains of the forces which <hi type="italic">were</hi> in the fields, <hi type="italic">even</hi> they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam governor in the land, and had committed unto him men, and women, and children, and of the poor of the land, of them that were not carried away captive to Babylon;

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:8
verses.text: Then they came to Gedaliah to Mizpah, even Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and Johanan and Jonathan the sons of Kareah, and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth, and the sons of Ephai the Netophathite, and Jezaniah the son of a Maachathite, they and their men.

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:9
verses.text: And Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan sware unto them and to their men, saying, Fear not to serve the Chaldeans: dwell in the land, and serve the king of Babylon, and it shall be well with you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:10
verses.text: As for me, behold, I will dwell at Mizpah to serve the Chaldeans, which will come unto us: but ye, gather ye wine, and summer fruits, and oil, and put <hi type="italic">them</hi> in your vessels, and dwell in your cities that ye have taken.

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:11
verses.text: Likewise when all the Jews that <hi type="italic">were</hi> in Moab, and among the Ammonites, and in Edom, and that <hi type="italic">were</hi> in all the countries, heard that the king of Babylon had left a remnant of Judah, and that he had set over them Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan;

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:12
verses.text: Even all the Jews returned out of all places whither they were driven, and came to the land of Judah, to Gedaliah, unto Mizpah, and gathered wine and summer fruits very much.

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:13
verses.text: ¶ Moreover Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces that <hi type="italic">were</hi> in the fields, came to Gedaliah to Mizpah,

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:14
verses.text: And said unto him, Dost thou certainly know that Baalis the king of the Ammonites hath sent Ishmael the son of Nethaniah to slay thee? But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam believed them not.

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:15
verses.text: Then Johanan the son of Kareah spake to Gedaliah in Mizpah secretly, saying, Let me go, I pray thee, and I will slay Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and no man shall know <hi type="italic">it:</hi> wherefore should he slay thee, that all the Jews which are gathered unto thee should be scattered, and the remnant in Judah perish?

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:16
verses.text: But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam said unto Johanan the son of Kareah, Thou shalt not do this thing: for thou speakest falsely of Ishmael.  <chapter eID="Jer.40"/><div eID="gen853" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:1
verses.text: NOW it came to pass in the seventh month, <hi type="italic">that</hi> Ishmael the son of Nethaniah the son of Elishama, of the seed royal, and the princes of the king, even ten men with him, came unto Gedaliah the son of Ahikam to Mizpah; and there they did eat bread together in Mizpah.

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:2
verses.text: Then arose Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and the ten men that were with him, and smote Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan with the sword, and slew him, whom the king of Babylon had made governor over the land.

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:3
verses.text: Ishmael also slew all the Jews that were with him, <hi type="italic">even</hi> with Gedaliah, at Mizpah, and the Chaldeans that were found there, <hi type="italic">and</hi> the men of war.

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:4
verses.text: And it came to pass the second day after he had slain Gedaliah, and no man knew <hi type="italic">it</hi>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:5
verses.text: That there came certain from Shechem, from Shiloh, and from Samaria, <hi type="italic">even</hi> fourscore men, having their beards shaven, and their clothes rent, and having cut themselves, with offerings and incense in their hand, to bring <hi type="italic">them</hi> to the house of the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:6
verses.text: And Ishmael the son of Nethaniah went forth from Mizpah to meet them, weeping all along as he went: and it came to pass, as he met them, he said unto them, Come to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam.

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:7
verses.text: And it was <hi type="italic">so</hi>, when they came into the midst of the city, that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah slew them, <hi type="italic">and cast them</hi> into the midst of the pit, he, and the men that <hi type="italic">were</hi> with him.

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:8
verses.text: But ten men were found among them that said unto Ishmael, Slay us not: for we have treasures in the field, of wheat, and of barley, and of oil, and of honey. So he forbare, and slew them not among their brethren.

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:9
verses.text: Now the pit wherein Ishmael had cast all the dead bodies of the men, whom he had slain because of Gedaliah, <hi type="italic">was</hi> it which Asa the king had made for fear of Baasha king of Israel: <hi type="italic">and</hi> Ishmael the son of Nethaniah filled it with <hi type="italic">them that were</hi> slain.

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:10
verses.text: Then Ishmael carried away captive all the residue of the people that <hi type="italic">were</hi> in Mizpah, <hi type="italic">even</hi> the king’s daughters, and all the people that remained in Mizpah, whom Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard had committed to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam: and Ishmael the son of Nethaniah carried them away captive, and departed to go over to the Ammonites.

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:11
verses.text: ¶ But when Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces that <hi type="italic">were</hi> with him, heard of all the evil that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had done,

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:12
verses.text: Then they took all the men, and went to fight with Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and found him by the great waters that <hi type="italic">are</hi> in Gibeon.

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:13
verses.text: Now it came to pass, <hi type="italic">that</hi> when all the people which <hi type="italic">were</hi> with Ishmael saw Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces that <hi type="italic">were</hi> with him, then they were glad.

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:14
verses.text: So all the people that Ishmael had carried away captive from Mizpah cast about and returned, and went unto Johanan the son of Kareah.

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:15
verses.text: But Ishmael the son of Nethaniah escaped from Johanan with eight men, and went to the Ammonites.

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:16
verses.text: Then took Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces that <hi type="italic">were</hi> with him, all the remnant of the people whom he had recovered from Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, from Mizpah, after <hi type="italic">that</hi> he had slain Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, <hi type="italic">even</hi> mighty men of war, and the women, and the children, and the eunuchs, whom he had brought again from Gibeon:

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:17
verses.text: And they departed, and dwelt in the habitation of Chimham, which is by Beth-lehem, to go to enter into Egypt,

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:18
verses.text: Because of the Chaldeans: for they were afraid of them, because Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had slain Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, whom the king of Babylon made governor in the land.  <chapter eID="Jer.41"/><div eID="gen854" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:1
verses.text: THEN all the captains of the forces, and Johanan the son of Kareah, and Jezaniah the son of Hoshaiah, and all the people from the least even unto the greatest, came near,

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:2
verses.text: And said unto Jeremiah the prophet, Let, we beseech thee, our supplication be accepted before thee, and pray for us unto the Lord thy God, <hi type="italic">even</hi> for all this remnant; (for we are left <hi type="italic">but</hi> a few of many, as thine eyes do behold us:)

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:3
verses.text: That the Lord thy God may shew us the way wherein we may walk, and the thing that we may do.

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:4
verses.text: Then Jeremiah the prophet said unto them, I have heard <hi type="italic">you;</hi> behold, I will pray unto the Lord your God according to your words; and it shall come to pass, <hi type="italic">that</hi> whatsoever thing the Lord shall answer you, I will declare <hi type="italic">it</hi> unto you; I will keep nothing back from you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:5
verses.text: Then they said to Jeremiah, The Lord be a true and faithful witness between us, if we do not even according to all things for the which the Lord thy God shall send thee to us.

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:6
verses.text: Whether <hi type="italic">it be</hi> good, or whether <hi type="italic">it be</hi> evil, we will obey the voice of the Lord our God, to whom we send thee; that it may be well with us, when we obey the voice of the Lord our God.

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:7
verses.text: ¶ And it came to pass after ten days, that the word of the Lord came unto Jeremiah.

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:8
verses.text: Then called he Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces which <hi type="italic">were</hi> with him, and all the people from the least even to the greatest,

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:9
verses.text: And said unto them, Thus saith the Lord, the God of Israel, unto whom ye sent me to present your supplication before him;

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:10
verses.text: If ye will still abide in this land, then will I build you, and not pull <hi type="italic">you</hi> down, and I will plant you, and not pluck <hi type="italic">you</hi> up: for I repent me of the evil that I have done unto you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:11
verses.text: Be not afraid of the king of Babylon, of whom ye are afraid; be not afraid of him, saith the Lord: for I <hi type="italic">am</hi> with you to save you, and to deliver you from his hand.

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:12
verses.text: And I will shew mercies unto you, that he may have mercy upon you, and cause you to return to your own land.

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:13
verses.text: ¶ But if ye say, We will not dwell in this land, neither obey the voice of the Lord your God,

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:14
verses.text: Saying, No; but we will go into the land of Egypt, where we shall see no war, nor hear the sound of the trumpet, nor have hunger of bread; and there will we dwell:

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:15
verses.text: And now therefore hear the word of the Lord, ye remnant of Judah; Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; If ye wholly set your faces to enter into Egypt, and go to sojourn there;

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:16
verses.text: Then it shall come to pass, <hi type="italic">that</hi> the sword, which ye feared, shall overtake you there in the land of Egypt, and the famine, whereof ye were afraid, shall follow close after you there in Egypt; and there ye shall die.

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:17
verses.text: So shall it be with all the men that set their faces to go into Egypt to sojourn there; they shall die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence: and none of them shall remain or escape from the evil that I will bring upon them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:18
verses.text: For thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; As mine anger and my fury hath been poured forth upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem; so shall my fury be poured forth upon you, when ye shall enter into Egypt: and ye shall be an execration, and an astonishment, and a curse, and a reproach; and ye shall see this place no more.

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:19
verses.text: ¶ The Lord hath said concerning you, O ye remnant of Judah; Go ye not into Egypt: know certainly that I have admonished you this day.

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:20
verses.text: For ye dissembled in your hearts, when ye sent me unto the Lord your God, saying, Pray for us unto the Lord our God; and according unto all that the Lord our God shall say, so declare unto us, and we will do <hi type="italic">it</hi>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:21
verses.text: And <hi type="italic">now</hi> I have this day declared <hi type="italic">it</hi> to you; but ye have not obeyed the voice of the Lord your God, nor any <hi type="italic">thing</hi> for the which he hath sent me unto you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:22
verses.text: Now therefore know certainly that ye shall die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, in the place whither ye desire to go <hi type="italic">and</hi> to sojourn.  <chapter eID="Jer.42"/><div eID="gen855" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 43:1
verses.text: AND it came to pass, <hi type="italic">that</hi> when Jeremiah had made an end of speaking unto all the people all the words of the Lord their God, for which the Lord their God had sent him to them, <hi type="italic">even</hi> all these words,

verses.name: Jeremiah 43:2
verses.text: Then spake Azariah the son of Hoshaiah, and Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the proud men, saying unto Jeremiah, Thou speakest falsely: the Lord our God hath not sent thee to say, Go not into Egypt to sojourn there:

verses.name: Jeremiah 43:3
verses.text: But Baruch the son of Neriah setteth thee on against us, for to deliver us into the hand of the Chaldeans, that they might put us to death, and carry us away captives into Babylon.

verses.name: Jeremiah 43:4
verses.text: So Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces, and all the people, obeyed not the voice of the Lord, to dwell in the land of Judah.

verses.name: Jeremiah 43:5
verses.text: But Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces, took all the remnant of Judah, that were returned from all nations, whither they had been driven, to dwell in the land of Judah;

verses.name: Jeremiah 43:6
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Even</hi> men, and women, and children, and the king’s daughters, and every person that Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard had left with Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan, and Jeremiah the prophet, and Baruch the son of Neriah.

verses.name: Jeremiah 43:7
verses.text: So they came into the land of Egypt: for they obeyed not the voice of the Lord: thus came they <hi type="italic">even</hi> to Tahpanhes.

verses.name: Jeremiah 43:8
verses.text: ¶ Then came the word of the Lord unto Jeremiah in Tahpanhes, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 43:9
verses.text: Take great stones in thine hand, and hide them in the clay in the brickkiln, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> at the entry of Pharaoh’s house in Tahpanhes, in the sight of the men of Judah;

verses.name: Jeremiah 43:10
verses.text: And say unto them, Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will send and take Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and will set his throne upon these stones that I have hid; and he shall spread his royal pavilion over them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 43:11
verses.text: And when he cometh, he shall smite the land of Egypt, <hi type="italic">and deliver</hi> such <hi type="italic">as are</hi> for death to death; and such <hi type="italic">as are</hi> for captivity to captivity; and such <hi type="italic">as are</hi> for the sword to the sword.

verses.name: Jeremiah 43:12
verses.text: And I will kindle a fire in the houses of the gods of Egypt; and he shall burn them, and carry them away captives: and he shall array himself with the land of Egypt, as a shepherd putteth on his garment; and he shall go forth from thence in peace.

verses.name: Jeremiah 43:13
verses.text: He shall break also the images of Beth-shemesh, that <hi type="italic">is</hi> in the land of Egypt; and the houses of the gods of the Egyptians shall he burn with fire.  <chapter eID="Jer.43"/><div eID="gen856" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:1
verses.text: THE word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the Jews which dwell in the land of Egypt, which dwell at Migdol, and at Tahpanhes, and at Noph, and in the country of Pathros, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:2
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Ye have seen all the evil that I have brought upon Jerusalem, and upon all the cities of Judah; and, behold, this day they <hi type="italic">are</hi> a desolation, and no man dwelleth therein,

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:3
verses.text: Because of their wickedness which they have committed to provoke me to anger, in that they went to burn incense, <hi type="italic">and</hi> to serve other gods, whom they knew not, <hi type="italic">neither</hi> they, ye, nor your fathers.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:4
verses.text: Howbeit I sent unto you all my servants the prophets, rising early and sending <hi type="italic">them</hi>, saying, Oh, do not this abominable thing that I hate.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:5
verses.text: But they hearkened not, nor inclined their ear to turn from their wickedness, to burn no incense unto other gods.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:6
verses.text: Wherefore my fury and mine anger was poured forth, and was kindled in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem; and they are wasted <hi type="italic">and</hi> desolate, as at this day.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:7
verses.text: Therefore now thus saith the Lord, the God of hosts, the God of Israel; Wherefore commit ye <hi type="italic">this</hi> great evil against your souls, to cut off from you man and woman, child and suckling, out of Judah, to leave you none to remain;

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:8
verses.text: In that ye provoke me unto wrath with the works of your hands, burning incense unto other gods in the land of Egypt, whither ye be gone to dwell, that ye might cut yourselves off, and that ye might be a curse and a reproach among all the nations of the earth?

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:9
verses.text: Have ye forgotten the wickedness of your fathers, and the wickedness of the kings of Judah, and the wickedness of their wives, and your own wickedness, and the wickedness of your wives, which they have committed in the land of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem?

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:10
verses.text: They are not humbled <hi type="italic">even</hi> unto this day, neither have they feared, nor walked in my law, nor in my statutes, that I set before you and before your fathers.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:11
verses.text: ¶ Therefore thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will set my face against you for evil, and to cut off all Judah.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:12
verses.text: And I will take the remnant of Judah, that have set their faces to go into the land of Egypt to sojourn there, and they shall all be consumed, <hi type="italic">and</hi> fall in the land of Egypt; they shall <hi type="italic">even</hi> be consumed by the sword <hi type="italic">and</hi> by the famine: they shall die, from the least even unto the greatest, by the sword and by the famine: and they shall be an execration, <hi type="italic">and</hi> an astonishment, and a curse, and a reproach.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:13
verses.text: For I will punish them that dwell in the land of Egypt, as I have punished Jerusalem, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence:

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:14
verses.text: So that none of the remnant of Judah, which are gone into the land of Egypt to sojourn there, shall escape or remain, that they should return into the land of Judah, to the which they have a desire to return to dwell there: for none shall return but such as shall escape.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:15
verses.text: ¶ Then all the men which knew that their wives had burned incense unto other gods, and all the women that stood by, a great multitude, even all the people that dwelt in the land of Egypt, in Pathros, answered Jeremiah, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:16
verses.text: <hi type="italic">As for</hi> the word that thou hast spoken unto us in the name of the Lord, we will not hearken unto thee.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:17
verses.text: But we will certainly do whatsoever thing goeth forth out of our own mouth, to burn incense unto the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto her, as we have done, we, and our fathers, our kings, and our princes, in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem: for <hi type="italic">then</hi> had we plenty of victuals, and were well, and saw no evil.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:18
verses.text: But since we left off to burn incense to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto her, we have wanted all <hi type="italic">things</hi>, and have been consumed by the sword and by the famine.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:19
verses.text: And when we burned incense to the queen of heaven, and poured out drink offerings unto her, did we make her cakes to worship her, and pour out drink offerings unto her, without our men?

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:20
verses.text: ¶ Then Jeremiah said unto all the people, to the men, and to the women, and to all the people which had given him <hi type="italic">that</hi> answer, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:21
verses.text: The incense that ye burned in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, ye, and your fathers, your kings, and your princes, and the people of the land, did not the Lord remember them, and came it <hi type="italic">not</hi> into his mind?

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:22
verses.text: So that the Lord could no longer bear, because of the evil of your doings, <hi type="italic">and</hi> because of the abominations which ye have committed; therefore is your land a desolation, and an astonishment, and a curse, without an inhabitant, as at this day.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:23
verses.text: Because ye have burned incense, and because ye have sinned against the Lord, and have not obeyed the voice of the Lord, nor walked in his law, nor in his statutes, nor in his testimonies; therefore this evil is happened unto you, as at this day.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:24
verses.text: Moreover Jeremiah said unto all the people, and to all the women, Hear the word of the Lord, all Judah that <hi type="italic">are</hi> in the land of Egypt:

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:25
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, saying; Ye and your wives have both spoken with your mouths, and fulfilled with your hand, saying, We will surely perform our vows that we have vowed, to burn incense to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto her: ye will surely accomplish your vows, and surely perform your vows.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:26
verses.text: Therefore hear ye the word of the Lord, all Judah that dwell in the land of Egypt; Behold, I have sworn by my great name, saith the Lord, that my name shall no more be named in the mouth of any man of Judah in all the land of Egypt, saying, The Lord God liveth.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:27
verses.text: Behold, I will watch over them for evil, and not for good: and all the men of Judah that <hi type="italic">are</hi> in the land of Egypt shall be consumed by the sword and by the famine, until there be an end of them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:28
verses.text: Yet a small number that escape the sword shall return out of the land of Egypt into the land of Judah, and all the remnant of Judah, that are gone into the land of Egypt to sojourn there, shall know whose words shall stand, mine, or theirs.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:29
verses.text: ¶ And this <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> a sign unto you, saith the Lord, that I will punish you in this place, that ye may know that my words shall surely stand against you for evil:

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:30
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord; Behold, I will give Pharaoh-hophra king of Egypt into the hand of his enemies, and into the hand of them that seek his life; as I gave Zedekiah king of Judah into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, his enemy, and that sought his life.  <chapter eID="Jer.44"/><div eID="gen857" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 45:1
verses.text: THE word that Jeremiah the prophet spake unto Baruch the son of Neriah, when he had written these words in a book at the mouth of Jeremiah, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 45:2
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord, the God of Israel, unto thee, O Baruch;

verses.name: Jeremiah 45:3
verses.text: Thou didst say, Woe is me now! for the Lord hath added grief to my sorrow; I fainted in my sighing, and I find no rest.

verses.name: Jeremiah 45:4
verses.text: ¶ Thus shalt thou say unto him, The Lord saith thus; Behold, <hi type="italic">that</hi> which I have built will I break down, and that which I have planted I will pluck up, even this whole land.

verses.name: Jeremiah 45:5
verses.text: And seekest thou great things for thyself? seek <hi type="italic">them</hi> not: for, behold, I will bring evil upon all flesh, saith the Lord: but thy life will I give unto thee for a prey in all places whither thou goest.  <chapter eID="Jer.45"/><div eID="gen858" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:1
verses.text: THE word of the Lord which came to Jeremiah the prophet against the Gentiles;

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:2
verses.text: Against Egypt, against the army of Pharaoh-necho king of Egypt, which was by the river Euphrates in Carchemish, which Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon smote in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:3
verses.text: Order ye the buckler and shield, and draw near to battle.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:4
verses.text: Harness the horses; and get up, ye horsemen, and stand forth with <hi type="italic">your</hi> helmets; furbish the spears, <hi type="italic">and</hi> put on the brigandines.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:5
verses.text: Wherefore have I seen them dismayed <hi type="italic">and</hi> turned away back? and their mighty ones are beaten down, and are fled apace, and look not back: <hi type="italic">for</hi> fear <hi type="italic">was</hi> round about, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:6
verses.text: Let not the swift flee away, nor the mighty man escape; they shall stumble, and fall toward the north by the river Euphrates.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:7
verses.text: Who <hi type="italic">is</hi> this <hi type="italic">that</hi> cometh up as a flood, whose waters are moved as the rivers?

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:8
verses.text: Egypt riseth up like a flood, and <hi type="italic">his</hi> waters are moved like the rivers; and he saith, I will go up, <hi type="italic">and</hi> will cover the earth; I will destroy the city and the inhabitants thereof.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:9
verses.text: Come up, ye horses; and rage, ye chariots; and let the mighty men come forth; the Ethiopians and the Libyans, that handle the shield; and the Lydians, that handle <hi type="italic">and</hi> bend the bow.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:10
verses.text: For this <hi type="italic">is</hi> the day of the Lord God of hosts, a day of vengeance, that he may avenge him of his adversaries: and the sword shall devour, and it shall be satiate and made drunk with their blood: for the Lord God of hosts hath a sacrifice in the north country by the river Euphrates.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:11
verses.text: Go up into Gilead, and take balm, O virgin, the daughter of Egypt: in vain shalt thou use many medicines; <hi type="italic">for</hi> thou shalt not be cured.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:12
verses.text: The nations have heard of thy shame, and thy cry hath filled the land: for the mighty man hath stumbled against the mighty, <hi type="italic">and</hi> they are fallen both together.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:13
verses.text: ¶ The word that the Lord spake to Jeremiah the prophet, how Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon should come <hi type="italic">and</hi> smite the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:14
verses.text: Declare ye in Egypt, and publish in Migdol, and publish in Noph and in Tahpanhes: say ye, Stand fast, and prepare thee; for the sword shall devour round about thee.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:15
verses.text: Why are thy valiant <hi type="italic">men</hi> swept away? they stood not, because the Lord did drive them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:16
verses.text: He made many to fall, yea, one fell upon another: and they said, Arise, and let us go again to our own people, and to the land of our nativity, from the oppressing sword.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:17
verses.text: They did cry there, Pharaoh king of Egypt <hi type="italic">is but</hi> a noise; he hath passed the time appointed.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:18
verses.text: <hi type="italic">As</hi> I live, saith the King, whose name <hi type="italic">is</hi> the Lord of hosts, Surely as Tabor <hi type="italic">is</hi> among the mountains, and as Carmel by the sea, <hi type="italic">so</hi> shall he come.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:19
verses.text: O thou daughter dwelling in Egypt, furnish thyself to go into captivity: for Noph shall be waste and desolate without an inhabitant.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:20
verses.text: Egypt <hi type="italic">is like</hi> a very fair heifer, <hi type="italic">but</hi> destruction cometh; it cometh out of the north.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:21
verses.text: Also her hired men <hi type="italic">are</hi> in the midst of her like fatted bullocks; for they also are turned back, <hi type="italic">and</hi> are fled away together: they did not stand, because the day of their calamity was come upon them, <hi type="italic">and</hi> the time of their visitation.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:22
verses.text: The voice thereof shall go like a serpent; for they shall march with an army, and come against her with axes, as hewers of wood.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:23
verses.text: They shall cut down her forest, saith the Lord, though it cannot be searched; because they are more than the grasshoppers, and <hi type="italic">are</hi> innumerable.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:24
verses.text: The daughter of Egypt shall be confounded; she shall be delivered into the hand of the people of the north.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:25
verses.text: The Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, saith; Behold, I will punish the multitude of No, and Pharaoh, and Egypt, with their gods, and their kings; even Pharaoh, and <hi type="italic">all</hi> them that trust in him:

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:26
verses.text: And I will deliver them into the hand of those that seek their lives, and into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of his servants: and afterward it shall be inhabited, as in the days of old, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:27
verses.text: ¶ But fear not thou, O my servant Jacob, and be not dismayed, O Israel: for, behold, I will save thee from afar off, and thy seed from the land of their captivity; and Jacob shall return, and be in rest and at ease, and none shall make <hi type="italic">him</hi> afraid.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:28
verses.text: Fear thou not, O Jacob my servant, saith the Lord: for I <hi type="italic">am</hi> with thee; for I will make a full end of all the nations whither I have driven thee: but I will not make a full end of thee, but correct thee in measure; yet will I not leave thee wholly unpunished.  <chapter eID="Jer.46"/><div eID="gen859" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 47:1
verses.text: THE word of the Lord that came to Jeremiah the prophet against the Philistines, before that Pharaoh smote Gaza.

verses.name: Jeremiah 47:2
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord; Behold, waters rise up out of the north, and shall be an overflowing flood, and shall overflow the land, and all that is therein; the city, and them that dwell therein: then the men shall cry, and all the inhabitants of the land shall howl.

verses.name: Jeremiah 47:3
verses.text: At the noise of the stamping of the hoofs of his strong <hi type="italic">horses</hi>, at the rushing of his chariots, <hi type="italic">and at</hi> the rumbling of his wheels, the fathers shall not look back to <hi type="italic">their</hi> children for feebleness of hands;

verses.name: Jeremiah 47:4
verses.text: Because of the day that cometh to spoil all the Philistines, <hi type="italic">and</hi> to cut off from Tyrus and Zidon every helper that remaineth: for the Lord will spoil the Philistines, the remnant of the country of Caphtor.

verses.name: Jeremiah 47:5
verses.text: Baldness is come upon Gaza; Ashkelon is cut off <hi type="italic">with</hi> the remnant of their valley: how long wilt thou cut thyself?

verses.name: Jeremiah 47:6
verses.text: O thou sword of the Lord, how long <hi type="italic">will it be</hi> ere thou be quiet? put up thyself into thy scabbard, rest, and be still.

verses.name: Jeremiah 47:7
verses.text: How can it be quiet, seeing the Lord hath given it a charge against Ashkelon, and against the sea shore? there hath he appointed it.  <chapter eID="Jer.47"/><div eID="gen860" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:1
verses.text: AGAINST Moab thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Woe unto Nebo! for it is spoiled: Kiriathaim is confounded <hi type="italic">and</hi> taken: Misgab is confounded and dismayed.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:2
verses.text: <hi type="italic">There shall be</hi> no more praise of Moab: in Heshbon they have devised evil against it; come, and let us cut it off from <hi type="italic">being</hi> a nation. Also thou shalt be cut down, O Madmen; the sword shall pursue thee.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:3
verses.text: A voice of crying <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> from Horonaim, spoiling and great destruction.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:4
verses.text: Moab is destroyed; her little ones have caused a cry to be heard.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:5
verses.text: For in the going up of Luhith continual weeping shall go up; for in the going down of Horonaim the enemies have heard a cry of destruction.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:6
verses.text: Flee, save your lives, and be like the heath in the wilderness.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:7
verses.text: ¶ For because thou hast trusted in thy works and in thy treasures, thou shalt also be taken: and Chemosh shall go forth into captivity <hi type="italic">with</hi> his priests and his princes together.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:8
verses.text: And the spoiler shall come upon every city, and no city shall escape: the valley also shall perish, and the plain shall be destroyed, as the Lord hath spoken.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:9
verses.text: Give wings unto Moab, that it may flee and get away: for the cities thereof shall be desolate, without any to dwell therein.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:10
verses.text: Cursed <hi type="italic">be</hi> he that doeth the work of the Lord deceitfully, and cursed <hi type="italic">be</hi> he that keepeth back his sword from blood.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:11
verses.text: ¶ Moab hath been at ease from his youth, and he hath settled on his lees, and hath not been emptied from vessel to vessel, neither hath he gone into captivity: therefore his taste remained in him, and his scent is not changed.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:12
verses.text: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that I will send unto him wanderers, that shall cause him to wander, and shall empty his vessels, and break their bottles.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:13
verses.text: And Moab shall be ashamed of Chemosh, as the house of Israel was ashamed of Beth-el their confidence.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:14
verses.text: ¶ How say ye, We <hi type="italic">are</hi> mighty and strong men for the war?

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:15
verses.text: Moab is spoiled, and gone up <hi type="italic">out of</hi> her cities, and his chosen young men are gone down to the slaughter, saith the King, whose name <hi type="italic">is</hi> the Lord of hosts.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:16
verses.text: The calamity of Moab <hi type="italic">is</hi> near to come, and his affliction hasteth fast.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:17
verses.text: All ye that are about him, bemoan him; and all ye that know his name, say, How is the strong staff broken, <hi type="italic">and</hi> the beautiful rod!

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:18
verses.text: Thou daughter that dost inhabit Dibon, come down from <hi type="italic">thy</hi> glory, and sit in thirst; for the spoiler of Moab shall come upon thee, <hi type="italic">and</hi> he shall destroy thy strong holds.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:19
verses.text: O inhabitant of Aroer, stand by the way, and espy; ask him that fleeth, and her that escapeth, <hi type="italic">and</hi> say, What is done?

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:20
verses.text: Moab is confounded; for it is broken down: howl and cry; tell ye it in Arnon, that Moab is spoiled,

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:21
verses.text: And judgment is come upon the plain country; upon Holon, and upon Jahazah, and upon Mephaath,

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:22
verses.text: And upon Dibon, and upon Nebo, and upon Beth-diblathaim,

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:23
verses.text: And upon Kiriathaim, and upon Beth-gamul, and upon Beth-meon,

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:24
verses.text: And upon Kerioth, and upon Bozrah, and upon all the cities of the land of Moab, far or near.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:25
verses.text: The horn of Moab is cut off, and his arm is broken, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:26
verses.text: ¶ Make ye him drunken: for he magnified <hi type="italic">himself</hi> against the Lord: Moab also shall wallow in his vomit, and he also shall be in derision.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:27
verses.text: For was not Israel a derision unto thee? was he found among thieves? for since thou spakest of him, thou skippedst for joy.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:28
verses.text: O ye that dwell in Moab, leave the cities, and dwell in the rock, and be like the dove <hi type="italic">that</hi> maketh her nest in the sides of the hole’s mouth.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:29
verses.text: We have heard the pride of Moab, (he is exceeding proud) his loftiness, and his arrogancy, and his pride, and the haughtiness of his heart.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:30
verses.text: I know his wrath, saith the Lord; but <hi type="italic">it shall</hi> not <hi type="italic">be</hi> so; his lies shall not so effect <hi type="italic">it</hi>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:31
verses.text: Therefore will I howl for Moab, and I will cry out for all Moab; <hi type="italic">mine heart</hi> shall mourn for the men of Kir-heres.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:32
verses.text: O vine of Sibmah, I will weep for thee with the weeping of Jazer: thy plants are gone over the sea, they reach <hi type="italic">even</hi> to the sea of Jazer: the spoiler is fallen upon thy summer fruits and upon thy vintage.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:33
verses.text: And joy and gladness is taken from the plentiful field, and from the land of Moab; and I have caused wine to fail from the winepresses: none shall tread with shouting; <hi type="italic">their</hi> shouting <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> no shouting.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:34
verses.text: From the cry of Heshbon <hi type="italic">even</hi> unto Elealeh, <hi type="italic">and even</hi> unto Jahaz, have they uttered their voice, from Zoar <hi type="italic">even</hi> unto Horonaim, <hi type="italic">as</hi> an heifer of three years old: for the waters also of Nimrim shall be desolate.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:35
verses.text: Moreover I will cause to cease in Moab, saith the Lord, him that offereth in the high places, and him that burneth incense to his gods.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:36
verses.text: Therefore mine heart shall sound for Moab like pipes, and mine heart shall sound like pipes for the men of Kir-heres: because the riches <hi type="italic">that</hi> he hath gotten are perished.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:37
verses.text: For every head <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> bald, and every beard clipped: upon all the hands <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> cuttings, and upon the loins sackcloth.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:38
verses.text: <hi type="italic">There shall be</hi> lamentation generally upon all the housetops of Moab, and in the streets thereof: for I have broken Moab like a vessel wherein <hi type="italic">is</hi> no pleasure, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:39
verses.text: They shall howl, <hi type="italic">saying</hi>, How is it broken down! how hath Moab turned the back with shame! so shall Moab be a derision and a dismaying to all them about him.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:40
verses.text: For thus saith the Lord; Behold, he shall fly as an eagle, and shall spread his wings over Moab.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:41
verses.text: Kerioth is taken, and the strong holds are surprised, and the mighty men’s hearts in Moab at that day shall be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:42
verses.text: And Moab shall be destroyed from <hi type="italic">being</hi> a people, because he hath magnified <hi type="italic">himself</hi> against the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:43
verses.text: Fear, and the pit, and the snare, <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> upon thee, O inhabitant of Moab, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:44
verses.text: He that fleeth from the fear shall fall into the pit; and he that getteth up out of the pit shall be taken in the snare: for I will bring upon it, <hi type="italic">even</hi> upon Moab, the year of their visitation, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:45
verses.text: They that fled stood under the shadow of Heshbon because of the force: but a fire shall come forth out of Heshbon, and a flame from the midst of Sihon, and shall devour the corner of Moab, and the crown of the head of the tumultuous ones.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:46
verses.text: Woe be unto thee, O Moab! the people of Chemosh perisheth: for thy sons are taken captives, and thy daughters captives.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:47
verses.text: ¶ Yet will I bring again the captivity of Moab in the latter days, saith the Lord. Thus far <hi type="italic">is</hi> the judgment of Moab.  <chapter eID="Jer.48"/><div eID="gen861" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:1
verses.text: CONCERNING the Ammonites, thus saith the Lord; Hath Israel no sons? hath he no heir? why <hi type="italic">then</hi> doth their king inherit Gad, and his people dwell in his cities?

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:2
verses.text: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that I will cause an alarm of war to be heard in Rabbah of the Ammonites; and it shall be a desolate heap, and her daughters shall be burned with fire: then shall Israel be heir unto them that were his heirs, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:3
verses.text: Howl, O Heshbon, for Ai is spoiled: cry, ye daughters of Rabbah, gird you with sackcloth; lament, and run to and fro by the hedges; for their king shall go into captivity, <hi type="italic">and</hi> his priests and his princes together.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:4
verses.text: Wherefore gloriest thou in the valleys, thy flowing valley, O backsliding daughter? that trusted in her treasures, <hi type="italic">saying</hi>, Who shall come unto me?

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:5
verses.text: Behold, I will bring a fear upon thee, saith the Lord God of hosts, from all those that be about thee; and ye shall be driven out every man right forth; and none shall gather up him that wandereth.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:6
verses.text: And afterward I will bring again the captivity of the children of Ammon, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:7
verses.text: ¶ Concerning Edom, thus saith the Lord of hosts; <hi type="italic">Is</hi> wisdom no more in Teman? is counsel perished from the prudent? is their wisdom vanished?

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:8
verses.text: Flee ye, turn back, dwell deep, O inhabitants of Dedan; for I will bring the calamity of Esau upon him, the time <hi type="italic">that</hi> I will visit him.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:9
verses.text: If grapegatherers come to thee, would they not leave <hi type="italic">some</hi> gleaning grapes? if thieves by night, they will destroy till they have enough.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:10
verses.text: But I have made Esau bare, I have uncovered his secret places, and he shall not be able to hide himself: his seed is spoiled, and his brethren, and his neighbours, and he <hi type="italic">is</hi> not.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:11
verses.text: Leave thy fatherless children, I will preserve <hi type="italic">them</hi> alive; and let thy widows trust in me.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:12
verses.text: For thus saith the Lord; Behold, they whose judgment <hi type="italic">was</hi> not to drink of the cup have assuredly drunken; and <hi type="italic">art</hi> thou he <hi type="italic">that</hi> shall altogether go unpunished? thou shalt not go unpunished, but thou shalt surely drink <hi type="italic">of it</hi>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:13
verses.text: For I have sworn by myself, saith the Lord, that Bozrah shall become a desolation, a reproach, a waste, and a curse; and all the cities thereof shall be perpetual wastes.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:14
verses.text: I have heard a rumour from the Lord, and an ambassador is sent unto the heathen, <hi type="italic">saying</hi>, Gather ye together, and come against her, and rise up to the battle.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:15
verses.text: For, lo, I will make thee small among the heathen, <hi type="italic">and</hi> despised among men.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:16
verses.text: Thy terribleness hath deceived thee, <hi type="italic">and</hi> the pride of thine heart, O thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, that holdest the height of the hill: though thou shouldest make thy nest as high as the eagle, I will bring thee down from thence, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:17
verses.text: Also Edom shall be a desolation: every one that goeth by it shall be astonished, and shall hiss at all the plagues thereof.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:18
verses.text: As in the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour <hi type="italic">cities</hi> thereof, saith the Lord, no man shall abide there, neither shall a son of man dwell in it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:19
verses.text: Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan against the habitation of the strong: but I will suddenly make him run away from her: and who <hi type="italic">is</hi> a chosen <hi type="italic">man</hi>, <hi type="italic">that</hi> I may appoint over her? for who <hi type="italic">is</hi> like me? and who will appoint me the time? and who <hi type="italic">is</hi> that shepherd that will stand before me?

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:20
verses.text: Therefore hear the counsel of the Lord, that he hath taken against Edom; and his purposes, that he hath purposed against the inhabitants of Teman: Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out: surely he shall make their habitations desolate with them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:21
verses.text: The earth is moved at the noise of their fall, at the cry the noise thereof was heard in the Red sea.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:22
verses.text: Behold, he shall come up and fly as the eagle, and spread his wings over Bozrah: and at that day shall the heart of the mighty men of Edom be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:23
verses.text: ¶ Concerning Damascus. Hamath is confounded, and Arpad: for they have heard evil tidings: they are fainthearted; <hi type="italic">there is</hi> sorrow on the sea; it cannot be quiet.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:24
verses.text: Damascus is waxed feeble, <hi type="italic">and</hi> turneth herself to flee, and fear hath seized on <hi type="italic">her:</hi> anguish and sorrows have taken her, as a woman in travail.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:25
verses.text: How is the city of praise not left, the city of my joy!

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:26
verses.text: Therefore her young men shall fall in her streets, and all the men of war shall be cut off in that day, saith the Lord of hosts.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:27
verses.text: And I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus, and it shall consume the palaces of Ben-hadad.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:28
verses.text: ¶ Concerning Kedar, and concerning the kingdoms of Hazor, which Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon shall smite, thus saith the Lord; Arise ye, go up to Kedar, and spoil the men of the east.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:29
verses.text: Their tents and their flocks shall they take away: they shall take to themselves their curtains, and all their vessels, and their camels; and they shall cry unto them, Fear <hi type="italic">is</hi> on every side.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:30
verses.text: ¶ Flee, get you far off, dwell deep, O ye inhabitants of Hazor, saith the Lord; for Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon hath taken counsel against you, and hath conceived a purpose against you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:31
verses.text: Arise, get you up unto the wealthy nation, that dwelleth without care, saith the Lord, which have neither gates nor bars, <hi type="italic">which</hi> dwell alone.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:32
verses.text: And their camels shall be a booty, and the multitude of their cattle a spoil: and I will scatter into all winds them <hi type="italic">that are</hi> in the utmost corners; and I will bring their calamity from all sides thereof, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:33
verses.text: And Hazor shall be a dwelling for dragons, <hi type="italic">and</hi> a desolation for ever: there shall no man abide there, nor <hi type="italic">any</hi> son of man dwell in it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:34
verses.text: ¶ The word of the Lord that came to Jeremiah the prophet against Elam in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:35
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Behold, I will break the bow of Elam, the chief of their might.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:36
verses.text: And upon Elam will I bring the four winds from the four quarters of heaven, and will scatter them toward all those winds; and there shall be no nation whither the outcasts of Elam shall not come.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:37
verses.text: For I will cause Elam to be dismayed before their enemies, and before them that seek their life: and I will bring evil upon them, <hi type="italic">even</hi> my fierce anger, saith the Lord; and I will send the sword after them, till I have consumed them:

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:38
verses.text: And I will set my throne in Elam, and will destroy from thence the king and the princes, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:39
verses.text: ¶ But it shall come to pass in the latter days, <hi type="italic">that</hi> I will bring again the captivity of Elam, saith the Lord.  <chapter eID="Jer.49"/><div eID="gen862" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:1
verses.text: THE word that the Lord spake against Babylon <hi type="italic">and</hi> against the land of the Chaldeans by Jeremiah the prophet.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:2
verses.text: Declare ye among the nations, and publish, and set up a standard; publish, <hi type="italic">and</hi> conceal not: say, Babylon is taken, Bel is confounded, Merodach is broken in pieces; her idols are confounded, her images are broken in pieces.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:3
verses.text: For out of the north there cometh up a nation against her, which shall make her land desolate, and none shall dwell therein: they shall remove, they shall depart, both man and beast.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:4
verses.text: ¶ In those days, and in that time, saith the Lord, the children of Israel shall come, they and the children of Judah together, going and weeping: they shall go, and seek the Lord their God.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:5
verses.text: They shall ask the way to Zion with their faces thitherward, <hi type="italic">saying</hi>, Come, and let us join ourselves to the Lord in a perpetual covenant <hi type="italic">that</hi> shall not be forgotten.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:6
verses.text: My people hath been lost sheep: their shepherds have caused them to go astray, they have turned them away <hi type="italic">on</hi> the mountains: they have gone from mountain to hill, they have forgotten their restingplace.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:7
verses.text: All that found them have devoured them: and their adversaries said, We offend not, because they have sinned against the Lord, the habitation of justice, even the Lord, the hope of their fathers.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:8
verses.text: Remove out of the midst of Babylon, and go forth out of the land of the Chaldeans, and be as the he goats before the flocks.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:9
verses.text: ¶ For, lo, I will raise and cause to come up against Babylon an assembly of great nations from the north country: and they shall set themselves in array against her; from thence she shall be taken: their arrows <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> as of a mighty expert man; none shall return in vain.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:10
verses.text: And Chaldea shall be a spoil: all that spoil her shall be satisfied, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:11
verses.text: Because ye were glad, because ye rejoiced, O ye destroyers of mine heritage, because ye are grown fat as the heifer at grass, and bellow as bulls;

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:12
verses.text: Your mother shall be sore confounded; she that bare you shall be ashamed: behold, the hindermost of the nations <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> a wilderness, a dry land, and a desert.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:13
verses.text: Because of the wrath of the Lord it shall not be inhabited, but it shall be wholly desolate: every one that goeth by Babylon shall be astonished, and hiss at all her plagues.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:14
verses.text: Put yourselves in array against Babylon round about: all ye that bend the bow, shoot at her, spare no arrows: for she hath sinned against the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:15
verses.text: Shout against her round about: she hath given her hand: her foundations are fallen, her walls are thrown down: for it <hi type="italic">is</hi> the vengeance of the Lord: take vengeance upon her; as she hath done, do unto her.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:16
verses.text: Cut off the sower from Babylon, and him that handleth the sickle in the time of harvest: for fear of the oppressing sword they shall turn every one to his people, and they shall flee every one to his own land.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:17
verses.text: ¶ Israel <hi type="italic">is</hi> a scattered sheep; the lions have driven <hi type="italic">him</hi> away: first the king of Assyria hath devoured him; and last this Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon hath broken his bones.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:18
verses.text: Therefore thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will punish the king of Babylon and his land, as I have punished the king of Assyria.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:19
verses.text: And I will bring Israel again to his habitation, and he shall feed on Carmel and Bashan, and his soul shall be satisfied upon mount Ephraim and Gilead.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:20
verses.text: In those days, and in that time, saith the Lord, the iniquity of Israel shall be sought for, and <hi type="italic">there shall be</hi> none; and the sins of Judah, and they shall not be found: for I will pardon them whom I reserve.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:21
verses.text: ¶ Go up against the land of Merathaim, <hi type="italic">even</hi> against it, and against the inhabitants of Pekod: waste and utterly destroy after them, saith the Lord, and do according to all that I have commanded thee.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:22
verses.text: A sound of battle <hi type="italic">is</hi> in the land, and of great destruction.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:23
verses.text: How is the hammer of the whole earth cut asunder and broken! how is Babylon become a desolation among the nations!

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:24
verses.text: I have laid a snare for thee, and thou art also taken, O Babylon, and thou wast not aware: thou art found, and also caught, because thou hast striven against the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:25
verses.text: The Lord hath opened his armoury, and hath brought forth the weapons of his indignation: for this <hi type="italic">is</hi> the work of the Lord God of hosts in the land of the Chaldeans.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:26
verses.text: Come against her from the utmost border, open her storehouses: cast her up as heaps, and destroy her utterly: let nothing of her be left.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:27
verses.text: Slay all her bullocks; let them go down to the slaughter: woe unto them! for their day is come, the time of their visitation.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:28
verses.text: The voice of them that flee and escape out of the land of Babylon, to declare in Zion the vengeance of the Lord our God, the vengeance of his temple.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:29
verses.text: Call together the archers against Babylon: all ye that bend the bow, camp against it round about; let none thereof escape: recompense her according to her work; according to all that she hath done, do unto her: for she hath been proud against the Lord, against the Holy One of Israel.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:30
verses.text: Therefore shall her young men fall in the streets, and all her men of war shall be cut off in that day, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:31
verses.text: Behold, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> against thee, <hi type="italic">O thou</hi> most proud, saith the Lord God of hosts: for thy day is come, the time <hi type="italic">that</hi> I will visit thee.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:32
verses.text: And the most proud shall stumble and fall, and none shall raise him up: and I will kindle a fire in his cities, and it shall devour all round about him.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:33
verses.text: ¶ Thus saith the Lord of hosts; The children of Israel and the children of Judah <hi type="italic">were</hi> oppressed together: and all that took them captives held them fast; they refused to let them go.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:34
verses.text: Their Redeemer <hi type="italic">is</hi> strong; the Lord of hosts <hi type="italic">is</hi> his name: he shall throughly plead their cause, that he may give rest to the land, and disquiet the inhabitants of Babylon.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:35
verses.text: ¶ A sword <hi type="italic">is</hi> upon the Chaldeans, saith the Lord, and upon the inhabitants of Babylon, and upon her princes, and upon her wise <hi type="italic">men</hi>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:36
verses.text: A sword <hi type="italic">is</hi> upon the liars; and they shall dote: a sword <hi type="italic">is</hi> upon her mighty men; and they shall be dismayed.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:37
verses.text: A sword <hi type="italic">is</hi> upon their horses, and upon their chariots, and upon all the mingled people that <hi type="italic">are</hi> in the midst of her; and they shall become as women: a sword <hi type="italic">is</hi> upon her treasures; and they shall be robbed.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:38
verses.text: A drought <hi type="italic">is</hi> upon her waters; and they shall be dried up: for it <hi type="italic">is</hi> the land of graven images, and they are mad upon <hi type="italic">their</hi> idols.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:39
verses.text: Therefore the wild beasts of the desert with the wild beasts of the islands shall dwell <hi type="italic">there</hi>, and the owls shall dwell therein: and it shall be no more inhabited for ever; neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:40
verses.text: As God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour <hi type="italic">cities</hi> thereof, saith the Lord; <hi type="italic">so</hi> shall no man abide there, neither shall any son of man dwell therein.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:41
verses.text: Behold, a people shall come from the north, and a great nation, and many kings shall be raised up from the coasts of the earth.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:42
verses.text: They shall hold the bow and the lance: they <hi type="italic">are</hi> cruel, and will not shew mercy: their voice shall roar like the sea, and they shall ride upon horses, <hi type="italic">every one</hi> put in array, like a man to the battle, against thee, O daughter of Babylon.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:43
verses.text: The king of Babylon hath heard the report of them, and his hands waxed feeble: anguish took hold of him, <hi type="italic">and</hi> pangs as of a woman in travail.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:44
verses.text: Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan unto the habitation of the strong: but I will make them suddenly run away from her: and who <hi type="italic">is</hi> a chosen <hi type="italic">man</hi>, <hi type="italic">that</hi> I may appoint over her? for who <hi type="italic">is</hi> like me? and who will appoint me the time? and who <hi type="italic">is</hi> that shepherd that will stand before me?

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:45
verses.text: Therefore hear ye the counsel of the Lord, that he hath taken against Babylon; and his purposes, that he hath purposed against the land of the Chaldeans: Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out: surely he shall make <hi type="italic">their</hi> habitation desolate with them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:46
verses.text: At the noise of the taking of Babylon the earth is moved, and the cry is heard among the nations.  <chapter eID="Jer.50"/><div eID="gen863" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:1
verses.text: THUS saith the Lord; Behold, I will raise up against Babylon, and against them that dwell in the midst of them that rise up against me, a destroying wind;

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:2
verses.text: And will send unto Babylon fanners, that shall fan her, and shall empty her land: for in the day of trouble they shall be against her round about.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:3
verses.text: Against <hi type="italic">him that</hi> bendeth let the archer bend his bow, and against <hi type="italic">him that</hi> lifteth himself up in his brigandine: and spare ye not her young men; destroy ye utterly all her host.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:4
verses.text: Thus the slain shall fall in the land of the Chaldeans, and <hi type="italic">they that are</hi> thrust through in her streets.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:5
verses.text: For Israel <hi type="italic">hath</hi> not <hi type="italic">been</hi> forsaken, nor Judah of his God, of the Lord of hosts; though their land was filled with sin against the Holy One of Israel.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:6
verses.text: Flee out of the midst of Babylon, and deliver every man his soul: be not cut off in her iniquity; for this <hi type="italic">is</hi> the time of the Lord’s vengeance; he will render unto her a recompence.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:7
verses.text: Babylon <hi type="italic">hath been</hi> a golden cup in the Lord’s hand, that made all the earth drunken: the nations have drunken of her wine; therefore the nations are mad.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:8
verses.text: Babylon is suddenly fallen and destroyed: howl for her; take balm for her pain, if so be she may be healed.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:9
verses.text: We would have healed Babylon, but she is not healed: forsake her, and let us go every one into his own country: for her judgment reacheth unto heaven, and is lifted up <hi type="italic">even</hi> to the skies.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:10
verses.text: The Lord hath brought forth our righteousness: come, and let us declare in Zion the work of the Lord our God.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:11
verses.text: Make bright the arrows; gather the shields: the Lord hath raised up the spirit of the kings of the Medes: for his device <hi type="italic">is</hi> against Babylon, to destroy it; because it <hi type="italic">is</hi> the vengeance of the Lord, the vengeance of his temple.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:12
verses.text: Set up the standard upon the walls of Babylon, make the watch strong, set up the watchmen, prepare the ambushes: for the Lord hath both devised and done that which he spake against the inhabitants of Babylon.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:13
verses.text: O thou that dwellest upon many waters, abundant in treasures, thine end is come, <hi type="italic">and</hi> the measure of thy covetousness.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:14
verses.text: The Lord of hosts hath sworn by himself, <hi type="italic">saying</hi>, Surely I will fill thee with men, as with caterpillers; and they shall lift up a shout against thee.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:15
verses.text: He hath made the earth by his power, he hath established the world by his wisdom, and hath stretched out the heaven by his understanding.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:16
verses.text: When he uttereth <hi type="italic">his</hi> voice, <hi type="italic">there is</hi> a multitude of waters in the heavens; and he causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth: he maketh lightnings with rain, and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasures.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:17
verses.text: Every man is brutish by <hi type="italic">his</hi> knowledge; every founder is confounded by the graven image: for his molten image <hi type="italic">is</hi> falsehood, and <hi type="italic">there is</hi> no breath in them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:18
verses.text: They <hi type="italic">are</hi> vanity, the work of errors: in the time of their visitation they shall perish.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:19
verses.text: The portion of Jacob <hi type="italic">is</hi> not like them; for he <hi type="italic">is</hi> the former of all things: and <hi type="italic">Israel is</hi> the rod of his inheritance: the Lord of hosts <hi type="italic">is</hi> his name.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:20
verses.text: Thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> my battle axe <hi type="italic">and</hi> weapons of war: for with thee will I break in pieces the nations, and with thee will I destroy kingdoms;

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:21
verses.text: And with thee will I break in pieces the horse and his rider; and with thee will I break in pieces the chariot and his rider;

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:22
verses.text: With thee also will I break in pieces man and woman; and with thee will I break in pieces old and young; and with thee will I break in pieces the young man and the maid;

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:23
verses.text: I will also break in pieces with thee the shepherd and his flock; and with thee will I break in pieces the husbandman and his yoke of oxen; and with thee will I break in pieces captains and rulers.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:24
verses.text: And I will render unto Babylon and to all the inhabitants of Chaldea all their evil that they have done in Zion in your sight, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:25
verses.text: Behold, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> against thee, O destroying mountain, saith the Lord, which destroyest all the earth: and I will stretch out mine hand upon thee, and roll thee down from the rocks, and will make thee a burnt mountain.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:26
verses.text: And they shall not take of thee a stone for a corner, nor a stone for foundations; but thou shalt be desolate for ever, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:27
verses.text: Set ye up a standard in the land, blow the trumpet among the nations, prepare the nations against her, call together against her the kingdoms of Ararat, Minni, and Ashchenaz; appoint a captain against her; cause the horses to come up as the rough caterpillers.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:28
verses.text: Prepare against her the nations with the kings of the Medes, the captains thereof, and all the rulers thereof, and all the land of his dominion.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:29
verses.text: And the land shall tremble and sorrow: for every purpose of the Lord shall be performed against Babylon, to make the land of Babylon a desolation without an inhabitant.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:30
verses.text: The mighty men of Babylon have forborn to fight, they have remained in <hi type="italic">their</hi> holds: their might hath failed; they became as women: they have burned her dwellingplaces; her bars are broken.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:31
verses.text: One post shall run to meet another, and one messenger to meet another, to shew the king of Babylon that his city is taken at <hi type="italic">one</hi> end,

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:32
verses.text: And that the passages are stopped, and the reeds they have burned with fire, and the men of war are affrighted.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:33
verses.text: For thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; The daughter of Babylon <hi type="italic">is</hi> like a threshingfloor, <hi type="italic">it is</hi> time to thresh her: yet a little while, and the time of her harvest shall come.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:34
verses.text: Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon hath devoured me, he hath crushed me, he hath made me an empty vessel, he hath swallowed me up like a dragon, he hath filled his belly with my delicates, he hath cast me out.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:35
