verses.text: ¶ And it came to pass, while they were slaying them, and I was left, that I fell upon my face, and cried, and said, Ah Lord God! wilt thou destroy all the residue of Israel in thy pouring out of thy fury upon Jerusalem?

verses.name: Ezekiel 9:9
verses.text: Then said he unto me, The iniquity of the house of Israel and Judah <hi type="italic">is</hi> exceeding great, and the land is full of blood, and the city full of perverseness: for they say, The Lord hath forsaken the earth, and the Lord seeth not.

verses.name: Ezekiel 9:10
verses.text: And as for me also, mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity, <hi type="italic">but</hi> I will recompense their way upon their head.

verses.name: Ezekiel 9:11
verses.text: And, behold, the man clothed with linen, which <hi type="italic">had</hi> the inkhorn by his side, reported the matter, saying, I have done as thou hast commanded me.  <chapter eID="Ezek.9"/><div eID="gen881" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:1
verses.text: THEN I looked, and, behold, in the firmament that was above the head of the cherubims there appeared over them as it were a sapphire stone, as the appearance of the likeness of a throne.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:2
verses.text: And he spake unto the man clothed with linen, and said, Go in between the wheels, <hi type="italic">even</hi> under the cherub, and fill thine hand with coals of fire from between the cherubims, and scatter <hi type="italic">them</hi> over the city. And he went in in my sight.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:3
verses.text: Now the cherubims stood on the right side of the house, when the man went in; and the cloud filled the inner court.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:4
verses.text: Then the glory of the Lord went up from the cherub, <hi type="italic">and stood</hi> over the threshold of the house; and the house was filled with the cloud, and the court was full of the brightness of the Lord’s glory.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:5
verses.text: And the sound of the cherubims’ wings was heard <hi type="italic">even</hi> to the outer court, as the voice of the Almighty God when he speaketh.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:6
verses.text: And it came to pass, <hi type="italic">that</hi> when he had commanded the man clothed with linen, saying, Take fire from between the wheels, from between the cherubims; then he went in, and stood beside the wheels.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:7
verses.text: And <hi type="italic">one</hi> cherub stretched forth his hand from between the cherubims unto the fire that <hi type="italic">was</hi> between the cherubims, and took <hi type="italic">thereof</hi>, and put <hi type="italic">it</hi> into the hands of <hi type="italic">him that was</hi> clothed with linen: who took <hi type="italic">it</hi>, and went out.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:8
verses.text: ¶ And there appeared in the cherubims the form of a man’s hand under their wings.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:9
verses.text: And when I looked, behold the four wheels by the cherubims, one wheel by one cherub, and another wheel by another cherub: and the appearance of the wheels <hi type="italic">was</hi> as the colour of a beryl stone.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:10
verses.text: And <hi type="italic">as for</hi> their appearances, they four had one likeness, as if a wheel had been in the midst of a wheel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:11
verses.text: When they went, they went upon their four sides; they turned not as they went, but to the place whither the head looked they followed it; they turned not as they went.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:12
verses.text: And their whole body, and their backs, and their hands, and their wings, and the wheels, <hi type="italic">were</hi> full of eyes round about, <hi type="italic">even</hi> the wheels that they four had.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:13
verses.text: As for the wheels, it was cried unto them in my hearing, O wheel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:14
verses.text: And every one had four faces: the first face <hi type="italic">was</hi> the face of a cherub, and the second face <hi type="italic">was</hi> the face of a man, and the third the face of a lion, and the fourth the face of an eagle.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:15
verses.text: And the cherubims were lifted up. This <hi type="italic">is</hi> the living creature that I saw by the river of Chebar.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:16
verses.text: And when the cherubims went, the wheels went by them: and when the cherubims lifted up their wings to mount up from the earth, the same wheels also turned not from beside them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:17
verses.text: When they stood, <hi type="italic">these</hi> stood; and when they were lifted up, <hi type="italic">these</hi> lifted up themselves <hi type="italic">also:</hi> for the spirit of the living creature <hi type="italic">was</hi> in them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:18
verses.text: Then the glory of the Lord departed from off the threshold of the house, and stood over the cherubims.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:19
verses.text: And the cherubims lifted up their wings, and mounted up from the earth in my sight: when they went out, the wheels also <hi type="italic">were</hi> beside them, and <hi type="italic">every one</hi> stood at the door of the east gate of the Lord’s house; and the glory of the God of Israel <hi type="italic">was</hi> over them above.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:20
verses.text: This <hi type="italic">is</hi> the living creature that I saw under the God of Israel by the river of Chebar; and I knew that they <hi type="italic">were</hi> the cherubims.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:21
verses.text: Every one had four faces apiece, and every one four wings; and the likeness of the hands of a man <hi type="italic">was</hi> under their wings.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:22
verses.text: And the likeness of their faces <hi type="italic">was</hi> the same faces which I saw by the river of Chebar, their appearances and themselves: they went every one straight forward.  <chapter eID="Ezek.10"/><div eID="gen882" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:1
verses.text: MOREOVER the spirit lifted me up, and brought me unto the east gate of the Lord’s house, which looketh eastward: and behold at the door of the gate five and twenty men; among whom I saw Jaazaniah the son of Azur, and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah, princes of the people.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:2
verses.text: Then said he unto me, Son of man, these <hi type="italic">are</hi> the men that devise mischief, and give wicked counsel in this city:

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:3
verses.text: Which say, <hi type="italic">It is</hi> not near; let us build houses: this <hi type="italic">city is</hi> the caldron, and we <hi type="italic">be</hi> the flesh.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:4
verses.text: ¶ Therefore prophesy against them, prophesy, O son of man.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:5
verses.text: And the Spirit of the Lord fell upon me, and said unto me, Speak; Thus saith the Lord; Thus have ye said, O house of Israel: for I know the things that come into your mind, <hi type="italic">every one of</hi> them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:6
verses.text: Ye have multiplied your slain in this city, and ye have filled the streets thereof with the slain.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:7
verses.text: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Your slain whom ye have laid in the midst of it, they <hi type="italic">are</hi> the flesh, and this <hi type="italic">city is</hi> the caldron: but I will bring you forth out of the midst of it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:8
verses.text: Ye have feared the sword; and I will bring a sword upon you, saith the Lord God.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:9
verses.text: And I will bring you out of the midst thereof, and deliver you into the hands of strangers, and will execute judgments among you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:10
verses.text: Ye shall fall by the sword; I will judge you in the border of Israel; and ye shall know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:11
verses.text: This <hi type="italic">city</hi> shall not be your caldron, neither shall ye be the flesh in the midst thereof; <hi type="italic">but</hi> I will judge you in the border of Israel:

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:12
verses.text: And ye shall know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord: for ye have not walked in my statutes, neither executed my judgments, but have done after the manners of the heathen that <hi type="italic">are</hi> round about you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:13
verses.text: ¶ And it came to pass, when I prophesied, that Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died. Then fell I down upon my face, and cried with a loud voice, and said, Ah Lord God! wilt thou make a full end of the remnant of Israel?

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:14
verses.text: Again the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:15
verses.text: Son of man, thy brethren, <hi type="italic">even</hi> thy brethren, the men of thy kindred, and all the house of Israel wholly, <hi type="italic">are</hi> they unto whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said, Get you far from the Lord: unto us is this land given in possession.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:16
verses.text: Therefore say, Thus saith the Lord God; Although I have cast them far off among the heathen, and although I have scattered them among the countries, yet will I be to them as a little sanctuary in the countries where they shall come.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:17
verses.text: Therefore say, Thus saith the Lord God; I will even gather you from the people, and assemble you out of the countries where ye have been scattered, and I will give you the land of Israel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:18
verses.text: And they shall come thither, and they shall take away all the detestable things thereof and all the abominations thereof from thence.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:19
verses.text: And I will give them one heart, and I will put a new spirit within you; and I will take the stony heart out of their flesh, and will give them an heart of flesh:

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:20
verses.text: That they may walk in my statutes, and keep mine ordinances, and do them: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:21
verses.text: But <hi type="italic">as for them</hi> whose heart walketh after the heart of their detestable things and their abominations, I will recompense their way upon their own heads, saith the Lord God.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:22
verses.text: ¶ Then did the cherubims lift up their wings, and the wheels beside them; and the glory of the God of Israel <hi type="italic">was</hi> over them above.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:23
verses.text: And the glory of the Lord went up from the midst of the city, and stood upon the mountain which <hi type="italic">is</hi> on the east side of the city.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:24
verses.text: ¶ Afterwards the spirit took me up, and brought me in a vision by the Spirit of God into Chaldea, to them of the captivity. So the vision that I had seen went up from me.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:25
verses.text: Then I spake unto them of the captivity all the things that the Lord had shewed me.  <chapter eID="Ezek.11"/><div eID="gen883" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:1
verses.text: THE word of the Lord also came unto me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:2
verses.text: Son of man, thou dwellest in the midst of a rebellious house, which have eyes to see, and see not; they have ears to hear, and hear not: for they <hi type="italic">are</hi> a rebellious house.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:3
verses.text: Therefore, thou son of man, prepare thee stuff for removing, and remove by day in their sight; and thou shalt remove from thy place to another place in their sight: it may be they will consider, though they <hi type="italic">be</hi> a rebellious house.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:4
verses.text: Then shalt thou bring forth thy stuff by day in their sight, as stuff for removing: and thou shalt go forth at even in their sight, as they that go forth into captivity.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:5
verses.text: Dig thou through the wall in their sight, and carry out thereby.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:6
verses.text: In their sight shalt thou bear <hi type="italic">it</hi> upon <hi type="italic">thy</hi> shoulders, <hi type="italic">and</hi> carry <hi type="italic">it</hi> forth in the twilight: thou shalt cover thy face, that thou see not the ground: for I have set thee <hi type="italic">for</hi> a sign unto the house of Israel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:7
verses.text: And I did so as I was commanded: I brought forth my stuff by day, as stuff for captivity, and in the even I digged through the wall with mine hand; I brought <hi type="italic">it</hi> forth in the twilight, <hi type="italic">and</hi> I bare <hi type="italic">it</hi> upon <hi type="italic">my</hi> shoulder in their sight.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:8
verses.text: ¶ And in the morning came the word of the Lord unto me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:9
verses.text: Son of man, hath not the house of Israel, the rebellious house, said unto thee, What doest thou?

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:10
verses.text: Say thou unto them, Thus saith the Lord God; This burden <hi type="italic">concerneth</hi> the prince in Jerusalem, and all the house of Israel that <hi type="italic">are</hi> among them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:11
verses.text: Say, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> your sign: like as I have done, so shall it be done unto them: they shall remove <hi type="italic">and</hi> go into captivity.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:12
verses.text: And the prince that <hi type="italic">is</hi> among them shall bear upon <hi type="italic">his</hi> shoulder in the twilight, and shall go forth: they shall dig through the wall to carry out thereby: he shall cover his face, that he see not the ground with <hi type="italic">his</hi> eyes.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:13
verses.text: My net also will I spread upon him, and he shall be taken in my snare: and I will bring him to Babylon <hi type="italic">to</hi> the land of the Chaldeans; yet shall he not see it, though he shall die there.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:14
verses.text: And I will scatter toward every wind all that <hi type="italic">are</hi> about him to help him, and all his bands; and I will draw out the sword after them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:15
verses.text: And they shall know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord, when I shall scatter them among the nations, and disperse them in the countries.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:16
verses.text: But I will leave a few men of them from the sword, from the famine, and from the pestilence; that they may declare all their abominations among the heathen whither they come; and they shall know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:17
verses.text: ¶ Moreover the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:18
verses.text: Son of man, eat thy bread with quaking, and drink thy water with trembling and with carefulness;

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:19
verses.text: And say unto the people of the land, Thus saith the Lord God of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, <hi type="italic">and</hi> of the land of Israel; They shall eat their bread with carefulness, and drink their water with astonishment, that her land may be desolate from all that is therein, because of the violence of all them that dwell therein.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:20
verses.text: And the cities that are inhabited shall be laid waste, and the land shall be desolate; and ye shall know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:21
verses.text: ¶ And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:22
verses.text: Son of man, what <hi type="italic">is</hi> that proverb <hi type="italic">that</hi> ye have in the land of Israel, saying, The days are prolonged, and every vision faileth?

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:23
verses.text: Tell them therefore, Thus saith the Lord God; I will make this proverb to cease, and they shall no more use it as a proverb in Israel; but say unto them, The days are at hand, and the effect of every vision.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:24
verses.text: For there shall be no more any vain vision nor flattering divination within the house of Israel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:25
verses.text: For I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord: I will speak, and the word that I shall speak shall come to pass; it shall be no more prolonged: for in your days, O rebellious house, will I say the word, and will perform it, saith the Lord God.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:26
verses.text: ¶ Again the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:27
verses.text: Son of man, behold, <hi type="italic">they of</hi> the house of Israel say, The vision that he seeth <hi type="italic">is</hi> for many days <hi type="italic">to come</hi>, and he prophesieth of the times <hi type="italic">that are</hi> far off.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:28
verses.text: Therefore say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God; There shall none of my words be prolonged any more, but the word which I have spoken shall be done, saith the Lord God.  <chapter eID="Ezek.12"/><div eID="gen884" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:1
verses.text: AND the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:2
verses.text: Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel that prophesy, and say thou unto them that prophesy out of their own hearts, Hear ye the word of the Lord;

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:3
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord God; Woe unto the foolish prophets, that follow their own spirit, and have seen nothing!

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:4
verses.text: O Israel, thy prophets are like the foxes in the deserts.

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:5
verses.text: Ye have not gone up into the gaps, neither made up the hedge for the house of Israel to stand in the battle in the day of the Lord.

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:6
verses.text: They have seen vanity and lying divination, saying, The Lord saith: and the Lord hath not sent them: and they have made <hi type="italic">others</hi> to hope that they would confirm the word.

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:7
verses.text: Have ye not seen a vain vision, and have ye not spoken a lying divination, whereas ye say, The Lord saith <hi type="italic">it;</hi> albeit I have not spoken?

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:8
verses.text: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Because ye have spoken vanity, and seen lies, therefore, behold, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> against you, saith the Lord God.

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:9
verses.text: And mine hand shall be upon the prophets that see vanity, and that divine lies: they shall not be in the assembly of my people, neither shall they be written in the writing of the house of Israel, neither shall they enter into the land of Israel; and ye shall know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord God.

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:10
verses.text: ¶ Because, even because they have seduced my people, saying, Peace; and <hi type="italic">there was</hi> no peace; and one built up a wall, and, lo, others daubed it with untempered <hi type="italic">morter:</hi>

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:11
verses.text: Say unto them which daub <hi type="italic">it</hi> with untempered <hi type="italic">morter</hi>, that it shall fall: there shall be an overflowing shower; and ye, O great hailstones, shall fall; and a stormy wind shall rend <hi type="italic">it</hi>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:12
verses.text: Lo, when the wall is fallen, shall it not be said unto you, Where <hi type="italic">is</hi> the daubing wherewith ye have daubed <hi type="italic">it?</hi>

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:13
verses.text: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; I will even rend <hi type="italic">it</hi> with a stormy wind in my fury; and there shall be an overflowing shower in mine anger, and great hailstones in <hi type="italic">my</hi> fury to consume <hi type="italic">it</hi>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:14
verses.text: So will I break down the wall that ye have daubed with untempered <hi type="italic">morter</hi>, and bring it down to the ground, so that the foundation thereof shall be discovered, and it shall fall, and ye shall be consumed in the midst thereof: and ye shall know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord.

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:15
verses.text: Thus will I accomplish my wrath upon the wall, and upon them that have daubed it with untempered <hi type="italic">morter</hi>, and will say unto you, The wall <hi type="italic">is</hi> no <hi type="italic">more</hi>, neither they that daubed it;

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:16
verses.text: <hi type="italic">To wit</hi>, the prophets of Israel which prophesy concerning Jerusalem, and which see visions of peace for her, and <hi type="italic">there is</hi> no peace, saith the Lord God.

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:17
verses.text: ¶ Likewise, thou son of man, set thy face against the daughters of thy people, which prophesy out of their own heart; and prophesy thou against them,

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:18
verses.text: And say, Thus saith the Lord God; Woe to the <hi type="italic">women</hi> that sew pillows to all armholes, and make kerchiefs upon the head of every stature to hunt souls! Will ye hunt the souls of my people, and will ye save the souls alive <hi type="italic">that come</hi> unto you?

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:19
verses.text: And will ye pollute me among my people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread, to slay the souls that should not die, and to save the souls alive that should not live, by your lying to my people that hear <hi type="italic">your</hi> lies?

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:20
verses.text: Wherefore thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> against your pillows, wherewith ye there hunt the souls to make <hi type="italic">them</hi> fly, and I will tear them from your arms, and will let the souls go, <hi type="italic">even</hi> the souls that ye hunt to make <hi type="italic">them</hi> fly.

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:21
verses.text: Your kerchiefs also will I tear, and deliver my people out of your hand, and they shall be no more in your hand to be hunted; and ye shall know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord.

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:22
verses.text: Because with lies ye have made the heart of the righteous sad, whom I have not made sad; and strengthened the hands of the wicked, that he should not return from his wicked way, by promising him life:

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:23
verses.text: Therefore ye shall see no more vanity, nor divine divinations: for I will deliver my people out of your hand: and ye shall know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord.  <chapter eID="Ezek.13"/><div eID="gen885" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:1
verses.text: THEN came certain of the elders of Israel unto me, and sat before me.

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:2
verses.text: And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:3
verses.text: Son of man, these men have set up their idols in their heart, and put the stumblingblock of their iniquity before their face: should I be inquired of at all by them?

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:4
verses.text: Therefore speak unto them, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God; Every man of the house of Israel that setteth up his idols in his heart, and putteth the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face, and cometh to the prophet; I the Lord will answer him that cometh according to the multitude of his idols;

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:5
verses.text: That I may take the house of Israel in their own heart, because they are all estranged from me through their idols.

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:6
verses.text: ¶ Therefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord God; Repent, and turn <hi type="italic">yourselves</hi> from your idols; and turn away your faces from all your abominations.

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:7
verses.text: For every one of the house of Israel, or of the stranger that sojourneth in Israel, which separateth himself from me, and setteth up his idols in his heart, and putteth the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face, and cometh to a prophet to inquire of him concerning me; I the Lord will answer him by myself:

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:8
verses.text: And I will set my face against that man, and will make him a sign and a proverb, and I will cut him off from the midst of my people; and ye shall know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord.

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:9
verses.text: And if the prophet be deceived when he hath spoken a thing, I the Lord have deceived that prophet, and I will stretch out my hand upon him, and will destroy him from the midst of my people Israel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:10
verses.text: And they shall bear the punishment of their iniquity: the punishment of the prophet shall be even as the punishment of him that seeketh <hi type="italic">unto him;</hi>

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:11
verses.text: That the house of Israel may go no more astray from me, neither be polluted any more with all their transgressions; but that they may be my people, and I may be their God, saith the Lord God.

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:12
verses.text: ¶ The word of the Lord came again to me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:13
verses.text: Son of man, when the land sinneth against me by trespassing grievously, then will I stretch out mine hand upon it, and will break the staff of the bread thereof, and will send famine upon it, and will cut off man and beast from it:

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:14
verses.text: Though these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, they should deliver <hi type="italic">but</hi> their own souls by their righteousness, saith the Lord God.

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:15
verses.text: ¶ If I cause noisome beasts to pass through the land, and they spoil it, so that it be desolate, that no man may pass through because of the beasts:

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:16
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Though</hi> these three men <hi type="italic">were</hi> in it, <hi type="italic">as</hi> I live, saith the Lord God, they shall deliver neither sons nor daughters; they only shall be delivered, but the land shall be desolate.

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:17
verses.text: ¶ Or <hi type="italic">if</hi> I bring a sword upon that land, and say, Sword, go through the land; so that I cut off man and beast from it:

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:18
verses.text: Though these three men <hi type="italic">were</hi> in it, <hi type="italic">as</hi> I live, saith the Lord God, they shall deliver neither sons nor daughters, but they only shall be delivered themselves.

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:19
verses.text: ¶ Or <hi type="italic">if</hi> I send a pestilence into that land, and pour out my fury upon it in blood, to cut off from it man and beast:

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:20
verses.text: Though Noah, Daniel, and Job, <hi type="italic">were</hi> in it, <hi type="italic">as</hi> I live, saith the Lord God, they shall deliver neither son nor daughter; they shall <hi type="italic">but</hi> deliver their own souls by their righteousness.

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:21
verses.text: For thus saith the Lord God; How much more when I send my four sore judgments upon Jerusalem, the sword, and the famine, and the noisome beast, and the pestilence, to cut off from it man and beast?

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:22
verses.text: ¶ Yet, behold, therein shall be left a remnant that shall be brought forth, <hi type="italic">both</hi> sons and daughters: behold, they shall come forth unto you, and ye shall see their way and their doings: and ye shall be comforted concerning the evil that I have brought upon Jerusalem, <hi type="italic">even</hi> concerning all that I have brought upon it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:23
verses.text: And they shall comfort you, when ye see their ways and their doings: and ye shall know that I have not done without cause all that I have done in it, saith the Lord God.  <chapter eID="Ezek.14"/><div eID="gen886" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 15:1
verses.text: AND the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 15:2
verses.text: Son of man, What is the vine tree more than any tree, <hi type="italic">or than</hi> a branch which is among the trees of the forest?

verses.name: Ezekiel 15:3
verses.text: Shall wood be taken thereof to do any work? or will <hi type="italic">men</hi> take a pin of it to hang any vessel thereon?

verses.name: Ezekiel 15:4
verses.text: Behold, it is cast into the fire for fuel; the fire devoureth both the ends of it, and the midst of it is burned. Is it meet for <hi type="italic">any</hi> work?

verses.name: Ezekiel 15:5
verses.text: Behold, when it was whole, it was meet for no work: how much less shall it be meet yet for <hi type="italic">any</hi> work, when the fire hath devoured it, and it is burned?

verses.name: Ezekiel 15:6
verses.text: ¶ Therefore thus saith the Lord God; As the vine tree among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire for fuel, so will I give the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

verses.name: Ezekiel 15:7
verses.text: And I will set my face against them; they shall go out from <hi type="italic">one</hi> fire, and <hi type="italic">another</hi> fire shall devour them; and ye shall know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord, when I set my face against them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 15:8
verses.text: And I will make the land desolate, because they have committed a trespass, saith the Lord God.  <chapter eID="Ezek.15"/><div eID="gen887" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:1
verses.text: AGAIN the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:2
verses.text: Son of man, cause Jerusalem to know her abominations,

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:3
verses.text: And say, Thus saith the Lord God unto Jerusalem; Thy birth and thy nativity <hi type="italic">is</hi> of the land of Canaan; thy father <hi type="italic">was</hi> an Amorite, and thy mother an Hittite.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:4
verses.text: And <hi type="italic">as for</hi> thy nativity, in the day thou wast born thy navel was not cut, neither wast thou washed in water to supple <hi type="italic">thee;</hi> thou wast not salted at all, nor swaddled at all.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:5
verses.text: None eye pitied thee, to do any of these unto thee, to have compassion upon thee; but thou wast cast out in the open field, to the lothing of thy person, in the day that thou wast born.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:6
verses.text: ¶ And when I passed by thee, and saw thee polluted in thine own blood, I said unto thee <hi type="italic">when thou wast</hi> in thy blood, Live; yea, I said unto thee <hi type="italic">when thou wast</hi> in thy blood, Live.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:7
verses.text: I have caused thee to multiply as the bud of the field, and thou hast increased and waxen great, and thou art come to excellent ornaments: <hi type="italic">thy</hi> breasts are fashioned, and thine hair is grown, whereas thou <hi type="italic">wast</hi> naked and bare.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:8
verses.text: Now when I passed by thee, and looked upon thee, behold, thy time <hi type="italic">was</hi> the time of love; and I spread my skirt over thee, and covered thy nakedness: yea, I sware unto thee, and entered into a covenant with thee, saith the Lord God, and thou becamest mine.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:9
verses.text: Then washed I thee with water; yea, I throughly washed away thy blood from thee, and I anointed thee with oil.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:10
verses.text: I clothed thee also with broidered work, and shod thee with badgers’ skin, and I girded thee about with fine linen, and I covered thee with silk.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:11
verses.text: I decked thee also with ornaments, and I put bracelets upon thy hands, and a chain on thy neck.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:12
verses.text: And I put a jewel on thy forehead, and earrings in thine ears, and a beautiful crown upon thine head.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:13
verses.text: Thus wast thou decked with gold and silver; and thy raiment <hi type="italic">was of</hi> fine linen, and silk, and broidered work; thou didst eat fine flour, and honey, and oil: and thou wast exceeding beautiful, and thou didst prosper into a kingdom.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:14
verses.text: And thy renown went forth among the heathen for thy beauty: for it <hi type="italic">was</hi> perfect through my comeliness, which I had put upon thee, saith the Lord God.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:15
verses.text: ¶ But thou didst trust in thine own beauty, and playedst the harlot because of thy renown, and pouredst out thy fornications on every one that passed by; his it was.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:16
verses.text: And of thy garments thou didst take, and deckedst thy high places with divers colours, and playedst the harlot thereupon: <hi type="italic">the like things</hi> shall not come, neither shall it be <hi type="italic">so</hi>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:17
verses.text: Thou hast also taken thy fair jewels of my gold and of my silver, which I had given thee, and madest to thyself images of men, and didst commit whoredom with them,

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:18
verses.text: And tookest thy broidered garments, and coveredst them: and thou hast set mine oil and mine incense before them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:19
verses.text: My meat also which I gave thee, fine flour, and oil, and honey, <hi type="italic">wherewith</hi> I fed thee, thou hast even set it before them for a sweet savour: and <hi type="italic">thus</hi> it was, saith the Lord God.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:20
verses.text: Moreover thou hast taken thy sons and thy daughters, whom thou hast borne unto me, and these hast thou sacrificed unto them to be devoured. <hi type="italic">Is this</hi> of thy whoredoms a small matter,

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:21
verses.text: That thou hast slain my children, and delivered them to cause them to pass through <hi type="italic">the fire</hi> for them?

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:22
verses.text: And in all thine abominations and thy whoredoms thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth, when thou wast naked and bare, <hi type="italic">and</hi> wast polluted in thy blood.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:23
verses.text: And it came to pass after all thy wickedness, (woe, woe unto thee! saith the Lord God;)

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:24
verses.text: <hi type="italic">That</hi> thou hast also built unto thee an eminent place, and hast made thee an high place in every street.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:25
verses.text: Thou hast built thy high place at every head of the way, and hast made thy beauty to be abhorred, and hast opened thy feet to every one that passed by, and multiplied thy whoredoms.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:26
verses.text: Thou hast also committed fornication with the Egyptians thy neighbours, great of flesh; and hast increased thy whoredoms, to provoke me to anger.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:27
verses.text: Behold, therefore I have stretched out my hand over thee, and have diminished thine ordinary <hi type="italic">food</hi>, and delivered thee unto the will of them that hate thee, the daughters of the Philistines, which are ashamed of thy lewd way.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:28
verses.text: Thou hast played the whore also with the Assyrians, because thou wast unsatiable; yea, thou hast played the harlot with them, and yet couldest not be satisfied.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:29
verses.text: Thou hast moreover multiplied thy fornication in the land of Canaan unto Chaldea; and yet thou wast not satisfied herewith.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:30
verses.text: How weak is thine heart, saith the Lord God, seeing thou doest all these <hi type="italic">things</hi>, the work of an imperious whorish woman;

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:31
verses.text: In that thou buildest thine eminent place in the head of every way, and makest thine high place in every street; and hast not been as an harlot, in that thou scornest hire;

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:32
verses.text: <hi type="italic">But as</hi> a wife that committeth adultery, <hi type="italic">which</hi> taketh strangers instead of her husband!

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:33
verses.text: They give gifts to all whores: but thou givest thy gifts to all thy lovers, and hirest them, that they may come unto thee on every side for thy whoredom.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:34
verses.text: And the contrary is in thee from <hi type="italic">other</hi> women in thy whoredoms, whereas none followeth thee to commit whoredoms: and in that thou givest a reward, and no reward is given unto thee, therefore thou art contrary.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:35
verses.text: ¶ Wherefore, O harlot, hear the word of the Lord:

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:36
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord God; Because thy filthiness was poured out, and thy nakedness discovered through thy whoredoms with thy lovers, and with all the idols of thy abominations, and by the blood of thy children, which thou didst give unto them;

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:37
verses.text: Behold, therefore I will gather all thy lovers, with whom thou hast taken pleasure, and all <hi type="italic">them</hi> that thou hast loved, with all <hi type="italic">them</hi> that thou hast hated; I will even gather them round about against thee, and will discover thy nakedness unto them, that they may see all thy nakedness.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:38
verses.text: And I will judge thee, as women that break wedlock and shed blood are judged; and I will give thee blood in fury and jealousy.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:39
verses.text: And I will also give thee into their hand, and they shall throw down thine eminent place, and shall break down thy high places: they shall strip thee also of thy clothes, and shall take thy fair jewels, and leave thee naked and bare.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:40
verses.text: They shall also bring up a company against thee, and they shall stone thee with stones, and thrust thee through with their swords.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:41
verses.text: And they shall burn thine houses with fire, and execute judgments upon thee in the sight of many women: and I will cause thee to cease from playing the harlot, and thou also shalt give no hire any more.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:42
verses.text: So will I make my fury toward thee to rest, and my jealousy shall depart from thee, and I will be quiet, and will be no more angry.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:43
verses.text: Because thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth, but hast fretted me in all these <hi type="italic">things;</hi> behold, therefore I also will recompense thy way upon <hi type="italic">thine</hi> head, saith the Lord God: and thou shalt not commit this lewdness above all thine abominations.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:44
verses.text: ¶ Behold, every one that useth proverbs shall use <hi type="italic">this</hi> proverb against thee, saying, As <hi type="italic">is</hi> the mother, <hi type="italic">so is</hi> her daughter.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:45
verses.text: Thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> thy mother’s daughter, that lotheth her husband and her children; and thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> the sister of thy sisters, which lothed their husbands and their children: your mother <hi type="italic">was</hi> an Hittite, and your father an Amorite.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:46
verses.text: And thine elder sister <hi type="italic">is</hi> Samaria, she and her daughters that dwell at thy left hand: and thy younger sister, that dwelleth at thy right hand, <hi type="italic">is</hi> Sodom and her daughters.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:47
verses.text: Yet hast thou not walked after their ways, nor done after their abominations: but, as <hi type="italic">if that were</hi> a very little <hi type="italic">thing</hi>, thou wast corrupted more than they in all thy ways.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:48
verses.text: <hi type="italic">As</hi> I live, saith the Lord God, Sodom thy sister hath not done, she nor her daughters, as thou hast done, thou and thy daughters.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:49
verses.text: Behold, this was the iniquity of thy sister Sodom, pride, fulness of bread, and abundance of idleness was in her and in her daughters, neither did she strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:50
verses.text: And they were haughty, and committed abomination before me: therefore I took them away as I saw <hi type="italic">good</hi>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:51
verses.text: Neither hath Samaria committed half of thy sins; but thou hast multiplied thine abominations more than they, and hast justified thy sisters in all thine abominations which thou hast done.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:52
verses.text: Thou also, which hast judged thy sisters, bear thine own shame for thy sins that thou hast committed more abominable than they: they are more righteous than thou: yea, be thou confounded also, and bear thy shame, in that thou hast justified thy sisters.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:53
verses.text: When I shall bring again their captivity, the captivity of Sodom and her daughters, and the captivity of Samaria and her daughters, then <hi type="italic">will I bring again</hi> the captivity of thy captives in the midst of them:

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:54
verses.text: That thou mayest bear thine own shame, and mayest be confounded in all that thou hast done, in that thou art a comfort unto them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:55
verses.text: When thy sisters, Sodom and her daughters, shall return to their former estate, and Samaria and her daughters shall return to their former estate, then thou and thy daughters shall return to your former estate.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:56
verses.text: For thy sister Sodom was not mentioned by thy mouth in the day of thy pride,

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:57
verses.text: Before thy wickedness was discovered, as at the time of <hi type="italic">thy</hi> reproach of the daughters of Syria, and all <hi type="italic">that are</hi> round about her, the daughters of the Philistines, which despise thee round about.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:58
verses.text: Thou hast borne thy lewdness and thine abominations, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:59
verses.text: For thus saith the Lord God; I will even deal with thee as thou hast done, which hast despised the oath in breaking the covenant.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:60
verses.text: ¶ Nevertheless I will remember my covenant with thee in the days of thy youth, and I will establish unto thee an everlasting covenant.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:61
verses.text: Then thou shalt remember thy ways, and be ashamed, when thou shalt receive thy sisters, thine elder and thy younger: and I will give them unto thee for daughters, but not by thy covenant.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:62
verses.text: And I will establish my covenant with thee; and thou shalt know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord:

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:63
verses.text: That thou mayest remember, and be confounded, and never open thy mouth any more because of thy shame, when I am pacified toward thee for all that thou hast done, saith the Lord God.  <chapter eID="Ezek.16"/><div eID="gen888" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:1
verses.text: AND the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:2
verses.text: Son of man, put forth a riddle, and speak a parable unto the house of Israel;

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:3
verses.text: And say, Thus saith the Lord God; A great eagle with great wings, longwinged, full of feathers, which had divers colours, came unto Lebanon, and took the highest branch of the cedar:

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:4
verses.text: He cropped off the top of his young twigs, and carried it into a land of traffick; he set it in a city of merchants.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:5
verses.text: He took also of the seed of the land, and planted it in a fruitful field; he placed <hi type="italic">it</hi> by great waters, <hi type="italic">and</hi> set it <hi type="italic">as</hi> a willow tree.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:6
verses.text: And it grew, and became a spreading vine of low stature, whose branches turned toward him, and the roots thereof were under him: so it became a vine, and brought forth branches, and shot forth sprigs.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:7
verses.text: There was also another great eagle with great wings and many feathers: and, behold, this vine did bend her roots toward him, and shot forth her branches toward him, that he might water it by the furrows of her plantation.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:8
verses.text: It was planted in a good soil by great waters, that it might bring forth branches, and that it might bear fruit, that it might be a goodly vine.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:9
verses.text: Say thou, Thus saith the Lord God; Shall it prosper? shall he not pull up the roots thereof, and cut off the fruit thereof, that it wither? it shall wither in all the leaves of her spring, even without great power or many people to pluck it up by the roots thereof.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:10
verses.text: Yea, behold, <hi type="italic">being</hi> planted, shall it prosper? shall it not utterly wither, when the east wind toucheth it? it shall wither in the furrows where it grew.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:11
verses.text: ¶ Moreover the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:12
verses.text: Say now to the rebellious house, Know ye not what these <hi type="italic">things mean?</hi> tell <hi type="italic">them</hi>, Behold, the king of Babylon is come to Jerusalem, and hath taken the king thereof, and the princes thereof, and led them with him to Babylon;

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:13
verses.text: And hath taken of the king’s seed, and made a covenant with him, and hath taken an oath of him: he hath also taken the mighty of the land:

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:14
verses.text: That the kingdom might be base, that it might not lift itself up, <hi type="italic">but</hi> that by keeping of his covenant it might stand.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:15
verses.text: But he rebelled against him in sending his ambassadors into Egypt, that they might give him horses and much people. Shall he prosper? shall he escape that doeth such <hi type="italic">things?</hi> or shall he break the covenant, and be delivered?

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:16
verses.text: <hi type="italic">As</hi> I live, saith the Lord God, surely in the place <hi type="italic">where</hi> the king <hi type="italic">dwelleth</hi> that made him king, whose oath he despised, and whose covenant he brake, <hi type="italic">even</hi> with him in the midst of Babylon he shall die.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:17
verses.text: Neither shall Pharaoh with <hi type="italic">his</hi> mighty army and great company make for him in the war, by casting up mounts, and building forts, to cut off many persons:

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:18
verses.text: Seeing he despised the oath by breaking the covenant, when, lo, he had given his hand, and hath done all these <hi type="italic">things</hi>, he shall not escape.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:19
verses.text: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; <hi type="italic">As</hi> I live, surely mine oath that he hath despised, and my covenant that he hath broken, even it will I recompense upon his own head.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:20
verses.text: And I will spread my net upon him, and he shall be taken in my snare, and I will bring him to Babylon, and will plead with him there for his trespass that he hath trespassed against me.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:21
verses.text: And all his fugitives with all his bands shall fall by the sword, and they that remain shall be scattered toward all winds: and ye shall know that I the Lord have spoken <hi type="italic">it</hi>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:22
verses.text: ¶ Thus saith the Lord God; I will also take of the highest branch of the high cedar, and will set <hi type="italic">it;</hi> I will crop off from the top of his young twigs a tender one, and will plant <hi type="italic">it</hi> upon an high mountain and eminent:

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:23
verses.text: In the mountain of the height of Israel will I plant it: and it shall bring forth boughs, and bear fruit, and be a goodly cedar: and under it shall dwell all fowl of every wing; in the shadow of the branches thereof shall they dwell.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:24
verses.text: And all the trees of the field shall know that I the Lord have brought down the high tree, have exalted the low tree, have dried up the green tree, and have made the dry tree to flourish: I the Lord have spoken and have done <hi type="italic">it</hi>.  <chapter eID="Ezek.17"/><div eID="gen889" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:1
verses.text: THE word of the Lord came unto me again, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:2
verses.text: What mean ye, that ye use this proverb concerning the land of Israel, saying, The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children’s teeth are set on edge?

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:3
verses.text: <hi type="italic">As</hi> I live, saith the Lord God, ye shall not have <hi type="italic">occasion</hi> any more to use this proverb in Israel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:4
verses.text: Behold, all souls are mine; as the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son is mine: the soul that sinneth, it shall die.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:5
verses.text: ¶ But if a man be just, and do that which is lawful and right,

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:6
verses.text: <hi type="italic">And</hi> hath not eaten upon the mountains, neither hath lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, neither hath defiled his neighbour’s wife, neither hath come near to a menstruous woman,

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:7
verses.text: And hath not oppressed any, <hi type="italic">but</hi> hath restored to the debtor his pledge, hath spoiled none by violence, hath given his bread to the hungry, and hath covered the naked with a garment;

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:8
verses.text: He <hi type="italic">that</hi> hath not given forth upon usury, neither hath taken any increase, <hi type="italic">that</hi> hath withdrawn his hand from iniquity, hath executed true judgment between man and man,

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:9
verses.text: Hath walked in my statutes, and hath kept my judgments, to deal truly; he <hi type="italic">is</hi> just, he shall surely live, saith the Lord God.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:10
verses.text: ¶ If he beget a son <hi type="italic">that is</hi> a robber, a shedder of blood, and <hi type="italic">that</hi> doeth the like to <hi type="italic">any</hi> one of these <hi type="italic">things</hi>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:11
verses.text: And that doeth not any of those <hi type="italic">duties</hi>, but even hath eaten upon the mountains, and defiled his neighbour’s wife,

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:12
verses.text: Hath oppressed the poor and needy, hath spoiled by violence, hath not restored the pledge, and hath lifted up his eyes to the idols, hath committed abomination,

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:13
verses.text: Hath given forth upon usury, and hath taken increase: shall he then live? he shall not live: he hath done all these abominations; he shall surely die; his blood shall be upon him.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:14
verses.text: ¶ Now, lo, <hi type="italic">if</hi> he beget a son, that seeth all his father’s sins which he hath done, and considereth, and doeth not such like,

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:15
verses.text: <hi type="italic">That</hi> hath not eaten upon the mountains, neither hath lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, hath not defiled his neighbour’s wife,

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:16
verses.text: Neither hath oppressed any, hath not withholden the pledge, neither hath spoiled by violence, <hi type="italic">but</hi> hath given his bread to the hungry, and hath covered the naked with a garment,

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:17
verses.text: <hi type="italic">That</hi> hath taken off his hand from the poor, <hi type="italic">that</hi> hath not received usury nor increase, hath executed my judgments, hath walked in my statutes; he shall not die for the iniquity of his father, he shall surely live.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:18
verses.text: <hi type="italic">As for</hi> his father, because he cruelly oppressed, spoiled his brother by violence, and did <hi type="italic">that</hi> which <hi type="italic">is</hi> not good among his people, lo, even he shall die in his iniquity.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:19
verses.text: ¶ Yet say ye, Why? doth not the son bear the iniquity of the father? When the son hath done that which is lawful and right, <hi type="italic">and</hi> hath kept all my statutes, and hath done them, he shall surely live.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:20
verses.text: The soul that sinneth, it shall die. The son shall not bear the iniquity of the father, neither shall the father bear the iniquity of the son: the righteousness of the righteous shall be upon him, and the wickedness of the wicked shall be upon him.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:21
verses.text: But if the wicked will turn from all his sins that he hath committed, and keep all my statutes, and do that which is lawful and right, he shall surely live, he shall not die.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:22
verses.text: All his transgressions that he hath committed, they shall not be mentioned unto him: in his righteousness that he hath done he shall live.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:23
verses.text: Have I any pleasure at all that the wicked should die? saith the Lord God: <hi type="italic">and</hi> not that he should return from his ways, and live?

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:24
verses.text: ¶ But when the righteous turneth away from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, <hi type="italic">and</hi> doeth according to all the abominations that the wicked <hi type="italic">man</hi> doeth, shall he live? All his righteousness that he hath done shall not be mentioned: in his trespass that he hath trespassed, and in his sin that he hath sinned, in them shall he die.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:25
verses.text: ¶ Yet ye say, The way of the Lord is not equal. Hear now, O house of Israel; Is not my way equal? are not your ways unequal?

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:26
verses.text: When a righteous <hi type="italic">man</hi> turneth away from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, and dieth in them; for his iniquity that he hath done shall he die.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:27
verses.text: Again, when the wicked <hi type="italic">man</hi> turneth away from his wickedness that he hath committed, and doeth that which is lawful and right, he shall save his soul alive.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:28
verses.text: Because he considereth, and turneth away from all his transgressions that he hath committed, he shall surely live, he shall not die.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:29
verses.text: Yet saith the house of Israel, The way of the Lord is not equal. O house of Israel, are not my ways equal? are not your ways unequal?

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:30
verses.text: Therefore I will judge you, O house of Israel, every one according to his ways, saith the Lord God. Repent, and turn <hi type="italic">yourselves</hi> from all your transgressions; so iniquity shall not be your ruin.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:31
verses.text: ¶ Cast away from you all your transgressions, whereby ye have transgressed; and make you a new heart and a new spirit: for why will ye die, O house of Israel?

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:32
verses.text: For I have no pleasure in the death of him that dieth, saith the Lord God: wherefore turn <hi type="italic">yourselves</hi>, and live ye.  <chapter eID="Ezek.18"/><div eID="gen890" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:1
verses.text: MOREOVER take thou up a lamentation for the princes of Israel,

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:2
verses.text: And say, What <hi type="italic">is</hi> thy mother? A lioness: she lay down among lions, she nourished her whelps among young lions.

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:3
verses.text: And she brought up one of her whelps: it became a young lion, and it learned to catch the prey; it devoured men.

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:4
verses.text: The nations also heard of him; he was taken in their pit, and they brought him with chains unto the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:5
verses.text: Now when she saw that she had waited, <hi type="italic">and</hi> her hope was lost, then she took another of her whelps, <hi type="italic">and</hi> made him a young lion.

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:6
verses.text: And he went up and down among the lions, he became a young lion, and learned to catch the prey, <hi type="italic">and</hi> devoured men.

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:7
verses.text: And he knew their desolate palaces, and he laid waste their cities; and the land was desolate, and the fulness thereof, by the noise of his roaring.

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:8
verses.text: Then the nations set against him on every side from the provinces, and spread their net over him: he was taken in their pit.

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:9
verses.text: And they put him in ward in chains, and brought him to the king of Babylon: they brought him into holds, that his voice should no more be heard upon the mountains of Israel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:10
verses.text: ¶ Thy mother <hi type="italic">is</hi> like a vine in thy blood, planted by the waters: she was fruitful and full of branches by reason of many waters.

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:11
verses.text: And she had strong rods for the sceptres of them that bare rule, and her stature was exalted among the thick branches, and she appeared in her height with the multitude of her branches.

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:12
verses.text: But she was plucked up in fury, she was cast down to the ground, and the east wind dried up her fruit: her strong rods were broken and withered; the fire consumed them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:13
verses.text: And now she <hi type="italic">is</hi> planted in the wilderness, in a dry and thirsty ground.

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:14
verses.text: And fire is gone out of a rod of her branches, <hi type="italic">which</hi> hath devoured her fruit, so that she hath no strong rod <hi type="italic">to be</hi> a sceptre to rule. This <hi type="italic">is</hi> a lamentation, and shall be for a lamentation.  <chapter eID="Ezek.19"/><div eID="gen891" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:1
verses.text: AND it came to pass in the seventh year, in the fifth <hi type="italic">month</hi>, the tenth <hi type="italic">day</hi> of the month, <hi type="italic">that</hi> certain of the elders of Israel came to inquire of the Lord, and sat before me.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:2
verses.text: Then came the word of the Lord unto me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:3
verses.text: Son of man, speak unto the elders of Israel, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God; Are ye come to inquire of me? <hi type="italic">As</hi> I live, saith the Lord God, I will not be inquired of by you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:4
verses.text: Wilt thou judge them, son of man, wilt thou judge <hi type="italic">them?</hi> cause them to know the abominations of their fathers:

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:5
verses.text: ¶ And say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God; In the day when I chose Israel, and lifted up mine hand unto the seed of the house of Jacob, and made myself known unto them in the land of Egypt, when I lifted up mine hand unto them, saying, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord your God;

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:6
verses.text: In the day <hi type="italic">that</hi> I lifted up mine hand unto them, to bring them forth of the land of Egypt into a land that I had espied for them, flowing with milk and honey, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> the glory of all lands:

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:7
verses.text: Then said I unto them, Cast ye away every man the abominations of his eyes, and defile not yourselves with the idols of Egypt: I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord your God.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:8
verses.text: But they rebelled against me, and would not hearken unto me: they did not every man cast away the abominations of their eyes, neither did they forsake the idols of Egypt: then I said, I will pour out my fury upon them, to accomplish my anger against them in the midst of the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:9
verses.text: But I wrought for my name’s sake, that it should not be polluted before the heathen, among whom they <hi type="italic">were</hi>, in whose sight I made myself known unto them, in bringing them forth out of the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:10
verses.text: ¶ Wherefore I caused them to go forth out of the land of Egypt, and brought them into the wilderness.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:11
verses.text: And I gave them my statutes, and shewed them my judgments, which <hi type="italic">if</hi> a man do, he shall even live in them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:12
verses.text: Moreover also I gave them my sabbaths, to be a sign between me and them, that they might know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord that sanctify them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:13
verses.text: But the house of Israel rebelled against me in the wilderness: they walked not in my statutes, and they despised my judgments, which <hi type="italic">if</hi> a man do, he shall even live in them; and my sabbaths they greatly polluted: then I said, I would pour out my fury upon them in the wilderness, to consume them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:14
verses.text: But I wrought for my name’s sake, that it should not be polluted before the heathen, in whose sight I brought them out.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:15
verses.text: Yet also I lifted up my hand unto them in the wilderness, that I would not bring them into the land which I had given <hi type="italic">them</hi>, flowing with milk and honey, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> the glory of all lands;

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:16
verses.text: Because they despised my judgments, and walked not in my statutes, but polluted my sabbaths: for their heart went after their idols.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:17
verses.text: Nevertheless mine eye spared them from destroying them, neither did I make an end of them in the wilderness.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:18
verses.text: But I said unto their children in the wilderness, Walk ye not in the statutes of your fathers, neither observe their judgments, nor defile yourselves with their idols:

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:19
verses.text: I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord your God; walk in my statutes, and keep my judgments, and do them;

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:20
verses.text: And hallow my sabbaths; and they shall be a sign between me and you, that ye may know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord your God.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:21
verses.text: Notwithstanding the children rebelled against me: they walked not in my statutes, neither kept my judgments to do them, which <hi type="italic">if</hi> a man do, he shall even live in them; they polluted my sabbaths: then I said, I would pour out my fury upon them, to accomplish my anger against them in the wilderness.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:22
verses.text: Nevertheless I withdrew mine hand, and wrought for my name’s sake, that it should not be polluted in the sight of the heathen, in whose sight I brought them forth.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:23
verses.text: I lifted up mine hand unto them also in the wilderness, that I would scatter them among the heathen, and disperse them through the countries;

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:24
verses.text: Because they had not executed my judgments, but had despised my statutes, and had polluted my sabbaths, and their eyes were after their fathers’ idols.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:25
verses.text: Wherefore I gave them also statutes <hi type="italic">that were</hi> not good, and judgments whereby they should not live;

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:26
verses.text: And I polluted them in their own gifts, in that they caused to pass through <hi type="italic">the fire</hi> all that openeth the womb, that I might make them desolate, to the end that they might know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:27
verses.text: ¶ Therefore, son of man, speak unto the house of Israel, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God; Yet in this your fathers have blasphemed me, in that they have committed a trespass against me.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:28
verses.text: <hi type="italic">For</hi> when I had brought them into the land, <hi type="italic">for</hi> the which I lifted up mine hand to give it to them, then they saw every high hill, and all the thick trees, and they offered there their sacrifices, and there they presented the provocation of their offering: there also they made their sweet savour, and poured out there their drink offerings.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:29
verses.text: Then I said unto them, What <hi type="italic">is</hi> the high place whereunto ye go? And the name thereof is called Bamah unto this day.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:30
verses.text: Wherefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord God; Are ye polluted after the manner of your fathers? and commit ye whoredom after their abominations?

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:31
verses.text: For when ye offer your gifts, when ye make your sons to pass through the fire, ye pollute yourselves with all your idols, even unto this day: and shall I be inquired of by you, O house of Israel? <hi type="italic">As</hi> I live, saith the Lord God, I will not be inquired of by you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:32
verses.text: And that which cometh into your mind shall not be at all, that ye say, We will be as the heathen, as the families of the countries, to serve wood and stone.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:33
verses.text: ¶ <hi type="italic">As</hi> I live, saith the Lord God, surely with a mighty hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with fury poured out, will I rule over you:

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:34
verses.text: And I will bring you out from the people, and will gather you out of the countries wherein ye are scattered, with a mighty hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with fury poured out.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:35
verses.text: And I will bring you into the wilderness of the people, and there will I plead with you face to face.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:36
verses.text: Like as I pleaded with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so will I plead with you, saith the Lord God.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:37
verses.text: And I will cause you to pass under the rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant:

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:38
verses.text: And I will purge out from among you the rebels, and them that transgress against me: I will bring them forth out of the country where they sojourn, and they shall not enter into the land of Israel: and ye shall know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:39
verses.text: As for you, O house of Israel, thus saith the Lord God; Go ye, serve ye every one his idols, and hereafter <hi type="italic">also</hi>, if ye will not hearken unto me: but pollute ye my holy name no more with your gifts, and with your idols.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:40
verses.text: For in mine holy mountain, in the mountain of the height of Israel, saith the Lord God, there shall all the house of Israel, all of them in the land, serve me: there will I accept them, and there will I require your offerings, and the firstfruits of your oblations, with all your holy things.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:41
verses.text: I will accept you with your sweet savour, when I bring you out from the people, and gather you out of the countries wherein ye have been scattered; and I will be sanctified in you before the heathen.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:42
verses.text: And ye shall know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord, when I shall bring you into the land of Israel, into the country <hi type="italic">for</hi> the which I lifted up mine hand to give it to your fathers.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:43
verses.text: And there shall ye remember your ways, and all your doings, wherein ye have been defiled; and ye shall lothe yourselves in your own sight for all your evils that ye have committed.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:44
verses.text: And ye shall know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord, when I have wrought with you for my name’s sake, not according to your wicked ways, nor according to your corrupt doings, O ye house of Israel, saith the Lord God.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:45
verses.text: ¶ Moreover the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:46
verses.text: Son of man, set thy face toward the south, and drop <hi type="italic">thy word</hi> toward the south, and prophesy against the forest of the south field;

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:47
verses.text: And say to the forest of the south, Hear the word of the Lord; Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I will kindle a fire in thee, and it shall devour every green tree in thee, and every dry tree: the flaming flame shall not be quenched, and all faces from the south to the north shall be burned therein.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:48
verses.text: And all flesh shall see that I the Lord have kindled it: it shall not be quenched.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:49
verses.text: Then said I, Ah Lord God! they say of me, Doth he not speak parables?  <chapter eID="Ezek.20"/><div eID="gen892" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:1
verses.text: AND the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:2
verses.text: Son of man, set thy face toward Jerusalem, and drop <hi type="italic">thy word</hi> toward the holy places, and prophesy against the land of Israel,

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:3
verses.text: And say to the land of Israel, Thus saith the Lord; Behold, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> against thee, and will draw forth my sword out of his sheath, and will cut off from thee the righteous and the wicked.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:4
verses.text: Seeing then that I will cut off from thee the righteous and the wicked, therefore shall my sword go forth out of his sheath against all flesh from the south to the north:

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:5
verses.text: That all flesh may know that I the Lord have drawn forth my sword out of his sheath: it shall not return any more.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:6
verses.text: Sigh therefore, thou son of man, with the breaking of <hi type="italic">thy</hi> loins; and with bitterness sigh before their eyes.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:7
verses.text: And it shall be, when they say unto thee, Wherefore sighest thou? that thou shalt answer, For the tidings; because it cometh: and every heart shall melt, and all hands shall be feeble, and every spirit shall faint, and all knees shall be weak <hi type="italic">as</hi> water: behold, it cometh, and shall be brought to pass, saith the Lord God.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:8
verses.text: ¶ Again the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:9
verses.text: Son of man, prophesy, and say, Thus saith the Lord; Say, A sword, a sword is sharpened, and also furbished:

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:10
verses.text: It is sharpened to make a sore slaughter; it is furbished that it may glitter: should we then make mirth? it contemneth the rod of my son, <hi type="italic">as</hi> every tree.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:11
verses.text: And he hath given it to be furbished, that it may be handled: this sword is sharpened, and it is furbished, to give it into the hand of the slayer.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:12
verses.text: Cry and howl, son of man: for it shall be upon my people, it <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> upon all the princes of Israel: terrors by reason of the sword shall be upon my people: smite therefore upon <hi type="italic">thy</hi> thigh.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:13
verses.text: Because <hi type="italic">it is</hi> a trial, and what if <hi type="italic">the sword</hi> contemn even the rod? it shall be no <hi type="italic">more</hi>, saith the Lord God.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:14
verses.text: Thou therefore, son of man, prophesy, and smite <hi type="italic">thine</hi> hands together, and let the sword be doubled the third time, the sword of the slain: it <hi type="italic">is</hi> the sword of the great <hi type="italic">men that are</hi> slain, which entereth into their privy chambers.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:15
verses.text: I have set the point of the sword against all their gates, that <hi type="italic">their</hi> heart may faint, and <hi type="italic">their</hi> ruins be multiplied: ah! <hi type="italic">it is</hi> made bright, <hi type="italic">it is</hi> wrapped up for the slaughter.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:16
verses.text: Go thee one way or other, <hi type="italic">either</hi> on the right hand, <hi type="italic">or</hi> on the left, whithersoever thy face <hi type="italic">is</hi> set.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:17
verses.text: I will also smite mine hands together, and I will cause my fury to rest: I the Lord have said <hi type="italic">it</hi>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:18
verses.text: ¶ The word of the Lord came unto me again, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:19
verses.text: Also, thou son of man, appoint thee two ways, that the sword of the king of Babylon may come: both twain shall come forth out of one land: and choose thou a place, choose <hi type="italic">it</hi> at the head of the way to the city.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:20
verses.text: Appoint a way, that the sword may come to Rabbath of the Ammonites, and to Judah in Jerusalem the defenced.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:21
verses.text: For the king of Babylon stood at the parting of the way, at the head of the two ways, to use divination: he made <hi type="italic">his</hi> arrows bright, he consulted with images, he looked in the liver.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:22
verses.text: At his right hand was the divination for Jerusalem, to appoint captains, to open the mouth in the slaughter, to lift up the voice with shouting, to appoint <hi type="italic">battering</hi> rams against the gates, to cast a mount, <hi type="italic">and</hi> to build a fort.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:23
verses.text: And it shall be unto them as a false divination in their sight, to them that have sworn oaths: but he will call to remembrance the iniquity, that they may be taken.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:24
verses.text: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Because ye have made your iniquity to be remembered, in that your transgressions are discovered, so that in all your doings your sins do appear; because, <hi type="italic">I say</hi>, that ye are come to remembrance, ye shall be taken with the hand.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:25
verses.text: ¶ And thou, profane wicked prince of Israel, whose day is come, when iniquity <hi type="italic">shall have</hi> an end,

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:26
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord God; Remove the diadem, and take off the crown: this <hi type="italic">shall</hi> not <hi type="italic">be</hi> the same: exalt <hi type="italic">him that is</hi> low, and abase <hi type="italic">him that is</hi> high.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:27
verses.text: I will overturn, overturn, overturn, it: and it shall be no <hi type="italic">more</hi>, until he come whose right it is; and I will give it <hi type="italic">him</hi>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:28
verses.text: ¶ And thou, son of man, prophesy and say, Thus saith the Lord God concerning the Ammonites, and concerning their reproach; even say thou, The sword, the sword <hi type="italic">is</hi> drawn: for the slaughter <hi type="italic">it is</hi> furbished, to consume because of the glittering:

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:29
verses.text: Whiles they see vanity unto thee, whiles they divine a lie unto thee, to bring thee upon the necks of <hi type="italic">them that are</hi> slain, of the wicked, whose day is come, when their iniquity <hi type="italic">shall have</hi> an end.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:30
verses.text: Shall I cause <hi type="italic">it</hi> to return into his sheath? I will judge thee in the place where thou wast created, in the land of thy nativity.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:31
verses.text: And I will pour out mine indignation upon thee, I will blow against thee in the fire of my wrath, and deliver thee into the hand of brutish men, <hi type="italic">and</hi> skilful to destroy.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:32
verses.text: Thou shalt be for fuel to the fire; thy blood shall be in the midst of the land; thou shalt be no <hi type="italic">more</hi> remembered: for I the Lord have spoken <hi type="italic">it</hi>.  <chapter eID="Ezek.21"/><div eID="gen893" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:1
verses.text: MOREOVER the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:2
verses.text: Now, thou son of man, wilt thou judge, wilt thou judge the bloody city? yea, thou shalt shew her all her abominations.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:3
verses.text: Then say thou, Thus saith the Lord God, The city sheddeth blood in the midst of it, that her time may come, and maketh idols against herself to defile herself.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:4
verses.text: Thou art become guilty in thy blood that thou hast shed; and hast defiled thyself in thine idols which thou hast made; and thou hast caused thy days to draw near, and art come <hi type="italic">even</hi> unto thy years: therefore have I made thee a reproach unto the heathen, and a mocking to all countries.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:5
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Those that be</hi> near, and <hi type="italic">those that be</hi> far from thee, shall mock thee, <hi type="italic">which art</hi> infamous <hi type="italic">and</hi> much vexed.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:6
verses.text: Behold, the princes of Israel, every one were in thee to their power to shed blood.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:7
verses.text: In thee have they set light by father and mother: in the midst of thee have they dealt by oppression with the stranger: in thee have they vexed the fatherless and the widow.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:8
verses.text: Thou hast despised mine holy things, and hast profaned my sabbaths.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:9
verses.text: In thee are men that carry tales to shed blood: and in thee they eat upon the mountains: in the midst of thee they commit lewdness.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:10
verses.text: In thee have they discovered their fathers’ nakedness: in thee have they humbled her that was set apart for pollution.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:11
verses.text: And one hath committed abomination with his neighbour’s wife; and another hath lewdly defiled his daughter in law; and another in thee hath humbled his sister, his father’s daughter.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:12
verses.text: In thee have they taken gifts to shed blood; thou hast taken usury and increase, and thou hast greedily gained of thy neighbours by extortion, and hast forgotten me, saith the Lord God.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:13
verses.text: ¶ Behold, therefore I have smitten mine hand at thy dishonest gain which thou hast made, and at thy blood which hath been in the midst of thee.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:14
verses.text: Can thine heart endure, or can thine hands be strong, in the days that I shall deal with thee? I the Lord have spoken <hi type="italic">it</hi>, and will do <hi type="italic">it</hi>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:15
verses.text: And I will scatter thee among the heathen, and disperse thee in the countries, and will consume thy filthiness out of thee.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:16
verses.text: And thou shalt take thine inheritance in thyself in the sight of the heathen, and thou shalt know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:17
verses.text: And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:18
verses.text: Son of man, the house of Israel is to me become dross: all they <hi type="italic">are</hi> brass, and tin, and iron, and lead, in the midst of the furnace; they are <hi type="italic">even</hi> the dross of silver.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:19
verses.text: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Because ye are all become dross, behold, therefore I will gather you into the midst of Jerusalem.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:20
