verses.text: <hi type="italic">As</hi> they gather silver, and brass, and iron, and lead, and tin, into the midst of the furnace, to blow the fire upon it, to melt <hi type="italic">it;</hi> so will I gather <hi type="italic">you</hi> in mine anger and in my fury, and I will leave <hi type="italic">you there</hi>, and melt you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:21
verses.text: Yea, I will gather you, and blow upon you in the fire of my wrath, and ye shall be melted in the midst thereof.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:22
verses.text: As silver is melted in the midst of the furnace, so shall ye be melted in the midst thereof; and ye shall know that I the Lord have poured out my fury upon you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:23
verses.text: ¶ And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:24
verses.text: Son of man, say unto her, Thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> the land that is not cleansed, nor rained upon in the day of indignation.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:25
verses.text: <hi type="italic">There is</hi> a conspiracy of her prophets in the midst thereof, like a roaring lion ravening the prey; they have devoured souls; they have taken the treasure and precious things; they have made her many widows in the midst thereof.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:26
verses.text: Her priests have violated my law, and have profaned mine holy things: they have put no difference between the holy and profane, neither have they shewed <hi type="italic">difference</hi> between the unclean and the clean, and have hid their eyes from my sabbaths, and I am profaned among them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:27
verses.text: Her princes in the midst thereof <hi type="italic">are</hi> like wolves ravening the prey, to shed blood, <hi type="italic">and</hi> to destroy souls, to get dishonest gain.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:28
verses.text: And her prophets have daubed them with untempered <hi type="italic">morter</hi>, seeing vanity, and divining lies unto them, saying, Thus saith the Lord God, when the Lord hath not spoken.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:29
verses.text: The people of the land have used oppression, and exercised robbery, and have vexed the poor and needy: yea, they have oppressed the stranger wrongfully.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:30
verses.text: And I sought for a man among them, that should make up the hedge, and stand in the gap before me for the land, that I should not destroy it: but I found none.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:31
verses.text: Therefore have I poured out mine indignation upon them; I have consumed them with the fire of my wrath: their own way have I recompensed upon their heads, saith the Lord God.  <chapter eID="Ezek.22"/><div eID="gen894" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:1
verses.text: THE word of the Lord came again unto me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:2
verses.text: Son of man, there were two women, the daughters of one mother:

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:3
verses.text: And they committed whoredoms in Egypt; they committed whoredoms in their youth: there were their breasts pressed, and there they bruised the teats of their virginity.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:4
verses.text: And the names of them <hi type="italic">were</hi> Aholah the elder, and Aholibah her sister: and they were mine, and they bare sons and daughters. Thus <hi type="italic">were</hi> their names; Samaria <hi type="italic">is</hi> Aholah, and Jerusalem Aholibah.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:5
verses.text: And Aholah played the harlot when she was mine; and she doted on her lovers, on the Assyrians <hi type="italic">her</hi> neighbours,

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:6
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Which were</hi> clothed with blue, captains and rulers, all of them desirable young men, horsemen riding upon horses.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:7
verses.text: Thus she committed her whoredoms with them, with all them <hi type="italic">that were</hi> the chosen men of Assyria, and with all on whom she doted: with all their idols she defiled herself.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:8
verses.text: Neither left she her whoredoms <hi type="italic">brought</hi> from Egypt: for in her youth they lay with her, and they bruised the breasts of her virginity, and poured their whoredom upon her.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:9
verses.text: Wherefore I have delivered her into the hand of her lovers, into the hand of the Assyrians, upon whom she doted.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:10
verses.text: These discovered her nakedness: they took her sons and her daughters, and slew her with the sword: and she became famous among women; for they had executed judgment upon her.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:11
verses.text: And when her sister Aholibah saw <hi type="italic">this</hi>, she was more corrupt in her inordinate love than she, and in her whoredoms more than her sister in <hi type="italic">her</hi> whoredoms.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:12
verses.text: She doted upon the Assyrians <hi type="italic">her</hi> neighbours, captains and rulers clothed most gorgeously, horsemen riding upon horses, all of them desirable young men.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:13
verses.text: Then I saw that she was defiled, <hi type="italic">that</hi> they <hi type="italic">took</hi> both one way,

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:14
verses.text: And <hi type="italic">that</hi> she increased her whoredoms: for when she saw men pourtrayed upon the wall, the images of the Chaldeans pourtrayed with vermilion,

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:15
verses.text: Girded with girdles upon their loins, exceeding in dyed attire upon their heads, all of them princes to look to, after the manner of the Babylonians of Chaldea, the land of their nativity:

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:16
verses.text: And as soon as she saw them with her eyes, she doted upon them, and sent messengers unto them into Chaldea.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:17
verses.text: And the Babylonians came to her into the bed of love, and they defiled her with their whoredom, and she was polluted with them, and her mind was alienated from them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:18
verses.text: So she discovered her whoredoms, and discovered her nakedness: then my mind was alienated from her, like as my mind was alienated from her sister.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:19
verses.text: Yet she multiplied her whoredoms, in calling to remembrance the days of her youth, wherein she had played the harlot in the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:20
verses.text: For she doted upon their paramours, whose flesh <hi type="italic">is as</hi> the flesh of asses, and whose issue <hi type="italic">is like</hi> the issue of horses.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:21
verses.text: Thus thou calledst to remembrance the lewdness of thy youth, in bruising thy teats by the Egyptians for the paps of thy youth.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:22
verses.text: ¶ Therefore, O Aholibah, thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I will raise up thy lovers against thee, from whom thy mind is alienated, and I will bring them against thee on every side;

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:23
verses.text: The Babylonians, and all the Chaldeans, Pekod, and Shoa, and Koa, <hi type="italic">and</hi> all the Assyrians with them: all of them desirable young men, captains and rulers, great lords and renowned, all of them riding upon horses.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:24
verses.text: And they shall come against thee with chariots, wagons, and wheels, and with an assembly of people, <hi type="italic">which</hi> shall set against thee buckler and shield and helmet round about: and I will set judgment before them, and they shall judge thee according to their judgments.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:25
verses.text: And I will set my jealousy against thee, and they shall deal furiously with thee: they shall take away thy nose and thine ears; and thy remnant shall fall by the sword: they shall take thy sons and thy daughters; and thy residue shall be devoured by the fire.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:26
verses.text: They shall also strip thee out of thy clothes, and take away thy fair jewels.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:27
verses.text: Thus will I make thy lewdness to cease from thee, and thy whoredom <hi type="italic">brought</hi> from the land of Egypt: so that thou shalt not lift up thine eyes unto them, nor remember Egypt any more.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:28
verses.text: For thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I will deliver thee into the hand <hi type="italic">of them</hi> whom thou hatest, into the hand <hi type="italic">of them</hi> from whom thy mind is alienated:

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:29
verses.text: And they shall deal with thee hatefully, and shall take away all thy labour, and shall leave thee naked and bare: and the nakedness of thy whoredoms shall be discovered, both thy lewdness and thy whoredoms.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:30
verses.text: I will do these <hi type="italic">things</hi> unto thee, because thou hast gone a whoring after the heathen, <hi type="italic">and</hi> because thou art polluted with their idols.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:31
verses.text: Thou hast walked in the way of thy sister; therefore will I give her cup into thine hand.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:32
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord God; Thou shalt drink of thy sister’s cup deep and large: thou shalt be laughed to scorn and had in derision; it containeth much.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:33
verses.text: Thou shalt be filled with drunkenness and sorrow, with the cup of astonishment and desolation, with the cup of thy sister Samaria.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:34
verses.text: Thou shalt even drink it and suck <hi type="italic">it</hi> out, and thou shalt break the sherds thereof, and pluck off thine own breasts: for I have spoken <hi type="italic">it</hi>, saith the Lord God.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:35
verses.text: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Because thou hast forgotten me, and cast me behind thy back, therefore bear thou also thy lewdness and thy whoredoms.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:36
verses.text: ¶ The Lord said moreover unto me; Son of man, wilt thou judge Aholah and Aholibah? yea, declare unto them their abominations;

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:37
verses.text: That they have committed adultery, and blood <hi type="italic">is</hi> in their hands, and with their idols have they committed adultery, and have also caused their sons, whom they bare unto me, to pass for them through <hi type="italic">the fire</hi>, to devour <hi type="italic">them</hi>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:38
verses.text: Moreover this they have done unto me: they have defiled my sanctuary in the same day, and have profaned my sabbaths.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:39
verses.text: For when they had slain their children to their idols, then they came the same day into my sanctuary to profane it; and, lo, thus have they done in the midst of mine house.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:40
verses.text: And furthermore, that ye have sent for men to come from far, unto whom a messenger <hi type="italic">was</hi> sent; and, lo, they came: for whom thou didst wash thyself, paintedst thy eyes, and deckedst thyself with ornaments,

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:41
verses.text: And satest upon a stately bed, and a table prepared before it, whereupon thou hast set mine incense and mine oil.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:42
verses.text: And a voice of a multitude being at ease <hi type="italic">was</hi> with her: and with the men of the common sort <hi type="italic">were</hi> brought Sabeans from the wilderness, which put bracelets upon their hands, and beautiful crowns upon their heads.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:43
verses.text: Then said I unto <hi type="italic">her that was</hi> old in adulteries, Will they now commit whoredoms with her, and she <hi type="italic">with them?</hi>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:44
verses.text: Yet they went in unto her, as they go in unto a woman that playeth the harlot: so went they in unto Aholah and unto Aholibah, the lewd women.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:45
verses.text: ¶ And the righteous men, they shall judge them after the manner of adulteresses, and after the manner of women that shed blood; because they <hi type="italic">are</hi> adulteresses, and blood <hi type="italic">is</hi> in their hands.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:46
verses.text: For thus saith the Lord God; I will bring up a company upon them, and will give them to be removed and spoiled.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:47
verses.text: And the company shall stone them with stones, and dispatch them with their swords; they shall slay their sons and their daughters, and burn up their houses with fire.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:48
verses.text: Thus will I cause lewdness to cease out of the land, that all women may be taught not to do after your lewdness.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:49
verses.text: And they shall recompense your lewdness upon you, and ye shall bear the sins of your idols: and ye shall know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord God.  <chapter eID="Ezek.23"/><div eID="gen895" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:1
verses.text: AGAIN in the ninth year, in the tenth month, in the tenth <hi type="italic">day</hi> of the month, the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:2
verses.text: Son of man, write thee the name of the day, <hi type="italic">even</hi> of this same day: the king of Babylon set himself against Jerusalem this same day.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:3
verses.text: And utter a parable unto the rebellious house, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God; Set on a pot, set <hi type="italic">it</hi> on, and also pour water into it:

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:4
verses.text: Gather the pieces thereof into it, <hi type="italic">even</hi> every good piece, the thigh, and the shoulder; fill <hi type="italic">it</hi> with the choice bones.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:5
verses.text: Take the choice of the flock, and burn also the bones under it, <hi type="italic">and</hi> make it boil well, and let them seethe the bones of it therein.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:6
verses.text: ¶ Wherefore thus saith the Lord God; Woe to the bloody city, to the pot whose scum <hi type="italic">is</hi> therein, and whose scum is not gone out of it! bring it out piece by piece; let no lot fall upon it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:7
verses.text: For her blood is in the midst of her; she set it upon the top of a rock; she poured it not upon the ground, to cover it with dust;

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:8
verses.text: That it might cause fury to come up to take vengeance; I have set her blood upon the top of a rock, that it should not be covered.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:9
verses.text: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Woe to the bloody city! I will even make the pile for fire great.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:10
verses.text: Heap on wood, kindle the fire, consume the flesh, and spice it well, and let the bones be burned.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:11
verses.text: Then set it empty upon the coals thereof, that the brass of it may be hot, and may burn, and <hi type="italic">that</hi> the filthiness of it may be molten in it, <hi type="italic">that</hi> the scum of it may be consumed.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:12
verses.text: She hath wearied <hi type="italic">herself</hi> with lies, and her great scum went not forth out of her: her scum <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> in the fire.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:13
verses.text: In thy filthiness <hi type="italic">is</hi> lewdness: because I have purged thee, and thou wast not purged, thou shalt not be purged from thy filthiness any more, till I have caused my fury to rest upon thee.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:14
verses.text: I the Lord have spoken <hi type="italic">it:</hi> it shall come to pass, and I will do <hi type="italic">it;</hi> I will not go back, neither will I spare, neither will I repent; according to thy ways, and according to thy doings, shall they judge thee, saith the Lord God.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:15
verses.text: ¶ Also the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:16
verses.text: Son of man, behold, I take away from thee the desire of thine eyes with a stroke: yet neither shalt thou mourn nor weep, neither shall thy tears run down.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:17
verses.text: Forbear to cry, make no mourning for the dead, bind the tire of thine head upon thee, and put on thy shoes upon thy feet, and cover not <hi type="italic">thy</hi> lips, and eat not the bread of men.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:18
verses.text: So I spake unto the people in the morning: and at even my wife died; and I did in the morning as I was commanded.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:19
verses.text: ¶ And the people said unto me, Wilt thou not tell us what these <hi type="italic">things are</hi> to us, that thou doest <hi type="italic">so?</hi>

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:20
verses.text: Then I answered them, The word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:21
verses.text: Speak unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I will profane my sanctuary, the excellency of your strength, the desire of your eyes, and that which your soul pitieth; and your sons and your daughters whom ye have left shall fall by the sword.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:22
verses.text: And ye shall do as I have done: ye shall not cover <hi type="italic">your</hi> lips, nor eat the bread of men.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:23
verses.text: And your tires <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> upon your heads, and your shoes upon your feet: ye shall not mourn nor weep; but ye shall pine away for your iniquities, and mourn one toward another.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:24
verses.text: Thus Ezekiel is unto you a sign: according to all that he hath done shall ye do: and when this cometh, ye shall know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord God.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:25
verses.text: Also, thou son of man, <hi type="italic">shall it</hi> not <hi type="italic">be</hi> in the day when I take from them their strength, the joy of their glory, the desire of their eyes, and that whereupon they set their minds, their sons and their daughters,

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:26
verses.text: <hi type="italic">That</hi> he that escapeth in that day shall come unto thee, to cause <hi type="italic">thee</hi> to hear <hi type="italic">it</hi> with <hi type="italic">thine</hi> ears?

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:27
verses.text: In that day shall thy mouth be opened to him which is escaped, and thou shalt speak, and be no more dumb: and thou shalt be a sign unto them; and they shall know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord.  <chapter eID="Ezek.24"/><div eID="gen896" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:1
verses.text: THE word of the Lord came again unto me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:2
verses.text: Son of man, set thy face against the Ammonites, and prophesy against them;

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:3
verses.text: And say unto the Ammonites, Hear the word of the Lord God; Thus saith the Lord God; Because thou saidst, Aha, against my sanctuary, when it was profaned; and against the land of Israel, when it was desolate; and against the house of Judah, when they went into captivity;

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:4
verses.text: Behold, therefore I will deliver thee to the men of the east for a possession, and they shall set their palaces in thee, and make their dwellings in thee: they shall eat thy fruit, and they shall drink thy milk.

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:5
verses.text: And I will make Rabbah a stable for camels, and the Ammonites a couchingplace for flocks: and ye shall know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord.

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:6
verses.text: For thus saith the Lord God; Because thou hast clapped <hi type="italic">thine</hi> hands, and stamped with the feet, and rejoiced in heart with all thy despite against the land of Israel;

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:7
verses.text: Behold, therefore I will stretch out mine hand upon thee, and will deliver thee for a spoil to the heathen; and I will cut thee off from the people, and I will cause thee to perish out of the countries: I will destroy thee; and thou shalt know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord.

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:8
verses.text: ¶ Thus saith the Lord God; Because that Moab and Seir do say, Behold, the house of Judah <hi type="italic">is</hi> like unto all the heathen;

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:9
verses.text: Therefore, behold, I will open the side of Moab from the cities, from his cities <hi type="italic">which are</hi> on his frontiers, the glory of the country, Beth-jeshimoth, Baal-meon, and Kiriathaim,

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:10
verses.text: Unto the men of the east with the Ammonites, and will give them in possession, that the Ammonites may not be remembered among the nations.

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:11
verses.text: And I will execute judgments upon Moab; and they shall know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord.

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:12
verses.text: ¶ Thus saith the Lord God; Because that Edom hath dealt against the house of Judah by taking vengeance, and hath greatly offended, and revenged himself upon them;

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:13
verses.text: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; I will also stretch out mine hand upon Edom, and will cut off man and beast from it; and I will make it desolate from Teman; and they of Dedan shall fall by the sword.

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:14
verses.text: And I will lay my vengeance upon Edom by the hand of my people Israel: and they shall do in Edom according to mine anger and according to my fury; and they shall know my vengeance, saith the Lord God.

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:15
verses.text: ¶ Thus saith the Lord God; Because the Philistines have dealt by revenge, and have taken vengeance with a despiteful heart, to destroy <hi type="italic">it</hi> for the old hatred;

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:16
verses.text: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I will stretch out mine hand upon the Philistines, and I will cut off the Cherethims, and destroy the remnant of the sea coast.

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:17
verses.text: And I will execute great vengeance upon them with furious rebukes; and they shall know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord, when I shall lay my vengeance upon them.  <chapter eID="Ezek.25"/><div eID="gen897" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:1
verses.text: AND it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the first <hi type="italic">day</hi> of the month, <hi type="italic">that</hi> the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:2
verses.text: Son of man, because that Tyrus hath said against Jerusalem, Aha, she is broken <hi type="italic">that was</hi> the gates of the people: she is turned unto me: I shall be replenished, <hi type="italic">now</hi> she is laid waste:

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:3
verses.text: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> against thee, O Tyrus, and will cause many nations to come up against thee, as the sea causeth his waves to come up.

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:4
verses.text: And they shall destroy the walls of Tyrus, and break down her towers: I will also scrape her dust from her, and make her like the top of a rock.

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:5
verses.text: It shall be <hi type="italic">a place for</hi> the spreading of nets in the midst of the sea: for I have spoken <hi type="italic">it</hi>, saith the Lord God: and it shall become a spoil to the nations.

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:6
verses.text: And her daughters which <hi type="italic">are</hi> in the field shall be slain by the sword; and they shall know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord.

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:7
verses.text: ¶ For thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I will bring upon Tyrus Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, a king of kings, from the north, with horses, and with chariots, and with horsemen, and companies, and much people.

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:8
verses.text: He shall slay with the sword thy daughters in the field: and he shall make a fort against thee, and cast a mount against thee, and lift up the buckler against thee.

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:9
verses.text: And he shall set engines of war against thy walls, and with his axes he shall break down thy towers.

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:10
verses.text: By reason of the abundance of his horses their dust shall cover thee: thy walls shall shake at the noise of the horsemen, and of the wheels, and of the chariots, when he shall enter into thy gates, as men enter into a city wherein is made a breach.

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:11
verses.text: With the hoofs of his horses shall he tread down all thy streets: he shall slay thy people by the sword, and thy strong garrisons shall go down to the ground.

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:12
verses.text: And they shall make a spoil of thy riches, and make a prey of thy merchandise: and they shall break down thy walls, and destroy thy pleasant houses: and they shall lay thy stones and thy timber and thy dust in the midst of the water.

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:13
verses.text: And I will cause the noise of thy songs to cease; and the sound of thy harps shall be no more heard.

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:14
verses.text: And I will make thee like the top of a rock: thou shalt be <hi type="italic">a place</hi> to spread nets upon; thou shalt be built no more: for I the Lord have spoken <hi type="italic">it</hi>, saith the Lord God.

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:15
verses.text: ¶ Thus saith the Lord God to Tyrus; Shall not the isles shake at the sound of thy fall, when the wounded cry, when the slaughter is made in the midst of thee?

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:16
verses.text: Then all the princes of the sea shall come down from their thrones, and lay away their robes, and put off their broidered garments: they shall clothe themselves with trembling; they shall sit upon the ground, and shall tremble at <hi type="italic">every</hi> moment, and be astonished at thee.

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:17
verses.text: And they shall take up a lamentation for thee, and say to thee, How art thou destroyed, <hi type="italic">that wast</hi> inhabited of seafaring men, the renowned city, which wast strong in the sea, she and her inhabitants, which cause their terror <hi type="italic">to be</hi> on all that haunt it!

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:18
verses.text: Now shall the isles tremble in the day of thy fall; yea, the isles that <hi type="italic">are</hi> in the sea shall be troubled at thy departure.

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:19
verses.text: For thus saith the Lord God; When I shall make thee a desolate city, like the cities that are not inhabited; when I shall bring up the deep upon thee, and great waters shall cover thee;

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:20
verses.text: When I shall bring thee down with them that descend into the pit, with the people of old time, and shall set thee in the low parts of the earth, in places desolate of old, with them that go down to the pit, that thou be not inhabited; and I shall set glory in the land of the living;

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:21
verses.text: I will make thee a terror, and thou <hi type="italic">shalt be</hi> no <hi type="italic">more:</hi> though thou be sought for, yet shalt thou never be found again, saith the Lord God.  <chapter eID="Ezek.26"/><div eID="gen898" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:1
verses.text: THE word of the Lord came again unto me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:2
verses.text: Now, thou son of man, take up a lamentation for Tyrus;

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:3
verses.text: And say unto Tyrus, O thou that art situate at the entry of the sea, <hi type="italic">which art</hi> a merchant of the people for many isles, Thus saith the Lord God; O Tyrus, thou hast said, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> of perfect beauty.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:4
verses.text: Thy borders <hi type="italic">are</hi> in the midst of the seas, thy builders have perfected thy beauty.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:5
verses.text: They have made all thy <hi type="italic">ship</hi> boards of fir trees of Senir: they have taken cedars from Lebanon to make masts for thee.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:6
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Of</hi> the oaks of Bashan have they made thine oars; the company of the Ashurites have made thy benches <hi type="italic">of</hi> ivory, <hi type="italic">brought</hi> out of the isles of Chittim.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:7
verses.text: Fine linen with broidered work from Egypt was that which thou spreadest forth to be thy sail; blue and purple from the isles of Elishah was that which covered thee.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:8
verses.text: The inhabitants of Zidon and Arvad were thy mariners: thy wise <hi type="italic">men</hi>, O Tyrus, <hi type="italic">that</hi> were in thee, were thy pilots.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:9
verses.text: The ancients of Gebal and the wise <hi type="italic">men</hi> thereof were in thee thy calkers: all the ships of the sea with their mariners were in thee to occupy thy merchandise.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:10
verses.text: They of Persia and of Lud and of Phut were in thine army, thy men of war: they hanged the shield and helmet in thee; they set forth thy comeliness.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:11
verses.text: The men of Arvad with thine army <hi type="italic">were</hi> upon thy walls round about, and the Gammadims were in thy towers: they hanged their shields upon thy walls round about; they have made thy beauty perfect.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:12
verses.text: Tarshish <hi type="italic">was</hi> thy merchant by reason of the multitude of all <hi type="italic">kind of</hi> riches; with silver, iron, tin, and lead, they traded in thy fairs.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:13
verses.text: Javan, Tubal, and Meshech, they <hi type="italic">were</hi> thy merchants: they traded the persons of men and vessels of brass in thy market.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:14
verses.text: They of the house of Togarmah traded in thy fairs with horses and horsemen and mules.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:15
verses.text: The men of Dedan <hi type="italic">were</hi> thy merchants; many isles <hi type="italic">were</hi> the merchandise of thine hand: they brought thee <hi type="italic">for</hi> a present horns of ivory and ebony.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:16
verses.text: Syria <hi type="italic">was</hi> thy merchant by reason of the multitude of the wares of thy making: they occupied in thy fairs with emeralds, purple, and broidered work, and fine linen, and coral, and agate.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:17
verses.text: Judah, and the land of Israel, they <hi type="italic">were</hi> thy merchants: they traded in thy market wheat of Minnith, and Pannag, and honey, and oil, and balm.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:18
verses.text: Damascus <hi type="italic">was</hi> thy merchant in the multitude of the wares of thy making, for the multitude of all riches; in the wine of Helbon, and white wool.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:19
verses.text: Dan also and Javan going to and fro occupied in thy fairs: bright iron, cassia, and calamus, were in thy market.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:20
verses.text: Dedan <hi type="italic">was</hi> thy merchant in precious clothes for chariots.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:21
verses.text: Arabia, and all the princes of Kedar, they occupied with thee in lambs, and rams, and goats: in these <hi type="italic">were they</hi> thy merchants.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:22
verses.text: The merchants of Sheba and Raamah, they <hi type="italic">were</hi> thy merchants: they occupied in thy fairs with chief of all spices, and with all precious stones, and gold.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:23
verses.text: Haran, and Canneh, and Eden, the merchants of Sheba, Asshur, <hi type="italic">and</hi> Chilmad, <hi type="italic">were</hi> thy merchants.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:24
verses.text: These <hi type="italic">were</hi> thy merchants in all sorts <hi type="italic">of things</hi>, in blue clothes, and broidered work, and in chests of rich apparel, bound with cords, and made of cedar, among thy merchandise.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:25
verses.text: The ships of Tarshish did sing of thee in thy market: and thou wast replenished, and made very glorious in the midst of the seas.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:26
verses.text: ¶ Thy rowers have brought thee into great waters: the east wind hath broken thee in the midst of the seas.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:27
verses.text: Thy riches, and thy fairs, thy merchandise, thy mariners, and thy pilots, thy calkers, and the occupiers of thy merchandise, and all thy men of war, that <hi type="italic">are</hi> in thee, and in all thy company which <hi type="italic">is</hi> in the midst of thee, shall fall into the midst of the seas in the day of thy ruin.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:28
verses.text: The suburbs shall shake at the sound of the cry of thy pilots.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:29
verses.text: And all that handle the oar, the mariners, <hi type="italic">and</hi> all the pilots of the sea, shall come down from their ships, they shall stand upon the land;

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:30
verses.text: And shall cause their voice to be heard against thee, and shall cry bitterly, and shall cast up dust upon their heads, they shall wallow themselves in the ashes:

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:31
verses.text: And they shall make themselves utterly bald for thee, and gird them with sackcloth, and they shall weep for thee with bitterness of heart <hi type="italic">and</hi> bitter wailing.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:32
verses.text: And in their wailing they shall take up a lamentation for thee, and lament over thee, <hi type="italic">saying</hi>, What <hi type="italic">city is</hi> like Tyrus, like the destroyed in the midst of the sea?

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:33
verses.text: When thy wares went forth out of the seas, thou filledst many people; thou didst enrich the kings of the earth with the multitude of thy riches and of thy merchandise.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:34
verses.text: In the time <hi type="italic">when</hi> thou shalt be broken by the seas in the depths of the waters thy merchandise and all thy company in the midst of thee shall fall.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:35
verses.text: All the inhabitants of the isles shall be astonished at thee, and their kings shall be sore afraid, they shall be troubled in <hi type="italic">their</hi> countenance.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:36
verses.text: The merchants among the people shall hiss at thee; thou shalt be a terror, and never <hi type="italic">shalt be</hi> any more.  <chapter eID="Ezek.27"/><div eID="gen899" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:1
verses.text: THE word of the Lord came again unto me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:2
verses.text: Son of man, say unto the prince of Tyrus, Thus saith the Lord God; Because thine heart <hi type="italic">is</hi> lifted up, and thou hast said, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> a God, I sit <hi type="italic">in</hi> the seat of God, in the midst of the seas; yet thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> a man, and not God, though thou set thine heart as the heart of God:

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:3
verses.text: Behold, thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> wiser than Daniel; there is no secret that they can hide from thee:

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:4
verses.text: With thy wisdom and with thine understanding thou hast gotten thee riches, and hast gotten gold and silver into thy treasures:

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:5
verses.text: By thy great wisdom <hi type="italic">and</hi> by thy traffick hast thou increased thy riches, and thine heart is lifted up because of thy riches:

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:6
verses.text: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Because thou hast set thine heart as the heart of God;

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:7
verses.text: Behold, therefore I will bring strangers upon thee, the terrible of the nations: and they shall draw their swords against the beauty of thy wisdom, and they shall defile thy brightness.

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:8
verses.text: They shall bring thee down to the pit, and thou shalt die the deaths of <hi type="italic">them that are</hi> slain in the midst of the seas.

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:9
verses.text: Wilt thou yet say before him that slayeth thee, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> God? but thou <hi type="italic">shalt be</hi> a man, and no God, in the hand of him that slayeth thee.

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:10
verses.text: Thou shalt die the deaths of the uncircumcised by the hand of strangers: for I have spoken <hi type="italic">it</hi>, saith the Lord God.

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:11
verses.text: ¶ Moreover the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:12
verses.text: Son of man, take up a lamentation upon the king of Tyrus, and say unto him, Thus saith the Lord God; Thou sealest up the sum, full of wisdom, and perfect in beauty.

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:13
verses.text: Thou hast been in Eden the garden of God; every precious stone <hi type="italic">was</hi> thy covering, the sardius, topaz, and the diamond, the beryl, the onyx, and the jasper, the sapphire, the emerald, and the carbuncle, and gold: the workmanship of thy tabrets and of thy pipes was prepared in thee in the day that thou wast created.

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:14
verses.text: Thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> the anointed cherub that covereth; and I have set thee <hi type="italic">so:</hi> thou wast upon the holy mountain of God; thou hast walked up and down in the midst of the stones of fire.

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:15
verses.text: Thou <hi type="italic">wast</hi> perfect in thy ways from the day that thou wast created, till iniquity was found in thee.

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:16
verses.text: By the multitude of thy merchandise they have filled the midst of thee with violence, and thou hast sinned: therefore I will cast thee as profane out of the mountain of God: and I will destroy thee, O covering cherub, from the midst of the stones of fire.

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:17
verses.text: Thine heart was lifted up because of thy beauty, thou hast corrupted thy wisdom by reason of thy brightness: I will cast thee to the ground, I will lay thee before kings, that they may behold thee.

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:18
verses.text: Thou hast defiled thy sanctuaries by the multitude of thine iniquities, by the iniquity of thy traffick; therefore will I bring forth a fire from the midst of thee, it shall devour thee, and I will bring thee to ashes upon the earth in the sight of all them that behold thee.

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:19
verses.text: All they that know thee among the people shall be astonished at thee: thou shalt be a terror, and never <hi type="italic">shalt</hi> thou <hi type="italic">be</hi> any more.

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:20
verses.text: ¶ Again the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:21
verses.text: Son of man, set thy face against Zidon, and prophesy against it,

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:22
verses.text: And say, Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> against thee, O Zidon; and I will be glorified in the midst of thee: and they shall know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord, when I shall have executed judgments in her, and shall be sanctified in her.

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:23
verses.text: For I will send into her pestilence, and blood into her streets; and the wounded shall be judged in the midst of her by the sword upon her on every side; and they shall know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord.

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:24
verses.text: ¶ And there shall be no more a pricking brier unto the house of Israel, nor <hi type="italic">any</hi> grieving thorn of all <hi type="italic">that are</hi> round about them, that despised them; and they shall know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord God.

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:25
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord God; When I shall have gathered the house of Israel from the people among whom they are scattered, and shall be sanctified in them in the sight of the heathen, then shall they dwell in their land that I have given to my servant Jacob.

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:26
verses.text: And they shall dwell safely therein, and shall build houses, and plant vineyards; yea, they shall dwell with confidence, when I have executed judgments upon all those that despise them round about them; and they shall know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord their God.  <chapter eID="Ezek.28"/><div eID="gen900" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:1
verses.text: IN the tenth year, in the tenth <hi type="italic">month</hi>, in the twelfth <hi type="italic">day</hi> of the month, the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:2
verses.text: Son of man, set thy face against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and prophesy against him, and against all Egypt:

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:3
verses.text: Speak, and say, Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> against thee, Pharaoh king of Egypt, the great dragon that lieth in the midst of his rivers, which hath said, My river <hi type="italic">is</hi> mine own, and I have made <hi type="italic">it</hi> for myself.

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:4
verses.text: But I will put hooks in thy jaws, and I will cause the fish of thy rivers to stick unto thy scales, and I will bring thee up out of the midst of thy rivers, and all the fish of thy rivers shall stick unto thy scales.

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:5
verses.text: And I will leave thee <hi type="italic">thrown</hi> into the wilderness, thee and all the fish of thy rivers: thou shalt fall upon the open fields; thou shalt not be brought together, nor gathered: I have given thee for meat to the beasts of the field and to the fowls of the heaven.

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:6
verses.text: And all the inhabitants of Egypt shall know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord, because they have been a staff of reed to the house of Israel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:7
verses.text: When they took hold of thee by thy hand, thou didst break, and rend all their shoulder: and when they leaned upon thee, thou brakest, and madest all their loins to be at a stand.

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:8
verses.text: ¶ Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I will bring a sword upon thee, and cut off man and beast out of thee.

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:9
verses.text: And the land of Egypt shall be desolate and waste; and they shall know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord: because he hath said, The river <hi type="italic">is</hi> mine, and I have made <hi type="italic">it</hi>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:10
verses.text: Behold, therefore I <hi type="italic">am</hi> against thee, and against thy rivers, and I will make the land of Egypt utterly waste <hi type="italic">and</hi> desolate, from the tower of Syene even unto the border of Ethiopia.

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:11
verses.text: No foot of man shall pass through it, nor foot of beast shall pass through it, neither shall it be inhabited forty years.

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:12
verses.text: And I will make the land of Egypt desolate in the midst of the countries <hi type="italic">that are</hi> desolate, and her cities among the cities <hi type="italic">that are</hi> laid waste shall be desolate forty years: and I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:13
verses.text: ¶ Yet thus saith the Lord God; At the end of forty years will I gather the Egyptians from the people whither they were scattered:

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:14
verses.text: And I will bring again the captivity of Egypt, and will cause them to return <hi type="italic">into</hi> the land of Pathros, into the land of their habitation; and they shall be there a base kingdom.

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:15
verses.text: It shall be the basest of the kingdoms; neither shall it exalt itself any more above the nations: for I will diminish them, that they shall no more rule over the nations.

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:16
verses.text: And it shall be no more the confidence of the house of Israel, which bringeth <hi type="italic">their</hi> iniquity to remembrance, when they shall look after them: but they shall know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord God.

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:17
verses.text: ¶ And it came to pass in the seven and twentieth year, in the first <hi type="italic">month</hi>, in the first <hi type="italic">day</hi> of the month, the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:18
verses.text: Son of man, Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon caused his army to serve a great service against Tyrus: every head <hi type="italic">was</hi> made bald, and every shoulder <hi type="italic">was</hi> peeled: yet had he no wages, nor his army, for Tyrus, for the service that he had served against it:

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:19
verses.text: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I will give the land of Egypt unto Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon; and he shall take her multitude, and take her spoil, and take her prey; and it shall be the wages for his army.

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:20
verses.text: I have given him the land of Egypt <hi type="italic">for</hi> his labour wherewith he served against it, because they wrought for me, saith the Lord God.

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:21
verses.text: ¶ In that day will I cause the horn of the house of Israel to bud forth, and I will give thee the opening of the mouth in the midst of them; and they shall know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord.  <chapter eID="Ezek.29"/><div eID="gen901" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:1
verses.text: THE word of the Lord came again unto me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:2
verses.text: Son of man, prophesy and say, Thus saith the Lord God; Howl ye, Woe worth the day!

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:3
verses.text: For the day <hi type="italic">is</hi> near, even the day of the Lord <hi type="italic">is</hi> near, a cloudy day; it shall be the time of the heathen.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:4
verses.text: And the sword shall come upon Egypt, and great pain shall be in Ethiopia, when the slain shall fall in Egypt, and they shall take away her multitude, and her foundations shall be broken down.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:5
verses.text: Ethiopia, and Libya, and Lydia, and all the mingled people, and Chub, and the men of the land that is in league, shall fall with them by the sword.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:6
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord; They also that uphold Egypt shall fall; and the pride of her power shall come down: from the tower of Syene shall they fall in it by the sword, saith the Lord God.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:7
verses.text: And they shall be desolate in the midst of the countries <hi type="italic">that are</hi> desolate, and her cities shall be in the midst of the cities <hi type="italic">that are</hi> wasted.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:8
verses.text: And they shall know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord, when I have set a fire in Egypt, and <hi type="italic">when</hi> all her helpers shall be destroyed.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:9
verses.text: In that day shall messengers go forth from me in ships to make the careless Ethiopians afraid, and great pain shall come upon them, as in the day of Egypt: for, lo, it cometh.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:10
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord God; I will also make the multitude of Egypt to cease by the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:11
verses.text: He and his people with him, the terrible of the nations, shall be brought to destroy the land: and they shall draw their swords against Egypt, and fill the land with the slain.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:12
verses.text: And I will make the rivers dry, and sell the land into the hand of the wicked: and I will make the land waste, and all that is therein, by the hand of strangers: I the Lord have spoken <hi type="italic">it</hi>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:13
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord God; I will also destroy the idols, and I will cause <hi type="italic">their</hi> images to cease out of Noph; and there shall be no more a prince of the land of Egypt: and I will put a fear in the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:14
verses.text: And I will make Pathros desolate, and will set fire in Zoan, and will execute judgments in No.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:15
verses.text: And I will pour my fury upon Sin, the strength of Egypt; and I will cut off the multitude of No.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:16
verses.text: And I will set fire in Egypt: Sin shall have great pain, and No shall be rent asunder, and Noph <hi type="italic">shall have</hi> distresses daily.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:17
verses.text: The young men of Aven and of Pi-beseth shall fall by the sword: and these <hi type="italic">cities</hi> shall go into captivity.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:18
verses.text: At Tehaphnehes also the day shall be darkened, when I shall break there the yokes of Egypt: and the pomp of her strength shall cease in her: as for her, a cloud shall cover her, and her daughters shall go into captivity.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:19
verses.text: Thus will I execute judgments in Egypt: and they shall know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:20
verses.text: ¶ And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the first <hi type="italic">month</hi>, in the seventh <hi type="italic">day</hi> of the month, <hi type="italic">that</hi> the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:21
verses.text: Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and, lo, it shall not be bound up to be healed, to put a roller to bind it, to make it strong to hold the sword.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:22
verses.text: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and will break his arms, the strong, and that which was broken; and I will cause the sword to fall out of his hand.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:23
verses.text: And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:24
verses.text: And I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and put my sword in his hand: but I will break Pharaoh’s arms, and he shall groan before him with the groanings of a deadly wounded <hi type="italic">man</hi>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:25
verses.text: But I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and the arms of Pharaoh shall fall down; and they shall know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord, when I shall put my sword into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall stretch it out upon the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:26
verses.text: And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and disperse them among the countries; and they shall know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord.  <chapter eID="Ezek.30"/><div eID="gen902" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:1
verses.text: AND it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the third <hi type="italic">month</hi>, in the first <hi type="italic">day</hi> of the month, <hi type="italic">that</hi> the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:2
verses.text: Son of man, speak unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, and to his multitude; Whom art thou like in thy greatness?

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:3
verses.text: ¶ Behold, the Assyrian <hi type="italic">was</hi> a cedar in Lebanon with fair branches, and with a shadowing shroud, and of an high stature; and his top was among the thick boughs.

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:4
verses.text: The waters made him great, the deep set him up on high with her rivers running round about his plants, and sent out her little rivers unto all the trees of the field.

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:5
verses.text: Therefore his height was exalted above all the trees of the field, and his boughs were multiplied, and his branches became long because of the multitude of waters, when he shot forth.

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:6
verses.text: All the fowls of heaven made their nests in his boughs, and under his branches did all the beasts of the field bring forth their young, and under his shadow dwelt all great nations.

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:7
verses.text: Thus was he fair in his greatness, in the length of his branches: for his root was by great waters.

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:8
verses.text: The cedars in the garden of God could not hide him: the fir trees were not like his boughs, and the chesnut trees were not like his branches; nor any tree in the garden of God was like unto him in his beauty.

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:9
verses.text: I have made him fair by the multitude of his branches: so that all the trees of Eden, that <hi type="italic">were</hi> in the garden of God, envied him.

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:10
verses.text: ¶ Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Because thou hast lifted up thyself in height, and he hath shot up his top among the thick boughs, and his heart is lifted up in his height;

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:11
verses.text: I have therefore delivered him into the hand of the mighty one of the heathen; he shall surely deal with him: I have driven him out for his wickedness.

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:12
verses.text: And strangers, the terrible of the nations, have cut him off, and have left him: upon the mountains and in all the valleys his branches are fallen, and his boughs are broken by all the rivers of the land; and all the people of the earth are gone down from his shadow, and have left him.

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:13
verses.text: Upon his ruin shall all the fowls of the heaven remain, and all the beasts of the field shall be upon his branches:

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:14
verses.text: To the end that none of all the trees by the waters exalt themselves for their height, neither shoot up their top among the thick boughs, neither their trees stand up in their height, all that drink water: for they are all delivered unto death, to the nether parts of the earth, in the midst of the children of men, with them that go down to the pit.

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:15
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord God; In the day when he went down to the grave I caused a mourning: I covered the deep for him, and I restrained the floods thereof, and the great waters were stayed: and I caused Lebanon to mourn for him, and all the trees of the field fainted for him.

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:16
verses.text: I made the nations to shake at the sound of his fall, when I cast him down to hell with them that descend into the pit: and all the trees of Eden, the choice and best of Lebanon, all that drink water, shall be comforted in the nether parts of the earth.

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:17
verses.text: They also went down into hell with him unto <hi type="italic">them that be</hi> slain with the sword; and <hi type="italic">they that were</hi> his arm, <hi type="italic">that</hi> dwelt under his shadow in the midst of the heathen.

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:18
verses.text: ¶ To whom art thou thus like in glory and in greatness among the trees of Eden? yet shalt thou be brought down with the trees of Eden unto the nether parts of the earth: thou shalt lie in the midst of the uncircumcised with <hi type="italic">them that be</hi> slain by the sword. This <hi type="italic">is</hi> Pharaoh and all his multitude, saith the Lord God.  <chapter eID="Ezek.31"/><div eID="gen903" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:1
verses.text: AND it came to pass in the twelfth year, in the twelfth month, in the first <hi type="italic">day</hi> of the month, <hi type="italic">that</hi> the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:2
verses.text: Son of man, take up a lamentation for Pharaoh king of Egypt, and say unto him, Thou art like a young lion of the nations, and thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> as a whale in the seas: and thou camest forth with thy rivers, and troubledst the waters with thy feet, and fouledst their rivers.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:3
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord God; I will therefore spread out my net over thee with a company of many people; and they shall bring thee up in my net.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:4
verses.text: Then will I leave thee upon the land, I will cast thee forth upon the open field, and will cause all the fowls of the heaven to remain upon thee, and I will fill the beasts of the whole earth with thee.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:5
verses.text: And I will lay thy flesh upon the mountains, and fill the valleys with thy height.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:6
verses.text: I will also water with thy blood the land wherein thou swimmest, <hi type="italic">even</hi> to the mountains; and the rivers shall be full of thee.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:7
verses.text: And when I shall put thee out, I will cover the heaven, and make the stars thereof dark; I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon shall not give her light.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:8
verses.text: All the bright lights of heaven will I make dark over thee, and set darkness upon thy land, saith the Lord God.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:9
verses.text: I will also vex the hearts of many people, when I shall bring thy destruction among the nations, into the countries which thou hast not known.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:10
verses.text: Yea, I will make many people amazed at thee, and their kings shall be horribly afraid for thee, when I shall brandish my sword before them; and they shall tremble at <hi type="italic">every</hi> moment, every man for his own life, in the day of thy fall.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:11
verses.text: ¶ For thus saith the Lord God; The sword of the king of Babylon shall come upon thee.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:12
verses.text: By the swords of the mighty will I cause thy multitude to fall, the terrible of the nations, all of them: and they shall spoil the pomp of Egypt, and all the multitude thereof shall be destroyed.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:13
verses.text: I will destroy also all the beasts thereof from beside the great waters; neither shall the foot of man trouble them any more, nor the hoofs of beasts trouble them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:14
verses.text: Then will I make their waters deep, and cause their rivers to run like oil, saith the Lord God.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:15
verses.text: When I shall make the land of Egypt desolate, and the country shall be destitute of that whereof it was full, when I shall smite all them that dwell therein, then shall they know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:16
verses.text: This <hi type="italic">is</hi> the lamentation wherewith they shall lament her: the daughters of the nations shall lament her: they shall lament for her, <hi type="italic">even</hi> for Egypt, and for all her multitude, saith the Lord God.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:17
verses.text: ¶ It came to pass also in the twelfth year, in the fifteenth <hi type="italic">day</hi> of the month, <hi type="italic">that</hi> the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:18
verses.text: Son of man, wail for the multitude of Egypt, and cast them down, <hi type="italic">even</hi> her, and the daughters of the famous nations, unto the nether parts of the earth, with them that go down into the pit.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:19
verses.text: Whom dost thou pass in beauty? go down, and be thou laid with the uncircumcised.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:20
verses.text: They shall fall in the midst of <hi type="italic">them that are</hi> slain by the sword: she is delivered to the sword: draw her and all her multitudes.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:21
verses.text: The strong among the mighty shall speak to him out of the midst of hell with them that help him: they are gone down, they lie uncircumcised, slain by the sword.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:22
verses.text: Asshur <hi type="italic">is</hi> there and all her company: his graves <hi type="italic">are</hi> about him: all of them slain, fallen by the sword:

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:23
verses.text: Whose graves are set in the sides of the pit, and her company is round about her grave: all of them slain, fallen by the sword, which caused terror in the land of the living.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:24
verses.text: There <hi type="italic">is</hi> Elam and all her multitude round about her grave, all of them slain, fallen by the sword, which are gone down uncircumcised into the nether parts of the earth, which caused their terror in the land of the living; yet have they borne their shame with them that go down to the pit.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:25
verses.text: They have set her a bed in the midst of the slain with all her multitude: her graves <hi type="italic">are</hi> round about him: all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword: though their terror was caused in the land of the living, yet have they borne their shame with them that go down to the pit: he is put in the midst of <hi type="italic">them that be</hi> slain.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:26
verses.text: There <hi type="italic">is</hi> Meshech, Tubal, and all her multitude: her graves <hi type="italic">are</hi> round about him: all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword, though they caused their terror in the land of the living.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:27
verses.text: And they shall not lie with the mighty <hi type="italic">that are</hi> fallen of the uncircumcised, which are gone down to hell with their weapons of war: and they have laid their swords under their heads, but their iniquities shall be upon their bones, though <hi type="italic">they were</hi> the terror of the mighty in the land of the living.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:28
verses.text: Yea, thou shalt be broken in the midst of the uncircumcised, and shalt lie with <hi type="italic">them that are</hi> slain with the sword.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:29
verses.text: There <hi type="italic">is</hi> Edom, her kings, and all her princes, which with their might are laid by <hi type="italic">them that were</hi> slain by the sword: they shall lie with the uncircumcised, and with them that go down to the pit.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:30
verses.text: There <hi type="italic">be</hi> the princes of the north, all of them, and all the Zidonians, which are gone down with the slain; with their terror they are ashamed of their might; and they lie uncircumcised with <hi type="italic">them that be</hi> slain by the sword, and bear their shame with them that go down to the pit.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:31
verses.text: Pharaoh shall see them, and shall be comforted over all his multitude, <hi type="italic">even</hi> Pharaoh and all his army slain by the sword, saith the Lord God.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:32
verses.text: For I have caused my terror in the land of the living: and he shall be laid in the midst of the uncircumcised with <hi type="italic">them that are</hi> slain with the sword, <hi type="italic">even</hi> Pharaoh and all his multitude, saith the Lord God.  <chapter eID="Ezek.32"/><div eID="gen904" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:1
verses.text: AGAIN the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:2
verses.text: Son of man, speak to the children of thy people, and say unto them, When I bring the sword upon a land, if the people of the land take a man of their coasts, and set him for their watchman:

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:3
verses.text: If when he seeth the sword come upon the land, he blow the trumpet, and warn the people;

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:4
verses.text: Then whosoever heareth the sound of the trumpet, and taketh not warning; if the sword come, and take him away, his blood shall be upon his own head.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:5
verses.text: He heard the sound of the trumpet, and took not warning; his blood shall be upon him. But he that taketh warning shall deliver his soul.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:6
verses.text: But if the watchman see the sword come, and blow not the trumpet, and the people be not warned; if the sword come, and take <hi type="italic">any</hi> person from among them, he is taken away in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at the watchman’s hand.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:7
verses.text: ¶ So thou, O son of man, I have set thee a watchman unto the house of Israel; therefore thou shalt hear the word at my mouth, and warn them from me.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:8
verses.text: When I say unto the wicked, O wicked <hi type="italic">man</hi>, thou shalt surely die; if thou dost not speak to warn the wicked from his way, that wicked <hi type="italic">man</hi> shall die in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at thine hand.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:9
verses.text: Nevertheless, if thou warn the wicked of his way to turn from it; if he do not turn from his way, he shall die in his iniquity; but thou hast delivered thy soul.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:10
verses.text: Therefore, O thou son of man, speak unto the house of Israel; Thus ye speak, saying, If our transgressions and our sins <hi type="italic">be</hi> upon us, and we pine away in them, how should we then live?

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:11
verses.text: Say unto them, <hi type="italic">As</hi> I live, saith the Lord God, I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked; but that the wicked turn from his way and live: turn ye, turn ye from your evil ways; for why will ye die, O house of Israel?

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:12
verses.text: Therefore, thou son of man, say unto the children of thy people, The righteousness of the righteous shall not deliver him in the day of his transgression: as for the wickedness of the wicked, he shall not fall thereby in the day that he turneth from his wickedness; neither shall the righteous be able to live for his <hi type="italic">righteousness</hi> in the day that he sinneth.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:13
verses.text: When I shall say to the righteous, <hi type="italic">that</hi> he shall surely live; if he trust to his own righteousness, and commit iniquity, all his righteousnesses shall not be remembered; but for his iniquity that he hath committed, he shall die for it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:14
verses.text: Again, when I say unto the wicked, Thou shalt surely die; if he turn from his sin, and do that which is lawful and right;

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:15
verses.text: <hi type="italic">If</hi> the wicked restore the pledge, give again that he had robbed, walk in the statutes of life, without committing iniquity; he shall surely live, he shall not die.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:16
verses.text: None of his sins that he hath committed shall be mentioned unto him: he hath done that which is lawful and right; he shall surely live.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:17
verses.text: ¶ Yet the children of thy people say, The way of the Lord is not equal: but as for them, their way is not equal.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:18
verses.text: When the righteous turneth from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, he shall even die thereby.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:19
verses.text: But if the wicked turn from his wickedness, and do that which is lawful and right, he shall live thereby.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:20
verses.text: ¶ Yet ye say, The way of the Lord is not equal. O ye house of Israel, I will judge you every one after his ways.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:21
verses.text: ¶ And it came to pass in the twelfth year of our captivity, in the tenth <hi type="italic">month</hi>, in the fifth <hi type="italic">day</hi> of the month, <hi type="italic">that</hi> one that had escaped out of Jerusalem came unto me, saying, The city is smitten.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:22
verses.text: Now the hand of the Lord was upon me in the evening, afore he that was escaped came; and had opened my mouth, until he came to me in the morning; and my mouth was opened, and I was no more dumb.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:23
verses.text: Then the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:24
verses.text: Son of man, they that inhabit those wastes of the land of Israel speak, saying, Abraham was one, and he inherited the land: but we <hi type="italic">are</hi> many; the land is given us for inheritance.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:25
verses.text: Wherefore say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God; Ye eat with the blood, and lift up your eyes toward your idols, and shed blood: and shall ye possess the land?

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:26
verses.text: Ye stand upon your sword, ye work abomination, and ye defile every one his neighbour’s wife: and shall ye possess the land?

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:27
verses.text: Say thou thus unto them, Thus saith the Lord God; <hi type="italic">As</hi> I live, surely they that <hi type="italic">are</hi> in the wastes shall fall by the sword, and him that <hi type="italic">is</hi> in the open field will I give to the beasts to be devoured, and they that <hi type="italic">be</hi> in the forts and in the caves shall die of the pestilence.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:28
verses.text: For I will lay the land most desolate, and the pomp of her strength shall cease; and the mountains of Israel shall be desolate, that none shall pass through.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:29
verses.text: Then shall they know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord, when I have laid the land most desolate because of all their abominations which they have committed.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:30
verses.text: ¶ Also, thou son of man, the children of thy people still are talking against thee by the walls and in the doors of the houses, and speak one to another, every one to his brother, saying, Come, I pray you, and hear what is the word that cometh forth from the Lord.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:31
verses.text: And they come unto thee as the people cometh, and they sit before thee <hi type="italic">as</hi> my people, and they hear thy words, but they will not do them: for with their mouth they shew much love, <hi type="italic">but</hi> their heart goeth after their covetousness.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:32
verses.text: And, lo, thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> unto them as a very lovely song of one that hath a pleasant voice, and can play well on an instrument: for they hear thy words, but they do them not.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:33
verses.text: And when this cometh to pass, (lo, it will come,) then shall they know that a prophet hath been among them.  <chapter eID="Ezek.33"/><div eID="gen905" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:1
verses.text: AND the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:2
verses.text: Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel, prophesy, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God unto the shepherds; Woe <hi type="italic">be</hi> to the shepherds of Israel that do feed themselves! should not the shepherds feed the flocks?

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:3
verses.text: Ye eat the fat, and ye clothe you with the wool, ye kill them that are fed: <hi type="italic">but</hi> ye feed not the flock.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:4
verses.text: The diseased have ye not strengthened, neither have ye healed that which was sick, neither have ye bound up <hi type="italic">that which was</hi> broken, neither have ye brought again that which was driven away, neither have ye sought that which was lost; but with force and with cruelty have ye ruled them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:5
verses.text: And they were scattered, because <hi type="italic">there is</hi> no shepherd: and they became meat to all the beasts of the field, when they were scattered.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:6
verses.text: My sheep wandered through all the mountains, and upon every high hill: yea, my flock was scattered upon all the face of the earth, and none did search or seek <hi type="italic">after them</hi>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:7
verses.text: ¶ Therefore, ye shepherds, hear the word of the Lord;

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:8
verses.text: <hi type="italic">As</hi> I live, saith the Lord God, surely because my flock became a prey, and my flock became meat to every beast of the field, because <hi type="italic">there was</hi> no shepherd, neither did my shepherds search for my flock, but the shepherds fed themselves, and fed not my flock;

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:9
verses.text: Therefore, O ye shepherds, hear the word of the Lord;

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:10
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> against the shepherds; and I will require my flock at their hand, and cause them to cease from feeding the flock; neither shall the shepherds feed themselves any more; for I will deliver my flock from their mouth, that they may not be meat for them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:11
verses.text: ¶ For thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I, <hi type="italic">even</hi> I, will both search my sheep, and seek them out.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:12
verses.text: As a shepherd seeketh out his flock in the day that he is among his sheep <hi type="italic">that are</hi> scattered; so will I seek out my sheep, and will deliver them out of all places where they have been scattered in the cloudy and dark day.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:13
verses.text: And I will bring them out from the people, and gather them from the countries, and will bring them to their own land, and feed them upon the mountains of Israel by the rivers, and in all the inhabited places of the country.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:14
verses.text: I will feed them in a good pasture, and upon the high mountains of Israel shall their fold be: there shall they lie in a good fold, and <hi type="italic">in</hi> a fat pasture shall they feed upon the mountains of Israel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:15
verses.text: I will feed my flock, and I will cause them to lie down, saith the Lord God.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:16
verses.text: I will seek that which was lost, and bring again that which was driven away, and will bind up <hi type="italic">that which was</hi> broken, and will strengthen that which was sick: but I will destroy the fat and the strong; I will feed them with judgment.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:17
verses.text: And <hi type="italic">as for</hi> you, O my flock, thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I judge between cattle and cattle, between the rams and the he goats.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:18
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Seemeth it</hi> a small thing unto you to have eaten up the good pasture, but ye must tread down with your feet the residue of your pastures? and to have drunk of the deep waters, but ye must foul the residue with your feet?

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:19
verses.text: And <hi type="italic">as for</hi> my flock, they eat that which ye have trodden with your feet; and they drink that which ye have fouled with your feet.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:20
verses.text: ¶ Therefore thus saith the Lord God unto them; Behold, I, <hi type="italic">even</hi> I, will judge between the fat cattle and between the lean cattle.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:21
verses.text: Because ye have thrust with side and with shoulder, and pushed all the diseased with your horns, till ye have scattered them abroad;

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:22
verses.text: Therefore will I save my flock, and they shall no more be a prey; and I will judge between cattle and cattle.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:23
verses.text: And I will set up one shepherd over them, and he shall feed them, <hi type="italic">even</hi> my servant David; he shall feed them, and he shall be their shepherd.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:24
verses.text: And I the Lord will be their God, and my servant David a prince among them; I the Lord have spoken <hi type="italic">it</hi>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:25
verses.text: And I will make with them a covenant of peace, and will cause the evil beasts to cease out of the land: and they shall dwell safely in the wilderness, and sleep in the woods.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:26
verses.text: And I will make them and the places round about my hill a blessing; and I will cause the shower to come down in his season; there shall be showers of blessing.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:27
verses.text: And the tree of the field shall yield her fruit, and the earth shall yield her increase, and they shall be safe in their land, and shall know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord, when I have broken the bands of their yoke, and delivered them out of the hand of those that served themselves of them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:28
verses.text: And they shall no more be a prey to the heathen, neither shall the beast of the land devour them; but they shall dwell safely, and none shall make <hi type="italic">them</hi> afraid.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:29
verses.text: And I will raise up for them a plant of renown, and they shall be no more consumed with hunger in the land, neither bear the shame of the heathen any more.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:30
verses.text: Thus shall they know that I the Lord their God <hi type="italic">am</hi> with them, and <hi type="italic">that</hi> they, <hi type="italic">even</hi> the house of Israel, <hi type="italic">are</hi> my people, saith the Lord God.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:31
verses.text: And ye my flock, the flock of my pasture, <hi type="italic">are</hi> men, <hi type="italic">and</hi> I <hi type="italic">am</hi> your God, saith the Lord God.  <chapter eID="Ezek.34"/><div eID="gen906" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:1
verses.text: MOREOVER the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:2
verses.text: Son of man, set thy face against mount Seir, and prophesy against it,

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:3
verses.text: And say unto it, Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, O mount Seir, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> against thee, and I will stretch out mine hand against thee, and I will make thee most desolate.

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:4
verses.text: I will lay thy cities waste, and thou shalt be desolate, and thou shalt know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord.

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:5
verses.text: Because thou hast had a perpetual hatred, and hast shed <hi type="italic">the blood of</hi> the children of Israel by the force of the sword in the time of their calamity, in the time <hi type="italic">that their</hi> iniquity <hi type="italic">had</hi> an end:

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:6
verses.text: Therefore, <hi type="italic">as</hi> I live, saith the Lord God, I will prepare thee unto blood, and blood shall pursue thee: sith thou hast not hated blood, even blood shall pursue thee.

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:7
verses.text: Thus will I make mount Seir most desolate, and cut off from it him that passeth out and him that returneth.

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:8
verses.text: And I will fill his mountains with his slain <hi type="italic">men:</hi> in thy hills, and in thy valleys, and in all thy rivers, shall they fall that are slain with the sword.

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:9
verses.text: I will make thee perpetual desolations, and thy cities shall not return: and ye shall know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord.

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:10
verses.text: Because thou hast said, These two nations and these two countries shall be mine, and we will possess it; whereas the Lord was there:

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:11
verses.text: Therefore, <hi type="italic">as</hi> I live, saith the Lord God, I will even do according to thine anger, and according to thine envy which thou hast used out of thy hatred against them; and I will make myself known among them, when I have judged thee.

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:12
verses.text: And thou shalt know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord, <hi type="italic">and that</hi> I have heard all thy blasphemies which thou hast spoken against the mountains of Israel, saying, They are laid desolate, they are given us to consume.

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:13
verses.text: Thus with your mouth ye have boasted against me, and have multiplied your words against me: I have heard <hi type="italic">them</hi>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:14
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord God; When the whole earth rejoiceth, I will make thee desolate.

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:15
verses.text: As thou didst rejoice at the inheritance of the house of Israel, because it was desolate, so will I do unto thee: thou shalt be desolate, O mount Seir, and all Idumea, <hi type="italic">even</hi> all of it: and they shall know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord.  <chapter eID="Ezek.35"/><div eID="gen907" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:1
