verses.text: ALSO, thou son of man, prophesy unto the mountains of Israel, and say, Ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord:

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:2
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord God; Because the enemy hath said against you, Aha, even the ancient high places are ours in possession:

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:3
verses.text: Therefore prophesy and say, Thus saith the Lord God; Because they have made <hi type="italic">you</hi> desolate, and swallowed you up on every side, that ye might be a possession unto the residue of the heathen, and ye are taken up in the lips of talkers, and <hi type="italic">are</hi> an infamy of the people:

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:4
verses.text: Therefore, ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord God; Thus saith the Lord God to the mountains, and to the hills, to the rivers, and to the valleys, to the desolate wastes, and to the cities that are forsaken, which became a prey and derision to the residue of the heathen that <hi type="italic">are</hi> round about;

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:5
verses.text: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Surely in the fire of my jealousy have I spoken against the residue of the heathen, and against all Idumea, which have appointed my land into their possession with the joy of all <hi type="italic">their</hi> heart, with despiteful minds, to cast it out for a prey.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:6
verses.text: Prophesy therefore concerning the land of Israel, and say unto the mountains, and to the hills, to the rivers, and to the valleys, Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I have spoken in my jealousy and in my fury, because ye have borne the shame of the heathen:

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:7
verses.text: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; I have lifted up mine hand, Surely the heathen that <hi type="italic">are</hi> about you, they shall bear their shame.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:8
verses.text: ¶ But ye, O mountains of Israel, ye shall shoot forth your branches, and yield your fruit to my people of Israel; for they are at hand to come.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:9
verses.text: For, behold, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> for you, and I will turn unto you, and ye shall be tilled and sown:

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:10
verses.text: And I will multiply men upon you, all the house of Israel, <hi type="italic">even</hi> all of it: and the cities shall be inhabited, and the wastes shall be builded:

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:11
verses.text: And I will multiply upon you man and beast; and they shall increase and bring fruit: and I will settle you after your old estates, and will do better <hi type="italic">unto you</hi> than at your beginnings: and ye shall know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:12
verses.text: Yea, I will cause men to walk upon you, <hi type="italic">even</hi> my people Israel; and they shall possess thee, and thou shalt be their inheritance, and thou shalt no more henceforth bereave them <hi type="italic">of men</hi>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:13
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord God; Because they say unto you, Thou <hi type="italic">land</hi> devourest up men, and hast bereaved thy nations;

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:14
verses.text: Therefore thou shalt devour men no more, neither bereave thy nations any more, saith the Lord God.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:15
verses.text: Neither will I cause <hi type="italic">men</hi> to hear in thee the shame of the heathen any more, neither shalt thou bear the reproach of the people any more, neither shalt thou cause thy nations to fall any more, saith the Lord God.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:16
verses.text: ¶ Moreover the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:17
verses.text: Son of man, when the house of Israel dwelt in their own land, they defiled it by their own way and by their doings: their way was before me as the uncleanness of a removed woman.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:18
verses.text: Wherefore I poured my fury upon them for the blood that they had shed upon the land, and for their idols <hi type="italic">wherewith</hi> they had polluted it:

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:19
verses.text: And I scattered them among the heathen, and they were dispersed through the countries: according to their way and according to their doings I judged them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:20
verses.text: And when they entered unto the heathen, whither they went, they profaned my holy name, when they said to them, These <hi type="italic">are</hi> the people of the Lord, and are gone forth out of his land.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:21
verses.text: ¶ But I had pity for mine holy name, which the house of Israel had profaned among the heathen, whither they went.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:22
verses.text: Therefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord God; I do not <hi type="italic">this</hi> for your sakes, O house of Israel, but for mine holy name’s sake, which ye have profaned among the heathen, whither ye went.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:23
verses.text: And I will sanctify my great name, which was profaned among the heathen, which ye have profaned in the midst of them; and the heathen shall know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord, saith the Lord God, when I shall be sanctified in you before their eyes.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:24
verses.text: For I will take you from among the heathen, and gather you out of all countries, and will bring you into your own land.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:25
verses.text: ¶ Then will I sprinkle clean water upon you, and ye shall be clean: from all your filthiness, and from all your idols, will I cleanse you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:26
verses.text: A new heart also will I give you, and a new spirit will I put within you: and I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you an heart of flesh.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:27
verses.text: And I will put my spirit within you, and cause you to walk in my statutes, and ye shall keep my judgments, and do <hi type="italic">them</hi>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:28
verses.text: And ye shall dwell in the land that I gave to your fathers; and ye shall be my people, and I will be your God.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:29
verses.text: I will also save you from all your uncleannesses: and I will call for the corn, and will increase it, and lay no famine upon you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:30
verses.text: And I will multiply the fruit of the tree, and the increase of the field, that ye shall receive no more reproach of famine among the heathen.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:31
verses.text: Then shall ye remember your own evil ways, and your doings that <hi type="italic">were</hi> not good, and shall lothe yourselves in your own sight for your iniquities and for your abominations.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:32
verses.text: Not for your sakes do I <hi type="italic">this</hi>, saith the Lord God, be it known unto you: be ashamed and confounded for your own ways, O house of Israel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:33
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord God; In the day that I shall have cleansed you from all your iniquities I will also cause <hi type="italic">you</hi> to dwell in the cities, and the wastes shall be builded.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:34
verses.text: And the desolate land shall be tilled, whereas it lay desolate in the sight of all that passed by.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:35
verses.text: And they shall say, This land that was desolate is become like the garden of Eden; and the waste and desolate and ruined cities <hi type="italic">are become</hi> fenced, <hi type="italic">and</hi> are inhabited.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:36
verses.text: Then the heathen that are left round about you shall know that I the Lord build the ruined <hi type="italic">places</hi>, <hi type="italic">and</hi> plant that that was desolate: I the Lord have spoken <hi type="italic">it</hi>, and I will do <hi type="italic">it</hi>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:37
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord God; I will yet <hi type="italic">for</hi> this be inquired of by the house of Israel, to do <hi type="italic">it</hi> for them; I will increase them with men like a flock.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:38
verses.text: As the holy flock, as the flock of Jerusalem in her solemn feasts; so shall the waste cities be filled with flocks of men: and they shall know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord.  <chapter eID="Ezek.36"/><div eID="gen908" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:1
verses.text: THE hand of the Lord was upon me, and carried me out in the spirit of the Lord, and set me down in the midst of the valley which <hi type="italic">was</hi> full of bones,

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:2
verses.text: And caused me to pass by them round about: and, behold, <hi type="italic">there were</hi> very many in the open valley; and, lo, <hi type="italic">they were</hi> very dry.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:3
verses.text: And he said unto me, Son of man, can these bones live? And I answered, O Lord God, thou knowest.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:4
verses.text: Again he said unto me, Prophesy upon these bones, and say unto them, O ye dry bones, hear the word of the Lord.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:5
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord God unto these bones; Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and ye shall live:

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:6
verses.text: And I will lay sinews upon you, and will bring up flesh upon you, and cover you with skin, and put breath in you, and ye shall live; and ye shall know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:7
verses.text: So I prophesied as I was commanded: and as I prophesied, there was a noise, and behold a shaking, and the bones came together, bone to his bone.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:8
verses.text: And when I beheld, lo, the sinews and the flesh came up upon them, and the skin covered them above: but <hi type="italic">there was</hi> no breath in them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:9
verses.text: Then said he unto me, Prophesy unto the wind, prophesy, son of man, and say to the wind, Thus saith the Lord God; Come from the four winds, O breath, and breathe upon these slain, that they may live.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:10
verses.text: So I prophesied as he commanded me, and the breath came into them, and they lived, and stood up upon their feet, an exceeding great army.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:11
verses.text: ¶ Then he said unto me, Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel: behold, they say, Our bones are dried, and our hope is lost: we are cut off for our parts.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:12
verses.text: Therefore prophesy and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, O my people, I will open your graves, and cause you to come up out of your graves, and bring you into the land of Israel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:13
verses.text: And ye shall know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord, when I have opened your graves, O my people, and brought you up out of your graves,

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:14
verses.text: And shall put my spirit in you, and ye shall live, and I shall place you in your own land: then shall ye know that I the Lord have spoken <hi type="italic">it</hi>, and performed <hi type="italic">it</hi>, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:15
verses.text: ¶ The word of the Lord came again unto me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:16
verses.text: Moreover, thou son of man, take thee one stick, and write upon it, For Judah, and for the children of Israel his companions: then take another stick, and write upon it, For Joseph, the stick of Ephraim, and <hi type="italic">for</hi> all the house of Israel his companions:

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:17
verses.text: And join them one to another into one stick; and they shall become one in thine hand.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:18
verses.text: ¶ And when the children of thy people shall speak unto thee, saying, Wilt thou not shew us what thou <hi type="italic">meanest</hi> by these?

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:19
verses.text: Say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I will take the stick of Joseph, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Israel his fellows, and will put them with him, <hi type="italic">even</hi> with the stick of Judah, and make them one stick, and they shall be one in mine hand.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:20
verses.text: ¶ And the sticks whereon thou writest shall be in thine hand before their eyes.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:21
verses.text: And say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I will take the children of Israel from among the heathen, whither they be gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land:

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:22
verses.text: And I will make them one nation in the land upon the mountains of Israel; and one king shall be king to them all: and they shall be no more two nations, neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all:

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:23
verses.text: Neither shall they defile themselves any more with their idols, nor with their detestable things, nor with any of their transgressions: but I will save them out of all their dwellingplaces, wherein they have sinned, and will cleanse them: so shall they be my people, and I will be their God.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:24
verses.text: And David my servant <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> king over them; and they all shall have one shepherd: they shall also walk in my judgments, and observe my statutes, and do them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:25
verses.text: And they shall dwell in the land that I have given unto Jacob my servant, wherein your fathers have dwelt; and they shall dwell therein, <hi type="italic">even</hi> they, and their children, and their children’s children for ever: and my servant David <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> their prince for ever.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:26
verses.text: Moreover I will make a covenant of peace with them; it shall be an everlasting covenant with them: and I will place them, and multiply them, and will set my sanctuary in the midst of them for evermore.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:27
verses.text: My tabernacle also shall be with them: yea, I will be their God, and they shall be my people.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:28
verses.text: And the heathen shall know that I the Lord do sanctify Israel, when my sanctuary shall be in the midst of them for evermore.  <chapter eID="Ezek.37"/><div eID="gen909" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:1
verses.text: AND the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:2
verses.text: Son of man, set thy face against Gog, the land of Magog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal, and prophesy against him,

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:3
verses.text: And say, Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> against thee, O Gog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal:

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:4
verses.text: And I will turn thee back, and put hooks into thy jaws, and I will bring thee forth, and all thine army, horses and horsemen, all of them clothed with all sorts <hi type="italic">of armour</hi>, <hi type="italic">even</hi> a great company <hi type="italic">with</hi> bucklers and shields, all of them handling swords:

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:5
verses.text: Persia, Ethiopia, and Libya with them; all of them with shield and helmet:

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:6
verses.text: Gomer, and all his bands; the house of Togarmah of the north quarters, and all his bands: <hi type="italic">and</hi> many people with thee.

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:7
verses.text: Be thou prepared, and prepare for thyself, thou, and all thy company that are assembled unto thee, and be thou a guard unto them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:8
verses.text: ¶ After many days thou shalt be visited: in the latter years thou shalt come into the land <hi type="italic">that is</hi> brought back from the sword, <hi type="italic">and is</hi> gathered out of many people, against the mountains of Israel, which have been always waste: but it is brought forth out of the nations, and they shall dwell safely all of them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:9
verses.text: Thou shalt ascend and come like a storm, thou shalt be like a cloud to cover the land, thou, and all thy bands, and many people with thee.

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:10
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord God; It shall also come to pass, <hi type="italic">that</hi> at the same time shall things come into thy mind, and thou shalt think an evil thought:

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:11
verses.text: And thou shalt say, I will go up to the land of unwalled villages; I will go to them that are at rest, that dwell safely, all of them dwelling without walls, and having neither bars nor gates,

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:12
verses.text: To take a spoil, and to take a prey; to turn thine hand upon the desolate places <hi type="italic">that are now</hi> inhabited, and upon the people <hi type="italic">that are</hi> gathered out of the nations, which have gotten cattle and goods, that dwell in the midst of the land.

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:13
verses.text: Sheba, and Dedan, and the merchants of Tarshish, with all the young lions thereof, shall say unto thee, Art thou come to take a spoil? hast thou gathered thy company to take a prey? to carry away silver and gold, to take away cattle and goods, to take a great spoil?

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:14
verses.text: ¶ Therefore, son of man, prophesy and say unto Gog, Thus saith the Lord God; In that day when my people of Israel dwelleth safely, shalt thou not know <hi type="italic">it?</hi>

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:15
verses.text: And thou shalt come from thy place out of the north parts, thou, and many people with thee, all of them riding upon horses, a great company, and a mighty army:

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:16
verses.text: And thou shalt come up against my people of Israel, as a cloud to cover the land; it shall be in the latter days, and I will bring thee against my land, that the heathen may know me, when I shall be sanctified in thee, O Gog, before their eyes.

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:17
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord God; <hi type="italic">Art</hi> thou he of whom I have spoken in old time by my servants the prophets of Israel, which prophesied in those days <hi type="italic">many</hi> years that I would bring thee against them?

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:18
verses.text: And it shall come to pass at the same time when Gog shall come against the land of Israel, saith the Lord God, <hi type="italic">that</hi> my fury shall come up in my face.

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:19
verses.text: For in my jealousy <hi type="italic">and</hi> in the fire of my wrath have I spoken, Surely in that day there shall be a great shaking in the land of Israel;

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:20
verses.text: So that the fishes of the sea, and the fowls of the heaven, and the beasts of the field, and all creeping things that creep upon the earth, and all the men that <hi type="italic">are</hi> upon the face of the earth, shall shake at my presence, and the mountains shall be thrown down, and the steep places shall fall, and every wall shall fall to the ground.

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:21
verses.text: And I will call for a sword against him throughout all my mountains, saith the Lord God: every man’s sword shall be against his brother.

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:22
verses.text: And I will plead against him with pestilence and with blood; and I will rain upon him, and upon his bands, and upon the many people that <hi type="italic">are</hi> with him, an overflowing rain, and great hailstones, fire, and brimstone.

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:23
verses.text: Thus will I magnify myself, and sanctify myself; and I will be known in the eyes of many nations, and they shall know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord.  <chapter eID="Ezek.38"/><div eID="gen910" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:1
verses.text: THEREFORE, thou son of man, prophesy against Gog, and say, Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> against thee, O Gog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal:

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:2
verses.text: And I will turn thee back, and leave but the sixth part of thee, and will cause thee to come up from the north parts, and will bring thee upon the mountains of Israel:

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:3
verses.text: And I will smite thy bow out of thy left hand, and will cause thine arrows to fall out of thy right hand.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:4
verses.text: Thou shalt fall upon the mountains of Israel, thou, and all thy bands, and the people that <hi type="italic">is</hi> with thee: I will give thee unto the ravenous birds of every sort, and <hi type="italic">to</hi> the beasts of the field to be devoured.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:5
verses.text: Thou shalt fall upon the open field: for I have spoken <hi type="italic">it</hi>, saith the Lord God.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:6
verses.text: And I will send a fire on Magog, and among them that dwell carelessly in the isles: and they shall know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:7
verses.text: So will I make my holy name known in the midst of my people Israel; and I will not <hi type="italic">let them</hi> pollute my holy name any more: and the heathen shall know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord, the Holy One in Israel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:8
verses.text: ¶ Behold, it is come, and it is done, saith the Lord God; this <hi type="italic">is</hi> the day whereof I have spoken.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:9
verses.text: And they that dwell in the cities of Israel shall go forth, and shall set on fire and burn the weapons, both the shields and the bucklers, the bows and the arrows, and the handstaves, and the spears, and they shall burn them with fire seven years:

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:10
verses.text: So that they shall take no wood out of the field, neither cut down <hi type="italic">any</hi> out of the forests; for they shall burn the weapons with fire: and they shall spoil those that spoiled them, and rob those that robbed them, saith the Lord God.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:11
verses.text: ¶ And it shall come to pass in that day, <hi type="italic">that</hi> I will give unto Gog a place there of graves in Israel, the valley of the passengers on the east of the sea: and it shall stop the <hi type="italic">noses</hi> of the passengers: and there shall they bury Gog and all his multitude: and they shall call <hi type="italic">it</hi> The valley of Hamon-gog.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:12
verses.text: And seven months shall the house of Israel be burying of them, that they may cleanse the land.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:13
verses.text: Yea, all the people of the land shall bury <hi type="italic">them;</hi> and it shall be to them a renown the day that I shall be glorified, saith the Lord God.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:14
verses.text: And they shall sever out men of continual employment, passing through the land to bury with the passengers those that remain upon the face of the earth, to cleanse it: after the end of seven months shall they search.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:15
verses.text: And the passengers <hi type="italic">that</hi> pass through the land, when <hi type="italic">any</hi> seeth a man’s bone, then shall he set up a sign by it, till the buriers have buried it in the valley of Hamon-gog.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:16
verses.text: And also the name of the city <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> Hamonah. Thus shall they cleanse the land.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:17
verses.text: ¶ And, thou son of man, thus saith the Lord God; Speak unto every feathered fowl, and to every beast of the field, Assemble yourselves, and come; gather yourselves on every side to my sacrifice that I do sacrifice for you, <hi type="italic">even</hi> a great sacrifice upon the mountains of Israel, that ye may eat flesh, and drink blood.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:18
verses.text: Ye shall eat the flesh of the mighty, and drink the blood of the princes of the earth, of rams, of lambs, and of goats, of bullocks, all of them fatlings of Bashan.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:19
verses.text: And ye shall eat fat till ye be full, and drink blood till ye be drunken, of my sacrifice which I have sacrificed for you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:20
verses.text: Thus ye shall be filled at my table with horses and chariots, with mighty men, and with all men of war, saith the Lord God.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:21
verses.text: And I will set my glory among the heathen, and all the heathen shall see my judgment that I have executed, and my hand that I have laid upon them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:22
verses.text: So the house of Israel shall know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord their God from that day and forward.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:23
verses.text: ¶ And the heathen shall know that the house of Israel went into captivity for their iniquity: because they trespassed against me, therefore hid I my face from them, and gave them into the hand of their enemies: so fell they all by the sword.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:24
verses.text: According to their uncleanness and according to their transgressions have I done unto them, and hid my face from them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:25
verses.text: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Now will I bring again the captivity of Jacob, and have mercy upon the whole house of Israel, and will be jealous for my holy name;

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:26
verses.text: After that they have borne their shame, and all their trespasses whereby they have trespassed against me, when they dwelt safely in their land, and none made <hi type="italic">them</hi> afraid.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:27
verses.text: When I have brought them again from the people, and gathered them out of their enemies’ lands, and am sanctified in them in the sight of many nations;

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:28
verses.text: Then shall they know that I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord their God, which caused them to be led into captivity among the heathen: but I have gathered them unto their own land, and have left none of them any more there.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:29
verses.text: Neither will I hide my face any more from them: for I have poured out my spirit upon the house of Israel, saith the Lord God.  <chapter eID="Ezek.39"/><div eID="gen911" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:1
verses.text: IN the five and twentieth year of our captivity, in the beginning of the year, in the tenth <hi type="italic">day</hi> of the month, in the fourteenth year after that the city was smitten, in the selfsame day the hand of the Lord was upon me, and brought me thither.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:2
verses.text: In the visions of God brought he me into the land of Israel, and set me upon a very high mountain, by which <hi type="italic">was</hi> as the frame of a city on the south.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:3
verses.text: And he brought me thither, and, behold, <hi type="italic">there was</hi> a man, whose appearance <hi type="italic">was</hi> like the appearance of brass, with a line of flax in his hand, and a measuring reed; and he stood in the gate.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:4
verses.text: And the man said unto me, Son of man, behold with thine eyes, and hear with thine ears, and set thine heart upon all that I shall shew thee; for to the intent that I might shew <hi type="italic">them</hi> unto thee <hi type="italic">art</hi> thou brought hither: declare all that thou seest to the house of Israel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:5
verses.text: And behold a wall on the outside of the house round about, and in the man’s hand a measuring reed of six cubits <hi type="italic">long</hi> by the cubit and an hand breadth: so he measured the breadth of the building, one reed; and the height, one reed.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:6
verses.text: ¶ Then came he unto the gate which looketh toward the east, and went up the stairs thereof, and measured the threshold of the gate, <hi type="italic">which was</hi> one reed broad; and the other threshold <hi type="italic">of the gate</hi>, <hi type="italic">which was</hi> one reed broad.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:7
verses.text: And <hi type="italic">every</hi> little chamber <hi type="italic">was</hi> one reed long, and one reed broad; and between the little chambers <hi type="italic">were</hi> five cubits; and the threshold of the gate by the porch of the gate within <hi type="italic">was</hi> one reed.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:8
verses.text: He measured also the porch of the gate within, one reed.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:9
verses.text: Then measured he the porch of the gate, eight cubits; and the posts thereof, two cubits; and the porch of the gate <hi type="italic">was</hi> inward.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:10
verses.text: And the little chambers of the gate eastward <hi type="italic">were</hi> three on this side, and three on that side; they three <hi type="italic">were</hi> of one measure: and the posts had one measure on this side and on that side.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:11
verses.text: And he measured the breadth of the entry of the gate, ten cubits; <hi type="italic">and</hi> the length of the gate, thirteen cubits.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:12
verses.text: The space also before the little chambers <hi type="italic">was</hi> one cubit <hi type="italic">on this side</hi>, and the space <hi type="italic">was</hi> one cubit on that side: and the little chambers <hi type="italic">were</hi> six cubits on this side, and six cubits on that side.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:13
verses.text: He measured then the gate from the roof of <hi type="italic">one</hi> little chamber to the roof of another: the breadth <hi type="italic">was</hi> five and twenty cubits, door against door.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:14
verses.text: He made also posts of threescore cubits, even unto the post of the court round about the gate.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:15
verses.text: And from the face of the gate of the entrance unto the face of the porch of the inner gate <hi type="italic">were</hi> fifty cubits.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:16
verses.text: And <hi type="italic">there were</hi> narrow windows to the little chambers, and to their posts within the gate round about, and likewise to the arches: and windows <hi type="italic">were</hi> round about inward: and upon <hi type="italic">each</hi> post <hi type="italic">were</hi> palm trees.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:17
verses.text: Then brought he me into the outward court, and, lo, <hi type="italic">there were</hi> chambers, and a pavement made for the court round about: thirty chambers <hi type="italic">were</hi> upon the pavement.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:18
verses.text: And the pavement by the side of the gates over against the length of the gates <hi type="italic">was</hi> the lower pavement.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:19
verses.text: Then he measured the breadth from the forefront of the lower gate unto the forefront of the inner court without, an hundred cubits eastward and northward.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:20
verses.text: ¶ And the gate of the outward court that looked toward the north, he measured the length thereof, and the breadth thereof.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:21
verses.text: And the little chambers thereof <hi type="italic">were</hi> three on this side and three on that side; and the posts thereof and the arches thereof were after the measure of the first gate: the length thereof <hi type="italic">was</hi> fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:22
verses.text: And their windows, and their arches, and their palm trees, <hi type="italic">were</hi> after the measure of the gate that looketh toward the east; and they went up unto it by seven steps; and the arches thereof <hi type="italic">were</hi> before them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:23
verses.text: And the gate of the inner court <hi type="italic">was</hi> over against the gate toward the north, and toward the east; and he measured from gate to gate an hundred cubits.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:24
verses.text: ¶ After that he brought me toward the south, and behold a gate toward the south: and he measured the posts thereof and the arches thereof according to these measures.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:25
verses.text: And <hi type="italic">there were</hi> windows in it and in the arches thereof round about, like those windows: the length <hi type="italic">was</hi> fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:26
verses.text: And <hi type="italic">there were</hi> seven steps to go up to it, and the arches thereof <hi type="italic">were</hi> before them: and it had palm trees, one on this side, and another on that side, upon the posts thereof.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:27
verses.text: And <hi type="italic">there was</hi> a gate in the inner court toward the south: and he measured from gate to gate toward the south an hundred cubits.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:28
verses.text: And he brought me to the inner court by the south gate: and he measured the south gate according to these measures;

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:29
verses.text: And the little chambers thereof, and the posts thereof, and the arches thereof, according to these measures: and <hi type="italic">there were</hi> windows in it and in the arches thereof round about: <hi type="italic">it was</hi> fifty cubits long, and five and twenty cubits broad.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:30
verses.text: And the arches round about <hi type="italic">were</hi> five and twenty cubits long, and five cubits broad.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:31
verses.text: And the arches thereof <hi type="italic">were</hi> toward the utter court; and palm trees <hi type="italic">were</hi> upon the posts thereof: and the going up to it <hi type="italic">had</hi> eight steps.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:32
verses.text: ¶ And he brought me into the inner court toward the east: and he measured the gate according to these measures.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:33
verses.text: And the little chambers thereof, and the posts thereof, and the arches thereof, <hi type="italic">were</hi> according to these measures: and <hi type="italic">there were</hi> windows therein and in the arches thereof round about: <hi type="italic">it was</hi> fifty cubits long, and five and twenty cubits broad.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:34
verses.text: And the arches thereof <hi type="italic">were</hi> toward the outward court; and palm trees <hi type="italic">were</hi> upon the posts thereof, on this side, and on that side: and the going up to it <hi type="italic">had</hi> eight steps.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:35
verses.text: ¶ And he brought me to the north gate, and measured <hi type="italic">it</hi> according to these measures;

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:36
verses.text: The little chambers thereof, the posts thereof, and the arches thereof, and the windows to it round about: the length <hi type="italic">was</hi> fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:37
verses.text: And the posts thereof <hi type="italic">were</hi> toward the utter court; and palm trees <hi type="italic">were</hi> upon the posts thereof, on this side, and on that side: and the going up to it <hi type="italic">had</hi> eight steps.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:38
verses.text: And the chambers and the entries thereof <hi type="italic">were</hi> by the posts of the gates, where they washed the burnt offering.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:39
verses.text: ¶ And in the porch of the gate <hi type="italic">were</hi> two tables on this side, and two tables on that side, to slay thereon the burnt offering and the sin offering and the trespass offering.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:40
verses.text: And at the side without, as one goeth up to the entry of the north gate, <hi type="italic">were</hi> two tables; and on the other side, which <hi type="italic">was</hi> at the porch of the gate, <hi type="italic">were</hi> two tables.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:41
verses.text: Four tables <hi type="italic">were</hi> on this side, and four tables on that side, by the side of the gate; eight tables, whereupon they slew <hi type="italic">their sacrifices</hi>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:42
verses.text: And the four tables <hi type="italic">were</hi> of hewn stone for the burnt offering, of a cubit and an half long, and a cubit and an half broad, and one cubit high: whereupon also they laid the instruments wherewith they slew the burnt offering and the sacrifice.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:43
verses.text: And within <hi type="italic">were</hi> hooks, an hand broad, fastened round about: and upon the tables <hi type="italic">was</hi> the flesh of the offering.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:44
verses.text: ¶ And without the inner gate <hi type="italic">were</hi> the chambers of the singers in the inner court, which <hi type="italic">was</hi> at the side of the north gate; and their prospect <hi type="italic">was</hi> toward the south: one at the side of the east gate <hi type="italic">having</hi> the prospect toward the north.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:45
verses.text: And he said unto me, This chamber, whose prospect <hi type="italic">is</hi> toward the south, <hi type="italic">is</hi> for the priests, the keepers of the charge of the house.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:46
verses.text: And the chamber whose prospect <hi type="italic">is</hi> toward the north <hi type="italic">is</hi> for the priests, the keepers of the charge of the altar: these <hi type="italic">are</hi> the sons of Zadok among the sons of Levi, which come near to the Lord to minister unto him.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:47
verses.text: So he measured the court, an hundred cubits long, and an hundred cubits broad, foursquare; and the altar <hi type="italic">that was</hi> before the house.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:48
verses.text: ¶ And he brought me to the porch of the house, and measured <hi type="italic">each</hi> post of the porch, five cubits on this side, and five cubits on that side: and the breadth of the gate <hi type="italic">was</hi> three cubits on this side, and three cubits on that side.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:49
verses.text: The length of the porch <hi type="italic">was</hi> twenty cubits, and the breadth eleven cubits; and <hi type="italic">he brought me</hi> by the steps whereby they went up to it: and <hi type="italic">there were</hi> pillars by the posts, one on this side, and another on that side.  <chapter eID="Ezek.40"/><div eID="gen912" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:1
verses.text: AFTERWARD he brought me to the temple, and measured the posts, six cubits broad on the one side, and six cubits broad on the other side, <hi type="italic">which was</hi> the breadth of the tabernacle.

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:2
verses.text: And the breadth of the door <hi type="italic">was</hi> ten cubits; and the sides of the door <hi type="italic">were</hi> five cubits on the one side, and five cubits on the other side: and he measured the length thereof, forty cubits: and the breadth, twenty cubits.

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:3
verses.text: Then went he inward, and measured the post of the door, two cubits; and the door, six cubits; and the breadth of the door, seven cubits.

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:4
verses.text: So he measured the length thereof, twenty cubits; and the breadth, twenty cubits, before the temple: and he said unto me, This <hi type="italic">is</hi> the most holy <hi type="italic">place</hi>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:5
verses.text: After he measured the wall of the house, six cubits; and the breadth of <hi type="italic">every</hi> side chamber, four cubits, round about the house on every side.

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:6
verses.text: And the side chambers <hi type="italic">were</hi> three, one over another, and thirty in order; and they entered into the wall which <hi type="italic">was</hi> of the house for the side chambers round about, that they might have hold, but they had not hold in the wall of the house.

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:7
verses.text: And <hi type="italic">there was</hi> an enlarging, and a winding about still upward to the side chambers: for the winding about of the house went still upward round about the house: therefore the breadth of the house <hi type="italic">was still</hi> upward, and so increased <hi type="italic">from</hi> the lowest <hi type="italic">chamber</hi> to the highest by the midst.

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:8
verses.text: I saw also the height of the house round about: the foundations of the side chambers <hi type="italic">were</hi> a full reed of six great cubits.

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:9
verses.text: The thickness of the wall, which <hi type="italic">was</hi> for the side chamber without, <hi type="italic">was</hi> five cubits: and <hi type="italic">that</hi> which <hi type="italic">was</hi> left <hi type="italic">was</hi> the place of the side chambers that <hi type="italic">were</hi> within.

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:10
verses.text: And between the chambers <hi type="italic">was</hi> the wideness of twenty cubits round about the house on every side.

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:11
verses.text: And the doors of the side chambers <hi type="italic">were</hi> toward <hi type="italic">the place that was</hi> left, one door toward the north, and another door toward the south: and the breadth of the place that was left <hi type="italic">was</hi> five cubits round about.

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:12
verses.text: Now the building that <hi type="italic">was</hi> before the separate place at the end toward the west <hi type="italic">was</hi> seventy cubits broad; and the wall of the building <hi type="italic">was</hi> five cubits thick round about, and the length thereof ninety cubits.

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:13
verses.text: So he measured the house, an hundred cubits long; and the separate place, and the building, with the walls thereof, an hundred cubits long;

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:14
verses.text: Also the breadth of the face of the house, and of the separate place toward the east, an hundred cubits.

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:15
verses.text: And he measured the length of the building over against the separate place which <hi type="italic">was</hi> behind it, and the galleries thereof on the one side and on the other side, an hundred cubits, with the inner temple, and the porches of the court;

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:16
verses.text: The door posts, and the narrow windows, and the galleries round about on their three stories, over against the door, cieled with wood round about, and from the ground up to the windows, and the windows <hi type="italic">were</hi> covered;

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:17
verses.text: To that above the door, even unto the inner house, and without, and by all the wall round about within and without, by measure.

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:18
verses.text: And <hi type="italic">it was</hi> made with cherubims and palm trees, so that a palm tree <hi type="italic">was</hi> between a cherub and a cherub; and <hi type="italic">every</hi> cherub had two faces;

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:19
verses.text: So that the face of a man <hi type="italic">was</hi> toward the palm tree on the one side, and the face of a young lion toward the palm tree on the other side: <hi type="italic">it was</hi> made through all the house round about.

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:20
verses.text: From the ground unto above the door <hi type="italic">were</hi> cherubims and palm trees made, and <hi type="italic">on</hi> the wall of the temple.

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:21
verses.text: The posts of the temple <hi type="italic">were</hi> squared, <hi type="italic">and</hi> the face of the sanctuary; the appearance <hi type="italic">of the one</hi> as the appearance <hi type="italic">of the other</hi>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:22
verses.text: The altar of wood <hi type="italic">was</hi> three cubits high, and the length thereof two cubits; and the corners thereof, and the length thereof, and the walls thereof, <hi type="italic">were</hi> of wood: and he said unto me, This <hi type="italic">is</hi> the table that <hi type="italic">is</hi> before the Lord.

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:23
verses.text: And the temple and the sanctuary had two doors.

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:24
verses.text: And the doors had two leaves <hi type="italic">apiece</hi>, two turning leaves; two <hi type="italic">leaves</hi> for the one door, and two leaves for the other <hi type="italic">door</hi>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:25
verses.text: And <hi type="italic">there were</hi> made on them, on the doors of the temple, cherubims and palm trees, like as <hi type="italic">were</hi> made upon the walls; and <hi type="italic">there were</hi> thick planks upon the face of the porch without.

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:26
verses.text: And <hi type="italic">there were</hi> narrow windows and palm trees on the one side and on the other side, on the sides of the porch, and <hi type="italic">upon</hi> the side chambers of the house, and thick planks.  <chapter eID="Ezek.41"/><div eID="gen913" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:1
verses.text: THEN he brought me forth into the utter court, the way toward the north: and he brought me into the chamber that <hi type="italic">was</hi> over against the separate place, and which <hi type="italic">was</hi> before the building toward the north.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:2
verses.text: Before the length of an hundred cubits <hi type="italic">was</hi> the north door, and the breadth <hi type="italic">was</hi> fifty cubits.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:3
verses.text: Over against the twenty <hi type="italic">cubits</hi> which <hi type="italic">were</hi> for the inner court, and over against the pavement which <hi type="italic">was</hi> for the utter court, <hi type="italic">was</hi> gallery against gallery in three <hi type="italic">stories</hi>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:4
verses.text: And before the chambers <hi type="italic">was</hi> a walk of ten cubits breadth inward, a way of one cubit; and their doors toward the north.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:5
verses.text: Now the upper chambers <hi type="italic">were</hi> shorter: for the galleries were higher than these, than the lower, and than the middlemost of the building.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:6
verses.text: For they <hi type="italic">were</hi> in three <hi type="italic">stories</hi>, but had not pillars as the pillars of the courts: therefore <hi type="italic">the building</hi> was straitened more than the lowest and the middlemost from the ground.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:7
verses.text: And the wall that <hi type="italic">was</hi> without over against the chambers, toward the utter court on the forepart of the chambers, the length thereof <hi type="italic">was</hi> fifty cubits.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:8
verses.text: For the length of the chambers that <hi type="italic">were</hi> in the utter court <hi type="italic">was</hi> fifty cubits: and, lo, before the temple <hi type="italic">were</hi> an hundred cubits.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:9
verses.text: And from under these chambers <hi type="italic">was</hi> the entry on the east side, as one goeth into them from the utter court.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:10
verses.text: The chambers <hi type="italic">were</hi> in the thickness of the wall of the court toward the east, over against the separate place, and over against the building.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:11
verses.text: And the way before them <hi type="italic">was</hi> like the appearance of the chambers which <hi type="italic">were</hi> toward the north, as long as they, <hi type="italic">and</hi> as broad as they: and all their goings out <hi type="italic">were</hi> both according to their fashions, and according to their doors.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:12
verses.text: And according to the doors of the chambers that <hi type="italic">were</hi> toward the south <hi type="italic">was</hi> a door in the head of the way, <hi type="italic">even</hi> the way directly before the wall toward the east, as one entereth into them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:13
verses.text: ¶ Then said he unto me, The north chambers <hi type="italic">and</hi> the south chambers, which <hi type="italic">are</hi> before the separate place, they <hi type="italic">be</hi> holy chambers, where the priests that approach unto the Lord shall eat the most holy things: there shall they lay the most holy things, and the meat offering, and the sin offering, and the trespass offering; for the place <hi type="italic">is</hi> holy.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:14
verses.text: When the priests enter therein, then shall they not go out of the holy <hi type="italic">place</hi> into the utter court, but there they shall lay their garments wherein they minister; for they <hi type="italic">are</hi> holy; and shall put on other garments, and shall approach to <hi type="italic">those things</hi> which <hi type="italic">are</hi> for the people.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:15
verses.text: Now when he had made an end of measuring the inner house, he brought me forth toward the gate whose prospect <hi type="italic">is</hi> toward the east, and measured it round about.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:16
verses.text: He measured the east side with the measuring reed, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed round about.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:17
verses.text: He measured the north side, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed round about.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:18
verses.text: He measured the south side, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:19
verses.text: ¶ He turned about to the west side, <hi type="italic">and</hi> measured five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:20
verses.text: He measured it by the four sides: it had a wall round about, five hundred <hi type="italic">reeds</hi> long, and five hundred broad, to make a separation between the sanctuary and the profane place.  <chapter eID="Ezek.42"/><div eID="gen914" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:1
verses.text: AFTERWARD he brought me to the gate, <hi type="italic">even</hi> the gate that looketh toward the east:

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:2
verses.text: And, behold, the glory of the God of Israel came from the way of the east: and his voice <hi type="italic">was</hi> like a noise of many waters: and the earth shined with his glory.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:3
verses.text: And <hi type="italic">it was</hi> according to the appearance of the vision which I saw, <hi type="italic">even</hi> according to the vision that I saw when I came to destroy the city: and the visions <hi type="italic">were</hi> like the vision that I saw by the river Chebar; and I fell upon my face.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:4
verses.text: And the glory of the Lord came into the house by the way of the gate whose prospect <hi type="italic">is</hi> toward the east.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:5
verses.text: So the spirit took me up, and brought me into the inner court; and, behold, the glory of the Lord filled the house.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:6
verses.text: And I heard <hi type="italic">him</hi> speaking unto me out of the house; and the man stood by me.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:7
verses.text: ¶ And he said unto me, Son of man, the place of my throne, and the place of the soles of my feet, where I will dwell in the midst of the children of Israel for ever, and my holy name, shall the house of Israel no more defile, <hi type="italic">neither</hi> they, nor their kings, by their whoredom, nor by the carcases of their kings in their high places.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:8
verses.text: In their setting of their threshold by my thresholds, and their post by my posts, and the wall between me and them, they have even defiled my holy name by their abominations that they have committed: wherefore I have consumed them in mine anger.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:9
verses.text: Now let them put away their whoredom, and the carcases of their kings, far from me, and I will dwell in the midst of them for ever.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:10
verses.text: ¶ Thou son of man, shew the house to the house of Israel, that they may be ashamed of their iniquities: and let them measure the pattern.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:11
verses.text: And if they be ashamed of all that they have done, shew them the form of the house, and the fashion thereof, and the goings out thereof, and the comings in thereof, and all the forms thereof, and all the ordinances thereof, and all the forms thereof, and all the laws thereof: and write <hi type="italic">it</hi> in their sight, that they may keep the whole form thereof, and all the ordinances thereof, and do them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:12
verses.text: This <hi type="italic">is</hi> the law of the house; Upon the top of the mountain the whole limit thereof round about <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> most holy. Behold, this <hi type="italic">is</hi> the law of the house.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:13
verses.text: ¶ And these <hi type="italic">are</hi> the measures of the altar after the cubits: The cubit <hi type="italic">is</hi> a cubit and an hand breadth; even the bottom <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> a cubit, and the breadth a cubit, and the border thereof by the edge thereof round about <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> a span: and this <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> the higher place of the altar.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:14
verses.text: And from the bottom <hi type="italic">upon</hi> the ground <hi type="italic">even</hi> to the lower settle <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> two cubits, and the breadth one cubit; and from the lesser settle <hi type="italic">even</hi> to the greater settle <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> four cubits, and the breadth <hi type="italic">one</hi> cubit.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:15
verses.text: So the altar <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> four cubits; and from the altar and upward <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> four horns.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:16
verses.text: And the altar <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> twelve <hi type="italic">cubits</hi> long, twelve broad, square in the four squares thereof.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:17
verses.text: And the settle <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> fourteen <hi type="italic">cubits</hi> long and fourteen broad in the four squares thereof; and the border about it <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> half a cubit; and the bottom thereof <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> a cubit about; and his stairs shall look toward the east.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:18
verses.text: ¶ And he said unto me, Son of man, thus saith the Lord God; These <hi type="italic">are</hi> the ordinances of the altar in the day when they shall make it, to offer burnt offerings thereon, and to sprinkle blood thereon.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:19
verses.text: And thou shalt give to the priests the Levites that be of the seed of Zadok, which approach unto me, to minister unto me, saith the Lord God, a young bullock for a sin offering.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:20
verses.text: And thou shalt take of the blood thereof, and put <hi type="italic">it</hi> on the four horns of it, and on the four corners of the settle, and upon the border round about: thus shalt thou cleanse and purge it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:21
verses.text: Thou shalt take the bullock also of the sin offering, and he shall burn it in the appointed place of the house, without the sanctuary.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:22
verses.text: And on the second day thou shalt offer a kid of the goats without blemish for a sin offering; and they shall cleanse the altar, as they did cleanse <hi type="italic">it</hi> with the bullock.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:23
verses.text: When thou hast made an end of cleansing <hi type="italic">it</hi>, thou shalt offer a young bullock without blemish, and a ram out of the flock without blemish.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:24
verses.text: And thou shalt offer them before the Lord, and the priests shall cast salt upon them, and they shall offer them up <hi type="italic">for</hi> a burnt offering unto the Lord.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:25
verses.text: Seven days shalt thou prepare every day a goat <hi type="italic">for</hi> a sin offering: they shall also prepare a young bullock, and a ram out of the flock, without blemish.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:26
verses.text: Seven days shall they purge the altar and purify it; and they shall consecrate themselves.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:27
verses.text: And when these days are expired, it shall be, <hi type="italic">that</hi> upon the eighth day, and <hi type="italic">so</hi> forward, the priests shall make your burnt offerings upon the altar, and your peace offerings; and I will accept you, saith the Lord God.  <chapter eID="Ezek.43"/><div eID="gen915" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:1
verses.text: THEN he brought me back the way of the gate of the outward sanctuary which looketh toward the east; and it <hi type="italic">was</hi> shut.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:2
verses.text: Then said the Lord unto me; This gate shall be shut, it shall not be opened, and no man shall enter in by it; because the Lord, the God of Israel, hath entered in by it, therefore it shall be shut.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:3
verses.text: <hi type="italic">It is</hi> for the prince; the prince, he shall sit in it to eat bread before the Lord; he shall enter by the way of the porch of <hi type="italic">that</hi> gate, and shall go out by the way of the same.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:4
verses.text: ¶ Then brought he me the way of the north gate before the house: and I looked, and, behold, the glory of the Lord filled the house of the Lord: and I fell upon my face.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:5
verses.text: And the Lord said unto me, Son of man, mark well, and behold with thine eyes, and hear with thine ears all that I say unto thee concerning all the ordinances of the house of the Lord, and all the laws thereof; and mark well the entering in of the house, with every going forth of the sanctuary.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:6
verses.text: And thou shalt say to the rebellious, <hi type="italic">even</hi> to the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord God; O ye house of Israel, let it suffice you of all your abominations,

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:7
verses.text: In that ye have brought <hi type="italic">into my sanctuary</hi> strangers, uncircumcised in heart, and uncircumcised in flesh, to be in my sanctuary, to pollute it, <hi type="italic">even</hi> my house, when ye offer my bread, the fat and the blood, and they have broken my covenant because of all your abominations.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:8
verses.text: And ye have not kept the charge of mine holy things: but ye have set keepers of my charge in my sanctuary for yourselves.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:9
verses.text: ¶ Thus saith the Lord God; No stranger, uncircumcised in heart, nor uncircumcised in flesh, shall enter into my sanctuary, of any stranger that <hi type="italic">is</hi> among the children of Israel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:10
verses.text: And the Levites that are gone away far from me, when Israel went astray, which went astray away from me after their idols; they shall even bear their iniquity.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:11
verses.text: Yet they shall be ministers in my sanctuary, <hi type="italic">having</hi> charge at the gates of the house, and ministering to the house: they shall slay the burnt offering and the sacrifice for the people, and they shall stand before them to minister unto them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:12
verses.text: Because they ministered unto them before their idols, and caused the house of Israel to fall into iniquity; therefore have I lifted up mine hand against them, saith the Lord God, and they shall bear their iniquity.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:13
verses.text: And they shall not come near unto me, to do the office of a priest unto me, nor to come near to any of my holy things, in the most holy <hi type="italic">place:</hi> but they shall bear their shame, and their abominations which they have committed.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:14
verses.text: But I will make them keepers of the charge of the house, for all the service thereof, and for all that shall be done therein.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:15
verses.text: ¶ But the priests the Levites, the sons of Zadok, that kept the charge of my sanctuary when the children of Israel went astray from me, they shall come near to me to minister unto me, and they shall stand before me to offer unto me the fat and the blood, saith the Lord God:

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:16
verses.text: They shall enter into my sanctuary, and they shall come near to my table, to minister unto me, and they shall keep my charge.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:17
verses.text: ¶ And it shall come to pass, <hi type="italic">that</hi> when they enter in at the gates of the inner court, they shall be clothed with linen garments; and no wool shall come upon them, whiles they minister in the gates of the inner court, and within.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:18
verses.text: They shall have linen bonnets upon their heads, and shall have linen breeches upon their loins; they shall not gird <hi type="italic">themselves</hi> with any thing that causeth sweat.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:19
verses.text: And when they go forth into the utter court, <hi type="italic">even</hi> into the utter court to the people, they shall put off their garments wherein they ministered, and lay them in the holy chambers, and they shall put on other garments; and they shall not sanctify the people with their garments.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:20
verses.text: Neither shall they shave their heads, nor suffer their locks to grow long; they shall only poll their heads.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:21
verses.text: Neither shall any priest drink wine, when they enter into the inner court.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:22
verses.text: Neither shall they take for their wives a widow, nor her that is put away: but they shall take maidens of the seed of the house of Israel, or a widow that had a priest before.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:23
verses.text: And they shall teach my people <hi type="italic">the difference</hi> between the holy and profane, and cause them to discern between the unclean and the clean.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:24
verses.text: And in controversy they shall stand in judgment; <hi type="italic">and</hi> they shall judge it according to my judgments: and they shall keep my laws and my statutes in all mine assemblies; and they shall hallow my sabbaths.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:25
verses.text: And they shall come at no dead person to defile themselves: but for father, or for mother, or for son, or for daughter, for brother, or for sister that hath had no husband, they may defile themselves.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:26
verses.text: And after he is cleansed, they shall reckon unto him seven days.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:27
verses.text: And in the day that he goeth into the sanctuary, unto the inner court, to minister in the sanctuary, he shall offer his sin offering, saith the Lord God.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:28
verses.text: And it shall be unto them for an inheritance: I <hi type="italic">am</hi> their inheritance: and ye shall give them no possession in Israel: I <hi type="italic">am</hi> their possession.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:29
verses.text: They shall eat the meat offering, and the sin offering, and the trespass offering; and every dedicated thing in Israel shall be theirs.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:30
verses.text: And the first of all the firstfruits of all <hi type="italic">things</hi>, and every oblation of all, of every <hi type="italic">sort</hi> of your oblations, shall be the priest’s: ye shall also give unto the priest the first of your dough, that he may cause the blessing to rest in thine house.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:31
verses.text: The priests shall not eat of any thing that is dead of itself, or torn, whether it be fowl or beast.  <chapter eID="Ezek.44"/><div eID="gen916" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:1
verses.text: MOREOVER, when ye shall divide by lot the land for inheritance, ye shall offer an oblation unto the Lord, an holy portion of the land: the length <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> the length of five and twenty thousand <hi type="italic">reeds</hi>, and the breadth <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> ten thousand. This <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> holy in all the borders thereof round about.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:2
verses.text: Of this there shall be for the sanctuary five hundred <hi type="italic">in length</hi>, with five hundred <hi type="italic">in breadth</hi>, square round about; and fifty cubits round about for the suburbs thereof.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:3
verses.text: And of this measure shalt thou measure the length of five and twenty thousand, and the breadth of ten thousand: and in it shall be the sanctuary <hi type="italic">and</hi> the most holy <hi type="italic">place</hi>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:4
verses.text: The holy <hi type="italic">portion</hi> of the land shall be for the priests the ministers of the sanctuary, which shall come near to minister unto the Lord: and it shall be a place for their houses, and an holy place for the sanctuary.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:5
verses.text: And the five and twenty thousand of length, and the ten thousand of breadth, shall also the Levites, the ministers of the house, have for themselves, for a possession for twenty chambers.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:6
verses.text: ¶ And ye shall appoint the possession of the city five thousand broad, and five and twenty thousand long, over against the oblation of the holy <hi type="italic">portion:</hi> it shall be for the whole house of Israel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:7
verses.text: ¶ And <hi type="italic">a portion shall be</hi> for the prince on the one side and on the other side of the oblation of the holy <hi type="italic">portion</hi>, and of the possession of the city, before the oblation of the holy <hi type="italic">portion</hi>, and before the possession of the city, from the west side westward, and from the east side eastward: and the length <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> over against one of the portions, from the west border unto the east border.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:8
verses.text: In the land shall be his possession in Israel: and my princes shall no more oppress my people; and <hi type="italic">the rest of</hi> the land shall they give to the house of Israel according to their tribes.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:9
verses.text: ¶ Thus saith the Lord God; Let it suffice you, O princes of Israel: remove violence and spoil, and execute judgment and justice, take away your exactions from my people, saith the Lord God.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:10
verses.text: Ye shall have just balances, and a just ephah, and a just bath.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:11
verses.text: The ephah and the bath shall be of one measure, that the bath may contain the tenth part of an homer, and the ephah the tenth part of an homer: the measure thereof shall be after the homer.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:12
verses.text: And the shekel <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> twenty gerahs: twenty shekels, five and twenty shekels, fifteen shekels, shall be your maneh.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:13
verses.text: This <hi type="italic">is</hi> the oblation that ye shall offer; the sixth part of an ephah of an homer of wheat, and ye shall give the sixth part of an ephah of an homer of barley:

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:14
verses.text: Concerning the ordinance of oil, the bath of oil, <hi type="italic">ye shall offer</hi> the tenth part of a bath out of the cor, <hi type="italic">which is</hi> an homer of ten baths; for ten baths <hi type="italic">are</hi> an homer:

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:15
verses.text: And one lamb out of the flock, out of two hundred, out of the fat pastures of Israel; for a meat offering, and for a burnt offering, and for peace offerings, to make reconciliation for them, saith the Lord God.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:16
verses.text: All the people of the land shall give this oblation for the prince in Israel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:17
verses.text: And it shall be the prince’s part <hi type="italic">to give</hi> burnt offerings, and meat offerings, and drink offerings, in the feasts, and in the new moons, and in the sabbaths, in all solemnities of the house of Israel: he shall prepare the sin offering, and the meat offering, and the burnt offering, and the peace offerings, to make reconciliation for the house of Israel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:18
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord God; In the first <hi type="italic">month</hi>, in the first <hi type="italic">day</hi> of the month, thou shalt take a young bullock without blemish, and cleanse the sanctuary:

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:19
verses.text: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering, and put <hi type="italic">it</hi> upon the posts of the house, and upon the four corners of the settle of the altar, and upon the posts of the gate of the inner court.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:20
verses.text: And so thou shalt do the seventh <hi type="italic">day</hi> of the month for every one that erreth, and for <hi type="italic">him that is</hi> simple: so shall ye reconcile the house.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:21
verses.text: In the first <hi type="italic">month</hi>, in the fourteenth day of the month, ye shall have the passover, a feast of seven days; unleavened bread shall be eaten.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:22
verses.text: And upon that day shall the prince prepare for himself and for all the people of the land a bullock <hi type="italic">for</hi> a sin offering.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:23
verses.text: And seven days of the feast he shall prepare a burnt offering to the Lord, seven bullocks and seven rams without blemish daily the seven days; and a kid of the goats daily <hi type="italic">for</hi> a sin offering.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:24
verses.text: And he shall prepare a meat offering of an ephah for a bullock, and an ephah for a ram, and an hin of oil for an ephah.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:25
verses.text: In the seventh <hi type="italic">month</hi>, in the fifteenth day of the month, shall he do the like in the feast of the seven days, according to the sin offering, according to the burnt offering, and according to the meat offering, and according to the oil.  <chapter eID="Ezek.45"/><div eID="gen917" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:1
verses.text: THUS saith the Lord God; The gate of the inner court that looketh toward the east shall be shut the six working days; but on the sabbath it shall be opened, and in the day of the new moon it shall be opened.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:2
verses.text: And the prince shall enter by the way of the porch of <hi type="italic">that</hi> gate without, and shall stand by the post of the gate, and the priests shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings, and he shall worship at the threshold of the gate: then he shall go forth; but the gate shall not be shut until the evening.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:3
verses.text: Likewise the people of the land shall worship at the door of this gate before the Lord in the sabbaths and in the new moons.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:4
verses.text: And the burnt offering that the prince shall offer unto the Lord in the sabbath day <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> six lambs without blemish, and a ram without blemish.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:5
verses.text: And the meat offering <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> an ephah for a ram, and the meat offering for the lambs as he shall be able to give, and an hin of oil to an ephah.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:6
verses.text: And in the day of the new moon <hi type="italic">it shall be</hi> a young bullock without blemish, and six lambs, and a ram: they shall be without blemish.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:7
verses.text: And he shall prepare a meat offering, an ephah for a bullock, and an ephah for a ram, and for the lambs according as his hand shall attain unto, and an hin of oil to an ephah.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:8
verses.text: And when the prince shall enter, he shall go in by the way of the porch of <hi type="italic">that</hi> gate, and he shall go forth by the way thereof.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:9
verses.text: ¶ But when the people of the land shall come before the Lord in the solemn feasts, he that entereth in by the way of the north gate to worship shall go out by the way of the south gate; and he that entereth by the way of the south gate shall go forth by the way of the north gate: he shall not return by the way of the gate whereby he came in, but shall go forth over against it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:10
verses.text: And the prince in the midst of them, when they go in, shall go in; and when they go forth, shall go forth.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:11
verses.text: And in the feasts and in the solemnities the meat offering shall be an ephah to a bullock, and an ephah to a ram, and to the lambs as he is able to give, and an hin of oil to an ephah.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:12
verses.text: Now when the prince shall prepare a voluntary burnt offering or peace offerings voluntarily unto the Lord, <hi type="italic">one</hi> shall then open him the gate that looketh toward the east, and he shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings, as he did on the sabbath day: then he shall go forth; and after his going forth <hi type="italic">one</hi> shall shut the gate.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:13
verses.text: Thou shalt daily prepare a burnt offering unto the Lord <hi type="italic">of</hi> a lamb of the first year without blemish: thou shalt prepare it every morning.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:14
verses.text: And thou shalt prepare a meat offering for it every morning, the sixth part of an ephah, and the third part of an hin of oil, to temper with the fine flour; a meat offering continually by a perpetual ordinance unto the Lord.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:15
verses.text: Thus shall they prepare the lamb, and the meat offering, and the oil, every morning <hi type="italic">for</hi> a continual burnt offering.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:16
verses.text: ¶ Thus saith the Lord God; If the prince give a gift unto any of his sons, the inheritance thereof shall be his sons’; it <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> their possession by inheritance.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:17
verses.text: But if he give a gift of his inheritance to one of his servants, then it shall be his to the year of liberty; after it shall return to the prince: but his inheritance shall be his sons’ for them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:18
verses.text: Moreover the prince shall not take of the people’s inheritance by oppression, to thrust them out of their possession; <hi type="italic">but</hi> he shall give his sons inheritance out of his own possession: that my people be not scattered every man from his possession.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:19
verses.text: ¶ After he brought me through the entry, which <hi type="italic">was</hi> at the side of the gate, into the holy chambers of the priests, which looked toward the north: and, behold, there <hi type="italic">was</hi> a place on the two sides westward.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:20
verses.text: Then said he unto me, This <hi type="italic">is</hi> the place where the priests shall boil the trespass offering and the sin offering, where they shall bake the meat offering; that they bear <hi type="italic">them</hi> not out into the utter court, to sanctify the people.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:21
verses.text: Then he brought me forth into the utter court, and caused me to pass by the four corners of the court; and, behold, in every corner of the court <hi type="italic">there was</hi> a court.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:22
verses.text: In the four corners of the court <hi type="italic">there were</hi> courts joined of forty <hi type="italic">cubits</hi> long and thirty broad: these four corners <hi type="italic">were</hi> of one measure.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:23
verses.text: And <hi type="italic">there was</hi> a row <hi type="italic">of building</hi> round about in them, round about them four, and <hi type="italic">it was</hi> made with boiling places under the rows round about.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:24
verses.text: Then said he unto me, These <hi type="italic">are</hi> the places of them that boil, where the ministers of the house shall boil the sacrifice of the people.  <chapter eID="Ezek.46"/><div eID="gen918" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:1
verses.text: AFTERWARD he brought me again unto the door of the house; and, behold, waters issued out from under the threshold of the house eastward: for the forefront of the house <hi type="italic">stood toward</hi> the east, and the waters came down from under from the right side of the house, at the south <hi type="italic">side</hi> of the altar.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:2
verses.text: Then brought he me out of the way of the gate northward, and led me about the way without unto the utter gate by the way that looketh eastward; and, behold, there ran out waters on the right side.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:3
verses.text: And when the man that had the line in his hand went forth eastward, he measured a thousand cubits, and he brought me through the waters; the waters <hi type="italic">were</hi> to the ancles.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:4
verses.text: Again he measured a thousand, and brought me through the waters; the waters <hi type="italic">were</hi> to the knees. Again he measured a thousand, and brought me through; the waters <hi type="italic">were</hi> to the loins.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:5
verses.text: Afterward he measured a thousand; <hi type="italic">and it was</hi> a river that I could not pass over: for the waters were risen, waters to swim in, a river that could not be passed over.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:6
verses.text: ¶ And he said unto me, Son of man, hast thou seen <hi type="italic">this?</hi> Then he brought me, and caused me to return to the brink of the river.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:7
verses.text: Now when I had returned, behold, at the bank of the river <hi type="italic">were</hi> very many trees on the one side and on the other.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:8
verses.text: Then said he unto me, These waters issue out toward the east country, and go down into the desert, and go into the sea: <hi type="italic">which being</hi> brought forth into the sea, the waters shall be healed.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:9
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, <hi type="italic">that</hi> every thing that liveth, which moveth, whithersoever the rivers shall come, shall live: and there shall be a very great multitude of fish, because these waters shall come thither: for they shall be healed; and every thing shall live whither the river cometh.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:10
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, <hi type="italic">that</hi> the fishers shall stand upon it from En-gedi even unto En-eglaim; they shall be a <hi type="italic">place</hi> to spread forth nets; their fish shall be according to their kinds, as the fish of the great sea, exceeding many.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:11
verses.text: But the miry places thereof and the marishes thereof shall not be healed; they shall be given to salt.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:12
verses.text: And by the river upon the bank thereof, on this side and on that side, shall grow all trees for meat, whose leaf shall not fade, neither shall the fruit thereof be consumed: it shall bring forth new fruit according to his months, because their waters they issued out of the sanctuary: and the fruit thereof shall be for meat, and the leaf thereof for medicine.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:13
verses.text: ¶ Thus saith the Lord God; This <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> the border, whereby ye shall inherit the land according to the twelve tribes of Israel: Joseph <hi type="italic">shall have two</hi> portions.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:14
verses.text: And ye shall inherit it, one as well as another: <hi type="italic">concerning</hi> the which I lifted up mine hand to give it unto your fathers: and this land shall fall unto you for inheritance.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:15
