verses.text: And this <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> the border of the land toward the north side, from the great sea, the way of Hethlon, as men go to Zedad;

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:16
verses.text: Hamath, Berothah, Sibraim, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> between the border of Damascus and the border of Hamath; Hazar-hatticon, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> by the coast of Hauran.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:17
verses.text: And the border from the sea shall be Hazar-enan, the border of Damascus, and the north northward, and the border of Hamath. And <hi type="italic">this is</hi> the north side.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:18
verses.text: And the east side ye shall measure from Hauran, and from Damascus, and from Gilead, and from the land of Israel <hi type="italic">by</hi> Jordan, from the border unto the east sea. And <hi type="italic">this is</hi> the east side.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:19
verses.text: And the south side southward, from Tamar <hi type="italic">even</hi> to the waters of strife <hi type="italic">in</hi> Kadesh, the river to the great sea. And <hi type="italic">this is</hi> the south side southward.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:20
verses.text: The west side also <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> the great sea from the border, till a man come over against Hamath. This <hi type="italic">is</hi> the west side.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:21
verses.text: So shall ye divide this land unto you according to the tribes of Israel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:22
verses.text: ¶ And it shall come to pass, <hi type="italic">that</hi> ye shall divide it by lot for an inheritance unto you, and to the strangers that sojourn among you, which shall beget children among you: and they shall be unto you as born in the country among the children of Israel; they shall have inheritance with you among the tribes of Israel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:23
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, <hi type="italic">that</hi> in what tribe the stranger sojourneth, there shall ye give <hi type="italic">him</hi> his inheritance, saith the Lord God.  <chapter eID="Ezek.47"/><div eID="gen919" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:1
verses.text: NOW these <hi type="italic">are</hi> the names of the tribes. From the north end to the coast of the way of Hethlon, as one goeth to Hamath, Hazar-enan, the border of Damascus northward, to the coast of Hamath; for these are his sides east <hi type="italic">and</hi> west; a <hi type="italic">portion for</hi> Dan.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:2
verses.text: And by the border of Dan, from the east side unto the west side, a <hi type="italic">portion for</hi> Asher.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:3
verses.text: And by the border of Asher, from the east side even unto the west side, a <hi type="italic">portion for</hi> Naphtali.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:4
verses.text: And by the border of Naphtali, from the east side unto the west side, a <hi type="italic">portion for</hi> Manasseh.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:5
verses.text: And by the border of Manasseh, from the east side unto the west side, a <hi type="italic">portion for</hi> Ephraim.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:6
verses.text: And by the border of Ephraim, from the east side even unto the west side, a <hi type="italic">portion for</hi> Reuben.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:7
verses.text: And by the border of Reuben, from the east side unto the west side, a <hi type="italic">portion for</hi> Judah.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:8
verses.text: ¶ And by the border of Judah, from the east side unto the west side, shall be the offering which ye shall offer of five and twenty thousand <hi type="italic">reeds in</hi> breadth, and <hi type="italic">in</hi> length as one of the <hi type="italic">other</hi> parts, from the east side unto the west side: and the sanctuary shall be in the midst of it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:9
verses.text: The oblation that ye shall offer unto the Lord <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> of five and twenty thousand in length, and of ten thousand in breadth.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:10
verses.text: And for them, <hi type="italic">even</hi> for the priests, shall be <hi type="italic">this</hi> holy oblation; toward the north five and twenty thousand <hi type="italic">in length</hi>, and toward the west ten thousand in breadth, and toward the east ten thousand in breadth, and toward the south five and twenty thousand in length: and the sanctuary of the Lord shall be in the midst thereof.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:11
verses.text: <hi type="italic">It shall be</hi> for the priests that are sanctified of the sons of Zadok; which have kept my charge, which went not astray when the children of Israel went astray, as the Levites went astray.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:12
verses.text: And <hi type="italic">this</hi> oblation of the land that is offered shall be unto them a thing most holy by the border of the Levites.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:13
verses.text: And over against the border of the priests the Levites <hi type="italic">shall have</hi> five and twenty thousand in length, and ten thousand in breadth: all the length <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> five and twenty thousand, and the breadth ten thousand.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:14
verses.text: And they shall not sell of it, neither exchange, nor alienate the firstfruits of the land: for <hi type="italic">it is</hi> holy unto the Lord.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:15
verses.text: ¶ And the five thousand, that are left in the breadth over against the five and twenty thousand, shall be a profane <hi type="italic">place</hi> for the city, for dwelling, and for suburbs: and the city shall be in the midst thereof.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:16
verses.text: And these <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> the measures thereof; the north side four thousand and five hundred, and the south side four thousand and five hundred, and on the east side four thousand and five hundred, and the west side four thousand and five hundred.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:17
verses.text: And the suburbs of the city shall be toward the north two hundred and fifty, and toward the south two hundred and fifty, and toward the east two hundred and fifty, and toward the west two hundred and fifty.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:18
verses.text: And the residue in length over against the oblation of the holy <hi type="italic">portion shall be</hi> ten thousand eastward, and ten thousand westward: and it shall be over against the oblation of the holy <hi type="italic">portion;</hi> and the increase thereof shall be for food unto them that serve the city.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:19
verses.text: And they that serve the city shall serve it out of all the tribes of Israel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:20
verses.text: All the oblation <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> five and twenty thousand by five and twenty thousand: ye shall offer the holy oblation foursquare, with the possession of the city.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:21
verses.text: ¶ And the residue <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> for the prince, on the one side and on the other of the holy oblation, and of the possession of the city, over against the five and twenty thousand of the oblation toward the east border, and westward over against the five and twenty thousand toward the west border, over against the portions for the prince: and it shall be the holy oblation; and the sanctuary of the house <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> in the midst thereof.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:22
verses.text: Moreover from the possession of the Levites, and from the possession of the city, <hi type="italic">being</hi> in the midst <hi type="italic">of that</hi> which is the prince’s, between the border of Judah and the border of Benjamin, shall be for the prince.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:23
verses.text: As for the rest of the tribes, from the east side unto the west side, Benjamin <hi type="italic">shall have</hi> a <hi type="italic">portion</hi>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:24
verses.text: And by the border of Benjamin, from the east side unto the west side, Simeon <hi type="italic">shall have</hi> a <hi type="italic">portion</hi>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:25
verses.text: And by the border of Simeon, from the east side unto the west side, Issachar a <hi type="italic">portion</hi>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:26
verses.text: And by the border of Issachar, from the east side unto the west side, Zebulun a <hi type="italic">portion</hi>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:27
verses.text: And by the border of Zebulun, from the east side unto the west side, Gad a <hi type="italic">portion</hi>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:28
verses.text: And by the border of Gad, at the south side southward, the border shall be even from Tamar <hi type="italic">unto</hi> the waters of strife <hi type="italic">in</hi> Kadesh, <hi type="italic">and</hi> to the river toward the great sea.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:29
verses.text: This <hi type="italic">is</hi> the land which ye shall divide by lot unto the tribes of Israel for inheritance, and these <hi type="italic">are</hi> their portions, saith the Lord God.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:30
verses.text: ¶ And these <hi type="italic">are</hi> the goings out of the city on the north side, four thousand and five hundred measures.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:31
verses.text: And the gates of the city <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> after the names of the tribes of Israel: three gates northward; one gate of Reuben, one gate of Judah, one gate of Levi.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:32
verses.text: And at the east side four thousand and five hundred: and three gates; and one gate of Joseph, one gate of Benjamin, one gate of Dan.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:33
verses.text: And at the south side four thousand and five hundred measures: and three gates; one gate of Simeon, one gate of Issachar, one gate of Zebulun.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:34
verses.text: At the west side four thousand and five hundred, <hi type="italic">with</hi> their three gates; one gate of Gad, one gate of Asher, one gate of Naphtali.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:35
verses.text: <hi type="italic">It was</hi> round about eighteen thousand <hi type="italic">measures:</hi> and the name of the city from <hi type="italic">that</hi> day <hi type="italic">shall be</hi>, The Lord <hi type="italic">is</hi> there. THE  <chapter eID="Ezek.48"/><div eID="gen920" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen872" osisID="Ezek" type="book"/>

verses.name: Daniel 1:1
verses.text: IN the third year of the reign of Jehoiakim king of Judah came Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon unto Jerusalem, and besieged it.

verses.name: Daniel 1:2
verses.text: And the Lord gave Jehoiakim king of Judah into his hand, with part of the vessels of the house of God: which he carried into the land of Shinar to the house of his god; and he brought the vessels into the treasure house of his god.

verses.name: Daniel 1:3
verses.text: ¶ And the king spake unto Ashpenaz the master of his eunuchs, that he should bring <hi type="italic">certain</hi> of the children of Israel, and of the king’s seed, and of the princes;

verses.name: Daniel 1:4
verses.text: Children in whom <hi type="italic">was</hi> no blemish, but well favoured, and skilful in all wisdom, and cunning in knowledge, and understanding science, and such as <hi type="italic">had</hi> ability in them to stand in the king’s palace, and whom they might teach the learning and the tongue of the Chaldeans.

verses.name: Daniel 1:5
verses.text: And the king appointed them a daily provision of the king’s meat, and of the wine which he drank: so nourishing them three years, that at the end thereof they might stand before the king.

verses.name: Daniel 1:6
verses.text: Now among these were of the children of Judah, Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah:

verses.name: Daniel 1:7
verses.text: Unto whom the prince of the eunuchs gave names: for he gave unto Daniel <hi type="italic">the name</hi> of Belteshazzar; and to Hananiah, of Shadrach; and to Mishael, of Meshach; and to Azariah, of Abed-nego.

verses.name: Daniel 1:8
verses.text: ¶ But Daniel purposed in his heart that he would not defile himself with the portion of the king’s meat, nor with the wine which he drank: therefore he requested of the prince of the eunuchs that he might not defile himself.

verses.name: Daniel 1:9
verses.text: Now God had brought Daniel into favour and tender love with the prince of the eunuchs.

verses.name: Daniel 1:10
verses.text: And the prince of the eunuchs said unto Daniel, I fear my lord the king, who hath appointed your meat and your drink: for why should he see your faces worse liking than the children which <hi type="italic">are</hi> of your sort? then shall ye make <hi type="italic">me</hi> endanger my head to the king.

verses.name: Daniel 1:11
verses.text: Then said Daniel to Melzar, whom the prince of the eunuchs had set over Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah,

verses.name: Daniel 1:12
verses.text: Prove thy servants, I beseech thee, ten days; and let them give us pulse to eat, and water to drink.

verses.name: Daniel 1:13
verses.text: Then let our countenances be looked upon before thee, and the countenance of the children that eat of the portion of the king’s meat: and as thou seest, deal with thy servants.

verses.name: Daniel 1:14
verses.text: So he consented to them in this matter, and proved them ten days.

verses.name: Daniel 1:15
verses.text: And at the end of ten days their countenances appeared fairer and fatter in flesh than all the children which did eat the portion of the king’s meat.

verses.name: Daniel 1:16
verses.text: Thus Melzar took away the portion of their meat, and the wine that they should drink; and gave them pulse.

verses.name: Daniel 1:17
verses.text: ¶ As for these four children, God gave them knowledge and skill in all learning and wisdom: and Daniel had understanding in all visions and dreams.

verses.name: Daniel 1:18
verses.text: Now at the end of the days that the king had said he should bring them in, then the prince of the eunuchs brought them in before Nebuchadnezzar.

verses.name: Daniel 1:19
verses.text: And the king communed with them; and among them all was found none like Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah: therefore stood they before the king.

verses.name: Daniel 1:20
verses.text: And in all matters of wisdom <hi type="italic">and</hi> understanding, that the king inquired of them, he found them ten times better than all the magicians <hi type="italic">and</hi> astrologers that <hi type="italic">were</hi> in all his realm.

verses.name: Daniel 1:21
verses.text: And Daniel continued <hi type="italic">even</hi> unto the first year of king Cyrus.  <chapter eID="Dan.1"/><div eID="gen922" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 2:1
verses.text: AND in the second year of the reign of Nebuchadnezzar Nebuchadnezzar dreamed dreams, wherewith his spirit was troubled, and his sleep brake from him.

verses.name: Daniel 2:2
verses.text: Then the king commanded to call the magicians, and the astrologers, and the sorcerers, and the Chaldeans, for to shew the king his dreams. So they came and stood before the king.

verses.name: Daniel 2:3
verses.text: And the king said unto them, I have dreamed a dream, and my spirit was troubled to know the dream.

verses.name: Daniel 2:4
verses.text: Then spake the Chaldeans to the king in Syriack, O king, live for ever: tell thy servants the dream, and we will shew the interpretation.

verses.name: Daniel 2:5
verses.text: The king answered and said to the Chaldeans, The thing is gone from me: if ye will not make known unto me the dream, with the interpretation thereof, ye shall be cut in pieces, and your houses shall be made a dunghill.

verses.name: Daniel 2:6
verses.text: But if ye shew the dream, and the interpretation thereof, ye shall receive of me gifts and rewards and great honour: therefore shew me the dream, and the interpretation thereof.

verses.name: Daniel 2:7
verses.text: They answered again and said, Let the king tell his servants the dream, and we will shew the interpretation of it.

verses.name: Daniel 2:8
verses.text: The king answered and said, I know of certainty that ye would gain the time, because ye see the thing is gone from me.

verses.name: Daniel 2:9
verses.text: But if ye will not make known unto me the dream, <hi type="italic">there is but</hi> one decree for you: for ye have prepared lying and corrupt words to speak before me, till the time be changed: therefore tell me the dream, and I shall know that ye can shew me the interpretation thereof.

verses.name: Daniel 2:10
verses.text: ¶ The Chaldeans answered before the king, and said, There is not a man upon the earth that can shew the king’s matter: therefore <hi type="italic">there is</hi> no king, lord, nor ruler, <hi type="italic">that</hi> asked such things at any magician, or astrologer, or Chaldean.

verses.name: Daniel 2:11
verses.text: And <hi type="italic">it is</hi> a rare thing that the king requireth, and there is none other that can shew it before the king, except the gods, whose dwelling is not with flesh.

verses.name: Daniel 2:12
verses.text: For this cause the king was angry and very furious, and commanded to destroy all the wise <hi type="italic">men</hi> of Babylon.

verses.name: Daniel 2:13
verses.text: And the decree went forth that the wise <hi type="italic">men</hi> should be slain; and they sought Daniel and his fellows to be slain.

verses.name: Daniel 2:14
verses.text: ¶ Then Daniel answered with counsel and wisdom to Arioch the captain of the king’s guard, which was gone forth to slay the wise <hi type="italic">men</hi> of Babylon:

verses.name: Daniel 2:15
verses.text: He answered and said to Arioch the king’s captain, Why <hi type="italic">is</hi> the decree <hi type="italic">so</hi> hasty from the king? Then Arioch made the thing known to Daniel.

verses.name: Daniel 2:16
verses.text: Then Daniel went in, and desired of the king that he would give him time, and that he would shew the king the interpretation.

verses.name: Daniel 2:17
verses.text: Then Daniel went to his house, and made the thing known to Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah, his companions:

verses.name: Daniel 2:18
verses.text: That they would desire mercies of the God of heaven concerning this secret; that Daniel and his fellows should not perish with the rest of the wise <hi type="italic">men</hi> of Babylon.

verses.name: Daniel 2:19
verses.text: ¶ Then was the secret revealed unto Daniel in a night vision. Then Daniel blessed the God of heaven.

verses.name: Daniel 2:20
verses.text: Daniel answered and said, Blessed be the name of God for ever and ever: for wisdom and might are his:

verses.name: Daniel 2:21
verses.text: And he changeth the times and the seasons: he removeth kings, and setteth up kings: he giveth wisdom unto the wise, and knowledge to them that know understanding:

verses.name: Daniel 2:22
verses.text: He revealeth the deep and secret things: he knoweth what <hi type="italic">is</hi> in the darkness, and the light dwelleth with him.

verses.name: Daniel 2:23
verses.text: I thank thee, and praise thee, O thou God of my fathers, who hast given me wisdom and might, and hast made known unto me now what we desired of thee: for thou hast <hi type="italic">now</hi> made known unto us the king’s matter.

verses.name: Daniel 2:24
verses.text: ¶ Therefore Daniel went in unto Arioch, whom the king had ordained to destroy the wise <hi type="italic">men</hi> of Babylon: he went and said thus unto him; Destroy not the wise <hi type="italic">men</hi> of Babylon: bring me in before the king, and I will shew unto the king the interpretation.

verses.name: Daniel 2:25
verses.text: Then Arioch brought in Daniel before the king in haste, and said thus unto him, I have found a man of the captives of Judah, that will make known unto the king the interpretation.

verses.name: Daniel 2:26
verses.text: The king answered and said to Daniel, whose name <hi type="italic">was</hi> Belteshazzar, Art thou able to make known unto me the dream which I have seen, and the interpretation thereof?

verses.name: Daniel 2:27
verses.text: Daniel answered in the presence of the king, and said, The secret which the king hath demanded cannot the wise <hi type="italic">men</hi>, the astrologers, the magicians, the soothsayers, shew unto the king;

verses.name: Daniel 2:28
verses.text: But there is a God in heaven that revealeth secrets, and maketh known to the king Nebuchadnezzar what shall be in the latter days. Thy dream, and the visions of thy head upon thy bed, are these;

verses.name: Daniel 2:29
verses.text: As for thee, O king, thy thoughts came <hi type="italic">into thy mind</hi> upon thy bed, what should come to pass hereafter: and he that revealeth secrets maketh known to thee what shall come to pass.

verses.name: Daniel 2:30
verses.text: But as for me, this secret is not revealed to me for <hi type="italic">any</hi> wisdom that I have more than any living, but for <hi type="italic">their</hi> sakes that shall make known the interpretation to the king, and that thou mightest know the thoughts of thy heart.

verses.name: Daniel 2:31
verses.text: ¶ Thou, O king, sawest, and behold a great image. This great image, whose brightness <hi type="italic">was</hi> excellent, stood before thee; and the form thereof <hi type="italic">was</hi> terrible.

verses.name: Daniel 2:32
verses.text: This image’s head <hi type="italic">was</hi> of fine gold, his breast and his arms of silver, his belly and his thighs of brass,

verses.name: Daniel 2:33
verses.text: His legs of iron, his feet part of iron and part of clay.

verses.name: Daniel 2:34
verses.text: Thou sawest till that a stone was cut out without hands, which smote the image upon his feet <hi type="italic">that were</hi> of iron and clay, and brake them to pieces.

verses.name: Daniel 2:35
verses.text: Then was the iron, the clay, the brass, the silver, and the gold, broken to pieces together, and became like the chaff of the summer threshingfloors; and the wind carried them away, that no place was found for them: and the stone that smote the image became a great mountain, and filled the whole earth.

verses.name: Daniel 2:36
verses.text: ¶ This <hi type="italic">is</hi> the dream; and we will tell the interpretation thereof before the king.

verses.name: Daniel 2:37
verses.text: Thou, O king, <hi type="italic">art</hi> a king of kings: for the God of heaven hath given thee a kingdom, power, and strength, and glory.

verses.name: Daniel 2:38
verses.text: And wheresoever the children of men dwell, the beasts of the field and the fowls of the heaven hath he given into thine hand, and hath made thee ruler over them all. Thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> this head of gold.

verses.name: Daniel 2:39
verses.text: And after thee shall arise another kingdom inferior to thee, and another third kingdom of brass, which shall bear rule over all the earth.

verses.name: Daniel 2:40
verses.text: And the fourth kingdom shall be strong as iron: forasmuch as iron breaketh in pieces and subdueth all <hi type="italic">things:</hi> and as iron that breaketh all these, shall it break in pieces and bruise.

verses.name: Daniel 2:41
verses.text: And whereas thou sawest the feet and toes, part of potters’ clay, and part of iron, the kingdom shall be divided; but there shall be in it of the strength of the iron, forasmuch as thou sawest the iron mixed with miry clay.

verses.name: Daniel 2:42
verses.text: And <hi type="italic">as</hi> the toes of the feet <hi type="italic">were</hi> part of iron, and part of clay, <hi type="italic">so</hi> the kingdom shall be partly strong, and partly broken.

verses.name: Daniel 2:43
verses.text: And whereas thou sawest iron mixed with miry clay, they shall mingle themselves with the seed of men: but they shall not cleave one to another, even as iron is not mixed with clay.

verses.name: Daniel 2:44
verses.text: And in the days of these kings shall the God of heaven set up a kingdom, which shall never be destroyed: and the kingdom shall not be left to other people, <hi type="italic">but</hi> it shall break in pieces and consume all these kingdoms, and it shall stand for ever.

verses.name: Daniel 2:45
verses.text: Forasmuch as thou sawest that the stone was cut out of the mountain without hands, and that it brake in pieces the iron, the brass, the clay, the silver, and the gold; the great God hath made known to the king what shall come to pass hereafter: and the dream <hi type="italic">is</hi> certain, and the interpretation thereof sure.

verses.name: Daniel 2:46
verses.text: ¶ Then the king Nebuchadnezzar fell upon his face, and worshipped Daniel, and commanded that they should offer an oblation and sweet odours unto him.

verses.name: Daniel 2:47
verses.text: The king answered unto Daniel, and said, Of a truth <hi type="italic">it is</hi>, that your God <hi type="italic">is</hi> a God of gods, and a Lord of kings, and a revealer of secrets, seeing thou couldest reveal this secret.

verses.name: Daniel 2:48
verses.text: Then the king made Daniel a great man, and gave him many great gifts, and made him ruler over the whole province of Babylon, and chief of the governors over all the wise <hi type="italic">men</hi> of Babylon.

verses.name: Daniel 2:49
verses.text: Then Daniel requested of the king, and he set Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, over the affairs of the province of Babylon: but Daniel <hi type="italic">sat</hi> in the gate of the king.  <chapter eID="Dan.2"/><div eID="gen923" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 3:1
verses.text: NEBUCHADNEZZAR the king made an image of gold, whose height <hi type="italic">was</hi> threescore cubits, <hi type="italic">and</hi> the breadth thereof six cubits: he set it up in the plain of Dura, in the province of Babylon.

verses.name: Daniel 3:2
verses.text: Then Nebuchadnezzar the king sent to gather together the princes, the governors, and the captains, the judges, the treasurers, the counsellers, the sheriffs, and all the rulers of the provinces, to come to the dedication of the image which Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up.

verses.name: Daniel 3:3
verses.text: Then the princes, the governors, and captains, the judges, the treasurers, the counsellers, the sheriffs, and all the rulers of the provinces, were gathered together unto the dedication of the image that Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up; and they stood before the image that Nebuchadnezzar had set up.

verses.name: Daniel 3:4
verses.text: Then an herald cried aloud, To you it is commanded, O people, nations, and languages,

verses.name: Daniel 3:5
verses.text: <hi type="italic">That</hi> at what time ye hear the sound of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, dulcimer, and all kinds of musick, ye fall down and worship the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king hath set up:

verses.name: Daniel 3:6
verses.text: And whoso falleth not down and worshippeth shall the same hour be cast into the midst of a burning fiery furnace.

verses.name: Daniel 3:7
verses.text: Therefore at that time, when all the people heard the sound of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, and all kinds of musick, all the people, the nations, and the languages, fell down <hi type="italic">and</hi> worshipped the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up.

verses.name: Daniel 3:8
verses.text: ¶ Wherefore at that time certain Chaldeans came near, and accused the Jews.

verses.name: Daniel 3:9
verses.text: They spake and said to the king Nebuchadnezzar, O king, live for ever.

verses.name: Daniel 3:10
verses.text: Thou, O king, hast made a decree, that every man that shall hear the sound of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, and dulcimer, and all kinds of musick, shall fall down and worship the golden image:

verses.name: Daniel 3:11
verses.text: And whoso falleth not down and worshippeth, <hi type="italic">that</hi> he should be cast into the midst of a burning fiery furnace.

verses.name: Daniel 3:12
verses.text: There are certain Jews whom thou hast set over the affairs of the province of Babylon, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego; these men, O king, have not regarded thee: they serve not thy gods, nor worship the golden image which thou hast set up.

verses.name: Daniel 3:13
verses.text: ¶ Then Nebuchadnezzar in <hi type="italic">his</hi> rage and fury commanded to bring Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego. Then they brought these men before the king.

verses.name: Daniel 3:14
verses.text: Nebuchadnezzar spake and said unto them, <hi type="italic">Is it</hi> true, O Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, do not ye serve my gods, nor worship the golden image which I have set up?

verses.name: Daniel 3:15
verses.text: Now if ye be ready that at what time ye hear the sound of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, and dulcimer, and all kinds of musick, ye fall down and worship the image which I have made; <hi type="italic">well:</hi> but if ye worship not, ye shall be cast the same hour into the midst of a burning fiery furnace; and who <hi type="italic">is</hi> that God that shall deliver you out of my hands?

verses.name: Daniel 3:16
verses.text: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, answered and said to the king, O Nebuchadnezzar, we <hi type="italic">are</hi> not careful to answer thee in this matter.

verses.name: Daniel 3:17
verses.text: If it be <hi type="italic">so</hi>, our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace, and he will deliver <hi type="italic">us</hi> out of thine hand, O king.

verses.name: Daniel 3:18
verses.text: But if not, be it known unto thee, O king, that we will not serve thy gods, nor worship the golden image which thou hast set up.

verses.name: Daniel 3:19
verses.text: ¶ Then was Nebuchadnezzar full of fury, and the form of his visage was changed against Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego: <hi type="italic">therefore</hi> he spake, and commanded that they should heat the furnace one seven times more than it was wont to be heated.

verses.name: Daniel 3:20
verses.text: And he commanded the most mighty men that <hi type="italic">were</hi> in his army to bind Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, <hi type="italic">and</hi> to cast <hi type="italic">them</hi> into the burning fiery furnace.

verses.name: Daniel 3:21
verses.text: Then these men were bound in their coats, their hosen, and their hats, and their <hi type="italic">other</hi> garments, and were cast into the midst of the burning fiery furnace.

verses.name: Daniel 3:22
verses.text: Therefore because the king’s commandment was urgent, and the furnace exceeding hot, the flame of the fire slew those men that took up Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego.

verses.name: Daniel 3:23
verses.text: And these three men, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, fell down bound into the midst of the burning fiery furnace.

verses.name: Daniel 3:24
verses.text: Then Nebuchadnezzar the king was astonied, and rose up in haste, <hi type="italic">and</hi> spake, and said unto his counsellers, Did not we cast three men bound into the midst of the fire? They answered and said unto the king, True, O king.

verses.name: Daniel 3:25
verses.text: He answered and said, Lo, I see four men loose, walking in the midst of the fire, and they have no hurt; and the form of the fourth is like the Son of God.

verses.name: Daniel 3:26
verses.text: ¶ Then Nebuchadnezzar came near to the mouth of the burning fiery furnace, <hi type="italic">and</hi> spake, and said, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, ye servants of the most high God, come forth, and come <hi type="italic">hither</hi>. Then Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, came forth of the midst of the fire.

verses.name: Daniel 3:27
verses.text: And the princes, governors, and captains, and the king’s counsellers, being gathered together, saw these men, upon whose bodies the fire had no power, nor was an hair of their head singed, neither were their coats changed, nor the smell of fire had passed on them.

verses.name: Daniel 3:28
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Then</hi> Nebuchadnezzar spake, and said, Blessed <hi type="italic">be</hi> the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, who hath sent his angel, and delivered his servants that trusted in him, and have changed the king’s word, and yielded their bodies, that they might not serve nor worship any god, except their own God.

verses.name: Daniel 3:29
verses.text: Therefore I make a decree, That every people, nation, and language, which speak any thing amiss against the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, shall be cut in pieces, and their houses shall be made a dunghill: because there is no other God that can deliver after this sort.

verses.name: Daniel 3:30
verses.text: Then the king promoted Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, in the province of Babylon.  <chapter eID="Dan.3"/><div eID="gen924" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 4:1
verses.text: NEBUCHADNEZZAR the king, unto all people, nations, and languages, that dwell in all the earth; Peace be multiplied unto you.

verses.name: Daniel 4:2
verses.text: I thought it good to shew the signs and wonders that the high God hath wrought toward me.

verses.name: Daniel 4:3
verses.text: How great <hi type="italic">are</hi> his signs! and how mighty <hi type="italic">are</hi> his wonders! his kingdom <hi type="italic">is</hi> an everlasting kingdom, and his dominion <hi type="italic">is</hi> from generation to generation.

verses.name: Daniel 4:4
verses.text: ¶ I Nebuchadnezzar was at rest in mine house, and flourishing in my palace:

verses.name: Daniel 4:5
verses.text: I saw a dream which made me afraid, and the thoughts upon my bed and the visions of my head troubled me.

verses.name: Daniel 4:6
verses.text: Therefore made I a decree to bring in all the wise <hi type="italic">men</hi> of Babylon before me, that they might make known unto me the interpretation of the dream.

verses.name: Daniel 4:7
verses.text: Then came in the magicians, the astrologers, the Chaldeans, and the soothsayers: and I told the dream before them; but they did not make known unto me the interpretation thereof.

verses.name: Daniel 4:8
verses.text: ¶ But at the last Daniel came in before me, whose name <hi type="italic">was</hi> Belteshazzar, according to the name of my god, and in whom <hi type="italic">is</hi> the spirit of the holy gods: and before him I told the dream, <hi type="italic">saying</hi>,

verses.name: Daniel 4:9
verses.text: O Belteshazzar, master of the magicians, because I know that the spirit of the holy gods <hi type="italic">is</hi> in thee, and no secret troubleth thee, tell me the visions of my dream that I have seen, and the interpretation thereof.

verses.name: Daniel 4:10
verses.text: Thus <hi type="italic">were</hi> the visions of mine head in my bed; I saw, and behold a tree in the midst of the earth, and the height thereof <hi type="italic">was</hi> great.

verses.name: Daniel 4:11
verses.text: The tree grew, and was strong, and the height thereof reached unto heaven, and the sight thereof to the end of all the earth:

verses.name: Daniel 4:12
verses.text: The leaves thereof <hi type="italic">were</hi> fair, and the fruit thereof much, and in it <hi type="italic">was</hi> meat for all: the beasts of the field had shadow under it, and the fowls of the heaven dwelt in the boughs thereof, and all flesh was fed of it.

verses.name: Daniel 4:13
verses.text: I saw in the visions of my head upon my bed, and, behold, a watcher and an holy one came down from heaven;

verses.name: Daniel 4:14
verses.text: He cried aloud, and said thus, Hew down the tree, and cut off his branches, shake off his leaves, and scatter his fruit: let the beasts get away from under it, and the fowls from his branches:

verses.name: Daniel 4:15
verses.text: Nevertheless leave the stump of his roots in the earth, even with a band of iron and brass, in the tender grass of the field; and let it be wet with the dew of heaven, and <hi type="italic">let</hi> his portion <hi type="italic">be</hi> with the beasts in the grass of the earth:

verses.name: Daniel 4:16
verses.text: Let his heart be changed from man’s, and let a beast’s heart be given unto him; and let seven times pass over him.

verses.name: Daniel 4:17
verses.text: This matter <hi type="italic">is</hi> by the decree of the watchers, and the demand by the word of the holy ones: to the intent that the living may know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men, and giveth it to whomsoever he will, and setteth up over it the basest of men.

verses.name: Daniel 4:18
verses.text: This dream I king Nebuchadnezzar have seen. Now thou, O Belteshazzar, declare the interpretation thereof, forasmuch as all the wise <hi type="italic">men</hi> of my kingdom are not able to make known unto me the interpretation: but thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> able; for the spirit of the holy gods <hi type="italic">is</hi> in thee.

verses.name: Daniel 4:19
verses.text: ¶ Then Daniel, whose name <hi type="italic">was</hi> Belteshazzar, was astonied for one hour, and his thoughts troubled him. The king spake, and said, Belteshazzar, let not the dream, or the interpretation thereof, trouble thee. Belteshazzar answered and said, My lord, the dream <hi type="italic">be</hi> to them that hate thee, and the interpretation thereof to thine enemies.

verses.name: Daniel 4:20
verses.text: The tree that thou sawest, which grew, and was strong, whose height reached unto the heaven, and the sight thereof to all the earth;

verses.name: Daniel 4:21
verses.text: Whose leaves <hi type="italic">were</hi> fair, and the fruit thereof much, and in it <hi type="italic">was</hi> meat for all; under which the beasts of the field dwelt, and upon whose branches the fowls of the heaven had their habitation:

verses.name: Daniel 4:22
verses.text: It <hi type="italic">is</hi> thou, O king, that art grown and become strong: for thy greatness is grown, and reacheth unto heaven, and thy dominion to the end of the earth.

verses.name: Daniel 4:23
verses.text: And whereas the king saw a watcher and an holy one coming down from heaven, and saying, Hew the tree down, and destroy it; yet leave the stump of the roots thereof in the earth, even with a band of iron and brass, in the tender grass of the field; and let it be wet with the dew of heaven, and <hi type="italic">let</hi> his portion <hi type="italic">be</hi> with the beasts of the field, till seven times pass over him;

verses.name: Daniel 4:24
verses.text: This <hi type="italic">is</hi> the interpretation, O king, and this <hi type="italic">is</hi> the decree of the most High, which is come upon my lord the king:

verses.name: Daniel 4:25
verses.text: That they shall drive thee from men, and thy dwelling shall be with the beasts of the field, and they shall make thee to eat grass as oxen, and they shall wet thee with the dew of heaven, and seven times shall pass over thee, till thou know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men, and giveth it to whomsoever he will.

verses.name: Daniel 4:26
verses.text: And whereas they commanded to leave the stump of the tree roots; thy kingdom shall be sure unto thee, after that thou shalt have known that the heavens do rule.

verses.name: Daniel 4:27
verses.text: Wherefore, O king, let my counsel be acceptable unto thee, and break off thy sins by righteousness, and thine iniquities by shewing mercy to the poor; if it may be a lengthening of thy tranquillity.

verses.name: Daniel 4:28
verses.text: ¶ All this came upon the king Nebuchadnezzar.

verses.name: Daniel 4:29
verses.text: At the end of twelve months he walked in the palace of the kingdom of Babylon.

verses.name: Daniel 4:30
verses.text: The king spake, and said, Is not this great Babylon, that I have built for the house of the kingdom by the might of my power, and for the honour of my majesty?

verses.name: Daniel 4:31
verses.text: While the word <hi type="italic">was</hi> in the king’s mouth, there fell a voice from heaven, <hi type="italic">saying</hi>, O king Nebuchadnezzar, to thee it is spoken; The kingdom is departed from thee.

verses.name: Daniel 4:32
verses.text: And they shall drive thee from men, and thy dwelling <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> with the beasts of the field: they shall make thee to eat grass as oxen, and seven times shall pass over thee, until thou know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men, and giveth it to whomsoever he will.

verses.name: Daniel 4:33
verses.text: The same hour was the thing fulfilled upon Nebuchadnezzar: and he was driven from men, and did eat grass as oxen, and his body was wet with the dew of heaven, till his hairs were grown like eagles’ <hi type="italic">feathers</hi>, and his nails like birds’ <hi type="italic">claws</hi>.

verses.name: Daniel 4:34
verses.text: And at the end of the days I Nebuchadnezzar lifted up mine eyes unto heaven, and mine understanding returned unto me, and I blessed the most High, and I praised and honoured him that liveth for ever, whose dominion <hi type="italic">is</hi> an everlasting dominion, and his kingdom <hi type="italic">is</hi> from generation to generation:

verses.name: Daniel 4:35
verses.text: And all the inhabitants of the earth <hi type="italic">are</hi> reputed as nothing: and he doeth according to his will in the army of heaven, and <hi type="italic">among</hi> the inhabitants of the earth: and none can stay his hand, or say unto him, What doest thou?

verses.name: Daniel 4:36
verses.text: At the same time my reason returned unto me; and for the glory of my kingdom, mine honour and brightness returned unto me; and my counsellers and my lords sought unto me; and I was established in my kingdom, and excellent majesty was added unto me.

verses.name: Daniel 4:37
verses.text: Now I Nebuchadnezzar praise and extol and honour the King of heaven, all whose works <hi type="italic">are</hi> truth, and his ways judgment: and those that walk in pride he is able to abase.  <chapter eID="Dan.4"/><div eID="gen925" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 5:1
verses.text: BELSHAZZAR the king made a great feast to a thousand of his lords, and drank wine before the thousand.

verses.name: Daniel 5:2
verses.text: Belshazzar, whiles he tasted the wine, commanded to bring the golden and silver vessels which his father Nebuchadnezzar had taken out of the temple which <hi type="italic">was</hi> in Jerusalem; that the king, and his princes, his wives, and his concubines, might drink therein.

verses.name: Daniel 5:3
verses.text: Then they brought the golden vessels that were taken out of the temple of the house of God which <hi type="italic">was</hi> at Jerusalem; and the king, and his princes, his wives, and his concubines, drank in them.

verses.name: Daniel 5:4
verses.text: They drank wine, and praised the gods of gold, and of silver, of brass, of iron, of wood, and of stone.

verses.name: Daniel 5:5
verses.text: ¶ In the same hour came forth fingers of a man’s hand, and wrote over against the candlestick upon the plaister of the wall of the king’s palace: and the king saw the part of the hand that wrote.

verses.name: Daniel 5:6
verses.text: Then the king’s countenance was changed, and his thoughts troubled him, so that the joints of his loins were loosed, and his knees smote one against another.

verses.name: Daniel 5:7
verses.text: The king cried aloud to bring in the astrologers, the Chaldeans, and the soothsayers. <hi type="italic">And</hi> the king spake, and said to the wise <hi type="italic">men</hi> of Babylon, Whosoever shall read this writing, and shew me the interpretation thereof, shall be clothed with scarlet, and <hi type="italic">have</hi> a chain of gold about his neck, and shall be the third ruler in the kingdom.

verses.name: Daniel 5:8
verses.text: Then came in all the king’s wise <hi type="italic">men:</hi> but they could not read the writing, nor make known to the king the interpretation thereof.

verses.name: Daniel 5:9
verses.text: Then was king Belshazzar greatly troubled, and his countenance was changed in him, and his lords were astonied.

verses.name: Daniel 5:10
verses.text: ¶ <hi type="italic">Now</hi> the queen, by reason of the words of the king and his lords, came into the banquet house: <hi type="italic">and</hi> the queen spake and said, O king, live for ever: let not thy thoughts trouble thee, nor let thy countenance be changed:

verses.name: Daniel 5:11
verses.text: There is a man in thy kingdom, in whom <hi type="italic">is</hi> the spirit of the holy gods; and in the days of thy father light and understanding and wisdom, like the wisdom of the gods, was found in him; whom the king Nebuchadnezzar thy father, the king, <hi type="italic">I say</hi>, thy father, made master of the magicians, astrologers, Chaldeans, <hi type="italic">and</hi> soothsayers;

verses.name: Daniel 5:12
verses.text: Forasmuch as an excellent spirit, and knowledge, and understanding, interpreting of dreams, and shewing of hard sentences, and dissolving of doubts, were found in the same Daniel, whom the king named Belteshazzar: now let Daniel be called, and he will shew the interpretation.

verses.name: Daniel 5:13
verses.text: Then was Daniel brought in before the king. <hi type="italic">And</hi> the king spake and said unto Daniel, <hi type="italic">Art</hi> thou that Daniel, which <hi type="italic">art</hi> of the children of the captivity of Judah, whom the king my father brought out of Jewry?

verses.name: Daniel 5:14
verses.text: I have even heard of thee, that the spirit of the gods <hi type="italic">is</hi> in thee, and <hi type="italic">that</hi> light and understanding and excellent wisdom is found in thee.

verses.name: Daniel 5:15
verses.text: And now the wise <hi type="italic">men</hi>, the astrologers, have been brought in before me, that they should read this writing, and make known unto me the interpretation thereof: but they could not shew the interpretation of the thing:

verses.name: Daniel 5:16
verses.text: And I have heard of thee, that thou canst make interpretations, and dissolve doubts: now if thou canst read the writing, and make known to me the interpretation thereof, thou shalt be clothed with scarlet, and <hi type="italic">have</hi> a chain of gold about thy neck, and shalt be the third ruler in the kingdom.

verses.name: Daniel 5:17
verses.text: ¶ Then Daniel answered and said before the king, Let thy gifts be to thyself, and give thy rewards to another; yet I will read the writing unto the king, and make known to him the interpretation.

verses.name: Daniel 5:18
verses.text: O thou king, the most high God gave Nebuchadnezzar thy father a kingdom, and majesty, and glory, and honour:

verses.name: Daniel 5:19
verses.text: And for the majesty that he gave him, all people, nations, and languages, trembled and feared before him: whom he would he slew; and whom he would he kept alive; and whom he would he set up; and whom he would he put down.

verses.name: Daniel 5:20
verses.text: But when his heart was lifted up, and his mind hardened in pride, he was deposed from his kingly throne, and they took his glory from him:

verses.name: Daniel 5:21
verses.text: And he was driven from the sons of men; and his heart was made like the beasts, and his dwelling <hi type="italic">was</hi> with the wild asses: they fed him with grass like oxen, and his body was wet with the dew of heaven; till he knew that the most high God ruled in the kingdom of men, and <hi type="italic">that</hi> he appointeth over it whomsoever he will.

verses.name: Daniel 5:22
verses.text: And thou his son, O Belshazzar, hast not humbled thine heart, though thou knewest all this;

verses.name: Daniel 5:23
verses.text: But hast lifted up thyself against the Lord of heaven; and they have brought the vessels of his house before thee, and thou, and thy lords, thy wives, and thy concubines, have drunk wine in them; and thou hast praised the gods of silver, and gold, of brass, iron, wood, and stone, which see not, nor hear, nor know: and the God in whose hand thy breath <hi type="italic">is</hi>, and whose <hi type="italic">are</hi> all thy ways, hast thou not glorified:

verses.name: Daniel 5:24
verses.text: Then was the part of the hand sent from him; and this writing was written.

verses.name: Daniel 5:25
verses.text: ¶ And this <hi type="italic">is</hi> the writing that was written, MENE, MENE, TEKEL, UPHARSIN.

verses.name: Daniel 5:26
verses.text: This <hi type="italic">is</hi> the interpretation of the thing: MENE; God hath numbered thy kingdom, and finished it.

verses.name: Daniel 5:27
verses.text: TEKEL; Thou art weighed in the balances, and art found wanting.

verses.name: Daniel 5:28
verses.text: PERES; Thy kingdom is divided, and given to the Medes and Persians.

verses.name: Daniel 5:29
verses.text: Then commanded Belshazzar, and they clothed Daniel with scarlet, and <hi type="italic">put</hi> a chain of gold about his neck, and made a proclamation concerning him, that he should be the third ruler in the kingdom.

verses.name: Daniel 5:30
verses.text: ¶ In that night was Belshazzar the king of the Chaldeans slain.

verses.name: Daniel 5:31
verses.text: And Darius the Median took the kingdom, <hi type="italic">being</hi> about threescore and two years old.  <chapter eID="Dan.5"/><div eID="gen926" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 6:1
verses.text: IT pleased Darius to set over the kingdom an hundred and twenty princes, which should be over the whole kingdom;

verses.name: Daniel 6:2
verses.text: And over these three presidents; of whom Daniel <hi type="italic">was</hi> first: that the princes might give accounts unto them, and the king should have no damage.

verses.name: Daniel 6:3
verses.text: Then this Daniel was preferred above the presidents and princes, because an excellent spirit <hi type="italic">was</hi> in him; and the king thought to set him over the whole realm.

verses.name: Daniel 6:4
verses.text: ¶ Then the presidents and princes sought to find occasion against Daniel concerning the kingdom; but they could find none occasion nor fault; forasmuch as he <hi type="italic">was</hi> faithful, neither was there any error or fault found in him.

verses.name: Daniel 6:5
verses.text: Then said these men, We shall not find any occasion against this Daniel, except we find <hi type="italic">it</hi> against him concerning the law of his God.

verses.name: Daniel 6:6
verses.text: Then these presidents and princes assembled together to the king, and said thus unto him, King Darius, live for ever.

verses.name: Daniel 6:7
verses.text: All the presidents of the kingdom, the governors, and the princes, the counsellers, and the captains, have consulted together to establish a royal statute, and to make a firm decree, that whosoever shall ask a petition of any God or man for thirty days, save of thee, O king, he shall be cast into the den of lions.

verses.name: Daniel 6:8
verses.text: Now, O king, establish the decree, and sign the writing, that it be not changed, according to the law of the Medes and Persians, which altereth not.

verses.name: Daniel 6:9
verses.text: Wherefore king Darius signed the writing and the decree.

verses.name: Daniel 6:10
verses.text: ¶ Now when Daniel knew that the writing was signed, he went into his house; and his windows being open in his chamber toward Jerusalem, he kneeled upon his knees three times a day, and prayed, and gave thanks before his God, as he did aforetime.

verses.name: Daniel 6:11
verses.text: Then these men assembled, and found Daniel praying and making supplication before his God.

verses.name: Daniel 6:12
verses.text: Then they came near, and spake before the king concerning the king’s decree; Hast thou not signed a decree, that every man that shall ask <hi type="italic">a petition</hi> of any God or man within thirty days, save of thee, O king, shall be cast into the den of lions? The king answered and said, The thing <hi type="italic">is</hi> true, according to the law of the Medes and Persians, which altereth not.

verses.name: Daniel 6:13
verses.text: Then answered they and said before the king, That Daniel, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> of the children of the captivity of Judah, regardeth not thee, O king, nor the decree that thou hast signed, but maketh his petition three times a day.

verses.name: Daniel 6:14
verses.text: Then the king, when he heard <hi type="italic">these</hi> words, was sore displeased with himself, and set <hi type="italic">his</hi> heart on Daniel to deliver him: and he laboured till the going down of the sun to deliver him.

verses.name: Daniel 6:15
verses.text: Then these men assembled unto the king, and said unto the king, Know, O king, that the law of the Medes and Persians <hi type="italic">is</hi>, That no decree nor statute which the king establisheth may be changed.

verses.name: Daniel 6:16
verses.text: Then the king commanded, and they brought Daniel, and cast <hi type="italic">him</hi> into the den of lions. <hi type="italic">Now</hi> the king spake and said unto Daniel, Thy God whom thou servest continually, he will deliver thee.

verses.name: Daniel 6:17
verses.text: And a stone was brought, and laid upon the mouth of the den; and the king sealed it with his own signet, and with the signet of his lords; that the purpose might not be changed concerning Daniel.

verses.name: Daniel 6:18
verses.text: ¶ Then the king went to his palace, and passed the night fasting: neither were instruments of musick brought before him: and his sleep went from him.

verses.name: Daniel 6:19
verses.text: Then the king arose very early in the morning, and went in haste unto the den of lions.

verses.name: Daniel 6:20
verses.text: And when he came to the den, he cried with a lamentable voice unto Daniel: <hi type="italic">and</hi> the king spake and said to Daniel, O Daniel, servant of the living God, is thy God, whom thou servest continually, able to deliver thee from the lions?

verses.name: Daniel 6:21
verses.text: Then said Daniel unto the king, O king, live for ever.

verses.name: Daniel 6:22
verses.text: My God hath sent his angel, and hath shut the lions’ mouths, that they have not hurt me: forasmuch as before him innocency was found in me; and also before thee, O king, have I done no hurt.

verses.name: Daniel 6:23
verses.text: Then was the king exceeding glad for him, and commanded that they should take Daniel up out of the den. So Daniel was taken up out of the den, and no manner of hurt was found upon him, because he believed in his God.

verses.name: Daniel 6:24
verses.text: ¶ And the king commanded, and they brought those men which had accused Daniel, and they cast <hi type="italic">them</hi> into the den of lions, them, their children, and their wives; and the lions had the mastery of them, and brake all their bones in pieces or ever they came at the bottom of the den.

verses.name: Daniel 6:25
verses.text: ¶ Then king Darius wrote unto all people, nations, and languages, that dwell in all the earth; Peace be multiplied unto you.

verses.name: Daniel 6:26
verses.text: I make a decree, That in every dominion of my kingdom men tremble and fear before the God of Daniel: for he <hi type="italic">is</hi> the living God, and stedfast for ever, and his kingdom <hi type="italic">that</hi> which shall not be destroyed, and his dominion <hi type="italic">shall be even</hi> unto the end.

verses.name: Daniel 6:27
verses.text: He delivereth and rescueth, and he worketh signs and wonders in heaven and in earth, who hath delivered Daniel from the power of the lions.

verses.name: Daniel 6:28
verses.text: So this Daniel prospered in the reign of Darius, and in the reign of Cyrus the Persian.  <chapter eID="Dan.6"/><div eID="gen927" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 7:1
verses.text: IN the first year of Belshazzar king of Babylon Daniel had a dream and visions of his head upon his bed: then he wrote the dream, <hi type="italic">and</hi> told the sum of the matters.

verses.name: Daniel 7:2
verses.text: Daniel spake and said, I saw in my vision by night, and, behold, the four winds of the heaven strove upon the great sea.

verses.name: Daniel 7:3
verses.text: And four great beasts came up from the sea, diverse one from another.

verses.name: Daniel 7:4
verses.text: The first <hi type="italic">was</hi> like a lion, and had eagle’s wings: I beheld till the wings thereof were plucked, and it was lifted up from the earth, and made stand upon the feet as a man, and a man’s heart was given to it.

verses.name: Daniel 7:5
verses.text: And behold another beast, a second, like to a bear, and it raised up itself on one side, and <hi type="italic">it had</hi> three ribs in the mouth of it between the teeth of it: and they said thus unto it, Arise, devour much flesh.

verses.name: Daniel 7:6
verses.text: After this I beheld, and lo another, like a leopard, which had upon the back of it four wings of a fowl; the beast had also four heads; and dominion was given to it.

verses.name: Daniel 7:7
verses.text: After this I saw in the night visions, and behold a fourth beast, dreadful and terrible, and strong exceedingly; and it had great iron teeth: it devoured and brake in pieces, and stamped the residue with the feet of it: and it <hi type="italic">was</hi> diverse from all the beasts that <hi type="italic">were</hi> before it; and it had ten horns.

verses.name: Daniel 7:8
verses.text: I considered the horns, and, behold, there came up among them another little horn, before whom there were three of the first horns plucked up by the roots: and, behold, in this horn <hi type="italic">were</hi> eyes like the eyes of man, and a mouth speaking great things.

verses.name: Daniel 7:9
verses.text: ¶ I beheld till the thrones were cast down, and the Ancient of days did sit, whose garment <hi type="italic">was</hi> white as snow, and the hair of his head like the pure wool: his throne <hi type="italic">was like</hi> the fiery flame, <hi type="italic">and</hi> his wheels <hi type="italic">as</hi> burning fire.

verses.name: Daniel 7:10
verses.text: A fiery stream issued and came forth from before him: thousand thousands ministered unto him, and ten thousand times ten thousand stood before him: the judgment was set, and the books were opened.

verses.name: Daniel 7:11
verses.text: I beheld then because of the voice of the great words which the horn spake: I beheld <hi type="italic">even</hi> till the beast was slain, and his body destroyed, and given to the burning flame.

verses.name: Daniel 7:12
verses.text: As concerning the rest of the beasts, they had their dominion taken away: yet their lives were prolonged for a season and time.

verses.name: Daniel 7:13
verses.text: I saw in the night visions, and, behold, <hi type="italic">one</hi> like the Son of man came with the clouds of heaven, and came to the Ancient of days, and they brought him near before him.

verses.name: Daniel 7:14
verses.text: And there was given him dominion, and glory, and a kingdom, that all people, nations, and languages, should serve him: his dominion <hi type="italic">is</hi> an everlasting dominion, which shall not pass away, and his kingdom <hi type="italic">that</hi> which shall not be destroyed.

verses.name: Daniel 7:15
verses.text: ¶ I Daniel was grieved in my spirit in the midst of <hi type="italic">my</hi> body, and the visions of my head troubled me.

verses.name: Daniel 7:16
verses.text: I came near unto one of them that stood by, and asked him the truth of all this. So he told me, and made me know the interpretation of the things.

verses.name: Daniel 7:17
verses.text: These great beasts, which are four, <hi type="italic">are</hi> four kings, <hi type="italic">which</hi> shall arise out of the earth.

verses.name: Daniel 7:18
verses.text: But the saints of the most High shall take the kingdom, and possess the kingdom for ever, even for ever and ever.

verses.name: Daniel 7:19
verses.text: Then I would know the truth of the fourth beast, which was diverse from all the others, exceeding dreadful, whose teeth <hi type="italic">were of</hi> iron, and his nails <hi type="italic">of</hi> brass; <hi type="italic">which</hi> devoured, brake in pieces, and stamped the residue with his feet;

verses.name: Daniel 7:20
verses.text: And of the ten horns that <hi type="italic">were</hi> in his head, and <hi type="italic">of</hi> the other which came up, and before whom three fell; even <hi type="italic">of</hi> that horn that had eyes, and a mouth that spake very great things, whose look <hi type="italic">was</hi> more stout than his fellows.

verses.name: Daniel 7:21
verses.text: I beheld, and the same horn made war with the saints, and prevailed against them;

verses.name: Daniel 7:22
verses.text: Until the Ancient of days came, and judgment was given to the saints of the most High; and the time came that the saints possessed the kingdom.

verses.name: Daniel 7:23
verses.text: Thus he said, The fourth beast shall be the fourth kingdom upon earth, which shall be diverse from all kingdoms, and shall devour the whole earth, and shall tread it down, and break it in pieces.

verses.name: Daniel 7:24
verses.text: And the ten horns out of this kingdom <hi type="italic">are</hi> ten kings <hi type="italic">that</hi> shall arise: and another shall rise after them; and he shall be diverse from the first, and he shall subdue three kings.

verses.name: Daniel 7:25
verses.text: And he shall speak <hi type="italic">great</hi> words against the most High, and shall wear out the saints of the most High, and think to change times and laws: and they shall be given into his hand until a time and times and the dividing of time.

verses.name: Daniel 7:26
verses.text: But the judgment shall sit, and they shall take away his dominion, to consume and to destroy <hi type="italic">it</hi> unto the end.

verses.name: Daniel 7:27
verses.text: And the kingdom and dominion, and the greatness of the kingdom under the whole heaven, shall be given to the people of the saints of the most High, whose kingdom <hi type="italic">is</hi> an everlasting kingdom, and all dominions shall serve and obey him.

verses.name: Daniel 7:28
verses.text: Hitherto <hi type="italic">is</hi> the end of the matter. As for me Daniel, my cogitations much troubled me, and my countenance changed in me: but I kept the matter in my heart.  <chapter eID="Dan.7"/><div eID="gen928" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 8:1
verses.text: IN the third year of the reign of king Belshazzar a vision appeared unto me, <hi type="italic">even unto</hi> me Daniel, after that which appeared unto me at the first.

verses.name: Daniel 8:2
verses.text: And I saw in a vision; and it came to pass, when I saw, that I <hi type="italic">was</hi> at Shushan <hi type="italic">in</hi> the palace, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> in the province of Elam; and I saw in a vision, and I was by the river of Ulai.

verses.name: Daniel 8:3
verses.text: Then I lifted up mine eyes, and saw, and, behold, there stood before the river a ram which had <hi type="italic">two</hi> horns: and the <hi type="italic">two</hi> horns <hi type="italic">were</hi> high; but one <hi type="italic">was</hi> higher than the other, and the higher came up last.

verses.name: Daniel 8:4
verses.text: I saw the ram pushing westward, and northward, and southward; so that no beasts might stand before him, neither <hi type="italic">was there any</hi> that could deliver out of his hand; but he did according to his will, and became great.

verses.name: Daniel 8:5
verses.text: And as I was considering, behold, an he goat came from the west on the face of the whole earth, and touched not the ground: and the goat <hi type="italic">had</hi> a notable horn between his eyes.

verses.name: Daniel 8:6
verses.text: And he came to the ram that had <hi type="italic">two</hi> horns, which I had seen standing before the river, and ran unto him in the fury of his power.

verses.name: Daniel 8:7
verses.text: And I saw him come close unto the ram, and he was moved with choler against him, and smote the ram, and brake his two horns: and there was no power in the ram to stand before him, but he cast him down to the ground, and stamped upon him: and there was none that could deliver the ram out of his hand.

verses.name: Daniel 8:8
verses.text: Therefore the he goat waxed very great: and when he was strong, the great horn was broken; and for it came up four notable ones toward the four winds of heaven.

verses.name: Daniel 8:9
verses.text: And out of one of them came forth a little horn, which waxed exceeding great, toward the south, and toward the east, and toward the pleasant <hi type="italic">land</hi>.

verses.name: Daniel 8:10
verses.text: And it waxed great, <hi type="italic">even</hi> to the host of heaven; and it cast down <hi type="italic">some</hi> of the host and of the stars to the ground, and stamped upon them.

verses.name: Daniel 8:11
verses.text: Yea, he magnified <hi type="italic">himself</hi> even to the prince of the host, and by him the daily <hi type="italic">sacrifice</hi> was taken away, and the place of his sanctuary was cast down.

verses.name: Daniel 8:12
verses.text: And an host was given <hi type="italic">him</hi> against the daily <hi type="italic">sacrifice</hi> by reason of transgression, and it cast down the truth to the ground; and it practised, and prospered.

verses.name: Daniel 8:13
verses.text: ¶ Then I heard one saint speaking, and another saint said unto that certain <hi type="italic">saint</hi> which spake, How long <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> the vision <hi type="italic">concerning</hi> the daily <hi type="italic">sacrifice</hi>, and the transgression of desolation, to give both the sanctuary and the host to be trodden under foot?

verses.name: Daniel 8:14
verses.text: And he said unto me, Unto two thousand and three hundred days; then shall the sanctuary be cleansed.

verses.name: Daniel 8:15
verses.text: ¶ And it came to pass, when I, <hi type="italic">even</hi> I Daniel, had seen the vision, and sought for the meaning, then, behold, there stood before me as the appearance of a man.

verses.name: Daniel 8:16
verses.text: And I heard a man’s voice between <hi type="italic">the banks of</hi> Ulai, which called, and said, Gabriel, make this <hi type="italic">man</hi> to understand the vision.

verses.name: Daniel 8:17
verses.text: So he came near where I stood: and when he came, I was afraid, and fell upon my face: but he said unto me, Understand, O son of man: for at the time of the end <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> the vision.

verses.name: Daniel 8:18
verses.text: Now as he was speaking with me, I was in a deep sleep on my face toward the ground: but he touched me, and set me upright.

verses.name: Daniel 8:19
verses.text: And he said, Behold, I will make thee know what shall be in the last end of the indignation: for at the time appointed the end <hi type="italic">shall be</hi>.

verses.name: Daniel 8:20
verses.text: The ram which thou sawest having <hi type="italic">two</hi> horns <hi type="italic">are</hi> the kings of Media and Persia.

verses.name: Daniel 8:21
verses.text: And the rough goat <hi type="italic">is</hi> the king of Grecia: and the great horn that <hi type="italic">is</hi> between his eyes <hi type="italic">is</hi> the first king.

verses.name: Daniel 8:22
verses.text: Now that being broken, whereas four stood up for it, four kingdoms shall stand up out of the nation, but not in his power.

verses.name: Daniel 8:23
verses.text: And in the latter time of their kingdom, when the transgressors are come to the full, a king of fierce countenance, and understanding dark sentences, shall stand up.

verses.name: Daniel 8:24
verses.text: And his power shall be mighty, but not by his own power: and he shall destroy wonderfully, and shall prosper, and practise, and shall destroy the mighty and the holy people.

verses.name: Daniel 8:25
verses.text: And through his policy also he shall cause craft to prosper in his hand; and he shall magnify <hi type="italic">himself</hi> in his heart, and by peace shall destroy many: he shall also stand up against the Prince of princes; but he shall be broken without hand.

verses.name: Daniel 8:26
verses.text: And the vision of the evening and the morning which was told <hi type="italic">is</hi> true: wherefore shut thou up the vision; for it <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> for many days.

verses.name: Daniel 8:27
verses.text: And I Daniel fainted, and was sick <hi type="italic">certain</hi> days; afterward I rose up, and did the king’s business; and I was astonished at the vision, but none understood <hi type="italic">it</hi>.  <chapter eID="Dan.8"/><div eID="gen929" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 9:1
verses.text: IN the first year of Darius the son of Ahasuerus, of the seed of the Medes, which was made king over the realm of the Chaldeans;

verses.name: Daniel 9:2
verses.text: In the first year of his reign I Daniel understood by books the number of the years, whereof the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah the prophet, that he would accomplish seventy years in the desolations of Jerusalem.

verses.name: Daniel 9:3
verses.text: ¶ And I set my face unto the Lord God, to seek by prayer and supplications, with fasting, and sackcloth, and ashes:

verses.name: Daniel 9:4
verses.text: And I prayed unto the Lord my God, and made my confession, and said, O Lord, the great and dreadful God, keeping the covenant and mercy to them that love him, and to them that keep his commandments;

verses.name: Daniel 9:5
verses.text: We have sinned, and have committed iniquity, and have done wickedly, and have rebelled, even by departing from thy precepts and from thy judgments:

verses.name: Daniel 9:6
verses.text: Neither have we hearkened unto thy servants the prophets, which spake in thy name to our kings, our princes, and our fathers, and to all the people of the land.

verses.name: Daniel 9:7
verses.text: O Lord, righteousness <hi type="italic">belongeth</hi> unto thee, but unto us confusion of faces, as at this day; to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and unto all Israel, <hi type="italic">that are</hi> near, and <hi type="italic">that are</hi> far off, through all the countries whither thou hast driven them, because of their trespass that they have trespassed against thee.

verses.name: Daniel 9:8
verses.text: O Lord, to us <hi type="italic">belongeth</hi> confusion of face, to our kings, to our princes, and to our fathers, because we have sinned against thee.

verses.name: Daniel 9:9
verses.text: To the Lord our God <hi type="italic">belong</hi> mercies and forgivenesses, though we have rebelled against him;

verses.name: Daniel 9:10
verses.text: Neither have we obeyed the voice of the Lord our God, to walk in his laws, which he set before us by his servants the prophets.

verses.name: Daniel 9:11
verses.text: Yea, all Israel have transgressed thy law, even by departing, that they might not obey thy voice; therefore the curse is poured upon us, and the oath that <hi type="italic">is</hi> written in the law of Moses the servant of God, because we have sinned against him.

verses.name: Daniel 9:12
verses.text: And he hath confirmed his words, which he spake against us, and against our judges that judged us, by bringing upon us a great evil: for under the whole heaven hath not been done as hath been done upon Jerusalem.

verses.name: Daniel 9:13
verses.text: As <hi type="italic">it is</hi> written in the law of Moses, all this evil is come upon us: yet made we not our prayer before the Lord our God, that we might turn from our iniquities, and understand thy truth.

verses.name: Daniel 9:14
verses.text: Therefore hath the Lord watched upon the evil, and brought it upon us: for the Lord our God <hi type="italic">is</hi> righteous in all his works which he doeth: for we obeyed not his voice.

verses.name: Daniel 9:15
verses.text: And now, O Lord our God, that hast brought thy people forth out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand, and hast gotten thee renown, as at this day; we have sinned, we have done wickedly.

verses.name: Daniel 9:16
verses.text: ¶ O Lord, according to all thy righteousness, I beseech thee, let thine anger and thy fury be turned away from thy city Jerusalem, thy holy mountain: because for our sins, and for the iniquities of our fathers, Jerusalem and thy people <hi type="italic">are become</hi> a reproach to all <hi type="italic">that are</hi> about us.

verses.name: Daniel 9:17
verses.text: Now therefore, O our God, hear the prayer of thy servant, and his supplications, and cause thy face to shine upon thy sanctuary that is desolate, for the Lord’s sake.

verses.name: Daniel 9:18
verses.text: O my God, incline thine ear, and hear; open thine eyes, and behold our desolations, and the city which is called by thy name: for we do not present our supplications before thee for our righteousnesses, but for thy great mercies.

verses.name: Daniel 9:19
verses.text: O Lord, hear; O Lord, forgive; O Lord, hearken and do; defer not, for thine own sake, O my God: for thy city and thy people are called by thy name.

verses.name: Daniel 9:20
verses.text: ¶ And whiles I <hi type="italic">was</hi> speaking, and praying, and confessing my sin and the sin of my people Israel, and presenting my supplication before the Lord my God for the holy mountain of my God;

verses.name: Daniel 9:21
verses.text: Yea, whiles I <hi type="italic">was</hi> speaking in prayer, even the man Gabriel, whom I had seen in the vision at the beginning, being caused to fly swiftly, touched me about the time of the evening oblation.

verses.name: Daniel 9:22
verses.text: And he informed <hi type="italic">me</hi>, and talked with me, and said, O Daniel, I am now come forth to give thee skill and understanding.

verses.name: Daniel 9:23
verses.text: At the beginning of thy supplications the commandment came forth, and I am come to shew <hi type="italic">thee;</hi> for thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> greatly beloved: therefore understand the matter, and consider the vision.

verses.name: Daniel 9:24
verses.text: Seventy weeks are determined upon thy people and upon thy holy city, to finish the transgression, and to make an end of sins, and to make reconciliation for iniquity, and to bring in everlasting righteousness, and to seal up the vision and prophecy, and to anoint the most Holy.

verses.name: Daniel 9:25
verses.text: Know therefore and understand, <hi type="italic">that</hi> from the going forth of the commandment to restore and to build Jerusalem unto the Messiah the Prince <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> seven weeks, and threescore and two weeks: the street shall be built again, and the wall, even in troublous times.

verses.name: Daniel 9:26
verses.text: And after threescore and two weeks shall Messiah be cut off, but not for himself: and the people of the prince that shall come shall destroy the city and the sanctuary; and the end thereof <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> with a flood, and unto the end of the war desolations are determined.

verses.name: Daniel 9:27
verses.text: And he shall confirm the covenant with many for one week: and in the midst of the week he shall cause the sacrifice and the oblation to cease, and for the overspreading of abominations he shall make <hi type="italic">it</hi> desolate, even until the consummation, and that determined shall be poured upon the desolate.  <chapter eID="Dan.9"/><div eID="gen930" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 10:1
verses.text: IN the third year of Cyrus king of Persia a thing was revealed unto Daniel, whose name was called Belteshazzar; and the thing <hi type="italic">was</hi> true, but the time appointed <hi type="italic">was</hi> long: and he understood the thing, and had understanding of the vision.

verses.name: Daniel 10:2
verses.text: In those days I Daniel was mourning three full weeks.

verses.name: Daniel 10:3
verses.text: I ate no pleasant bread, neither came flesh nor wine in my mouth, neither did I anoint myself at all, till three whole weeks were fulfilled.

verses.name: Daniel 10:4
verses.text: And in the four and twentieth day of the first month, as I was by the side of the great river, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> Hiddekel;

verses.name: Daniel 10:5
verses.text: Then I lifted up mine eyes, and looked, and behold a certain man clothed in linen, whose loins <hi type="italic">were</hi> girded with fine gold of Uphaz:

verses.name: Daniel 10:6
verses.text: His body also <hi type="italic">was</hi> like the beryl, and his face as the appearance of lightning, and his eyes as lamps of fire, and his arms and his feet like in colour to polished brass, and the voice of his words like the voice of a multitude.

verses.name: Daniel 10:7
verses.text: And I Daniel alone saw the vision: for the men that were with me saw not the vision; but a great quaking fell upon them, so that they fled to hide themselves.

verses.name: Daniel 10:8
verses.text: Therefore I was left alone, and saw this great vision, and there remained no strength in me: for my comeliness was turned in me into corruption, and I retained no strength.

verses.name: Daniel 10:9
verses.text: Yet heard I the voice of his words: and when I heard the voice of his words, then was I in a deep sleep on my face, and my face toward the ground.

verses.name: Daniel 10:10
verses.text: ¶ And, behold, an hand touched me, which set me upon my knees and <hi type="italic">upon</hi> the palms of my hands.

verses.name: Daniel 10:11
verses.text: And he said unto me, O Daniel, a man greatly beloved, understand the words that I speak unto thee, and stand upright: for unto thee am I now sent. And when he had spoken this word unto me, I stood trembling.

verses.name: Daniel 10:12
verses.text: Then said he unto me, Fear not, Daniel: for from the first day that thou didst set thine heart to understand, and to chasten thyself before thy God, thy words were heard, and I am come for thy words.

verses.name: Daniel 10:13
verses.text: But the prince of the kingdom of Persia withstood me one and twenty days: but, lo, Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help me; and I remained there with the kings of Persia.

verses.name: Daniel 10:14
verses.text: Now I am come to make thee understand what shall befall thy people in the latter days: for yet the vision <hi type="italic">is</hi> for <hi type="italic">many</hi> days.

verses.name: Daniel 10:15
verses.text: And when he had spoken such words unto me, I set my face toward the ground, and I became dumb.

verses.name: Daniel 10:16
verses.text: And, behold, <hi type="italic">one</hi> like the similitude of the sons of men touched my lips: then I opened my mouth, and spake, and said unto him that stood before me, O my lord, by the vision my sorrows are turned upon me, and I have retained no strength.

verses.name: Daniel 10:17
verses.text: For how can the servant of this my lord talk with this my lord? for as for me, straightway there remained no strength in me, neither is there breath left in me.

verses.name: Daniel 10:18
verses.text: Then there came again and touched me <hi type="italic">one</hi> like the appearance of a man, and he strengthened me,

verses.name: Daniel 10:19
verses.text: And said, O man greatly beloved, fear not: peace <hi type="italic">be</hi> unto thee, be strong, yea, be strong. And when he had spoken unto me, I was strengthened, and said, Let my lord speak; for thou hast strengthened me.

verses.name: Daniel 10:20
verses.text: Then said he, Knowest thou wherefore I come unto thee? and now will I return to fight with the prince of Persia: and when I am gone forth, lo, the prince of Grecia shall come.

verses.name: Daniel 10:21
verses.text: But I will shew thee that which is noted in the scripture of truth: and <hi type="italic">there is</hi> none that holdeth with me in these things, but Michael your prince.  <chapter eID="Dan.10"/><div eID="gen931" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 11:1
