verses.text: That day <hi type="italic">is</hi> a day of wrath, a day of trouble and distress, a day of wasteness and desolation, a day of darkness and gloominess, a day of clouds and thick darkness,

verses.name: Zephaniah 1:16
verses.text: A day of the trumpet and alarm against the fenced cities, and against the high towers.

verses.name: Zephaniah 1:17
verses.text: And I will bring distress upon men, that they shall walk like blind men, because they have sinned against the Lord: and their blood shall be poured out as dust, and their flesh as the dung.

verses.name: Zephaniah 1:18
verses.text: Neither their silver nor their gold shall be able to deliver them in the day of the Lord’s wrath; but the whole land shall be devoured by the fire of his jealousy: for he shall make even a speedy riddance of all them that dwell in the land.  <chapter eID="Zeph.1"/><div eID="gen987" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:1
verses.text: GATHER yourselves together, yea, gather together, O nation not desired;

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:2
verses.text: Before the decree bring forth, <hi type="italic">before</hi> the day pass as the chaff, before the fierce anger of the Lord come upon you, before the day of the Lord’s anger come upon you.

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:3
verses.text: Seek ye the Lord, all ye meek of the earth, which have wrought his judgment; seek righteousness, seek meekness: it may be ye shall be hid in the day of the Lord’s anger.

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:4
verses.text: ¶ For Gaza shall be forsaken, and Ashkelon a desolation: they shall drive out Ashdod at the noon day, and Ekron shall be rooted up.

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:5
verses.text: Woe unto the inhabitants of the sea coast, the nation of the Cherethites! the word of the Lord <hi type="italic">is</hi> against you; O Canaan, the land of the Philistines, I will even destroy thee, that there shall be no inhabitant.

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:6
verses.text: And the sea coast shall be dwellings <hi type="italic">and</hi> cottages for shepherds, and folds for flocks.

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:7
verses.text: And the coast shall be for the remnant of the house of Judah; they shall feed thereupon: in the houses of Ashkelon shall they lie down in the evening: for the Lord their God shall visit them, and turn away their captivity.

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:8
verses.text: ¶ I have heard the reproach of Moab, and the revilings of the children of Ammon, whereby they have reproached my people, and magnified <hi type="italic">themselves</hi> against their border.

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:9
verses.text: Therefore <hi type="italic">as</hi> I live, saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, Surely Moab shall be as Sodom, and the children of Ammon as Gomorrah, <hi type="italic">even</hi> the breeding of nettles, and saltpits, and a perpetual desolation: the residue of my people shall spoil them, and the remnant of my people shall possess them.

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:10
verses.text: This shall they have for their pride, because they have reproached and magnified <hi type="italic">themselves</hi> against the people of the Lord of hosts.

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:11
verses.text: The Lord <hi type="italic">will be</hi> terrible unto them: for he will famish all the gods of the earth; and <hi type="italic">men</hi> shall worship him, every one from his place, <hi type="italic">even</hi> all the isles of the heathen.

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:12
verses.text: ¶ Ye Ethiopians also, ye <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> slain by my sword.

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:13
verses.text: And he will stretch out his hand against the north, and destroy Assyria; and will make Nineveh a desolation, <hi type="italic">and</hi> dry like a wilderness.

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:14
verses.text: And flocks shall lie down in the midst of her, all the beasts of the nations: both the cormorant and the bittern shall lodge in the upper lintels of it; <hi type="italic">their</hi> voice shall sing in the windows; desolation <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> in the thresholds: for he shall uncover the cedar work.

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:15
verses.text: This <hi type="italic">is</hi> the rejoicing city that dwelt carelessly, that said in her heart, I <hi type="italic">am</hi>, and <hi type="italic">there is</hi> none beside me: how is she become a desolation, a place for beasts to lie down in! every one that passeth by her shall hiss, <hi type="italic">and</hi> wag his hand.  <chapter eID="Zeph.2"/><div eID="gen988" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:1
verses.text: WOE to her that is filthy and polluted, to the oppressing city!

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:2
verses.text: She obeyed not the voice; she received not correction; she trusted not in the Lord; she drew not near to her God.

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:3
verses.text: Her princes within her <hi type="italic">are</hi> roaring lions; her judges <hi type="italic">are</hi> evening wolves; they gnaw not the bones till the morrow.

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:4
verses.text: Her prophets <hi type="italic">are</hi> light <hi type="italic">and</hi> treacherous persons: her priests have polluted the sanctuary, they have done violence to the law.

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:5
verses.text: The just Lord <hi type="italic">is</hi> in the midst thereof; he will not do iniquity: every morning doth he bring his judgment to light, he faileth not; but the unjust knoweth no shame.

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:6
verses.text: I have cut off the nations: their towers are desolate; I made their streets waste, that none passeth by: their cities are destroyed, so that there is no man, that there is none inhabitant.

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:7
verses.text: I said, Surely thou wilt fear me, thou wilt receive instruction; so their dwelling should not be cut off, howsoever I punished them: but they rose early, <hi type="italic">and</hi> corrupted all their doings.

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:8
verses.text: ¶ Therefore wait ye upon me, saith the Lord, until the day that I rise up to the prey: for my determination <hi type="italic">is</hi> to gather the nations, that I may assemble the kingdoms, to pour upon them mine indignation, <hi type="italic">even</hi> all my fierce anger: for all the earth shall be devoured with the fire of my jealousy.

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:9
verses.text: For then will I turn to the people a pure language, that they may all call upon the name of the Lord, to serve him with one consent.

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:10
verses.text: From beyond the rivers of Ethiopia my suppliants, <hi type="italic">even</hi> the daughter of my dispersed, shall bring mine offering.

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:11
verses.text: In that day shalt thou not be ashamed for all thy doings, wherein thou hast transgressed against me: for then I will take away out of the midst of thee them that rejoice in thy pride, and thou shalt no more be haughty because of my holy mountain.

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:12
verses.text: I will also leave in the midst of thee an afflicted and poor people, and they shall trust in the name of the Lord.

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:13
verses.text: The remnant of Israel shall not do iniquity, nor speak lies; neither shall a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth: for they shall feed and lie down, and none shall make <hi type="italic">them</hi> afraid.

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:14
verses.text: ¶ Sing, O daughter of Zion; shout, O Israel; be glad and rejoice with all the heart, O daughter of Jerusalem.

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:15
verses.text: The Lord hath taken away thy judgments, he hath cast out thine enemy: the king of Israel, <hi type="italic">even</hi> the Lord, <hi type="italic">is</hi> in the midst of thee: thou shalt not see evil any more.

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:16
verses.text: In that day it shall be said to Jerusalem, Fear thou not: <hi type="italic">and to</hi> Zion, Let not thine hands be slack.

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:17
verses.text: The Lord thy God in the midst of thee <hi type="italic">is</hi> mighty; he will save, he will rejoice over thee with joy; he will rest in his love, he will joy over thee with singing.

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:18
verses.text: I will gather <hi type="italic">them that are</hi> sorrowful for the solemn assembly, <hi type="italic">who</hi> are of thee, <hi type="italic">to whom</hi> the reproach of it <hi type="italic">was</hi> a burden.

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:19
verses.text: Behold, at that time I will undo all that afflict thee: and I will save her that halteth, and gather her that was driven out; and I will get them praise and fame in every land where they have been put to shame.

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:20
verses.text: At that time will I bring you <hi type="italic">again</hi>, even in the time that I gather you: for I will make you a name and a praise among all people of the earth, when I turn back your captivity before your eyes, saith the Lord.  <chapter eID="Zeph.3"/><div eID="gen989" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen986" osisID="Zeph" type="book"/>

verses.name: Haggai 1:1
verses.text: IN the second year of Darius the king, in the sixth month, in the first day of the month, came the word of the Lord by Haggai the prophet unto Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest, saying,

verses.name: Haggai 1:2
verses.text: Thus speaketh the Lord of hosts, saying, This people say, The time is not come, the time that the Lord’s house should be built.

verses.name: Haggai 1:3
verses.text: Then came the word of the Lord by Haggai the prophet, saying,

verses.name: Haggai 1:4
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Is it</hi> time for you, O ye, to dwell in your cieled houses, and this house <hi type="italic">lie</hi> waste?

verses.name: Haggai 1:5
verses.text: Now therefore thus saith the Lord of hosts; Consider your ways.

verses.name: Haggai 1:6
verses.text: Ye have sown much, and bring in little; ye eat, but ye have not enough; ye drink, but ye are not filled with drink; ye clothe you, but there is none warm; and he that earneth wages earneth wages <hi type="italic">to put it</hi> into a bag with holes.

verses.name: Haggai 1:7
verses.text: ¶ Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Consider your ways.

verses.name: Haggai 1:8
verses.text: Go up to the mountain, and bring wood, and build the house; and I will take pleasure in it, and I will be glorified, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Haggai 1:9
verses.text: Ye looked for much, and, lo, <hi type="italic">it came</hi> to little; and when ye brought <hi type="italic">it</hi> home, I did blow upon it. Why? saith the Lord of hosts. Because of mine house that <hi type="italic">is</hi> waste, and ye run every man unto his own house.

verses.name: Haggai 1:10
verses.text: Therefore the heaven over you is stayed from dew, and the earth is stayed <hi type="italic">from</hi> her fruit.

verses.name: Haggai 1:11
verses.text: And I called for a drought upon the land, and upon the mountains, and upon the corn, and upon the new wine, and upon the oil, and upon <hi type="italic">that</hi> which the ground bringeth forth, and upon men, and upon cattle, and upon all the labour of the hands.

verses.name: Haggai 1:12
verses.text: ¶ Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest, with all the remnant of the people, obeyed the voice of the Lord their God, and the words of Haggai the prophet, as the Lord their God had sent him, and the people did fear before the Lord.

verses.name: Haggai 1:13
verses.text: Then spake Haggai the Lord’s messenger in the Lord’s message unto the people, saying, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> with you, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Haggai 1:14
verses.text: And the Lord stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest, and the spirit of all the remnant of the people; and they came and did work in the house of the Lord of hosts, their God,

verses.name: Haggai 1:15
verses.text: In the four and twentieth day of the sixth month, in the second year of Darius the king.  <chapter eID="Hag.1"/><div eID="gen991" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Haggai 2:1
verses.text: IN the seventh <hi type="italic">month</hi>, in the one and twentieth <hi type="italic">day</hi> of the month, came the word of the Lord by the prophet Haggai, saying,

verses.name: Haggai 2:2
verses.text: Speak now to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest, and to the residue of the people, saying,

verses.name: Haggai 2:3
verses.text: Who <hi type="italic">is</hi> left among you that saw this house in her first glory? and how do ye see it now? <hi type="italic">is it</hi> not in your eyes in comparison of it as nothing?

verses.name: Haggai 2:4
verses.text: Yet now be strong, O Zerubbabel, saith the Lord; and be strong, O Joshua, son of Josedech, the high priest; and be strong, all ye people of the land, saith the Lord, and work: for I <hi type="italic">am</hi> with you, saith the Lord of hosts:

verses.name: Haggai 2:5
verses.text: <hi type="italic">According to</hi> the word that I covenanted with you when ye came out of Egypt, so my spirit remaineth among you: fear ye not.

verses.name: Haggai 2:6
verses.text: For thus saith the Lord of hosts; Yet once, it <hi type="italic">is</hi> a little while, and I will shake the heavens, and the earth, and the sea, and the dry <hi type="italic">land;</hi>

verses.name: Haggai 2:7
verses.text: And I will shake all nations, and the desire of all nations shall come: and I will fill this house with glory, saith the Lord of hosts.

verses.name: Haggai 2:8
verses.text: The silver <hi type="italic">is</hi> mine, and the gold <hi type="italic">is</hi> mine, saith the Lord of hosts.

verses.name: Haggai 2:9
verses.text: The glory of this latter house shall be greater than of the former, saith the Lord of hosts: and in this place will I give peace, saith the Lord of hosts.

verses.name: Haggai 2:10
verses.text: ¶ In the four and twentieth <hi type="italic">day</hi> of the ninth <hi type="italic">month</hi>, in the second year of Darius, came the word of the Lord by Haggai the prophet, saying,

verses.name: Haggai 2:11
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Ask now the priests <hi type="italic">concerning</hi> the law, saying,

verses.name: Haggai 2:12
verses.text: If one bear holy flesh in the skirt of his garment, and with his skirt do touch bread, or pottage, or wine, or oil, or any meat, shall it be holy? And the priests answered and said, No.

verses.name: Haggai 2:13
verses.text: Then said Haggai, If <hi type="italic">one that is</hi> unclean by a dead body touch any of these, shall it be unclean? And the priests answered and said, It shall be unclean.

verses.name: Haggai 2:14
verses.text: Then answered Haggai, and said, So <hi type="italic">is</hi> this people, and so <hi type="italic">is</hi> this nation before me, saith the Lord; and so <hi type="italic">is</hi> every work of their hands; and that which they offer there <hi type="italic">is</hi> unclean.

verses.name: Haggai 2:15
verses.text: And now, I pray you, consider from this day and upward, from before a stone was laid upon a stone in the temple of the Lord:

verses.name: Haggai 2:16
verses.text: Since those <hi type="italic">days</hi> were, when <hi type="italic">one</hi> came to an heap of twenty <hi type="italic">measures</hi>, there were <hi type="italic">but</hi> ten: when <hi type="italic">one</hi> came to the pressfat for to draw out fifty <hi type="italic">vessels</hi> out of the press, there were <hi type="italic">but</hi> twenty.

verses.name: Haggai 2:17
verses.text: I smote you with blasting and with mildew and with hail in all the labours of your hands; yet ye <hi type="italic">turned</hi> not to me, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Haggai 2:18
verses.text: Consider now from this day and upward, from the four and twentieth day of the ninth <hi type="italic">month</hi>, <hi type="italic">even</hi> from the day that the foundation of the Lord’s temple was laid, consider <hi type="italic">it</hi>.

verses.name: Haggai 2:19
verses.text: Is the seed yet in the barn? yea, as yet the vine, and the fig tree, and the pomegranate, and the olive tree, hath not brought forth: from this day will I bless <hi type="italic">you</hi>.

verses.name: Haggai 2:20
verses.text: ¶ And again the word of the Lord came unto Haggai in the four and twentieth <hi type="italic">day</hi> of the month, saying,

verses.name: Haggai 2:21
verses.text: Speak to Zerubbabel, governor of Judah, saying, I will shake the heavens and the earth;

verses.name: Haggai 2:22
verses.text: And I will overthrow the throne of kingdoms, and I will destroy the strength of the kingdoms of the heathen; and I will overthrow the chariots, and those that ride in them; and the horses and their riders shall come down, every one by the sword of his brother.

verses.name: Haggai 2:23
verses.text: In that day, saith the Lord of hosts, will I take thee, O Zerubbabel, my servant, the son of Shealtiel, saith the Lord, and will make thee as a signet: for I have chosen thee, saith the Lord of hosts.  <chapter eID="Hag.2"/><div eID="gen992" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen990" osisID="Hag" type="book"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 1:1
verses.text: IN the eighth month, in the second year of Darius, came the word of the Lord unto Zechariah, the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo the prophet, saying,

verses.name: Zechariah 1:2
verses.text: The Lord hath been sore displeased with your fathers.

verses.name: Zechariah 1:3
verses.text: Therefore say thou unto them, Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Turn ye unto me, saith the Lord of hosts, and I will turn unto you, saith the Lord of hosts.

verses.name: Zechariah 1:4
verses.text: Be ye not as your fathers, unto whom the former prophets have cried, saying, Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Turn ye now from your evil ways, and <hi type="italic">from</hi> your evil doings: but they did not hear, nor hearken unto me, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Zechariah 1:5
verses.text: Your fathers, where <hi type="italic">are</hi> they? and the prophets, do they live for ever?

verses.name: Zechariah 1:6
verses.text: But my words and my statutes, which I commanded my servants the prophets, did they not take hold of your fathers? and they returned and said, Like as the Lord of hosts thought to do unto us, according to our ways, and according to our doings, so hath he dealt with us.

verses.name: Zechariah 1:7
verses.text: ¶ Upon the four and twentieth day of the eleventh month, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> the month Sebat, in the second year of Darius, came the word of the Lord unto Zechariah, the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo the prophet, saying,

verses.name: Zechariah 1:8
verses.text: I saw by night, and behold a man riding upon a red horse, and he stood among the myrtle trees that <hi type="italic">were</hi> in the bottom; and behind him <hi type="italic">were there</hi> red horses, speckled, and white.

verses.name: Zechariah 1:9
verses.text: Then said I, O my lord, what <hi type="italic">are</hi> these? And the angel that talked with me said unto me, I will shew thee what these <hi type="italic">be</hi>.

verses.name: Zechariah 1:10
verses.text: And the man that stood among the myrtle trees answered and said, These <hi type="italic">are they</hi> whom the Lord hath sent to walk to and fro through the earth.

verses.name: Zechariah 1:11
verses.text: And they answered the angel of the Lord that stood among the myrtle trees, and said, We have walked to and fro through the earth, and, behold, all the earth sitteth still, and is at rest.

verses.name: Zechariah 1:12
verses.text: ¶ Then the angel of the Lord answered and said, O Lord of hosts, how long wilt thou not have mercy on Jerusalem and on the cities of Judah, against which thou hast had indignation these threescore and ten years?

verses.name: Zechariah 1:13
verses.text: And the Lord answered the angel that talked with me <hi type="italic">with</hi> good words <hi type="italic">and</hi> comfortable words.

verses.name: Zechariah 1:14
verses.text: So the angel that communed with me said unto me, Cry thou, saying, Thus saith the Lord of hosts; I am jealous for Jerusalem and for Zion with a great jealousy.

verses.name: Zechariah 1:15
verses.text: And I am very sore displeased with the heathen <hi type="italic">that are</hi> at ease: for I was but a little displeased, and they helped forward the affliction.

verses.name: Zechariah 1:16
verses.text: Therefore thus saith the Lord; I am returned to Jerusalem with mercies: my house shall be built in it, saith the Lord of hosts, and a line shall be stretched forth upon Jerusalem.

verses.name: Zechariah 1:17
verses.text: Cry yet, saying, Thus saith the Lord of hosts; My cities through prosperity shall yet be spread abroad; and the Lord shall yet comfort Zion, and shall yet choose Jerusalem.

verses.name: Zechariah 1:18
verses.text: ¶ Then lifted I up mine eyes, and saw, and behold four horns.

verses.name: Zechariah 1:19
verses.text: And I said unto the angel that talked with me, What <hi type="italic">be</hi> these? And he answered me, These <hi type="italic">are</hi> the horns which have scattered Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem.

verses.name: Zechariah 1:20
verses.text: And the Lord shewed me four carpenters.

verses.name: Zechariah 1:21
verses.text: Then said I, What come these to do? And he spake, saying, These <hi type="italic">are</hi> the horns which have scattered Judah, so that no man did lift up his head: but these are come to fray them, to cast out the horns of the Gentiles, which lifted up <hi type="italic">their</hi> horn over the land of Judah to scatter it.  <chapter eID="Zech.1"/><div eID="gen994" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 2:1
verses.text: I LIFTED up mine eyes again, and looked, and behold a man with a measuring line in his hand.

verses.name: Zechariah 2:2
verses.text: Then said I, Whither goest thou? And he said unto me, To measure Jerusalem, to see what <hi type="italic">is</hi> the breadth thereof, and what <hi type="italic">is</hi> the length thereof.

verses.name: Zechariah 2:3
verses.text: And, behold, the angel that talked with me went forth, and another angel went out to meet him,

verses.name: Zechariah 2:4
verses.text: And said unto him, Run, speak to this young man, saying, Jerusalem shall be inhabited <hi type="italic">as</hi> towns without walls for the multitude of men and cattle therein:

verses.name: Zechariah 2:5
verses.text: For I, saith the Lord, will be unto her a wall of fire round about, and will be the glory in the midst of her.

verses.name: Zechariah 2:6
verses.text: ¶ Ho, ho, <hi type="italic">come forth</hi>, and flee from the land of the north, saith the Lord: for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the heaven, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Zechariah 2:7
verses.text: Deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwellest <hi type="italic">with</hi> the daughter of Babylon.

verses.name: Zechariah 2:8
verses.text: For thus saith the Lord of hosts; After the glory hath he sent me unto the nations which spoiled you: for he that toucheth you toucheth the apple of his eye.

verses.name: Zechariah 2:9
verses.text: For, behold, I will shake mine hand upon them, and they shall be a spoil to their servants: and ye shall know that the Lord of hosts hath sent me.

verses.name: Zechariah 2:10
verses.text: ¶ Sing and rejoice, O daughter of Zion: for, lo, I come, and I will dwell in the midst of thee, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Zechariah 2:11
verses.text: And many nations shall be joined to the Lord in that day, and shall be my people: and I will dwell in the midst of thee, and thou shalt know that the Lord of hosts hath sent me unto thee.

verses.name: Zechariah 2:12
verses.text: And the Lord shall inherit Judah his portion in the holy land, and shall choose Jerusalem again.

verses.name: Zechariah 2:13
verses.text: Be silent, O all flesh, before the Lord: for he is raised up out of his holy habitation.  <chapter eID="Zech.2"/><div eID="gen995" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 3:1
verses.text: AND he shewed me Joshua the high priest standing before the angel of the Lord, and Satan standing at his right hand to resist him.

verses.name: Zechariah 3:2
verses.text: And the Lord said unto Satan, The Lord rebuke thee, O Satan; even the Lord that hath chosen Jerusalem rebuke thee: <hi type="italic">is</hi> not this a brand plucked out of the fire?

verses.name: Zechariah 3:3
verses.text: Now Joshua was clothed with filthy garments, and stood before the angel.

verses.name: Zechariah 3:4
verses.text: And he answered and spake unto those that stood before him, saying, Take away the filthy garments from him. And unto him he said, Behold, I have caused thine iniquity to pass from thee, and I will clothe thee with change of raiment.

verses.name: Zechariah 3:5
verses.text: And I said, Let them set a fair mitre upon his head. So they set a fair mitre upon his head, and clothed him with garments. And the angel of the Lord stood by.

verses.name: Zechariah 3:6
verses.text: And the angel of the Lord protested unto Joshua, saying,

verses.name: Zechariah 3:7
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; If thou wilt walk in my ways, and if thou wilt keep my charge, then thou shalt also judge my house, and shalt also keep my courts, and I will give thee places to walk among these that stand by.

verses.name: Zechariah 3:8
verses.text: Hear now, O Joshua the high priest, thou, and thy fellows that sit before thee: for they <hi type="italic">are</hi> men wondered at: for, behold, I will bring forth my servant the BRANCH.

verses.name: Zechariah 3:9
verses.text: For behold the stone that I have laid before Joshua; upon one stone <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> seven eyes: behold, I will engrave the graving thereof, saith the Lord of hosts, and I will remove the iniquity of that land in one day.

verses.name: Zechariah 3:10
verses.text: In that day, saith the Lord of hosts, shall ye call every man his neighbour under the vine and under the fig tree.  <chapter eID="Zech.3"/><div eID="gen996" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 4:1
verses.text: AND the angel that talked with me came again, and waked me, as a man that is wakened out of his sleep,

verses.name: Zechariah 4:2
verses.text: And said unto me, What seest thou? And I said, I have looked, and behold a candlestick all <hi type="italic">of</hi> gold, with a bowl upon the top of it, and his seven lamps thereon, and seven pipes to the seven lamps, which <hi type="italic">are</hi> upon the top thereof:

verses.name: Zechariah 4:3
verses.text: And two olive trees by it, one upon the right <hi type="italic">side</hi> of the bowl, and the other upon the left <hi type="italic">side</hi> thereof.

verses.name: Zechariah 4:4
verses.text: So I answered and spake to the angel that talked with me, saying, What <hi type="italic">are</hi> these, my lord?

verses.name: Zechariah 4:5
verses.text: Then the angel that talked with me answered and said unto me, Knowest thou not what these be? And I said, No, my lord.

verses.name: Zechariah 4:6
verses.text: Then he answered and spake unto me, saying, This <hi type="italic">is</hi> the word of the Lord unto Zerubbabel, saying, Not by might, nor by power, but by my spirit, saith the Lord of hosts.

verses.name: Zechariah 4:7
verses.text: Who <hi type="italic">art</hi> thou, O great mountain? before Zerubbabel <hi type="italic">thou shalt become</hi> a plain: and he shall bring forth the headstone <hi type="italic">thereof with</hi> shoutings, <hi type="italic">crying</hi>, Grace, grace unto it.

verses.name: Zechariah 4:8
verses.text: Moreover the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

verses.name: Zechariah 4:9
verses.text: The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house; his hands shall also finish it; and thou shalt know that the Lord of hosts hath sent me unto you.

verses.name: Zechariah 4:10
verses.text: For who hath despised the day of small things? for they shall rejoice, and shall see the plummet in the hand of Zerubbabel <hi type="italic">with</hi> those seven; they <hi type="italic">are</hi> the eyes of the Lord, which run to and fro through the whole earth.

verses.name: Zechariah 4:11
verses.text: ¶ Then answered I, and said unto him, What <hi type="italic">are</hi> these two olive trees upon the right <hi type="italic">side</hi> of the candlestick and upon the left <hi type="italic">side</hi> thereof?

verses.name: Zechariah 4:12
verses.text: And I answered again, and said unto him, What <hi type="italic">be these</hi> two olive branches which through the two golden pipes empty the golden <hi type="italic">oil</hi> out of themselves?

verses.name: Zechariah 4:13
verses.text: And he answered me and said, Knowest thou not what these <hi type="italic">be?</hi> And I said, No, my lord.

verses.name: Zechariah 4:14
verses.text: Then said he, These <hi type="italic">are</hi> the two anointed ones, that stand by the Lord of the whole earth.  <chapter eID="Zech.4"/><div eID="gen997" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 5:1
verses.text: THEN I turned, and lifted up mine eyes, and looked, and behold a flying roll.

verses.name: Zechariah 5:2
verses.text: And he said unto me, What seest thou? And I answered, I see a flying roll; the length thereof <hi type="italic">is</hi> twenty cubits, and the breadth thereof ten cubits.

verses.name: Zechariah 5:3
verses.text: Then said he unto me, This <hi type="italic">is</hi> the curse that goeth forth over the face of the whole earth: for every one that stealeth shall be cut off <hi type="italic">as</hi> on this side according to it; and every one that sweareth shall be cut off <hi type="italic">as</hi> on that side according to it.

verses.name: Zechariah 5:4
verses.text: I will bring it forth, saith the Lord of hosts, and it shall enter into the house of the thief, and into the house of him that sweareth falsely by my name: and it shall remain in the midst of his house, and shall consume it with the timber thereof and the stones thereof.

verses.name: Zechariah 5:5
verses.text: ¶ Then the angel that talked with me went forth, and said unto me, Lift up now thine eyes, and see what <hi type="italic">is</hi> this that goeth forth.

verses.name: Zechariah 5:6
verses.text: And I said, What <hi type="italic">is</hi> it? And he said, This <hi type="italic">is</hi> an ephah that goeth forth. He said moreover, This <hi type="italic">is</hi> their resemblance through all the earth.

verses.name: Zechariah 5:7
verses.text: And, behold, there was lifted up a talent of lead: and this <hi type="italic">is</hi> a woman that sitteth in the midst of the ephah.

verses.name: Zechariah 5:8
verses.text: And he said, This <hi type="italic">is</hi> wickedness. And he cast it into the midst of the ephah; and he cast the weight of lead upon the mouth thereof.

verses.name: Zechariah 5:9
verses.text: Then lifted I up mine eyes, and looked, and, behold, there came out two women, and the wind <hi type="italic">was</hi> in their wings; for they had wings like the wings of a stork: and they lifted up the ephah between the earth and the heaven.

verses.name: Zechariah 5:10
verses.text: Then said I to the angel that talked with me, Whither do these bear the ephah?

verses.name: Zechariah 5:11
verses.text: And he said unto me, To build it an house in the land of Shinar: and it shall be established, and set there upon her own base.  <chapter eID="Zech.5"/><div eID="gen998" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 6:1
verses.text: AND I turned, and lifted up mine eyes, and looked, and, behold, there came four chariots out from between two mountains; and the mountains <hi type="italic">were</hi> mountains of brass.

verses.name: Zechariah 6:2
verses.text: In the first chariot <hi type="italic">were</hi> red horses; and in the second chariot black horses;

verses.name: Zechariah 6:3
verses.text: And in the third chariot white horses; and in the fourth chariot grisled and bay horses.

verses.name: Zechariah 6:4
verses.text: Then I answered and said unto the angel that talked with me, What <hi type="italic">are</hi> these, my lord?

verses.name: Zechariah 6:5
verses.text: And the angel answered and said unto me, These <hi type="italic">are</hi> the four spirits of the heavens, which go forth from standing before the Lord of all the earth.

verses.name: Zechariah 6:6
verses.text: The black horses which <hi type="italic">are</hi> therein go forth into the north country; and the white go forth after them; and the grisled go forth toward the south country.

verses.name: Zechariah 6:7
verses.text: And the bay went forth, and sought to go that they might walk to and fro through the earth: and he said, Get you hence, walk to and fro through the earth. So they walked to and fro through the earth.

verses.name: Zechariah 6:8
verses.text: Then cried he upon me, and spake unto me, saying, Behold, these that go toward the north country have quieted my spirit in the north country.

verses.name: Zechariah 6:9
verses.text: ¶ And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

verses.name: Zechariah 6:10
verses.text: Take of <hi type="italic">them of</hi> the captivity, <hi type="italic">even</hi> of Heldai, of Tobijah, and of Jedaiah, which are come from Babylon, and come thou the same day, and go into the house of Josiah the son of Zephaniah;

verses.name: Zechariah 6:11
verses.text: Then take silver and gold, and make crowns, and set <hi type="italic">them</hi> upon the head of Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest;

verses.name: Zechariah 6:12
verses.text: And speak unto him, saying, Thus speaketh the Lord of hosts, saying, Behold the man whose name <hi type="italic">is</hi> The BRANCH; and he shall grow up out of his place, and he shall build the temple of the Lord:

verses.name: Zechariah 6:13
verses.text: Even he shall build the temple of the Lord; and he shall bear the glory, and shall sit and rule upon his throne; and he shall be a priest upon his throne: and the counsel of peace shall be between them both.

verses.name: Zechariah 6:14
verses.text: And the crowns shall be to Helem, and to Tobijah, and to Jedaiah, and to Hen the son of Zephaniah, for a memorial in the temple of the Lord.

verses.name: Zechariah 6:15
verses.text: And they <hi type="italic">that are</hi> far off shall come and build in the temple of the Lord, and ye shall know that the Lord of hosts hath sent me unto you. And <hi type="italic">this</hi> shall come to pass, if ye will diligently obey the voice of the Lord your God.  <chapter eID="Zech.6"/><div eID="gen999" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 7:1
verses.text: AND it came to pass in the fourth year of king Darius, <hi type="italic">that</hi> the word of the Lord came unto Zechariah in the fourth <hi type="italic">day</hi> of the ninth month, <hi type="italic">even</hi> in Chisleu;

verses.name: Zechariah 7:2
verses.text: When they had sent unto the house of God Sherezer and Regem-melech, and their men, to pray before the Lord,

verses.name: Zechariah 7:3
verses.text: <hi type="italic">And</hi> to speak unto the priests which <hi type="italic">were</hi> in the house of the Lord of hosts, and to the prophets, saying, Should I weep in the fifth month, separating myself, as I have done these so many years?

verses.name: Zechariah 7:4
verses.text: ¶ Then came the word of the Lord of hosts unto me, saying,

verses.name: Zechariah 7:5
verses.text: Speak unto all the people of the land, and to the priests, saying, When ye fasted and mourned in the fifth and seventh <hi type="italic">month</hi>, even those seventy years, did ye at all fast unto me, <hi type="italic">even</hi> to me?

verses.name: Zechariah 7:6
verses.text: And when ye did eat, and when ye did drink, did not ye eat <hi type="italic">for yourselves</hi>, and drink <hi type="italic">for yourselves?</hi>

verses.name: Zechariah 7:7
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Should ye</hi> not <hi type="italic">hear</hi> the words which the Lord hath cried by the former prophets, when Jerusalem was inhabited and in prosperity, and the cities thereof round about her, when <hi type="italic">men</hi> inhabited the south and the plain?

verses.name: Zechariah 7:8
verses.text: ¶ And the word of the Lord came unto Zechariah, saying,

verses.name: Zechariah 7:9
verses.text: Thus speaketh the Lord of hosts, saying, Execute true judgment, and shew mercy and compassions every man to his brother:

verses.name: Zechariah 7:10
verses.text: And oppress not the widow, nor the fatherless, the stranger, nor the poor; and let none of you imagine evil against his brother in your heart.

verses.name: Zechariah 7:11
verses.text: But they refused to hearken, and pulled away the shoulder, and stopped their ears, that they should not hear.

verses.name: Zechariah 7:12
verses.text: Yea, they made their hearts <hi type="italic">as</hi> an adamant stone, lest they should hear the law, and the words which the Lord of hosts hath sent in his spirit by the former prophets: therefore came a great wrath from the Lord of hosts.

verses.name: Zechariah 7:13
verses.text: Therefore it is come to pass, <hi type="italic">that</hi> as he cried, and they would not hear; so they cried, and I would not hear, saith the Lord of hosts:

verses.name: Zechariah 7:14
verses.text: But I scattered them with a whirlwind among all the nations whom they knew not. Thus the land was desolate after them, that no man passed through nor returned: for they laid the pleasant land desolate.  <chapter eID="Zech.7"/><div eID="gen1000" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 8:1
verses.text: AGAIN the word of the Lord of hosts came <hi type="italic">to me</hi>, saying,

verses.name: Zechariah 8:2
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; I was jealous for Zion with great jealousy, and I was jealous for her with great fury.

verses.name: Zechariah 8:3
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord; I am returned unto Zion, and will dwell in the midst of Jerusalem: and Jerusalem shall be called a city of truth; and the mountain of the Lord of hosts the holy mountain.

verses.name: Zechariah 8:4
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; There shall yet old men and old women dwell in the streets of Jerusalem, and every man with his staff in his hand for very age.

verses.name: Zechariah 8:5
verses.text: And the streets of the city shall be full of boys and girls playing in the streets thereof.

verses.name: Zechariah 8:6
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; If it be marvellous in the eyes of the remnant of this people in these days, should it also be marvellous in mine eyes? saith the Lord of hosts.

verses.name: Zechariah 8:7
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Behold, I will save my people from the east country, and from the west country;

verses.name: Zechariah 8:8
verses.text: And I will bring them, and they shall dwell in the midst of Jerusalem: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God, in truth and in righteousness.

verses.name: Zechariah 8:9
verses.text: ¶ Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Let your hands be strong, ye that hear in these days these words by the mouth of the prophets, which <hi type="italic">were</hi> in the day <hi type="italic">that</hi> the foundation of the house of the Lord of hosts was laid, that the temple might be built.

verses.name: Zechariah 8:10
verses.text: For before these days there was no hire for man, nor any hire for beast; neither <hi type="italic">was there any</hi> peace to him that went out or came in because of the affliction: for I set all men every one against his neighbour.

verses.name: Zechariah 8:11
verses.text: But now I <hi type="italic">will</hi> not <hi type="italic">be</hi> unto the residue of this people as in the former days, saith the Lord of hosts.

verses.name: Zechariah 8:12
verses.text: For the seed <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> prosperous; the vine shall give her fruit, and the ground shall give her increase, and the heavens shall give their dew; and I will cause the remnant of this people to possess all these <hi type="italic">things</hi>.

verses.name: Zechariah 8:13
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, <hi type="italic">that</hi> as ye were a curse among the heathen, O house of Judah, and house of Israel; so will I save you, and ye shall be a blessing: fear not, <hi type="italic">but</hi> let your hands be strong.

verses.name: Zechariah 8:14
verses.text: For thus saith the Lord of hosts; As I thought to punish you, when your fathers provoked me to wrath, saith the Lord of hosts, and I repented not:

verses.name: Zechariah 8:15
verses.text: So again have I thought in these days to do well unto Jerusalem and to the house of Judah: fear ye not.

verses.name: Zechariah 8:16
verses.text: ¶ These <hi type="italic">are</hi> the things that ye shall do; Speak ye every man the truth to his neighbour; execute the judgment of truth and peace in your gates:

verses.name: Zechariah 8:17
verses.text: And let none of you imagine evil in your hearts against his neighbour; and love no false oath: for all these <hi type="italic">are things</hi> that I hate, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Zechariah 8:18
verses.text: ¶ And the word of the Lord of hosts came unto me, saying,

verses.name: Zechariah 8:19
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; The fast of the fourth <hi type="italic">month</hi>, and the fast of the fifth, and the fast of the seventh, and the fast of the tenth, shall be to the house of Judah joy and gladness, and cheerful feasts; therefore love the truth and peace.

verses.name: Zechariah 8:20
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; <hi type="italic">It shall</hi> yet <hi type="italic">come to pass</hi>, that there shall come people, and the inhabitants of many cities:

verses.name: Zechariah 8:21
verses.text: And the inhabitants of one <hi type="italic">city</hi> shall go to another, saying, Let us go speedily to pray before the Lord, and to seek the Lord of hosts: I will go also.

verses.name: Zechariah 8:22
verses.text: Yea, many people and strong nations shall come to seek the Lord of hosts in Jerusalem, and to pray before the Lord.

verses.name: Zechariah 8:23
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; In those days <hi type="italic">it shall come to pass</hi>, that ten men shall take hold out of all languages of the nations, even shall take hold of the skirt of him that is a Jew, saying, We will go with you: for we have heard <hi type="italic">that</hi> God <hi type="italic">is</hi> with you.  <chapter eID="Zech.8"/><div eID="gen1001" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 9:1
verses.text: THE burden of the word of the Lord in the land of Hadrach, and Damascus <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> the rest thereof: when the eyes of man, as of all the tribes of Israel, <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> toward the Lord.

verses.name: Zechariah 9:2
verses.text: And Hamath also shall border thereby; Tyrus, and Zidon, though it be very wise.

verses.name: Zechariah 9:3
verses.text: And Tyrus did build herself a strong hold, and heaped up silver as the dust, and fine gold as the mire of the streets.

verses.name: Zechariah 9:4
verses.text: Behold, the Lord will cast her out, and he will smite her power in the sea; and she shall be devoured with fire.

verses.name: Zechariah 9:5
verses.text: Ashkelon shall see <hi type="italic">it</hi>, and fear; Gaza also <hi type="italic">shall see it</hi>, and be very sorrowful, and Ekron; for her expectation shall be ashamed; and the king shall perish from Gaza, and Ashkelon shall not be inhabited.

verses.name: Zechariah 9:6
verses.text: And a bastard shall dwell in Ashdod, and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines.

verses.name: Zechariah 9:7
verses.text: And I will take away his blood out of his mouth, and his abominations from between his teeth: but he that remaineth, even he, <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> for our God, and he shall be as a governor in Judah, and Ekron as a Jebusite.

verses.name: Zechariah 9:8
verses.text: And I will encamp about mine house because of the army, because of him that passeth by, and because of him that returneth: and no oppressor shall pass through them any more: for now have I seen with mine eyes.

verses.name: Zechariah 9:9
verses.text: ¶ Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion; shout, O daughter of Jerusalem: behold, thy King cometh unto thee: he <hi type="italic">is</hi> just, and having salvation; lowly, and riding upon an ass, and upon a colt the foal of an ass.

verses.name: Zechariah 9:10
verses.text: And I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim, and the horse from Jerusalem, and the battle bow shall be cut off: and he shall speak peace unto the heathen: and his dominion <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> from sea <hi type="italic">even</hi> to sea, and from the river <hi type="italic">even</hi> to the ends of the earth.

verses.name: Zechariah 9:11
verses.text: As for thee also, by the blood of thy covenant I have sent forth thy prisoners out of the pit wherein <hi type="italic">is</hi> no water.

verses.name: Zechariah 9:12
verses.text: ¶ Turn you to the strong hold, ye prisoners of hope: even to day do I declare <hi type="italic">that</hi> I will render double unto thee;

verses.name: Zechariah 9:13
verses.text: When I have bent Judah for me, filled the bow with Ephraim, and raised up thy sons, O Zion, against thy sons, O Greece, and made thee as the sword of a mighty man.

verses.name: Zechariah 9:14
verses.text: And the Lord shall be seen over them, and his arrow shall go forth as the lightning: and the Lord God shall blow the trumpet, and shall go with whirlwinds of the south.

verses.name: Zechariah 9:15
verses.text: The Lord of hosts shall defend them; and they shall devour, and subdue with sling stones; and they shall drink, <hi type="italic">and</hi> make a noise as through wine; and they shall be filled like bowls, <hi type="italic">and</hi> as the corners of the altar.

verses.name: Zechariah 9:16
verses.text: And the Lord their God shall save them in that day as the flock of his people: for <hi type="italic">they shall be as</hi> the stones of a crown, lifted up as an ensign upon his land.

verses.name: Zechariah 9:17
verses.text: For how great <hi type="italic">is</hi> his goodness, and how great <hi type="italic">is</hi> his beauty! corn shall make the young men cheerful, and new wine the maids.  <chapter eID="Zech.9"/><div eID="gen1002" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 10:1
verses.text: ASK ye of the Lord rain in the time of the latter rain; <hi type="italic">so</hi> the Lord shall make bright clouds, and give them showers of rain, to every one grass in the field.

verses.name: Zechariah 10:2
verses.text: For the idols have spoken vanity, and the diviners have seen a lie, and have told false dreams; they comfort in vain: therefore they went their way as a flock, they were troubled, because <hi type="italic">there was</hi> no shepherd.

verses.name: Zechariah 10:3
verses.text: Mine anger was kindled against the shepherds, and I punished the goats: for the Lord of hosts hath visited his flock the house of Judah, and hath made them as his goodly horse in the battle.

verses.name: Zechariah 10:4
verses.text: Out of him came forth the corner, out of him the nail, out of him the battle bow, out of him every oppressor together.

verses.name: Zechariah 10:5
verses.text: ¶ And they shall be as mighty <hi type="italic">men</hi>, which tread down <hi type="italic">their enemies</hi> in the mire of the streets in the battle: and they shall fight, because the Lord <hi type="italic">is</hi> with them, and the riders on horses shall be confounded.

verses.name: Zechariah 10:6
verses.text: And I will strengthen the house of Judah, and I will save the house of Joseph, and I will bring them again to place them; for I have mercy upon them: and they shall be as though I had not cast them off: for I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord their God, and will hear them.

verses.name: Zechariah 10:7
verses.text: And <hi type="italic">they of</hi> Ephraim shall be like a mighty <hi type="italic">man</hi>, and their heart shall rejoice as through wine: yea, their children shall see <hi type="italic">it</hi>, and be glad; their heart shall rejoice in the Lord.

verses.name: Zechariah 10:8
verses.text: I will hiss for them, and gather them; for I have redeemed them: and they shall increase as they have increased.

verses.name: Zechariah 10:9
verses.text: And I will sow them among the people: and they shall remember me in far countries; and they shall live with their children, and turn again.

verses.name: Zechariah 10:10
verses.text: I will bring them again also out of the land of Egypt, and gather them out of Assyria; and I will bring them into the land of Gilead and Lebanon; and <hi type="italic">place</hi> shall not be found for them.

verses.name: Zechariah 10:11
verses.text: And he shall pass through the sea with affliction, and shall smite the waves in the sea, and all the deeps of the river shall dry up: and the pride of Assyria shall be brought down, and the sceptre of Egypt shall depart away.

verses.name: Zechariah 10:12
verses.text: And I will strengthen them in the Lord; and they shall walk up and down in his name, saith the Lord.  <chapter eID="Zech.10"/><div eID="gen1003" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 11:1
verses.text: OPEN thy doors, O Lebanon, that the fire may devour thy cedars.

verses.name: Zechariah 11:2
verses.text: Howl, fir tree; for the cedar is fallen; because the mighty are spoiled: howl, O ye oaks of Bashan; for the forest of the vintage is come down.

verses.name: Zechariah 11:3
verses.text: ¶ <hi type="italic">There is</hi> a voice of the howling of the shepherds; for their glory is spoiled: a voice of the roaring of young lions; for the pride of Jordan is spoiled.

verses.name: Zechariah 11:4
verses.text: Thus saith the Lord my God; Feed the flock of the slaughter;

verses.name: Zechariah 11:5
verses.text: Whose possessors slay them, and hold themselves not guilty: and they that sell them say, Blessed <hi type="italic">be</hi> the Lord; for I am rich: and their own shepherds pity them not.

verses.name: Zechariah 11:6
verses.text: For I will no more pity the inhabitants of the land, saith the Lord: but, lo, I will deliver the men every one into his neighbour’s hand, and into the hand of his king: and they shall smite the land, and out of their hand I will not deliver <hi type="italic">them</hi>.

verses.name: Zechariah 11:7
verses.text: And I will feed the flock of slaughter, <hi type="italic">even</hi> you, O poor of the flock. And I took unto me two staves; the one I called Beauty, and the other I called Bands; and I fed the flock.

verses.name: Zechariah 11:8
verses.text: Three shepherds also I cut off in one month; and my soul lothed them, and their soul also abhorred me.

verses.name: Zechariah 11:9
verses.text: Then said I, I will not feed you: that that dieth, let it die; and that that is to be cut off, let it be cut off; and let the rest eat every one the flesh of another.

verses.name: Zechariah 11:10
verses.text: ¶ And I took my staff, <hi type="italic">even</hi> Beauty, and cut it asunder, that I might break my covenant which I had made with all the people.

verses.name: Zechariah 11:11
verses.text: And it was broken in that day: and so the poor of the flock that waited upon me knew that it <hi type="italic">was</hi> the word of the Lord.

verses.name: Zechariah 11:12
verses.text: And I said unto them, If ye think good, give <hi type="italic">me</hi> my price; and if not, forbear. So they weighed for my price thirty <hi type="italic">pieces</hi> of silver.

verses.name: Zechariah 11:13
verses.text: And the Lord said unto me, Cast it unto the potter: a goodly price that I was prised at of them. And I took the thirty <hi type="italic">pieces</hi> of silver, and cast them to the potter in the house of the Lord.

verses.name: Zechariah 11:14
verses.text: Then I cut asunder mine other staff, <hi type="italic">even</hi> Bands, that I might break the brotherhood between Judah and Israel.

verses.name: Zechariah 11:15
verses.text: ¶ And the Lord said unto me, Take unto thee yet the instruments of a foolish shepherd.

verses.name: Zechariah 11:16
verses.text: For, lo, I will raise up a shepherd in the land, <hi type="italic">which</hi> shall not visit those that be cut off, neither shall seek the young one, nor heal that that is broken, nor feed that that standeth still: but he shall eat the flesh of the fat, and tear their claws in pieces.

verses.name: Zechariah 11:17
verses.text: Woe to the idol shepherd that leaveth the flock! the sword <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> upon his arm, and upon his right eye: his arm shall be clean dried up, and his right eye shall be utterly darkened.  <chapter eID="Zech.11"/><div eID="gen1004" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 12:1
verses.text: THE burden of the word of the Lord for Israel, saith the Lord, which stretcheth forth the heavens, and layeth the foundation of the earth, and formeth the spirit of man within him.

verses.name: Zechariah 12:2
verses.text: Behold, I will make Jerusalem a cup of trembling unto all the people round about, when they shall be in the siege both against Judah <hi type="italic">and</hi> against Jerusalem.

verses.name: Zechariah 12:3
verses.text: ¶ And in that day will I make Jerusalem a burdensome stone for all people: all that burden themselves with it shall be cut in pieces, though all the people of the earth be gathered together against it.

verses.name: Zechariah 12:4
verses.text: In that day, saith the Lord, I will smite every horse with astonishment, and his rider with madness: and I will open mine eyes upon the house of Judah, and will smite every horse of the people with blindness.

verses.name: Zechariah 12:5
verses.text: And the governors of Judah shall say in their heart, The inhabitants of Jerusalem <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> my strength in the Lord of hosts their God.

verses.name: Zechariah 12:6
verses.text: ¶ In that day will I make the governors of Judah like an hearth of fire among the wood, and like a torch of fire in a sheaf; and they shall devour all the people round about, on the right hand and on the left: and Jerusalem shall be inhabited again in her own place, <hi type="italic">even</hi> in Jerusalem.

verses.name: Zechariah 12:7
verses.text: The Lord also shall save the tents of Judah first, that the glory of the house of David and the glory of the inhabitants of Jerusalem do not magnify <hi type="italic">themselves</hi> against Judah.

verses.name: Zechariah 12:8
verses.text: In that day shall the Lord defend the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and he that is feeble among them at that day shall be as David; and the house of David <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> as God, as the angel of the Lord before them.

verses.name: Zechariah 12:9
verses.text: ¶ And it shall come to pass in that day, <hi type="italic">that</hi> I will seek to destroy all the nations that come against Jerusalem.

verses.name: Zechariah 12:10
verses.text: And I will pour upon the house of David, and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the spirit of grace and of supplications: and they shall look upon me whom they have pierced, and they shall mourn for him, as one mourneth for <hi type="italic">his</hi> only <hi type="italic">son</hi>, and shall be in bitterness for him, as one that is in bitterness for <hi type="italic">his</hi> firstborn.

verses.name: Zechariah 12:11
verses.text: In that day shall there be a great mourning in Jerusalem, as the mourning of Hadadrimmon in the valley of Megiddon.

verses.name: Zechariah 12:12
verses.text: And the land shall mourn, every family apart; the family of the house of David apart, and their wives apart; the family of the house of Nathan apart, and their wives apart;

verses.name: Zechariah 12:13
verses.text: The family of the house of Levi apart, and their wives apart; the family of Shimei apart, and their wives apart;

verses.name: Zechariah 12:14
verses.text: All the families that remain, every family apart, and their wives apart.  <chapter eID="Zech.12"/><div eID="gen1005" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 13:1
verses.text: IN that day there shall be a fountain opened to the house of David and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem for sin and for uncleanness.

verses.name: Zechariah 13:2
verses.text: ¶ And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the Lord of hosts, <hi type="italic">that</hi> I will cut off the names of the idols out of the land, and they shall no more be remembered: and also I will cause the prophets and the unclean spirit to pass out of the land.

verses.name: Zechariah 13:3
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, <hi type="italic">that</hi> when any shall yet prophesy, then his father and his mother that begat him shall say unto him, Thou shalt not live; for thou speakest lies in the name of the Lord: and his father and his mother that begat him shall thrust him through when he prophesieth.

verses.name: Zechariah 13:4
verses.text: And it shall come to pass in that day, <hi type="italic">that</hi> the prophets shall be ashamed every one of his vision, when he hath prophesied; neither shall they wear a rough garment to deceive:

verses.name: Zechariah 13:5
verses.text: But he shall say, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> no prophet, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> an husbandman; for man taught me to keep cattle from my youth.

verses.name: Zechariah 13:6
verses.text: And <hi type="italic">one</hi> shall say unto him, What <hi type="italic">are</hi> these wounds in thine hands? Then he shall answer, <hi type="italic">Those</hi> with which I was wounded <hi type="italic">in</hi> the house of my friends.

verses.name: Zechariah 13:7
verses.text: ¶ Awake, O sword, against my shepherd, and against the man <hi type="italic">that is</hi> my fellow, saith the Lord of hosts: smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered: and I will turn mine hand upon the little ones.

verses.name: Zechariah 13:8
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, <hi type="italic">that</hi> in all the land, saith the Lord, two parts therein shall be cut off <hi type="italic">and</hi> die; but the third shall be left therein.

verses.name: Zechariah 13:9
verses.text: And I will bring the third part through the fire, and will refine them as silver is refined, and will try them as gold is tried: they shall call on my name, and I will hear them: I will say, It <hi type="italic">is</hi> my people: and they shall say, The Lord <hi type="italic">is</hi> my God.  <chapter eID="Zech.13"/><div eID="gen1006" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 14:1
verses.text: BEHOLD, the day of the Lord cometh, and thy spoil shall be divided in the midst of thee.

verses.name: Zechariah 14:2
verses.text: For I will gather all nations against Jerusalem to battle; and the city shall be taken, and the houses rifled, and the women ravished; and half of the city shall go forth into captivity, and the residue of the people shall not be cut off from the city.

verses.name: Zechariah 14:3
verses.text: Then shall the Lord go forth, and fight against those nations, as when he fought in the day of battle.

verses.name: Zechariah 14:4
verses.text: ¶ And his feet shall stand in that day upon the mount of Olives, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> before Jerusalem on the east, and the mount of Olives shall cleave in the midst thereof toward the east and toward the west, <hi type="italic">and there shall be</hi> a very great valley; and half of the mountain shall remove toward the north, and half of it toward the south.

verses.name: Zechariah 14:5
verses.text: And ye shall flee <hi type="italic">to</hi> the valley of the mountains; for the valley of the mountains shall reach unto Azal: yea, ye shall flee, like as ye fled from before the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah: and the Lord my God shall come, <hi type="italic">and</hi> all the saints with thee.

verses.name: Zechariah 14:6
verses.text: And it shall come to pass in that day, <hi type="italic">that</hi> the light shall not be clear, <hi type="italic">nor</hi> dark:

verses.name: Zechariah 14:7
verses.text: But it shall be one day which shall be known to the Lord, not day, nor night: but it shall come to pass, <hi type="italic">that</hi> at evening time it shall be light.

verses.name: Zechariah 14:8
verses.text: And it shall be in that day, <hi type="italic">that</hi> living waters shall go out from Jerusalem; half of them toward the former sea, and half of them toward the hinder sea: in summer and in winter shall it be.

verses.name: Zechariah 14:9
verses.text: And the Lord shall be king over all the earth: in that day shall there be one Lord, and his name one.

verses.name: Zechariah 14:10
verses.text: All the land shall be turned as a plain from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem: and it shall be lifted up, and inhabited in her place, from Benjamin’s gate unto the place of the first gate, unto the corner gate, and <hi type="italic">from</hi> the tower of Hananeel unto the king’s winepresses.

verses.name: Zechariah 14:11
verses.text: And <hi type="italic">men</hi> shall dwell in it, and there shall be no more utter destruction; but Jerusalem shall be safely inhabited.

verses.name: Zechariah 14:12
verses.text: ¶ And this shall be the plague wherewith the Lord will smite all the people that have fought against Jerusalem; Their flesh shall consume away while they stand upon their feet, and their eyes shall consume away in their holes, and their tongue shall consume away in their mouth.

verses.name: Zechariah 14:13
verses.text: And it shall come to pass in that day, <hi type="italic">that</hi> a great tumult from the Lord shall be among them; and they shall lay hold every one on the hand of his neighbour, and his hand shall rise up against the hand of his neighbour.

verses.name: Zechariah 14:14
verses.text: And Judah also shall fight at Jerusalem; and the wealth of all the heathen round about shall be gathered together, gold, and silver, and apparel, in great abundance.

verses.name: Zechariah 14:15
verses.text: And so shall be the plague of the horse, of the mule, of the camel, and of the ass, and of all the beasts that shall be in these tents, as this plague.

verses.name: Zechariah 14:16
verses.text: ¶ And it shall come to pass, <hi type="italic">that</hi> every one that is left of all the nations which came against Jerusalem shall even go up from year to year to worship the King, the Lord of hosts, and to keep the feast of tabernacles.

verses.name: Zechariah 14:17
verses.text: And it shall be, <hi type="italic">that</hi> whoso will not come up of <hi type="italic">all</hi> the families of the earth unto Jerusalem to worship the King, the Lord of hosts, even upon them shall be no rain.

verses.name: Zechariah 14:18
verses.text: And if the family of Egypt go not up, and come not, that <hi type="italic">have</hi> no <hi type="italic">rain;</hi> there shall be the plague, wherewith the Lord will smite the heathen that come not up to keep the feast of tabernacles.

verses.name: Zechariah 14:19
verses.text: This shall be the punishment of Egypt, and the punishment of all nations that come not up to keep the feast of tabernacles.

verses.name: Zechariah 14:20
verses.text: ¶ In that day shall there be upon the bells of the horses, HOLINESS UNTO THE LORD; and the pots in the Lord’s house shall be like the bowls before the altar.

verses.name: Zechariah 14:21
verses.text: Yea, every pot in Jerusalem and in Judah shall be holiness unto the Lord of hosts: and all they that sacrifice shall come and take of them, and seethe therein: and in that day there shall be no more the Canaanite in the house of the Lord of hosts.  <chapter eID="Zech.14"/><div eID="gen1007" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen993" osisID="Zech" type="book"/>

verses.name: Malachi 1:1
verses.text: THE burden of the word of the Lord to Israel by Malachi.

verses.name: Malachi 1:2
verses.text: I have loved you, saith the Lord. Yet ye say, Wherein hast thou loved us? <hi type="italic">Was</hi> not Esau Jacob’s brother? saith the Lord: yet I loved Jacob,

verses.name: Malachi 1:3
verses.text: And I hated Esau, and laid his mountains and his heritage waste for the dragons of the wilderness.

verses.name: Malachi 1:4
verses.text: Whereas Edom saith, We are impoverished, but we will return and build the desolate places; thus saith the Lord of hosts, They shall build, but I will throw down; and they shall call them, The border of wickedness, and, The people against whom the Lord hath indignation for ever.

verses.name: Malachi 1:5
verses.text: And your eyes shall see, and ye shall say, The Lord will be magnified from the border of Israel.

verses.name: Malachi 1:6
verses.text: ¶ A son honoureth <hi type="italic">his</hi> father, and a servant his master: if then I <hi type="italic">be</hi> a father, where <hi type="italic">is</hi> mine honour? and if I <hi type="italic">be</hi> a master, where <hi type="italic">is</hi> my fear? saith the Lord of hosts unto you, O priests, that despise my name. And ye say, Wherein have we despised thy name?

verses.name: Malachi 1:7
verses.text: Ye offer polluted bread upon mine altar; and ye say, Wherein have we polluted thee? In that ye say, The table of the Lord <hi type="italic">is</hi> contemptible.

verses.name: Malachi 1:8
verses.text: And if ye offer the blind for sacrifice, <hi type="italic">is it</hi> not evil? and if ye offer the lame and sick, <hi type="italic">is it</hi> not evil? offer it now unto thy governor; will he be pleased with thee, or accept thy person? saith the Lord of hosts.

verses.name: Malachi 1:9
verses.text: And now, I pray you, beseech God that he will be gracious unto us: this hath been by your means: will he regard your persons? saith the Lord of hosts.

verses.name: Malachi 1:10
verses.text: Who <hi type="italic">is there</hi> even among you that would shut the doors <hi type="italic">for nought?</hi> neither do ye kindle <hi type="italic">fire</hi> on mine altar for nought. I have no pleasure in you, saith the Lord of hosts, neither will I accept an offering at your hand.

verses.name: Malachi 1:11
verses.text: For from the rising of the sun even unto the going down of the same my name <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> great among the Gentiles; and in every place incense <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> offered unto my name, and a pure offering: for my name <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> great among the heathen, saith the Lord of hosts.

verses.name: Malachi 1:12
verses.text: ¶ But ye have profaned it, in that ye say, The table of the Lord <hi type="italic">is</hi> polluted; and the fruit thereof, <hi type="italic">even</hi> his meat, <hi type="italic">is</hi> contemptible.

verses.name: Malachi 1:13
verses.text: Ye said also, Behold, what a weariness <hi type="italic">is it!</hi> and ye have snuffed at it, saith the Lord of hosts; and ye brought <hi type="italic">that which was</hi> torn, and the lame, and the sick; thus ye brought an offering: should I accept this of your hand? saith the Lord.

verses.name: Malachi 1:14
verses.text: But cursed <hi type="italic">be</hi> the deceiver, which hath in his flock a male, and voweth, and sacrificeth unto the Lord a corrupt thing: for I <hi type="italic">am</hi> a great King, saith the Lord of hosts, and my name <hi type="italic">is</hi> dreadful among the heathen.  <chapter eID="Mal.1"/><div eID="gen1009" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Malachi 2:1
verses.text: AND now, O ye priests, this commandment <hi type="italic">is</hi> for you.

verses.name: Malachi 2:2
verses.text: If ye will not hear, and if ye will not lay <hi type="italic">it</hi> to heart, to give glory unto my name, saith the Lord of hosts, I will even send a curse upon you, and I will curse your blessings: yea, I have cursed them already, because ye do not lay <hi type="italic">it</hi> to heart.

verses.name: Malachi 2:3
verses.text: Behold, I will corrupt your seed, and spread dung upon your faces, <hi type="italic">even</hi> the dung of your solemn feasts; and <hi type="italic">one</hi> shall take you away with it.

verses.name: Malachi 2:4
verses.text: And ye shall know that I have sent this commandment unto you, that my covenant might be with Levi, saith the Lord of hosts.

verses.name: Malachi 2:5
verses.text: My covenant was with him of life and peace; and I gave them to him <hi type="italic">for</hi> the fear wherewith he feared me, and was afraid before my name.

verses.name: Malachi 2:6
verses.text: The law of truth was in his mouth, and iniquity was not found in his lips: he walked with me in peace and equity, and did turn many away from iniquity.

verses.name: Malachi 2:7
verses.text: For the priest’s lips should keep knowledge, and they should seek the law at his mouth: for he <hi type="italic">is</hi> the messenger of the Lord of hosts.

verses.name: Malachi 2:8
verses.text: But ye are departed out of the way; ye have caused many to stumble at the law; ye have corrupted the covenant of Levi, saith the Lord of hosts.

verses.name: Malachi 2:9
verses.text: Therefore have I also made you contemptible and base before all the people, according as ye have not kept my ways, but have been partial in the law.

verses.name: Malachi 2:10
verses.text: Have we not all one father? hath not one God created us? why do we deal treacherously every man against his brother, by profaning the covenant of our fathers?

verses.name: Malachi 2:11
verses.text: ¶ Judah hath dealt treacherously, and an abomination is committed in Israel and in Jerusalem; for Judah hath profaned the holiness of the Lord which he loved, and hath married the daughter of a strange god.

verses.name: Malachi 2:12
verses.text: The Lord will cut off the man that doeth this, the master and the scholar, out of the tabernacles of Jacob, and him that offereth an offering unto the Lord of hosts.

verses.name: Malachi 2:13
verses.text: And this have ye done again, covering the altar of the Lord with tears, with weeping, and with crying out, insomuch that he regardeth not the offering any more, or receiveth <hi type="italic">it</hi> with good will at your hand.

verses.name: Malachi 2:14
verses.text: ¶ Yet ye say, Wherefore? Because the Lord hath been witness between thee and the wife of thy youth, against whom thou hast dealt treacherously: yet <hi type="italic">is</hi> she thy companion, and the wife of thy covenant.

verses.name: Malachi 2:15
verses.text: And did not he make one? Yet had he the residue of the spirit. And wherefore one? That he might seek a godly seed. Therefore take heed to your spirit, and let none deal treacherously against the wife of his youth.

verses.name: Malachi 2:16
verses.text: For the Lord, the God of Israel, saith that he hateth putting away: for <hi type="italic">one</hi> covereth violence with his garment, saith the Lord of hosts: therefore take heed to your spirit, that ye deal not treacherously.

verses.name: Malachi 2:17
verses.text: ¶ Ye have wearied the Lord with your words. Yet ye say, Wherein have we wearied <hi type="italic">him?</hi> When ye say, Every one that doeth evil <hi type="italic">is</hi> good in the sight of the Lord, and he delighteth in them; or, Where <hi type="italic">is</hi> the God of judgment?  <chapter eID="Mal.2"/><div eID="gen1010" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Malachi 3:1
verses.text: BEHOLD, I will send my messenger, and he shall prepare the way before me: and the Lord, whom ye seek, shall suddenly come to his temple, even the messenger of the covenant, whom ye delight in: behold, he shall come, saith the Lord of hosts.

verses.name: Malachi 3:2
verses.text: But who may abide the day of his coming? and who shall stand when he appeareth? for he <hi type="italic">is</hi> like a refiner’s fire, and like fullers’ soap:

verses.name: Malachi 3:3
verses.text: And he shall sit <hi type="italic">as</hi> a refiner and purifier of silver: and he shall purify the sons of Levi, and purge them as gold and silver, that they may offer unto the Lord an offering in righteousness.

verses.name: Malachi 3:4
verses.text: Then shall the offering of Judah and Jerusalem be pleasant unto the Lord, as in the days of old, and as in former years.

verses.name: Malachi 3:5
verses.text: And I will come near to you to judgment; and I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers, and against the adulterers, and against false swearers, and against those that oppress the hireling in <hi type="italic">his</hi> wages, the widow, and the fatherless, and that turn aside the stranger <hi type="italic">from his right</hi>, and fear not me, saith the Lord of hosts.

verses.name: Malachi 3:6
verses.text: For I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the Lord, I change not; therefore ye sons of Jacob are not consumed.

verses.name: Malachi 3:7
verses.text: ¶ Even from the days of your fathers ye are gone away from mine ordinances, and have not kept <hi type="italic">them</hi>. Return unto me, and I will return unto you, saith the Lord of hosts. But ye said, Wherein shall we return?

verses.name: Malachi 3:8
verses.text: ¶ Will a man rob God? Yet ye have robbed me. But ye say, Wherein have we robbed thee? In tithes and offerings.

verses.name: Malachi 3:9
verses.text: Ye <hi type="italic">are</hi> cursed with a curse: for ye have robbed me, <hi type="italic">even</hi> this whole nation.

verses.name: Malachi 3:10
verses.text: Bring ye all the tithes into the storehouse, that there may be meat in mine house, and prove me now herewith, saith the Lord of hosts, if I will not open you the windows of heaven, and pour you out a blessing, that <hi type="italic">there shall</hi> not <hi type="italic">be room</hi> enough <hi type="italic">to receive it</hi>.

verses.name: Malachi 3:11
verses.text: And I will rebuke the devourer for your sakes, and he shall not destroy the fruits of your ground; neither shall your vine cast her fruit before the time in the field, saith the Lord of hosts.

verses.name: Malachi 3:12
verses.text: And all nations shall call you blessed: for ye shall be a delightsome land, saith the Lord of hosts.

verses.name: Malachi 3:13
verses.text: ¶ Your words have been stout against me, saith the Lord. Yet ye say, What have we spoken <hi type="italic">so much</hi> against thee?

verses.name: Malachi 3:14
verses.text: Ye have said, It <hi type="italic">is</hi> vain to serve God: and what profit <hi type="italic">is it</hi> that we have kept his ordinance, and that we have walked mournfully before the Lord of hosts?

verses.name: Malachi 3:15
verses.text: And now we call the proud happy; yea, they that work wickedness are set up; yea, <hi type="italic">they that</hi> tempt God are even delivered.

verses.name: Malachi 3:16
verses.text: ¶ Then they that feared the Lord spake often one to another: and the Lord hearkened, and heard <hi type="italic">it</hi>, and a book of remembrance was written before him for them that feared the Lord, and that thought upon his name.

verses.name: Malachi 3:17
verses.text: And they shall be mine, saith the Lord of hosts, in that day when I make up my jewels; and I will spare them, as a man spareth his own son that serveth him.

verses.name: Malachi 3:18
verses.text: Then shall ye return, and discern between the righteous and the wicked, between him that serveth God and him that serveth him not.  <chapter eID="Mal.3"/><div eID="gen1011" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Malachi 4:1
verses.text: FOR, behold, the day cometh, that shall burn as an oven; and all the proud, yea, and all that do wickedly, shall be stubble: and the day that cometh shall burn them up, saith the Lord of hosts, that it shall leave them neither root nor branch.

verses.name: Malachi 4:2
verses.text: ¶ But unto you that fear my name shall the Sun of righteousness arise with healing in his wings; and ye shall go forth, and grow up as calves of the stall.

verses.name: Malachi 4:3
verses.text: And ye shall tread down the wicked; for they shall be ashes under the soles of your feet in the day that I shall do <hi type="italic">this</hi>, saith the Lord of hosts.

verses.name: Malachi 4:4
verses.text: ¶ Remember ye the law of Moses my servant, which I commanded unto him in Horeb for all Israel, <hi type="italic">with</hi> the statutes and judgments.

verses.name: Malachi 4:5
verses.text: ¶ Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the coming of the great and dreadful day of the Lord:

verses.name: Malachi 4:6
verses.text: And he shall turn the heart of the fathers to the children, and the heart of the children to their fathers, lest I come and smite the earth with a curse. <div eID="gen1012" type="x-p"/> <chapter eID="Mal.4"/> <title type="x-s">THE END OF THE PROPHETS.</title> <div canonical="true" eID="gen1008" osisID="Mal" type="book"/>

verses.name: Matthew 1:1
verses.text: THE book of the generation of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.

verses.name: Matthew 1:2
verses.text: Abraham begat Isaac; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat Judas and his brethren;

verses.name: Matthew 1:3
verses.text: And Judas begat Phares and Zara of Thamar; and Phares begat Esrom; and Esrom begat Aram;

verses.name: Matthew 1:4
verses.text: And Aram begat Aminadab; and Aminadab begat Naasson; and Naasson begat Salmon;

verses.name: Matthew 1:5
verses.text: And Salmon begat Booz of Rachab; and Booz begat Obed of Ruth; and Obed begat Jesse;

verses.name: Matthew 1:6
verses.text: And Jesse begat David the king; and David the king begat Solomon of her <hi type="italic">that had been the wife</hi> of Urias;

verses.name: Matthew 1:7
verses.text: And Solomon begat Roboam; and Roboam begat Abia; and Abia begat Asa;

verses.name: Matthew 1:8
verses.text: And Asa begat Josaphat; and Josaphat begat Joram; and Joram begat Ozias;

verses.name: Matthew 1:9
verses.text: And Ozias begat Joatham; and Joatham begat Achaz; and Achaz begat Ezekias;

verses.name: Matthew 1:10
verses.text: And Ezekias begat Manasses; and Manasses begat Amon; and Amon begat Josias;

verses.name: Matthew 1:11
verses.text: And Josias begat Jechonias and his brethren, about the time they were carried away to Babylon:

verses.name: Matthew 1:12
verses.text: And after they were brought to Babylon, Jechonias begat Salathiel; and Salathiel begat Zorobabel;

verses.name: Matthew 1:13
verses.text: And Zorobabel begat Abiud; and Abiud begat Eliakim; and Eliakim begat Azor;

verses.name: Matthew 1:14
verses.text: And Azor begat Sadoc; and Sadoc begat Achim; and Achim begat Eliud;

verses.name: Matthew 1:15
verses.text: And Eliud begat Eleazar; and Eleazar begat Matthan; and Matthan begat Jacob;

verses.name: Matthew 1:16
verses.text: And Jacob begat Joseph the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.

verses.name: Matthew 1:17
verses.text: So all the generations from Abraham to David <hi type="italic">are</hi> fourteen generations; and from David until the carrying away into Babylon <hi type="italic">are</hi> fourteen generations; and from the carrying away into Babylon unto Christ <hi type="italic">are</hi> fourteen generations.

verses.name: Matthew 1:18
verses.text: ¶ Now the birth of Jesus Christ was on this wise: When as his mother Mary was espoused to Joseph, before they came together, she was found with child of the Holy Ghost.

verses.name: Matthew 1:19
verses.text: Then Joseph her husband, being a just <hi type="italic">man</hi>, and not willing to make her a publick example, was minded to put her away privily.

verses.name: Matthew 1:20
verses.text: But while he thought on these things, behold, the angel of the Lord appeared unto him in a dream, saying, Joseph, thou son of David, fear not to take unto thee Mary thy wife: for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Ghost.

verses.name: Matthew 1:21
