verses.text: This people draweth nigh unto me with their mouth, and honoureth me with <hi type="italic">their</hi> lips; but their heart is far from me.

verses.name: Matthew 15:9
verses.text: But in vain they do worship me, teaching <hi type="italic">for</hi> doctrines the commandments of men.

verses.name: Matthew 15:10
verses.text: ¶ And he called the multitude, and said unto them, Hear, and understand:

verses.name: Matthew 15:11
verses.text: Not that which goeth into the mouth defileth a man; but that which cometh out of the mouth, this defileth a man.

verses.name: Matthew 15:12
verses.text: Then came his disciples, and said unto him, Knowest thou that the Pharisees were offended, after they heard this saying?

verses.name: Matthew 15:13
verses.text: But he answered and said, Every plant, which my heavenly Father hath not planted, shall be rooted up.

verses.name: Matthew 15:14
verses.text: Let them alone: they be blind leaders of the blind. And if the blind lead the blind, both shall fall into the ditch.

verses.name: Matthew 15:15
verses.text: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Declare unto us this parable.

verses.name: Matthew 15:16
verses.text: And Jesus said, Are ye also yet without understanding?

verses.name: Matthew 15:17
verses.text: Do not ye yet understand, that whatsoever entereth in at the mouth goeth into the belly, and is cast out into the draught?

verses.name: Matthew 15:18
verses.text: But those things which proceed out of the mouth come forth from the heart; and they defile the man.

verses.name: Matthew 15:19
verses.text: For out of the heart proceed evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, fornications, thefts, false witness, blasphemies:

verses.name: Matthew 15:20
verses.text: These are <hi type="italic">the things</hi> which defile a man: but to eat with unwashen hands defileth not a man.

verses.name: Matthew 15:21
verses.text: ¶ Then Jesus went thence, and departed into the coasts of Tyre and Sidon.

verses.name: Matthew 15:22
verses.text: And, behold, a woman of Canaan came out of the same coasts, and cried unto him, saying, Have mercy on me, O Lord, <hi type="italic">thou</hi> Son of David; my daughter is grievously vexed with a devil.

verses.name: Matthew 15:23
verses.text: But he answered her not a word. And his disciples came and besought him, saying, Send her away; for she crieth after us.

verses.name: Matthew 15:24
verses.text: But he answered and said, I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel.

verses.name: Matthew 15:25
verses.text: Then came she and worshipped him, saying, Lord, help me.

verses.name: Matthew 15:26
verses.text: But he answered and said, It is not meet to take the children’s bread, and to cast <hi type="italic">it</hi> to dogs.

verses.name: Matthew 15:27
verses.text: And she said, Truth, Lord: yet the dogs eat of the crumbs which fall from their masters’ table.

verses.name: Matthew 15:28
verses.text: Then Jesus answered and said unto her, O woman, great <hi type="italic">is</hi> thy faith: be it unto thee even as thou wilt. And her daughter was made whole from that very hour.

verses.name: Matthew 15:29
verses.text: And Jesus departed from thence, and came nigh unto the sea of Galilee; and went up into a mountain, and sat down there.

verses.name: Matthew 15:30
verses.text: And great multitudes came unto him, having with them <hi type="italic">those that were</hi> lame, blind, dumb, maimed, and many others, and cast them down at Jesus’ feet; and he healed them:

verses.name: Matthew 15:31
verses.text: Insomuch that the multitude wondered, when they saw the dumb to speak, the maimed to be whole, the lame to walk, and the blind to see: and they glorified the God of Israel.

verses.name: Matthew 15:32
verses.text: ¶ Then Jesus called his disciples <hi type="italic">unto him</hi>, and said, I have compassion on the multitude, because they continue with me now three days, and have nothing to eat: and I will not send them away fasting, lest they faint in the way.

verses.name: Matthew 15:33
verses.text: And his disciples say unto him, Whence should we have so much bread in the wilderness, as to fill so great a multitude?

verses.name: Matthew 15:34
verses.text: And Jesus saith unto them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven, and a few little fishes.

verses.name: Matthew 15:35
verses.text: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground.

verses.name: Matthew 15:36
verses.text: And he took the seven loaves and the fishes, and gave thanks, and brake <hi type="italic">them</hi>, and gave to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.

verses.name: Matthew 15:37
verses.text: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken <hi type="italic">meat</hi> that was left seven baskets full.

verses.name: Matthew 15:38
verses.text: And they that did eat were four thousand men, beside women and children.

verses.name: Matthew 15:39
verses.text: And he sent away the multitude, and took ship, and came into the coasts of Magdala.  <chapter eID="Matt.15"/><div eID="gen1028" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Matthew 16:1
verses.text: THE Pharisees also with the Sadducees came, and tempting desired him that he would shew them a sign from heaven.

verses.name: Matthew 16:2
verses.text: He answered and said unto them, When it is evening, ye say, <hi type="italic">It will be</hi> fair weather: for the sky is red.

verses.name: Matthew 16:3
verses.text: And in the morning, <hi type="italic">It will be</hi> foul weather to day: for the sky is red and lowring. O <hi type="italic">ye</hi> hypocrites, ye can discern the face of the sky; but can ye not <hi type="italic">discern</hi> the signs of the times?

verses.name: Matthew 16:4
verses.text: A wicked and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given unto it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas. And he left them, and departed.

verses.name: Matthew 16:5
verses.text: And when his disciples were come to the other side, they had forgotten to take bread.

verses.name: Matthew 16:6
verses.text: ¶ Then Jesus said unto them, Take heed and beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.

verses.name: Matthew 16:7
verses.text: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, <hi type="italic">It is</hi> because we have taken no bread.

verses.name: Matthew 16:8
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Which</hi> when Jesus perceived, he said unto them, O ye of little faith, why reason ye among yourselves, because ye have brought no bread?

verses.name: Matthew 16:9
verses.text: Do ye not yet understand, neither remember the five loaves of the five thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?

verses.name: Matthew 16:10
verses.text: Neither the seven loaves of the four thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?

verses.name: Matthew 16:11
verses.text: How is it that ye do not understand that I spake <hi type="italic">it</hi> not to you concerning bread, that ye should beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees?

verses.name: Matthew 16:12
verses.text: Then understood they how that he bade <hi type="italic">them</hi> not beware of the leaven of bread, but of the doctrine of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.

verses.name: Matthew 16:13
verses.text: ¶ When Jesus came into the coasts of Cæsarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, Whom do men say that I the Son of man am?

verses.name: Matthew 16:14
verses.text: And they said, Some <hi type="italic">say that thou art</hi> John the Baptist: some, Elias; and others, Jeremias, or one of the prophets.

verses.name: Matthew 16:15
verses.text: He saith unto them, But whom say ye that I am?

verses.name: Matthew 16:16
verses.text: And Simon Peter answered and said, Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God.

verses.name: Matthew 16:17
verses.text: And Jesus answered and said unto him, Blessed art thou, Simon Bar-jona: for flesh and blood hath not revealed <hi type="italic">it</hi> unto thee, but my Father which is in heaven.

verses.name: Matthew 16:18
verses.text: And I say also unto thee, That thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.

verses.name: Matthew 16:19
verses.text: And I will give unto thee the keys of the kingdom of heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.

verses.name: Matthew 16:20
verses.text: Then charged he his disciples that they should tell no man that he was Jesus the Christ.

verses.name: Matthew 16:21
verses.text: ¶ From that time forth began Jesus to shew unto his disciples, how that he must go unto Jerusalem, and suffer many things of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and be raised again the third day.

verses.name: Matthew 16:22
verses.text: Then Peter took him, and began to rebuke him, saying, Be it far from thee, Lord: this shall not be unto thee.

verses.name: Matthew 16:23
verses.text: But he turned, and said unto Peter, Get thee behind me, Satan: thou art an offence unto me: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but those that be of men.

verses.name: Matthew 16:24
verses.text: ¶ Then said Jesus unto his disciples, If any <hi type="italic">man</hi> will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

verses.name: Matthew 16:25
verses.text: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: and whosoever will lose his life for my sake shall find it.

verses.name: Matthew 16:26
verses.text: For what is a man profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul? or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?

verses.name: Matthew 16:27
verses.text: For the Son of man shall come in the glory of his Father with his angels; and then he shall reward every man according to his works.

verses.name: Matthew 16:28
verses.text: Verily I say unto you, There be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the Son of man coming in his kingdom.  <chapter eID="Matt.16"/><div eID="gen1029" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Matthew 17:1
verses.text: AND after six days Jesus taketh Peter, James, and John his brother, and bringeth them up into an high mountain apart,

verses.name: Matthew 17:2
verses.text: And was transfigured before them: and his face did shine as the sun, and his raiment was white as the light.

verses.name: Matthew 17:3
verses.text: And, behold, there appeared unto them Moses and Elias talking with him.

verses.name: Matthew 17:4
verses.text: Then answered Peter, and said unto Jesus, Lord, it is good for us to be here: if thou wilt, let us make here three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.

verses.name: Matthew 17:5
verses.text: While he yet spake, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them: and behold a voice out of the cloud, which said, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased; hear ye him.

verses.name: Matthew 17:6
verses.text: And when the disciples heard <hi type="italic">it</hi>, they fell on their face, and were sore afraid.

verses.name: Matthew 17:7
verses.text: And Jesus came and touched them, and said, Arise, and be not afraid.

verses.name: Matthew 17:8
verses.text: And when they had lifted up their eyes, they saw no man, save Jesus only.

verses.name: Matthew 17:9
verses.text: And as they came down from the mountain, Jesus charged them, saying, Tell the vision to no man, until the Son of man be risen again from the dead.

verses.name: Matthew 17:10
verses.text: And his disciples asked him, saying, Why then say the scribes that Elias must first come?

verses.name: Matthew 17:11
verses.text: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Elias truly shall first come, and restore all things.

verses.name: Matthew 17:12
verses.text: But I say unto you, That Elias is come already, and they knew him not, but have done unto him whatsoever they listed. Likewise shall also the Son of man suffer of them.

verses.name: Matthew 17:13
verses.text: Then the disciples understood that he spake unto them of John the Baptist.

verses.name: Matthew 17:14
verses.text: ¶ And when they were come to the multitude, there came to him a <hi type="italic">certain</hi> man, kneeling down to him, and saying,

verses.name: Matthew 17:15
verses.text: Lord, have mercy on my son: for he is lunatick, and sore vexed: for ofttimes he falleth into the fire, and oft into the water.

verses.name: Matthew 17:16
verses.text: And I brought him to thy disciples, and they could not cure him.

verses.name: Matthew 17:17
verses.text: Then Jesus answered and said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him hither to me.

verses.name: Matthew 17:18
verses.text: And Jesus rebuked the devil; and he departed out of him: and the child was cured from that very hour.

verses.name: Matthew 17:19
verses.text: Then came the disciples to Jesus apart, and said, Why could not we cast him out?

verses.name: Matthew 17:20
verses.text: And Jesus said unto them, Because of your unbelief: for verily I say unto you, If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye shall say unto this mountain, Remove hence to yonder place; and it shall remove; and nothing shall be impossible unto you.

verses.name: Matthew 17:21
verses.text: Howbeit this kind goeth not out but by prayer and fasting.

verses.name: Matthew 17:22
verses.text: ¶ And while they abode in Galilee, Jesus said unto them, The Son of man shall be betrayed into the hands of men:

verses.name: Matthew 17:23
verses.text: And they shall kill him, and the third day he shall be raised again. And they were exceeding sorry.

verses.name: Matthew 17:24
verses.text: ¶ And when they were come to Capernaum, they that received tribute <hi type="italic">money</hi> came to Peter, and said, Doth not your master pay tribute?

verses.name: Matthew 17:25
verses.text: He saith, Yes. And when he was come into the house, Jesus prevented him, saying, What thinkest thou, Simon? of whom do the kings of the earth take custom or tribute? of their own children, or of strangers?

verses.name: Matthew 17:26
verses.text: Peter saith unto him, Of strangers. Jesus saith unto him, Then are the children free.

verses.name: Matthew 17:27
verses.text: Notwithstanding, lest we should offend them, go thou to the sea, and cast an hook, and take up the fish that first cometh up; and when thou hast opened his mouth, thou shalt find a piece of money: that take, and give unto them for me and thee.  <chapter eID="Matt.17"/><div eID="gen1030" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Matthew 18:1
verses.text: AT the same time came the disciples unto Jesus, saying, Who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?

verses.name: Matthew 18:2
verses.text: And Jesus called a little child unto him, and set him in the midst of them,

verses.name: Matthew 18:3
verses.text: And said, Verily I say unto you, Except ye be converted, and become as little children, ye shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven.

verses.name: Matthew 18:4
verses.text: Whosoever therefore shall humble himself as this little child, the same is greatest in the kingdom of heaven.

verses.name: Matthew 18:5
verses.text: And whoso shall receive one such little child in my name receiveth me.

verses.name: Matthew 18:6
verses.text: But whoso shall offend one of these little ones which believe in me, it were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and <hi type="italic">that</hi> he were drowned in the depth of the sea.

verses.name: Matthew 18:7
verses.text: ¶ Woe unto the world because of offences! for it must needs be that offences come; but woe to that man by whom the offence cometh!

verses.name: Matthew 18:8
verses.text: Wherefore if thy hand or thy foot offend thee, cut them off, and cast <hi type="italic">them</hi> from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life halt or maimed, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into everlasting fire.

verses.name: Matthew 18:9
verses.text: And if thine eye offend thee, pluck it out, and cast <hi type="italic">it</hi> from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire.

verses.name: Matthew 18:10
verses.text: Take heed that ye despise not one of these little ones; for I say unto you, That in heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father which is in heaven.

verses.name: Matthew 18:11
verses.text: For the Son of man is come to save that which was lost.

verses.name: Matthew 18:12
verses.text: How think ye? if a man have an hundred sheep, and one of them be gone astray, doth he not leave the ninety and nine, and goeth into the mountains, and seeketh that which is gone astray?

verses.name: Matthew 18:13
verses.text: And if so be that he find it, verily I say unto you, he rejoiceth more of that <hi type="italic">sheep</hi>, than of the ninety and nine which went not astray.

verses.name: Matthew 18:14
verses.text: Even so it is not the will of your Father which is in heaven, that one of these little ones should perish.

verses.name: Matthew 18:15
verses.text: ¶ Moreover if thy brother shall trespass against thee, go and tell him his fault between thee and him alone: if he shall hear thee, thou hast gained thy brother.

verses.name: Matthew 18:16
verses.text: But if he will not hear <hi type="italic">thee</hi>, <hi type="italic">then</hi> take with thee one or two more, that in the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.

verses.name: Matthew 18:17
verses.text: And if he shall neglect to hear them, tell <hi type="italic">it</hi> unto the church: but if he neglect to hear the church, let him be unto thee as an heathen man and a publican.

verses.name: Matthew 18:18
verses.text: Verily I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever ye shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.

verses.name: Matthew 18:19
verses.text: Again I say unto you, That if two of you shall agree on earth as touching any thing that they shall ask, it shall be done for them of my Father which is in heaven.

verses.name: Matthew 18:20
verses.text: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.

verses.name: Matthew 18:21
verses.text: ¶ Then came Peter to him, and said, Lord, how oft shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? till seven times?

verses.name: Matthew 18:22
verses.text: Jesus saith unto him, I say not unto thee, Until seven times: but, Until seventy times seven.

verses.name: Matthew 18:23
verses.text: ¶ Therefore is the kingdom of heaven likened unto a certain king, which would take account of his servants.

verses.name: Matthew 18:24
verses.text: And when he had begun to reckon, one was brought unto him, which owed him ten thousand talents.

verses.name: Matthew 18:25
verses.text: But forasmuch as he had not to pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, and his wife, and children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.

verses.name: Matthew 18:26
verses.text: The servant therefore fell down, and worshipped him, saying, Lord, have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.

verses.name: Matthew 18:27
verses.text: Then the lord of that servant was moved with compassion, and loosed him, and forgave him the debt.

verses.name: Matthew 18:28
verses.text: But the same servant went out, and found one of his fellowservants, which owed him an hundred pence: and he laid hands on him, and took <hi type="italic">him</hi> by the throat, saying, Pay me that thou owest.

verses.name: Matthew 18:29
verses.text: And his fellowservant fell down at his feet, and besought him, saying, Have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.

verses.name: Matthew 18:30
verses.text: And he would not: but went and cast him into prison, till he should pay the debt.

verses.name: Matthew 18:31
verses.text: So when his fellowservants saw what was done, they were very sorry, and came and told unto their lord all that was done.

verses.name: Matthew 18:32
verses.text: Then his lord, after that he had called him, said unto him, O thou wicked servant, I forgave thee all that debt, because thou desiredst me:

verses.name: Matthew 18:33
verses.text: Shouldest not thou also have had compassion on thy fellowservant, even as I had pity on thee?

verses.name: Matthew 18:34
verses.text: And his lord was wroth, and delivered him to the tormentors, till he should pay all that was due unto him.

verses.name: Matthew 18:35
verses.text: So likewise shall my heavenly Father do also unto you, if ye from your hearts forgive not every one his brother their trespasses.  <chapter eID="Matt.18"/><div eID="gen1031" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Matthew 19:1
verses.text: AND it came to pass, <hi type="italic">that</hi> when Jesus had finished these sayings, he departed from Galilee, and came into the coasts of Judæa beyond Jordan;

verses.name: Matthew 19:2
verses.text: And great multitudes followed him; and he healed them there.

verses.name: Matthew 19:3
verses.text: ¶ The Pharisees also came unto him, tempting him, and saying unto him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife for every cause?

verses.name: Matthew 19:4
verses.text: And he answered and said unto them, Have ye not read, that he which made <hi type="italic">them</hi> at the beginning made them male and female,

verses.name: Matthew 19:5
verses.text: And said, For this cause shall a man leave father and mother, and shall cleave to his wife: and they twain shall be one flesh?

verses.name: Matthew 19:6
verses.text: Wherefore they are no more twain, but one flesh. What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.

verses.name: Matthew 19:7
verses.text: They say unto him, Why did Moses then command to give a writing of divorcement, and to put her away?

verses.name: Matthew 19:8
verses.text: He saith unto them, Moses because of the hardness of your hearts suffered you to put away your wives: but from the beginning it was not so.

verses.name: Matthew 19:9
verses.text: And I say unto you, Whosoever shall put away his wife, except <hi type="italic">it be</hi> for fornication, and shall marry another, committeth adultery: and whoso marrieth her which is put away doth commit adultery.

verses.name: Matthew 19:10
verses.text: ¶ His disciples say unto him, If the case of the man be so with <hi type="italic">his</hi> wife, it is not good to marry.

verses.name: Matthew 19:11
verses.text: But he said unto them, All <hi type="italic">men</hi> cannot receive this saying, save <hi type="italic">they</hi> to whom it is given.

verses.name: Matthew 19:12
verses.text: For there are some eunuchs, which were so born from <hi type="italic">their</hi> mother’s womb: and there are some eunuchs, which were made eunuchs of men: and there be eunuchs, which have made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom of heaven’s sake. He that is able to receive <hi type="italic">it</hi>, let him receive <hi type="italic">it</hi>.

verses.name: Matthew 19:13
verses.text: ¶ Then were there brought unto him little children, that he should put <hi type="italic">his</hi> hands on them, and pray: and the disciples rebuked them.

verses.name: Matthew 19:14
verses.text: But Jesus said, Suffer little children, and forbid them not, to come unto me: for of such is the kingdom of heaven.

verses.name: Matthew 19:15
verses.text: And he laid <hi type="italic">his</hi> hands on them, and departed thence.

verses.name: Matthew 19:16
verses.text: ¶ And, behold, one came and said unto him, Good Master, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?

verses.name: Matthew 19:17
verses.text: And he said unto him, Why callest thou me good? <hi type="italic">there is</hi> none good but one, <hi type="italic">that is</hi>, God: but if thou wilt enter into life, keep the commandments.

verses.name: Matthew 19:18
verses.text: He saith unto him, Which? Jesus said, Thou shalt do no murder, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness,

verses.name: Matthew 19:19
verses.text: Honour thy father and <hi type="italic">thy</hi> mother: and, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

verses.name: Matthew 19:20
verses.text: The young man saith unto him, All these things have I kept from my youth up: what lack I yet?

verses.name: Matthew 19:21
verses.text: Jesus said unto him, If thou wilt be perfect, go <hi type="italic">and</hi> sell that thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come <hi type="italic">and</hi> follow me.

verses.name: Matthew 19:22
verses.text: But when the young man heard that saying, he went away sorrowful: for he had great possessions.

verses.name: Matthew 19:23
verses.text: ¶ Then said Jesus unto his disciples, Verily I say unto you, That a rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven.

verses.name: Matthew 19:24
verses.text: And again I say unto you, It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.

verses.name: Matthew 19:25
verses.text: When his disciples heard <hi type="italic">it</hi>, they were exceedingly amazed, saying, Who then can be saved?

verses.name: Matthew 19:26
verses.text: But Jesus beheld <hi type="italic">them</hi>, and said unto them, With men this is impossible; but with God all things are possible.

verses.name: Matthew 19:27
verses.text: ¶ Then answered Peter and said unto him, Behold, we have forsaken all, and followed thee; what shall we have therefore?

verses.name: Matthew 19:28
verses.text: And Jesus said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That ye which have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of man shall sit in the throne of his glory, ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

verses.name: Matthew 19:29
verses.text: And every one that hath forsaken houses, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name’s sake, shall receive an hundredfold, and shall inherit everlasting life.

verses.name: Matthew 19:30
verses.text: But many <hi type="italic">that are</hi> first shall be last; and the last <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> first.  <chapter eID="Matt.19"/><div eID="gen1032" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Matthew 20:1
verses.text: FOR the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man <hi type="italic">that is</hi> an householder, which went out early in the morning to hire labourers into his vineyard.

verses.name: Matthew 20:2
verses.text: And when he had agreed with the labourers for a penny a day, he sent them into his vineyard.

verses.name: Matthew 20:3
verses.text: And he went out about the third hour, and saw others standing idle in the marketplace,

verses.name: Matthew 20:4
verses.text: And said unto them; Go ye also into the vineyard, and whatsoever is right I will give you. And they went their way.

verses.name: Matthew 20:5
verses.text: Again he went out about the sixth and ninth hour, and did likewise.

verses.name: Matthew 20:6
verses.text: And about the eleventh hour he went out, and found others standing idle, and saith unto them, Why stand ye here all the day idle?

verses.name: Matthew 20:7
verses.text: They say unto him, Because no man hath hired us. He saith unto them, Go ye also into the vineyard; and whatsoever is right, <hi type="italic">that</hi> shall ye receive.

verses.name: Matthew 20:8
verses.text: So when even was come, the lord of the vineyard saith unto his steward, Call the labourers, and give them <hi type="italic">their</hi> hire, beginning from the last unto the first.

verses.name: Matthew 20:9
verses.text: And when they came that <hi type="italic">were hired</hi> about the eleventh hour, they received every man a penny.

verses.name: Matthew 20:10
verses.text: But when the first came, they supposed that they should have received more; and they likewise received every man a penny.

verses.name: Matthew 20:11
verses.text: And when they had received <hi type="italic">it</hi>, they murmured against the goodman of the house,

verses.name: Matthew 20:12
verses.text: Saying, These last have wrought <hi type="italic">but</hi> one hour, and thou hast made them equal unto us, which have borne the burden and heat of the day.

verses.name: Matthew 20:13
verses.text: But he answered one of them, and said, Friend, I do thee no wrong: didst not thou agree with me for a penny?

verses.name: Matthew 20:14
verses.text: Take <hi type="italic">that</hi> thine <hi type="italic">is</hi>, and go thy way: I will give unto this last, even as unto thee.

verses.name: Matthew 20:15
verses.text: Is it not lawful for me to do what I will with mine own? Is thine eye evil, because I am good?

verses.name: Matthew 20:16
verses.text: So the last shall be first, and the first last: for many be called, but few chosen.

verses.name: Matthew 20:17
verses.text: ¶ And Jesus going up to Jerusalem took the twelve disciples apart in the way, and said unto them,

verses.name: Matthew 20:18
verses.text: Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be betrayed unto the chief priests and unto the scribes, and they shall condemn him to death,

verses.name: Matthew 20:19
verses.text: And shall deliver him to the Gentiles to mock, and to scourge, and to crucify <hi type="italic">him:</hi> and the third day he shall rise again.

verses.name: Matthew 20:20
verses.text: ¶ Then came to him the mother of Zebedee’s children with her sons, worshipping <hi type="italic">him</hi>, and desiring a certain thing of him.

verses.name: Matthew 20:21
verses.text: And he said unto her, What wilt thou? She saith unto him, Grant that these my two sons may sit, the one on thy right hand, and the other on the left, in thy kingdom.

verses.name: Matthew 20:22
verses.text: But Jesus answered and said, Ye know not what ye ask. Are ye able to drink of the cup that I shall drink of, and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with? They say unto him, We are able.

verses.name: Matthew 20:23
verses.text: And he saith unto them, Ye shall drink indeed of my cup, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with: but to sit on my right hand, and on my left, is not mine to give, but <hi type="italic">it shall be given to them</hi> for whom it is prepared of my Father.

verses.name: Matthew 20:24
verses.text: And when the ten heard <hi type="italic">it</hi>, they were moved with indignation against the two brethren.

verses.name: Matthew 20:25
verses.text: But Jesus called them <hi type="italic">unto him</hi>, and said, Ye know that the princes of the Gentiles exercise dominion over them, and they that are great exercise authority upon them.

verses.name: Matthew 20:26
verses.text: But it shall not be so among you: but whosoever will be great among you, let him be your minister;

verses.name: Matthew 20:27
verses.text: And whosoever will be chief among you, let him be your servant:

verses.name: Matthew 20:28
verses.text: Even as the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.

verses.name: Matthew 20:29
verses.text: And as they departed from Jericho, a great multitude followed him.

verses.name: Matthew 20:30
verses.text: ¶ And, behold, two blind men sitting by the way side, when they heard that Jesus passed by, cried out, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, <hi type="italic">thou</hi> Son of David.

verses.name: Matthew 20:31
verses.text: And the multitude rebuked them, because they should hold their peace: but they cried the more, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, <hi type="italic">thou</hi> Son of David.

verses.name: Matthew 20:32
verses.text: And Jesus stood still, and called them, and said, What will ye that I shall do unto you?

verses.name: Matthew 20:33
verses.text: They say unto him, Lord, that our eyes may be opened.

verses.name: Matthew 20:34
verses.text: So Jesus had compassion <hi type="italic">on them</hi>, and touched their eyes: and immediately their eyes received sight, and they followed him.  <chapter eID="Matt.20"/><div eID="gen1033" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Matthew 21:1
verses.text: AND when they drew nigh unto Jerusalem, and were come to Bethphage, unto the mount of Olives, then sent Jesus two disciples,

verses.name: Matthew 21:2
verses.text: Saying unto them, Go into the village over against you, and straightway ye shall find an ass tied, and a colt with her: loose <hi type="italic">them</hi>, and bring <hi type="italic">them</hi> unto me.

verses.name: Matthew 21:3
verses.text: And if any <hi type="italic">man</hi> say ought unto you, ye shall say, The Lord hath need of them; and straightway he will send them.

verses.name: Matthew 21:4
verses.text: All this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying,

verses.name: Matthew 21:5
verses.text: Tell ye the daughter of Sion, Behold, thy King cometh unto thee, meek, and sitting upon an ass, and a colt the foal of an ass.

verses.name: Matthew 21:6
verses.text: And the disciples went, and did as Jesus commanded them,

verses.name: Matthew 21:7
verses.text: And brought the ass, and the colt, and put on them their clothes, and they set <hi type="italic">him</hi> thereon.

verses.name: Matthew 21:8
verses.text: And a very great multitude spread their garments in the way; others cut down branches from the trees, and strawed <hi type="italic">them</hi> in the way.

verses.name: Matthew 21:9
verses.text: And the multitudes that went before, and that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna to the Son of David: Blessed <hi type="italic">is</hi> he that cometh in the name of the Lord; Hosanna in the highest.

verses.name: Matthew 21:10
verses.text: And when he was come into Jerusalem, all the city was moved, saying, Who is this?

verses.name: Matthew 21:11
verses.text: And the multitude said, This is Jesus the prophet of Nazareth of Galilee.

verses.name: Matthew 21:12
verses.text: ¶ And Jesus went into the temple of God, and cast out all them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves,

verses.name: Matthew 21:13
verses.text: And said unto them, It is written, My house shall be called the house of prayer; but ye have made it a den of thieves.

verses.name: Matthew 21:14
verses.text: And the blind and the lame came to him in the temple; and he healed them.

verses.name: Matthew 21:15
verses.text: And when the chief priests and scribes saw the wonderful things that he did, and the children crying in the temple, and saying, Hosanna to the Son of David; they were sore displeased,

verses.name: Matthew 21:16
verses.text: And said unto him, Hearest thou what these say? And Jesus saith unto them, Yea; have ye never read, Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings thou hast perfected praise?

verses.name: Matthew 21:17
verses.text: ¶ And he left them, and went out of the city into Bethany; and he lodged there.

verses.name: Matthew 21:18
verses.text: Now in the morning as he returned into the city, he hungered.

verses.name: Matthew 21:19
verses.text: And when he saw a fig tree in the way, he came to it, and found nothing thereon, but leaves only, and said unto it, Let no fruit grow on thee henceforward for ever. And presently the fig tree withered away.

verses.name: Matthew 21:20
verses.text: And when the disciples saw <hi type="italic">it</hi>, they marvelled, saying, How soon is the fig tree withered away!

verses.name: Matthew 21:21
verses.text: Jesus answered and said unto them, Verily I say unto you, If ye have faith, and doubt not, ye shall not only do this <hi type="italic">which is done</hi> to the fig tree, but also if ye shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; it shall be done.

verses.name: Matthew 21:22
verses.text: And all things, whatsoever ye shall ask in prayer, believing, ye shall receive.

verses.name: Matthew 21:23
verses.text: ¶ And when he was come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came unto him as he was teaching, and said, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority?

verses.name: Matthew 21:24
verses.text: And Jesus answered and said unto them, I also will ask you one thing, which if ye tell me, I in like wise will tell you by what authority I do these things.

verses.name: Matthew 21:25
verses.text: The baptism of John, whence was it? from heaven, or of men? And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say unto us, Why did ye not then believe him?

verses.name: Matthew 21:26
verses.text: But if we shall say, Of men; we fear the people; for all hold John as a prophet.

verses.name: Matthew 21:27
verses.text: And they answered Jesus, and said, We cannot tell. And he said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.

verses.name: Matthew 21:28
verses.text: ¶ But what think ye? A <hi type="italic">certain</hi> man had two sons; and he came to the first, and said, Son, go work to day in my vineyard.

verses.name: Matthew 21:29
verses.text: He answered and said, I will not: but afterward he repented, and went.

verses.name: Matthew 21:30
verses.text: And he came to the second, and said likewise. And he answered and said, I <hi type="italic">go</hi>, sir: and went not.

verses.name: Matthew 21:31
verses.text: Whether of them twain did the will of <hi type="italic">his</hi> father? They say unto him, The first. Jesus saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That the publicans and the harlots go into the kingdom of God before you.

verses.name: Matthew 21:32
verses.text: For John came unto you in the way of righteousness, and ye believed him not: but the publicans and the harlots believed him: and ye, when ye had seen <hi type="italic">it</hi>, repented not afterward, that ye might believe him.

verses.name: Matthew 21:33
verses.text: ¶ Hear another parable: There was a certain householder, which planted a vineyard, and hedged it round about, and digged a winepress in it, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country:

verses.name: Matthew 21:34
verses.text: And when the time of the fruit drew near, he sent his servants to the husbandmen, that they might receive the fruits of it.

verses.name: Matthew 21:35
verses.text: And the husbandmen took his servants, and beat one, and killed another, and stoned another.

verses.name: Matthew 21:36
verses.text: Again, he sent other servants more than the first: and they did unto them likewise.

verses.name: Matthew 21:37
verses.text: But last of all he sent unto them his son, saying, They will reverence my son.

verses.name: Matthew 21:38
verses.text: But when the husbandmen saw the son, they said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and let us seize on his inheritance.

verses.name: Matthew 21:39
verses.text: And they caught him, and cast <hi type="italic">him</hi> out of the vineyard, and slew <hi type="italic">him</hi>.

verses.name: Matthew 21:40
verses.text: When the lord therefore of the vineyard cometh, what will he do unto those husbandmen?

verses.name: Matthew 21:41
verses.text: They say unto him, He will miserably destroy those wicked men, and will let out <hi type="italic">his</hi> vineyard unto other husbandmen, which shall render him the fruits in their seasons.

verses.name: Matthew 21:42
verses.text: Jesus saith unto them, Did ye never read in the scriptures, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner: this is the Lord’s doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?

verses.name: Matthew 21:43
verses.text: Therefore say I unto you, The kingdom of God shall be taken from you, and given to a nation bringing forth the fruits thereof.

verses.name: Matthew 21:44
verses.text: And whosoever shall fall on this stone shall be broken: but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.

verses.name: Matthew 21:45
verses.text: And when the chief priests and Pharisees had heard his parables, they perceived that he spake of them.

verses.name: Matthew 21:46
verses.text: But when they sought to lay hands on him, they feared the multitude, because they took him for a prophet.  <chapter eID="Matt.21"/><div eID="gen1034" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Matthew 22:1
verses.text: AND Jesus answered and spake unto them again by parables, and said,

verses.name: Matthew 22:2
verses.text: The kingdom of heaven is like unto a certain king, which made a marriage for his son,

verses.name: Matthew 22:3
verses.text: And sent forth his servants to call them that were bidden to the wedding: and they would not come.

verses.name: Matthew 22:4
verses.text: Again, he sent forth other servants, saying, Tell them which are bidden, Behold, I have prepared my dinner: my oxen and <hi type="italic">my</hi> fatlings <hi type="italic">are</hi> killed, and all things <hi type="italic">are</hi> ready: come unto the marriage.

verses.name: Matthew 22:5
verses.text: But they made light of <hi type="italic">it</hi>, and went their ways, one to his farm, another to his merchandise:

verses.name: Matthew 22:6
verses.text: And the remnant took his servants, and entreated <hi type="italic">them</hi> spitefully, and slew <hi type="italic">them</hi>.

verses.name: Matthew 22:7
verses.text: But when the king heard <hi type="italic">thereof</hi>, he was wroth: and he sent forth his armies, and destroyed those murderers, and burned up their city.

verses.name: Matthew 22:8
verses.text: Then saith he to his servants, The wedding is ready, but they which were bidden were not worthy.

verses.name: Matthew 22:9
verses.text: Go ye therefore into the highways, and as many as ye shall find, bid to the marriage.

verses.name: Matthew 22:10
verses.text: So those servants went out into the highways, and gathered together all as many as they found, both bad and good: and the wedding was furnished with guests.

verses.name: Matthew 22:11
verses.text: ¶ And when the king came in to see the guests, he saw there a man which had not on a wedding garment:

verses.name: Matthew 22:12
verses.text: And he saith unto him, Friend, how camest thou in hither not having a wedding garment? And he was speechless.

verses.name: Matthew 22:13
verses.text: Then said the king to the servants, Bind him hand and foot, and take him away, and cast <hi type="italic">him</hi> into outer darkness; there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

verses.name: Matthew 22:14
verses.text: For many are called, but few <hi type="italic">are</hi> chosen.

verses.name: Matthew 22:15
verses.text: ¶ Then went the Pharisees, and took counsel how they might entangle him in <hi type="italic">his</hi> talk.

verses.name: Matthew 22:16
verses.text: And they sent out unto him their disciples with the Herodians, saying, Master, we know that thou art true, and teachest the way of God in truth, neither carest thou for any <hi type="italic">man:</hi> for thou regardest not the person of men.

verses.name: Matthew 22:17
verses.text: Tell us therefore, What thinkest thou? Is it lawful to give tribute unto Cæsar, or not?

verses.name: Matthew 22:18
verses.text: But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, Why tempt ye me, <hi type="italic">ye</hi> hypocrites?

verses.name: Matthew 22:19
verses.text: Shew me the tribute money. And they brought unto him a penny.

verses.name: Matthew 22:20
verses.text: And he saith unto them, Whose <hi type="italic">is</hi> this image and superscription?

verses.name: Matthew 22:21
verses.text: They say unto him, Cæsar’s. Then saith he unto them, Render therefore unto Cæsar the things which are Cæsar’s; and unto God the things that are God’s.

verses.name: Matthew 22:22
verses.text: When they had heard <hi type="italic">these words</hi>, they marvelled, and left him, and went their way.

verses.name: Matthew 22:23
verses.text: ¶ The same day came to him the Sadducees, which say that there is no resurrection, and asked him,

verses.name: Matthew 22:24
verses.text: Saying, Master, Moses said, If a man die, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.

verses.name: Matthew 22:25
verses.text: Now there were with us seven brethren: and the first, when he had married a wife, deceased, and, having no issue, left his wife unto his brother:

verses.name: Matthew 22:26
verses.text: Likewise the second also, and the third, unto the seventh.

verses.name: Matthew 22:27
verses.text: And last of all the woman died also.

verses.name: Matthew 22:28
verses.text: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife shall she be of the seven? for they all had her.

verses.name: Matthew 22:29
verses.text: Jesus answered and said unto them, Ye do err, not knowing the scriptures, nor the power of God.

verses.name: Matthew 22:30
verses.text: For in the resurrection they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are as the angels of God in heaven.

verses.name: Matthew 22:31
verses.text: But as touching the resurrection of the dead, have ye not read that which was spoken unto you by God, saying,

verses.name: Matthew 22:32
verses.text: I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob? God is not the God of the dead, but of the living.

verses.name: Matthew 22:33
verses.text: And when the multitude heard <hi type="italic">this</hi>, they were astonished at his doctrine.

verses.name: Matthew 22:34
verses.text: ¶ But when the Pharisees had heard that he had put the Sadducees to silence, they were gathered together.

verses.name: Matthew 22:35
verses.text: Then one of them, <hi type="italic">which was</hi> a lawyer, asked <hi type="italic">him a question</hi>, tempting him, and saying,

verses.name: Matthew 22:36
verses.text: Master, which <hi type="italic">is</hi> the great commandment in the law?

verses.name: Matthew 22:37
verses.text: Jesus said unto him, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind.

verses.name: Matthew 22:38
verses.text: This is the first and great commandment.

verses.name: Matthew 22:39
verses.text: And the second <hi type="italic">is</hi> like unto it, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

verses.name: Matthew 22:40
verses.text: On these two commandments hang all the law and the prophets.

verses.name: Matthew 22:41
verses.text: ¶ While the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them,

verses.name: Matthew 22:42
verses.text: Saying, What think ye of Christ? whose son is he? They say unto him, <hi type="italic">The Son</hi> of David.

verses.name: Matthew 22:43
verses.text: He saith unto them, How then doth David in spirit call him Lord, saying,

verses.name: Matthew 22:44
verses.text: The Lord said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstool?

verses.name: Matthew 22:45
verses.text: If David then call him Lord, how is he his son?

verses.name: Matthew 22:46
verses.text: And no man was able to answer him a word, neither durst any <hi type="italic">man</hi> from that day forth ask him any more <hi type="italic">questions</hi>.  <chapter eID="Matt.22"/><div eID="gen1035" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Matthew 23:1
verses.text: THEN spake Jesus to the multitude, and to his disciples,

verses.name: Matthew 23:2
verses.text: Saying, The scribes and the Pharisees sit in Moses’ seat:

verses.name: Matthew 23:3
verses.text: All therefore whatsoever they bid you observe, <hi type="italic">that</hi> observe and do; but do not ye after their works: for they say, and do not.

verses.name: Matthew 23:4
verses.text: For they bind heavy burdens and grievous to be borne, and lay <hi type="italic">them</hi> on men’s shoulders; but they <hi type="italic">themselves</hi> will not move them with one of their fingers.

verses.name: Matthew 23:5
verses.text: But all their works they do for to be seen of men: they make broad their phylacteries, and enlarge the borders of their garments,

verses.name: Matthew 23:6
verses.text: And love the uppermost rooms at feasts, and the chief seats in the synagogues,

verses.name: Matthew 23:7
verses.text: And greetings in the markets, and to be called of men, Rabbi, Rabbi.

verses.name: Matthew 23:8
verses.text: But be not ye called Rabbi: for one is your Master, <hi type="italic">even</hi> Christ; and all ye are brethren.

verses.name: Matthew 23:9
verses.text: And call no <hi type="italic">man</hi> your father upon the earth: for one is your Father, which is in heaven.

verses.name: Matthew 23:10
verses.text: Neither be ye called masters: for one is your Master, <hi type="italic">even</hi> Christ.

verses.name: Matthew 23:11
verses.text: But he that is greatest among you shall be your servant.

verses.name: Matthew 23:12
verses.text: And whosoever shall exalt himself shall be abased; and he that shall humble himself shall be exalted.

verses.name: Matthew 23:13
verses.text: ¶ But woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye shut up the kingdom of heaven against men: for ye neither go in <hi type="italic">yourselves</hi>, neither suffer ye them that are entering to go in.

verses.name: Matthew 23:14
verses.text: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye devour widows’ houses, and for a pretence make long prayer: therefore ye shall receive the greater damnation.

verses.name: Matthew 23:15
verses.text: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye compass sea and land to make one proselyte, and when he is made, ye make him twofold more the child of hell than yourselves.

verses.name: Matthew 23:16
verses.text: Woe unto you, <hi type="italic">ye</hi> blind guides, which say, Whosoever shall swear by the temple, it is nothing; but whosoever shall swear by the gold of the temple, he is a debtor!

verses.name: Matthew 23:17
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Ye</hi> fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gold, or the temple that sanctifieth the gold?

verses.name: Matthew 23:18
verses.text: And, Whosoever shall swear by the altar, it is nothing; but whosoever sweareth by the gift that is upon it, he is guilty.

verses.name: Matthew 23:19
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Ye</hi> fools and blind: for whether <hi type="italic">is</hi> greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifieth the gift?

verses.name: Matthew 23:20
verses.text: Whoso therefore shall swear by the altar, sweareth by it, and by all things thereon.

verses.name: Matthew 23:21
verses.text: And whoso shall swear by the temple, sweareth by it, and by him that dwelleth therein.

verses.name: Matthew 23:22
verses.text: And he that shall swear by heaven, sweareth by the throne of God, and by him that sitteth thereon.

verses.name: Matthew 23:23
verses.text: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye pay tithe of mint and anise and cummin, and have omitted the weightier <hi type="italic">matters</hi> of the law, judgment, mercy, and faith: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.

verses.name: Matthew 23:24
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Ye</hi> blind guides, which strain at a gnat, and swallow a camel.

verses.name: Matthew 23:25
verses.text: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye make clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and excess.

verses.name: Matthew 23:26
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Thou</hi> blind Pharisee, cleanse first that <hi type="italic">which is</hi> within the cup and platter, that the outside of them may be clean also.

verses.name: Matthew 23:27
verses.text: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are like unto whited sepulchres, which indeed appear beautiful outward, but are within full of dead <hi type="italic">men</hi>’<hi type="italic">s</hi> bones, and of all uncleanness.

verses.name: Matthew 23:28
verses.text: Even so ye also outwardly appear righteous unto men, but within ye are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.

verses.name: Matthew 23:29
verses.text: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! because ye build the tombs of the prophets, and garnish the sepulchres of the righteous,

verses.name: Matthew 23:30
verses.text: And say, If we had been in the days of our fathers, we would not have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.

verses.name: Matthew 23:31
verses.text: Wherefore ye be witnesses unto yourselves, that ye are the children of them which killed the prophets.

verses.name: Matthew 23:32
verses.text: Fill ye up then the measure of your fathers.

verses.name: Matthew 23:33
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Ye</hi> serpents, <hi type="italic">ye</hi> generation of vipers, how can ye escape the damnation of hell?

verses.name: Matthew 23:34
verses.text: ¶ Wherefore, behold, I send unto you prophets, and wise men, and scribes: and <hi type="italic">some</hi> of them ye shall kill and crucify; and <hi type="italic">some</hi> of them shall ye scourge in your synagogues, and persecute <hi type="italic">them</hi> from city to city:

verses.name: Matthew 23:35
verses.text: That upon you may come all the righteous blood shed upon the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel unto the blood of Zacharias son of Barachias, whom ye slew between the temple and the altar.

verses.name: Matthew 23:36
verses.text: Verily I say unto you, All these things shall come upon this generation.

verses.name: Matthew 23:37
verses.text: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, <hi type="italic">thou</hi> that killest the prophets, and stonest them which are sent unto thee, how often would I have gathered thy children together, even as a hen gathereth her chickens under <hi type="italic">her</hi> wings, and ye would not!

verses.name: Matthew 23:38
verses.text: Behold, your house is left unto you desolate.

verses.name: Matthew 23:39
verses.text: For I say unto you, Ye shall not see me henceforth, till ye shall say, Blessed <hi type="italic">is</hi> he that cometh in the name of the Lord.  <chapter eID="Matt.23"/><div eID="gen1036" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Matthew 24:1
verses.text: AND Jesus went out, and departed from the temple: and his disciples came to <hi type="italic">him</hi> for to shew him the buildings of the temple.

verses.name: Matthew 24:2
verses.text: And Jesus said unto them, See ye not all these things? verily I say unto you, There shall not be left here one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.

verses.name: Matthew 24:3
verses.text: ¶ And as he sat upon the mount of Olives, the disciples came unto him privately, saying, Tell us, when shall these things be? and what <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> the sign of thy coming, and of the end of the world?

verses.name: Matthew 24:4
verses.text: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Take heed that no man deceive you.

verses.name: Matthew 24:5
verses.text: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.

verses.name: Matthew 24:6
verses.text: And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that ye be not troubled: for all <hi type="italic">these things</hi> must come to pass, but the end is not yet.

verses.name: Matthew 24:7
verses.text: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be famines, and pestilences, and earthquakes, in divers places.

verses.name: Matthew 24:8
verses.text: All these <hi type="italic">are</hi> the beginning of sorrows.

verses.name: Matthew 24:9
verses.text: Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted, and shall kill you: and ye shall be hated of all nations for my name’s sake.

verses.name: Matthew 24:10
verses.text: And then shall many be offended, and shall betray one another, and shall hate one another.

verses.name: Matthew 24:11
verses.text: And many false prophets shall rise, and shall deceive many.

verses.name: Matthew 24:12
verses.text: And because iniquity shall abound, the love of many shall wax cold.

verses.name: Matthew 24:13
verses.text: But he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.

verses.name: Matthew 24:14
verses.text: And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations; and then shall the end come.

verses.name: Matthew 24:15
verses.text: When ye therefore shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, stand in the holy place, (whoso readeth, let him understand:)

verses.name: Matthew 24:16
verses.text: Then let them which be in Judæa flee into the mountains:

verses.name: Matthew 24:17
verses.text: Let him which is on the housetop not come down to take any thing out of his house:

verses.name: Matthew 24:18
verses.text: Neither let him which is in the field return back to take his clothes.

verses.name: Matthew 24:19
verses.text: And woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!

verses.name: Matthew 24:20
verses.text: But pray ye that your flight be not in the winter, neither on the sabbath day:

verses.name: Matthew 24:21
verses.text: For then shall be great tribulation, such as was not since the beginning of the world to this time, no, nor ever shall be.

verses.name: Matthew 24:22
verses.text: And except those days should be shortened, there should no flesh be saved: but for the elect’s sake those days shall be shortened.

verses.name: Matthew 24:23
verses.text: Then if any man shall say unto you, Lo, here <hi type="italic">is</hi> Christ, or there; believe <hi type="italic">it</hi> not.

verses.name: Matthew 24:24
verses.text: For there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets, and shall shew great signs and wonders; insomuch that, if <hi type="italic">it were</hi> possible, they shall deceive the very elect.

verses.name: Matthew 24:25
verses.text: Behold, I have told you before.

verses.name: Matthew 24:26
verses.text: Wherefore if they shall say unto you, Behold, he is in the desert; go not forth: behold, <hi type="italic">he is</hi> in the secret chambers; believe <hi type="italic">it</hi> not.

verses.name: Matthew 24:27
verses.text: For as the lightning cometh out of the east, and shineth even unto the west; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.

verses.name: Matthew 24:28
verses.text: For wheresoever the carcase is, there will the eagles be gathered together.

verses.name: Matthew 24:29
verses.text: ¶ Immediately after the tribulation of those days shall the sun be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light, and the stars shall fall from heaven, and the powers of the heavens shall be shaken:

verses.name: Matthew 24:30
verses.text: And then shall appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven: and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn, and they shall see the Son of man coming in the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.

verses.name: Matthew 24:31
verses.text: And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.

verses.name: Matthew 24:32
verses.text: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When his branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer <hi type="italic">is</hi> nigh:

verses.name: Matthew 24:33
verses.text: So likewise ye, when ye shall see all these things, know that it is near, <hi type="italic">even</hi> at the doors.

verses.name: Matthew 24:34
verses.text: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass, till all these things be fulfilled.

verses.name: Matthew 24:35
verses.text: Heaven and earth shall pass away, but my words shall not pass away.

verses.name: Matthew 24:36
verses.text: ¶ But of that day and hour knoweth no <hi type="italic">man</hi>, no, not the angels of heaven, but my Father only.

verses.name: Matthew 24:37
verses.text: But as the days of Noe <hi type="italic">were</hi>, so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.

verses.name: Matthew 24:38
verses.text: For as in the days that were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark,

verses.name: Matthew 24:39
verses.text: And knew not until the flood came, and took them all away; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.

verses.name: Matthew 24:40
verses.text: Then shall two be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.

verses.name: Matthew 24:41
verses.text: Two <hi type="italic">women shall be</hi> grinding at the mill; the one shall be taken, and the other left.

verses.name: Matthew 24:42
verses.text: ¶ Watch therefore: for ye know not what hour your Lord doth come.

verses.name: Matthew 24:43
verses.text: But know this, that if the goodman of the house had known in what watch the thief would come, he would have watched, and would not have suffered his house to be broken up.

verses.name: Matthew 24:44
verses.text: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.

verses.name: Matthew 24:45
verses.text: Who then is a faithful and wise servant, whom his lord hath made ruler over his household, to give them meat in due season?

verses.name: Matthew 24:46
verses.text: Blessed <hi type="italic">is</hi> that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing.

verses.name: Matthew 24:47
verses.text: Verily I say unto you, That he shall make him ruler over all his goods.

verses.name: Matthew 24:48
verses.text: But and if that evil servant shall say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming;

verses.name: Matthew 24:49
verses.text: And shall begin to smite <hi type="italic">his</hi> fellowservants, and to eat and drink with the drunken;

verses.name: Matthew 24:50
verses.text: The lord of that servant shall come in a day when he looketh not for <hi type="italic">him</hi>, and in an hour that he is not aware of,

verses.name: Matthew 24:51
verses.text: And shall cut him asunder, and appoint <hi type="italic">him</hi> his portion with the hypocrites: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.  <chapter eID="Matt.24"/><div eID="gen1037" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Matthew 25:1
verses.text: THEN shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins, which took their lamps, and went forth to meet the bridegroom.

verses.name: Matthew 25:2
verses.text: And five of them were wise, and five <hi type="italic">were</hi> foolish.

verses.name: Matthew 25:3
verses.text: They that <hi type="italic">were</hi> foolish took their lamps, and took no oil with them:

verses.name: Matthew 25:4
verses.text: But the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.

verses.name: Matthew 25:5
verses.text: While the bridegroom tarried, they all slumbered and slept.

verses.name: Matthew 25:6
verses.text: And at midnight there was a cry made, Behold, the bridegroom cometh; go ye out to meet him.

verses.name: Matthew 25:7
verses.text: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.

verses.name: Matthew 25:8
verses.text: And the foolish said unto the wise, Give us of your oil; for our lamps are gone out.

verses.name: Matthew 25:9
verses.text: But the wise answered, saying, <hi type="italic">Not so;</hi> lest there be not enough for us and you: but go ye rather to them that sell, and buy for yourselves.

verses.name: Matthew 25:10
verses.text: And while they went to buy, the bridegroom came; and they that were ready went in with him to the marriage: and the door was shut.

verses.name: Matthew 25:11
verses.text: Afterward came also the other virgins, saying, Lord, Lord, open to us.

verses.name: Matthew 25:12
verses.text: But he answered and said, Verily I say unto you, I know you not.

verses.name: Matthew 25:13
verses.text: Watch therefore, for ye know neither the day nor the hour wherein the Son of man cometh.

verses.name: Matthew 25:14
verses.text: ¶ For <hi type="italic">the kingdom of heaven is</hi> as a man travelling into a far country, <hi type="italic">who</hi> called his own servants, and delivered unto them his goods.

verses.name: Matthew 25:15
verses.text: And unto one he gave five talents, to another two, and to another one; to every man according to his several ability; and straightway took his journey.

verses.name: Matthew 25:16
verses.text: Then he that had received the five talents went and traded with the same, and made <hi type="italic">them</hi> other five talents.

verses.name: Matthew 25:17
verses.text: And likewise he that <hi type="italic">had received</hi> two, he also gained other two.

verses.name: Matthew 25:18
verses.text: But he that had received one went and digged in the earth, and hid his lord’s money.

verses.name: Matthew 25:19
verses.text: After a long time the lord of those servants cometh, and reckoneth with them.

verses.name: Matthew 25:20
verses.text: And so he that had received five talents came and brought other five talents, saying, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me five talents: behold, I have gained beside them five talents more.

verses.name: Matthew 25:21
verses.text: His lord said unto him, Well done, <hi type="italic">thou</hi> good and faithful servant: thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.

verses.name: Matthew 25:22
verses.text: He also that had received two talents came and said, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me two talents: behold, I have gained two other talents beside them.

verses.name: Matthew 25:23
verses.text: His lord said unto him, Well done, good and faithful servant; thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.

verses.name: Matthew 25:24
verses.text: Then he which had received the one talent came and said, Lord, I knew thee that thou art an hard man, reaping where thou hast not sown, and gathering where thou hast not strawed:

verses.name: Matthew 25:25
verses.text: And I was afraid, and went and hid thy talent in the earth: lo, <hi type="italic">there</hi> thou hast <hi type="italic">that is</hi> thine.

verses.name: Matthew 25:26
verses.text: His lord answered and said unto him, <hi type="italic">Thou</hi> wicked and slothful servant, thou knewest that I reap where I sowed not, and gather where I have not strawed:

verses.name: Matthew 25:27
verses.text: Thou oughtest therefore to have put my money to the exchangers, and <hi type="italic">then</hi> at my coming I should have received mine own with usury.

verses.name: Matthew 25:28
verses.text: Take therefore the talent from him, and give <hi type="italic">it</hi> unto him which hath ten talents.

verses.name: Matthew 25:29
verses.text: For unto every one that hath shall be given, and he shall have abundance: but from him that hath not shall be taken away even that which he hath.

verses.name: Matthew 25:30
verses.text: And cast ye the unprofitable servant into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

verses.name: Matthew 25:31
verses.text: ¶ When the Son of man shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory:

verses.name: Matthew 25:32
verses.text: And before him shall be gathered all nations: and he shall separate them one from another, as a shepherd divideth <hi type="italic">his</hi> sheep from the goats:

verses.name: Matthew 25:33
verses.text: And he shall set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.

verses.name: Matthew 25:34
verses.text: Then shall the King say unto them on his right hand, Come, ye blessed of my Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world:

verses.name: Matthew 25:35
verses.text: For I was an hungred, and ye gave me meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me drink: I was a stranger, and ye took me in:

verses.name: Matthew 25:36
verses.text: Naked, and ye clothed me: I was sick, and ye visited me: I was in prison, and ye came unto me.

verses.name: Matthew 25:37
verses.text: Then shall the righteous answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, and fed <hi type="italic">thee?</hi> or thirsty, and gave <hi type="italic">thee</hi> drink?

verses.name: Matthew 25:38
verses.text: When saw we thee a stranger, and took <hi type="italic">thee</hi> in? or naked, and clothed <hi type="italic">thee?</hi>

verses.name: Matthew 25:39
verses.text: Or when saw we thee sick, or in prison, and came unto thee?

verses.name: Matthew 25:40
verses.text: And the King shall answer and say unto them, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye have done <hi type="italic">it</hi> unto one of the least of these my brethren, ye have done <hi type="italic">it</hi> unto me.

verses.name: Matthew 25:41
verses.text: Then shall he say also unto them on the left hand, Depart from me, ye cursed, into everlasting fire, prepared for the devil and his angels:

verses.name: Matthew 25:42
verses.text: For I was an hungred, and ye gave me no meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me no drink:

verses.name: Matthew 25:43
verses.text: I was a stranger, and ye took me not in: naked, and ye clothed me not: sick, and in prison, and ye visited me not.

verses.name: Matthew 25:44
verses.text: Then shall they also answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, or athirst, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and did not minister unto thee?

verses.name: Matthew 25:45
verses.text: Then shall he answer them, saying, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye did <hi type="italic">it</hi> not to one of the least of these, ye did <hi type="italic">it</hi> not to me.

verses.name: Matthew 25:46
verses.text: And these shall go away into everlasting punishment: but the righteous into life eternal.  <chapter eID="Matt.25"/><div eID="gen1038" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Matthew 26:1
verses.text: AND it came to pass, when Jesus had finished all these sayings, he said unto his disciples,

verses.name: Matthew 26:2
verses.text: Ye know that after two days is <hi type="italic">the feast of</hi> the passover, and the Son of man is betrayed to be crucified.

verses.name: Matthew 26:3
verses.text: Then assembled together the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders of the people, unto the palace of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas,

verses.name: Matthew 26:4
verses.text: And consulted that they might take Jesus by subtilty, and kill <hi type="italic">him</hi>.

verses.name: Matthew 26:5
verses.text: But they said, Not on the feast <hi type="italic">day</hi>, lest there be an uproar among the people.

verses.name: Matthew 26:6
verses.text: ¶ Now when Jesus was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper,

verses.name: Matthew 26:7
verses.text: There came unto him a woman having an alabaster box of very precious ointment, and poured it on his head, as he sat <hi type="italic">at meat</hi>.

verses.name: Matthew 26:8
verses.text: But when his disciples saw <hi type="italic">it</hi>, they had indignation, saying, To what purpose <hi type="italic">is</hi> this waste?

verses.name: Matthew 26:9
verses.text: For this ointment might have been sold for much, and given to the poor.

verses.name: Matthew 26:10
verses.text: When Jesus understood <hi type="italic">it</hi>, he said unto them, Why trouble ye the woman? for she hath wrought a good work upon me.

verses.name: Matthew 26:11
verses.text: For ye have the poor always with you; but me ye have not always.

verses.name: Matthew 26:12
verses.text: For in that she hath poured this ointment on my body, she did <hi type="italic">it</hi> for my burial.

verses.name: Matthew 26:13
verses.text: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached in the whole world, <hi type="italic">there</hi> shall also this, that this woman hath done, be told for a memorial of her.

verses.name: Matthew 26:14
verses.text: ¶ Then one of the twelve, called Judas Iscariot, went unto the chief priests,

verses.name: Matthew 26:15
verses.text: And said <hi type="italic">unto them</hi>, What will ye give me, and I will deliver him unto you? And they covenanted with him for thirty pieces of silver.

verses.name: Matthew 26:16
verses.text: And from that time he sought opportunity to betray him.

verses.name: Matthew 26:17
verses.text: ¶ Now the first <hi type="italic">day</hi> of the <hi type="italic">feast of</hi> unleavened bread the disciples came to Jesus, saying unto him, Where wilt thou that we prepare for thee to eat the passover?

verses.name: Matthew 26:18
verses.text: And he said, Go into the city to such a man, and say unto him, The Master saith, My time is at hand; I will keep the passover at thy house with my disciples.

verses.name: Matthew 26:19
verses.text: And the disciples did as Jesus had appointed them; and they made ready the passover.

verses.name: Matthew 26:20
verses.text: Now when the even was come, he sat down with the twelve.

verses.name: Matthew 26:21
verses.text: And as they did eat, he said, Verily I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.

verses.name: Matthew 26:22
verses.text: And they were exceeding sorrowful, and began every one of them to say unto him, Lord, is it I?

verses.name: Matthew 26:23
verses.text: And he answered and said, He that dippeth <hi type="italic">his</hi> hand with me in the dish, the same shall betray me.

verses.name: Matthew 26:24
verses.text: The Son of man goeth as it is written of him: but woe unto that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! it had been good for that man if he had not been born.

verses.name: Matthew 26:25
verses.text: Then Judas, which betrayed him, answered and said, Master, is it I? He said unto him, Thou hast said.

verses.name: Matthew 26:26
verses.text: ¶ And as they were eating, Jesus took bread, and blessed <hi type="italic">it</hi>, and brake <hi type="italic">it</hi>, and gave <hi type="italic">it</hi> to the disciples, and said, Take, eat; this is my body.

verses.name: Matthew 26:27
verses.text: And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and gave <hi type="italic">it</hi> to them, saying, Drink ye all of it;

verses.name: Matthew 26:28
verses.text: For this is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many for the remission of sins.

verses.name: Matthew 26:29
verses.text: But I say unto you, I will not drink henceforth of this fruit of the vine, until that day when I drink it new with you in my Father’s kingdom.

verses.name: Matthew 26:30
verses.text: And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.

verses.name: Matthew 26:31
verses.text: Then saith Jesus unto them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock shall be scattered abroad.

verses.name: Matthew 26:32
verses.text: But after I am risen again, I will go before you into Galilee.

verses.name: Matthew 26:33
verses.text: Peter answered and said unto him, Though all <hi type="italic">men</hi> shall be offended because of thee, <hi type="italic">yet</hi> will I never be offended.

verses.name: Matthew 26:34
verses.text: Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this night, before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.

verses.name: Matthew 26:35
verses.text: Peter said unto him, Though I should die with thee, yet will I not deny thee. Likewise also said all the disciples.

verses.name: Matthew 26:36
verses.text: ¶ Then cometh Jesus with them unto a place called Gethsemane, and saith unto the disciples, Sit ye here, while I go and pray yonder.

verses.name: Matthew 26:37
verses.text: And he took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and very heavy.

verses.name: Matthew 26:38
verses.text: Then saith he unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful, even unto death: tarry ye here, and watch with me.

verses.name: Matthew 26:39
verses.text: And he went a little further, and fell on his face, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass from me: nevertheless not as I will, but as thou <hi type="italic">wilt</hi>.

verses.name: Matthew 26:40
verses.text: And he cometh unto the disciples, and findeth them asleep, and saith unto Peter, What, could ye not watch with me one hour?

verses.name: Matthew 26:41
verses.text: Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed <hi type="italic">is</hi> willing, but the flesh <hi type="italic">is</hi> weak.

verses.name: Matthew 26:42
verses.text: He went away again the second time, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if this cup may not pass away from me, except I drink it, thy will be done.

verses.name: Matthew 26:43
verses.text: And he came and found them asleep again: for their eyes were heavy.

verses.name: Matthew 26:44
verses.text: And he left them, and went away again, and prayed the third time, saying the same words.

verses.name: Matthew 26:45
verses.text: Then cometh he to his disciples, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take <hi type="italic">your</hi> rest: behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

verses.name: Matthew 26:46
verses.text: Rise, let us be going: behold, he is at hand that doth betray me.

verses.name: Matthew 26:47
verses.text: ¶ And while he yet spake, lo, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and elders of the people.

verses.name: Matthew 26:48
verses.text: Now he that betrayed him gave them a sign, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he: hold him fast.

verses.name: Matthew 26:49
verses.text: And forthwith he came to Jesus, and said, Hail, master; and kissed him.

verses.name: Matthew 26:50
verses.text: And Jesus said unto him, Friend, wherefore art thou come? Then came they, and laid hands on Jesus, and took him.

verses.name: Matthew 26:51
verses.text: And, behold, one of them which were with Jesus stretched out <hi type="italic">his</hi> hand, and drew his sword, and struck a servant of the high priest’s, and smote off his ear.

verses.name: Matthew 26:52
verses.text: Then said Jesus unto him, Put up again thy sword into his place: for all they that take the sword shall perish with the sword.

verses.name: Matthew 26:53
verses.text: Thinkest thou that I cannot now pray to my Father, and he shall presently give me more than twelve legions of angels?

verses.name: Matthew 26:54
verses.text: But how then shall the scriptures be fulfilled, that thus it must be?

verses.name: Matthew 26:55
verses.text: In that same hour said Jesus to the multitudes, Are ye come out as against a thief with swords and staves for to take me? I sat daily with you teaching in the temple, and ye laid no hold on me.

verses.name: Matthew 26:56
verses.text: But all this was done, that the scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled. Then all the disciples forsook him, and fled.

verses.name: Matthew 26:57
verses.text: ¶ And they that had laid hold on Jesus led <hi type="italic">him</hi> away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were assembled.

verses.name: Matthew 26:58
verses.text: But Peter followed him afar off unto the high priest’s palace, and went in, and sat with the servants, to see the end.

verses.name: Matthew 26:59
verses.text: Now the chief priests, and elders, and all the council, sought false witness against Jesus, to put him to death;

verses.name: Matthew 26:60
verses.text: But found none: yea, though many false witnesses came, <hi type="italic">yet</hi> found they none. At the last came two false witnesses,

verses.name: Matthew 26:61
verses.text: And said, This <hi type="italic">fellow</hi> said, I am able to destroy the temple of God, and to build it in three days.

verses.name: Matthew 26:62
verses.text: And the high priest arose, and said unto him, Answerest thou nothing? what <hi type="italic">is it which</hi> these witness against thee?

verses.name: Matthew 26:63
verses.text: But Jesus held his peace. And the high priest answered and said unto him, I adjure thee by the living God, that thou tell us whether thou be the Christ, the Son of God.

verses.name: Matthew 26:64
