verses.text: ¶ Then Peter began to say unto him, Lo, we have left all, and have followed thee.

verses.name: Mark 10:29
verses.text: And Jesus answered and said, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my sake, and the gospel’s,

verses.name: Mark 10:30
verses.text: But he shall receive an hundredfold now in this time, houses, and brethren, and sisters, and mothers, and children, and lands, with persecutions; and in the world to come eternal life.

verses.name: Mark 10:31
verses.text: But many <hi type="italic">that are</hi> first shall be last; and the last first.

verses.name: Mark 10:32
verses.text: ¶ And they were in the way going up to Jerusalem; and Jesus went before them: and they were amazed; and as they followed, they were afraid. And he took again the twelve, and began to tell them what things should happen unto him,

verses.name: Mark 10:33
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Saying</hi>, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be delivered unto the chief priests, and unto the scribes; and they shall condemn him to death, and shall deliver him to the Gentiles:

verses.name: Mark 10:34
verses.text: And they shall mock him, and shall scourge him, and shall spit upon him, and shall kill him: and the third day he shall rise again.

verses.name: Mark 10:35
verses.text: ¶ And James and John, the sons of Zebedee, come unto him, saying, Master, we would that thou shouldest do for us whatsoever we shall desire.

verses.name: Mark 10:36
verses.text: And he said unto them, What would ye that I should do for you?

verses.name: Mark 10:37
verses.text: They said unto him, Grant unto us that we may sit, one on thy right hand, and the other on thy left hand, in thy glory.

verses.name: Mark 10:38
verses.text: But Jesus said unto them, Ye know not what ye ask: can ye drink of the cup that I drink of? and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?

verses.name: Mark 10:39
verses.text: And they said unto him, We can. And Jesus said unto them, Ye shall indeed drink of the cup that I drink of; and with the baptism that I am baptized withal shall ye be baptized:

verses.name: Mark 10:40
verses.text: But to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give; but <hi type="italic">it shall be given to them</hi> for whom it is prepared.

verses.name: Mark 10:41
verses.text: And when the ten heard <hi type="italic">it</hi>, they began to be much displeased with James and John.

verses.name: Mark 10:42
verses.text: But Jesus called them <hi type="italic">to him</hi>, and saith unto them, Ye know that they which are accounted to rule over the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and their great ones exercise authority upon them.

verses.name: Mark 10:43
verses.text: But so shall it not be among you: but whosoever will be great among you, shall be your minister:

verses.name: Mark 10:44
verses.text: And whosoever of you will be the chiefest, shall be servant of all.

verses.name: Mark 10:45
verses.text: For even the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.

verses.name: Mark 10:46
verses.text: ¶ And they came to Jericho: and as he went out of Jericho with his disciples and a great number of people, blind Bartimæus, the son of Timæus, sat by the highway side begging.

verses.name: Mark 10:47
verses.text: And when he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he began to cry out, and say, Jesus, <hi type="italic">thou</hi> Son of David, have mercy on me.

verses.name: Mark 10:48
verses.text: And many charged him that he should hold his peace: but he cried the more a great deal, <hi type="italic">Thou</hi> Son of David, have mercy on me.

verses.name: Mark 10:49
verses.text: And Jesus stood still, and commanded him to be called. And they call the blind man, saying unto him, Be of good comfort, rise; he calleth thee.

verses.name: Mark 10:50
verses.text: And he, casting away his garment, rose, and came to Jesus.

verses.name: Mark 10:51
verses.text: And Jesus answered and said unto him, What wilt thou that I should do unto thee? The blind man said unto him, Lord, that I might receive my sight.

verses.name: Mark 10:52
verses.text: And Jesus said unto him, Go thy way; thy faith hath made thee whole. And immediately he received his sight, and followed Jesus in the way.  <chapter eID="Mark.10"/><div eID="gen1052" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Mark 11:1
verses.text: AND when they came nigh to Jerusalem, unto Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount of Olives, he sendeth forth two of his disciples,

verses.name: Mark 11:2
verses.text: And saith unto them, Go your way into the village over against you: and as soon as ye be entered into it, ye shall find a colt tied, whereon never man sat; loose him, and bring <hi type="italic">him</hi>.

verses.name: Mark 11:3
verses.text: And if any man say unto you, Why do ye this? say ye that the Lord hath need of him; and straightway he will send him hither.

verses.name: Mark 11:4
verses.text: And they went their way, and found the colt tied by the door without in a place where two ways met; and they loose him.

verses.name: Mark 11:5
verses.text: And certain of them that stood there said unto them, What do ye, loosing the colt?

verses.name: Mark 11:6
verses.text: And they said unto them even as Jesus had commanded: and they let them go.

verses.name: Mark 11:7
verses.text: And they brought the colt to Jesus, and cast their garments on him; and he sat upon him.

verses.name: Mark 11:8
verses.text: And many spread their garments in the way: and others cut down branches off the trees, and strawed <hi type="italic">them</hi> in the way.

verses.name: Mark 11:9
verses.text: And they that went before, and they that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna; Blessed <hi type="italic">is</hi> he that cometh in the name of the Lord:

verses.name: Mark 11:10
verses.text: Blessed <hi type="italic">be</hi> the kingdom of our father David, that cometh in the name of the Lord: Hosanna in the highest.

verses.name: Mark 11:11
verses.text: And Jesus entered into Jerusalem, and into the temple: and when he had looked round about upon all things, and now the eventide was come, he went out unto Bethany with the twelve.

verses.name: Mark 11:12
verses.text: ¶ And on the morrow, when they were come from Bethany, he was hungry:

verses.name: Mark 11:13
verses.text: And seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came, if haply he might find any thing thereon: and when he came to it, he found nothing but leaves; for the time of figs was not <hi type="italic">yet</hi>.

verses.name: Mark 11:14
verses.text: And Jesus answered and said unto it, No man eat fruit of thee hereafter for ever. And his disciples heard <hi type="italic">it</hi>.

verses.name: Mark 11:15
verses.text: ¶ And they come to Jerusalem: and Jesus went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves;

verses.name: Mark 11:16
verses.text: And would not suffer that any man should carry <hi type="italic">any</hi> vessel through the temple.

verses.name: Mark 11:17
verses.text: And he taught, saying unto them, Is it not written, My house shall be called of all nations the house of prayer? but ye have made it a den of thieves.

verses.name: Mark 11:18
verses.text: And the scribes and chief priests heard <hi type="italic">it</hi>, and sought how they might destroy him: for they feared him, because all the people was astonished at his doctrine.

verses.name: Mark 11:19
verses.text: And when even was come, he went out of the city.

verses.name: Mark 11:20
verses.text: ¶ And in the morning, as they passed by, they saw the fig tree dried up from the roots.

verses.name: Mark 11:21
verses.text: And Peter calling to remembrance saith unto him, Master, behold, the fig tree which thou cursedst is withered away.

verses.name: Mark 11:22
verses.text: And Jesus answering saith unto them, Have faith in God.

verses.name: Mark 11:23
verses.text: For verily I say unto you, That whosoever shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; and shall not doubt in his heart, but shall believe that those things which he saith shall come to pass; he shall have whatsoever he saith.

verses.name: Mark 11:24
verses.text: Therefore I say unto you, What things soever ye desire, when ye pray, believe that ye receive <hi type="italic">them</hi>, and ye shall have <hi type="italic">them</hi>.

verses.name: Mark 11:25
verses.text: And when ye stand praying, forgive, if ye have ought against any: that your Father also which is in heaven may forgive you your trespasses.

verses.name: Mark 11:26
verses.text: But if ye do not forgive, neither will your Father which is in heaven forgive your trespasses.

verses.name: Mark 11:27
verses.text: ¶ And they come again to Jerusalem: and as he was walking in the temple, there come to him the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders,

verses.name: Mark 11:28
verses.text: And say unto him, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority to do these things?

verses.name: Mark 11:29
verses.text: And Jesus answered and said unto them, I will also ask of you one question, and answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.

verses.name: Mark 11:30
verses.text: The baptism of John, was <hi type="italic">it</hi> from heaven, or of men? answer me.

verses.name: Mark 11:31
verses.text: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then did ye not believe him?

verses.name: Mark 11:32
verses.text: But if we shall say, Of men; they feared the people: for all <hi type="italic">men</hi> counted John, that he was a prophet indeed.

verses.name: Mark 11:33
verses.text: And they answered and said unto Jesus, We cannot tell. And Jesus answering saith unto them, Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things.  <chapter eID="Mark.11"/><div eID="gen1053" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Mark 12:1
verses.text: AND he began to speak unto them by parables. A <hi type="italic">certain</hi> man planted a vineyard, and set an hedge about <hi type="italic">it</hi>, and digged <hi type="italic">a place for</hi> the winefat, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country.

verses.name: Mark 12:2
verses.text: And at the season he sent to the husbandmen a servant, that he might receive from the husbandmen of the fruit of the vineyard.

verses.name: Mark 12:3
verses.text: And they caught <hi type="italic">him</hi>, and beat him, and sent <hi type="italic">him</hi> away empty.

verses.name: Mark 12:4
verses.text: And again he sent unto them another servant; and at him they cast stones, and wounded <hi type="italic">him</hi> in the head, and sent <hi type="italic">him</hi> away shamefully handled.

verses.name: Mark 12:5
verses.text: And again he sent another; and him they killed, and many others; beating some, and killing some.

verses.name: Mark 12:6
verses.text: Having yet therefore one son, his wellbeloved, he sent him also last unto them, saying, They will reverence my son.

verses.name: Mark 12:7
verses.text: But those husbandmen said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and the inheritance shall be ours.

verses.name: Mark 12:8
verses.text: And they took him, and killed <hi type="italic">him</hi>, and cast <hi type="italic">him</hi> out of the vineyard.

verses.name: Mark 12:9
verses.text: What shall therefore the lord of the vineyard do? he will come and destroy the husbandmen, and will give the vineyard unto others.

verses.name: Mark 12:10
verses.text: And have ye not read this scripture; The stone which the builders rejected is become the head of the corner:

verses.name: Mark 12:11
verses.text: This was the Lord’s doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?

verses.name: Mark 12:12
verses.text: And they sought to lay hold on him, but feared the people: for they knew that he had spoken the parable against them: and they left him, and went their way.

verses.name: Mark 12:13
verses.text: ¶ And they send unto him certain of the Pharisees and of the Herodians, to catch him in <hi type="italic">his</hi> words.

verses.name: Mark 12:14
verses.text: And when they were come, they say unto him, Master, we know that thou art true, and carest for no man: for thou regardest not the person of men, but teachest the way of God in truth: Is it lawful to give tribute to Cæsar, or not?

verses.name: Mark 12:15
verses.text: Shall we give, or shall we not give? But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said unto them, Why tempt ye me? bring me a penny, that I may see <hi type="italic">it</hi>.

verses.name: Mark 12:16
verses.text: And they brought <hi type="italic">it</hi>. And he saith unto them, Whose <hi type="italic">is</hi> this image and superscription? And they said unto him, Cæsar’s.

verses.name: Mark 12:17
verses.text: And Jesus answering said unto them, Render to Cæsar the things that are Cæsar’s, and to God the things that are God’s. And they marvelled at him.

verses.name: Mark 12:18
verses.text: ¶ Then come unto him the Sadducees, which say there is no resurrection; and they asked him, saying,

verses.name: Mark 12:19
verses.text: Master, Moses wrote unto us, If a man’s brother die, and leave <hi type="italic">his</hi> wife <hi type="italic">behind him</hi>, and leave no children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.

verses.name: Mark 12:20
verses.text: Now there were seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and dying left no seed.

verses.name: Mark 12:21
verses.text: And the second took her, and died, neither left he any seed: and the third likewise.

verses.name: Mark 12:22
verses.text: And the seven had her, and left no seed: last of all the woman died also.

verses.name: Mark 12:23
verses.text: In the resurrection therefore, when they shall rise, whose wife shall she be of them? for the seven had her to wife.

verses.name: Mark 12:24
verses.text: And Jesus answering said unto them, Do ye not therefore err, because ye know not the scriptures, neither the power of God?

verses.name: Mark 12:25
verses.text: For when they shall rise from the dead, they neither marry, nor are given in marriage; but are as the angels which are in heaven.

verses.name: Mark 12:26
verses.text: And as touching the dead, that they rise: have ye not read in the book of Moses, how in the bush God spake unto him, saying, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob?

verses.name: Mark 12:27
verses.text: He is not the God of the dead, but the God of the living: ye therefore do greatly err.

verses.name: Mark 12:28
verses.text: ¶ And one of the scribes came, and having heard them reasoning together, and perceiving that he had answered them well, asked him, Which is the first commandment of all?

verses.name: Mark 12:29
verses.text: And Jesus answered him, The first of all the commandments <hi type="italic">is</hi>, Hear, O Israel; The Lord our God is one Lord:

verses.name: Mark 12:30
verses.text: And thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind, and with all thy strength: this <hi type="italic">is</hi> the first commandment.

verses.name: Mark 12:31
verses.text: And the second <hi type="italic">is</hi> like, <hi type="italic">namely</hi> this, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself. There is none other commandment greater than these.

verses.name: Mark 12:32
verses.text: And the scribe said unto him, Well, Master, thou hast said the truth: for there is one God; and there is none other but he:

verses.name: Mark 12:33
verses.text: And to love him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, and with all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love <hi type="italic">his</hi> neighbour as himself, is more than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.

verses.name: Mark 12:34
verses.text: And when Jesus saw that he answered discreetly, he said unto him, Thou art not far from the kingdom of God. And no man after that durst ask him <hi type="italic">any question</hi>.

verses.name: Mark 12:35
verses.text: ¶ And Jesus answered and said, while he taught in the temple, How say the scribes that Christ is the Son of David?

verses.name: Mark 12:36
verses.text: For David himself said by the Holy Ghost, The Lord said to my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstool.

verses.name: Mark 12:37
verses.text: David therefore himself calleth him Lord; and whence is he <hi type="italic">then</hi> his son? And the common people heard him gladly.

verses.name: Mark 12:38
verses.text: ¶ And he said unto them in his doctrine, Beware of the scribes, which love to go in long clothing, and <hi type="italic">love</hi> salutations in the marketplaces,

verses.name: Mark 12:39
verses.text: And the chief seats in the synagogues, and the uppermost rooms at feasts:

verses.name: Mark 12:40
verses.text: Which devour widows’ houses, and for a pretence make long prayers: these shall receive greater damnation.

verses.name: Mark 12:41
verses.text: ¶ And Jesus sat over against the treasury, and beheld how the people cast money into the treasury: and many that were rich cast in much.

verses.name: Mark 12:42
verses.text: And there came a certain poor widow, and she threw in two mites, which make a farthing.

verses.name: Mark 12:43
verses.text: And he called <hi type="italic">unto him</hi> his disciples, and saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That this poor widow hath cast more in, than all they which have cast into the treasury:

verses.name: Mark 12:44
verses.text: For all <hi type="italic">they</hi> did cast in of their abundance; but she of her want did cast in all that she had, <hi type="italic">even</hi> all her living.  <chapter eID="Mark.12"/><div eID="gen1054" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Mark 13:1
verses.text: AND as he went out of the temple, one of his disciples saith unto him, Master, see what manner of stones and what buildings <hi type="italic">are here!</hi>

verses.name: Mark 13:2
verses.text: And Jesus answering said unto him, Seest thou these great buildings? there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.

verses.name: Mark 13:3
verses.text: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives over against the temple, Peter and James and John and Andrew asked him privately,

verses.name: Mark 13:4
verses.text: Tell us, when shall these things be? and what <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> the sign when all these things shall be fulfilled?

verses.name: Mark 13:5
verses.text: And Jesus answering them began to say, Take heed lest any <hi type="italic">man</hi> deceive you:

verses.name: Mark 13:6
verses.text: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am <hi type="italic">Christ;</hi> and shall deceive many.

verses.name: Mark 13:7
verses.text: And when ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars, be ye not troubled: for <hi type="italic">such things</hi> must needs be; but the end <hi type="italic">shall</hi> not <hi type="italic">be</hi> yet.

verses.name: Mark 13:8
verses.text: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be earthquakes in divers places, and there shall be famines and troubles: these <hi type="italic">are</hi> the beginnings of sorrows.

verses.name: Mark 13:9
verses.text: ¶ But take heed to yourselves: for they shall deliver you up to councils; and in the synagogues ye shall be beaten: and ye shall be brought before rulers and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them.

verses.name: Mark 13:10
verses.text: And the gospel must first be published among all nations.

verses.name: Mark 13:11
verses.text: But when they shall lead <hi type="italic">you</hi>, and deliver you up, take no thought beforehand what ye shall speak, neither do ye premeditate: but whatsoever shall be given you in that hour, that speak ye: for it is not ye that speak, but the Holy Ghost.

verses.name: Mark 13:12
verses.text: Now the brother shall betray the brother to death, and the father the son; and children shall rise up against <hi type="italic">their</hi> parents, and shall cause them to be put to death.

verses.name: Mark 13:13
verses.text: And ye shall be hated of all <hi type="italic">men</hi> for my name’s sake: but he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.

verses.name: Mark 13:14
verses.text: ¶ But when ye shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not, (let him that readeth understand,) then let them that be in Judæa flee to the mountains:

verses.name: Mark 13:15
verses.text: And let him that is on the housetop not go down into the house, neither enter <hi type="italic">therein</hi>, to take any thing out of his house:

verses.name: Mark 13:16
verses.text: And let him that is in the field not turn back again for to take up his garment.

verses.name: Mark 13:17
verses.text: But woe to them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!

verses.name: Mark 13:18
verses.text: And pray ye that your flight be not in the winter.

verses.name: Mark 13:19
verses.text: For <hi type="italic">in</hi> those days shall be affliction, such as was not from the beginning of the creation which God created unto this time, neither shall be.

verses.name: Mark 13:20
verses.text: And except that the Lord had shortened those days, no flesh should be saved: but for the elect’s sake, whom he hath chosen, he hath shortened the days.

verses.name: Mark 13:21
verses.text: And then if any man shall say to you, Lo, here <hi type="italic">is</hi> Christ; or, lo, <hi type="italic">he is</hi> there; believe <hi type="italic">him</hi> not:

verses.name: Mark 13:22
verses.text: For false Christs and false prophets shall rise, and shall shew signs and wonders, to seduce, if <hi type="italic">it were</hi> possible, even the elect.

verses.name: Mark 13:23
verses.text: But take ye heed: behold, I have foretold you all things.

verses.name: Mark 13:24
verses.text: ¶ But in those days, after that tribulation, the sun shall be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light,

verses.name: Mark 13:25
verses.text: And the stars of heaven shall fall, and the powers that are in heaven shall be shaken.

verses.name: Mark 13:26
verses.text: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in the clouds with great power and glory.

verses.name: Mark 13:27
verses.text: And then shall he send his angels, and shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from the uttermost part of the earth to the uttermost part of heaven.

verses.name: Mark 13:28
verses.text: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When her branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is near:

verses.name: Mark 13:29
verses.text: So ye in like manner, when ye shall see these things come to pass, know that it is nigh, <hi type="italic">even</hi> at the doors.

verses.name: Mark 13:30
verses.text: Verily I say unto you, that this generation shall not pass, till all these things be done.

verses.name: Mark 13:31
verses.text: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.

verses.name: Mark 13:32
verses.text: ¶ But of that day and <hi type="italic">that</hi> hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels which are in heaven, neither the Son, but the Father.

verses.name: Mark 13:33
verses.text: Take ye heed, watch and pray: for ye know not when the time is.

verses.name: Mark 13:34
verses.text: <hi type="italic">For the Son of man is</hi> as a man taking a far journey, who left his house, and gave authority to his servants, and to every man his work, and commanded the porter to watch.

verses.name: Mark 13:35
verses.text: Watch ye therefore: for ye know not when the master of the house cometh, at even, or at midnight, or at the cockcrowing, or in the morning:

verses.name: Mark 13:36
verses.text: Lest coming suddenly he find you sleeping.

verses.name: Mark 13:37
verses.text: And what I say unto you I say unto all, Watch.  <chapter eID="Mark.13"/><div eID="gen1055" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Mark 14:1
verses.text: AFTER two days was <hi type="italic">the feast of</hi> the passover, and of unleavened bread: and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might take him by craft, and put <hi type="italic">him</hi> to death.

verses.name: Mark 14:2
verses.text: But they said, Not on the feast <hi type="italic">day</hi>, lest there be an uproar of the people.

verses.name: Mark 14:3
verses.text: ¶ And being in Bethany in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at meat, there came a woman having an alabaster box of ointment of spikenard very precious; and she brake the box, and poured <hi type="italic">it</hi> on his head.

verses.name: Mark 14:4
verses.text: And there were some that had indignation within themselves, and said, Why was this waste of the ointment made?

verses.name: Mark 14:5
verses.text: For it might have been sold for more than three hundred pence, and have been given to the poor. And they murmured against her.

verses.name: Mark 14:6
verses.text: And Jesus said, Let her alone; why trouble ye her? she hath wrought a good work on me.

verses.name: Mark 14:7
verses.text: For ye have the poor with you always, and whensoever ye will ye may do them good: but me ye have not always.

verses.name: Mark 14:8
verses.text: She hath done what she could: she is come aforehand to anoint my body to the burying.

verses.name: Mark 14:9
verses.text: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached throughout the whole world, <hi type="italic">this</hi> also that she hath done shall be spoken of for a memorial of her.

verses.name: Mark 14:10
verses.text: ¶ And Judas Iscariot, one of the twelve, went unto the chief priests, to betray him unto them.

verses.name: Mark 14:11
verses.text: And when they heard <hi type="italic">it</hi>, they were glad, and promised to give him money. And he sought how he might conveniently betray him.

verses.name: Mark 14:12
verses.text: ¶ And the first day of unleavened bread, when they killed the passover, his disciples said unto him, Where wilt thou that we go and prepare that thou mayest eat the passover?

verses.name: Mark 14:13
verses.text: And he sendeth forth two of his disciples, and saith unto them, Go ye into the city, and there shall meet you a man bearing a pitcher of water: follow him.

verses.name: Mark 14:14
verses.text: And wheresoever he shall go in, say ye to the goodman of the house, The Master saith, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?

verses.name: Mark 14:15
verses.text: And he will shew you a large upper room furnished <hi type="italic">and</hi> prepared: there make ready for us.

verses.name: Mark 14:16
verses.text: And his disciples went forth, and came into the city, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.

verses.name: Mark 14:17
verses.text: And in the evening he cometh with the twelve.

verses.name: Mark 14:18
verses.text: And as they sat and did eat, Jesus said, Verily I say unto you, One of you which eateth with me shall betray me.

verses.name: Mark 14:19
verses.text: And they began to be sorrowful, and to say unto him one by one, <hi type="italic">Is</hi> it I? and another <hi type="italic">said</hi>, <hi type="italic">Is</hi> it I?

verses.name: Mark 14:20
verses.text: And he answered and said unto them, <hi type="italic">It is</hi> one of the twelve, that dippeth with me in the dish.

verses.name: Mark 14:21
verses.text: The Son of man indeed goeth, as it is written of him: but woe to that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! good were it for that man if he had never been born.

verses.name: Mark 14:22
verses.text: ¶ And as they did eat, Jesus took bread, and blessed, and brake <hi type="italic">it</hi>, and gave to them, and said, Take, eat: this is my body.

verses.name: Mark 14:23
verses.text: And he took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave <hi type="italic">it</hi> to them: and they all drank of it.

verses.name: Mark 14:24
verses.text: And he said unto them, This is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many.

verses.name: Mark 14:25
verses.text: Verily I say unto you, I will drink no more of the fruit of the vine, until that day that I drink it new in the kingdom of God.

verses.name: Mark 14:26
verses.text: ¶ And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.

verses.name: Mark 14:27
verses.text: And Jesus saith unto them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered.

verses.name: Mark 14:28
verses.text: But after that I am risen, I will go before you into Galilee.

verses.name: Mark 14:29
verses.text: But Peter said unto him, Although all shall be offended, yet <hi type="italic">will</hi> not I.

verses.name: Mark 14:30
verses.text: And Jesus saith unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this day, <hi type="italic">even</hi> in this night, before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice.

verses.name: Mark 14:31
verses.text: But he spake the more vehemently, If I should die with thee, I will not deny thee in any wise. Likewise also said they all.

verses.name: Mark 14:32
verses.text: And they came to a place which was named Gethsemane: and he saith to his disciples, Sit ye here, while I shall pray.

verses.name: Mark 14:33
verses.text: And he taketh with him Peter and James and John, and began to be sore amazed, and to be very heavy;

verses.name: Mark 14:34
verses.text: And saith unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful unto death: tarry ye here, and watch.

verses.name: Mark 14:35
verses.text: And he went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that, if it were possible, the hour might pass from him.

verses.name: Mark 14:36
verses.text: And he said, Abba, Father, all things <hi type="italic">are</hi> possible unto thee; take away this cup from me: nevertheless not what I will, but what thou wilt.

verses.name: Mark 14:37
verses.text: And he cometh, and findeth them sleeping, and saith unto Peter, Simon, sleepest thou? couldest not thou watch one hour?

verses.name: Mark 14:38
verses.text: Watch ye and pray, lest ye enter into temptation. The spirit truly <hi type="italic">is</hi> ready, but the flesh <hi type="italic">is</hi> weak.

verses.name: Mark 14:39
verses.text: And again he went away, and prayed, and spake the same words.

verses.name: Mark 14:40
verses.text: And when he returned, he found them asleep again, (for their eyes were heavy,) neither wist they what to answer him.

verses.name: Mark 14:41
verses.text: And he cometh the third time, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take <hi type="italic">your</hi> rest: it is enough, the hour is come; behold, the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

verses.name: Mark 14:42
verses.text: Rise up, let us go; lo, he that betrayeth me is at hand.

verses.name: Mark 14:43
verses.text: ¶ And immediately, while he yet spake, cometh Judas, one of the twelve, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and the scribes and the elders.

verses.name: Mark 14:44
verses.text: And he that betrayed him had given them a token, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he; take him, and lead <hi type="italic">him</hi> away safely.

verses.name: Mark 14:45
verses.text: And as soon as he was come, he goeth straightway to him, and saith, Master, master; and kissed him.

verses.name: Mark 14:46
verses.text: ¶ And they laid their hands on him, and took him.

verses.name: Mark 14:47
verses.text: And one of them that stood by drew a sword, and smote a servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.

verses.name: Mark 14:48
verses.text: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Are ye come out, as against a thief, with swords and <hi type="italic">with</hi> staves to take me?

verses.name: Mark 14:49
verses.text: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and ye took me not: but the scriptures must be fulfilled.

verses.name: Mark 14:50
verses.text: And they all forsook him, and fled.

verses.name: Mark 14:51
verses.text: And there followed him a certain young man, having a linen cloth cast about <hi type="italic">his</hi> naked <hi type="italic">body;</hi> and the young men laid hold on him:

verses.name: Mark 14:52
verses.text: And he left the linen cloth, and fled from them naked.

verses.name: Mark 14:53
verses.text: ¶ And they led Jesus away to the high priest: and with him were assembled all the chief priests and the elders and the scribes.

verses.name: Mark 14:54
verses.text: And Peter followed him afar off, even into the palace of the high priest: and he sat with the servants, and warmed himself at the fire.

verses.name: Mark 14:55
verses.text: And the chief priests and all the council sought for witness against Jesus to put him to death; and found none.

verses.name: Mark 14:56
verses.text: For many bare false witness against him, but their witness agreed not together.

verses.name: Mark 14:57
verses.text: And there arose certain, and bare false witness against him, saying,

verses.name: Mark 14:58
verses.text: We heard him say, I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and within three days I will build another made without hands.

verses.name: Mark 14:59
verses.text: But neither so did their witness agree together.

verses.name: Mark 14:60
verses.text: And the high priest stood up in the midst, and asked Jesus, saying, Answerest thou nothing? what <hi type="italic">is it which</hi> these witness against thee?

verses.name: Mark 14:61
verses.text: But he held his peace, and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked him, and said unto him, Art thou the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?

verses.name: Mark 14:62
verses.text: And Jesus said, I am: and ye shall see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.

verses.name: Mark 14:63
verses.text: Then the high priest rent his clothes, and saith, What need we any further witnesses?

verses.name: Mark 14:64
verses.text: Ye have heard the blasphemy: what think ye? And they all condemned him to be guilty of death.

verses.name: Mark 14:65
verses.text: And some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to buffet him, and to say unto him, Prophesy: and the servants did strike him with the palms of their hands.

verses.name: Mark 14:66
verses.text: ¶ And as Peter was beneath in the palace, there cometh one of the maids of the high priest:

verses.name: Mark 14:67
verses.text: And when she saw Peter warming himself, she looked upon him, and said, And thou also wast with Jesus of Nazareth.

verses.name: Mark 14:68
verses.text: But he denied, saying, I know not, neither understand I what thou sayest. And he went out into the porch; and the cock crew.

verses.name: Mark 14:69
verses.text: And a maid saw him again, and began to say to them that stood by, This is <hi type="italic">one</hi> of them.

verses.name: Mark 14:70
verses.text: And he denied it again. And a little after, they that stood by said again to Peter, Surely thou art <hi type="italic">one</hi> of them: for thou art a Galilæan, and thy speech agreeth <hi type="italic">thereto</hi>.

verses.name: Mark 14:71
verses.text: But he began to curse and to swear, <hi type="italic">saying</hi>, I know not this man of whom ye speak.

verses.name: Mark 14:72
verses.text: And the second time the cock crew. And Peter called to mind the word that Jesus said unto him, Before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice. And when he thought thereon, he wept.  <chapter eID="Mark.14"/><div eID="gen1056" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Mark 15:1
verses.text: AND straightway in the morning the chief priests held a consultation with the elders and scribes and the whole council, and bound Jesus, and carried <hi type="italic">him</hi> away, and delivered <hi type="italic">him</hi> to Pilate.

verses.name: Mark 15:2
verses.text: And Pilate asked him, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answering said unto him, Thou sayest <hi type="italic">it</hi>.

verses.name: Mark 15:3
verses.text: And the chief priests accused him of many things: but he answered nothing.

verses.name: Mark 15:4
verses.text: And Pilate asked him again, saying, Answerest thou nothing? behold how many things they witness against thee.

verses.name: Mark 15:5
verses.text: But Jesus yet answered nothing; so that Pilate marvelled.

verses.name: Mark 15:6
verses.text: Now at <hi type="italic">that</hi> feast he released unto them one prisoner, whomsoever they desired.

verses.name: Mark 15:7
verses.text: And there was <hi type="italic">one</hi> named Barabbas, <hi type="italic">which lay</hi> bound with them that had made insurrection with him, who had committed murder in the insurrection.

verses.name: Mark 15:8
verses.text: And the multitude crying aloud began to desire <hi type="italic">him to do</hi> as he had ever done unto them.

verses.name: Mark 15:9
verses.text: But Pilate answered them, saying, Will ye that I release unto you the King of the Jews?

verses.name: Mark 15:10
verses.text: For he knew that the chief priests had delivered him for envy.

verses.name: Mark 15:11
verses.text: But the chief priests moved the people, that he should rather release Barabbas unto them.

verses.name: Mark 15:12
verses.text: And Pilate answered and said again unto them, What will ye then that I shall do <hi type="italic">unto him</hi> whom ye call the King of the Jews?

verses.name: Mark 15:13
verses.text: And they cried out again, Crucify him.

verses.name: Mark 15:14
verses.text: Then Pilate said unto them, Why, what evil hath he done? And they cried out the more exceedingly, Crucify him.

verses.name: Mark 15:15
verses.text: ¶ And <hi type="italic">so</hi> Pilate, willing to content the people, released Barabbas unto them, and delivered Jesus, when he had scourged <hi type="italic">him</hi>, to be crucified.

verses.name: Mark 15:16
verses.text: And the soldiers led him away into the hall, called Prætorium; and they call together the whole band.

verses.name: Mark 15:17
verses.text: And they clothed him with purple, and platted a crown of thorns, and put it about his <hi type="italic">head</hi>,

verses.name: Mark 15:18
verses.text: And began to salute him, Hail, King of the Jews!

verses.name: Mark 15:19
verses.text: And they smote him on the head with a reed, and did spit upon him, and bowing <hi type="italic">their</hi> knees worshipped him.

verses.name: Mark 15:20
verses.text: And when they had mocked him, they took off the purple from him, and put his own clothes on him, and led him out to crucify him.

verses.name: Mark 15:21
verses.text: And they compel one Simon a Cyrenian, who passed by, coming out of the country, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to bear his cross.

verses.name: Mark 15:22
verses.text: And they bring him unto the place Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, The place of a skull.

verses.name: Mark 15:23
verses.text: And they gave him to drink wine mingled with myrrh: but he received <hi type="italic">it</hi> not.

verses.name: Mark 15:24
verses.text: And when they had crucified him, they parted his garments, casting lots upon them, what every man should take.

verses.name: Mark 15:25
verses.text: And it was the third hour, and they crucified him.

verses.name: Mark 15:26
verses.text: And the superscription of his accusation was written over, THE KING OF THE JEWS.

verses.name: Mark 15:27
verses.text: And with him they crucify two thieves; the one on his right hand, and the other on his left.

verses.name: Mark 15:28
verses.text: And the scripture was fulfilled, which saith, And he was numbered with the transgressors.

verses.name: Mark 15:29
verses.text: And they that passed by railed on him, wagging their heads, and saying, Ah, thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest <hi type="italic">it</hi> in three days,

verses.name: Mark 15:30
verses.text: Save thyself, and come down from the cross.

verses.name: Mark 15:31
verses.text: Likewise also the chief priests mocking said among themselves with the scribes, He saved others; himself he cannot save.

verses.name: Mark 15:32
verses.text: Let Christ the King of Israel descend now from the cross, that we may see and believe. And they that were crucified with him reviled him.

verses.name: Mark 15:33
verses.text: And when the sixth hour was come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.

verses.name: Mark 15:34
verses.text: And at the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani? which is, being interpreted, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?

verses.name: Mark 15:35
verses.text: And some of them that stood by, when they heard <hi type="italic">it</hi>, said, Behold, he calleth Elias.

verses.name: Mark 15:36
verses.text: And one ran and filled a spunge full of vinegar, and put <hi type="italic">it</hi> on a reed, and gave him to drink, saying, Let alone; let us see whether Elias will come to take him down.

verses.name: Mark 15:37
verses.text: And Jesus cried with a loud voice, and gave up the ghost.

verses.name: Mark 15:38
verses.text: And the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom.

verses.name: Mark 15:39
verses.text: ¶ And when the centurion, which stood over against him, saw that he so cried out, and gave up the ghost, he said, Truly this man was the Son of God.

verses.name: Mark 15:40
verses.text: There were also women looking on afar off: among whom was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome;

verses.name: Mark 15:41
verses.text: (Who also, when he was in Galilee, followed him, and ministered unto him;) and many other women which came up with him unto Jerusalem.

verses.name: Mark 15:42
verses.text: ¶ And now when the even was come, because it was the preparation, that is, the day before the sabbath,

verses.name: Mark 15:43
verses.text: Joseph of Arimathæa, an honourable counseller, which also waited for the kingdom of God, came, and went in boldly unto Pilate, and craved the body of Jesus.

verses.name: Mark 15:44
verses.text: And Pilate marvelled if he were already dead: and calling <hi type="italic">unto him</hi> the centurion, he asked him whether he had been any while dead.

verses.name: Mark 15:45
verses.text: And when he knew <hi type="italic">it</hi> of the centurion, he gave the body to Joseph.

verses.name: Mark 15:46
verses.text: And he bought fine linen, and took him down, and wrapped him in the linen, and laid him in a sepulchre which was hewn out of a rock, and rolled a stone unto the door of the sepulchre.

verses.name: Mark 15:47
verses.text: And Mary Magdalene and Mary <hi type="italic">the mother</hi> of Joses beheld where he was laid.  <chapter eID="Mark.15"/><div eID="gen1057" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Mark 16:1
verses.text: AND when the sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the <hi type="italic">mother</hi> of James, and Salome, had bought sweet spices, that they might come and anoint him.

verses.name: Mark 16:2
verses.text: And very early in the morning the first <hi type="italic">day</hi> of the week, they came unto the sepulchre at the rising of the sun.

verses.name: Mark 16:3
verses.text: And they said among themselves, Who shall roll us away the stone from the door of the sepulchre?

verses.name: Mark 16:4
verses.text: And when they looked, they saw that the stone was rolled away: for it was very great.

verses.name: Mark 16:5
verses.text: And entering into the sepulchre, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, clothed in a long white garment; and they were affrighted.

verses.name: Mark 16:6
verses.text: And he saith unto them, Be not affrighted: Ye seek Jesus of Nazareth, which was crucified: he is risen; he is not here: behold the place where they laid him.

verses.name: Mark 16:7
verses.text: But go your way, tell his disciples and Peter that he goeth before you into Galilee: there shall ye see him, as he said unto you.

verses.name: Mark 16:8
verses.text: And they went out quickly, and fled from the sepulchre; for they trembled and were amazed: neither said they any thing to any <hi type="italic">man;</hi> for they were afraid.

verses.name: Mark 16:9
verses.text: ¶ Now when <hi type="italic">Jesus</hi> was risen early the first <hi type="italic">day</hi> of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, out of whom he had cast seven devils.

verses.name: Mark 16:10
verses.text: <hi type="italic">And</hi> she went and told them that had been with him, as they mourned and wept.

verses.name: Mark 16:11
verses.text: And they, when they had heard that he was alive, and had been seen of her, believed not.

verses.name: Mark 16:12
verses.text: ¶ After that he appeared in another form unto two of them, as they walked, and went into the country.

verses.name: Mark 16:13
verses.text: And they went and told <hi type="italic">it</hi> unto the residue: neither believed they them.

verses.name: Mark 16:14
verses.text: ¶ Afterward he appeared unto the eleven as they sat at meat, and upbraided them with their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they believed not them which had seen him after he was risen.

verses.name: Mark 16:15
verses.text: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.

verses.name: Mark 16:16
verses.text: He that believeth and is baptized shall be saved; but he that believeth not shall be damned.

verses.name: Mark 16:17
verses.text: And these signs shall follow them that believe; In my name shall they cast out devils; they shall speak with new tongues;

verses.name: Mark 16:18
verses.text: They shall take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it shall not hurt them; they shall lay hands on the sick, and they shall recover.

verses.name: Mark 16:19
verses.text: ¶ So then after the Lord had spoken unto them, he was received up into heaven, and sat on the right hand of God.

verses.name: Mark 16:20
verses.text: And they went forth, and preached every where, the Lord working with <hi type="italic">them</hi>, and confirming the word with signs following. Amen.  <chapter eID="Mark.16"/><div eID="gen1058" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen1042" osisID="Mark" type="book"/>

verses.name: Luke 1:1
verses.text: FORASMUCH as many have taken in hand to set forth in order a declaration of those things which are most surely believed among us,

verses.name: Luke 1:2
verses.text: Even as they delivered them unto us, which from the beginning were eyewitnesses, and ministers of the word;

verses.name: Luke 1:3
verses.text: It seemed good to me also, having had perfect understanding of all things from the very first, to write unto thee in order, most excellent Theophilus,

verses.name: Luke 1:4
verses.text: That thou mightest know the certainty of those things, wherein thou hast been instructed.

verses.name: Luke 1:5
verses.text: ¶ THERE was in the days of Herod, the king of Judæa, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the course of Abia: and his wife <hi type="italic">was</hi> of the daughters of Aaron, and her name <hi type="italic">was</hi> Elisabeth.

verses.name: Luke 1:6
verses.text: And they were both righteous before God, walking in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord blameless.

verses.name: Luke 1:7
verses.text: And they had no child, because that Elisabeth was barren, and they both were <hi type="italic">now</hi> well stricken in years.

verses.name: Luke 1:8
verses.text: And it came to pass, that while he executed the priest’s office before God in the order of his course,

verses.name: Luke 1:9
verses.text: According to the custom of the priest’s office, his lot was to burn incense when he went into the temple of the Lord.

verses.name: Luke 1:10
verses.text: And the whole multitude of the people were praying without at the time of incense.

verses.name: Luke 1:11
verses.text: And there appeared unto him an angel of the Lord standing on the right side of the altar of incense.

verses.name: Luke 1:12
verses.text: And when Zacharias saw <hi type="italic">him</hi>, he was troubled, and fear fell upon him.

verses.name: Luke 1:13
verses.text: But the angel said unto him, Fear not, Zacharias: for thy prayer is heard; and thy wife Elisabeth shall bear thee a son, and thou shalt call his name John.

verses.name: Luke 1:14
verses.text: And thou shalt have joy and gladness; and many shall rejoice at his birth.

verses.name: Luke 1:15
verses.text: For he shall be great in the sight of the Lord, and shall drink neither wine nor strong drink; and he shall be filled with the Holy Ghost, even from his mother’s womb.

verses.name: Luke 1:16
verses.text: And many of the children of Israel shall he turn to the Lord their God.

verses.name: Luke 1:17
verses.text: And he shall go before him in the spirit and power of Elias, to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children, and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just; to make ready a people prepared for the Lord.

verses.name: Luke 1:18
verses.text: And Zacharias said unto the angel, Whereby shall I know this? for I am an old man, and my wife well stricken in years.

verses.name: Luke 1:19
verses.text: And the angel answering said unto him, I am Gabriel, that stand in the presence of God; and am sent to speak unto thee, and to shew thee these glad tidings.

verses.name: Luke 1:20
verses.text: And, behold, thou shalt be dumb, and not able to speak, until the day that these things shall be performed, because thou believest not my words, which shall be fulfilled in their season.

verses.name: Luke 1:21
verses.text: And the people waited for Zacharias, and marvelled that he tarried so long in the temple.

verses.name: Luke 1:22
verses.text: And when he came out, he could not speak unto them: and they perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple: for he beckoned unto them, and remained speechless.

verses.name: Luke 1:23
verses.text: And it came to pass, that, as soon as the days of his ministration were accomplished, he departed to his own house.

verses.name: Luke 1:24
verses.text: And after those days his wife Elisabeth conceived, and hid herself five months, saying,

verses.name: Luke 1:25
verses.text: Thus hath the Lord dealt with me in the days wherein he looked on <hi type="italic">me</hi>, to take away my reproach among men.

verses.name: Luke 1:26
verses.text: And in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from God unto a city of Galilee, named Nazareth,

verses.name: Luke 1:27
verses.text: To a virgin espoused to a man whose name was Joseph, of the house of David; and the virgin’s name <hi type="italic">was</hi> Mary.

verses.name: Luke 1:28
verses.text: And the angel came in unto her, and said, Hail, <hi type="italic">thou that art</hi> highly favoured, the Lord <hi type="italic">is</hi> with thee: blessed <hi type="italic">art</hi> thou among women.

verses.name: Luke 1:29
verses.text: And when she saw <hi type="italic">him</hi>, she was troubled at his saying, and cast in her mind what manner of salutation this should be.

verses.name: Luke 1:30
verses.text: And the angel said unto her, Fear not, Mary: for thou hast found favour with God.

verses.name: Luke 1:31
verses.text: And, behold, thou shalt conceive in thy womb, and bring forth a son, and shalt call his name JESUS.

verses.name: Luke 1:32
verses.text: He shall be great, and shall be called the Son of the Highest: and the Lord God shall give unto him the throne of his father David:

verses.name: Luke 1:33
verses.text: And he shall reign over the house of Jacob for ever; and of his kingdom there shall be no end.

verses.name: Luke 1:34
verses.text: Then said Mary unto the angel, How shall this be, seeing I know not a man?

verses.name: Luke 1:35
verses.text: And the angel answered and said unto her, The Holy Ghost shall come upon thee, and the power of the Highest shall overshadow thee: therefore also that holy thing which shall be born of thee shall be called the Son of God.

verses.name: Luke 1:36
verses.text: And, behold, thy cousin Elisabeth, she hath also conceived a son in her old age: and this is the sixth month with her, who was called barren.

verses.name: Luke 1:37
verses.text: For with God nothing shall be impossible.

verses.name: Luke 1:38
verses.text: And Mary said, Behold the handmaid of the Lord; be it unto me according to thy word. And the angel departed from her.

verses.name: Luke 1:39
verses.text: And Mary arose in those days, and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Juda;

verses.name: Luke 1:40
verses.text: And entered into the house of Zacharias, and saluted Elisabeth.

verses.name: Luke 1:41
verses.text: And it came to pass, that, when Elisabeth heard the salutation of Mary, the babe leaped in her womb; and Elisabeth was filled with the Holy Ghost:

verses.name: Luke 1:42
verses.text: And she spake out with a loud voice, and said, Blessed <hi type="italic">art</hi> thou among women, and blessed <hi type="italic">is</hi> the fruit of thy womb.

verses.name: Luke 1:43
verses.text: And whence <hi type="italic">is</hi> this to me, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?

verses.name: Luke 1:44
verses.text: For, lo, as soon as the voice of thy salutation sounded in mine ears, the babe leaped in my womb for joy.

verses.name: Luke 1:45
verses.text: And blessed <hi type="italic">is</hi> she that believed: for there shall be a performance of those things which were told her from the Lord.

verses.name: Luke 1:46
verses.text: And Mary said, My soul doth magnify the Lord,

verses.name: Luke 1:47
verses.text: And my spirit hath rejoiced in God my Saviour.

verses.name: Luke 1:48
verses.text: For he hath regarded the low estate of his handmaiden: for, behold, from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed.

verses.name: Luke 1:49
verses.text: For he that is mighty hath done to me great things; and holy <hi type="italic">is</hi> his name.

verses.name: Luke 1:50
verses.text: And his mercy <hi type="italic">is</hi> on them that fear him from generation to generation.

verses.name: Luke 1:51
verses.text: He hath shewed strength with his arm; he hath scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.

verses.name: Luke 1:52
verses.text: He hath put down the mighty from <hi type="italic">their</hi> seats, and exalted them of low degree.

verses.name: Luke 1:53
verses.text: He hath filled the hungry with good things; and the rich he hath sent empty away.

verses.name: Luke 1:54
verses.text: He hath holpen his servant Israel, in remembrance of <hi type="italic">his</hi> mercy;

verses.name: Luke 1:55
verses.text: As he spake to our fathers, to Abraham, and to his seed for ever.

verses.name: Luke 1:56
verses.text: And Mary abode with her about three months, and returned to her own house.

verses.name: Luke 1:57
verses.text: Now Elisabeth’s full time came that she should be delivered; and she brought forth a son.

verses.name: Luke 1:58
verses.text: And her neighbours and her cousins heard how the Lord had shewed great mercy upon her; and they rejoiced with her.

verses.name: Luke 1:59
verses.text: And it came to pass, that on the eighth day they came to circumcise the child; and they called him Zacharias, after the name of his father.

verses.name: Luke 1:60
verses.text: And his mother answered and said, Not <hi type="italic">so;</hi> but he shall be called John.

verses.name: Luke 1:61
verses.text: And they said unto her, There is none of thy kindred that is called by this name.

verses.name: Luke 1:62
verses.text: And they made signs to his father, how he would have him called.

verses.name: Luke 1:63
verses.text: And he asked for a writing table, and wrote, saying, His name is John. And they marvelled all.

verses.name: Luke 1:64
verses.text: And his mouth was opened immediately, and his tongue <hi type="italic">loosed</hi>, and he spake, and praised God.

verses.name: Luke 1:65
verses.text: And fear came on all that dwelt round about them: and all these sayings were noised abroad throughout all the hill country of Judæa.

verses.name: Luke 1:66
verses.text: And all they that heard <hi type="italic">them</hi> laid <hi type="italic">them</hi> up in their hearts, saying, What manner of child shall this be! And the hand of the Lord was with him.

verses.name: Luke 1:67
verses.text: And his father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Ghost, and prophesied, saying,

verses.name: Luke 1:68
verses.text: Blessed <hi type="italic">be</hi> the Lord God of Israel; for he hath visited and redeemed his people,

verses.name: Luke 1:69
verses.text: And hath raised up an horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David;

verses.name: Luke 1:70
verses.text: As he spake by the mouth of his holy prophets, which have been since the world began:

verses.name: Luke 1:71
verses.text: That we should be saved from our enemies, and from the hand of all that hate us;

verses.name: Luke 1:72
verses.text: To perform the mercy <hi type="italic">promised</hi> to our fathers, and to remember his holy covenant;

verses.name: Luke 1:73
verses.text: The oath which he sware to our father Abraham,

verses.name: Luke 1:74
verses.text: That he would grant unto us, that we being delivered out of the hand of our enemies might serve him without fear,

verses.name: Luke 1:75
verses.text: In holiness and righteousness before him, all the days of our life.

verses.name: Luke 1:76
verses.text: And thou, child, shalt be called the prophet of the Highest: for thou shalt go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways;

verses.name: Luke 1:77
verses.text: To give knowledge of salvation unto his people by the remission of their sins,

verses.name: Luke 1:78
verses.text: Through the tender mercy of our God; whereby the dayspring from on high hath visited us,

verses.name: Luke 1:79
verses.text: To give light to them that sit in darkness and <hi type="italic">in</hi> the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the way of peace.

verses.name: Luke 1:80
verses.text: And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, and was in the deserts till the day of his shewing unto Israel.  <chapter eID="Luke.1"/><div eID="gen1060" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Luke 2:1
verses.text: AND it came to pass in those days, that there went out a decree from Cæsar Augustus, that all the world should be taxed.

verses.name: Luke 2:2
verses.text: (<hi type="italic">And</hi> this taxing was first made when Cyrenius was governor of Syria.)

verses.name: Luke 2:3
verses.text: And all went to be taxed, every one into his own city.

verses.name: Luke 2:4
verses.text: And Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judæa, unto the city of David, which is called Bethlehem; (because he was of the house and lineage of David:)

verses.name: Luke 2:5
verses.text: To be taxed with Mary his espoused wife, being great with child.

verses.name: Luke 2:6
verses.text: And so it was, that, while they were there, the days were accomplished that she should be delivered.

verses.name: Luke 2:7
verses.text: And she brought forth her firstborn son, and wrapped him in swaddling clothes, and laid him in a manger; because there was no room for them in the inn.

verses.name: Luke 2:8
verses.text: And there were in the same country shepherds abiding in the field, keeping watch over their flock by night.

verses.name: Luke 2:9
verses.text: And, lo, the angel of the Lord came upon them, and the glory of the Lord shone round about them: and they were sore afraid.

verses.name: Luke 2:10
verses.text: And the angel said unto them, Fear not: for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all people.

verses.name: Luke 2:11
verses.text: For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.

verses.name: Luke 2:12
verses.text: And this <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> a sign unto you; Ye shall find the babe wrapped in swaddling clothes, lying in a manger.

verses.name: Luke 2:13
verses.text: And suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly host praising God, and saying,

verses.name: Luke 2:14
verses.text: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men.

verses.name: Luke 2:15
verses.text: And it came to pass, as the angels were gone away from them into heaven, the shepherds said one to another, Let us now go even unto Bethlehem, and see this thing which is come to pass, which the Lord hath made known unto us.

verses.name: Luke 2:16
verses.text: And they came with haste, and found Mary, and Joseph, and the babe lying in a manger.

verses.name: Luke 2:17
verses.text: And when they had seen <hi type="italic">it</hi>, they made known abroad the saying which was told them concerning this child.

verses.name: Luke 2:18
verses.text: And all they that heard <hi type="italic">it</hi> wondered at those things which were told them by the shepherds.

verses.name: Luke 2:19
verses.text: But Mary kept all these things, and pondered <hi type="italic">them</hi> in her heart.

verses.name: Luke 2:20
verses.text: And the shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, as it was told unto them.

verses.name: Luke 2:21
verses.text: And when eight days were accomplished for the circumcising of the child, his name was called JESUS, which was so named of the angel before he was conceived in the womb.

verses.name: Luke 2:22
verses.text: And when the days of her purification according to the law of Moses were accomplished, they brought him to Jerusalem, to present <hi type="italic">him</hi> to the Lord;

verses.name: Luke 2:23
verses.text: (As it is written in the law of the Lord, Every male that openeth the womb shall be called holy to the Lord;)

verses.name: Luke 2:24
verses.text: And to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.

verses.name: Luke 2:25
verses.text: And, behold, there was a man in Jerusalem, whose name <hi type="italic">was</hi> Simeon; and the same man <hi type="italic">was</hi> just and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel: and the Holy Ghost was upon him.

verses.name: Luke 2:26
verses.text: And it was revealed unto him by the Holy Ghost, that he should not see death, before he had seen the Lord’s Christ.

verses.name: Luke 2:27
verses.text: And he came by the Spirit into the temple: and when the parents brought in the child Jesus, to do for him after the custom of the law,

verses.name: Luke 2:28
verses.text: Then took he him up in his arms, and blessed God, and said,

verses.name: Luke 2:29
verses.text: Lord, now lettest thou thy servant depart in peace, according to thy word:

verses.name: Luke 2:30
verses.text: For mine eyes have seen thy salvation,

verses.name: Luke 2:31
verses.text: Which thou hast prepared before the face of all people;

verses.name: Luke 2:32
verses.text: A light to lighten the Gentiles, and the glory of thy people Israel.

verses.name: Luke 2:33
verses.text: And Joseph and his mother marvelled at those things which were spoken of him.

verses.name: Luke 2:34
verses.text: And Simeon blessed them, and said unto Mary his mother, Behold, this <hi type="italic">child</hi> is set for the fall and rising again of many in Israel; and for a sign which shall be spoken against;

verses.name: Luke 2:35
verses.text: (Yea, a sword shall pierce through thy own soul also,) that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.

verses.name: Luke 2:36
verses.text: And there was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Aser: she was of a great age, and had lived with an husband seven years from her virginity;

verses.name: Luke 2:37
verses.text: And she <hi type="italic">was</hi> a widow of about fourscore and four years, which departed not from the temple, but served <hi type="italic">God</hi> with fastings and prayers night and day.

verses.name: Luke 2:38
verses.text: And she coming in that instant gave thanks likewise unto the Lord, and spake of him to all them that looked for redemption in Jerusalem.

verses.name: Luke 2:39
verses.text: And when they had performed all things according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city Nazareth.

verses.name: Luke 2:40
verses.text: And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, filled with wisdom: and the grace of God was upon him.

verses.name: Luke 2:41
verses.text: Now his parents went to Jerusalem every year at the feast of the passover.

verses.name: Luke 2:42
verses.text: And when he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem after the custom of the feast.

verses.name: Luke 2:43
verses.text: And when they had fulfilled the days, as they returned, the child Jesus tarried behind in Jerusalem; and Joseph and his mother knew not <hi type="italic">of it</hi>.

verses.name: Luke 2:44
verses.text: But they, supposing him to have been in the company, went a day’s journey; and they sought him among <hi type="italic">their</hi> kinsfolk and acquaintance.

verses.name: Luke 2:45
verses.text: And when they found him not, they turned back again to Jerusalem, seeking him.

verses.name: Luke 2:46
verses.text: And it came to pass, that after three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the doctors, both hearing them, and asking them questions.

verses.name: Luke 2:47
verses.text: And all that heard him were astonished at his understanding and answers.

verses.name: Luke 2:48
verses.text: And when they saw him, they were amazed: and his mother said unto him, Son, why hast thou thus dealt with us? behold, thy father and I have sought thee sorrowing.

verses.name: Luke 2:49
verses.text: And he said unto them, How is it that ye sought me? wist ye not that I must be about my Father’s business?

verses.name: Luke 2:50
verses.text: And they understood not the saying which he spake unto them.

verses.name: Luke 2:51
verses.text: And he went down with them, and came to Nazareth, and was subject unto them: but his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.

verses.name: Luke 2:52
verses.text: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favour with God and man.  <chapter eID="Luke.2"/><div eID="gen1061" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Luke 3:1
verses.text: NOW in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Cæsar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judæa, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of Ituræa and of the region of Trachonitis, and Lysanias the tetrarch of Abilene,

verses.name: Luke 3:2
verses.text: Annas and Caiaphas being the high priests, the word of God came unto John the son of Zacharias in the wilderness.

verses.name: Luke 3:3
verses.text: And he came into all the country about Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins;

verses.name: Luke 3:4
verses.text: As it is written in the book of the words of Esaias the prophet, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.

verses.name: Luke 3:5
verses.text: Every valley shall be filled, and every mountain and hill shall be brought low; and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough ways <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> made smooth;

verses.name: Luke 3:6
verses.text: And all flesh shall see the salvation of God.

verses.name: Luke 3:7
verses.text: Then said he to the multitude that came forth to be baptized of him, O generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

verses.name: Luke 3:8
verses.text: Bring forth therefore fruits worthy of repentance, and begin not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to <hi type="italic">our</hi> father: for I say unto you, That God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.

verses.name: Luke 3:9
verses.text: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: every tree therefore which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.

verses.name: Luke 3:10
verses.text: And the people asked him, saying, What shall we do then?

verses.name: Luke 3:11
verses.text: He answereth and saith unto them, He that hath two coats, let him impart to him that hath none; and he that hath meat, let him do likewise.

verses.name: Luke 3:12
verses.text: Then came also publicans to be baptized, and said unto him, Master, what shall we do?

verses.name: Luke 3:13
verses.text: And he said unto them, Exact no more than that which is appointed you.

verses.name: Luke 3:14
verses.text: And the soldiers likewise demanded of him, saying, And what shall we do? And he said unto them, Do violence to no man, neither accuse <hi type="italic">any</hi> falsely; and be content with your wages.

verses.name: Luke 3:15
verses.text: And as the people were in expectation, and all men mused in their hearts of John, whether he were the Christ, or not;

verses.name: Luke 3:16
verses.text: John answered, saying unto <hi type="italic">them</hi> all, I indeed baptize you with water; but one mightier than I cometh, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to unloose: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost and with fire:

verses.name: Luke 3:17
verses.text: Whose fan <hi type="italic">is</hi> in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and will gather the wheat into his garner; but the chaff he will burn with fire unquenchable.

verses.name: Luke 3:18
verses.text: And many other things in his exhortation preached he unto the people.

verses.name: Luke 3:19
verses.text: But Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias his brother Philip’s wife, and for all the evils which Herod had done,

verses.name: Luke 3:20
verses.text: Added yet this above all, that he shut up John in prison.

verses.name: Luke 3:21
verses.text: Now when all the people were baptized, it came to pass, that Jesus also being baptized, and praying, the heaven was opened,

verses.name: Luke 3:22
verses.text: And the Holy Ghost descended in a bodily shape like a dove upon him, and a voice came from heaven, which said, Thou art my beloved Son; in thee I am well pleased.

verses.name: Luke 3:23
verses.text: And Jesus himself began to be about thirty years of age, being (as was supposed) the son of Joseph, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Heli,

verses.name: Luke 3:24
verses.text: Which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Matthat, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Levi, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Melchi, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Janna, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Joseph,

verses.name: Luke 3:25
verses.text: Which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Mattathias, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Amos, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Naum, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Esli, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Nagge,

verses.name: Luke 3:26
verses.text: Which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Maath, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Mattathias, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Semei, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Joseph, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Juda,

verses.name: Luke 3:27
verses.text: Which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Joanna, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Rhesa, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Zorobabel, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Salathiel, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Neri,

verses.name: Luke 3:28
verses.text: Which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Melchi, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Addi, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Cosam, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Elmodam, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Er,

verses.name: Luke 3:29
verses.text: Which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Jose, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Eliezer, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Jorim, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Matthat, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Levi,

verses.name: Luke 3:30
verses.text: Which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Simeon, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Juda, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Joseph, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Jonan, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Eliakim,

verses.name: Luke 3:31
verses.text: Which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Melea, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Menan, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Mattatha, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Nathan, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of David,

verses.name: Luke 3:32
verses.text: Which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Jesse, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Obed, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Booz, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Salmon, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Naasson,

verses.name: Luke 3:33
verses.text: Which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Aminadab, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Aram, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Esrom, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Phares, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Juda,

verses.name: Luke 3:34
verses.text: Which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Jacob, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Isaac, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Abraham, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Thara, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Nachor,

verses.name: Luke 3:35
verses.text: Which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Saruch, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Ragau, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Phalec, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Heber, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Sala,

verses.name: Luke 3:36
verses.text: Which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Cainan, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Arphaxad, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Sem, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Noe, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Lamech,

verses.name: Luke 3:37
verses.text: Which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Mathusala, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Enoch, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Jared, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Maleleel, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Cainan,

verses.name: Luke 3:38
verses.text: Which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Enos, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Seth, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of Adam, which was <hi type="italic">the son</hi> of God.  <chapter eID="Luke.3"/><div eID="gen1062" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Luke 4:1
verses.text: AND Jesus being full of the Holy Ghost returned from Jordan, and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness,

verses.name: Luke 4:2
verses.text: Being forty days tempted of the devil. And in those days he did eat nothing: and when they were ended, he afterward hungered.

verses.name: Luke 4:3
verses.text: And the devil said unto him, If thou be the Son of God, command this stone that it be made bread.

verses.name: Luke 4:4
verses.text: And Jesus answered him, saying, It is written, That man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God.

verses.name: Luke 4:5
verses.text: And the devil, taking him up into an high mountain, shewed unto him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.

verses.name: Luke 4:6
verses.text: And the devil said unto him, All this power will I give thee, and the glory of them: for that is delivered unto me; and to whomsoever I will I give it.

verses.name: Luke 4:7
verses.text: If thou therefore wilt worship me, all shall be thine.

verses.name: Luke 4:8
verses.text: And Jesus answered and said unto him, Get thee behind me, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.

verses.name: Luke 4:9
verses.text: And he brought him to Jerusalem, and set him on a pinnacle of the temple, and said unto him, If thou be the Son of God, cast thyself down from hence:

verses.name: Luke 4:10
verses.text: For it is written, He shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee:

verses.name: Luke 4:11
verses.text: And in <hi type="italic">their</hi> hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.

verses.name: Luke 4:12
verses.text: And Jesus answering said unto him, It is said, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.

verses.name: Luke 4:13
verses.text: And when the devil had ended all the temptation, he departed from him for a season.

verses.name: Luke 4:14
verses.text: ¶ And Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee: and there went out a fame of him through all the region round about.

verses.name: Luke 4:15
verses.text: And he taught in their synagogues, being glorified of all.

verses.name: Luke 4:16
verses.text: ¶ And he came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up: and, as his custom was, he went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and stood up for to read.

verses.name: Luke 4:17
verses.text: And there was delivered unto him the book of the prophet Esaias. And when he had opened the book, he found the place where it was written,

verses.name: Luke 4:18
verses.text: The Spirit of the Lord <hi type="italic">is</hi> upon me, because he hath anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor; he hath sent me to heal the brokenhearted, to preach deliverance to the captives, and recovering of sight to the blind, to set at liberty them that are bruised,

verses.name: Luke 4:19
verses.text: To preach the acceptable year of the Lord.

verses.name: Luke 4:20
verses.text: And he closed the book, and he gave <hi type="italic">it</hi> again to the minister, and sat down. And the eyes of all them that were in the synagogue were fastened on him.

verses.name: Luke 4:21
verses.text: And he began to say unto them, This day is this scripture fulfilled in your ears.

verses.name: Luke 4:22
verses.text: And all bare him witness, and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth. And they said, Is not this Joseph’s son?

verses.name: Luke 4:23
verses.text: And he said unto them, Ye will surely say unto me this proverb, Physician, heal thyself: whatsoever we have heard done in Capernaum, do also here in thy country.

verses.name: Luke 4:24
verses.text: And he said, Verily I say unto you, No prophet is accepted in his own country.

verses.name: Luke 4:25
verses.text: But I tell you of a truth, many widows were in Israel in the days of Elias, when the heaven was shut up three years and six months, when great famine was throughout all the land;

verses.name: Luke 4:26
verses.text: But unto none of them was Elias sent, save unto Sarepta, <hi type="italic">a city</hi> of Sidon, unto a woman <hi type="italic">that was</hi> a widow.

verses.name: Luke 4:27
verses.text: And many lepers were in Israel in the time of Eliseus the prophet; and none of them was cleansed, saving Naaman the Syrian.

verses.name: Luke 4:28
verses.text: And all they in the synagogue, when they heard these things, were filled with wrath,

verses.name: Luke 4:29
verses.text: And rose up, and thrust him out of the city, and led him unto the brow of the hill whereon their city was built, that they might cast him down headlong.

verses.name: Luke 4:30
verses.text: But he passing through the midst of them went his way,

verses.name: Luke 4:31
verses.text: And came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee, and taught them on the sabbath days.

verses.name: Luke 4:32
verses.text: And they were astonished at his doctrine: for his word was with power.

verses.name: Luke 4:33
