verses.name: Luke 14:5
verses.text: And answered them, saying, Which of you shall have an ass or an ox fallen into a pit, and will not straightway pull him out on the sabbath day?

verses.name: Luke 14:6
verses.text: And they could not answer him again to these things.

verses.name: Luke 14:7
verses.text: ¶ And he put forth a parable to those which were bidden, when he marked how they chose out the chief rooms; saying unto them,

verses.name: Luke 14:8
verses.text: When thou art bidden of any <hi type="italic">man</hi> to a wedding, sit not down in the highest room; lest a more honourable man than thou be bidden of him;

verses.name: Luke 14:9
verses.text: And he that bade thee and him come and say to thee, Give this man place; and thou begin with shame to take the lowest room.

verses.name: Luke 14:10
verses.text: But when thou art bidden, go and sit down in the lowest room; that when he that bade thee cometh, he may say unto thee, Friend, go up higher: then shalt thou have worship in the presence of them that sit at meat with thee.

verses.name: Luke 14:11
verses.text: For whosoever exalteth himself shall be abased; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.

verses.name: Luke 14:12
verses.text: ¶ Then said he also to him that bade him, When thou makest a dinner or a supper, call not thy friends, nor thy brethren, neither thy kinsmen, nor <hi type="italic">thy</hi> rich neighbours; lest they also bid thee again, and a recompence be made thee.

verses.name: Luke 14:13
verses.text: But when thou makest a feast, call the poor, the maimed, the lame, the blind:

verses.name: Luke 14:14
verses.text: And thou shalt be blessed; for they cannot recompense thee: for thou shalt be recompensed at the resurrection of the just.

verses.name: Luke 14:15
verses.text: ¶ And when one of them that sat at meat with him heard these things, he said unto him, Blessed <hi type="italic">is</hi> he that shall eat bread in the kingdom of God.

verses.name: Luke 14:16
verses.text: Then said he unto him, A certain man made a great supper, and bade many:

verses.name: Luke 14:17
verses.text: And sent his servant at supper time to say to them that were bidden, Come; for all things are now ready.

verses.name: Luke 14:18
verses.text: And they all with one <hi type="italic">consent</hi> began to make excuse. The first said unto him, I have bought a piece of ground, and I must needs go and see it: I pray thee have me excused.

verses.name: Luke 14:19
verses.text: And another said, I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I go to prove them: I pray thee have me excused.

verses.name: Luke 14:20
verses.text: And another said, I have married a wife, and therefore I cannot come.

verses.name: Luke 14:21
verses.text: So that servant came, and shewed his lord these things. Then the master of the house being angry said to his servant, Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in hither the poor, and the maimed, and the halt, and the blind.

verses.name: Luke 14:22
verses.text: And the servant said, Lord, it is done as thou hast commanded, and yet there is room.

verses.name: Luke 14:23
verses.text: And the lord said unto the servant, Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel <hi type="italic">them</hi> to come in, that my house may be filled.

verses.name: Luke 14:24
verses.text: For I say unto you, That none of those men which were bidden shall taste of my supper.

verses.name: Luke 14:25
verses.text: ¶ And there went great multitudes with him: and he turned, and said unto them,

verses.name: Luke 14:26
verses.text: If any <hi type="italic">man</hi> come to me, and hate not his father, and mother, and wife, and children, and brethren, and sisters, yea, and his own life also, he cannot be my disciple.

verses.name: Luke 14:27
verses.text: And whosoever doth not bear his cross, and come after me, cannot be my disciple.

verses.name: Luke 14:28
verses.text: For which of you, intending to build a tower, sitteth not down first, and counteth the cost, whether he have <hi type="italic">sufficient</hi> to finish <hi type="italic">it?</hi>

verses.name: Luke 14:29
verses.text: Lest haply, after he hath laid the foundation, and is not able to finish <hi type="italic">it</hi>, all that behold <hi type="italic">it</hi> begin to mock him,

verses.name: Luke 14:30
verses.text: Saying, This man began to build, and was not able to finish.

verses.name: Luke 14:31
verses.text: Or what king, going to make war against another king, sitteth not down first, and consulteth whether he be able with ten thousand to meet him that cometh against him with twenty thousand?

verses.name: Luke 14:32
verses.text: Or else, while the other is yet a great way off, he sendeth an ambassage, and desireth conditions of peace.

verses.name: Luke 14:33
verses.text: So likewise, whosoever he be of you that forsaketh not all that he hath, he cannot be my disciple.

verses.name: Luke 14:34
verses.text: ¶ Salt <hi type="italic">is</hi> good: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be seasoned?

verses.name: Luke 14:35
verses.text: It is neither fit for the land, nor yet for the dunghill; <hi type="italic">but</hi> men cast it out. He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.  <chapter eID="Luke.14"/><div eID="gen1073" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Luke 15:1
verses.text: THEN drew near unto him all the publicans and sinners for to hear him.

verses.name: Luke 15:2
verses.text: And the Pharisees and scribes murmured, saying, This man receiveth sinners, and eateth with them.

verses.name: Luke 15:3
verses.text: ¶ And he spake this parable unto them, saying,

verses.name: Luke 15:4
verses.text: What man of you, having an hundred sheep, if he lose one of them, doth not leave the ninety and nine in the wilderness, and go after that which is lost, until he find it?

verses.name: Luke 15:5
verses.text: And when he hath found <hi type="italic">it</hi>, he layeth <hi type="italic">it</hi> on his shoulders, rejoicing.

verses.name: Luke 15:6
verses.text: And when he cometh home, he calleth together <hi type="italic">his</hi> friends and neighbours, saying unto them, Rejoice with me; for I have found my sheep which was lost.

verses.name: Luke 15:7
verses.text: I say unto you, that likewise joy shall be in heaven over one sinner that repenteth, more than over ninety and nine just persons, which need no repentance.

verses.name: Luke 15:8
verses.text: ¶ Either what woman having ten pieces of silver, if she lose one piece, doth not light a candle, and sweep the house, and seek diligently till she find <hi type="italic">it?</hi>

verses.name: Luke 15:9
verses.text: And when she hath found <hi type="italic">it</hi>, she calleth <hi type="italic">her</hi> friends and <hi type="italic">her</hi> neighbours together, saying, Rejoice with me; for I have found the piece which I had lost.

verses.name: Luke 15:10
verses.text: Likewise, I say unto you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner that repenteth.

verses.name: Luke 15:11
verses.text: ¶ And he said, A certain man had two sons:

verses.name: Luke 15:12
verses.text: And the younger of them said to <hi type="italic">his</hi> father, Father, give me the portion of goods that falleth <hi type="italic">to me</hi>. And he divided unto them <hi type="italic">his</hi> living.

verses.name: Luke 15:13
verses.text: And not many days after the younger son gathered all together, and took his journey into a far country, and there wasted his substance with riotous living.

verses.name: Luke 15:14
verses.text: And when he had spent all, there arose a mighty famine in that land; and he began to be in want.

verses.name: Luke 15:15
verses.text: And he went and joined himself to a citizen of that country; and he sent him into his fields to feed swine.

verses.name: Luke 15:16
verses.text: And he would fain have filled his belly with the husks that the swine did eat: and no man gave unto him.

verses.name: Luke 15:17
verses.text: And when he came to himself, he said, How many hired servants of my father’s have bread enough and to spare, and I perish with hunger!

verses.name: Luke 15:18
verses.text: I will arise and go to my father, and will say unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and before thee,

verses.name: Luke 15:19
verses.text: And am no more worthy to be called thy son: make me as one of thy hired servants.

verses.name: Luke 15:20
verses.text: And he arose, and came to his father. But when he was yet a great way off, his father saw him, and had compassion, and ran, and fell on his neck, and kissed him.

verses.name: Luke 15:21
verses.text: And the son said unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in thy sight, and am no more worthy to be called thy son.

verses.name: Luke 15:22
verses.text: But the father said to his servants, Bring forth the best robe, and put <hi type="italic">it</hi> on him; and put a ring on his hand, and shoes on <hi type="italic">his</hi> feet:

verses.name: Luke 15:23
verses.text: And bring hither the fatted calf, and kill <hi type="italic">it;</hi> and let us eat, and be merry:

verses.name: Luke 15:24
verses.text: For this my son was dead, and is alive again; he was lost, and is found. And they began to be merry.

verses.name: Luke 15:25
verses.text: Now his elder son was in the field: and as he came and drew nigh to the house, he heard musick and dancing.

verses.name: Luke 15:26
verses.text: And he called one of the servants, and asked what these things meant.

verses.name: Luke 15:27
verses.text: And he said unto him, Thy brother is come; and thy father hath killed the fatted calf, because he hath received him safe and sound.

verses.name: Luke 15:28
verses.text: And he was angry, and would not go in: therefore came his father out, and intreated him.

verses.name: Luke 15:29
verses.text: And he answering said to <hi type="italic">his</hi> father, Lo, these many years do I serve thee, neither transgressed I at any time thy commandment: and yet thou never gavest me a kid, that I might make merry with my friends:

verses.name: Luke 15:30
verses.text: But as soon as this thy son was come, which hath devoured thy living with harlots, thou hast killed for him the fatted calf.

verses.name: Luke 15:31
verses.text: And he said unto him, Son, thou art ever with me, and all that I have is thine.

verses.name: Luke 15:32
verses.text: It was meet that we should make merry, and be glad: for this thy brother was dead, and is alive again; and was lost, and is found.  <chapter eID="Luke.15"/><div eID="gen1074" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Luke 16:1
verses.text: AND he said also unto his disciples, There was a certain rich man, which had a steward; and the same was accused unto him that he had wasted his goods.

verses.name: Luke 16:2
verses.text: And he called him, and said unto him, How is it that I hear this of thee? give an account of thy stewardship; for thou mayest be no longer steward.

verses.name: Luke 16:3
verses.text: Then the steward said within himself, What shall I do? for my lord taketh away from me the stewardship: I cannot dig; to beg I am ashamed.

verses.name: Luke 16:4
verses.text: I am resolved what to do, that, when I am put out of the stewardship, they may receive me into their houses.

verses.name: Luke 16:5
verses.text: So he called every one of his lord’s debtors <hi type="italic">unto him</hi>, and said unto the first, How much owest thou unto my lord?

verses.name: Luke 16:6
verses.text: And he said, An hundred measures of oil. And he said unto him, Take thy bill, and sit down quickly, and write fifty.

verses.name: Luke 16:7
verses.text: Then said he to another, And how much owest thou? And he said, An hundred measures of wheat. And he said unto him, Take thy bill, and write fourscore.

verses.name: Luke 16:8
verses.text: And the lord commended the unjust steward, because he had done wisely: for the children of this world are in their generation wiser than the children of light.

verses.name: Luke 16:9
verses.text: And I say unto you, Make to yourselves friends of the mammon of unrighteousness; that, when ye fail, they may receive you into everlasting habitations.

verses.name: Luke 16:10
verses.text: He that is faithful in that which is least is faithful also in much: and he that is unjust in the least is unjust also in much.

verses.name: Luke 16:11
verses.text: If therefore ye have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true <hi type="italic">riches?</hi>

verses.name: Luke 16:12
verses.text: And if ye have not been faithful in that which is another man’s, who shall give you that which is your own?

verses.name: Luke 16:13
verses.text: ¶ No servant can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon.

verses.name: Luke 16:14
verses.text: And the Pharisees also, who were covetous, heard all these things: and they derided him.

verses.name: Luke 16:15
verses.text: And he said unto them, Ye are they which justify yourselves before men; but God knoweth your hearts: for that which is highly esteemed among men is abomination in the sight of God.

verses.name: Luke 16:16
verses.text: The law and the prophets <hi type="italic">were</hi> until John: since that time the kingdom of God is preached, and every man presseth into it.

verses.name: Luke 16:17
verses.text: And it is easier for heaven and earth to pass, than one tittle of the law to fail.

verses.name: Luke 16:18
verses.text: Whosoever putteth away his wife, and marrieth another, committeth adultery: and whosoever marrieth her that is put away from <hi type="italic">her</hi> husband committeth adultery.

verses.name: Luke 16:19
verses.text: ¶ There was a certain rich man, which was clothed in purple and fine linen, and fared sumptuously every day:

verses.name: Luke 16:20
verses.text: And there was a certain beggar named Lazarus, which was laid at his gate, full of sores,

verses.name: Luke 16:21
verses.text: And desiring to be fed with the crumbs which fell from the rich man’s table: moreover the dogs came and licked his sores.

verses.name: Luke 16:22
verses.text: And it came to pass, that the beggar died, and was carried by the angels into Abraham’s bosom: the rich man also died, and was buried;

verses.name: Luke 16:23
verses.text: And in hell he lift up his eyes, being in torments, and seeth Abraham afar off, and Lazarus in his bosom.

verses.name: Luke 16:24
verses.text: And he cried and said, Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water, and cool my tongue; for I am tormented in this flame.

verses.name: Luke 16:25
verses.text: But Abraham said, Son, remember that thou in thy lifetime receivedst thy good things, and likewise Lazarus evil things: but now he is comforted, and thou art tormented.

verses.name: Luke 16:26
verses.text: And beside all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed: so that they which would pass from hence to you cannot; neither can they pass to us, that <hi type="italic">would come</hi> from thence.

verses.name: Luke 16:27
verses.text: Then he said, I pray thee therefore, father, that thou wouldest send him to my father’s house:

verses.name: Luke 16:28
verses.text: For I have five brethren; that he may testify unto them, lest they also come into this place of torment.

verses.name: Luke 16:29
verses.text: Abraham saith unto him, They have Moses and the prophets; let them hear them.

verses.name: Luke 16:30
verses.text: And he said, Nay, father Abraham: but if one went unto them from the dead, they will repent.

verses.name: Luke 16:31
verses.text: And he said unto him, If they hear not Moses and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded, though one rose from the dead.  <chapter eID="Luke.16"/><div eID="gen1075" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Luke 17:1
verses.text: THEN said he unto the disciples, It is impossible but that offences will come: but woe <hi type="italic">unto him</hi>, through whom they come!

verses.name: Luke 17:2
verses.text: It were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he cast into the sea, than that he should offend one of these little ones.

verses.name: Luke 17:3
verses.text: ¶ Take heed to yourselves: If thy brother trespass against thee, rebuke him; and if he repent, forgive him.

verses.name: Luke 17:4
verses.text: And if he trespass against thee seven times in a day, and seven times in a day turn again to thee, saying, I repent; thou shalt forgive him.

verses.name: Luke 17:5
verses.text: And the apostles said unto the Lord, Increase our faith.

verses.name: Luke 17:6
verses.text: And the Lord said, If ye had faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye might say unto this sycamine tree, Be thou plucked up by the root, and be thou planted in the sea; and it should obey you.

verses.name: Luke 17:7
verses.text: But which of you, having a servant plowing or feeding cattle, will say unto him by and by, when he is come from the field, Go and sit down to meat?

verses.name: Luke 17:8
verses.text: And will not rather say unto him, Make ready wherewith I may sup, and gird thyself, and serve me, till I have eaten and drunken; and afterward thou shalt eat and drink?

verses.name: Luke 17:9
verses.text: Doth he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded him? I trow not.

verses.name: Luke 17:10
verses.text: So likewise ye, when ye shall have done all those things which are commanded you, say, We are unprofitable servants: we have done that which was our duty to do.

verses.name: Luke 17:11
verses.text: ¶ And it came to pass, as he went to Jerusalem, that he passed through the midst of Samaria and Galilee.

verses.name: Luke 17:12
verses.text: And as he entered into a certain village, there met him ten men that were lepers, which stood afar off:

verses.name: Luke 17:13
verses.text: And they lifted up <hi type="italic">their</hi> voices, and said, Jesus, Master, have mercy on us.

verses.name: Luke 17:14
verses.text: And when he saw <hi type="italic">them</hi>, he said unto them, Go shew yourselves unto the priests. And it came to pass, that, as they went, they were cleansed.

verses.name: Luke 17:15
verses.text: And one of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, and with a loud voice glorified God,

verses.name: Luke 17:16
verses.text: And fell down on <hi type="italic">his</hi> face at his feet, giving him thanks: and he was a Samaritan.

verses.name: Luke 17:17
verses.text: And Jesus answering said, Were there not ten cleansed? but where <hi type="italic">are</hi> the nine?

verses.name: Luke 17:18
verses.text: There are not found that returned to give glory to God, save this stranger.

verses.name: Luke 17:19
verses.text: And he said unto him, Arise, go thy way: thy faith hath made thee whole.

verses.name: Luke 17:20
verses.text: ¶ And when he was demanded of the Pharisees, when the kingdom of God should come, he answered them and said, The kingdom of God cometh not with observation:

verses.name: Luke 17:21
verses.text: Neither shall they say, Lo here! or, lo there! for, behold, the kingdom of God is within you.

verses.name: Luke 17:22
verses.text: And he said unto the disciples, The days will come, when ye shall desire to see one of the days of the Son of man, and ye shall not see <hi type="italic">it</hi>.

verses.name: Luke 17:23
verses.text: And they shall say to you, See here; or, see there: go not after <hi type="italic">them</hi>, nor follow <hi type="italic">them</hi>.

verses.name: Luke 17:24
verses.text: For as the lightning, that lighteneth out of the one <hi type="italic">part</hi> under heaven, shineth unto the other <hi type="italic">part</hi> under heaven; so shall also the Son of man be in his day.

verses.name: Luke 17:25
verses.text: But first must he suffer many things, and be rejected of this generation.

verses.name: Luke 17:26
verses.text: And as it was in the days of Noe, so shall it be also in the days of the Son of man.

verses.name: Luke 17:27
verses.text: They did eat, they drank, they married wives, they were given in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark, and the flood came, and destroyed them all.

verses.name: Luke 17:28
verses.text: Likewise also as it was in the days of Lot; they did eat, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they builded;

verses.name: Luke 17:29
verses.text: But the same day that Lot went out of Sodom it rained fire and brimstone from heaven, and destroyed <hi type="italic">them</hi> all.

verses.name: Luke 17:30
verses.text: Even thus shall it be in the day when the Son of man is revealed.

verses.name: Luke 17:31
verses.text: In that day, he which shall be upon the housetop, and his stuff in the house, let him not come down to take it away: and he that is in the field, let him likewise not return back.

verses.name: Luke 17:32
verses.text: Remember Lot’s wife.

verses.name: Luke 17:33
verses.text: Whosoever shall seek to save his life shall lose it; and whosoever shall lose his life shall preserve it.

verses.name: Luke 17:34
verses.text: I tell you, in that night there shall be two <hi type="italic">men</hi> in one bed; the one shall be taken, and the other shall be left.

verses.name: Luke 17:35
verses.text: Two <hi type="italic">women</hi> shall be grinding together; the one shall be taken, and the other left.

verses.name: Luke 17:36
verses.text: Two <hi type="italic">men</hi> shall be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.

verses.name: Luke 17:37
verses.text: And they answered and said unto him, Where, Lord? And he said unto them, Wheresoever the body <hi type="italic">is</hi>, thither will the eagles be gathered together.  <chapter eID="Luke.17"/><div eID="gen1076" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Luke 18:1
verses.text: AND he spake a parable unto them <hi type="italic">to this end</hi>, that men ought always to pray, and not to faint;

verses.name: Luke 18:2
verses.text: Saying, There was in a city a judge, which feared not God, neither regarded man:

verses.name: Luke 18:3
verses.text: And there was a widow in that city; and she came unto him, saying, Avenge me of mine adversary.

verses.name: Luke 18:4
verses.text: And he would not for a while: but afterward he said within himself, Though I fear not God, nor regard man;

verses.name: Luke 18:5
verses.text: Yet because this widow troubleth me, I will avenge her, lest by her continual coming she weary me.

verses.name: Luke 18:6
verses.text: And the Lord said, Hear what the unjust judge saith.

verses.name: Luke 18:7
verses.text: And shall not God avenge his own elect, which cry day and night unto him, though he bear long with them?

verses.name: Luke 18:8
verses.text: I tell you that he will avenge them speedily. Nevertheless when the Son of man cometh, shall he find faith on the earth?

verses.name: Luke 18:9
verses.text: And he spake this parable unto certain which trusted in themselves that they were righteous, and despised others:

verses.name: Luke 18:10
verses.text: Two men went up into the temple to pray; the one a Pharisee, and the other a publican.

verses.name: Luke 18:11
verses.text: The Pharisee stood and prayed thus with himself, God, I thank thee, that I am not as other men <hi type="italic">are</hi>, extortioners, unjust, adulterers, or even as this publican.

verses.name: Luke 18:12
verses.text: I fast twice in the week, I give tithes of all that I possess.

verses.name: Luke 18:13
verses.text: And the publican, standing afar off, would not lift up so much as <hi type="italic">his</hi> eyes unto heaven, but smote upon his breast, saying, God be merciful to me a sinner.

verses.name: Luke 18:14
verses.text: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified <hi type="italic">rather</hi> than the other: for every one that exalteth himself shall be abased; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.

verses.name: Luke 18:15
verses.text: And they brought unto him also infants, that he would touch them: but when <hi type="italic">his</hi> disciples saw <hi type="italic">it</hi>, they rebuked them.

verses.name: Luke 18:16
verses.text: But Jesus called them <hi type="italic">unto him</hi>, and said, Suffer little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.

verses.name: Luke 18:17
verses.text: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child shall in no wise enter therein.

verses.name: Luke 18:18
verses.text: And a certain ruler asked him, saying, Good Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?

verses.name: Luke 18:19
verses.text: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? none <hi type="italic">is</hi> good, save one, <hi type="italic">that is</hi>, God.

verses.name: Luke 18:20
verses.text: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Honour thy father and thy mother.

verses.name: Luke 18:21
verses.text: And he said, All these have I kept from my youth up.

verses.name: Luke 18:22
verses.text: Now when Jesus heard these things, he said unto him, Yet lackest thou one thing: sell all that thou hast, and distribute unto the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, follow me.

verses.name: Luke 18:23
verses.text: And when he heard this, he was very sorrowful: for he was very rich.

verses.name: Luke 18:24
verses.text: And when Jesus saw that he was very sorrowful, he said, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!

verses.name: Luke 18:25
verses.text: For it is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.

verses.name: Luke 18:26
verses.text: And they that heard <hi type="italic">it</hi> said, Who then can be saved?

verses.name: Luke 18:27
verses.text: And he said, The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.

verses.name: Luke 18:28
verses.text: Then Peter said, Lo, we have left all, and followed thee.

verses.name: Luke 18:29
verses.text: And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or parents, or brethren, or wife, or children, for the kingdom of God’s sake,

verses.name: Luke 18:30
verses.text: Who shall not receive manifold more in this present time, and in the world to come life everlasting.

verses.name: Luke 18:31
verses.text: ¶ Then he took <hi type="italic">unto him</hi> the twelve, and said unto them, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem, and all things that are written by the prophets concerning the Son of man shall be accomplished.

verses.name: Luke 18:32
verses.text: For he shall be delivered unto the Gentiles, and shall be mocked, and spitefully entreated, and spitted on:

verses.name: Luke 18:33
verses.text: And they shall scourge <hi type="italic">him</hi>, and put him to death: and the third day he shall rise again.

verses.name: Luke 18:34
verses.text: And they understood none of these things: and this saying was hid from them, neither knew they the things which were spoken.

verses.name: Luke 18:35
verses.text: ¶ And it came to pass, that as he was come nigh unto Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the way side begging:

verses.name: Luke 18:36
verses.text: And hearing the multitude pass by, he asked what it meant.

verses.name: Luke 18:37
verses.text: And they told him, that Jesus of Nazareth passeth by.

verses.name: Luke 18:38
verses.text: And he cried, saying, Jesus, <hi type="italic">thou</hi> Son of David, have mercy on me.

verses.name: Luke 18:39
verses.text: And they which went before rebuked him, that he should hold his peace: but he cried so much the more, <hi type="italic">Thou</hi> Son of David, have mercy on me.

verses.name: Luke 18:40
verses.text: And Jesus stood, and commanded him to be brought unto him: and when he was come near, he asked him,

verses.name: Luke 18:41
verses.text: Saying, What wilt thou that I shall do unto thee? And he said, Lord, that I may receive my sight.

verses.name: Luke 18:42
verses.text: And Jesus said unto him, Receive thy sight: thy faith hath saved thee.

verses.name: Luke 18:43
verses.text: And immediately he received his sight, and followed him, glorifying God: and all the people, when they saw <hi type="italic">it</hi>, gave praise unto God.  <chapter eID="Luke.18"/><div eID="gen1077" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Luke 19:1
verses.text: AND <hi type="italic">Jesus</hi> entered and passed through Jericho.

verses.name: Luke 19:2
verses.text: And, behold, <hi type="italic">there was</hi> a man named Zacchæus, which was the chief among the publicans, and he was rich.

verses.name: Luke 19:3
verses.text: And he sought to see Jesus who he was; and could not for the press, because he was little of stature.

verses.name: Luke 19:4
verses.text: And he ran before, and climbed up into a sycomore tree to see him: for he was to pass that <hi type="italic">way</hi>.

verses.name: Luke 19:5
verses.text: And when Jesus came to the place, he looked up, and saw him, and said unto him, Zacchæus, make haste, and come down; for to day I must abide at thy house.

verses.name: Luke 19:6
verses.text: And he made haste, and came down, and received him joyfully.

verses.name: Luke 19:7
verses.text: And when they saw <hi type="italic">it</hi>, they all murmured, saying, That he was gone to be guest with a man that is a sinner.

verses.name: Luke 19:8
verses.text: And Zacchæus stood, and said unto the Lord; Behold, Lord, the half of my goods I give to the poor; and if I have taken any thing from any man by false accusation, I restore <hi type="italic">him</hi> fourfold.

verses.name: Luke 19:9
verses.text: And Jesus said unto him, This day is salvation come to this house, forsomuch as he also is a son of Abraham.

verses.name: Luke 19:10
verses.text: For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost.

verses.name: Luke 19:11
verses.text: And as they heard these things, he added and spake a parable, because he was nigh to Jerusalem, and because they thought that the kingdom of God should immediately appear.

verses.name: Luke 19:12
verses.text: He said therefore, A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom, and to return.

verses.name: Luke 19:13
verses.text: And he called his ten servants, and delivered them ten pounds, and said unto them, Occupy till I come.

verses.name: Luke 19:14
verses.text: But his citizens hated him, and sent a message after him, saying, We will not have this <hi type="italic">man</hi> to reign over us.

verses.name: Luke 19:15
verses.text: And it came to pass, that when he was returned, having received the kingdom, then he commanded these servants to be called unto him, to whom he had given the money, that he might know how much every man had gained by trading.

verses.name: Luke 19:16
verses.text: Then came the first, saying, Lord, thy pound hath gained ten pounds.

verses.name: Luke 19:17
verses.text: And he said unto him, Well, thou good servant: because thou hast been faithful in a very little, have thou authority over ten cities.

verses.name: Luke 19:18
verses.text: And the second came, saying, Lord, thy pound hath gained five pounds.

verses.name: Luke 19:19
verses.text: And he said likewise to him, Be thou also over five cities.

verses.name: Luke 19:20
verses.text: And another came, saying, Lord, behold, <hi type="italic">here is</hi> thy pound, which I have kept laid up in a napkin:

verses.name: Luke 19:21
verses.text: For I feared thee, because thou art an austere man: thou takest up that thou layedst not down, and reapest that thou didst not sow.

verses.name: Luke 19:22
verses.text: And he saith unto him, Out of thine own mouth will I judge thee, <hi type="italic">thou</hi> wicked servant. Thou knewest that I was an austere man, taking up that I laid not down, and reaping that I did not sow:

verses.name: Luke 19:23
verses.text: Wherefore then gavest not thou my money into the bank, that at my coming I might have required mine own with usury?

verses.name: Luke 19:24
verses.text: And he said unto them that stood by, Take from him the pound, and give <hi type="italic">it</hi> to him that hath ten pounds.

verses.name: Luke 19:25
verses.text: (And they said unto him, Lord, he hath ten pounds.)

verses.name: Luke 19:26
verses.text: For I say unto you, That unto every one which hath shall be given; and from him that hath not, even that he hath shall be taken away from him.

verses.name: Luke 19:27
verses.text: But those mine enemies, which would not that I should reign over them, bring hither, and slay <hi type="italic">them</hi> before me.

verses.name: Luke 19:28
verses.text: ¶ And when he had thus spoken, he went before, ascending up to Jerusalem.

verses.name: Luke 19:29
verses.text: And it came to pass, when he was come nigh to Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount called <hi type="italic">the mount</hi> of Olives, he sent two of his disciples,

verses.name: Luke 19:30
verses.text: Saying, Go ye into the village over against <hi type="italic">you;</hi> in the which at your entering ye shall find a colt tied, whereon yet never man sat: loose him, and bring <hi type="italic">him hither</hi>.

verses.name: Luke 19:31
verses.text: And if any man ask you, Why do ye loose <hi type="italic">him?</hi> thus shall ye say unto him, Because the Lord hath need of him.

verses.name: Luke 19:32
verses.text: And they that were sent went their way, and found even as he had said unto them.

verses.name: Luke 19:33
verses.text: And as they were loosing the colt, the owners thereof said unto them, Why loose ye the colt?

verses.name: Luke 19:34
verses.text: And they said, The Lord hath need of him.

verses.name: Luke 19:35
verses.text: And they brought him to Jesus: and they cast their garments upon the colt, and they set Jesus thereon.

verses.name: Luke 19:36
verses.text: And as he went, they spread their clothes in the way.

verses.name: Luke 19:37
verses.text: And when he was come nigh, even now at the descent of the mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works that they had seen;

verses.name: Luke 19:38
verses.text: Saying, Blessed <hi type="italic">be</hi> the King that cometh in the name of the Lord: peace in heaven, and glory in the highest.

verses.name: Luke 19:39
verses.text: And some of the Pharisees from among the multitude said unto him, Master, rebuke thy disciples.

verses.name: Luke 19:40
verses.text: And he answered and said unto them, I tell you that, if these should hold their peace, the stones would immediately cry out.

verses.name: Luke 19:41
verses.text: ¶ And when he was come near, he beheld the city, and wept over it,

verses.name: Luke 19:42
verses.text: Saying, If thou hadst known, even thou, at least in this thy day, the things <hi type="italic">which belong</hi> unto thy peace! but now they are hid from thine eyes.

verses.name: Luke 19:43
verses.text: For the days shall come upon thee, that thine enemies shall cast a trench about thee, and compass thee round, and keep thee in on every side,

verses.name: Luke 19:44
verses.text: And shall lay thee even with the ground, and thy children within thee; and they shall not leave in thee one stone upon another; because thou knewest not the time of thy visitation.

verses.name: Luke 19:45
verses.text: And he went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold therein, and them that bought;

verses.name: Luke 19:46
verses.text: Saying unto them, It is written, My house is the house of prayer: but ye have made it a den of thieves.

verses.name: Luke 19:47
verses.text: And he taught daily in the temple. But the chief priests and the scribes and the chief of the people sought to destroy him,

verses.name: Luke 19:48
verses.text: And could not find what they might do: for all the people were very attentive to hear him.  <chapter eID="Luke.19"/><div eID="gen1078" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Luke 20:1
verses.text: AND it came to pass, <hi type="italic">that</hi> on one of those days, as he taught the people in the temple, and preached the gospel, the chief priests and the scribes came upon <hi type="italic">him</hi> with the elders,

verses.name: Luke 20:2
verses.text: And spake unto him, saying, Tell us, by what authority doest thou these things? or who is he that gave thee this authority?

verses.name: Luke 20:3
verses.text: And he answered and said unto them, I will also ask you one thing; and answer me:

verses.name: Luke 20:4
verses.text: The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men?

verses.name: Luke 20:5
verses.text: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then believed ye him not?

verses.name: Luke 20:6
verses.text: But and if we say, Of men; all the people will stone us: for they be persuaded that John was a prophet.

verses.name: Luke 20:7
verses.text: And they answered, that they could not tell whence <hi type="italic">it was</hi>.

verses.name: Luke 20:8
verses.text: And Jesus said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.

verses.name: Luke 20:9
verses.text: Then began he to speak to the people this parable; A certain man planted a vineyard, and let it forth to husbandmen, and went into a far country for a long time.

verses.name: Luke 20:10
verses.text: And at the season he sent a servant to the husbandmen, that they should give him of the fruit of the vineyard: but the husbandmen beat him, and sent <hi type="italic">him</hi> away empty.

verses.name: Luke 20:11
verses.text: And again he sent another servant: and they beat him also, and entreated <hi type="italic">him</hi> shamefully, and sent <hi type="italic">him</hi> away empty.

verses.name: Luke 20:12
verses.text: And again he sent a third: and they wounded him also, and cast <hi type="italic">him</hi> out.

verses.name: Luke 20:13
verses.text: Then said the lord of the vineyard, What shall I do? I will send my beloved son: it may be they will reverence <hi type="italic">him</hi> when they see him.

verses.name: Luke 20:14
verses.text: But when the husbandmen saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, This is the heir: come, let us kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.

verses.name: Luke 20:15
verses.text: So they cast him out of the vineyard, and killed <hi type="italic">him</hi>. What therefore shall the lord of the vineyard do unto them?

verses.name: Luke 20:16
verses.text: He shall come and destroy these husbandmen, and shall give the vineyard to others. And when they heard <hi type="italic">it</hi>, they said, God forbid.

verses.name: Luke 20:17
verses.text: And he beheld them, and said, What is this then that is written, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner?

verses.name: Luke 20:18
verses.text: Whosoever shall fall upon that stone shall be broken; but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.

verses.name: Luke 20:19
verses.text: ¶ And the chief priests and the scribes the same hour sought to lay hands on him; and they feared the people: for they perceived that he had spoken this parable against them.

verses.name: Luke 20:20
verses.text: And they watched <hi type="italic">him</hi>, and sent forth spies, which should feign themselves just men, that they might take hold of his words, that so they might deliver him unto the power and authority of the governor.

verses.name: Luke 20:21
verses.text: And they asked him, saying, Master, we know that thou sayest and teachest rightly, neither acceptest thou the person <hi type="italic">of any</hi>, but teachest the way of God truly:

verses.name: Luke 20:22
verses.text: Is it lawful for us to give tribute unto Cæsar, or no?

verses.name: Luke 20:23
verses.text: But he perceived their craftiness, and said unto them, Why tempt ye me?

verses.name: Luke 20:24
verses.text: Shew me a penny. Whose image and superscription hath it? They answered and said, Cæsar’s.

verses.name: Luke 20:25
verses.text: And he said unto them, Render therefore unto Cæsar the things which be Cæsar’s, and unto God the things which be God’s.

verses.name: Luke 20:26
verses.text: And they could not take hold of his words before the people: and they marvelled at his answer, and held their peace.

verses.name: Luke 20:27
verses.text: ¶ Then came to <hi type="italic">him</hi> certain of the Sadducees, which deny that there is any resurrection; and they asked him,

verses.name: Luke 20:28
verses.text: Saying, Master, Moses wrote unto us, If any man’s brother die, having a wife, and he die without children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.

verses.name: Luke 20:29
verses.text: There were therefore seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and died without children.

verses.name: Luke 20:30
verses.text: And the second took her to wife, and he died childless.

verses.name: Luke 20:31
verses.text: And the third took her; and in like manner the seven also: and they left no children, and died.

verses.name: Luke 20:32
verses.text: Last of all the woman died also.

verses.name: Luke 20:33
verses.text: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them is she? for seven had her to wife.

verses.name: Luke 20:34
verses.text: And Jesus answering said unto them, The children of this world marry, and are given in marriage:

verses.name: Luke 20:35
verses.text: But they which shall be accounted worthy to obtain that world, and the resurrection from the dead, neither marry, nor are given in marriage:

verses.name: Luke 20:36
verses.text: Neither can they die any more: for they are equal unto the angels; and are the children of God, being the children of the resurrection.

verses.name: Luke 20:37
verses.text: Now that the dead are raised, even Moses shewed at the bush, when he calleth the Lord the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.

verses.name: Luke 20:38
verses.text: For he is not a God of the dead, but of the living: for all live unto him.

verses.name: Luke 20:39
verses.text: ¶ Then certain of the scribes answering said, Master, thou hast well said.

verses.name: Luke 20:40
verses.text: And after that they durst not ask him any <hi type="italic">question at all</hi>.

verses.name: Luke 20:41
verses.text: And he said unto them, How say they that Christ is David’s son?

verses.name: Luke 20:42
verses.text: And David himself saith in the book of Psalms, The Lord said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand,

verses.name: Luke 20:43
verses.text: Till I make thine enemies thy footstool.

verses.name: Luke 20:44
verses.text: David therefore calleth him Lord, how is he then his son?

verses.name: Luke 20:45
verses.text: ¶ Then in the audience of all the people he said unto his disciples,

verses.name: Luke 20:46
verses.text: Beware of the scribes, which desire to walk in long robes, and love greetings in the markets, and the highest seats in the synagogues, and the chief rooms at feasts;

verses.name: Luke 20:47
verses.text: Which devour widows’ houses, and for a shew make long prayers: the same shall receive greater damnation.  <chapter eID="Luke.20"/><div eID="gen1079" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Luke 21:1
verses.text: AND he looked up, and saw the rich men casting their gifts into the treasury.

verses.name: Luke 21:2
verses.text: And he saw also a certain poor widow casting in thither two mites.

verses.name: Luke 21:3
verses.text: And he said, Of a truth I say unto you, that this poor widow hath cast in more than they all:

verses.name: Luke 21:4
verses.text: For all these have of their abundance cast in unto the offerings of God: but she of her penury hath cast in all the living that she had.

verses.name: Luke 21:5
verses.text: ¶ And as some spake of the temple, how it was adorned with goodly stones and gifts, he said,

verses.name: Luke 21:6
verses.text: <hi type="italic">As for</hi> these things which ye behold, the days will come, in the which there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.

verses.name: Luke 21:7
verses.text: And they asked him, saying, Master, but when shall these things be? and what sign <hi type="italic">will there be</hi> when these things shall come to pass?

verses.name: Luke 21:8
verses.text: And he said, Take heed that ye be not deceived: for many shall come in my name, saying, I am <hi type="italic">Christ;</hi> and the time draweth near: go ye not therefore after them.

verses.name: Luke 21:9
verses.text: But when ye shall hear of wars and commotions, be not terrified: for these things must first come to pass; but the end <hi type="italic">is</hi> not by and by.

verses.name: Luke 21:10
verses.text: Then said he unto them, Nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom:

verses.name: Luke 21:11
verses.text: And great earthquakes shall be in divers places, and famines, and pestilences; and fearful sights and great signs shall there be from heaven.

verses.name: Luke 21:12
verses.text: But before all these, they shall lay their hands on you, and persecute <hi type="italic">you</hi>, delivering <hi type="italic">you</hi> up to the synagogues, and into prisons, being brought before kings and rulers for my name’s sake.

verses.name: Luke 21:13
verses.text: And it shall turn to you for a testimony.

verses.name: Luke 21:14
verses.text: Settle <hi type="italic">it</hi> therefore in your hearts, not to meditate before what ye shall answer:

verses.name: Luke 21:15
verses.text: For I will give you a mouth and wisdom, which all your adversaries shall not be able to gainsay nor resist.

verses.name: Luke 21:16
verses.text: And ye shall be betrayed both by parents, and brethren, and kinsfolks, and friends; and <hi type="italic">some</hi> of you shall they cause to be put to death.

verses.name: Luke 21:17
verses.text: And ye shall be hated of all <hi type="italic">men</hi> for my name’s sake.

verses.name: Luke 21:18
verses.text: But there shall not an hair of your head perish.

verses.name: Luke 21:19
verses.text: In your patience possess ye your souls.

verses.name: Luke 21:20
verses.text: And when ye shall see Jerusalem compassed with armies, then know that the desolation thereof is nigh.

verses.name: Luke 21:21
verses.text: Then let them which are in Judæa flee to the mountains; and let them which are in the midst of it depart out; and let not them that are in the countries enter thereinto.

verses.name: Luke 21:22
verses.text: For these be the days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.

verses.name: Luke 21:23
verses.text: But woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck, in those days! for there shall be great distress in the land, and wrath upon this people.

verses.name: Luke 21:24
verses.text: And they shall fall by the edge of the sword, and shall be led away captive into all nations: and Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled.

verses.name: Luke 21:25
verses.text: ¶ And there shall be signs in the sun, and in the moon, and in the stars; and upon the earth distress of nations, with perplexity; the sea and the waves roaring;

verses.name: Luke 21:26
verses.text: Men’s hearts failing them for fear, and for looking after those things which are coming on the earth: for the powers of heaven shall be shaken.

verses.name: Luke 21:27
verses.text: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.

verses.name: Luke 21:28
verses.text: And when these things begin to come to pass, then look up, and lift up your heads; for your redemption draweth nigh.

verses.name: Luke 21:29
verses.text: And he spake to them a parable; Behold the fig tree, and all the trees;

verses.name: Luke 21:30
verses.text: When they now shoot forth, ye see and know of your own selves that summer is now nigh at hand.

verses.name: Luke 21:31
verses.text: So likewise ye, when ye see these things come to pass, know ye that the kingdom of God is nigh at hand.

verses.name: Luke 21:32
verses.text: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass away, till all be fulfilled.

verses.name: Luke 21:33
verses.text: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.

verses.name: Luke 21:34
verses.text: ¶ And take heed to yourselves, lest at any time your hearts be overcharged with surfeiting, and drunkenness, and cares of this life, and <hi type="italic">so</hi> that day come upon you unawares.

verses.name: Luke 21:35
verses.text: For as a snare shall it come on all them that dwell on the face of the whole earth.

verses.name: Luke 21:36
verses.text: Watch ye therefore, and pray always, that ye may be accounted worthy to escape all these things that shall come to pass, and to stand before the Son of man.

verses.name: Luke 21:37
verses.text: And in the day time he was teaching in the temple; and at night he went out, and abode in the mount that is called <hi type="italic">the mount</hi> of Olives.

verses.name: Luke 21:38
verses.text: And all the people came early in the morning to him in the temple, for to hear him.  <chapter eID="Luke.21"/><div eID="gen1080" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Luke 22:1
verses.text: NOW the feast of unleavened bread drew nigh, which is called the Passover.

verses.name: Luke 22:2
verses.text: And the chief priests and scribes sought how they might kill him; for they feared the people.

verses.name: Luke 22:3
verses.text: ¶ Then entered Satan into Judas surnamed Iscariot, being of the number of the twelve.

verses.name: Luke 22:4
verses.text: And he went his way, and communed with the chief priests and captains, how he might betray him unto them.

verses.name: Luke 22:5
verses.text: And they were glad, and covenanted to give him money.

verses.name: Luke 22:6
verses.text: And he promised, and sought opportunity to betray him unto them in the absence of the multitude.

verses.name: Luke 22:7
verses.text: ¶ Then came the day of unleavened bread, when the passover must be killed.

verses.name: Luke 22:8
verses.text: And he sent Peter and John, saying, Go and prepare us the passover, that we may eat.

verses.name: Luke 22:9
verses.text: And they said unto him, Where wilt thou that we prepare?

verses.name: Luke 22:10
verses.text: And he said unto them, Behold, when ye are entered into the city, there shall a man meet you, bearing a pitcher of water; follow him into the house where he entereth in.

verses.name: Luke 22:11
verses.text: And ye shall say unto the goodman of the house, The Master saith unto thee, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?

verses.name: Luke 22:12
verses.text: And he shall shew you a large upper room furnished: there make ready.

verses.name: Luke 22:13
verses.text: And they went, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.

verses.name: Luke 22:14
verses.text: And when the hour was come, he sat down, and the twelve apostles with him.

verses.name: Luke 22:15
verses.text: And he said unto them, With desire I have desired to eat this passover with you before I suffer:

verses.name: Luke 22:16
verses.text: For I say unto you, I will not any more eat thereof, until it be fulfilled in the kingdom of God.

verses.name: Luke 22:17
verses.text: And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and said, Take this, and divide <hi type="italic">it</hi> among yourselves:

verses.name: Luke 22:18
verses.text: For I say unto you, I will not drink of the fruit of the vine, until the kingdom of God shall come.

verses.name: Luke 22:19
verses.text: ¶ And he took bread, and gave thanks, and brake <hi type="italic">it</hi>, and gave unto them, saying, This is my body which is given for you: this do in remembrance of me.

verses.name: Luke 22:20
verses.text: Likewise also the cup after supper, saying, This cup <hi type="italic">is</hi> the new testament in my blood, which is shed for you.

verses.name: Luke 22:21
verses.text: ¶ But, behold, the hand of him that betrayeth me <hi type="italic">is</hi> with me on the table.

verses.name: Luke 22:22
verses.text: And truly the Son of man goeth, as it was determined: but woe unto that man by whom he is betrayed!

verses.name: Luke 22:23
verses.text: And they began to inquire among themselves, which of them it was that should do this thing.

verses.name: Luke 22:24
verses.text: ¶ And there was also a strife among them, which of them should be accounted the greatest.

verses.name: Luke 22:25
verses.text: And he said unto them, The kings of the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and they that exercise authority upon them are called benefactors.

verses.name: Luke 22:26
verses.text: But ye <hi type="italic">shall</hi> not <hi type="italic">be</hi> so: but he that is greatest among you, let him be as the younger; and he that is chief, as he that doth serve.

verses.name: Luke 22:27
verses.text: For whether <hi type="italic">is</hi> greater, he that sitteth at meat, or he that serveth? <hi type="italic">is</hi> not he that sitteth at meat? but I am among you as he that serveth.

verses.name: Luke 22:28
verses.text: Ye are they which have continued with me in my temptations.

verses.name: Luke 22:29
verses.text: And I appoint unto you a kingdom, as my Father hath appointed unto me;

verses.name: Luke 22:30
verses.text: That ye may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom, and sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

verses.name: Luke 22:31
verses.text: ¶ And the Lord said, Simon, Simon, behold, Satan hath desired <hi type="italic">to have</hi> you, that he may sift <hi type="italic">you</hi> as wheat:

verses.name: Luke 22:32
verses.text: But I have prayed for thee, that thy faith fail not: and when thou art converted, strengthen thy brethren.

verses.name: Luke 22:33
verses.text: And he said unto him, Lord, I am ready to go with thee, both into prison, and to death.

verses.name: Luke 22:34
verses.text: And he said, I tell thee, Peter, the cock shall not crow this day, before that thou shalt thrice deny that thou knowest me.

verses.name: Luke 22:35
verses.text: And he said unto them, When I sent you without purse, and scrip, and shoes, lacked ye any thing? And they said, Nothing.

verses.name: Luke 22:36
verses.text: Then said he unto them, But now, he that hath a purse, let him take <hi type="italic">it</hi>, and likewise <hi type="italic">his</hi> scrip: and he that hath no sword, let him sell his garment, and buy one.

verses.name: Luke 22:37
verses.text: For I say unto you, that this that is written must yet be accomplished in me, And he was reckoned among the transgressors: for the things concerning me have an end.

verses.name: Luke 22:38
verses.text: And they said, Lord, behold, here <hi type="italic">are</hi> two swords. And he said unto them, It is enough.

verses.name: Luke 22:39
verses.text: ¶ And he came out, and went, as he was wont, to the mount of Olives; and his disciples also followed him.

verses.name: Luke 22:40
verses.text: And when he was at the place, he said unto them, Pray that ye enter not into temptation.

verses.name: Luke 22:41
verses.text: And he was withdrawn from them about a stone’s cast, and kneeled down, and prayed,

verses.name: Luke 22:42
verses.text: Saying, Father, if thou be willing, remove this cup from me: nevertheless not my will, but thine, be done.

verses.name: Luke 22:43
verses.text: And there appeared an angel unto him from heaven, strengthening him.

verses.name: Luke 22:44
verses.text: And being in an agony he prayed more earnestly: and his sweat was as it were great drops of blood falling down to the ground.

verses.name: Luke 22:45
verses.text: And when he rose up from prayer, and was come to his disciples, he found them sleeping for sorrow,

verses.name: Luke 22:46
verses.text: And said unto them, Why sleep ye? rise and pray, lest ye enter into temptation.

verses.name: Luke 22:47
verses.text: ¶ And while he yet spake, behold a multitude, and he that was called Judas, one of the twelve, went before them, and drew near unto Jesus to kiss him.

verses.name: Luke 22:48
verses.text: But Jesus said unto him, Judas, betrayest thou the Son of man with a kiss?

verses.name: Luke 22:49
verses.text: When they which were about him saw what would follow, they said unto him, Lord, shall we smite with the sword?

verses.name: Luke 22:50
verses.text: ¶ And one of them smote the servant of the high priest, and cut off his right ear.

verses.name: Luke 22:51
verses.text: And Jesus answered and said, Suffer ye thus far. And he touched his ear, and healed him.

verses.name: Luke 22:52
verses.text: Then Jesus said unto the chief priests, and captains of the temple, and the elders, which were come to him, Be ye come out, as against a thief, with swords and staves?

verses.name: Luke 22:53
verses.text: When I was daily with you in the temple, ye stretched forth no hands against me: but this is your hour, and the power of darkness.

verses.name: Luke 22:54
verses.text: ¶ Then took they him, and led <hi type="italic">him</hi>, and brought him into the high priest’s house. And Peter followed afar off.

verses.name: Luke 22:55
verses.text: And when they had kindled a fire in the midst of the hall, and were set down together, Peter sat down among them.

verses.name: Luke 22:56
verses.text: But a certain maid beheld him as he sat by the fire, and earnestly looked upon him, and said, This man was also with him.

verses.name: Luke 22:57
verses.text: And he denied him, saying, Woman, I know him not.

verses.name: Luke 22:58
verses.text: And after a little while another saw him, and said, Thou art also of them. And Peter said, Man, I am not.

verses.name: Luke 22:59
verses.text: And about the space of one hour after another confidently affirmed, saying, Of a truth this <hi type="italic">fellow</hi> also was with him: for he is a Galilæan.

verses.name: Luke 22:60
verses.text: And Peter said, Man, I know not what thou sayest. And immediately, while he yet spake, the cock crew.

verses.name: Luke 22:61
verses.text: And the Lord turned, and looked upon Peter. And Peter remembered the word of the Lord, how he had said unto him, Before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.

verses.name: Luke 22:62
verses.text: And Peter went out, and wept bitterly.

verses.name: Luke 22:63
verses.text: ¶ And the men that held Jesus mocked him, and smote <hi type="italic">him</hi>.

verses.name: Luke 22:64
verses.text: And when they had blindfolded him, they struck him on the face, and asked him, saying, Prophesy, who is it that smote thee?

verses.name: Luke 22:65
verses.text: And many other things blasphemously spake they against him.

verses.name: Luke 22:66
verses.text: ¶ And as soon as it was day, the elders of the people and the chief priests and the scribes came together, and led him into their council, saying,

verses.name: Luke 22:67
verses.text: Art thou the Christ? tell us. And he said unto them, If I tell you, ye will not believe:

verses.name: Luke 22:68
verses.text: And if I also ask <hi type="italic">you</hi>, ye will not answer me, nor let <hi type="italic">me</hi> go.

verses.name: Luke 22:69
verses.text: Hereafter shall the Son of man sit on the right hand of the power of God.

verses.name: Luke 22:70
verses.text: Then said they all, Art thou then the Son of God? And he said unto them, Ye say that I am.

verses.name: Luke 22:71
verses.text: And they said, What need we any further witness? for we ourselves have heard of his own mouth.  <chapter eID="Luke.22"/><div eID="gen1081" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Luke 23:1
verses.text: AND the whole multitude of them arose, and led him unto Pilate.

verses.name: Luke 23:2
verses.text: And they began to accuse him, saying, We found this <hi type="italic">fellow</hi> perverting the nation, and forbidding to give tribute to Cæsar, saying that he himself is Christ a King.

verses.name: Luke 23:3
verses.text: And Pilate asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answered him and said, Thou sayest <hi type="italic">it</hi>.

verses.name: Luke 23:4
verses.text: Then said Pilate to the chief priests and <hi type="italic">to</hi> the people, I find no fault in this man.

verses.name: Luke 23:5
verses.text: And they were the more fierce, saying, He stirreth up the people, teaching throughout all Jewry, beginning from Galilee to this place.

verses.name: Luke 23:6
verses.text: When Pilate heard of Galilee, he asked whether the man were a Galilæan.

verses.name: Luke 23:7
verses.text: And as soon as he knew that he belonged unto Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who himself also was at Jerusalem at that time.

verses.name: Luke 23:8
verses.text: ¶ And when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceeding glad: for he was desirous to see him of a long <hi type="italic">season</hi>, because he had heard many things of him; and he hoped to have seen some miracle done by him.

verses.name: Luke 23:9
verses.text: Then he questioned with him in many words; but he answered him nothing.

verses.name: Luke 23:10
verses.text: And the chief priests and scribes stood and vehemently accused him.

verses.name: Luke 23:11
verses.text: And Herod with his men of war set him at nought, and mocked <hi type="italic">him</hi>, and arrayed him in a gorgeous robe, and sent him again to Pilate.

verses.name: Luke 23:12
verses.text: ¶ And the same day Pilate and Herod were made friends together: for before they were at enmity between themselves.

verses.name: Luke 23:13
verses.text: ¶ And Pilate, when he had called together the chief priests and the rulers and the people,

verses.name: Luke 23:14
verses.text: Said unto them, Ye have brought this man unto me, as one that perverteth the people: and, behold, I, having examined <hi type="italic">him</hi> before you, have found no fault in this man touching those things whereof ye accuse him:

verses.name: Luke 23:15
verses.text: No, nor yet Herod: for I sent you to him; and, lo, nothing worthy of death is done unto him.

verses.name: Luke 23:16
verses.text: I will therefore chastise him, and release <hi type="italic">him</hi>.

verses.name: Luke 23:17
verses.text: (For of necessity he must release one unto them at the feast.)

verses.name: Luke 23:18
verses.text: And they cried out all at once, saying, Away with this <hi type="italic">man</hi>, and release unto us Barabbas:

verses.name: Luke 23:19
verses.text: (Who for a certain sedition made in the city, and for murder, was cast into prison.)

verses.name: Luke 23:20
verses.text: Pilate therefore, willing to release Jesus, spake again to them.

verses.name: Luke 23:21
verses.text: But they cried, saying, Crucify <hi type="italic">him</hi>, crucify him.

verses.name: Luke 23:22
verses.text: And he said unto them the third time, Why, what evil hath he done? I have found no cause of death in him: I will therefore chastise him, and let <hi type="italic">him</hi> go.

verses.name: Luke 23:23
verses.text: And they were instant with loud voices, requiring that he might be crucified. And the voices of them and of the chief priests prevailed.

verses.name: Luke 23:24
verses.text: And Pilate gave sentence that it should be as they required.

verses.name: Luke 23:25
verses.text: And he released unto them him that for sedition and murder was cast into prison, whom they had desired; but he delivered Jesus to their will.

verses.name: Luke 23:26
verses.text: And as they led him away, they laid hold upon one Simon, a Cyrenian, coming out of the country, and on him they laid the cross, that he might bear <hi type="italic">it</hi> after Jesus.

verses.name: Luke 23:27
verses.text: ¶ And there followed him a great company of people, and of women, which also bewailed and lamented him.

verses.name: Luke 23:28
verses.text: But Jesus turning unto them said, Daughters of Jerusalem, weep not for me, but weep for yourselves, and for your children.

verses.name: Luke 23:29
verses.text: For, behold, the days are coming, in the which they shall say, Blessed <hi type="italic">are</hi> the barren, and the wombs that never bare, and the paps which never gave suck.

verses.name: Luke 23:30
verses.text: Then shall they begin to say to the mountains, Fall on us; and to the hills, Cover us.

verses.name: Luke 23:31
verses.text: For if they do these things in a green tree, what shall be done in the dry?

verses.name: Luke 23:32
verses.text: And there were also two other, malefactors, led with him to be put to death.

verses.name: Luke 23:33
verses.text: And when they were come to the place, which is called Calvary, there they crucified him, and the malefactors, one on the right hand, and the other on the left.

verses.name: Luke 23:34
verses.text: ¶ Then said Jesus, Father, forgive them; for they know not what they do. And they parted his raiment, and cast lots.

verses.name: Luke 23:35
verses.text: And the people stood beholding. And the rulers also with them derided <hi type="italic">him</hi>, saying, He saved others; let him save himself, if he be Christ, the chosen of God.

verses.name: Luke 23:36
verses.text: And the soldiers also mocked him, coming to him, and offering him vinegar,

verses.name: Luke 23:37
verses.text: And saying, If thou be the king of the Jews, save thyself.

verses.name: Luke 23:38
verses.text: And a superscription also was written over him in letters of Greek, and Latin, and Hebrew, THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.

verses.name: Luke 23:39
verses.text: ¶ And one of the malefactors which were hanged railed on him, saying, If thou be Christ, save thyself and us.

verses.name: Luke 23:40
verses.text: But the other answering rebuked him, saying, Dost not thou fear God, seeing thou art in the same condemnation?

verses.name: Luke 23:41
verses.text: And we indeed justly; for we receive the due reward of our deeds: but this man hath done nothing amiss.

verses.name: Luke 23:42
verses.text: And he said unto Jesus, Lord, remember me when thou comest into thy kingdom.

verses.name: Luke 23:43
verses.text: And Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, To day shalt thou be with me in paradise.

verses.name: Luke 23:44
verses.text: And it was about the sixth hour, and there was a darkness over all the earth until the ninth hour.

verses.name: Luke 23:45
verses.text: And the sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was rent in the midst.

verses.name: Luke 23:46
verses.text: ¶ And when Jesus had cried with a loud voice, he said, Father, into thy hands I commend my spirit: and having said thus, he gave up the ghost.

verses.name: Luke 23:47
verses.text: Now when the centurion saw what was done, he glorified God, saying, Certainly this was a righteous man.

verses.name: Luke 23:48
verses.text: And all the people that came together to that sight, beholding the things which were done, smote their breasts, and returned.

verses.name: Luke 23:49
verses.text: And all his acquaintance, and the women that followed him from Galilee, stood afar off, beholding these things.

verses.name: Luke 23:50
verses.text: ¶ And, behold, <hi type="italic">there was</hi> a man named Joseph, a counseller; <hi type="italic">and he was</hi> a good man, and a just:

verses.name: Luke 23:51
verses.text: (The same had not consented to the counsel and deed of them;) <hi type="italic">he was</hi> of Arimathæa, a city of the Jews: who also himself waited for the kingdom of God.

verses.name: Luke 23:52
verses.text: This <hi type="italic">man</hi> went unto Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus.

verses.name: Luke 23:53
verses.text: And he took it down, and wrapped it in linen, and laid it in a sepulchre that was hewn in stone, wherein never man before was laid.

verses.name: Luke 23:54
verses.text: And that day was the preparation, and the sabbath drew on.

verses.name: Luke 23:55
verses.text: And the women also, which came with him from Galilee, followed after, and beheld the sepulchre, and how his body was laid.

verses.name: Luke 23:56
verses.text: And they returned, and prepared spices and ointments; and rested the sabbath day according to the commandment.  <chapter eID="Luke.23"/><div eID="gen1082" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Luke 24:1
verses.text: NOW upon the first <hi type="italic">day</hi> of the week, very early in the morning, they came unto the sepulchre, bringing the spices which they had prepared, and certain <hi type="italic">others</hi> with them.

verses.name: Luke 24:2
verses.text: And they found the stone rolled away from the sepulchre.

verses.name: Luke 24:3
verses.text: And they entered in, and found not the body of the Lord Jesus.

verses.name: Luke 24:4
verses.text: And it came to pass, as they were much perplexed thereabout, behold, two men stood by them in shining garments:

verses.name: Luke 24:5
verses.text: And as they were afraid, and bowed down <hi type="italic">their</hi> faces to the earth, they said unto them, Why seek ye the living among the dead?

verses.name: Luke 24:6
verses.text: He is not here, but is risen: remember how he spake unto you when he was yet in Galilee,

verses.name: Luke 24:7
verses.text: Saying, The Son of man must be delivered into the hands of sinful men, and be crucified, and the third day rise again.

verses.name: Luke 24:8
verses.text: And they remembered his words,

verses.name: Luke 24:9
verses.text: And returned from the sepulchre, and told all these things unto the eleven, and to all the rest.

verses.name: Luke 24:10
verses.text: It was Mary Magdalene, and Joanna, and Mary <hi type="italic">the mother</hi> of James, and other <hi type="italic">women that were</hi> with them, which told these things unto the apostles.

verses.name: Luke 24:11
verses.text: And their words seemed to them as idle tales, and they believed them not.

verses.name: Luke 24:12
verses.text: Then arose Peter, and ran unto the sepulchre; and stooping down, he beheld the linen clothes laid by themselves, and departed, wondering in himself at that which was come to pass.

verses.name: Luke 24:13
verses.text: ¶ And, behold, two of them went that same day to a village called Emmaus, which was from Jerusalem <hi type="italic">about</hi> threescore furlongs.

verses.name: Luke 24:14
verses.text: And they talked together of all these things which had happened.

verses.name: Luke 24:15
verses.text: And it came to pass, that, while they communed <hi type="italic">together</hi> and reasoned, Jesus himself drew near, and went with them.

verses.name: Luke 24:16
verses.text: But their eyes were holden that they should not know him.

verses.name: Luke 24:17
verses.text: And he said unto them, What manner of communications <hi type="italic">are</hi> these that ye have one to another, as ye walk, and are sad?

verses.name: Luke 24:18
verses.text: And the one of them, whose name was Cleopas, answering said unto him, Art thou only a stranger in Jerusalem, and hast not known the things which are come to pass there in these days?

verses.name: Luke 24:19
verses.text: And he said unto them, What things? And they said unto him, Concerning Jesus of Nazareth, which was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people:

verses.name: Luke 24:20
verses.text: And how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him to be condemned to death, and have crucified him.

verses.name: Luke 24:21
verses.text: But we trusted that it had been he which should have redeemed Israel: and beside all this, to day is the third day since these things were done.

verses.name: Luke 24:22
verses.text: Yea, and certain women also of our company made us astonished, which were early at the sepulchre;

verses.name: Luke 24:23
verses.text: And when they found not his body, they came, saying, that they had also seen a vision of angels, which said that he was alive.

verses.name: Luke 24:24
verses.text: And certain of them which were with us went to the sepulchre, and found <hi type="italic">it</hi> even so as the women had said: but him they saw not.

verses.name: Luke 24:25
verses.text: Then he said unto them, O fools, and slow of heart to believe all that the prophets have spoken:

verses.name: Luke 24:26
verses.text: Ought not Christ to have suffered these things, and to enter into his glory?

verses.name: Luke 24:27
verses.text: And beginning at Moses and all the prophets, he expounded unto them in all the scriptures the things concerning himself.

verses.name: Luke 24:28
verses.text: And they drew nigh unto the village, whither they went: and he made as though he would have gone further.

verses.name: Luke 24:29
verses.text: But they constrained him, saying, Abide with us: for it is toward evening, and the day is far spent. And he went in to tarry with them.

verses.name: Luke 24:30
verses.text: And it came to pass, as he sat at meat with them, he took bread, and blessed <hi type="italic">it</hi>, and brake, and gave to them.

verses.name: Luke 24:31
verses.text: And their eyes were opened, and they knew him; and he vanished out of their sight.

verses.name: Luke 24:32
verses.text: And they said one to another, Did not our heart burn within us, while he talked with us by the way, and while he opened to us the scriptures?

verses.name: Luke 24:33
verses.text: And they rose up the same hour, and returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together, and them that were with them,

verses.name: Luke 24:34
verses.text: Saying, The Lord is risen indeed, and hath appeared to Simon.

verses.name: Luke 24:35
verses.text: And they told what things <hi type="italic">were done</hi> in the way, and how he was known of them in breaking of bread.

verses.name: Luke 24:36
verses.text: ¶ And as they thus spake, Jesus himself stood in the midst of them, and saith unto them, Peace <hi type="italic">be</hi> unto you.

verses.name: Luke 24:37
verses.text: But they were terrified and affrighted, and supposed that they had seen a spirit.

verses.name: Luke 24:38
verses.text: And he said unto them, Why are ye troubled? and why do thoughts arise in your hearts?

verses.name: Luke 24:39
verses.text: Behold my hands and my feet, that it is I myself: handle me, and see; for a spirit hath not flesh and bones, as ye see me have.

verses.name: Luke 24:40
verses.text: And when he had thus spoken, he shewed them <hi type="italic">his</hi> hands and <hi type="italic">his</hi> feet.

verses.name: Luke 24:41
verses.text: And while they yet believed not for joy, and wondered, he said unto them, Have ye here any meat?

verses.name: Luke 24:42
verses.text: And they gave him a piece of a broiled fish, and of an honeycomb.

verses.name: Luke 24:43
verses.text: And he took <hi type="italic">it</hi>, and did eat before them.

verses.name: Luke 24:44
verses.text: And he said unto them, These <hi type="italic">are</hi> the words which I spake unto you, while I was yet with you, that all things must be fulfilled, which were written in the law of Moses, and <hi type="italic">in</hi> the prophets, and <hi type="italic">in</hi> the psalms, concerning me.

verses.name: Luke 24:45
verses.text: Then opened he their understanding, that they might understand the scriptures,

verses.name: Luke 24:46
verses.text: And said unto them, Thus it is written, and thus it behoved Christ to suffer, and to rise from the dead the third day:

verses.name: Luke 24:47
verses.text: And that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name among all nations, beginning at Jerusalem.

verses.name: Luke 24:48
verses.text: And ye are witnesses of these things.

verses.name: Luke 24:49
verses.text: ¶ And, behold, I send the promise of my Father upon you: but tarry ye in the city of Jerusalem, until ye be endued with power from on high.

verses.name: Luke 24:50
verses.text: ¶ And he led them out as far as to Bethany, and he lifted up his hands, and blessed them.

verses.name: Luke 24:51
verses.text: And it came to pass, while he blessed them, he was parted from them, and carried up into heaven.

verses.name: Luke 24:52
verses.text: And they worshipped him, and returned to Jerusalem with great joy:

verses.name: Luke 24:53
verses.text: And were continually in the temple, praising and blessing God. Amen.  <chapter eID="Luke.24"/><div eID="gen1083" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen1059" osisID="Luke" type="book"/>

verses.name: John 1:1
verses.text: IN the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

verses.name: John 1:2
verses.text: The same was in the beginning with God.

verses.name: John 1:3
verses.text: All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.

verses.name: John 1:4
verses.text: In him was life; and the life was the light of men.

verses.name: John 1:5
verses.text: And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.

verses.name: John 1:6
verses.text: ¶ There was a man sent from God, whose name <hi type="italic">was</hi> John.

verses.name: John 1:7
verses.text: The same came for a witness, to bear witness of the Light, that all <hi type="italic">men</hi> through him might believe.

verses.name: John 1:8
verses.text: He was not that Light, but <hi type="italic">was sent</hi> to bear witness of that Light.

verses.name: John 1:9
verses.text: <hi type="italic">That</hi> was the true Light, which lighteth every man that cometh into the world.

verses.name: John 1:10
verses.text: He was in the world, and the world was made by him, and the world knew him not.

verses.name: John 1:11
verses.text: He came unto his own, and his own received him not.

verses.name: John 1:12
verses.text: But as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of God, <hi type="italic">even</hi> to them that believe on his name:

verses.name: John 1:13
verses.text: Which were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.

verses.name: John 1:14
verses.text: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.

verses.name: John 1:15
verses.text: ¶ John bare witness of him, and cried, saying, This was he of whom I spake, He that cometh after me is preferred before me: for he was before me.

verses.name: John 1:16
verses.text: And of his fulness have all we received, and grace for grace.

verses.name: John 1:17
verses.text: For the law was given by Moses, <hi type="italic">but</hi> grace and truth came by Jesus Christ.

verses.name: John 1:18
verses.text: No man hath seen God at any time; the only begotten Son, which is in the bosom of the Father, he hath declared <hi type="italic">him</hi>.

verses.name: John 1:19
verses.text: ¶ And this is the record of John, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, Who art thou?

verses.name: John 1:20
verses.text: And he confessed, and denied not; but confessed, I am not the Christ.

verses.name: John 1:21
verses.text: And they asked him, What then? Art thou Elias? And he saith, I am not. Art thou that prophet? And he answered, No.

verses.name: John 1:22
verses.text: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? that we may give an answer to them that sent us. What sayest thou of thyself?

verses.name: John 1:23
verses.text: He said, I <hi type="italic">am</hi> the voice of one crying in the wilderness, Make straight the way of the Lord, as said the prophet Esaias.

verses.name: John 1:24
verses.text: And they which were sent were of the Pharisees.

verses.name: John 1:25
verses.text: And they asked him, and said unto him, Why baptizest thou then, if thou be not that Christ, nor Elias, neither that prophet?

verses.name: John 1:26
verses.text: John answered them, saying, I baptize with water: but there standeth one among you, whom ye know not;

verses.name: John 1:27
verses.text: He it is, who coming after me is preferred before me, whose shoe’s latchet I am not worthy to unloose.

verses.name: John 1:28
