verses.text: The Lord grant unto him that he may find mercy of the Lord in that day: and in how many things he ministered unto me at Ephesus, thou knowest very well.  <chapter eID="2Tim.1"/><div eID="gen1225" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: II Timothy 2:1
verses.text: THOU therefore, my son, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:2
verses.text: And the things that thou hast heard of me among many witnesses, the same commit thou to faithful men, who shall be able to teach others also.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:3
verses.text: Thou therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:4
verses.text: No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of <hi type="italic">this</hi> life; that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:5
verses.text: And if a man also strive for masteries, <hi type="italic">yet</hi> is he not crowned, except he strive lawfully.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:6
verses.text: The husbandman that laboureth must be first partaker of the fruits.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:7
verses.text: Consider what I say; and the Lord give thee understanding in all things.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:8
verses.text: Remember that Jesus Christ of the seed of David was raised from the dead according to my gospel:

verses.name: II Timothy 2:9
verses.text: Wherein I suffer trouble, as an evil doer, <hi type="italic">even</hi> unto bonds; but the word of God is not bound.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:10
verses.text: Therefore I endure all things for the elect’s sakes, that they may also obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:11
verses.text: <hi type="italic">It is</hi> a faithful saying: For if we be dead with <hi type="italic">him</hi>, we shall also live with <hi type="italic">him:</hi>

verses.name: II Timothy 2:12
verses.text: If we suffer, we shall also reign with <hi type="italic">him:</hi> if we deny <hi type="italic">him</hi>, he also will deny us:

verses.name: II Timothy 2:13
verses.text: If we believe not, <hi type="italic">yet</hi> he abideth faithful: he cannot deny himself.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:14
verses.text: Of these things put <hi type="italic">them</hi> in remembrance, charging <hi type="italic">them</hi> before the Lord that they strive not about words to no profit, <hi type="italic">but</hi> to the subverting of the hearers.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:15
verses.text: Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:16
verses.text: But shun profane <hi type="italic">and</hi> vain babblings: for they will increase unto more ungodliness.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:17
verses.text: And their word will eat as doth a canker: of whom is Hymenæus and Philetus;

verses.name: II Timothy 2:18
verses.text: Who concerning the truth have erred, saying that the resurrection is past already; and overthrow the faith of some.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:19
verses.text: Nevertheless the foundation of God standeth sure, having this seal, The Lord knoweth them that are his. And, Let every one that nameth the name of Christ depart from iniquity.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:20
verses.text: But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth; and some to honour, and some to dishonour.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:21
verses.text: If a man therefore purge himself from these, he shall be a vessel unto honour, sanctified, and meet for the master’s use, <hi type="italic">and</hi> prepared unto every good work.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:22
verses.text: Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:23
verses.text: But foolish and unlearned questions avoid, knowing that they do gender strifes.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:24
verses.text: And the servant of the Lord must not strive; but be gentle unto all <hi type="italic">men</hi>, apt to teach, patient,

verses.name: II Timothy 2:25
verses.text: In meekness instructing those that oppose themselves; if God peradventure will give them repentance to the acknowledging of the truth;

verses.name: II Timothy 2:26
verses.text: And <hi type="italic">that</hi> they may recover themselves out of the snare of the devil, who are taken captive by him at his will.  <chapter eID="2Tim.2"/><div eID="gen1226" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: II Timothy 3:1
verses.text: THIS know also, that in the last days perilous times shall come.

verses.name: II Timothy 3:2
verses.text: For men shall be lovers of their own selves, covetous, boasters, proud, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,

verses.name: II Timothy 3:3
verses.text: Without natural affection, trucebreakers, false accusers, incontinent, fierce, despisers of those that are good,

verses.name: II Timothy 3:4
verses.text: Traitors, heady, highminded, lovers of pleasures more than lovers of God;

verses.name: II Timothy 3:5
verses.text: Having a form of godliness, but denying the power thereof: from such turn away.

verses.name: II Timothy 3:6
verses.text: For of this sort are they which creep into houses, and lead captive silly women laden with sins, led away with divers lusts,

verses.name: II Timothy 3:7
verses.text: Ever learning, and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.

verses.name: II Timothy 3:8
verses.text: Now as Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses, so do these also resist the truth: men of corrupt minds, reprobate concerning the faith.

verses.name: II Timothy 3:9
verses.text: But they shall proceed no further: for their folly shall be manifest unto all <hi type="italic">men</hi>, as theirs also was.

verses.name: II Timothy 3:10
verses.text: But thou hast fully known my doctrine, manner of life, purpose, faith, longsuffering, charity, patience,

verses.name: II Timothy 3:11
verses.text: Persecutions, afflictions, which came unto me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra; what persecutions I endured: but out of <hi type="italic">them</hi> all the Lord delivered me.

verses.name: II Timothy 3:12
verses.text: Yea, and all that will live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution.

verses.name: II Timothy 3:13
verses.text: But evil men and seducers shall wax worse and worse, deceiving, and being deceived.

verses.name: II Timothy 3:14
verses.text: But continue thou in the things which thou hast learned and hast been assured of, knowing of whom thou hast learned <hi type="italic">them;</hi>

verses.name: II Timothy 3:15
verses.text: And that from a child thou hast known the holy scriptures, which are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.

verses.name: II Timothy 3:16
verses.text: All scripture <hi type="italic">is</hi> given by inspiration of God, and <hi type="italic">is</hi> profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness:

verses.name: II Timothy 3:17
verses.text: That the man of God may be perfect, throughly furnished unto all good works.  <chapter eID="2Tim.3"/><div eID="gen1227" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: II Timothy 4:1
verses.text: I CHARGE <hi type="italic">thee</hi> therefore before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, who shall judge the quick and the dead at his appearing and his kingdom;

verses.name: II Timothy 4:2
verses.text: Preach the word; be instant in season, out of season; reprove, rebuke, exhort with all longsuffering and doctrine.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:3
verses.text: For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine; but after their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers, having itching ears;

verses.name: II Timothy 4:4
verses.text: And they shall turn away <hi type="italic">their</hi> ears from the truth, and shall be turned unto fables.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:5
verses.text: But watch thou in all things, endure afflictions, do the work of an evangelist, make full proof of thy ministry.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:6
verses.text: For I am now ready to be offered, and the time of my departure is at hand.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:7
verses.text: I have fought a good fight, I have finished <hi type="italic">my</hi> course, I have kept the faith:

verses.name: II Timothy 4:8
verses.text: Henceforth there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give me at that day: and not to me only, but unto all them also that love his appearing.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:9
verses.text: Do thy diligence to come shortly unto me:

verses.name: II Timothy 4:10
verses.text: For Demas hath forsaken me, having loved this present world, and is departed unto Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia, Titus unto Dalmatia.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:11
verses.text: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark, and bring him with thee: for he is profitable to me for the ministry.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:12
verses.text: And Tychicus have I sent to Ephesus.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:13
verses.text: The cloke that I left at Troas with Carpus, when thou comest, bring <hi type="italic">with thee</hi>, and the books, <hi type="italic">but</hi> especially the parchments.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:14
verses.text: Alexander the coppersmith did me much evil: the Lord reward him according to his works:

verses.name: II Timothy 4:15
verses.text: Of whom be thou ware also; for he hath greatly withstood our words.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:16
verses.text: At my first answer no man stood with me, but all <hi type="italic">men</hi> forsook me: <hi type="italic">I pray God</hi> that it may not be laid to their charge.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:17
verses.text: Notwithstanding the Lord stood with me, and strengthened me; that by me the preaching might be fully known, and <hi type="italic">that</hi> all the Gentiles might hear: and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:18
verses.text: And the Lord shall deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve <hi type="italic">me</hi> unto his heavenly kingdom: to whom <hi type="italic">be</hi> glory for ever and ever. Amen.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:19
verses.text: Salute Prisca and Aquila, and the household of Onesiphorus.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:20
verses.text: Erastus abode at Corinth: but Trophimus have I left at Miletum sick.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:21
verses.text: Do thy diligence to come before winter. Eubulus greeteth thee, and Pudens, and Linus, and Claudia, and all the brethren.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:22
verses.text: The Lord Jesus Christ <hi type="italic">be</hi> with thy spirit. Grace <hi type="italic">be</hi> with you. Amen. ¶ The second <hi type="italic">epistle</hi> unto Timotheus, ordained the first bishop of the church of the Ephesians, was written from Rome, when Paul was brought before Nero the second time.  <chapter eID="2Tim.4"/><div eID="gen1228" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen1224" osisID="2Tim" type="book"/>

verses.name: Titus 1:1
verses.text: PAUL, a servant of God, and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God’s elect, and the acknowledging of the truth which is after godliness;

verses.name: Titus 1:2
verses.text: In hope of eternal life, which God, that cannot lie, promised before the world began;

verses.name: Titus 1:3
verses.text: But hath in due times manifested his word through preaching, which is committed unto me according to the commandment of God our Saviour;

verses.name: Titus 1:4
verses.text: To Titus, <hi type="italic">mine</hi> own son after the common faith: Grace, mercy, <hi type="italic">and</hi> peace, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Saviour.

verses.name: Titus 1:5
verses.text: For this cause left I thee in Crete, that thou shouldest set in order the things that are wanting, and ordain elders in every city, as I had appointed thee:

verses.name: Titus 1:6
verses.text: If any be blameless, the husband of one wife, having faithful children not accused of riot or unruly.

verses.name: Titus 1:7
verses.text: For a bishop must be blameless, as the steward of God; not selfwilled, not soon angry, not given to wine, no striker, not given to filthy lucre;

verses.name: Titus 1:8
verses.text: But a lover of hospitality, a lover of good men, sober, just, holy, temperate;

verses.name: Titus 1:9
verses.text: Holding fast the faithful word as he hath been taught, that he may be able by sound doctrine both to exhort and to convince the gainsayers.

verses.name: Titus 1:10
verses.text: For there are many unruly and vain talkers and deceivers, specially they of the circumcision:

verses.name: Titus 1:11
verses.text: Whose mouths must be stopped, who subvert whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for filthy lucre’s sake.

verses.name: Titus 1:12
verses.text: One of themselves, <hi type="italic">even</hi> a prophet of their own, said, The Cretians <hi type="italic">are</hi> alway liars, evil beasts, slow bellies.

verses.name: Titus 1:13
verses.text: This witness is true. Wherefore rebuke them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith;

verses.name: Titus 1:14
verses.text: Not giving heed to Jewish fables, and commandments of men, that turn from the truth.

verses.name: Titus 1:15
verses.text: Unto the pure all things <hi type="italic">are</hi> pure: but unto them that are defiled and unbelieving <hi type="italic">is</hi> nothing pure; but even their mind and conscience is defiled.

verses.name: Titus 1:16
verses.text: They profess that they know God; but in works they deny <hi type="italic">him</hi>, being abominable, and disobedient, and unto every good work reprobate.  <chapter eID="Titus.1"/><div eID="gen1230" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Titus 2:1
verses.text: BUT speak thou the things which become sound doctrine:

verses.name: Titus 2:2
verses.text: That the aged men be sober, grave, temperate, sound in faith, in charity, in patience.

verses.name: Titus 2:3
verses.text: The aged women likewise, that <hi type="italic">they be</hi> in behaviour as becometh holiness, not false accusers, not given to much wine, teachers of good things;

verses.name: Titus 2:4
verses.text: That they may teach the young women to be sober, to love their husbands, to love their children,

verses.name: Titus 2:5
verses.text: <hi type="italic">To be</hi> discreet, chaste, keepers at home, good, obedient to their own husbands, that the word of God be not blasphemed.

verses.name: Titus 2:6
verses.text: Young men likewise exhort to be sober minded.

verses.name: Titus 2:7
verses.text: In all things shewing thyself a pattern of good works: in doctrine <hi type="italic">shewing</hi> uncorruptness, gravity, sincerity,

verses.name: Titus 2:8
verses.text: Sound speech, that cannot be condemned; that he that is of the contrary part may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say of you.

verses.name: Titus 2:9
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Exhort</hi> servants to be obedient unto their own masters, <hi type="italic">and</hi> to please <hi type="italic">them</hi> well in all <hi type="italic">things;</hi> not answering again;

verses.name: Titus 2:10
verses.text: Not purloining, but shewing all good fidelity; that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Saviour in all things.

verses.name: Titus 2:11
verses.text: For the grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared to all men,

verses.name: Titus 2:12
verses.text: Teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly, righteously, and godly, in this present world;

verses.name: Titus 2:13
verses.text: Looking for that blessed hope, and the glorious appearing of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ;

verses.name: Titus 2:14
verses.text: Who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify unto himself a peculiar people, zealous of good works.

verses.name: Titus 2:15
verses.text: These things speak, and exhort, and rebuke with all authority. Let no man despise thee.  <chapter eID="Titus.2"/><div eID="gen1231" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Titus 3:1
verses.text: PUT them in mind to be subject to principalities and powers, to obey magistrates, to be ready to every good work,

verses.name: Titus 3:2
verses.text: To speak evil of no man, to be no brawlers, <hi type="italic">but</hi> gentle, shewing all meekness unto all men.

verses.name: Titus 3:3
verses.text: For we ourselves also were sometimes foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving divers lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, <hi type="italic">and</hi> hating one another.

verses.name: Titus 3:4
verses.text: But after that the kindness and love of God our Saviour toward man appeared,

verses.name: Titus 3:5
verses.text: Not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to his mercy he saved us, by the washing of regeneration, and renewing of the Holy Ghost;

verses.name: Titus 3:6
verses.text: Which he shed on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Saviour;

verses.name: Titus 3:7
verses.text: That being justified by his grace, we should be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.

verses.name: Titus 3:8
verses.text: <hi type="italic">This is</hi> a faithful saying, and these things I will that thou affirm constantly, that they which have believed in God might be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable unto men.

verses.name: Titus 3:9
verses.text: But avoid foolish questions, and genealogies, and contentions, and strivings about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.

verses.name: Titus 3:10
verses.text: A man that is an heretick after the first and second admonition reject;

verses.name: Titus 3:11
verses.text: Knowing that he that is such is subverted, and sinneth, being condemned of himself.

verses.name: Titus 3:12
verses.text: When I shall send Artemas unto thee, or Tychicus, be diligent to come unto me to Nicopolis: for I have determined there to winter.

verses.name: Titus 3:13
verses.text: Bring Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey diligently, that nothing be wanting unto them.

verses.name: Titus 3:14
verses.text: And let ours also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses, that they be not unfruitful.

verses.name: Titus 3:15
verses.text: All that are with me salute thee. Greet them that love us in the faith. Grace <hi type="italic">be</hi> with you all. Amen. ¶ It was written to Titus, ordained the first bishop of the church of the Cretians, from Nicopolis of Macedonia.  <chapter eID="Titus.3"/><div eID="gen1232" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen1229" osisID="Titus" type="book"/>

verses.name: Philemon 1:1
verses.text: PAUL, a prisoner of Jesus Christ, and Timothy <hi type="italic">our</hi> brother, unto Philemon our dearly beloved, and fellowlabourer,

verses.name: Philemon 1:2
verses.text: And to <hi type="italic">our</hi> beloved Apphia, and Archippus our fellowsoldier, and to the church in thy house:

verses.name: Philemon 1:3
verses.text: Grace to you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.name: Philemon 1:4
verses.text: I thank my God, making mention of thee always in my prayers,

verses.name: Philemon 1:5
verses.text: Hearing of thy love and faith, which thou hast toward the Lord Jesus, and toward all saints;

verses.name: Philemon 1:6
verses.text: That the communication of thy faith may become effectual by the acknowledging of every good thing which is in you in Christ Jesus.

verses.name: Philemon 1:7
verses.text: For we have great joy and consolation in thy love, because the bowels of the saints are refreshed by thee, brother.

verses.name: Philemon 1:8
verses.text: Wherefore, though I might be much bold in Christ to enjoin thee that which is convenient,

verses.name: Philemon 1:9
verses.text: Yet for love’s sake I rather beseech <hi type="italic">thee</hi>, being such an one as Paul the aged, and now also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.

verses.name: Philemon 1:10
verses.text: I beseech thee for my son Onesimus, whom I have begotten in my bonds:

verses.name: Philemon 1:11
verses.text: Which in time past was to thee unprofitable, but now profitable to thee and to me:

verses.name: Philemon 1:12
verses.text: Whom I have sent again: thou therefore receive him, that is, mine own bowels:

verses.name: Philemon 1:13
verses.text: Whom I would have retained with me, that in thy stead he might have ministered unto me in the bonds of the gospel:

verses.name: Philemon 1:14
verses.text: But without thy mind would I do nothing; that thy benefit should not be as it were of necessity, but willingly.

verses.name: Philemon 1:15
verses.text: For perhaps he therefore departed for a season, that thou shouldest receive him for ever;

verses.name: Philemon 1:16
verses.text: Not now as a servant, but above a servant, a brother beloved, specially to me, but how much more unto thee, both in the flesh, and in the Lord?

verses.name: Philemon 1:17
verses.text: If thou count me therefore a partner, receive him as myself.

verses.name: Philemon 1:18
verses.text: If he hath wronged thee, or oweth <hi type="italic">thee</hi> ought, put that on mine account;

verses.name: Philemon 1:19
verses.text: I Paul have written <hi type="italic">it</hi> with mine own hand, I will repay <hi type="italic">it:</hi> albeit I do not say to thee how thou owest unto me even thine own self besides.

verses.name: Philemon 1:20
verses.text: Yea, brother, let me have joy of thee in the Lord: refresh my bowels in the Lord.

verses.name: Philemon 1:21
verses.text: Having confidence in thy obedience I wrote unto thee, knowing that thou wilt also do more than I say.

verses.name: Philemon 1:22
verses.text: But withal prepare me also a lodging: for I trust that through your prayers I shall be given unto you.

verses.name: Philemon 1:23
verses.text: There salute thee Epaphras, my fellowprisoner in Christ Jesus;

verses.name: Philemon 1:24
verses.text: Marcus, Aristarchus, Demas, Lucas, my fellowlabourers.

verses.name: Philemon 1:25
verses.text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ <hi type="italic">be</hi> with your spirit. Amen. ¶ Written from Rome to Philemon, by Onesimus a servant.  <chapter eID="Phlm.1"/><div eID="gen1234" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen1233" osisID="Phlm" type="book"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 1:1
verses.text: GOD, who at sundry times and in divers manners spake in time past unto the fathers by the prophets,

verses.name: Hebrews 1:2
verses.text: Hath in these last days spoken unto us by <hi type="italic">his</hi> Son, whom he hath appointed heir of all things, by whom also he made the worlds;

verses.name: Hebrews 1:3
verses.text: Who being the brightness of <hi type="italic">his</hi> glory, and the express image of his person, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself purged our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high;

verses.name: Hebrews 1:4
verses.text: Being made so much better than the angels, as he hath by inheritance obtained a more excellent name than they.

verses.name: Hebrews 1:5
verses.text: For unto which of the angels said he at any time, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee? And again, I will be to him a Father, and he shall be to me a Son?

verses.name: Hebrews 1:6
verses.text: And again, when he bringeth in the firstbegotten into the world, he saith, And let all the angels of God worship him.

verses.name: Hebrews 1:7
verses.text: And of the angels he saith, Who maketh his angels spirits, and his ministers a flame of fire.

verses.name: Hebrews 1:8
verses.text: But unto the Son <hi type="italic">he saith</hi>, Thy throne, O God, <hi type="italic">is</hi> for ever and ever: a sceptre of righteousness <hi type="italic">is</hi> the sceptre of thy kingdom.

verses.name: Hebrews 1:9
verses.text: Thou hast loved righteousness, and hated iniquity; therefore God, <hi type="italic">even</hi> thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.

verses.name: Hebrews 1:10
verses.text: And, Thou, Lord, in the beginning hast laid the foundation of the earth; and the heavens are the works of thine hands:

verses.name: Hebrews 1:11
verses.text: They shall perish; but thou remainest; and they all shall wax old as doth a garment;

verses.name: Hebrews 1:12
verses.text: And as a vesture shalt thou fold them up, and they shall be changed: but thou art the same, and thy years shall not fail.

verses.name: Hebrews 1:13
verses.text: But to which of the angels said he at any time, Sit on my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool?

verses.name: Hebrews 1:14
verses.text: Are they not all ministering spirits, sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation?  <chapter eID="Heb.1"/><div eID="gen1236" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 2:1
verses.text: THEREFORE we ought to give the more earnest heed to the things which we have heard, lest at any time we should let <hi type="italic">them</hi> slip.

verses.name: Hebrews 2:2
verses.text: For if the word spoken by angels was stedfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just recompence of reward;

verses.name: Hebrews 2:3
verses.text: How shall we escape, if we neglect so great salvation; which at the first began to be spoken by the Lord, and was confirmed unto us by them that heard <hi type="italic">him;</hi>

verses.name: Hebrews 2:4
verses.text: God also bearing <hi type="italic">them</hi> witness, both with signs and wonders, and with divers miracles, and gifts of the Holy Ghost, according to his own will?

verses.name: Hebrews 2:5
verses.text: For unto the angels hath he not put in subjection the world to come, whereof we speak.

verses.name: Hebrews 2:6
verses.text: But one in a certain place testified, saying, What is man, that thou art mindful of him? or the son of man, that thou visitest him?

verses.name: Hebrews 2:7
verses.text: Thou madest him a little lower than the angels; thou crownedst him with glory and honour, and didst set him over the works of thy hands:

verses.name: Hebrews 2:8
verses.text: Thou hast put all things in subjection under his feet. For in that he put all in subjection under him, he left nothing <hi type="italic">that is</hi> not put under him. But now we see not yet all things put under him.

verses.name: Hebrews 2:9
verses.text: But we see Jesus, who was made a little lower than the angels for the suffering of death, crowned with glory and honour; that he by the grace of God should taste death for every man.

verses.name: Hebrews 2:10
verses.text: For it became him, for whom <hi type="italic">are</hi> all things, and by whom <hi type="italic">are</hi> all things, in bringing many sons unto glory, to make the captain of their salvation perfect through sufferings.

verses.name: Hebrews 2:11
verses.text: For both he that sanctifieth and they who are sanctified <hi type="italic">are</hi> all of one: for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brethren,

verses.name: Hebrews 2:12
verses.text: Saying, I will declare thy name unto my brethren, in the midst of the church will I sing praise unto thee.

verses.name: Hebrews 2:13
verses.text: And again, I will put my trust in him. And again, Behold I and the children which God hath given me.

verses.name: Hebrews 2:14
verses.text: Forasmuch then as the children are partakers of flesh and blood, he also himself likewise took part of the same; that through death he might destroy him that had the power of death, that is, the devil;

verses.name: Hebrews 2:15
verses.text: And deliver them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.

verses.name: Hebrews 2:16
verses.text: For verily he took not on <hi type="italic">him the nature of</hi> angels; but he took on <hi type="italic">him</hi> the seed of Abraham.

verses.name: Hebrews 2:17
verses.text: Wherefore in all things it behoved him to be made like unto <hi type="italic">his</hi> brethren, that he might be a merciful and faithful high priest in things <hi type="italic">pertaining</hi> to God, to make reconciliation for the sins of the people.

verses.name: Hebrews 2:18
verses.text: For in that he himself hath suffered being tempted, he is able to succour them that are tempted.  <chapter eID="Heb.2"/><div eID="gen1237" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 3:1
verses.text: WHEREFORE, holy brethren, partakers of the heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our profession, Christ Jesus;

verses.name: Hebrews 3:2
verses.text: Who was faithful to him that appointed him, as also Moses <hi type="italic">was faithful</hi> in all his house.

verses.name: Hebrews 3:3
verses.text: For this <hi type="italic">man</hi> was counted worthy of more glory than Moses, inasmuch as he who hath builded the house hath more honour than the house.

verses.name: Hebrews 3:4
verses.text: For every house is builded by some <hi type="italic">man;</hi> but he that built all things <hi type="italic">is</hi> God.

verses.name: Hebrews 3:5
verses.text: And Moses verily <hi type="italic">was</hi> faithful in all his house, as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were to be spoken after;

verses.name: Hebrews 3:6
verses.text: But Christ as a son over his own house; whose house are we, if we hold fast the confidence and the rejoicing of the hope firm unto the end.

verses.name: Hebrews 3:7
verses.text: Wherefore (as the Holy Ghost saith, To day if ye will hear his voice,

verses.name: Hebrews 3:8
verses.text: Harden not your hearts, as in the provocation, in the day of temptation in the wilderness:

verses.name: Hebrews 3:9
verses.text: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my works forty years.

verses.name: Hebrews 3:10
verses.text: Wherefore I was grieved with that generation, and said, They do alway err in <hi type="italic">their</hi> heart; and they have not known my ways.

verses.name: Hebrews 3:11
verses.text: So I sware in my wrath, They shall not enter into my rest.)

verses.name: Hebrews 3:12
verses.text: Take heed, brethren, lest there be in any of you an evil heart of unbelief, in departing from the living God.

verses.name: Hebrews 3:13
verses.text: But exhort one another daily, while it is called To day; lest any of you be hardened through the deceitfulness of sin.

verses.name: Hebrews 3:14
verses.text: For we are made partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence stedfast unto the end;

verses.name: Hebrews 3:15
verses.text: While it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts, as in the provocation.

verses.name: Hebrews 3:16
verses.text: For some, when they had heard, did provoke: howbeit not all that came out of Egypt by Moses.

verses.name: Hebrews 3:17
verses.text: But with whom was he grieved forty years? <hi type="italic">was it</hi> not with them that had sinned, whose carcases fell in the wilderness?

verses.name: Hebrews 3:18
verses.text: And to whom sware he that they should not enter into his rest, but to them that believed not?

verses.name: Hebrews 3:19
verses.text: So we see that they could not enter in because of unbelief.  <chapter eID="Heb.3"/><div eID="gen1238" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 4:1
verses.text: LET us therefore fear, lest, a promise being left <hi type="italic">us</hi> of entering into his rest, any of you should seem to come short of it.

verses.name: Hebrews 4:2
verses.text: For unto us was the gospel preached, as well as unto them: but the word preached did not profit them, not being mixed with faith in them that heard <hi type="italic">it</hi>.

verses.name: Hebrews 4:3
verses.text: For we which have believed do enter into rest, as he said, As I have sworn in my wrath, if they shall enter into my rest: although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.

verses.name: Hebrews 4:4
verses.text: For he spake in a certain place of the seventh <hi type="italic">day</hi> on this wise, And God did rest the seventh day from all his works.

verses.name: Hebrews 4:5
verses.text: And in this <hi type="italic">place</hi> again, If they shall enter into my rest.

verses.name: Hebrews 4:6
verses.text: Seeing therefore it remaineth that some must enter therein, and they to whom it was first preached entered not in because of unbelief:

verses.name: Hebrews 4:7
verses.text: Again, he limiteth a certain day, saying in David, To day, after so long a time; as it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts.

verses.name: Hebrews 4:8
verses.text: For if Jesus had given them rest, then would he not afterward have spoken of another day.

verses.name: Hebrews 4:9
verses.text: There remaineth therefore a rest to the people of God.

verses.name: Hebrews 4:10
verses.text: For he that is entered into his rest, he also hath ceased from his own works, as God <hi type="italic">did</hi> from his.

verses.name: Hebrews 4:11
verses.text: Let us labour therefore to enter into that rest, lest any man fall after the same example of unbelief.

verses.name: Hebrews 4:12
verses.text: For the word of God <hi type="italic">is</hi> quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and <hi type="italic">is</hi> a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.

verses.name: Hebrews 4:13
verses.text: Neither is there any creature that is not manifest in his sight: but all things <hi type="italic">are</hi> naked and opened unto the eyes of him with whom we have to do.

verses.name: Hebrews 4:14
verses.text: Seeing then that we have a great high priest, that is passed into the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold fast <hi type="italic">our</hi> profession.

verses.name: Hebrews 4:15
verses.text: For we have not an high priest which cannot be touched with the feeling of our infirmities; but was in all points tempted like as <hi type="italic">we are</hi>, <hi type="italic">yet</hi> without sin.

verses.name: Hebrews 4:16
verses.text: Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.  <chapter eID="Heb.4"/><div eID="gen1239" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 5:1
verses.text: FOR every high priest taken from among men is ordained for men in things <hi type="italic">pertaining</hi> to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins:

verses.name: Hebrews 5:2
verses.text: Who can have compassion on the ignorant, and on them that are out of the way; for that he himself also is compassed with infirmity.

verses.name: Hebrews 5:3
verses.text: And by reason hereof he ought, as for the people, so also for himself, to offer for sins.

verses.name: Hebrews 5:4
verses.text: And no man taketh this honour unto himself, but he that is called of God, as <hi type="italic">was</hi> Aaron.

verses.name: Hebrews 5:5
verses.text: So also Christ glorified not himself to be made an high priest; but he that said unto him, Thou art my Son, to day have I begotten thee.

verses.name: Hebrews 5:6
verses.text: As he saith also in another <hi type="italic">place</hi>, Thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.

verses.name: Hebrews 5:7
verses.text: Who in the days of his flesh, when he had offered up prayers and supplications with strong crying and tears unto him that was able to save him from death, and was heard in that he feared;

verses.name: Hebrews 5:8
verses.text: Though he were a Son, yet learned he obedience by the things which he suffered;

verses.name: Hebrews 5:9
verses.text: And being made perfect, he became the author of eternal salvation unto all them that obey him;

verses.name: Hebrews 5:10
verses.text: Called of God an high priest after the order of Melchisedec.

verses.name: Hebrews 5:11
verses.text: Of whom we have many things to say, and hard to be uttered, seeing ye are dull of hearing.

verses.name: Hebrews 5:12
verses.text: For when for the time ye ought to be teachers, ye have need that one teach you again which <hi type="italic">be</hi> the first principles of the oracles of God; and are become such as have need of milk, and not of strong meat.

verses.name: Hebrews 5:13
verses.text: For every one that useth milk <hi type="italic">is</hi> unskilful in the word of righteousness: for he is a babe.

verses.name: Hebrews 5:14
verses.text: But strong meat belongeth to them that are of full age, <hi type="italic">even</hi> those who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern both good and evil.  <chapter eID="Heb.5"/><div eID="gen1240" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 6:1
verses.text: THEREFORE leaving the principles of the doctrine of Christ, let us go on unto perfection; not laying again the foundation of repentance from dead works, and of faith toward God,

verses.name: Hebrews 6:2
verses.text: Of the doctrine of baptisms, and of laying on of hands, and of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.

verses.name: Hebrews 6:3
verses.text: And this will we do, if God permit.

verses.name: Hebrews 6:4
verses.text: For <hi type="italic">it is</hi> impossible for those who were once enlightened, and have tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy Ghost,

verses.name: Hebrews 6:5
verses.text: And have tasted the good word of God, and the powers of the world to come,

verses.name: Hebrews 6:6
verses.text: If they shall fall away, to renew them again unto repentance; seeing they crucify to themselves the Son of God afresh, and put <hi type="italic">him</hi> to an open shame.

verses.name: Hebrews 6:7
verses.text: For the earth which drinketh in the rain that cometh oft upon it, and bringeth forth herbs meet for them by whom it is dressed, receiveth blessing from God:

verses.name: Hebrews 6:8
verses.text: But that which beareth thorns and briers <hi type="italic">is</hi> rejected, and <hi type="italic">is</hi> nigh unto cursing; whose end <hi type="italic">is</hi> to be burned.

verses.name: Hebrews 6:9
verses.text: But, beloved, we are persuaded better things of you, and things that accompany salvation, though we thus speak.

verses.name: Hebrews 6:10
verses.text: For God <hi type="italic">is</hi> not unrighteous to forget your work and labour of love, which ye have shewed toward his name, in that ye have ministered to the saints, and do minister.

verses.name: Hebrews 6:11
verses.text: And we desire that every one of you do shew the same diligence to the full assurance of hope unto the end:

verses.name: Hebrews 6:12
verses.text: That ye be not slothful, but followers of them who through faith and patience inherit the promises.

verses.name: Hebrews 6:13
verses.text: For when God made promise to Abraham, because he could swear by no greater, he sware by himself,

verses.name: Hebrews 6:14
verses.text: Saying, Surely blessing I will bless thee, and multiplying I will multiply thee.

verses.name: Hebrews 6:15
verses.text: And so, after he had patiently endured, he obtained the promise.

verses.name: Hebrews 6:16
verses.text: For men verily swear by the greater: and an oath for confirmation <hi type="italic">is</hi> to them an end of all strife.

verses.name: Hebrews 6:17
verses.text: Wherein God, willing more abundantly to shew unto the heirs of promise the immutability of his counsel, confirmed <hi type="italic">it</hi> by an oath:

verses.name: Hebrews 6:18
verses.text: That by two immutable things, in which <hi type="italic">it was</hi> impossible for God to lie, we might have a strong consolation, who have fled for refuge to lay hold upon the hope set before us:

verses.name: Hebrews 6:19
verses.text: Which <hi type="italic">hope</hi> we have as an anchor of the soul, both sure and stedfast, and which entereth into that within the veil;

verses.name: Hebrews 6:20
verses.text: Whither the forerunner is for us entered, <hi type="italic">even</hi> Jesus, made an high priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.  <chapter eID="Heb.6"/><div eID="gen1241" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 7:1
verses.text: FOR this Melchisedec, king of Salem, priest of the most high God, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings, and blessed him;

verses.name: Hebrews 7:2
verses.text: To whom also Abraham gave a tenth part of all; first being by interpretation King of righteousness, and after that also King of Salem, which is, King of peace;

verses.name: Hebrews 7:3
verses.text: Without father, without mother, without descent, having neither beginning of days, nor end of life; but made like unto the Son of God; abideth a priest continually.

verses.name: Hebrews 7:4
verses.text: Now consider how great this man <hi type="italic">was</hi>, unto whom even the patriarch Abraham gave the tenth of the spoils.

verses.name: Hebrews 7:5
verses.text: And verily they that are of the sons of Levi, who receive the office of the priesthood, have a commandment to take tithes of the people according to the law, that is, of their brethren, though they come out of the loins of Abraham:

verses.name: Hebrews 7:6
verses.text: But he whose descent is not counted from them received tithes of Abraham, and blessed him that had the promises.

verses.name: Hebrews 7:7
verses.text: And without all contradiction the less is blessed of the better.

verses.name: Hebrews 7:8
verses.text: And here men that die receive tithes; but there he <hi type="italic">receiveth them</hi>, of whom it is witnessed that he liveth.

verses.name: Hebrews 7:9
verses.text: And as I may so say, Levi also, who receiveth tithes, payed tithes in Abraham.

verses.name: Hebrews 7:10
verses.text: For he was yet in the loins of his father, when Melchisedec met him.

verses.name: Hebrews 7:11
verses.text: If therefore perfection were by the Levitical priesthood, (for under it the people received the law,) what further need <hi type="italic">was there</hi> that another priest should rise after the order of Melchisedec, and not be called after the order of Aaron?

verses.name: Hebrews 7:12
verses.text: For the priesthood being changed, there is made of necessity a change also of the law.

verses.name: Hebrews 7:13
verses.text: For he of whom these things are spoken pertaineth to another tribe, of which no man gave attendance at the altar.

verses.name: Hebrews 7:14
verses.text: For <hi type="italic">it is</hi> evident that our Lord sprang out of Juda; of which tribe Moses spake nothing concerning priesthood.

verses.name: Hebrews 7:15
verses.text: And it is yet far more evident: for that after the similitude of Melchisedec there ariseth another priest,

verses.name: Hebrews 7:16
verses.text: Who is made, not after the law of a carnal commandment, but after the power of an endless life.

verses.name: Hebrews 7:17
verses.text: For he testifieth, Thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.

verses.name: Hebrews 7:18
verses.text: For there is verily a disannulling of the commandment going before for the weakness and unprofitableness thereof.

verses.name: Hebrews 7:19
verses.text: For the law made nothing perfect, but the bringing in of a better hope <hi type="italic">did;</hi> by the which we draw nigh unto God.

verses.name: Hebrews 7:20
verses.text: And inasmuch as not without an oath <hi type="italic">he was made priest:</hi>

verses.name: Hebrews 7:21
verses.text: (For those priests were made without an oath; but this with an oath by him that said unto him, The Lord sware and will not repent, Thou <hi type="italic">art</hi> a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec:)

verses.name: Hebrews 7:22
verses.text: By so much was Jesus made a surety of a better testament.

verses.name: Hebrews 7:23
verses.text: And they truly were many priests, because they were not suffered to continue by reason of death:

verses.name: Hebrews 7:24
verses.text: But this <hi type="italic">man</hi>, because he continueth ever, hath an unchangeable priesthood.

verses.name: Hebrews 7:25
verses.text: Wherefore he is able also to save them to the uttermost that come unto God by him, seeing he ever liveth to make intercession for them.

verses.name: Hebrews 7:26
verses.text: For such an high priest became us, <hi type="italic">who is</hi> holy, harmless, undefiled, separate from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;

verses.name: Hebrews 7:27
verses.text: Who needeth not daily, as those high priests, to offer up sacrifice, first for his own sins, and then for the people’s: for this he did once, when he offered up himself.

verses.name: Hebrews 7:28
verses.text: For the law maketh men high priests which have infirmity; but the word of the oath, which was since the law, <hi type="italic">maketh</hi> the Son, who is consecrated for evermore.  <chapter eID="Heb.7"/><div eID="gen1242" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 8:1
verses.text: NOW of the things which we have spoken <hi type="italic">this is</hi> the sum: We have such an high priest, who is set on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens;

verses.name: Hebrews 8:2
verses.text: A minister of the sanctuary, and of the true tabernacle, which the Lord pitched, and not man.

verses.name: Hebrews 8:3
verses.text: For every high priest is ordained to offer gifts and sacrifices: wherefore <hi type="italic">it is</hi> of necessity that this man have somewhat also to offer.

verses.name: Hebrews 8:4
verses.text: For if he were on earth, he should not be a priest, seeing that there are priests that offer gifts according to the law:

verses.name: Hebrews 8:5
verses.text: Who serve unto the example and shadow of heavenly things, as Moses was admonished of God when he was about to make the tabernacle: for, See, saith he, <hi type="italic">that</hi> thou make all things according to the pattern shewed to thee in the mount.

verses.name: Hebrews 8:6
verses.text: But now hath he obtained a more excellent ministry, by how much also he is the mediator of a better covenant, which was established upon better promises.

verses.name: Hebrews 8:7
verses.text: For if that first <hi type="italic">covenant</hi> had been faultless, then should no place have been sought for the second.

verses.name: Hebrews 8:8
verses.text: For finding fault with them, he saith, Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah:

verses.name: Hebrews 8:9
verses.text: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day when I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt; because they continued not in my covenant, and I regarded them not, saith the Lord.

verses.name: Hebrews 8:10
verses.text: For this <hi type="italic">is</hi> the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days, saith the Lord; I will put my laws into their mind, and write them in their hearts: and I will be to them a God, and they shall be to me a people:

verses.name: Hebrews 8:11
verses.text: And they shall not teach every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know the Lord: for all shall know me, from the least to the greatest.

verses.name: Hebrews 8:12
verses.text: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness, and their sins and their iniquities will I remember no more.

verses.name: Hebrews 8:13
verses.text: In that he saith, A new <hi type="italic">covenant</hi>, he hath made the first old. Now that which decayeth and waxeth old <hi type="italic">is</hi> ready to vanish away.  <chapter eID="Heb.8"/><div eID="gen1243" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 9:1
verses.text: THEN verily the first <hi type="italic">covenant</hi> had also ordinances of divine service, and a worldly sanctuary.

verses.name: Hebrews 9:2
verses.text: For there was a tabernacle made; the first, wherein <hi type="italic">was</hi> the candlestick, and the table, and the shewbread; which is called the sanctuary.

verses.name: Hebrews 9:3
verses.text: And after the second veil, the tabernacle which is called the Holiest of all;

verses.name: Hebrews 9:4
verses.text: Which had the golden censer, and the ark of the covenant overlaid round about with gold, wherein <hi type="italic">was</hi> the golden pot that had manna, and Aaron’s rod that budded, and the tables of the covenant;

verses.name: Hebrews 9:5
verses.text: And over it the cherubims of glory shadowing the mercyseat; of which we cannot now speak particularly.

verses.name: Hebrews 9:6
verses.text: Now when these things were thus ordained, the priests went always into the first tabernacle, accomplishing the service <hi type="italic">of God</hi>.

verses.name: Hebrews 9:7
verses.text: But into the second <hi type="italic">went</hi> the high priest alone once every year, not without blood, which he offered for himself, and <hi type="italic">for</hi> the errors of the people:

verses.name: Hebrews 9:8
verses.text: The Holy Ghost this signifying, that the way into the holiest of all was not yet made manifest, while as the first tabernacle was yet standing:

verses.name: Hebrews 9:9
verses.text: Which <hi type="italic">was</hi> a figure for the time then present, in which were offered both gifts and sacrifices, that could not make him that did the service perfect, as pertaining to the conscience;

verses.name: Hebrews 9:10
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Which stood</hi> only in meats and drinks, and divers washings, and carnal ordinances, imposed <hi type="italic">on them</hi> until the time of reformation.

verses.name: Hebrews 9:11
verses.text: But Christ being come an high priest of good things to come, by a greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this building;

verses.name: Hebrews 9:12
verses.text: Neither by the blood of goats and calves, but by his own blood he entered in once into the holy place, having obtained eternal redemption <hi type="italic">for us</hi>.

verses.name: Hebrews 9:13
verses.text: For if the blood of bulls and of goats, and the ashes of an heifer sprinkling the unclean, sanctifieth to the purifying of the flesh:

verses.name: Hebrews 9:14
verses.text: How much more shall the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without spot to God, purge your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?

verses.name: Hebrews 9:15
verses.text: And for this cause he is the mediator of the new testament, that by means of death, for the redemption of the transgressions <hi type="italic">that were</hi> under the first testament, they which are called might receive the promise of eternal inheritance.

verses.name: Hebrews 9:16
verses.text: For where a testament <hi type="italic">is</hi>, there must also of necessity be the death of the testator.

verses.name: Hebrews 9:17
verses.text: For a testament <hi type="italic">is</hi> of force after men are dead: otherwise it is of no strength at all while the testator liveth.

verses.name: Hebrews 9:18
verses.text: Whereupon neither the first <hi type="italic">testament</hi> was dedicated without blood.

verses.name: Hebrews 9:19
verses.text: For when Moses had spoken every precept to all the people according to the law, he took the blood of calves and of goats, with water, and scarlet wool, and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book, and all the people,

verses.name: Hebrews 9:20
verses.text: Saying, This <hi type="italic">is</hi> the blood of the testament which God hath enjoined unto you.

verses.name: Hebrews 9:21
verses.text: Moreover he sprinkled with blood both the tabernacle, and all the vessels of the ministry.

verses.name: Hebrews 9:22
verses.text: And almost all things are by the law purged with blood; and without shedding of blood is no remission.

verses.name: Hebrews 9:23
verses.text: <hi type="italic">It was</hi> therefore necessary that the patterns of things in the heavens should be purified with these; but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.

verses.name: Hebrews 9:24
verses.text: For Christ is not entered into the holy places made with hands, <hi type="italic">which are</hi> the figures of the true; but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of God for us:

verses.name: Hebrews 9:25
verses.text: Nor yet that he should offer himself often, as the high priest entereth into the holy place every year with blood of others;

verses.name: Hebrews 9:26
verses.text: For then must he often have suffered since the foundation of the world: but now once in the end of the world hath he appeared to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself.

verses.name: Hebrews 9:27
verses.text: And as it is appointed unto men once to die, but after this the judgment:

verses.name: Hebrews 9:28
verses.text: So Christ was once offered to bear the sins of many; and unto them that look for him shall he appear the second time without sin unto salvation.  <chapter eID="Heb.9"/><div eID="gen1244" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 10:1
verses.text: FOR the law having a shadow of good things to come, <hi type="italic">and</hi> not the very image of the things, can never with those sacrifices which they offered year by year continually make the comers thereunto perfect.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:2
verses.text: For then would they not have ceased to be offered? because that the worshippers once purged should have had no more conscience of sins.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:3
verses.text: But in those <hi type="italic">sacrifices there is</hi> a remembrance again <hi type="italic">made</hi> of sins every year.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:4
verses.text: For <hi type="italic">it is</hi> not possible that the blood of bulls and of goats should take away sins.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:5
verses.text: Wherefore when he cometh into the world, he saith, Sacrifice and offering thou wouldest not, but a body hast thou prepared me:

verses.name: Hebrews 10:6
verses.text: In burnt offerings and <hi type="italic">sacrifices</hi> for sin thou hast had no pleasure.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:7
verses.text: Then said I, Lo, I come (in the volume of the book it is written of me,) to do thy will, O God.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:8
verses.text: Above when he said, Sacrifice and offering and burnt offerings and <hi type="italic">offering</hi> for sin thou wouldest not, neither hadst pleasure <hi type="italic">therein;</hi> which are offered by the law;

verses.name: Hebrews 10:9
verses.text: Then said he, Lo, I come to do thy will, O God. He taketh away the first, that he may establish the second.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:10
verses.text: By the which will we are sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once <hi type="italic">for all</hi>.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:11
verses.text: And every priest standeth daily ministering and offering oftentimes the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins:

verses.name: Hebrews 10:12
verses.text: But this man, after he had offered one sacrifice for sins for ever, sat down on the right hand of God;

verses.name: Hebrews 10:13
verses.text: From henceforth expecting till his enemies be made his footstool.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:14
verses.text: For by one offering he hath perfected for ever them that are sanctified.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:15
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Whereof</hi> the Holy Ghost also is a witness to us: for after that he had said before,

verses.name: Hebrews 10:16
verses.text: This <hi type="italic">is</hi> the covenant that I will make with them after those days, saith the Lord, I will put my laws into their hearts, and in their minds will I write them;

verses.name: Hebrews 10:17
verses.text: And their sins and iniquities will I remember no more.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:18
verses.text: Now where remission of these <hi type="italic">is</hi>, <hi type="italic">there is</hi> no more offering for sin.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:19
verses.text: Having therefore, brethren, boldness to enter into the holiest by the blood of Jesus,

verses.name: Hebrews 10:20
verses.text: By a new and living way, which he hath consecrated for us, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh;

verses.name: Hebrews 10:21
verses.text: And <hi type="italic">having</hi> an high priest over the house of God;

verses.name: Hebrews 10:22
verses.text: Let us draw near with a true heart in full assurance of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience, and our bodies washed with pure water.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:23
verses.text: Let us hold fast the profession of <hi type="italic">our</hi> faith without wavering; (for he <hi type="italic">is</hi> faithful that promised;)

verses.name: Hebrews 10:24
verses.text: And let us consider one another to provoke unto love and to good works:

verses.name: Hebrews 10:25
verses.text: Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as the manner of some <hi type="italic">is;</hi> but exhorting <hi type="italic">one another:</hi> and so much the more, as ye see the day approaching.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:26
verses.text: For if we sin wilfully after that we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remaineth no more sacrifice for sins,

verses.name: Hebrews 10:27
verses.text: But a certain fearful looking for of judgment and fiery indignation, which shall devour the adversaries.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:28
verses.text: He that despised Moses’ law died without mercy under two or three witnesses:

verses.name: Hebrews 10:29
verses.text: Of how much sorer punishment, suppose ye, shall he be thought worthy, who hath trodden under foot the Son of God, and hath counted the blood of the covenant, wherewith he was sanctified, an unholy thing, and hath done despite unto the Spirit of grace?

verses.name: Hebrews 10:30
verses.text: For we know him that hath said, Vengeance <hi type="italic">belongeth</hi> unto me, I will recompense, saith the Lord. And again, The Lord shall judge his people.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:31
verses.text: <hi type="italic">It is</hi> a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:32
verses.text: But call to remembrance the former days, in which, after ye were illuminated, ye endured a great fight of afflictions;

verses.name: Hebrews 10:33
verses.text: Partly, whilst ye were made a gazingstock both by reproaches and afflictions; and partly, whilst ye became companions of them that were so used.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:34
verses.text: For ye had compassion of me in my bonds, and took joyfully the spoiling of your goods, knowing in yourselves that ye have in heaven a better and an enduring substance.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:35
verses.text: Cast not away therefore your confidence, which hath great recompence of reward.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:36
verses.text: For ye have need of patience, that, after ye have done the will of God, ye might receive the promise.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:37
verses.text: For yet a little while, and he that shall come will come, and will not tarry.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:38
verses.text: Now the just shall live by faith: but if <hi type="italic">any man</hi> draw back, my soul shall have no pleasure in him.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:39
verses.text: But we are not of them who draw back unto perdition; but of them that believe to the saving of the soul.  <chapter eID="Heb.10"/><div eID="gen1245" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 11:1
verses.text: NOW faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:2
verses.text: For by it the elders obtained a good report.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:3
verses.text: Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of God, so that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:4
verses.text: By faith Abel offered unto God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, by which he obtained witness that he was righteous, God testifying of his gifts: and by it he being dead yet speaketh.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:5
verses.text: By faith Enoch was translated that he should not see death; and was not found, because God had translated him: for before his translation he had this testimony, that he pleased God.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:6
verses.text: But without faith <hi type="italic">it is</hi> impossible to please <hi type="italic">him:</hi> for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and <hi type="italic">that</hi> he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:7
verses.text: By faith Noah, being warned of God of things not seen as yet, moved with fear, prepared an ark to the saving of his house; by the which he condemned the world, and became heir of the righteousness which is by faith.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:8
verses.text: By faith Abraham, when he was called to go out into a place which he should after receive for an inheritance, obeyed; and he went out, not knowing whither he went.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:9
verses.text: By faith he sojourned in the land of promise, as <hi type="italic">in</hi> a strange country, dwelling in tabernacles with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise:

verses.name: Hebrews 11:10
verses.text: For he looked for a city which hath foundations, whose builder and maker <hi type="italic">is</hi> God.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:11
verses.text: Through faith also Sara herself received strength to conceive seed, and was delivered of a child when she was past age, because she judged him faithful who had promised.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:12
verses.text: Therefore sprang there even of one, and him as good as dead, <hi type="italic">so many</hi> as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as the sand which is by the sea shore innumerable.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:13
verses.text: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them afar off, and were persuaded of <hi type="italic">them</hi>, and embraced <hi type="italic">them</hi>, and confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:14
verses.text: For they that say such things declare plainly that they seek a country.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:15
verses.text: And truly, if they had been mindful of that <hi type="italic">country</hi> from whence they came out, they might have had opportunity to have returned.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:16
verses.text: But now they desire a better <hi type="italic">country</hi>, that is, an heavenly: wherefore God is not ashamed to be called their God: for he hath prepared for them a city.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:17
verses.text: By faith Abraham, when he was tried, offered up Isaac: and he that had received the promises offered up his only begotten <hi type="italic">son</hi>,

verses.name: Hebrews 11:18
verses.text: Of whom it was said, That in Isaac shall thy seed be called:

verses.name: Hebrews 11:19
verses.text: Accounting that God <hi type="italic">was</hi> able to raise <hi type="italic">him</hi> up, even from the dead; from whence also he received him in a figure.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:20
verses.text: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau concerning things to come.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:21
verses.text: By faith Jacob, when he was a dying, blessed both the sons of Joseph; and worshipped, <hi type="italic">leaning</hi> upon the top of his staff.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:22
verses.text: By faith Joseph, when he died, made mention of the departing of the children of Israel; and gave commandment concerning his bones.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:23
verses.text: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hid three months of his parents, because they saw <hi type="italic">he was</hi> a proper child; and they were not afraid of the king’s commandment.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:24
verses.text: By faith Moses, when he was come to years, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter;

verses.name: Hebrews 11:25
verses.text: Choosing rather to suffer affliction with the people of God, than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a season;

verses.name: Hebrews 11:26
verses.text: Esteeming the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures in Egypt: for he had respect unto the recompence of the reward.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:27
verses.text: By faith he forsook Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king: for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:28
verses.text: Through faith he kept the passover, and the sprinkling of blood, lest he that destroyed the firstborn should touch them.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:29
verses.text: By faith they passed through the Red sea as by dry <hi type="italic">land:</hi> which the Egyptians assaying to do were drowned.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:30
verses.text: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down, after they were compassed about seven days.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:31
verses.text: By faith the harlot Rahab perished not with them that believed not, when she had received the spies with peace.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:32
verses.text: And what shall I more say? for the time would fail me to tell of Gedeon, and <hi type="italic">of</hi> Barak, and <hi type="italic">of</hi> Samson, and <hi type="italic">of</hi> Jephthae; <hi type="italic">of</hi> David also, and Samuel, and <hi type="italic">of</hi> the prophets:

verses.name: Hebrews 11:33
verses.text: Who through faith subdued kingdoms, wrought righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions,

verses.name: Hebrews 11:34
verses.text: Quenched the violence of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, out of weakness were made strong, waxed valiant in fight, turned to flight the armies of the aliens.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:35
verses.text: Women received their dead raised to life again: and others were tortured, not accepting deliverance; that they might obtain a better resurrection:

verses.name: Hebrews 11:36
verses.text: And others had trial of <hi type="italic">cruel</hi> mockings and scourgings, yea, moreover of bonds and imprisonment:

verses.name: Hebrews 11:37
verses.text: They were stoned, they were sawn asunder, were tempted, were slain with the sword: they wandered about in sheepskins and goatskins; being destitute, afflicted, tormented;

verses.name: Hebrews 11:38
verses.text: (Of whom the world was not worthy:) they wandered in deserts, and <hi type="italic">in</hi> mountains, and <hi type="italic">in</hi> dens and caves of the earth.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:39
verses.text: And these all, having obtained a good report through faith, received not the promise:

verses.name: Hebrews 11:40
verses.text: God having provided some better thing for us, that they without us should not be made perfect.  <chapter eID="Heb.11"/><div eID="gen1246" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 12:1
verses.text: WHEREFORE seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset <hi type="italic">us</hi>, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,

verses.name: Hebrews 12:2
verses.text: Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of <hi type="italic">our</hi> faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God.

verses.name: Hebrews 12:3
verses.text: For consider him that endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, lest ye be wearied and faint in your minds.

verses.name: Hebrews 12:4
verses.text: Ye have not yet resisted unto blood, striving against sin.

verses.name: Hebrews 12:5
verses.text: And ye have forgotten the exhortation which speaketh unto you as unto children, My son, despise not thou the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when thou art rebuked of him:

verses.name: Hebrews 12:6
verses.text: For whom the Lord loveth he chasteneth, and scourgeth every son whom he receiveth.

verses.name: Hebrews 12:7
verses.text: If ye endure chastening, God dealeth with you as with sons; for what son is he whom the father chasteneth not?

verses.name: Hebrews 12:8
verses.text: But if ye be without chastisement, whereof all are partakers, then are ye bastards, and not sons.

verses.name: Hebrews 12:9
verses.text: Furthermore we have had fathers of our flesh which corrected <hi type="italic">us</hi>, and we gave <hi type="italic">them</hi> reverence: shall we not much rather be in subjection unto the Father of spirits, and live?

verses.name: Hebrews 12:10
verses.text: For they verily for a few days chastened <hi type="italic">us</hi> after their own pleasure; but he for <hi type="italic">our</hi> profit, that <hi type="italic">we</hi> might be partakers of his holiness.

verses.name: Hebrews 12:11
verses.text: Now no chastening for the present seemeth to be joyous, but grievous: nevertheless afterward it yieldeth the peaceable fruit of righteousness unto them which are exercised thereby.

verses.name: Hebrews 12:12
verses.text: Wherefore lift up the hands which hang down, and the feeble knees;

verses.name: Hebrews 12:13
verses.text: And make straight paths for your feet, lest that which is lame be turned out of the way; but let it rather be healed.

verses.name: Hebrews 12:14
verses.text: Follow peace with all <hi type="italic">men</hi>, and holiness, without which no man shall see the Lord:

verses.name: Hebrews 12:15
verses.text: Looking diligently lest any man fail of the grace of God; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble <hi type="italic">you</hi>, and thereby many be defiled;

verses.name: Hebrews 12:16
verses.text: Lest there <hi type="italic">be</hi> any fornicator, or profane person, as Esau, who for one morsel of meat sold his birthright.

verses.name: Hebrews 12:17
verses.text: For ye know how that afterward, when he would have inherited the blessing, he was rejected: for he found no place of repentance, though he sought it carefully with tears.

verses.name: Hebrews 12:18
verses.text: For ye are not come unto the mount that might be touched, and that burned with fire, nor unto blackness, and darkness, and tempest,

verses.name: Hebrews 12:19
verses.text: And the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which <hi type="italic">voice</hi> they that heard intreated that the word should not be spoken to them any more:

verses.name: Hebrews 12:20
verses.text: (For they could not endure that which was commanded, And if so much as a beast touch the mountain, it shall be stoned, or thrust through with a dart:

verses.name: Hebrews 12:21
verses.text: And so terrible was the sight, <hi type="italic">that</hi> Moses said, I exceedingly fear and quake:)

verses.name: Hebrews 12:22
verses.text: But ye are come unto mount Sion, and unto the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to an innumerable company of angels,

verses.name: Hebrews 12:23
verses.text: To the general assembly and church of the firstborn, which are written in heaven, and to God the Judge of all, and to the spirits of just men made perfect,

verses.name: Hebrews 12:24
verses.text: And to Jesus the mediator of the new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling, that speaketh better things than <hi type="italic">that of</hi> Abel.

verses.name: Hebrews 12:25
verses.text: See that ye refuse not him that speaketh. For if they escaped not who refused him that spake on earth, much more <hi type="italic">shall not</hi> we <hi type="italic">escape</hi>, if we turn away from him that <hi type="italic">speaketh</hi> from heaven:

verses.name: Hebrews 12:26
verses.text: Whose voice then shook the earth: but now he hath promised, saying, Yet once more I shake not the earth only, but also heaven.

verses.name: Hebrews 12:27
verses.text: And this <hi type="italic">word</hi>, Yet once more, signifieth the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that are made, that those things which cannot be shaken may remain.

verses.name: Hebrews 12:28
verses.text: Wherefore we receiving a kingdom which cannot be moved, let us have grace, whereby we may serve God acceptably with reverence and godly fear:

verses.name: Hebrews 12:29
verses.text: For our God <hi type="italic">is</hi> a consuming fire.  <chapter eID="Heb.12"/><div eID="gen1247" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 13:1
verses.text: LET brotherly love continue.

verses.name: Hebrews 13:2
verses.text: Be not forgetful to entertain strangers: for thereby some have entertained angels unawares.

verses.name: Hebrews 13:3
verses.text: Remember them that are in bonds, as bound with them; <hi type="italic">and</hi> them which suffer adversity, as being yourselves also in the body.

verses.name: Hebrews 13:4
verses.text: Marriage <hi type="italic">is</hi> honourable in all, and the bed undefiled: but whoremongers and adulterers God will judge.

verses.name: Hebrews 13:5
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Let your</hi> conversation <hi type="italic">be</hi> without covetousness; <hi type="italic">and be</hi> content with such things as ye have: for he hath said, I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee.

verses.name: Hebrews 13:6
verses.text: So that we may boldly say, The Lord <hi type="italic">is</hi> my helper, and I will not fear what man shall do unto me.

verses.name: Hebrews 13:7
verses.text: Remember them which have the rule over you, who have spoken unto you the word of God: whose faith follow, considering the end of <hi type="italic">their</hi> conversation.

verses.name: Hebrews 13:8
verses.text: Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever.

verses.name: Hebrews 13:9
verses.text: Be not carried about with divers and strange doctrines. For <hi type="italic">it is</hi> a good thing that the heart be established with grace; not with meats, which have not profited them that have been occupied therein.

verses.name: Hebrews 13:10
verses.text: We have an altar, whereof they have no right to eat which serve the tabernacle.

verses.name: Hebrews 13:11
verses.text: For the bodies of those beasts, whose blood is brought into the sanctuary by the high priest for sin, are burned without the camp.

verses.name: Hebrews 13:12
verses.text: Wherefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people with his own blood, suffered without the gate.

verses.name: Hebrews 13:13
verses.text: Let us go forth therefore unto him without the camp, bearing his reproach.

verses.name: Hebrews 13:14
verses.text: For here have we no continuing city, but we seek one to come.

verses.name: Hebrews 13:15
verses.text: By him therefore let us offer the sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of <hi type="italic">our</hi> lips giving thanks to his name.

verses.name: Hebrews 13:16
verses.text: But to do good and to communicate forget not: for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.

verses.name: Hebrews 13:17
verses.text: Obey them that have the rule over you, and submit yourselves: for they watch for your souls, as they that must give account, that they may do it with joy, and not with grief: for that <hi type="italic">is</hi> unprofitable for you.

verses.name: Hebrews 13:18
verses.text: Pray for us: for we trust we have a good conscience, in all things willing to live honestly.

verses.name: Hebrews 13:19
verses.text: But I beseech <hi type="italic">you</hi> the rather to do this, that I may be restored to you the sooner.

verses.name: Hebrews 13:20
verses.text: Now the God of peace, that brought again from the dead our Lord Jesus, that great shepherd of the sheep, through the blood of the everlasting covenant,

verses.name: Hebrews 13:21
verses.text: Make you perfect in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is wellpleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ; to whom <hi type="italic">be</hi> glory for ever and ever. Amen.

verses.name: Hebrews 13:22
verses.text: And I beseech you, brethren, suffer the word of exhortation: for I have written a letter unto you in few words.

verses.name: Hebrews 13:23
verses.text: Know ye that <hi type="italic">our</hi> brother Timothy is set at liberty; with whom, if he come shortly, I will see you.

verses.name: Hebrews 13:24
verses.text: Salute all them that have the rule over you, and all the saints. They of Italy salute you.

verses.name: Hebrews 13:25
verses.text: Grace <hi type="italic">be</hi> with you all. Amen. ¶ Written to the Hebrews from Italy by Timothy.  <chapter eID="Heb.13"/><div eID="gen1248" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen1235" osisID="Heb" type="book"/>

verses.name: James 1:1
verses.text: JAMES, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are scattered abroad, greeting.

verses.name: James 1:2
verses.text: My brethren, count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations;

verses.name: James 1:3
verses.text: Knowing <hi type="italic">this</hi>, that the trying of your faith worketh patience.

verses.name: James 1:4
verses.text: But let patience have <hi type="italic">her</hi> perfect work, that ye may be perfect and entire, wanting nothing.

verses.name: James 1:5
verses.text: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all <hi type="italic">men</hi> liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.

verses.name: James 1:6
verses.text: But let him ask in faith, nothing wavering. For he that wavereth is like a wave of the sea driven with the wind and tossed.

verses.name: James 1:7
verses.text: For let not that man think that he shall receive any thing of the Lord.

verses.name: James 1:8
verses.text: A double minded man <hi type="italic">is</hi> unstable in all his ways.

verses.name: James 1:9
verses.text: Let the brother of low degree rejoice in that he is exalted:

verses.name: James 1:10
verses.text: But the rich, in that he is made low: because as the flower of the grass he shall pass away.

verses.name: James 1:11
verses.text: For the sun is no sooner risen with a burning heat, but it withereth the grass, and the flower thereof falleth, and the grace of the fashion of it perisheth: so also shall the rich man fade away in his ways.

verses.name: James 1:12
verses.text: Blessed <hi type="italic">is</hi> the man that endureth temptation: for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life, which the Lord hath promised to them that love him.

verses.name: James 1:13
verses.text: Let no man say when he is tempted, I am tempted of God: for God cannot be tempted with evil, neither tempteth he any man:

verses.name: James 1:14
verses.text: But every man is tempted, when he is drawn away of his own lust, and enticed.

verses.name: James 1:15
verses.text: Then when lust hath conceived, it bringeth forth sin: and sin, when it is finished, bringeth forth death.

verses.name: James 1:16
verses.text: Do not err, my beloved brethren.

verses.name: James 1:17
verses.text: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.

verses.name: James 1:18
verses.text: Of his own will begat he us with the word of truth, that we should be a kind of firstfruits of his creatures.

verses.name: James 1:19
verses.text: Wherefore, my beloved brethren, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath:

verses.name: James 1:20
verses.text: For the wrath of man worketh not the righteousness of God.

verses.name: James 1:21
verses.text: Wherefore lay apart all filthiness and superfluity of naughtiness, and receive with meekness the engrafted word, which is able to save your souls.

verses.name: James 1:22
verses.text: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.

verses.name: James 1:23
verses.text: For if any be a hearer of the word, and not a doer, he is like unto a man beholding his natural face in a glass:

verses.name: James 1:24
verses.text: For he beholdeth himself, and goeth his way, and straightway forgetteth what manner of man he was.

verses.name: James 1:25
verses.text: But whoso looketh into the perfect law of liberty, and continueth <hi type="italic">therein</hi>, he being not a forgetful hearer, but a doer of the work, this man shall be blessed in his deed.

verses.name: James 1:26
