verses.text: I know thy works, and where thou dwellest, <hi type="italic">even</hi> where Satan’s seat <hi type="italic">is:</hi> and thou holdest fast my name, and hast not denied my faith, even in those days wherein Antipas <hi type="italic">was</hi> my faithful martyr, who was slain among you, where Satan dwelleth.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:14
verses.text: But I have a few things against thee, because thou hast there them that hold the doctrine of Balaam, who taught Balac to cast a stumblingblock before the children of Israel, to eat things sacrificed unto idols, and to commit fornication.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:15
verses.text: So hast thou also them that hold the doctrine of the Nicolaitans, which thing I hate.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:16
verses.text: Repent; or else I will come unto thee quickly, and will fight against them with the sword of my mouth.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:17
verses.text: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the hidden manna, and will give him a white stone, and in the stone a new name written, which no man knoweth saving he that receiveth <hi type="italic">it</hi>.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:18
verses.text: And unto the angel of the church in Thyatira write; These things saith the Son of God, who hath his eyes like unto a flame of fire, and his feet <hi type="italic">are</hi> like fine brass;

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:19
verses.text: I know thy works, and charity, and service, and faith, and thy patience, and thy works; and the last <hi type="italic">to be</hi> more than the first.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:20
verses.text: Notwithstanding I have a few things against thee, because thou sufferest that woman Jezebel, which calleth herself a prophetess, to teach and to seduce my servants to commit fornication, and to eat things sacrificed unto idols.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:21
verses.text: And I gave her space to repent of her fornication; and she repented not.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:22
verses.text: Behold, I will cast her into a bed, and them that commit adultery with her into great tribulation, except they repent of their deeds.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:23
verses.text: And I will kill her children with death; and all the churches shall know that I am he which searcheth the reins and hearts: and I will give unto every one of you according to your works.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:24
verses.text: But unto you I say, and unto the rest in Thyatira, as many as have not this doctrine, and which have not known the depths of Satan, as they speak; I will put upon you none other burden.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:25
verses.text: But that which ye have <hi type="italic">already</hi> hold fast till I come.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:26
verses.text: And he that overcometh, and keepeth my works unto the end, to him will I give power over the nations:

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:27
verses.text: And he shall rule them with a rod of iron; as the vessels of a potter shall they be broken to shivers: even as I received of my Father.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:28
verses.text: And I will give him the morning star.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:29
verses.text: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.  <chapter eID="Rev.2"/><div eID="gen1279" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:1
verses.text: AND unto the angel of the church in Sardis write; These things saith he that hath the seven Spirits of God, and the seven stars; I know thy works, that thou hast a name that thou livest, and art dead.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:2
verses.text: Be watchful, and strengthen the things which remain, that are ready to die: for I have not found thy works perfect before God.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:3
verses.text: Remember therefore how thou hast received and heard, and hold fast, and repent. If therefore thou shalt not watch, I will come on thee as a thief, and thou shalt not know what hour I will come upon thee.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:4
verses.text: Thou hast a few names even in Sardis which have not defiled their garments; and they shall walk with me in white: for they are worthy.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:5
verses.text: He that overcometh, the same shall be clothed in white raiment; and I will not blot out his name out of the book of life, but I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:6
verses.text: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:7
verses.text: And to the angel of the church in Philadelphia write; These things saith he that is holy, he that is true, he that hath the key of David, he that openeth, and no man shutteth; and shutteth, and no man openeth;

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:8
verses.text: I know thy works: behold, I have set before thee an open door, and no man can shut it: for thou hast a little strength, and hast kept my word, and hast not denied my name.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:9
verses.text: Behold, I will make them of the synagogue of Satan, which say they are Jews, and are not, but do lie; behold, I will make them to come and worship before thy feet, and to know that I have loved thee.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:10
verses.text: Because thou hast kept the word of my patience, I also will keep thee from the hour of temptation, which shall come upon all the world, to try them that dwell upon the earth.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:11
verses.text: Behold, I come quickly: hold that fast which thou hast, that no man take thy crown.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:12
verses.text: Him that overcometh will I make a pillar in the temple of my God, and he shall go no more out: and I will write upon him the name of my God, and the name of the city of my God, <hi type="italic">which is</hi> new Jerusalem, which cometh down out of heaven from my God: and <hi type="italic">I will write upon him</hi> my new name.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:13
verses.text: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:14
verses.text: And unto the angel of the church of the Laodiceans write; These things saith the Amen, the faithful and true witness, the beginning of the creation of God;

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:15
verses.text: I know thy works, that thou art neither cold nor hot: I would thou wert cold or hot.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:16
verses.text: So then because thou art lukewarm, and neither cold nor hot, I will spue thee out of my mouth.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:17
verses.text: Because thou sayest, I am rich, and increased with goods, and have need of nothing; and knowest not that thou art wretched, and miserable, and poor, and blind, and naked:

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:18
verses.text: I counsel thee to buy of me gold tried in the fire, that thou mayest be rich; and white raiment, that thou mayest be clothed, and <hi type="italic">that</hi> the shame of thy nakedness do not appear; and anoint thine eyes with eyesalve, that thou mayest see.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:19
verses.text: As many as I love, I rebuke and chasten: be zealous therefore, and repent.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:20
verses.text: Behold, I stand at the door, and knock: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:21
verses.text: To him that overcometh will I grant to sit with me in my throne, even as I also overcame, and am set down with my Father in his throne.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:22
verses.text: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.  <chapter eID="Rev.3"/><div eID="gen1280" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 4:1
verses.text: AFTER this I looked, and, behold, a door <hi type="italic">was</hi> opened in heaven: and the first voice which I heard <hi type="italic">was</hi> as it were of a trumpet talking with me; which said, Come up hither, and I will shew thee things which must be hereafter.

verses.name: Revelation of John 4:2
verses.text: And immediately I was in the spirit: and, behold, a throne was set in heaven, and <hi type="italic">one</hi> sat on the throne.

verses.name: Revelation of John 4:3
verses.text: And he that sat was to look upon like a jasper and a sardine stone: and <hi type="italic">there was</hi> a rainbow round about the throne, in sight like unto an emerald.

verses.name: Revelation of John 4:4
verses.text: And round about the throne <hi type="italic">were</hi> four and twenty seats: and upon the seats I saw four and twenty elders sitting, clothed in white raiment; and they had on their heads crowns of gold.

verses.name: Revelation of John 4:5
verses.text: And out of the throne proceeded lightnings and thunderings and voices: and <hi type="italic">there were</hi> seven lamps of fire burning before the throne, which are the seven Spirits of God.

verses.name: Revelation of John 4:6
verses.text: And before the throne <hi type="italic">there was</hi> a sea of glass like unto crystal: and in the midst of the throne, and round about the throne, <hi type="italic">were</hi> four beasts full of eyes before and behind.

verses.name: Revelation of John 4:7
verses.text: And the first beast <hi type="italic">was</hi> like a lion, and the second beast like a calf, and the third beast had a face as a man, and the fourth beast <hi type="italic">was</hi> like a flying eagle.

verses.name: Revelation of John 4:8
verses.text: And the four beasts had each of them six wings about <hi type="italic">him;</hi> and <hi type="italic">they were</hi> full of eyes within: and they rest not day and night, saying, Holy, holy, holy, Lord God Almighty, which was, and is, and is to come.

verses.name: Revelation of John 4:9
verses.text: And when those beasts give glory and honour and thanks to him that sat on the throne, who liveth for ever and ever,

verses.name: Revelation of John 4:10
verses.text: The four and twenty elders fall down before him that sat on the throne, and worship him that liveth for ever and ever, and cast their crowns before the throne, saying,

verses.name: Revelation of John 4:11
verses.text: Thou art worthy, O Lord, to receive glory and honour and power: for thou hast created all things, and for thy pleasure they are and were created.  <chapter eID="Rev.4"/><div eID="gen1281" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:1
verses.text: AND I saw in the right hand of him that sat on the throne a book written within and on the backside, sealed with seven seals.

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:2
verses.text: And I saw a strong angel proclaiming with a loud voice, Who is worthy to open the book, and to loose the seals thereof?

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:3
verses.text: And no man in heaven, nor in earth, neither under the earth, was able to open the book, neither to look thereon.

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:4
verses.text: And I wept much, because no man was found worthy to open and to read the book, neither to look thereon.

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:5
verses.text: And one of the elders saith unto me, Weep not: behold, the Lion of the tribe of Juda, the Root of David, hath prevailed to open the book, and to loose the seven seals thereof.

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:6
verses.text: And I beheld, and, lo, in the midst of the throne and of the four beasts, and in the midst of the elders, stood a Lamb as it had been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God sent forth into all the earth.

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:7
verses.text: And he came and took the book out of the right hand of him that sat upon the throne.

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:8
verses.text: And when he had taken the book, the four beasts and four <hi type="italic">and</hi> twenty elders fell down before the Lamb, having every one of them harps, and golden vials full of odours, which are the prayers of saints.

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:9
verses.text: And they sung a new song, saying, Thou art worthy to take the book, and to open the seals thereof: for thou wast slain, and hast redeemed us to God by thy blood out of every kindred, and tongue, and people, and nation;

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:10
verses.text: And hast made us unto our God kings and priests: and we shall reign on the earth.

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:11
verses.text: And I beheld, and I heard the voice of many angels round about the throne and the beasts and the elders: and the number of them was ten thousand times ten thousand, and thousands of thousands;

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:12
verses.text: Saying with a loud voice, Worthy is the Lamb that was slain to receive power, and riches, and wisdom, and strength, and honour, and glory, and blessing.

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:13
verses.text: And every creature which is in heaven, and on the earth, and under the earth, and such as are in the sea, and all that are in them, heard I saying, Blessing, and honour, and glory, and power, <hi type="italic">be</hi> unto him that sitteth upon the throne, and unto the Lamb for ever and ever.

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:14
verses.text: And the four beasts said, Amen. And the four <hi type="italic">and</hi> twenty elders fell down and worshipped him that liveth for ever and ever.  <chapter eID="Rev.5"/><div eID="gen1282" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:1
verses.text: AND I saw when the Lamb opened one of the seals, and I heard, as it were the noise of thunder, one of the four beasts saying, Come and see.

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:2
verses.text: And I saw, and behold a white horse: and he that sat on him had a bow; and a crown was given unto him: and he went forth conquering, and to conquer.

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:3
verses.text: And when he had opened the second seal, I heard the second beast say, Come and see.

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:4
verses.text: And there went out another horse <hi type="italic">that was</hi> red: and <hi type="italic">power</hi> was given to him that sat thereon to take peace from the earth, and that they should kill one another: and there was given unto him a great sword.

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:5
verses.text: And when he had opened the third seal, I heard the third beast say, Come and see. And I beheld, and lo a black horse; and he that sat on him had a pair of balances in his hand.

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:6
verses.text: And I heard a voice in the midst of the four beasts say, A measure of wheat for a penny, and three measures of barley for a penny; and <hi type="italic">see</hi> thou hurt not the oil and the wine.

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:7
verses.text: And when he had opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth beast say, Come and see.

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:8
verses.text: And I looked, and behold a pale horse: and his name that sat on him was Death, and Hell followed with him. And power was given unto them over the fourth part of the earth, to kill with sword, and with hunger, and with death, and with the beasts of the earth.

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:9
verses.text: And when he had opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of them that were slain for the word of God, and for the testimony which they held:

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:10
verses.text: And they cried with a loud voice, saying, How long, O Lord, holy and true, dost thou not judge and avenge our blood on them that dwell on the earth?

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:11
verses.text: And white robes were given unto every one of them; and it was said unto them, that they should rest yet for a little season, until their fellowservants also and their brethren, that should be killed as they <hi type="italic">were</hi>, should be fulfilled.

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:12
verses.text: And I beheld when he had opened the sixth seal, and, lo, there was a great earthquake; and the sun became black as sackcloth of hair, and the moon became as blood;

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:13
verses.text: And the stars of heaven fell unto the earth, even as a fig tree casteth her untimely figs, when she is shaken of a mighty wind.

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:14
verses.text: And the heaven departed as a scroll when it is rolled together; and every mountain and island were moved out of their places.

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:15
verses.text: And the kings of the earth, and the great men, and the rich men, and the chief captains, and the mighty men, and every bondman, and every free man, hid themselves in the dens and in the rocks of the mountains;

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:16
verses.text: And said to the mountains and rocks, Fall on us, and hide us from the face of him that sitteth on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb:

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:17
verses.text: For the great day of his wrath is come; and who shall be able to stand?  <chapter eID="Rev.6"/><div eID="gen1283" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:1
verses.text: AND after these things I saw four angels standing on the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, that the wind should not blow on the earth, nor on the sea, nor on any tree.

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:2
verses.text: And I saw another angel ascending from the east, having the seal of the living God: and he cried with a loud voice to the four angels, to whom it was given to hurt the earth and the sea,

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:3
verses.text: Saying, Hurt not the earth, neither the sea, nor the trees, till we have sealed the servants of our God in their foreheads.

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:4
verses.text: And I heard the number of them which were sealed: <hi type="italic">and there were</hi> sealed an hundred <hi type="italic">and</hi> forty <hi type="italic">and</hi> four thousand of all the tribes of the children of Israel.

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:5
verses.text: Of the tribe of Juda <hi type="italic">were</hi> sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Reuben <hi type="italic">were</hi> sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Gad <hi type="italic">were</hi> sealed twelve thousand.

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:6
verses.text: Of the tribe of Aser <hi type="italic">were</hi> sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Nepthalim <hi type="italic">were</hi> sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Manasses <hi type="italic">were</hi> sealed twelve thousand.

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:7
verses.text: Of the tribe of Simeon <hi type="italic">were</hi> sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Levi <hi type="italic">were</hi> sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Issachar <hi type="italic">were</hi> sealed twelve thousand.

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:8
verses.text: Of the tribe of Zabulon <hi type="italic">were</hi> sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Joseph <hi type="italic">were</hi> sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Benjamin <hi type="italic">were</hi> sealed twelve thousand.

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:9
verses.text: After this I beheld, and, lo, a great multitude, which no man could number, of all nations, and kindreds, and people, and tongues, stood before the throne, and before the Lamb, clothed with white robes, and palms in their hands;

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:10
verses.text: And cried with a loud voice, saying, Salvation to our God which sitteth upon the throne, and unto the Lamb.

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:11
verses.text: And all the angels stood round about the throne, and <hi type="italic">about</hi> the elders and the four beasts, and fell before the throne on their faces, and worshipped God,

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:12
verses.text: Saying, Amen: Blessing, and glory, and wisdom, and thanksgiving, and honour, and power, and might, <hi type="italic">be</hi> unto our God for ever and ever. Amen.

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:13
verses.text: And one of the elders answered, saying unto me, What are these which are arrayed in white robes? and whence came they?

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:14
verses.text: And I said unto him, Sir, thou knowest. And he said to me, These are they which came out of great tribulation, and have washed their robes, and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:15
verses.text: Therefore are they before the throne of God, and serve him day and night in his temple: and he that sitteth on the throne shall dwell among them.

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:16
verses.text: They shall hunger no more, neither thirst any more; neither shall the sun light on them, nor any heat.

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:17
verses.text: For the Lamb which is in the midst of the throne shall feed them, and shall lead them unto living fountains of waters: and God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes.  <chapter eID="Rev.7"/><div eID="gen1284" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:1
verses.text: AND when he had opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven about the space of half an hour.

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:2
verses.text: And I saw the seven angels which stood before God; and to them were given seven trumpets.

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:3
verses.text: And another angel came and stood at the altar, having a golden censer; and there was given unto him much incense, that he should offer <hi type="italic">it</hi> with the prayers of all saints upon the golden altar which was before the throne.

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:4
verses.text: And the smoke of the incense, <hi type="italic">which came</hi> with the prayers of the saints, ascended up before God out of the angel’s hand.

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:5
verses.text: And the angel took the censer, and filled it with fire of the altar, and cast <hi type="italic">it</hi> into the earth: and there were voices, and thunderings, and lightnings, and an earthquake.

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:6
verses.text: And the seven angels which had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:7
verses.text: The first angel sounded, and there followed hail and fire mingled with blood, and they were cast upon the earth: and the third part of trees was burnt up, and all green grass was burnt up.

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:8
verses.text: And the second angel sounded, and as it were a great mountain burning with fire was cast into the sea: and the third part of the sea became blood;

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:9
verses.text: And the third part of the creatures which were in the sea, and had life, died; and the third part of the ships were destroyed.

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:10
verses.text: And the third angel sounded, and there fell a great star from heaven, burning as it were a lamp, and it fell upon the third part of the rivers, and upon the fountains of waters;

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:11
verses.text: And the name of the star is called Wormwood: and the third part of the waters became wormwood; and many men died of the waters, because they were made bitter.

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:12
verses.text: And the fourth angel sounded, and the third part of the sun was smitten, and the third part of the moon, and the third part of the stars; so as the third part of them was darkened, and the day shone not for a third part of it, and the night likewise.

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:13
verses.text: And I beheld, and heard an angel flying through the midst of heaven, saying with a loud voice, Woe, woe, woe, to the inhabiters of the earth by reason of the other voices of the trumpet of the three angels, which are yet to sound!  <chapter eID="Rev.8"/><div eID="gen1285" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:1
verses.text: AND the fifth angel sounded, and I saw a star fall from heaven unto the earth: and to him was given the key of the bottomless pit.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:2
verses.text: And he opened the bottomless pit; and there arose a smoke out of the pit, as the smoke of a great furnace; and the sun and the air were darkened by reason of the smoke of the pit.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:3
verses.text: And there came out of the smoke locusts upon the earth: and unto them was given power, as the scorpions of the earth have power.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:4
verses.text: And it was commanded them that they should not hurt the grass of the earth, neither any green thing, neither any tree; but only those men which have not the seal of God in their foreheads.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:5
verses.text: And to them it was given that they should not kill them, but that they should be tormented five months: and their torment <hi type="italic">was</hi> as the torment of a scorpion, when he striketh a man.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:6
verses.text: And in those days shall men seek death, and shall not find it; and shall desire to die, and death shall flee from them.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:7
verses.text: And the shapes of the locusts <hi type="italic">were</hi> like unto horses prepared unto battle; and on their heads <hi type="italic">were</hi> as it were crowns like gold, and their faces <hi type="italic">were</hi> as the faces of men.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:8
verses.text: And they had hair as the hair of women, and their teeth were as <hi type="italic">the teeth</hi> of lions.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:9
verses.text: And they had breastplates, as it were breastplates of iron; and the sound of their wings <hi type="italic">was</hi> as the sound of chariots of many horses running to battle.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:10
verses.text: And they had tails like unto scorpions, and there were stings in their tails: and their power <hi type="italic">was</hi> to hurt men five months.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:11
verses.text: And they had a king over them, <hi type="italic">which is</hi> the angel of the bottomless pit, whose name in the Hebrew tongue <hi type="italic">is</hi> Abaddon, but in the Greek tongue hath <hi type="italic">his</hi> name Apollyon.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:12
verses.text: One woe is past; <hi type="italic">and</hi>, behold, there come two woes more hereafter.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:13
verses.text: And the sixth angel sounded, and I heard a voice from the four horns of the golden altar which is before God,

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:14
verses.text: Saying to the sixth angel which had the trumpet, Loose the four angels which are bound in the great river Euphrates.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:15
verses.text: And the four angels were loosed, which were prepared for an hour, and a day, and a month, and a year, for to slay the third part of men.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:16
verses.text: And the number of the army of the horsemen <hi type="italic">were</hi> two hundred thousand thousand: and I heard the number of them.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:17
verses.text: And thus I saw the horses in the vision, and them that sat on them, having breastplates of fire, and of jacinth, and brimstone: and the heads of the horses <hi type="italic">were</hi> as the heads of lions; and out of their mouths issued fire and smoke and brimstone.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:18
verses.text: By these three was the third part of men killed, by the fire, and by the smoke, and by the brimstone, which issued out of their mouths.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:19
verses.text: For their power is in their mouth, and in their tails: for their tails <hi type="italic">were</hi> like unto serpents, and had heads, and with them they do hurt.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:20
verses.text: And the rest of the men which were not killed by these plagues yet repented not of the works of their hands, that they should not worship devils, and idols of gold, and silver, and brass, and stone, and of wood: which neither can see, nor hear, nor walk:

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:21
verses.text: Neither repented they of their murders, nor of their sorceries, nor of their fornication, nor of their thefts.  <chapter eID="Rev.9"/><div eID="gen1286" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:1
verses.text: AND I saw another mighty angel come down from heaven, clothed with a cloud: and a rainbow <hi type="italic">was</hi> upon his head, and his face <hi type="italic">was</hi> as it were the sun, and his feet as pillars of fire:

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:2
verses.text: And he had in his hand a little book open: and he set his right foot upon the sea, and <hi type="italic">his</hi> left <hi type="italic">foot</hi> on the earth,

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:3
verses.text: And cried with a loud voice, as <hi type="italic">when</hi> a lion roareth: and when he had cried, seven thunders uttered their voices.

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:4
verses.text: And when the seven thunders had uttered their voices, I was about to write: and I heard a voice from heaven saying unto me, Seal up those things which the seven thunders uttered, and write them not.

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:5
verses.text: And the angel which I saw stand upon the sea and upon the earth lifted up his hand to heaven,

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:6
verses.text: And sware by him that liveth for ever and ever, who created heaven, and the things that therein are, and the earth, and the things that therein are, and the sea, and the things which are therein, that there should be time no longer:

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:7
verses.text: But in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he shall begin to sound, the mystery of God should be finished, as he hath declared to his servants the prophets.

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:8
verses.text: And the voice which I heard from heaven spake unto me again, and said, Go <hi type="italic">and</hi> take the little book which is open in the hand of the angel which standeth upon the sea and upon the earth.

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:9
verses.text: And I went unto the angel, and said unto him, Give me the little book. And he said unto me, Take <hi type="italic">it</hi>, and eat it up; and it shall make thy belly bitter, but it shall be in thy mouth sweet as honey.

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:10
verses.text: And I took the little book out of the angel’s hand, and ate it up; and it was in my mouth sweet as honey: and as soon as I had eaten it, my belly was bitter.

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:11
verses.text: And he said unto me, Thou must prophesy again before many peoples, and nations, and tongues, and kings.  <chapter eID="Rev.10"/><div eID="gen1287" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:1
verses.text: AND there was given me a reed like unto a rod: and the angel stood, saying, Rise, and measure the temple of God, and the altar, and them that worship therein.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:2
verses.text: But the court which is without the temple leave out, and measure it not; for it is given unto the Gentiles: and the holy city shall they tread under foot forty <hi type="italic">and</hi> two months.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:3
verses.text: And I will give <hi type="italic">power</hi> unto my two witnesses, and they shall prophesy a thousand two hundred <hi type="italic">and</hi> threescore days, clothed in sackcloth.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:4
verses.text: These are the two olive trees, and the two candlesticks standing before the God of the earth.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:5
verses.text: And if any man will hurt them, fire proceedeth out of their mouth, and devoureth their enemies: and if any man will hurt them, he must in this manner be killed.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:6
verses.text: These have power to shut heaven, that it rain not in the days of their prophecy: and have power over waters to turn them to blood, and to smite the earth with all plagues, as often as they will.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:7
verses.text: And when they shall have finished their testimony, the beast that ascendeth out of the bottomless pit shall make war against them, and shall overcome them, and kill them.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:8
verses.text: And their dead bodies <hi type="italic">shall lie</hi> in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also our Lord was crucified.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:9
verses.text: And they of the people and kindreds and tongues and nations shall see their dead bodies three days and an half, and shall not suffer their dead bodies to be put in graves.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:10
verses.text: And they that dwell upon the earth shall rejoice over them, and make merry, and shall send gifts one to another; because these two prophets tormented them that dwelt on the earth.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:11
verses.text: And after three days and an half the Spirit of life from God entered into them, and they stood upon their feet; and great fear fell upon them which saw them.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:12
verses.text: And they heard a great voice from heaven saying unto them, Come up hither. And they ascended up to heaven in a cloud; and their enemies beheld them.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:13
verses.text: And the same hour was there a great earthquake, and the tenth part of the city fell, and in the earthquake were slain of men seven thousand: and the remnant were affrighted, and gave glory to the God of heaven.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:14
verses.text: The second woe is past; <hi type="italic">and</hi>, behold, the third woe cometh quickly.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:15
verses.text: And the seventh angel sounded; and there were great voices in heaven, saying, The kingdoms of this world are become <hi type="italic">the kingdoms</hi> of our Lord, and of his Christ; and he shall reign for ever and ever.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:16
verses.text: And the four and twenty elders, which sat before God on their seats, fell upon their faces, and worshipped God,

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:17
verses.text: Saying, We give thee thanks, O Lord God Almighty, which art, and wast, and art to come; because thou hast taken to thee thy great power, and hast reigned.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:18
verses.text: And the nations were angry, and thy wrath is come, and the time of the dead, that they should be judged, and that thou shouldest give reward unto thy servants the prophets, and to the saints, and them that fear thy name, small and great; and shouldest destroy them which destroy the earth.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:19
verses.text: And the temple of God was opened in heaven, and there was seen in his temple the ark of his testament: and there were lightnings, and voices, and thunderings, and an earthquake, and great hail.  <chapter eID="Rev.11"/><div eID="gen1288" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:1
verses.text: AND there appeared a great wonder in heaven; a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and upon her head a crown of twelve stars:

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:2
verses.text: And she being with child cried, travailing in birth, and pained to be delivered.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:3
verses.text: And there appeared another wonder in heaven; and behold a great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and seven crowns upon his heads.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:4
verses.text: And his tail drew the third part of the stars of heaven, and did cast them to the earth: and the dragon stood before the woman which was ready to be delivered, for to devour her child as soon as it was born.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:5
verses.text: And she brought forth a man child, who was to rule all nations with a rod of iron: and her child was caught up unto God, and <hi type="italic">to</hi> his throne.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:6
verses.text: And the woman fled into the wilderness, where she hath a place prepared of God, that they should feed her there a thousand two hundred <hi type="italic">and</hi> threescore days.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:7
verses.text: And there was war in heaven: Michael and his angels fought against the dragon; and the dragon fought and his angels,

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:8
verses.text: And prevailed not; neither was their place found any more in heaven.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:9
verses.text: And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:10
verses.text: And I heard a loud voice saying in heaven, Now is come salvation, and strength, and the kingdom of our God, and the power of his Christ: for the accuser of our brethren is cast down, which accused them before our God day and night.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:11
verses.text: And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony; and they loved not their lives unto the death.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:12
verses.text: Therefore rejoice, <hi type="italic">ye</hi> heavens, and ye that dwell in them. Woe to the inhabiters of the earth and of the sea! for the devil is come down unto you, having great wrath, because he knoweth that he hath but a short time.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:13
verses.text: And when the dragon saw that he was cast unto the earth, he persecuted the woman which brought forth the man <hi type="italic">child</hi>.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:14
verses.text: And to the woman were given two wings of a great eagle, that she might fly into the wilderness, into her place, where she is nourished for a time, and times, and half a time, from the face of the serpent.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:15
verses.text: And the serpent cast out of his mouth water as a flood after the woman, that he might cause her to be carried away of the flood.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:16
verses.text: And the earth helped the woman, and the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed up the flood which the dragon cast out of his mouth.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:17
verses.text: And the dragon was wroth with the woman, and went to make war with the remnant of her seed, which keep the commandments of God, and have the testimony of Jesus Christ.  <chapter eID="Rev.12"/><div eID="gen1289" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:1
verses.text: AND I stood upon the sand of the sea, and saw a beast rise up out of the sea, having seven heads and ten horns, and upon his horns ten crowns, and upon his heads the name of blasphemy.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:2
verses.text: And the beast which I saw was like unto a leopard, and his feet were as <hi type="italic">the feet</hi> of a bear, and his mouth as the mouth of a lion: and the dragon gave him his power, and his seat, and great authority.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:3
verses.text: And I saw one of his heads as it were wounded to death; and his deadly wound was healed: and all the world wondered after the beast.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:4
verses.text: And they worshipped the dragon which gave power unto the beast: and they worshipped the beast, saying, Who <hi type="italic">is</hi> like unto the beast? who is able to make war with him?

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:5
verses.text: And there was given unto him a mouth speaking great things and blasphemies; and power was given unto him to continue forty <hi type="italic">and</hi> two months.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:6
verses.text: And he opened his mouth in blasphemy against God, to blaspheme his name, and his tabernacle, and them that dwell in heaven.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:7
verses.text: And it was given unto him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them: and power was given him over all kindreds, and tongues, and nations.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:8
verses.text: And all that dwell upon the earth shall worship him, whose names are not written in the book of life of the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:9
verses.text: If any man have an ear, let him hear.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:10
verses.text: He that leadeth into captivity shall go into captivity: he that killeth with the sword must be killed with the sword. Here is the patience and the faith of the saints.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:11
verses.text: And I beheld another beast coming up out of the earth; and he had two horns like a lamb, and he spake as a dragon.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:12
verses.text: And he exerciseth all the power of the first beast before him, and causeth the earth and them which dwell therein to worship the first beast, whose deadly wound was healed.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:13
verses.text: And he doeth great wonders, so that he maketh fire come down from heaven on the earth in the sight of men,

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:14
verses.text: And deceiveth them that dwell on the earth by <hi type="italic">the means of</hi> those miracles which he had power to do in the sight of the beast; saying to them that dwell on the earth, that they should make an image to the beast, which had the wound by a sword, and did live.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:15
verses.text: And he had power to give life unto the image of the beast, that the image of the beast should both speak, and cause that as many as would not worship the image of the beast should be killed.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:16
verses.text: And he causeth all, both small and great, rich and poor, free and bond, to receive a mark in their right hand, or in their foreheads:

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:17
verses.text: And that no man might buy or sell, save he that had the mark, or the name of the beast, or the number of his name.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:18
verses.text: Here is wisdom. Let him that hath understanding count the number of the beast: for it is the number of a man; and his number <hi type="italic">is</hi> Six hundred threescore <hi type="italic">and</hi> six.  <chapter eID="Rev.13"/><div eID="gen1290" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:1
verses.text: AND I looked, and, lo, a Lamb stood on the mount Sion, and with him an hundred forty <hi type="italic">and</hi> four thousand, having his Father’s name written in their foreheads.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:2
verses.text: And I heard a voice from heaven, as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of a great thunder: and I heard the voice of harpers harping with their harps:

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:3
verses.text: And they sung as it were a new song before the throne, and before the four beasts, and the elders: and no man could learn that song but the hundred <hi type="italic">and</hi> forty <hi type="italic">and</hi> four thousand, which were redeemed from the earth.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:4
verses.text: These are they which were not defiled with women; for they are virgins. These are they which follow the Lamb whithersoever he goeth. These were redeemed from among men, <hi type="italic">being</hi> the firstfruits unto God and to the Lamb.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:5
verses.text: And in their mouth was found no guile: for they are without fault before the throne of God.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:6
verses.text: And I saw another angel fly in the midst of heaven, having the everlasting gospel to preach unto them that dwell on the earth, and to every nation, and kindred, and tongue, and people,

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:7
verses.text: Saying with a loud voice, Fear God, and give glory to him; for the hour of his judgment is come: and worship him that made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and the fountains of waters.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:8
verses.text: And there followed another angel, saying, Babylon is fallen, is fallen, that great city, because she made all nations drink of the wine of the wrath of her fornication.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:9
verses.text: And the third angel followed them, saying with a loud voice, If any man worship the beast and his image, and receive <hi type="italic">his</hi> mark in his forehead, or in his hand,

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:10
verses.text: The same shall drink of the wine of the wrath of God, which is poured out without mixture into the cup of his indignation; and he shall be tormented with fire and brimstone in the presence of the holy angels, and in the presence of the Lamb:

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:11
verses.text: And the smoke of their torment ascendeth up for ever and ever: and they have no rest day nor night, who worship the beast and his image, and whosoever receiveth the mark of his name.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:12
verses.text: Here is the patience of the saints: here <hi type="italic">are</hi> they that keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:13
verses.text: And I heard a voice from heaven saying unto me, Write, Blessed <hi type="italic">are</hi> the dead which die in the Lord from henceforth: Yea, saith the Spirit, that they may rest from their labours; and their works do follow them.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:14
verses.text: And I looked, and behold a white cloud, and upon the cloud <hi type="italic">one</hi> sat like unto the Son of man, having on his head a golden crown, and in his hand a sharp sickle.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:15
verses.text: And another angel came out of the temple, crying with a loud voice to him that sat on the cloud, Thrust in thy sickle, and reap: for the time is come for thee to reap; for the harvest of the earth is ripe.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:16
verses.text: And he that sat on the cloud thrust in his sickle on the earth; and the earth was reaped.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:17
verses.text: And another angel came out of the temple which is in heaven, he also having a sharp sickle.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:18
verses.text: And another angel came out from the altar, which had power over fire; and cried with a loud cry to him that had the sharp sickle, saying, Thrust in thy sharp sickle, and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth; for her grapes are fully ripe.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:19
verses.text: And the angel thrust in his sickle into the earth, and gathered the vine of the earth, and cast <hi type="italic">it</hi> into the great winepress of the wrath of God.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:20
verses.text: And the winepress was trodden without the city, and blood came out of the winepress, even unto the horse bridles, by the space of a thousand <hi type="italic">and</hi> six hundred furlongs.  <chapter eID="Rev.14"/><div eID="gen1291" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 15:1
verses.text: AND I saw another sign in heaven, great and marvellous, seven angels having the seven last plagues; for in them is filled up the wrath of God.

verses.name: Revelation of John 15:2
verses.text: And I saw as it were a sea of glass mingled with fire: and them that had gotten the victory over the beast, and over his image, and over his mark, <hi type="italic">and</hi> over the number of his name, stand on the sea of glass, having the harps of God.

verses.name: Revelation of John 15:3
verses.text: And they sing the song of Moses the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, Great and marvellous <hi type="italic">are</hi> thy works, Lord God Almighty; just and true <hi type="italic">are</hi> thy ways, thou King of saints.

verses.name: Revelation of John 15:4
verses.text: Who shall not fear thee, O Lord, and glorify thy name? for <hi type="italic">thou</hi> only <hi type="italic">art</hi> holy: for all nations shall come and worship before thee; for thy judgments are made manifest.

verses.name: Revelation of John 15:5
verses.text: And after that I looked, and, behold, the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened:

verses.name: Revelation of John 15:6
verses.text: And the seven angels came out of the temple, having the seven plagues, clothed in pure and white linen, and having their breasts girded with golden girdles.

verses.name: Revelation of John 15:7
verses.text: And one of the four beasts gave unto the seven angels seven golden vials full of the wrath of God, who liveth for ever and ever.

verses.name: Revelation of John 15:8
verses.text: And the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God, and from his power; and no man was able to enter into the temple, till the seven plagues of the seven angels were fulfilled.  <chapter eID="Rev.15"/><div eID="gen1292" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:1
verses.text: AND I heard a great voice out of the temple saying to the seven angels, Go your ways, and pour out the vials of the wrath of God upon the earth.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:2
verses.text: And the first went, and poured out his vial upon the earth; and there fell a noisome and grievous sore upon the men which had the mark of the beast, and <hi type="italic">upon</hi> them which worshipped his image.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:3
verses.text: And the second angel poured out his vial upon the sea; and it became as the blood of a dead <hi type="italic">man:</hi> and every living soul died in the sea.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:4
verses.text: And the third angel poured out his vial upon the rivers and fountains of waters; and they became blood.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:5
verses.text: And I heard the angel of the waters say, Thou art righteous, O Lord, which art, and wast, and shalt be, because thou hast judged thus.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:6
verses.text: For they have shed the blood of saints and prophets, and thou hast given them blood to drink; for they are worthy.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:7
verses.text: And I heard another out of the altar say, Even so, Lord God Almighty, true and righteous <hi type="italic">are</hi> thy judgments.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:8
verses.text: And the fourth angel poured out his vial upon the sun; and power was given unto him to scorch men with fire.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:9
verses.text: And men were scorched with great heat, and blasphemed the name of God, which hath power over these plagues: and they repented not to give him glory.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:10
verses.text: And the fifth angel poured out his vial upon the seat of the beast; and his kingdom was full of darkness; and they gnawed their tongues for pain,

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:11
verses.text: And blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores, and repented not of their deeds.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:12
verses.text: And the sixth angel poured out his vial upon the great river Euphrates; and the water thereof was dried up, that the way of the kings of the east might be prepared.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:13
verses.text: And I saw three unclean spirits like frogs <hi type="italic">come</hi> out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:14
verses.text: For they are the spirits of devils, working miracles, <hi type="italic">which</hi> go forth unto the kings of the earth and of the whole world, to gather them to the battle of that great day of God Almighty.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:15
verses.text: Behold, I come as a thief. Blessed <hi type="italic">is</hi> he that watcheth, and keepeth his garments, lest he walk naked, and they see his shame.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:16
verses.text: And he gathered them together into a place called in the Hebrew tongue Armageddon.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:17
verses.text: And the seventh angel poured out his vial into the air; and there came a great voice out of the temple of heaven, from the throne, saying, It is done.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:18
verses.text: And there were voices, and thunders, and lightnings; and there was a great earthquake, such as was not since men were upon the earth, so mighty an earthquake, <hi type="italic">and</hi> so great.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:19
verses.text: And the great city was divided into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell: and great Babylon came in remembrance before God, to give unto her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of his wrath.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:20
verses.text: And every island fled away, and the mountains were not found.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:21
verses.text: And there fell upon men a great hail out of heaven, <hi type="italic">every stone</hi> about the weight of a talent: and men blasphemed God because of the plague of the hail; for the plague thereof was exceeding great.  <chapter eID="Rev.16"/><div eID="gen1293" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:1
verses.text: AND there came one of the seven angels which had the seven vials, and talked with me, saying unto me, Come hither; I will shew unto thee the judgment of the great whore that sitteth upon many waters:

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:2
verses.text: With whom the kings of the earth have committed fornication, and the inhabitants of the earth have been made drunk with the wine of her fornication.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:3
verses.text: So he carried me away in the spirit into the wilderness: and I saw a woman sit upon a scarlet coloured beast, full of names of blasphemy, having seven heads and ten horns.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:4
verses.text: And the woman was arrayed in purple and scarlet colour, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls, having a golden cup in her hand full of abominations and filthiness of her fornication:

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:5
verses.text: And upon her forehead <hi type="italic">was</hi> a name written, MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS AND ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:6
verses.text: And I saw the woman drunken with the blood of the saints, and with the blood of the martyrs of Jesus: and when I saw her, I wondered with great admiration.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:7
verses.text: And the angel said unto me, Wherefore didst thou marvel? I will tell thee the mystery of the woman, and of the beast that carrieth her, which hath the seven heads and ten horns.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:8
verses.text: The beast that thou sawest was, and is not; and shall ascend out of the bottomless pit, and go into perdition: and they that dwell on the earth shall wonder, whose names were not written in the book of life from the foundation of the world, when they behold the beast that was, and is not, and yet is.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:9
verses.text: And here <hi type="italic">is</hi> the mind which hath wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains, on which the woman sitteth.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:10
verses.text: And there are seven kings: five are fallen, and one is, <hi type="italic">and</hi> the other is not yet come; and when he cometh, he must continue a short space.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:11
verses.text: And the beast that was, and is not, even he is the eighth, and is of the seven, and goeth into perdition.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:12
verses.text: And the ten horns which thou sawest are ten kings, which have received no kingdom as yet; but receive power as kings one hour with the beast.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:13
verses.text: These have one mind, and shall give their power and strength unto the beast.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:14
verses.text: These shall make war with the Lamb, and the Lamb shall overcome them: for he is Lord of lords, and King of kings: and they that are with him <hi type="italic">are</hi> called, and chosen, and faithful.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:15
verses.text: And he saith unto me, The waters which thou sawest, where the whore sitteth, are peoples, and multitudes, and nations, and tongues.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:16
verses.text: And the ten horns which thou sawest upon the beast, these shall hate the whore, and shall make her desolate and naked, and shall eat her flesh, and burn her with fire.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:17
verses.text: For God hath put in their hearts to fulfil his will, and to agree, and give their kingdom unto the beast, until the words of God shall be fulfilled.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:18
verses.text: And the woman which thou sawest is that great city, which reigneth over the kings of the earth.  <chapter eID="Rev.17"/><div eID="gen1294" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:1
verses.text: AND after these things I saw another angel come down from heaven, having great power; and the earth was lightened with his glory.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:2
verses.text: And he cried mightily with a strong voice, saying, Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen, and is become the habitation of devils, and the hold of every foul spirit, and a cage of every unclean and hateful bird.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:3
verses.text: For all nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her fornication, and the kings of the earth have committed fornication with her, and the merchants of the earth are waxed rich through the abundance of her delicacies.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:4
verses.text: And I heard another voice from heaven, saying, Come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:5
verses.text: For her sins have reached unto heaven, and God hath remembered her iniquities.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:6
verses.text: Reward her even as she rewarded you, and double unto her double according to her works: in the cup which she hath filled fill to her double.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:7
verses.text: How much she hath glorified herself, and lived deliciously, so much torment and sorrow give her: for she saith in her heart, I sit a queen, and am no widow, and shall see no sorrow.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:8
verses.text: Therefore shall her plagues come in one day, death, and mourning, and famine; and she shall be utterly burned with fire: for strong <hi type="italic">is</hi> the Lord God who judgeth her.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:9
verses.text: And the kings of the earth, who have committed fornication and lived deliciously with her, shall bewail her, and lament for her, when they shall see the smoke of her burning,

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:10
verses.text: Standing afar off for the fear of her torment, saying, Alas, alas, that great city Babylon, that mighty city! for in one hour is thy judgment come.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:11
verses.text: And the merchants of the earth shall weep and mourn over her; for no man buyeth their merchandise any more:

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:12
verses.text: The merchandise of gold, and silver, and precious stones, and of pearls, and fine linen, and purple, and silk, and scarlet, and all thyine wood, and all manner vessels of ivory, and all manner vessels of most precious wood, and of brass, and iron, and marble,

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:13
verses.text: And cinnamon, and odours, and ointments, and frankincense, and wine, and oil, and fine flour, and wheat, and beasts, and sheep, and horses, and chariots, and slaves, and souls of men.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:14
verses.text: And the fruits that thy soul lusted after are departed from thee, and all things which were dainty and goodly are departed from thee, and thou shalt find them no more at all.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:15
verses.text: The merchants of these things, which were made rich by her, shall stand afar off for the fear of her torment, weeping and wailing,

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:16
verses.text: And saying, Alas, alas, that great city, that was clothed in fine linen, and purple, and scarlet, and decked with gold, and precious stones, and pearls!

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:17
verses.text: For in one hour so great riches is come to nought. And every shipmaster, and all the company in ships, and sailors, and as many as trade by sea, stood afar off,

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:18
verses.text: And cried when they saw the smoke of her burning, saying, What <hi type="italic">city is</hi> like unto this great city!

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:19
verses.text: And they cast dust on their heads, and cried, weeping and wailing, saying, Alas, alas, that great city, wherein were made rich all that had ships in the sea by reason of her costliness! for in one hour is she made desolate.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:20
verses.text: Rejoice over her, <hi type="italic">thou</hi> heaven, and <hi type="italic">ye</hi> holy apostles and prophets; for God hath avenged you on her.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:21
verses.text: And a mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone, and cast <hi type="italic">it</hi> into the sea, saying, Thus with violence shall that great city Babylon be thrown down, and shall be found no more at all.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:22
verses.text: And the voice of harpers, and musicians, and of pipers, and trumpeters, shall be heard no more at all in thee; and no craftsman, of whatsoever craft <hi type="italic">he be</hi>, shall be found any more in thee; and the sound of a millstone shall be heard no more at all in thee;

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:23
verses.text: And the light of a candle shall shine no more at all in thee; and the voice of the bridegroom and of the bride shall be heard no more at all in thee: for thy merchants were the great men of the earth; for by thy sorceries were all nations deceived.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:24
verses.text: And in her was found the blood of prophets, and of saints, and of all that were slain upon the earth.  <chapter eID="Rev.18"/><div eID="gen1295" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:1
verses.text: AND after these things I heard a great voice of much people in heaven, saying, Alleluia; Salvation, and glory, and honour, and power, unto the Lord our God:

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:2
verses.text: For true and righteous <hi type="italic">are</hi> his judgments: for he hath judged the great whore, which did corrupt the earth with her fornication, and hath avenged the blood of his servants at her hand.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:3
verses.text: And again they said, Alleluia. And her smoke rose up for ever and ever.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:4
verses.text: And the four and twenty elders and the four beasts fell down and worshipped God that sat on the throne, saying, Amen; Alleluia.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:5
verses.text: And a voice came out of the throne, saying, Praise our God, all ye his servants, and ye that fear him, both small and great.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:6
verses.text: And I heard as it were the voice of a great multitude, and as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of mighty thunderings, saying, Alleluia: for the Lord God omnipotent reigneth.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:7
verses.text: Let us be glad and rejoice, and give honour to him: for the marriage of the Lamb is come, and his wife hath made herself ready.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:8
verses.text: And to her was granted that she should be arrayed in fine linen, clean and white: for the fine linen is the righteousness of saints.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:9
verses.text: And he saith unto me, Write, Blessed <hi type="italic">are</hi> they which are called unto the marriage supper of the Lamb. And he saith unto me, These are the true sayings of God.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:10
verses.text: And I fell at his feet to worship him. And he said unto me, See <hi type="italic">thou do it</hi> not: I am thy fellowservant, and of thy brethren that have the testimony of Jesus: worship God: for the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:11
verses.text: And I saw heaven opened, and behold a white horse; and he that sat upon him <hi type="italic">was</hi> called Faithful and True, and in righteousness he doth judge and make war.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:12
verses.text: His eyes <hi type="italic">were</hi> as a flame of fire, and on his head <hi type="italic">were</hi> many crowns; and he had a name written, that no man knew, but he himself.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:13
verses.text: And he <hi type="italic">was</hi> clothed with a vesture dipped in blood: and his name is called The Word of God.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:14
verses.text: And the armies <hi type="italic">which were</hi> in heaven followed him upon white horses, clothed in fine linen, white and clean.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:15
verses.text: And out of his mouth goeth a sharp sword, that with it he should smite the nations: and he shall rule them with a rod of iron: and he treadeth the winepress of the fierceness and wrath of Almighty God.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:16
verses.text: And he hath on <hi type="italic">his</hi> vesture and on his thigh a name written, KING OF KINGS, AND LORD OF LORDS.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:17
verses.text: And I saw an angel standing in the sun; and he cried with a loud voice, saying to all the fowls that fly in the midst of heaven, Come and gather yourselves together unto the supper of the great God;

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:18
verses.text: That ye may eat the flesh of kings, and the flesh of captains, and the flesh of mighty men, and the flesh of horses, and of them that sit on them, and the flesh of all <hi type="italic">men</hi>, <hi type="italic">both</hi> free and bond, both small and great.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:19
verses.text: And I saw the beast, and the kings of the earth, and their armies, gathered together to make war against him that sat on the horse, and against his army.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:20
verses.text: And the beast was taken, and with him the false prophet that wrought miracles before him, with which he deceived them that had received the mark of the beast, and them that worshipped his image. These both were cast alive into a lake of fire burning with brimstone.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:21
verses.text: And the remnant were slain with the sword of him that sat upon the horse, which <hi type="italic">sword</hi> proceeded out of his mouth: and all the fowls were filled with their flesh.  <chapter eID="Rev.19"/><div eID="gen1296" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:1
verses.text: AND I saw an angel come down from heaven, having the key of the bottomless pit and a great chain in his hand.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:2
verses.text: And he laid hold on the dragon, that old serpent, which is the Devil, and Satan, and bound him a thousand years,

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:3
verses.text: And cast him into the bottomless pit, and shut him up, and set a seal upon him, that he should deceive the nations no more, till the thousand years should be fulfilled: and after that he must be loosed a little season.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:4
verses.text: And I saw thrones, and they sat upon them, and judgment was given unto them: and <hi type="italic">I saw</hi> the souls of them that were beheaded for the witness of Jesus, and for the word of God, and which had not worshipped the beast, neither his image, neither had received <hi type="italic">his</hi> mark upon their foreheads, or in their hands; and they lived and reigned with Christ a thousand years.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:5
verses.text: But the rest of the dead lived not again until the thousand years were finished. This <hi type="italic">is</hi> the first resurrection.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:6
verses.text: Blessed and holy <hi type="italic">is</hi> he that hath part in the first resurrection: on such the second death hath no power, but they shall be priests of God and of Christ, and shall reign with him a thousand years.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:7
verses.text: And when the thousand years are expired, Satan shall be loosed out of his prison,

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:8
verses.text: And shall go out to deceive the nations which are in the four quarters of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them together to battle: the number of whom <hi type="italic">is</hi> as the sand of the sea.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:9
verses.text: And they went up on the breadth of the earth, and compassed the camp of the saints about, and the beloved city: and fire came down from God out of heaven, and devoured them.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:10
verses.text: And the devil that deceived them was cast into the lake of fire and brimstone, where the beast and the false prophet <hi type="italic">are</hi>, and shall be tormented day and night for ever and ever.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:11
verses.text: And I saw a great white throne, and him that sat on it, from whose face the earth and the heaven fled away; and there was found no place for them.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:12
verses.text: And I saw the dead, small and great, stand before God; and the books were opened: and another book was opened, which is <hi type="italic">the book</hi> of life: and the dead were judged out of those things which were written in the books, according to their works.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:13
verses.text: And the sea gave up the dead which were in it; and death and hell delivered up the dead which were in them: and they were judged every man according to their works.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:14
verses.text: And death and hell were cast into the lake of fire. This is the second death.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:15
verses.text: And whosoever was not found written in the book of life was cast into the lake of fire.  <chapter eID="Rev.20"/><div eID="gen1297" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:1
verses.text: AND I saw a new heaven and a new earth: for the first heaven and the first earth were passed away; and there was no more sea.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:2
verses.text: And I John saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down from God out of heaven, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:3
verses.text: And I heard a great voice out of heaven saying, Behold, the tabernacle of God <hi type="italic">is</hi> with men, and he will dwell with them, and they shall be his people, and God himself shall be with them, <hi type="italic">and be</hi> their God.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:4
verses.text: And God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain: for the former things are passed away.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:5
verses.text: And he that sat upon the throne said, Behold, I make all things new. And he said unto me, Write: for these words are true and faithful.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:6
verses.text: And he said unto me, It is done. I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end. I will give unto him that is athirst of the fountain of the water of life freely.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:7
verses.text: He that overcometh shall inherit all things; and I will be his God, and he shall be my son.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:8
verses.text: But the fearful, and unbelieving, and the abominable, and murderers, and whoremongers, and sorcerers, and idolaters, and all liars, shall have their part in the lake which burneth with fire and brimstone: which is the second death.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:9
verses.text: And there came unto me one of the seven angels which had the seven vials full of the seven last plagues, and talked with me, saying, Come hither, I will shew thee the bride, the Lamb’s wife.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:10
verses.text: And he carried me away in the spirit to a great and high mountain, and shewed me that great city, the holy Jerusalem, descending out of heaven from God,

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:11
verses.text: Having the glory of God: and her light <hi type="italic">was</hi> like unto a stone most precious, even like a jasper stone, clear as crystal;

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:12
verses.text: And had a wall great and high, <hi type="italic">and</hi> had twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels, and names written thereon, which are <hi type="italic">the names</hi> of the twelve tribes of the children of Israel:

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:13
verses.text: On the east three gates; on the north three gates; on the south three gates; and on the west three gates.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:14
verses.text: And the wall of the city had twelve foundations, and in them the names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:15
verses.text: And he that talked with me had a golden reed to measure the city, and the gates thereof, and the wall thereof.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:16
verses.text: And the city lieth foursquare, and the length is as large as the breadth: and he measured the city with the reed, twelve thousand furlongs. The length and the breadth and the height of it are equal.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:17
verses.text: And he measured the wall thereof, an hundred <hi type="italic">and</hi> forty <hi type="italic">and</hi> four cubits, <hi type="italic">according to</hi> the measure of a man, that is, of the angel.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:18
verses.text: And the building of the wall of it was <hi type="italic">of</hi> jasper: and the city <hi type="italic">was</hi> pure gold, like unto clear glass.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:19
verses.text: And the foundations of the wall of the city <hi type="italic">were</hi> garnished with all manner of precious stones. The first foundation <hi type="italic">was</hi> jasper; the second, sapphire; the third, a chalcedony; the fourth, an emerald;

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:20
verses.text: The fifth, sardonyx; the sixth, sardius; the seventh, chrysolite; the eighth, beryl; the ninth, a topaz; the tenth, a chrysoprasus; the eleventh, a jacinth; the twelfth, an amethyst.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:21
verses.text: And the twelve gates <hi type="italic">were</hi> twelve pearls; every several gate was of one pearl: and the street of the city <hi type="italic">was</hi> pure gold, as it were transparent glass.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:22
verses.text: And I saw no temple therein: for the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are the temple of it.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:23
verses.text: And the city had no need of the sun, neither of the moon, to shine in it: for the glory of God did lighten it, and the Lamb <hi type="italic">is</hi> the light thereof.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:24
verses.text: And the nations of them which are saved shall walk in the light of it: and the kings of the earth do bring their glory and honour into it.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:25
verses.text: And the gates of it shall not be shut at all by day: for there shall be no night there.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:26
verses.text: And they shall bring the glory and honour of the nations into it.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:27
verses.text: And there shall in no wise enter into it any thing that defileth, neither <hi type="italic">whatsoever</hi> worketh abomination, or <hi type="italic">maketh</hi> a lie: but they which are written in the Lamb’s book of life.  <chapter eID="Rev.21"/><div eID="gen1298" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:1
verses.text: AND he shewed me a pure river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:2
verses.text: In the midst of the street of it, and on either side of the river, <hi type="italic">was there</hi> the tree of life, which bare twelve <hi type="italic">manner of</hi> fruits, <hi type="italic">and</hi> yielded her fruit every month: and the leaves of the tree <hi type="italic">were</hi> for the healing of the nations.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:3
verses.text: And there shall be no more curse: but the throne of God and of the Lamb shall be in it; and his servants shall serve him:

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:4
verses.text: And they shall see his face; and his name <hi type="italic">shall be</hi> in their foreheads.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:5
verses.text: And there shall be no night there; and they need no candle, neither light of the sun; for the Lord God giveth them light: and they shall reign for ever and ever.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:6
verses.text: And he said unto me, These sayings <hi type="italic">are</hi> faithful and true: and the Lord God of the holy prophets sent his angel to shew unto his servants the things which must shortly be done.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:7
verses.text: Behold, I come quickly: blessed <hi type="italic">is</hi> he that keepeth the sayings of the prophecy of this book.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:8
verses.text: And I John saw these things, and heard <hi type="italic">them</hi>. And when I had heard and seen, I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel which shewed me these things.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:9
verses.text: Then saith he unto me, See <hi type="italic">thou do it</hi> not: for I am thy fellowservant, and of thy brethren the prophets, and of them which keep the sayings of this book: worship God.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:10
verses.text: And he saith unto me, Seal not the sayings of the prophecy of this book: for the time is at hand.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:11
verses.text: He that is unjust, let him be unjust still: and he which is filthy, let him be filthy still: and he that is righteous, let him be righteous still: and he that is holy, let him be holy still.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:12
verses.text: And, behold, I come quickly; and my reward <hi type="italic">is</hi> with me, to give every man according as his work shall be.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:13
verses.text: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end, the first and the last.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:14
verses.text: Blessed <hi type="italic">are</hi> they that do his commandments, that they may have right to the tree of life, and may enter in through the gates into the city.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:15
verses.text: For without <hi type="italic">are</hi> dogs, and sorcerers, and whoremongers, and murderers, and idolaters, and whosoever loveth and maketh a lie.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:16
verses.text: I Jesus have sent mine angel to testify unto you these things in the churches. I am the root and the offspring of David, <hi type="italic">and</hi> the bright and morning star.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:17
verses.text: And the Spirit and the bride say, Come. And let him that heareth say, Come. And let him that is athirst come. And whosoever will, let him take the water of life freely.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:18
verses.text: For I testify unto every man that heareth the words of the prophecy of this book, If any man shall add unto these things, God shall add unto him the plagues that are written in this book:

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:19
verses.text: And if any man shall take away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God shall take away his part out of the book of life, and out of the holy city, and <hi type="italic">from</hi> the things which are written in this book.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:20
verses.text: He which testifieth these things saith, Surely I come quickly. Amen. Even so, come, Lord Jesus.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:21
verses.text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ <hi type="italic">be</hi> with you all. Amen. THE END.  <chapter eID="Rev.22"/><div eID="gen1299" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen1277" osisID="Rev" type="book"/>
